I tried the Buffalo chicken Mac n Cheese (appetizer size) and it was fantastic. Also had one of their cheese steaks and it was very good. Honestly can not wait to go back and try one of their burgers - the guy next to me had one and it looked REALLY good!
We stopped by today for lunch & WOW! Everything was amazing! From the food to the service! We are so happy that we stumbled across this place.
Food is overpriced and inedible. Don't bother, you are paying for atmosphere and in 100 degree temperatures who wants to eat and sweat! Fish was over cooked, steaks were grisly. Do not recommend.

Great atmosphere.  Nice little sidewalk dining area for nice days.  Broad menu will please almost everybody.  All of the employees were super friendly. I ordered a 1/2 muffaletta and cup of gumbo and it was amazing.  Prices were reasonable and service was fast!  I would certainly return.

Not my favorite location. Drove over a long way to take part inn the national bagel day. There was no clear instruction or anything around promoting the special day. You have to know before arriving, thanks social media.

Anyway, I ordered a toasted nova lox toasted which I paid for separately since this was not part of national bagel day. Wifey got an toasted Asiago Bagel with Cream Cheese shmear. I asked for the same, except I asked for chive shmear.

I get charged for the second Asiago toast, which the manager corrected once I pointed out the error. Wifey grabbed the order and waited inn the car before I could check the order. 

Anyway, we drove back home and my order was off. Lox Bagel wasn't toasted and my toasted asiago bagel didn't have come with a drop of shmear. What a waste of time.

First time customer today. I went there with my 9 year old son. we sat at the counter which had a great view of the outside. he got a corn dog and I got chili mac fries. both were very good. the place was small and it was very clean. The staff was friendly. Even the customers were friendly. as one was walking out the door she stopped and asked me what I got. I told her and she was excited about it. I would come here often.
$18 for over cooked fish and canned vegetables. I need fresh food. There is always a line. Don't understand why. The fried chicken was bland.

My wife and I decided to head to the near north side for lunch one Friday in February.  We appreciated the free parking in the lot north of the restaurant.  

The atmosphere was clean and a colorful with a long row of tables by the windows and a huge amount of seats next to the bar counter.  We were seated promptly at a table.

After looking over the menu, I decided to go with the Hoosier sandwich (pork patty, apple, arugula, smoked gouda, and hickory dijon) and Yucca fries.  The sandwich flavor was excellent!  I highly recommend this to anyone who is a first time customer.  The yucca fries came with a dipping sauce, were huge in portion, but without the sauce, were rather bland.  I probably wouldn't order them again.

My wife and I decided to share the white chocolate & raspberry bread pudding.  This was a tasty item as well.

This is a place I would definitely return to.

Review #57

This place popped up on Yelp and my family and I decided to try it, what an awesome surprise it was! The regular prices were prices I can get only during Happy Hour in San Diego. The taste of the meat was exceptional (lengua, chicken fajitas, adobada [pork], asada [beef]. The staff are quick and super nice, too! Made for a very memorable visit, will definitely be coming back to this place during our next trip to Santa Barbara! :)

The atmosphere was nice and the service was good. My husband ordered the crab cakes which were delicious. I ordered the mushroom boudin and it was good but the presentation was dull. I also enjoyed the eggplant, tomato and ricotta but the potato tempeh was not good. I don't know if I spelled it correctly. The price was not that bad. I will return but my husband will not.

Long's is an Indianapolis legend.  Their yeast donuts are to-die-for.  Longs are such a tradition, and are so unique that many of my friends can identify them on sight.

As the previous reviewer mentioned they don't have much selection.  I also recommend the cinammon "fritters", not quite sure what they're called.  

The biggest caveat here is that they are CASH ONLY, so make sure to take the green when you go. 

The neighborhood is a little rough by Indianapolis standards, but during the day it's no problem.

It's been 35 minutes and they just said it'd be another 10-15 minutes before the food is ready because the rice cooker is broken. What type of bs is that, do you only have one rice cooker?

Last two experiences have been crappy. They were doing a bogo boba, I bought boba and was not given the bogo, apparently it was "a secret kind of" and you had to show a picture of the bogo from Facebook to receive. 

Don't bother coming, food is alright but not worth the wait nor the hassle. They couldn't have told me 35 minutes ago when I bought the food that the rice cooker was broken? Iv has its shitty restaurants, but this definitely takes home the prize. Stay away

This is my new favorite pizza place. We ordered Brooklyn style pizza, a veggie panini, chicken parmesan sandwich, cheese steak with the works, and a cannoli. The food was fantastic and the service was excellent. I am already planning my next meal here.

Amazing and adorable. I love this coffee shop. It looks sort of like it was birthed from a kitschy diner, but the way it has been transformed make it the sweetest, most adorable coffee shop around. You can order coffee on the go by hitting the drive-thru or stop in and sit at one of the tables and read or write for a bit. The baristas are friendly and know their coffee. If you're a coffee lover and you are not attached to the green mermaid place, I would definitely come to Big Star.

Seafood, done right! Flavorful with spice, but not too spicy. Season is not in full effect set but these were so tasty I overlooked the size of them, plus I'm certain they are frozen crawfish. 
I had the crawfish (be sure to ask for crawfish juice), crabs, turkey necks and sausage. Also had fried rice and Chicken PoBoy. Everything was good. The seafood was exceptional!

Worst pizza I've had. We ordered the Red Dragon pizza when got there they said they had made a mistake with the ticket and the pizza was gonna take longer than usual. Ok sure no problem we're willing to wait. When we got home imagine how disappointed we are to see this piece of crap of a pizza. Stuck to the paper, falling apart, and with pieces of burnt crap in the crust. You would think that with the whole COVID thing that's happening they would be focused on making quality pizzas. I am so upset and disappointed.

The breakdown!

I had a short stack with a side of bacon mmmm bacon.. And sausage links! 

I'm a lover of all three items and critique hard, so my honest opinion is I've had better but the service was so good it made me smile! Great southern hospitality!
This is one of my favorite places to get Margherita Pizza. It is very reasonably priced ($7.95) and very delicious.  I would definitely recommend Snap Pizza to anyone who loves pizza!

Cute, cozy, urban, botanical feel in the middle of South Street. Came here visiting from ATL & did not want to miss this pop up. This place is the cutest and has tasty drinks! When you walk up to the garden fence it feels like you are walking into another world outside of South City Philly. PHS is dressed head to toe in plants and flowers. We ordered the Frozen Mojito & Gritty Granita so refreshing on a hot summer's day! PHS is also dog friendly so you can see 4 legged friends here and there while sipping on some great booze. Perfect place for a date night or girl's night out.

This place is one of my favorite cocktail bars in STL. Very chic/eclectic decor. Their mixologists know what they're doing. Favorite drink is the smoked Manhattan. Their cheese boards don't disappoint either.

I am giving this place 5 stars because you should go and these are the reasons: great atmosphere, excellent chicken/ribs, friendly/very speedy service and reasonable pricing. Their downside is their side items but it is still a very well run restaurant with excellent chicken/sausage.

Great little place for breakfast.we have been here a few times now and it's always been good. The staff is always friendly and helpful. You may have a wait for breakfast but it's worth it.we are going to try something else next time we go maybe a burger. They look really good the couple next to us had them a said they were very good.

We had family come down and wanted to go out for brunch their last day in town. We researched and found that Casa Blanca had endless mimosas, brunch and menudo. We bring our family and find out the menu described online is an old special they had. So their online menu is not updated, they don't offer brunch, don't have endless mimosas or menudo. Had we known before sitting down, we would have found a different restaurant. Now what we did order, actually still wasn't great.

We stopped in for a late breakfast on our way out of town. Best ending to a birthday trip! Lisa's cafe literally had the best corned beef hash we've ever eaten. Everything is made homemade. All their food is fresh, never frozen. The crab cake Benedict was to die for. Service was excellent and topped it off with a fantastic Bloody Mary. Will be returning to Lisa's next time we visit for sure!
I had lunch here today a true mom & pop store place is old service was great I had #9 pho its was delicious meat was fresh I could have drank a quart of the broth.
Superb pastas salad and pizza. Excellent service. Prices good. Most entries include salad.

I absolutely love the Irish Rover Station House! They have such a great atmosphere and make you feel like family when you walk in the door. Their food is great and reasonably priced. We try and make it in on Wednesdays for their Prime Rib special which is delicious! Their location is perfect and their outdoor patio is hard to pass up on a nice day. I love it there and I will always recommend the Rover to others looking to have a great dining experience!

By the way, try their Cajun Chicken bites! They are amazing!!!
This place is so cool.  Food was great, concept is great - very happy that I found it.  I had a stir fry - yum!  My friend had a smoothie - also yum!

Nothing to write home about. Had to do a spit take with the sweet tea because it was so bitter. The sauces were too watery. Mac and cheese left a lot to be desired. The pulled pork was good, but not enough to make eating here worthwhile. Maybe I'm just spoiled on Memphis BBQ, but I wouldn't recommend this to any of my friends.

As a Texan this is exactly what I think of when I want a cheese steak. Fantastic bread, flavorful meat, nice gooey cheese and hot peppers. The owner greets you and makes your sandwich right in front of you. Super nice folks and the kind of great local joints we should all support.
Tasty spot,  I like the fried items but I'm not a fan of the burger.  It looked like it was a frozen patty,and it was not tasty.

I wanted to love this place after all the hype I have heard..but it leaves a lot to be desired. We had reservations for a Saturday night and we were seated quickly. We started with the fondue and it was delicious. My friend tried to order three different things on the menu, but the server kept coming back and saying they weren't available. She settled with the Meatball Flatbread, and I could not even swallow the bite I tried. It was so tasteless and terrible. Boo! I ordered the Lobster Mac & Cheese and it was good. We were short on water the whole meal, and they were not very busy. I would probably not go back.

I gave this 2 stars but if I could have done 2 and half I would have. The place is very modern looking and had an overall good ambience.  The food was also very good. My husband had the #12 and I had the fried rice. I took my husband here because he loves Pho and Vietnamese food. I am more of a novice to this type of food. 

The service here is the reason why I did not rate this location well. The hostess was prompt and friendly and the food came out quickly...that is the only plus to service. Our server took our drink order which was cold tea and a Coke. He came back 5 minutes later and said they 'ran out' of Coke. We asked what options he had for soft drinks and he said Mountain Dew and Sierra Mist. Great selection...not. Then what was supposed to be tea came out. It tasted like water that cleaned out a tea pot. I sent it back. Then we ordered. Since Im not big on sauces which I am unsure of I asked about what sauce the fried rice came with and was subjected to 3 minute talk from the waiter about how the restaurant  has to pay for other people's orders when they send that back. That is my problem? Completely unprofessional.  No one came to our table the whole time we were there except for the nice hostess who asked did we want a box for our to go food. Maybe that's because our waiter was at one of the other customer tables along with other waiters having a meal. If you want good Pho you can get it but get it to go.

Women's bathroom was also dirty with two stalls not for use.

This weekend my mom was in town and we always like to check out the group Nashville Originals restaurants. She's originally a Nashvillian and loves to support the locals. So we headed to Bound'ry with a total of 7 in our party. We made a reservation, but it was uncharacteristically slow for a Midtown restaurant on a Saturday night. I'm giving it 3 stars because the kitchen was incredibly slow with our entrees and our server started out great, but completely flopped toward the end and messed a few of the orders up- although she was nice enough to comp a free dessert. We probably will not return, unless it is for drinks/apps.

Pros:
Great libations
Ashley Farms Stuffed Chicken
Cedar Plank TN Trout

Cons:
Bount'ry Salad/Caesar Salad (looked like they came straight out of a bag onto the plate)
Pizzas
Service

I was excited to find another vegan spot for breakfast/brunch but I was not overly impressed with our meal. I appreciate that there are vegan options here and that's awesome but they're the vegan options that are just kind of thrown together without the thought of actually making it taste good. Like a breakfast burrito with a vegan burger patty? Doesn't really sound that appetizing. I wish they would have put more thought into what was actually going in the food. I got the southwestern spuds and the beans and salsa tasted like they came out of a can. It was salty and greasy with no real flavor. I am grateful for the options they do have but wish they were a little bit better. The customer service was good and everyone is friendly. Make sure to add some extra time as there is a little bit of a wait.

My favorite bagels in Tampa. They're made fresh daily and there a a ton of options to choose from. The bagels are made every morning and once they sell out that's it. My favorite is smoked salmon with tomato, onion, and cream cheese on an everything bagel. Yum!

I knocked a star off because the owner (middle aged man with a north eastern accent) is a major pain and often rings up your order. As  some of the reviewers mentioned whenever you use a credit card he "jokes" with you and and pretends he's going to keep your card. I find this "joking" incredibly annoying. 

PRO TIP: Bring $10 in cash when you visit to avoid the owner's foolishness.

This place has incredible ambience. Perfect for date night or girls night. The pizza is the best I've had and the rolls I can't get enough of. They gave my kids some sauce and dough to entertain them as we waited for the food to be served. Over all it was a great experience from beginning to the end.

Dined here in Dec. 2009 while spending a few days sightseeing in Philly. We found a "buy one, get one half off" coupon and decided to use it for dinner on our last night in the city. 

Loved this place!! The staff are dressed in colonial attire, the dinnerware is a replica of colonial dinnerware - everything in this place is done as if you were dining during colonial times (can you tell I've never been to colonial Williamsburg?). The building is from the 1700's. 

Anyway, the food was delicious, the portions were huge - or maybe we just shouldn't have had those cheesesteak's for lunch? 

There was a gentleman playing the harp in the hallway, which was very pleasant. The hot mulled wine was wonderful! 

We'll be back next time we're in Philly!

I had the Mexican chicken salad.  The chicken was done perfectly, and it was still steaming as the plate arrived.  Nicely seasoned.  The lettuce was not iceberg, always a plus.  Some of the extras like avocado and tomato etc. were good.  

But the tortilla chips advertised to some with it were sorely lacking.  The dressing on top was ranch.  I did know this because it said so on the menu, but for some reason I guess I thought there might be something out there that exists that is "Mexican" ranch dressing.  I must be wrong, because overall, this salad  could probably have been made at Applebee's or TGI Fridays or wherever.  Not real Mexican, not real interesting, but at least it was fairly tasty.

I took an order of chips with pico de gallo sauce to go.  They were home-made, or I guess we're supposed to say "house made" now.  But a bit greasy to suit me.  The pico de gallo was decently spicy.

DO NOT GO HERE.  Gave me the wrong order tonight after driving all the way home.  Overcharged me and did not offer to refund the difference.  No apology from "manager".  Then argued with me on my way out of the store.  Worst service.  Spend your money elsewhere I know I will.  Lesson learned.  I'll wait for the 'under new management' sign to go up before I return.  Later.
Very much meh.  Not putting much effort into this review since I am obviously finishing my review long after they closed, but wanted to document it since I started it in 2016.

We have been searching throughout Reno and Sparks for a particular brand of ramen noodles: MaMa. In California (Sacramento), you could find them in some Targets, Wal-Marts, and local supermarkets but no such luck here.

We tried everything from Old Northwest Reno to the Cost Plus World Market near Sun Valley to various Targets and Wal-Marts. Finally, we asked the clerk at the Cost Plus for some suggestions and explained that we were looking for a particular brand of Thai ramen and he suggested this store.

We were pleased to find our coveted MaMa Ramen and a variety of supplies (wasabi, sesame and chili oil) as well as Boss Iced Coffee Drinks from Japan. It's an old building but clean and easy to navigate wider aisles, and the owner/cashier was extremely friendly. It was easy for my wife to shop and the only thing stopping us from giving it five stars is they only had nine packages of ramen on the shelf. We will happily come back to see if we can buy them in bulk next time!

I stopped in back in January after following them for a while on Instagram and drooling at every post!  
I purchased three different items: a Jawn, a cupcake and  a lemon bar I believe.  They didn't have the flavor Jawn that I wanted to try so I went with the one they had.  I wasn't blown away by any of the items.  I mean, they were good but for the price and hype, I thought I would have been speechless.
I will try them again for the Jawn that I still want to try.

We had dinner and two breakfasts here during our stay at Sirata. The food was left to be desired but our service from Alex made up for the poor quality of food. There was another server named Eddie who was rude to Alex the whole time and wore his face mask below his nose. Alex remained  professional and courteous. It was great meeting you Alex! the rating is not a reflection of your outstanding customer service.

I usually really like this bar. Pretty neat venue and fun crowd but the music lately SUCKS. Saturday night, my friends requested something more along the lines of Britney Spears or at least something that can be danced to and the DJ's reply was "this is a gay bar". With the DJ having such fantastic observational skills, you would think he would have noticed that no one was dancing (gay or straight). Get better music and you'll make more money because people will actually stay as opposed to heading over to other bars in the area.

Went on a Tuesday night.  The restaurant wasn't busy.  We were seated immediately.  We were seated for a bit before our server showed up to take our drink order.  We gave her our entire order, drinks and all.  I got a diet coke with lemon, my daughter had water.  To start, my daughter and I ordered chips, salsa and guacamole.  We both ordered plain chicken and cheese quesadillas.  I couldn't find our server nor the bartender so I went to the hostess.  I asked her to find out where our food is.  People seated 10 min. after us got there food before us.  It took40 minutes

Rudest dunkin bout to smack one of the workers for how she wa simply taking my order and getting frustrated with the register getting a bad attitude with me. Not only was the cashier so unprofessional the whole team was ignorant and rude and slow getting out my two coffees.

My first time at first watch didn't disappoint. The pancake was light and fluffy, the mains were tasty with good portions, and the fresh juices were worth the price. Would highly recommend for a weekend brunch! 5/5.

Great casual spot with a small but solid draft choice and super food. Our group was in for the NO Bowl and wanted something outside the Quarter but not hole-in-the-wall and Capdeville fit the bill. Food was tasty- we started with the alligator sausage corn dogs and the group's choices ranged from a salmon salad to the tacos and I had the parmesan chicken. All solid choices, I'd definitely go back.
Walked past a nice patio seating area in the front into a large, crowded, extremely loud and noisy room with crying children.  No ambiance and very stressful environment.  We did not stay.

Being from out  of  town, I was relying on other reviews...

I ordered the veggie omelet with hash browns and toast. The food was very good. House made salsa was tasty. Service was exceptional; my coffee cup and salsa bowl never went dry.

An excellent local breakfast joint!

AMAZING. A-M-A-Z-I-N-G! Capital Tacos is, hands down, THE best place to get good food in the area--and maybe, dare I say it, the best foodie tacos in Tampa. And at great prices!

This is not your traditional Mexican style tacos, or even your traditional Tex-Mex. This is tacos with a unique twist, served up with tons of flavor and nothing but wonderful. It's a bit more like BBQ meets taco in a lot of the options, and literally everything I've ever had was fabulous. I'm hard pressed to pick just one favorite, but if I had to it would be  the Peacemaker. They also just switched the Yelp offer over to free chips and queso, which was amazing, and in my opinion the guacamole is definitely worth the money. I'm also a huge fan of their bottled beer selection, although my mom is continually sad that they don't serve margaritas (not even wine ones). 

I love hole in the walls, so I wouldn't want to change the quirky atmosphere, but at busy times I definitely wish there was a bit more seating. Still, it's more than worth the wait, and the funky interior and booths just adds to the charm. I absolutely cannot recommend this place enough!

This jasn't been open very long but its a great place for lunch or dinner. You order at the counter and they serve at your table.
It's located on main street. Enjoy...I did!

Ann L: this place is fabulous. All fresh quality ingredients, made to order. The bread crust is not "thin," it's "pressed." This is how cubanos are served. Lovely. The avocado salad is to die for. Simple, fresh, constructed after ordered.  After ordered. I've never seen this made anywhere else. Beautiful meal, gracious service. And the quote on the wall makes the atmosphere.
No one under the age of 18. My three kids are tired and hungry after a great day in NOLA and this was a sour ending for sure.

Okay, as stingy as I am with the five star reviews this place deserves one hands down for several reasons.

I'll start with the obvious, the food. I started with the chop salad romaine lettuce, roasted grape tomatoes, olives, shallots, gorgonzola, and lemon citronette. It was fresh and light and invigorating to the taste buds.  It was a pale, crisp, fresh, light salad with a bit of a zip.

The pizza is a fresh warm melt in your mouth amazing thin crust artesian pizza.  I went for the Margherita with crushed San Marzano tomatoes, our hand stretched mozzarella, and fresh local basil.  I opened the box and the smell was intoxicating.

The second reason are the people.  The service was prompt, kind, and amazing.  The owner is also committed to giving back and supporting the community and that's a small business that I want to support!

This bakery is just a gem in the neighbourhood you walk in the staff are always welcoming, you can purchase very unique items while shopping in the store like Dutch spices, shoes, baking needs and they have  a candy wall (which my kiddos love going to) from the candy wall you can then you walk to the cafe where you can have a sandwich made fresh and a delicious cup of koffie, you walk a few steps more you get a lovely selection of meat at the deli with a variety of cheese, sausage, and then you hit the bakery fresh bread, pastries all well priced, made in store (they have a FB page) and their sausage rolls are to die for! They have baking classes and they invite children from schools to learn how to bake, it's just a great business! I have been coming to this bakery since I was young and I am happy to be able to bring my children as it's such a treat walking into Dutch Delicious , you know your getting baking that comes from the heart!

Place was clean & 2:30 on a Monday so sounds like they are getting better or I just lucked out. Employees were nice  and helpful. Got a homewrecker chips and a drink for 649 since it's Monday so extra star for that. Cannot complain about size it was almost too big. I'd go lighter on the rice next time .

Holy moly this place was amazing! Food was delicious! The place was packed! They close once they run out of food and by the time we left they had run out of food! I would recommend to come early. If you are in the area I would highly recommend stopping in for a meal.

Although, I am saddened i left my favorite teal hoodie there. As I had an early flight out the next day I couldn't get it back. I hope it found a good home and is keeping someone else cozy and warm

Absolutely the worst Uber eats decision I've ever made. The chicken pad Thai smelled and tasted (it was poor judgment to taste it after the smell) like the chicken had spoiled. We ordered gyoza that was equally as terrible, but at least didn't smell spoiled. I would have been better off grabbing frozen gyoza in the supermarket. The tofu rivaled the gyoza for worst appetizer. The only benefit was that I at least had a slightly warmed (though expensive) block of tofu to cook for later. I'm pretty sure they just heated the tofu slightly and added a sprinkle of seasoning on top. Absolutely terrible, do yourself a favor and avoid at all costs.
The pies are wonderful. We had the peaches and cream and the coconut cream. Both were outstanding. I can't wait to try their cakes and other desserts.

Cute location, the wait was a bit long so we opted for the take out counter and picnic seating outside.  I had the sampler and everything was well made and fresh.  Fair price for the location and quality.
Got the meatloaf wellington, it was great. The potatoes were great too. Would love to go back here.

We visit often but now found some specials we never tried before. It's amazing what they do with vegan and locally sourced ingredients. My favorite is the new beyond burger choices but still go for the Hawaiian Dream sandwich for a variety. Nice people and service too.
Delicious vegetarian food, good music and decor, big open front windows in the summer and great service! Would definitely come back.

I just ordered delivery from this establishment and they were very thorough with the delivery process. The delivery man was very kind and I had realized after I sat down that I gave him $49? on a $25 bill. I thought that he would never come back and take off with the money, but surprisingly he returned telling me that I accidentally gave him two $20 bills and returned my money. He apologized and I don't even know why. What a kind person! Just judging by how honest and kind the staff are, I'm pretty sure that I will be ordering from them more often. Judging by the reviews, this restaurant really tries to cater to their customers. That is a pretty rare find these days. No matter how good the food is at a restaurant, if the service is atrocious it can leave a bad taste in your mouth. This place deserves more customers than it already has :)

Went out to this BYOB for a child-free date night with my husband. Reservations are highly recommended during the pandemic. We were seated promptly and given water almost immediately. The staff was very friendly and attentive. We had the bruschetta as an appetizer, and it was some of the most delicious bruschetta I'd ever had. My husband had a seafood pasta dish, and I had the lamb special, also delicious. They do have a children's menu, so we will definitely be back with our son.

Yes. As a second lunch/snack my friend eyed someone with one of these corn dogs so we had to find where this fancy looking corn dog came from! 
My friend and I got two different ones. She got the jalapeno cheddar corn dog while I got the chorizo sweet potato corn dog. They were both pricer than what you expect a corn dog to be but oh so delicious that it's worth it!  Both were excellent and had their own distinct flavor. They even had vegan corn dogs which my vegan friend would have loved! A must when you come to terminal reading market
What an awesome pizza and even more awesome is the mission to better the lives of the disabled the Walter and his Wife Judy promote with their business!

Amazing persona and excellent service! We were going to order a pickup and we had called the wrong one so they helped us figure it out with the other location and then proceeded to rush our order so that we weren't waiting a long time! Very helpful and genuine people! On top of the service the smell alone will sell you on the food! Very pleased!

My favorite brunch spot in Philly!! Everything on the menu is absolutely delicious!  I have never had a bad meal here EVER!  It is so hard to decide what to order because everything sounds so good. Everyone there is so friendly and the owner there is great. They make sure you are taken care of and enjoy your meal.  Excellent customer service!  So if you are looking for a brunch spot this place is it!

Metro Diner in Jacksonville, FL was delicious and fresh...finding one in TN was a no brainer. We experienced the same goodness. Our waiting time was to be 25-30 minutes. After less then 10 min we were seated inside ordering our cup of coffee. Our waiter "Tracy"was very friendly and knowledgeable. Menu options were just enough without making difficult to choose . Everything sounded pretty good.My San Francisco Egg Benedits were delishhh!!! Tracy told us that this item was a popular one. My husband ordered the Protein Breakfast (meats and eggs) and a spicy chicken biscuit.  Dessert: we ordered the white red and blue waffle -Crispy waffle along fresh fruit. (Blueberries,Strawberries and whip cream). Service was friendly and we liked that everyone (other servers) were working together and checking on other customers besides the tables they were overseeing. We saw even the manager taking food to tables and checking on customers. Bathrooms were clean and well kept. Since we were traveling our server Tracy made sure we had our dessert and check ready to go. We most definitely be back here to do a repeat!

The Jalapeño sausage kolache... is all you need to know. It's a must every time we go (if they're not sold out). We mixed in the cream cheese and apple cinnamon last week, and were not disappointed! Great spot for a quick grab and go breakfast on the east side.

My go-to place for pho.  

Standard accoutrements (basil, lemongrass, sprouts, jalapenos) are always fresh.  Pho is on your table before you can say "chopsticks".  

Service can be spotty as far as water refills which are a must when you're lacing your pho with Sriracha as I do.  And you'll seldom get greeted at the door; instead, you're more likely to be pointed at from across the dining room upon entry which is their way of seating you  - not warm and fuzzy but certainly efficient.

Guys' bathroom is sketchy.  Wash the bottom of your shoes after using the urinal.  'Nuff said there.

Run don't walk to this delightful place!  While shopping at Publix one day we spotted Pie12 and checked it out on Yelp.  The reviews were wonderful so we decided to give it a shot!  WOW were we impressed!  Started with the Caesar salad with was one of the best we have had around town.  From there the meatball appetizer which was absolutely delicious!  As we were finishing up the chef popped our Gustosa pizza in the coal fired oven.  Timed perfectly and equally wonderful!  Finally tiramisu to finish things off.  Oh my.... perfection!  I would highly recommend this locally owned business to anyone looking for a great meal.  From the service to the food... all impeccable!  We will definitely be back many times!  So thrilled we found this spot!

Wait time is crazy. We were given a wait time link on our phones . 

Took me a min to figure it out since I asked 3 employees who didn't know how to use their own system. 

Found one gal named Billy who was the only one with any sense . She helped me check my wait-time and had me seated as soon as she could . 

Billy what would they do with out you!
I adore this bakery for their baked goods, good coffee, and wonderful, warm service.  Really an exceptional bakery!

We hit up the new Shake Shack in Metairie for the first time last night for a quick family dinner. We've heard mixed reviews, but had a good overall experience on our first visit. 

I REALLY enjoyed the SmokeShack burger... I like the way they cook the patties and found the smoked ranch bacon and chopped cherry pepper spread to be very unique and full of good, spicy flavor. It was one of the better fast food burgers I've had in a while. 

My wife had the Chick'n Shack fried chicken sandwich... also very good. She commented that it was better than the Popeye's sandwich (we had a slight disagreement there ;) ...... 

We didn't try the shakes... hope to get to that next time. 

BOTTOM LINE: A great new addition to the fast food scene in Metairie. I will definitely be back for that SmokeShack burger.

This place is a great little neighborhood Mexican restaurant. 
 Its not gourmet and I probably wouldn't describe it as authentic but we really love it and keep going back.  They have good margaritas, we always get the Cadillac and they are huge so you only need one.  We start with the Queso with Chorizo and its great and comes with warm tortillas.  My husbands favorite is their Chile Poblanos which he tries at most Mexican restaurants we try and he has always said theirs are the best.  My favorite is their special quesadilla with Chorizo and beans.  We have also had the chimichangas and Chicken Enchiladas with Mole sauce and they were great too.  

The atmosphere is fun and they often have a mariachi band or just a guy who comes around and sings.  The big plus is we have always had great friendly service even with a language barrier every time we have gone.

I had a fantastic and flavorful lunch today at this Middle Eastern restaurant that I've been wanting to try for a while now. 

 The chicken shawarma was perfectly cooked.  Hummus was the best I've ever had, and the pita bread was good.  Labaneh and babaganoush were ok. 

 The staff were very friendly and helpful.  I thought the prices were a little high, but I will be back anyway to try more of their food.
Yes, everyone now likes McDonald's, but we only ordered 4 Shakes and had to wait over 20 minutes.  They finally started working on them when I mentioned we were waiting over 20 minutes.

A delicious lunch on a Thursday afternoon. We shared the scrumptious hummus to start, then a schwarma combo and a pine nut salad with beef schwarma. 
Everything was fresh, delicately seasoned, light but filling. Portions are generous, service friendly and prompt, and prices reasonable. 
Hummus is our new favorite for middle-eastern food, and go-to spot on Maple.

Bomb completely bomb!  If you don't like presto pasta you suck. My girlfriend loves this place my boss loves this place my kids live this place I love this place. A whole lotta love going around at this eatery.

Real good sushi. My go to spot when I'm working in the area.  What's the best thing they do?  Soy sauce in an actual sauce cup!  Unfortunately their udon is just okay, and they don't have soba.  Come here for sushi, but go elsewhere for noodle soup.

We love this place! My family and I have been going here for years. We mostly order to go but, have eaten in as well. The people who work here are very sweet and helpful. We especially LOVE the Crab Rangoon and the Broccoli with chicken. It is very cute inside and has an outdoor patio space as well.

A first choice for special occasions or even an above average dinner when we have a few extra coins to spare! This is the best steak house in New Orleans. Always top-notch service and consistently perfectly presented and mouth watering apps and entrees! I've been to all the big name steakhouses in NOLA and they far outshine the comps! Desi Vega is the sister restaurant with an identical menu but a more contemporary atmosphere! Have been to both and prefer Mr. John's of the two!!! You won't be disappointed with Mr. Johns! 
Happy Eats! -Candy

Jim's Steaks is my favorite in Philly! I was turned on to them when i was 16 and 9 years later i still crave them and make a trip to South St. for a steak with wiz and onions! defiantly a staple of south street. It is cash only but if you don't have any there is an ATM with a 3 dollar fee right at the door for you. Upstairs is a tiny seating area filled with tons of autographed photos of everyone who has indulged in Jim's, including Ben Franklin.
You got to go to Jim's, it blows Pats and Genos out of the water! Fresh cooked steak off the well seasoned grill in front of you and the employees all have character. Plus an added bonus, you don't have to wait out in the cold for the line.

Very disappointing.  We have eaten Sunday brunch many times at the Grill and found it to be very good.  But this Christmas Day we had the dinner buffet at the Grill and it was not very good.  Good items were fine except the smoked salmon was not very tasty at all.  Deserts were delicious but we had to wait for them to be refilled before we could have any.  But the prime rib was awful.  No taste and tough.  I love the Grill and  Hebert was an excellent waiter but I think we will stay away from holidays in the future.

Would really love to give this place a great review, due to great interior and interesting  menu.  Unfortunately I can't.  Service just WAAAYYY too slow.  Not that many people here either.  Food good but not great.

Aus Deutschland kommend muss ich sagen, dass mich dieses All-You-Can-Eat-Buffet regelrecht umgehauen hat! Mit wahnsinnig viel Platz und einer sauberen Präsentation (natürlich ist dabei auch die Klimatisierung selbstverständlich) kann man sich hier den Bauch vollschlagen, jedoch alles in einer sehr guten Qualität.

Hauptsächlich aber nicht ausschließlich gibt es Meeresfrüchte, frischen Fisch, gutes und vielfältiges Sushi, mariniertes Fleisch, Udon-Suppen, Crepes, Hibachi (wo das Essen auf riesigen Kochflächen vor deinen Augen zubereitet wird) und eine üppige Dessert-Theke mit Obst, Kuchen, Plätzchen und Softeis-Maschine.

Abends ist das Angebot größer (z.B. gibt es große Krebse zum "Selberknacken" mit Buttersauce), kostet dann 30,00$. Die Bedienung ist (wie man es in Amerika immer wieder antrifft) sehr zuvorkommend und überaus freundlich. Daher: Beim Trinkgeld nicht geizen!

I wanted to love this place because it's independent and in my neighborhood, but I just can't give it a glowing review. I was surprised that we weren't offered a drink menu since margaritas are supposed to be one of their "things", but even after we asked what drinks they had they didn't bring us a menu; they just told us some stuff they had. We ordered guacamole which was good, but mostly a bowl of lettuce with one spoon of guac on top. I ordered Camarones a la Parrilla, and it was nothing like it was described in the menu. It was supposed to be grilled shrimp, ancho Chile cream sauce and roasted poblano cream sauce on the side. It came out as 6 grilled shrimp--no sauce of any kind. When I asked at least about the sauce on the side, the server asked me what kind of sauce I wanted. So I said, the sauce that the menu says it comes with. Do the servers not even know what's on the menu? Maybe it was an off night, but I'm really not that charged up to go back. The taste of the food was fine, but I can get better (at way more reasonable prices) at several other Mexican-style restaurants around town.
They have really no stars, their security is bad they allowed fraudulent activities on my card without checking ID.

Wow! Amazing. I've been wanting to go here for some time now and I am so happy that I was able to go. The building alone is huge and sooo beautifully decorated. The service is amazing everyone was so nice and attentive. Our food! Our food!!!!! Yummm delicious, incredible. You won't be disappointed. I will definitely be going back and recommending to everyone. (Operating dine in and take out during Covid-masks upon arrival but you can remove when you sit down. Hand sanitizer station available. Very clean restaurant)

The atmosphere and service was really good. Price of food is good and proportions are large. The kids did not like the food. They ordered the spaghetti, grilled cheese and pizza. I had the Sarah sandwich with salad. The wife had the tuna melt with salad. Something about it just didnt "wow" us. We wont eat here again but was worth trying.
Great little diner. Best clam chowder I have ever had! It's a mix of new england and manhattan, mostly red based. Perfect locations too!

2-18-21
Take out order. 
Staff - Very helpful and polite. 
Gumbo soup - Super tasty and excellent. 
Haddock Fish & Chips - DELICIOUS.....Loved it 100%
Highly recommend.......can't wait to return for more
Best sushi in New Orleans, hands down. But it is NOT true that they take reservations. Get it together, Yelp.

Hands down the best place in Nashville to get a really excellent drink. In keeping with the prohibition theme, their drink menus aren't available online but they are constantly changing with the seasons and consistently excellent. At $12 they're among the most expensive drinks in Nashville, but unlike other pricy cocktails in the city they're incredibly generous in both size and strength; it's really like getting two drinks. I've gone with my college friends and with my parents, and this place is equally enjoyed across all ages. 

If the drinks are the highlight of this place, the service and atmosphere come in close second. The bartenders know the menu like the back of their hand, and if you don't see something you like, they can create something just for you. The bar is dimly lit  with great music and looks of the prohibition period, with a beautiful wood bar in the center of the room. It's not the kind of place where people mill around the room; the hostess sits you down at the bar or at a table, and ensures that once all seats are full, no one else comes in - that way, you never have to worry about it being too crowded. 

On weekend nights you can expect over an hour wait if you go at peak times, because the word has really gotten out about this place.
Pretty good place for a Monday night. The tables are insanely uneven. The drink I had was pretty delicious and the oysters were yummy.

So I received a card in the mail to try one of their chef's specials for free...Needless to say I was surprised at the food...I ordered a fish, beans, cheese and spinach tortilla and I took it for take out..
When I got the food home....Needless to say it was awesome! !! The flavors and the fish is what had me sold...plus I love spinach....
I don't do too many chain restaurants but I will definitely be back to this one

I'm giving them 5 stars because I want them to do well and stay in business went to the soft opening and like all new restaurants they are working out the kinks, happens everywhere. Owner and staff were very friendly food was good and as time goes on and students come back in the fall I expect this place to be packed. So get there now during the summer. I hope they get spicier sauces.

Food was very good...nice vibe and not crazy busy on a Saturday morning in January.  Strawberry Mimosa I felt was average and waitress was nice but seemed rushed, I'm sure was very busy with all of her tables.  I'd definitely go back next time I'm in Clearwater

Great clam chowder. It's a big bowl full of clams with chunky vegetables in a flavorful broth.  The waitstaff was attentive without being invasive. We also had a huge order of fried mushrooms crispy and yummy. Thank goodness they reheat

My dolls and I stopped her for the infamous Hurricane drink to start off a wild night on Bourbon Street! Not only did this drink taste delish but the bartender provided great service. This bar is beyond huge! Once we got our drinks we went across the hall to another room that was having a piano duel of modern pop music. It was so much fun. I did not get to explore the massive compound but from the looks and sounds of things, all the patrons were having a really good night. The next time that I am in NOLA I will definitely return!

It's really gone downhill lately. My food was fine but overpriced--$20 with tip for a soda and a main dish that was honestly small, smaller serving then what I'm used to there. I hate that you have to reserve tickets to sit near your friends too, makes it a real pain bc everyone has to buy on the same bill. And I watched my friend only get her app and not the main dish she ordered--rather then to the right thing and compher bill they squabbled with her about it!  I probably won't be coming back here again soon....

Not so great. Slow service and below average food.  Shocking for the high price. Much better seafood options in Indy.  Won't return.  Large party and if say half the people found the good average to worse.

Excellent! Shannon J. was warm and welcoming.  She had us in stitches with her attitude and sass!  Food was excellent and we left stuffed.  Great location on Bourbon Street near our hotel.  Will be back on next visit to the Big Easy.

My favorite burger in Indy.  Do yourself a favor, and make the trip downtown.  The wait on a weekend night is typically at least an hour, and it's well worth it.  The host or hostess will take down your phone number on arrival, and text you when your table is ready.  Since it's located on Mass. Ave., it's easy to kill an hour or so walking around the stores, people watching in the summer time, etc.

While I love Workingman's Friend, comparing it to Bru Burger is like comparing apples and oranges.  Instead of thin, crispy patties served with iced tea in a Mason jar, you get a thick, juicy, burger made from grass-fed beef, sandwiched between two freshly made buns, and topped with a wide variety of gourmet toppings.  Unlike many places that use the list of toppings to get you in the door *COUGH* FIVE GUYS *COUGH*, the toppings here complement the burger; not overwhelm it.  The Bru Burger offers Taleggio cheese, bacon, tomato jam, and carmelized onion, and is my favorite on the menu.  The Roma burger, arugula pesto, prosciutto, roasted red peppers, mozzarella, and balsamic onion is great, as is every other burger I've tried.  

For the less adventurous, there is a classic cheeseburgers, patty melt, bacon cheeseburger, etc.

The onion rings are huge, and the breading has a nice seasoning, which was a pleasant surprise compared to the sweet batter most places offer.  I am easily overwhelmed by all the breading, so I typically stick to the fries.    

Despite the large portions, every time I walk out the door, I want to make U-turn and go back in for another burger and maybe even another cup of HOMEMADE KETCHUP.  No, I didn't stutter.  This isn't the pasty slop my grandma made from leftover garden tomatoes.  It's light, fresh, sweet, and the perfect complement to the crispy, house-made fries.

We went to Bridget's to celebrate a special occasion, it was our first trip there- We picked it because I have a gluten allergy and saw online they had a ton of gluten free options.  I informed the waiter of my allergy but somehow still got sick. How is this possible? I paid $170 for the meal and got sick? When I can go to Chick-Fil A for dinner and don't get sick? Do they take more care at Chick-Fil-A than Bridget's?

 The prices are that of higher end restaurants like Capital Grill and Morton's but we were disappointed to see that the ambiance wasn't as nice.  The service was subpar, the waiter was running around over stressed and whenever he was talking to us he was backing away as if to run to the next table. The food was good, not great. It just wasn't on par with the prices, I don't ever mind dropping a lot of money on a meal but for the quality it was disappointing.
Absolutely amazing fast service! Delicious food and even better frozen custard! Good prices, good music!

Not exactly taking COVID safety protocols seriously.  Uncomfortable carryout protocols.   Would not return.  

We ordered carryout Saturday night.  When we arrived we called to see if they were offering curbside or otherwise, and we were told we had to come inside to pickup.  Usually that would be OK but it was completely packed inside the door, with large groups in front of the hostess stand, half of them maskless while waiting for the hostess.  By the time I made it up to the hostess counter no one was there and I continued to wait.  Once someone showed up then I was told we had to pickup at the bar area, which had nearly every seat full ( thought phase 4 re opening required capacity limits for standing areas if not in the dining room ).  Having to fight for the overwhelmed bartenders attention while staying away from the packed maskless crowds at the bar I nearly walked out instead of picking up our order.

We've supported this local business for years, and seems they've forgotten about those who have supported them through carryout business during the pandemic.  Would be nice to see some increased focus for those of us who are not comfrotable coming into restaurant dining rooms.

Love the new location because:
- air conditioning
- larger so all the seating is in one room (the last loc had 2 separate rooms)
- bar can seat more people
- more TVs

The beers and staff are excellent as always.

LOVE getting breakfast here. There was a bit of a wait, but it was worth it! They have coffee and water in the waiting area which was really nice! I had an amazing eggs benedict with a sabrina's spin. Poached eggs, homemade tomato hollandaise sauce, avacados and turkey bacon over english muffins and breakfast potatoes on the side. One of the best breakfast platters i have ever had. My boyfriend got lunch, he had a burger and fries that he really enjoyed. Will definitely try this place again!

My husband will only order his pizza from this location. We've picked up & had delivery and have always been pleased with either method. I've had the greek salad and was quite impressed with the taste & quality of the salad while my husband prefers a more tasty tomato sauce  he always manages to eat the whole pizza without too much effort!

Went to Olive Garden today (Wednesday) around 12 PM. A lot of open tables and not too noisy. We ordered the garlic marinara mussels as an appetizer. As an entree I ordered chicken parmigiana and got the chicken & gnocchi soup then reloaded with the Zuppa Toscana. Very great food.

I'm a little late in writing this review, our visit was a few weeks ago, but I wanted to make sure that I got this out there!  

Sabrina's in Collingswood has become one of my happy places!  I always enjoy the food and the atmosphere is great in their bright and cheerful dining room.  It's such a great space with inviting decor.  The real stars on our most recent visit though, were the staff.  We had a party of friends visiting from NYC and the UK, with wildly different tastes. They were young and old, including a baby, and toddlers, all on a very busy Saturday morning (yikes, I know).  We warned them ahead of time of our arrival and we were given an area to sit in that accommodated everyone's needs nicely and a place to stow the strollers, canes, etc.  We were all able to chat and eat comfortably.  The servers were amazing with the kids and brought them a little bowl of yummy avocado, cheese chunks and fruit to keep them busy while we were waiting for our food.  They asked the little ones all about The Camden Aquarium, which is where we were headed after breakfast. The kids were in heaven!  The specials that day were cool and inventive and I think everyone at the table had one.  Our food was delicious and the much needed coffee was perfect. I could eat the challah French Toast every day.  Both the die-hard foodies, and the picky eaters of the group were extremely happy with their breakfasts.  Service was prompt and friendly. In the past I have only come in with just my BF and everything was tasty and pleasant, but I was truly impressed with how Sabrina's handled our large party on this visit.

I used to drink here when I first was legally allowed to, and I remember it being much easier on the wallet. Now, I literally live up the block and stopped in on a hot Friday afternoon after work for a pick me up and paid 6 dollars for a super weak rum and Coke; 8 dollars for a DOUBLE! EIGHT DOLLARS! Meanwhile, a Yuengling pint was only 2 bucks. Advice: Come back here, hang with the guys old enough to be your Dad and drink the cheap drafts. STAY AWAY from anything else.

Five Guys has moved to the Burbs and has taken over. On the weekend this place is over run with Minivans and H3's(why do you still DRIVE these things people!!). Must be the smell of the burgers wafting through the mini mall but  it brings the hordes in like the stampeding herd they are. I think its that everyone is trying to be " lean and healthy" and everyone once in a while 'Meg'(standard culdesac name) likes to chow down on some PURE GREASE. 

Me? I try to go at least 3 times a week for a quick bacon burger, but only add the seasoned fries. No need to waste money on the regular droopy dog fries if they aren't going to have any taste.

Like the slogan says It's probably the best burger you are going to get under 5 bucks.

Side note: regular burgers have 2 patties and jr.'s have 1.

We got to this place really early, around 7 am, before the waiting lines were down the street. Nestled right in the French Quarter area, this restaurant has a mixture if traditional and eclectic dishes. By far my favorite dishes were the Costa Rican and the French toast. The Costa Rican had yummy crispy plantain chips that adorned the filling rice and beans classic; this dish was cooked very close to the authentic Central American way. The French toast I highly recommend at whatever time you visit--you could even eat it as a shared appetizer or dessert with other people as the sticks are easy to share and eat. My least favorite item I tried were the biscuits that were the "beds" for several of the dishes I tried. While the eggs and chicken flavorful, I found the biscuits to be a little too doughy and not as flaky as I wish they could be. All our food was fresh and very well prepared. would come back to this place.

Pretty good corn dog - I've never had a chili/scallion covered corn dog so glad I was able to try it! The hot dog part itself was okay in my opinion, but the batter and the toppings outside were very crunchy and tasty! 

I wasn't full after one corn dog, but it's fine when there's a ton of other things you can eat here as well.

Basil Spice is a sold choice for carry out Thai on S.Grand. I have really enjoyed the Gang Masa, Gang Dang and Panang although my only complaint is that I can never get the dishes spicy, despite ordering  that way. 
I recommend carry out or delivery but don't recommend dining in (even pre covid) as the dining area is just not welcoming or cozy. 
Portions are decent albeit on the smaller side however the quality of food/ingredients is excellent.
Definitely recommend as they are solidly in my ordering rotation.

I don't know how I haven't written a review on this place yet... Let me preface this with I AM A CARNIVORE. I eat meat pretty much every meal of every day. So I was a little skeptical to try a vegetarian restaurant. That being said, this place blew me out of the water! The Buffalo Cauliflower Bites legitimately taste like you're eating wings. I always thought that was something fitness freaks said to make the rest of us feel bad about ourselves, but they really do. I always get the Buffalo Cauliflower Wrap as well. It's extremely filling (and I'm usually a clean plate club kind of girl) so I always have leftovers to bring home. The tater tots with the dipping sauce are delicious as well. This place has definitely become one of me and my husband's favorite restaurants (who is also a carnivore). Definitely worth trying!
Solid Chesterfield restaurant.  Great wine selection and prices.  Wonderful helpful staff
Great location and friendly staff. Chargrilled oysters were good but not the best. Unfortunately, food was not memorable.

Food was amazing! The hotdog and the burger with Pimento and onion sauce was so good. Wait staff was super friendly and helpful. Place is clean and very comfortable. I will definitely bring friends and family!

As others have noted, the service here is on the inconsistent side.  I was in town for a conference 2 weeks ago and ate at Deanie's twice (once for dinner, the second time for lunch).  My lunch server was great, but the dinner server (while nice) was a bit scattered/out-of-it.

Never-the-less, the reason to come back to Deanie's is the food.  Admittedly, I think there are things that aren't so great--like the crawfish po boy I had for lunch.  I should have remembered the previous night's dinner where I had AMAZING grilled oysters (the butter and parmsean cheese were so lovey) and INCREDIBLE BBQ shrimp (my friend and I shared a bowl and she was literally slurping up the sauce with a soup spoon), and the seafood gumbo--SO GOOD!  Also my friend got a dozen oysters on the half shell and LOVED THEM so much that the same night she went back with friends for a night cap and a second round of oysters.

Deanie's, I will dream of your BBQ shrimp!
This seemed like a restaurant that rushed to open before they could assess what it would take to give customers a good food and visual experience during Covid. That's all I'm going to say.
Bright and clean inside.  Attentive and helpful wait staff.  The Pho is authentic, tasty, and endlessly customizable!  ***TIP- for a smaller size, order the children's portion!

I am always surprised that this place is Not crowded.  We have been here many times over the years but a few times in the last few weeks.  This place is simple, unassuming.  Wine bar? Ok? Pizza? Absolutely.  But a basic place nonetheless.  Not the best seating, but the menu is intriguing and some of the dishes are delicious.  I have several favorites.  One is the chicken wings.  I will be honest- they do not look appetizing.  But we ended up ordering a second order for our group.  The burrata with arugula is very very good.  The meatballs in a skillet I would order again.  But the pizza, any rule I've had has been superb.

Great restaurant and yummy food. Definitely a little more upscale than what the group and I thought it was going to be. Oysters from Cape Cod were $31. Worth it! A couple of people got the Luke Burger and I had a bite of it...it is so good. The MOULES ET FRITES were delicious as well. A plate full of PRINCE EDWARD ISLAND MUSSELS STEAMED WITH GARLIC & THYME WITH HOUSE-MADE FRIES..yes...delicious..wow. JUMBO LOUISIANA SHRIMP EN COCOTTEI was another dish that a couple of the group members ordered. Same comment, consistently great. They both enjoyed it so much. I had the Fruge Farms Crawfish Etouffee and it was definitely something that I enjoyed eating, but the presentation of it was not so great. Let's just say that the noodles don't look so appetizing. Overall, great restaurant...very beautiful on the inside and great service. We left the restaurant highly satisfied. What more can you ask for?

I love the outdoor space in back for summer drinking.  Food is alright but you have to pay for chips and salsa.  Service has been terrible every time I've gone - servers are inattentive and annoyed when you ask for things.  It has always taken me a very long time to get service or to get my drink after ordering.  Once they even forgot me and I had to go up to the bar and re order.  Also somehow smoking is allowed on the patio in back which could be good or bad depending on your preference.
Awesome food service was great our waitor was amaizin food was awesome and restaurant was verry clean

I'm sorry but my wife and I both had bad dinners and I will not return to this restaurant again. I ordered the Bangkok Duck and it came out very over cooked. My wife ordered a chicken dish and the chicken was over cooked. 30 minutes later I wound up home sitting on the toilet. Not this place ever again. The service was good and the staff was friendly.
We come here every time we are in New Orleans and this time Alan was behind the bar and did an amazing sugar free vodka mix for  my husband. We love that everything was fresh!

Not at all impressed.  The burger was over cooked and pretty tasteless.  The cashier was not friendly or helpful.  Overall, very disappointing.  Truth be told, there is a Wendy's down the street and the new Hot N' Juicy burgers there are far superior to the one I had at Cheeseburger Eddie's.  Probably will not return for the burger, but would like to give the other fare a chance.
this place is good has many different sauces you can choose from. I always end up over ordering! Definitely recommend this place to  someone that wants to grab a quick bite.

I was meeting some friends for lunch on Sunday in Audubon. I couldn't think of a single interesting place to hit that wasn't a chain. My friend's mom suggested we try the new diner that just opened in the former location for the Osaka restaurant.

We were seated immediately. Although there were booths open, our host tried to seat us in the middle of the room. I asked for a booth and I have to say I was surprised he didn't seat us in one anyway. Who doesn't want a booth as their first choice after all? Other than that one-off, the service was fine, our waitress served us quickly and she let us sit and linger over our meal while we caught up. Bonus points for that.

The meal was fine, as okay as any meal in a PA diner. Come on, this isn't New Jersey, or even New York, so I wasn't prepared to be wowed. I had a crab sandwich. It came on a grilled sourdough bread with a mild Swiss cheese (which was quite nice) and the crab was imitation, although the description didn't say so. That was fine, I love imitation crab. It was good. The fries that came with it were beyond bland. My girl-friend got a chocolate shake (quite good) and a grilled ham and cheese that she quite enjoyed. My guy-friend got a bowl of vegetable soup and finished my crab sandwich. Overall it was fine, probably better than about 90% of the diners in the area.

So many great items to choose from, it's quite the challenge. As we sat and ate our food we looked around and thought, "wow, that looks great."  Don't wait in a long line down the street, come here and have great food without the hassle.

Similar to making love, sloppy seconds generally is a losers game. However, the second time I went deep into the ship was as good as the first. Planning  to see just how deep I can go. Curious to see how much man the ship can handle on Thursday.

I was there last weekend.
I'm not a big fan of the food court at the mall because it's always very busy and noisy.
But if I have to eat there, like I did on the weekend, I would pick Freshii.
The food is pretty good and healthy and shorter line!
The staff is friendly and it seems they handle the orders efficiently.

Great local restaurant, which appeared to cater to 90% locals and 10% tourists, or on this night, almost everyone appeared to be a local. 

Within 2 blocks of the St. Charles streetcar line, make a left once disembarking and walking down the quaint Oak Street neighborhood and you've arrived once you see the tricked out pick up truck, completed with plastic alligators, welcoming guests. 

As others have noted, Jacques-Imo's was quite busy and our 30 minute wait was only 15. Try the fried grits, smothered in various sauces and cheeses, quite yummy. Corn bread was tasty as was the alligator craw fish cheesecake, but not the uber hype that others have noted.

Mismatched plates and thin as paper silverware add to the kitchy atmosphere.

I have gone to Lanna Thai at this location for years. Ownership changed. Cooks changed. Prices raised.  Very disappointed.
I will not return

After Greg's across the street was an hour+ wait, we ducked into US Hotel Bar & Grill to get out of the rain (and lured in by the promise of $1 mimosas and bacon gouda tater tots).

Our meal took awhile, which we didn't mind much but if you're in a hurry this probably isn't the stop for you. I enjoyed the Early Angry Bird sandwich (spicy fried chicken sandwich with sunny-side-up egg) and the tots. They were also randomly out of coffee by the time we arrived, so bear that in mind.

We heard through some friends later that they're closing soon?

They are really good specials and the Greek salad is the best thing on the menu. It is the best dressing i have ever tasted!!! 

The pizza is very good, it has a thick crust and usually get it with pepperoni and sausage. My wife likes to dip hers into the greek  dressing which is delicious. I also get the italian grinder with there curly fries and its like heaven on a hoagie roll. 

Staff are always nice and they have a drive thru window to pick up to go orders!

LOVED the cheese plate.  So good.
However, service was at first a bit pushy-dunno if that's because it was kind of slow so they were checking on us a lot.  We had never been before, so we needed time to look over the menu.  We asked for more time...then asked again from another server...then from a third, all in the span of about 4 minutes.  Then, once all members of staff had ascertained for themselves that we needed more time, they gave it to us.  Boy, did they.  We used the international symbol for "we're ready to order": put menus down, napkins in lap and looked up expectantly.  Nothing for a while.
The free pastry thing was great.  Fabulous idea.
Fiance asked for orange juice.  It never came.  Upshot: we weren't charged for it.
I had the cheese plate, as I mentioned, and it was wonderful.  I thought it could have used some fresh fruit, but the excellence of their marmalade nearly made up for that.
Fiance had the sampler of 4 pastries.  Disappointment.  They looked beautiful, but seemed a bit stale.  And perhaps it's just a personal pet peeve, but I like to know what food is in front of me...would have been awesome if the server had said, "Well, this is that, and that is this" etc.  We could recognize the apple strudel, and it looked delish, but was disappointingly hard.  The scone was a scone...not always a favorite for me, admittedly.  There was some sort of other filled pastry-the pastry was flaky and nice, but I'm still not sure what the filling was...dates? Prunes? Figs?  And the fourth pastry was (I think) almond, but undercooked a bit.  
Have to say their coffee was good, though, and the service was friendly, if a little desperate.
We will go again, however, as fiance feels that he just has "bad breakfast juju" and anyplace we try for the first time, he'll order something he doesn't love.  The benedict on the table next to ours looked great.

Well, well, well! Sitting pretty on the outskirts of rittenhouse square Park is this absolute gem. They use a method of wood baking which allows the bagels to be very soft. Nice variety for all your taste buddlings lol. Just know if you want a BETTER bagel go. CAUTION: not for slim pockets

$30 to get in today (normally $38).  This gets you four hours of free food, soft drinks, beer, bar-level cocktails, and food.   And comfortable chairs, plenty of plugs, and private restrooms. Do the math.  If you're suddenly hit with a 3 hour flight delay like I was, you can more than make up for that entrance fee.   Only negative thing I can say is that it faces the airport driveway instead of the runway, so the view isn't much to look at.  Well worth it.  I would come early for an outgoing flight just to visit again.

On Sunday, January 31st while closing, "Executive Sous Chef" Nathan was dumping water and grease right down the alley. (No grease trap in sight anywhere on the premises.) Nathan cursed up a storm and argued that it was "just water". He then decided to enter the neighboring business, make a scene in their shop, slam their doors, and toss some of their patio property across Macklind Ave. (All while on the clock, very professional!) Nonetheless after the incident on January 31st, a brand new grease trap appeared behind their business on February 2nd. I thought it was "JuSt WaTeR"? Even upper-level management tried saying that the mess was "water frozen over from the night before", when it never dropped to freezing temperatures. It's a shame when the businesses don't respect the neighborhood they belong to. The neighbors thank you for finally properly disposing of your waste!

The food has always been good, but the customer service is lacking. Everytime, and I mean everytime I have come into the store, same poor service. The older thin lady wearing a hat is the worst.  They must stay open from the food being great, definitely not for the friendly smile greetings :(

My boyfriend and I came here for the East Passyunk Restaurant Week. They were full when we arrived, and awkwardly stood by the "Please Wait to Be Seated" sign in the front. It was a good 10-15 minutes before any of the staff said anything to us, even though they were walking by us. A simple "hi" would have been appreciated. They offered us a secluded table which we were fine with. The table itself was a quarter game machine! We got to play some Pacman while waiting for our food. The Restaurant Week deal going on was $15 for french fries, mozzarella sticks or onion rings to start. 2nd was a choice of burger and 3rd was a choice of 3 milkshakes. We both chose mozzarella sticks and we're so glad that we did. Very yummy and cheesy! I got the pesto caprese burger with a veggie burger. I've had much better veggie burgers. I just didn't like the taste that much. My boyfriend got the blue cheese, garlic, and bacon burger. He didn't feel like it was very garlicy, even though it was labeled "garlic insanity bacon." That night, they only had 2 types of milkshake. We got the nutella milkshake & speculoos. I LOVED the speculoos milkshake and he liked the nutella. We would come back, but mostly for the mozzarella sticks and milkshakes.

Disappointing. The food was average at best - the popular appetizer croquettes was presented well but the marinara side sauce tasted like it was out of a jar. The beef barley soup looked flavorful, but nearly tasteless and the Steak of the Union was poorly cooked and ropy. Nice atmosphere but the service was just okay. Not worth the trip and  we won't return...

Our service here was great! It is very popular so allow yourself enough time and be prepared to wait if you come at a popular time. The servers were awesome and had great recommendations. This place was typical beach fare but still very high quality seafood. We had the crab cakes which had great flavor and the salmon which was a very large portion for the price and had good flavor as well. Their sides are great, especially the very cheesy Mac and cheese! We had a birthday we were celebrating and they gave complimentary key lime pie. Great experience!

I ordered a bahama breeze cocktail, appetizer (happy hour) size order of mozzarella sticks and a chicken quesadilla. The mozzarella sticks were to die for!! They were perfectly cooked, gooey on the inside and had a nice light reading crisp to the outside. I do not recommend the chicken quesadilla due to the chewiness of pre-frozen and reheated tasting chicken inside of the dilla. The drink is fine- nothing special or great about the flavors. Service was friendly but since it's 6:30 and dead, the waitress is MIA. The music is quite loud, which is expected in a sports bar. But this TV, it's pretty fantastic. It takes up the whole wall. I love this hotel (Marriott waterside) so I don't mind the 2.5 grade food at their sports bar.

After many weeks of anticipation, we finally made it over to the new location for lunch this Saturday. I'm disappointed to say it was not a positive experience. Two stars is generous. One for decor. One because it appears clean. Unfortunately the dining experience itself wasn't even kinda good. 

The people in front of us got the last table, so we landed at the bar. No biggie. Except it became immediately obvious that the bartender wasn't interested in providing service so much as he was interested in just going through the motions. Zero hustle in this guy. Getting anything in a timely manner was like pulling teeth. Nothing was anticipated; I had to request literally everything (straw, app plates, another beer, chips, hot sauce, everything). Didn't help that we witnessed the bartender and other staff taking shots and then continuously sipping on margaritas throughout our meal. 

As bad as the service was, the food was even worse. We ordered the Cardinal Queso to start but were out of chips by the time the queso arrived (it comes without chips). So, we had no way to eat it. The woman who'd brought the queso said she'd be right back with chips. She wasn't. Five full minutes passed before we were able to catch the bartender's attention and get more chips. Wasn't worth the wait. The queso turned out to be thin and watery. Literally so soupy it wouldn't even stick to chips, dripped right off. Gross. 

My husband's "Mission style" burrito was clearly made by somebody who has never been to The Mission. It was undersized, underseasoned and extremely overpriced for what you get, especially considering adding beans and rice costs an extra $5.

I ordered the Migas, but I'm sure what I got wasn't the dish I ordered. What I got seemed to be some of the migas ingredients (eggs and potatoes), but the setup was done as nachos--set atop chips and smothered in an inedible amount of sour cream and guacamole (neither of which is supposed to be on the dish). It was also missing the beans and tortillas the menu said the dish came with. I brought all this up with the bartender, but he expressed he'd never seen the Migas before and didn't really know... yet he didn't make an attempt to figure it out. Needless to say this was not what I'd been expecting, and it was nearly impossible to eat since it was messy and haphazardly atop chips. As we were leaving the bartender apologized for "the debacle that was my migas." What?! He just watched me struggle, didn't offer to make it right, yet had just charged me full price for what he admits was a debacle? Unacceptable. 

Waste of my time and money.

The worst KFC around!! They never get our order right and the manager is so rude!!! The food is good it's KFC but because of the staff and manager and the fact we never get what we order we don't go here any more! Let us know when it's under new management!

They have an awesome happy hour, which includes weekends. Unfortunately, the rolls weren't that great. I ordered a philly, geisha and cuckoos nest and they all seemed bland. The cucumber saketini was good and a great deal at 2 for $6. Probably wouldn't come here again unless I was in the area and really craving sushi.

Beautiful outdoor winery and charming indoors includes a wine cork wall.
A simple but tasty salad and glass of wine for lunch.  Worth checking out!

I love this restaurant! You can catch fish and bring it to the restaurant and they will make it into a meal. They charged us about $15 for 2 people and deep fried the fish and included french fries and cole slaw. They cooked the fish perfectly. They wont clean the fish for you, you have to clean it yourself.
I didn't know that and so I bought them a whole fish, and when I found out they couldn't clean it, I went down to the edge of water  and cleaned the fish, filled it and brought it back to them.
Sitting outside is beautiful here. The location is about as good as it gets. Very under appreciated place. The bartenders and waitrers are great.

The white waitress explained that I couldn't have a side of silken tofu to our table (a table of Japanese / Chinese / Filipino folks) because Chinese and Japanese cuisine "uses them differently."  This explanation left us scratching our heads. a n y w a y s....

This is a fusion restaurant. If you prepare yourself for that and set your expectations it's not bad - we got the peppers, squash, and burmese salad as appetizers. The burmese salad is more of a cole slaw closer to Curtido than a tea leaf salad. I had the Dan Dan noodles, they were very salty and sour and had a strong sesame oil taste - but not much else.
The worst McDonald's in Reno, cold food, stale fries and there shake machine NEVER WORKS ar this one either.

Good food, good costumer service, and nice location!

This spot checks off the things I typically like in a restaurant. The only reason I I don't tend to come here often is because I try to stay within a budget for dinning out and it can be on the pricier side. Outside of the price, this is most definitely a nice spot to go and bring family/friends visiting who want to see what cool food spots we have to offer in Tampa Bay. 

This year I've been here to eat twice. I came for a birthday lunch and enjoyed the charbroiled oysters. These were good! No one has yet to top the charbroiled oysters I had day after day in the Nola, but these were pretty darn good! 

My most recent visit was for an outdoor event hosted by a non-profit and one of the stand-outs on the menu we had was the beer mac & cheese which was the BOMB.com.

Best pizza I have had in Meridian. Went with my family which included several kids. They were very helpful with each kids order very friendly and they have games in the back for both adults and kids. The place is loud. The pizza was great. Very good pricing. Only down size is the salad bar. Small not a lot of selection , but hell I was there for the pizza. The pizza great the kids loved theirs.
