Our server JC was amazing and pleasant he made our visit one to remember. He went out of his way to make us feel special by offering an ice cream treat for our birthday girl daughter who just turned 6. She and all of our family were really appreciative of the gesture and will return because of it. The coffee is always hot and good and the hash browns are golden and cooked to perfection. We frequent the Santa Clara and milpitas Ihop locations and they need major improvements. JC needs to make a trip to the Bay Area to train our local Ihop servers. They are never pleasant and they always seem to have an attitude. We will be back to this Ihop location in the future and we are looking forward to it. Thanks JC

Wow, wow, wow!  I was surprised by how much I loved this place.  Two of my girls and I had the best salads for lunch today - they both had Greek salads and I had the Yia (pronounced 'Yah') which was basically a Greek salad with orzo instead of lettuce.  Soo good!  

The restaurant itself is in an attractive brick building and is bright and airy with lots of windows and huge pictures of Greece which almost made me feel like I was there.  The place was spotless as well.   

The service was great too - the cashier was pleasant and so was the girl wiping down the tables.  The food came out really quick. 

Oh and the prices were right, not overpriced like a lot of the places in Media.  So like I said in the beginning - WOW!  Loved it and cannot wait until my next visit!

The food is actually good but yesterday 10/11 I went there for dinner.  As I was ordering they had a lady with her dog sitting at another table feeding her dog from her plate.  I even saw staff petting it during food service.   I am an animal person but not in a restaurant.   My next letter is to the health department on these people and management.   What are we ?  A 3rd world country?
We ordered to-go and the pizza was great! I don't know that I would dine-in, though. The inside was very basic and pretty dark. Average pricing, although, they do charge extra for dipping sauce.
Food is very good. Service is excellent. Food is reasonably priced. I definitely recommend coming here for casual or family dining.

Great food, super fast service, nice you can get a drink if you want too! I like the Gyro and my wife thought the Wedge salad was great. Very clean, well kept Diner.
Convenient location right off of 676 and close to REI. Definitely will be back again.

Always have the best experience at Stogie Joe's. The stromboli is the best in the city, and world. The mussels are on par with, maybe even better than Monk's; so damn good. And the bartender and staff are always cool as hell. 

It's a cool neighborhood place.

"That's how they do Cappuccinos in Italia."  That is what they say after they charge five bucks for a coffee. It's really too bad that in order to get a decent cup of coffee in New Orleans you have to go to way Up Uptown to Velvet for their almost 5 dollar lattes and over 3 dollar coffees. Velvet is like a 90's sitcom about a coffee shop, except not funny or friendly. Decent and expensive coffee with a pretentious flair to make you feel like you have to over pay just to leave the small store. 

The barista is very kind and sweet. There was an obnoxious man with a large dog sitting in center of the store. He must be an owner because he walked behind the counter with his dog and looked through inventory.  The dog was adorable; the owner was not.  For some reason he takes it upon himself to make one liners at 8:00 in the morning to customers as they wait for their over priced coffee. Too early for some guy from Philadelphia or New York to be talking so loud and obnoxiously, especially at that hour to a customer in the store for their first time.  

Velvet has good coffee and a cute barista. I would have given a 4 star for the quality of their coffee, but the prices and ambience dropped a star each.

HOT DIGGITY DOG!  Well, okay, they specialize in hot dogs, but I didn't get one. Instead, I got a slice of their limited-time LEMON CAKE.  It was actually good and not too sweet.  So, if you're like me and your friends eat pork and beef but you DON'T, just cut to the chase--indulge in dessert! You can thank me later. ;-)

What can I say? This place is awesome. Every dish we ordered was tasty, fresh, and professionally presented.  Loved my arugula salad and the sweet dressing. I had chicken added to this salad. The chicken was grilled but a bit over salted. Otherwise, the dish would've been perfect. We also ordered the salmon (yum!), and the egg on a gluten free bread with gorgeous roasted potatoes. Service was the best!!

They were very busy over lunch, but the food was excellent and service was quick.  Every staff member was friendly & helpful - especially our server Austin.  One member of our party ordered the sirloin. It was tender and perfectly cooked to medium rare.  If you like a little heat, the Spicy Nashville chicken sandwich is a frat choice. The chicken was moist and the pepper sauce had wonderful flavor.

Hate to give 3 stars... but deducted one for price and one for slow service. I've had the vitality bowl twice, it's so delicious! Fills me up without feeling completely stuffed after. The price is a little steep and I wouldn't mind paying that much if the service was a little better. This location is typically understaffed and takes 30+ minutes for an order. Staff is nice and helpful though.

I have been dying to go to Beddia since before it moved. We were able to get a reservation late on a Sunday night. Cute decor. The only wine they serve are natural wines but they also have beer. The arrabiata pizza was the best! Spicy, but you could take off some of the peppers if it was too spicy. We also split a pepperoni and the special pizza, the thanksgiving. The pepperoni was also really good. They were not kidding when they said the thanksgiving tasted like thanksgiving, it had stuffing and cranberry on it. I was not as much a fan of that pizza. Had some interesting salads I did not try. Overall solid pizza place! Not sure it is up tot he hype as one of the best pizza in the US, very good but that is a high standard.

Hibachi, Hibachi, Hibachi!!
Man, a meal and a floor show, how could you possibly go wrong!
Every aspect of this was amazing!
The Scallops are beautiful, and so big!
The fried rice is not too greasy, and cooked there in front of your watchful eye.
I did feel a little on the spot being flung ingredients like a trained seal, but I caught the shrimp and honked my little horn like a good circus performer.
And this is what makes Hibachi so much fun, isn't is.. the crowd participation.
You get a show that you also get to be a part of.
Although a little bit pricy, it is a must do for any important occasion, Weddings, anniversary, Birthday, Bris (Maybe not, shellfish) but you get the point.
Whereas the Little Tokyo in Uptown is my go-to place for Ramen, this place blows the doors off with the "Super-Happy-Fun-Time-Hibachi!"
And that's my take on this joint..
See you there!
B.E.D.

Was never a fan but have been there several times when friends suggested it as a meeting place. Last night was last straw. Flat beer served in warm pint glasses. Horrible food that had to be sent back. Terrible,slow service. Another patron slipped and fell on a wet spot on floor. Banged her head hard but was given almost no attention by staff.  I had to clean up the wet spot on the floor with cocktail napkins after it became clear staff/management wasn't going to do it. Really not much to recommend about this place other than the flatbread which I've had on past visits.

Ordered room service from here, it was convenient. Once we got the food and drinks we opened the food, on my food I ordered there was a very visible dark hair in my food and rather long stretching across the top of my food. They took it back and refunded 25 off of the total  charge....... My friends ate some of theirs and didn't finish they said it tastes horrible. The food was a waste of money and was left in the room barely touched, talked to them the next day and they refunded 25$ more off the check. Very expensive an over priced, horrible quality food. Didn't get to eat my food lost my appetite and Will never eat here ever!!!!!
This place is flat out awful.  Our waitress was just short of being an idiot and half the items on the menu were not available.  I heard they are going out of business, not surprised.

Came in for a Friday night. Ordered southwest chicken bowl, prime dipper and the mega fireball sangria. Might be the sangria talking but for Applebee's, food was good, server was really nice and drink was strong. Will come back of course. This place deserves more stars for the chain that it is!

Very good food, friendly and helpful staff, do not expect a fancy churrascaria, it's a family restaurant, they have a salad and hot food selection or a rodizio, with various cuts of meat, chicken and home made sausage. You'll not be disappointed.
Good food, good service, good price. The bison burger was on point and the fries are always great
The best Indian food In The Lou. Fresh, cooked to order and great service! We had Chicken Tikka Masala, Vegetable Samosas and Naan that melts in your mouth.

My eyeballs just about popped out of my head, Looney Tunes style, when a co-worker informed me MacGenie was going to be just around the corner for the lunch hour. Oh. Boy. I've been wanting to try this truck forever. I couldn't even think straight. I became some sort of mad mac & cheese zombie. Must...have...mac.  Ok, well maybe my reaction wasn't outwardly that dramatic. Needless to say, I bolted out the door at the first opportunity.

What I found when I arrived was a dilemma of epic proportions. MacGenie was joined by Slider Station and Citizen's Hash. Now, my obsessive love with Citizen's Hash and their Korean BBQ tacos is well documented. But, I hadn't tried Slider Station or MacGenie before. I steeled myself. I was on a mac mission and refused to be lured by the Hash's temptress just this once.

I ordered the GenieMac. I was a twinge disappointed they weren't serving the Flaming Dill or Hot Reuben Mac I've heard so much about, but alas that is the nature of the food truck dance. Plus, it's never a bad idea to grab the signature dish when trying out a new restaurant, right? I placed my order and began the wait. I didn't quite have drool on my face, but it was close. I will note here, I was very pleased they had the option to tip when using a credit card. As someone who very rarely has cash, it's nice to note I don't have to do that mad search for a few bucks when they're in the area. The cash only tip thing does pose a bit of a problem for me at other trucks. I was very pleased to see this wouldn't be an issue when at MacGenie in the future.

I received the most beautiful mac & cheese ever. EVER. It was just stunning. It was also just okay mac & cheese. The noodles were done well, there were plenty of toppings. But the overall effect was just underwhelming. There was no "x factor". It was definitely good, solid mac & cheese. It was just not interesting. I'll probably give MacGenie another go. But only if there is something on the menu besides the staples, something with flair.

Great experience absolutely would recommend to others!  The food is very good and like nothing you will have anywhere else. The staff is very welcoming and engaging. Great laid back atmosphere very enjoyable meal. Each course is well described by the server. Our party had both the alcoholic and non-alcoholic drink pairings with dinner, both were equally good. Not the least expensive dinner you will have but will definitely one of the most enjoyable.

Used to love walking across the street to Algustos when I was attending the University of Tampa for inexpensive tacos and beer.  Lots of healthy options on the menu; I love that everything is not smothered in cheese and refried beans.  The hot salsa and homemade guacamole are awesome.  I highly recommend the tortilla soup and the red enchiladas.

The service is a little slow so I would suggest getting your order to go if you are in a rush.
Really great service and really good food. A healthier option compared to everything else around.

First couple times I picked up a couple six packs... 12 packs of beer.  Finally got a chance to sit down a grab something to eat.  I asked the owner what he would recommend under 12 dollars and went through his menu.  I ended up ordering a Gyro and by all mercy god I made a good decision.  Staff seems to be tight and owner obviously cares about his business.  I would highly recommend Pappa's for quick beer, good food and if your with your family not to worry... They have a nice back room to cater towards your needs.  Nice change a pace in compared to the over priced pizza place 2 minutes down the street.

VZW Matt

I came here because one of my fave sushi places nearby was doing take out only and I wanted to dine in. I should have just eaten in my car. The shrimp and vegetable tempura were delicious, however my Nola roll did not taste very fresh. I actually wanted to spit out my very first bite, but refrained. In an attempt to be polite about the situation I told the manager I simply did not like it. She then told me that next time she can not pay for me to not know what I am ordering. Excuse me?! I have been eating sushi since I was in middle school- I know what I am ordering! AND I have been in the restaurant industry for over 15 years- addressing an issue like that was highly unprofessional and needless to say there will not be a next time. Hopefully for the rest of you the food and service will be better in the future.

We were passing through Tuscon and thanks to fellow Yelpers, we decided to try this place. As someone not familiar with the area, I thought we were lost when we followed directions to get here. It's tucked away by the railroad and at night, can seem like it's in the middle of nowhere. 

We were pleasantly surprised by the wide selection of beer and food they had. The industrial decor is really fitting too. 

We ordered:
Chips & Salsa - delicious, very fresh and spicy!
Sonoran Dog - $2.95 might seem suspicious at first but WOW, makes for a great snack and definitely a Tuscon classic. You can even add fries for $1.00!
Barrio Blonde, Barrio Blanco, Raspberry Ale and Rae's IPA (yes we were thirsty!) - all amazing.

The service was attentive and friendly. She knew we were from (way) out of town and recommended some great places to check out.

Overall, I'm glad we gave this place a try to add to our Tuscon experience!

Great biscuits, probably the best in the Uptown area...and the grits were also very tasty...overall this cool breakfast spot on Maple offers live music on the weekends...I am not a fan of the overall menu, seems like many restaurants are trying so desperately to be different...I just enjoy the simple breakfast items (scrambled eggs, biscuits, grits, coffee)....Service may have been understaffed that day, was very busy and we had to request refills of coffee multiple times, order did take some time to get to us...This is a tough industry, but the waitress did work very hard. Overall nice concept, beautiful restaurant, great music and great homemade biscuits

Ridiculously amazing eggs Benedict!!! I can't wait to return. Should have skipped the chopped steak. But, my bust it's a breakfast joint what was I thinking? The fresh squeezed orange juice more than made up for thes steaks' deficiencies

This used to be a favorite of our family but no more! Who staffs a Chinese restaurant with about 4 people on Christmas? The owner was extremely rude and could not care about the customer service that is offered at her restaurant. We had a 6 o'clock reservation and didn't get a waiter until 6:45. We tried to give the whole order to save time and the waiter couldn't handle that and only took the appetizer order. Those came out one at a time and some forgotten. We had to ask for a waiter at least 7 times to get the rest of order, tea, more place settings, etc. Finally, placed our order for dinner and that came 1 at a time for 4 entrees(1 forgotten). To finish the meal at 8 o'clock! At the end we tried to talk to the manager about the experience and she told us to not come back, not I'm sorry, what can we do for you. Who does that? 
It is sad because their food is good but not that good to withstand incompetence!

We made reservations for two on Saturday evening and got seated outside. There was a live jazz trio playing which was a nice surprise. The food was very delicious and flavorful. We ordered the mango lassi, vegetable samosas, paneer makhni, and eggplant koora along with the garlic naan. The paneer makhni was a standout. Excited to come back.

Don't be fooled by the temporary sign and shopping center. 
Delicious food, would highly recommend. I been here about a dozen times now and every dish ordered has been delicious. LOVE the roti appetizer, the mei goreng, ketchup noodles and the thai curry dishes. 
Lucky to live right down the street from here so i can stop in often.

I've never been so disappointed. I've eaten Taco Bus previously and this was disgraceful. After spending over $30 on two meals, we were greeted with a steak taco that included nothing that was advertised. In addition, the steak was chewy, tasteless, and caused all who tried it to become increasingly nauseous. What a sad, sad day Taco Bus. We will not be back.
Good ingredients in the Margherita pizza, but I don't believe their oven was hot as needed (900FH+) on my Sunday night there.  I imagine it must be costly to burn wood all day, but still...

Such a cute little bar! If I lived nearby I think this is the place my friends and I would designate as the official "meet up a couple times a week after work to catch up" spot. 

The atmosphere is relaxed and chill. It's lithe comfort and friendliness of a dive bar without the gross bathrooms and better decor. 

They have great deals on drinks too and a fairly decent menus of foods to choose from. If your local I would highly suggest this place (thought you probably already know all about it).

After my first bite of the Testarossa I think I just realized I'm never getting another sandwich from anywhere else ever again in Rittenhouse. Also the roasted red pepper pesto is simply stupid delicious. Gonna have to think of a way to decide between the pepperoncini aioli & red pepper pesto going forward though. Decisions, decisions! 
Finally, the upstairs sitting area is the real game changer. Clean, cool & quaint. The tables are awesome. Can't wait to come back!

Food was mediocre wife's dinner was cold and she order chicken enchiladas. The bottomless chips weren't bottomless as they only brought us a single tray of chips. At least they comp'd us for my wife's dinner. Won't be eating here again. I use to love chili's but not now

I popped in here to get a surprise nougat gift for a friend and after a short wait, recieved wonderful service and even a complimentary piece of tiramisu to boot! I ended up getting a ricotta chocolate chip cannoli while I was there because I wanted to taste what everyone raves about. Hand filled while I waited, it was delicious but I wasn't blown away as everyone claims. The shell wasn't greasy, the filling wasn't grainy and the chocolate chips added the perfect balance. My friend thoroughly enjoyed his nougat, I can see how this place fills up during the holidays- but I'm not sure I'll be standing in line with them. But I'm sure I'll make my way there again for some treats!

We just had a wonderful brunch buffet at this hidden treasure.  It is almost invisible in a 2 story storefront complex of little shops.  Interior is small but pleasant.  Sunday offers a brunch from 10=2pm with a great variety.  Two kinds of pita, one with a baked crust of zataar (thyme, sumac, sesame mix), boiled eggs, eggs with potatoes and cheese, eggs with zucchini, felafel, tsatsiki (yoghurt, garlic, mint, cuke) sauce, a lemon-garlic sauce, hummus, babaganoush,  labneh (thick, greek-like) yogurt, assorted pickled olives and other veggies plus sliced fresh. We ate out fill and since we were the only 2 customers at 11am, the owner kindly explained dishes, chatted about Jerusalem and sent us home with the makings for the zataar crusted pita.   A pity there were not more customers but we got special treatment.  
Other a la carte dishes included lamb stew, shwarma chicken, grape leaves, Jerusalem and other salads.  Best of East Med so far and reasonably priced.

The service was fine. Every Chili's I've gone to has had awful service and once again there was no one to greet me when I entered the restaurant. The food quality was awful and processed. The "beef" from my nachos was chewy. Yuck... I'll never step foot in another Chili's again.

I had the worst Chicken Cheese Steak or maybe any kind of Cheese Steak I ever had here last night... The Chicken was drier than a piece of cardboard and the Cheese was basically undetectable... Nice People and my Waitress Jourdan couldn't have been any nicer..But she told Me how popular this sandwich was supposed to be so She can hop onto My One Star rating as well... The fact that a place near Philly would even serve Me a POS sandwich like this blows My mind... Save your money and go to Champs down the street in the Woodhaven Shopping Center for a delicious alternative that rivals anything in South Philly
Y'all going to reply to me or make me come to Yelp to ask for my w-2? Also this restaurant always gives their employees checks that bounce and quite frankly have no money :)

We were here with three other couples.  They gave us all rooms next to each other.  The rooms were huge, with each having a separate living area.  There is an enclosed walkway to the casino and free parking.

First let me start by raving about their amazing/friendly service.

The way it works is that you order at the counter and they bring your food for you. There's a cozy area with long tables covered by umbrellas that you can sit at and enjoy your food.

I ordered the beet salad which was out of this world! For my drink, I ordered a grapefruit kombucha, which was also amazing! 

You have to give this place a try when you're on town.

I've been a repeat customer at Brat Haus because their fries are great and they have an awesome beer selection. Crystal (sp?) is a fantastic bartender. Recently, though, I had a negative experience with other employees which prompted me to write this review.

Last week I placed an order online for fries. 15 minutes later I was in the restaurant to let the cashier know that I was there to pick up my order. She rudely told me they had "just" gotten the order so I'd have to wait. Seriously? What's the point of ordering online if it takes them 15 minutes just to check their online orders? 

I then waited for about 15 minutes for my fries to come up. In the meantime, another employee, presumably a manager, told another customer that fries take 10 minutes to make. Cool. I ordered online to save time during my workday, and it still took a total of 30 minutes to get an order that, according to Brat Haus, takes 10 minutes. Also relevant is that the restaurant wasn't busy whatsoever when I got there, so it didn't really make sense.

Here's the kicker: when this (possible) manager rang me up, the total was higher than what I'd agreed to online. I let him know this. Instead of apologizing, he blankly stated that the online menu is wrong and that you can't actually order the small sized fries, as I had done. It seemed that he wasn't going to tell me this unless I asked, he was just going to overcharge me. Nice. I politely told him that they need to update their online ordering system. In an unapologetic tone he said "yeah well there are a lot of things that need to be updated." Uh yeah, like your attitude! 

Probably not going back to Brat Haus. There aren't exactly a lack of places to spend money around here.
Excellent food. Even better bartender, Heather. She made our experience there awesome. Highly recommend going to see her!!

Lloyd is a whiskey bar, and its selection does not disappoint. You can sit at the bar and try various whiskeys neat all night. The bartenders are knowledgeable and always able to recommend something great. If whiskey isn't your style, you can always go with a tasty cocktail, because Lloyd has a great selection of these as well.

If you're planning to drink the night away at Lloyd's, I recommend having some food as well. Get the crispy duck things - in fact, get two orders, because you won't want to stop eating them, and don't even think about sharing with a friend. They're like spicy buffalo wings, but duck, and they are crispy and hot and absolutely delicious. Just writing about them now is making my mouth water.

Lloyd's recently hosted the Burger Club, and provided several delicious burger options. The lamb burger was delicious, tender, and very unique in flavor. They struggled a little with timing despite knowing ahead of time how many people would be coming, but they made up for it with delicious food and extending the happy hour so we could continue imbibing in cocktails and, of course, whiskey.

BEST GREEK FOOD IN TOWN!! I was impressed not only by how quickly my food was made but the customer service is amazing. one of the employees there (Fatima) was exceptional. She helped me order for my first time and recommended the chicken pita, by the time I paid and grabbed my food my mouth was watering by how deliciously it was prepared. I'd call her the da Vinci of pitas if you ask me!! P.S  (There was also a customer who went in with a dog and started to get rowdy because they asked him to leave. He continued to lie and say she was harassing him as I was watching the whole altercation. The customer was way out of line but she handled the situation perfectly) DONT GO INTO RESTAURANTS WITH YOUR DOG IF IT IS NOT A SERVICE ANIMAL.

I've been here years ago at night for dancing and had a great time with the DJ and the bar service.  I recently returned with my husband for a late lunch fix.  I was disappointed they wouldn't let us order to go at the front and we had to walk in.  With the amount of time it took to get any attention, we figured we might as well sit and eat or else we'll end up standing around forever for our order.  We had the baked potato soup and the nachos.  Soup was delicious but it got cold quick and had a lot of cheese in it.  Nachos were a huge plate.  I asked for black beans to replace the chili.  I think they gave what was equivalent to 1 tablespoon of black beans.  Given that my nachos were skimped on so badly with the toppings, I had to knock down the star rating.

The worst place!!! They brought me an ice tea and it smelled like mold. I complained and I asked for just a glass of ice. The ice smelled like mold. So that tells me they never clean it. This place can kill you do not eat there!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

PROS: Well-composed ramen bowls (lots of vegetables and different textures)
CONS: Limited vegetarian selection, no seafood selection

As a well-seasoned noodle soup consumer, it probably takes more than your average bowl of noodle and broth to impress me. I was quite pleased with the flavors of the vegetarian broths at Ramen Bar. The price is a bit ridiculous, though. Also, I wish they had more of a seafood selection. Anyhow, I may return when the winter nights get too cold.
I had the portabella panini and it was delicious. Salad it came with was great too. Friendly service and nice little area to eat outside.

A fine place to grab a Hoegaarden and catch the game on the numerous flat screen TVs. Beers were brought promptly and we were left to our own devices until our pints neared empty at which point our waitress reappeared.

Sorry Kazoku, you have now been replaced... SHOGUN is now my new favorite sushi spot in town for several reasons.  The staff there are probably sick of seeing my face, but I can't help but go a few times a week now!  Why?!

1. They have special half-off deals on at least 5 different rolls EVERY day of the week including weekends, AND at ANY time of the day OR night!   How often does a sushi place offer this kind of deal? NEVER.  Not only that, but their roll sizes are HUGE. I would estimate double the size of any normal roll at any other place.  I will also say, I've never been disappointed by any of their rolls I've selected for that day!  

2. I'm a sashimi lover, and not only are their pieces probably at least 3X the size of any other place, but their fish is seriously FRESH.  

3. Surprisingly, if you have to take leftovers home (which I pretty much do every time), everything is STILL tasty the next day (including the sushi rice and sashimi).
 
4. For non rawfish eaters, they have plenty of options for you too!  Their lunch specials are an AMAZING deal for great quality food and includes a bit of other Asian foods (I.e. Korean, Chinese) on the menu!  I would highly recommend their beef short rib galbi or their salmon teriyaki.  

5. Their dessert options are very inexpensive and a great final touch to your meal!  A friend and I shared their generously portioned green tea icecream (2 scoops, not 1) for $2 only!  Their other dessert options are refreshing and inexpensive as well - mocha icecream and tempura icecream!

Their wait staff are generally nice but do get fairly busy, so you may have to flag them down a few times. But they'll provide you whatever you need.  I've taken so many friends here it's ridiculous!  I should get paid commission.  If you haven't been, come check it out, and hopefully you'll become a fan foh SHO.  

Eat it up!
Service prompt and courteous ..excellent pork chops...

The food was good and the prices were reasonable. I had the Lou Melt and it was very filling. We also tried the vegetarian Rueben, which also wasn't bad but didn't blow us away. They have a good sized vegetarian menu if that's what you're into. The setting is a little odd, upstairs is for quiet study time and the downstairs is for groups. Feels like eating in the basement of an old school.

We come here once a week. We love this spot!! Delicious food, great service and even better deals. I recommend this place to everyone in hopes to recruit more customers for this place. Now my friend and her family come all the way up from south philly just to eat at Yomato.

Went for a lunch buffet. The food tastes fresh and not much spicy. Liked their chicken wings and lamb curry. Most Indian restaurants can not make lamb/goat curry well. Origin of India did a good job. Not many options in the buffet but good enough to fill your stomach. Liked their dessert - specially Roshogolla and malai. Salad is also good but did not like their fruits. Lunch buffet is 14 dollar, I will go there again. Atmosphere is good.

This is a great oit stop for when you're hibhry in a hurry and don't want to spend a lot of money! Honestly it looks like a cheap commercialized place but the food is very good. The customer service is great too

I went in and got the burrito bowl that has a base of Mexican rice with peas and corn, black beans, pico de gallo, grilled chicken (or your meat of choice) and shredded lettuce. I opted out of the cheese but it comes with that too. Served with sour cream and guacamole on the side.  If you're used to Chipotle bowls this one measures out to be Better! The only downside is the salsa, served out of a pump dispenser, it tastes like ketchup.

Great place for tacos, but go for the burrito bowl, and it's only $9!
Breakfast passed. The French fries are too hard because it was the rest of last night. I bite my toothache. It's a waste of my money fries. It won't be bought so early
Came to check out this new place and it has delicious food, cupcakes and beer. Cute atmosphere and Brianna was super helpful!!

This was a great place to dine out! The food was delicious, a lot of their small plates you have to try. I would love to come back to try more of the menu. Although I think some small plates were on the pricier side, they were totally worth it! Service was exceptional and although we didn't have a reservation, the wait was not too long. I would absolutely recommend this place!

Worth the wait!  Kitchen was slammed for holiday brunch... the chefs were hustling but too much volume. 

Decor is very cool - well lit and comfortable. 

Pleasant and courteous staff!

Huevos Rancheros were delicious. Spicy sauce, pico de gallo, eggs and beans on a crunchy tortilla. Seasoned home fries were also strong. 

Only negatives were the food wait and they ran out of Bloody Mary.

Been here a few times for breakfast, dinner, and just dessert and have had excellent food every time. Everything I have had is made with quality ingredients and the food has always seemed incredibly fresh. Highlights that stand out in my mind are all the ways good fruit is used, including in their homemade raspberry jam and all their great fruit pies. Small space but they manage to fit a lot of spaces and tables in-cozy thanks to the decor. Classy place, decent prices.

Hubby and I went to Culvers in Plainfield today - our first time to eat at a Culvers.  We went because of getting a BOGO for a Deluxe Double Cheeseburger (found in the Icon Hendricks County paper).  So glad we went.  The burger beat our usual favorites of Five Guys & Steak & Shake.  At $5 it is cheaper than Five Guys (just as good or maybe little better), but more costly than Steak & Shake (which also includes fries but is no comparison in flavor & size).  In our opinions, Culvers' burger had the best flavor - yummy!  (Can't compare to the other fast food places because we don't eat at those.)  We didn't get fries so we would have room for custard.  We got a Concrete Mixer with Reese's Peanut Butter & Cookie Dough - very good - much better than DQ, plus we got chocolate custard - DQ only has vanilla ice milk.  Might be cheaper than DQ, not sure - about $5 for regular size with 2 mixins - I think DQ is about $7, not sure.  Don't think Culvers' custard beats Frost Bite in Avon though - difference is at Frost Bite the peanut butter cups aren't chopped as fine, which we prefer.  We arrived about 11:30am (Tues) & no wait to order.  We ordered at the counter & our food was brought to our table.  Employees extremely friendly (but not bothersome so) & helpful with us as first-timers.  The restaurant was clean, temp comfortable, plenty of parking.  Drinks are self service - we got water which is free of course - not to be cheap, just that's all we drink.  We definitely have put Culvers on our frequent dine-out spots.

After hearing about there chicken sandwhich we strolled in to give it a shot and we were highly impressed. The chicken is cooked and breaded perfect a long with the spicy sauce its a hit. While we didn't try the donuts we did enjoy the iced coffee. The hype is real the chicken sandwhich is very good simple as that and holds it's own against other local competitors. Definitely will be back again!
Magic, game changing sauces... Ruined any other chances at finding better Mexican. Worth the trip to Santa Barbara if you're a foodie, this place is a must!!

Selection & Price: 4 Out of 5
Sushi and a creme brûlée cost me ~$20 out the door. It was worth the splurge versus gambling on what available in the area. I love the amount of quality products they carry. The only thing is some of the products they sell is on the pricer side where I know I can find of the same things on Amazon. 

Service: 5 Out of 5
Wonderful people from the deli counter, to the cheese guy, and the lady at the check out. 

Environment: 5 Out of 5
Clean, organized, easy to navigate around for my first time being here. 

Overall: 4.5 Out of 5
My inner adult leapt for joy, my inner fat child pleaded to be released, but my wallet held me back. I could be in here for hours. Reminds me of being in Whole Foods, but the local Philly version. Bright lights, friendly employees, and a fantastic selection of organic and local/relatively local goods. Heads up though this place is on the pricer side $$ to $$$.

The service was terrible I told them I needed a table that I could sit too high chairs and they sent us to a booth the service was very slow it took them like 20 minutes to get us our drinks I asked for barbecued chicken I got chunks of chicken that was overcooked with very little barbecue sauce on them

Very disappointed this evening. Apparently they don't know the difference between corn and flour tortillas first of all. Chicken was dry and of the pieces we received we had mostly wings and legs. Disappointing for the price paid. Only edible part of the meal was the Mac and cheese.

Great family restaurant,  good food, awesome pizza,  great homemade blue cheese dressing.  I recommend this place. I just wish they served garlic toast instead of the sesame seed cold bread they serve with meals.

Ok. I'm pretty sure I saw them using generic baby wipes to clean the tables. That one statement should stop a lot of you from going there...

First of all, it explains why there's this weird film on the tables... and why when I moved my napkin across it there were things stuck to it.


But more importantly it tells you two things:
This place is gross.
Nobody really cares.


And that pretty much sums up my experience.

Just don't.

Went here on a Saturday evening with my family and had great service. Even though it doesn't seem like it from the outside, the restaurant is cozy and cute on the inside. Everything was delicious, even the kids' chicken tenders. And the fajita wrap was fantastic! Check this place out for sure!

I have been to the Adobe Cafe several times and I have to say the best part is the pitcher of margarita. On Monday and Tuesday the fiesta dinner is the best deal in town. Don't forget to get a pitcher of margarita.
Nice service, good salsa BUT the 2 things I tried to order they didn't have so 2 stars. Wanted spinach enchiladas and an Amaretto Sour
Came for lunch and was pleasantly surprised.  From onions rings to lettuce wraps to greasy burgers, it's ALL GOOD.

I honestly don't know what to say about this place, our experience wasn't bad, but wasn't great ether. 

We were really exited to eat here because we haven't had Mediterranean food since we moved from LA  and this place has good reviews. 

When my family and I arrived , we were seated right away. Only a few tables occupied.
The place is out dated, dark and has random decor. 

Our server was really nice and helpful, she answered any questions we had about the menu. 
She took our order and left briefly. Came back with a basket of "naan" and torshi. This naan was more of a pita bread. And the "torshi" I swear tasted a lot like a salsa I make at home lmao, But anyways free stuff and something to nibble on while you wait. 
Our food came out on decent time, it looked great. 

I ordered the chicken kabob plate, which comes with rice, and grilled veggies. I'm sorry to say this and hate writing negative reviews, but  I found more flavor in the piece of grilled tomato than the whole plate. 
It was bad, not like disgusting bad, the food was edible, but so extremely bland! That chicken had not been marinated in anything , it had color but no flavor, at all what's so ever. It was somewhat dried and extremely bland. The rice was just as bland, the few pieces of zucchini bland! Disappointed I ate my food, and finished it on the solemn belief we should never waste food.

My son ordered a burger, which was super dry, he's a 10 year old and a burger is a burger to him, so he ate it. 

My bf, got a chicken gyro, which was actually good. unfortunately made him sick, right after he finished it. Go figure. 

Prior to getting our food, our server told my son,he could get free ice cream if he drew a picture on his paper plate mat, and she handed him crayons. (Like I said ,she was sweet) 

His ice cream came, as promised. 
It was saffron pistachio ice cream , with a bit of Rose water I recall.  Now that was tasty, if you like "perfumy" stuff you'll like this! 

These flavors are something I'm familiar with, and this place just didn't have them. Food is a little pricy for what is being put out. And I don't understand all the good reviews. Bottom line I give them 3 stars. Our server was nice, the ice cream and gyro were good, bathrooms are clean, however that's not enough for my family and I to return.

In my line of work I spend a great deal of time going to conferences all over the United States. I have had the opportunity to experience a number of schmancy hotels but this Ritz Carlton is by far my favorite.

If you were looking for a great place to host conferences, etc. The Ritz Carlton will work with you to help make the experience affordable and memorable. From the menus, to the venues. From the courtyard to the ballrooms. Everything is perfection.

I think what I find most humorous in having worked with this hotel on conference business is that my conference attendees commented most often about how much they loved the gardenia candle in the lobby. I have to admit, though. It is a pretty damn awesome candle.

In the conference managers at the hotel are top notch! I can't say enough about how great they are! I only wish I could host every conference here.

Visited here on Oct 17 but to my surprise- it didn't have a yelp page set up so I submitted it as a restaurant...The steamed soup buns were excellent, as good as the ones I ate in Asia - the tripe with chili sauce was also excellent with Szechuan peppercorns gave that numbing sensation- the stir fried kidney as good.

New restaurant so will have growing pains but their chefs are top notch - hope they don't lose them

If you are going for real deal Mexican this is the hub of all things great! I highly recommend this place, they have yet to disappoint! Everything from tacos to burritos to fajitas will rock your socks! The hot sauce that comes with the tacos are the best!

Went for raw oysters. Ordered alligator po boy, Creole pasta, for drink ordered local Amber beer and something (forgot) sunrise. Drinks were good. Presentation of cocktail was good. Raw oysters were fresh and very delicious. However Po boy and pasta dishes were disappointing. It was definitely NOT worth of paying $17 for each dish. Atmosphere was good although we were there little later than actual supper time so business was slow. Waiter seems to be forgetful for slow night

Great beer list, and there seems to always be a table. However, the food is often mediocre (of maybe half a dozen burgers I've had here, only one has truly been medium-rare, which I always ask for). They also seem to be working out the kinks with service--there can be very long waits outside, or at the hostess stand. I had a very attentive waiter there last time I went, hopefully this is an indication things are moving in the right direction...

I discovered this downtown dumpling place due to Downtown Dining Week and wow, I had no idea what to expect but I am a complete fan. I'd give it 6 stars if I could. Their specialty is the soup-filled dumplings that are exactly what they sound like: little dumplings filled with a bit of meat and a burst of delicious warm pork broth. 

The regular pork soup dumplings are smaller and easy to pop in your mouth, but the pan-fried pork or shrimp and pork dumplings are larger so it's a bit more challenging to figure out how to eat these without getting soup all over you! (Maybe those of you with bigger mouths can eat them in one, but I sure can't.) In terms of flavour I personally prefer the pork and shrimp, because I'm a big shrimp fan, but they're all delicious.

In addition to their soup dumplings, they do the sandwich style bao buns: a sweet steamed bun filled with fried chicken, or fried tofu, or pork - all these are delicious also, but probably similar bao can be obtained in other places in Edmonton (such as 99St Kanto) whereas as far as I know, the soup dumplings are a specialty that only BaoBao makes like this. Their spicy wontons were pretty delicious too. Basically, I've been going here at least once a week since discovering it ... so if you haven't tried this place out yet, please do!

One caution: due to popularity, their soup dumplings do sell out. So, safer to stop by for lunch if you absolutely must try them, or call to check in advance.

Got a small pizza and a fry and only coast me 10 bucks I thought that was a good deal, the pizza was very good a nice thin crust and crispy thin crust. Wry convenient little spot in center city I'll be coming back for sure and suggest it to anyone whose in this area for a quick bite to eat
Went on a Saturday night and they were sold out of circles so I got a square. It took a little over an hour but was well worth the wait.
Its very clean inside, and has a good staff. It's a nice place to eat in also.

I love the open atmosphere of this bar. It's large and open and allows for people to mingle, dance and relax with good beer and tasty apps. The music level is good in order to still hear each other, but loud enough to get your dance on if desired. We went with a Tampa Bay Club Sport event and partook in a keg of beer as part of the ticket package. It was great to be a part of the festivities and head over to the Tropicana for the baseball game that evening following happy hour. I also love that this place is at the end of the southern Pinellas bike trail. It's a good break point in a ride.

Its not the best place to eat in the area.
I tryed the shawarma chicken it was pretty nice but very small plate.
I tryed also the spicy wings with cheesestake, well the cheesetake is a real shame absolutely not the true flavor.
As for the wings I liked them pretty much but I was surprised that the guy asked me if you want the halal one or the normal one which made me suspicious about the food if they do halal things and "normal thing " in the same dishes so I will not try it again

This location is new and it painstakingly showed during my family's visit. Some of our party arrived before the rest, so we ordered some appetizers during the wait. Too bad they didn't even come out til much after the rest of my family arrived. In fact, we had to remind our server that we placed an order in the first place. The sad part is that our server made an excuse and blamed it on the new chef. I think that's so unprofessional! You're a team! Don't point fingers! Isn't it also part of her responsibility to check that we got our apps? I've never worked at a restaurant, so maybe my thinking is flawed, but that just didn't look good in my eyes.

The service didn't improve much after that. They were still slow in getting out the entrees and sushi. Hibachi chef came out quickly, but I was not happy with my shrimp. It was too wet to be coming off the grill. The sushi was better, but still not great.

The Koizi in Tampa is much better, and I hope this Brandon location can make the moves to get it up to par.

The meal at Adolfo 's was the biggest disappointment of our visit to New Orleans.    The wine choices were limited.   The presentation of the food was not at all appetizing but I can look past that if the food is delicious.    The crab canneloni was soggy and bready. The hose salad consisted of iceberg lettuce and a few leaves of greens that were old.   The entire salad was swimming in dressing.   The sauce on the pasta was watery and the pasta was overcooked.   We had heard that the ocean sauce was amazing but it was not.     It was runny and sloppy and, I hate to say this, looked a little like vomit on the plate.    My husband ordered his steak medium rare and it was brown throughout.   I had veal and it was overly breaded and not at all tender.   There are so many wonderful restaurants in NOLA.   We had great meals every day except for the meal at Adolfo 's.

Great place to eat, friendly service, food is well cooked. Garlic naan was delicious. I have tried quite a few Indian restaurants throughout my travels and would list this place as one of my top choices
Nice casual fun atmosphere.  Limited menu with 90%seafood. Fried green tomatoes where good (a bit hard) the fried catfish and shrimp were great.  Service was good as well.

First time made a good impression. Great selection with lots of healthy options. Lucas did a great job of explaining the menu and answering our questions. Both he and Ian went above and beyond our expectations. Veggies, chips and hummus appetizer was great. We both had variations of chicken entrees, mine was stir fry chicken with broccoli and other veggies. The spaghetti squash paired well with it.  Wifey had boom-boom chicken with just the right amount of slight spiciness. Gluten free chocolate cupcake split between us was just right. Wonderful.

Simply fantastic. Went on a Thursday and everyone in my party had something different and everyone was thrilled with their meals. I personally had shrimp and grits and could have cried over how good it was. Paula was our waitress and she was AMAZING!

Having lived in the Middle East, I am fussy about finding good middle Eastern food, but these guys were great. Excellent food.  I went with 2 friends and we shared saffron rice, tabouleh, Babaganoush, cucumber salad, humus and hot pita bread. They ordered kebabs.  We were stuffed afterwards, everything was perfectly seasoned, cooked, spiced, roasted, etc.  Boise is lucky to have this place!

Amazing amazing amazing!! Who knew you could find this good a lobster roll in the Midwest!!! It was the star of the show. Port Royal (rum/pineapple) was splendid and the chowder had just the right spice! A+++! Love you guys!

I ordered the Cuban sandwich combo and was highly dissatisfied. The Cuban sandwich had one slice of ham folded and barely a slice of cheese along other things it didn't have as you can tell in the picture. Service was rude. Will not be going again.

I was pleasantly surprised when I walked in to Laketown Harbor.  For those of you who had the "experience" of visiting the previous restaurant at this location, Laketown Harbor did a fantastic job of remodeling the building.

Lakeview Harbor in Lakeview is one of my favorite casual dining spots, and now Lakeview comes to Kenner.

The staff were very pleasant, and the menu offers a wide variety of choices from salads to their signature burgers.

We both ordered the burgers and baked potatoes.  Very consistent with the sister location in Lakeview.  The prices are reasonable, and it is casual, so whether coming from a playground soccer game, or just want to meet some friends for a beer and burger, it's the place to go in Kenner.

Definitely will visit again soon to try some other items on the menu.

Kudos to Laketown Harbor, and wish you much success in the "Kenna bra"!

I saw this place on HOT NEW BUSINESSES on yelp and I was compelled to go!! The place was decorated very well with soft colors and stainless steal fixtures...I came for the famous smoothie but could not get it due the smoothie having bananas, which I am deadly allergic too...So my girlfriend got the smoothie and enjoyed it so much...that is good enough for me to rate this place a 4...I loved the electronic ordering system...the salads were fresh and made right there to order...the only reason this place does not get a five was because the noodle dishes were made with frozen noodles...I am huge natural person and I try not to eat too many frozen things due to preservatives and salt content..my friends laugh at me cause I have absolutely no canned food in my house...I expect the same things from a natural restaurant!!!

I really love when the truck comes on the BSU campus. The food is great but recently the proportions and service hasn't been the best with the new people I've seen on the truck. I usually have them Substitute the rice with noodles and recently it seems as though I've gotten half the amount I usually get with Rhonda or the other girls that would previously work the truck. It's just a little disappointing considering I pay $10-13 a bowl and come every Wednesday. Probably won't be coming again.

So this place is located on the Grounds for Sculpture- you are able to access it walking from the park or you can drive to the entrance of the restaurant from the service road on the left side of the welcome center. 

Check website for times but it did stay open past 6pm ( weekday) in which the welcome center etc closes. 

You can sit outside on the patio marveling at the beautiful pond/garden that resembles Monet's actual house and garden in Giverny, France. It's f'ing gorgeous!!!!  ( view is 5 stars) 

You can also sit inside ( AC during the summer is refreshing lol). There is a dining area and a bar room. Decor is romantic and old fashioned. 

Happy hour is 4-7pm which was when I strolled in and I must say it was pretty crowded for a weekday.  Tried a cocktail (watermelon Sangria) which wasn't that great I must admit but it had rosé and I'm not that fond of it - but I was so parched that I was willing to down anything with ice in it lol.  I should have tried wine because I tried a cheese plate Appetizer ( which I loved). You could chose from 3 cheeses and I opted for the blue ( yum) - came with nuts and cherry liquid jam. Bread and herb butter (shallot) was served with it 

Staff was super friendly and helpful

I would like to return to have a full meal so stay tuned for that :) 

Cheers darlings 
Xoxo

These folks have been in business for over 50 years so they must be doing something right.
    Our server was Jamie and she is a jewel with a nice smile and lots of moxy. Jamie has been here 20 years but she must have started when she was10. 
   The ground beef comes from a high quality purveyor.
We took advantage of the Yelp deal and saved $10.
    The Hot Rod Sourdough burger was yummy with bacon and jack cheese. The shoe string fries were crispy.
    The regular burger was also tasty done medium.
Drinks and sundaes were included with the Yelp deal for free.
The Heath bar ice cream with hot fudge, whipped cream and chopped almonds disappeared. The banana split was too much for this cowboy so
I took a Roadie split to go.
 This is a great old school soda fountain shop with a great kitchen.

Sushi Land is the best sushi on the Mainline, hands down!  The prices and neon "Sushi Land" sign suggest this spot would be a dive but it is a total home-run.  Great unique special rolls are amazing - I recommend the French Kiss, Honeymoon, Dynamite, and Pink Lady.  Service is quick and friendly with a casual, BYOB atmosphere.  Sushi Land is a once a week staple in my restaurant line up!!!!
Super good food with reasonable price. We went in for the first time as we were waiting for our transportation outside, totally impressed by the food so we went for a second time the very next day.

Alright,  this is on the same level as the Green eggs cafe in Philly.  This bistro knows how the make fish sandwiches,  burgers, and pancakes very well.  Their cream chip beef is also something to jump about.   The mushroom burger is topped with boursin cheese.   If you haven't had that type of cheese before,  shame on you...  I also had a grouper sandwich here.....good night!  That's what brought me back.... nuff said...
Barely any meat on the sandwiches.spouts market has a deli that has better meat and more on the sandwiches and for a lot cheaper.
Everything we ordered had a wonderful homemade flavor, spiced just right. Service ve was excellent and the atmosphere was very relaxing and quiet. Perfect!
Best miso soup ever! Always tastes great, but recommend taking your food to go as the actual restaurant is very cramped.

Order to go here....turns out I had to go get it myself because they left me in the parking lot hungry as hell..horrible fucking place!


Ps Applebee's get ride of the prison trays you serve our "food" on!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Friendly customer service and amazing Cuban!! Huge potions! Rough exterior but great place!!
The best pizza in town hands down and it's the only pizza place I eat from . Excellent food. Excellent customer service.

Monks cafe is always a treat on any given day in Philadelphia.  Well known for their Belgian style mussels that are always wonderful.  I prefer to hit this upscale "divey atmosphere" for lunch because dinnertime it is a zoo!  Always a wait and incredibly noisy.  Great for business!  Not great for a relaxed meal with a pal.  And one cannot talk about Monks without mentioning their stellar beer selection.  You want mouth watering Belgian brew this is the place for you!

I stumbled upon this restaurant by accident when I thought I was at Oceana but luckily everything was delicious! The service was good, the interior was classy, cozy, and loud. Now onto the food:

Shrimp and grits - The sauce is so thick that you can see cracks in it. It was creamy to perfection and was the same consistency as clam chowder. It tasted like a hybrid of chowder and thousand island dressing. There aren't that much grits. 

The creole trio was good. The sausage was delicious and I enjoyed the jambalaya. 

I prefer raw oysters and of course, being in Louisiana, all of the oysters are plump and delicious. The charbroiled oysters were alright but that's because I prefer them raw. The horseradish sauce added a nice kick to the cocktail sauce.

This is the BEST food truck in the city and one of the best places to get Korean food! Everytime I order from them the food comes out hot and perfect. 

The portions are a perfect size, you get a small salad and gyoza with your food. The owners are very friendly. If I had to say something negative it is that they are hard to find them. They need a store front for sure. If you are looking for fast delicious Korean food then look no further!

The World Cafe Live is conveniently located near UPenn and Drexel Univ campus. Parking is conveniently located either under the overpass at 31st Street- near ice rink lower entrance or near the LSRM Engineering UPenn bldg on Walnut Street just past World Cafe Live. It shares its stage with the WXPN radio station which usually broadcasts all the live events on NPR's music show of the same name. Many artists passes through here so you are bound to find something that you will like. There is upstairs and downstairs as well. I have been told that the downstairs stage is bigger and nicer. I visited the upstairs and it's more of a dining area with a small stage at the front. Sondre Lerche just played last weekend for his birthday (Sept 5). It was pretty cool with his casual monologues thrown into his performance. Very cool atmosphere. If you want to save money on tickets than purchase ahead of time at the box office to avoid the service fee. Also, pick up the calendar postcards which lists the latest news on artists visiting World Cafe Live. If you choose standing room, be sure to take note most performances last almost 3 hours. If you want to sit down, then you will get a table and have to spend minimum $10 for food/drinks. So, it's a compromise and probably better to get the dining experience which looks posh. However, I opted with the standing room to save a little money and found it to be better although difficult to feel my legs afterwards. I was able to get some great photos and you can tell from my photo album. Staff is friendly and helpful. Just be sure to get there early if you have standing room to get a close spot near the stage. I really enjoyed it and the fans helped out too with the sing-along from Sondre Lerche. Overall, you will like this intimate setting opposed to the huge Wachovia Center which Coldplay looked tiny on the stage with my seats. But, then again I got my tickets for free from listening to radio 104.5 for the contest.
Great breakfast food and service from Molly. Pancakes were Fantastic & substitutions were much appreciated. The omelettes were cooked perfectly and had great flavor. Will return soon! Thanks Molly!
Great place for a sandwich. I've been there many times I am always happy. Several nice juices to choose from and awesome coffee. This place gets busy so be prepared to wait during rush hour.

They need work here. The last couple times I have waited 45+ minutes for a couple of sandwiches and soup. I was told there were five orders ahead of me and they were "slammed" it wasn't even lunch time.  I think the staff needs training or people that work a little harder. Avoid this location.

We have ordered take out twice in the past month. Both orders  more than met our expectations. I have ordered the turkey club twice. It Is made with freshly sliced turkey, bacon and the usual lettuce and tomato. Tastes fresh and is more than what one person can eat. My daughter had the grilled cheese with bacon and loved it, my husband enjoys their burgers. My mother ordered a cheese steak and not only enjoyed it but found the portion to be large. We will probably order again tonight! The staff is very professional and the restaurant is always clean when I visit. Definitely worth the trip!

I realize when I type this that this is Checkers I am talking about, what do I expect. However, this is the worst Checkers (Rallys when I lived in the midwest) I have ever been to. I will never be back. There is so much wrong with this place I don't know where to begin. Food is typical of Checkers, however, their service is the pits. They take forever, you have to order from behind bullet proof glass, they don't even understand their menu and have overcharged me. They have forgotten items, and they are rude. I once stood there for about three minutes before they even acknowledged my existence. Terrible. I will never go back. Avoid this place.

Horrible service. Their break time is 3pm and I told them over the phone that I would be there by 2:20pm. I was already on my way there and the owner called me five minutes before I get there and told me not to come because they are already cleaning the tables and starting their break earlier.

First time eating Portillo's was in Chicago and we fell in love with their hot dogs and chocolate cake. During our vacations we always made a stop at Portillo's to eat Now that we have a second home in Tampa we discovered this Portillos and it is an exact replica! We are so excited. The food is amazing and you just have to get them Hot Dogs here.

The best for po-boys. Reasonably priced and delicious. They also have a huge selection. Never wait more than ten minutes for your food. The only downfall is that the line is usually pretty long and it's difficult to park because the lot is always full. I think that means it's good though, right?

Had been a great admirer of the Village until after their expansion and rehab. Several months ago I went,and took friends, was charged $12 for pitchers of Bud Light. Come on guys even at the crappiest bars I can get Bud Light on draft for 5 or 6 bucks cheaper! The customers shouldn't have to pay for the greed of the owner because they decide to expand. Food is okay but not great. Service could have been better. I won't be back and have crossed it off of one of my go to bars. Good Luck.

A friend recommended this place and honestly it wasn't too bad. I love Caribbean food cause I'm Dominican but I was surprise the inside was more nicer and elegant than a normal mom and pops restaurant. The server/service was amazing and he was very attentive. As for the food, it was just average. I ordered jerk chicken and it was too spicy for me (if you like jerk and spicy you'd prolly enjoy it more but I can't do too too spicy) everything else was pretty good.. and the portion sizes were big. The server did say the Mac and cheese was bussin' (he actually said it's "next level") and my bf ordered it, however... it was not indeed "next level". Kind of disappointed. It's worth a try but not to die for. I would go again but i would prob order something else like the oxtail (that gravy WAS indeed bussin lol)
The food was fantastic, & the service & conversation we got from the 3 bartenders Ricky, Leah, & Danny was even better!
Went there with our hockey team so you can imagine 16 players and families decending upon a pizza place. Very accommodating, efficient with the orders and the food was good. Recommended.
Yup thus is the place, lomo de res and saudero all day...I sometimes just get the meat by the pound...used to live in Dallas and been looking for true tacos...no ground beef here!  Yum

Dropped in here on a Saturday and was pleasantly suprised. The building is nice with large windows overlooking JFK street and Comcast. The bartender was really friendly and knowledgeable and made the whole experience great. He mentioned that they have a great happy hour , $4 all drafts and $5 cocktails .
We tried the Moscow mule and the gin apple blossom and both were strong and well balanced. We also shared the burger sliders and they were really good though the bun to burger ratio was off. The fries were amazing.

Overall we would come back during a football Sunday or for some quick food . A nice addition to the area and I appreciate that they're open on the weeekends.

Not open. Not sure if permanently. But today Saturday, at 10:42am it should be open. 
Done with trying to guess their schedule, the Union st. And the Market St. location.
This place is EVERYTHING!  Omg the pork banh MI is rolling!  Full of meat, full of flavor!
We loved all the food that we ordered. Appetizers, entrees, and desserts! Service could have been much better.

If you like barbecued meat and sauce, this is the place to come.  I got the pulled pork and a side of collard greens and a side of cold slaw.  All cooked to perfection.  All nicely seasoned, but not overpowered with seasonings.  They brought several flavors of barbecue sauce to the table and I was able to sample them on my pulled pork.  Service was very good, waiters pleasant and efficient.  Price was very reasonable.  I paid $15.00 for the pulled pork and 2 sides.  I highly recommend the restaurant.

We figured this would be the best place to take 5 children after being at a water park. Wrong. Location was fine but not much else. They were pretty busy which is to be expected on a Saturday night. With that being said, I would think they would have a better understanding of keeping food stocked since it is so busy. Nope. Didn't happen. Plus, no one was staying on top of the food stations and making sure they were cleaned. Every plate and silverware I picked up was dirty. It was a waste of time and money but at least the kids ate.

We have been here several times and have not had a bad experience yet. 

It is a perfect place to go to for dinner if you are going to Keswick theater. However be warned, that there will be a lot of people there at those times. 

It has everything i look for in a restaurant.
1. The service staff is very attentive.
2. It is BYOB
3. The prices are very reasonable and the portions are so big that we usually end up taking more home then we end up eating there.


I recommend the Octopus, the cold Combination platter which has babagonous, and hummus, and the Pikelia, which is a combination of different meats. 

I have also had the whole striped bass and it was fantastic.

This was my first time here. Everything at the restaurant was awesome. They food was great even the presentation of the food was awesome. The ambiance of the restaurant was 10 stars if allowed. I really enjoyed the food and the restaurant. Weill be returning there soon...Cauliflower Katsu Sandwich awesome and filling.

Best Cajun around.  Poboys are much better than Ricky Ps.  The Cajun has a slight Asian twist,  but it's authentic with a lake Charles type spin.  Hope this place stays around,  a true unique place that isn't geared as a tourist trap.

This used to be a good place but it's gone downhill. You have to ask for fries specifically now, and it took us about 3 times to ask until we got them, and they came after our food. The utensils and cups were all dirty. The manager was walking around asking about the service so we told her and they didn't do anything about it. Really? Why even ask? The burger tastes like mcdonalds $1 menu, and that's pathetic because it's $11. People near us that came after us got the same exact food and same amount of people had their food come out way before us. Don't see myself ever coming back.

We've been coming to Frog for years now and the service has always been great. Lindsey took care of us most recently and she was exceptional!! She is by far the best server we have ever had! I never write reviews on yelp, but I felt compelled to after she took care of us so well. She deserves a raise!

ABSOLUTELY THE BEST TACOS!!!! My family and I tried each kind of taco they have. We each our favorites but since I am the writing the review, my favorite was the shredded beef taco. Seriously all of the them were delicious,  flour tortillas were perfect,  perfect size, good amount of meet on each taco. Service was good, smooth and fast. We definitely will be back! The guys behind the counter are very friendly too. Great job guys!!!

First time there, and we had Carly as our server.  I managed restaurants for years, and I was EXTREMELY picky about my servers.  Carly was fantastic, and I would have poached her in a heartbeat if I were still in business.  And the food was absolutely fantastic.  Get the tomato and zucchini tower.  It sounds meh, bit it was delicious!  Next time we're in town, we're definitely coming back!

Junction can be whatever you want or need it to be. It's a neighborhood bar where you can try a ton of great beers. It's a quick spot to grab a no-fuss burger. It can be a restaurant destination for grabbing a table, ordering one of their specialty burgers, and making a dining experience of it. (NOTE: it is 21+ to enter)

All orders are placed at the bar. The barkeep characters range from the super friendly to the harmless but standoff-ish. In the recent past it often seemed like they were understaffed at the bar, which made for longer service times especially with a crowd. I am pleased to report that they seem to have taken care of this recently. 

The burgers are creative. My favorite one was rotated off the menu, but they still made it for me when I asked. The fries are only $1 more so definitely worth it. The fried pickles are worth the splurge for a pretty huge serving size. 

Flipping through their deck of beers provides lots of entertainment while also showcasing their amazing beer selection with lots of local flavors. The backyard is a best-kept secret of outdoor seating in the area... picnic tables, nothing fancy, but clean and pleasant. There's no guessing what the juke box will be playing. It seems to have an eclectic selection. And same with the TV's although you can be sure to catch football games. And some nights they do movie screenings. 

And for those of us who often crave frozen Irish coffees, but can't necessarily trek into our favorite Irish pubs in the FQ, Junction's got you covered.

My first experience with this restaurant was a complete disappointment. We arrived early for our reservation, and decided to have a seat in the bar area. The bartender was having a lively conversation with a few people seated at the bar and completely ignored us. There was a server who also joined a conversation, completely ignoring us as well. We decided to go outside and partake of the view, which was spectacular. A few minutes later the receptionist came to ask us inside to take our table. Seated next to us was a large group of very loud customers, partaking of many bottles of wine. Our server also was responsible for their table. He devoted most of his time to them, took our order, brought the food, did not return to ask us if it was acceptable. I have to say for the price of the entrées, I cannot recommend this restaurant. As for the service, it speaks for itself.

This restaurant is beautiful and comfortable, as equally cozy on a January day as it is cool and clean in the sweltering middle of July. On a recent quiet Wednesday winter lunch I ordered El Desayuno, a very unique plate of seasoned and smoky saucy chicken with egg and avocado, all mixed up with thick corn chips. It was delicious for the first 75% of eating it, but then I found myself looking for something to make it a little brighter and zippier (some verde salsa or something of that nature). That being said, I would happily eat it again for its smoky crunch.  
My husband had the breakfast sammie, and said it was "good". Food reviews are not his forte. He also liked the flavor the green skhug sauce brought to the sandwich, and I even borrowed some to try in my dish.  My pour over coffee was a nice addition. 
We are already looking forward to our return! This menu has many appetizing choices to pick from.
The redfish Ponchatrain is spectacular, as is the crab cakes. Its a cool oasis off Bourbon Street.

Nice little gem on Wells ave. I stopped by their food truck version that sits next to a house for convenient dining. Although I took mine to go. All my tacos came with hand made tortilla and that made the difference  between a regular taco and an awesome taco. I went with yummy Lengua, cabeza and a regional cochinita. All were delicious and I would recommend even in this cold weather.

Every time I am in Reno, I have Pegs.  This is my go-to breakfast place. I recommend the corned beef hash and eggs, the huevos, and the sierra omelette. Be prepared for huge portions- you wont leave hungry! I crave Pegs when I am not in Reno. Seriously, try this place. I promise you that you will leave happy. There is the strongly possibility that you will need to wait for a table, but if you arrive early enough, they will seat you immediately.
I eat their enchiladas verde, 3-4 times a week.  My butt hole wishes I was exaggerating.  By far my favorite spot in the city.

Don't bother and come back, we make a reservation and we have to wait 45 minutes with the reservation 
Then I hate those places with too much people and their are not ready to handle it.
Cold Food, and poor services

One can never go wrong with Dune! My personal faves are their Iced Tres Leches and Iced Vanilla Latte, both with oat milk. Since quarantine started, their Zap Zippers have been a life saver! My order is always ready for pick up with a fun little note by the baristas who prepare them so well every time!

Once again, another place in Tucson that is always crowded, but was not a good choice to eat. The 1/2 rack of ribs for $19 were chewy, tough and just were not fun to eat. The baked potato had a weird nacho cheese sauce involved and the order of nachos was lacking ingredients besides chips and cheese. Their famous salad bar was kind of overmatched and not that impressive either. Tucson folks really will eat anywhere, bad or good, so if you see a line, do yourself a favor and don't wait for a table. Also, annoying that they call out people on the menu who like well done steak. Hire better cooks and give people what they want. What a dump.

Danny gave us excellent service and the food was beyond yummy!  I had the ribeye with mixed mushrooms- cooked perfectly. I had the polenta cake (amazing!) instead of mashed and grilled/steamed (?) vegetables that were wonderful.  My husband had the mahi special and said it was the best fish he's had in a long time - it was a huge fish steak, also cooked to a flaky perfection. I suggest starting with the caprese, the tomatoes are grilled so it's served warm for a change, with quality mozzarella, olive oil, balsamic and pesto - so good!!!

We stayed here for the Halestorm Concert.  
The Hotel Room:
check in was easy (we booked thru Expedia), access to the rooms from the parking garage was easy, elevators clean and smooth.  The room was sufficient for what we wanted/needed.  Problems with room:  holes in sheets, stains on sheets, TV remote did not work for the services menu, and the bath tub grab bar was rusted off and swinging free. Otherwise it was clean and spacious.
  
Spa:
The spa area was VERY BASIC, but it was clean.  No robe or flip-flops offered at check in (you could purchase a robe for $89, but not any flip-flops), no tour - left to figure it all out on your own.  

The locker area was very small and the lockers are made for miniature people.  Barely enough room for your clothes.  Plenty of towels offered, and they were nice and new and fluffy.  The hot tub was pleasant, but hardly any jet output.  More like a hot soak. The steam room was large and well saturated but no eucalyptus infusion.  The wet room (steam and hot tub) is a very small area and no lounge chairs anywhere .  Their "quiet room" had no lounge chairs, just waiting room chairs.  Again, very small, and they only offered lemon water.  Upon entering the shower area there are towels, razors, and shower caps offered.  The showers had body wash shampoo and conditioner.  I found it amusing they offered razors but no shaving cream.  I did not get any body services so I didn't get to see the massage rooms.  The vanity area was not lit at all, and located right next to the lockers.  They offered hand soap and spray deodorant but no lotion.  

Overall, I would say this is more of a gym area that happens to offer hot tub, steam and sauna. Its fine for an after work out kind of place, but not to hang out for 3 or 4 hours to relax.  One thing that was really appreciated: the resort fee covers use of the spa amenities. 2 Thumbs up for that!  It seems more and more the hotels are charging the resort fee but then you have to pay a day use fee for the spa amenities. 

Casino Amenities:
Multiple restaurants offered a wide range of eating options - Mexican, Chinese, American, Surf and turf.  Everything was well marked and easy to navigate.  Bonus - The El Dorado, Circus Circus, and Silver Legacy are all connected.  So it is very easy to travel from one resort to another.  Downside, your players club card only works in the casino you sign up at.  if they are all linked together and run by the same management, one card should work in all casinos.  Also, we've gambled at multiple casinos, and find the Native Casinos have looser slots.  

My Hubby said it perfectly:  This is a Blue Collar get away.  Its fine if you are on a budget, but if looking for something special, look elsewhere.
This place was a great find. The food is super flavorful and service was fast and friendly. Loved the empanadas!

So it's been 55 min sitting here and still have not received food. Tables that arrived well  after us have already eaten and left. Waitress keeps saying 10 more minutes. 
Without a doubt the worst experience ever
Avoid this place like the plague. 
It's awful
We come here with friends for dinner tonight... We had vegi combo and the meat combo... Really good food and we enjoyed it a lot

Stopped here after flying into the Nashville airport. Our service was very pleasant. Ordered the chicken tenders with buffalo flavoring because it came with a side salad. The side salad also included a tasty roll, which was much nicer than croutons. 

Being from the Northwest, I didn't expect the Buffalo chicken to have a very strong hint of honey. Maybe this is a South thing. But it was very distracting from the overall flavor of buffalo. 

They menu is very robust, so if I were to go back, I would definitely go a different route.
Very loud atmosphere, however, has nice vegan sides and pasta dishes available to enjoy a nice meal.

Coming from out of town and attempted to make a reservation several times through email and website but never received a confirmation.  Decided to reserve a table at another restaurant since the Bistro was not responsive.
