Best rooftop bar in Nashville! Especially if the weather is nice. If not, the ambiance inside is perfect as well. Their drinks do not disappoint. If you are in town, you cannot skip this place!

Nice little restaurant tucked away on a veterans. Everything is very fresh and servings are sizable. The Thai Wonton soup was spicy fun. I added this place to my list of quick stops for family take out. Not to say anything about the service, I just easy to get in and out and solve the family dinner dilemma.

Disappointed!!
We now have another son that chose  to go to SLU for college so we get to St. Louis often. We've been to the Rooster several times for Bloody Mary's and Crepes. We went Sunday for a late lunch and were disappointed. The smoked salmon crepe had very little salmon. The sirloin in my crepe was over cooked.

I am so surprised at these poor reviews. I stopped by here the other night- very late- and had great customer service and an absolutely PHENOMENAL pizza!! I loved it so much I just ordered from them again!

This was a great dinner out for us. There were two sushi chefs who were backed up so it took a while, but we didn't mind waiting. Got the Rose and Viva rolls with a few other pieces of sushi. Everything was wonderful and the presentation was gorgeous. 

The Thai Tea was great but it was huge and I made the mistake of drinking most of it while we waited so I was quite full by the time the sushi came. :) I brought home most of it though and it was delicious.

I was coaxed to meet up with High School mate , so I went o Kaminskis . I think it has been over 15 yrs since I came here.It was hole in wall, apparently in cherry Hill it is historic landmark now, they have since added on tent, fire pit outside, extended dining area.Adelphia's wanted to knock it down, build it up-But Cherry Hill didnt allow it. From what my school mate said, bought out by same owners as Adelphia's. No wonder the menu is more impressive & bigger too!! The wraps, burgers, etc were all good. The nachos I got(Yes-it was my cheat day) was enough for 4 people-ridiculous size!!! I got Malibu Bay breeze, the bartender made it spot on!! What!! I had 2 -yeah..you know I'm light weight!!! But it was good to catch up..nice place to meet up. 
Me personally, not real diverse, but then again it is in heart of Cherry Hill, NJ.
Oh well!! All in all, not bad place, just not my personal choice to go here!!
I love it.  My bartender tonight Irish-y and so I pretended it was an Irish pub and he was so happy!  And he put so much rum in my drink!  So I love it.
Great service, food was solid, ordered oxtails, candied yams and cabbage, also fried whiting! Good portions! Definitely will go and try other food here

After a week of po' boys and fried everything, the Green Goddess was a delight. Nice to eat outside on a pleasant pedestrian mall. Cold local beer and inventive local cuisine with plenty of vegetarian options. The service wasn't outstanding, but it was solid, and the food more than made up for it.

This food was inedible. 

Calamari smelled rancid fishy and tasted awful. 

Meatballs and spaghetti were like cardboard and tasteless

I can't imagine how  anyone could write a positive reviews.

Harvest is always fresh and tasty. Their menu is pretty standard American fare, but everything I've tried there has felt very fresh and healthy. It's nice to have a local spot to support in Oro Valley.

I thought this little hidden gem was pretty darn perfect.  Walked in for lunch and there was a bit of a line, but that's okay because it took me forever to decide what to order.  All of the sandwiches and salads are posted on the board up above with descriptions of its contents, however, prices are not listed and that's the ONLY reason for one less star.  Everything else was stellar.  I went with a friend and we each got a grilled sandwich and a Greek salad to split.  The salad was something out of a 5 star restaurant.  Beautiful presentation and dressed perfectly.  My sandwich was the tenderloin and I can't stop dreaming about it - come on, apricot preserves and brie and then grilled!  I don't recall the other sandwich's name but was smoked ham with apple butter and cheddar.  So stinkin' amazing, all of the concoctions' ingredients complemented each other!  The side was a homemade bow-tie pasta salad with a mayo based dressing that was just light enough to not overwhelm, or chips.  All employees were great as well.  Courteous and eager to help, great teamwork!
terrible service！！I have never been to a bad restaurant like Lulu！we sit there for moren than 10 mins， nobody ask us anything to drink. really bad service！

This was such a great experience the best service ever! Its like they were reading my mind. Id want to ask something and they tell me before i can even speak. My water cup was never not full. But the food was amazing cooked/prepped to perfection.

Lots of negative reviews here and I DON'T GET IT! My experience here was INCREDIBLE! 

My wife and I went with some friends on a Saturday afternoon. The server was with us within a minute and never let our drinks run out once. 

The food was also great! I had a double cheese burger with fries and chili, we also shared an appetizer of the popcorn shrimp nachos. Nothing was too greasy and the flavor on everything was top notch. 

What struck us most though, was how CLEAN the diner was. Nothing was sticky, the air didn't smell like fry oil and I felt like if we wanted to, we could eat right off of the tables.

All said, it was the best diner experience I can remember. 

Our experience may have been an anomaly, but I hope not, because I totally intend to go back and try it again.

This place is really not good. My husband and I ate dinner there and he instantly got sick he was puking for an hour. I had the lomein and it was tasteless so I only had a few bites then threw it away, I also had a shrimp roll it to was tasteless. I would recommend not going to this restaurant

I've lived in the FQ for a little over 6 years and one of the places I enjoy periodically is the balcony at Johnny White's Restaurant.  I've spent some pleasant evenings there on the balcony overlooking Bourbon Street.
On Wednesday April 18, 2018, a friend and I decided to have dinner out since it was such a beautiful day.  On the way to the entry I glanced up to be sure a table was available on the balcony.  The gentleman who is always out front working hard to drum up business for the restaurant was hard at work.  We just got ahead of two of his most recent recruits who headed up the stairs just behind us.  After reaching the top of the stairs, it appeared the wait staff was busy.  Thinking I could save some time I asked the "lady" behind the bar if we could sit on the balcony.  She smiled and said someone would be back to seat us.  For some reason, she became a raging smart- -? I decided it best to ignore her.  While waiting considerable time for a table, a lady and her party who had been seated spoke with the bartender asking to cancel her order as they had decided to leave the restaurant.  Shortly after, the couple who came up the stairs right behind me decided they didn't want to stay and left. I decided to wait and finally after a considerable time a young man came to seat me and my friend. There was a nice table I had observed being open at the corner of the balcony and I asked to be seated there. He informed me the table was being held for a larger group (4 max, I believe).  There were no other customers waiting to be seated and he wanted to seat us at a very small 2 person table which was squeezed between other small tables.
Having been irritated by the very rude woman bartender, seeing a seated guest and friends wanting to leave before their order arrived, watching a couple decide they didn't want to stay in that environment and being denied a nice available table I decided I didn't want to give my business or endure that negative environment so my friend and I left.
On previous visits I had a regular waitress who was always so pleasant and helpful.  I hope we still works there and I may return. In the past I always enjoyed my visits to Johnny White's even though the cook did not do the food justice.  Whoever the manager needs to apologize to the hard working man on the street who dutifully sends customers in while the bartender and wait staff send them out before being seated!!  I'll think twice before I return and will monitor reviews here to see if the problem bartender and wait staff are gone or retrained!!!!!!!!
I had some trouble ordering online but I called the store and DK (I believe his name was) helped out and got everything fixed. Greatly appreciated because the pizza & calzone we ordered was amazing!!

The food was fantastic.  The service wasn't so much.  Servers were pleasant and attentive but our food took a long time to get to our table. Our server did apologize for the delay.  So perhaps this is an anomaly or perhaps its relation to Shige restaurant, which has always had crappy service is the reason?

Food was tasty, spicy, can well proportioned.  Actually had no room left for any dessert.  

Black Tea Pork was great.  A bit sweet but not overly so.  Kind of like teriyaki but less sweet and think.  Side of sweet corn which was great.  Not sure what they did to that corn but it was really good. 

Stuffed Pepper Jambalya was nice and spicy.  And the roasted pepper was roasted to perfection.  If you like mild Jambalya that is not overly hot with spices but spiced for flavor this is the dish for you. 

I will give this place another try.  Hopefully the service will improve on my next visit.

I love Panera.  I've enjoyed soups, salads, sandwiches, desserts for just about ever.  My faves are broccoli cheddar soup, asiago roast beef sandwich, turkey artichoke panini, iced green tea, blue cheese steak salad.  In fact, I had surgery last summer and could only eat liquids for 2 weeks after and I ate their soup just about every day.  The You Pick Two option is great.  You gets a lot of food for a decent price.  I usually eat half then take the rest home for later.  Iced green tea here is yummy and refreshing.  Lastly, get their Panera card - it's free and your rewards add up quick!

I liked the three cheese tortellini with chicken I ordered takeout and it was ready when it said it was and had good communication. They let us know they were busy and our food would come later, and gave us a call when it was ready. Although I did not dine in, I'd like to in the future.

Wasn't very happy with this place. We went on happy hour to try some appetizers and to get a drink. Their happy hour menu isn't very big as far as food goes. We tried their boudin balls, pork tacos, and gumbo. Wasn't impressed with any of them. I also ordered a Moscow mule on their happy hour menu and it literally only tasted of ginger beer. Not worth it. I think this is just another tourist trap close to bourbon street. Wouldn't recommend
Love the food, service and especially the mission. I can't wait to eat the Cajun Cobb Salad again.

Great 1st experience. Loved the food and the service. We were here at 6pm on a Saturday. Had the veal parm  & the grouper special. Excellent. Our server was Madie. She was very good. We will reserve 5 stars until our 2nd visit, which will be soon.
Ordered fried catfish and shrimp. It was excellent. Service was friendly and reasonably quick. A very mom and pop place popular with locals. A good choice.

Review #143 - 2019

After our not so good drinks from Bubble Tea Station, I decided to search for another place to grab my drink & we ended up here.

We showed up around 6:30 PM & the place was empty.

The kids weren't actually in the mood for anything so my nephew, the only one who was actually smart enough not to get a drink at Bubble Tea, decided to get a taro smoothie with boba and he said it was good.

I got the only fresh fruit smoothie that's offered here, which is the avocado smoothie, and it was pretty good.  It was pretty bland, but I didn't mind that they don't add any extra sugar to my drink.  I don't need the extra fat any ways.

My son was actually hungry so he ordered a combination fried rice, which they all decided to share & said it was actually really good.  

Unfortunately, the portion is quite small here so I guess we should've ordered another one; but we were planning to have AYCE KBBQ for dinner, I didn't want them to over eat before dinner.

The place is actually cute & clean.  I guess they were in the process of getting ready to clean up for the evening when we showed up since the lady was mopping the front.

We stayed for a good 45 minutes playing Uno & the lady didn't mind us being there that whole time.

Friendly and accommodating service!

Went here with family, had an amazing time.  Started with the chopped salad, perfectly put together.  For dinner had one of the best filet's I've ever cut with a knife.  Sweet potatoes souffle was incredible.  Tasted my mom's lobster, incredible.  It was a beautiful night, I wish they had an outdoors.  Service perfect.
Big fan of double knot, I had high expectations that weren't met. Great atmosphere but food wasn't up to what I was expecting.

Have been here two other times and everything was great. Left a great review and recommendation however, today was not one of those times. Granted the other times were not pick up but that shouldn't affect the food quality. We ordered 1 pound of brisket and a full slab of ribs with onion rings and macaroni and cheese to go. It was ready and hot when we got there (we only lice 2 miles away). The brisket was tender and juicy however had very little smoke in it and lacked a "beef" taste you look for. The ribs Had no discernible smoke flavor and could have been prepared in an oven just as well. In the Mac and cheese the pasta was over cooked and mushy but the onion rings were excellent. While this meal was terribly disappointing we will come back and give it another chance in the event this was a once off possibly due the the current pandemic social situation.

I went to Don Pablo's  at this location in De. I have to say I was totally disappointed with the acceptation  of our Waiter. The  taco cheese sauces were bland and pasty, my beef fajita  had a piece of hair in it, fried ice cream was too battered , the Sopapillla was drench in the butter brandy sauce and  my Kamikazi drink was cloudy and sour. 
 I been to much better location and this one was the worst. This is a Great location but horrible service for a very popular chain restaurant.

I ordered a cappuccino and sourdough toast with cream cheese cucumber and smoked salmon amazing. Only issue I had was the Quality of tables that were not stable. Most of all their outdoor tables would rock 2 inches.....not great when you're trying to enjoy your coffee and cut your toast. Come with some  shims to put on those table legs and enjoy the amazing coffee and food.

A bit pricey for what is essentially a fast food place, but the food is really good, the staff are friendly, the dining room has always been clean when we've gone, and while I think it is pricey, it is still cheaper than some other comparable restaurants (in particular, Super Burrito).
What really pushes this place over the top though is their less traditional dishes (don't get me wrong, their traditional dishes are amazing). My favorite is the Carne Asada Fries. I don't know why it took so long for someone to think of that combination, but I'm glad someone finally did, because they are delicious.

I've been wanting to try Sho Gud out for quite some time now but finally made it today, although it was a late 2:30 lunch. The restaurant is in somewhat of an odd location and if you were whisking south on Armenia often you'd probably miss it. Inside is pretty nice and clean and their trophies are displayed in the window- they are quite proud of them, and should be.

I ordered a pulled pork sandwich with a side and drink. I chose the fries only because there were 2 other people in the restaurant eating them and they caught my eye; I'd usually go for mac n' cheese, baked beans, or greens with my 'Que.

The pulled pork was piled high on the sandwich- they don't short you on meat here. It had a good bit of flavor and was pretty tender. I was fearing I'd get dried out pork at that late in the day. The fries were as good as I hoped, crispy and had a special seasoning on them.

Sho Gud won't take over my spot for Best BBQ in Tampa (a place further north on Armenia holds that), but I would definitely recommend lunch here to anyone.

For the price of the ceviche I think it was very poorly served, it was pretty good but corn got soaked And only one slice of sweet potato. My wife ordered the bistec a lo pobre, beef was very tough and dry, I guess the cook or butcher needs a butchering class, the meat was cut with the grain instead of against it, impossible to cut even with the knife, the portion of beans was very small to the amount of rice. I was not happy with the service, I would have ordered another dish after my ceviche but instead I got the check.

Staff are very nice! They make their own bread and pasta too! I always get the same things! cavitelli pomodoro but I sub Fettuccine. The pasta is great and fresh, the onions add a nice sweetness to it, the panchetta, everything about it is great! The caprease hoagie is amazing and fresh too! They even make their own dressings too! Also the rice balls are to die for! The 1 cashier told me to try it with hot sauce and she gave me a side of it and put the sauce and the hot sauce together and bam! The rice balls are so fresh and flavorful! This is my go to place for fresh made pasta and other goodies!
One of my favorite places to go for food and drink.  A good variety of items on the menu.  The service is fantastic and I love the atmosphere.
We enjoyed dinner on the covered patio. The calamari and tuna were very good. The octopus was the only meh part of the meal.  Our group also enjoyed a few specialty cocktails. Service was also great!
Murray's is a wonderful little deli that fulfills all expectations. Their great service, friendly wait staff, and simple nostalgic aesthetic made my lunch all the better.

The beautiful wife and I forgot that reading is fundamental -- as in, make sure that when you go to a place that when it comes to food 90%+ of the reviews have only mentioned St. Louis style pizza, there's a chance that they DO NOT SERVE ANY OTHER FOOD BESIDES THAT.

How the hell did we miss that fact?

First off, I should remove the "Irish" category and replacing with "Pizza (Crappy)." Shamrock shakes from McDonald's are more Irish than their Hoosier Pizza topped with vile Hoosier Cheese.

Second, to add injury to insult, I wasn't all that thrilled with their pour of Guinness.

Third, well, I'll just stop.

The only redeeming factor this evening (and the second star) is that you can smoke in there. Which we even didn't do despite their being a cigar in our possession.

Maybe on another night under different circumstances (a.k.a. that I'd never be hungry), I'd have a different opinion, but honestly, there are other dark, smoky (or formerly smoky) corner bar that I'd rather cozy up to.

This could be the worst restaurant I've ever been too in my life.  The service was beyond horrible and everything was completely overcooked.  Do yourself a favor and skip this restaurant.

I feel bad for leaving such a negative review during Covid times, but this place should find a new chef and staff ASAP!

Hands down the best pizza joint in New Port Richey!  Authentic, hot and fresh, and delicious. If you dine in you will find great ambience, a clean facility and friendly wait staff. It's worth the drive. Give them a try!

My experience here was okay. We walked in with a party of 7 and were seated in less than 5 minutes. The restuarant itself was spacious and had a great ambiance. The decor was fun and the place as a whole felt very inviting. The service was fairly good. The servers were attentive and accommodating. But the food was just okay. The nutella crepe with strawberries and bananas was fresh but had way too little nutella. It tasted as though they put on as little as possible. Another crepe was ordered: the 4. It was tasted as though it lacked that oomph in flavor, either that or any flavor that was there became entirely consumed by the amount of egg they stuffed in. No matter how great the wait staff were, if the food isn't stellar then the experience as a whole is lacking.
Always love coming here. Great atmosphere and the bartenders are amazing. Check out Whataburro.... The food is amazing. Love coming here on the weekends. Usually on Sundays I come here with my dog.

KEY LIME RUM PUNCH!!!!. I had been wanting to try the Rum House since I had a chance to view their menu. It was FAR better than I could have ever anticipated! Their menu is like no other in the city, the taco menu alone (11 different unique tacos from duck to scallop) is worth the trip. The salads are HUGE and very good, the appetizers are amazing (I LOVE the Sweet Potato Conch Fritters) The drink menu is CRAZY Good! The Key Lime Rum Punch and the Sangria are both so good. Every chance I get I bring friends and family here, I Love It!

This is our go to place (and has been for years and years while visiting Saint Pete Beach!)
The bartenders are phenomenal (as well as the margaritas!) and the food never disappoints! The blackened grouper sandwich as well as the grouper Reuben are phenomenal... But the burger is equally delicious! Love this place!
I had the Chicken Parmesan combo. I was the best I have had in the two years I have lived in TN. Can't wait to go back!!
Amazing chicken and biscuits!  I had the farmer and loved it!  My friend had the squawking goat and said the pepper jelly had the perfect amount of spice.

good food good drinks  and good service
i came with my family and they love it too i will be back agin

I've had two meals at Flatbread in the last two weeks since first trying it and I'm pretty sure that's only going to be more often. I haven't had a bad experience yet. Last time we went to the Meridian location and Austin was our server and he was great. The little patio was great and I especially enjoyed the little water fountain view. I really want to go back for their happy hour soon. I love going to happy hour with my girlfriends! Very impressed with how the sandwiches taste and I can't wait to go and actually try the flatbread. Soon! Very soon!
The food and atmosphere were absolutely amazing.  The wait staff was also great.  I would go back anytime!

It's pretty good pho. My brother and I have been to most of the Vietnamese restaurants in the city. Pho Saigon's price is definitely higher than most of them. But again the food is pretty good I'm not complaining. Will stop by again for lunch.

We came here for a bachelorette dinner and really enjoyed it! They accommodated our large party and the service was great. 

The good was delicious. My favorite were the chilled roasted carrots, cast iron cornbread, and pappardelle bolognese.

We finished with the Hubig's style pies which were absolutely delicious! 

A lovely evening outside on their beautiful courtyard. I also loved that they personalized the menu with the Brides name and congratulatory message.
The food was cold and not good. Will not be back. The tables was not clean. I wipe my own table off. The line was long.

We visited twice today for two different orders, and each visit, they got our orders correct! The food actually tastes great from this store too. The employees seemed very hospitable, and they seemed like they actually care to make your order right! I've visited numerous other locations and have never received food or service as good as I have today at this one. I went out of my way just to come back here for my second order because the service was so good!

The meatball and supreme panini were delicious. The restaurant is very clean, service was fast and friendly, and the food was delicious. I recommend if you are in the area and want a casual lunch or a nice dinner. The menu had options from salads and paninis to nice Italian and Spanish dishes. Made to order, delicious and fresh!
Never disappoints!! Food was amazing, service was great! Will continue to frequent! By far the best Mexican in town!

Really 2 1/2 stars. On the touristy side but solid service. Basically NY, Chicago,LA prices for food that's okay but not stellar. The spices are dumbed down for the tourists instead of true local intensity. Proportions are small for entrees. Bourbon St location explains a lot. I'm guessing conventioneers come in and think this is real Cajun cuisine, walk away happy. Nothing wrong with that but generally the food is bland. My advice is to find a side street and get some real gumbo :)

First of all, South Street is definitely one of the places to be in Philly! It's so live! One of our Uber drivers told us to come here if we want to a good cheesesteak or chicken cheesesteak. Things shutdown @ 2am in Philly ( boooo). It was after midnight and we were STARVED so we headed over to this location because it has the Dine in. it was PACKED but luckily we got a table, the ordering process is really fast so make sure you know what you want when it's your turn. They give you a ticket number once you place your order and call out the number when your order is ready. The subs are big, packed with meat and pretty good but sorry to say not the best I had in Philly. I only had their chicken cheesesteak though...next time i would order the regular cheesesteak...that one tasted better. Also, if you like to people watch for entertainment, this is the place to be after hours!!! I like the name Ishkabibbles too, i thought my uber driver was speaking gibberish when he first told us about this spot lol!
Good food at good prices. The burger is so big it can feed two people. Would recommend.

This building has gone through quite a few different businesses over the years, but it looks like this bar is really grabbing hold, which is nice. I've been here at night, and I've always found the place to be fun and reasonably priced. As a couple other yelpers have mentioned, there's quite a variety of things happening here, so you may be in for a surprise if you're just popping in for a pint. The crowd in here is subdued but definitely out for a good time. I felt relaxed, and that was before I started drinking.

I finally went back for brunch, and that left me very underwhelmed. Service was just ok - I waited over half an hour for a coffee refill and didn't get much information when I asked about a couple entrees. Food was average. It wasn't bad, but I didn't walk away impressed. With all the great brunch competition in the city, don't think I'll be back anytime really soon for that.

A totally decent place to come at night. But there's so much competition for brunch, think some other spots have priority.

That said, I love the atmosphere and I'll definitely be back for drinks.

Mother's was always a solid family favorite for breakfast and some of the best biscuits around town. Note the past tense Now that being said our latest visit 2/19/18 was disappointing! My dad was craving the roast beef debris which was actually just shredded roast beef. No debris,  which by definition is the crusty bits and pieces, leftover remnants of the heartier roast beef. Just call it roast beef and not debris- no problem.  Quit selling on false advertisement. 
Now the service has never been great. A bunch of seemingly over worked or just plain unfriendly women working the front. It must suck to hate your work and look so miserable already at 8am. So if you like gruff, no frills, lacking customer service eating enjoy. Once again something that used to be a great representation of New Orleans has become too big for its britches attracting unsuspecting tourists losing quality and respect of locals.
Gorgeous space. Great for large parties and brunch menu was on point! Highly recommend the hasbrowns!

I wanted to make the 100th a good one, and I cannot believe that I have never review the glinch. I can only try to do it justice through the hazy gaze of my sly fox soaked brain. 

Most of my friends have always been older than me, and if you have read any of my previous reviews, you know that I started frequenting some of the grosser bars in Philadelphia when I was just a baby (Actually! see reivew for Pub & Kitchen). However, McGlincheys was where I really learned how to drink.

I used to come here after work at 6 and stay until last call at 2 am, never spending more than 20 dollars on all the lager and hot dogs my stomach could handle. I loved the dirty boys, the mean waitresses, the smoke, and of course, the jukebox. I loved the feeling of getting away with something that obviously I shouldn't be doing. I loved it all. 

We always had the same waitress, Bernadette, who is no longer with the team. She was mean and crazy, but we loved her. I mean, she brought us lager and hot dogs, and cleared our ashtrays after just about each butt went out. We never put up a fuss, so she was always civil to us, although I have seen some crazy action from the waitresses there.

Which brings me to the next reason that I love McGlinchey's. For me, it is a family institution. My 96 year old Grandmother used to come here for drinks when she was teaching at UArts (PCA when she was teaching) with my grandfather and their friends (she says it wasn't as divey or smokey back then, I say Embrace it, Grandma). My parents used to come here when they were young advertisers living at the Sprucemont (based on my parents stories, apparently the glinch is a little more tame now than it was in the early to mid 80s, but then again what isn't?). I used to drink here underage, play radiohead song after radiohead song on the jukebox and long to be the girlfriend of one of the smelly, bearded boys at the bar with calf tattoos and ratty messenger bags. AND NOW, for the shiny glory of the Fox/Weiner family, my sister works here. That's right folks, A Fox at the Glinch. 

Last night when I brought two buddies from the burbs here (one is moving out west and wants to hit all of the Philly landmarks), my sister waited on us. And we could smoke. And radiohead was on the jukebox. 

I was wearing a new KJL tiger crystal bracelet, and I felt like a lady, so I refrained from eating a hot dog. And instead of yuengling, we were drinking sly fox because now we are adults. And sometimes adults go out on school nights and drink too much beer and smoke too many cigarettes and listen to too much radiohead. But aside from being able to eat dessert for dinner, that's really the best part about growing up, isn't it?

TTFN.

Made a special trip on a friend's recommendation and they didn't steer us wrong. Server suggested pizza and it was outstanding as was the house salad and the ice cold beer. Great, friendly service, comfortable environment, couldn't have asked for more. This was a mid afternoon Saturday and they were busy but did have immediate seating. I suspect they are much busier at dinner. Can't wait to return to try the sandwiches and pastas. Highly recommend.

This is the closest to good BBQ you will find in Tucson. And they have locations all over. 

The downside to this location is the physical location. Parking is limited and it can be difficult to get in and out of the parking lot. 

The food is very good. The menu has something for everyone, as long as they eat meat. The sauces are always well stocked. So are the napkins, which is good since it is a bit messy to eat all the goodness. I usually get something with pulled pork. One of my favorite things is the pulled pork baked potato. The brisket is also good. So are the loaded fries. 

Service was fast and we found seating easily. Prices are decent. Wish it was easier to get to because it is well maintained and the food is good.

Wanted so to like this place as we loved the pizza place that was here (pre-COVID). But frankly the food was meh. 

I ordered a the shrimp fajitas. Cooked about right but sadly flat in taste. The rice and refried beans were plentiful but again, nothing to brag about.  Unfortunately there was much guacamole or pico. The flour tortillas were hot and the fantastic- the best part of this meal. 

G ordered a delux burrito that was anything but delicious. She added cheese - the best thing about this mess. When asked, her one word description was "Gross" and she might have been kind. Sure, the proportions were large but the one bite I had made my fajitas seem sublime. 

Drinks were Pepsi products plus a root beer and a pineapple soda (which was good, if not sugary).  They said they are working on adding ice tea to the drink selection. 

Prices were reasonable, which may explain the lines and the crowds. Or that folks want to get out (now that we can). 

So yes, working thru some things at this new place but doubtful we will give it a second chance. There are too many other good places to eat in MJ. Too bad this isn't another one of those. 

BTW, no sense that dogs were allowed inside but there is outside seating. Also, no COVID precautions or restrictions.  (Which isn't surprising given Tennessee's approach to opening things up.)

Food was amazing, the ribs were fall off the bone amazing and the white sauce with the toasted ravioli burnt ends fantastic! Liquor selection was expansive. Waitress was top notch and knew her stuff, this is a must stop when visiting St Louis!

They have plexiglass separating every booth. Every booth is occupied. The effect is it's 2019 all over again. The sound of families and couples enjoying their breakfast and rock and roll music in the background. The feeling of community. All this with covid precautions firmly in place. We love this place.
The food and service is excellent. The staff never allow your coffee cup to go empty. The staff and management support each other to the benefit of the customer. Very rare in most restaurants.
Try any of the skillet breakfasts. All are excellent. My favorite is the Western. My wife is partial to the French Toast filled sandwich. I'm amazed she is able to finish it.

We love this place.  My wife and I have been ordering here since we bought a house on the island 6 years ago.  We would be lost without it, or we would have to travel to another Chinese restaurant another 5 miles away that we don't like nearly as much.

    They have very reasonable prices for such a high priced zip code, very fresh food in large portions, and it's a family run business with friendly owners/son and daughter who get to know you, and even what your special likes are.

  We hope Kai (sp?) and Mary never retire!!
What a fun place to go and have cocktails on your girls trip. The champagne jello shots were big and a little hard to go down but we couldn't leave without trying them.

I don't get the other reviews. This place is awesome. The staff was super friendly. The ambiance was cool and I loved being able to see out the windows during breakfast. The food was soooo good. I just have to say, This was the BEST BISCUIT I've ever had. 

tip- Cash only so make sure you hit up the ATM before.

Came out yesterday to Cui Hua Gui Lin Noodle House for the first time as part of the inaugural Chinatown Week YEG!

Their set menu offering for $15 for Chinatown Week was:

Appetizer: bacon wrapped shrimp
Main: beef brisket vermicelli in soup (Guilin style)

I met up with a fellow foodie and we delved right in - requesting the set menu for Chinatown Week.

There was plenty of seating - tables and booths available.  I chose a table in the middle of the restaurant and watched the place fill up EVERY single other table around me for the noon lunch rush.

The food came out fast! Perfect for work break lunches!

The bacon wrapped grilled shrimp were tasty with smoky flavours from the BBQ and didn't need the accompanying sweet chili sauce at all.

The highlight for me was the beef brisket soup - YUM!  My dining partner wasn't as pleased with the fattier bites but I enjoyed every bit of that beef brisket soup.  The broth didn't come our separately for us which I had looked forward to reading other people's reviews of the Guilin style soups but was delish none the less!

While waiting for my friend, the waitress chatted with me about the history of the restaurant (3 years) and the origins of the food mostly from South Western China.  She said that they chose this dish for Chinatown Week because it's yummy but also mild.  I let her know that I LOVE spicy food and would be most interested next time in trying out stronger flavoured dishes.  Halfway through our meal, she brought out a plate of "spicy bamboo" that she said goes in the soup dishes she would recommend to me next time.  And DANG that bamboo was delicious!  I ate some straight and plopped the rest into my soup bowl.  I had also added a tablespoon or so of their house made chili oil (which they sell - YES!) to spice up my soup.

I will most definitely be back and am so thankful that Chinatown Week introduced me to this place!

Noodle On!

We were originally going to go to Dante's across the street, but liked the menu here better.

The atmosphere is amazing; it's literally like walking into a friend's house, with different dining areas in each room. It was very romantic and upscale without being stuffy.

I started with the crawfish etouffe with a pepper biscuit which was out-of-this-world amazing. Then I went for the Seafood Platter which was really good, with the Jalapeno Shrimp cornbread being the best thing. For dessert, we shared the white chocolate creme brulee which was tasty though I'm not really a fan of white chocolate. My wife loved it.

A note for vegetarians: my wife doesn't really eat seafood so we asked if the chef could accommodate her and he ended up making a grilled artichoke and eggplant dish that she absolutely loved.

If you're from up north, you know Dunkin Donuts just isn't the same down here.  BUT, one of the managers (Phyllis) at this location really changes that.  You'll know her when you meet her by her accent and Bostonian nature (loud, funny etc).  Compared to other Dunks in the area, she really makes the trip worth going outta the way for.  And she knows how to make an iced coffee the right way too!
great comfy spot with eccentric creative menu and perfect noise level.

I had the crab cake eggs benedict with soft shell crab. The food was good but very stingy on the hollandaise sauce.

Services very poor. I waited over 10 minutes with empty glass of water and coffee. Service staff, cashier and busboys passing by and standing at cash register.  No one offered refills. The waitress came three times. She did give us one refill of coffee after 10 minutes of dry cups.  I had dry cups again when she handed the bill. Not asking if I needed anything else.


Raven was are server.  She said she had not tasted the menu.  That she only likes one thing.  She liked one other because of the name.  She said she had not had it.


.
Not bad BYO ughh but is good food tuna was very fresh . I think was the owner she was very nice services very fast and good quality parking spot very hard to find

Charles at Margaritaville served me recently for an most enjoyable dinner.  The lightly blackened catfish po boy is excellent.  I took a friend for dinner for another delightful experience.  It's just nice to walk into Margaritaville and be greeted by a caring staff!!

Most of the dishes I had at Penang were passable but not very tasty.  Generally, Penang's kitchen oversimplified the flavours of the dishes such that they each had one shallow dominating flavour instead of a blend of flavours with more depth.

Best I had at Penang: Roti canai (appetizer) was pretty good.  It's standard for what you can get in Philly, which is to say it's on the overly crisp, overcooked side but that's par for the course.

Shrimp sambal: sauce was good (if you like sambal, which I do). Shrimp was overcooked, so texture was non-ideal. Bad texture, good flavour.

Mango tofu: tofu is dry and a little hard. This dish is mainly just sweet, not particularly good. Bad texture and bad flavour. I'd avoid this one.

Steamed Chicken - Disappointing. This style of chicken should be slippery and succulent, but instead it was overcooked. Sauce was okay, flavourwise.

Noodle dishes were edible, but not great. Not tasty. Bad texture.

Summary: the food's edible but I wouldn't look forward to coming back.

First time there and we will be back!  Amazing food and fantastic service.   We had a party of 9 and all of us were very happy with our orders. Definitely a local place but also popular with frequent travelers. We are thankful for the referral to RBar and Grill!
We love Southside Grill! Fantastic food and cocktails, great ambiance, and great service.
Stayed at the hotel.  The ladies working at the bar went above and beyond.  Korean wings were delicious.  Would recommend.

Being new to Philadelphia, I made my first trip over the bridge for Sagami and it was worth it. Good thing we made reservations because the place was packed on a Friday night! 

I appreciate the traditional feel of Sagami from the decor to the dishes. The service by kimono clad waitresses was excellent even with the overwhelming crowd. 

I would definitely order the eggplant appetizer (with ground chicken and miso paste) again. It was so flavorful, probably the best I've ever had. All of sushi/sashimi was fresh and beautifully presented. Even the udon noodles I ordered, served simply in a clear broth,  were delicious.

My only complaint is that the dinner entrees are a little pricey, even for Japanese food, but the quality more than compensates. Next time I'm craving traditional Japanese I know where to go - New Jersey!

Love this place! The farm burger is AMAZING. Sweet potato fries are the best. Family friendly environment. My son loved they served his sprite from the bottle. He says it tastes so much better! Wait times can get a little crazy but it's worth the wait!

Portion sizes small.
If you eat gluten free or Keto this probably isn't the place for you. Apparently they count on the customer eating lots of bread and rice to get filled up. Food is good and presented nicely other than that. Many of the combinations are with bread and rice and few with salad. They also lack any kind of vegetarian combo. I was there for lunch and ordered the eggplant dish. It came with rice and bread. I requested salad in place of that. It was a nice salad but very small. And the eggplant was like a side dish and even served on a small plate (I suppose to make the portion look larger). There is no a-la-carte menu; they will only sell you another entree. So I had lunch and spent $17.50 with tip & water was my drink & now I have to go find a couple of tacos somewhere.. too bad they would a coma date a full stomach at a reasonable price and I am not a hog.

We came after the Cardinals game. I ordered a Martini. It came and was 2/3 full. Didn't really think much about it but when the bill came it was 19 dollars. I mentioned this at the end of the meal to the server, who was very nice and did a good job overall. She said, well they measure it exactly. So it's by design that they pour light martinis and charge a premium price.

We also got the nachos. They were OK.

There's better places for a better value, like Ruth's Chris on the other side of the hotel. Better, full martinis and a couple bucks less.

We tried this place for the first time today and lemme tell ya man, I wish we woulda visited this place sooner.
It's not a very big place, it's a deli, Italian grocery store and small small restaurant in one building. I was amazed with the selection of take home fresh and frozen meals that are available for take home meals.
We stopped here to try authentic Italian food and they didn't disappoint. My wife had the chicken parmesan with spaghetti and I ordered ravioli stuffed with shrimp served with a cream sauce. The marinara sauce on the chicken parmesan was two thumbs up. My wife was happy with her meal and I was also impressed with the ravioli shrimp.
The only downside is that they sell refrigerated canned sodas and bottled teas but they don't have ice to enjoy our drinks. That won't make me knock them down from 5 stars.
I highly recommend this quaint place!

We ate here twice- 1st dinner and last during our trip to NOLA. Love this place. Both meals were outstanding. Savory cheese cake and gumbo change daily and are the best we had. The staff is friendly, knowledgable, and attentive. Painted plates on the walls and paintings are charming. Low key, laid back place, with fresh delicious meals.

Minus one star for this place's alter ego, which can, on the wrong day, make it feel  an Oscar Night party --  crowded, pretentious and bordering on chaotic.

But on the right day, it's buzzing, vibrant and just loud enough to pass on some of its fun energy to you and your table mates, guaranteeing a good time had by all.

On those days, you can't go wrong with:

* Open-face shrimp quesadilla.
* El Vez guacamole, made fresh just seconds before it   gets to you
* Mahi-mahi tacos
* Black beans and rice side dish
* Macho nachos!!!!!
* Blood orange (frozen) margarita

Honorable mentions also go to:

* Vaca frita burrito
* Guava mojito

Overall, a solid spot with nice service, that can be both fun and sophisticated in its ambiance and cuisine.

We had a table for 12 with 6 kids! And the service was fantastic.  Food was great and by all accounts the ingredients were fresh and flavorful.   Margaritas were average- we should've upgraded for the Presidente's or the Cadillacs.  Appetizer, especially the seafood nachos were killer.  Scallops were Britney, buttery and just the perfect amount of chewy.

My negative experience comes from a reservation I made and attended to a week ago from today for my partner's birthday. What should've been a special occasion and fine dining experience-- turned out to be one of the worst that I've experienced in a while. The service was completely unacceptable. Starting from a spilled drink all over me and our table to no acknowledgement from the waiter or a manager. After receiving a follow up call and sharing my honest opinion the following day, after paying my full bill including the spilled drink, I was promised a call back from a manager (8 days ago) and that has yet to happen. I would say that it was quite a disappointment for the hype that is made about this place, I've experienced much better at several other restaurants locally and can say I do not recommend and will not return after the lack of customer service and respect offered.

Honestly- it was a good meal! Reading some of the reviews before coming here made me feel sort of iffy, but since it was raining and close by, I decided to give it a try! 

I'm Korean, so korean food is near and dear to my heart! I came in around 8 with in a group of 5 and we were seated immediately. We ordered a seafood scallion pancake for the table and needless to say- we demolished that. It reminded me of my mom's and was perfect for the weather outside. 

My friends had ordered Galbi Tang, Jjangmyun, Tangsooyook, Ddak Galbi, and Naengmyun. It all came out pretty reasonably and needless to say- it was good! It wasn't mouthwatering but it was enough to fill me up and it put a smile on my face. The only tip I have is to order several things that are sort of different from each other so that everyone at the table can try something new.

Give this place a try for yourself- it looks like this place is owned by a Korean family, so you can't get anymore authentic than that!

It's pretty crowded and pretty loud but it's a staple of Ybor.  You have to go at least once.  The food is decent and the sangria is delicious. Expect to wait a LONG time without a reservation.  Expect to still wait even with a reservation lol.  Admire the decor while waiting. Every time I have gone our wait staff has been exceptional which sort of takes away from the negative.

I had the crab cakes to start off they were absolutely delicious..full of meat inside of stuffing 
We order the shrimp and fish platter it was awesome as well and their cocktails  were just right

My husband and I went to Byblos for the first time since their remodel. The inside is more upscale and elegant than it was before. It looks very modern. We were going to sit outside but after we sat down, the table had dirt on it and wasn't clean. We asked to sit inside afterwards which was much cleaner, had better lighting, and was less noisy.

Once we got to our table, we ordered two Stellas. They were served in chilled glasses. Since my husband is Lebanese we wanted to order some traditional items that usually his mom makes when she visits. We ordered the baba ganush with pita, zatar fries with harissa aioli, kebeh, and for a main course we split the chicken kabob. The harissa aioli was amazing and the chicken kabob was very tender and flavorful. I will say the hummus lacked flavor compared to the baba ganush. 

Comparing to my mother-in-law's Lebanese cooking this was very close. Some of the best Lebanese food we have had in Tampa. I recommend Byblos to anyone wanting a middle eastern food experience.

Pizza was tasty, but still a bit greasy. And that's a great thing! Had a meat lovers pizza- enjoyed the shaved meatballs. Also had a friend that ordered the cold Italian sub and we all ended up sharing. I think I enjoyed the sandwich better than the pizza!

Ambiance - its tight cozy atmosphere. Tables are so close . Adjacent tables guests can hear our conversation . Lot of noise . Lights in the room are nice. 

Food- we ordered appam with goat curry, And parota with egg curry . In Goat curry they are oly two pieces . Taste wise they are not extraordinary. Currys are like  South Indian, homemade style. But presented well. 

Service- fast and good .

Price- reasonable.

I finally tried Dinic's for the first time after seeing it on Man v. Food last night.  Living in Philly my whole life, it's been long enough.  I tried "the greatest sandwich in America" with a little tweak.  I got the roast pork, sharp provolone, and hot roasted peppers instead of the broccoli rabe.  I don't know how much of a difference it made, but I surprisingly found the sandwich to be a tad overrated.  Calm down die-hards, don't get me wrong, I really enjoyed it and thought it was good, but I'm failing to see that it's the best in the country.  If my pork was drenched in the juices as seen on TV, they evaporated by the time I ate it.  I was fully expecting the roll to be soaked.  The strong tastes of the sharp provolone and hot of the peppers give it a lot of character than some plain roast pork sandwich.  How can it be named best in the country when it's not even best in the city?  I'll take a cheesesteak any day over it.  Also, I only gave it 3 stars BECAUSE of the famous title of best in America.  Had it not have that title, it'd be a 4 star sandwich.
This place has the best tasting ramen in all of St. Louis! Plus the staff is very friendly and the prices are reasonable.

I first tasted Yeast Nashville before they opened and was impressed by their Yazoo Jalapeno bread. When I saw that they had opened their physical location, I had to stop by. The experience was by no means unpleasant, but I did notice that my sausage and cheese kolache had generic American cheese. It was also warmed up in a microwave prior to being served. That's probably why the prices were so reasonable!

My hope is that the cost-cutting measures they appear to be taking will disappear in favor of higher quality ingredients and better warming methods as they become more and more popular.

Do yourself a favor if you are in New Orleans and visit this amazing find. I was on a trip from San Francisco and wanted a great neighborhood restaurant and stumbled across Kenton's. Wow - simply fantastic. The food, service and ambiance was just perfect. I don't post often but felt the need to do so. Will definitely be returning the next time I am there.

I am a pizza snob. As far as I was concerned Nashville's pizza scene is bogus. Sorry but that was how I felt before my husband brought home a thick flavorful Sicilian!  Topped with mushrooms, green peppers, and onions, i ate a whole piece. Yes one whole piece...each slice is HUGE!  The crust is chewy and soft, and they actually season the pizza. The sauce...divine! Its not cheesy and gooey...its not supposed to be. I can not wait to try the NY style.
Great neighborhood bar, with above average bar food! Friendly waitstaff, and guests!! The quesadilla was especially good! And they have live music sometimes, which is extra fun!

I ordered an order of egg rolls and to go pineapple fried rice, by the time when I opened it. It stupidly didn't have any pineapple nor flavor in it ,and their egg roll wasn't not as good as it used to be. Not sure if I'm going to this place again.

The Rum House used to be great. I gotta say though, passed few times I've been the quality of the food, and the waitresses really put me off, taking a huge break from Rum House. Last time I was here, they were out of sides, and waitress was flat out rude. Not every waitress here is bad, prior experiences I had good ones, but this one you could tell just really didn't want the job. 

If you catch them on a good day, get the nachos and sub the pork for with calypso beef, it's so much better that way. If you plan on drinking the fish bowl, just know you're gonna have a killer headache when it's complete, cheap ass booze but we all know that.

This place is the worst. Horrible customer service. We live near by and stop in time to time because it's close. EVERY TIME we have walked in the door the bartenders and servers just stare at you like your from another planet, no hello, they don't tell you where to sit they just stare like they are hoping you don't sit in their section. Last night was no exception, my husband and I walked in for a late dinner around 9:30pm, the bar was a little busy but the restaurant was not. The bartender watched us walk in, not a hello, a smile, nothing. There was even a server standing there wiping down a table and she just stared at us! Not one word, just a blank stare! I had to say hello to her and ask her if we could sit anywhere we liked. This is bizarre to me! I have been a bartender for 10+ years, you ALWAYS greet everyone coming into your establishment. You want to make them feel comfortable, welcomed. Not just stare at them like they are idiots. This is probably the 3rd time this has happened here that's why I am writing a review. I suggest the managers train these girls a little better. We will be going to The Lake bar and grill across the street from now on and I suggest you do too! They at least have the common courtesy say hello to you when you walk in the door.

Dropped by while in Philadelphia for an event in the nearby convention center, and we've come back to Philadelphia almost specifically for this place!!

It is AMAZING Malaysian food--some of the most authentic and flavorful dishes we've had. They don't water down the strong flavors of lemongrass, garlic, and shrimp paste. Plus, the staff is incredibly friendly and efficient. The place gets very busy at night, so they've got their order processing down pat and dishes come out amazingly fast. BYOB is another plus--there are a ton of groups that book out large tables for this place.

Come here for a loud, good time and great food. Order the roti canai, chicken rendang (or nasi lemak), sizzling tofu, and kangkung belacan (stir fried water spinach in shrimp paste)!

Had a great afternoon here! Got here early enough to have an outside table and catch part of the band. Tasting was great. After tasting, we decided to go with the white sangria, which was excellent! The pizza was very good and the atmosphere was very relaxing. I look forward to returning here soon!

It surprised me to learn that the chef is vegan.  This is terrific news for me since I have dietary restrictions and cannot eat anything dairy.  Lindsey our server was wonderful.  She made sure that my food arrived without any dairy.  Usually, I feel that Mexican food is a bit easier for me because it's easy to leave it out - no sour cream on the side or cheese on top,...  This was a fun restaurant and I felt completely comfortable that I was in good hands.  I also felt like I had a fair bit of selection to pick from.  I agree with the other reviewers that it's well done Mexican food.  This restaurant has great atmosphere, terrific service and quality food.  What more can you ask for.  Oh, by the way, I only gave it 4 stars because I ordered a pumpkin margarita and it was only O.K.

Coming from NYC, I'd like to say I have had a fair share of good pho places so when it comes to pho I think I am pretty picky.
It's all about the nitty gritty, borderline suspect, Vietnamese restaurants, that are always the ones with the best pho.
When you first look at Pho Cali, the store front itself looks a bit suspect, and maybe the sparse furnishing within the restaurant continues with this, however, the place seems actually quite cleanly.
It's a breathe of fresh air when you realize you can have good quality pho and not be scared to peek behind into the kitchen.
As for the meat of the review, the Pho here is very flavorful, the soup is rich and not too salty with a great beefy taste that I've known to love. The meat balls are tasty and the beef (including all the random parts) tastes fresh as well. The price for the "everything" (No. 1) is $10 which is very fair for the large portion received, with the other styles that are a bit smaller at $9. Also they seem to have very strong/fresh jalapenos here which is perfect for me cause I love spicy, but just a warning if you aren't a big spicy eater.

This place is definitely my go-to when it comes to pho in the Newark Delaware area and with the cold weather and flu season coming soon, I suggest any one coming down with a cold or even just on a chilly day to check this spot out. The pho is definitely worth the trip!

Great atmosphere very family friendly. I live the options they have available. The thing that makes them stand out from the rest would probably be the aesthetic. I live the red and white patterns. It's a pretty chill place to go with your friends if your looking for a nice cold treat.

Ate here for the first time tonight and really loved it. The food was healthy and flavorful, the sauces were a nice complement, the portion sizes were generous, and the price was affordable. I will definitely be going back many times.

came from out of town and searched all over for a good restaurant. the hotel i stayed at recommended this place. the restaurant is clean and has a authentic atmosphere. serve is excellent and attentive. they make fresh, handmade salsa to your liking right at your table. reasonable price for the quality of food, if you're ever in tucson definitely come check guadalajara out.
It's a small family owned restaurant. We had the Veggie Lebanese Pizza. It was very tasty, and wonderful.  The staff was very friendly. We will definitely come back to Cedar's cafe.

This place is horribleeeeeeeeee !!! Rude rude people . Don't come here ! They were not welcoming or professional. Constantly communicated with one another when I asked for anything . Like my drink that I asked for when entering, that I never got until after my 2nd plate ! Place is horrible . Don't come here !!!!!

We found this place on a whim while walking around downtown before a soccer game. It was delicious and the service was fantastic - attentive and so friendly. I'm a Texan and more than a little snobby about Mexican/Texmex food of any kind. Pancho and Lefty's is legit and it's great to be able to order as many or as few tacos as you want from the menu. The catfish was our favorite hands down!

The chairs, and ability 2 order from said chairs is a great concept! My comment is about the bartender at the bar. My husband and I were there for a date night. We came early so we could have a drink b/f the movie. The bartender was such a sourpuss, and acted like we were putting her out when we asked for a drink was a complete turn off.Something is wrong when you are nicer to your server than they are PAID to be to you. We were there on 6/18/16.Tighten up your ship Roadhouse.

This is the best sushi I've had probably.. ever. It's very, very fresh. Actually, all of their food tastes as though it's premium quality. Their chicken teriyaki is amazing... the sauce has all the flavor you want but isn't thick and heavy like take out tends to be. It comes with a seemingly standard side salad.. but the ginger dressing that comes with it is so bright and flavorful; you won't be left wanting. The vegetable tempura is light and crispy, and delivers the savory crunch you want when you order tempura, without feeling as though the oil is going to leave you with a carotid artery. 10/10 would recommend!

So my boyfriend  and I just moved to Tampa and we were very excited for our first date night! My boyfriend is Hawaiian and he found this place via the web. The view is of course amazing and the ONLY good part of our experience unfortunately. We were seated and served our drinks, then ordered an appetizer , the shrimp martini glass one. We waited over 20 min without getting our appetizer and our waiter was barely checking on us. We had ask him for suggestions on what to eat and he said he didn't really know, which made us very confused . My boyfriend is a chef so we love Asking about the staff recommendations...so to not have any was upsetting ! Finally , someone from the kitchen came out apologizing about our appetizer and said she'd take off bill...we were like, "ok let's give it a chance ". The appetizer was honestly just "ok". THEN, our meal..I ordered sushi and he ordered the Hawaiian chicken . We waiting for almost 45 min!!! The couple next to us were seated after us and were paying their bill before we got our dinner! Also, this was a SLOW evening ...there were maybe 25 people between the inside and outside ! The waiter was NOT good at communicating with us, and we are typically super easy to please because we both work in customer service . The food was horrible !!! My sushi was dry and had to be sitting on waiting counter for over 10 min..and his chicken was incredibly sad...they cut half a chicken, threw sauce on it and wrapped in banana leaves ...so he had to sit and pick it apart . The sides for the chicken were wrong as well. After our food was served the waiter NEVER checked on us again only to bring the bill! We were SO SO SO disappointed in every way. Do not give this place your money ! Go get better food SOMEWHERE else and then maybe go to the bar for a drink and the view!

This place is amazing. I've now been coming for lunch to sit outside and it's so nice for lunch. Dinner is also amazing. I love the chicken sharma no rice so it's like a salad. The server we had was amazing probably the best service I've had in a long time and were used to high end places to eat so I was impressed again. Had their tzatizi yogurt which was really good as well. Will order this instead of hummus as I like this better.

Wow this is the best Chinese I have ever had.  I have ate inside once and had take out probably 8 or so times.  It is excellent.  I love the Garlic Chicken, Hot Pot Chicken, Dan Dan noodles, and the Deep Fried Chicken with Chilli Peppers.  Have not had a bad item here.  I live in Mt. Airy and can't order from anywhere else now.  It is easily worth driving a little out of my way to come here.  They do both Americanized Chinese (Orange Chicken etc.) and some more authentic dishes.  Both are very good.

On top of the food being excellent the owners and staff are all very nice and really seem to appreciate my business.  I will keep coming back.

Awesome food and such a quaint atmosphere!  The happy hour prices were amazing! A California roll for $3.00!

The Tantan Man soup was amazing!  The service was spectacular!

This place good bouhl! Great hoagies, never had a bad one. Been eating from here for years and the sammies always taste good and are always priced good as well. Wish they were open for more hours but oh well. Love a good hoagie you should come here.

Sushi Teri is a great spot! I come here way to often well at least in the last week lol. I just get California rolls which isn't super fancy, each time they have been fresh and perfectly rolled with a good portion of each of the ingredients! When I've dined in at the place the service has been always excellent!

Going to keep this review short and sweet. 

5 stars, easy.

Food is consistent with the chain so if you have been to one PFC, you know the taste of the food and what to expect.

Food came out very quickly.

Good service and all staff members were friendly.

If you can take something like Kale and cook it up to taste like Heaven then I am a fan.  I have never been one to crave Kale but after eating their dish that consisted of sauteed Kale and mushrooms I can't get it out of my mind and crave it on a daily basis.  Vedge makes eating like a Herbivore sexy and sophisticated.

Never had mexican food in an egg-roll before. Also, never ordered mexican food from a drive through window before (because, well, Taco Bell isn't Mexican food...) I got the Mini-Chimi Tasters plate. Came with three chimis, each with a different filling.  Tasted good, but more because of the fried exterior rather than delicious interior. Also came with rice, cheese, beans, lettuce and guac on the side, with some actually good salsa. Service was very quick at least. I should try a main dish next time, if there is a next time.

Service : nice and friendly
Food : well cooked and well seasoned. 
Ambience: nice and comfortable

Loved the farmers market on Sunday. I drive pass this place every Sunday morning and I cant believe I didn't know about this place. What made me stop by was a food truck that I heard was gonna be here and I mistakenly parked across the whole plaza from it. But it gave me the chance to check out the whole thing. Lots of local farmers and shops/restaurant that offer great healthy and organic produce and food. If I didn't have to work I would come here more often :(
Food was ok  the girl Ashley who took are order looked like we were bothering her to do her job. Sorry you work at firehouse and hate it but don't act like a turd to me a paying customer.
This place is a waste of money and time the burgers are tasteless the fries suck do yourself a favor you csn fix a better burger at home you could not pay me to eat in this place again

Great breakfast spot. Love the new remodel. First Watch brass please, please do not get rid of your greatest food creation the "Big Sur Breakfast Burrito"!! It was a March special but deserves to be on the permanent menu. I will be having a candle light vigil until it returns.

We dined here for breakfast on Sunday & it was nice. we had to wait about 20 minutes but were seated pretty quickly. the waitress took our order very quickly and was very attentive. i ordered an egg white omelet & my mom got the french toast. the omelet was very large & filling. a bit salty but good. my mom said the french toast was really good. this is a convenient location if you're staying downtown and want a good breakfast. i would come back!

Customer service was great. The food is basic. Nothing different from other places to grab a bite. If you have a place you love choose it first. Check this one out if your passing by and just hungry. They're stingy with the dressing.

Hands down best meal I have had in all of NOLA. 
I did fine dining, French Quarter, BBQ, Soulfood... and this place tops all. 

Trust the reviews this place is beyond good. 
We had blackened catfish, chicken fried chicken and the best chicken Alfredo around. Red beans and rice, fried okra... Queso with home made chips  Do I have to go on? I can. 
Do not think twice just go!

Great services, Delicious Food, Good Vibes.

I wish I could transport you back to California but I will be back soon and every time I visit.

This place is HORRIBLE..... the Rooms are not clean. The staff is extremely rude. Money was stolen out of a purse that was left in a room that was told not be be cleaned. They came into the room anyway and the money was stolen. They treated us like we stole the money. I'm assuming since this is a casino they think people can't keep track of their money. But with us they have it wrong. We didn't come here to gamble we were at a convention. Never entered the Casino and we don't drink. So needless to say we were fully aware of how much money was in the bag. And was sure no one would enter the room BECAUSE WE ASKED THEM NOT TO. Reporting the incident to the security guard because the manager didn't think it was important enough for us to talk to him/her. The supervisor of the security guards was rude and unapologetic. Basically it was our lost. He did promise me he would investigate and get back to me. That was a Wednesday......moving to Friday no one had contacted me so I went to inquire. 
They treated me as if The situation never happen and told me lies about the situation. I was so appalled by the situation I couldn't believe he was  treating me this way. I called the police to get a formal report. The supervisor of security was livid at the fact I wanted to involve the police and was still rude. He lied to the officer and all. He was supposed to give the officer a report he made which of course never came up. He made all types of excuses why the he couldn't give the officer the report. It's now Sunday night I check out in the morning. If the convention didn't have all the hotels full at other hotels we would have left a long ago. This hotel is not clean. They hang dirty towels back in the bathroom room today will be the 6th night we have been here and they have not changed the sheets. They haven't vacuumed ect...... Don't stay here it's not worth it. And the money being stolen was the icing on the cake for me!!!!

I've ordered from dozens of Dominos all over the US and have never had it take half an hour for them to start making my order. Maybe the pizza is phenomenal and I will change this when it is delivered. I doubt it. Dominos is mediocre at best. Their only benefit is speed, and that is shot to h-e-double hockey sticks.

We came here for the first time today after attending church. It was a good sign, in my eyes, that we had to park across the street because there was no space in the front of the restaurant. Busy! 

We didn't wait long at all for our family of 4 to be seated. But then, they asked us to move to a smaller table to accommodate a bigger group which was fine. 

My daughter's eyes lit up as soon as we sat in the second table. This restaurant had Santa walking around talking to everyone! Other places you have to pay an extra fee to have breakfast with Santa! Definitely shows that they're a family restaurant. 

Now onto the food, I ordered silver dollar pancakes for my daughter and they gave me regular sized ones but it was still $3. Awesome! 

I highly recommend their Chicken Fried Steak! Yummy! My husband also enjoyed his Corned Beef breakfast. 

My husband even commented, "Good find, Babe!" 

We'll be back!!!

My wife and I really enjoy coming here for Saturday brunch.  We come 1-2 times per month.  The food is usually on point with a few exceptions.  We have a couple regular servers that we request who take good care of us.  The decor is something I might call rustic chic. Great atmosphere. All around a great place. One thing to note...where they could use improvement is service. On any given day it can take you 1.5-2hours from the time you're seated until you get the check.  This is for a drink, appetizer, entree service for 2 people. This is also why we've come to dine with our choice servers whenever possible.  That said, it's still a great place and worth a trip
Food was average nothing special, the female staff was ok but the male guy delivering food just tossed it on the table with no care.

Waitress was the only nice thing at this visit. It took forever to get our food (7:30 pm Friday night and very few people) then husband got a moldy bun on his burger.   I now understand why there were very few people here on a Friday evening. We loved Penny's but will NOT be back here.

This place is amazing ... I've only gone twice but each time was worth driving along Eagle Road.  Their momos are really good and they have different choices.  I've tried all but their yak. The curry chicken is sweet and tender.  The owner is very nice and down to earth.  He actually gave us a free extra momo because he thought his pork momos came out a little too small.  My boyfriend and I split the 5 momo + 1 side dish and there were even leftovers.  It isn't greasy at all and the flavors are wonderful.  I highly recommend getting their specialty drink the mango lassi.

I was really excited to try this place because i always see their food on IG. The experience was just as the bad reviews said, wish i would of looked here first. It's a self serve / order. When walking in no one greets you. To the right is a hidden cash register to order from and get your number. Placed the order and self seated our selves. It wasn't packed there was about 3-4 tables in. We had ordered tacos, rice and and meat ball appetizers. We never got napkins or utensils or greeted again till our tacos came out. There is a sign at the registered which says food takes time cause it's made fresh. Perfect i love that. The tacos were dropped off (cold) and we weren't asked if we needed anything else. The rice came out hot but wasn't to my liking. We got up and saw the utensils/ napkins at the bar and helped our self. We than saw a employee cleaning tables and asked for the appetizer since we got our tacos first. She said "oh no let me get them with salsa and chips for you." Then she never came back. We asked another "server" if we can get refunded for the appetizer since we basically are done and over the experience. She told the man working the bar who then gave us cash back. He handed me the cash which didn't belong to me it was the person i was with. however, if he took his time to genuinely apologize or see why we asked he would of known. he very quickly placed it in my hand and said "sorry about the meat balls" and walked away.

Their crawfish are massive but could be spicier, and their boiled sides aren't phenomenally full of flavor like I expect. However,  their onion rings are some of the best I've ever had and the andouille stir fry side is so good I've asked for it as my meal before.  Also their cheesy crab dip is so full of crab you can eat it with a fork--so scrumptious.  I also have had the boiled shrimp which was flavored well but overcooked for my liking.  The staff is always great, and it's fun to see the cooks in the kitchen from wherever you sit.  And finally... Their pineapple bread pudding is sliced and fried, then served with caramelized pineapple, which may be the best bread pudding I've had in Louisiana.  Yum.

Wow this place is good. It's about a 20 min hike from the main State Street SB area. When we arrived around 5:15PM there was a line out the door. It was incredibly crammed because they are currently doing construction in one of the dining areas. 

I liked that you went up and ordered and then sat down because it gave me a chance to spy on everyone else's food and determine what I wanted to order. The portions are huge but this place is NOT cheap. I think we spent close to $50 for just two people. I got the steak quesadilla and my husband got the fish tacos. They were amazing. They have a big selection of salsa that you can get to go with your food/chips. They definitely rush you out so this is not the place for a relaxed, extended meal. I hope I can come back once they are done renovating and not feel as rushed and cramped.

It was very nice to find a Japanese restaurant that had so many amazing options. My husband had some yellowtail and said it was amazing. I had Tonkotsu ramen and it was delicious. Although my husband and I have been to Japan many times and knew what to expect from the food my parents had never had Japanese food and they loved it as well. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for good Japanese food.
1st time going here and amazing customer service and food is GUCCI!!! So Dam Good. The music selection was great and they have parking in the back for free.

Their food is tasty, their service ok. I hate their tech, no screens to see what you are ordering and the speaker is had. Still I love the corn dog and the tots. Those are awesome. This location has classic car shows on Friday nights. The specialty drinks are nice but way too sugary for me. Also, the restrooms are outside which is kind of weird

While some Sonic's have convenient trash cans at the exits to there drive-ins, this one only has a good trash can at the exit to the drive-thru which is a little frustrating. also while it's not the fault of this Sonic the parking lot overall for the shopping complex is very frustrating to work your way through

This is my second visit to this restaurant. I am not a local resident, but after arriving due to an unexpected visit, I was happy to be able to eat here again. My first experience was dine in , which was wonderful. This visit was take out. My order was ready in 10 minutes and of course cooked to perfection. I would like to say that I tried a different item from last time however the chile rellenos was too Tasty last time to not have again. As expected I was not  disappointed! If you're in Carmel, you need to stop at the Cancun! It does not disappoint.

Great little pizza shop. Everyone was friendly & more than helpful. Food was delicious!! We stopped in after a travel hockey game at the Flyers Skate Zone (we are from Hershey, Pa) and thoroughly enjoyed our dinner before jumping on the turnpike to travel home. We will be back when we're in town for hockey again.

Super friendly service and really good food (if a bit heavy on salt). The staff seems genuine, not the fake friendly you get at a lot of places. The food is good, but it is a scratch kitchen, so be prepared to wait a bit longer than you might be used to if you eat at other chain restaurants. Their croissants are  awesome and I highly recommend them. Fair warning, unlike most other places, they salt their fries, so either ask for them unseasoned or taste before adding salt.

Decided to give this place another shot and was very pleased. It was a busy Friday night the food took a little while to arrive but that was expected. 

Our sirloin steak ordered medium rare was cooked perfectly and was well seasoned. The Monte Carlo was much bigger than expected and delicious but very greasy. The Texas sweet tea was huge and a bargain for the price. They have redeemed themselves from my last visit with great service and good food.

Will be back again.

My sister and dad kept raving about this place, and even though it's a chain, I thought I'd give it a shot. I'm sorry I did.

The atmosphere is nice and cozy, and I liked the little "windows" at the end of the table that butted up to the kitchen area where the waitress took our order and delivered our food. But that's about where it stopped.

The hashbrowns were greasy and tasteless and the eggs a little runnier than the over medium I ordered, but still hot and yolk flowing. For four triangles of toast, you are given one small package of jelly. No jam, no preserves.
