The appetizers we chose were all exciting (I ordered the vegi spring rolls, my friends the shrimp spring rolls).  I ordered the pad see ew - and it was DELICIOUS.  The vegis, the egg, the noodles.  All of it - GREAT.  My friends seemed pretty happy with their pork and chicken dishes also. The service was great, the food was delicious and very inexpensive, and overall provided for an awesome experience. I was pretty darn happy with the whole thing.  Can't wait to go back and try other options!

This was our first visit here. Not impressed. When we walked in there was a small wait. That turned into a longer than necessary wait. There were multiple open tables yet no one was being seated. Service was ok. However, there was a hair in my fiancé's drink. The food ended up being pretty good which was the redeeming quality of the visit.

Very unhappy with my order this evening. The BBQ calamari was extremely cold, my hoagie didn't have mayo when I asked the young lady for everything on it, they didn't give me a fork to eat with the salad. Which didn't seem so fresh. In addition to being 12 mins late for the 35-40 minute wait they quoted the driver was not friendly at all. This is the second time ordering from there, I'll pass for the next time.

We tried this place first for happy hour. We ordered a bloody mary,and sure glad we did,this is best blood mary I have ever had in my life. We tried thg is drink in at least 3 different places on NOLA and we just decided to go back here and have our fix. As for the food, the grilled oysters were the best, the rockefeller and thermador was good but a bit too much breadcrumbs for me and last but not the least...the crab claws-wowww,that sauce, we actually asked for a spoon to finish off the sauce like a soup. It was right across from Omni hotel where we stayed and across from Antoine's

We've gone here a few times, each one the same as the last! Pretty good! The sheer volume of downtown folks coming here seems to overwhelm the staff which is a shame because they're such nice people I'm sure, food is great come on in!!

The food hasn't let me down and I've never left hungry. The service is pretty fast in all the times I've gone and the staff is friendly. The place is also pretty clean. The only downside is the prices are a bit high. For an example, a plate of chow fun is $10 whereas any other places charge $6-7. But other than that, I have no problems with this place!
Super sweet, generous staff. I can't say enough about how welcoming they are to us each time we go there. Portions are huge, and everything we've ever had has been delicious.

easily the best chinese restaurant in the philadelphia region. ive been eating here for over ten years. the service is fast and friendly and the food rocks. i find it extremely difficult to dine at ANY other chinese restaurants bcuz theyve set the bar extremely high. id recommend this place to anyone.

I'll never eat at this place again.  My 3 year daughter was served milk that was clearly sour, and nearly made her throw up.  I asked for the owner's contact information in case I needed to take my daughter to the doctor.  I watched the waitress tell the manager about our situation, and instead of him coming over to personally apologize, he laughed at my request discussing with the waitress, and the waitress returned and pointed to the phone number on the place mat, and told me I could call the manager if my daughter needed medical attention.  I said no thank you, and I told her I watched him laugh when she explained it to him, and I asked for the owner's contact information again.  The manager came to my table and proceeded to tell me the date on the milk carton had not expired, so the milk was still good, and he gave me the co-owner's contact information.

We were visiting Tucson and stopped in. The food is awesome with lots of options. Atmosphere is friendly and comfortable. I had the breakfast quesadilla and my husband had biscuits and gravy, both were delicious. Would definitely recommend going there.

My fiancé and I had our Thai favorites: Crab Rangoon, Tom Yum, Thai Fried Rice, and Pad Thai Noodles. 
DELICIOUS! We pride ourselves on visiting the best Thai restaurants around the city and this hidden gem shines bright! If you're in Castleton, do not hesitate to stop by.

What's not to love about this little spot tucked just off the Monon? Not only is this place adorable, they serve up ice cream just as delicious. Their portions are quite generous and you can easily get away with ordering a kiddie scoop and fulfilling that ice cream fix.

I figured I'll give it a 2nd try ,yet again I was let down . I ordered a ten piece combo meal although the chicken wings and sauce were really good the fry were burnt and extremely greasy. The lack of cleansing in this store is simply downright awful. From dirty tables,dirty greasy floors, dirty  bathroom sink ,nasty greasy food trays and dirty main entrance door glass with handprints all over it. That let's me wonder how prep their food. I'm guessing that was the reason why the place was empty at lunchtime hour. One star for the chicken wings.
Some creative and delicious sandwiches. One thing I tried had a bit too much salt in it. Also, some sandwiches could use a bit more meat.

This place is excellent.    Very unique place.  They offer a five item platter for a very reasonable price so you can try many different dishes.   The food was high quality and delicious.   They have spicy and non-spicy and the spicy food is not all that spicy which suited me just fine.    The owners were very friendly and eager to please.

Inspired by the George Peabody Library
This place is perfect for brunch. Another spot you should make a reservation early and request to sit inside. As the name indicates, the theme is a library so the walls are filled with books and the check providers come in old books! To start with drinks, they have the typical variations of mimosa, bellina, etc but if you want a signature cocktail I say go for the beautiful pink Hawthorne Margarita it had corazon blanco tequila with fresh lime juice, and hibiscus syrup very tasty but not overly sweet! The library's signature cocktail, The Librarian  was also a good choice, Hendrick's Gin with St Germain, orange bitters and filthy cherry  and the  Title with vodka, rosemary, lavender and lemon.  Most of us had the shrimp cesar salad. It was a big portion with romain, tomato, chopped eggs, olives, pancetta and a garlic crostini on top. The Breakfast Flatbread Pizza was also a great option, caramelized onions, three cheeses, sausage and eggs on top! For the sides no matter what you get, go for the truffle fries! We got two for our table because they were so good! And for dessert, go for the cinnamon bun with the cream cheese glaze and fresh strawberries!

Stopped in for lunch today with a friend.  The service was fast and friendly enough and the ambiance purely noodle house, which I like.  

We opened with a shrimp roll for an appetizer.  It came with the peanut sauce and it was refreshing and tasty.  My companion, ordered a clam soup, which she enjoyed thoroughly.  I ordered the Bun Bo Hue, which I was a little disappointed with. The broth was a little bland and lack that kick that a good bun bo hue broth should have.  The prices were very reasonable, and because of that alone, it would be worth a try. I am sure my companion would give it four stars, but because my main course was no better than average, I am resigned to give it 3.  

Give it try.  It is solid noodle house that will more than take care of your lunch or dinner needs.

You can spend time your time sharing tapas on sofas, dining at tables, or enjoying your wine flight in the bar area. There is also a pet friendly patio.

Tapping the Vine...a true casual wine bar and bistro where you'll hear conversations not televisions and the ambiance is easy going. The owners Howard and Laura are awesome people and are very knowledgeable when it comes to wines. Whether novice or expert, we can help find a wine to suit your mood. The staff is friendly, courteous, warm, and genuine.  

If you are ever in the area check out some of the incredible wines, top quality beer, and very tasty food...like the Gluten Free Crab Cakes (with real crab and zero breadcrumbs)

Greeted by a nice lady with a nice smile, however, we were greeted by the awesome bartender! And my awesome I mean the worst bartender ever! This guy did not greet us, did not recite the specials as asked for, and had terrible tattoos on his hand. We had high hopes for this "gastropub" but it left a bad tastes in our mouths. Happily enjoying good beers and good company at Broadway Brewhouse!
Had the Saganaki burger with Cajun fries and a winter ale... delightful. I will definitely be back.

Characters has gone downhill... this used to be one of my favorite restaurants in town so we figured this would be fun to come back for our family GTG... boy, were we wrong!  Used to be a solid 4 stars up to 2007, but this is max a 3 star now.

Service is poor.  There were enough servers in the restaurant but ours was terrible.  Our drinks went low several times during the dinner and he didn't even know any vegetarian or dairy-free options on the menu.  One main dish came much later than the others and he had difficulty splitting the bill and put incorrect items together, even after we divided it up for him!  Duh.

In terms of the food, the bread service is now gone.  They do this french fry and potato chip with miso gravy instead which is pretty tasty.  The food itself was OK.  My beef tenderloin was quite nice and the meat was very flavorful with nice presentation.  Other dishes ordered were the duck (great feedback around the table) and a few pasta options (average).

For dessert, the chocolate belgian waffle with ice cream and chocolate dipped oranges sounded like a no-brainer for me... unfortunately, the batter they used made the waffle quite dry so it didn't have the crisp shell and light interior that I usually like.

All in all, a big disappointment to come back to what used to be one of my favorite restos when I lived in Edmonton.  Perhaps I've become a Vancouver snob, but this is definitely skippable, especially when your entrees are $35-$40 each.

When the bartender is on her phone picking her fantasy football team and not making drinks - bar fail. You can't have a business run by hipsters, it's just not a realistic model. There are about 100 better places to go here in the city, so skip this one.

This place used to have ok pizza, good cheesesteaks, and awesome hoagies.  Cheap too.  Have gone a few times after Mike(the old cook) left...  Just not the same anymore.  Now it tastes like what I can get home in Virginia. Prices are still cheap, but when I'm in Philly, il be going elsewhere.  Marinucci's for hoagies and Frusco's or Steve's for cheesesteaks... until I find something better.

We wanted to try something new and The Station was close to home. We won't be going back! The service was horrible. Our waitress was rude and never smiled once. The ticket says her name as Kazsalea? When she came to ask us if we were ready to order she walked away before I could order our appetizer. When asked questions about menu she answered like we were idiots. Our appetizer was cold and we had to ask another waiter to fix the problem because she would not pay attention to the full plate of food sitting on the edge of the table. And needless to say the nachos need some work. Described in the menu as house made chips but clearly out of a bag, topped with cold cheese and iceberg lettuce. YUMMY. She seemed to be complaining to all the other servers when she was putting in orders. It clearly was not just our opinion because we heard the table behind us say they would never come back. I turned out to agree with them. They had been waiting forever to get their check and had two young children ready to leave. They had the same server and they said she was so rude and felt like she had a chip on her shoulder. When their check was brought to them it was just sat on the table with no thank you or anything. I am really sad that we can't get a good place in this spot. We really need a great place in this area. I'm sure if you are just coming to drink it would be alright but don't waste your time for the dinner experience.

Come on 2011 and the smoke-free law! I took one step into Blueberry Hill and was awash in smoke. So disgusting. Especially for a place that is as much a restaurant as it is a bar. But my brother wanted to eat there for his birthday, so I went. It is a pretty cool place minus the smoke and the hipster at the door with a slight attitude who carded me for no apparent reason. Especially when my 19 year old brother just waltzed right by him. (??)

I do really like the tall booths and the collection of stuff on the walls. I usually stick with the grilled cheese, which is good, but I need to try their hamburgers because they look great. And everyone I've been with has raved about them. I especially like that they offer a 5 oz. and a 7 oz. so you have the option of getting a slightly smaller burger. And our server last night was incredibly nice. I'll probably be back once the smoke has had a chance to clear.

Absolutely love this restaurant! Staff is fabulous and the food n wine are delightful!

Ordered enough truffled cheese and wine to last a lifetime, but just couldn't resist!

Two thumbs up and a def repeat customer!

I seem to always miss their food truck at places so I'm very glad they have a brick and mortar place. The location is small but cozy. It's very bright and all of the wood tables and light fixtures are all very well done. Upon walking in we were greeted by the happy owners and they explained the menu and what are the fan favorites. After reviewing their chalkboard menu and a long conversation on to order (so many options!). We chose to do an order of wings, a lamb sausage, a chicken verde sausage, a order of load fries (because regular fries were not going to cut it) and a house made bottle cocktail. Yes we over did it but it is completely worth it.

First off, the wings are incredible. Large wings that are perfectly crispy and covered with a sauce similar to Alabama white bbq sauce. The sausages were both fantastic. A nice crunch from the casing and they were juicy and full of flavor. The buns were toasted which was a nice little touch. The hand cut fries were also nothing short of amazing as well. Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside. They were salted perfectly and then they were smothered in cheese and covered with bacon crumbles. 

Overall this was a great experience from walking in the door to walking out the door. Being welcome with owners who are happy and proud of their work makes the experience so much better! We will return for sure, there are many more sausages we have to try!
Staff is very friendly and accommodating. Yousel is the best -- very nice and helpful. Food is good. They have vegan cheese and gluten- free options!

So I went here today for the first time on my brother's recommendation, though he had never been himself. I guess he had heard good things from a number of people, and seeing as how he's a vegetarian, learned that this place was extremely vegetarian friendly--and is it!

Rudy, the man behind the counter, is freakin' awesome. It seems that nothing will make this man happier than to ensure that you have an amazing meal and that its exactly what you want. The menu is very extensive--far moreso than what the website implies--and you have nearly infinite options to choose from. Rudy is the guy who's gonna help you navigate, and he's very good at his job.

The vegetarian options at this place are ridiculous. Ive had soy chorizo before, and have even been to one mexican restaurant that offered it as an option, but that is just the beginning for these guys. Try vegan pozole! Or how about soy green chile? Ok, here's one I guarantee nobody's ever seen before: soy chicharrones! I mean, wow! But it doesnt stop there. Of course they have calabacitas, napolitos, and lots of other veggie and non-lard-infused dishes as well.

My brother wanted to try an assortment of vegetarian options, and Rudy was happy to make some suggestions. Finally, he settled on Napolitos (cactus) enchiladas, soya verde taco, and a calabacitas (zucchini) tostada combo which came with rice beans and chips & salsa. I was in the mood for chicken and just had to order the dish by which I judge many Mexican restaurants: a chicken chimichanga, enchilada style. I know chimis are not exactly truly mexican, but its got more to do with the filling and the enchilada sauce than it does the whole fried burrito thing. They do their chicken 3 ways: Plain, Ranchero, and uhm...something else. I went ranchero which had onion, tomato, and green chiles along with the shredded chicken, and you're able to add 3 additional toppings for free. I added cabbage, rice, and cheese to mine as well. Chimi style and enchilada style are only two of about 6 different styles they offer your burrito. This is true customization here...

But wait! There's more! Last but not least, pick your size. There's 4 sizes to their burritos: Small, regular, large and XXL. I went regular because their display showing the sizes made me realize that was going to be plenty. The prices are really quite fair here, and you if you dont go all crazy with the customization, you could get a meal on the super-cheap.

I was originally going to give this place 4 stars, because my chimi was very good, but I have to admit Ive had some slightly better ones in the past. But that being said, there was absolutely nothing wrong with it and I ate every single ounce of it--and was happy to do so, I might add! But there are three things that kicked this place up to 5 stars for me: The extensive vegetarian options, the full customization approach they take towards their menu, and Rudy. I really wish there was someone like this at every restaurant I ever eat at. At the end, he remembered our names, shook our hands, and thanked us profoundly for giving him the opportunity to provide us with a good meal. Just outstanding!

One thing to be mindful of, this place has VERY limited parking, so you may have to be creative with your parking location. Really only a minor issue though, and totally worth the minor inconvenience.
Awesome atmosphere, service and way better then average food.  Would definitely recommend.

I'm very picky with Chinese and was hesitant to try places since moving to this area. I went by Online reviews and finally ordered from King House. I'm so glad I did! It was delivered super fast, was steaming hot, and delicious! I have found my Chinese restaurant.

The food was mediocre and my soda was flat -- not a good start. To make matters worse, the server was way too talkative. He was constantly joining into our conversation for five, ten minutes at a time! At first I figured it was because he was bored and we were the only people in the restaurant (we went for an early dinner at ~4 pm). Now, don't get me wrong - I greatly appreciate a friendly server and always tip them well. This was a bit much. I tried holding my boyfriend's hand (PDA, yuck, I know) as if to say "Hey, we're a couple, give us some privacy!" He wasn't getting the message.

It all made a little more sense at the end of the meal when the server refused my credit card - even though it was in the little black book - to take my boyfriend's. Hey, what happened to being impartial and taking whoever gives it to you first? No big deal. I wouldn't have thought twice about it, except that when we got the receipt back, the server had left my boyfriend a little note, including the server's name and number. ..really!?! What an annoying experience.

Went there with my friend for her brother in law's birthday dinner. It was a set menu but with ample choices.  I think I might have picked wrong though. 

The cioppino was so bland, I mean it's supposed to be a little spicy and flavorful but it was defiantely not. The scallops were the best part in the soup for sure, the shrimp tasteless, the mussels average...The sirlois was ok, and the people who ordered the lamb RAVED about it.

 I give this place 3.5 stars because I tried some of the other things, like the bread basket, OMG, the cheesy garlic bisquits were amazing. The wedge salad and creme brulee were delicious and let's not forget about the ambiance... gorgeous! But we have steak houses and great seafood in the west so I'm a picky customer, especially when the prices are as high as they are.

I would definately like to go back next time I'm in town...if I can afford it!

Omg what a great find for a local breakfast spot! The options alone are amazing. Everything from eggs and bacon to custom bagel sandwiches. Ordering is easy from the touch screen monitors. Bagels are fresh and delicious!
Although the clam chowder is awesome, they can't keep entertainment,  make me wonder why.
Wow arrived when it opened and it was ready in 15-20 minutes. Ordered the general tso and chicken garlic combos... good customer service here and fast

From what I've heard, this place will never live up to the Slow Bar.  But I was never part of the Slow Bar era, so this review will contain no Slow Bar bias.

3 Crow Bar is only a short walk from my house, and it's a solid neighborhood bar.  It always seems to attract a good size crowd, with a mix of people who are typically East Nashville.  The food is pretty good for this type of place (I like the queso, turkey reuben, and pizza), and they always have excellent beers on tap.  They also have good specials - two for one all day Sunday is my personal favorite, for selfish football reasons.  

Plus - and this is a big plus - they have the Bushwhacker.  Have you ever taken a Wendy's Frosty and put a bunch of alcohol in it?  I bet you haven't.  (And if you have, I give you serious credit.  You are some kind of mad drinking genius.)  This thing is probably my favorite drink in all of Nashville (aside from a nice whiskey on the rocks).  It's smooth, strong, sweet, AND gives you a brain freeze (literally and figuratively).  A Bushwhacker alone makes the trip worthwhile.

My one complaint is the smoke.  Even with all the garage door windows open, it's like someone just lit a carton of Camel Lights on fire in the middle of the bar.  I'm not a smoker, and smoke doesn't generally bother me, but this is a visible haze that just slowly seeps into you.  People think I smoke four packs a day whenever I go somewhere else after this place.

Regardless, 3 Crow Bar is a local favorite of mine.  Good drinks, good crowds, good times.

I was looking for a break from my conference with a quick lunch out and this place delivered great food at a very reasonable price.  The bartender suggested the soup and sandwich combo since I said I was interested in local food - I picked fowl gumbo and half a shrimp po'boy. Delicious.

Let me just say the first time we went here it was the worst experience of my life. We wanted to sit outside so the kids would not disturb people. the girl sitting us became confused when we requested to sit outside and forgot to grab any menus or any type of place setting and just sent us outside. We then, got one server who came up to us and asked if we were served we stated we were not and she walked away. Another server came to us asked if we were served we stated no, another lady asked the same thing but walked away she said okay, one moment and also walked away. We SAT there for about 10 minutes with no one coming to us. finally I became frustrated, as our children were hungry, and went inside. we found the manager who is very prompt and she was very nice and apologized profusely. 

When it was time to get our food the same thing happened the girl went to get our food came back with nothing she said let me check and disappeared. Another girl been came and we told her we needed our food she left and disappeared the manager finally came with our food half an hour after asking the same questions. 

when Initially ordering for our son the girl stated that kids meals were free, today, but for $2 we could get a frisbee that was served as the plate for the food. so we decided to purchase the $2 frisbee. But once we receive our bill it showed the full charge for the meal plus the cost of the frisbee. Advise the server of the mistake she became confused and advice you would look for the manager. About 10 minutes later the manager came out with the correct amount on the receipt. We were probably there about 2 hours just dealing with the situation, alone.

The second time we went it was much smoother. The server was prompt understood what we were asking and got our food quickly. She also refilled our drinks without us asking. 

We have used the order system for hooters through bed roxx, several other time, which was quick except for the one time the phone was broken. my husband had to call with his cell phone and placed on hold for 5 minutes before he hung up and called back.

What is it that makes a place great? Is is the atmosphere, the food, the service, a combination of all of these? I wasn't sure after I ate here. I had heard, to quote, that La Strada was "Named one of the top 10 Italian restaurants in the nation." That seems impressive, and in fact, I had thought that all of the elements that I listed above would be great, and really, only the atmosphere was. Perhaps the key here is to stress this point about its "top ten" status (in whose poll, BTW? As named in the "Favorite non-Olive Garden Italian restaurant for people who mainly eat at the Olive Garden?" poll) and then you will BELIEVE that you are eating the finest food in the country. An experiment in mind control?
The prices are reasonable, the food is good and the vibe outside is fun. They usually have live music outside and the jerk chicken pasta is amazing. The drinks are really good too.

This food is just OK. Right below Steak 'n Shake quality.

Fries and sandwiches MUST have been frozen prior to cooking -- they lacked freshness and flavor. I had the tenderloin -- would not order it again. Dry and tasteless.

We also got a small ice cream -- found it to be runny and have a strange aftertaste.

Over priced for what you get...
Food was interesting and the service was excellent!  Also great ambiance while dining.  Apparently there is more to see during the day, but I was happy with the great dining experience!

I do like this place a lot.  The only reason not to give it 5 stars is I think the average food price is a little too much and the beer prices on tap are also a little to high.  If they took a buck off across the board this place would be perfect.  Our bill settling out is around $55-65 and for 2 kids and 2 adults that is a little much for a couple of beers, 2 dinners and 2 kids meals.  Even taking advantage of happy hour and their club card, which both a good deals, still keeps the bill around that level.  

The half off bar nachos on Thursday is a real good deal though.  So if your only there for a game, couple of drinks, or to hang out, grab the buffalo chicken nachos for $5 and a couple of good drafts and they will take good care of you and your wallet.

We will likely continue to go here but as often as we continue to explore the food in our new town.

Never disappoints! Kenji catered our company, and they didn't miss a beat. Food selection was small, but that's okay because there was about 130+ employees. They brought the truck in and started serving our hungry workers. My favorite is just about everything on their menu. Be sure to check them out on Longley and get a pork taco or two! Thank you guys and keep up the great work!
Our sandwiches were AWESOME! They have definitely made their tomato soup thicker, but now it's almost marinara sauce...a little cream ain't hurt nobodyyyyyyyyy

Pretty nice place to hangout with family and friends. I would prefer if the tables were  more family friendly and private. Our waiter unfortunately wasn't the best, seemed a little lost  (maybe a bad day?). Service was friendly, our cook was entertaining. Tons of food and great vibes. Would come back!

Everytime I come here I ask myself why its been so long. I studied abroad in Thessaloniki and get home sick all the time. When I walk in, it feels like a tavern we used to frequent around the corner from my apartment. 
      Do yourself a favor and order the grilled octopus and whole snapper. Add a carafe of Retsina with a splash of coke.
      This particular time I had the pleasure of having Evelyn as our server. She was wonderful throughout our whole experience. I accidently ordered incorrectly (absolutely my fault) and she still fixed it for us. The staff as a whole seemed to work as a team and we're helping eachother out the entire time. Being ex hospitality I truly appreciate the way she handled my mistake. I hope the management knows how wonderful their staff is! Thank you Mykonos, I will be back soon!

Sushi Sake is a good, local place to get sushi. I've gotten sushi here twice and both times have been good, but the second left a little to be desired. Both times I got a California roll - the first time was pretty good, but the second time the avocado was too mushy which ruined the roll. However, I have also ordered the fantasy roll with shrimp and cucumber, which has been consistently good. Overall, Sushi Sake is pretty good and worth going to.
The best Thai take out on the north side of Indy. Delicious ingredients, saucy noodles, lots of flavor. So glad to have found a Thai place I love close to home.

Walked in yesterday a little after noon with my little girl and was greeted almost immediately by a very friendly young lady. This was our first time dining here, so was just a little worried. The waitress approached us within a few mins and was extremely friendly. She gave us some time to look over the menu, but also told me the daily specials,  which was nice. The food was well priced and came out in a timely manner. Well portioned and great tasting. The service was beyond wonderful.  She kept up with us, but still gave us space. My little girls says it's her new favorite place! Hope our next visit will be just as lovely.
Food was ok, I wouldn't go back. The host or whoever gave off a rushing/hasty vibe. It was quite annoying.

The girlfriend and I are able to eat one cheat meal every week and it just so happens we saved our pick for this spot. Barbuzzo's setting is more of a modern day bar with a classy feel to it. The lighting is dim so it gives it a more private feel and the workers are all kind and very helpful. I noticed from reading other reviews that people take a look at the bathrooms so I did make a stop off at the bathrooms and you would be happy to hear that they're very clean. Me and Kate started off with a few drinks we got the sangria which was great, I also grabbed a vodka basil Lemonade and that was kind of on the bitter side. Ordered a dead man ale beer and that was pleasant. It kind of reminded me of Yuengling. For our meals we shared both the Fico pizza and the stuffed meatballs. The Fico pizza was good it has a creamy and sweet taste to it the figs made it very sweet I liked it, Kate loved it. All about preference. The meatballs were a bit of a let down, I had been anticipating these bad boys all day and sad to say the meatball tasted very harsh on the seasonings. Tasted spicy like an Italian sausage. More spicy than I had intended. Topping off the night Kate ordered the Salted Caramel desert and I got the raspberry bread pudding desert, Hers had the texture of pudding and it came in a nice size cup. I tasted hers and felt like it was a little too salty. She tore it up. My raspberry bread pudding was decent but nothing to brag about. Honestly tasted like a bowl of fruity pebbles. This all came out to $100, but we did get a decent amount of drinks. All in all this place it nice just was expecting a little more.

This seems like a chain where almost everything is frozen and little effort is put into making the food anything other than average. We started by ordering mozzarella sticks and they were fine but I could have gotten the same thing from the grocery store.  For the entrees I got a black bean burger.  It was crunchy and had a revolting taste.  The rest of the group all felt that their dishes were merely average.  The only saving grace was out attentive waitress.  I have no desire to go back, there are plenty of better restaurants in the area.

We used to come here every Sunday for years but we moved out of the area, this is first time here in  3 years!!! The same Sunday one man band guy still here and he is great!!! Menu has changed a lot. It is smaller but what we ordered was very good!!! 6 wings and a pitcher 10$!! Pretzels with beer cheese great!!! Burger was better than before!!! We ordered the drunken burger it was a special and it was nuts!!! Service was excellent!!!

The place looked cute and the service was very good. We tried the verde empanadas, they were brought to us piping hot and perfectly yummy. We ended up wanting more and reordered the same things. Even the vegan option, batata vegan was lip smacking. Overall a must try place when visiting Santa Barbara

Excellent! Service, quality, and atmosphere was on point for a great burger joint. A huge plus was how fast  our food was done. I ordered the Mushroom Cloud and it did not disappoint, at all! I love a good mushroom and swiss burger and the one I ate at Boom Burgers was juicy, cooked to perfection and loaded with mushrooms and swiss and the boom! My son had the 3/4 lb. Landmine and he said his was just what he needed after a long drive. Many thanks to the owners, staff, and chefs for making a place where my family can go when we travel and know we are going to be more than satisfied with the food!

3.5 stars. I'll round up because I'm probably gonna eat there again so I guess I'll give it a 4 star. Tried this place twice and I'm trying really hard to love it but it falls short. Wings were fried to a crisp the second time we ate there. I said I wanted the pizza crispy! Instead the wings were scorched instead of flash fried. Tasted like they salted the wings after they fried them. I could see salt crystals. Not good. Wings were better the first time, no complaints the first time). The pizza has decent flavor but it's just missing that wood fired cracker crust and I don't think they understand that so I'm just gonna stop asking for it. Their dough is very soft. If you watch YouTube pizza making reviews or if you've actually had real world class pizza you'd know that a good proper pizza dough and crust will give you a good little crispy "crunch". Great pizza is not supposed to "flop" like a limp noodle. Great pizza dough is not super soft. C'mon man get some crunch! Please for the love of pizza! Epic search for a nice cracker crunchy pizza pie.
Ate here for lunch for the first time, it was very good. Portions were bigger then I could handle!!

This place gets 5 stars because of 1.quality of service
2.the killer food 3.beer selection 3.the location 4. bowling 5.the pool tables 6.dart boards 7.the giant tv's.  The point is...get yourself in here and enjoy for yourself. Don't be greedy & bring your friends

Great place to eat! Super good quality and great prices! Staff was very friendly and professional! Would definitely eat here again! Crispiest chicken I've ever had from a Chinese restaurant! (In a good way)

Our first venture into Lilly's on Valentine's Day was not only visually extraordinary; but for how busy it was (it was packed), the noise level was very comfortable. Service was warm and efficient. The presentation was thoughtful, and our meals were delightfully tasty. We will be back, over and over, again. So many dishes still to try...

My daughter has proclaimed that The Sandwich on Main is her favorite restaurant.  My kids go straight towards the wall of chips-most often grabbing the delicious dill chips.  We usually order them the charcuterie plate to share.  I love the salads, especially that you can turn any sandwich into a salad.  Also, their chocolate chip cookies are amazing.  The service is friendly, the restaurant has unique art, and my family enjoys our meals there.

The fried chicken wings where so good man oh man I was in love I ate there 4 times during my trip. The food was so good. Everything was fresh made to order, the red beans and rice where to die for. The biscuit with honey oh boy was it good, especially when it was hot and fresh the honey butter was sweet and sticky. If I could I would be there right now.

Went here for a goodbye party for a co-worker. This place is big and well appointed, with pleny of TV's an in-door out-door bar, comfortable seating and a big fireplace. The menu has a lot of different unique items on the menu. I was boring and had the sirloin sliders, but they WERE really good. Other friends had the meatballs which they had no complaints about. The beer menu is much better than most places I've been to (sans world of beer) I think this place would be great for game watching, catching up with friends, or a date. The only drawback is the parking. Its very limited for the size of the place, but don't let that deter you from going.
Great place to see a movie. Comfortable seating Amd good food. The extra cost is well worth it

We frequent this location, because our food is consistently hot and fresh.   Service is what is, Try to avoid the kids 1/2 price night too much traffic.  Check mail for coupons.  They'll take multiple coupons at one transaction.

This place is awesome! Had no idea what to expect but I was pleasantly surprised. It was hard to not grab a dozen! 

Ended up with a sandwich and it was fantastic!

Oh my god you guys I found my people, I found my place. This is the type of restaurant I want to live in. I would like to try every single thing on the menu eventually, which, guess what? People do! The waiters! Our waitress told us that she had just gotten back from vacation (where did she go during covid?) and she tried EVERYTHING ON THE MENU this very morning. I guess she just takes one bite of each dish? I was lost in my thoughts trying to picture her doing this but super impressed. She wore her mask correctly, while attending to our table, hopefully not while sampling the dishes or things could get messy.

The brunch cocktails are like health kick infusions - mine came with kombucha - and there are so many more I want to try. Future Husband even got this blood orange citrusy beer that didn't taste TOO much like burps. 

We saw a woman at a table more than 12 feet away from us dive into the Chop Chop salad, and it looked so good so Joey asked her what salad it was (we are trying to make friends), and she told me it was the Chop Chop. I swiftly made the decision and added chicken. Future husband got spicy fajita bowl with scrambled eggs that he said were not as good as the ones he makes at home but I don't believe him. I didn't try his meal because I refrain from things that are too spicy and I was in heaven enjoying myself next to the heat lamp while people watching outdoors.

Young crowd on Mass Ave flocks to this spot. I wanted to be friends with all of them. I complimented one of the hosts on his vintage sweater, def thrifted, but no one gave me their number. Will try again soon. Yes, for what this joint is, it provides all that and then some. I didn't leave too stuffed and we got to our next apartment tour on time because the service is super speedy. This is the restaurant that changed my mind about Indy and put a smile on my face. Future husband I know you're smiling reading this right now (if you've made it this far) and I just want to say, thank you. While you're on the road traveling, I'll be sitting here sampling all the healthy cold pressed juices. And I will probably ask for them with tequila.
Edited for the mistake being fixed.  Wasn't going to argue it.
Love everything about this place! If you're a sushi addicted like me it's like heaven. And reasonably priced too.

I've eaten here on two occasions for lunch at my stay at the Tradewinds. During my first visit I ate the fish and chips that were on special, it was delicious. Yesterday I wasn't that hungry so I just ordered the fritters. They were also very good. 

My daughter had two different children's meals the cheeseburger, which she devoured and the hot dog. Both looked very good. My wife had a lobster roll wrap on one visit and a crab cake sandwich she said both were very tasty. 

Both the interior and exterior of this restaurant are relaxing. I definitely enjoyed dining here.

The absolute BEST BBQ in Tampa hands down!! The sides and the sauces are just as good as the BBQ. The ribs are smoked to perfection! The customer service here is also amazing! A perfect fit for Seminole Heights

If you are looking for some good Mexican Food and a really fun atmosphere, El Vez is the place to go. I had read the wait time to get in can get long so we went ahead and booked a table on a third-party app and we got in right away!  The service was very friendly and everyone at our table LOVED their food (in fact, we are all still talking about it). 

We started our meal with guacamole, The El Vez "original". It was some of the best guac I have ever had and they did not skimp. At our table, we had two orders of the Crispy Mahi Tacos and one order of the Shrimp Tacos. My husband, who ordered the Mahi Tacos said, "When someone asks me what the best tacos I have ever eaten are, these are them." The shrimp tacos also were a hit. 

I was so surprised at how fresh and filling everything tasted and how fast the service was. We will defintieyl be back!

I have eaten at Tela's on several occasions.  The food is always exceptional and service is outstanding.  The BEST part of the Tela's experience is the manager Karl who is always accommodating his customers above and beyond!   Thank you for giving us a great eating and shopping experience!

I'm liking Ryebread more and more every day.  I was a bit on the fence when they first opened, but the sandwiches were delicious.  Every new shop has kinks they will need to iron out, and Ryebread is doing a good job of it.  Some people complain about the prices ($7-8 a sandwich or salad) but it's not unreasonable considering the decent amount of food you get.  My boyfriend and I usually share a soup and salad and it's enough to fill our bellies.  The staff is always friendly and helpful and I'm glad they extended their hours.  Also I am in love with the gazpacho.  

My only complaint (first world problems!) is the seating is awkward both inside (why is this bench so uncomfortable and high?) and out back (never fun to sit so close to an central air system- loud and hot), but  they make the most with what little space they have.

Came here with a group of friends as we were recently visiting St. Louis.  At first, it seemed like a typical neighborhood bar.  And then the bartender/server welcomed us.. got us our margaritas (yummy and affordable!). 

Our group took a table.. and the menu was quite affordable and impressive too. The bartender took our orders, helped the vegetarians in our group make selections... then pointed us to the salsa bar!  The strawberry & blueberry salsas were AWESOME!

The food was fantastic and the service exceptional.. and the bill at the end of the evening pleasant to receive!

We'll definitely be coming back here again to get our cheap margarita & taco fix!
best brunch place in town. would recommend to anyone visiting. they tend to get busy around noon so try to avoid going then

Lesson learned on this.. stopped In for chicken sandwich baked potato -NOT the 5.00 deal cashier 1 says you can get the 5.00 deal if you get a drink) so I order chicken sandwich/ baked potato and some type of lemonade drink. Well we don't have anymore baked potatoes.. ok well give me the fries.. At the same time this other kid (Cashier 2)proceed to make the lemonade drink but the cashier 1 tells him it is some other kind of flavor . The other kid (cashier 2) takes what he has already poured and literally smells it with his nose and then say this is the lemonade flavor she wants and  proceeds to finish mixing it up.  I told him wait.. I don't want that.. you just stuck your nose in it... AGAIN who trains these people? How dirty!!!

Yay!  A Japanese restaurant in SJ that serves booze automatically makes me a fan.  My beau & I went on a recent Sunday afternoon for a late lunch and found much to like about this unassuming place.  Not only do they serve booze, but they have some nice bottles of cold sake on the menu here.  I'm all for byobs, but procuring a good bottle of sake takes some extra planning that is frequently beyond me so I appreciate a sushi joint with a liquor license.

The sashimi & rolls we had were very fresh and authentic.  Nicely seasoned rice & presentation.  They also had broiled yellowtail neck as an appetizer, which is our favorite kitchen food.  It was great.  The ramen was just ok.  Overall though, we really enjoyed our meal and thought it was the best Japanese in SJ that we've experienced so far-outside of Sagami.  Thanks fellow yelpers for the find.  My tummy thanks you too.

Eureka never disappoints! Great burgers, probably some of the best in Santa Barbara and great service. Good beer and wine available as well, with creative, tasty and fun appetizers. I highly suggest the jalepeno egg burger and truffle fries! I recently tried the slaw and goat cheese bruschetta which was also amazing!

This place is a blast!  And quite the reno staple.  I have never actually sat down in the restaurant area here, but I am a frequent customer at the bar area and enjoy their bar menu very much.  They make great drinks for decent prices (I am not a picon fan, but others rave about it).  The bar menu is inexpensive and delicious with items like wings, fries, sandwiches, burgers, and other appetizer goodies.  On our most recent visit, we celebrated my BF's birthday there.  They were kind enough to reserve some bar space for us and we had about 20 people crowded around 2 small tables in the bar, all drinking, snacking and enjoying ourselves.  They even let me bring in birthday cupcakes for dessert and were very accommodating of our large group!

I stumbled across this place on Yelp after discovering that my favorite juice company is closed on Sunday's. Going in, I had very high expectations because Good Vibes Juice Co. sets the bar pretty high. 

Walking in, we were greeted with friendly, smiling faces and hugged while saying "Aloha". Love it. That extra personal touch can go a LONG way! 

My husband and I hadn't eaten all day so we ordered a variety of items including an acai bowl, a pitaya bowl, a heart healthy smoothie, Hawaiian Punch juice, and we took a gluten free chocolate banana muffin to go.

Service was slow but I presume they are making everything fresh without any premades? 

The bowls were prepared first. They looked pretty (but not as impressive as my previously mentioned fave and not with as much of a fruit variety). The taste was good but not excellent - the frozen juice was a tad bitter.

My husband and I weren't that crazy about our juice selections. His smoothie was dominated by beets and my Hawaiian Punch tasted grassy but I don't remember the ingredients to share with you all. 

The muffin was a smudge on the dry side. 

I mean, I REALLY like the concept of fresh and healthy options but they just don't compare to my first choice. I don't wanna sit on the floor Japanese style with my shoes off staring at myself eat in a gigantic mirror - I just want a tasty acai bowl. Mahalo.

I think that Thai Select was delicious.  Reading other reviews, I see that Thai Select has been "dinged" for poor service.  Please keep in mind that as of today, this restaurant has been open less than 2 weeks, anyone that has ever worked in the restaurant industry knows that there will always be issues in the first month or so.  You cannot put a group of new employees together in a new place and expect everything to run seamlessly from day one, give them a break!

The Red Curry was delicious.  Please note that my husband and I like spicy food so he ordered a 3 (hot) out of 5 spice level and it was too spicy (for us) combined with the other spices found in Red Curry.  I would recommend ordering a 2 spice level if you like spicy and add more spices if that is not enough for you.

As for me, I ordered the Tom-Kah soup (coconut soup) and it was delicious as well.  I also ordered a 3 spice level and it was fine considering the amount of Coconut Milk used to produce this dish.

The Thai Sweet Tea was different and delicious.  The table next to us ordered the Hawaiian Rice and as you can see by the picture, the presentation was incredible.

I would definitely recommend Thai Select.  Great food in a BEAUTIFUL atmosphere.

This place is like a second home to me, as I am here almost more than my flat. 2x/wk

The staff is great. Friendly faces that always say hello. The food is great and consistent, either a slower Wednesday morning or a busy Saturday rush, the kitchen puts out delicious food, and never looks like it was thrown on the place to hurry things up.   

Try the Eggs Ben/PB&J pancakes/Rancheros/ and all the specials.  

Recently changed the menu this week, nothing to crazy, but still yum!

Now that most of the staff have served me multiple times, I cant wait to sit down and have my coffee drink delivered without me even asking for it.  That's what will set this place over the top.

One downside- the music choice, but that's personal preference. 


Thanks for the great breakfast spot-   Ice Latte with dbl shot.

I wanted to update from my last post. I've been back to Jersey Mike's a few times since my last review.  The food has been delicious.  On Friday, August 2, I went in to orders subs for work. There were five young gentleman working at the time. All were very friendly, clean, kept their gloves clean and took pride in making my order.  Not only are the subs outstanding, sometimes the right attitude goes a long way. I commend these gentlemen for some upstanding employee pride. Thank you

I went the other night for dinner with some friends. The place was busy but not overly crowded. The service was terrible. Bar rescue should come into this restaurant and help them out. We ordered a pitcher of margaritas which took 45 minutes to receive. We also asked what the price would be for a pitcher since it was not advertised anywhere. Our server said she would let us know, but never did. When the food arrived we ordered nachos, and guacamole as an appetizer. The guacamole came with an embarrassing amount of 10 chips. We had to ask multiple times for more chips which took over 15 minutes to receive. When the entrees came out, we had to send a couple dishes back. Our server was apologetic and said sometimes the kitchen messes up a meal and said she would be right back to get another dish on the menu. She never came back... When we got the bill we were charged $65 for a pitcher of college grade tequila! Not to mention that the dishes we sent back to the kitchen were still on our bill. 

Save your time and money unless you like eating crappy food. Taco Bell would have been a better choice

Get the loaded biscuits and gravy, smother it with hot sauce, and do NOT skip the espresso. I've had a lot of coffee in my life and this was probably one of the best cappuccinos I've ever had. I could have consumed 10... or more... it's that good. Omg now I want to go back and get another just typing this. Great. 
This is a place you get in line, order, they give you a number and you go sit down. I sat at the bar as I was by myself, the staff is all very friendly. Biscuits are homemade fluffy goodness and the sausage gravy was delicious, 2 over easy eggs, I added avocado, and left with a smile on my face. Good stuff.

My husband and I first ate at Campo for our 17th wedding anniversary.  The food and service were top notch.  We had several people stop by our table to make sure the food and service were ok. 

We came back with our 8-year-old daughter and she order a cheeseburger.  She said it was the bast cheeseburger she ever ate.  Even though she couldn't finish it, she growled at my husband for trying to finish it.  We ended up getting it to go and she finished it later that night.

Both experiences were great.  We will go back again and again.  Have no complaints.

I would of enjoyed this place, but I waited for 30 mins and then heared them say...."we must of lost your ticket". My rating is for service. The breakfest sandwich and beignet that my friends ordered were good. I did get my coffee and that was ok. OJ was refreshing, but out of a gallon bottle.

This place could be a really chill spot. If only the bartenders weren't so rude! There's a few that think their shit don't stink, especially this buff manly bartender. It has good food and live music. My only complaint is the bartenders were absolutely terrible!

Found this place while looking for a place to eat lunch before a tour at Eastern State Penn. Small but cute and appears very authentic. The food had a lot of good flavor. We both got the gyro platter which came with rice, potatoes, veggies, and pita bread. Decent prices. Definitely recommend if you are in the area.

Awesome place! Sit at the hibachi grills! It's worth the wait and fun to watch the cook prepare your food. And all the food is sooo good. Stir fried rice, noodles, veggies, and my hibachi shrimp. Also their sushi is awesome. We tried the crunchy and crawfish both were good. This is a must go to

If I were rating this place a few months ago it would have been a 4 or 5 stars.  I truly struggle with the 3 stars because this place has a great atmosphere, great steaks, great staff and the sides are delicious (at least the ones I've had so far).  The truffle fries are my favorite.  Plus, we live just a short walk away so we love it.  However, my wife and I took an out of state guest here this past Saturday night. My wife has looked forward to going for weeks because she LOVES the prime rib.  She gets it every time and won't even think about ordering anything else.  The meat is tender, juicy and flavorful, and the au jus is amazing.  We both have said multiple times to our friends that it is by far the best we have ever had.  However, on Saturday night when we tried to order it and we were informed that THEY NO LONGER SERVE THEIR PRIME RIB!!  We were very disappointed to say the least.  They told us it was not a great seller and they often gave much of the leftovers to their staff (lucky staff).  My guess is that they buy cuts that are too big.  Or maybe they should offer it on certain nights only.  I'm not sure what the answer is but my wife says she doubts she will go back unless the prime rib returns.  PLEASE FIND A WAY TO BRING THE PRIME RIB BACK!!!!

Again, there are many great things about this restaurant, but I don't understand how you can take one of your best tasting items off the menu.

It was alright. The staff were nice and accommodating, especially considering we were a large group who wanted the TV on convention coverage. And they were really nice about the fact that we showed up minutes before they closed. So 5 stars for all of that.

The food, however, was just mediocre. It was standard Americanized Mexican fare. And the packet of salad dressing was kinda creepy. Between 2 and 3 stars.

So we'll even it all out to 3 stars. It was an alright experience. If you're in the area and hankering for Mexican, why not.

Five years ago, this place was the first beacon of hope that rung, "hey, Jon Bon, look... this is in Indy, stick around for awhile." Now, I may have taken off for a couple years after that... but I always knew... if I returned that maybe something like this would still be around. And, lo, this exact place was still around to my delight.

Food Trucks exploded in Indy in 2011. El Taco Veloz... was around back in 2007... and they don't need trending topics or twitterering to sustain a following -- they have what everyone needs: tortillas, meat, cilantro, onions. And, they have a traditional Al Pastor spit. And, they haven't moved. They don't move. Imagine that... a food truck you know will always be there. 

Two Pastor. One Cabeza. One Chorizo Quesadilla. If you haven't soaked up your night or day with a chorizo quesadilla... give it a go. If you've never had the al pastor here... prepare for char & give it a go. 

When I roll off my Swedish futon, my heart thumps to have its blood thickened... I'm almost always drawn to having meat on a tortilla, and this time around I remembered a place that's been there longer than most places in downtown Indy, The Veloz. I suppose you could equate it to your bowl of cereal in the morning. Or, your glass of OJ. I prefer protein on an edible plate. From nearly sun up into the late nights... they're going to be there no matter the schedule you hold. For $10, you're going to fulfill two major obligations in your day: a smile and a face full of pork.
My family and I love this place.  The staff is always friendly.  The subs are always fresh and delicious.

This is a spacious restaurant/bar on the second, third, and fourth floors of large building on the main drag on Broadway. There's a huge stage for local performers, plenty of bars to get drinks from, and a fun crowd of people. It wasn't too crowded last night when we visited to get some live music on our last night in Nashville. 

The rooftop is huge, equivalent to two buildings' width. There are cozy seats and fire pits and Spring Breakers spilling drinks and gyrating and dancing poorly but enthusiastically to rap, rock, and pop music hits.

No country music on the rooftop!

At the rooftop bar, I ordered a rum and pineapple and it cost $10. The female bartender's expression was deadpan, and she moved mechanically, likely the result of a long night of the second day of spring break. Zero personality but efficient.

We did not spot Jason Aldean, unfortunately.

I love that we have AMAZING bbq less than a mile away. You can dine in or order from the bike waiter (if weather sucks like it has as of late). I suggest the BBQ sammy with fries, baked beans, or the mac n' cheese. I know, I know, I rarely eat my sacred mac n' cheese when I dine out, because honestly, most places suck and I am pissed I paid for it. Not here, this cheese is perfectly choosen with flavor and elasticity. I'm a huge fan of it all, now go, try for yourself. Let's keep this amazing little gem alive and thriving in South City. Cheers!

I have mixed feelings about this place. It's small and adorable, but uncomfortable if you're part of a party larger than two. The wireless wasn't working when I was there, but the pastries and tea were great. I would go there again, but probably only by myself, since it feels a little too cramped to host a long chat with even one friend.

Wow! That Reuben was amazing! I was so surprised the texture of the Seitan was SO LEGIT! I wasn't expecting that from seitan. It the mushrooms and seitan were just like the traditional Philly cheesesteaks I remember. And omg, those fries, flavorful and fried to perfection. Aside from being a bit pricey for the sandwich and fries, it was really tasty! Definitely recommend!

If you want a subpar experience then I highly recommend this establishment! Where do I begin? First off, the hostess if you want to call her that kept on redirecting guests to the lounge even though it was clearly full. She did not take our name and lost track of who came in and when. Once we were seated it seems like things where going to get better but after our waitress took our orders we never saw her again until the food came out. When the food arrived without my son's meal the waitress did not even notice. Once my son's food arrived it was clear it was microwave and tasted like cardboard. We spent $16 on one slice of meat loaf with what tasted like instant mash potatoes. It was a Saturday and the parking lot was barely half full we now know the reason why...

Ordered takeout for dinner tonight, and best Chinese food I've had in awhile. So hard to find a good Chinese spot, but think we finally found one! the wonton soup was so good and the pepper steak was very tender, not chewy at all.  They also have sushi here and Thai food, but went for the Chinese tonight.  Def recommend!
If your in the mood for great wings that are super crunchy and flavorful this place is your nirvana

Great little place. Food was quick and tasty. Service was awesome. Bathroom was clean. Wasn't very busy on a Saturday around dinner time which was great for us but a shame for this little place. We will be back for sure.

If you like things done over the top, but not particularly good, you'll maybe love it.  I was really disappointed.  Everything was over the top and gloppy.  Their po-boys were iffy. They were out of lemons.  But, everyone else loves them and if you do, go for it.  My sister and her friend were also not impressed.

If I could rate this place zero stars I would. 

-No wait staff.
-Overpriced crappy chips and salsa (which came in a to-go bag, despite being a sit down restaurant) 
-Instructions of "order at the bar" then asks why you don't have a number yet, proceeding to require your ENTIRE PARTY to come up and show ID from outdoor seating
-Advertises 30 beers yet had only 6 written on a roll of paper on the wall
-Stood at the bar 10 minutes to get beer and above chips and salsa 
-argued with manager about his own website showing 30 craft beers

I could go on, but I didn't and walked out. Stay far away.

Not great, went there based off Yelp 4 star review.  Giving two stars, French onion soup was very very good and margarita was awesome and our server was very nice.  Steak, rolling my eyes, was over cooked  no flavor, we had to use A1 sauce, and salt.  My side mash potatoes with brown gravy was horrible, my husbands baked potatoe was nothing to write home about.  We ate in the " lounge" which was just a back room..no ambience to be found.  I would be embarrassed to recommend this to any one!!

After five years, Blu Moon is still my favorite lunch place in Indy. The constant mentions in the local media and their new expanded kitchen and dining room proves how successful they've been. Hoping for a Zionsville/West Carmel location one day!

Honestly I'm extremely disappointed. I've been to Vessel in the past for happy hour and absolutely love the cocktails and decided to test out their dinner. Any place that takes over an hour to get your food and cocktails  makes it hard to enjoy. Let alone, once we got our food, it was cold and over cooked. I would never come here again for food.

Went here for some after dinner dessert and couldn't have been been happier... Yes, there was a wait but it was quicker than expected.  I went with the bourbon banana sundae and was happy with all the delicious flavors it had to offer. I will definitely be going back for more ice cream.

Went here for a birthday lunch and so glad we did.  Everything everyone got was 5 star!  I tried the pumpkin ricotta ravioli and it was the best ravioli I've had.  For dessert I tried the lemon tart. Wow!  I can't say enough nice things.  Our waitress was friendly and knowledgeable. The busboy was on top of everything. The decor was lovely.  I can't wait to go back. Best Italian I've had outside of Italy!

This is without a doubt, the best Thai restaurant I have eaten at yet! The service, the beautiful interior, and the food exceeded all my expectations. They also serve Sushi! But, the owner Bryan is the sweetest person by giving back to the GLBT community, and he deserves a round of kudos.

I have been to both locations and am so darn happy they are in the Northwest area of town. The food is absolutely delicious, the prices are just right and the service is top notch. My wife always gets a Pita when we go, but I'm alway a Poke' guy.... I do a double scoop of Ahi and extra of a lot of things on top of it, all on top of a bed of brown rice.
Thanks Jimmys for doing what you do....

HORRIBLE & GROSS! Weellll, let's start with we were sitting near the window and the lady came over and pulled the string for the blinds and TONS of bugs and dirt fell out onto the window ledge and onto our table. We kinda laughed it off and thought, guess they don't clean those often. Then we ordered our food. I got a bonus with my eggs, there was about a 4" long wirey dyed pinkish orange hair stuck in my well done eggs. At first I thought it was an "egg string", you know, those long orangish brownish things that happen sometimes? When you grab those, they break off, when I grabbed this one, I was able to pick up my eggs! Not only did it not break, it held on for dear life! It was so gross! I couldn't even get anyone to come over and help me so I carried my eggs by the hair over to the counter and set it down and told them we were leaving. GROSS!!!! Really though, the whole place is pretty dirty, yes it is old but old doesn't have to mean bad health rating. I would NOT recommend you eat here, trust me, you will regret it and if you DO decide to go, just know that breakfast all day means breakfast all day EXCEPT: biscuits, gravy, pancakes, hash browns, corn beef hash, oatmeal... the list went on!  So what's left? Eggs?

The food was good! The Monday night music was a blast! Real good blues, and then an awesome open jam session consisting of a band of six people who never met, but sounded awesome together! It doesn't look like much from the outside, but you you must check this Place out!

This is my favorite coffee house in New Orleans. I am not really into 'fancy' coffee; I usually get a small cup of whatever is somebody's darkest roast, or at most a cafe au lait. The reason I love Luna is the location itself, the space in which you consume whatever you got, whether inside or outside. Something about the porch's design keeps air moving even in the summer, I comfortably read quite a few books out there despite the heat. Good place to work, meet people, sit and ponder the world. Reasonably quiet inside, a busy but not terrible intersection, great to walk or bike to and easy to park within a block on a side street. Just far enough from Tulane and Loyola not to be overrun with students, but close enough to be convenient to those most dedicated to the ambiance.
The bison burger was delicious, as were the Rosemary Asiago fries. Service was good too, and quick!

I saw a lot of people sitting outside.  I also saw a lot of people bowling.
The place seems to have quite a bit of stuff to entertain, long enough that someone will have more than two drinks, while here.

Friend and I walked over from downtown and grabbed a little something at the counter.   Lots of wait staff, lots of hired help, lots of people to keep it organized and clean.  Aisles are wide so no one knocks into the other.  It's spacious and cavernous.

I'm not sure about the menu.  Nothing really popped out at us, and we weren't looking to spend $30 each.. We were looking for a little something to fill our bellies before going home..
Things like a slice of date nut bread, served with cream cheese would have been nice, or how about dates and cream cheese blended and served with a slice of banana bread?  Simple, delicious, sweet..  Nothing on this menu jumped out at me.  I think there should be more $5 snacks for people just wanting to get out and be social for an hour or two.

I got the bowl of tomatillo gazpacho that I thought was very good.  The right amount of tanginess.. The right portion size.  My friend got the skillet cookie.  We were both looking for something small, something cheap, something to keep us there for an hour while we finish up our date.

I'm glad they were open late.  I'm glad there is plenty of seating so that you can find somewhere to sit and not feel like you should have brought friends along.  Sitting at the wifi counter or the food counter.. was perfect for a couple of people that wanted to eat and then go home.

Went there with a small group of friends. There was an older guy creeping around and groping women. A couple people reported him but bartenders did nothing about it. We found out later that the creepy guy was friends with the owner of the bar. The bartenders kept defending him and it was disgusting. Will never go there again.

Sat outside for dinner, as it was a nice enough day.  DH and I shared the large cut of Ribeye, ordered medium rare.  This thick piece of meat came out and was medium rare in some parts and medium in others.  It didn't seem to be a good cut of meat as there were a lot of tough bites.  Flavor was good but just a bit too chewy and tough in many parts.  Side were pretty good though... brussel sprouts, mac&cheese, parmesan fries and mushrooms.  Nothing really wow'd me at all here, so probably would not come back.

I've been to urban grub at least four times now. My friends and colleagues absolutely rave about this spot. I wanted to see for myself what it was all about.

My first visit, i absolutely did not enjoy it. The food was not that good. I had the french onion soup. It was pretty salty. I had also ordered the sausages, that was a little too much for my liking as well. The ambiance was great. I loved the vibe. We were seated by the fire so it was nice and warm. The bill was pretty high for the few things I had ordered but that's expected. I didn't hate my first visit but it definitely did not win me over. It took a while for me to give it another go yet again I continuously hear such great things about Urban Grub. Not wanting to give up on one of the most loved seafood restaurants of nashville, I decided to give it a go again a few more times. I went with a massive group of girls for my friends 30th birthday brunch. If i could point out anything, it's the service. The service needs a touch of work. It's not awful, but it's not the greatest. My most recent visit was for a late mother's day brunch. My sister and I decided to sit by the bar although we weren't given an option for a table. That's ok. We waited over an hour for the restaurant to open ( we arrived way too early) Our food was everything. Scallop ceviche, bomb. It's a must try. we order a dozen blue point oysters, SO good. We also decided on the salmon! We really enjoyed our meal. The bartender was absolutely awesome he addressed us by our first name while serving us many delicious mimosas. He was very attentive and informative over each menu and option. The only downfall to the previous visit was our last dish took a lot longer to come out than expected. I was very pleased by our recent visit. I've decided on three stars due to every other visit for that the service wasn't so great ... this last time gave me hope and we were very pleased. I look forward to my next stop and hope to update my review. Thumbs up.
Love this place! They have the best sandwiches in town. My destination to satisfy my sweet tooth!

Pork Soup Dumplings are way on point. This is the best dim sum we have had in Chinatown. I don't know what happened to dim sum garden, but it's all crae over there right now. Tom's is my go to for dim sum. I roll in on my dolo sometimes too, no awkwardness.

I've been a fan of global quesadilla company since it was a little shop on Clayton called casadilla! My favorites include the buffalo and Greek! As long as you keep making awesome quesadillas and I'll keep bringing my family for more!
Good food.  The smoked turkey was delicious as was the brisket tips.  Service was fast and friendly. We would definitely return.

Very good food, prices are a little high for the style restaurant it is, cheap chairs and tables, small and cramped, Klove (Christian radio) is always playing. All the negatives don't seem to matter after you taste the food, I keep going back its that good.

Everything we had was great! Loved loved the crab beignets, the spaghetti with shrimp was out of this world, tried the braised ribs DELICIOUS. The desserts by pastry chef Austin where to die for some of the best pastries I've had. The peanut butter brownie, the crepe brûlée, honey dew sorbet every single dessert we tried was to die for!!! The staff was friendly and welcoming. I would say if your in New Orleans you must must have dinner at La Petit Grocery.

The pint is a very classy bar and public house and a must for the younger crowd in Edmonton. Downside is how long it takes to get a drink or food (for a drink you are waiting 10+ minutes on a weekend and for upwards of half an hour). Nice staff and good vibes.

This was my second time here and I'm so happy they now have a covered outdoor patio. Had a nice dinner outside enjoying the beautiful weather. We ordered a pitcher of mojitos, the meatloaf sandwich and the 1905 salad. The food was excellent and the mojito was perfect!

Ate here for lunch and had a pretty tasty meal. This place is nothing fancy, that's for sure. But if you know what you're getting yourself into, I think it's fairly reasonable. It's kind of a good place to go when you don't worry about being messy or loud. 

Don't take anybody here to impress them or to find some sort of foodie experience. If you just want a local mom-and-pop this is a good option.

I had the white fish sandwich and was very pleased with the overall taste, the flavor was pleasant but not overtly strong. Best of all it was not fishy and seemed quite fresh. It was a tad on the greasy side but this place kind of reminds me of the pub version of a greasy spoon restaurant. That's not bad as long as you're okay with that type of thing.

I have been driving past this place since it opened for 10 months! Since the sign said "Tacos" I assumed it was another Mexican joint so I procrastinated visiting. Looked online and saw it was Venezuelan and I had to come. Mind you I live around the corner! My husband got to finally try the Patacones Ive told him about and is hooked! Very clean, well maintained and the FOOOOD IS ON POINT! I love this gem and will visit weekly now .

We picked Pub 5 for my friends bachelorette party dinner and we obviously weren't the only group to think it was a good idea. Our group of 14 was seated upstairs with two other bachelorette parties - clearly we picked a good place! The atmosphere of Pub 5 is very cozy with fireplaces, windows out the street and exposed brick. 

The wait staff was attentive - made sure to get water out for us right away while we looked through the menu. We started with the goat cheese appetizer and a week later we are STILL talking about how good that was. I had the lamb burger with duck fat fries as my meal which was just alright. The fries however were to die for - those were polished off in an instant. 

If youre looking for a casually classy dining experience, this is the place to go.
Ok food, generiske portions, and the best viet to 4th of July fire work if you can time the seating...

Came here for Sunday brunch and had the Tofu Scramble. Expectations were low for a tofu dish made by an American restaurant. It was actually pretty delicious! The tofu wasn't bland, the rosemary potatoes were the right amount of salty and flavorful, and even the English muffin was good. Still thinking of this dish everytime I try to decide on what to eat for breakfast.
Best Cuban food in Tampa! I love this place I go all the time and the service is great! Can't find a better Cuban sandwich anywhere else!
Absolutely outstanding!! Pigs & peppers appetizers- out of this world.  Brisket and turkey -excellent.
The absolute most basic sushi place I've ever eaten from. They didn't even include chopsticks.

I was looking for a brunch place, and stumbled upon this Cafe. The pictures on Yelp are what enticed me to try it, and I was not at disappointed. I would highly recommend the Sunny Puffs, and all of the staff were extremely accommodating (as my mom has a broken foot and couldn't sit at the table they originally gave us). We will definitely be returning!
Still not upgrading my review after trying to reach out to me. There is no excuse for the employees you hired.

My husband and I recently ate here. The whole theme of the place being cars was really cool. They had these old ford cars above the bars and the tires constantly slow spin like it's driving. Really cool. The food however, huge let down. Prices are kinda high for food that is just average to me. The chili was really good, but very spicy. My husband got the mac n cheese with pulled pork and the cheese sauce lacked flavor. We will go back to try other things, who knows maybe other things will be better.

I was skeptical about a Japanese/Thai fusion place when I first moved to this area, but, i must say, i was particularly impressed with Lemongrass. These days it seems like so many Thia polaces are changing owners every few months, and with that, the recipes, so my avorite spots have t change...not lemongrass. ive been going there consistently for about 2 years now. The staff is always friendly the atmosphere is relaxed and very professional,and the food is DIVINE.  Highly recommend

Came here last Sunday for brunch!

Pastaria reminds me of a school cafeteria in that the ceilings are very high and the seating is open. Beyond a fun and fresh vibe, the food makes it a fine Italian restaurant that is worth driving and Parking in downtown Clayton. I'm not sure even Sauce on the Side is worth that.

Waiter marked vegetarian dishes on my menu and put stars next to his personal favorites. I ordered a pasta pomodoro, which is one of my standard Italian dishes. Our waiter was busy and the service was very slow. By the time to the food was delivered about 35 minutes after we'd ordered it, I had to ask for to-go boxes and our checks. The noodles were chewier than is typical, but not at all bad. But my favorite part of the meal was the bread and olive oil -- much fresher and better than that at most Italian restaurants. 

It would appear that Pastaria is a great place to go with 90 minutes to burn for brunch, though I even enjoyed my rushed 60.  Next time I'm getting gelato!

I truly understand why Steak & Shake are going under.  I ordered food over the app and was given a time to pick it up.  I gave it a couple extra minutes because I wanted to make sure it was ready when I arrived.  When I say "couple" I mean not more than 5 minutes.  When I arrived, my food was not ready...of course.  AND the manager was talking on the phone while trying to work...which she was failing at miserably.  The line cook asked what was my order and when he looked into my order he discovered the manager (remember she was on the phone the whole time) had given my order to someone else...big surprise.  When I asked to speak with the manager, she kind of ignored me at first but finally did come over to talk.  She was not friendly, understanding, or apologetic at all and would not let me speak when I tried...again, very poor management.  This is not the first time I have had terrible service at this location, but it will definitely be the last.  I kept thinking this location would get better since these places are closing left and right, but that was not the case.  My advise, go across the street to 5 Guys or down the road a bit to Freddie's.  Same or better meal and much better management.  I wish I could give the review a -5.
