Looking for a good pizza in the sun city center area, we checked yelp and saw this little pizza place with good reviews.  We checked it out.  Not much to look at but wow..it is delicious and can't wait to go back.  Can't eat there..it's a take-out place or they deliver but we suggest you try it.

I went today because I love acai bowls so I wanted to give them a try.. mhmm idk I'm not convinced . Don't get me wrong it wasn't bad it just wasn't as good as other acai bowls I've had in the past either . I'm not a fan of the acai clumpiness and how it dosent melt . They don't put much fruit and it's not as fresh as others I've had . It was just overall ok and not a fan of where location is . Also pricy for the small amount they give you ...
Amazing! Had the Kvass, Borscht, Pelmemi. Was an amazing flavorful bang for my buck! I live 45 minutes or so away but would legitimately drive just to come here.

Last night we went for dinner at Three Muses, we were seated by Emma and Benjamin our waiter tended to us. One of the individuals we were with fell sick and we decided it was better to take what we ordered to go. 
We paid the tab which with tip was 100 dollars worth of food as we had ordered FIVE entrees When we got home to our surprise we had 2 orders of mac and cheese and an order of fries, the size of my hand. 

We had not eaten all night so we resorted to TRADER JOES FROZEN PIZZA. 
We would appreciate it if Kaitlin the Manager on duty would void our transaction as we paid with the kindest intention and were left completely disappointed with the service. 
When we called to advise the team, Kaitlin the manager or supervisor called me "babe" and said that they were "tapas" style menu. 
I have no idea what that has to do with the failure of service: we paid for food, we did not even receive. 

We will return in person TODAY all 5 of us to speak with RACHEL the leading manager.  

Make sure your aware of this before you sit and THINK you will enjoy the Three Muses when you might not after such experience.

Usually Asian fusion means a) deep fried, b) sushi, or c) a chinese restaurant that's trying to branch out by offering thai noodle dishes, pho soup, and a few rolls out of a how to make sushi handbook.  Thus, when my friend suggested we try Sampan, I was a little worried that all the good Michael Schulson dishes would be left at his restaurant and we'd be stuck with yet another cheesesteak eggroll, tuna tartare, and duck salad.  While there is a tuna tartare (which we didn't try out of want to be different), I was pleasantly surprised by the variety of the menu on the website.

Arriving at the restaurant, there was no wait (several tables were open -- I guess it is a Monday), but I was struck instantly by the sleek, sultry, yet inviting and Asian decor.  Think Pegu Club in NY.  I think this is the look that Chew Man Chu was going for and missed. 

For drinks, they have a small beer and wine by the glass list, as well as a few specialty cocktails.  My friend went with some iced tea thing that was a little too girly for me -- I stuck with a decent, albeit light, Chinese beer (Tiger) that I hadn't had before.  

As for food: everything is served family style with no rhyme or reason to delivery.  Which is fine, because there's no delineation between apps and entrees (ahem, another strike to Chew Man Chu -- read my review ;) ) Cheesesteak Bao get a little away from the cheesesteak eggroll trend, and alas, these are delish, with sriracha replacing ketchup, a sharp provolone adding a salty bite, and the tender, juicy meat just enough for one-to-two bites of goodness.  But these are hardly bao.  More like a softer bruschetta. 

Edamame dumplings are as everybody's stated.  Decadent (due to the truffle oil), yet a little heavy.  Are they mixed with potato?  Even if you puree the crap out of edamame, the edamame flavor isn't so light...

Chicken Buri Bap is a play on Bi Bim Bap -- moist dark meat chicken is piled on already-crisp rice, topped with veggies and a fried egg, and the egg is broken apart by the runner.  Frankly, I'd rather this was done in the kitchen -- while I would have missed the "show," our runner really didn't do justice to this dish, so I had to do a little work on it.  Furthermore, without the typical hot sauce, it missed a little of bi bim bap's kick.  I bet we could have asked for it on the side, but that's almost like asking for salt -- I just wouldn't do it at a well-respected chef's restaurant.

Speaking of salt, the short ribs were beautifully presented over lo mein with a few well chosen veggies, and some sort of honey wasabi sweet crunch that was a welcomed surprise.  But the meat was too salty and although tender, was not as moist as I expected.

Continuing our gluttony we also tried the chicken samosa -- although surprisingly spicy (it hit late and hard), the soft flaky pastry helped hold together one of the strongest dishes of the night.

For dessert, we shared the peanut butter cups -- baked chocolate cups filled with peanut butter and mascarpone.  Decadent.  Simply.

Bill was very reasonable and I left stuffed.  Frankly, several more dishes I wanted to try (which rarely happens for me), so I plan to be back.  But first, I will have to try Zama...

The staff is very welcoming and friendly and helpful if you want to find your way around the area.

The coffee/espresso is very good. 

And that bread - I have dreams about the bread and pastries!
Great salads & really cute area to sit & eat. Very enjoyable! Will definitely go again

If you have a good menu and there's nobody there to serve it, does it even matter?  Been there twice...should've of walked out given how slow the service was.  I wasn't willing to get burnt on the second try, so gave it ten minutes for at least a coffee order and then cut my losses.  This area needed a good breakfast spot and, unfortunately, still does.

The risotto was awesome and I ordered the cheese steak. Great choice btw. My daughter ordered the cheese ravioli with kalamata olives and Roma tomatoes and my husband ordered the linguini with shrimp and bay scallops. Everyone enjoyed everything!!!!

Was out shopping and asked a local where to go for a sandwich. She suggested Grumpy's. I had the southwest roast beef my bf had beef and blue cheese. Both sandwiches were jam packed with meat. The taste was great. Everything there is made that day. Owner is very nice and happy to chat.

Came here for the Mimosa Flight, which was amazing!

Ordered the grilled cheese and fries, two slices of bread and a slice of cheese that was cold. Fries were cold as well.

Service was extremely slow, very disappointed. The reviews were great, but not for us.

This place needs help or something. Went in for dinner about 8pm. It wasn't too busy but the staff left us standing at the door for a good 10 minutes. Once we we were seated we had chips before we had anyone offer to bring us a beverage. I ordered iced tea & my husband ordered a root beer. We placed our order for food at the same time we ordered our drinks. When they brought out our meal we had to ask for silverware and napkins. That was the last time we saw our server. There were only 3 tables in our section with diners at them but the whole time during our meal not one server checked on us even though they were blatantly standing around chatting with people. Dude walked by our table multiple times with my empty tea glass sitting on the edge of the table! The food was sub par as well. I left no tip as no one in that place earned one. If you stay at the Grand Sierra and are looking for good food,  go to the buffet. The cantina in no bueno!

Reminds me of all the bistros in Paris. Food was delicious, authentic, service was great. I got the duck and my husband got the trout.
Fabulous and we will be back for sure!

I like the bbq, it is combos or a la carte depending if you are used to luthers or a real place in Texas.

It's new, it's clean, but some thing I don't understand maybe the owner can respond....

Why is there brisket only on Tuesday and Friday???

It's like I always have to stop by Whole Foods and grab some brisket from there.  A bbq place without brisket is like an Autozone without oil.  There must be some strange marketing going on... Are you unsure how to make one properly?

VERY ODD!  to say the least.  You could buy from a competitor and re-sell it.  There was a certain place on Aris that did that with muffulettas....  Many NOLA restaurants have grandmothers cook for them at home and bring it to the restaurant.  (That will be our secret)

Anybody know the rationale behind this?  To artificially drive up demand like shake shack or something.
Ordered a salad for pick up per the app. Fresh and delicious! Definitely check this spot out.
Food sucked, never go here again. How can you not cook shrimp correctly. Oysters and clam chowder were good, but that's it

It is always good to have another Moroccan restaurant to go to.  Moroccan food has long been popular in Philly with its hearty components enhanced by an aromatic blend of herbs & spices.  Argana is well-located at the corner of Lansdowne Ave and the Baltimore Pike.  

Actually I didn't find the food exceptional here but everything was tasty enough and it was a BYOB so it is good on the wallet.  Apps included a large serving of falafels and a fine spinach pie.  The tagines had the usual slow-cooked consistency in the meats (tried both lamb & chicken).  However, I would prefer to have them served in a tagine itself rather than just on a plate.  The restaurant was fairly busy and there was only one waiter but he tried his best to be as attentive as possible under the circumstances.
All in all, this is a credible Moroccan eatery for those who enjoy the flavors of North Africa.

On Friday night we had a hankering for some Mexican grub. Haven't been back to this joint in awhile so we decided this was were we were getting it on. 

This time, I ordered the enchilada's Aztecas based on our servers suggestion. It's 4 chicken enchiladas topped with refried beans, green chili sauce, sour cream, lettuce, tomato and avocado. Never had a green chili sauce so I was excited to give it a whirl. 10 min or so after I ordered, bam it was on the table. These guys and gals are super quick with the food. 

Let me tell you, this dish was absolutely outstanding. The chicken was fresh and juicy, the toppings also extremely fresh and flavorful. I couldn't believe that I ate the entire plate. It was that good. To be honest, after only 2 enchiladas I was satisfied, but it was to damn tasty that I couldn't stop. I felt like a glutton, but I don't care. Diet be damned!!

If, for some strange reason, you are ever in the Pottstown area and you're looking for some good quick grub, check this place out.

First time breakfast today. Myself and a few friends. Waitress seemed rushed and a bit on the rude side. Our food arrived quickly, but the service wasn't the greatest. The food was average at best. Prices are ok don't think we'll be going back anytime soon!

Terrible dinner experience. Firstly, it took about 10 minutes for the server to arrive at our table. By that time, it was 6:03, and so happy hour prices were no longer available. Seriously. 
Drinks - GROSS. I ordered a French 75 and it came full of froth and terribly sweet. Obviously the champagne used was flat, or had been open for too long, which should have been obvious to the server and bartender based on the inch of froth in the glass. I was grossed out, but willing to overlook it initially.  
Next, they made a huge stink about us moving our drink orders from a small bar table to a dinner table once our entire party arrived. I have done this many times, in many restaurants, and never had such a huge deal made about it! In the meantime, a woman came by multiple times to remind us that this was a "VIP area" and we shouldn't take up room standing at different ends of the table and talking to each other (we had a large party to celebrate a birthday). 
The food was alright. Overpriced and unexceptional, but good, I guess. Nothing to write home about. 
When we divided up our check (we had a large party), it took 15 minutes for our server to return. When she did, she pointed out we had a discrepancy with our check - oops, sorry, here's how to fix it. Another 15 minutes, and she had run our cards. Half an hour to charge 6 cards? It was beyond awkward, and totally unnecessary. The woman there to apparently remind us how to behave had time to drop by during this time, just to ask us "how was everything," and yet our server couldn't be bothered to run the check for 30 minutes. 
In a city of exceptional food, please don't overpay here for decor and location, when service and quality is so severely lacking. 
Will NOT return, would not recommend!

I've been here a couple times. It's always great!! I had the House Omelette the last time and it was fantastic. There was a little bit of a wait, but it was hopping on a Saturday afternoon. I try to come here whenever I'm in Tampa. I recommend it to anyone who wants great food at a sensible price, and really friendly staff!!!!
Brilliant! Steamed shrimp dumplings were so good I had them twice and the duck with rice and veg was excellent too!

Came here with a group and the food and experience could use improvement. We ordered some veggie and meat dishes and the quality was low. Not a lot of meat in any of the dishes and the flavor was okay. The could be another server as we had to constantly ask for water, rice, etc. There are better options around Philly.

This is a no-frills restaurant in a big shopping center. For me the big surprise is the very extensive menu and how well they handle the variety of countries they cover. You will find specialties from China, Korea, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam. I don't know how they do it. My only gripe is that they close too early- 8PM.

This was our first visit to this Marcos.  We had very much enjoyed their pizza in another location, so thought we'd give the more local place a try.
The pizza was really good!  Lots of flavor, and done just right!  The biggest problem that we had was that it was so noisy when we were ordering that we could not hear or understand the woman who was taking our order.  We were the only customers there, but it was the loud TV, air conditioner, and not sure what else, but it was this way the entire time we were eating our pizza too. Several mistakes were made even before we got the right pizza.  Half way through our pizza, we realized we never got the salad that we ordered!
It turned out that we weren't charged for it, I am guessing that this error goes back to the noise level.
We don't expect 5 star service at a pizza place, but I have never been to one that expects you to come up to the counter to collect your pizza inside the box, and take it back to your table.  No plates or utensils were offered until we went back to the counter to request them.
  Once again, the pizza was top notch, and deserves at least 4 stars.  The service and the environment deserves about one star.  Sadly, we will not return, and we live too far away for delivery.

After dining at Villa Peru, I mentioned to a Peruvian acquaintance that I'd gone there and enjoyed it, and she responded, "oh yes -- you went to the GOOD Peruvian restaurant here!"

Her validation aside, we enjoyed our dinner at Villa Peru a great deal. When first seated, you're given salsa and a bowl of plantains and choclo (Peruvian corn). I could eat that mix all day! It was a unique twist on the typical chips and salsa, and the salsa was a spicy, smooth dip that could easily be addictive. 

We got Queso Tequenos to start; they're little fried cheese puffs served with a stellar guacamole. The creamy cheese retained its integrity inside the wonton, balancing the salty crunch and subtle heat of the sauce drizzled on the plate. 

For entrees, we got the Jalea de Mariscos (a plate of fried seafood including fish, shrimp, squid, mussels, as well as fried yucca, and choclo and citrus-marinated onions) and Arroz con Mariscos (a Peruvian seafood paella containing shrimp, mussels, clams, squid, octopus, with citrus-marinated onion). Both were excellent. The breading on the fried seafood was very light, giving them an airy crunch without any heaviness or grease. The paella was very rich and savory, but the onions provided acid and brightness to the dish. I would absolutely order either dish again! 

For dessert, we got the Picarones, pumpkin and sweet potato fritters dusted with powdered sugar and served with a lovely spiced syrup. They struck a perfect balance of earthiness and spiced sweetness; you might imagine they're the lovely, nuanced baby of pumpkin pie and funnel cake at the county fair.

Our server was very friendly and helpful, talking through the various menu items about which we inquired, and helping us pick a wine that would pair well with our selections. 

I look forward to going back for more! I intent to try new things, but the siren song of the paella may be too strong to resist. Only one way to find out!

all i can say about this place is.AMAZING. excellent service and delicious food. i have great experience working with french cuisine and this place dishes out some great art work for your palate. and they serve dinner now on friday evenings. i highly recommend ghinis. i will be there every friday!the pricing is reasonable also.
This a def must see for a drink or two! Bartenders are great, view is amazing, and beautiful people all over!

Pros: Great location in Lakeview and a good atmosphere both inside and out to enjoy a meal with friends or family. Gone here several times and the food has always come out pretty quickly and is fairly good for the price you pay.
Cons: Poor service. Recently went for brunch and put the name in for a table for 4 adults and 1 highchair. Being brunch on a Saturday, we waited 45 minutes to sit, which we expected and were prepared for. The hostess finally seats us at a very large table, TOO large, (we had to yell across the table to speak to each other) and with no highchair. Ended up having to wait over 5 minutes for the highchair to be brought out. Then, we were never offered drink refills and had to flag down our waitress to request syrup for the pancakes because it wasn't brought out with the meal. This is a consistent problem I see with this location, and I don't know how many more chances I'm willing to give it to improve.

I wish I could give less than a 1 star review. My friend and I were to meet at cafe blackbird for lunch. I arrived first and decided to go in and check it out. Not one barista or worker there said hi to me . I was probably in the cafe for a good 5 minutes before deciding to take my business elsewhere . I work in retail as well and first impressions are everything. Definitely taking this off my places of local businesses to try.

I ordered a poke bowl on Uber eats and I definitely have to say that is the best I've tried so far! They are generous with the serving portions and they're not expensive. I would definitely order from Poke Express again!

Chatham Tap was a great place to spend a Friday evening after a long bus trip.  The seating situation can be a little frustrating since you'll have to scout out a table yourself, which is only a problem if it's a full house (or close to it).  But once seated, I found the service and food to be better than expected for a pub.

My sister and I split  the hummus/lemon zest pizza as well as the spinach/avocado/goat cheese salad. Her boyfriend had a burger and we all shared an order of the portobello mushroom fries.  My only gripe was with the pizza - the crust wasn't crusty enough (too breadlike) and the unique ingredients didn't provide as much of a unique, distinctive flavor as I was hoping they would.  Service was good though, and our server always on top of making sure we had drink refills if we wanted them.
Service and food are always on point. Even when they at their busiest time the food comes quickly and is always wonderful.

Great little restaurant in downtown Tarpon. Quiet spot for lunch. Food was great with just the right portion sizes. Had the shrimp and grits, and it was the best in the area. Service was spot on, attentive, polite and anticipated out needs. Will be back again.

This is the closest thing to a perfect meal I have had in a long while. Amazing food. Great flavors. Fresh ingredients. Charming proprietors. Line was long but moved fast. And it was worth every minute of the short wait. Wish I lived here so I could come back every day!!!

This is our favorite Resturant in the parish. The staff is always friendly and the food is always amazing. The menu is so big, you will never run out of options. The fire roasted chicken is to die for. The quesadilla is perfect. And the crab cakes covered in crawfish sauce have made my life better. I appreciatethe hard work and care these people put into their jobs. Cuz we all know that the service at most restaurants in Saint Bernard is pitiful. Love ya Charlie's! Please stay open forever!

My wife and I go to quite a few restaurants in the downtown area, but had yet to visit The Eagle. The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, but was easily outshined by the amazing service and delicious food. Our server, Conner, was incredibly courteous and patient as he walked us through the menu, answering every question we had along the way. He consistently checked up on us throughout our visit and ultimately added a tremendous amount to the overall experience. The food itself was wonderful. We had a whole chicken, with mac & cheese and cornbread as sides. My wife and I tore up the food so quickly, that I'm not sure I can give a detailed description of the meal; all that I can say definitively is that the chicken was juicy, the mac and cheese was tasty, and the cornbread was ridiculous. I'd recommend this restaurant to any couple or family looking for a great meal couched in a vibrant setting.

I am so disappointed in this place. I regularly come here but the service and quality of food have steadily gone down. The pho has turned very greasy and the waitstaff is terrible and inattentive. I really wanted to keep liking it but I'm not coming back to this restaurant again.
Wonderful meal. We had the pasta special and the Boscaiola pizza.  They were delicious and the service was excellent. We sat outside and it was a wonderfully Italian atmosphere.

Stopped in on a visit to Villanova. Very impressed by the fresh ingredients and creative combinations for salads, bowls and sandwiches. 

The staff were super friendly the restaurant was large and clean and the food was great. 

The food was fast but it was a far cry from fast food.

Outstanding lobster roll!!! You can not find a better lobster roll at high end restaurants.
Hats off to you guy for a fresh and delicious lunch today in downtown Tampa!
Please come back next month.

Omg! After hearing how yummy the food and desserts are here, finally ate there a few weeks ago (late in adding my review). Preferred a pizza which was so good. Thin crust, just the right amount of toppings, hot and tasty. Desserts were large portioned and so good. I will be back, over and over again!

Valentines edition 2021! 

This place is super cool! Fairly tiny little room, super cozy with elegant lighting...basically what you would expect from a snuggly little tapa's bar. Tonight we had a set menu of either a meat or seafood platter plus some ala cart items as well..here we go

The options were both 99 bucks but with that you got a bunch of food but we decided to go seafood. Started us out with crispy calamari with a kinda tzatziki drizzled over top...dynamite! They had a nice little kick of heat you usually don't see in calamari dishes. Next were the piri piri prawns which were gigantic! Don't know what kind of shrimp growth hormone these guys were on but omg were they big and equally delivered in flavour. Some delightful crispy empanita's arrived stuffed full of veggies and shrimp excellent! Next roasted brussel sprouts with a citrus sauce. Perfectly roasted and they just get nice and sweet if done properly. Ordered a seared strip loin off the ala cart side of the menu cause why not, topped with an amazing fresh chimichurri. On the money medium rare cook but with a nice crispy charred outside. The seafood kept rolling in with 4 enormous seared scallops on a bed of cucumber slaw a little light in flavour but perfectly cooked, Ramsey would approve. Finished our dinner with a lobster risotto topped with a halibut and tuna steak. Risotto was next level, creamy yet firm, lots of cheese. Tuna was a little over cooked for my taste and halibut was really salty but still good. Polished off the night with a cherry cheesecake to die for...

Such a great experience front to back, our service was outstanding, great food, great wine, great Valentines Day meal. Would highly highly recommend checking this place out. Wonderful date spot for sure.

Cheers 

Andy

Never been into cheese but i found myself there one afternoon while shopping with the family and WOW. Some of the men that work there mmm muy bueno. I have never been sold cheese by a sexier person before.

Al i can say is since the cutie sold me some parm and provolone, I've been reading up and trying new cheeses. Thanks to that hooking smile.

The assortments they have available is amazing and you get to try whatever you want and the prices are pretty reasonable. Finding parking is just the frustrating part

Food was about ok for the price. Extremely expensive and food was not up to the mark. Have had better quality Mediterranean food.
Also, did not find a lot of vegetarian or vegan options so they have a very limited menu!

I was at Tina's yesterday for my daughter's 16th birthday.  To say it was underwhelming would be an understatement.  The service was horrible.  Beyond slow and we had to literally beg someone to bring us water.  After waiting 45 minutes we finally received our "High Tea" meal.  It was $25 a person and it was as bland and boring as it could have been.  The bathroom was filthy.  And the salt in the wound was when paying you had to select a 15 20 or 25 % tip, non of which I wanted to pay but did not want to cause a fuss because of my daughter's birthday.  Avoid this place!

This place would have definitely gotten 4 to 5 stars if it wasn't for the service. 

Came here with a friend for dinner on a Monday night a little after 7. The place is actually a lot smaller than I thought and the dining room was about 1/2 full so not that busy at all. It took a couple minutes waiting up front for someone to finally acknowledge us and get us seated.

We were brought waterr right away and a few minutes later our waiter asked if we needed anything else to drink. We said water was fine which he seemed irritated by and quickly rushed off. My friend had a question about the menu and kept waiting for the server to come by again but it took about 15 minutes for him to come back and check on us. We placed our order, two entrees and a salad, and at the time I also ordered an iced tea.

We waited for almost another 20 minutes and nothing came out. We had to flag down our waiter to inquire about my iced tea which he simply said he forgot about. Waited a good 45 minutes for our food to finally arrive. The food itself was delicious. We split a salad with baby spinach, mandarin oranges, crumbled cheese, and this super yummy orange and cinnamon vinegarette. For my entree I had the seared duck breast. The meat was slightly overcooked and a little chewy but the flavor was spot on. The accompaning sauce, sauteed spinach, and potatoes were fantastic. 

Yet not once during our meal did our waiter come to see how everything was or if we needed refills. We had to flag him down yet again to get a refill on my tea. Yet he was constantly buzzing around the dining room and could clearly see us and our empty drinks. Once done we waited for about 15 more minutes for him to finally come by and ask if we needed boxes. At that time I pulled out my groupon to let him know so he didn't have to ring up the bill twice. When I tried to hand it to him he quickly threw it back on the table and snapped that he'll take care of it later. 

When he came back with the boxes he handed us the bill and said the groupon was already on there and rushed off. Looking at the bill the discount was not applied so yet again had to flag him down. Once adjusted we waited for him to pick up the bill to receive change. He even walked by and looked at the bill and walked away. My friend eventually just went to the bar to get change so we could leave. In all the whole experience took 2 hours which is just ridiculous. Not only was it so slow but our waiter was curt and just rude. I'm not sure if I would return when there are so many other restaurants, especially in that area, that serves great food quickly and courteously.

This place is incredible. Such a great tasting healthy fresh option for lunch - my favorite is building my own bowl. Everything is amazing and I love the dressings. Not much to say other than I love it. Definitely go :)
If you like supporting your local businesses then give this restaurant a shot! I spoke with the manager a few times and they've been great!

Great fresh salads with a lot of vegetables. Not your typical lettuce and tomato salad. 
Chicken sandwiches are consistently good. And it is owned by Christians. Closed Sunday!

Got great deal on grouper and 12 of us came here. This place had great music fun lights and a cool vintage feel. We had a great time bowling and throwing back beers. 

All of the screens are touch and they have features that you can aim other lanes. It was a riot and added extra entertainment. 

As for drinks and food the tater tots are pretty much amazing. Normally I would never order these but they are known for them here with crazy flavors like "pulled pork" and "buffalo". 

Ps Don't forget to check in on yelp you get a 2 dollar beer of your choice!
Wanted something that wasn't on the menu and they still made it for me. Great way to start our vacation. Definitely will be back food was great!

Great sandwich place that has unique and imaginative flavors.  They also have an alteristic side to their brand.  I'm sorry it took me so long to give them a try.  I highly recommend this establishment!
Went to this place with my girlfriend. I'm not really into movie theaters but it wasn't too bad. The bar's a nidce touch.

We have been to the Melting Pot for many years and usually a few times a year for family occasions. So no complaints on price as we knew what we were getting into but it just seemed the portions on the main fondue was just very light with meats and seafood than in the past. 

But the failure was purely service and they just need to be much more on top of it. I think they need at least a few floater people to assist the main server when they are busy. Things like extra bread or needed items shouldn't take more than a few minutes. I don't think the server should be making a cheese fondue for another table before she brings us the few key items we requested for our current fondue so it took about 10 minutes. Upsetting...
Same thing happened with we asked for the check. 

I am sure we will come back but I hope for a better experience next time.

Don't like it at all... the place is small, and the price has just went up.. for dinner is 17.99 all you can eat, and they have another special of getting 3 rolls and 4 sushi and i appertize for 15.99 not that cheap at all. And the portion is small, i can't really find a fish it there really.....

Wow, I was expecting the Mitchell's of seafood restaurants and I got Long John Silver's. Okay, maybe not quite that bad, but the service was sub par and I can say with 100% certainty that I could've prepared my meal better. 

After a short shopping trip at West County, Matthew and I decided on McCormick's for dinner. I had heard good things about the place and figured it was worth a shot. We walked inside and I instantaneously felt snubbed. It wasn't on a verbal level as much as it was the staff's condescending "I'm looking down my nose at you" expression. We got the same vibe from the bar tender as well. Since they were apparently "booked all night" (I saw plenty of open seating during the hour we were there), we were told to find seating at the bar. We weren't exactly attended to promptly and every time I gestured for the bar tender, it almost felt as though it was a nuisance for him to assist us. 

When we got our food, neither one of us were impressed. Give the ambiance of the establishment and they way we were treated (I wasn't sure if it was that we were CLEARLY the youngest people there [no money] or that we weren't wearing any designer apparel...), I at least had high hopes for the quality and presentation of our entrees, but to no avail. Just another typical chain. I definitely won't be back.

I stopped into Beyond Bread on a drive to Phoenix to get a quick lunch. I got the Pauly's Pesto sandwich and Tomato Basil soup and both of them were very good. I would definitely recommend trying this place.

Moved out of the area in the early '90s. Gaetano's was the only pizza we ate. Moved back recently and have ordered a couple times now. God Bless the old guy who ran it a couple decades ago. Today it's a different pizza, the sauce doesn't taste as fresh and the last 2 times, the crust was burnt!!! I'm REALLY disappointed.
Love their pad Thai! Everything else is OK but I would go back again  and again for the pad Thai!

OMG these donuts!!! The best donuts I've had. I found them on this app and went to check it out when I was on vacation. Definitely worth the trip, I got the chocolate chip cookie & a cheesecake stuffed doughnut. AMAZING!!

We arrived early since we did t have a reservation and were welcomed and seated right away. The host was friendly and made good eye contact and seemed calm given a neighborhood event happening concurrently.

We were sat and immediately given water. Our server appeared almost instantly, very well informed on the menu, helpful and educated. All course we're AMAZING and I must say I'm writing this before we have received our dessert.

First we had the scallops, perfectly seared and the combination of bacon and panko led to a really nice textural experience.

It just got better even through dessert!

I came on a Thur 4:00 and there was No parking.. So I figured the food and drinks would be banging.. And well, drinks were good. I got the blood orange margarita, their version of old fashion and Oaxak straight, all good.. Food, I got the Korean empanadia and it was very saucy, but spicy, which is what I liked about it. I got the regualr nachos and they were just okay, nothing special (i have def had better), the tacos were over priced for their size( smaller then my hand). i would rate this place a better place to drink then eat, and be ready to wait for awhile...

I never write negative reviews BUT this has to be said. We went to Mother's Day brunch and ordered off the menu. For the second time in two Sunday brunch visits, our food took more than an hour to arrive. When it did arrive our "over medium" eggs were cooked hard and my wife's bowl of yogurt looked like it was placed in its bowl last night. The yogurt was an island in a pool of clear liquid. Two of our kids got the buffet and they were through with their lunch and left before our food even arrived. We asked our waitress, who was excellent, what was going on. She told us the restaurant had staffing problems in the kitchen. The place was only about half full. All they have to do is stop taking orders, and only offer the buffet! We like the staff, we like the setting, the music was great! But do yourself a favor and don't even look at the menu for Sunday Brunch. Go straight to the buffet line and enjoy!

Awesome food and service. Good place to watch the game with a cold beer or margarita. 
We had enchiladas and all different kind of tacos.

Ok the bad reviews are from salty people obsessed with the whole mask thing and not willing to hear their flexibility.  The server wore a mask and asked us to let her know what we preferred.  We are from up North and enjoyed the "freedom" of deciding and not being forced or snarled at. The room is well spaced and ventilated, there is plenty of consideration so I just didn't see any disregard for anyone's safety.  
Now for the food, it was top notch and very flavorful.  We had the signature appetizers and 4 entrees and all were amazing. I highly recommend this restaurant, you just can't go wrong.  Also, try the specialty cocktails, they know how to mix drinks to suit your palate.  We will come back again when visiting this area for sure.

The food is really good, if you're looking for a small bite. The staff seems pretty unorganized very slow service, they confused our order about 3 times & we got one of our food plate until seconds before we were ready to leave

Not very good customer service.  My order (pizza, 10 wings, cheese bread) took 45 minutes to wait.  We waited outside for a while, got bored, decided to go inside and wait, also to make sure they still were going to make our order.  There were about 6 employees in the restaurant.  They were cursing very loudly.  My wife asked them nicely to stop cursing because our 4 year old son was with us.  My son turned to me and asked "Bitch please?" , because he heard one of the employees yell this comment.  The employees didn't stop cursing when my wife asked them to stop. Very disappointing visit, pizza was ok for the price, but we will never go to another hungry howies again.

Really wanted to like this restaurant as it's a favorite of our good friends. While the service was stellar, the food was not. My steak was over cooked and very tough. My husband's salmon was supposed to have been cooked "medium" but most of it was "rare".  Most likely won't go back.

To respond to Chad - Thank you for your response. We were there tonight, July 29. I'd read lots of previous reviews that the steaks tend to be over cooked so I requested "scant Medium" hoping for medium. I got medium well. And it was truly one of the toughest steaks I've ever been served. My husband went along with the recommendation of staff to order his salmon medium. Parts of it were medium but parts were very rare. Neither of us spoke to a manager about this. I know you would have made it right if we'd asked but we were with another couple and it just would have been awkward for us to wait while another meal was prepared and then have our friends wait while we ate our newly cooked meal after they'd finished theirs.

This place is amazing. It was recommended by friends and said we had to go. We got there and it was SUPER busy (Recommend making a reservation) We were able to sit outside and ordered a little bit of everything to try and shared it with the table.  Of course the hot chicken was killer and the sides were to die for as well.  I am writing this review wishing I was back in Nashville eating here.

The service was quick and friendly. The catfish was flavorful and juicy and the restaurant is super chill. Would have loved to have sit upstairs. The muffin cornbread hit in a certain type of way. I feel like the sides are meh but the meat makes up for it.

I've dined here several times but the last two occasions we received poor service and the food was underwhelming. Very disappointing as we used to love to eat lunch here. Probably won't be back.  Not worth the money.

I have been coming to Shrimp Store for years and have always enjoyed it but after today I will never go back. We ordered our food and the server brought out just one persons order.and we asked about it she got mad and said you will have to pay for that rolled her eyes and continued to tell my daughter that she didn't have time for this. We demanded a manager and all he would do was make excuses stating everyone is just upset by COVID. Our nice lunch was ruined by the staff they were rude and when we left the same waitress tried to start another argument by yelling out "I hope your day gets better. Our day was just fine until we entered the restaurant. I will never eat their again I have never had such horrible service in my life.

Great food served hot and quickly even during mid day rush. Friendly staff was very efficient. Only thing that kept this from a 5 star review was a rude hostess named Anne who rung up my bill. Overall a very pleasant place to brunch at.

Sure it's a greasy spoon on the side of a budget motel.  The food doesn't need to be caked with cheese sauce that looks like cheese whiz.   I think you can get a respectable breakfast here if you only order aka carte.

Chao Vietnamese Street Food just opened a week ago and I was excited to see a new Vietnamese spot in Indy near my hotel (in fact it's behind my hotel).  
Since it's still new, I wasn't expecting anything phenomenal.  But I was pleasantly surprised!

The space clean and inviting.  You have to place your order at the counter and pay for it there.  The menu is small.  For appetizers, they offer egg or spring rolls.  For Pho, they offer rare steak, chicken or meatballs.  For Bun, they offer chicken, pork, beef or shrimp.  For Banh Mi, they offer beef, pork or chicken.  And for rice platters, they offer chicken, pork or beef.  They also offer Boba Smoothies with Strawberry, avocado, watermelon, coconut, mango and honey dew.

I had a serving of Bun with grilled chicken and the strawberry smoothie with boba (large tapioca pearls).  The Bun was just what I would expect out of the many Vietnamese places in Seattle, definitely meeting my expectations!  And the strawberry smoothie with boba was delightfully fresh!

I hope to visit Chao the next time I'm in town!

Grand opening is July 5. Great food and service. The ribs we're served with the sauce added andTo be honest, a little to much sauce but excellent never the less.  I was personally thanked by the owner for stopping in.  I fell the place will do well.

Overall, this place was pretty good. Some of the lighting sucks (I had to change seats as soon as I sat down because some crazy track light thing was shining right in my eyes, but I'm sensitive to such things).

The bathroom is cool, especially the trough sink, except that unisex = guys don't put the seat down. 

Happy hour drink specials are a good deal, though I don't know if I could ever ask for a drink with "kitty" in the name. I had the Smokin' Bettly's Blonde beer and the Betty's Grilled Cheese, which was delicious. My only issue is that I ordered it without prosciutto but still had to pay full price; it would be nice if a veg grilled cheese was on the menu. There were other vegetarian options available, but they were of the mushrooms/roasted vegetables/veggie burger variety that just bores me to death. 

The hosting staff seemed a bit nervously overattentive (possibly because we didn't look like businessfolk?) and the place seemed slightly too organized for the rather unorganized happy hour I attend. Our server did a great job... he was always there to ask if anyone needed another drink, reminded us when happy hour was over, patiently split our checks, and was overall very accommadating to our group.

I'd visit this place again with my boyfriend so he can try the bbq, though I probably wouldn't end up here on my own. I'd give this 3.5 stars, and I'll err on the positive side for now.

I along with a party of 14 we're seated by a hostess, only to shortly there after be informed by another staff member that our party (which was already seated) could not be accommodated. It was suggested that we find another venue on the premise in which to spend our money. We gladly obliged.

Unseating a large party, most of whom already had tabs open at the bar?

Good luck. You're going to need it...

One of the owners reached out to me and tried to remedy the situation as best as possible  for the last visit I had at the brewery. And for that I feel is the biggest token of respect. And because of that I am rewriting my review. Can't wait to go back and try some of their amazing beer again

The food was amazing! The Margaritas were even better!! The service was very laid back. I don't like to be rushed so I didn't mind, but it took kinda long for drinks and the check. Either way it was great and I would recommend trying it out!!

We ordered the super yummy jerk chicken plate and po boy. The sides are rice, which was a bit dry, and a fermented salad. Plate was missing the plantains. The po boy came with the average restaurant fries. The jerk spices were divine! Would go back to try their other food items. Take out only for now and their hours vary so call before you go. Their menu is online. The hot sauce is SUPER hot! You've been warned!
#ThankYouThursday #yelplove

Didn't get out and about until late one night and this place had the only open kitchen. The cheeseburger I had was DELICIOUS and they have mimosa buckets!!! Like beer buckets but an orange juice carafe and 5 or 6 small, one serving bottles of champagne. So cool! Great atmosphere. 2 floors (that I know of..only been downstairs), Music playing, sports on the TVs, friendly staff. Husband and I have been twice now and will be back again!

It's like being at someone's house here. 
The food is cooked to order. No frozen food here!  Hummus is very good. Lamb kebab was wonderful. Baklava is very good.

A great respite this afternoon! This restaurant strikes me as a place that takes the simple goodness of a dish and elevates it with some interesting and tasty touches. The falafel was a good example: a simple dish but well executed. The falafel was crunchy on the outside with a creamier center and it was served with a divine radish, cucumber and mint garnish that was so refreshing! The service was great - helpful without hovering. And a great atmosphere as well.

Such a fun place to visit. Besides the obvious Rocky statue and famous steps (which EVERYONE was running up), this is a great place to see some amazing art and cool off on a really hot day. We only had time to see about a quarter of the exhibits, but we took the time to walk through the Impressionist gallery, which was truly a "who's who" of the time period. The other special exhibition on the first floor was woodblock prints from the late 1800s by a Japanese artist by the name of Tsukioka Yoshitoshi. They were fascinating - not at all what I expected. Admission is a bit pricey ($20 per person) but it looked like there were multi-day and/or multi-museum passes available. We had purchased an all-inclusive deal so admission was included for us. I think I would still pay for the admission if I were to go back. There is so much more to see!

The food is amazing, but the service and wait SUCKS! I waited 50 minutes for my food with NO explanation. Informed the "manager" who said they would go "see" about my food, but walked right past me as they left the kitchen. After overhearing a cashier tell another patron there was a wait on wings for an "unknown" amount of time....I witness a COOK walk out with a huge bag of chicken as he brags about having 20 wings to bring home. I was beyond livid and got my money back. My loving gf decided to attempt to call up there, place an order, and go get it when it was finished. Lo and behold, the phone line was busy for 2 hours. Eventually we stopped trying and went to the new Helen's by Vanderbilt which was quicker and better.
Had a phenomenal experience at this location, the manager Carrie made sure we had an amazing time and went out of her way to guarantee perfect service. Will be back!

Had time before my acupuncture appointment and was pleasantly surprised by a light but satisfying meal of root/seed burger & guava almond tart. Drinking silver dragon tea actually made me think of "eating" tea leaves on a tour of Hangzhou and Suzhou. The host at the door had told me about the art gallery, and so I went to check it out afterward. Even the architecture is impressive. Best part was my server Nicholas came up as I was crossing the street and presented my hat. That would have been the third one I've lost. Thank the universe for attentive staff.

Just fabulous!! 

The only suggestion I have is more vegetables in the curry.

We found our new favorite Thai place. 

We will definitely go back!!

Let me start out by saying that I LOVED this place and I am honestly very sad to give them a poor review, but there is good reason for this which I will get to in just a moment. Their food selection is very diverse (same with the beer list!) and has never been anything short of excellent, the atmosphere is very cool and low key and the service has always been on point at both the restaurant, the bar and the pick-up room. We would frequent this place on a regular basis, until our latest experience this past Friday. 

My fiance' and I were here on Friday, 8/7/15, and we had a server by the name of Jack. Jack was a strange guy- he seemed way too comfortable with us right from the get-go calling me baby and stealing french fires off of our plates when he would come to check on us. It was a little uncomfortable, but we just chalked it up to him being overly confident/friendly/comfortable as my fiance and I are pretty friendly, down-to-Earth people and easy to have fun with. All was well and good until the end of the night when we had asked for a to-go bag. Jack brought them over to us and wrapped up my food and then my fiance's. He asked what my fiance's name was and I told him. Thinking he was writing his name on the bag, he set the bag down in front of us and walked away. He wrote "DICKHEAD Thanks for eating at Rons!!" on my fiance's to-go bag. WTF?!? SERIOUSLY??? Joking or not, that is NOT cool. The picture of the bag is posted here as well.

Needless to say, we were both fuming. We found the floor manager, Steve, and told him about it right away and showed him the bag. Steve looked at me in disbelief and I told him this way over the line and uncalled for. I explained that we are all about having fun with people, but this was completely inappropriate and that Jack did not know us at all to be joking around with us in that sort of a way. Steve said he understood and I asked him what was going to be done about it and he replied that this will cost Jack his job and then we were ushered out the door. No profuse apology or offer to comp our meal or speak to the owner, etc. 

Your employee just blatantly insulted a regular-visiting, paying customer by calling him a dickhead on paper and all we received was a non-concerned apology and were showed the door. Not satisfied with the way this handled, I called back and spoke with a female manager. She did apologize to us more than once which we appreciated and told us that this was unacceptable but we didn't need to hear the obvious stated again- the option to allow us to speak with the owner, comp our meal, or follow-up as to how this would be handled would have been the right way to handle this. Very disappointing and we won't be back.

Do you want to pay 3x for a McDonald's hamburger? Or how about the soggiest chicken paired with Holiday inn waffles? Then this is perfect! Limp fries and a clueless bartender rounded out this lovely experience. Please save yourself and find a gas station with week old sandwiches to better sustain your late night needs.

So disappointed ! Food flavorless ,pancakes so dry,I add lot on butter on them,the omelet instead of Swiss cheese they add nacho cheese,I add salt and pepper on it but still doesn't taste good,my mistake was order to-go so Bad.Ill keep going to Perkins even if is too far
I gotta say.... They have my burboun and the food is great. Ask for Chris behind the bar.... He makes amazing old fashioneds and rusty nails!

I initially found the woman at the front counter to be a little pushy and off putting. She asked if I was ready to order in quite a gruff tone. After I did so, she then directed me to sit down on a stool. When I wasn't moving fast enough she said, "you, please, sit here". 

I wouldn't say by the set up that I would ever dine in here. What would be the dining room is filled with boxes and other miscellaneous items that don't exude the kind of atmosphere that it should.

All of this aside, let's talk about my order. I got my regular go to rolls, eel and cucumber and spicy tuna. I also tried the hidden dragon roll which consisted of crab and avocado and topped with salmon, tobiko, scallion and a special sauce. The roll was good but there was a sweet element in the sauce that seemed out of place. Speaking of sauces, I've never had a spicy tuna roll that didn't include one of some kind usually a spicy mayo. I was kind of disappointed in that. 

 That being said I would definitely be willing to try more rolls from them. The fish was fresh and the prices were reasonable.

Delicious! I finally made it to Cheu after months of hearing about its greatness from my friends. 

Went for lunch and even at 1:00 on a weekday, the place was saturated with hungry lunch-goers. If you're not too concerned about where you sit, belly-up to the bar and make friends with the chef. Watch as he effortlessly prepares each dish fresh. Ask him for recommendations and then take him up on it!

To start, we had the broccoli/pork appetizer. It was solid and now has me wondering how I can re-create it at home (eating more veggies and all). For my entreé I had the cold green curry noodles. Look, I'm not a huge fan of tofu, but I absolutely loved this dish. Perfect for a humid day when the thought of hot broth makes your mouth sweat.

The chef/bartender gave us some corn rangoons to test and they were somewhat spicy and definitely something I would order with a round of drinks at happy hour (which they have, M-F 5-6:30).

I've heard dinner can be super packed, so make reservations if you're a party of 4 or less and decide to hit up the joint on a weeknight between 5-6; otherwise, just waltz in.

Stopped here for lunch one day when I was traveling for work and wanted to eat something besides the standard American lunch items. I went here alone, as always, and decided to see what they had going on. I stumbled upon this place while looking through yelp and of course had to give it a try. It had great reviews and was authentic! Walking in, I definitely saw that it was authentic since they were all Indian and had a grocery store they owned next to it. The dining area was kinda blah and didn't feel very warm, but I guess who really cares too much. This would for sure be somewhere I would like to get take out from if I come back into town again. 

For lunch I ordered a goat spicy curry and plain rice. I was kinda taken back that rice was not included, but i got it anyways since you can't just eat curry plain! So good business  strategy on their part. The curry I got did have goat in it, which I was feelings adventurous that day to try it for lunch. I have never had goat before at least not that I recall, but I'm sure my parents fed it to me sometime before that. I will say it was the best goat I have had! It was very moist and lean. I didn't feel bloated eating it, but I will say that this dish does have bones in it. The curry itself was very rich and delicious as well. I was told when i ordered it that it was a medium spicy. Tasting it I would have to say it is spicier than want you would classify as "medium" but I guess to them that's not the worst. I enjoyed my meal a lot here and  would love to get take out! Any place that serves goat is a winner in my book. I'll have to try the garlic naan as well next time I am in town!

I do not want to write about Hawthorne's because I fear that too many good reviews will result in lines similar to Sabrina's or Morning Glory! But alas, it is my duty to attest to the fabulousness that is Hawthorne's. My parents, sister and brother in law wanted to have brunch yesterday and after much encouragement from friends in the city, my husband and I opted to try out Hawthorne's. We had a table of six and although the host told us it would be 20-25 minutes, we sat much quicker than that. Our table ordered an array of things, including a falafel sandwich, creamed chipped beef, a sandwich and two make your own omelettes. Everyone was delighted with their food and its presentation. The service was a tad slow, but the ambience is such that you don't mind. You feel as if you are sitting in someone's farmhouse drinking coffee -- no one is lording over you as you sit at the table waiting for you to get up. I feel so lucky that this place is so close to our house. I can't wait to go back for dinner!

As long as you can sit in the back garden, this place gets 5 stars just for atmosphere - the fact that the food is so delicious is almost a bonus.  But it is delicious: comfort food meets creative cuisine.  I've been twice and have had terrific service both times - friendly, attentive waitresses.  I just wish they had a wider vegetarian selection - the veggie small plates were delicious, but there aren't enough of them to go more than once in a while.

The place was packed and the 2 bartenders kept leaving the bar... i think to serve the tables around the bar...leaving many still wanting drinks! I think they may ask them to do too much, or they just dont have enough servers...food is mediocre.. better than some, but not the best. .prices are too high... also was charged for a double drink, watched them pour a single in front of me... save your money!

A good lunch spot, not if you are in a hurry. Slow to get through the line. Have eaten here a couple of times due to everyone else at work. Did a to go order today for 10 people. One small bag of chips and we spent almost 90.00 dollars, we even tipped. The food taste good, though a bit pricey and if you do not call ahead the wait can be long. No Salsa bar. I personally like super burrito more but am out voted when we go here. The burittos seem good, and the salsa has a good bit to it. Agree with others, wish they had a salsa bar.
So so good! We were lucky to stumble across this little gem and I am glad we did. Food is authentic Italian and the service was wonderful. Definitely a must if you are in the area!

I was driving by and noticed the old Wingstop turned into Papa Locos. Don't worry wing lovers; Wingstop moved next door. After reading a couple of positive reviews for the fish tacos, I decided to give it a go. The dishes looked delicious, plated carefully and cleanly. To my surprise, the food quality was comparable to a higher end sit-down restaurant. The fish tacos, did not disappoint. Unlike the typical greasy, fried fish tacos, these tacos were delightfully grilled. The large chunks of smokey, flaky fish were excellent. Additionally, the salsa bar was very well-stocked and tidy. Just a warning: this is a very small place so finding a booth may be difficult at certain times. If the seating does not allow it, I recommend changing your order to take out. With the pleasant staff and scrumptious dishes, I will definitely be back to try new menu items.

----------------------------------------------
This is an update for my review ... just deducted some stars for their stinginess with their salsa containers for take-out. They will only provide you 1 small container for each entree you order. Not only the container is very small, the salsa tasted watered down. Plan to use your own salsa when you do take-out here.

My family and I were very excited to try the broken yolk cafe, and unfortunately I will not be back. We did get seated quickly, but once we got seated and our waitress came to take our drink order my husband saw that they had espresso on the menu so he asked for an americano (which is 2 shots of espresso and hot water) and the waitress looked completely clueless to what that was.. She said "we don't have that here we only have lattes".... I think she was confused so we just ordered drip coffee, and a latte then she comes back 15 minutes later and tells us "actually our espresso machine just broke" we came for breakfast and coffee.. And I understand things happen but for a place that's supposed to provide something like coffee in a breakfast establishment it was weird. So then we ordered food and we all said "if this food is great then it'll make up for everything else" food was good, not great. Our hash browns were VERY over salted and the potatoes didn't feel like they were fully cooked through. Over all not the best breakfast/brunch place and won't be back.

Annoying bartenders. No last call system. They allowed me to order a round of beers at 1:35 (2am closing time). At 140, they turned the lights off and forced us out before finishing our drinks. Impressive that they were able to have everyone out by 1:45 but annoying there was no warning of last call by the bartenders. Pretty much STEALING MONEY. A bartender also complained about a 20% tip.........

This place was good, not great. The fries were honestly better than the burger. It's a very limited menu--which was expected for this type of place--so if a burger isn't what you really want, don't come here. I think there maybe was one chicken sandwich on the menu, maybe. Service was fine. The thing that really got me was that they bring out a bottle of ketchup and aioli to each table with your food and there was a guy at the table sitting next to us that was licking off the aioli bottle and touching the tip of the bottle to his burger after biting off of it. Perhaps just putting it in some cups for people who request it would be a better option :$ Also, there wasn't a burger option with crunchy onion straws and/or steak sauce and that was really disappointing. Also, no wild options like Mac and cheese on top or cheese sauce. Like I said, limited menu, for sure.
My favorite Indian in Indy, I highly recommend the pakora appetizer and the tandoori chicken! The tikka masala is also incredible. If the buffet is an option I highly recommend!

Love this place.  I usally order a chicken curry comes with freshly baked naan  call in the order 15 min away and it's ready.when i arrive. ... spice as you like mild med or Indian.. I prefer spicy my wife Med.. After enjoying a few times, we have attempted to duplicate at home... not even close.. 
Also Best Samoso ever   OMG... huge freshly fried crisp vibrant favors with two different dipping sauces ..
Dont be shy... folks there are approachable.
Ask a question or two.

I Haven't tried the huge display of sweets. But I watched a lot of items being purchased.  Looks delicious. . 

But again will pass due to waste line .

We came in with high expectations, and left disappointed. My husband and I came to eat after a UNR football game. The inside was smaller than I expected, but there was still booths for us to sit. I ordered cheese enchiladas with a side of guacamole and chips. My husband , a carne asada burrito. He had requested extra cilantro and onion, but was told they only serve onion and cilantro with their pico. 
Once we received the food I discovered my chips and guacamole came almost nacho like. The guacamole had good flavor and I enjoyed them. My enchilada sauce was very bland and had no flavor. My husbands burrito only came with Carne asada and guacamole, no pico. I had gone up to get a side of pico but was a little surprised the burrito didn't come with rice and beans. 
They had a salsa bar which included a variety of salsa with different heat. Carrots and onions, radishes, and whole green onions. I must say, the salsa bar was my favorite part of the experience. 
I will probably not return, or recommend to  anyone.

This was amazing! I had the chicken dumplings and the Hawaiian fried rice. Crazy good. Pretty sure I'll be back. 

The restaurant is super hippy, but nice; nothing fancy, so don't go looking for this super amazing white tablecloth experience. It's down home, family style.   

Almost made it to five stars, but the flies were annoying me.

I went to this place for the first time because I was interested in the karaoke they had advertised in Clippers (a local family coupon mag).  Although the staff were attentive and friendly no one did anything about the guys who were using foul and offensive language.  I had to say something.  The guy could barely stand and they kept serving him. He kept saying "fa**ot" and his friend kept talking about "banging chicks".  I would not have stayed if my friends didn't come cause I wouldn't have felt safe.  All patrons should feel welcome.

I finally paid a visit to Central BBQ today. Having recently taken a job that puts me downtown, I'm taking advantage of all the places that Nashville has to offer. I heard about Central BBQ from a Memphis friend as one of the better barbecue places in Memphis, I was eager to try it since I've never been to Memphis before. All I know about Memphis-style BBQ is from Peg Leg Porker, which in my opinion, has one of the best barbecue pork ribs Nashville has to offer.

I'm not sure why, but Central was nearly empty the whole time me and my friend were there. The menu had several items missing, which I'm sure has to do with post-COVID supply issues. Nevertheless, I came for the ribs but I was warned that they weren't as good as the Central in Memphis.

I ended up ordering half-a-rack, half-wet/half-dry (dry rub, wet sauce) with macaroni & cheese and greens with a dinner roll. After all I wanted to compare it to the only other Memphis-style barbecue in Nashville (Peg Leg Porker).

The ribs were decent. Smoky but slightly dry. Surprising for an 11:30 lunch visit. The meat was tender and I liked the wet rub but I didn't care for the dry rub. It was too bitter for my tastes. However I did like their warm "regular" & "hot" barbecue sauces that was in a crock pot at the condiment station. I ended up dipping my ribs in both of them. They both had a nice sweetness to it that wasn't overpowering at all. The hot version added a nice warm kick to it that stayed with you through the entire meal.

The sides were a little small in my opinion. They could have been bigger. My favorite were the greens. Lightly vinegary and hearty, I added additional pepper vinegar to bring up the acidity. The macaroni & cheese had what appeared to be dry rub seasoning on it. Tender noodles bit the cheese was more on the creamier side than sharp side. It was ok.

I would definitely pay Central another visit to try other items on the menu. The ribs weren't the best I've had but they were smoked well and had food flavor. I'll probably do full wet next time if I were to get the ribs again. My friend got the sausage and cheese plate that looked absolutely fantastic. Pan fried smoked sausages, various cheeses, with a ample serving of pickle spears and pepperoncinis. I was told to try the BBQ bologna sandwich or smoke sausage sandwich next time.
This Taco Bell is pretty legit. I don't have high expectations for this American/southwest gastro spot, but this exceeds my bell expectations.
Excellent food, great service, and a really cute outdoor ambiance. The happy hour was also pretty decent.
Open till 10 my ass every fucken time i go they dnt want to take my order at 830 what kind of place is this no customer service at all

Located in Pythian Market! 

The food was really good. I tried the El Pabellon Arepas. The flavors were great but I found it very heavy. I could only finish one! The beef in both dishes was nice and tender. I gave it 4 stars because I thought the service could have been a little friendlier.

LOVED IT!! My first time in Tucson Arizona, and family members suggested breakfast at Jerry Bob's. Was among the best breakfast meals I have had in a long long time. In addition to their menu, look at the whiteboard in the back of the restaurant. On that board, I found the "create your own omelette". I got that with pancakes. It was super cheesy, super yummy!! And it was only around $8.00!!!!! That is an absolute steal for breakfast this delicious. If I lived in Tucson Arizona, I would eat at this place a lot!!

Loved this place!  Great ambience, mellow and cozy.  They seated us up on the little upstairs patio, so cute and romantic! 

Everything we ate was delicious: The Greek Salad bowl (lamb sausage, yum!), rack of lamb, and grilled duck breast.  The only thing we didn't like as much was the creme brûlée for dessert. 

Will definitely go back here the next time I'm in Santa Barbara.

I gave it one star because I had to do so.  (Would not let me leave zero stars!). We went to eat here last night and waited over an hour for our food.  I had to chase the waitress down to even get drinks and then again to tell her we were ready to order.  After ordering, we sat for over an hour!  I asked the waitress when we were going to get our food and her reply was that she had no control over the food.  How hard is it to make a taco salad and fry clam strips, chicken tenders and french fries?  When the food finally came and I complained about the wait, the guy told me we weren't  the only ones that had to wait, there were lot of people that had a wait!  Seriously?  Great customer service...not!! BTW, the food was less than average and my fiancé's clam strips were more batter than clam and half cooked!  We will not return!!  (they did comp the drinks but should have comped the entire meals!). Don't waste your time going to this place unless you have a LONG time to waste to get food that isn't very good!

What a delightful surprise! Came to St. Pete Beach with a large group of families. We picked 82 Degrees because of 1) the good reviews, 2) it was close to our hotel, and 3) they would take a reservation for 12. My expectations of the quality of food were modest and I would have been ok if it had been some version of "florida beach food" (fried everything?).

Instead, what I found was an absolutely first-rate dining experience. The service for our group of 12 (which can be a little bit of work) was excellent. Both our waitress and the manager made sure everyone was happy. Having said that, I want to save the bulk of my praise for the crew in the kitchen. Everything we ate (and there was a lot sharing going on at the table!) was bright, fresh and innovative.

So many nice surprises. I started with The Saint Smoked Fish Dip. I've lived in Florida for 50 years... There isn't going to be anything new under the sun with fish dip, right? Wrong! Short version: best smoked fish dip I have ever had. Another huge hit from the appetizer menu: Pappas Cubanos (House potato chips, chile spice blend, gruyere cheese, mojo pork, pickled okra, whole grain mustard dill aioli, crispy lardons, jalapeno). Unique and delicious! And huge... plenty to share. It would make a generous sized entree.

For main course, the folks sitting within arms-reach ("forks reach" might be more accurate) of me ordered the pan seared black grouper, red curry scallops, Grilled Summer Peach Salad, and Fig & Prosciutto Flatbread. Rave reviews for all of them.

On future trips to St. Pete Beach, I'm not going to be looking for a good restaurant near my hotel, I'm going to be looking for a good hotel near 82-Degrees!
Every time I eat here I'm just like wow this is the best food I have ever tasted in my life
Excellent food...tom yum hot was great.....staff was awesome....full bee and good drinks....would highly recommend!!!

I got the ribs, Mac and cheese and pork n beans. 

I am honestly speechless and am not going to even try to describe it.

My boyfriend got food poisoning from eating the ribs here. He refuses to eat here anymore. Only thing we get is the rice and pizookies. They are the best things here. We hate that the gourmet Mac and cheese was removed. Service was great, and you can order takeout too.
I eat here when I'm in the mood to get together with girlfriends and have a bite to eat and a good drink. I give them thumbs up for quick, courteous service and great food at an affordable price!

This is a great breakfast sandwich spot with an eclectic menu and reasonable prices. All the sandwiches are very different and offer something for everyone. I got The Special with a side of tots and it was a little over $12 with tip. Everything was served made-to-order and the sandwich was a good size for the money and the homemade sauce was a nice addition. There's a small seating area outside that's covered, but with temperatures climbing this is definitely a spot to grab something to go. Staff was friendly and service was quick. 5 out 5, will return to try something else.

I've been to Joto several times, though admittedly never without a Groupon.  Each time I try a different kind of sushi and thus far I've enjoyed them all.  I think my favorite is the Spicy Salmon.

Definitely a good spot, I just don't live in the area anymore.

Very good. We went based on yelp reviews and we were impressed. Did not expect to find a classic French place here. Small, no view, but romantic, intimate, homemade scratch food. Can get pricey if you allow it, we did, but much different than all the other seafood shacks up and down the coast. Nice to see something unique. 

The special was a flounder in a light egg batter and white wine cream sauce. Fantastic. Deserts were awesome. We will visit again.

Watched people who ordered behind me in line get their food 5-10 minutes before me.  My to-go order was two chicken tacos and yet I waited 31 minutes from transaction until my lunch order was ready.  Very disappointed as this place has gone downhill since it first opened.
Yes, yes, yes. This is the right place if you want a cocktail person's cocktail. Bring grandma

Honestly hate that I'm even writing this because I wanted to love this place. My boyfriend and I looked at reviews and pics online before going to Roy's for our first time and we're so excited! Unfortunately, we were really let down - service, food, and atmosphere. 

To start, the food.... was so bad. Cheesesteak eggrolls, yuck. Meat was practically raw inside and outside edges were soggy. The bacon/beef dim sum... I don't even know why this is on the menu the flavor was terrible and the dipping sauce, even worse. The sushi...I was able to stomach 2 of the pieces and quickly decided I probably shouldn't with how "mooshy" my roll was... fish just didn't seem fresh. 

With all of that being said, not once were we asked "how is everything?". It was blatantly obvious we didn't enjoy our food as we hardly touched anything we were served, but were still handed our entire check with hesitation or concern. 

Next, atmosphere. It actually makes me laugh because the background music was driving my boyfriend insane... same sound/ beat of the song over and over and over again....idk if it was some sort of trance music but not enjoyable for what was supposed to be a romantic dinner date. 


To top it all off, we used their "complimentary" valet ... I asked the valet guy for change, to tip him...he handed me my change and didn't say another word...as if he was disappointed in the amount I tipped? No "thank you", nothing. 

All around awful experience. We will definitely never go back.

If you're looking for a laid back place with a good beer list, ok pizza and above average sandwiches, this is a great place for you and the family. If you're looking for a place with basic, well made italian dishes and good service, try elsewhere. They do some things well and should stick to them.

We had such a great dining experience. The food was amazing and the staff was very kind and friendly! The dessert was amazing, we had the Apple cider doughnuts and the homemade ice cream! The atmosphere is so warm and inviting and the decor is so cute and they even have a place for events and parties.

As soon as you walk in, the pleasant smell of flame-broiled food hits your nose. Yum! 

The menu has pretty standard burger restaurant fare, with many choices to customize from a regular patty to chicken to a veggie burger. 

My husband ordered the Southwest Chicken Salad and ordered extra chicken. We forgot to take a photo but it was a heaping portion of chicken and salad fixings. 

I had a standard burger with cheddar and the optional pretzel bun. It was very juicy and just the right size. It could have used a little more seasoning but the taste overall was good. The fries were also crispy and well seasoned. The portion was large enough for sharing too. 

What really made our trip special was the service. Our waitress was very attentive to filling drinks and ensuring our meal was correct and we were happy. The manager also stopped by and we complimented them on the good service. 

There are a number of items on the menu that I'd like to go back to try, including the chicken Parmesan sandwich, wings, and several appetizers. We likely will be back!

Unreal good.  Probably best meal I have had in Nashville so far.  Had Crispy Brussel sprouts, Spicy Tuna Guacamole, and Blustered Baby Heirloom Tomatoes.  Has good patio area, good atmosphere, and must have good drinks by the laughter at tables near me ;-)

We stopped by for a quick walk around and I was impressed by the offerings inside. Very reminiscent of Napa Valley's and LA's market. We stopped by the charcuterie and got a cone and the portion size was a lot, so good bang for your buck. There's a nice variety of juices, seafood, pasta, etc. A great place to visit!

It is very hard to write an honest review when you like the owners and do not want to be critical.  We went here with a group of 5 and the food was far from good.  In fact it appeared that there was flour used as a thickening agent in a cream sauce. We have so few restaurants in the Land O Lakes area that we try everywhere.

My friends had went here dinner recently and really enjoyed it. So a week and half later and in need of some margaritas, we decided to visit on a Saturday afternoon. Our timing was good because it wasn't crowded. The decor reminds me of Mexico, and it's extremely colorful. We were immediately seated at a booth. The booth table seemed lower than most. The menu options are plentiful so we needed a few extra minutes to decide. I decided to get a mango daiquiri and the Locos Nachos. My drink was okay, and I could definitely taste the alcohol. I enjoyed my nachos although I felt they could use a lettuce or tomatoes or more onions and peppers. The meat was plentiful, but I felt like I was just eating meat at times.  It could use more chips as well. My friends were disappointed in their meals and drinks this visit. I'd give it a try for a second time.

Not sure how thousands of people go through here and don't provide a good review.  

It's been consistent for me and my family when we go.  I haven't had one problem at this location.  I've been coming here for over 7 years.  I can't say I'm going to do a three page write up on this location ... Or take pictures of McDonalds food however I can say the bathroom is always clean, and it has the kids play room on this location.  If your tired of the food ... Get some for the kids then walk to the Starbucks next door for yourself.  Staff has always been nice and the floors are clean.

Ok! Y'all not ready to hear about how AMAZING this place is
Location: it's off Moana right next to zpizza, very convenient parking! The place is very nice on the inside, plenty of tables, granted they just opened, but I suspect this place to get packed in the future, a lot of phone orders and pick ups!

Ok moving on.

The food! The freaking food! The whole menu is Vegan! To all of you non vegans, the best, I mean best, the best carne asada fries! You will question if you just had meat and cheese, or they just lied to you!
