Soooo I got a little carried away, I got their double burger, upgraded to the impossible burger($3 more), their normal patty is soy based but i am sure it's good too, i ll try it next time. (which by the way, was a far better experience the first time i tried the impossible burger). And yessss it's not ground beef. It's all plant based!
I upgraded to carne asada fries, $3 more. (Do it, it's worth it!
Ok the in house cheese! I have nooo idea what wizards work in the kitchen, and I got to tell you I ve tried a number of vegan cheese. This by far, was the best I ve had!

Ok I should have just stopped there, but I also ordered the nachos to go! Ummm but it was sooooooooooo good!"

Price: ok soo all that food came out to $40 with tip. But I ate for two, and did every upgrade possible. In hindsight I should have just stuck to the nachos, that would have filled me up, but you know, you want to try everything the first time around! 
The nachos, which are loaded, I mean loaded is $10, very fair prices!

Service: ok Marco (I hope I got that right) him and his brother own the place, and they are so humble and provided such great service, very professional and prompt. Typically vegan food takes longer to prepare, nope in less than $10 mins I was scarfing Down my food!

Would I recommend? Ummm go look at the pictures! 



Update:
Consistency is the biggest reason why they deserve a 5 Star! 
Same great food! Same great service, and actually I got my food faster!
Only constructive feedback is the paper-plates,  but I am sure that will change!

The girls here skimp so bad on portions. If you are going to try and be an overpriced Chipotle at least have generous serving sizes. It's good but not worth the money.  A $1.50 for a few extra Roma tomatoes. You gotta be kidding me mang. If overpriced tiny portions is your thing, this place is for you. ;)

One of my favorite go to places for lunch.  Their specials are always good as well as their steak salad!
For those of you that like beer...they have a huge tap selection that you don't always find at a smaller restaurant like this.

I was in town for a training, and ducked into Spice 28 since everywhere was totally packed when I went out for dinner. Where I'm from, Portland OR, has some reeeeeally good Thai food, so i wasn't totally sure about this place... But it turned out to be super delicious! Drunken noodles were on point, as was the Dragonfruit drink I had. Would totally come back next time I'm in Philly!
Hands down my favorite restaurant in St. Louis!! The alligator cheesecake, lobster poboy and shrimp and grits are our go to items! I cannot say enough great things about it

I was here once last year and once this year and each time the service was appalling. Service during my first visit was arrogant and this past time deserves a whole explanation. 

My mother and I were seated at 8:25pm for 8:00 reservation on a Thursday night. We had a drink at the bar while waiting which should have been comped but was not. It took nearly 10 minutes for the server to come to our table, which are very uncomfortable because if you are sitting on the wall side your neck will be close to table height. When our server finally did come by our table she was not knowledgeable and her clothes and breath smelt like cigarettes. As someone who's worked in many restaurants I am 100% positive she was taught to mint after a smoke before returning to a table. The service itself was adequate but far from friendly. 

If I never had Spanish food in Spain I'd probably really enjoy this place. I know tapas are bold and unrefined but the tapas at Amada are to heavy with butter, oil and garlic. Grilled dishes such as lamb are very good. A salmon with a foam was also very good. 

If you order the chef's menu you will not believe how much you'll get. I cannot say whether or not I will ever be back at Amada. If I ever do come back it may be at the bar to escape the downfalls of the service and I'd certainly not order any tapas.

Food was amazing as usual. Service was a little slacking. Waiter was chatty. Didn't come back very often. When asked for something it took forever for him to return. Wanted dessert after our meal but he never came to take our order after we told him. So we slipped desert and went home. Not what it used to be.

I was very disappointed by Basin. The charbroiled oysters at $12 for a half dozen sounded like a steal. But they were literally the smallest oysters I've ever seen in New Orleans. I expect that in the Midwest or somewhere similarly removed from a coast. But not in New Orleans. I actually didn't even know oysters existed that were that small. And they were gritty, too. A huge letdown.

The entrees were OK, but not great. There's a range of price points, and they're reasonable for a place on that stretch of Magazine (where checking accounts go to die). The pork & hash was tasty, and filling, which I needed after barely getting more than a sniff of an oyster. The mahi mahi was a decent piece of fish, but the risotto wasn't anything special.

The food here was good for dinner. It was strange to me that we had an 8:30 reservation but when I came to the door it said "closed at 8:30". Nonetheless we were seated. Service was great, the waitress was honest about the best dishes. They were also very accommodating when my dish has sausage on it (I didn't know) and I dont eat pork. I had the fried chicken and my friends has the shrimp and grits and various pizzas. We all finished our plates.  So basically, good food. Will be back!

A friend and I used their online order system to get two salads to-go. It was super easy to run in and pick up the orders from the designated pick-up area they provide. The salads were great! I was a little worried I wouldn't be full from just the salad but it was really perfectly balanced and filling. All the ingredients tasted delicious and I will definitely order again!

Went to my friends new pad in East Falls and her boyfriend brought in food from this place for Friday night dinner. I have been dreaming of the duck pizza ever since.  The hummus, baby green salad were fresh and DELISH. But it was the pizza that won me over. I will be back for sure.

I must say with happy hour from 230-700pm you cant go wrong. Old fashion is on the happy hour menu...thank me later! I highly suggest any of the sticky buns as an absolute go to...very tasty! Also the tater tots are fantastic.

This is my first time trying this food at this restaurant. I am in from out of town and I'm several hours removed from New Year's Eve. My husband is passed out on a Cheesesteak and I needed to order something for myself. This was a great choice the food was delicious they delivered before the expected time. Very fortunate as I did not have any recommendations other than this app

Perfect food! Perfect atmosphere, and our waitress was impeccable!! We went for my loves recent work promotion and we are going again in 3 weeks for our 5 year anniversary. I can't say enough about this place, I just love it!
Tiny hole in the wall joint but damn, the best pad Thai on the planet. They always get my complicated order spot on and make it mild enough for me to handle. BEST CHICKEN PAD THAI, you're welcome.

Overall: Great spot for a good lunch or dinner. Classy bar atmosphere

The good: Great sized menu when it comes to food. A lot of options to choose from. The food portions were good sized and the food tasted good. The service was very friendly and attentive, but we were there in the middle of the day on a Tuesday. Restaurant was clean and classy.

The bad: Not much really.

Atmosphere: 9/10
Service: 10/10
Food: 8/10

I seriously don't know how this place is getting so many good reviews. Besides my soda and nice server, everything else simply sucked. First off, we waited too long to get the pizza; there were people that came in after us that got their pizza before we did. Once the pizza finally came out, I wish it hadn't - the Cura pizza was disgusting. Almost no cheese, tasted raw, and like bad salami. Ugh..... I'm so disappointed.

As a Tampa native, my family and I have frequented this restaurant since its opening. As a group, and individually, we have decided to frequent another restaurant. The food has become less than average for the money. This mothers day we went because my mother and I have been craving the eggplant parmesan which is now no longer on the menu and no matter what salad you order, it is always wilted and lackluster. Our pasta was cold and lacked real flavor.

4.5

There's a lot of real-deal amazingness happening at Rudie's. At this point, I feel as though it's still somewhat of a secret. Yeah, people come here and I can't say this corner of Inglewood is hidden... but Rudie's isn't getting the kind of you-have-got-to-try-this love it should be. Change this. Fall's coming* and you're going to want some spicy comfort food in your belly. And if it doesn't get cold for a while, avail yourself of Rudie's outdoor seating.

But first you're going to want a beer. Rudie's has a really nice beer program that extends far past IPAs (this is a good thing). I enjoyed a Fatso Russian Imperial Stout with my meal (well, a couple). First off, I was psyched Rudie's offered this on the menu. Secondly, I was excited that my server (Wes/Wesley; awesome) told me about it. This, alone, would have made me a fan of Rudie's. But that would have been way too premature. The food is fantastic, filling and fan-worthy.

Rudie's isn't an inaccessible eatery that offers high-end dining. It's the kind of place you come with friends for an evening of good eats, drinks, a soundtrack that'll make you wiggle in your seat, and food that will make you happy. Don't get me wrong: the quality acquits itself nicely. But this ain't no place to be if you planned on being a star. I began my meal with the corn & arugula salad. I know, I know: seafood. 1.) Wait for it. 2.) After living in New Orleans, the only way I do oysters if if they're cooked and breaded. I'm not going out on a poisonous bivalve. 3.) The salad was truth. The description (arugula, grilled corn, goat cheese, sun-dried tomato, pecans, and a citrus vinaigrette) doesn't do justice to the taste. I wouldn't have thought to combine these foods but the flavor profile they add up to is serious. Far from boring, this was a bright and substantial way to start my meal. In fact, I think this salad could be a meal in and of itself. And the fact that I couldn't finish my entree speaks to that. Now, remember the outrage about me starting the meal with a salad? Relax. For my main, I ordered the jambalaya. Again, remember when I said I used to live in New Orleans? Yeah. This jambalaya was legit. First off, the portion was tremendous. For $14, I, easily, received two orders. The spice profile was just right (even if I did add tobasco; it's a habit when it comes to cajun fare). The stew was packed with fish & pork protein (andouille sausage, crawfish and white fish) and topped with fresh chives & tomato to help cool it down and add a texture to the dish. And, the rice wasn't an afterthought. Sometimes rice in jambalaya is mealy, relying on the overall flavor of the dish to carry it. Not here. The rice could stand on its own... but I'm glad it came with all the other good stuff. 

I couldn't finish it all. I tried mightily but failed. The upside is that I had a delicious lunch waiting for me the next day. If you haven't been here, come. If you've tried it before, you're due for a return visit. Rudie's adds a good deal to the seafood culture of Nashville's food scene. I'm glad it's here.

*Does it start today?

Really good food. Went for breakfast. Shrimp and grits were out of this world. St Charles Chicken and biscuits were a solid eat too. Don't be fooled by the bacon infused vodka they literally stick a piece of bacon in the Bloody Mary. Still a really good sip though.
Always a good time with laid back friendly service. Good veggie options like the mojado and super green burritos. Great range of margaritas. Come for the vibes, stay for the milkshakes.

This so called "resturant" is sorry even for airport standards. The incompatance of the employees is matched only by their disinterest in being helpful. Expect 45 min ticket times...and prepare to be disappointed when it arrives. Possibly the worst experience having anything to do with food, eating, drinking, or conversing with humans in my entire life! Great job .
Bread was fresh, chicken was amazing, and the Boba was  delicious. Service was great, I can't wait to go back!

I'm a bit generous giving it three stars, but I'm on vacation, so what the hell?

They told us we'd have to wait 25 minutes for our table, but it turned out to be three (no kidding). So far, so good.

Blue Moon on tap? Yes please! Feta-covered shrimp fondue appetizer? Yes! (FYI, by "fondue" they mean shrimp floating in butter with a bit of feta dropped in). Fresh scallops? You've won my heart.

And then the meal came...

Food was decent, but over-priced. $17 for 10 quarter-sized scallops (that were mediocre at best), a small dollop of rice (the cheapest food in the world), and a couple sprouts of broccoli? I'm on vacation, but DAMN that's absurd.

Also tried some of the fish tacos: gross. Too much liquid & different sauces, and the fish itself was tough & dry. 

At least the beer was good. I'm going to drink another while I'm deciding on a different restaurant to get dessert at. Too bad that chocolate lava melting cake looked so fkn tasty...

Did not meet expectations or the hype around this place. 

We totally didn't get it, food was more than bland and lacked any real flavour or substance. 

Two stars* because the corn and soup are good. 

Other than that if you eat Mexican and tacos a lot, this will be a let down.
Came here based on previous reviews and we were not disappointed.    Boudin balls were great , shrimp was fantastic.     Loved this place.

Delicious, delicious, delicious. Came here with a creep but the food was amazing. Perfect tapas menu for trying new things. But chances are you'll love it. Can get pricey quickly so be prepared if you want to try a lot of different things.

I frequent the El Sitio location at Fairview next to McDonalds and have never been disappointed.  

Recently I was in the area so I decided to try this location on Calle Real behind the 7/11.  

When I ordered I was the only person in the place.  After placing my usual #4 taco order I went to get salsa and Pico De Gallo.  The door to the bathroom was open and I noticed a smell similar to a gas station bathroom - nasty.  Too late now - I moved to the other side of the "restaurant" and waited for my order.  It took 10 - 15 minutes to get my order and when I sat down I noticed portion of meat was half what I normally received.  The meat was cold as well as the two corn tortillas.  The meat wasn't "Adobado" it was something else altogether.  I had asked for onion and cilantro on my taco which didn't happen, but by that time I decided to eat and run.  

(Run far, far away and never come back!)

There was nothing pleasant about this experience.

Ambiance: I was confused at first. It didn't seem like an eating establishment. There was a guy chilling in the corner, studying. And he was on and off the trampoline incessantly. It was noon on a Thursday. 

Food: we came to have a vegan lunch. And a vegan lunch we had! It certainly did look and taste like a vegan meal. Unlike the Green Fork that tastes more satisfying and appetizing. 

Service: AMAZING!! Everyone is sooooo nice here!!

Overall: I will certainly be back again to try more dishes. I haven't given up on Arnold's Way!

There was hype so we came to check it out. I don't know if I'd say it was the best burger I've ever had but it was pretty good. I loved the bun that it came on, it's specially made for The Pharmacy. The price for burgers aren't bad either. I loved their beer garden so that's where we sat. It was a good day outside which made the experience even better. I ordered their hand crafted soda which I was hesitant on but I think I liked it better than the burger.

Recently I had a big birthday but thanks to 'Rona no party. However I have wonderful friends who went to Mazzaro's and bought me their cannoli cake. OMG!   FAB-U-LOUS!!! I love good cannolis but making a cake out of them Genius! If you've never had one you just have to try it. Caution: make sure you share it's enormous and rich!

Kat was awesome!!!!! It was one of my friends bday and she recommended all these shots to us that definitely hit the spot!!!! If it wasn't for Kat I would've left the bar!! She is freaking awesome and the only reason why I will be returning!! I am from LA and heard about the legend, the myth  of Kat and decided to see it for myself !!! She had great convo , great cocktail recommendations plus the shot she poured were on point!! I will be returning for her!!!!! Haven't had the food but she said it was delicious so I will try next time.  They have Sunday brunch specials as well as Bingo night on Tuesday!! Kat thank you!! There is outdoor seating as well as tables inside.

Great steak on a seeded roll. Definitely NOT your lacking tourist cheese steak with 2 pieces of folded unchopped meat here like the others in town. Nice an full cheese steak. Well worth the money. Garlic parm fries are a must. If your active duty military or veteran they offer a discount as well.

Adorable. I walked in and it smelled so nostalgic! Reminded me of summers at my Aunts resorts in Indiana. Super cute bakery across the street that was an old drive up dinner. The smell of fresh pastries got me 

I look forward to eating her besides a latte Togo. Fun art I inside and easy parking outback. Above are condos or timeshares so they have a dock out back that I walked out and took in some morning ocean breeze. 

I highly recommend this cute little spot
Incredible little cafe. Ryan is an awesome guy. Go here for breakfast or lunch! Food is incredible!!!!!

Just had a wonderful meal, FRESH is an understatement,sashimi that must have been caught this morning, and trust me I know my fish,we catch our own most of the time. My wife had the red curry that was out of this world, and ask about the Chef's special sushi or sashimi,(which I did not know about until tonite, fresh catch of the day asian style) they had fresh Hogfish,Wahoo,Mahi Mahi,Yellow tail and more, absolutely fantastic, if I hadn't gotten so filled up I would have tried them all. Also the staff is just as nice as pie with whip cream, have a question they have no problem answering it, it's really hard for me to get very excited over a restaurant any more,I've worked in the industry for over 35 years doing refrigeration,this place is clean and the fish is at proper temp. Thanks for a great meal!

Service was good.
Atmosphere was pleasant. 
Food was ok.  Of the three meals only one person was satisfied. 
Burrito was not what we expected.  
Cardenas family meal (3 tacos and sope) was ok at best... 
Beef tacos were well relieved.
Decor was nice.

I drive 25 minutes out of my way to this chipotle cause I know they got me. Time after time they have proven to me that they might have the best chipotle I've ever had. Ingredients banging meats banging service insane highly recommend

Ordered a bunch of sides (cheese fries, fried okra, onion rings) for delivery. Took an hour and a half to be delivered and everything was lukewarm, soggy, and basically inedible. I would absolutely not order from this place again.
Didn't think it was very good.  Burger was really dry as was my wife's short ribs.  Not bad, but rather go to Scottie's next door.

Service was great, but food was very overpriced and very underwhelming. The menu was limited and they were out of a lot of things, including hummus which is a staple that we were hoping to try. Though nothing was bad tasting, nothing was really exciting either. It was disappointing to hear so much hype about the restaurant and to spend over $100 trying things and really just leave unimpressed.

Great experience!! Billie took good care of us!  I could have ordered ten different things. I love all of the plant based options too!!  We had the falafel appetizer and it was so good.  We also enjoyed the lunch specials.
Omg, carafes of sangria! Omg, white, Spanish anchovies! Omg, braised ribs. Omg, service, ambiance and locale of restaurant. WOW!

Walked over from our hotel room. Great service and awesome food. I particularly liked the dinner roll and the butter spread. I forgot to ask what were the ingredients in the butter that made it so tasty. Highly recommend this fun place. Awesome atmosphere to take the whole family after a movie night. Price is pretty reasonable.
Overpriced street food served in a manner just pretentious enough to fool you into thinking it's worth it.
The BBQ Oysters were great then the Crawfish boil was awesome. Pair with the Nola Blonde to cut the spice. Nice!

Design is great, food is tasty, and coffee is brewed delightfully.. the staff on the other hand is one of the worst in the city. 

Forget a warm friendly hello greeting or smile when you enter, these snarky people look at like you have ten heads for entering. Forbid you ask any questions at all. I almost feel bad having to ask questions because of the reaction you get. I've been here at least 50 times and every visit is exactly the same. Sadly, I have come to realize this isn't a go-to spot when family or guests are visiting town. I'd much rather brew my own tea/coffee at home than interact with this staff. 

All you moms out there, this facility is definitely not stroller or mommy friendly either, which is such a bummer considering their are so many moms in the neighborhood.

I came to Primanti Brothers for the first time and I had half price drinks which were very good! Loved the deal, 5 stars for the drinks. However, I was unsettled by the way they treated their employees who have been laid off during quarantine. It was obvious these employees were visiting and having a good time with their coworkers who they've not seen during the pandemic. I choose not to support a business that treats their employees with such lack of respect or empathy.

If you like breakfast. This is the best option on the entire strip! We had multiple breakfast places around the area and they were all very good. This one takes the cake by far and this is the only restaurant we came back to twice during our week here!

From the start walked in you know service wasn't as great but you know it's whatever. It's like Denny's on Sunday morning packed so I couldn't expect anything more. Our server stunk like cannabis and that wasn't very great. They forgot an order which include both a drink and the food. Had to grab a servers attention by whaling our arms and even then had to wait a good 2 and a half minutes. The burger is okay it would've been great if it weren't to include a whole slice of raw onion which isn't as appealing as an aftertaste in my opinion but hey I'm not other people so that's you to decide. In reality the bacon is all the same they are just different shades and disintegrate into your mouth because they were over cooked.

Board games, pc gaming and older console gaming like 360, wii universe,  Sega, 64, etc... nice and cool indoors ! Special if you facebooked them $5 for console playing and $10 pc all day. Just wish they had more PS 4 and XBox 1 capabilities. Very nice folks. Great for the kids.

This place is actually called Sisters' Pancake House.

We originally went to Milktooth to eat brunch, parked a block away, hiked in, but it turned out brunch for 2 was an hour wait.  Fed up we decided not to stay, and wound up here.

What a different experience. I parked in a parking lot in front of the restaurant, was immediately sat, was immediately waited on, and my food came out exactly how I ordered it (crispy bacon and all) piping hot and really fast.  Service was amazing, friendly, and they seemed genuinely glad to see us. The food was nothing fancy, but delicious. 

Look, this place isn't trendy, so if you're offended by out of date carpet and furniture, you probably won't love it. But the dining room was full of different races, regulars, newcomers, young, old and everyone in-between, and if you're like me, that stuff is a big plus.

Wow I can't believe I didn't come in sooner. I used to visit the old location on waters years ago... This place serves delicious food. I ordered the pineapple buns which were so soft and not extremely sweet (I'm not a huge fan of super sweet stuff) but yes I do recommend the variety of buns/bread rolls they have. The menu was massive and I had a hard time choosing what to eat because everything looked great! I ended up ordering the spicy seafood hot pot with black bean sauce and if you love lots of spice, seafood, mushrooms and whole pieces of garlic (I'm a garlic monster) it's a must try. My mother ordered the first chicken option (I forgot the name) and it was very similar to a general tso chicken dish except much much better than carry out style and had mushrooms and asparagus! YUM! We decided to also order a soup to share and the wonton soup was so good! Can't wait to go back again to try more items on the menu! Lol. Only thing is I feel like the dishes should come with rice automatically but the $1 up-charge is not a big deal.

I really wanted to like this place more. For 12PM on a Thursday afternoon, they weren't busy at all. The food came out quickly and was still hot by the time I got home. The grab rangoon honestly reminded me of a hot, crab cannoli. There was SO much filling! And the sweet and sour sauce on the side is definitely different than what you typically get with crab rangoon, however it wasn't horrible. The sushi came with eel sauce over top. I really enjoyed it! I am used to spicy mayo ontop of this roll and I enjoyed the different taste. Overall, however, I was just not amazed. I'll return to try their hibachi.
I mean, if you're hungry and don't mind the high volume of people and music, it's a great place to stop while browsing the city.

Best brunch in town hands down! 
Buffet always has great choice and attentive wait staff! Can't wait to come back again

With service and food overall, four star. The waitress was sweet. My boyfriend ordered the meatball dish which we gave that a 4. We loved the Brussel sprout from the appetizer menu-5. His salad was also good which had pomegranate-rate 4. Now it was my dishes that we didn't enjoy as much we both agree. Between 3-3.5. My salad had red beets, avocado, nuts. Great ingredients but it seem to lack flavor. My main dish was the salmon with mash cauliflower/potatoes. Healthy. The salmon was lacking flavor too. We had to add more black pepper, salt and lemon. As for the environment, look like you guys are trying to fit all age group. Weird hip hop/techno like music. We would only return because we saw someone next to us order a delicious Looking pork chop. If it wasn't that great looking like my salmon dish, I would said no.

So I was here for Downtown Dining Week. This was one of 6 places that I visited for the week. My hubby and I went here for lunch. It doesn't seem as well plated as the other restaurants we visited during this week, however the food was really tasty. We both tried something different so we could sample it all. First course - cream of cauliflower, jalapeno, and cheddar soup. Shrimp salad with butter leaf lettuce with baby shrimps and a honey mustard dressing.  The soup was amazing! If this is on the menu, you should really try it. Although everything was good, this was my favourite thing on the menu. The shrimp salad was tasty too...we were both impressed on how many fresh baby shrimp were in this salad. I really dislike mustard, so I didn't think I would like this much, but actually it was really flavourful. We both tried different main dishes. I picked the Tandoori salmon with shrimp Biryani, raita and saffron sauce. My husband went with the chicken rigatoni with mushrooms, spinach and alfredo sauce.  So I am not sure if the chef was feeling under pressure, but both dishes seemed like they were not quite finished. The salmon was tasty and the yogurt raita a good compliment. the saffron sauce  did not add to the dish, and I was really confused by the rice. First of all, I know Biryani and this wasn't it. Biryani is the East Indian version of fried rice...should be evenly mixed with spices and whatever meat and veggies are available.  This rice was a pale counterpart. There wasn't any shrimp in it,  it had a very odd colour (pinkish) and was not evenly flavoured. It seemed like the broccoli was thrown off as an afterthought.  Biryani done properly should be fragrant full of East Indian spices...not the white rice with a smear of pink as shown.  It wasn't bad tasting but definitely not what you should be expecting when ordering it. My husbands' chicken rigatoni was flavourful enough but definitely not hot enough. If you see the photos the cheese isn't melted. However, with saying these things...the portions were large, the flavours were there, just needed some tweaking.  Or server was pleasant enough and they have a very nice cocktail menu. And for 15 bucks a real bang for your buck. My verdict is that for Edmonton dining this was a great deal...generally the flavours worked well, the portions were generous, and they had a good diversity of things to try. However, I would not pay full price for these dishes (except the soup...the soup was amazing).
Cheesy dinner theatre that you grandparents would kill to attend.  If you like Wednesday night church spaghetti, this is your joint.

This is your neighborhood diner where good wholesome food is available at reasonable prices and with large portions.  It's not fancy but it is clean and the staff are friendly.  They have a full liquor license so you can add beer, wine, or a mixed drink to dinner.  I was here for a lunch and a dinner and both my gyro and prime rib were excellent, particularly considering the price.

Some of my fellow conference goers were on the hunt for a restaurant that was vegetarian and vegan friendly so after searching on Yelp we found Carmo! It was within in walking distance from our hotel so we were sold.

This restaurant has a trendy, organic yet artsy type of vibe, I loved it. I liked that you order your food first and then they bring it to you at your table. I decided to go for their soup of the day and flat bread that was topped with cheese, shrimp and tomatoes. I was surprised to see that they even had fresh fruit juices with some very unique flavors. I played it safe and went with the mango juice, it was very refreshing! The flatbread was crispy and the ingredients tasted super fresh. 

Great find in a city that you wouldn't think would be known for having great vegetarian food!

Very disappointed when going into this Wendy's.  Our numbers in Florida for Covid  are going up!  ALL of the staff were wearing their masks however they were all wearing them WRONG; below their noses or on their chins.  I watched for quite a period of time and none of the young staff were noted to place their mask over their nose.  Once home I contacted the Manager Cindy who says she is at work all the time and all
Of her staff were wearing masks.  When I told her they were  wearing them, but INCoRRECTLY, she was not forgiving and did not apologize.  She did not sound surprised or alerted and did not say that she would correct this behavior.  REALLY?!  So sad that I will not be going back.  I love Wendy's but not when it's unsafe!
Try The Taco Bell on 19, they mask, glove, pass your food to you on a tray and sanitize in front of you at the drive thru window!!!

For an iron chef I was expecting an elevated Chinese dining experience, sad to say the service was terrible and the food was meh!! The only decent dish at the table was the orange chicken the rest was sorely disappointing

Nice, solid asian place in Chinatown. Food was decent, the server prompt and polite, and prices fair. A little disappointed because the only alcohol they had available the particular night I went, was red wine.

Best BBQ I think I've ever had. Food was ready just a few minutes after being ordered. Bartender was super nice. Tried their own whiskey, that was great too. I got the nachos / machos and it was super tasty! The BBQ sauce is great too. Basically everything was great and soooooo tasty.

Being from San Francisco I have some high expectations when it comes to mexican food - unfortunately Bertha Miranda's didn't deliver. The chips were ice cold and the salsa was so-so. My chili relleno and tamale were just ok - smothered in sauce alongside re fried beans and very dry spanish rice. The margaritas were weak - made with too much sour mix and not enough tequila to taste.

Next time I'll go back to Miguel's where the food and drinks are much better

Upon first reading some negative reviews I was a little standoffish but upon my first bite of phó I was so pleased! When two people can easily fill their bellies under $15 it's one to remember for future visits!

Well, it happened again.  Went in for a couple "Hot 'N Ready" pizzas and they were not available.  OK no problem.....  10-15 minutes.  But the smug attitudes of the employees is what gets me going.  I don't have a problem waiting (even though it is supposed to be "Hot 'N Ready"), but the lack of customer care/service and attitude is UNREAL.  I don't know if it's an ownership or a management issue, but it is an issue.  I like the pizza, but I probably won't be back.  Not good service........

The food is really really good the biggest problem is that they tell you every time your food will be out in 20 minutes but expect to wait MINIMUM an hour and a half. They need to hire more people and answer their phone so your not waiting.

It's not a bad place but also nothing fancy. It loses a star in the fact that this isn't a "wing zone" Pizza Hut so the only wings your can get are basic traditional ones and no special side orders like you'll see advertised on most commercials. Kinda weird actually.
BOMB ASS SANDWICHES!!!! Definitely stop by this place- great portions, filling and delicious. Tip: dabble with their variety of breads- pressed sourdough and focaccia are so good!
Great vibe. Great food. Great Margaritas. Expansive dining room. Plenty of space. Not as tight as the Cbus location. And as always nice respect to OH-IO!

I traveled a ways because I had a taste for oxtails and found this place on Google. I called ahead of time and drove 30 minutes. Pulled up to the drive thru and paid. Thank God I opened my food before I left. For that much money I had little oxtails  with barely any meat on the bones. And that meat was tough and not cooked fully. I drove back around and asked for my money back. The owner was offended. And because rude.  I got my money back and threw the food in the dumpster behind their store. FLAVAZ had no flavor. I will never go back.

I stopped going here first off due to the insane amounts of beggars out front. That's not the only reason tho. It's always dirty, there's always people taking up seating that didn't buy anything such as the methadone mom brigade as I call them. Also no matter how many times I go there and no matter how much I spent I was still followed around like a criminal. Meanwhile Mr crazy pants over there is opening bags of chips while throwing them into the air while screaming foul language.

Beer is good.   Food is pure crap.   I ordered enchiladas and it come out with cream sauce.  Really cream sauce? Someone in the back really need to visit Mexico before calling his/her cooking Mexican food.   Never go there again.

I called and I placed an order they told me 15 to 20 min. When I went to pick up my order after 20 min they told me they where out! They never gave me a call to tell me what I ordered was out! Thanks guys
The steak was excellent the wait horrible! We waited an 1 1/2 after ordering to be served! Never understood why as there were very few dinners.

Love Tin Roof Tacos!!!
 Great food, totally affordable street tacos, and fast service. Eat inside or out.

This establishment is in my top 5 restaurants. The menu is locally inspired and very charming. It's a great place for date night and the cocktails are extremely well made. My boyfriend and I enjoy walking by the water and enjoying the sunset. Ulele is a very unique atmosphere and very sizable portions. They really have something for everyone.

Super clean, friendly staff and servers, and free chips and salsa.  I'm still amazed when a Mexican restaurant doesn't offer free chips and salsa with all the competition nowadays, La Parilla definitely delivered!

The carnitas tacos were simply amazing.  Even the refried beans were delish and I'm not typically a fan of refried beans.

The steak nachos were very good and most definitely should be shared.

We just ordered takeout for the very first time. First I have to say that you cannot beat the prices! The food was outstanding and the portions are large. Hands-down the best hummus I have ever had in my life. The falafel sandwich was excellent as was the shrimp kebab. My kids both ordered chicken dishes that they enjoyed very much. My only suggestion was that they gave us focaccia  bread with the hummus instead of naan or pita which was strange. Otherwise it was outstanding. We will definitely be back. So excited we found this place!! Needs a much better website.  I had to keep calling to understand what was in certain dishes.  But they were VERY nice!!

Traveling to Nashville for the 4th of July weekend, we were looking for the go-to brunch place in the city. Biscuit love fits all the criteria -- Southern charm, in the hip part of the city, and BISCUITS. I wasn't sure what to expect (afterwards Aliza thought I was crazy for not seeing what was to come after entering their doors). We got the southern benny and the egg plate. 

Coming from Chicago, we are no strangers to intense food experiences, but Holy smokes. I'm a big guy and could only muscle down a biscuit and a half (although the sliced ham was excellent -- side note: the ham should be a prominent feature on this plate, but was masked by the gravy). The egg plate is a great choice if you want to try a little bit of everything. I personally liked the sausage the best, the way it was spiced and smokey was delish. Aliza thought the biscuit and jam was the bee's knees.
Great tasting food served hot and fast! I enjoyed the shrimp soup and fish tacos. The server was friendly, polite and attentive.

We stopped by here to watch a little college football while walking the garden district. Good sized bar with TV's and an oyster bar in the back. Menu looked good (go up and order at the counter). For drinks, same premise, order at the bar. The frozen irish coffee was quite tasty (and strong). The bartenders were friendly sometimes and surly others. I do like the self serve water - cold and good. Seemed like a good neighborhood option.

One of my goto spots for great BBQ.  The brisket never fails to impress, and I recently had a pulled pork sandwich that will definitely be ordering again soon!  Sadly, their ribs have been a disappointment in the past, but with such good brisket I am perfectly happy to eat here anytime!  They have a great variety of sauces...hard to go wrong with any of them.  The white Carolina style sauce is perfect on pulled pork or brisket.

Wish I'd read reviews before choosing this place. I can't recommend it on the basis of their grilled octopus. I've eaten it many times in the past, and thought it didn't smell too fresh when it was served. I ate some of one piece that tasted ok, though pretty tough and definitely not as fresh as one would like. I mentioned this to the wait staff person and she went into denial mode, claiming that it always is that way, it's normal, etc. I wasn't asking for anything, just letting her know, but she clearly didn't want to hear it. In addition I felt an urgent need to locate a restroom an hour later. These to me are signs of bad management and a place to be avoided!

In the mountains high above Santa Barbara, in what seems like the middle of nowhere, is a magical place that serves great food and drinks. An old stage coach stop from the late 1800's is the setting of this magical place. My friends and I were there on a Friday afternoon and there were people waiting outside for a table. Our reservations were for 1:30 pm and it was still croso if possible, I would recommend making reservations. The French dip, tri-tip sandwich, and ribs with onion rings on the side were what my friends ordered. The onion rings looked fabulous and my friends confirmed they were as were the sandwiches and ribs. I had the roasted vegetable salad and it was delicious. We had Cold Spring Tavern's bacon and asparagus quiche for breakfast that morning and it was the best quiche I had ever had. Our server that day was very personable and provided excellent service. My previous visit to the Cold Spring Tavern was about 23 years ago and the food was great then, so I am pretty confident the great quality is consistent.

There are better hoagies to be had in Philly, honey, and the same goes for cheesesteaks.

Decent? Yeah. Maybe.
But with long lines the likes of which are extremely commonplace here? You can do better -- especially for the price.

Very cute spot in the square of downtown Franklin.

Quick service, friendly staff---they all seem to enjoy working there.

Tasty savories and treats.

I plan on bringing my family here when they come from Europe. They like small places that are homey/tastey. I think it's a good fit all around.

Our favorite Mexican food in the area. I've ordered at least a dozen different items from the menu. Never a disappointment.

Their prices are great. The only problem I've had is the wait staff, while always friendly, can sometimes be less-than attentive. We occasionally have to wait quite a while to place our orders, or ask for refills on our beverages.

A serious walk for food that wasn't very special. Maybe I ordered unwisely.  

- Very friendly and timely service
- The beef tartare had zero flavor.  Nothing there.  No bite, no nothing
- The chicken (yes, it was chicken) had a little tang, but again, not much

For an out of the way place, the food should blow me away.  It didn't.

Great meal for a reasonable price.  

Went for a quick dinner prior to a show. 

Started with the Baby Tomato and Bocconcini salad.  Very tasty. 

For a tender flavourful steak I highly recommend the striploin steak.  Excellent cut and marbling.   

The roasted free range chicken stuffed with goat cheese, chestnuts and pancetta.  Very tender and flavourful. 

Definitely worth a visit.

I haven't been here in a while, since they were dog friendly, they are not anymore. It annoys me a bit because most of the restaurants in Dunedin are. 

They have a nice size outside covered shaded patio. Come on Kelly's bring it back. Most pet owners are 200% responsible. (I really hate how the irresponsible pet owners kill it for the rest of us.)

This time around we came for my pre-birthday celebration. I was excited that they accepted reservations, and having a bigger group was done with ease. Make sure u do ask if the fan works. We got the section that did not. 

Since we were in the group section, it was super loud. It was everyone's birthday so it was super fitting.

Our waitress was pretty good considering how busy it was.  

For food, it was difficult for me to choose. I wanted a fish entree they had on special, it was gone. Many of what they had for options had tons of carbs, which I really wanted to lay off on. My hubby and a handful of the group had the espresso rubbed steak and loved it. Of course, my hubby always says get something diff. 

I'm not listening to him next time. I chose the beef tenderloin app and ahi tuna. I liked the ahi tuna better.

My birthday cake was a nice cherry on top that I split with the rest of the group.

I didn't get a drink this time around. I did try my friend's drink which was hella strong.

All in all, I'm blessed to have great friends that make my night perfect as can be.

This has quickly become my favorite Wawa in the city. It's pretty new and is a perfect mix of spaciousness and selection. Whereas the one at 6th and chestnut is HUGE, but perhaps a bit too vast, this one is is really the perfect size to get a nice selection of snacks and what not. It's right at 12th and market, so super convenient location for any regional rail travelers.

Nice atmosphere, very attentive server, and great menu.  The food was pretty good, but not great.  I had the smoked tuna, which was good, but the mesquite flavor was a bit too  much.  The sweet potato rolls were the bomb though!
Shortest. Review. Ever. We went in for lunch, found out they have absolutely zero lunch specials and left because I'm not spending $60 on a lunch date. It's just not happening. :(

I have mixed reviews about this place. The food is always good but the service & wait time can be hit and miss. We've eaten there often over the last two years (mainly brunch) The atmosphere is nice, not too fancy not too laid back. The staff is usually attentive(the waitresses are usually nice but the girl that makes reservations on the weekends is usually rude.Not sure if she still works there.) The last two times we went we weren't impressed with the service because we made reservations for brunch and brought our whole family only to be told they they stopped serving breakfast by the time the waitress got to our table. Then the last time we went we were in a rush and we told the hostess/waitress but things still took so long that we ended up missing our appointment. 

Lets get to the food: The fruit is usually fresh and the French toast with blueberry cream cheese is to die for! Their portions are decent and I've never had a meal there that I didn't like. I also like that they typically have things going on like Santa for Christmas, mother day menus and Valentine's Day, etc. 

All in all, we will probably keep going back for the food alone.

I am completely obsessed with this place. The food is always good. Their burgers are awesome, but their fried pickles are fantastic. Service is always great. And did I mention their fried pickles? Holy crap...I can't get enough of them.

What a cool place.   Great atmosphere, great service.   We sat at a high top in the bar, and had a great time.  Plenty of sports on the tube.  They have an excellent in house stout.  I would prefer Guinness, but this was a great substitute.  I decent selection of food on the menu, I ordered the crab stuffed chicken and it delivered. We will defiantly be dining here on a regular basis, as there are so many other things on the menu that I need to try.  Everyone seems to be recommending the French Onion Soup.

Due to a shortage of employees over the holiday weekend, only allowing drive-thru orders. Had a craving for a chocolate shake. From the Courtyard next door I drove 30 feet. When I got to the drive thru order menu, I heard "will be with you shortly". Even if there was just one employee, what could he be possibly doing? There were no other customers in drive through. Aren't customers #1 ? It took 5 minutes to prepare my order. Not exactly stellar customer service as far as I'm concerned. However the shake was great!

Went here tonite and it was wonderful. Food was delicious and plentiful. They will spice it as you like, and it seems to be made to order. You can make it a meal and get naan and a drink for only a bit more. I think this is now our favorite Indian restaurant. Give it a try- you won't be disappointed. And try the iced tea. Really special blend of tea and spices. So refreshing.

Yum!!  Delicious, flavorful, well priced Greek food!  We got the sampler platter as an appetizer, the horitaki salad and chicken pita sandwich- everything was delicious.  Service and atmosphere were just ok- average diner.  I will go back for sure- burgers looked amazing!
Good dinner and I ate inside! Good service, good social distancing, clean restaurant.

I'm a wing lover ! I really wanted to like this place . Wings came in a really cool bag . Unfortunately, wings were inedible :( I ordered two flavors , both sets of wings were undercooked. The flavor was extremely off as well . The tater tots were great , but I had to throw the rest of the meal away . What a waste !

Our first time here and it definitely won't be our last. Let me start by saying when you get out of your vehicle you can smell the aromas in the parking lot. You're greeted with smiles as you enter the doors. Seated and gifted with bread and butter. Now all bread and butter isn't good but I could have ate the entire basket by myself it was so good. The waiter I wish I remembered his name was so kind and knowledgeable of the menu. After taking our orders and serving the dishes he did check on us which I can appreciate. The food was delicious especially those lamp chops omg finger licking good. The crab cakes melted in my mouth. The mac and cheese was also good it could have used maybe a pinch more of salt but no biggie I did that on my own. The lobster on top of the macaroni was so sweet yummy. I think this maybe my new favorite restaurant 

Also on our way out my hunni and I asked one of the guys if they didn't mind taking our picture which they did
This place is great! The food has always been good and our waiters have always been super chill dudes. Highly recommended. Though it's a restaurant that does allow smoking.

I came here with one of my friends for a delicious night out and The Italian Barrel delivered.  We were lucky to get a table as we didn't have a reservation, and the place was very busy.  The ambiance was romantic, with a dimly lit dining room in a cozy setting.  

We spent a few hours enjoying a slow dinner with appetizers, mains, dessert and a couple of bottles of wine, sharing everything we ate.  It was easily one of the best meals I've ever had.  The service was exceptional, and considering how much food (and the flavour...mmmm) we had, and how long we had spent there, the cost was relatively fair.  

I can see why The Italian Barrel had 23 awards on the wall!

The pizza was ok but after checking my receipt the next day, I noticed that the guy charged me $4.50/slice instead of $4.25 that's posted on the price board. It's not worth my time to go back and argue over 50  cents but its a grimey practice and best believe they lost my trust and business going forward.

I'm pretty sure this place is relatively new...but great find! And so happy a new Indian place popped up that is eager to please new customers. My boyfriend and I were driving down Girard to Ekta, when I saw a sign for Bombay Royal. I said let's try this place and see how it is. To start with the only reason I gave it 4 stars rather than 5 was that they need some serious work on the interior. We had wanted to sit and eat in but this place isn't quite ready for that....alas we decided on take out. I ordered the shrimp Tikka Masala in mild and my boyfriend got the chicken Tikka Masala in medium. Both come with a very generous portion of rice. When asked if we wanted naan we declined. The food was prepared for us quickly and the guys working were not shy about talking to us and making us feel comfortable as we waited. When we paid for our food the owner threw in some wrapped up naan in our bag and said take it on the house. We were surprised and very thankful. They kept pushing the fact that they deliver...which I wasn't thinking much of because we live pretty far east on Allegheny. Then the guys tell me they deliver within a 4-5 MILE RADIUS! That is unheard of! Awesome!

So we get home so excited to try our food. It. Was. Delicious. And dare I say, maybe better than Ekta. The pieces of shrimp were huge, I got through about 4 and still had a few to spare. Mi novios chicken was awesome, big chunks and soooo soft it just melted in your mouth. My sauce was great, creamy how I like it. His medium sauce was great as well, not too spicy but a great flavor. The naan was delicious, fluffy but still thick at the same part.

I will definitely be hitting these guys up again. Great food, great service, and delivery pretty much to the whole city!
Awesome!
So cheap and good. Steak was cooked to the perfect temp. Will come back the next time in PA.

Been going there for most of my life and they are always great. They are nice people. Great and efficient service in a timely matter. It's very clean. The food is fresh and delicious! I could not ask for more :) 

5/5 stars if you ask me! I'd highly recommend them :)

A small neighborhood bar that actually serves authentic Cajun food! I've tried a few of the Po' Boys here and every one is delicious. Made just like they are in New Orleans on authentic Leidenheimer rolls. You won't find a better po boy in Philly, and I'm a Po' Boy connoisseur. I've also tried the Muffuleta and it's made just like they are in New Orleans as well. 

You can't go wrong if you stick with the Cajun portion of the menu. The chef here must have new Orleans roots. A drink and a po boy here is one of my favorite meals. I hope they add a breakfast po boy at some point. They have breakfast po boys in New Orleans...

One word: YUM. definitely recommend coming here for your own personalized pizza. My go to is the buffalo bleu for those who enjoy pizza & wings this is like a mix between the two. I've never had anything like it. Or you can create your own pizza just like chipotle lets you create your own burrito down the assembly line. Only negative is that it's always hot and always packed inside of this place. And the grease might upset your stomach a little :/

This is my favorite taco place ever! Every time I'm in Philly I try to come here. Honestly, don't come here because it will ruin tacos for you forever. Nothing compares (I have looked). I have tried all their tacos here and the pollo is the best so now I only get those. I wouldn't come for $1 tacos (declared on the Facebook and Instagram pages) because it's super busy and worth paying the marginal amount more on a normal day. The tacos are small and simple and cheap. The chicken tacos come only with onion, cilantro, radishes, and a lime. The homemade sauces are all amazing. I love the verde one!

Their drinks are also amazing. The coup de ville marg is super good with the blood orange flavor.

This place is definitely quirky inside. The art is strange and it is super hipster but it's fun. It's a cool bar and super dark. If you feel brave try the 20 taco challenge and get on the Gordo Board. The record is just over 2 minutes!

I wish they would open a loco pez wherever I move!

I couldn't imagine why they don't have a higher rating. I brought my mother and sister here and we enjoyed everything!!! The service was fantastic, great complimentary offering of a small shareable appetizer (they gave us smoked tuna with crackers) and the meals were great! The charcoal shrimp, i wish me had ordered more. My sister loved her crab grilled cheese, I had blackened salmon, the cheesy hash brown potatoes were great and My mother loved her fish tacos. Will definitely beback to enjoy some drinks and their outdoor seating.

Ah typical chain place, not great if you expect more. If you like Fridays, chilies and places of that nature, you'll be fine here. Don't come here for wow factor or a great tasting meal. It's not cheap either, but the seafood quality is low.

This is my favorite food I have eaten in Reno as of yet. The ambiance is quaint and charming. The food was flavorful and the choices were abundant but not overwhelming. I'm so happy I stumbled across this fantastic little Gastropub. I had the garden salad, it was nice and colorful. My son had cheese pizza which was cooked to perfection. The most surprisingly delicious plate we ordered was the jackfruit tacos. I would have never thought in a million years to order this. Wow! It was fantastic!! I strongly recommend it. I will definitely be back, it did not disappoint.
My favorite margs. Best bartenders in DTSP! Nachos here are a staple in my diet. Upstairs is cool and a completely different vibe. Love you, cantina.

Stopped off here to grab a to-go drink before heading down to the parade, bar tender had an attitude about serving us even though the place was empty. Not worth wasting time stopping at this spot, plenty other bars in the city worth checking out.

Had been looking forward to trying their chicken sandwich for over a year. Stopped by today and was underwhelmed. Sandwich had been microwaved to death. So much so that the bottom bun was hard. Chicken breading was soggy, not at all crisp, and it stuck to the bun. Chicken was tender but not at all juicy. Will not return.

Super fun atmosphere and good food. We sat up on the bench today and it was really comfy. We've come another night and sat around the fire pit and made friends with people from all over the world. You might have a hard time getting a drink sitting over there though. The frozen Margs are amazing! We had lunch today and were disappointed there was no kids menu. We ended up ordering an a la carte taco for the youngling, the supreme burrito with chicken (massive but nothing special) and mahi mahi tacos (yummy but literally came with 3 small slivers of fish...don't come hungry for that dish. Kind of a rip off if you ask me. Bloody Mary's were pretty good. Would be back for fun atmosphere and super delicious chips and salsa!

My friends and I came here yesterday and it was pretty good. 

Service: the bartender was nice. He also took our food order. We were there for a long time but we didn't feel rushed to leave, it was nice to hang out and relax at the bar for as long as we wanted without the pressure to vacate in a hurry.

Food/ drinks: we each tried 2 different beers. They were all pretty good, not the best any of us had ever had but still solid. Between the three of us I think we tried all of their house beers. Foodwise, we shared the beer cheese dip and each had a chicken sandwich. Everything was tasty! 

Price: on par for a place like this, more upscale than BJ's or Gordon Biersch, but the product was better too. I think we each ended up paying $35ish for two beers, a sandwich, and splitting an appetizer. Not bad.

I'm glad we came here, I'll probably return.

Pros:
Great food
Great value
Huge Portions

Cons:
Touristy location
Little seating
Very crowded

We like the roast pork and the roast beef.

This place never ceases to amaze. The staff are awesome and they are very knowledgeable on great combinations of you don't know what you want. I'm here on a weekly basis ever since I moved to Delaware from out of state.

Great, great, great food! We stopped in on our way back to Orlando. We will be back for sure! We ordered the sampler plater, rib plater and chicken plater. The sides we tasted were Mac n cheese, potato salad, green beans, corn casserole, coleslaw, baked beans and fried okra; ALL great tasting! Friendly and attentive staff. Clean, efficient and homely place. Highly recommended
This was excellent. We got the Sex and the City roll, Tchoupitoulas roll, philly and tuna. It was all excellent. It was the perfect end to our trip.

Favorite go to spot in Lansdowne for Jumbo shrimp w/ buffalo sauce , steak fries and their chicken cheesesteaks are bomb! This little hidden gem is great for delivery. It's fast , staff is friendly and good food.

Best tacos in Florida, by a long shot. Great flavor, quality meat, good portions. You won't be disappointed. The Austinite is my favorite. Generous portions of steak and avocado. The queso is also fantastic!
Love this place. Very good food. Never had anything that wasn't good. They get very busy so you may want to call ahead. Highly recommend.

This is another one of those super romantic dining spots in the gazillion restaurants in downtown Santa Barbara. But this one was ranked highly on trip advisor and yelp so we had to check it out since Downey and Bouchon were fully booked already. The place is located literally right next door to Downey and Jane. The ambiance was definitely very dressy casual as you'll notice older patrons all around. The decor actually seemed very random with abstract art on the walls with the dark candle lit tables. But hey the food and service was top notch so no complaints here! 

We had:
Roasted Duck with raspberry compote demi glace served on a bed of wild rice. This was a semi hit and miss dish. On the one hand the super crispy duck was perfectly cooked and the raspberry compote was yummy. On the other hand the super hard wild rice on the rice was just a turn off. 
http://www.yelp.com/user_local_photos?select=RecSJCtsu1oxGlV-BR92FQ&userid=RS4AjuF4glgClCkdgD4nDA

Lemon Grass Crusted Fresh Salmon Filet with a Thai Curry Sauce. This dish was definitely the better of the two as it was perfectly prepared with a perfect mixture of sweet and tanginess from the coconutty thai curry sauce. 
http://www.yelp.com/user_local_photos?select=nKyjX1nV0GK1a8JDTLBpUQ&userid=RS4AjuF4glgClCkdgD4nDA

We definitely had to have dessert so we had some chocolate gelato. But they also had vanilla, and coffee bean. It was served with a triangular butter crisp cookie and drizzled dark chocolate on the plate for your dipping pleasure!
http://www.yelp.com/user_local_photos?select=WJbyHBoBpJsqOXEqci1L0A&userid=RS4AjuF4glgClCkdgD4nDA

Overall the entire experience was excellent. The staff was friendly and very professional the entire night.
Small little diner with great food.  I had the egg scramble with Sriracha ketchup and my wife had the corned beef hash, both were excellent.

My husband and I have eaten here several times. We have always gotten great food. We stopped in last night and had an exceptional experience. We both ordered sirloins and they were excellent. Both cooked perfect. The salad was chilled and the bread was fresh. Our server was one of the best ones we have had here. Not sure her name but the ticket said A-Lang. We never had to ask for anything. Highly recommend this restaurant!

I got the chicken and fish tacos with fried rice and loved both. My husband got the combination beef and shrimp teriyaki and could not stop raving about the beef. Perfect texture and flavor. 

Clean and pleasant ambiance. Very attentive wait staff. At one point the chef walked out and made sure that everything was ok with our meals. He noticed that my husband liked spicy food and offered to make it spicier and/or saucier next time. We were very pleased.

Will definitely be back.

Thai Rama nine never disappoints! I eat there regularly and everything on the menu is prepared perfectly and they will alter plates based on diet requirements. The owner is a joy to sit and visit with when she has time. I can't give a higher recommendation then this.
I've been trying all the local Thai restaurants since I moved here a year ago and they are by far my favorite!
New management has really turned things around for the better. Great customer service and punctuality. Keep up the good work Travjs!

What a disappointment to say the least. Came all the way from California to try a "real" cheesesteak and was very disappointed. The cheesesteak didn't taste like anything. Super bland. The cheesesteak at Pat's was a lot better. I tried both cheesesteaks ordered the exact same way and Geno's was pretty bad. It's another example of trendiness outweighing quality.

This is a fun bar with nice atmosphere.  I recommend going here if you just want to enjoy a couple of drinks and have an appetizer.  This is NOT the place to go if you are interested in having dinner.  The menu is very limited and the food is average at best especially considering the prices are high.  The service was good and everyone was friendly.  Overall, I would say have dinner somewhere else and stop in here for a drink.

Came here with friends. There's seating in the back patio and inside the restaurant. The attentive crew wore masks and abided by the social distanced rule. I didn't have any drinks but my friends loved their concoctions. 

For food, i had the Truffle deviled eggs which was quite good but My main entree suffered. The blacked steak was very tough and chewy. Not sure what happened there. The andouille sausage & spinach was yummy. 

Overall, my meal was ok, could've been better if the steak was cooked better
campione's is the best kept secret in gallatin the food is great and people are awesome ..........if you haven't  been there yet go its GREAT......the parker boys from Miracle Ford .....

Visited this restaurant when it first opened (in the same location Square One was located. It seemed over priced and my food was too salty.  
HOWEVER, sometimes new restaurants go through trainings and inconsistencies when first opened.  Tried The Local again and they definitely got the kinks out!

Food was delicious and the prices of the items we ordered are good. Service was excellent.  

A great ambiance for the younger crowd and the 'not as young :). 

Though it is no longer Square One Burger, the server told us they sell an abundance of burgers so they must be good!

Though burgers are popular, they have a great variety of appetizers, entrees, sides, beverages (non and alcoholic).

Hope The Local is here to stay!

This is our family's favorite spot. We go for breakfast, lunch or dinner at least once a week maybe twice. Everyone here is super nice and always welcoming. You can't go wrong with anything that you order. Every dish is fresh and delicious. Did I mention kid friendly! 

If you haven't been give it a try!!
The best old fashion cheese burgers anywhere!
If you haven't tried this place it's a must!!!! I drive over 20miles for the best civche!!!!

Hands down, the best tacos we have eaten in the U.S. The food is so good and fresh, we visited this place twice in four days! The staff is amazingly friendly and welcoming. The very nice lady even remembered my name when I came in the second time. The place is small, seating about 20 - 25 and it is busy. But service was fast and efficient. We tasted just about every taco except the fish, which I simply overlooked. Our favorites were the pastor, shrimp and chorizo tacos. The Aqua de Jamaica is a flower tea that is very refreshing, a bit sweet, but delicious; you may can cut the sweetness by adding just a bit more water. However we also loved the ribeye, lengua and chicken tacos. If you want tamales, get there early! The prices are very reasonable and this place could easily charge more and not lose one customer. This place is a guaranteed hit!

Whew this is truly a place you come for convenience and that is it. Were staying at the Ramada and wanted to get some breakfast. The chef, well cook not a chef, is not so great. There was a buffet option with grits, so you would think they make grits. NOPE! When you want grits on the regular menu, "that is a specialty item that cannot be ordered." Food is bland, wait staff is forgetful when it is not busy, and atmosphere is non existent. Do yourselves a favor and spend the extra $5 total between two people and eat breakfast elsewhere. Did not venture to try lunch, Indian food buffet, or dinner.

THIS REVIEW IS FOR THE RESTAURANT PORTION ONLY! They are purely a market although they have a menu. No "lunch" menu offerings. I never saw the Po Boy offered like the other reviewer. No soup offerings.  Again, a word of caution, this is NOT a place to eat. 

*Was requested to review as a seafood market, so upped to 2 stars since I didn't experience the market portion of the business. Please refer to other review of market experiences.
This was such a great place to stop to on vacation! The wait wasn't terribly long and the food was incredible!

It was just ok to me. Food was ok, staff was ok, location ok. Nothing exciting. Prices are a bit steep, other then that I have no positives or  negatives about this place. Honestly,  I probably will not go back unless i am obligated by invitation or something. Just didnt do it for me.

Note: This restaurant serves contemporary Cuban food, not strictly traditional Cuban food. I always think that's good to know in advance.

I went to Alma de Cuba with a big group, and that added unusual complexity to the moment. The restaurant handled our big group reservation okay--but not great. They were good at getting us out the door, however, because we needed to be somewhere after, and I was grateful for that.

The food was very good. It was hot and tasty, and it came out pretty quickly. I ordered the appetizer sampler, and I thought the three appetizers were good but not great. Next time I'd try a ceviche.

Almost everyone at our table ordered either the pork with crispy skin or the skirt steak. I liked the crispy skin pork best (after we asked for and added salt), but my husband liked the skirt steak best. The yucca side was good but it needed something to really kick it over the top.

The people near me who got sweet plantains seemed very happy with that side, and it looked and smelled really good. The tostones were good but not great, as reported by the people who ordered them (including a native Cuban).

In all, I'd go back again, but I'd order everything different. As of my first visit, I'd call it a solid four-star restaurant.

Probably my favorite local bakery.  Terrific doughnuts and pepperoni bread.  I originally found this place when I was looking for a local place which had fasnachts (traditional German doughnut eaten during Lent). JB and L & M Bakery in Riverside are the only local bakeries I know of which carries these and boy, are they good!  They come in sugar, cinnamon sugar, powdered sugar and jelly filled varieties, freshly made.  Yum!

Ok.  I went last night, Wednesday. It was packed but we got seats at the window, our waiter was AWESOME. Very attentive, very...! I had the red table wine, it was ok. For an appetizer, polenta with brown sugar.... I didn't care for it. Then I had gnocchi- it was traditional gnocchis, dumplings, it was like one big flattened gnocchi. It also was good, not excellent, the sauce was a little ragu-ish. The best thing about dinner was dessert, we had a belgian waffle with Nutella & ice cream on it, that was delicious.. but my Tartufo... OMG. Sooooooooooooooooo............... delicious, perfect. I got goosebumps just by remembering it now. I would go back again, the ambiance was excellent.

More on the pricey side, but you're getting some authentic cuisine here you won't find elsewhere in the city. 

This is a fairly large authentic french restaurant with a beautiful view of lovely Rittenhouse square. 

Right off the bat, before we even had ordered our food, the service was the best I had ever seen. It was above and beyond. Not only quick, friendly, and attentive, but also very knowledgeable of the items on the menu. It allowed for a very welcoming atmosphere. 

For my appetizer, the waiter recommended the asparagus soup, and it was a wise choice. The soup was very creamy and, as you could imagine, had a wonderful subtle taste of asparagus. This was totally something I would look past, so I'm glad the waiter recommended it or I would have never had ordered it. 5/5.

I then had my lamb shank delivered to me. Lamb has become a new found love of mine, so I've been getting it where I can. It was a very generous portion shank, laying on a goat cheese polenta sauce, topped with some nicoise olives (yummy). There was a thin layer of sauce that covered the lamb, though I'm not entirely sure what it was. To be honest, I was expecting more flavor from this dish than I had received. What I saw before me was what looked like a wonderful symphony of flavor, however it just wasn't delivered in full force. I'm not saying it wasn't enjoyable, but I'd probably be ordering something else next time around. 4/5

Desert came next, and I asked the waiter what the favorite on the menu was. He noted the Profiteroles, and that's what I got. Holy cow were these amazing. They were little pastries sandwiching vanilla ice cream, topped with some powered sugar and a chocolate drizzle. In fact, the chocolate drizzle came in a little mini jug on the side, so you could sauce it up as much as you wanted. The pastries were warm and fresh, and the ice cream wasn't supermarket ice cream as it was rich and creamy. I would get these time and time again. 5/5

Overall I had a pleasant experience at Parc. The service was top tier, and though I was hoping for more out of my entree, there were so many other options to choose from that I'll be back to check those out.

Don't get me wrong Mod Pizza is great. I think the choose your own toppings is a great idea . However, it is super slow. The back of their shirts say super fast, but they are by no means fast. The last time I went, they ripped my first pizza and had to re do it. After re doing it they burnt it which was disappointing. 2 stars.

Very good food and the owner is an excellent host. From the beginning he greeted my family with smiles and engaged my young kids with conversation  He stopped by our table and challenged my son to rock, paper, scissors; which my son loved. I'll be back again.

Great experience, friendly service, the food was all good and the tea was fantastic and only a $1! We will definitely be coming back. The cocktails looked yummy as well and were reasonably priced especially for being in Santa Barbara :) So happy to have found a new Chinese food place that is good in SB!

When I go to Denny's I'm just expecting a half way descent meal for a half way descent price. What I got was a descent burger but a salad that was yellow with bits of brown I had to pick out. So why make a descent burger and go fuck it all up by giving me a rotten salad. Why don't they just close if they don't give a shit!

WOW! Just WOW! Customer service is such a rarity these days so it was so refreshing to see an abundance of it at Johnny Rockets in Carson City.
My boys picked Johnny Rockets for their birthday party in hopes they could still have a fun time with friends in this season of challenges.
And boy did they! The staff was so accommodating and helpful! Not only was the service amazing, the food delicious, the atmosphere fun and inviting.... Jessica (our amazing help) & her team, decorated our area for my boys birthday! It was a total surprise and just made our night! Balloons and homemade streamers and signs.... it was so fantastic! 
We had such a great experience we've been back 3 times in the last few weeks. We got to meet Tamara (GM) who was so helpful and contributed to our most recent fabulous experience dining there. We love it, we will continue to go often and encourage you to check it out if you haven't already! Simply AWESOME!!!!

As a Peruvian, I understand the complexity of making authentic Peruvian food. The key ingredients needed are hard to find. With that being said, if someone was to ask for a Peruvian restaurant recommendation, Happy fish would not be the first place to come to mind. The food tends to be salty, the service is not great, the sangria is too sweet, and some of their dishes are not very coherent. Their salving grace is their ceviche. It is a gigantic portion - which is a huge plus, and if your into spicy food, it can have the right amount of heat.
Love it!  Great St. Patricks Day fish and chips. Melt in your mouth. Glad to see you serve local beer Telegraph too!
Walked in the door and first thing we see is Mr An's friendly face greeting us.  Dinner was delish...everything we ordered was great, from appetizers to dessert and the service was amazing!

I'm giving this place 5 stars because I have been craving the buffalo shrimp wrap regularly since I had it about three months ago.

When I first went here, we pulled up and I swear I thought my boyfriend had taken me to some crazy bar. The outside area was packed and the first thing I saw was a lady dancing up on some man by the bar. However, I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food! We ended up eating inside where it was much quieter, in fact we were the only people in there for awhile. 

I ordered the shrimp wrap buffalo style and it was SO GOOD. They told me that their blue cheese was delicious. I don't really like blue cheese so I ordered a side of that as well as ranch. I ate both, it was truly delicious. 

I feel that the atmosphere of this place doesn't match how amazingly high quality and delicious their food is. The food is better than I've had in some fancy restaurants yet the atmosphere is super relaxed and beachy. I'm already planning my next trip back!

Great Lobster Roll, fresh and plenty of Lobster.
Next time I am in Florida I will be visiting again.

Love the BBQ tofu!  I am not a fan of tofu but these are the bomb.com. Hubby loves hot and jazzy bowl. The soups are amazing especially the tortilla cheese soup!!!!  Definitely give it a try you won't be disappointed!!
Great food - wonderful pizza and really nice and affordable wine list. Good family atmosphere and my friends enjoyed watching LSU game. Nice to get to another part of town too.

I'm not one to normally look for fried Chicken on a dinner menu, but their fried chicken is a must if you are dining in the Big Easy. I have no idea what makes it worth the price, but every bite makes you want more. Everything on the menu is delicious but dont pass on the Chicken  if it's your first visit.

The fried pickles were delicious but the truffled cauliflower was unimpressive. The burger was very good, but certainly not the greatest I've ever enjoyed. I miss the old coffee shop that used to inhabit the same space. The ambiance is very dark. The service was very good.

Yes you will wait in line, but yes it will be worth it! The line moves, the food is so affordable, and it's of course delicious. 

Service & atmosphere: so the place is small with counter service, but the people working here are so friendly and accommodating! It's casual and the perfect place to just eat chicken.

Food: I got the medium small dark with pimento mac n cheese and the greens. I've had Nashville style chicken before, but this is easily the best I've had. Super flavorful chicken with just enough spice for kick but not overwhelming. The mac n cheese was awesome and helped balance out the spice. The greens came with small pieces of ham hock which was great. 

Definitely worth the wait and the visit!
The food is always good here .I love their palomilla steak and their stuffed potatoes. Super reasonable prices and food is always fresh.

Y'all, this is the place for tacos! I swear they infuse tiny little bites of heaven into each one of their authentic tacos. If you're not in the mood for tacos, that's OK, they won't judge you,  they have something for everyone. They also have an amazing California burrito, Carne Asada fries, and other classic Mexican dish options- all simple, fresh and delicious. Plus they have deals that your wallet will appreciate. If you're in the mood for some thing a little indulgent I recommend the Carne Asada fries or their take on a crunch wrap. You won't be disappointed.

I had the Thai basil burger which was more like a grilled cheese sandwich with a flavored patty - absolutely loved it. My friends ordered the shrimp roll - amazing shrimp tofu mix with the red curry sauce, and the pork bahn mi sandwich (My favorite). The food was delightfully amazing and fresh. It was a little more on the spicy end, but was worth every bite. Overall great service and great food! I'm looking forward to coming back here again!
