They were backed up, though (still not sure what the problem was here -- maybe someone didn't show up to work?), so it took a long time for the food to arrive (despite many apologies from the waiters!).   I believe our dessert was comped due to the long waits on both our seats and our food, but I honestly can't remember, and it didn't really matter to me.

Anyway, when our food did come out, it was good -- they had a nice combination of traditional and cajun-style entrees and appetizers.  The seafood was fresh and flavorful, but my fish was a little bit overcooked.  Overall, it was about middle-of-the-road for this type of restaurant in New Orleans; perhaps a bit better than average in terms of ambience and food quality, definitely above-average in terms of server eagerness, but below-average with regard to management and host attitude.

I would eat there again if other people had already made reservations, but I wouldn't endorse it.

Been coming here for years since i moved to this part of New Tampa....Great Pizza...family friendly...  The strombolis are huge!!!!  your tempted to order a large for a few bucks more and it could feed a family!  Not the best pizza I have ever had but for the area and the $ you can't go wrong.
Tight BBQ. Best handsome in the diner. Also, good at making time pass. I'm full. Will eat again.
Had the spicy cheesesteak deluxe and it was beyond amazing. So good, a bit pricey but worth it! Employees were kind and food was prepared in a timely manner

Super cute new spot in Wilmington! We made a reservation to dine first before bowling and we're seated immediately. The atmosphere is perfect for a small group outing or double date. Keep in mind the bowling is smaller handball style bowling. 
Our table ordered the cornbread (super moist and buttery, so good!), the roasted chicken with Mac & cheese and the shrimp & grits. The chicken had a strong smoky flavor and was served with buttery mashed potatoes. My friend really enjoyed the shrimp & grits entree. The drink were STRONG but delicious. 
The decor around the bar is super cute and there's a staircase in the back for a photo opp. 
There's also a small arcade with a couple of games for after dinner

Came here for lunch while visiting the area.  Restaurant/Taproom is clean inside and out.  Staff is super friendly and knows the menus well.  Multiple tap offerings, including craft beer. Meal was served promptly and was delicious.  I had the (huge) chicken breast pannini, a friend the PB&J Burger, awesome!  
It's not a large place but we came at the right time and had no wait.  I'm told there are times you'll stand outside waiting to get in.  Some might find this place a little pricey.  I'll be back next time I'm in the area.

After a very bad experience a few years ago, my daughter and I decided to give Desi Tadka another chance. We arrived a little before noon, for the lunch buffet. The decor of the place is really in need of an update (the yellow tablecloths are blinding), but we were here for the food.

The buffet items were hot and fresh and my daughter and I really enjoyed our meal. The naan was fresh and at one point when a new batch was ready, the owner stopped by every table to ask if they would like one. This was a nice touch. (I should note that this appears to be a new owner, different from the one I remembered seeing last time.)

Our server was attentive and friendly, refilling our water at appropriate intervals. We ate several dishes, including the butter chicken, vegetable rice, aloo gobhi, and another chicken dish. All were suitably tasty and well prepared. Best of all, we had no stomach issues this time around. 

All in all, a big improvement. Kudos!

Absolutely awful pizza. Had no cheese and my sister cried and cried because she was so hungry and the food was THAT awful. No one should ever cry because food was bad. Just a warning don't order here or eat here.

Stopped off for a quick bite on my way to pick up my son from school. Got value curly fry and a two pack of sliders. Food was hot and fresh. Cashier was precise when i asked about the sliders details.

Can't say enough good about this place. 

We have been several times now, for brunch & dinner.

The staff is very welcoming & attentive. The atmosphere is casual and fresh.

We have had a variety of foods here, from beignets, salmon tacos, quinoa salad, burgers, soup, panzanella, etc - it is ALL so good, like keeps you thinking about it days later so good!

They don't really have a posted kids menu but they do offer kids item and my daughter has been pleased with any meal she has decided on here.

The only bad thing I have ever had here was a mixed drink that was just super heavy on the liquor (might work out well for some! ha) and not tasty at all in my opinion. I fully intended to pay for the drink as I felt it was a personal preference over being actually "bad" or not well prepared. To my surprise, and appreciation, they removed it from the bill.

I think brunch is my favorite meal at Grit, between their amazing OJ (I'm telling ya, it is so good, and I don't really even like OJ regularly) and the chilaquiles & beignets, you need to visit!

Okay so I know Applebee's is a chain, but this one has to be one of the worst. The server we had was wonderful, but the food was so bad. I know it's not know for it's food, but this was ROUGH. The drinks tasted watered down, so it wasn't even worth it for happy hour. Do not recommend.
Our fav go to place. Careful and clean. Masks worn by all. Great service. Delicious food

I am so impressed!  And I am a sushi snob.  I also rarely give 5 stars.  I ordered online and paid in the store.  (The online pay option wasn't going through) My order was ready as promised and nicely packed.  I had the shrimp shumai and it was so delectably delish I forgot to take a pic of it.  I got the Harumaki spring rolls and got the Crazy Salmon Roll.  Everything was fresh, perfectly & creatively prepared.  I am a big salmon fan and this roll did not disappoint.  There were so many items on the menu I want to try.  I will be making more visits! The store is practicing social distancing and is nice and clean.  Looks like take out for now.  No dining in.  Great location and plenty of parking in this strip of stores.

The atmosphere was nice and the food was good! I chose the Peacemaker with a vanilla latte for a morning pick me up. The Ruby Slipper is known for its egg Benedict dishes and if you're indecisive like me, the Peacemaker is a fabulous choice! Instead of choosing only one type of egg Benedict, you can choose two from the menu for $15. I chose the mon Cochon and the St. Charles (not sure if I got those names right). I liked the mon cochon better than the St Charles. I personally thought the chicken from the St Charles was dry and they should have put more hollandaise sauce. The biscuit was also dry. Would have been better if they used an English muffin. Overall, good restaurant and good brunch spot.

Been wanting to try this place since we went to their sister restaurant Mai Lee during our visit to look at apartments in St Louis one month ago l. Finally made it out here now that we moved.

I got the spicy miso and my husband got the curry up with chicken. We also got their special of the day tamarind tofu since we had that at Mai Lee and loved it. The spicy miso was amazing with the perfect level of spice and the ratio of the greens and sprouts was perfect. Highly recommend getting this!

The curry up was a different flavor to the traditional ramen you'd get elsewhere but I felt like there was too much going on with the bowl being crowded with a bunch of carrots and peanuts. It tasted great but it was more like a coconut curry you'd get at a Thai restaurant than ramen. 

The tamarind tofu was amazing again and highly recommend trying this if it's available!

Next time I'm going to try the Hebrew hammer.

Stopped here for a late lunch today. I placed my order requesting light ice with my drink. I took my order and the guy working the drive thur says "Bye Bye" in a really all attitude tone. I then realize I have no straw and my drink is so full of ice the lid will not stay on. I generally have good service here and rarely post reviews. This exchange and lack of effort from the employee today was very disappointing.

We have been to the Southport location many times and always have great experiences.  The pizza is always hot and fresh, and always tastes great.  We have tried almost every pizza they offer, and loved every one!  The breadsticks are amazing!  The staff is always friendly and helpful.  There is also a weekly half price pizza that rotates weekly.
I absolutely love this place , very friendly servers and food is amazing , great portions , always fresh and quick
Very delicious southern food! Tried this place for the first time today with my husband and we loved it .  Will definitely come again
Why are people hating on the Cosi? Admittedly, all I got was a cup of tea, but the service was prompt and polite. I usually can't stand Cosi, but about this one I have no complaints.

Went to the Oracle Road location Saturday night and it was a disaster. After sitting for 15 minutes, asked a waitress for menus. She said she was too busy. After 10 more minutes of being ignored, we walked out. Other people also were fed up and leaving, vowing not to return. I won't waste my time here.
Love this place! Food is always fresh and fantastic. The Joe roll is to die for! Nom Nom Nom and I've always had great service even when they've been really busy.

OK -- you get what you pay for, right? It's edible, cheap food. Nothing's wonderful; nothing is particularly awful. 
If you absolutely have to have asian food, are not too fussy and are on a tight budget, go for it. If you have a little more to spend, you'll find better food elsewhere.

Has a hipster feel to it. Small restaurant with a good amount of drinks. Got a bottle of French wine, which was really smooth--I really liked it. Good appetizers and dishes, but small plates for the price.

Me and my friends came to Santa Barbara for a day trip and was told this was an excellent place to go for afternoon coffee and pastries. And it definitely is! Very small but comforting and intimate, we had 2 passion fruit macaroons, chocolate eclair, and a croissant with jam plus 2 coffee's and a hot chocolate. The lady behind the counter was super nice and inviting, I'm not sure if she was the owner or not, but either way I loved her! Definitely will come back whenever we plan another trip to Santa Barbara.

I love this place. Every item I've had on the menu is excellent. I love the lettuce wraps, sushi cones, butternut squash ravioli, all the salads and the tuna tataki. The atmosphere is great and the patio is beautiful. I recommend this restaurant to anyone. It's definitely a younger crowd, especially in the evenings. I don't think it's very children friendly - though I've seen kids there in the evening. They're normally busy so be ready to wait on Fridays and Saturdays. Limited reservations.

Meals are pretty good but nothing special. Would not come back for the food alone. However, the ambiance and amazing cocktails are what keep me coming back. An easy place to meet for drinks and bites.
I'm pretty sure these pancakes are what Mrs. Butterworth thinks of when she's pleasuring herself. They're amazing.

Traildust Town is a really sweet little place to visit. If I recall the history, it was a movie set built for a Glenn Ford western. 
The Dakota Cafe is one of the places where you can grab a bite to eat.
I had the crabcake bites (photo) and while it was tasty, it was a little too greasy for me and the texture was too soft. I don't think I'll order them again.There are definitely other items I'd like to try.
My partner, however, had the portebello sandwich and loved it. To quote her, "It was an inspired and complex blend of flavors that went together perfectly." It had roasted peppers, eggplant, hervarti dill cheese, spinach, and red pepper spread on a ciabatta roll. The fries what came with it were crispy and hot.
All in all, a nice lunch.

This was my first time there and this place is awesome. The waitress was extremely friendly and helpful with the menu. It's not big place but the decor is very cool. The risotto balls are a good appetizer to get especially with the sharp cheese in them. Loved the meatloaf taste like it was made at home. Definitely going to make this place a regular spot.

Best breakfast for celiacs.
My wife is not a celiac but she really enjoyed what she had. 
Congratulations for this great tastes.

When in philly don't  forget to stop here for your Philly cheesesteak. Went to a concert with friends and this place was packed but the service was quick. They had stools to sit on inside and the sweet potato fries were awesome.

Pizza in Florida, like The Big apple. The pizza was delicious but being downtown and having to pay for parking sucks. Parking is across the street but the minimum is 4hours for 10 dollars... make a day of it and explore things around the restaurant.
Awesome food. Nothing but mouth Os!  If you love Louisiana style food this is the place

I have always wanted to come here. I have no idea why it took us so long, but we were down the street at Easley and I saw on Yelp that it was like 2 blocks up the street, so it was like fate! It was 5 on a Saturday so they weren't busy and there was ample parking. we were seated right away and everyone was super friendly. My Aunt decided to get the pan friend chicken which did take 45 min to cook so we ordered it as soon as we sat down. She enjoyed it and she had a good portion of onion rings and she got fried green tomatoes as her side. she only ate 2 of the pieces, she got all dark. she thought it was a bit salty, but I had one of the pieces for lunch today and it was good. I am sure it would have been even better yesterday fresh. 
We decided to get an order of friend green tomatoes as an appetizer. They weren't my grandmother's but they were good. The dip was good too. 
They also brought us a plate of little cornbread pancakes and peach butter. They were really good. The first plate is free, but I think whatever they cost it would be worth it. I'd probably do that instead of the tomatoes next time. 
While our waitress got our drinks another lady came over and pointed out the special and said we should get in and just to make sure we tell our waitress. The special was Buy One, Get One 50% Off Chicken and Waffles Entrée.  It's only till mid July. So you'll have to see what they currently have. 
So of course we got the chicken and waffles! I got the 3 chicken tenders and my husband got the 3 chicken wings. We opted for normal waffles this time. But for .50 more you can get sweet potato, vanilla, strawberry, and I think blueberry. It's a flavor added to the waffle. 
My aunt was thrilled they had Pepsi and our waitress kept our glasses filled. I didn't time how long it took to get her chicken, but it must have been that long. Of course they served us together, but it was probably hers they took longer. 
I enjoyed my chicken tenders. I only ate one and took the other 2 home. They were good sized. Next time I plan to try the catfish. 
Our waitress did forget to factor in the special, but she fixed it immediately and apologized.  They helped up get out the door with my Aunt's wheel chair and even brought our leftovers which I totally left on the table. I was really grateful that he brought it out to us. 
I didn't find it overly expensive and we all enjoyed our meal. we will for sure go back.
One of the best-take out from a restaurant we've had. Fast, friendly and delicious!! We ordered twice dieting out 3 night beach stay and everything was perfect. Keep being awesome!

Great food large portions, unfortunately I did not get to enjoy my food as much as I wanted to because it was hot inside and could never cool down. May I suggest turning the air down lower so it's no so uncomfortably hot inside.

if you are gluten free, this is a great place to get mexican with a lot of options. their sopas are AMAZINGLY AWESOME. probably my favorite thing there! sometimes the dishes are almost too authentic for my americanized taste, but this place knows how to make a mean dish. the prices are definitely reasonable. one thing though, its cash only.

IN SHORT: Worth trying, and you won't be disappointed. Food was all well-executed and delicious. Ambiance, view, and a few dishes (especially desserts) were worth returning for. 4/5 because server was overbearing and interruptive, and one app's mustard took the dish over (was a cool flavor idea, but mustard masked the rest of the flavors) 

DETAILS: Server was doing their best to be entertaining, but ended up being overzealous and jarring. Up-selling felt obvious ($38 caviar was suggested as a "light starter" almost immediately after we sat, $54 lobster entree was recommended after we'd already finished ordering, one of my guests asked which of two wines was drier and the server said another, more expensive glass was "the better choice"), trying-too-hard jokes kept coming and falling flat, including nearly 6 about ordering tequila shots (we get you're tying to be fun, but read the room. Also one of my guests is pregnant). I feel bad because the server clearly cared, wanted us to enjoy ourselves, and was experienced, but it made conversation with my table difficult, and the otherwise-noteworthy meal annoying. They were very kind to return Sazeracs we found too sweet (I'm a mixologist and am very particular about Sazeracs).

Red Snapper app was great, Black Seabass entree w sweet/sour jus was a unique and delicious preparation, complementary bread selection was great on its own and as a sauce-soaker (never waste a good sauce...) and the two desserts we had were worth returning for. I can't remember names exactly, as I was too busy figuring out their intriguing physical design and flavors, but one had a dacquiose and fresh fruits on the bottom, and the other had a few scoops of honey peanut ice cream that looked like a solar system.

Overall, great experience, and I'll be back. All other staff was lovely and accommodating. Sit just before sunset if you can, as watching the skyline as the sun sets, letting the inky night grow speckled with streetlights, is unforgettable.

Wiz Kid is a great fast casual option if you're looking for something different in Center City for lunch.  I got the KFT sandwich and Wiz Fries, both of which were tasty and filling.  The KFT is apparently one of their smallest sandwiches, but I thought it was totally reasonable in size, and the portion for the fries was generous.  I'll definitely be getting lunch here again!
Yum, yum, yum.  I would go here everyday if I had the patience to wait and hour and a half for dinner every night.  The drinks are also fantastic!
Usually go to the Carmel Blaze. Came here tonight and Greg and his crew were spot on!  Fast, courteous, and very welcoming!  Pies were hot and delicious. Thanks!

Went for the cheesesteak.  Somewhat disappointing.  Meat was over salted.  Chopped well with mushrooms that were few and peppers.  Roll was weak and tasteless.  Other things may be good but there are better cheesesteak options

Love this place! Go there all the time for happy hour. They serve Oreana wines for their house wine for $5!!! Usually i go to places and for "Happy Hour " I get an off brand wine that is barley tolerable. Oreana rocks love their tasting room and all their wines! The happy hour food is really good too, lots of options and good portions! Definitely one of the top Happy places I would go to!!

Ordering is very easy, they use a kiosk really similar to Wawa. 

The cheesesteak here can hold its own. The meat is well seasoned and they have a housemade whiz. Bread is not your Amoroso hearth baked bread, but is fair. I wish the steak was cut in ribbons. The chunks are really small and almost minced. All of it was really good though.

Love the fries. Their cajun seasoning is really special. It's definitely not just Old Bay. Pay the extra .25 and give it a try.
I had no idea this restaurant existed. Probably because Carmel won't let them have a sign. Really? Way to support business!  Any who, the food was great. Locally owned. Can't wait to return.

Love yards beer, unfortunately my coworkers and I went here 3 times in the past two weeks and had horrible service each time. The wait staff is very slow, and this time the food unfortunately was not even edible. Last time we got our food before we even got our beers. Then this current time our waitress rang someone else's order onto my card , proceeded to bring the card back to me and insist that it was only a couple cense  difference on the charge and that it would make no sense for her to remove it and re ring my order to my card. I unfortunately will not be back . We asked to speak to the front of house manager and instead a very nice apologetic chef handled the situation. He refunded my meal which I fully appreciated.  Unfortunately I still will not be back due to the lack of good service, and the quality of my food. Shout out to chef Dylan though. He's the man
Best pizza EVER!!! Spaghetti is the best also!!!! I wasn't expecting the spaghetti to be very good, but I ordered it anyway and I was shocked. It's INCREDIBLE!!! I love this place!

This is the worst fast food restaurant ever. Not because of the food, I like the food, it's because of the ineptitude of the staff. This is not a one time thing...it is time after time after time. If you go there 10 times, 5 of the orders are wrong. It boggles the mind. There is nothing difficult about taking an order, typing it in the computer, and handing the person what they ordered. Unreal. Hire people with brains. That would help.

Going strong for 60+ years, this Delco restaurant staple delivers very good rustic food and service in an English pub atmosphere:  The best sautéed calves liver in pan gravy topped with bacon and onions...tender liver with still crisp bacon in a thickened au jus...FLAVORFUL!  While the rooms are kept meticulously clean, the heavily antiqued decor is heavy on the eye and this interpretation of 'English pub' stands a refresh. Get here before 5pm M-F for 30% off the entire food menu for an outstanding value.

Watered down tequila shots on "1/2 off ALL tequila shots". 
Here's the real punch in the face, brought a lemon with water, a lime with tequila, but no orange with blue moon... Not cool!

This was my first time at Siam Square. Unfortunately it is the only Thai food (that I know of) in downtown Indy. I ordered two lunch items to go: drunken noodles with tofu and the Bangkok fried rice with tofu. I ordered both Thai hot. Both came with a small cup of Thom yum soup. The soup was delicious- it had a nice spicy kick to it. Also came with the standard spring roll. The lunch portions were alright...for $9/entree, I felt a little cheated. There wasn't really any tofu in it either- maybe 4 pieces in each dish. However, I think maybe they forgot to add the spices to it? It was so mild, not even a trace of spiciness. I asked for a lot of the spicy red sauce to go with it and he gave me one small container. I asked for another one and he said he had to charge me for it! That is ridiculous. I have never been charged for hot sauce. If they would have made it Thai hot as I requested, I wouldn't have needed it anyways. So it ended up being $22 for two lunch entrees, including my extra hot sauce. So for small portions and those small portions not being flavored right and also lacking in tofu, I feel ripped off. Also, the guy who was working at the register and who took my order was really unpleasant. He seemed truly pissed off that I was inconveniencing him by being there. I probably won't go back here. I'll stick to my usual Thai place: Thai Kitchen in Fishers. Their lunch items come with soup, salad, and a spring roll. Those chefs there know how to do Thai spicy- I leave without being able to feel my tongue, just the way I want to feel after eating Thai food. Also, their lunch specials are only $7.50 and the portions are bigger. The staff are also much more pleasant and the ambiance of the restaurant is nicer. Sorry, Siam Square. I'm not a fan.
One of my favorites places to grab a beer on Mass ave. Great beer, good prices, and also good appetizers. Overall great experience every time I go.

So I went her on my lunch break. I thought since I had never been there I better get a taco salad because who can screw that up. I go it. It wasn't to bad. I will def go back and try other things. The taco salad was basically the Shell, hamburger, liquid white cheese, and shredded white cheese. It needs more flavor but wasn't to bad

Had a less than stellar experience here when it first opened, decided to give it another try.  Turned out to be a great return visit as the owner was extremely helpful, the steam table exceptionally clean, and the food was fresh, flavorful and authentic and the portions were generous.  Plantains were a real plus!  Being a real Chipotle fan, I would say that Andale is at the least comparable and it is about 25% less expensive.  That works in my book.

I have eaten at the Capital Grille and Philadelphia and DC and loved both of them.  I have been going to Barclay Prime for steaks the last few years but decided to try Capital Grille again mainly because of the location in King of Prussia.

This location does not compare to the other Capital Grille locations i have eaten at.  We went to celebrate a birthday; when we arrived we were told our table might be a few minutes late and strongly encouraged to go to the bar.  We chose to wait instead.  We were told that our table would be ready in a couple of minutes, so we waited, and waited and waited, directly in front of the host stand that featured 3-4 employees casually chatting and intermittently complaining about the other employees, to one another, dropping napkins on the floor, picking them up and refolding them to use!  About fifteen minutes after we were told our table was almost ready, I inquired how much longer it would be, to which one hostess giggled and nonchalantly said something to the effect of "oh, I'm sorry, I forgot" and immediately sat us.  This complete lack of concern should have been a red flag!

Our server was fairly good, forget to get us bread, but attentive otherwise.  I ordered their signature Kona crusted bone in new york strip, medium, my favorite dish at the Capital Grille--at this location it was a complete disaster.  They served it well done instead of medium, I sent it back, they brought me a new one rare, to medium rare--I asked them to heat it for just a minute or two--again it came back mostly well done.  At this point I did not bother sending it back and ate what I could of a piece of meat that had the texture of shoe leather.  My appetizer and sides were just okay, (one side had little to no salt).  Other reviewers stated that the bread was the highlight of their meal--sadly I had the same experience.  

I gave two stars because the decor is very nice and they deducted my disastrous steak from the bill.  However, I go to a high-end steak house to get great service and a good steak.  Unfortunately, in this case, the experience was reminiscent of eating at some cheap chain restaurant.
Rip off, food not worth the price especially for the small quantity given.  The Spaghetti was dry and very small amount foe $18!  Lasagna was Was better but that was 26.

Came in town for the day and looked up mexican restaurants and this place had great reviews.. the food was not good at all. I had chicken enchiladas and maybe it was the peanut butter sauce but it was disgusting.  The ground beef taco was even worse. I would have been better off going to taco bell. My stomach did not like this food.
good beers on tap and TVs are everywhere. Tired Hands just has me by the balls now, unfortunately.

This is a great texmex restaurant. Steak burrito is my go to option. Warning though, it can be spicy so you may want to get the sauce on the side. The charo beans will be spicy non-the-less. The margarita is also very good. Almost every chuy's has a different theme, so it is interesting to see how a region takes on the texmex theme. A great time to go is on Elvis's birthday, since they have a number of specials
Good stuff and supper good service custard id good and all problems are taken care of Nicely.

Place is really nice, kind of thought it would be bigger inside, bar as you come in, plenty of open seating when we arrived. Couldn't get an entrée since the kitchen wasn't set up for that so partner and I ordered the lamb burgers, mine medium his med rare. 

Mine was ok, partner didn't care for his and only ate half, didn't think it was that bad, friend told me it was a texture thing for him. On the plus side, the beer really was pretty good. Got a flight 4/4 oz pours for $6, not a stinker in the bunch.

I'd try this in the future and hit some entrees up, service was competent, no complaints.

There are those who live to eat (me), and then there are those who eat to live (the yawners).

Those who eat to live would like Fire by the Monon.  It's a safe pick, with options that are familiar to your palate.  In my opinion, the food reads better than it tastes.  I wasn't the biggest fan of my bites of Dirty Mac 'n' Cheese, Carnivore Flatbread, or Coop Chicken Sandwich. Perhaps more seasoning or a more zesty ingredient to give the dishes a little bit of pizzazz and a reminder that the best things in life should be delicious.

Given the other options in Broad Ripple and my overall food philosophy, I'm not going to fight the yawners for a table.  Life's too short to waste my calories.
Like the five stars state, St. Elmo Steak House is as good as it gets.  The steaks are juicy and delicious, and the servers always have a smile.

The truck is in a lot near Ye Old Coventry Tavern on Route 100.  Slow down when you see the "BBQ" sign (there's one on either side depending on what direction you're coming from).  

Fantastic BBQ!  The ribs are St. Louis cut - meaty, very little fat, with just the right amount of "tug".  Nice bark with a gorgeous color.  Lightly sauced in their house sauce.  Neatly cut.  Brisket was great, too - again, very little fat, cut at a good thickness, and well smoked with that tell-tale pink ring.  Baked beans taste of smoke and aren't overly sweet.  Cole slaw had nice crunch and very lightly dressed (mayo with a touch of vinegar but I could be wrong) which some might not prefer but I definitely do.  

TIPS: In addition to the house sauce, they also offer a terrific spicy sauce.  They only list small sizes for sides on their menu so you may want to ask if large sizes are available.  I definitely would've paid more for large sizes of the beans and slaw.

Friendly service and the prices are more than reasonable.  These good folks have definitely earned a spot in my BBQ rotation.
We waited ten minutes after being seated without being acknowledged, while several other people came in, were seated and served before we finally walked out. Terrible service.

Tried it twice. Wasn't the greatest hot chicken in Nashville. Spice was good but chicken was dry. Tried to grab some sweet tea second time around but they were out. I asked an employee for some sweet tea and I was told they aren't making anymore. It was not even closing time or any time close to it. Disappointed by the lack of attention to quality and customer satisfaction. Thank goodness for Hattie B's hot chicken!
The food was fantastic. The two guys running the show are some of the most friendly people I ever met. Hands down best Cajun food in the Nashville area.

Best little cafe, the V-Dal crepe was so good. Too big to eat both both the crepes with the Aioli was what made it. We enjoyed our breakfast in this quaint place. Waitress was super nice and attentive. Get there early the place fills up fast.

Venue outside is absolutely awesome. Pizza is not very good. This would be my favorite pizza place if the pizza was better. The sauce taste like it came from a can of spaghettios and they don't put much on for toppings. I ordered  a slice that came with 1 vegan pepperoni, 1 jalapeño, and 3 slivers of white onion on top. It was pretty weak. Crust was thin and s crispy with not much chew. I hope they improve their pizza quality as they have a lot of potential in their location. Guy working the window was nice.

This is my favorite place to get delicious food. I ordered at 8 pm on a Friday night last week and I expected to wait an hour like I have before with other pizza places but it came just within 25 minutes. The delivery boy (he drove a red car didn't get his name) was really courteous and one of the sweetest boys I've met in his generation. This is now my go to food place and I can't wait to order again and try their famous calzones and I will make sure to get extra cannolis this time for my kids- yum!!

Great and banging.  Great vibe.  Really nice staff.  


The one I get always is the spicy one and the truffle with the oozy egg. Soooo good.

Would love to eat here daily but I can't afford it. 
Would get 5 stars if they were cheaper.

The place has a great selection of breads. I like their sandwiches because you can tell they use fresh ingredients and like their bread, they have a good variety of sandwiches. I enjoy the cookies as well; they have some different flavors as well as the usual chocolate chip. The location is nice; it has a spacious sitting area and you can sit outside too if you prefer.

I am so appalled by this place due to the server we had. Clear classes 50's and curly red hair. 

We actually got married there so wanted to enjoy and visit anchor and brine and catch up. It was 3 in total. We ordered our drinks... toook forever. It took server 10'min to let us know they were out of a specific liquor. Fine no problem, here is the problem 

She dropped off our check saying this seating is only for people ordering food and there's people waiting. There was the booth behind us open and several seats by bar open . Mind you we wanted to order another round and were deciding on apps to share. She was so rude and abrasive. I told her we wanted another round and she denied us service at first and then said "okay I can do one more round" as if she's doing us a favor. When I told her we wanted to order a few apps she then had a change of heart which I followed with a nevermind . We were so off put by her and offended we decided to pay and leave. 

Place was NOT packed . The booth behind us waS EMPTY. Totally rude. Shame on you. We wanted to do our reception with them.... yeah no!

Went last night after working brunch and shopping. Had the arugula salad and then the mussels and had the picos (fruit forward red) all were absolutely delightful. Service was just right and of course, the atmosphere is beautiful.
Food was outstanding, best BBQ I had ever had. Service was fantastic, she was blonde and had a great smile. If you haven't been here... Get here.
Joining the waitlist in advance made a huge difference. The wait staff was friendly and accommodating. We went with several food options and none of them disappointed. Perfect brunch spot!

I definitely suggest making a reservation.  We arrived at our reservation time, heard them tell the gentleman in front of us it would be a 45 minute wait, and then were promptly seated at the table they had waiting for us. 

We ordered the duck fat tater tots as an appetizer, only order the half is there are just two of you.  The full order was way more than we needed for two. 

My friend had the sweet tea pork loin and I had the chicken fried chicken. Both were excellent. 

The staff is all very friendly and attentive.  This is for sure on the list for a return trip the next time I'm in Nashville.

We were in Gulfport for a wedding. Fish happened to be right across the street from where we were staying. One evening when we needed a bite to eat, we literally walked across the street. My husband ordered the chicken, which he reported being quite delicious. I ordered the breaded fish with a delicious mango sauce. Service with excellent. They provided bug repellent for the mosquitoes, and pointed the fans in my direction so that the bugs would stay off of us. This was a definitely plus for us. If anywhere near Gulfport, definitely stop over at Fish, you won't regret it!

Loved the tacos. It's awesome that they horchata that's really good too. The seating outside on the heated patio felt nice on a 55 degree day. Will definitely be back to try some of the amazing sounding cocktails.

We visited New Orleans from Milwaukee, and Friday lunch at Antoine's was our first meal in town. Our server was excellent. We both got the lunch special, which was three courses for $20.18. We also got the 25-cent cocktails and coffee with dessert. The food was delicious and a fantastic value. The dress was business casual, but the other reviewers are spot on when they said it ranges from shorts/T-shirt's/sneakers to very dressy for lunch. I think a nice pair of jeans and a dressier top for ladies and at least a collared shirt for guys is the safest choice. Would highly recommend as part of your New Orleans experience!

I was in the area and was looking for a breakfast place at a decent price. We stupid in on a Sunday morning and we're lucky enough to find an open booth. The place was pretty full! While the waiter was cleaning off our table, a man behind the counter was super friendly and chatted with us. We mentioned we were from out of state and had read good reviews about the company on Yelp. We ordered a cheeseburger, bacon and eggs, and the General Wayne sandwich. While we waited for our food, they brought us free samples of their fresh squeezed orange juice. It was some of the best orange juice we'd ever had. Our food was really fresh and hot, and everything was really tasty and well-priced. At the end of our meal, the owner surprised us with a slice of warm apple pie, telling us that "before we went back to New York, we had to try heir apple pie." It was a fantastic dessert. The staff was incredibly friendly, and the restaurant was clean and the atmosphere was really inviting. I'd definitely recommend checking this place out for breakfast or lunch. Thanks for a great meal!

I am shocked at the number of good reviews for this place! We stopped by here for a quick bite, and found the tables sticky and the food bland. I ordered their house specialty roast pork sandwich. It was just roast pork shavings between bread, and no flavor or spice AT ALL. I have eaten roast pork sandwiches at thousands of places, and this was definitely nowhere close to good. Yes, the pork was cooked well, but ZERO spices? We also ordered their country omelette, and till then I did not know someone could even mess up a simple omelette. Again, pretty tasteless and bland. The service was very good, but the food was just not something I will remember even an hour later, except for its blandness.

I used to live in the DC area where boba tea is delicious and abundant so my expectations may be a little high. With that being said I feel as if this place is just ok. 

I came here the other day and ordered an order of spring rolls and almond boba tea. The spring roll was good however it was almost $5 for just one. Most places an order consists of 2. The boba tea tasted like powder, water, and sugar. Definitely not the worst but not the best I've had.
I like to go for their daily lunch buffet. It's worth it for the price, but it might take awhile to get your drinks refilled.

This location has the best employees of any Taco Bell in town! They always have someone in the Drive Thru that's super energetic and sweet. And even when I go inside I'm ALWAYS met with nice employees. This is also the only location in town that's never messed up my order. A round of applause for the manager here, seriously.

Apparently getting seated right away is a rarity and getting to choose where you want to sit even rarer. We choose the covered patio as the view of the water at night is simply amazing. Besides the occasional cold draft, it was a great dining experience -- this has no bearing on my rating -- more to help explain my ordering the hot combination platter. 

Started with the combination platter with shrimp, clams. oysters, and mussels. This alone could have made me a happy camper and before I could finish, my order of fish and chips was presented. My companion ordered the cioppino and the seafood pasta. Imagine our whole table filled with seafood galore. Talk about getting our money's worth as the expression on the waiter's face when he had set everything on our table down was priceless. I think he was shocked by how much we had ordered... but we were definitely in the mood for some seafood.

This is by far the worst eating out experience I have had in the last 6-10 months. The place was completely empty except for one couple when I walked in and I imagined this would mean I would receive my food quickly but I was wrong. The restaurant was not very clean either, I counted 4 pieces of trash just from the vantage point of my booth. 

I waited about 15 minutes and at this point I was the only one in the restaurant. I had ordered a grilled horseradish roast beef and cheddar with NO ONIONS because, as I emphatically told the cashier (and she even said she didn't care for them either) I **hate** onions. I also ordered a side of mac and cheese.

I was facing the kitchen when I sat down and I could see at least one person working in the kitchen on their cell phone from the time I sat down to when I left which may explain the wait.

After 15 or so minutes, I received my order and immediately smelled onions. I opened the sandwich and I kid you not there was more onion than roast beef! It was an onion extravaganza. 

I returned the sandwich and waited about 5-8 minutes for them to make me another one which they brought out with new mac and cheese. Unfortunately the mac and cheese tasted like it had been made a week before and was completely mush. Disgusting and tasteless. 

The sandwich was on a nicely toasted bun but they were very stingy on the roast beef and the beef that was there was dry, boring, and tasteless. There was as much cheddar cheese as roast beef and hardly any horseradish. 

After a fountain drink,  I felt like I was eating a slightly less than medicare $11 grilled cheese with a few spoonfuls of whatever they were alleging to be roast beef.

This place was one disappointment after another and I did not even eat 1/2 of my food because it was terrible. I really dislike this place and will never EVER go back.

Ninja is my favorite place in New Orleans to have sushi. I have been a customer here for 15 years. The rolls are larger than most sushi bars. It's a laid back place and prices are reasonable try the Goma miso roll its excellent. Their fish is always the freshest.

The wait is pretty long, but I think that's just because this place is fairly new and is among some of Tucson's very few ramen-specific places.  I've been here 4 times now and have tried the black garlic tonkatsu, red chili tonkatsu, white tonkatsu, and miso ramen. My favorite is the black garlic, the flavor is really rich and savory. The chili was good as well, it was just a bit too much spice for me as I got near the end of the bowl. After having the other 2 types of tonkatsu ramen, the white tonkatsue was too boring for me in comparison. The miso is the most "basic" or typical ramen flavor in my opinion.
Each bowl comes with a slice of chashu pork, ginger, (some come with corn), and I think seaweed. I think that the portions are okay for their price, but if you're still left hungry, you can order more noodles for a small price.

Got the spicy broiled fish filet for dinner tonight.  I was super surprised to realize that it's actually very legit one I got!  The flavor, fish tenseness, overall is very good consider I'm no longer in Southern California neighborhood, and that I didn't ask them to make sure it's cooked authentically.  Will rerun if I'm in town again next time.

4 stars with all things considered!

PS. Portion is decent too

This place has TERRIBLE customer service and are RACIST. A group of friends and I went to get a slice of pizza from the bar. I didn't add a tip to my ticket because I was going to pay cash and as soon as I was reaching in my pocket to get her cash tip the bartender aggressively asked "Why aren't you tipping me?" I told her that I was actually getting cash out of my pocket but felt attacked and did not feel comfortable tipping more as she was extremely unprofessional. She then continued to yell and tell everyone at the bar that I was a "black cheap ass". I left the bar immediately as I did not want to allow her to mess with my inner peace but I will NEVER go here again and if you are any POC you will more thank likely have the same experience, sadly. This truly saddens me. Do better!
Delicious BBQ and Friendly staff.  It is very busy so you may have to wait to eat in.

I came into town to visit my parents and this spot caught our eye. Everything was amazing!!! From the view to the food to the drinks & service. I enjoyed the Surf & Turf sliders as well as the Crab Stuffed Shrimp. They were so unique and delicious. Also if you're a cheesehead like myself the Charcuterie & Cheese Board omg I cant even get started on that one. Definitely recommended and I'll definitely be coming back before my vacation is over!

I'm a regular here for a good reason! The owner and employees are wonderful. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming. The employees are always helpful, if you don't know what you want they'll give you great suggestions. Much better than Starbucks. The almond milk chai is my favorite and their breakfast sandwiches are prefect for when you are on the go.
Adele is so nice and the food was amazing!!  Will be coming back.

I am not sure what really intrigues me about this place the atmosphere, friendly staff, or the food.  I experienced all three.  I also, not sure why, like the fact that the restaurant is two stories.  I was greeted very nicely with a "ello love", not sure if that was intentional but it put me in the mood.  I stated I wanted to get a table, asking how long the wait was, and explained if none was available I had shopping to do to take up the time (prior visits they have taken my cell phone number and text me when my table was ready).  She replied that seating was available and did I want inside or outside and sat me immediately.

One of the reasons I wanted to stop here for dinner was I remembered they serve Hobgoblin from Wychwood Brewery.  It is a full bodied British ale with a good hop taste that has some fruity chocolate after tones due to the malt they use.  Not much to say just full of flavor dark ruby colored beer. Good!

It was not long before I was ordering my beer and checking out the food menu.  There was a bunch of nice choices. I decided on the English Pot Roast.  It came out in a plate with an oversized edge with shredded beef mixed with carrots and peas topped with mashed potatoes.  Because the mashed potatoes were on top I tried them first.  The initial impression was they were cool and I was concerned.  So not to be hasty I tried the pot roast which was more than hot enough and had the home cooked pot roast juicy (yummy) flavor (even had a small touch of fat left in it) that you would expect from mom's slow cooker.  The roast was the hit of the dish.  The carrots and peas were good adding texture with complimentary flavors to round out the dish.  Of course the pot roast wound up mixed with the mashed potato which totally changed my opinion on the potatoes.  As the juices from the pot roast melded with the mashed potatoes accompanied by carrots and peas it became chorus that could not be ignored.  I was practically full but found myself forcing to the finish.

Well a Pub means meeting friendly folk.  I was not disappointed.  From the first person I met to the floor manager roaming the dining area, everyone was extremely friendly.  Even the staff passing by did not hesitate to answer a question.  That is when I found out they air Barclay's Premier League games which means lunch, soccer, and beer someday.  

I am still going with four stars because in spite of the one negative I experienced they handled it giving me the confidence it would be taken care of.  I had the unfortunate experience of having to report the men's room needed attention as there was  1/2 inch flooding in one of the stall areas and the other had paper towels strewn throughout.  I experienced this going out the door and they did give me a positive impression of responding to the situation.  So I am sticking with my positive experience.

Amazing!

Got the octopus appetizer. Amazing. The bruschetta, the goat cheese and honey and egg salad. Delicious. Spaghetti carbonara. Thank you YELP for helping me find this place!
Great place. Fun atmosphere. Great staff. The food was on point. If you want fresh seafood with an East coast twist in the Tampa area- this place is for you. Very family friendly.

I came In yesterday for a single lady date day, and it was seriously the best experience I've had in a very long time! My server was Lacy, she was amazing! Beyond helpful, I asked her to surprise me with lunch and I'm sure that's annoying but she picked the perfect meal! The Gorgonzola burger so yum! She made me feel like I was an old friend and I love that kind of service! Thanks yard house for a great lunch and thanks lacy for the great conversation!

My favorite local spot. Server Ovid is very polite, genuine, and funny. His sincerity in wanting to give you best experience possible is refreshing. The restaurant is clean and inviting. I recommend this place to all my friends who think there is nothing to offer in the willingboro area besides fast food. This location is a neighborhood gem.

The BF and I stopped in on a Saturday night around 7:30pm.  We did not have a reservation and were fine with sitting at the bar.  Cute restaurant with big garage door windows.  The windows were open and it was not cool enough for that.  I thought the bar area was way too warm and needed the AC.  The bar itself is quite large but they jammed in so many bar stools, we were crammed in.  I think removing 1-2 chairs would make the bar more comfortable.

Our bartender was very friendly.  She was quick to come over and get our drink order and ask if we wanted to see the food menu.  I ordered the JW chicken and the JW potatoes; the BF went with the grilled steak.  It took over 40 minutes for us to get our food.  Seriously.

The chicken was good.  I would not say it was THE BEST chicken of my life.  It was moist with a semi-crispy skin.  I had a bite of the grilled steak and I thought that was more flavorful than the chicken.  I was really disappointed with the potatoes.  They were so overcooked they tasted burnt.  Not good at all and definitely not worth the price.

I had high hopes for Adele's and was really looking forward to trying it out.  I would probably give it another try--everyone has an off night.
Good food, busy atmosphere. A surprisingly good burger that lives up to the hype.  The wurst platter is a nice bit of food for the money.  I'll be back for sure.

I had high hopes for these street tacos. Unfulfilled :(
They were luke warm and seemed like it was not cooked fresh.

One of the best gumbos around.  So always order at least a cup when you go.  I am a boiled shrimp kinda guy but the fried shrimp poboys are really good. 

Oysters.  Oysters. Oysters!  That's another reason why I come and all forms served here is fantastic. 

Did I mention the gumbo was really good?   I don't live very far from here so needless to say I sometimes wear it out.  I forget to check in to add it to my Yelp kingdom but its that good I forget to do anything else like take pics or check in... all I want to do its consume once I walk in.

Lunch time pre covid days can get very LOUD.  Especially a back room. The worst is being in there with a bunch of loud salesmen that start shouting over each other. Ugh.   Dinners is different unless there is some super loud woo woo women in there.  Though they go where the margaritas are so it isn't often they end up in Salvos.  Except for all you can eat nights.  Then it gets loud.  

During crawfish season they also sell live sacks of crawfish out the side of the building.  Competitively priced too.  And unlike the the Lafitte based crawfish sellers , I think Salvos "crawls" their sacks so I rarely get any dead ones or other fish or grass in the sacks.

The gumbo here is awesome.

This is a place you'd drive by a few times and think, "Uh, is that a trailer? I shouldn't eat there." But, you'd be wrong. You should definitely eat here. Yes, this place is a double wide with a patio but what it lacks in actual walls it makes up for in charm and fun. 

My boyfriend and I randomly stopped here one night after a tough workout. We were starving and a salad just wasn't gonna cut it. I was craving a burger and fries while my boyfriend ordered the Thursday night sirloin special. Neither item disappointed. The fries were perfection and while my burger wasn't a stand out, it was exactly what I wanted. The boyfriend loved his sirloin and mashed potatoes and didn't leave any on the plate. 

To close out our post workout pig out we ordered the $1 shooter desserts which was basically a little cup of butter pecan ice cream with some delicious syrup drizzle. They were perfect. 

This place has live music, an owner who stops by the table just to say hi and see how everything is. The service was fast, friendly, and easy on the eyes. This place lives up to the phrase "never judge a book by it's cover."

My first trip there, it is such a cool little place! I got pancakes, they were delicious, but so big, I could only eat 1 1/4.my husband got their spin on eggs Benedict. Awesome! I want to bring my nephews, they would love everything about it! Definitely coming back! Thank you for a great breakfast!

Bought a 10pc combo (1/2 spicy hot and island jerk) with garlic rosemary parmesan fries. The wings were unbearably salty and the fries weren't what I expected, I should have asked, they were too dry i.e. parmesan sprinkled on fries, dry rosemary and whole roasted garlic, I was expecting something like a garlic butter. I have had better, I'll give the Fresh Side a try next time. Neat place, at least I can say I've been there.

I love this place but I think the website needs fine tuning. I ordered a scoop but got a sandwich. It might have been user error but then again scoop should be scoop right??  Overall this is the best spot for chicken salad for sure.

Stopped by Huck Finns as it was a pick up place for a tour we had booked. We had enough time for breakfast so reviewed the menu..
We both had Pain Perdu which basically means you are getting french toast with a small bowl of fruit.
The french toast was excellent, maybe the best we have eaten in a long while. The menu says it is prepared New Orleans style. Not sure what that means but it was something a little unique to make it different than other french breads (Pain Perdu) we have had.
The fruit was okay but the star of the show is the Pain Perdu.
The waitress was excellent, there to refill the coffee when needed and friendly.

We were driving through the city of Reno en route to San Francisco, and my vegan friend needed some eats. This place popped up, and despite the seemingly strange neighborhood, this place was amazing from the second I stepped in the door.

There was a line, but it was moving quickly.  The menu presents many options for all appetites, and all diets. The prices were moderate especially for somewhere offering so many vegetables, which many restaurants lack. 

I got a thai bowl, and a highway to kale salad. This was too much food for me, but leftovers are dope so whatev.

If I ever find myself in the worlds biggest little city again, I'll def stop by these digs.
Good, normal quality. However, I have to cancel my order 50% of the time because the online ordering doesn't work.

Came in late night for a slice. Their line was super long and the process did not seem very efficient to get people through. I got a cheese and pep/sausage slice. It tasted like boxed frozen pizza. And it was luke warm. Not very good at all! The prices are outrageous too. 5 dollars for a slice. Come on!!

After living in Tampa for over 5 years and seeing the Mel's Hot Dog sign off 275 we finally made it there. What in the world were we waiting for??? I could kick myself! 

When you first walk in it's a sight, decorated like a 50's diner with red and chrome everywhere. I personally thought it was pretty cool. The menu is on the wall in huge letters. You order, give them your name and when it's done you will be called. 

While waiting you can take in the sights that offer pictures from over the years of people in their Mel's tshirts, hats, etc from all over the world, including some celebrities. 

The hot dogs were completely on point! I ordered a chili dog with onions, now I wasn't excited that to add onions it was 79 cents considering the cost of the hot dog in the first place, but after eating it, who the heck cares?? The bun is a poppy seed steamed bun and it was perfect. I would suggest that if you are expecting a "regular" sized hot dog to order a Mighty Mel's size dog... the dog that came on mine was 1/8th of a pound and was pretty hidden in the chili and onions, but keep in mind that the Mighty Mel is a skinless version so it won't have the snap like the natural casing does. Brian ordered the Chicago dog, and just looking at it, amazing. His face after the first bite said it all. HOMERUN!!

Now that we have finally tried this place, we will be back, and probably more often than I'll want to admit. We have already told family about it!

As a side note, it you are looking for a cheap hot dog joint, this is not the place for you. If you know good quality Chicago style franks and understand the good quality equals more money, then you're at the right place.
We have never had a bad experience here. We always pick it up ourselves. So I can't comment on delivery. Their food is always super hot & great tasting. Definitely recommend.

Excellent BBQ, the brisket was thick cut, tender and flavorful! The sides are great. I guess they have special sides that aren't normally on the menu. On the day I went, they had burnt ends, beer, cheese soup. YELP, it was the truth.

This place is dangerously convenient from my house so I've had a handful of experiences here. The problem is there has never been consistency with the service and/or the food. SoWe recently celebrated their 1 year birthday (and had a celebratory party which was a disaster for too many reasons to list) so I don't buy the "growing pains" anymore. With such a centralized graduate hospital location it's a shame this place can never be on the same page.

I will say the pork belly sandwich I had recently was a 5 star item. So much flavor and the herb salad was a fantasy complement. But this is after the previous time my medium burger came out well done and a over a half hour later. In my experiences the fries have always been crispy and seasoned well though. I'm not sure what's going on behind the scenes but during a happy hour recently a bartender was giving my friend unprovoked lip, not cool. See a common theme here?

I really want to like this place and if I could trust it, I would be spending a lot more time here. But for now when I have people over that want to go out and grab a quick local bite I'll take the extra time to walk somewhere I can get the experience I'm expecting.

I absolutely love the gyros!!! And the tatzikie (sp) sauce!! And they have the best French fries which was unexpected lol. Meat melts in your mouth! We are regulars for sure and recommend them to everyone!!! And the staff are so friendly and patient!!
Not a good experience.  Been there before and it was always good. Lately its really been bad. Food is tasteless and burnt and takes a long time to get.  What happened ????   Darn shame.....
Don't come here if you are vegan, 90% of the menu items that say vegan are mislabeled. This is very dangerous for anyone with food allergies, they should be shut down

We were looking for a place outside expensive and busy Santa Barbara and I've always loved Carpinteria.  I'd never eaten there.  Just been there for the beach and on the way to camping.  Found it on Yelp and decided to give it a try.  My sister in law from Scotland was with me as we had just visited my son (her nephew) up at UCSB.  We were attended to immediately even though it was a busy Sunday morning.  Nice man with alot of energy seated us and took our order.  Really seemed to care about our experience and the food we ordered.  My sister in law loved the authentic diner/cafe feel.  The food was delicious and plentiful. I will definitely be back next time I'm in Carpinteria.

Don't use the online ordering system. I was quoted 15 minutes and 45 minutes later still no email saying my order was ready. When I showed up to inquire as to why it was still not ready they told me they were out of the crazy bites. I received no call, email, or anything. I assume they were just not going to do anything at all. I placed the order online for the sole purpose of avoiding this and to give them time to make them. When I asked to replace the crazy bites with normal crazy bread they informed me that they were also out of the crazy bread. Because I had prepaid with my card I wound up being charged for bites I never received and cold wings. Never again.
We walked in the other day.  The waitress was singing.  Loudly and badly.  The diners looked horrified.  Like a hostage video.  We turned around and left.
I don't wanna discourage ppl from eating here but good luck  the entire city is lacking when it comes to food so again good luck
Food is ok but service is horrible every time, the kids act like they are doing you a favor to wait on you, never been in here that this was not the attitude

Oddly enough, I don't come here often for gyros. I love their hamburgers and Greek salads. Don't get me wrong, the gyros are good, but the way they cook their patties on a wood burning grill gives it just the right amount of smoky flavor that keeps me coming back for more. Their Greek Salad is always made top-notch with 100% fresh ingredients so I always add this with my burger.

The employees here are great and really seem to care about their job. I'm not saying this is a necessity and that I always expect people I restaurants to LOVE their job, but it's nice to see when they do. I don't know if I'm looking way more into this than I need but I get the feeling that the owner of this Hungry Greek is very selective about who he hires. Maybe I'm noticing this because there's another Greek place down the street (Pita Pit) that has decent food but I avoid like the plague    because I can't stand the people who work there. But Pita Pit is more fast food and the Hungry Greek is more or less the in-between fast food and a full scale restaurant.

Note: $4.99 Gyros on Tuesday!!

Great food option in Westchase, especially if you like Greek food. But I wouldn't be a true Yelper if I didn't find something to complain about and this is the only flaw I can see: their fries. It's the weakest link. They do so good at other items but miss the fries. They taste like the freezer ones from the store. It's somewhat of a letdown to finish this juicy, well made burger or gyro and then you get to the fries - and don't want to finish half of them.

Anyway, overall I'm always ringing the bell to hear the guys say "opa" when I leave.

I came here on Passover, so I can't comment on the bread or in fact most of the dishes. But, my short ribs were tasty. There was nothing special or innovate about the dish, but it was prepared well. At the table, some really enjoyed their meals (Eg duck special) and some did not (chicken with rice dish). But overall, a good BYO option.

I must of went to the wrong place from the rest of these people. Really!! all these people must be veggie, because if you call that a steak sandwich we are in trouble. 3 slides of meat does not make a steak... LOL. The chicken salad on two piece of dry bread with some lettuce and a few olives does not cut it.  Very disappointing  from these reviews with my visit. I will say it was better than subway.

Nothing fancy about this place, but great quality. This a great low-key place to grab some good food, a couple beers, and catch up with some friends. The calzones are superb, and many options are available. There is a great beer list as well. Prices are affordable, and appropriate for the portion sizes. This place is keeping it simple, and doing it well.

Having loved the food at their University location, I visited the new downtown location this past weekend.  This was not the food that I remembered at all.  It tasted different and the presentation was just unappetizing.  The worst part was the awful, horrible music they had on satellite radio in the background that was just loud enough that you couldn't ignoreit.  We didn't even stay for my favorite mango sticky rice dessert because of the music.  The service was nice, but everything from food, decor, raised prices and a lack of take-out has created in me a firm desire to eat elsewhere.

I really liked this place! I am very familiar with the shopping center that the cafe is located and just never went in. I don't know why! I had the fruit & cheese salad with grilled chicken. It was really good! You can tell everything was made fresh and used fresh product. The portion was also big enough I was able to save the rest of the salad for dinner. I will definitely be back and soon!! I can't wait to try other dishes. I think the lavender salad is next...
The salty pig is absolutely amazing! I come here from center city just because it's just that good. Friendly people too.
Very good wine selection. Service was great. Food so-so. The menu is pretty good, just not executed well.

This place caught my eye when I was searching for a place to celebrate my birthday. I made reservations through the Resy app. Parking was easy to find in the structure across the street from the restaurant. Liberty will validate your parking for you. Just remember to bring your parking ticket with you and give it to your server. 

I ordered the pappardelle bolognese and the winter Paloma. The bolognese was great and all their pastas are handmade in-house. It was very filling that I had to take some of it home. Others in my party got the black spaghetti and the pizza special. The black spaghetti came with clams, scallops and shrimp and was delicious. The pizza special was similar to a Margherita except with burrata cheese and red onion. 

Overall the food and service were excellent. I loved the ambiance. The walls were decorated with artsy photos of famous people. The price point was very reasonable for a dinner out. The server also gave me a complimentary dessert since I was celebrating my birthday. I would recommend going here and stopping by the axe bar next door for a fun night out.
Skip everything on the menu except for just the original homemade pancake with butter and syrup....

Not a fan.  The fajitas were bland and the steak seemed as though it were steamed not grilled or even sautéed.  The tamales weren't good either. Very thick masa and dry pork.  

I wouldn't recommend it.

Have been to this location several time and service is just not very good.  There are no lines and everyone just stands around waiting.  They pick who they like to wait on.  There is never enough counter help.  I felt so disrespected today by lack of service that I will not return.  I've over looked the lousy service before but I'm done being not waited on and ignored.

I walked in and was wow'ed. Not my first time at a food court but somehow Reading Terminal is better and is a bit more than your typical food court. There are a lot of homemade goods and freshly made food. I loved all the Amish stalls. The prices for the most part are pretty decent. My favorite stall is the fresh donut stall from Beiller's. if you are visiting Philly, this is a must see place.

The shakes are AMAZING!!! Wait was expected because of the events and attractions in the area so we managed our time and when we got to our table we were blown away by the service and professionalism by everyone involved! In these difficult times with the pandemic and restaurants doing everything they can to make it and make every customer safe they really did an excellent job! Will be taking all my visiting family here when they come in town!

Food magicians! This place is amazing. I stop in for a weekly vegan BLT and it's usually my favorite part of Thursday. The coconut "bacon" is out of control delicious. Everything they make is pretty, delicious, and nutritious. It's great for dine in or take out. Their space is pretty and welcoming and clean, with art on the walls and smiles on their faces. The staff is friendly and the owner will take time to talk with you about the food. They will also modify things for you without any second guessing or judgement (I have been known to make my BLT into a salad and they do it happily!) Ingredients are fresh and vibrant and everything is perfectly prepared. Love love love Leaf! 

Note: You *do not* have to be a vegan to enjoy the food. If you like good food, you will like Leaf. Their menu is easy to navigate for vegans and non vegans alike.

I came here for dinner with my fiance.  Averaging $50/person, I was expecting better tasting food and better service.

The risotto was steeped in butter and sodium.  I don't know how anyone eats something like that.  I had 1/3 of the plate then threw the rest out.

The evening was not busy, yet, we had to ask for the other wait staff to find our waiter.  He comes to take our orders 5 minutes later.  The next time we see him is when our food comes out.   From the way we were treated from being seated to leaving the restaurant, I only have one word to describe our waiter's demeanor:  Arrogant.

The one-star for the evening goes to the serving boys.  I commend them for being well-dressed and attentive to our table (refilling our glasses, bread, and butter frequently).

In the end, my fiance and I left John Mineo's hungry and with $100 less in my wallet.  We stopped by Taco Bell on the way home.

The next time I'm feeling like Italian, I'm going back to the Hill or Maggiano's...

The best sea food restaurant I've been to! The spice level was on point! We choose the hottest and it was exactly as we imagined...if you're Yoruba, this is ata rodo spice level! Also the sauce was absolutely delicious and I enjoyed every piece, from the potatoes to the corn, crab and shrimp...will visit again and again!

This review is commenting specifically on the baked goods, the coffee, and the soups--the only items I've purchased from ABP. 

Speedy service especially if you are in a rush. While prices are considered higher than the other places around the medical campus, I always know I will get good food quickly. They always have the "fresh until" sign hanging on their coffee dispensers.  For coffee that's been sitting out, it's good.

bruh. the worst service I have ever experienced. When we walked in, they said they just had to quickly clean off a table for us. Turns out it was their "trash table" that they had been placing all of their dirty dishes on. After watching 2 waitresses move as slow as molasses to clean off all of their crap, they finally just put 5 of us outside at a tiny table. 
Waiting around for over 30 minutes, they finally took our order. The salads and appetizers came out relatively quick, but then the main meals sat under warmers for another 30 minutes. 
overall the worst service I have ever received; the staff showed a glaring lack of interest to serve customers. DON'T GO HERE.
Just tried it! Extremely impressed with the quality AND quantity of food! I'll absolutely be back! Came back again and got the chicken tenders! They were awesome can't go wrong with the food here!

Eugene and John definitely have the best coffeehouse in this city. They not only serve the best coffee they offer the best service I have encountered. In the short time i have know them, I consider them my friends. I am very critical of coffee. I am from Seattle so we know our stuff. I moved here two months ago and it took a while to find a great coffee place. I will not go anywhere else but here for coffee. Anything else, is just plain subpar. Try out their pastries as well, you won't be dissapointed.

A friend and I went down staurday night for karaoke. The place seemed cool at first.The lady running it we figured out pretty fast was not kind to new people singing. she would turn the microphone all the waaaay down so you couldn't hear them. This happened to me and my friend too. At first the place was packed. But I think when people started figuring that part out they left. Toward the end people started complaining to her to restart the song and turn up the microphone. Once you could hear them they were actually pretty good. She also let the people she new cut others in the list. She drove away business except for the 4 locals that she let sing with their mics turned up. We had a couple of drinks which were not good and left. Won't be back. I have done a lot of karaoke in my life and have never had this experience. Not a good one either.

My husband loved it, particularly the short rib taco...Me? It's ok, I wasn't the biggest fast- the bread is kinda oilly -overpowering for me. Service was poor and the place was a mess- maybe because it was viva la fiesta weekend- that's why I gave it a average rating and not a lower rating. This is what it comes down to, I really really love tacos, but once you change the corn tortillas to parata bread, Indian flatbread, pan fried- the whole dynamic of the taco changes & probably why I can't rate them any higher... Nice try guys, you have a cool concept, but it's not for everyone

I go in here all the time and a couple days ago I went in unsure of what to get and the employee named Julianna was very helpful with informing me on all their drinks. She helped me finally decide on a vanilla latte and made it seconds later. She was friendly, informative, and I could tell she was very hardworking. Employees like her are what make me come back to restaurants and coffee shops.

So being a California girl we were so nervous to find a place with good Mexican food. Welp we found it! Being vegan there are several things you can tweak to make this place a hit. I went for the large tortilla plain bean burrito, topped with a red sauce. 

Not only am I still full but, it was as authentic to Cali as I have found yet. No tex-mex here. 

The margaritas are amazing, being that I can't consume sweet and sour they made a skinny margarita that was delightful. Fresh fruit inside.... (which I will say hold off on next time because the seeds) but, still top notch.

We will return with the kiddos next time! 

Thanks Iguana's for taking us back to Cali for a delicious

VERY healthy. Love what they are aiming for, we need MORE healthy options in this city.. time for eating garbage is no time. Service was quick, food was good.. drinks at juice bar were ridiculous.. we loved them.  Sit down service, or takeout.. it's worth checking out. 

A little pricey, wish they could lower their margins a bit to make this a place we can hit more often.
Fun and creative menu of small plates. Unique ingredients total foodie spot. Great date night!

Giovanni sandwich was legit - really flavorful bread and a solid amount of veggies and cheese inside, nothing skimped here. Also, fresh chocolate chip and cherry cookies 2/$3?!...how can you say no- great spot and friendly staff!

Didn't expect it but, James Joyce Irish Pub & Eatery was truly extremely good. Wonderful energy across the board. James Joyce Irish Pub & Eatery has a magnificent Award Winning Jameson Burger, this dish will blow you away with its outstanding taste and flavor. All of the staff are super welcoming - you certainly feel welcome and taken care of. I definitely recommend this place and will be back.

Still not understanding why this place has so many stars. 

Ordered the boom boom shrimp for appetizer, I got the jambalaya with a caesar salad and my boyfriend got the shrimp/crab cakes with french fries and a shrimp bisque. Needless to say the best part of the meal was probably the fries (probably frozen). The boom boom shrimp was basically overly fried pieces of batter with a thick honey mustard-like sauce. My jambalaya was okay, nothing spectacular but I could not have more than a couple of bites. My boyfriend barely ate even one of his two crab cakes, which is saying a lot because he eats massive portions. His shrimp bisque was too thick and obviously microwaved. 

Not only was it not very good, the prices were high for what it was. Definitely would not recommend.

The only positive about this place was the service. Our waitress was attentive and quick. Not her fault the food was awful.

I was expecting great food to come out of here because a lot of people from work had talked this place up.  Well, I was very disappointed, the fries seemed like they had been sitting in oil all day, the burger was dry and the drinks were flat. Don't waist your time here.....
I loved this place. It had the Panera menu I like so much and a quiet area where I could focus on my laptop for a while.

Best breakfast in Santa Barbara! Highly recommend the Tugboat, YOLO, or Rolex.

Staff is always friendly and service is prompt!

Piper's is currently running their 'Around the World' menu.  You can check the menu under 'Specials' on their website. We have not been yet (just started on Oct 26th) but we have gone in past years and had amazingly wonderful ethnic dishes. They are offering  fare  from Germany, Hungary, Mexico, Italy, Spain, Korea, China and more. And, if you go on Wednesday you can also take advantage of their 1/2 price bottles of wine offer.

This place is fabulous, the location the vibe and the food.  They have inside or outside seating.  I arrived around 5 pm and most of the outside seating was booked with an hour wait.  Inside seating was available so I requested a seat close to the patio door.  Which was denied but my waiter Ricardo made it happen for me. Ricardo was helpful with picking out drinks and explaining entrees.  We ordered the Gator tail, Alligator hush puppies, Calamari, Crab Mac and cheese, charbroiled oysters and the Seafood Risotto.

The Gator tail was seasoned well and nice size portion.  The hush puppies also and came with four.  The Calamari was so good still thinking about it.  The Crab Mac n Cheese was not my favorite.  It was just okay!  Could've used some real cheese and less watery cheese.  The charbroiled oysters were delicious my only complaint is that 3 of my oysters were so small they were literally the size of a quarter and when this was brought to Ricardo's attention he said you can't choose or control what you get!  Wow that's a statement when the oysters are $17 for 6.  He did however replace one of the 3 small oysters so I guess he tried.
The highlight was the seafood risotto, it is my new favorite.  The dish is everything you would imagine a great mix of seafood with all the flavors.  My compliments to the chef.
