Staff very nice and you can sit on very swanky twist lounge where full menu is available  or morr traditional dining area good for kids, those who don't like hanging beads and unique decor.

Bathroom was clean and updated/huge trough sink outside bathroom in twist lounge-unique but did not love washing hands outside of bathroom

Not so good-my smoking goose bacon ony biscuit Sammie not very good, biscuit Sammie sorta small and served on tony plate
Wanted to place to go order and they didn't have enough food to give me 1/4 lb? How does a restaurant have a problem making an item they make? Oh well, it was for egg salad and server was kind enough to give me free small sample where I learned their egg salad was quite salty and had capers-NOt a fan of capers and I like salt but it was too much.

Sweet and cute local diner. We were in the area for the weekend and ate breakfast here two days in a row. The menu is straightforward not fancy breakfast and lunch. Service is fast and friendly, and the clientele is friendly locals. There is a retro counter with stools, and a separate dining room with tables. We sat in the dining room. Breakfast prices are pretty reasonable for this affluent area, and our eggs, turkey sausage and rye toast were done perfectly. The coffee was very good too, and our server was quick to refill our cups. You gotta love a good diner and this is a good diner.

Ate at the bar to elude the ridiculous double-line queue of hungry patrons. Our wait: 3-4 minutes because we sharked out the bar area.

Expected and reliable fare for the brunch hour. Pineapple mojito was quite tasty!
Some rocket salad with shaved cheese, some pear, blue cheese flatbread, a chicken avocado grilled club, and we foiled our own plans: absolutely no room for any cheesecake.

Kinda defeated the purpose for coming. Among 3-4 other CF that O have patronized, this one in DE is a bit smaller (Pdx, Sacto, SF). Ever popular and swarming...can access the restaurant from the exterior. 90 degrees away from the Brio/CPK/Lawson side.
This restaurant has amazing food! The avocado fries are a must try. Good service, small restaurant feeling. Expect a long wait if it's peak time, but it's worth it!
I've been coming to this place for 20+ years. Awesome food. Great service. I'd eat there everyday if I could. Great food!  The staff is great to deal with. Prices are affordable. Great atmosphere.
I love this place so much! Happy hour specials are the best in the city and our waiter joe was so awesome!! Definitely check it out!

I am a complete sucker for an authentic torta.  Tell me a place has tortas and I will book mark it right away and get there as soon as the opportunity presents itself.

These guys have a boatload of reviews and I hate doing the "me too" write ups so here are some bullet points instead:

+ green & red salsa: both flavorful and the green one was unique

+ spicy shrimp torta: really good, loved the flavor of the shrimp and the spice level

- No fountain soda, only cans

+/- frozen offerings looked good but I was not offered anything (yes, I could have asked if I was really interested)

Very friendly service + good food = I'll be back!
The best Thai I've ever had, and I live in New York! My dads go to place so we've ordered multiple times since I've been here. Pad Se Ew, Pad Thai & Egg rolls are my go to, all incredible.

Sat for 20 mins with 2 cars ahead of me to start. Absolutely the worst costumer service. Sat at the pick up window for 5 minutes as the employees sat and talked. My food was previously packed and waiting on the counter but still the employees still sat and chatted. Employee hands me wrong bag  I said is this the door dash order says nothing shakes head and finally gets my ready order off the counter and throws it in my car without saying a word. Good luck with your future guys!

This place is amazing! Always welcoming & food is delicious! They have gone above and beyond to make sure customers are safe during these trying times. They sanitize tables, they ALL wear mask & insure patrons wear mask as well. It is city ordinance to wear a mask. It  is sad that humans lack the compassion and are so inconsiderate not wearing mask, I will continue to patronize them. Shame on the person that is upset they actually want to protect others. I was actually there last night when a group came in with no mask. The staff was polite yet direct. 

I didn't notice any Trump paraphernalia but I did notice a large group of people that had no regard for public safety. Sad times indeed. Stay home if you don't want to wear a mask.
Based solely on the customer service or not the food. The guy who took my order with a small ponytail tonight was rude and shouldn't work here. I love the food but damn what a jerk.

We had my sister in laws baby shower here a few weeks ago, and everything was amazing. They were nice enough to let us set up the night before, the room was comfortable and private. The food was all incredible. Everyone enjoyed it! Also, the service was amazing. All of the servers are dolls and the owners are so sweet! 11/10.

Great service! Hostess was amazing and very accommodating! Our server's name was Justin, and his presentation was on point! Great variety of tapas and so flavorful! We ordered the beet plate, fried calamari, bruschetta, grilled steak skewer and the meatballs! The ambiance was perfect!! Definitely coming back here when visiting from L. A.

First let me say that this is not cheap. But it is nice. Rooms are large and quiet. There is. I smoking or vestiges of smoking. 

Views of the skyline are spectacular on the 11 the floor and higher. 

The restaurants are quite good. The kitchen notes and barlines are great.  The music in barlines is live and excellent. 

Breakfast in the kitchen notes is a must. Not heal but well done.  

THe beet salad In barlines was one of the best I have had.  This is a great place to stay. 

Missing is indoor swimming (yes the pool is heated but is is 28 degrees outside). 

The hot tub is all the way on the other end of the pool and no place to change easily. Poorly thought out.
The desserts here were out of this world! I had a delicious raspberry chocolate "cake", if it can even be called cake and not a little slice of heaven! This was a great stop for a sweet bite to eat.
I do not think I have ever had a bad meal here. The waldorf salad is my go-to and my husband is a huge fan of the pizzas!

We wanted something different for dinner & decided to try this place out after reading the reviews. I ordered the Fajitas Del Mar. It was delicious! The server wasn't very friendly and he never checked on us or he would've known we needed a chip/water refills.

I have loved Poke for years and have been waiting for them to open up on the East coast.  I went to one in Brooklyn that was pretty good but this one in Philly was more like the ones in California...because you build your own bowl.  The fish was fresh, the sides were good, the marinades were a bit disappointing (one layer of favor like ginger, sweet, soy, citrus or sesame instead of more interesting mixed favors) and the finishing sauces were very good...although a little spicy.

We all ordered the "small" and contrary to many earlier reviews, it had plenty of fish with the three scoops (I think they finally listened to the reviewers!) The meal was great and my three teen-aged girls loved the hip vibe of the place and Northern Liberties neighborhood.  We will definitely be back!

It's going to be compared to freebirds regardless of how you look at it, and it's kind of dirty, but their menus are, for the most part, pretty different. Their enchiladas are okay, and their california burrito is good, but the majority of the time I find myself coming here is because I'm on the loop. It's just not worth phoning home for.

Not had a better burger in town. This place isn't perfect but it is truly a step above the rest. 

A few things:

They will actually cook your burger the way you ask. Which is refreshing 

The ranch dipping sauce has an addictive drug in it 

The fries are the best frozen fries I have ever had. They have their oil temp and fry time dialed in to perfection. 

The meat patties are made for them from Ponderosa meats. 

They know how to build the sandwich properly. 

You can tell the owner operator of this place keeps everyone on the ball. Well done.
First time here while I visited George's Music and definitely wont be my last. Their Pizza is outstanding!  Thank you.

Beignets are good, lighter than Cafe Dumonde. The coffee, however, tastes like hot water. No flavor, no chicory, no foamy milk. Definitely needs work.  No wait for service.
Clean restrooms.
Absolutely the best Hawaiian omelette ever. Our waitress Gabriella was fantastic. Very personal-able offered suggestions , and most of all kept checking in on us. We will definitely be back again!!

First off, it was Valentines day, you own a restaurant you know your going to have more customers than usual, so you have a larger staff working. Not the case here. I've been to this Lanna Thai many times and I have never been disappointed. Although, tonight was a different story. I had to ask several times for my early bird (before 6:00) spring rolls and soup. When it finally came, she brought only one egg roll and only one soup and there were two of us. Service was horrible and they have a very bad ANT problem. Not going back. There are too many other places I can spend my money.

I've order two for $12 ...I got flatbread ...yes was good..than food running bring me the wrong plate of chicken fingers...was kiddy kid plate than other waiter brought mine out...now I have two plates of chicken fingers ...after that the manager come to my table telling me he is going to charge me for that extra kiddy kid chicken finger plate they screw up... very bad customer service...I've worked in restaurant over 20 yrs ....I'll never gonna come back here again.
This place is awesome! Blows Fresh Kitchen out of the water and it is a shorter drive from Riverview. I love this place so far!

Staff is very pleasant and attentive.  Summer Roll is the best appy on the menu - a must try!  Their soups are awesome.  Seafood pho and the beef/lemongrass is delish.  If you like pho, you will love theirs - the broth is very rich and tasty! Finally...a Vietnamese restaurant in Berlin!  We needed some different choices in this town.  Thanks Pho Le!

This is really just an office for Arbuckle coffee. I picked up some of their famous Ariosa coffee for us and some as a gift for my parents. The woman who worked the front desk was very nice, and they even mixed up a fresh bag of decaf at my request. The coffee itself has a pleasant, mild flavor that I really like, and I'm not much of a coffee person. But I like this. (My wife loves coffee and also thinks quite highly of it.) There's no discount buying the coffee here vs. some of the other stores that carry it, but you get the full selection AND it's guaranteed fresh here. The coffee is pretty expensive, around $16 per pound I think, so we only get it as a treat. But I'd definitely recommend for any coffee drinker to try "the coffee that won the west" at least once.

Portlandia in Fairmount.  This place has reclaimed wood decor, more gluten free cookies than you can shake a stick at, and a staff with piercings and dyed hair galore.  But don't hold any of that against them.  This place is fantastic.

The people who work there are competent, nice, and efficient.  I love having a coffee shop with real food choices, not just packaged up hummus and sandwiches.  Their breakfasts are really good, though portions small.  I cannot comment on the coffee as I am a tea drinker, but their tea selection is huge, which I appreciate.

It is a big space with a vibrant buzz and study hall feeling at the same time.  It is perfects a place to have a meeting or get some work done.  Thank you for free wi-fi with no time limit.  

While I felt badly for Mugshots being replaced by another coffee shop, this one is far better.
Such a joke of a zaxbys, 15mins to take my order. Another 15mins to make. Forgets the zax sauce. Y'all need to fire the whole staff. The place was empty
Hit or miss. Service is usually ok. Bahn mi is good when they have bread. The pho is not too bad. Wonton soup is awful though. Still waiting for a great Vietnamese spot in Meridian

Try it! It's totally worth it. You are getting the same if not better quality cheese steak minus the hectic environment. This place is super clean and the staff is very nice. I've had the other "famous" cheesesteaks in Philly. My suggestion is if you have to pass by Oregon to get to your final cheesesteak destination just go to Oregon! You will be totally satisfied because it's totally delicious.

Small little unassuming pizza place on Westfield Ave next to Troy's place (Deli) we just ordered the buffalo wings hot and they were pretty good but definitely not hot! The prices were average. Staff were friendly. I would have to go again to try more menu items to give it a real review but for the wing review? About average

We came right after Church with plans to have breakfast. We were so disappointed that they cut off breakfast at 11:00 and there is no flexibility.   We arrived a few minutes after 11:00.

We ordered sandwiches and soup. It was very good but our hearts were set on breakfast. We could have gone elsewhere but everything was packed because it was Mother's Day.

Had dinner in the early evening on a Sunday...AFC game was on--place was busy, but not packed.  Zero complaints.  Morgan did a great job bring drinks, food was as I remembered it (it's been a few years).  Strongly recommend a return trip.

This is a miserable restaurant whose ONLY concerb is taking your money.
They disrespect your health and personal choice

They are pure Trump supports who claim STILL that CoVID is a farce
I just buried my brother who patronized this restaurant and is now DEAD.
JOSH is a MISERABLE human being who can't handle his love life and his promise to his patrons. This is a toxic environment with a toxic, go Fuck yourself ATTITUDE. PLEASE PROTECTED YOURSELF and do not patronize this anti constitutional establishment. I used to believe in this company... GO screw yourselves now

Very authentic boba milk tea! Love that it is sweetened with black sugar. It's also a great place for meeting up with a friend or to get some work done. I went at 5 pm and it was a bit crowded. 

Staff is very accommodating to sweetness and ice adjustments. They also deliver on uber eats!

Wandering Webster Groves for the first time and needed a place to stop and have a Saturday cocktail. We met Corey who was one of the best servers I've met in any context and provided our group with a solid 4 hours of drink and food recommendations with a complete knowledge of both the menu and adaptation to our groups preferences. I kid you not he literally walked an old lady across the street, which means nothing for the culinary aptitude of the establishment but absolutely communicates an ethical and quality of character standard that resonates through the experience. We will be back, many times.

Recs: Baked Camembert, olde fashioned, manhattan, elderflower champagne cocktail, sugared hibiscus cocktail

A-FREAKING-MAXING. First time in Santa Barbara and first spot I hit to eat. Line was out the door and let me tell you all, 100% worth the wait. Tortillas made fresh, steak cooked to absolute perfection. The number 16, oh my gosh, I can't even. Everything here so so delicious and the staff was so kind a friendly. Highly recommend!

This was my second time eating here and I really enjoyed my meal. I went during lunch but it didn't appear that they had lunch menus. I ordered the Bamboo special ($10.50) that consisted of a layer of shredded cabbage, plain rice noodles, seasoned chicken, with carrots/cucumbers on the side in addition to pieces of fried, spring rolls around. The more I ate my meal, the more I enjoyed it. 

To my recollection, the service was good but I was also deep in conversation with my two girlfriends. The food definitely came out fast. I'm sure I will be back as this place is a fave for my co-workers that work in the area..

One of the best donuts I've had. Hands down. 

Cash only.

Family business (?).

Lovely.

Every time I go to NOLA, I always look forward to a trip to Pat O's! My favorite part is the piano bar which is always so much fun, full of energy, and the artists play some really awesome classic songs. It's by far the best piano bar I have ever been too.... the hurricane's may have helped! :)

Disappointing salmon bagel. Not enough cream cheese, it did not even cover the whole bagel. The everything bagel itself was devoid of any taste. For 8.95$ without tax, this is what you get....Never coming back

Hmm... what can I say? It's another burger place.
Be prepared to wait and wait for it.
For a little over $7 you get a burger with fresh lettuce pickle and onion no cheese and a few fresh hot crinkle cut fries. Got an appetite? You'll need to shell out over $5 for a second burger - they're not very filling.
No drink included for that either.
It's a good burger, but let's face it there are lots of places that deliver a tasty burger much faster at a better price.  
Negatives? It's crowded, noisy, and very very cold - keep your coat on. Ceiling fans running on the coldest day this winter.
This was also annoying - remember to get napkins and straws before you sit down, they don't put them in the bag or ask if you want any...
Oh yes, clean up your table when you leave.
This is the 3rd time I've been there. With any luck maybe it'll be the last!

My better half and I visited Nashville for some live music a while back and decided to make reservations. We arrived a little early and had a drink at the bar. Solid selection of cocktails and bourbon for sure. Friendly and knowledgeable bartender. Soon after we were brought to our table. We ordered 3 or four small plates as well as entrees and deserts. Nothing disappointed. Every dish was cooked expertly. Wait staff was attentive. The atmosphere was classy yet casual. We'll definitely go back the next time we're in town.

This Ultimate Brazilian Sandwich hit the spot!! With sausage and chimichurri thin steak, peppers and more... it was amazing!! I would 100% get it again. The steak was so flavorful and the sausage was a great addition with the sweet peppers. The bun was just a standard white bun. Fries accompanied this hefty sandwich. 

Reminded me of a Mexican Philly cheese steak, without being as juicy and Instead chimichurri flavor. 

$14 for what is pictured and I'd say worth it, not cheap but easy to want to support local. Gauchos Fire was fire.

Fall weather, great wine and tasty bites. Cheese. Wine. Duck flatbread. Specials on wine flights. Very friendly and eager to help staff. What more could a girl ask for? Oh, maybe some handsome company. Check. I recommend Robust to anyone who wants to learn more about wine since their staff is willing to help and the wine flights are somewhat cheap. The food is good and served in somewhere between tapas and starter sizes so it's enough to nibble on and share a bite or two. Plenty of options also. 

My favorite thing is that the entire menu is set up to easily pair food and wine options. Each dish has a number next to it corresponding to a wine type. Genius!

Good and traditional Japanese restaurant. The noodle is always delicious. It is a tiny restaurant right in a corner of Chinatown. There are so many people there every day. The waitress are always busy.

Super Bummed! I'll never order from SoFresh again! I used to eat here all the time but the last three times I've gotten the grass fed steak it's been inedible and the quality of the rest of the ingredients are subpar. A shadow of the former quality and taste. 
Tried to give the benefit of doubt but 3 strikes, this place is OUT!!
Went for dinner last night. Steven was the best waiter I have ever had. Keep up the good Job. The food was 5star as well.

Took a seat at the counter at 0700 for breakfast. Took over 5 minutes for waitress to tear herself away from her chat with the cook to take my order. She then returned to her chat, with her back to the  counter. Where she stayed while four businessmen came in, got tired of waiting for service, and left. After ten minutes she came back to ask what I had ordered. Over 25 minutes after my order I received eggs Benedict with an overwhelming lemony hollandaise and hash browns that clearly had been cooked some time previously. The gentleman next to me sat waiting with cash and check in hand while waitress stood with her back to the counter again chatting with cook; he finally got up and went to her to pay. Service 1 star. Food 2 stars. Coffee was ok.
Pat's vs Geno's, definitely Pat's but I think Subway has a better cheese steak than these two.

Vedge is my new favorite restaurant.  As a brand new vegan and total foodie, I am thrilled I can still experience Philly fine dining at its best.  The food here is incredible.  It's as simple as that.  And the vegetables really are the star -- the menu features a lot less tofu-based, substitution-esque food than I expected.  A highlight is the salt-roasted golden beet dish.  Reminiscent of the flavors and textures of a tartare, only better.  It blew me away.  The sweet potato pate was also a stand out.  The texture was unbelievably smooth and rich.  I can't wait to go back and have them again -- not to mention every single item on the rotating dirt list. 

Only a week after our epic NYE dinner, my girlfriend and I went back for a wintery happy hour.   Happy hour is a seriously great deal, with drinks and dishes priced at $4-5.  Not only that, it's probably the most efficiently run happy hour I've ever seen.  The bar is relatively small, and, as is the case at all in-demand happy hours spots in the city, everyone waiting starts to get itchy as the clock inches toward 7.  But at Vedge, there's no need for the anxious vigilance often required to secure a coveted seat -- the host keeps track of arrivals and kindly tells anyone trying to jump the line that there's an order to be seated.  Very impressive.  

In sum:  go to here.  I can't wait for another amazing vegan dinner with my girlfriend, and to show it off to my meat-eating father next time he's in town.

I wish I could give "0" stars but the least I can do is 1. I was hesitant to come here in the first place because the ratings averaged out at 2-stars but I decided to give it a try and form my own opinion... Should have listened to the reviews and saved my time. I sat for nearly 15 minutes and was already ready to leave and never return. I was there in a party of 4 but 2 of us weren't ordering hookahs. They said we had to order another one since there were 4 people, based on their 2/hookah policy BUT 2 of us weren't smoking!! I told the guy, whoever he was, not the server or manager, that I'd rather leave than to give them any business. As the guy proceeded to get the manager the dude delivering the hookahs and coals delivered the hookah (cool) but the confusing part is that he brought 4 tips... If only 2 people are allowed per hookah, why the 4-tips? -_- i'd rather you go to Hookah House on Magazine St. They have their issues too but not as bad as here.
Awesome food and incredible service! Love the carrot soup and the salmon! Awesome shrimp & grits! Generous portions! Save room for dessert! Can't wait to go back!
The bottomless soup and salad is the best lunch around for $6.99!!!  The loaded baked potato soup is delicious!!!

I've had this Papa John's location several times as I live very close by. So i decided on this spot for diner. I ordered carry out tonight because I live so close and 41 minutes later I went to pick up to pick up the order and the two employees at the store looked at me like I was crazy saying there was no pizza on order. So i showed them my app and email from 40 mins ago and they realized there was an order and they just hadn't put it in the oven. I was then told, oh my mistake you can sit down and wait seven minutes for the pizza to be cooked.

5 Stars!!! During our 6 week stay at Redington Towers we ordered Beach Pizza 5 times. Was happy with everything each and every time! We ordered a variety of items from the menu. Garlic knots, various pizzas, Stromboli's, calzones, and salads. Definitely would eat here again, and with so many places to choose from that says a lot.
Just good food. Waitress was great! Cappuccino and chocolate mousse cake .. WOW! Berkshire chop was good. A little noisy for me.

I love to review the comments of the last year or so.  I've been going to the Pantry sicne 1980; back when it was a good little place and before it was "the" power breakfast of Nashville.  Back in those days, it wasn't unusual to see many of the country music's legends show up fro breakfast.

Times change, but one thing is true:  The Pancake Pantry food is and has always been one my favorites for breakfast in the world (and I've been to every continent).  

The pancakes are 'melt in your mouth' and it really doesn't matter what you get, it'll be good.  The lines are long and legendary, but in the age of the iPad, who cares?  If you don't like the lines, you can easily avoid them, even on Saturday and Sunday by getting there at 6:00 or 6:30.  

I haven't been a resident of Nasvhille since 1989, but I still will go out of my way (and time) to have a meal there.

If you are a TN traveler, you'll also find that there is a similar name-sake in Gatlinburg, TN in the downtown area.  The Gatlinburg TN one is actually the original and the Nasvhille store is the ONLY time the original has allowed their name (and their flour) to be used.

Used to love me a chipotle cheesesteak.  Went in today, the staff were not very friendly,  but I let it slide, hey everyone has bad days. 

But they were working without gloves and the one guy in the front was going from sandwiches to cash register without washing or sanitizing his hands. Ewwww. No thank you

This woman old lady curly hair really rude to me got me waiting hours for my check n taking forever to serve like hating n looking at costumers every time I asked for something like I look like bum n being really rude m annoying to me the entire time I don't know why I got this luck ... n being extra nice to everyone but not to me when we all should be treated equally you know what I mean lol I tipped as she deserved muchas gracias debora

A while ago, I wrote a review for a different chicken establishment that I hopped would be Reno's answer to Nashville style hot chicken. While that place disappointed, it turns out Reno had a true Nashville style hot chicken joint all along. Enter Crazy D's Hot Chicken!

I ordered Combo #2, which are 2 GIANT Sliders. It sounds like an oxymoron, doesn't it? Well these "sliders" are basically sandwiches! I was not expecting such large tenders, but luckily for me I had quite the appetite. The chicken was crispy on the outside, yet juicy on the inside. I'm a sucker for spicy food, and there are 5 levels to select; from Country Style (no heat) to CRAZY! They came with a side of fries, which were hot and freshly seasoned, along with a tasty sauce to dip them in. The woman who took my order was an absolute sweetheart. She came back to check on me to make sure the food was too my liking, which it certainly was. 

Crazy D's is the chicken joint that I've been looking for. I'm definitely coming back for more.

The most amazing boba joint in reno! I definitely recommend the monster boba latte and the signature milk tea. The drinks are so delicious and refreshing. I'm never going to another boba place in reno.

We chose this place cuz we didn't find the one we planned to go. It turned out to be a surprise!!! Their service is super good and we ordered the steamed tilapia. It was so yummy and totally worths the wait!!!

My gfriend and I jst had a FOODGASM!...not only did we house a MOUTH WATERING Margherita pizza (w extra basil n garlic per usual), but then, then, we had their Cannolis...now, we went out on a limb ordering said Italian dessert item at a ma and pa corner Pizzaria...but theses Cannolis...ahhh ...the Cannnolis....they left me breathless and smiley on the couch....go...order...eat...FOODGASM!

Great Cambodian food. The smells when you walk in will make you salivate! This place reminded my Thai wife of home. They use delicious authentic ingredients which are very hard to find anywhere else. The only downside is the location.

Amazing! I am very picky about my Italian food, and when I am in the area, this place never disappoints. The chicken marsala is truly the best out there and who doesn't love brick oven pizzas? The general manager, Greg, goes above and beyond to make sure that every visit is as perfect as the food, and always has great suggestions on what to order. Their take out service during these unstable times provides high quality comfort when we all need it most. Highly recommend!!

Everything about this place is top notch, from the service to the food. You know a joint is well operated when the workers and patrons are happy, and this is that kind of place. Music is great, people are having fun, and the food, oh, that hot fried chicken. It's not offensive but well balanced and impossibly juicy. The queue gets long but it's worth the wait. I can't think of a better operated restaurant in the south than this place. Restauranteurs come and get your learn on. This is how you do things.

If you want GREAT PHO, this is the place for you!  

My aunt and I decided to have Vietnamese for our first meal on our one day food tour of Philadelphia. After searching for a bit, we decided to try Nam Phuong.  It's located in what seems to be a little Vietnamese neighborhood with other restaurants and shops/supermarkets. We were seated right away by a very pleasant host and given two glasses of iced water and the menus. The decor of the restaurant was awe-inspiring.  Its quite a large space and great for large parties. The atmosphere was very loud and bustling so not the best choice if you're looking for a quiet dinner. 

To start we decided to try the Steak and Beef meatballs Pho, Summer Shrimp Rolls and Green Tea.  As I mentioned in my first line, the PHO is the best I've tasted so far!! The broth was so full of flavor and the meats were tender and tasty.  The PHO also came with bean sprouts, jalapeño peppers and fresh basil on the side for added deliciousness.  On to the rolls which came with a peanut sauce on the side for dipping.  I was a bit taken aback because I expected warm rolls but these were served chilled.  The rolls contained rice noodles, shrimp and basil (if you don't like the taste of basil I wouldn't opt for this appetizer).  The rolls were decent, but not my favorite.  The Green Tea was very comforting with our meal and they were served in the cutest little tea cups. 

For our Entrees, we ordered Needle Noodles with Shrimp and Flat Rice Noodles with Beef. Both dishes were absolutely delicious but my favorite was the Beef. It tasted like it was barbecued in some type of barbecue soy sauce which was just yummy!  And the best part was that our bill was only $44!!!  The only reason I gave it four stars was due to the delay in receiving our Entrees after our appetizers. All in all, the service was GREAT and the food was A1!!
This is a really good place that lives up to its name. It feels like a family eatery. The food was great! If you're looking for a good southern experience you gotta go here.

I was skeptical about paying almost $5 for a banh mi (Vietnamese sandwich) but since I'm a bit deprived where I live (I don't live in Philly), I wanted to try it (banh mi should only be around $3).  Anyway, there was not enough meat in the sandwich and the picked slaw was only carrots - what happened to the daikon?  The slaw was also not picked enough.  The only thing possibly good about this place: the bread.  I wouldn't come back here.  I'd rather make a sandwich at home; one that doesn't cost $5.

Love this place! Great attention to detail in regards to the decor and atmosphere. Very similar to Vegas! Fun themed meals and drinks and an inviting and colorful menu. Drink specials on Wednesday, including 5 mini martinis for $10! Amazing! Decently priced, good service in a fun yet relaxing environment. Wish I lived closer!

"BEST Hoagie in the free world"?
I THINK NOT!
BEST Hoagie on the Planet.
Now we're talking.

Superb selection of hotdogs. Must try the Alligator hotdog, it was very soft. 


 We had the polish one and the alligator one and both were amazing.
Service is blah... And there's nothing like a pissy bartender in morning. Doesn't really seem to know what a customer interaction she look like. Perhaps some more training is needed

Sat outside under trees with dappled december sunshine resting on the linen table cloth. A single rose and a homemade marmalade wait on every table. It's not the excellent breakfast of the array of homemade pastries that makes The Andersens deserve 5 stars, it s the little touches in presentation and service, and the location.
This place has it all, great food, nice decor.  A must visit!

My husband and I came here for dinner tonight because of all the amazing reviews we have heard. This place did not let us down. It's reputation proceeds itself!!!! Valissa was our waitress and was one of the most personable and attentive waitresses we have had in a long time. The sushi was amazing and we will definitely be back soon.

Came here for Restaurant Week with a friend. Delicious Pre Fix menu of various popular entrees and appetizers. Escargot is a MUST! It is delicious and a wonderful presentation. I got the rabbit entree and my friend got a lamb entree. Both were delicious. Everything is this location including ambiance, location, and food are perfect. I no longer live in Philadelphia but will come here when I am in town.

Items Selected:
Combo Plate - Brisket, Shoulder, St. Louis Style Ribs, Creamed Corn, Mac n' Cheese
Cornbread
Chocolate Chess Pie
Chess Pie

Exceedingly unimpressed with Barista Parlor, but with more than an hour to kill before the conference resumed, it was to Broadway that I turned and with reviews of Jack's BBQ ranging from 'tourist trap' to 'Best BBQ in Nashville" I decided to take a chance, the answer found somewhere in between as not only the cuisine but the experience was worthwhile, if not particularly worth writing home about.

A staple of Nashville's entertainment alley long before the city's recent wave of growth, and since spawning additional locations where waiting is rarely an issue, it was to a short line that I entered the three-story property and quickly entering the queue it was with only a few seconds to decide that I approached the wordless server, a combo plate quickly slapped together and handed to me on a tray with cornbread - two pieces of pie added en route to the cashiers who did little more than collect $20 before sending me off to find a table.

Opting to eschew upstairs seating and instead occupying a teensy two-top near the front door it was amidst a décor of sports, pork, and country regalia that I partook in my 'cue and immediately finding the wet "St. Louis Style" ribs meager in meat and overly sugared a transition to the brisket and shoulder proved far more competent, both versions juicy and moist with a good bit of smoke complimented by light sauce, while both creamed corn and macaroni n' cheese were on par with the environs, the former none too sweet and far more creamy than that from a can.

Moving to desserts, but remiss to not mention slabs of toothsome cornbread that reminded me of the savory stuff down in North Carolina, it was admittedly a bit of a surprise when I popped open clamshells to realize I'd selected two versions of Chess rather than what looked to be Pecan, but never one to quibble a good piece of pie one would be hard pressed to name a better slice of either in the city of Nashville, the vinegar notes peaking through the sugar at all the right times in the traditional version while the chocolate was far more rich despite a mouthfeel closer to that of pudding.

The beignets that my husband and I got were a little over cooked. I got the Cajun hasbrown and it was okay the potatoes were not crispy. The sausage was good though and the environment itself was pleasant.

Ordered quite a bit of food for a group for delivery, only received half of an $88 order.  Tried to call the restaurant that night to correct it and only received voice mail.  
Called Corporate and left a message.
Heard back 3 days later and was told a regional manager would call me.
They did and said they would sent gift cards as a refund. Never received the cards.
Texted manager, no response.
Called the restaurant again, still getting voice mail.
Called Corporate again, and was told they would not do anything.
I am referring this to the Better Business Bureau at this point.  Would not order from them again. This has been going on for months.

Quality is standard little Cesar's- not great but cheap. This particular little Cesar's never has hot and ready- it regularly takes 30 minutes to get a cheese, they don't answer the phone, and they run out of dough. Try dominos for faster not great pizza, or twin peaks for better pizza in 20-30 minutes.

Place is a scam. I will never do business with them. Called and ordered a pizza, after 1.5 hours I called and they said they didn't deliver because something was wrong with my address. They never even tried to call me or inform of the problem. My only option was to come get the cold pizza or refund. I took the refund. If I wouldn't have called they would have never voided the charges. The people they have working here have no common sense.

Great Mexican stand - lives up to the hype.

Here's a clip from an article by Cindy Price in last week's NY Times surveying taquerias up and down the coast (NY is finally discovering real tacos!):


"Do rich people eat tacos? I had heard that wealthy Santa Barbara was a hotbed of authentic taco activity, but I was hard-pressed to believe it. A cruise down quaint, tree-peppered North Milpas Street, however, confirms it. The street is lined with taquerias, including the one that started the craze --- La Super Rica Taqueria.

Known to many as "the Julia Child joint" --- she was a loyal customer until she died two years ago --- La Super Rica is bright and airy, and the tortillas are handmade on the spot. On the cashier's recommendation, I pair a taco de bistec (charbroiled steak) with a queso de cazuela (a heavenly cheese baked in tomato sauce).

Just as I'm sitting down with the owner, Isidoro Gonzlez, a white-bearded passer-by leans in. "It's not just a taqueria, it's the best restaurant in town," he says. Heart be still, it's David Crosby. A fellow taco-hound! "You don't have to continue any further," he says, eyes twinkling. "This is it --- this is the place.""

Absolutely love this place, I eat here all the time. The service is pretty good and very quick. It's a locally owned business and the owner is almost always in there and makes everyone feel comfortable. 

The food is slightly authentic and very good. My favorite would have to be their Mushu Chicken and their General Tso's. Definitely worth checking out!

The wait staff is so friendly...Zoe and Shana are two of the best!  We stopped in here as an alternative late night dinner.  We were so delighted with the quality of the service and the food.  The Fish and Chips was fabulous. Fresh Grouper breaded with beer batter, melted in your mouth. Light fluffy fresh is how I would describe it.  My partner had a filet with asparagus and smashed potatoes. The filet was seasoned just right and super tender and delicious.

Two stars is way too generous. We went this morning for breakfast. There was nowhere to park, so the place was packed. We were a small party of three. We waited about 25-39 minutes to be seated. We noticed it was warm and too muggy inside (it was pouring rain today), which was amplified in one of the smaller rooms we were packed into. The lighting was way too stark white, which made the small room feel so much less comfortable. Our 9yr old even mentioned how claustrophobic he felt. I was personally sweating. I don't know why restaurants don't use filtered water, especially in an area where tap water doesn't taste well at all. I mentioned these  points to our server, to which she answered "It is very hot, but there's nothing I can do" so there that was. I ordered a small apple juice, we got our breakfast and got out of there. My shirt was drenched from the sweat. Never again. Seriously, we won't be returning.

We had a four course meal prepared by Jeremy Wells. Excellent! My favorite, and first time trying, was scallops. It had a sweet spicy cream sauce that complimented perfectly. The last course was a steak filet that was my husbands favorite. I love the personal touch of a chef preparing a meal for you. Step out of your box and try.

I suppose this place doesn't need my review at this point, but I feel compelled to give it anyway, because the food is so good. Even my wife, who started out upset at me because we had trouble finding it, and it was going to be a longer stop than she wanted, was completely won over by the food. In fact, we all agreed it was the best Mexican food we'd ever had. What makes it even better though, is the super friendly service, and to see how earnestly the cooks are working to make it all happen. This is Mexican food served up with a whole lot of heart and soul. The service is friendly and efficient. We had the tilapia platter, carne asada tacos, a carnitas burrito, and a combo platter of chili relleno, chicken enchilada, and carne asada. Everything was delicious. The portions were generous, but we managed to polish it all off because it was so good. In particular, if you've ever wanted to see what really good carnitas are supposed to taste like, get them here.

One of our staples in the quarter. Favorite things to get are the crab cakes, crawfish pistolettes and the fried shrimp poboy which comes with a tabasco mayo. Pro tip, ask for extra tabasco mayo because they don't really put enough and the right amount changes the whole sandwich and makes it delicious. The more the better in my opinion. I've started making it at home ever since I tried it. The wait staff has always been friendly too and they have a good beer selection.

Disappointing. I wanted to like Prince's. The dark meat was 4 stars. The white meat was only 3 stars - dry and disappointing. If you go, order dark meat.  Following the Philadelphia cheesesteak tradition of Pat's and Gino's we visited Prince's and Hattie B's. The chicken is spicier at Prince's.  You order at a counter at both restaurants.

Went for happy hour tonight.  The noise level was high.  Why restaurants/bars don't invest in acoustic panels are beyond me.  The food was good.   The tater tots were crisp and well seasoned.  The shrimp were delicious, evenly battered with just the right amount of sauce.  The sliders were bland and nothing special.  Food aside, the service at the bar was awful!  My friend and I were there for 2 hours.  They never asked if we wanted more drinks.  Never checked to see how the food was. I asked for a glass of water which the original bartender never gave me.  Ended up asking for it again to the other bartender.  Made the manager aware that the bar service was less than adequate.  He provided some compensation but I don't think I will go back anytime soon.

You must get the Sampler Platter!!!! It was fantastic!! Gumbo, jambalaya , crawfish ettoufee and red beans and rice, you will not regret it!! Erin was our super friendly and efficient server. Definitely would love to come back again when we are back in town.
Love this place they have great service good food and relatively cheap prices.  Also the portions are large.  I come here as often as possible. Great value for your money

Firstimer! Went for just cocktails and sat at the bar. It is quaint and cute and bartenders were top notch! Ordered a Strawberry Manilow cocktail that was divine, followed by the Ayinger Dopple. We are coming back for sure for dinner as it was the perfect marriage of intimate and trendy and the food smelt great!
Pizza was under cooked, they screwed up fried pickles (how is that possible?) and the place just felt generally unclean. Staff was attentive and the only good thing there other than the giant drafts.

Brauhaus. What happened? I came here with a friend last night and we were both incredibly disappointed. In looking for a middle-of-the-road option (nothing dressy or too expensive, but something nicer than say a hot wings corner bar), I suggested we head to this spot.

We each got a 1 liter beer, an entree, and potato pancakes to share. 

The beer: My friend and I wanted to drink out of a boot, one of those glass 1-2 liter boots we'd seen others enjoy. After selecting the Ayinger Oktoberfest brew and my friend getting the Hausbrau liter, the waitress informed us that his pick didn't come in a 1 liter serving (because the manager doesn't like to offer that beer by the liter). Without really explaining why, she walks away, but only to come back with both of our selections in a boot! Super! Except that my beer was warm...and later cost me $19.50!!!!! She explained that they didn't have a way to charge me for the boot (um, hello, why do you even have them then?) so she just charged me for 3 beers. Based on a general rule of thumb, whenever there are, let's say, 3 different sizes of things, each one costs more, yes, BUT you've got to save a little for going with the larger size. Think of it as if you were ordering a large drink over a medium one at a movie theater ("for only a quarter more..."). My friend's beer, $11...exactly what that boot should cost.

Food: My friend ordered the Wurst plate ($16) and I went with the Rouladen ($20). The wurst came out cold. Cold! As for the Rouladen, I should've ordered the Wiener Schnitzel.

The most redeeming part of last night's dinner were the potato pancakes ($6)...not because they were amazing (they're just potato pancakes), but because they were still warm when they hit our table. 

Our grand total came to $78.49. I would ordinarily have no problem paying that much for excellent food and service, but here, I felt swindled. 

Final thoughts: completely overpriced for food and beer that's half-assed.

I recently contacted Roberto's about some concerns I had with sanitation at Roberto's by sending a message through Contact Us on the website. Rey, the owner, who's father was the original, "Roberto" contacted me within 1 hour (Impressive!) 

He told me he's instructed the staff in Reno to change out containers that hold salsa, jalapeños and carrots, etc. rather than refilling. 

I feel 100% confident this is the right thing to do. 

The reason is if anything in the containers gets contaminated, which is highly likely at some point starting after a few hours up to 2 days maximum, contamination will not get fixed if you don't change out and sanitize the containers. I thought deep about this, you don't cook over and over with pots and pans, so why would you not clean out and sanitize a container? It's really the same thing! 

If you think about this our hands should be washed, and washed often, which I personally do, but I think I am the exception. Before you start customizing your order w/ salsa, jalapeños, etc. EVERYONE was just touching something VERY GERM LADEN examples: cell phones, keys, credit cards, cash, door handles, steering wheels. etc. 

At some point between a few hours up to 2 days there is going to be a transference of germs, hopefully unintentionally. Once that happens the container will start breeding and growing stuff that can make you ill. 

I won't go into specifics, but cell phones have tested dirtier than toilet seats, and you can imagine everything else you touch often, what's lingering there. 

I really appreciate the professionalism and concern, and as always, this place again proves it is 5 stars! I am excited to get my red salsa, jalapeños, carrots, and asada fries or burrito 1-3x again per week as I was doing!

I frequent this establishment usually about 3 nights a week and have become a regular..Yet I had never had dinner there. So Tuesday night me and 2 friends decided to try out the menu..The food was really good..But the service was the worst I have EVER EXPERIENCED IN MY LIFE..I have never stiffed a server before and this night was my first..He was completely rude and had attitude from the very beginning of the evening.. I will continue to to go there at night but I will never return for dinner again..The service was that bad..
Love! Has a great atmosphere, awesome food! Coffee and specialty drinks are on point! Good for the family or to come on your own to enjoy a lunch or breakfast. Hands down one of my favorite places!

Great food, and super friendly people.  The entrees on the menu are mostly limited to sandwiches and burgers right now, but I'm excited as they said they'll be expanding the menu in the not to distant future.  Definitely worth checking out.

The garbanzo beans they (sometimes) give you when you first arrive are addicting! Everything I have order has been wonderful. The churros are a must at least during one visit (just plan to walk off the guilt by doing some laps on State St) :)
I was craving Indian food and this really hit the spot. Really great food. Definitely coming back.
Ordered the sour cream chicken enchilada and had bones galore in it - not to mention how flavorless it was :(

This was the first Nashville chicken place we tried since visiting TN and it was great.  Nashville hot chicken was great, so moist, so spicy, so good!!!  We also tried the Mac n cheese balls that were yummy.  Fries were good and well seasoned.  My kids didn't love their kids grilled cheese and wished they had just gotten the chicken.  Chicken was great!!

Had the tacos (shrimp, grouper, and ribeye) food came out quick and  it was fresh. And i liked their selection of drafts. The bar also had a cool, calm and collected atmosphere.Would definitely come back again.

I have NEVER written a review on Yelp before, until now. I've been to Our Bar twice now and shouldn't have returned after the first visit. However, being a believer in second chances, I decided to return for a hopefully redemptive experience.

On my first visit I sat at a table for over 20 min. before walking up to the bar and asking to order food. I ordered 10 wings and a water. A relatively simple order, or so I thought. It took Our Bar 38 minutes to fulfill my mundane request. In the time I waited for my wings, I could've flown to a chicken farm, picked out 5 of the most gorgeous birds and trained them to sing Firework by Katy Perry.

On my second visit, I knew the hell strategy that they call ordering. I walked up to the bar and promptly told the bartender I would like to order. He said "well I just put in a bunch of orders so I would wait 20 min. and then put in an order." I was flabbergasted by his response to my order. As much as I would like to pull apart his philosophy of ordering, this is not the time or place. I ordered the pork sandwich and a Dr. Pepper.

I know what you're thinking "Brandon, why haven't you told me about the food yet." In due time my friend. In due time. 

And now onto the food. The Thai Orange Wings were decent. Piping hot but a tad over cooked. The sauce was good, sticky and very sweet with a burn at the end. I would like to write a review of the pork sandwich, but I was told that my ticket had not been entered..After waiting another 25 minutes I finally got my sandwich. The meat was good with a fantastic spicy BBQ sauce. The coleslaw was nothing special and I could tell that it had been sitting in the dressing all day.

At the end of the day, the food at Our Bar is good. The prices are reasonable, but the biggest flaw is the service. There is no hustle from the staff and no desire to please the customer. Hopefully the owner of Our Bar will read this and hear the need to hire more workers per shift.

The real tragedy of Our Bar is that the food and atmosphere have so much potential. I cannot look past the service though. Slow, lethargic and unmotivated. 2/5

This place was amazing! My family ate here during our stay in NOLA and honestly wanted to double back the next day. Everything from the Starters, main entrees sides, and beverages were tasty and on point! I highly recommend this place if you love seafood!

This place was recommended to me by a local during my trip to new Orleans. I had the fried shrimp and catfish which was AMAZING!!!!!. My  friends had the cajun crab legs and that was also great. They need to work on their sides though. The fries that my fish and shrimp came with were not desirable and the corn that the crab comes with is obviously frozen and takes away from the overall experience however the crabs, fish, and shrimp are by far some off the best that I have had in my 32 yrs of life.
This place is convenient,has great prices and friendly staff. They give you so much food for your money. Highly recommended!!!

Miles' Table is my favorite place in the 'hood.  I'm always surprised by how each dish delights with a small twist.  The blt, the burger, the falafel burger, the chopped salad and the grilled cheese with bacon (such a deal at $6!) are all super.  Since it opened I don't want to go anyplace else for lunch with my daughter or a friend.  Good atmosphere, diverse clientele.  Congrats to Miles' parents!

Sad. My husband got us loco mocos and this is is how mine came. The patty was dry and incomplete. Why would you serve a patty that looks like it's been eaten already? We live in Clarksville so we couldn't just go back and ask for a new one. This is pretty pathetic though L&L. TN L&L and CA L&L obviously have two different standards because this meal was so disappointing.

BEST Japanese Hibachi EVER!
In a sketchy area of town, but food is AMAZING.  Best steak & shrimp sauces anywhere!

I really should learn not to give a bad rating for one experience.  I went back tonight and was very impressed.  Maybe it was from my bad review.  The bartenders were all over it.  Quickly said hello to me and got my drink.  while I was waiting I noticed the manager talking to a group of folks at the bar and they were having a great time.  He then started helping the bartender with there orders.  They took my order and my salad and bread came out very quickly.  I had more than enough time to eat it waiting for my entree.  very important to me.  I started to order the prime rib but the bartender told me they were almost out and I might not get the best they offer so I got a ribeye instead.  It was cooked perfectly medium rare.  That is awesome that he was aware of the food quality and didn't want me to be disappointed.  Going back to the manager, he was running around helping out everywhere he could.  I use a comp card to pay that I thought was a gift card but it was limited to what I ordered so no remaining balance.  Jennie, another manager that has worked there for many years came to me and suggested I take something home to get the most out of the comp card so i could get the best value.  We talked about how many years I have been going there and how I stopped because things got really bad but I came back and was very impressed.  She was very happy that I had a good experience.  I hope she passes it on to the staff because compared to my last experience this was excellent.  I keep learning that I shouldnt let one bad experience stop me from eating somewhere.  jennie told me the manager that impressed me was a partner so I think that means he has ownership.  Maybe his presence made the staff work better but I have to say, the two bartenders were awesome.  they paid attention to there guest and didnt ignore anyone.  Over all I would say they are really trying to make a difference.  Service was great, management was productive and food was excellent.  I hope when I go back its the same.  compared to the service I got the last time I noticed a huge difference so maybe my poor review helped.  as always, if the management responds to my review and I notice that they take the changes needed I will always change my raitings.

I love Liberty Bell, best breakfast in town but today I doubt I will go back, during this pandemic I worry about health and not ONE server, or the owner, or the busboy was wearing a proper mask!!  I cannot take a chance of the best breakfast being my last! Done with Liberty Bell for the foreseeable future and you should be too!! Let me give them a bit of advice, the mask goes OVER your MOUTH and NOSE!!

Pretty darn good Bar-B-Que.  Now, this is no local Kansas City or Memphis hole-in-the-wall, but I walk away from Famous Dave's with that, "yeah, I just ate some good BBQ" feeling.  The ambiance is cool, it's got that southern vintage look and feel.  The service can be pretty slow at times, especially during the busy lunch hour on Fridays.  Speaking of lunch, their specials are pretty well priced - under $8 (with a water).  They have some pretty decent sized platter offerings too.  I've only had the Georgia Chopped Pork Sandwich, wet, liked it.  FD's also has a good selection of house BBQ sauces, from spicy to mild.  I'd head back for some more...

I love the food and would go back for that, however my last 2 experiences have left me rethinking that.  We left a cash tip the last time were were there and someone decided to add their own tip on after we left.  Thankfully we still had our receipt and noticied when the cc statement came. Management said they would follow up but we have yet to hear back despite a follow up call on our part.  The other time we had to fill our own water and waited a very long time for our food.  It seemed to be unusally slow service.

The food and waitstaff are a step up from Penang. They were very nice to baby Jack! I loved the food (Vegetable Curry in clay pot, Fried Whole Snapper, Satay Tofu, Mee Siam, Shrimp Puffs (my mom loves anything wrapped in bacon)) Chinatown is always a favorite destination and I love Malaysian BUT all in all for a trip to chinatown there are equally good dishes for a quarter of the price at Ting Wong! (Chinese) Ting Wong is still the shit! (roast duck with chinese vegetable a must) then I am going for Vietnam Palace or Banana Leaf! even Lee How Fook! 

-M

I would come here for drinks, entertainment and possibly oysters or shrimp, something you don't mind getting your hands dirty with. I will not come back to have a hot dinner or with people I am hoping to converse with. 

My parents were in town and they made reservations for 6:30 outside as they were told there was an acoustic performed (literally four hours before). They are in town to look for a condo so we were going to have dinner to discuss what they saw so far. Well it was amplified open mic night. It was loud, extremely loud so a conversation was not possible without yelling and leaning into the person you were listening to. 
Service was average. Took about 15 minutes to get a drink order and get our drinks. They were busy but perhaps a bit understaffed. Our reserved table had random locals sitting at it with their food because I guess you can just ignore the reserved sign and they won't bother you. The problem is they left a mess and the table did not get wiped down properly, so we did it ourselves. 

The food was average. Shrimp and grits were decently unique but nothing I would crave. The portion of catfish was average but providing about 9 fries with it is a joke. Tells me they had some left over and didn't want to fry more. They also only carry tilapia on their regular menu for fish. You are less than a mile from the Gulf and you serve tilapia. I think I'll end it there.

I was assured that John's would offer me a quality Philly cheesesteak. My co-worker comes here all the time while traveling for business, and raves about it. Being from AZ, I'd never actually had a Philly cheesesteak while in the state of PA, so I had high hopes. Honestly, I've had better cheesesteaks at Charlie's (the chain restaurant). I feel awful saying that about this mom and pop shop, but I could barely find the cheese, and the steak had no flavor. The pizza we ordered was also soggy and flavorless. Sorry.

I love their Charbroiled oysters. They have the best Charbroiled in New Orleans that I tried so far. I also recommend the seafood pasta. 

Tip: make reservation in advance
GROSS!!! If I wanted Awful, I would have gone to the Little Nugget for an Awful-Awful instead!
Everytime, all the time, fast, fresh, delicious! My favorite salsa in all of Tampa!

Wow! That should say it all.

The atmosphere is bad a$$. Love it! They make you want to hang out there all day. The chairs the walls the tables.. Perfect. 

The service was great the whole time.

Went during happy hour so the drink prices were on point.

Can't wait to go back.

The Temperance House has been in operation (off and on with a variety of owners) for over a century.  It consists of a restaurant, barroom, bed & breakfast. Since reopening earlier this year under new ownership, I have stopped in a few times for happy hour or later in the evening with friends and associates for after meeting meetings and socializing.  

While I really did not like, "The Temp," before due to its heavy political personality, the new version is much more friendly to all invitees, and offers a few small back rooms for groups to get together with quality bar and kitchen service.  We were there last night for a couple of hours to catch up after last week's national elections (more commiseration, than celebration).  Our server was warm and efficient, and the food and drink were good and reasonably priced.  

From our vantage point behind the barroom, we heard the live band playing in the bar, but not loud enough to interfere with conversation.  Entering and leaving, I spied several people I knew from around town, and we acknowledged each other with nod, smile or wave. They were all having a good time.  

Now that the vibe is more welcoming, a check on their dinner menu is in order.  Hope it, too, is more warm and tasty than the dusty dryness of past party clubbiness.
Very good Mexican food.  They have a bacon and shrimp burrito that is amazing.  The burritos are also huge.  Also reasonably priced.

Blaze has become one of my new favorite places to eat at. 

Location- this location is almost never packed. I am in and out with my pizza within 10-15 minutes. Parking is usually pretty good around there. 

Staff- the staff here is extremely friendly. I go there pretty often and the employees always recognize me and make conversation- which is something I appreciate when it comes to customer service. 

Food- If you haven't been here, this is the equivalent of Chipotle but for pizzas. You go down the line and pick your sauce, cheeses, and ingredients. The toppings bar is always fully stocked and the ingredients are fresh. I pretty much get the same pizza every time. It's amazing that I can get all the ingredients that I want on my pizza for just $8.25. Everyone can get what they want for a low price. If you decide to dine in and you don't finish your pie, they have cute half boxes were you can place the rest of your pizza and take it home. They have a fresh water station that I tend to skip out on because they are extremely sweet.
Great atmosphere, service, and prices!   Food was amazing and we will defiantly return!

Their pizzas and hot sandwiches are reasonable, and the staff has always been nice when I have ordered take-out. I would say that the pizza is average NJ pizzeria fare, but I do like the fact that Mike's supports local community activities and events.

The location is convenient if you are stopping by the Target or PetSmart to pick something up, but otherwise the location is very strange- somewhat tucked into a corner of a strip mall.

I went to the Mill in Tampa which I have a feeling has a different atmosphere than the one in St. Pete. Because of the outstanding ratings, I was expecting to be blown by the meal. However, it was sub par. The atmosphere was an older brunch crowd which also threw me off. I think next time, I'll try the one in St. Pete which looks like a more "happening" scene.

Still waiting for my order placed 2 hours ago. I've eaten here before and I like the pizza. Waiting this long will ensure I get my pizza elsewhere. Honestly it should be half off at this point. So call and make sure your wait won't be so long!

    Well wish this update was a positive one. I ordered 70$ in food and told them to call when they got here. I missed there call but called the driver back twice with no answer. The store called and said the driver was heading back to the store so I cancelled my order. Doing business like this is not ok. I won't recommend them to anyone ever or order again. This is the second time they have done something unacceptable in my book. I was outside waiting when they said he was returning to the store. Is it that hard for the driver to wait 2-3 min when I wait 30-40 for my food?? Um you wouldn't think so.

Food was good, service good but a little slow. The entertainment device at the table is a SCAM. My grown daughter picked it up to see what it was. She touched the trivia tab. She was asked if she wanted to proceed. She chose yes, only then did  it state there would be a fee for use. She immediately hit cancel and set it down. That action alone cost $2.00.

It was Sunday and at home we do pizza and salad.  This place fit the bill.  Our server was over and beyond the expectation.  Food was a nicely assembled anti pasto salad. Pizza thin and crispy!  We liked it.

My wife and i stopped in here while we waied to be able to get checked in to our hotel.
I got the taste of new orleans.  I liked it.  Ive never have had crawfish etoufe (spelled wrong) before, so i have nothing to compare it to but i thought it was great.  The jambalaya was ok, a little dry.  And the reds beans and rice was alright.
Service was quick and polite.  
It had the feel of a sports bar which was right up my alley.
It was also happy hour, which i was unaware of and the waiter brought me over a second beer before it ended so i didnt miss out on the deal.  I liked that, especially cuz you Cn take your beers to go in new orleans. 
Overall a pleasant experience.

The milk tea was ok, but the customer service is the very bad. They gave my order to someone else, but blamed all on me for not listening for the order when I was literally waiting there for 30 minutes.

Touristy atmosphere, it was very nice to sit out on the boardwalk and watch the birds and boats go by but the drink and food were nothing I would care to experience again. The salad was wilted, tomatoes were mushy and not edible. I ordered blackened sea scallops with garlic mashed potatoes and vegetables. What I received was not sea scallops, it was some sort of processed rubbery fish in the shape of scallops. The blackened seasoning was very tasty but the rubberized processed texture of the scallops left me unable to eat them. The veggies were steamed summer squash and zucchini but were completely tasteless. My garlic mashed potatoes were absolutely the best part and delicious however, they were ice cold. My husband had 8oz steak with baked stuffed shrimp. The steak was good, the shrimp were tiny and the stuffing- not so great. $9 each for strawberry daiquiri that were like drinking a strawberry Coolata from Dunkin Donuts. They clearly did not put any alcohol in either of our drinks.

Pro: Went here for Thursday night $.45 wings and had a great time. My fiance and 
         I thought the wings were delicious and well done.

Con: Not so much a con since it is a bar but it felt like the speakers/t.v.'s were a 
          little loud but it could be because we were there to just enjoy the wings, 
          not drink.  
         Also, we didn't know the celery & blue cheese is an extra $1.00. No big deal.

Pro: The waitress was nice and attentive. We shall definitely return soon.
beef Pho with oxtail wasgood. my daughter had chicken pho. big portions and reasonably priced. did not like metal soup spoons. checked in and got a free cupcake. overall good experience.

Amani's is hands down one of the best restaurants in town. The food is so good and the atmosphere is very cute. Never had anything on the menu that I didn't like. Service is wonderful as well. I highly recommend the grilled octopus if they have it; the duck fat fries are amazing as well. We used their takeout option during the COVID shutdown; the food was always well portioned and very tasty.

Hello.I went to have a quick cocktail, being a local, and had the worst experience of my life. Let me begin by saying I had just spent a month traveling in Ireland, Scotland, Northern Spain, Normandy, and Germany... where I was treated warmly and orderly.  By that I mean they took our drinks in an orderly fashion... I waited 25 minutes at the bar to order a beer (not that hard) and was ignored (a $12 beer mind you). By the time I got the loser (and I mean loser) male bartender's attention two young beautiful women shoved their way in and got his undivided attention. We left, a party of six (so maybe $150?). And may I mention my daughter, whom is young and beautiful, couldn't get bar service at the other end either?? You need to step it up. I've told everyone I know that I will never give it another chance. I'll return to SYR and Lucky's. Ugh to this joke of a bar/restaurant from OC.

I FREAKING LOVE THIS PLACE !!!   I've been 3 times so far and have not been disappointed.. 
 FRIES are THEE BEST , service is excellent.. 
try the burgers! Try the steak ! Try everything !!!
 Prices are normal , quality is way above average.. 

I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE !!

I had heard good things about Katie's and it lived up to the hype. They were easily able to accommodate our large group (with a reservation) and seat us at one solid table rather than piecing several together. The waitstaff was on top of things and our server, Elise, was fantastic. 

     For appetizers we ordered the artichoke toasted ravioli, fried artichokes, fried burratta, and the figs and beet salad. All were excellent but my personal favorite were the fried artichokes which were delightfully not breaded. 

    Our table sampled several of the pizzas: cured meats, Ted's meatball, sausage and béchamel, and the roasted chicken. The roasted chicken pizza was the only item to disappoint. It features gorgonzola cheese which was a bit overpowering. 

    We also ordered 3 of the pasta entrees. The spaghetti and meatballs was well executed and flavorful. The wild boar pappardelle was unique and delicious. The meat had the texture of pulled pork which we found pleasant. Last but not least we tried the black spaghetti. This cannot be missed! Don't let the thought of squid ink dissuade you, it does not affect the flavor. It was very light and flavorful. The seafood cooked perfectly. The pasta in all 3 dishes was made fresh and you can tell. It was cooked to perfection!

     We capped off the meal with dessert. This did not disappoint. We had the chocolate torte, ricotta donuts, and gelato. All were tasty but the donuts were the table favorite. A cross between a beignet and a funnel cake - my mouth is watering just thinking about it!

    All in all, Katie's is a great spot for a casual dinner or family gathering. We were warmly welcomed and not rushed - even on a busy Saturday night. I highly recommend and definitely will return!

Did you know Famoso does vegan pizzas?  They do!  And that's why I love Famoso.  As someone who eats a mostly vegan diet it was great to find another restaurant that offers vegan options.  And the fact it's pizza is even better (so sick of the standard 'vegan chili' at restaurants)!  Oh, and they don't even charge extra for the Daiya 'cheese'.

I've visited this restaurant pretty consistently for the past few years and always enjoy the food.  High quality food with fresh ingredients for a reasonable price.  There's no waiting for a waiter/ess as you go to the counter to order your own dishes.  Service otherwise is prompt and friendly.

Don't forget to try their gelato!
It was good but different a little too dark for me. Not somewhere I would rush back too but glad I tried it.
Quality is hit or miss if you order during a rush, but overall pretty consistent. I usually get my order within 10-15mins. It's my go-to if I need food fast without leaving the house!

$2.00 for soda water? Really?

Overpriced, mediocre food, but nice staff (aside from upper management...I get the sense that management struggles a bit with temper tantrums and alcohol abuse). I go here on my lunch break 'cause it's a nice place to sit and chill in the chaos of center city, at very least.

This was a favorite spot, it has since changed hands, but it is still a very good place, and probably one of the best in Reno, if not on the west coast!  It could use some updating, but still very cool and a great price for all you can eat sushi!

A great location. Great place to watch some football! Andrew, the bartender was fantastic. He made us feel right at home, introduced himself and asked our names. They've got unique beers on tap and great food. All of the other staff was super friendly too. Overall a great place to hang out.

This restaurant deserves 6 stars! Had a truly wonderful time at Dunedin's new prohibition kitchen last night. The service was stellar, our food came out quickly and our server was on his A+ Game the entire evening. When the food came out, it tasted delicious. Was also super impressed by the decor. One of the most well decorated speakeasies that I've been to yet. Can't wait to go back soon!

If I could write -5 I would! 
Most horrible experience we have ever had. Customer service is at -10000000. We had trip booked and our 1 year old got very sick, so we called to reschedule. THEY told us to cancel and to call back when their manager is in on Monday (2 days after our call). We called non stop to hotel and manager and No one was picking up. When days after they finally did the manager said they are following their Cancellation policy and cant reschedule or do anything. THEY TOLD US TO CANCEL TO BEGIN WITH! Reassuring everything will be fine!!!! So now we lost $1,000+ for the rooms! Cannot believe a place with such a name can have such horrible service! We stayed in many great expensive hotels and in Ritz in Moscow and always had great customer service: the bigger the name - the better the service as IT IS actually what you pay for. Stay away! Spend your money on other hotel that actually cares about its guests and can provide you with great vacation!

Nice little diner. Ordered the sausage and gravy over biscuits but they were out (it was about 1pm). Instead got their dried beef & gravy side of bacon over toast and it was good. Service was great. Inexpensive. Would go again to try the sausage & gravy and apparently the sticky buns the other reviewers rave about.
Great food! The kofta and chicken shawarma were delightful. The staff was very friendly and accommodated my friends and I right before closing and let us dine in.

I personally wouldn't have picked this place myself as the food was below average. Awfully greasy and it tasted like they just threw some soy sauce on top of the noodles (I got the vegetable ho fun) instead being cooked to flavor. Lots of veggies but some of the broccoli was a bit bitter. The dishes are very reasonably sized, if not on the larger side so I was definitely very full and the price is cheap. But for what it is, don't expect amazing. The location is also oddly located in a warehouse/office like area. Maybe good for a quick lunch fix if there aren't many options nearby but wouldn't exactly recommend it.

This is without a doubt my favorite place to eat at in the area. I have not had hummus that good outside of the Middle East.  Their gyros are not only delicious, but extremely filling.  I would love to leave a review on their other food as well, but honestly have not made it last the gyro and hummus!  The staff is super friendly, jokesters even, and make you want to return.
Fun. Great beer and food. Good atmosphere- very cool building. Nice for a chill night out with friends!

As we walked through the first set of doors of Patterson House, we were immediately transported to a time where alcohol was prohibited and speak easy bars were the norm. Once behind the red curtains though, the true journey began.


  Our first move once inside was to grab a seat at the bar. The show that the 1920s clad bartenders put on was as much a part of the experience as the rustic drink menu full of classic cocktails and ingredients. As we perused through the lofty choices, we decided to try something we've never tried before, as they feature drinks you can't find on any regular menus around town. 

The drinks are made strong and with fresh ingredients and most come with a large ice sphere. Made from molds designed specifically for Patterson House, these spheres take 5 minutes each to create and keep drinks the perfect temperature while not watering down. Cole went with one of their most popular drinks, the Bacon infused whiskey. This drink could please even non whiskey drinkers as it is smooth yet strong, with a subtle amount of bacon hints. I went with the champagne cocktail that may sound normal and plain, but The Patterson House put a vintage twist on this classic by adding a touch of bitters.  

Read More - http://uncharterednashville.blogspot.com/

A good spot, as other have said the decor is plain (but clean!) but the food is quite good - ensure that you spend some time talking with them (despite the language barrier) to find out what's good.  Cucumber salad was great (as opposed to the beet salad) and the chicken paprikash is definitely a good mainstay of the non-specials menu.  Enjoy!  We will be back!

Extremely rude while trying to place orders. Bad enough that I said never mind and backed out of the drive-thru at lunch. Never waste your time driving to this location. Nothing but horrible reviews for a reason.

I'm taking 1 star right off the top because this is another 1 of THOSE places that has either can sodas or 2 liters and no fountains. I started to pick up a drink at Fresh Grocer down the street, but it was too crowded. I figured how bad could it be? I got a 2 liter and a couple of cups (1 for a friend).

Eh, this place was alright. I tried the pesto chicken calzone and I really liked the idea, but not so much the execution. I think it needed more sauce and more seasoning. I was pleased though that they let me add bacon for free. Also, I would've enjoyed it more if they had sturdier forks. My fork was all bent up. And seating was sparse. There's enough room for about 5 people.

I probably won't be back since I don't frequent this area. I do respect that they had a recycling bin in there. I always recycle given the chance.

I buy 2 to 3 frozen coffees a day from Dunkin.  But I am now at the point that I may try Starbucks, or at least not fo to Maryland Ave store again.  I placed a mobile order yesterday, at the Maryland Avenue store in Wilmington DE on my way to an appt.  I placed it at least 5 minutes before my arrival. There were no customers, except someone that came in after me.  There were 4 people behind the counter.  No order.  At that point, I was running late and said never mind, just credit my account.
