They said they could not.  Then I looked over and the woman making my drink that I had asked to be canceled had her mask down at her chin.  I again said, "Cancel my order, she does not even have a mask on."  Then a  young girl came over and said "what is the problem?"  I began to explain only to be interrupted by her.  I said, "let me finish, she said, (and I still can't believe I heard this) "hurry up. "I then said never mind "I will write corporate."  Her response?  "Write to corporate.  The biggest loss to any business is the customer that never returns.  The arrogance this young girl possed still amazes me.  Maybe she was the owner's daughter.  If that were true, this place will not be around long.

Not terrible, but not the best either. For just under $6, I got a can of side plus a small serving of sautéed broccoli in some sauce with a container of white rice. The sauce on the broccoli was too bitter for my liking. 

Service was decent and the food was prepared quickly.

Solid BYO brunch spot in South Philly with a variety of options.
 
I came to On Point Bistro with a party of 10 for BYO brunch to celebrate a friend's birthday. The staff was friendly and accommodating to our larger party; in fact, I highly recommend booking here if you have a large party because they had ample capacity to seat us and we didn't feel rushed at all. I ordered the Farm Omelet which had sautéed mushrooms and spinach inside and was drizzled with truffle aioli. Great, attentive service and solid brunch food.

Delicious Sangria! I'm from Arizona and I loved the southwest Sedona vibes! 

Only reason I gave it 4 stars is because my Mexican street corn was not exactly what I expected it to be, it was more of just a corn and bell pepper mixture.

Ok Willa Jean or mgt. yes the food was amazing And we all know city is short-staffed but I need to offer a simple suggestion. The hostess is really doing nothing. Yall need to get him/her bussing your dirty tables instead of just standing there w the folks in line. Yall could be seating ppl WAY faster by btr use of the staff. Guy making coffee working bakery counter --he could deliver trays. If this were Top Chef you woulda won on flavor list on service. James Beard ??? Mmmm must be pre-pandemic. But biscuits, cornbread, chicken BIG YES!!
This is THE place to go if you have to pick one restaurant on your trip to NOLA. best BBQ EVER!

Only giving this more than one star because of the veggie burgers, which are actually quite good. Besides this, the burgers and sides are nothing to write home about. Of course the food is not terrible, it's just a little pricey for what it actually is. I have been here twice because I believed it deserved a second chance, but unfortunately I was not impressed. The atmosphere would be a lot more pleasant if it wasn't so loud. Having a conversation with someone right in front of you is a chore. Overall, this places is overpriced and the atmosphere is nice but too loud. I would only go again if a friend really wanted me to tag along with them.

This is a large super Wawa located on route 30 in Barrington. It's on the east side of 295 and on the south side of Route 30. It is your classic super Wawa with the big store and many pumps.  However you cannot enter from route 30.   The entrance driveway is actually located behind the store. There's a service road that you have to turn into either right before or right after the store itself. Very strange but it works. This is probably why the gas here was five cents cheaper than the other super Wawas in the area.

Not a good dinner experience.  We visited on a Friday night and there were plenty of empty tables.  There were 7 of us, so they put together a few tables.  Our server hustled to get us situated with menus and then drinks.  Then everything went to hell in a hand basket. (Am I showing my age with that comment?).

There was 1, yes 1, server working and when we arrived, not many other patrons.  Then they started piling in and that included a group of 11.  We had gotten our orders in and then got no service at all.  NOTHING.  No drink refills, no food, nobody stopping by to apologize for the wait.

When they brought the food, it was in waves.  A few would get their orders, then a few more, some partial orders and strangely enough, my salad was the last item.  A salad with grilled chicken.

We were still missing drink refills and some other parts of our order so we had to go up to the front counter in hopes of waving someone down to help.  When the brought my Mom's soup it felt like it had been in the refrigerator.

The burgers were cold and my "salad" was a bunch of lettuce with some chicken on top.  While we were unhappy with our situation and couldn't wait to leave, we all felt bad for our server.  The poor thing was just so overwhelmed.  Where was the Manager?

Getting a check required another visit to the front counter and much waiting.  When we left, my Dad found someone who looked like a manager and asked him why he wasn't helping out.  I think it took every fiber of my Dad's being to not explode and go off on the guy. If that would have happened, everyone in the place would have stood up and cheered.

Don't.

We usually shy away from chain restaurants. This one however, seems to have it figured out. Good food, good service, reasonable prices. Because of their location near the Frontenac Mall, often after seeing a movie we will stop here for a bite. It is always busy, but it is rather spacious so you can usually get a seat. We love their outdoor patio. Especially if you can sit on the north side of the restaurant. Its quiet and intimate. It was warm this evening so we stayed inside and were seated in Laura B's section. We ordered a bottle of wine and placed our order quite quickly. 2 salads and then entrees. The thing about this chain is their consistency. It's always good food. Salads cold, not lukewarm like most chains and hot food to the table. Half chicken was good and the short rib ragu was plentiful and tasty. $106.00 for a nice meal.

Two main complaints: the food quality did not match the quality of the decor. What I mean is the inside of the place is very trendy and the food tasted like Chef Mic was involved...
Also, there was a jazz band playing and the acoustics were truly terrible. The place was echoey and loud and the music was diminished. I feel bad for the jazz band. 

Time to add some sound-absorbing insulation to the place, Hops otherwise, I don't think I would ever go back.

I manage a food instagram with 230,000 followers that reviews restaurants based in Philly. I will NOT be recommending this restaurant as it deserves a 0/10 rating.

I have never been to a restaurant where I was SO insulted. The waiter should be fired. This restaurant is a BYOB so we brought wine and ordered two $16 10'' pizzas between three girls. When we ordered the two pizzas, the waiter said "do you know this is a restaurant" and called us cheap for bringing wine and ordering only a little bit of food. We were clearly shocked and said that two pizzas was more than enough food for us. He then rolled his eyes, continued insulting us, and threatened to check our IDs until he pressured us into buying an extra entree. I dont understand what kind of restaurant treats its customers like this, especially when the customers havent done anything wrong. We continued to speak respectfully to the waiter as we got insulted for buying TWO pizzas amongst 3 people. What was the waiter expecting - for each of us to buy one pizza each??? I am disturbed by how this restaurant treated us and I hope they learn some decent courtesy.

I love the beignets from cafe Du monde! A must stop in New Orleans. I always order a large frozen coffee and an order of beignets. You get 3 beignets per order. Make sure you get two orders if you have more then 2 people in your party. Make sure so always shake your bag of beignets for extra powdered sugar all I've them!! Mmmmm! The large coffee IG pretty big so if on the fence get the small one.

My girlfriend and I went here for a romantic date with the intention of getting seafood. I had the shrimp, and my girlfriend had the swordfish. Her exacts words was that it was "stupid good", I agree! My shrimp was superb and tasteful, a burst of flavor.  This place is exquisite!

I enjoyed the Chicago dog here but was disappointed it wasn't the traditional Vienna Beef with natural casing, which provides a distinctive snap and taste with each bite. I was looking forward to the dog you get in Chicago--especially since the Vienna Beef logo is all over the restaurant. 
Crisp and seasoned fries were just like those you get in Chicagoland hot dog stands.
A bit slow: four customers awaited their orders when I stepped to the counter. My dog, fries and Coke arrived after 10 minutes, along with other customers' orders. One couple ordered before me but waited another 10 minutes for their meals.

I do not understand all the hype over this place! I got to the plaza of their CWE location a lot and it always seems pretty crowded. I have tried it 3 times now and I just don't like it. The sushi is simply not good. It doesn't taste fresh, I have brown on my avocado more than once, and the combinations are just average. On top of all of that, it is way over-priced. I will say that the service is impeccable so if that's one area where they really deliver. It's got a nice ambiance and all but the food is just eh. I prefer the sushi from ladue or clayton schnucks to the sushi I've eaten here.

our server Michael was very friendly and walked us through how the menu worked as it was our first time here my mom got the Monte Crisco skillet I got the Spanish skillet and my sister got the Ham and cheese sandwich with fries. 

The servings are huge and the pricing is great we walked out bellies full with enough leftovers to last us at least two more meals the picture below is my takeout box.

Also the location is great too it's great to have a good restaurant in South Saint Pete we will be back for sure!

Place is great! Chorizo burrito is typically my go to when getting mexican and this one definitely did not disappoint. Flavorful and hearty portions for a reasonable price.  The epitomy of what I think good Mexican food should be. My wife has had many of the tacos and has enjoyed all. Her only complaint, if you can call it that, is she thought there was a little too much meat for her to eat.

Well id like to give 3 1/2 stars, only cause the appetizers were great. I had full slab baby back ribs and if you are going to call yourself a barbecue then you should actually be a barbecue. The ribs are definitely baked I know this because you can taste the smoke flavoring. That being said it's very original barbecue sauce that they use and I did enjoy the ribs. With it you get 2 sides, I chose onion rings and baked beans. The baked beans were not good by any means! I took one bite and didn't like it, then took a second bite and knew my pallet was telling me that these were overcooked and close to burnt & left an awful taste in my mouth. 
I figured since Santa Barbara has mostly great restaurants that it might actually be the real BBQ deal. 
My girlfriend had the pulled pork sandwich and let me tell you that was delicious. However the three-star rating is going to the fact that the service was sub-par especially since it was not a busy night whatsoever and I don't feel that for a vacation town like Santa Barbara on a slow night you should get over cooked food and sub par service.

The absolute worst pizza place ever!!  I will never use them again.. we have tried twice now, three months apart, still unbelievably terrible.  Why is this place still in existence? Look at the other reviews?  Awful! There call center is in Memphis and we're outside of Nashville!

I wish I could review the food, but after being treated rudely we didn't stay. We live a few blocks away and decided to try the shrimp after reading the article in the Beach Buzz paper.  Although it was a Saturday it was around 2:15 between lunch and dinner so we headed over. About half the tables were empty. There was nobody in the "order here" line so it seemed like a good time when we entered. There was one lady working behind the counter.  She served beers to three customers who were waiting.  Two of them were getting refills and still waiting for their food.  I smiled when she looked over at us, but she didn't smile back or greet us.  She told another customer it would be a few minutes more for his food.  Then she said to us "if you want to go sit down there are menus on the table but it's going to be a few minutes I am by myself." No Hi welcome to groupers or how are you doing or anything. She could have asked what we wanted to drink but she didn't . The article had said you order at the counter and we knew what we wanted.  Despite being the only people standing there where she just poured beers she didn't even offer us a beer or even any water.  She literally turned her back on us and walked away.  We walked away too - toward the Red Lion Pub right around the corner. If you can't handle the business you have then why did you expand your hours and your menu and brag about it in the paper?  We would have been good customers and we often encounter visitors who ask us where they should go.  Yes people get busy and flustered, but it could have and should have been handled better.  With a little courtesy or friendliness we would have stayed to check it out.

Nice little spot. It's on the corner of my aunts house and I've never been here. Tonight was my first time. Friendly owners and staff. Small and quiet. Really a home feel to just chill and do whatever it is, reading, writing or a quiet conversation. Good prices for their products. 

Favorite part was the friendly people. Super family oriented so to me, that's perfect.
Terrible.! Just went through the drive through and wanted a milk shake and was told the machine was down. Like always

I'm really picky about burgers, and having Celiac disease I rarely get to eat one with a bun. My first reaction to walking inside was the Arcade size Pacman game they had and I knew it was a good sign. There was a little bit of a line but the guy behind the counter was responding to each customer with answers to their questions so that I pretty much knew what I wanted when he got to me. He gave me a few tips for ordering the cheapest way (combo if ordering a drink) a la Carte if not. Then came right out pretty quickly with my shakes right to my table. About 5 minutes later he personally brought out my To Go order and addressed me by name (he actually remembered) then asked if he could get me any condiments or anything else. As for the food, there's a reason they are in the top 10 burgers in the USA. And around $10 for a gourmet 1/2 pound burger that's ground right there of premium meat, lamb, chicken,etc.. Is extremely affordable!! Now I gotta try their Caprese Burger...
Had the east Nashville breakfast sandwich. It was great.  The place needs a better exhaust system, Though.

Great food and great service!
The food was fresh, it was prepared in front of us, and the area was very clean. They seem to put an emphasis on quality.
We will be back!

We learned a lot of haunted history from our guide Sandy. Her stories inspired us to investigate some of the locations on our own.  Muriel's, Lafitte's Blacksmith Bar & the Andrew Jackson hotel became much more interesting after learning about the ghosts-in-residence.  I've done several NOLA ghost tours & this one was very good.  Make sure to reserve a spot.  It's quite popular!

I got the pear salad with balsamic dressing for lunch. This was by far the best meal I've had while visiting Philadelphia this week, and I ate at some high priced restaurants for dinner. The chicken on the salad was tender and had amazing seasoning and just the right amount of grilling and browning. The entire salad was very fresh and I'm picky about my lettuce. The sweetened pecans with the seasoned chicken, cranberries and feta was an awesome combo.  Wish I found this place yesterday.
Very happy the Plumb location has reopened! Same good wine, food and service.  Hope it stays that way!

The owner Joe, and the waitress Irina were both very nice and friendly.  the place was clean, warm, cozy and had a nice atmosphere.

Ate there last night.  I had the scallops.  My food was lukewarm and bland.  Before the meal they served bread with olive oil.  It tasted like ordinary supermarket bread, and the olive oil was cold.

I've been to fazzi's a ton of times in previous years! They have always had great food! It's a nice little hole in the wall restaurant that needs a bit remodeling! Majority of all their appetizers are super! My favorite are the wings and friend cauliflower. I am also a fan of their pasta and I'm not a fan of pasta in general! I can't wait to come back here.
This place serves the best chicken sandwich I have ever had in Philly. It is pricer than a regular chicken sandwich, but the quality and size of the chicken sandwich is worthwhile.

This restaurant blue(beard) me away. We arrived on a busy Saturday evening expecting a significant wait, however we were able to be seated at the bar immediately. The restaurant has a beautiful outdoor patio, but the inside feels like you are almost inside someone's home, in the absolute best way. 

We ordered two drinks, the waldorf, a beautiful navy cocktail starring basil and balsamic syrup, and Bryan's song, pink with lichi liqueur. These were both unique and delicious, and some of the best cocktails I've ever had, highly recommend. The two bartenders were super friendly. We got the skirt steak and the grilled quail with kimchi. Both dishes were quite tasty and perfectly balanced. Bluebeard is a highly regarded restaurant in Indy for a reason, reward yourself with a night there, it's worth it!

Love this place. Whether trying a Special or the Jane, I can consistently expect delicious and creative slices. They keep me coming back for more and more. 

Great service, friendly faces, and top notch decor. And don't even get me started on how amazing their soda machine is. Just trust me on this -- EAT HERE!

My sister and I went to the bar Monday and Wednesday evenings. Monday's piano players engaged with the audience and sounded great; we had a blast. Wednesday night was a completely different scenario. The two female piano players playing together made all of the requested songs they played sound exactly the same and with some of the songs we couldn't tell what they were. I have no doubt they are very talented but the fun part of singing along was lost.

Really good food and service! I had the grilled chicken wings with waffle fries and a side Cesar salad. With a lemonade. Very good. Cheap too. They sale beer which is a plus for my step dad. 
We never ate here before and we enjoyed it. I'd eat here again definitely.

I'm going to give it 3 stars because it was very greasy. The burger and fries I had were delicious and just what I was craving. The service was spectacular. It was quick and all the employees were friendly and inviting. If they could work on cleanliness within the building that would be my one point. It was clean but since the kitchen is open the grease splashes out.

The service is fast polite and friendly, seating is adequate and clean, the food is prepared in front of the breakfast bar seating, and the chef is an artist with your breakfast creation. Local business, great food, authentic decor and of course lightly playing music.

Good restaurant. Ambience is not but food is good.

Tried chicken satay, chicken fried rice and thai tea...All were tasty.
They messed up my order once but hey, that can happen at any place.
Only hassle is parking, if you can manage that definitely give it a try.

We are in Indianapolis every year for GenCon and always end up eating at the Ram at least twice. The service is quick, the servers are friendly and accommodating to large groups, and the food is delicious. Can't go wrong with a trip to the Ram!

Much better food this visit!  Dear Hubby chose the Maui burger, and I had the turkey burger. Both were prepared to the perfect state of doneness.  I would order the turkey burger again, but ask for the thousand island on the side, as it got a bit much.

Also, I was disappointed to learn that grilled mushrooms aren't an option as an add-on.  Bit of deduction in satisfaction for that.    Overall, it was nice to return to this tropical-themed seaside venue.  It's definitely family friendly, and welcoming to all ages.

Music in the garden varies between reggae, country, vintage pop, and other options that are uplifting / add to the relaxed vibe.  The tables are naturally spread out, very safe in these lingering COVID times.

The staff keeps the freshly prepared food coming with a friendly attitude.  Free parking!

We came around 3:15 on a Saturday afternoon and walked right up to the ordering counter.  Now to head to Linden Ave. to walk off our meal!

I have been a customer of Pure Sweets and the amazing Norwalk cold pressed Pure Tonics for over a year. Sitting in this sunny well designed cafe and have my favorite juices along with some of the best organic savories is a great treat. The decor matches the vibe of the cafe, recycled, natural and friendly along with being delicious.Philadelphia has needed more vegan kosher organic options and Andrea and her crew make it happen. I am in love with the coconut fruit of the day yogurt and the Burmese salad is a touch of Yangon in Rittenhouse.
I agree with another review that the really easy iPad payment is made awkward by the recommended tip and glad to see it is being addressed. Now if there just was parking.....well it is worth getting a ticket to eat this incredible food.

My boyfriend, of the McMenamin clan, kept raving about this joint and he loves, loves, loves it.  I was not sold, although I've been there a handful of times. 

Tonight we went there for the Flyers playoff game - a great vibe and is is perfect for sporting events and hanging out with friends.  The people are really friendly and is a good mix of locals and regulars.  I always meet people when I am in there and have good conversation.  At times it can be rightly crowded, but it's still a cozy atmosphere.  

The beer selection is quite varied but if you want a domestic, you'll have to have bottled.  They have a killer beer selection of Belgians, Germans, etc. for the beer snob.  They also have a fridge full of 25 oz. corked imports.  I don't think you will not be able to find something to your liking.  I am not a beer girl, per say, but I always try a new draft when I am there.  Great selection.

The waitstaff and 'tenders are attentive and the food comes quick.  It's clean. Typical pub fare or that's what I always get even though they always have some interesting sounding specials, but I think overall the menu is limited or basic.  The chcken tenders I had tonight were fresh but a tad greasy and the spicy fries - they were a bit heavy-handed with the spice.  

Overall, though - I can't say I have ever had a bad meal here.  I always have a good time and we keep coming back..

Disappointed all the reviews seemed good. Ordered the 2 meat combo plate Brisket and Turkey. Brisket was horrible looked like chop meat. Definitely the last piece of the brisket where the cook just chopped it up. Turkey was OK both meats where at best Luke warm. Best part of the meal was the Creamed Spinach and the MAC & Cheese. Shame that the sides were the highlight of a BBQ place.

Just an update that McDonalds at Tucson, Grey Management, called and left a message.  Also, got a response from them at a corp level.  So that was nice and good follow-up.  Feedback is still, work on getting it right at the window.
The best chicken wings in the USA... thank you Jess ... excellent sever... cute and clean business...

The wait for your food can be quite lengthy if they're busy but it's totally worth it!!!! I would suggest bringing a little snack while you wait if you're prone to getting hangry :) Best burger in Tampa, hands down. I got the Cali burger.. *chef's kiss*
We have ordered and dined in plenty of times. Sushi is very good. Delivery is always quick. Chinese food is as the usual. Can't go wrong here.
We stumbled into District on a Garden District walk and were very impressed.  The Croquent Monte is a must!  It may sound like a crazy mix of ingredients, but they taste incredible together!

My husband and I always enjoy our food from A Taste of Jamaica. The food is always fresh hot and delicious. I appreciate the different sizes offered because I am not a big eater so I can order a Taste(small) and enjoy all the different items on the menu.

I get the same fried rice every time I come here. It's exceptional, and so consistent. Perfect salt to soy sauce ratio, and the chicken somehow always comes out juicy and tender. Portion sizes are also ideal - $10 gets you a great dinner, but not too large you can't finish it. I will be coming here many more times as long as it stays open, greatest fried rice I've ever had in my life!!!

I like this place, it makes me feel like I'm eating somewhat healthy. The atmosphere is very friendly, laid back and can get very crowded. They are opened pretty late as well which is nice. They have inside and outside seating. They have parking in the front that is one hr parking, as well as parking in the back. A VERY small parking lot. Be careful you do not get stuck in from another car. You are able to eat there, pick up or they deliever to you as well! However, with delievery you have to order a minimum. They have a new location now in downtown SB on Chapala. 

They have everything from salads to sundaes. You can't go wrong really. I love the thai steak salad, but sometimes it can get a little soggy when you order it to go with all the dressing, so be careful. My favorite is the half and half. You get to pick two between sandwiches, soup, salad, or fruit. I think that this is a good idea because you get the best of both worlds and it definitely fills you up. There soups are great! I love them all but my favorite is the tomato basil, not too heavy. Be warned that the soups you can't get them everyday, each soup has its own week schedule. Their almond berry split is very good as well and you can get it to go :D. The thai chicken pasta is good but I've had better. Uhhhh haha I've had all the sandwiches. They are all good, just be careful which bread you choose to have your sandwich on, because that could make or break it. With all the sandwiches you get to choose the fruit popper or the cookie. I like the cookie. Also with the salads, the seared ahi seems to be very popular. 

They also have calorie intake etc. on all of their receipts so you always now how much you are eating if you are one of those crazy people who counts calories. 

Worth checking out, I go there at least once a week! :D

I usually don't like Tapas so much, but Amada and Chef Garcia brings it to a whole new level..
Not only I enjoyed every bite of the "million" of food that brought up to the table, the service was excellent as well.
I was lucky to be invited to dinner.
Just GO there. You won't regret it. I promise!

2nd time here and still excellent!  The bread service is super tasty pizza dough style and t ravs homemade and delicious.  Maybe a tad greasy inside and you get a chunky marinara.

Pollo scallopini was great as usual.  Maybe the ghnocci could have had a touch more flavor and have been warmer.

The boathouse is a great place to drop by for a couple drinks or enjoy a family dinner. The wait staff is very attentive. If you value yourself a wing connoisseur then you must try the sweet suicide, asian bbq, or hot honey garlic. The wings are a great size and meaty. They are never broken or soggy. If you like blue cheese for your wings then you must get a side to dip. Wings aren't the only great thing on their menu. Often when I go my wife gets a Rib-eye steak panini and my mother swears by the fish & chips. IMO the best place to eat in Conshy!
excellent food. i love it. i had the alu gobi and it was fantastic. no complaints whatsover- this is as good as it gets outside of india!

This place definitely isn't fancy but it's a diner, what do you expect? 

The food is GREAT and the service is quick!! This is my favorite breakfast place within a reasonable driving distance from North Wilmington. That's including the ever trendy "Lucky's" which is always over packed with a long wait and not as many options on the menu. 

The pricing is decent and the food is yummy and satisfying.

I normally get the sausage biscuit meal which comes with homefries. I LOVE their homefries. They are super browned and crispy with some un-crispy parts too. Add your own salt and pepper and they are perfect. I've also gotten the regular egg meals with toast, bacon, sausage, etc. The portions are huge for what you pay. 

I've also been here for lunch and got a huge burger that was delicious. It was enough food to feed two people and it was less than you'd pay at a TGIF or similar restaurant.

Will keep coming back here, again and again.

The best thing about this place: balcony dining! If you get lucky and can grab a seat out in the balcony and not freeze or sweat to death, this is the place to be. You can see the parades, listen to live music, throw some beads, or just people watch while enjoying a good meal.

Check in on Yelp and get a free appetizer (up to $10) when you order two entrees! Note: the raw oysters don't count as an entree but if you order a dozen of the Chargrilled Oysters this counts as an entree.

Food: 4 stars
- Raw Oysters ($16): really good...smaller than Acme and Luke's
- Combo of 3 Rockefeller Oysters and 3 Oysters Royale: AMAZING! The Rockefeller was baked with sautéed spinach and bacon. The Royale was stuffed and baked with seafood (yummm!). My favorite non raw oysters in New Orleans!
- Jambalaya topped with Blackened Shrimp ($18): good, but Acme is a lot more flavorful. The jambalaya here was a bit dry
- Eggplant and Oyster ($19): really good but very heavy. Fried eggplant and oysters over linguine and alfredo and marinara with veggies

Service and Wait Time: 2 stars
- Our server was very sweet and kept checking up on us so that was great but...
- We waited probably around 20 minutes to receive our raw oysters and then another ~30-35 minutes to receive our entrees. It wasn't even a packed house and another table of two that arrived he exact same time as us received their entrees and finished them before we received our entrees
- There were empty tables ready for customers but the restaurant still made people wait outside in line (if there's a line, people will be drawn to it!). This was not cool!

Overall, the food was really good but the wait time was dreadful. With a plethora of other Cajun restaurants all around French Quarter, I wouldn't come back to this one unless I absolutely wanted balcony dining!

Upon first inspection this restaurant seemed to have some hope. You walk in to a ten person thick line at one register..the other one that is directly in front of two other employees is never offered up to help hasten your time in line. No one tells you that you have to order ur snow cone then or waste another 15 minutes of your life in the poorly attended line. The food was mediocre and over priced. My child wouldn't eat their chicken soft taco. And she will literally eat anything so that will tell you a lot about this restaurant. My drink was refilled once... with an eye roll and an almost reluctant attitude by the unnamed sour server. Another server asked if our food was good and I told her that the chips were horribly stale. She promised to tell someone something and never returned. The owner (or manager) was behind the counter both times when we were standing in line for 15 minutes to order our food...then a snow cone...he had looked right at us...my kid goes over with him...he makes the snow cone...then he makes her come get the receipt before handing her the snow cone! Memory loss? He was right there when we bought it...and walked her to the snow cone machine!? You couldn't pay me to eat here ever again...the onion rings were burnt and FYI...as an actual chef to another...serve the sweet sauce with ur sweet potato fries...your chili powder yack dip you currently serve with them need to be thrown out!

I went back and forth over to give it 4-or-5 stars but there's a few things on the menu that just lack a 5-star pizzazz. They have good, not fantastic prices but a few things on the menu are fantastic! I come here on the weekends and get the House French Toast for breakfast... Its definitely a guilty pleasure but your taste-buds will thank you! Definitely worth checking out for breakfast, possibly lunch... oH and don't take the old lady at the front door personally, she doesn't smile at ANYONE!!

Was in the area toady and decided to try this restaurant. I love Mediterranean food amd I have to say that Shawarmaji is one of the best in Edmonton. I ordered their chicken shawarma lunch special. Was so tasty and fresh. First time to taste the Lebanese coffee and I liked it. The person in charge was so friendly too. Resto was clean. Service was great. Will definitely come back.

Can I say get your meat on!!! From beginning to end everything had tons of flavor!!  For the appetizer we tried the toasted ravioli,  yummy!! It had a crispy outside and when you took a bite you get a burst of beef brisket in your mouth! I could have eaten it all day!! The beastie combo will satisfy any meat craving! The everything was cooked perfectly! The meats were all juicy, well seasoned and smoked!! The ribs had a nice crispy on the one side but still so moist n tender. The pulled pork and brisket just melted in your mouth. Had the mac which was loaded w cheese,  the brisket chilli was was nice n hearty, loaded w brisket and tons of flavor! Even the pop over bread was rockin! This meal definitely made my mouth happy!!! :D also a good beer selection

Hands down one of the best eats in Reno. Everything was so delicious and thoughtfully prepared.  We ordered one of everything on the menu and I'd give 5 stars to each taco. But the Carnitas was mind blowingly good.  They do some wizardry with the cheese that makes it gooey and grilled crispy...mix in the meat and the sauces and it is like a party in your mouth.

Terrific restaurant! The kimchi jigae was perfect, and the pajeon was excellent as well. I fully intend on coming back with friends the next time I'm in town!

Also, the staff was very friendly. Thanks!

I am obsessed with the MDF. I love their flavor combinations and their prices are pretty reasonable in my opinion. They can be on the slow side if you go when they're busy. But honestly, this is to be expected. This is not like a regular donut place where the employee just has to grab donuts and put them in a box. Each donut has to be glazed, decorated, drizzled, etc. If someone in front of you bought a dozen different donuts, it could take awhile! But I think it's well worth it! The ONLY reason I'm leaving 4 stars instead of 5 is because there isn't a changing table in the bathroom and the counter isn't big enough either. A place with mini donuts is obviously going to attract families, including ones with children in diapers. It was not fun changing my son on the bathroom floor.

Jesse's family love Golden Star and they said "It's dependable." 

We came here during the holiday and yes they were opened on Christmas Day. We got seated quickly. They have pretty big selections of American Chinese food on their menu. You can get combos which equal to fried rice or chow mien and one entree. 

I ordered the Kung Pao Chicken and Fried Rice. My meal was just alright. The Kung Pao could used more salt and pepper. The Fried Rice was okay. I think overall this place was just okay. I don't know how they got the Best of Boise from 2008-2011 because they aren't bad but they aren't great either. One thing for sure, you will leave this place with a full stomach. That's about it.
They will not let you have a seat until all the parties arrive. They said it's their policy but I have never heard of that in other places. Weird! Two thumbs down!

It's Pizza Hut and not expecting greatness but every freaking time there is an issue.  Not complaining that it was late the delivery driver was the one who actually pointed it out and apologized and advised we now had a coupon due to its lateness but the freaking quality. It's a pizza!!! The rocket science to its creation has already been done. Dough, sauce, cheese and toppings. Bake, cut and box. It's a franchise where everything is laid out on the how to. Why is the pizza either burnt or not done all the way or a large half pepperoni half cheese is made and cut to provide 3 slices of cheese and 5 slices of pepperoni.  Also the cut aspect must have been in question as it was not fully cut as in the edges of the crust were cut but no farther. Not sure if the lateness caused the pizza to be barely above room temperature or if this particular store just has given up. It's sad to work hard for your money and in the occasion you are running home late with a family to feed you call on what is suppose to be an old stand by at least when you were a child and be faced once again with wasted money and serving peanut butter and jelly now due to the hour.

This restaurant have the best Vietnamese food in town especially their ice coffee and spring rolls. Every time I want to eat some Vietnamese food, I'll always come to this restaurant. There service is pho-nominal! 10/10 would come back again!

This place is a one of a kind, amazing experience.  After getting the recommendation from my friend, who told me I would love it here since I enjoy trying different cuisines, I decided I would make this my birthday celebration location. 

I called a week ahead of time for reservations for 7 people at 7:30 on a Saturday night.   When we got there we were introduced to the speakeasy type door that you have to knock on to enter.  I assumed it was because this was just something that makes this restaurant stands out on this little alley but I soon found out its because the restaurant is super narrow inside.  As soon as you walk in BAM, there is tables.  

So, if its rainy or cold out, you might want to think about if you want to wait outside while your table is getting ready.  

Its $25 per person, fixed menu with the only options of meat or vegetarian.   Since we had both meat eaters and vegetarians in our group, we actually got two trays of food for each course, which gave a meat eater like me a chance to try everything they offer. 

My favorite dishes - b'stella, which was this amazing pie with chicken and potatoes and other yummy things covered in powdered sugar and cinnamon.  You would think that wouldn't work but you are wrong!

the full chicken - I think this chicken may have been my most favorite chicken my taste buds have ever made out with!

At no point during the evening did I or any of my friends tell the restaurant it was my birthday, but I guess they saw the gift bags and surprised me with a birthday baklava with a sparkler in the middle and a belly dancer!!! It was beyond fun, and the dancer even got my boyfriend who does NOT dance to get up and bust a move.  


As amazing as it is here, I can only do it once a year because I was full for about 3 days.  But its totally worth it!!

Wow. This place is AMAZING. The flavors are ridiculous and so classic yet inventive. Great waiter, nice ambiance, delicious food. The highlights of the meal were wild boar tagliatelle and sweet lump crab meat with a potato pancake, but really every dish was 5 star quality. My husband said the nutella semi fredo should be on the best thing I ever ate and i loved the creamy tiramisu. For $90 for 2 of us (which includes tip and some leftovers) this food is more than worth it!!!!! And 2 free sambuca shots at the end of meal! Seriously my favorite place in the city. Def make a reservation! Cash only BYOB.

Great little sandwich shop located right off street..... The sandwich was very authentic and tasted like it was freshly prepared. Nothing fancy here, just great sandwiches and friendly staff!! Good Job!

I have been to multiple chili's in this country.  This is hands down the worst I have ever been to. (I even went an airport chili's; that chili's was better.) The hostess didn't know how long the wait would be - she gave us multiple answers of differing times. She originally said it would be 20 min and we were waiting over an hour. Avoid this chili's at all costs.

Ok place. Not great but have had worse. I ordered the Carnitas based on a few previous reviews. Only ate about half as the rest of them were burned crispy. I can overlook that as the rice and beans and margarita were all good. The 3 star rating is for the service. I asked the server for a Coke as well as the margarita and he brought me a water. Not a big deal at all, I just asked him to grab the Coke. He acknowledged and proceeded to have a 15-minute personal conversation with a neighboring table. I happened to glance at my watch when he started the conversation so it really was 15 minutes.  He also never checked back after we received our meals, did not offer refills on anything, and we had flag him down to ask for our check.  We likely won't be back as there are so many options for Mexican cuisine in town.
Service was great. Food was even better. We enjoyed the patio and enjoyed our whole experience.

Delicious!  Haven't had Mediterranean food in a long time, and went to this place on a whim. The hummus was delicious, and I don't normally like hummus.  I had the  Chicken Tikka Masala, and I loved every bite!  My boyfriend had a lamb chop dish and was also highly pleased.  

It is a small low-key restaurant in a unexpected place, but totally worth the trip!

We visited yesterday. We were sitted quickly, but it took 2 hrs for the food to be served. The server was very nice. The "mofongo relleno con churrasco" wasn't "churrasco" and the "parcha sangria", please..... a shame. 
Besides, very expensive. The portions were ridiculous. Will not be back or recommend. Overpriced.

This place is AMAZING! The atmosphere was classy and exciting. We waited for a bit for a table but that was all worth it! The food came out fresh and steaming. The flavors and seasonings were all on point. Everything blended very well and all together I had an awesome experience! It was my first time there and I would definitely recommend this to anyone who hasn't tried it yet.

Great place for breakfast. Try the waffles and chicken...you will not be disappointed.  Freshly squeezed juices and many coffee options. The service was great. If you can, ask for Kiasia... she was friendly and attentive. A tad on the high side price wise but its worth it.  I will return.

I usually eat here at least once each time I'm in New Orleans.  Good portions, clean but casual vibe at medium prices.  I've brought friends and clients here and continue to be happy with the product.  Good grilled and fried seafoods.  Hope my photos of the crab stuffed flounder and shrimp platter show up.

Quick stop on the way to the outlet, located across the street right in front of the new floor and decor. We ordered the Butterfly Sunset Tea which is butterfly pea flower w/ kumquat Green tea and lemonade. that was pretty amazing I could actually taste each of the flavors in the tea. The lychee peachie was also delightful, much stronger in caffeine and sweeter in flavor. I wish they would offer different levels of sweetness as other Boba places. I understand the teas are pre-mix but surely there is a way around that. Otherwise it's a good thing I don't live nearby as this place would be part of my daily routine.

Holy Smokes this place is busy! We arrived at 530 on a Sat and we were told there was a 75 minute wait. We were joining friends so we went ahead and waited. It was about  95 minutes later that we were seated. 
Be sure to grab a menu while u wait because it's legit 15 pages! 

When we finally had a server,Hannah was very nice and  had drinks out and orders in quickly. Then we waited another 45 minutes for food. Our orders came out one at a time which is odd if you're in a group. My wife waited another 20 minutes for her meal and by that time my food was cold because I didn't want to eat while she waited. 

All 4 of us really enjoyed our food though... saving grace! All the chicken dishes were really tasty. 

Cheesecake was a must but it's a take home dessert for sure! It's soo heavy after a pretty large meal. 


If you plan to have a meal.. be sure you plan ahead and make this a 3 hour event! I think reservations are needed here sooooooo bad!
Excellent shrimp tempura and tender Hitachi chicken on fried rice. Would recommend. I'm visiting Clearwater and wanted some good Asian food. I was not disappointed.

1st time visit with my family because I saw a lots of positive reviews here. There's limited free parking lot in front of the restaurant. BYOB, Staff is OK but you needs to ask if you need to Order again or refill your tea ( Surprised that House Tea is not complimentary ). Clean environment ( Including Toilet).

The quality, tastes, presentation of the Sushi & Sashimi is not that good. Sashimi is not that fresh (Specially the Salmon & Tunna) & small portion, Red Clam sliced very small. Hot & Sour Soup was good, Shanghai Roll not recommended ( Tastes Like Vegi Roll ), Hot foods served hot. 

But for All You Can Eat less than $25 per person , what can you expect. At least my tummy was full:) However, I would prefer any others places better than here.

Don't too high expectations. At the end, I feel a bit disappointed.

Of the three Indian restaurants we have ordered from this was the only one from which I will never order again. The main dishes were soupy and oily. Sag paneer watery. Lamb Rohan Josh was also like soup with layer of oil.  Naan was ok.  Never again. Hole bay leaf in lamb dish with a lump of some spice. Not the best of India

Found this place on Yelp looking for a place to stop when passing through. Soooooo gooood! We had the chicken tacos, carne burrito and a side of the Mexican rice. Nothing was bad, it was all great! I love the little flour tortillas and I would definitely come back. Customer service was awesome! Do yourself a favor.

I travel from North Pinellas just to visit Pipos. This is a fav and now serving breakfast, pancakes, sausages, bacon, egg sandwiches, home fries. I love the crab cakes and stuffed potatoes and cafe con leche, of course.

Quality is consistent. They always offer specials of the day: stuffed peppers; roast chicken, beef stew and more.

This is cafeteria style. Enjoy their great Cuban sandwiches !

This is the real deal in authentic Cuban food and very reasonably priced!

My absolute favorite neighborhood spot in the summertime (the patio is beautiful, the inside makes me a bit claustrophobic). The wine menu has great options at reasonable prices, and I absolutely cannot get enough of the mussels.

Super busy authentic Chinese eatery near Wonton King and Private Kitchen on Olive.      Modern decor, young Asian vibe.  All of the entrees are in large shareable sizes average $12 per person and leave full and happy.  I tried a variety of things, but my favorite was the eggplant dish at the bottom of the black menu.  Soooo good.

Food was great, drinks really good. Had a great bartender, but issues with food service. I guess the cook left or something so it took forever to get our food, but manager came out and apologized and gave all of our drinks for free! Live music was popping! Great atmosphere.
This is my seafood place to go especially in the afternoons to watch the sunset. Always bring family and friends to this location at Frenchy's. Clearwater Beach.

Best cheesesteak in Philadelphia. Period. The rolls are soft, the meat is fresh, the sauce is just right (ie not pizza sauce) and the cheese is provolone (although I was asked today, for the first time ever, if I wanted American cheese!?!) and it's all perfectly cooked. I always get mine with grilled onions and extra sauce but, if you are taking them to go, you might want to ask for sauce on the side because the bread is really soft so it gets mushy pretty fast.

 I love eating at the small counter. (warning: don't count on getting a seat....there aren't many but they now have three tables outside) There are a zillion kinds of peppers on the counter you can add. I tried the chicken cheesesteak for the first time today and it was really high quality white meat but I don't think I'll do that again. It just wasn't the same. I'll save healthier for some other time. 

Carol behind the eat-in counter is a blast and has been there since the dawn of time but she still seems the same age since I came here as a kid. 

They also have hoagies and chips but no fries (sometimes we send one of our party to go get fries from Chubby's across the street) they also have beer and take only cash...

Still, after many years, one of Tucson's only truly unique and exceptional upper end restaurants. This is a real chef with both vision and style, who ultimately satisfies you with her food first. As already noted in other reviews, if on a budget, go for lunch for the same food at lower prices. The quirks of the brimming over salad, the dressing that is always separated, the no substitutions and no birthday candles policies, etc., etc., are the way it has always been. Take it or leave it. I can't imagine the latter.

Excellent food. Came in here for dinner after 11 pm one night and their kitchen was still open! We had a pizza, burger, and fries and everything was really tasty. I will definitely be back to try more from their pretty large menu. Friendly service as well. This is a classic neighborhood spot I wish I had been to sooner!

Most of my dining experience here is ordering pizza to go.  It's excellent!  The few times I've been in the dining room have been a very pleasant experience.  This is an upscale restaurant - not a run of the mill chain restaurant.  I expect better treatment here.  See review by Priscilla G.  She was generous with 2 stars.  

A nice touch I've seen at some chain restaurants is that the manager walks around and checks on the guests.   Maybe Piccolo Trattoria should try that.

Stopped in today for the cheese crawl and the place was packed, but had a great time shopping and tasting all the goodies that were being given out for samples.  They had a great selection all around, a bit pricy, but you get what you pay for.  In my opinion, definitely worth every penny.

Such a waste of a good location. There is nothing good about this place. Hubby and I started with the spinach and artichoke dip, which our waiter recommended. Worst spinach dip I ever had. It literally tasted like cream... just cream with chunks of artichokes. I ordered the veggie pasta, which had so much oil from the pesto. I had to ask for extra marinara sauce just to balance it out. Lastly, babe ordered Alfredo which wasn't bad, but not "Olive Garden" great. 

Moral of the story... only come here if your craving pasta and olive garden and local Italian restaurants are packed with people.

Love this place!! We've had brunch and dinner here several times recently, and it's always delicious. This past weekend, we hosted a brunch for 45 guests to celebrate our twin daughters' baptisms. The event coordinator, Dan, was extremely responsive and accommodating. We reserved the sunroom for a private section of the restaurant with a personalized menu and a mimosa and Bloody Mary bar (BYO alcohol!). The food at the party came out just as timely and delicious (with large portions) as it had when we had dined for brunch/dinner by ourselves. All of the staff are wonderful and very friendly, and we had an amazing time! 

I would highly recommend this place for a meal any time of day and definitely for special events!

Visiting from California, we were visiting our Sister at Vanco and was told by niece to go. It was very good food. Had Grilled chicken salad, one had Meat Loaf,one had Ground Steak covered with grilled onion. All of us where pleased with selections. We may go back for breakfast before leaving. Very nice people own it and great service. Go check for yourself. Good food for good price

Ate at Smees for the first time today.  We sat on the outdoor patio with gorgeous views of the river.  Both of us had the Fish and Chips and they were some of the best I have had in Reno.  Our server, Ali, was top notch and the whole staff was covid compliant.  A great experience and I will definitely be back.

Today I got the best surprise ever. After almost a year and a half I hugged both my mom AND my dad. I knew I'd get to hug my mom, and while that was already reason to celebrate, my dad was a complete surprise and having them both here to meet their new grandchild and see us after so long made this one of the most memorable days in my life. 

That meant we had to celebrate in the only way I know how... food and booze. 

Straight from the airport we headed to Arario because our family LOVES Asian flavors, and as it turns out, we all love Arario too. Mom actually asked if we could go here while en route, remembering it from a previous visit! 

What I love most about Arario is you can eat multiple ways here depending on your appetite or preferred style. We love sharing and all the apps are more small plates and totally shareable. I saw a photo of the crab tofu on Yelp earlier this week and thought it would be some time before I got to try it, but the day came early and I went for it. No regrets. Crispy fried tofu with the softest melty and fluffy interior was topped with real crispy fried crab and a light sweet and vinegary dressing. The perfect light starter to any meal. We also downed the kimchi fries and squid salad, two of my personal favorites.

What about booze? So glad you asked. One of my favorite whiskey selections in town, and it's always changing. Today we tasted through some of the Bardstown bourbons and they were all great. Such fun. 

Gosh. I love this place. You will too.

A real nice micro brewery right in town. They have very good beer selections and we had a couple of drafts. 

We got a duck pizza to split, which was wonderful. The place was busy but not crowded. It was about 4pm on a Saturday.

There were servers everywhere and it is likely the table service was fine. We sat at the bar, which we prefer to do. The bartender was pleasant enough. 

We had not been here in awhile and noted that the entire back side of the place has been re done with a bar and seating area for live music. We will certainly be back to check that scene out soon.

Mark & Nancy.

This place is right on Broadway so it's bound to get a lot of traffic and get really busy. When I went on a Saturday evening of Labor Day I waited about 25 minutes from the time I got in line until I got my food.

The hospitality started right when I started standing in line. There was a friendly worker sitting outside and then when I was inside telling us the run down at Jack's. They have an outside patio as well as an upstairs for more seating.

I ordered the combo ($18.15) which includes three meats and two sides. I got the Tennessee pork shoulder, Texas beef brisket, and St. Louis style pork ribs. For sides I got the mac and cheese and the cole slaw. It is a cafeteria style so you get your food really quickly.

The ribs were fall off the bone, the pork shoulder was really good and fatty, and the brisket was good as well. The meat isn't super hot but the sauces are hot so when you dip the meats in the sauce they feel hot in your mouth. 

Speaking of sauces, they have three sauces: Tennessee (original; tangy and vinegar), Texas (sweet hot; tomato base), and Kansas City (mild; sweet and smoky). My favorites were the Texas and then then the Kansas City.

The mac and cheese was pretty good but not super cheesy and the cole slaw was just okay. The combo also comes with two slices of corn bread which were also okay.

The worker mentioned the combo is a lot of food and is for two people. I finished it by myself although I was really full after eating it. The food itself was a 3/5 but the hospitality bumps it up to a 4/5 for me. Also, if you check in on Yelp you get a free hand rub which is cool too. I'll aim to make some ribs in the future and use the rub.

Not sure why it's highly rated. Maybe people around here don't cook or eat often hot cooked meals. I occasionally splurge for Chinese but this one always disappoints. The quality is poor and the sauces are cheap and quickly made. Also the inside looks dingy - such a great location but it's a miss

Incredible food and incredible service. From the gentleman who sat us to our server Akorn we had wonderful service and a very good time. We ordered chicken curry dip and thai lettuce wraps for apps are both were very tasty. For dinner we ordered the kennett mushrooms and pad thai. I was stuck with making a selection and Akorn suggested the mushrooms and they did not disappoint! If you're looking for an enjoyable evening out with excellent service, this is it!

Only ever had take out but it is my go to place for Chinese food. Never disappointed. 
Food always arrives promptly and piping hot.

Food is great, staff is great (I sat at the bar, was served by Myles) drinks are great, desserts are great. Made it a point to come here after being recommended by a true southerner. Not pricey unless you're ordering massive amounts of entrees and drinks . I'm an apps and drinks kinda girl so if you're in town make it a point to stop here.
FYI- new to this pic taking on yelp so it didn't post but if you're a fan of sweets, for the love of God get the butterscotch pudding!

Great flavor , beautiful designs ... they delivered  my wedding  cake and it was leaning to the left and the  refused to do anything about it  ... Just bad bushiness ... The crazy part of the whole thing is I never asked for a refund and they still treated me poor ...

My friends came here a couple days before I did and highly recommended this place. She said their steak and seafood are all freshly made and delicious. I probably went on a day when everything went wrong in the kitchen. Everything was covered in salt.... a lot of salt. I did enjoy the sides but the steak and seafood that I was looking forward to were really bad.

The ambience was gorgeous and we had a really nice waitress; however, my meal was just okay.  I ordered the grave digger (breakfast dish) that included scrambled eggs, sausage, pulled pork, bacon and potato's.  The scrambled eggs tasted like powdered eggs which threw off the entire plate.  My drinks (coke and oj) was flat and tasted off.  The meats and potatoes were good, but, with bad drinks and eggs my meal was off.  
My friends pub fries were really good, but, they said that their drinks (margaritas) were weak.  I would probably come back.

Over the past couple of months we have eaten at this restaurant at least 7 times.  Given that each meal has been at least $150, we've spent over 1K here.  With that, it goes without saying we love the food.  {the amazing tuna roll is beyond amazing!}

Unfortunately, service is hit or miss.  Yesterday {9/23} was the worst experience. We arrived for lunch a little after 1:30.  The restaurant was pretty empty and yet we waited for almost 7 minutes before the hostess arrived to seat us.  When she took us to our table in the hibachi room things got worse.  

The hostess stated that we were to sit in specific seats starting at the end of the table.  We, however, had already sat down leaving the two end seats empty.  This also left four empty seats to the right of us.  

The hostess became very belligerent telling us that if we wanted to eat in the hibachi room we had to sit where she told us. After a few minutes of her insisting we move, we asked to speak to the manager.  Low and behold, she is the manager! 

She said that the restaurant has a policy of seating each guest at the end table and then working their way around the table.  Now, had we arrived at a peak lunch or dinner hour, I would have completely understood this request.  Quite frankly, had she been professional in her request, even at such a slow time, I would have been more understanding.  She chose to speak to us in the rudest of manner.  

Quite frankly, given the state of the dining room {tables completely surrounding us full of dirty dishes from previous guests}, I would think her focus should have been spent on cleaning the room instead of harassing her guests.  

Will not return.  There are many other restaurants in the area that appreciate their guests.

Yet another sushi joint that has blessed the Reno area. And yes it is closest to my house also. We live in the north valley area so everything is far from us. And this is one of my favorite sushi places. I love their other location but it is absolutely far from me and anything else in town. Haha. 

So I know the owner again!! And he is very very nice. When he saw us he greeted is right away and chatted with us for a little also. The unique rolls that we tried was amazing. There was one roll with salmon and lemon slices and that's it. But it was our favorite. We tend to go more for the raw stuff. 

I'll have to update my review when I get all the names to the rolls that we've tried. Im a bad yelper for not knowing. And I apologize. 

The tobiko with quail egg is my absolute favorite everywhere I go and this place had black tobiko. Felt like I was eating a fancy caviar. 

The owner says he orders a better quality of fish which you can definitely taste. And if you smell the fish before you eat it you can also tell that way. So glad this place has opened and we have now found our go to sushi place.

Having grown up in the south I equate fried food with comfort. I live in California where it isn't inextricably woven as in my heart. Zydeco filled me up with great food and did my heart good as well.  The catfish was the most tender and succulent that I've had in memory.  The shrimp and oysters were flash fried to perfection. The okra was crunchy and perfectly salted!  Go?

New remodel looks great, went here for mothers day with 8 adults and 6 kids.  I really wish I took a picture of the poor waitress's face that had to deal with our crew.  As you can imagine it was more than busy, if noises bother you (dish clank, loud chatter, some music) avoid this as you will not have a pleasant experience.

Food today was great, did prime rib, crab, Mongolian (put some shrimp in your bowl first and a little fried rice, they'll season it up and its delicious), and some nachos.  Food was good high turnover so all fresh.

Desserts are slow, so that was annoying, again really busy day on mothers day, people we're waiting over 90 min (to get in) on this day.

FYI: They'll throw in a free spring roll if you order more than $15 on grubhub. They also have a $8 delivery minimum.

What can I say? I was in the mood for some really jank Chinese food.

WHAT I GOT: Chicken fried rice and crab rangoon

PROS: Well, I'm gonna be honest and say that the best part about this was the price. Both items added together was only $12ish and that was including tax and tip. The crab rangoon was like $4 for 10 of them and your average sized, typical Chinese takeout container was filled all the way to the top with the fried rice. The taste actually wasn't terrible either. Basically what you would expect from Americanized Chinese food.

CONS: You get what you paid for I guess. The skin to the crab rangoons were less than crispy. They were kind of on the flaccid side. Not much filling to them either but it was ok. I'm also kinda scared that the chicken in the fried rice wasn't cooked all the way so I might feel the pain later.

Love their Icky! Enjoyed the company at the bar and got a recommendation for a new brew with a hint of jalapeno; "Cerveza Chilibeso." Thanks Katy!

Totally enjoyed the food! Best deep fried pickles in town. Fish and chips were spectacular... Actually we opted for the lighter plate and substituted cucumber salad instead of fries - nice to have a healthier option at a brewery!

Outstanding, will be back!

Nice!  Great Sports Bar.  Good Food. Nice Menu. Great Service!

A little more lit up than I like, but it's a Sports Bar!

Moving from San Diego to NOLA, I have a love for authentic Mexican food. And Juan's is definitely not that. It is fusion Mexican food and I love it! We got the Hawaii 5-0-4 nachos and it was so big my man and I did not need to order more, but we did! We also got the chicken & goat cheese quesadilla w/ cuc salad (tzatziki) which was amazing too. Though I am partial to anything w goat cheese cuz I love it! Good priced beers and good priced food. Will be back to try the black & gold burrito! Yummay!

What a great meal. We ate at the bar and we're so happy we did.  Full menu at the bar, great service, spontaneous wine tasting.  Great decor and atmosphere. Thank you Yelp for bringing us here. We will be back next time.

What a huge disappointment! We went for an early dinner before a Predator game because friends recommended it. Had a house salad ($11) that had old lettuce and overly dressed so it was a wet mess. Then tried the prosciutto and arugula pizza that was so dry it was like eating saltine crackers. Worse these were recommendations by our waiter. Needless to say, we did not stay for dessert!

First time yelp has let me down.  The service was great. Food..... wow!  Disappointing is not really strong enough.   Ordered steamed oysters to start.  They stunk and looked rotten. We refused them. Next came shrimp tacos. I did not recognize shrimp on my tacos.  Store bought fried shrimp cut in pieces. Soggy and the sauce was way too sweet.   The rest of my party tried fried scallops, steamed shrimp and crab. At least they are consistent. All bad. Draft beer was good and saved the day.

After all the good reviews below, I was anxious to give this place a try...but in the end I have still yet to find any really good 'Que in the Reno area.

Came here recently with a co-worker, on our never-ending quest for great barbecue.  We ordered two dishes to share, the famous kick-ass fried and a two-meat sampler platter.  Not too many folks in the place when we arrived, so the service was friendly, attentive and prompt.

I started off with a cold PBR and we dug in to the kick-ass fries.  They were a unique take on "cowboy" style nachos with pulled pork piled high, BBQ sauce, shredded cheese, sour cream, etc.  The fries were shoestring style, so they lost their heat rather quickly and those last bites were less appetizing.

Our sampler platter looked good out of the gate!  The ribs and brisket were decent, but neither had any real bark on their exterior and the mild sauce we chose was too thin and sweet (the medium sauce had a better kick to it).  Thinly sliced brisket also leads to cold food rather quickly, which is a bummer.  The cole slaw was nice and creamy, but lacked any zip to it, and the baked beans had too much of a ketchup taste so we barely touched them.  both of us enjoyed the flavor of the cornbread; it was moist, but served room temperature which was disappointing.

Overall, I'd say aspect of the meal was just slightly off the mark making it hard for me to give them a ringing endorsement.  I guess our quest continues!

The pecan crusted baby drum had a delicious rich sauce and the pork chop was probably the best I've ever had; awesome smokey flavor. Unfortunately, I was really looking forward to the turtle soup but it was meh...overheated. overall highly recommended.

360 is my absolute favorite place to go in STL. All the service is wonderful and I am always excited to see my FAVORITE bartender ever Chris (he is the bald beauty)!!! When you go, be sure to find him and grab a drink. Whether you want something classic or an original he will be sure to set you up! If you can't find Chris find Michael (the tall guy with long brown hair) for some amazing shots!

This is the best vending food cart that I have ever eaten from. Let me preface this by saying that I am neither vegetarian nor vegan. The healthy food options here are superb! The style of food is more Middle Eastern and Mediterranean. 

Everything that I ordered from this food truck has been delicious. The line near UPenn's campus can get fairly long during the lunch hour. 

Here is what I tried so far:
Spinach Pie
Falafel
Taboulli salad
Greek Salad
Pita Sandwich on whole wheat pita with baba ganouj, w/ salad

They have two carts 11am-3pm Monday-Fri:
courtyard at 34th and Walnut streets
Spruce St. between 35th and 36th

Love this place. When I lived in the Fairmount area we shopped here every Saturday. Now that I am back in the city I go often. Fox & Sons is ALL GF!  The grilled cheese place in the rear makes some delicious GF grilled cheese.

Have ordered twice from here.  First time was really good and second time was decent but not amazing.  For Thai delivery or take out, I think they are decent.  I got the papaya salad which I didn't love.  I had pad thai which was good and a curry which was good.

Not sure if they really want to stay in business for the general public.  Ordered from beyond menu and they gave us 2 almost identical items.  Some things were cold also.  I will not be buying from them again.  They didn't add any sauce or fortune cookies either.
Great spot for coffee. Im so happy to have found this place! It was such a nice quiet place to sit and enjoy the excellent coffee.

If you are looking for authentic mexican food this place definitely has it. My partner and I think the cuisine fares from the eastern coast of Mexico. They serve their tortilla chips with a cool chipotle sauce. The restaurant is located in a corner of a building with 3 tables and one waitress....They service is excellent and with all the neon it is very bright:-) I had the mixed meat fajitas which were excellent. My partner had a seafood dish that he really liked. If you are looking for a quick and easy place to sit down eat good food and get out this is the place to go. I would probably go there more for lunch than anything...
Pretty good pizza, but just a touch too pricey for what you get. Staff was friendly and attentive. Also, the name "Nutbelly" is borderline inappropriate :-). All of that said, I'd go back.
Delicious lunch of Fish Stew, Coconut Shrimp, and a Shrimp Louie salad. We loved the view and the vibe in the restaurant.

I have a huge problem with all the ignorant reviews on this page.
The service here is impressive, sometimes it can be a bit slow but only because this place is seriously bumping all the time.

The ladies that have served our tables have been ridiculously kind and go the extra mile.

The quality of meat and side dishes is amazing. They also serve cooked entrees that we really enjoy including the spicy and sweet chicken (which you should order on the first round as it takes some time to cook). 

It's hard for me to comment on this place because it informs people of it's excellence and makes it harder for me to get a table on the weekends. I feel, however, for the review to be my duty considering all the shade being thrown by morons who have no idea what they're talking about.

I seriously recommend this place for it's prime cuts of meat and the pleasant service rendered by the staff.

The best sticky bun I've ever had. And I love sticky buns. I was blown away. The whole bakery case is incredible. The Amish places at Reading Terminal are 2nd place for me, but Barry's is #1 with a bullet.

Worst steak ever. To think I came to Philly for that.
They just slapped some seasoning-less meat on bland bread and serve you the whole soggy mess and expect you to love it. My cab driver called it a tourist trap yet the line was long out the door.
Oh well, love and learn. Go to Ishkebibbles instead.
Used to love it but really going downhill. Awful steak and the stingiest salad I've ever been served. Iceberg ain't that expensive. It comes across as stingy.

I stopped here after worship Sunday.  First, I went to the to go side thinking it was the cafeteria side. There was only two people in front of me. I was thinking this can't be good for there to only be two people in line after worship. Then, I noticed there were only a few dishes on the line. While waiting, I noticed a lady use some shears to cut up the chicken.  That turned me off no one else had a problem with it.  I finally asked if there was another section and they informed me I was in the to go section. 

I made my way to the cafeteria section and the line was long.  I thought this makes more sense.  While in line, I looked at some of the pictures on the wall.  I saw the some photos the Traveler's Green Book and Swett's was a part of it.  How awesome is that!!!  
I finally, made it to the front of the line.  I ordered the beef tips with greens, macaroni and cheese, fried cornbread, and a slice of sweet potato pie. The beef tips were tender and delicious. The macaroni and cheese was okay. I wished it had a piece of that baked cheese on top but I got the last of the macaroni and cheese out of the dish.  I didn't like the greens at all. I wished I had tried the cabbage instead.  I didn't eat the sweet potato pie until later that evening.  That sweet potato pie was fantastic!  I wished I had gotten two slices.  It was so smooth and flavorful!

Have been here twice (in one week, no less) and both times was blown away by the food. I'm vegan and the staff are very knowledgable and accommodating. I've had the falafel (with muhammara rather than tzatziki), curried cauliflower hummus, the falafel sandwich, lutenitsa, pickles, and Israeli salad. People I've been with have had the lamb, caviar, and matzoh ball soup (which was described as incredible). Nothing has been "just okay" - and I'm pretty sure I've had dreams about the pita bread they bring you. Their drinks menu and their cocktails are also dreamy.

I'll be returning to Shaya many times in the future.

This place = yummers !! I will defy come back!

I came here to celebrate Peru's independence day July 28th! I needed some home loving!!
 
Only 4 stars?! Well the food was great (I had better - but not in the Tampa area) but the decor and atmosphere is really blahhh and boring! I had Bistec a lo Pobre (steak, fries, rice, plantains, fried egg, and beans) The portion was huge! So it was well worth it to take some home. I had some yuca and huancaina because I just love it! I order that anywhere I go :) ! My mom had Arroz Chaufa (Chinese fried rice peruvian style) and it tasted so good! Just like home! 

If they work on how the place looks they would have 5 stars in no time! 

Another HUGE thing I didnt like, is that only 2 people were serving the place. When it got full, they locked the door and people outside were knocking and couldnt get it. Sometimes they would ignore them. If that would had happen to me, it would be probably 2 stars, but I had excellent service! 

Just a heads up !!!

I love this place because it is clean, everyone is friendly and the goods are reasonably priced. And because it is open til midnight. When it starts selling beer, I may move in. I stop in a few times a week for fresh fruit and veggies, a cold drink, sandwich meat/bread, and other random stuff and usually leave very happy. Welcome to the neighborhood!

Great food, decent price.

My friends and I eat here then walk across the street to Finnigan's Wake.

I've eaten here probably four times.  I've never had the sushi.  Crab Rangoon, soups, and stinky tofu is very good.

young crowd, great wait staff, nice ambiance!

I would have gave it less than 1 star if I could. 
My husband made reservations for 2 at 6pm on the patio under the overhang, out of the sun. 
Today is our 44th anniversary.
When we arrived we were brought over to a table in full sun, right by the stairs to the pool. 
We told the waitress it was too sunny and she returned with a women who had quite a pissed off attidude. The woman who we later found out was the Owner, asked if we wanted to wait til 7:30 for a better table. 
I told her we already had reservations for 6pm.
Our options She showed us was 2 tables one in the middle of the floor surrounding with Large occupied tables and another in the sun. I asked her what her position is here and she told me... "she was the owner"!
I told her I would never be back here again and we left.
Beware of making specific reservations to be given completely what you didn't ask for with an attitude!

Just visited Katie's for the 3rd or 4th time.  I do recommend Katie's if you're looking for high end pizza and pasta around Rock Hill area.  This restaurant is wildly popular, so I recommend using the waitlist app to cut down and wait times.  Wait times were over an hour on a Saturday night for a 6:30 pm seating for 2.  

Last night we enjoyed the sprouts, and the fennel sausage pizza, and a couple of glasses of wine.   The sprouts and pizza were delicious.  The sprouts came with currants and pine nuts with balsamic.  Pizza crust was chewy, and had just the right balance of sausage and cheese.  I really liked the little red chili peppers on top as well.  Wine list by the glass had several options including many Italian wines.  Our server did a nice job helping us with the selection.  

I agree with other reviews that say the atmosphere is too loud.  I happen to like the music they were playing.  (Jazz, bee-bopp, Charlie Parker's way).  Not sure if this is their "standard" music selection or not.  Once my wife and I adjusted to the volume, conversation was not a problem.

Some of the non-wait staff seemed a bit irritable .  Not sure if it was the pressure of the packed restaurant, or the loud music or what, but if you are working where customers can see you, I recommend smiling a bit.  Fake it if you must.  

They do have some TVs with sports on, and a projector screen in the middle of the bar.  Last night we enjoyed watching Football on the TVs.  On the projector screen was what appeared to be Katie's YouTube channel?  In previous visits there were movies playing on the screen.  I'd rather have a movie playing.

we've loved this place since it opened,  I can never understand why it has so few people and how it can stay open with so few.  Having been to India, food is authentic.   polite service - maybe you do have to track them down, but that's better than being hovered over the whole time.  This is our favorite place for exotic food

This place is so good. I saved time by joining the waitlist on yelp. I got the Tomato oxtail soup and my girlfriend got the "beautiful tomato" soup. They were both really good. The tomato was a little sweeter and the oxtail had a meatier taste to it. I got the beef combo, fish ball with roe, lobster balls ansome veggies and mushroom. This was my first time trying Wagyu beef and it didn't disappoint. The fish balls with roe were also one of my favorites. I got a free item from the yelp check in. Apparently there isn't a limit so if you have friends who check in on yelp you can get additional free items.  Erika was our server and she was great. 
 
Visited a second time with a bigger party. Had Daniel aka dirty dan as a server. He was very helpful and funny. As well as attentive. Great second  visit and looking forward to come back again !

The menu is pretty limited and they do NOT allow substitutions on their pizzas.
