If you don't feel like sitting on a picnic table beside Bearss or do not have time for the unique experience, call in and take out your order.  We saw a lot of people doing just that to enjoy their tacos in the cold A/C.

Fantastic!
Best sushi around and so friendly! Love going to Hachi! Everything is crafted with such care. Great taste and beautiful presentation! Classy and yummy!

Chic and contemporary space in a section of town that was once home to many old-school establishments.  Nice view of the lake. 

Went here for lunch on a workday, so it was fairly empty. Service was not quite as attentive as I would expect given the lack of a crowd, but it was basically fine. 

Had the gumbo to start (decent flavor, small bit of a kick, a few too many bone fragments).  Then had an oyster/catfish traditional po-boy.  It was good, and large (especially for the price), but not phenomenal -- bread was not quite crusty enough, fry job wasn't as good as many other places I've tried.  It came with kettle-cooked potato chips, which may have been better than the sandwich.   

Wine list looked decent but I had iced tea .... 

I would probably go back at a different time of year (we went in the winter, so it was a bit chilly) and try one of their "special" po-boys, like the "Buffalo Oyster."

I am not usually a fan of hotel restaurants, I much prefer checking out where the locals eat when I travel. Tonight I was tired after a long travel day so I gave 1808 a shot. First, everyone is super friendly and it has a great atmosphere and nice decor. Next, the food is great, much better than average hotel food. I recommend the classic Caesar salad and add steak instead of chicken, the dressing is really good and there are large shavings of Parmesan. The flatbread is also quite good with a sprinkling of kale and pesto but the balsamic onions put it over the edge. Last, I love tasting local craft beers when I travel and the bartender suggested a nice IPA,  Tennessee Brew Works Cutaway Rye IPA, really good.  While I will check out the local fare, 1808 was great.

Worst Wendy's Ever! Stopped for breakfast after a long weekend in Nashville. Line was long for which I discovered was a result of the extremely slow counter help and slower kitchen. Slower than a herd of turtles. One woman was working the counter and seemed annoyed to even be working. She spoke softly so you couldn't here here and after taking my order once, she asked me to repeat because she did't punch it in computer. After about 15 minutes, I got my breakfast sandwich and chicken biscuit. Both were dry and tasted like they came out of a microwave. No ketchup to be found. It's Wendy's so I wasn't expecting prime cuisine but mediocrity would have been nice and maybe a smile from the employee. Skip this place if you can.

I came home late the other night and caught this place just as it was closing.  Inexpensive, delicious, healthy food is exactly what this neighborhood needs.  Turkish food is delicious, and this place does it well.  The guys behind the counter were super friendly.  I can't wait to go back!

Just purchased a home in Reno and will be moving permanently from the East Coast in a month.  To me, a bakery that makes good bread is a must, and House of Bread surpasses my standards.  I tried their challah and marble rye, and both were excellent.  The marble rye is dense and loaded with flavor, the way bread should be.  None of that soft and bland bread you get in most American bakeries for me.  And as far as I'm concerned, the fact that the women who run House of Bread don't wear masks is a bonus.  As a woman, I love seeing strong and independent women who refuse to submit to arbitrary rules that don't do anything to protect public health and safety.  Go girls!

Nice people watching seating outdoors. I ordered the small app nachos for my meal and they good. It was a lot of for a small size order.   I also ordered avocado fries, but they never came so I had to ask the waiter to take it off the bill.  My friend ordered the chips and salsa app. It came with 3 different salsa's. They were good, not amazing, not bad, but good.  She also ordered tacos, and I tried a bite.  NO thanks. Basic, pretty boring tacos.  They should change the name to Rocco's Nachos because those were WAY better.
This is my favorite place of all time, the wings are the bomb great drinks great company everything I want in a bar is here thank you JoJo

I've tried ordering from this place twice in the last two weeks through the pizzahut website. 

1st experience - Order was place for delivery with an estimated time of 40 minutes. Received a call approximately 1 1/2 hrs later and was informed they don't have any delivery drivers.

2nd experience - Order was placed online for delivery. Estimated time was 40 minutes. Received a call about 10 minutes after the order was placed. Again.. was informed there weren't any delivery drivers. 

This is a shame, if you don't have any delivery drivers, you shouldn't have the option for delivery. I officially give up on ordering from pizzahut. I think their competitors PapaJohns and Dominos would appreciate my money.

I have to say that I had high expectations from Chase Club since it is located in a fancy hotel and had good images on their website, but I have to say I wasn't pleased. I made a reservation on OpenTable which asked me whether I prefer high top tables or regular seating. I chose regular table but when I got there, I realized my choice cannot be honored because all they have is high top or bar seating. There isn't a lot on their menu for someone who doesn't eat pork or bacon. Food is okay and service is fast. I wish they had more options on their menu for food and drinks. Fried pickles smears were great and so was the bread pudding.

Super awesome spot to grab a bite and a drink! Options are endless and tons of room no matter how big your party is! My favs: Pattys Cheesecake, Poptimism, and Buenos Aries. Looking forward to going back. Rated 4 because I want more to open up! :)
Doesn't look like anything special from outside. But what it lacks in curb appeal, well makes up for in food! Prices are fair, service was good. We will definitely return!

This was my third time here, the beers on tap are delicious and the food is amazing.  I had the tuna salad this time and wasn't disappointed.  My husband had the shepherds pie and even had to take some home.  We had the pretzel as an appetizer- it came with beer cheese and mustard- delicious.  Will be back on our next visit to Tampa

Awesome local spot for tacos & Indian fry bread. They were able to handle our big order of 55+ tacos no problem in 15 minutes. Friendly service & great salsita! The only thing is the smaller parking lot but is still worth it hands down!

Some of the freshest tasting sushi in St. Louis! The Cherry Blossom Roll is my favorite. Their rolls have generous amounts of fish, and I've never had a roll with  too much rice like some other sushi places in St. Louis. Prices are fair. The staff have always been nice and courteous! On my last take out order (pictured), they purposely gave me an extra two pieces of sushi nigiri which was awesome. I would highly recommend this place, whether dine-in or take-out. Take-out orders are normally ready in 15 minutes. Parking in the front is limited and sometimes difficult to get out since it's right off the street, so I would recommend parking around back. Overall, great family run sushi place!

What just happened in that MMA match I've been looking forward to for months? I don't know because I can't hear the announcers. Serious audio issues while trying to watch UFC PPVs. 

The first time, a few months ago, the only audio for UFC was coming from one side of the downstairs area. We were upstairs on the other side of the building. We went downstairs and the sound quality was just terrible. We could hear that there was announcing but could not make out the words. I made it a point to tell our waitress AND what looked like a manager on duty that we had to leave over this and no one seemed to care. The waitress told us there was sound coming out of a speaker above our table and there wasn't. 

Last night, we tried again. Same issue in addition to not many TVs being tuned to the fights despite every table in our section sporting MMA shirts. Once we complained about the TVs and the audio they were improved. After that our waitress ignored us for the creepy trolls next to us that were just freed from their mama's basement. 

Both times I've seen some dirty old men here but a place like this attracts them. The nachos and mixed drinks are great. They have a huge tap selection but no printed list to select from and the waitress only knew a few. To be fair no one should have to remember 20 micro brews. There should be a list. Quesadillas were terrible. Wings and nachos were better than good. 

I'll be ordering our next UFC at home.
Some of the best Indian food I've had! If you love spicy try the chicken kadhai!! The staff was also incredibly welcoming and friendly!  You will not be disappointed!

This was one place that I was looking forward to trying in Nashville and was easily my most memorable meal. Yes, try the dry rub ribs I couldn't get enough of it!! The best dry rub ribs I've had. The seasoning and moistness of the ribs were just fantastic. The green beans were surprisingly different from what I'm used to but it was really tasty and good and so were the beans for sides. We also tried the pulled pork nachos and was finger-licking good with all the cheese. Even their sweet tea was delicious.
There's street parking along the road. Go in and get in line (the entire time we were there, the line was out the door but its worth it!) There is a bar area and was able to catch some games on tv while we were there too as we're eating. It is crowded but table turnover is fast. 
The pictures don't do it enough justice. Go and try it, you won't be disappointed. If I ever go back to Nashville, I'd definitely eat here again!

Amazing food for really low prices! Its like authentic Mexican food even though its text mex and the meat is so good idk how people say its not real this stuff right here is gotta be real. The service is good enoug for me and you get your stuff pretty dang fast gotta say I was impressed I'm used to mcdonalds and taco bell with there fake nasty food that you have to wait 20 to 30 min to get

I ordered chicken liver toast and burger. They were both the best taste i have ever had. Highly recommend！Specially，the smell of the service girl was so sweet and warm like spring，warming me in such winter.

We visited this spot twice in a matter of days and experienced good ol' southern hospitality and great southern breakfast food.

This place is a diner, and serves exactly what you'd expect at a breakfast place in the south -- lots of meaty breakfasts (not for me), grits, and dessert for breakfast, a.k.a banana split waffles.  Yep, my husband had to get those waffles.  I ordered an omelet on one visit and grits and an egg on another visit.  I love that this place is open 24 hours per day too!

Food is good, service is very friendly and fast, and this will continue to be a breakfast spot we'll visit on return trips to NOLA.
Comfy interior. Very nice staff. The food was delicious. Loved the potato spirals. And the deep fried bread with dip - don't miss out on those!!

Dined here on Christmas Eve with hubby, and a couple of friends, the restaurant is beautiful, the service impeccable, and the food to die for.

The hot bread with butter is one of the best breads I have ever tasted. Totally yummy!

I had the NY steak, perfectly cooked, and so tasty. My husband enjoyed his Sword Fish, while my friend Dena swore the chicken was the Best. Martha complimented the Sole.

We shared 3 large side dishes:
1. Truffled MAC & Cheese
2. Broccolini with Parmesan
3. Augratin potatoes 

All were over the top goodness.

We shared 2 desserts. The S'mores something or another, and the Bananas Foster Cake with Praline Ice cream both were scrumptious.

This restaurant is expensive, but well worth the $$$$ for a fantastic meal, and wonderful service.

Ordered a Cheesesteak with sweet peppers cooked in . The steak itself had no flavor and the sweet peppers had no taste . The meat is cheap . Don't waste your time ordering steak sandwiches. Give them one star for effort .
Very good breakfast-solid omelette & eggs Benedict.  Coffee good but cups could use some scrubbing.  Service excellent.

Skip this place. It doesn't even deserve one star. I had an awful experience and the bouncers were very aggressive.  In absolutely no situation is it appropriate to hit a woman.  This place should be shut down!
Food and service exceeded my expectations! What a great place. It's a must if you are seeking a nice place with reasonable prices. Way cheaper that Mortons and they serve a better product! Enjoy

I really wanted to like Galatoir's and my girlfriend and I were looking forward to our lunch reservation all morning and showed up very hungry. The service and food were good, but not great by any means. I wouldn't recommend for the price and I don't think I'll be back; too many other choices in the quarter.

Came here for lunch with a co worker.  The menu was fairly limited for lunch with not a lot to choose from   looked like they had a lot to choose from by way of drinks but since we were working we could not partake   We both decided on fish and chips   Today the fish was Halibut.  Looks like the fish changes day to day    it was pretty good, exactly like we wanted    looking forward to going back for drinks some time

They served the BEST HUMMUS. I know.. its just hummus, but whatever they do to their hummus makes it delicious.

I've tried a few other of their dishes.. I was blown away by the first one but I don't remember what it was. I told the owner I was a vegetarian, and she hooked me up. I remember that it was rice, salad, and veggies. It was delicious! 

I've also tried their fried eggplant wrap and their falafel burger. Both were good but I wouldn't go out of my way to get them.

Would not return - burnt ends already drowned in sauce (never understood this - if you don't sauce my brisket, why would you sauce my burnt ends?).

My brisket was extremely fatty despite being sliced somewhat thin. The macaroni was lukewarm (I almost forgot non-baked macaroni was a thing), and the beans were meh. 

Prices are reasonable - I don't want my money back as much as I want the pointless calories on my flabby stomach back.

The Boudin balls are really good and so are the onion rings and so are the burgers one of the best burgers ever and pork steaks are pretty good to and then he got really good dessert from the bakery how to Kansas City called golden boys buttercream cake I ever had

This is a take out place not a restaurant. I wanted to try this place out because it said it has New York style pizzas.  I ordered the fried zucchini which turned out to be a combination of fried zucchinis and mozzarella, missing a side of ranch.  I also ordered chicken wings in the hottest sauce they have (forgetaboutit) and those were ok. The straw that broke the camel's back was the pizza!! They claim that their pizzas are New York style but perhaps there were from a part of New York that doesn't know how to make pizzas!!  I ordered a grandma pie which was supposed to have plum tomatoes (marinara sauce instead) and fresh mozzarella (shredded mozzarella instead). Won't be back.

No kids? Yay! There is always a Chuckee Cheese nearby and other optiins for families. People need to understand that a business as a private party has a right to choose their practices. I support my constitution!

We came here recently for lunch. The tables are affixed to the floor as are the benches/chairs which makes breastfeeding awkward among other things, but otherwise the decor is unremarkable. Our food was standard Dairy Queen fare. The high chair could use better maintenance as it was very dirty and was missing the seatbelt that keeps the child safe in it. Likewise it seemed rather old and potentially unsafe. This location has a soda fountain for refills so that was convenient. I'm most likely to come here in the future for dessert/cool treats rather than for hot eats/main course options.

I never like to write a review based on customer service, but this one deserves a review. My friends and I were looking forward to dinning here over the holiday and when we entered we waited a decent 10-15 minutes and then seated. The waitress walked by us several times without acknowledgment and then gave a half-ass hello 5 minutes later. When she returned another 5 minutes later she didn't address the menu or the specials. We ended up leaving. 
I debated on this review, but was so offended (3 days later) that I wanted to put my voice out there.

11/17- I appreciate when a manager contacts me with concern over my reviews and I do plan to give this restaurant a second try when in town. People have their days, but you have to put on your paid for personality when working with the public.

We wanted to get that Bourbon St. experience and it was really interesting. Alot of people n of course the beads! We found this sports-bar right around the corner from it all and it was great!

They sat us down really quickly and brought us out the water. Very friendly service! We wanted to get the main courses of New Orleans: Gumbo & Po'Boy Sandwich! That is what we got and it was delicious!

The gumbo didn't look as appealing, but tasted was sooo good!! The po'boy sandwich was a little messy and the fried breaded fish was falling off the sandwich but oh well! It doesn't hurt to get your hands dirty...It was really tasty and delicious. I would definitely come back and try other dishes.

If your getting a pizza here don't get excited, I don't know how they rate for Philadelphia but as pizza I have had its ok, 3 star maybe (it was not bad, just not memorable). the wings however are to die for! I consider myself a bit of a wing connoisseur and attempt to eat them when ever i can, so I have eaten some wings in my day. these my friends are top notch.
Had the Persian lamb and a couple other goodies. Everything was well-worth the price and the short wait. Outstanding service, food, drink, and atmosphere.
Hoagies here are good but I'm a Wawa guy when in philly. My opinion, no Wawa around, go here! Miss my hoagies down here in GA.

BLUF: First timer and very glad I visited! Very affordable prices for a full 4 course meal. Centercut sirloin 

This is my first time visiting an Outback Steakhouse and I'm thinking to myself, "why the heck have I been waiting so long?!"  

The food here is pretty good! We shared blooming onions as our appetizer (HUGE portions; probably good for 3-4 ppl). I got a 4 course meal combo (soup, salad, sirloin steak w/ asparagus, and cheesecake). Very delightful! Our server, Ashia, was great! She saw the burnt asparagus and made sure we got fresh ones before we asked. Great customer service!

Some things that could've been better was how fast the food coming out. It was pretty slow but it was okay since we needed time to digest the food lol.

Overall, it was a very delightful experience

So excited about Teru sushi! I have been a long time customer of Teru's at Sakana. I am so excited he has opened his own restaurant. He is from japan, having been trained there in both sushi and the kitchen, and is a true culinary genius. He is such a interesting person to talk tWe loved the sunny press box roll, the eggplant appetizer and the cooked mackerel! Can't wait to try the other items on the menu!

Not sure why this place "moved". Perhaps for a fresh start on Yelp? Anyways, I will play ball. 

I've been enjoying the bakery items lately. In this area it is hard to find a good bakery for when you need desserts. 10 miles away maybe, but with the hideous construction project right in front of this place, it's not so easy to justify driving past this place to go elsewhere for, at best, an inferior product.

Having some important guests visit soon from a place where good diners do not exist. This is the place I plan to take them to. I consider it my go-to diner. 

P.s. Customer service has been tops the last year or so. There were complaints earlier, but I'm not really seeing it. Plus,these guys service a bazillion customers every day, so 2 or 3 complaints of rudeness don't account for much in my book.

This is my go-to place for cheesesteaks in Philly. Their pizza is great and there are so many options! Only issues I've ever had are missing items from order but Nish, the owner, took care of me and ensured that I was happy and that the issues were resolved. Food has always been delicious, hot, and fresh!
Well over due for a review.... I visited Central Grocery & Deli last month. It's a surprise to me to have  the one of the best deli sandwich. Home of the best Muffuletta

This place was crazy good food! I found staying at a local hotel on Yelp. It was a 1.7 mile walk and well worth the exercise that we needed in addition after we ate the 1.7 mile return. I had the ultimate lobster roll and my husband had the fish and chips. We shared the huge free piece of bourbon bread pudding for checking in on Yelp. Best we ever had! see pics

We ended up at Firebirds by chance actually... Hubby and I were in the area and looking for a good bite to eat. We saw that they have happy hour from 3-7 WOW and popped in to check it out. 

We sat at the bar which is a beautiful backdrop! The servers were attentive and friendly with good recommendations. 

I HAD TO try the Skrewball Russian as the White Russian is my fave drink. The Skrewball is a mix of White Russian with peanut butter flavor whiskey in it. The bartender warned me its a bit sweet, but I like dessert style drinks and she was right - I LOVED IT! Hubby had some beers.

We ordered apps off the happy hour menu. Hubby RAVED about the tuna tacos and said they are the best he's had. I loved the mini burgers and we both loved the shrimp. We decided we couldn't leave with out trying the Philly Cheesesteak eggrolls and I'm glad we did. They were very tasty, though next time I may order them without sauce. I think a lil A1 would be perfection on these!

I learned that they have a rewards program and if you sign up online you get $10 off your next order (so hurry and sign up). We will def be back here to try the dinners. We watched quite a few dinners being delivered and they looked amazing!

15 years ago I ventured into the Khyber to watch a friend play in a band. Only drank beer, but I likes the ambiance. I heard it was closing, and was sad. Fearing the rumors of a Japanese-style place, I was releived when it reopened as a revamped Khyber.

Checked out the new place on Friday. Quite impressed. The beer list was fantastic. The bbq-style food was good. Kind of sad that there is Q around the corner and Khyber. Two places that serve bbq. Hopefully everyone will win.

Khyber wasn't overly crowded. Bartenders were friendly, and knowldgeable about the beer selection. Food was good. I had beef brisket, mac and cheese, and collard greens. My wife had fried chicken, mashed potatoes, and baked beans. 

Brisket was moist, but had a lot of fat. Fried chicken was crispy and juicy. 

Beer selection was quite impressive, and based solely on that, we will return.

It looks like Khyber righted itself, hopefully it will maintain a decent following and stay afloat for a long time.

Visited this spot for the first time today and it did not disappoint! They had a plethora of tasty looking options on their menu and probably couldn't have gone wrong with any of them. Ordered an americano, fresh squeezed OJ, vegan slinger and pork slinger and they were the most scrumptious savory options! Amazing, would definitely go back again. They also still offer indoor dining during this time which is a nice option!

Vientiane Cafe - oh I love you dearly. Not only do you always provide an affordable meal that all seem to enjoy - you are consistent, every dish is made to order, and OMG can you accommodate all food preferences!


This visit is bitter-sweet, as I am departing the Philadelphia area for a new career opportunity.

While I know I will be back from time-to-time, as I do have family in the area, I still can't just pop on over to one of my favorites when I need a good friend's couch to sit on. Because of all realistic measures, that is exactly what Vientiane is - a good friend's couch that you can come hang out in a laid back and chilled BYOB atmosphere.


It's that friend that makes you that big bowl of comfort food to help you celebrate the highs or to crush to lows... and for all of the amazing experiences I have had here - I thank you! I thank you for making eating out and being social a possibility for a gal who has multiple food allergies, is a bit of a food snob, and living on a budget. You are amazing and I will continue to spread the word that all of Philadelphia needs to come check out Vientiane, if they have not already!


This evening, we were seated and handed the revamp menu - which, is visually much more appealing. It is also helpful that this menu consists of GF (gluten-free) codes so I know what is and is not safe for me.


I ordered a good classic for a table share - Lao Porridge (jow-piek) or congee. It is a smooth and comforting bowl of heaven - not too many more ways to explain it.  It is a subtle dish with simple flavors meant to heal. Good thing I planned on sharing and that I ordered the large because the entire table went nuts over it. P.S I order it with the soft tofu rather than fried - it is just a preference, but I think it makes a world of difference.


Then, despite having a huge list of things I wanted to try (aka the casserole, Laab, any of their fried rice dishes, Banh-Xeo, a dessert, and more.....) I had to go out with the first dish I ever ordered.......


Drum roll please..... the King Soup - or as I like to describe it as a Pho with coconut milk and much more spice! We all know I love coconut, love a creamy dish, and we LOVE spice - so win was always written all over this dish! Oh, and did I mention that they can make it gluten-free, vegan and it comes in a GIANT bowl for under 15!?


A friend of mine did order the new dish, Bamboo Stew (gang-naw-mai) which is bamboo shoots mixed with pumpkin and mushrooms (very earthy) and served with their famous sticky rice. Note, while this dish is not marked gluten-free, I am sure that if you ask, they are able to modify it for us gluten-free folks! 


In conclusion, it has been real Vientiane Cafe and I will certainly be back to visit! In the meantime, keep making some more awesome additions to your menu and oh, if any of my readers try the other dishes on my wish list, PLEASE SEND ME REVIEWS!


Until next time.


Oh, and check out all my other reviews of Vientiane Cafe below:
http://gf-flamingo.blogspot.com/

Been living in the Square for a year, and I have to say I enjoy the Dairy Queen Stand. I have noticed they are building a drive-thru, but when you're like me and you live close it gives you a good excuse to lose some calories before eating ice cream.
They are really fast and nice. 

I enjoy the fact they give my dog some vanilla ice cream in a little dixie cup for free. He is a big fan of that. No, really...when we walk up to the counter, he puts his paws up and makes the best sad eye face. It's a good place for some ice cream, a chat with neighbors, and an enjoyable spot on a hot afternoon.

No bueno . Prices are double than posted. Food is smaller, I ordered two Chicken burritos, so damn small and they were filled with lettuce and smeared with beans and barely any meat. This woman works so hard, I know they are doing the best they can but obviously the increase of goods and possibly rent have force them into the situation.

I am excited to find really good BBQ in Nola!  The ribs and pork were perfectly cooked and I loved the warm BBQ sauce!!Lots of freshly made sides to choose from ( I had jalapeño  grits and greens)  will definately be a regular at this new place!

OUr family of four at breakfast at Stella's.  It was very crowded.  Luckily we only had to wait 10 minutes.  We ate in the outdoor pare, which is very dog friendly.  

Waiter was ok.  Coffee good.
We had a Denver omelette, pancakes, fried green detonators omelette and corn beef hash with the standout dish being the awesome awesome awesome corn beef hash.  The fried green tomato omelette was also good.  Pancake had maybe cinnamon syrup, it was good too..solid Denver omelette...  

This is my favorite breakfast place in the st Pete area...other places we have tried, strata hotel, the frog pond, grand plaza hotel buffet, soleil, the pancakes were good too,

Great local dive bar hidden away just a short drive from Mass Ave! The bloody marry is excellent here and they also make all their infusions for drinks in house! The food is way better then your average bar food! I have ordered the chicken tenders, Gish and chips, and pizza and all where excellent!

Great place to watch the Saints game! Nice locals bars recommended by our AirBnB Neighbor. Good drinks, friendly bartenders and patrons. Reasonable prices. The outside patio is nice but all the seats were filled when we got there. The whole place was pretty packed actually so get there early if you want a seat. They had someone making Pad Thai outside all day too if you got hungry. We didn't have any but it smelled good!

Aroma just bending the corner and seeing Dr BBQ's sign was AMAZING. Mouth salivating and my internal happy food was ignited! 

We started off with their fries, pretty damn good!

I had the brisket, baked beans and a side of corn bread. 
The brisket crust was PERFECT, wonderfully flavored beans and the CUTEST lil corn breads ever. 

The husband had the pick two meats with pulled pork and sausage with the blue cheese bacon slaw. 

From BBQ vibe is complete here. Even the bathrooms! Every detail was well thought out. 

We will be back!

Don't let the location and dining room fool you the food is very tasty, veggies are fresh and prices are down right cheap. Much Better than all at the same price point and better than many at all price points. I don't get why wings get some bad reviews. Not a date place unless your a foodie couple, great for take out.

The abmiance is nearly as good as the food.  The art and colorful walls of this very clean cottage make you ready for a perfect meal.  They play perfect dinner music - Modest Mouse was rotated in.  All glasses of wine are only $5 and the list compliments the food very well.  The mixed drinks are top notch too!  Like all NOLA eateries, this one serves up generous portions.  I had a terrible time deciding what to get but am very pleased with the scallops.  I noticed most other tables in the restaurant ordered the BBQ shrimp so I am going to go back for mine!  Oh yeah, most of the ingredients are FRESH AND LOCAL.  It's been my favorite meal so far this trip....

This is one of my favorite places in St. Louis! Great spot to take out of town guests or date night. The atmosphere and decor are top notch and the food is even better. I ordered the Louie cocktail which was so tasty, followed by a platter of assorted oysters, and clam chowder to share with the table. Do yourself a favor and get the lobster roll with a side of brussel sprouts, half fried, half steamed. The bun on this roll is the most buttery, fluffy thing, so delish! Can you tell I liked the food? HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

We like the Palm Harbor location and have been waiting for years for this place to open like most of the Westshore area. We finally got the chance to stop in for lunch. The wait was manageable for a Saturday and first week being open...maybe 15 minutes. The place looks awesome inside and they did a great job with the design and the details.  Patio seating was perfect for us today and our server was friendly and spot on. 

I ordered the pretzel breaded chicken fingers that is served with fries. Wow...what a disappointment. Five tiny, thin and overlooked chicken 'fingers' we're served with soggy fries. The chicken seemed to be thin chicken cutlets that were cut into fingers. They were almost the side of nuggets. Dry and over cooked, the sauce was a must. At $16 we felt that this was the worst value in Tampa. 

We also ordered the half Ruben and salad combo. The meat was good but didn't seem made in house and was your average supermarket variety. The sauerkraut was pretty good and the cheese tied it all together.  The Greek salad was fresh, but was mostly leafy green romaine with no crunchy hearts. Pasta salad was one of the highlights. 

While we understand this is their first week open, there is no excuse for letting chicken fingers leave the kitchen in the state they arrived. If this is appetizer meant to be shared, only one person is eating  - 

UPDATE - Stopped in today to give their new breakfast a try. 9 AM on a Sunday and it was empty. Menu is large with some unique items and of course the bakery is also on display. Service was slow , mostly the food from the kitchen. I mean really slow. I ordered two eggs with the ham steak. The ham was a thin piece of over cooked dried out ham. Sure it was a whole 'steak' but was too thin and could hardly cut with a knife. Egg whites were good as well as potatoes. We also ordered once of the Cuban type sandwiches with egg pork salami and ham. Was a bit too soggy.   We won't be going back as there are so many better breakfast options around the area. Bathrooms were unavailable at 9 am as they picked that time to clean them. Great planning. 

I also find it odd that half of  LCD screens around the dining area show advertisements for Pasco County lawyers and other services. Find it such a cheap thing for the owners to do, but I guess they have to make up some revenue for how long this place took to open. 

We won't be back for more than just a beer.

We happened into Blinkers, caught the last two spots at the bar and couldn't have been happier. The pork chop was outstanding and the crab cake - good Lordy it was amazing. Cocktails were tasty and the service was stellar!!  Thanks.

*This review is based solely on the sushi- not the Korean food*

I enjoyed my experience at Matoi. It is very hard to find Toro in the Tampa area, but Matoi had a great cut of it. All of the nigiri we ordered was delicious. Most of the specialty rolls didn't appeal to me since they mostly consisted of fried fish or shrimp, but the TT roll had spicy tuna topped with tuna and cream cheese and a tangy house ponzu.

The staff was very accommodating. They took our order at 10:30 (last call) and waited on us past close. They even brought out an extra dish which was a charred fish free of charge. They were very friendly, and the sushi chef himself came out to our table to ask if we enjoyed our meal. I will definitely be making a visit back here.

You can't turn a corner in Reno without getting smacked in the face by an AYCE sushi place it seems.  Really, I believe this place has at least 2 other sushi restaurants within a 1/2 mile radius.  Tha Joint has never been my favorite, but they are decent and really cater to those who like rolls and more fusion cooked rolls.  The interior looks cheaply thrown together, with little more than flat black paint thrown everywhere and all hard surfaces so it's very loud inside.  Not a great place for a date night, but they do have several large tables so they are a good place to accommodate larger groups, something most sushi places aren't really designed for.  We had a group of 12.  Service is friendly and the girls seem to work together really well, 3 or 4 different waitresses came around checking on us.  There was some duplication of orders so we got some stuff we didn't order, but they didn't make a big deal when we didn't eat the extra stuff.  They offer a few grilled entrees (salmon, chicken) for those that don't want AYCE, but not much and no bento boxes.

Visited Pasco last night after the basketball game.  The food here continued to impress.  I got the grass-fed burger, which was full of flavor and cooked perfectly.  My wife got the enchiladas, which was a fresh take on an old favorite.  The drinks are creative and delicious.  

The atmosphere is loud and energetic, so it's not a place for a quiet dinner.  That being said, it's a nice mix of clientele - both college, young, and older folks.  It's perfect for meeting friends.  Our server was great, but a bit overworked which made things a little slow. 

Overall we really like Pasco, which has become one of our Tucson favorites.  We look forward to going back.

Impasto's is the real deal when you talk Italian. We all had the four course special and as delicious as it was we couldn't finish. Mr. Impasto was in the bar greeted us and offered us a drink while talking about Italy with the wife.
Love the huge variety of the menu. Huge menu of boba and I like that we can buy snacks on the other side of the restaurant. Would definitely recommend to a friend.

When you want beignets but don't want to wait in a long line this is the place to go! Beautiful atmosphere, set in the middle of the park among the big beautiful trees. Couldn't ask for anything better. They're open 24 hrs and also have other foods as well. I highly recommend this place!!

I lived in Mexico city for several years. This is not Mexican food.

- food was bland
- no children's menu
- tomatoe sauce was watery...and made my burrito mushy.
- where are the beans?
- burrito had very little meat in it - mostly rice - came with nothing else on the plate; swimming in a red watery liquid 
- expensive for what you get
- automatically brings up an 18% tip as the norm! Don't tell me what to tip! 
- food was bland (oh I said that already? well it was really bland) 
- sign at the front door told me to respect the nearby tables??!! I wasn't planning on going in and turning on loud music. Is this kindergarten? 
- ambiance? none

Won't be going back to a place where I'm told how to behave, how much to tip and served underwhelming food.

Having tried both places, Geno's is definitely much better than Pat's. 

Compared to what else the city has to offer however, Geno's just doesn't cut it.
Met some friends here for chess today. The baristas were pleasant, the coffee and pastries were tasty, and there was plenty of space to play a few games. Great location. Will return.

Good stop location 
Many restaurants inside the welcome center
Easy parking in and out ! 
Very easy get back to the highway !

I had high hopes for this one but I was very disappointed.  Had a seasonal blueberry/lemonade and keylime pie donuts and a coffee.  I don't mind paying stupid high prices sometimes for a special donut.  I expected a slight crunch on outside of donut and a light cake interior-- I got neither.   And the flavors were great ideas but the flavor did not meet expectations -- in summary, too much $$ for substandard donut

Sat down and enjoyed my delivery until I reached in my bag for dessert ( 2 pieces of Baklava) and realized it was just pita bread!  Common! You can't leave the dessert!  And no answer when I called back....oh well, I guess I might try them again.  I loved the taste....they just jacked up my night...my wife really wanted dessert ;-(

This place is excellent if you want something fast and the value of the food is superb. The cashier and the vendors are always so friendly. Love coming here you can get your grocery done and eat a good meal. Although I do have to complaint about the parking. super hard to find parking on Saturday and Sunday.

Great food and service! My family liked everything we ordered. Super cute inside. Came on a Sunday and there was a bit of a wait so plan accordingly if it is a weekend! The biscuits and bacon were especially good!

We usually go there at least once every two weeks for a team lunch. The lunch pizza and salad bar is good. We like that they ask us what we want for the pizza bar and they spin something up for us and others within 10-15 minutes. Great customer service and the price is about right for what they offer.

I am impressed.  

I think I ate at one of these someplace some time ago.  I'm thinking it was an airport, but who knows.  It obviously didn't make much of an impression.  I couldn't even remember what kind of food they served.   When one popped up on Veterans advertising gourmet sandwiches, my interest was peaked.  A little po-boy competition will benefit us all.

I walked in after watching the Saints win in overtime.  No exaggeration, there were no other customers in the restaurant and  at least 9 people behind the counter waiting for an order.  I was under a little pressure to speed read the menu board and place an order. I finally settled on the number 11, the Country Club.  While I was paying for the order, the Jimmy John's machine apparently kicked into action.  I truly don't know how this happened, but the cashier handed me my sandwich with my change.  Maybe they have a pile of #11's in the back? Maybe I was having a couple of mini-strokes?

My head spinning, I wandered over to a table to eat my sandwich and figure out what just happened.  I noticed a couple of "Freaky Fast" T-shirts that helped cleared things up.  Apparently, speed is a big part of the Jimmy John offering.  

Good sandwich, very good bread that isn't French.  I would have liked some pepper spread, but not a deal breaker.  Sandwich and drink was about $7.50.  Good deal, I'll be back.

Ever since starting a job in the area, I've been looking for a place that serves  "San Francisco" style burritos.  These are the closest I've found, with all food prepared fresh on the premises. Nothing fancy here, just basic burrito counter service with choice of meat, rice and toppings

When it comes to BBQ, Carver's does it pretty well. In fact, they have a set amount they produce each day. So if you stop by after the lunch rush, you might miss out. The Pork Ka-bob is absolutely delicious and won't cost you an arm and a leg. The selection of sauces is minimal, but still a good place for a quick bite.

I think this girl worked there, hard to tell. She took our order but never brought it. What added insult to injury is she stood at a table close by socializing with her friends all night instead of working. I started to feel bad for the owner who is paying this person to "work'. That owner paid her hourly rate as well as what I could see her drinks and who knows maybe her friends too. I have never experienced worse service in my life! I am actually embarrased for the owner!

Always the best bread here obviously by the name but it really is good stuff. If you go anywhere near lunchtime expect a little bit of a wait but nobody wants to eat at an empty restaurant right?  While you're waiting in line you can sample all the different breads it is the best
I love Omoni!! Quick curbside delivery of delicious food. I can't wait until I'm comfortable dining in so I can eat the dolsot bibimbap.

Inflated prices 

Food was like bad Italian home cooking 

Have had many better Italian restaurants

My husband and I have come here a few times and have really enjoyed the food and service at each visit.  

Our favorite appetizer is the garlic shrimp. Be sure you save some of the complimentary bread that is delivered soon after you sit down to sop up the savory sauce these shrimp are served in!

Latin tapas restaurant located in the beautiful and eclectic Garden District. This cute little spot is spacious enough inside to accommodate a small crowd as well as outdoor seating for those who prefer to catch a few rays. 

Being a tapas restaurant the portions are small however; the dishes pack a mean flavor punch! Tapas is just never enough food for me so I go with the intentions of snacking not complete satiety.

I started with the succulent Crab Cake accompanied by a delicious Beet Salad...I wanted a second order it was so divine. I decided to try the Salmon Ceviche served with addictive crisply tortilla chips. I enjoyed the magnificent food and friendly service. 

~Christy

Great food, no matter what you get. I'm completely addicted to their fruit tea! This time I got chicken fried chicken and it was amazing! Last time I got the Mac n Cheese with pulled pork--which was also great! And the wait staff is preeeeeeetty fantastic. Chris was talkative & funny & helpful! Definitely added to our great experience.
Great tasting food. Best tasting yucca I ever had and the freshness of the food is amazing.

A nice atmosphere. It was a lovely day out and we had a relaxing time eating salad and pizza while enjoying a beer on the front patio.  HOWEVER- we had the pizza packaged and brought it home for our boys.  While eating, one of my boys bit into a TACK.  A green push pin tack.  Upon discovery, they took a picture of the tack and threw the pizza out.  I called the restaurant the following morning, concerned as to why a tack would be inside the pizza.  Also, as a way to let them know for future prevention and quality improvement.  I didn't expect anything in return.  The manager was nice and apologetic.  She took my name and number and asked me to text a picture of the tack, which I did.  She said the owners would like to know about this asap and someone would be in touch with me.  She also offered a credit on a future dinner.  I said that was not needed, but then realized I did spend $66 there and our pizza was thrown out, so that would be nice reimbursement.  
I have given the management and owners 3 weeks to respond.  NOTHING.  I guess they don't care enough to follow up as they said they did.  So that's my review.  Food was good until the tack was discovered.  Luckily my son bit into the plastic edge and not the sharp edge.  And since management/owners never reached out beyond my initial call to question or work on improvement - Beware what you bit into.

Yum
Nom nom nom nom 
Yup!
Shhhh
Don't tell anyone
Skip the pharmacy and the taco joint for this usda prime beef extravaganza of flavor
Oh
Did I mention biscuits too? 
#heaven

I have grown up eating Cocco's.   I recently moved to Ridley and am now ordering from Folsom.  I LOVE their food, and it is always fresh, but every single time I order delivery they get it wrong!!! It's little things, but it is every single time! Last night I ordered a grilled buffalo chicken sandwich on a long roll that I wanted to split with someone.  I got it delivered, and they put it on a kaiser roll (I made sure to specifically ask for a long roll!)  So my friend and I had to split a mini-sandwich! I also asked for blue cheese on the side. They gave me ranch!!!  Last week I ordered a buffalo chicken cheese steak.  When i got it delivered, it was just a regular cheese steak.  I asked for Blue cheese on the side. I got no side!!  Two weeks ago I ordered a pizza with ranch on the side, and a side of boneless buffalo bites.  I got a pizza with no side, and regular wings. 

Hopefully these are flukes because I LOVE LOVE their food. Can't say a  bad word about anything I've eaten, but just really wish I could get what I ordered!!!!

Tried it twice since being a resident of Belle Chasse. Twice I was very under impressed. The first time we got a few lbs of boiled crawfish. We got em home and tore into them. Way salty...the second time I went all out and got a combo platter with potato salad and a side of crab stuffed jalapeno poppers. First off, the shrimp were tiny as hell, like popcorn shrimp. The Oysters tasted like they've been sitting under the heat lamp for about an hour and Not fresh at all. The fried fish was decent and my potato salad ended up being a house salad wjen I got home so they give about as mich attention to putting a plate together as McDonalds. The jalapeno poppers tasted weird, not like they were going bad but just not like crab so I dunno. I am willing to give them another try since people swear by them but thus far I have absolutely no idea whatbthe big hoo haa is. They do manage to stay packed with a line out the door so something in there must be awefully good. I haven't found it.

nice spot off of Rittenhouse Square. Big bar serving up Craft Cocktails on the first floor with a dining room on the second floor.
We went on a Thursday night and the place was packed. Super loud in there too, hopefully they install some sounds panels soon.
Food was delish-- we started out with the Scallop Crudo, followed by the Chicken Liver Mousse and the Mussel toast. Best dish of the night by far was the Corn Agnolotti. We finished it off with the New York Strip, cooked to perfection, paired with some smoked mashed potatoes.

The cocktails my wife and i had were so-so. A little too much going on, with flavors fighting eachother. I thought the Wine List was very extensive, for its size, portraying some good Italian and French wines, while also throwing in some under-dog wines from Greece.

For dessert, we had the Labneh Panna Cotta, which was creamy and delicious, with a layer of Strawberry jam-like topping. Delicious!

Service was good-- Our server wasn't super personable, but was very attentive. The staff is a little plate-removal happy, almost taking our food before we were finished on a couple occasions.

All in all, i would recommend Friday Saturday Sunday if you're looking for some New American fare. I'd say great for a group of people, as you'll easily find something for everyone to eat.

I want this place to be good. In fact, the food is good. The atmosphere is good. The service is beyond awful. We had a fairly large party, so if you're going to go here with a few friends or with your significant other, it's probably fine. But I've never seen such unorganized service. They accommodated our party by comping five burgers that took 45 minutes to come out after everyone's food, but even that didn't make up for the ineptitude. They are clearly understaffed and from I found out last night, there's no immediate attention being paid to making sure that's fixed. 

As I said, if you're on a date, or with maybe five friends, you're probably going to be okay. Maybe drink beforehand because they don't even acknowledge you at the lanes. On second thought, maybe go somewhere else.

The food is delicious but.......... first impressions make a big difference. The fellow that usually greets and seats the customers REALLY needs to be trained on how to seat his customers. Number one, he is a large young man. He leads you to your seat and then, rather than stand back (maybe past the seat) so you can actually get into the booth, or sit down in your chair, he proceeds to immediately walk back right ON you almost knocking you down to return to his post out in the lobby. Happened to me and I watched him consistently do this on July 2, 2019, over and over as he seated at least 6 or 7  groups as we ate.
Please instruct him on how to safely and politely seat his customers. I watched many startled faces as this occurred over and over.
As said, we love the food, but if this happens again, I may not be as polite to him as I have been in the past, as he has done this many times in our past visits over the years he has been there. I finally decided enough was enough.
Please fix this. Should be SO easy.
Love the food!

This is the best restaurant for food and drinks in the area. I've never had a dish that wasn't delicious! The wait staff and bartenders are efficient and friendly! I love their drinks and drink menu. Good happy hour deals! Sitting on the deck out on the water is always pleasant! This is always our favorite restaurant when we visit the area!

Great restaurant, went for lunch with two other, its well worth the stop
and highly recommended.
If I lived in SB I would be there often, wonderful
Great Decor and location not bad prices omelette was not too good so I would try something else French press coffee was amazing
Went a few weeks ago looking for a quick bite. I was blown away by the service and quality of food. Me and my wife both loved it can't wait to go back.
Stopped in for a bite to eat. Super friendly staff, great location, selection of beer, and the Big Ass Tacos are excellent....I recommend the Alabama White they were delicious!

So great that we have a neighborhood burger place in Northeast Edmonton. The staff is super friendly and accommodating. There are 2 high chairs (with littles this is a struggle because a lot of places only have one!). Fountain pop which is a win (although no ice. They claim their drinks are "pre chilled"). Burgers are tasty. My husband really likes their chicken sandwiches. Kids meal is generous for a very reasonable price. Portion sizes are great. This is a definite win for us!
This place is absolutely amazing. Food and service was impeccable. Shout out to Lavern, she was the best!!!! Catfish and charbroiled oysters a must :-)

I was introduced to this restaurant about two years ago when my fiance took me there.  I loved it. Even though through those two years I've been to many other japanese restaurants, I can still say that Yokohama is my favorite. 

The staff is friendly and the atmosphere is great for anything from just you and your S.O. to a group of friends. Quiet and laid back. It's BYOB so you can bring your favorite wine or sake along (coincidentally, there's a wine and spirits store right across from the restaurant).

There are two sides, a normal sit down side and a hibachi side (which I admit I've never been on but I've had their teriyaki beef and it is delicious) as well as a sushi bar. I've never gotten something from Yokohama that I don't love. From sushi to bentos to udon, miso, teriyaki and tempura, it's all good and most importantly reasonably priced. I haven't found ANY japanese restaurant that offers the quality of food that Yokohama does for the prices.  

Please take the time to check out this local restaurant and support it!

Lunch specials are a great price. Green curry chicken is delicious. Not overpriced Thai food!!

I am updating this review. Chang Mai is awesome.! Great value great price great food great service!!!!

A delightful experience that mixes burrito bar customizations with a fun pizzeria! Taylor was extremely welcoming upon our arrival. The environment is spacious and clean with a very hip vibe. I got one of the recommended pizzas but customized it to my liking and it was fantastic! I will definitely be back in the future!

Not good at all. Was craving pizza and this shop was right outside my house so why not give it a try.

Bad decision and we ordered so much food too. 2 pies, 24 wings, fried mushrooms, calamari, and waffle fries. The wings were cold; calamari and waffle fries were hard and stale; the Margarita pizza had sliced tomatoes and old basil on it.. the only "okay" food was the Italiano pizza and fried mushroom. Not worth the money or time.

The Red Shack is absolutely delicious!! Everything is made to order and always fresh! The menu is always changing and has just about anything you could think of in a taco or burrito. Very friendly staff and great atmosphere. The only thing, if your head is hungrier than your stomach, you will spend a lot more money than you would necessarily prefer. But at the same time, it is totally worth it!! 5 Star!

This is the best IHOP around.  This place is always packed, yet the service is always quick and friendly.  I get the International Passport Crepe breakfast every time and it is consistent and delicious.  Had breakfasst here yestrday and Jaime is the best server we've had here.

Definitely wayyyy better than the location on Speedway. There was no wait time (there's always a wait at Speedway), and it took literally half the time for them to cook our stuffed pizza. Food was delicious and fresh, I will definitely be back!
Our chicken parmesan was wonderful and large enough to share.  The Tiramisu was one of the best we've ever had!  Our waitress was friendly and attentive.  Great experience on a Saturday evening.
Very courteous.  Food that's on the healthier side.  Let you know the calorie counts of most things.  Great especially after a workout.

Today I went to Tampa to try out The Latin Twist. Wow I was impressed to food was very good I had breaded chicken with yellow rice red beans and plantains . Service was with a smile. People were very friendly. I will return with family or friends. And the prices are good too. It's a must see and eat place. Thank you Latin twist Team for your good food and great workers that treat you like a family.

Came in for my birthday rewards dinner. Service was fabulous with Kalie. She was very attentive, helpful and accommodating. 

Food was amazing. Thank you Sullivan's for such a nice program and staff.
Yummmmmmm!!! This place is soooo good!! The pesto chicken sandwich and fries with the house sauce is amazing! Thanks!!

if i could leave 0 stars i would. i came on a sunday with a small group of friends to a basically empty restaurant. it took our server 20 min to even come over to us. & that was just beginning. she disappeared for at least 20 mins in between each trip to the table. service was so slow and there were about 4 other tables here. no one apologized for the wait. i ordered a to go when we got our tickets. an appetizer. & it took close to 40 mins to come out. 40 MINS FOR A TO GO APP. that is just bad service. don't go here if you're in a rush. actually don't go here at all.

Won't recommend it to anyone.

I ordered Veg Parm along Pumpkin Beet soup. Food was stale as I know how fresh vegan food taste like.
In addition, portion size was a joke.

And service was really pathetic. I asked a waitress to get me paper napkins and spoon. She asked me to pick them myself from the counter. And look how shrewd these guys are. They will ask you choose tip while ordering the food so that tip couldn't get affected as result of their pathetic service.
It's Ruby's! It's a chain but they have a nice salad bar and a really good turkey burger. Very friendly staff. If you've been to one..... Well you get it.

We went on a slow day thankfully. Didn't have to wait too long. We were seated inside right next to another table. Barely a foot between tables. So much for covid precautions I guess. I ordered the Gaufre Chicken Cordon Bleu. The flavor of everything was really good. The ham in it was hard. Like really hard. I was having difficulty cutting abs chewing it. Ultimately I ended up taking it off so I could eat in peace. Unfortunately the cheese was stuck to the hard peace of ham. I tried getting it off but was unsuccessful. So I ended up removing the ham and the cheese from the dish. Do opt for outdoor seating if you're at all worried about distancing. The ham being that hard was disgraceful

The first time I had gumbo was in Chicago when I was like 12. I hated the taste of it and haven't had gumbo since. 12 years later, I decided to open up myself to try it again in New Orleans. Our tour guide said that gumbo shop has the best gumbo within the French quarter so we decided to stop by. 

We got the gumbo dinner. The waiter of course said it's not enough for two. But it's a lot of food! We got a full size seafood creole, a cup of gumbo, and a chocolate cake sundae. We couldn't even finish all that.

They're all really good, but I can't say I can eat that every day as these southern food is very heavy.

A friend of mine took me here for brunch the first time I came to visit Philly and it was such a good place! The atmosphere had a great vibe and the decor is pretty awesome. It's such a hidden gem. Our service was a bit hectic since we had a couple of people waiting on our table but the gentleman who looked like a manager seem to fix everything accordingly . I def would go back , and I would recommend this place to others.

I have been to this location 2 previous times with no issues. Today I ordered smoothies for my wife and kids and my wife's smoothie had a large hairball in her smoothie. I immediately called and they refunded my money but that is unacceptable!
This is our favorite Sushi place.  Great service.  Very welcoming.  We have tried a lot of sushi places in the Reno Sparks area and they are almost all really good but this is by far our favorite.

Came here with a 2 for 1 coupon from the NOLA visitors bureau magazine. Ate late lunch on the 2nd floor. Hubby had the Weiss 
in-house brew which was very good but pricey for $7.50. He had the shrimp and grits and I had the seared duck. Both were pretty good. Duck was very tasty but a bit on the dry side. Still very good. The grits were good enough to be sopped up with the bread. Brian our server was the best. Personable, kept checking on us.  Sitting overlooking the street made for a relaxing meal. Go for lunch, same menu but cheaper. With the coupon, it was a great deal. Tourists, don't ignore those coupons in the back of the visitors bureau book!

It's a small hole in the wall in the midst of a lot of nice restaurants, with close proximity to the river. Parked down the street in a residential neighborhood for free parking. I got a mango strawberry bubble tea with green apple popping boba. Also, papa con chorizo taco and skirt steak. Total came out to about $11 ($3 per taco and $4 for large boba tea). Tacos and boba is a really interesting combination. The tea (smoothie) was fresh and very tasty. Tacos as well--very interesting taste. Superb and well worth it. Definitely a must try up in Indianapolis!

My friend and I checked out this place on st. Patrick's day in hopes it wouldn't be too busy and it wasn't! The food was very good and fresh and the drinks were great. Our waiter was very kind, fast, and efficient although he had several tables! We would definitely go back!

I've never met a crew so helpful and nice. The service is amazing and the food is worth every penny. They have something for almost everyone. Having celiac disease iy s difficult to find anywhere to eat. They asked me questions and made sure I didn't leave unsatisfied! Also the owner has a bad ass truck!
Good food but the prices on the menu are wrong and they cover their azz's by having a barely visible "prices are subject to change" message. Its just not right.

Stopped in for a quick lunch in-between rounds of golf, and wanted my playing partners to experience a spot with unique food.

As it turns out, we all ordered the same dish (albeit with different sides)...jerk chicken.  The meal came with with sides, I choice the fried plantains and rice & beans.

The food took a while to come out (even though the place was unfortunately mostly empty)...but had a nice presentation on the plate.  There were three pieces of cut-up chicken alongside my two sides.  The jerk chicken was spicy but moist and tasty. The fried plantains could have been a bit more caramelized but had a good, sweet flavor. The dirty rice and beans were mildly spiced and complimented the chicken well.

Server was very friendly but a bit absent during the meal.  Would definitely return if in the area.

We got food from here for takeout, and had some great dishes, and some that were so-so. The nachos, short rib tacos, and cauliflower were fantastic! The guacomole, tofu tacos, and eggplant enchiladas could use some work. It would be worth trying again.

This mom and pop restaurant does not disappoint! The food is extremely fresh, and sooo tasty. I had the falafel plate and my fiance had the chicken kebob plate. They both came with tabouli and a choice of babaganuj or hummus. It was a lot of food! We were both stuffed but made sure to save room for a piece of pistachio baklava, we did not regret it. The service and meal were both outstanding. Lots of fresh garlic and herbs.
LOVE this place. Yummy & authentic! The Pad Thai is delicious. Great for big groups as well. You can order you food as spicy as you like.
New find! The breads are all amazing!! We got a free sample right when we walked in. Will be coming back soon. Taking some to go!!

Karla's is very quaint and homey, and has a nice cozy feel to it. My friend and I were able to snag a table on a Saturday for lunch, no wait. We started with the poutine fries which were SO good- the short rib gravy really elevated the dish. My friend ordered the shrimp tacos and I opted for the Caesar salad. While Caesar salads can be hit or miss, this one was definitely a hit: it had freshly grated cheese, crispy croutons and the perfect amount of creamy dressing. I would definitely come back to Karla's again during my next visit to New Hope!

I was excited to try this place out. I even bookmarked this place before coming here for vacation, but upon getting there they said they only allowed 10 people seating. We had 12 people, about half were kids. We even offered to be split up. We were all hungry and tired. It was very disappointing.
Incredible sushi that tastes super fresh. Crab Rangoon was on point and every roll we tried hit the spot. Definitely worth a visit.

This place is great, came for lunch one day, returned for dinner and lunch again following day, couldn't get enough! Very reasonably priced, friendly service and delicious. 
Menu is customer friendly and a cozy little outdoor area along with nice indoor seating.
Highly reccomended.

Food came fast but even still was all cold except the white rice. Bland won ton soup. Tasted like noodle water and no crispy won ton strips to go with it. Rangoon also bland and barely any filling. Hard to find any chicken in the cashew chicken. And worst yet, no free egg roll with $15 order as promised. Will never order from here again.

This place really needs some help. I used to be a frequent customer and have been so turned off that I refuse to go now. It takes them half an hour to make a breakfast sandwich! I used to get mine there several times a week, and despite how tasty it is, I just cannot continue to patronize a place that is clearly so disorganized. I can't understand how it takes them this long to process their food orders with so many people working there. Also, some of the staff are really lovely, but some don't have good customer service skills. The staff will bicker with each other in front of customers without a second thought. It's really off putting! Bill needs to get this place together!
We had the Shrimp & Grits followed by the Chicken and Crawfish. It was excellent!

Hodaks was great.  We ordered fried mushrooms as an appetizer, which were excellent, and the quantity you get for the price was quite impressive. The service was very quick and friendly. I ordered their famous fried chicken as the meal, with mac and cheese and mashed potatoes and gravy as the sides. The chicken was very, very good, but I would say that it was not quite the best I've ever had. Don't get me wrong, it was darn good. The mashed potatoes and gravy were simple, nothing special; good but nothing extraordinary. The mac and cheese was pretty bland however. Quite overlooked, soggy noodles, not very much flavor to the cheese sauce. Overall, I would certainly go back, as the prices and service were excellent, as was the chicken and the mushrooms. I would love to see them spend a little bit of time mastering their craft in the side dishes to make an overall knockout experience.

Since moving to the area I've been looking for good Chinese food. I was about ready to give up but thought I'd try one more time. I decided to try China 1. After several bad Chinese dinners in the area, I didn't have high hopes. I'm happy to say that I was surprised and delighted! 
We had egg rolls, fried dumplings, General Tso's Shrimp, Happy family, Shrimp fried rice, and pork fried rice.
The fried rice was exceptional. Rich in flavors, large pieces of meat, savory and crispy.
The General Tso's shrimp was delicious! The Shrimp were enormous! 
The egg rolls were nothing special, but no complaints.
The portions were generous, the food was delicious, and everything was delivered in a timely manner. I would highly recommend China 1!

Fishers' Nickel Plate District is constantly evolving, and a local brewery/gastropub was just what the doctor ordered for this neck of the woods. It's clear the community is receptive to its presence, because when I went on a Friday night, it was PACKED. On a weekend, a 1-2 hour wait is the norm, so be prepared! Bummed they don't take reservations.

I don't drink beer, but I enjoyed the food. The pretzel sticks with beer cheese appetizer was good, and I liked my taco of the day entree - this day was pulled pork, served with fresh chips, guac and salsa. A perfect amount of food! The soft taco shells were incredible.

I drool over the FDR Instagram, so I knew I couldn't skip dessert - so the skillet cookie it was. The flavor of a chocolate chip cookie baked in a cast iron skillet is SO good, and it was topped with ice cream and fudge - sinfully delicious. It was a bit rich, so next time, I'll find someone to split it with me. 

Our group enjoyed our night at Four Day Ray, but there were a number of misses that I hope are fixed next time. This was during Devour Indy, so maybe this was an off night.

*The wait was long, like we knew it could be. One of our friends got there at 5:30 to put our names in, and we weren't seated until about 6:50 - even though they said our table would be ready at 6:30.
*The entrance and brewery side were heavily congested with folks waiting - to the point where it made me a bit claustrophobic and I was wondering what the capacity is...
*For our party of 11, they put together two round tables that formed an edge, so it was a bit awkward - a long rectangular table would've been better.
*The waitress was super sweet and explained the FDR concept to us, as it was our first visit - but she missed me when taking drink orders (maybe due to the aforementioned odd table arrangement) and I had to flag her down to come take my dinner order.
*Getting drinks, apps, dessert, etc. was slow. We were there until 9:30, but it was leisurely and no one was starving for food.
*Our waitress admitted the kitchen's timing was off and profusely apologized. Some people finished their appetizers before others apps were even delivered. Pretzel sticks and desserts were forgotten. The waitress seemed flustered. 
*The space is LOUD. Be warned.

Despite the disappointments, I'm holding out hope that Four Day Ray can learn to handle the large crowds (perhaps allowing reservations would help?). We really did enjoy our experience and the food and plan to come again, with hope that the next visit will be more smooth.

The good very much outweighs the bad here.  First and most importantly, our waiter and, moreover, the manager were incredibly accommodating and professional dealing with a number of serious food allergies and dietary restrictions of members of our party.  Second, the vegetarian lettuce wraps rock! ... always a good choice.  My only complaint is that I was very disappointingly surprised that my order of sczechewan seafood lacked not only the spice one comes to expect from Sichewan-style cuisine, but, moreover had no veggies at all ... not one! ... making me miss out not only one the texural variations I expect when eating wok-prepared cuisine, but not allowing the seafood to benefit from the flavors the veggies add.  A walk around the restaurant suggested that this is a common theme in a number of their dishes.

I have been eating at this restaurant for years and it has always been a consistently good experience with food and service. It's at a very nice location on beach drive, they have metered street parking as well as valet parking ($6 validated) so it's not a problem to get to. They have indoor and outdoor seating, I like to sit outside because you have a cute view of the park and ocean, or if it's night time, pretty lights and the hustle and bustle. 

The food here is always on point. I usually order seafood. I recommend the king crab legs, tuna steak and my new favorite, cobia. You don't see Cobia a lot so I wasn't really sure what to expect so I decided to try it today and it was amazing. I can compare it to a mix between swordfish and mahi mahi. Everything is so tasty, whether it's brunch, lunch or dinner. The Mac and cheese is one of the best I've ever had, it's so flavorful and you can tell it's made with real cheese. They have great brunch options here also. The service is always great, very attentive and friendly, what you would expect for this restaurant level. 

All in all, you can't go wrong with this restaurant for any meal of the day, or even just for drinks. it is great for couples, friends, families. Highly recommend this place to everyone.

Thai Prime was delicious! We had previous tried the sushi during their 2-roll for $15.00 happy hour. After that experience we agreed to try it again. This visit was exceptional. We again had two sushi rolls (spicy tuna and the Mexican roll). The tuna was fresh and delicious. We did not love the Mexican roll, but this was more a matter of personal taste. For our main dishes we ordered the Pad see ew and the pad ke mao. They were both incredible. We both preferred the ke mao for its fresh and sweet flavors. We ordered the ke mao with chicken and shrimp and the shrimp was so fresh! In terms of the spiciness, the medium was not very spicy, so we will both order hot in the future. You can always ask for the spice-tray which has an array of four different spicy additives. We will definitely plan to go back for a moderately priced and delicious meal.
My go to philadelphia kosher food place. Always a pleasure always friendly and always hits the spot.

This place is great for lunch. The line can get pretty long, but it usually moves pretty quickly. They have a bunch of lunch specials, but my favorite thing about LaScala's lunch options is that they sell pizza by the slice, allowing you to try multiple flavors. I tried the Veggie and the White Spinach and both were delicious! I can't wait to try more flavors in the future.
Best value there is, love sweet tomatoes, fresh, healthy and great soups. Senior discount too! I go once or twice a week!

Decided to stop by and give them a try because I have been into donuts lately. I got the cream doughnut, vanilla icing doughnut with some cinnamon swirl?, and plain glazed. I thought they were just okay, nothing amazing to warrant a special visit but they're not horrible (you really can't go wrong with sweets!) I'd probably say I prefer the cream donuts at McMillian's in Haddonfield. Another thing to note, you have to eat the donuts in the first day or else they get hard, so they don't last very long.

This place is easy to miss. Been here a handful of times the past 5 years since it was revealed to me by a friend. Food is always great! It's super sketchy and the workers look rough lmao but the food is bomb. I usually call in my order, because if not, I'll be waiting for about 10 to 15 minutes. Only time I ever ate there was my very 1st time, there's only about 4 tables there. I like that it's in the back of a liquor store... call on your order, pick up, and buy some drinks/snacks on your way out! They also have delivery, not sure what's the protocol on that though.

The filet is awesome, so tender you can't believe it's steak. And Tasha is probably the best bartender in town. 

Sitting at the bar, drinking a new-fashioned and eating a Bison filet is as good as it gets.

Chicken special is way to expensive cost $16 for 3 pieces, very small portion of collards green like 2ozs and a small scoop of mashed potatoes. Fried chicken was over breaded and dry, collards ok not great for the cost and mashed potatoes was lacking in favor (just plain potatoes not smooth). Wasn't a good meal at all. People next to us had a po boy and chips. It looked much better then what we got.

Tried to find your food truck in Clarksville today. Went to the location posted on your website. Waiting an hour and a half and your still a no show. Update: added social media snapshot after owner reply

For a girl and her boyfriend who were eating nothing but cruciferous veggies, apples and pears for three days straight, the prospect of avocado and cucumber rolls made with brown rice was about as exciting as a steak-lover eating gratis at Barclay Prime. 

While we loved that we were eating something new after three days of darkness, the rolls were just okay. The rice wasn't as sticky as I've come to expect from sushi rice. Pieces were on the small side, though each roll came with 12 (priced accordingly). 

Service was lackluster. I immediately received a water when I arrived but we had to ask for one for my boyfriend. Also, we sat around for a while before our order was taken, even though we were the only people there at that point. 

We chose Mizu because of the seating and option of brown rice, but I'll stick with one of my other spots for sushi in Rittenhouse now that my crazy detox diet is over!

This used to be my favorite restaurant in Ballwin. they changed the menu and now it's basically a taco bar instead of a Mexican restuarant. Food is still good drinks are good but now it seems overpriced for what it is.

We ordered take out at Red Pavilion yesterday.  When we called they said it would be a 45 minute wait.  We showed up 50 minutes from the time we called thinking that was plenty of time.  Little did we know what we were walking into.  When entering the restaurant it was already extremely crowded with 2 different people yelling at the staff and storming out without their food.  Without thinking too much about that, we let them know we were there to pick up our food and they said it would be a few more minutes.  20 minutes goes by nothing, 20 more minutes goes by and nothing, another 20 minutes goes by and we say something, they respond with "your order is being boxed now".  How convenient.  Another 10 minutes go by, with a total of waiting in the restaurant for our take out food that was supposed to take 45 minutes, was an hour and 10 minutes so 2 hours total from the time we ordered.  They also so kindly put all the chow rice in one box for 4 people to share, pretty sure we didn't get all our rice.  They did not offer to comp any meals or apologize for it taking so long!  In fact, when we complained about how long we waited and we said we are not sure if we want to the food anymore, they took it out of the bag and took it back to the kitchen.  Didn't care at all! I should have stormed out with those people from the beginning.  I will never eat at Red Pavilion again as they don't care about customer service or communication.

Decent bar and restaurant... However our server NYE helped really put a damper on our night. He was awkward at times but mostly nice. Spilled my drink a bit as delivered and just left the spill there the whole night. I was then brought the wrong meal without the substitution I asked for and with additional protein I didn't request, he offered to fix it and I politely agreed to just eat it anyway. I was then charged the full price for the additional shrimp I didn't ask for around an extra 5$ so I gave an average tip for average service (I am in the industry for 16 years you don't get 20% for avg to below service especially if I pay extra for something I didn't want). 

The kicker though and the only reason im writing this review is he passed us on the street later right before midnight on New years and had the balls to sarcastically and rudely say "thanks for the tip before" & make some gestures at me. Sorry I only paid you 10$ of my hard earned money for your subpar service and the extra 5$ for the unwanted protein (your mistake) cost you your 20%. He is lucky I didn't punch him in his face but really pissed me off and put a big damper on the end of my NYE night.
