We walked in to this location and all seemed ok. Overheard a customer ask for metal utensils and was told they were all dirty. Hmmm we went ahead and ordered our lunch got our drinks and went to find a table. However quite literally entire half the dining room had tables filled with uncleared plates tables that hadn't been cleared from the earlier rush it appears. 20 minutes later our sandwiches arrived. The pre cooked bacon appeared raw. The honey mustard that should be on the sandwich was barely visible let alone taste able. It's noted that the chips aren't stocked for guests to know what to pick from, the workers did not attempt to clear tables once the 4 guests sat down and there was nothing left to do for workers.  Short handed may be an understatement. The woman that helped us muttered under her breath that "she should have clocked back in if she was still working." Not the best experience. We won't be back to this location.
Never had a bad experience! My boyfriend and I are regulars (once a week) and the service is amazing (if you don't get a newby) great food and good price

The burritos are wonderful the portions I love the service is great friendly service where they still- - one of the few places where they still seem to care about customer service especially in the burrito industry because many places you go the service is horrible while the food is great but El Fuego Nails them both love going there one of my favorite locations in town and very cheap and affordable

Ordered here during COVID, but I hear that it's typically an all-you-can-eat sushi restaurant. To be honest, I never order from all-you-can-eat restaurants in general, because I find the quality to be subpar. This was the case here. One of the rolls tasted kind of fishy and the others didn't seem to have the quality that I'm used to. The order was packaged on time and pick up was easy at the door. I would order from here again but it was not terrible.

When I am traveling I like finding neighborhood coffee shops.  Add this one to your list.  Great coffee and home made muffins and scones.  The scones tend to sell out fast and they are really good.  Read the other 4/5 star reviews like I did and you will make a point of stopping in.  This is on my list to re visit.

The food at Bouchon is exceptional! My boyfriend and I were so lucky to have made a reservation ahead of time, because when we arrived they had to turn people away since they were booked the whole evening. The service was great - Abe was an awesome waiter. He told us a little bit about the restaurant since it was our first time dining there and was very knowledgeable about wine pairings for our meals. We both started with the squash puree. It had crispy kale and pomegranate seeds on top - no other squash puree will taste the same. My boyfriend had the pork shank (literally fell off the bone) and I had the yellowfin tuna (perfectly seared). The restaurant is intimate, elegant, and great for dates. They don't have many large tables, so if you plan on going as a group, definitely get a reservation ahead of time. They do have a really nice private dining room adjacent to the main dining room. It was a great experience and we will definitely be going back next time we are in Santa Barbara!
Very good. The sushi chef we had was amazing to watch and very quick and efficient. Wonderful experience, will very much go again.

This place is a Ten!  Wonderful southern food with great service.  Neat little compound of shops too. Chicken fried steak was best ever.  Biscuits were incredible. Not to mention the decadent all handmade desert menu.  Fudge pie?  Only in the south. Do not miss this place!  A bit of a drive from Nashville but so worth it.

Unique fast casual counter serve spot serving up a variety of Taiwanese grub for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. They're situated among a strip of storefronts in the base of a larger building on JFK. Look for the chalkboard sign out front. Once inside you can expect a fast casual vibe with nondescript booths, yellow walls, and a few tablets to place your order. 

The open kitchen confirms the majority of their menu is made in house. We went with a variety pack of bao buns, chicken wonton soup, Taiwanese fried chicken paired with slaw, and potstickers. We were most impressed by the soft, pillowy bao buns. Specifically, the heritage pork belly buns which are packed with tender meat, tangy picked radishes, creamy aioli, and slightly sweet crushed peanuts. The fried chicken was perfectly crunchy, but the chicken was a little bit salty in my opinion.

The location and atmosphere suggest the majority of their business comes via to-go orders. I'd certainly return for a midweek order of bao buns or one of the menu items we didn't order. Recommended for a quick, casual meal or creative to-go option.

Just got our order delivered through Door Dash and both orders were 100% wrong. One was a veggie bowl that arrived with zero veggies in it (they lIterally only threw the requested toppings into the bowl without any veggies at all), and the other was a sofritas bowl that was made  with pork instead. I can't even imagine the level of incompetence required to make so many egregious errors in a single order.
Best taqueria in town. I'm from Los Angeles so you can trust my judgement. Fajitas mixtos is delicious. Good prices. Friendly staff

Glad to have my Yelp app going when in yet another new part of town.  First fall like evening here in Florida, early November, with a dark rainy night had us craving Fish and Chips at a Pub - reminding us of a night in London a few years back... Found this cute hipster vibe pub with an excellent list of beers including bottled beers from around the world  - going back to my years in the Caribbean - I was happy to feel at home with Kalik.  As we were both in a mood for pub fare we both had the fish and chips made with Alaskan Pollock and home fries with home made ketchup and malt vinegar on the side.   We enjoyed our rainy Florida night and had a relaxing time in a cute Tampa Pub - happy to find this place through other Yelp buddies!! Definitely coming back!

Perhaps the cleanest diner I've ever been in, I was caught off guard when I ate here the other day. I came here right after a football game-my cleats still on and my clothes completely covered in dirt. I never felt underdressed for a 24 hour diner until that moment. Dare I say that the Broad Street Diner looked classy.

The food was still diner quality food, with cheap fried food, but I was surprised again to see healthier options. I ultimately ignored those options, but it was nice to know that they were there.  I ordered the chicken parmesan sandwich, and unlike some of the previous reviews where their sandwich was served burt, mine turned out okay. Just okay. The chicken was thin and slightly overcooked, but I've definitely had worse.

When it came to service, I had quite the opposite experience compared to previous reviews.. The waitress was very friendly, and she was attentive to her customers. Granted, I found out later that she just started working there, but sometimes all a business needs is a little fresh air. I'll stop by again if the mood strikes again.
I'd skip this spot. Yes, there are beignets and you don't have to wait. But they don't even put powdered sugar on (there are shakers filled with granular sugar) and the employees seem miserable.

Absolutely amazing, best Thai food I've tasted in the Reno Sparks area, really anywhere. It is located downtown between Virginia & Center north off of Pine Street in a small strip mall. Parking is limited in some spots are metered by the city.  Upon entering the atmosphere is a mix of rustic and industrial. We were quickly seated and our server was very attentive. The water is not just your average tap water, it is flavored with fresh green apples, lemons & 
Mint. We ordered appetizers which came in a very timely manner. Everything is extremely fresh, abundance of flavor and absolutely delicious. Our entrées were equally as good, my beef drunken noodles was perfectly cooked and full of flavor.  My only caution would be the level of spice, I ordered two stars and I would say it was closer to a strong three stars, still very good but had a little kick.The Chicken Pad Thai was also very good, extremely fresh, the girls couldn't stop talking about it.

A far better selection than most chinese buffets but the quality is about the same.  Avoid the sushi bar.  This is only the 2nd buffet that I have found with hard ice cream.  The pineapple tasted fresh.  The buffet area was pretty clean.

For what it is-or at least when I went there-it was solid. I had been fasting, and travelling, so by the time I got to Bucks County, I had not eaten in almost 24 hours.

Food was solid. Open-faced shrimp melt and open-faced tuna melt were really good. It is a diner, and it gets 4 stars for a diner.

I rate things depending on what they are and what they are trying to be. I am not going there looking to be fed Michelin worthy food. But it was simple, the older lady was nice, the people were helpful. Btw I took my food to go to the hotel. The Crowne Plaza. Now the hotel, that SUCKED.

The place is cute and lovely. You can tell everything here is delicate, well designed and managed. It's just like having brunch in a movie. However, I'm a food-most-important person. And taking into account their prices, there was nothing special or very tasty for me to come back again.

I thought highly of this place and had been looking forward to it. I knew it was rated one of the best restaurants on many magazines. But, high expectations lead to disappointment.
The pizza is super delicious!! I just had cheese, yum. Bartender was very friendly. No live music here but they played great music on the radio!

Back with friends for a fun midweek dinner we were proud to show off our Broad Ripple  Thai place! The service was super friendly and the food was delicious hubby had Pad Thai spice level 3 and I had green curry chicken both so great! Our friends were impressed with the portion sizes and variety and BC of the leftovers our teenage son got fantastic leftovers for lunch! The lemongrass soup appetizer was so yummy too!

The only reason why I am giving this place a 3 star is because the blonde counter person/cashier chick was kind of bitchy. 

Other than that, the butterscotch pie was good and the interior is very nice.

On a recent trip to Philadelphia, we ate at an old established restaurant south of center city, The Saloon.  Never disappointed.  Great friendly bar, and excellent service and food.  The veal chop is a favorite.

I'm going to be blunt. If you had a bad experience here. You were the cause! I've been to restaurants all across the nation. Tried several different Brazilian steakhouses. The quality of food and service at Bull Grill beats the other's hands down! Yes!! Even Texas De Brazil. Their desserts are so good we bought an extra to take home. Our waitress was lovely and on point. Never needed to ask for any refills and had great recommendations. The owner himself came to make sure we were being taken care of. And honestly I liked that personal touch. Not to mention! He made the awesome desserts himself! You can have a romantic/intimate dinner at Bull Grill unlike the big chain steakhouses. Can't say enough great things about this place. I look forward to going back. 

~ Javier

Super quick delivery. If you are into gooey cheese and fluffy crusted pizza, Frank's is a must. Their cheese steaks are made south philly style using sliced meat rather than chopped and their Frank's italian special hoagie is almost on par with Primo which I think is the best (just wish it came with a little more oil/spices/peppers but I'll add them next time I order. Definitely making them my go-to since I've moved to East Falls.

Again, similar issues as last time, except this time was carryout. We were told 20 minutes to pickup, arrived 20 minutes later than proceeded to wait almost another half hour. Very frustrating. The very accommodating and apologetic manager took $5 off our order which was nice. I enjoyed my wings, however my wife's were very chewy, almost like it was poor quality chicken or undercooked. The fried pickles were soggy as well. It's going to take a lot to get my to come back to this location when there are others within just a short distance away.

Mama's is delicious!  Don't be turned off by the line out the door at lunch - it moves fast and the food is worth the wait.  This is the best falafel I have ever had.  I usually get the Mama's sandwich (the small on a normal day, the large if I'm particularly hungry).  It's falafel in a pita, so you can't go wrong.  Their platters are huge and if I get one, I usually save half for lunch the next day.

Don't forget cash; they don't take credit cards.

Our last night in NOLA, my husband and I decided to grab a few slices here and then go elsewhere to watch the Bruins and Celtics play. The pizza was awesome and the host and bartender were so accommodating and put the Bruins game on for us at the bar. Bartender was super friendly and attentive and made us some tasty sangria. There is so much great food in NOLA but this was by far one of our favorite meals because the staff was so friendly and the pizza was delicious!

Service was really great, he was very polite and willing to listen to my request. Didn't give me an attitude like other restaurants and in general a very good experience. 
It was my first time in chubby cattle and my waiter went through the menu explaining the details and made me feel very week informed about what I'm going to get.

Finally got a chance to try Speck's Drive In!  I was very pleased!  The chicken was tender and juicy.  It might have been a bit small...I've seen bigger breasts in my time, but it was quite tasty and came with fries, a roll, and a side for under 7 bucks...I got the mac and cheese on the side which was creamy and delicious...

The food was served almost immediately, meaning it was sitting under a hot light somewhere...but it was still warm and juicy when I got back to the office 10 minutes later...the fries were pretty good too, crinkle fries as others have noted.  They include a little baggie with a fork, wet nap, salt, and ketchup with your order...I always appreciate a wet nap after a meal!

I like the decour...it seems almost stuck in time...it did NOT seem dirty to me as others have mentioned...could probably use a little makeover, but i wasn't worried about the cleanliness.

They do have shakes, but they aren't what I'd call milkshakes...it certainly won't bring the boys to the yard....milkshakes are hand dipped iced cream and milk...Speck's has a shake machine that seems to have vanilla soft serve and the ability to add 11 flavors to it...I got the chocolate, and it was passable, but not what i drool over when I think Milkshake...and nothing I'd miss when I go back...

Overall a very tasty lunch...I'll have more chicken and skip the shake next time!

We asked a cab driver to take us somewhere local with good food and he dropped us here. I had the BBQ Beef Po'Boy and hubby had shrimp. We also split the gravy fries (OMG - to die for!) and fried pickles. Fun, upbeat environment and the food was delicious!! I would definitely go back - especially for St. Paddy's since of all things, this was an Irish Pub!

The to-go side of govindas is absolutely worth checking out for the vegan chicken cheese steak and delicious desserts. Other things on the menu like kofta balls and ham and egg sandwich were dissapointing. The staff is sometimes rude and the wait is always significant. Cheeseteak is amazing though. I had an altogether different experience their "fine dining" side of the place.  The soups were fantastic, and everything else was HORRIBLE. Our entrees were cold, after an inexplicable hour wait for them. (there was only one other table) The appetizers were soggy and bland. The sauces were watery, the pasta overcooked. And everything is grossly overpriced. Our inattentive waiter actually delivered our check while on his cell phone! In conclusion, stick to the chicken cheese steak, soups and dessert to go.

Tony and I went here for dinner. I was excited. I love Mexican food and I love trying new restaurants but it was just OKAY...nothing special. 
I wouldn't recommend it and I wouldn't go here again. 
But, we didn't get ill or die...lol !!!
This restaurant maybe packed on a Friday to the max but it is hella good. Really really really great margaritas!
Best steaks in the city, hands down! Be sure you know how to order like a Philadelphian. Forget the city tourist traps, this is the real deal...

I went to Five Happiness today for lunch.  It is one of my favorite Chinese restaurants, but that it not why I'm writing this...  In Orleans parish, there is currently a requirement that restaurant patrons be vaccinated or show negative covid test.  This is supposed to be enforced.  I was disappointed that there was absolutely no attempt to enforce this.  Apart from a sign on the door, I was not asked whether I had been vaccinated nor required to show proof of vaccination.

It made me feel uneasy eating my lunch.  Other restaurants I have been to since this requirement came into effect have asked for proof of vaccination upon entry.

this is a really nice place. i wish i lived closer so i could go more often. they serve standard persian food. chicken and beef kebabs with yellow/white rice. it tastes really good. you get some sides as well and some crispy/crunchy bread with butter that tastes absolutely great. if you live close to here then lucky you

LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS PLACE! Nice family owned joint. During COVID, my family ordered here at least five times and this was the ONLY place where every order was absolutely correct, fresh, and perfect. Since restrictions have lifted we've already been there twice to dine. Great service, clean, and totally amazing. My go to is the Hoosier daddy sandwich- in my opinion one of the best tenderloins around. I've also ordered the philly which was delicious. Everything on their menu is great. This is a must try if you haven't been yet.

My fiancé and I enjoyed this place very much. We ordered the Spiny Lobster, Oysters, the shrimp ceviche, shrimp tacos and the lobster roll. Definently get a BANG FOR YOUR BUCK! Our waiter was very informative of the types of shellfish/ flavoring & knew how it was cooked as well. His service was also very attentive! Definently will be returning here our next visit to SB.
My sandwich was great. Customer services skills are horrible. Seems like majority of the staff has additudes  , which makes it very uncomfortable.  As much as I enjoy their food I wont go back.

We love Eddie & Sam's! It really feels like your in NYC when you go through the carry out line. The pieces are huge and the salads are great too in different sizes. Would definitely recommend if you're looking for a good slice or two!

New restaurant in West Conshohocken. My husband and I went in on a Saturday night because it's close to home and a BYOB. Service was good, prices reasonable. After the waiter told us about the specials we asked if the salmon special was fresh wild salmon....he told us, with delight, that it it, of course, fresh farm raised salmon. Ugh!! We started to wonder what else was not freshly prepared or not fresh to start with.We ordered the veal shank and truly enjoyed our meal. Bread was served with olive oil to dip it in but no bread plates were provided. MMM. We will definitely go back for another try...but probably won't order the salmon.  
Nice atmosphere, good for small or larger parties.

The food was yummy. The spices were perfect. The country style rib I had was slightly under cooked but I m sure it was an off day. Love the fried okaras and all the side dishes just as how southern food should taste.

First off, dear Lord has it really been 6 months since I've Yelped? Guess working 3 jobs at once will do that for you... Fortunately the extra cash flow means I can afford the gas to drive to Metairie and eat at China Rose once a week. Win. 

It's not the best Chinese food I've ever had, but it's the best you're going to find in New Orleans. There are many dishes that I can't make myself and are impossible to find elsewhere, such as Wu Gen Chang Wan (Pork Intestines with Pickled Vegetables), one of my favorite foods of all time. They do a great stir fried green bean (Gan Bian Si Ji Dou) with ginger and peppers, unlike the nasty mushy ones at 5 Happiness; I love the stirfried eggplant; and they even have Xiao Long Bao, which are hit or miss (sometimes they are steamed too long and the skins break so the soup leaks all out). 

The prices are moderate to high, although not as high as the other good Chinese restaurants here. When I told my dad it was about $10-12 per dish, he reminded me that in LA, comparable food is $4-6... thanks Pops. 

All in all, though, here and Hoa Hong are comfort food for Daniel and I and we're not going to stop going by.

Went here for lunch after an afternoon at the beach. We where not pleased with anything. The chips and salsa where not fresh, the salsa was definitely from a can served in a container with a lid. Ordered blacked fish tacos, the fish was not blackened and there was hardly any fish in the taco. The restaurant service didn't really seem to care that the tables are all too close together, can barely move your chair without hitting someone else. For being a restaurant on the water they did not offer many seafood choices. Nothing seemed special here, we will not be back.
Love this place for a great beer flight. The food is good and they have a very wide selection of beers on tap. Many TVs as well as both indoor and outdoor seating. Trivia is also very fun to do here.

What a fabulous evening. Clancy's excels in food and service.  The Crawfish Pie was out of this world and my wife loved the Crab Salad. My Pompano dinner was delicious with lump crab meat on top. We shared the Lemon Icebox pie for desert and it was rich and smooth with just the right amount of tartness. Our server, Brandy, was attentive and knowledgable. Each of her recommendations were spot on.   This neighborhood restaurant is a favorite with the locals and after eating there I know why.  The next time you're in the Big Easy be sure to make a reservation at Clancy's. You'll be glad you did.

8:40am on Monday MAY 3rd. The woman wearing a leopard shirt working the drive-through absolutely terrible service. Just an attitude behind everything she says. I got to the drive-through and waited two minutes with my window down while it's raining. She made me repeat everything twice having to literally shout. Unacceptable. I get to the window to pay him I wait another minute and a half waiting for them to turn around and finally acknowledged I rolled up. And what I get  greeted with is more attitude. I'm giving three stars because the food is usually good and the staff usually isn't a pain in the ass like this woman. Fix your damn drive-through machine and hire people with the personality greater than a fly!

This is a little slice of Italy in St. Pete.  It's so much cheaper than a one way ticket to Rome.  The employees do need to employ their hands in native gesticulation...other than that..."Manga, manga!"

Went to lunch with a group of girlfriends. We were seated in the Garden Room, which we love. We had a wonderful time. The food was wonderful. I had the Tourneodos of Beef. It was perfectly cooked. The potatoes, mushrooms, and the sauce were delicious. So much flavor. Everyone else at the table had the honey glazed fish. They all loved it. We split the Bread Pudding and the Cheesecake for dessert. They were amazing. We enjoyed our experience so much. We only had one problem. Service. It was sadly lacking. Our server, Troy didn't seem to want to be bothered. There was another girl, none of us can remember her name, she also left a lot to be desired. We had to ask repeatedly for cocktail refills. She also had problems with refilling our ice tea and water glasses. We had to ask constantly. Sometimes, she would refill with a pitcher. Other times, she would take the glass and never return. We would have to ask for our glass. Also, when it was time to collect our check we had to flag someone down that wasn't our server to take it because we couldn't find Troy. I've been to Commander's many times, and never had these issues. Of course, we will return, the food was amazing as always. Would have rated 5-stars if not for the service.

First the good.  Loved the concept, and the food was very good.  But the bad:  the concept and the execution leave much room for improvement. 

VERY messy - you must wear the provided bib and rubber gloves.  When I'm wearing rubber gloves, I'm usually not doing something enjoyable.  

Unappetizing presentation - all your boiled food is served in a plastic bag you have to fish through to find things and hope you don't spill the contents all over your table.  

Finally, the staff was (at best) under-informed.  Didn't know where the Mussels or Lobster were from, and sold us an appetizer that was really another entree.  

Granted - it's brand new and they're probably working the kinks out - but if you go - consider it an experiment - not a refined dining experience.

We stopped in for dinner on Thursday. There was a slight issue with my wife's entree. The waitress brought the manager over to take a look. My wife got a new plate in a very timely manner. The manager also took care of us on the bill. Our waitress was very good working through the issues.  Highly recommend based on service and how an issue was handled.

The Bellefonte Cafe has been a home away from home for years! The staff and the food are outstanding and the atmosphere is trendy and fun! Great music always! Thank you to the cafe for Making my 60Th Birthday celebration such memorable one! Dave, Donna and the entire staff I thank you from the Bottom of my heart!

At here last week and it was outstanding! The food was delicious and the service was phenomenal! I recommend everyone to come here. The atmosphere is amazing the food was amazing and the service was amazing!
Food was delicious. The chef (maybe the owner?) came out to check if we enjoyed our food. The shrimp & grits had a nice flavor and the pancakes were tasty. I'd go again.

Got Carryout last night.  Very well organized. Gave an accurate eta for the food & also called when ready for pickup. The food was excellent!  We got a few common sushi rolls (California, Alaska), which were as good as any.  What really shined were the Korean items we got.  I really liked the seafood soba noodle entree I had, but what knocked my socks off were the appetizers & dessert we got.  The pork & veggie fried dumplings were the best I ever had, but the kimchi pancake thing knocked my socks off!  I'm still thinking about it.  Topping things off was a lemon Bundt cake- very good, but I lost another set of socks to the green tea mochi.  It's a favorite of mine at Asian restaurants so I know it well, but this was SO much better!  The rice shell was soft & goey & the ice cream inside was soft and creamy.  I don't know how they did it, but it is something else I'll be dreaming about until we return.

If you like waiting an hour and a half for average food and pretentious service then the Pharmacy is for you. You wait in line for 30 minutes just to get your name on the actual waiting list. The food is decent, their beer selection is plentiful, but the service is slow and smug. Good luck.

Decent selection of food. 
Of course it's far from healthy, but good for a once in awhile thing. Waitresses aren't always the most friendly, but I think it's because they're overworked and and underpaid. Avoid going Sunday mornings/afternoons because once church gets out and the hangovers of people start you'll be waiting a LONG time.
I love there breakfast selections, nom nom nom!!

The fam and I enjoyed our experience here.  The service was great.  Food and drinks came out quickly.  I tried the BBQ chicken breasts, collars greens and coke slaw.  Gotta say,  I was pleasantly surprised by the how well seasoned and how much flavor the greens had!  For me, the greens alone are worth going back for.  Not everyone can get those collards just right.  The chicken breasts were very tender and moist.  Win!  The live music was great and made for an overall cool night out.  I will most def go back.

This is for the restaurant only. The fish & chips....well the fish was rock hard and I couldn't cut through it...but the fries were delicious! They replaced my meal with a chicken quesadilla. It was dead quiet except for the movie the chef was playing on his phone/tablet. (Which was quite loud and violent sounding)

I've always liked the food and service here....would I recommend it or go out of my way to be here? NO. Sorry Radisson....
Here at a slow time, but service was fast and very friendly. Bagel was good and the coffee excellent.

Desperately looking for a good Thai place and voila my prayers have been heard. The restaurant atmosphere is very calm and super clean. Ordered the pad Thai and Thai basil fried rice. I was so impressed with the flavors here. If your looking for a good pad thai this is the place!

I love this place and the ambiance is great. They have recently lowered their standards and people dressed poorly can arrive; which is a downfall; however the wait staff is knowledgeable and the food is amazing. The price is reasonable when you consider other comparably priced restraints offer food a la Carr instead of all inclusive (salad, bread, soup + enter). My favorite cut of meat is the chateau briand. To top it all off you can end your night in the desert room, a cool experience.
DUDEEEE... this place is awesome! The turkey melt is amazing and the atmosphere is perfect. The music selection is on point and the outdoor seating couldn't be better. Love it!
Bow tie Michael was absolutely great today!! Made my brother in laws bday very nice. Food was great. Good vegetarian options

Recently got an internship downtown and Ike's is the closest coffee shop, their espresso drinks do the trick and taste good too. The staff is really friendly and they have a buy 8 coffee's get 1 free card, which I take full advantage of. Nice place to get coffee

Simple little dive bar where I had lunch with a colleague.  My burger (The Chupacabra) was fantastically juicy and full of flavorful oozy goodness [sweet-chili jam and goat cheese].  The crinkle fries were salted just right and the house thousand-islandish sauce went perfectly with them.

My only qualm was that it seemed a bit on the pricey side given the smaller-than-typical burger, the $3 add-on for basic fries, combined with the no-frills setting.  I wouldn't have batted an eye if this were any other new Nashville burger joint, but it felt like trendy Nashville prices ($15 for a burger and fries after tax and tip) without any of the niceties or comforts that a new place would offer.
it was an okay atmosphere. the dj wasn't that good he played popular music but nothing anyone could dance to. at least i didn't leave smelling like cigarettes

This is by far the best place on the south side to grab drinks and a nacho. 
I've travelled across the world far and wide and I've never found better nachos.

The perfect amount of cheese and humungoes portions make this a go to dish for me.

Prices of beers are $5 for the specials, and I can always find a special I like.

The service is pretty much the most impressive I've ever seen in a customer service/bar environment.

I write this and can tell you the management and staff at this Original Joe's are even better than the other other Original Joe's in the city.

Pros:
Everything

Cons:
Sometimes gets redonkulously busy and you can't get a seat for a long time.

Good food.  Tried the East and West Texas dogs with a half fry and onion ring.  The rolls that the dogs come on are New England style butter toasted buns that resemble Texas toast.  They were toasted perfect and held up to the toppings well.  The onion rings were crisp and so were the fresh cut fries.  Look at the menu before arriving so that you can decide on what you want, you'll thank me later.  So far, they have 2 locations to choose from.  Give them a try.

WE GOT TIP MONEY!!!!

Kinda reminiscent of an overzealous dancer in a gentleman's club, but if you can get past that corny statement as a thank you for a tip, you will find yourself in a sweet spot! 

I go for the same thing every time the cheese steak with chips and a drink. Trust me, you can't go wrong with this bad boy. As I'm watching my waistline I don't venture here often (maybe once per month). It is the right amount of steak, bread, cheese and onions! 

The staff at this joint rock; they are getting the work done and having fun! Parking is ample as most are in and out keeping parking spaces opening up regularly. 

Bottom Line:

Gooooo here!

Great, friendly service with a smile. Food came out hot and quick. I had the Reuben sandwich with "Magic Fries". The sandwich was one of the best Reuben's I've ever had. Highly recommended for a beer, munchies and whatever game is on.

Don't bother stopping. Seems like its a chore to order even though 4 staff members were behind counter. Too distracted to give good customer service and then gave orders to wrong people. Register person looked bored and was snappy in her comments to me as I left and to the others people who were ordering. So, drive on by this place.

The crew here is so unprofessional! Went in today and saw a cook sneeze right on a hamburger and walked away. When discussed the issue with the manager (who didn't look a day over 14), he shrugged his shoulders and ignored me. They also were very disorganized and my burger was totally the wrong order. It was also dirty inside and the bathrooms hadn't been cleaned in some time. We won't be back and calling the state department on Monday.

The hubs and I were in town overnight for a concert at the Met in mid-August. Being a bit pressed for time, I scoped out the Tria beforehand and since it was just across the street from our quant hotel, it seemed like a no brainier for a light meal. And, the front desk highly recommended it at check-in so...bonus! Let me just say that EVERYTHING was amazing!! It was busy but our server at the bar, Tim, was so friendly, so accommodating, so sincere and helpful that I was immediately at ease. The hubs had a few interesting brews and I a few glasses of some outstanding reds. But the food? Oh. My. Lord. We had the charcuterie board, crab stuffed peppers, chicken liver mousse and 2 or 3 luscious cheeses! All came with the yummiest crostini, mustards, oils, etc. So much for a light meal . After the concert, we could have gone anywhere in the city for drinks or a nosh but we couldn't get back to Tria fast enough! More beer, more wine and some of the absolutely best cheeses I have ever eaten. And, to make the evening perfect, we got to spend another hour with Tim. Such a terrific guy, a real asset to this wonderful little establishment. We cannot wait for another opportunity to drive almost two hours just to go back!

This was my first stop in TN. Service was excellent Amy took good care us and went over the menu like a PRO. Did not know it was her second day of work. I ordered the Pedro and made it a sandwich. The place is clean and with parking in the rear.

As a Chicago girl, and a pizza snob, be warned..there is NOTHING about this pizza that says Chicago. It's an insult. Take it out of the name. The service was terrible, the prices too high and the pizza was soaked in butter. I would not even take the leftovers home. The bar looks fun. It's about the only thing I would go back for. Don

My sister and I couldn't hang with the crazy deep line for brunch across the street at BL so we popped in to see what The Pub had to offer. Solid brunch menu and Smithwicks on tap. The Hangover Cure Bowl is a must. Really cool decor and fancy furniture that gives the place an authentic traditional pub feel. The place really opens up in the back with an area for darts and lots of standing tables and booths. Will definitely come back for their Happy Hour and beer cheese and pretzels

I've been to Jack Patrick's many a time. I think of it as a neighborhood bar that happens to be Downtown. It's open until 3 am. Mostly male bartenders, strong drinks, regulars, low key, lots of games like shuffle board, darts, etc. They serve mediocre pub grub until 10 pm, which seems like an early shut down time for a 3am bar. Especially since so many of them have late kitchens. 

One thing new that I found through fellow Yelper Erin G., is the downstairs party room. For $100 bucks you get the room, a bartender, and a bocce court, which is kind of cool! Good to know. Thanks Erin!

Gelato was so good! Customer service was awesome. The vibe is great and it is located in a beautiful part of the city. You get a MASSIVE amount of ice cream in the piccolo with a choice of up to 3 flavors. Please give all flavors at one time when you order. Since the weight of all sizes (ie piccolo, etc) should all be about the same weight you cannot expect to have equal sized servings of you add a flavor at the very end.

I'm constantly craving food from here cause it's some of the best I've had! The smoked salmon is so good, you must try it. The fig dish is also delicious and isn't overly sweet. Definitely come here with a group of friends so you can order one of everything and try all the yummy pastries! A must eat cafe that you won't stop thinking about!

Don't order the thin fried catfish unless you love just batter.  Literally the fish was as thin as a sheet of paper, maybe thinner.  This is a rip off meal.  Even on special, you are getting no fish!
Also, I hate whatever oil they pour on the fries.
Unless I am getting a hamburger, I am not going here for a meal again.

WOW! Normally I only write BAD reviews to steer you away from the lousy one's, I usually sit at the counter, so my service was fast, the food was served in an acceptable time and usually waited for the line to go down to pay the bill or just threw the money on the counter. The people writing slow service reviews kinda looks like is at the tables, so Thanks Guys for letting me know not to change my routine, (smirk) food has always been consistent however you have to watch out for the slide in the order up sell. Want cheese on that? is one of them. PS if you want to get served fast at cody's next door, start eating the peanuts like they are goin outa stye, they'll get your food to you FAST!
Perfect every time. The Filet the service everything. Love the Stoli doli drink is so yummy.

Really fun atmosphere with picnic tables and red-checkered table clothes.  I had a great piece of brisket and the potato salad and house beans were delicious.  They had a pitcher of beer for $10 which really can't be beat!  Overall great experience.  I love to support local businesses!

3.5 stars

This is only a review for takeout. The tonkotsu ramen was enough to keep me coming back, but the sushi was mediocre at best. It was a little more expensive than I wanted to spend on takeout, but overall I enjoyed the meal.
Wonderful atmosphere and cocktails. Loved the appetizers and menu variety. We had a great time sipping and sampling many different items from the menu with friends and had great service!

Just wow! This truly is a unique spin on dessert. The desserts are a shaved ice with the consistency of ice cream when you bite into it. When you take your spoon and grab a bite full of the dessert it falls apart like sand in a sand castle. Truly unique and delicious! 

My boyfriend tried the Smoreos and I tried the Cotton Candy! The Smoreos was primarily a chocolate flavor with crushed Oreos mixed in the ice topped with graham crackers, marshmallows and chocolate sauce! For the Cotton Candy I decided to add strawberry boba in place of the whipped cream and it was a great choice. Each bite was sweet and melted in my mouth - literally! 

The best part is that you don't feel gross after eating this dessert, it feels fresh and satisfies the sweet tooth. I love how unique the brand is too - definitely something I haven't heard of before! 

A must try in Tampa Bay!

The flavors of the food were ok and the waitress was fantastic. But we went here for surf and turf because this is supposed to be a steak and seafood restaurant. They did not have lobster or shrimp the owner then said it is because she gets her lobster in Honduras  and they have a problem with their lobster now........um ok we are in Florida you can get lobster anywhere so it a bunch of crap watch out for this place she must be going out of business and she uses that as an excuse because she doesn't want to spend money on lobster and have it go bad because no one comes in. Also my filet was completely grey which means it's old and my friends steak was perfect. I will never go back such a shame
Jimmy and his folks make the best after dinner desserts in Chinatown. Came here w a group of five and had the Cookie Spree and Mango Sticky Rice. Phenomenal tastes and quick service.

Ordered a bacon egg and cheese with extra bacon on white TOAST, and a medium hot chocolate and received this. No hot chocolate in sight. Went back up to the cashier with the attitude and she didn't ring in my hot chocolate that I ordered which made no sense. Did not offer to ring it in or offer it in anyway. 
The food is terrible along with the service.

I'll be honest, pulled up to place and thought maybe I should go somewhere else. Kind of sketchy area, but absolutely glad we went in. The food was fresh and amazing and the customer service was great!

How do I love you mini churros let me count the ways - in orders of 5 or 10 is the correct answer.  What I don't really understand about this new addition to the southside is how you can have so many people working there, yet you are always out of condiments, or straws, or the place looks like a bomb went off and eventually you may see someone with a broom- but they are just pushing it to another corner.  I have been impressed with what I have ordered, all though you constantly seem to be out of milkshakes- the staff should also learn what items have meat and what items don't- it doesnt bother me much- but to others that have gone with me it does.
Finally-  not so much a review of JitB but to the customers-  if you choose to take your kids out for fast foor between the hours of late o'clock and 4 a.m. (late o'clock in my book is anytime after 9) than you should expect them to be a little rowdy, or to see people that are not your normal 9-5 buisness class.  I will be the first to say something when you are yelling at your kid to calm down or sit down, or in one case even spanking them for walking around---i get it- it's your kid and raise them the way you want- but have a little common sense please!


I am really excited to use the new credit card machine where you can place your order and not even talk to one of the people at a register--- could this be the next big rage?

Yellow curry fried rice was phenomenal. Not too spicey, with generous portion. Beef pad thai doesn't taste like other pad thai but it was good. My mother in law has enjoyed her cashew chicken here for over 13 years. A hole in the wall, but nice interior and very quick if you order togo.

So happy to have them in Affton. Not only are the pretzels great, the owners are wonderful members of the community. I have been genuinely impressed on my many occasions going there now watching how well the owner treats people. Large variety of pretzel choices too. Like any restaurant I think they are probably best during peak hours. The price is great, better than average for fast food. I love to support a small business!
If you want a delicious burger and fries this is the place to come to in Boise! The onion rings are very good as well. The service is fast and friendly!
They have the best PB&J burger I've ever had! Only tried it once but it was amazing. Didn't taste as weird as I expected. I think the only complaint I have would be seating.
The chicken fried steak sandwich is honestly one of the best sandwiches I've ever had in my entire life.

Lots to choose from. We finally did the bang bang shrimp and mussels for apps.  Then we split the rainbow trout with lemon butter sauce and lobster thermidor on side. Espresso Martini was really delicious, too.  Great meal.

I had 45 minutes to celebrate the last vestiges of a very subpar b-day.
G/f and my buddy pulled this random gem out and they did not disappoint.  Some random sandwich (top of the menu) the very kind waitress recommended, the turkey chili (excellent) and a Guinness and my b-day didn't suck as bad as it did all day prior.

A fine if not snug local bar.  One of the gems of Germantown.  Pissed I didn't go sooner.

It is time for me to stop eating Five Guys Burgers.  They are SO GOOD!  I wish I was a vegetarian so that I wouldn't eat so many burgers.  I'm not sure of the exact chemical reaction that happens in the brain, but the endorphin release is insane after eating here.  It could cause an addiction.  That's why I will stop (tomorrow).

4/5 times we order from this location for delivery they don't get our order right.  It's pointless to call the store because we're hungry and don't want to wait another 15 minutes to get the rest of the order.  If you order a salad it's likely you won't get dressing, if you order bread bites you're not getting marinara.  I'm done.  I've complained to the store, to customer service, our order still shows up incomplete.

The claim chowder was very good as well as the prime rib. The crab mac and cheese was very good. The sauce could have been thicker, but very tasty. Larry, our server, was GREAT. He didn't over bug us, but took the initiative to meet our needs. All around very good experience. We couldn't believe we were in Reno.

It has been YEARS since I have been to Applebee's, and all my past experiences have been really underwhelming. Our daughter won a free kid's meal for doing well in school.  She'd been begging to go and we kept putting her off, but we finally caved.  We were pleasantly surprised. 

Our server was prompt, friendly, and helpful.  The food came out quickly and honestly was tastier than I expected.  My daughter's burger was well seasoned, my boneless buffalo wings were spicy with plenty of sauce, and my husband's pasta was also tasty.  

The inside needs a facelift.  It seemed a bit grimy and dusty, and had a vibe of being rundown.  Our server was great, but on my way to and from the restroom, and saw several employees standing around doing nothing and talking loudly, while our poor server hustled about.  They had a lot of people on staff for an unbusy time of day, and they seem to have given our server more tables than she needed.

Don't bother. We ordered the pretzel
battered chicken strips and the aioli fries. The chicken strips were nothing special, couldn't taste any pretzel batter, very small portion for the price. The fries were way overcooked, brown and saugie and the aioli had no flavor. The two beers my boyfriend ordered (first choice was a yueng ling and second choice was an IPA) from their menu, were both tapped, so he had to order a house special IPA, I wanted an Irish Cider, but they didn't have that, so ended up with a blueberry peach cider, not very good. Bartender seemed very unhappy and there was a another loud lady that was behind the bar, not sure what her role was, since she was only seating people, not serving. Anyway, don't bother with this place, not up to the hype.

Holy freaking moly! Looking for a great seafood restaurant with a cajun flair and fantastic portions, you have it here!

The waitress was the bomb.com and the rest of the staff was amazingly nice too. 

I have NEVER been served a piece of Ahi tuna this large on a sandwich. 2 thumbs up!

The best bbq I've ever had...all of it!
The sides are just as incredible! First time visit was last night. Had two meat plate (ribs and turkey) juicy and smoked to perfection! However...the men behind the counter are very Rude...poor people/customer service skills and the menu, needs a lot of work...like list what you actually serve!

Bathrooms were thrashed, literally poop smeared on surfaces. No toilet paper and the hostess seemed uncaring when told about it. 
"Blackened Grouper" was just a filet in the middle of a plate with no garnish. I know just presentation but come on. The fish was slimy with a weird texture and it was not blackened like in some of the photos. It was browned but not in a good or pretty way. All the rest of the dishes was subpar for the prices. 
1 item of $200 worth of food was pretty good. The filet bites in the black and blue sauce was great. 
I say 2 1/2 stars.

Recently changed owners I think within the last 6 months to a year I can't pinpoint the time. Still chinese owners. But probably new chef too. The food is still good BUT not AS good. The new owners are nice but can be difficult and rude in some certain situations from what I've observed from other customers experiences. Really loved this place and the food. Hate it when a restaurant gets new owners. Will continue coming here for the food but it will never be the same.

This was the second and LAST time eating at PM. The appetizer plates came out within the first three minutes of ordering. Then almost and hour later our entrees came. I asked the server what he would like me to do with the appetizer plates(hoping he would get the point) and he just looked at me(no such luck). After struggling to get through the bowl of noodles soaked in soy sauce, I informed the server that we no longer wanted the appetizer. He didn't seemed worried about forgetting it either. 
The only flavor the food had was salt and more salt. 
The whole place needs a good cleaning and the restrooms were DISGUSTING! 

I wish there was a HALF a STAR. 
Sadest excuse for a restaurant.

Can I say: this place is SUPERB!!!! We went for anniversary and it was amazing. The hospitality there was TO DIE FOR. I think that was the beat part of there meal. We got the lobster bisque, which had so much flavor AND lots of lobster. I got the crab cakes and the husband got the scallops and neither disappointed. We ended with creme brûlée and the portion was seriously amazing (as well as the flavor!!!). The drinks, hands down, were divine. We cannot wait to make this place our annual anniversary treat!!!

Awesome Food!!! Lobster bisque, Lobster Alfredo...TO DIE FOR!!! I went there Saturday night, I made reservations and passed the 1 hour wait line (BIG THUMBS UP TO RESERVATIONS!!!) I had a glass of the "Menage a Trois " red wine, I could not believe the great taste of that wine! It floored me! Anyway, we hat the Lobster bisque soup, I could not believe it was just part of the meal, tasty like no other, with giant chunks of lobster! My wife had the Lobster Alfredo, same as the soup, more lobster than you can shake a stick at. I had the prime rib, I have to admin, it was not the best. I love my prime rib with the horseradish sauce on it, not au jus. This came swimming in au jus, literally swimming. That might be great for some people, just not my taste. All in all, we will go back again and again, just not for the prime rib.
Decent rolls people are nice that run the counter .. Much better than delBuonos .. Sometimes they run out if rolls early or would be 5 stars

I am new to the area and heard great things about this place. My husband and I are beer freaks and their selection does not disappoint. They also have several different sangria variations which I am always a fan of if I'm beered out.

We came in on a Friday night and I found the atmosphere very chaotic and disorganized. I love the casual concept, however the execution, at least in our experience, failed. We came in looking for take out and a growler fill. We expressed our needs to the host looking for some kind of direction. It was a quite mess from there on. After 45 minutes of waiting and observing the shit storm system of confused patrons and friendly, but ineffective waitstaff, the seemingly most competent waitress asked us if we were waiting for a take out order. We replied yes, and she disappeared then came back asking for our receipt to clarify our food order because there was no trace of it. Soon there after, she found our food which had been sitting at the bar for quite sometime because it was lukewarm. My kale salad was also missing chicken, so we asked waitstaff to add the missing ingredient we had paid for. On the way out, we picked up a square of mac and cheese from the case.

We were starving by the time we got home, and devoured our food. Which was quite delicious in flavor, yet was soggy and cool from transport and sitting around the bar for longer than it should have. My husband ordered the chicken tacos which were perfectly spicy and tasty. The mac and cheese however, was disgusting. It tasted like butter that had been sitting in a refrigerator for weeks uncovered. I got no hint of cheese, only bland bread crumbs, which was surprising because the market had a wonderful cheese selection. 

We may have went the wrong route by ordering takeout, however it was clear no one in the place, even employees of 320 Market, knew how to do it right.

Wow. Ok so my wife and I decided to get Uber Eats and to be honest, never heard of The Duke. She saw the good rating on Uber Eats and decided to try it. I am simply going to say it was excellent. The burger was great. The nachos were great. The fried macaroni and cheese was out of this world. And Back to the burger, it was the size of my face. And kudos to Uber Eats for getting us the food timely and still really hot.

Carrabba's is not a terrible restaurant but our experiences were such that there will not be any return visits. We visited Carrabba's On the August 24, 2012 to celebrate my eldest son's coming of age on his twenty first birthday.  Junior is pretty fond of their lobster raviolis. Festivities were cut short when our worst fears were realized, in that our sixteen year old daughter, who has some severe food allergies began reacting despite our having repetitively iterated to our server that she was allergic to specific food items. Furthermore, as an additional preventative measure we queried the server of ingredients in an effort to make absolutely certain that nothing she ordered contained allergens. By all accounts there was no excuse. Less than five minutes of being served our appetizers my wife was rushing my daughter to the local pharmacy for some over the counter anti histamines to counter act her reaction. Our daughter forgot her EpiPen and her symptoms progressively worsened which led to a subsequent visit to the E.R. Needless, to say we were livid. It had not occurred to me at that moment to involve the manager obviously because of my concern for my daughter's well being. However, I did manage to call and speak to the manager who relentlessly apologized for our negative experiences at his franchise. Nevertheless, I would be remiss if I did not mention that the manager seemed genuinely sincere and went as far as sending us two twenty five dollar gift cards with a personal invitation in an attempt to make things right. Moreover, he promised that if we would give him the opportunity to redeem himself that he would personally oversee our service to include ensuring procedures for patrons with food allergies would be adhered to which, obviously were not in our previous visit. We decided to oblige him. While the service the second time was better than the first, we found that the food was unappealing despite the manager's best efforts to win us over. Perhaps we were jaded from our previous dining experience, perhaps the chef was having a bad night, in either case we will not be patronizing Carrabba's again.

Love the atmosphere and the food is very tasty.
The bartenders know how to make a delightful cocktail! Try the cucumber, basil and mint vodka drink on their drink menu! soooo good!

We tried the chicken empanadas and they were a bit over cooked and very greasy =(

I grew up in Brentwood and became hooked on brisket from eating a Judge Bean's BBQ.  She grew up in North Carolina and loves that chopped,sweet bbq flavor.  After searching around Nashville for our go-to BBQ place, we finally settled on Edley's. 

Almost every Friday night we both venture over to Edley's 12South location, and skip the line where you order at the counter because if we can find 2 seats at the bar, of course with our favorite bartender Ashlee, then you are able to order and eat there. Let me just say that as of right now I have now eaten everything on the menu, including the daily specials, which leads me to my favorite...The Rib Sandwich. (Pictured)  

The Rib Sammie is my favorite, and is only available on Friday and is served with a heaping stack of Edley's rib meat pulled right off the bone, a dallop of cole slaw, 4 or 5 fried pickles, and red/white bbq sauce.  It. is. amazing.  I go with Mac and Cheese for my sides and pour the BBQ sauce on top, which may not sound great, but it puts me in my happy place.
 
My wife has her favorite at Edley's as well. In her words "the best pulled pork in Nashville, not to smoky, but still has bountiful flavor so that you don't have to drown it in sauce."  She loves the cornbread! Just try it and you will know exactly why.

Other favorites: The Tuck Special Sandwich (Brisket, Over-Easy Fried Egg, Smoked Pimento Cheese, and red/whites sauce) and the Catfish is really good.

It's the Cracker Barrel. You generally know what you get coming here. The service is excellent though. We eat lunch here occasionally and are always impressed by the service. Lunch rush is not bad, we are served quickly and the meals are always correct.
This place was terrible. The bartender is rude and talks to herself... Sorry bitches to herself while people order. I would avoid this place.

Update: This Robert guy, affiliated with the "restaurant," possibly, chose to cyberbully me instead of dealing with the fact that the food is expensive and shitty? I haven't been back, but I HAVE been downtown and convinced a lot of people to go ANYWHERE else. This place does not deserve to be in business.

We had dinner on Saturday night and Brunch on Sunday morning.  Dinner was underwhelming and nothing to write home about.  They prepared my meal much more well done than I expected and took it off of the bill - which was nice because it really wasn't very good, especially for the price.  Bland, simple side dishes at dinner.  Service for beverages was slow for both dinner and brunch.  My wife and I received slightly different menus for dinner, which seemed odd.

Brunch was actually really good.  Hard to save room for the impressive array of desserts at brunch.

I wouldn't go back again for dinner, too many great options in the area.  I might consider Brunch again.
This is an amazing experience every time i go. I go with a group or some times go alone. Tea selection is wonderful, service is so sweet and food is really taste

I've had bad experiences here before but tonight was the worst. At 7pm I ordered online. I ordered a hot roast beef sandwich with extra cheese and au jus. It took almost 2 hours for the order and when it arrived there was no au jus. When I called I was first told they would sent a new sandwich but then he said no they were closed. 

This is not the first time this happened. Last month I placed the same order and the same thing happened. 

All I want is what I paid for. There are too many other places that deliver that want my business.

We first went to the corner pub and there's a 35 minute wait. We decide to look for another restaurants with less waiting time. I called over to squeakers barbecue and there's no wait. We were very glad that we decide to go over there the food was excellent, much better than anything at the corner pub and the service was very nice.
Very nice. The Osso Buco special was excellent, and the Merlot was delicious. I'll come back for sure. My companion had the Salmon and was quite pleased as well.

Sunday afternoon lunch. Walked in to sit at the bar, which had no customers sitting there.  Full of dirty plates and cups, salsa/chip containers. Proceeded to sit down - literally in front of the bartender who had his head down. Instead of offering to clean up the mess immediately in front of us, he just handed us menus. Shortly thereafter, we were brought chips/salsa. Over halfway through the chips/salsa, someone came to clean the mess. Only then did the    bartender ask if we're ready to order (not if we wanted a drink - smh!).
Food was average at best once delivered.
Lots of employees just standing around talking to one another & checking their phones.
Walked right past (4) of them as we were leaving - not one said "thank you" or "come again".
Horrible - never again!

I had placed an order for delivery at the wedge location and the manager at the Longley location was unwilling to deliver my food that I had placed and order for yesterday. What type of customer service is that when I had to reach out about not getting any information about my order until I reached out to both locations.

Crappy.
I've had fun sitting at the communal table.  It's on the expensive side for SB, but definitely one of the best restaurants in town.

Other than the weird drive-thru setup, everything gets a thumbs up here.

First off, the place is clean, so that shoots down one of my restaurant pet-peeves (what's another term for pet peeve? I have a pet peeve with the term pet peeve).

The burger really is a tasty little sucker, for around $5. If you're not into gluten, they'll wrap it in lettuce for you. Fries are pretty good too (wish I could make them like this), as are the shakes (Oreo cookie is awesome).

I've heard they have pizza, maybe that'll get a try next time. Or maybe the hot dog? Or maybe I'll just stick to that tasty little burger... 

Oh, and they have beer too.

Good food but a horrible funky smell in here. The atmosphere is kinda lacking but I suppose this is a delicatessen so what do you expect.  The biggest issue is the stank. Time to change the mop water... Hard to eat when it smells like a dirty bar.

The winner for best service on our four day trip to Santa Barbara definitely goes to our server here, Lee W. She was very knowledgeable, friendly, and attentive. Food was good as well...they have calamari strips which she informed us upon ordering and it was actually really good. Fried shrimp, fries, and onion rings were all very good. The fried red snapper was just ok. Awesome views too!

Wanted to try this place forever. Waited outside on a beautiful day for about 20 min. We got the sweet potato pancakes with non wet whipped cream (acts like butter). Then you pour the cinnamon cream on top...HEAVEN!!! We also got the Santa Fe corn cakes. These were also delish. Not sweet at all unless you add the provided maple syrup. If you love cornbread, you will love these!!
I would gladly come back here. Also eggs and non breakfast sandwiches available. It's a sit down place. You just have to wait in line for a table. Good service. Good was served hot and fairly fast.

The best breakfast place I've found so far in the 208 area!!! Hugee portions and the best menu selection I've found! The staff was super nice and the prices are reasonable. Both dishes were AMAZING and I have yet to find any breakfast potatoes that even compare to theirs! Moe Joe's is a must!

One word, Awesome! This place is awesome top to bottom. The steak, cooked perfectly. The salmon,  I will order next time. So beautifully prepared and presented. The staff are amazing as well. Sherod, if he is on, ask for him. He knows his stuff. Drinks, strong but not overpowering. Just go and thank the reviewers later. Lol.

10/10 people will say that the original Willie Mae's Chicken is better.
I can't confirm that because I've only been to this location.

Willie Mae's chicken batter is different than any chicken batter I had before. It's thin and airy. The seasoning is good, flavorful. I still need ketchup though. I choose the 3 piece (thigh, wing, & drum). I requested to exchange the drum for a wing and the server said they didn't do that.

I picked green bean w/ rice and gravy as my side. The green beans were okay. I have tasted better green beans. I also tried the red beans and cornbread muffins. I have eaten better red beans and cornbread.

This is our number one restaurant. The prices are beyond reasonable, the sushi and cuisine are amazing, and the staff are so kind. We love the owner/head sushi chef. He is so great! Oh and they are open late! (huge plus)
In short:  the wait staff was inattentive and needed to be flagged down with much effort, the food took forever to come, and finally, we were served raw quail.

Wing Stop, is one of the most affordable meals, that Reno could offer a college student. The meals are not that expensive. For example you could buy a meal with 10 wings, any two different flavors, with a basket of fries. The meal is cooked, right when it is ordered. And it should take up to about 14 minutes to prepare the meal. So you know the meal is fresh. 

The service that the employees provides make you feel as if you are in a family oriented environment. The environment is very clean. They clean up after everyone that leaves, 

THis is a great place to go

I wore a face shield into their restaurant in an attempt to respect the mask ordinance, even though I have a medical condition where I can't wear masks. I had to take it off because I had a severe non triggered panic attack from the rebreathing of CO2. I notified who I thought was a hostess but was actually a manager and was informed of their policies and asked if I had a card from the doctor. After doing the same with the General manager I was again notified of their policies or that I would have to take curbside or to go if I couldn't wear it while in the aisles.  He even had the gall to send me an email making yet more excuses about his behavior and the behavior of his manager.  What I can't understand is how they act this way when frankly their food is mediocre at best.  I watched a customer choke on their olive oil mix which clearly was using a blended substandard oil.  I had Sirloin steak fajitas with tiny ramekins of salsa, sour cream and lettuce. I had to ask for tomatoes. Seriously?  This restaurant can't even offer a Sirloin Steak and baked potato? Sorry but Bascoms and Berns are leagues better. Even Longhorn and outback of all places are better than this place.  At least other restaurants treat me with respect. They'll never get my business again.

Wow not impressed.
$8 for the bread plate, the highlight but not much for the $
The sides, mac n cheese with a strange flavor and 1/2 a sweet potato with a unwelcome suprise of marshmallow spread all over them. $4.50 each?
The chicken was ?
Heavy coating, well done and just OK, I guess. $18 for half, the breast is deboned which was a surprise.
It was a little to hippster and for me, to be told you can't have a Bud but we have Busch or PBR and then pay too much for mediocre food.
The bourbon list ls impressive.

I read some of these reviews and think, these MFers must be high. Is this their first time eating sushi? (if the California rolls are any hint!) First and foremost, the rolls are SMALL and you only get 6 pieces per roll. That right there makes this a two star sushi place in my books for $6-9 rolls. To top it off, the rolls that I ordered are made with the rice on the inside of the seaweed. There is a slight taste and presentation difference here. If you can score the 1000 point open table, or the living social deal, that makes this more worth it. But you shouldn't have to have a coupon to make a restaurant worth going to! However, that being said, I would continue to go here if the coupons keep getting pumped out. 

Aside from that, the restaurant is huge, and is nicely decorated. The staff was friendly and service was appropriate. 

All credit cards seem to be accepted here. 

Food Quality/Taste =  4 Stars
Portion Size Given Price = 2 Stars
Price = 3 Stars
Service = 3 Stars
Experience with Staff = 3 Stars
Decor = 4 Stars

I am shocked to have realized I never wrote a review for Surrey's, yet it is one of my most visited brunch spots! I am never let down by the food quality or fresh juice selections. I always seem to get an egg dish except for one time I actually got the ginormous banana pancake...wow. Delicious! I fought to finish the whole thing, but alas, I could not finish. Even after a 5K!

The wait is usually never too long, and on nice days, one must sit outside on the patio!
 
My only issues are when I forget cash and have to use their ATM (fee addition) and the price of the juices (as much as a meal almost!). Otherwise, l heart Surrey's!!!
Had the seared scallop appetizer absolutely delicious served with asparagus and broccoli cooked just right !

This is easily my favorite Thai place around. They know their regular customers, the food is exquisite, I have had everything from their pad Thai to curry, to drunken noodles. I have loved every dish I have had. I love that they are really family based and genuinely nice when we are there. My favorite thing there is probably the fact they make their hot oil and curry paste, fresh there. They are both super flavorful and have just the perfect amount of heat.

Real mugs!  Most coffee places give you a paper cup with a plastic lid even if you're going to stay there. Not this place unless you're taking it to go. They have big ceramic mugs so if feels like home. 
The food is light, limited and tastes great. 
They display local artists work on the walls. 
Oh yeah the coffee is wonderful. I drink it black so I can actually taste it. 
It's not incredibly acidic or bold. It's a bit nutty and nice and soft. 
What a great spot in a great neighborhood. 
Thanks Henry!

I am so excited that Unit Su Vege is within walking distance of my office. The staff is so warm and welcoming. The food is delicious and they deliver via GrubHub. They are definitely worth a try. And the lunch specials come with rice, soup and a spring roll. Enough food for two meals, for less than $10.00!

This shop is hidden in a rundown strip mall front that is easy to miss. I was brought here by local friends and they drove by the store by accident. 

Walking in the restaurant you immediately spot multiple tables of Korean retirees out to lunch, which is good sign. The tofu soup at this place is on par with ones I've had in LA and NYC, and the 6 refillable banchan were good - included kimchi, bean sprouts, cucumber, broiled potato, fish cakes. Service was speedy, 10 minutes from ordering to food arrival (I timed it.)

Pudge's is a must stop joint when we find ourselves in Conshohocken. Vintage decor and a good sandwich. You can't go wrong. I typically don't stray from that combination because I'm usually looking for my cheesesteak fix when I come. Parking is easy. It's wirt

The ambiance and decor had me at hello. Excellent service by our waiter Eric, the sushi he suggested, the 3 Musketeers, was nothing short of exceptional though yes, a bit pricey. The saki and seaweed salad were also delicious. I would definitely recommend it and would go again. I heard they have great HH specials.

I have been coming to Berns' for 45 years.  I haven't lived in the Bay Area in many years. Every time I come to Florida, I find an opportunity to visit Berns'


Berns' is simply the BEST. Everything they do, is done in enhance your dining experience. Everything is the very best of quality available. 

Please keep in mind, these are dry aged steaks. They look similar, but taste much different than fresh cut meat. Most people understand, and appreciate the different taste experience. Some reviewers seem to have completely missed this point, comparing Berns' steaks to fresh cut, not dry aged steaks served by Ruth Chris, and virtually every other chain affiliated steak house. While fresh cut meat is delicious, it's not comparable to dry aged. 

We had the chateaubriand for 2. One of the best pieces of red meat I have ever tasted. 

The onion soup, the steak house salad, the loaded baked potato, and at least 1 vegetable are included in the price of the entree, making the over all cost here very reasonable. 

Be sure to visit the dessert room, and try a scoop of macadamia nut ice cream. 

The service, the atmosphere, and most importantly, the meat, are the best you can get, anywhere.

Great food and good service, never had a bad meal here.had the wings with Caribbean jerk sauce and cold beer on draft, what else could you ask for. Logan's has always been good to me and my family and I am a customer of theirs from here on out.

I ordered over the phone around 7am and went to pick it up at 7:30. Was greeted at the door and able to pick up my order. (Scrambled eggs, pork bacon, french toast for $5.25) Not bad for the price. The french toast was three pieces of bread soaked in the egg mixture....nothing special...not thick bread most places usually use for french toast. It was the kind of french toast I could have made at home with regular white bread. The scrambled eggs and bacon were also OK. The pancakes I happened to notice on the grill appeared to be fluffy and delicious. Will try them next time! Will definitely go again. THIS PLACE IS CASH ONLY, BUT THERE IS AN ATM NEAR THE DOOR.

Best brisket in Boise! 

I am a brisket snob, and this is the best I've had in this county. It was so good I wasn't going to let any sauce near it, but I had to try just a little of their sauces. They were all amazing, especially the Carolina sauce. You won't find anything like it in the area. Very pleased and will definitely be back to try the other meats.

Ordered the Chicken Tikka Dinner and the shrimp apolla for pick up. Well apparently their printer was broken so they didn't start makin my food until I arrived. The Shrimp is ok but bland! I ordered the spice level Medium. And the chicken is extremely dry and bland as well. The dinner entree came with naan & rice, which of those items helps with the super dry, over cooked BLAND chicken! Will never order from them again! One star for effort

Stopped in for lunch with my daughter after a visit to the arch. Great thin crust pizza. Free giant muffin rolls. Great service. Great prices. 
Fish tank ledges are a little dirty. Otherwise a great place and atmosphere.

-Rubbery lobster tail
-Extremely over cooked meat
-Shorted our ice cream and green tea
-Servers acting like "zombies" 
-Small, overpriced plates


This is the first review I have ever written.  I registered with Yelp to specifically write this review.  When a dining experience is this inexcusable  that I have to go out of my way and take time out of my schedule to warn others to rethink their decision to go to Benihana's, that should be your first warning!  My wife and I ordered from the six course menu.  She had the steak and lobster tail. I had the teriyaki combo - chix, steak and shrimp.  The steak which we both ordered rare was cooked well done.  Plates were about $40 each and were supposed to be six courses.  I was handed the check immediately upon finishing my main course.  We were not offered green tea or ice cream (both items part of the meal).  Our children's meals were brought to the table about half way into our main course.  Honestly, at the risk of loosing you, the readers, interest I'm going to stop now.  It was our first and last time to a Benihana's.  I was under the impression we were going out for fine dining.  Isn't that the image Benihana's promotes?   I've had MUCH BETTER meals at the cheap buffet for $25 vs $120!  Save your time, money and frustration - eat ANYWHERE ELSE!
Amazing pastries and great location. I walked there so I'm not sure what parking is like. Unsweetened matcha is hard to find and my day was MADE when they told me they had it!

Heard a lot about this place from one of my cousins  who lived in Indianapolis. My husband and I decided to go  there for a pre - anniversary dinner. Since we are in Nashville for a few days. The food was excellent freshly cooked to order, the portions were more than enough.  Crystal our waitress made the experience awesome  she asked had we been here before and if we were celebrating anything. Told her our anniversary in few days but wouldn't be in town. She went the extra mile from being to end about the restaurant and specials on the menu. At the end of dinner she brought us the most delicious lemon cookies with one candle burning  and took our picture. Maggiano's is our new go to spot  when visiting Nashville.

Hard to customize the flavor of the drinks you want.  Or at least, I've not like their tea lattes very much, and I keep trying. Definitely cozy with all the options for seating, but I've tried several drinks here and I'm not sure the price justifies the product. They actually have wifi, which works pretty well, so that's a good way to get out of the house and get some work done. The baked goods and sandwiches are about average for a coffee shop, except Green Line has done vegan and vegetarian options which is a necessity for these parts. 

Overall, nothing crazy about this place, but they keep a clean bathroom and every time I walk by, I see a few of the same regulars chilling around. Lots of students, it seems, and near a lot of restaurants. With more people in line, service can be super slow, so unless you come at off hours, expect a wait in the cramped area up near the counter when you walk in.
I've not been here since covid and I miss it. I crave the Chili Colorado. And the salsa. And the beans. Yep, it's yummy and the staff has always been very friendly.

Cute decore.  Walked in not knowing what to expect. I had the rise and shine with a side salad.  The vinagerette was delicious. Wish they had bottles if it i could buy.  The sandwich itself was so good. Great hangover sandwich ;-)   I will definitely be returning to try more!
We were in St. Petersburg on vacation and found Larry's. The ice cream was good but the homemade Italian gelato was amazing.
The duck and pho spices appetizer is AMAZING!! We also got the pork belly sliders and the short rib sliders-everything was incredible! Can't wait to come back and try more!!

I think that the recent local movement that Reno has had is spoiling me. Chain restaurants like Chili's certainly seem to be going downhill while more local restaurants are on the rise. 

At my most recent visit here, the service was mediocre for a non-busy night and the food wasn't quite up to par. The appetizer was overcooked and the tilapia I had for the main meal was kind of soggy. Chili's is fine for a chain restaurant and an average dining experience but if you're just visiting Reno, I highly recommend checking out our local offerings.

I've only been here for ice cream desserts, but it's a fun place for that, and both the ice cream and the hot fudge are delicious.  We often come with our little girl if we're out in the city on a weekend afternoon, and she loves the "fancy" space, which sets it apart from other options in town.  Definitely kid friendly during the day.

If not for the second bartender this would have been a one star review. First bartender was inattentive and didn't listen when I asked for water initially, so that took about 10 minutes to get when she came by a second time.
