I had a picture of my driver's license on my phone but they said nope. Grrr... that's okay, they are just trying to keep their liquor license. I understand. Food came out... I ordered 4 tacos, it was 2 for 1 Taco Tuesday with a purchase of a beverage (can be non-alcoholic). The Al pastor (pork and pineapple) was not tasty at all - I didn't even finish it. The skirt steak was pretty good. The shrimp was just okay. The best one was actually the red snapper, it's grilled with a nice slaw.
I would probably go for the taco Tuesday and just get red snapper.

When you first enter this place, you'll find that it's especially busy if you're here around happy hour, which is from 5 pm to 7 pm every day. After that time, the place clears out a bit. The impression that I got from this was that the food was really not the reason why people come here; the drinks are. And that turned out to be at least somewhat true, at least for myself.

This is the second time I've tried this place. Often times, I'll give a place a second try because I didn't feel the meal and/or service the first time was fully representative of the place in question. This was one of those places. The first time I came here, I ordered to go right before my overnight shift, at 11 pm. I got an ancho chicken burrito that was absolutely horrible. What made it horrible was the chicken, not the other ingredients in the burrito. The chicken was dry, pasty, and nasty! I chalked it up to the time being so late, and also because no other customers were around that night so the food must not have been so fresh.

Today, I came with a friend and wanted to try a few different things to give this place a more well-rounded review. I had a shrimp burrito today, and my friend had empanadas, pork carnitas tacos, and a few drinks. I have to say that today was much better than the first time, which I'd have rated a 1/5 if I was going by just that time alone. Today, it's a solid 2/5 on Yelp.

A lot of the items were hit or miss, and that's why I had to settle at this rating. Some items were really good, and some were really bad. I'll start by saying that the salsa and chips was OK. The salsa itself was fine, nothing amazing. The chips were bad in my opinion. They were overly thick, which some people might like. But they also had a really bad aftertaste that I just couldn't put my finger on.

Another thing to note was that a lot of the menu items weren't available. For instance, they had no chicharron despite it being on their regular menu. They also didn't have any of the desserts on their "Cantina's Favorites" menu. As a place that serves Latino food (or an Americanized version of it at least), they also had no regular, raw onions. That was really weird. The cheesecake also tasted really bad.

**** NOW for the service.**** The service here SUCKS! It wasn't even that busy after the happy hour rush passed, and the waitresses weren't attentive at all. They didn't check up on us. We had to keep flagging them down for everything we wanted. And when we did flag them down, they were quick to pay attention to only one of us, and not notice the other one who also wanted something - then, we'd have to flag them again as soon as they turned around. I actually was gonna rate this place slightly higher at a 3/5, but the service was just so bad. Especially for the fact that the cheesecake tasted like pure crap, and she didn't even comp it or offer anything in return for the crap cheesecake. We were still charged for it, because I think she wasn't even listening when my friend mentioned how off it tasted.

Some of the food items were actually really good, though, I will add. The stars of the show today were the pork carnitas tacos, the shrimp burrito, and the fried ice cream. I do not recommend the empanadas or the cheesecake. The empanadas tasted incredibly sweet/gingery, like someone added far too much ginger and sugar where it didn't belong. My friend remarked that the carnitas had a good flavor to them. The shrimp burrito did as well. The fried ice cream was coated in some cereal-like concoction that was just delicious.

Overall, I'm not excited or in a rush to come back to this place. Maybe someday, but there are too many other places on my list to make this place a regular spot, especially when things weren't so good not once, but BOTH times I came here. In summation, the service sucks and that's a major factor in not coming back. Also, plenty of items are just hit or miss on the menu, so you'll need to do a bit of experimenting to get the right item, and by that time you'll probably already be $70 deep in the bill like we were.

I've been to this place a few times since it has opened and every time it's gets better and better. I feel every time I go they change there menu which is awesome because I get to try something different every time. There beers on tap are really good and always have good rotating seasonally! I had Troegs Nugget Nectar the last time I was there( Citrus amber ale) Also there wine list is always changing and not overly priced which is good because my girlfriend loves wine! She knows way more than me and always says its really good and doesn't kill my wallet. When we got there we got sat in about 10mins but we waited at the bar and the bartender was really nice. I think he's name was Gabe and he was very personably and never waited for a drink. We got sat in the front section where the TV's are and the flyers game was on so I could watch and still have a nice meal. Our server was very nice and knew a lot about the menu which was very impressive because it was a lot to remember. Her name was Christina and was wonderful! She kept making sure our drinks were filled and if we needed anything. So my girlfriend got the mac and cheese shorts ribs as her app because she loves them so much and I got the caprese salad. Both were excellent!  Then for our entrees my girlfriend had the scallops which she couldn't finish because they were huge but thats good for me because then I have leftovers! I had the skate which I never even heard before but it was so good and was reasonably priced at like $20 and they give you two huge pieces. We were so full after dinner but Christina said we had to try the Bread pudding for dessert which I was glad that we got because it was amazing! It was warm with ice cream! Everything was great 100% recommend this place to anyone who loves good food, wine, and great atmosphere! Great Service too!

I generally rave about Giordanos, however this trip wasn't the best. 
The restaurant was nearly empty and the service was pretty slow and when we received our pizza it was dripping with grease.  The taste was a little bland. 
I'm thinking we caught this location on an off day, but I think I will stick with one of the Chicago locations.

Excellent smoked BBQ meats.  The BBQ is tender, well cooked and jiucy.  My favorite is the thin end rib dinner with collards and Mac n Cheese.  Smoked sausage is also terrific. The place is very smoky with the huge pit right behind the counter but exactly what you expect in a sho-nuff BBQ Joynt. A mixed crowd dines in or take the goodies with them.

As a frequent traveler I eat at more chic fil a than most and my 2 recent visits were excellent. The staff was attractive and friendly and the portions were ample. Trust me portions aren't always consistent. My only problem was parking which isn't a premium at this location. There is a large strip mall parallel with more parking but if it's raining or dah hot not convenient but overall great location.

Great bar with a solid beer and alcohol selection. The food is also pretty decent. Couple plasma TV's add a nice touch and it's definitely the only bar I go to in Old City when I am looking to kick back and talk with friends or watch a game.

Atmosphere gets 5 Stars
Service and Food get1 or less...

We were thrilled to know a new eatery/bar was opening near Vail and thought for sure it would be our new hang out.

I am so disappointed in Hot Rods.. the food is mediocre, the service is crappy and the cost is high. The atmosphere is definitely one of a kind, just wish we could say the same about the food.

I've been here several times. For a bar and grill, they have great homemade food.  Either at the bar or in the dinning room, service on the other hand has always lacked. This is a 2 star place. I gave it 3 because they are fighting an uphill battle in the declining city of Trenton.

Good grief, so many people blasting E-Bar.

I've got great college memories getting sloshed at E-Bar, eating free happy hour grub, listening to live reggae music and watching planes land at the tiny podunk airport in its backyard. 

Back in the day, before there were more than 2 or 3 Elephant Bars (that I know of), this was the place to be.  Yeah, yeah, the food is not great, but its good enough.  I also sold their corporate office like 100  shirts from Eddie Bauer (the one that used to be in La Cumbre Plaza) and my manager stole my sale!

This is a good restaurant, it's presented nicely and the food is great. The service was nice, and the environment is welcoming. 

I had the fish tacos, they were crispy and the sides were flavorful. Though the food is tasteful, it's apparent that this is not authentic Mexican food (yet still good). 

What stood out the most to me was the horchata, it was visually appealing and was sweet just how I like it.
Big points for the portioning, worth the money

Big John's was one of the best.  Here lately they've slacked off on their quality and service.  They're usually so nice it's a shame to have to give them a poor review, but nothing changes without feedback.  They could do better but they don't seem to evolve for the better and are content with where they are. The last two times I went there, it wasn't what I expected. First, they got the order wrong, which can happen and there is a "no return" policy; but, when this last time I went there, the pork sandwich was nothing but grisly and fat with a smidgen of pork.  That's when I knew I wouldn't be back for a long time.  I do hope their standards and quality improve.

NY pizza and More!  Spaghetti and meatballs were pleasantly good.Salads were fresh and the creamy basil dressing was very tasty!  Garlic rolls were yummy but the inch deep of butter at the bottom of basket was scary and messy!

We all rcvd giant portions that were very tasty!  Don't understand why there was lots of wait staff and only 2 guys were busting their guts to wait the entire restaurant?!

Minus 1 star for my hubby's chicken Marsala.  If you don't use real Marsala wine, it ain't gonna taste right. Boo, you gots a liquor store now next door, they can order it for you!

Low key and not crowded on a Saturday night (perhaps a bad thing?). Service was attentive. I had a tasty grilled chicken sandwich with pesto and red peppers...a sizable portion with good fries. My friend had a huge cobb salad. The prices and the portions will bring us back!
Crappy food- wait staff slow. Beer and atmosphere great- but for the birds. I'll stick to brown county's

I was referred by someone to come here and holy cow. I'm so happy I stopped in. From the people to the food everything is amazing. 
I got the andouille & grits and it was perfect. If you are in the area this is not one to pass on.

Great food horrible service. The waiter made a mistake on my Order and brought out the wrong thing.  Not one apology.  And he then avoided our table.  I was excited to visit again since the food was so good.  But it's not worth a 3rd time since service is something i value.  So no

The food was great, and the workers were super friendly. I don't know what these people are talking about in their reviews. Prices are great and food tastes great. You will walk out full and satisfied for less than 8 dollars. Some of the reviews complain about flavor...the way i see it is, Don't pay for meatloaf and expect filet mignon. For the money the food was great! Totally coming back!

Excellent establishment, the food is on point and the boba teas/smoothies are a must have. It's tooled away in a nice plaza, and the experience from beginning to end is very organic. Don't be fooled by this place they can cook, game day wings for large gatherings and a wide range of food options makes this place a no brainer for the whole family.

Well I have to start off by saying the food is delicious here.  But they are not cheap for the Exton area as most of their dinners are $17+ each.  Their Chicken Tikka Masala and Thai Red Curry (chicken) are delicious in my book along with their Garlic Naan (rosemary naan was just OK).   The interior is very nice and well lit and the owner and staff are quite nice.   They have a tandoor oven on site and it shows with their great food.   I could eat here more then once a week, if it didn't cost $40 a meal for 2 people!

I heard good things about their lunch buffet, but have not gone yet.

Horrible service and way overpriced.  Took 15 minutes and flagging our waiter just to order food. Waiter walked past us many times without inquiring about our needs and we found ourselves asking other help (busboy once and once got up to ask the bartender) to get us something.  Wouldn't have been as big of a deal if some kind of acknowledgement of poor timing was made but it wasn't. Not even a simple "I'm sorry I know things are taking longer".  Then took another 15 minutes after finished eating to request our check and our plates were never cleared. If I want to pay $4.50 to add 20 mediocre french fries to a $15 cheeseburger I'll go someplace with better service (overpriced sandwiches don't come with any side, not even $0.35 worth of potato chips!).

I am just sad I did not have enough days to come back here to try their other sandwiches. If you have time, try to avoid the lunch crowd since there seemed to be a lot of office people coming here for lunch.

sammich is absolutely a gem I'd rather not share for selfish reasons of keeping this menu and staff to myself BUT this crew is too phenomenal to not gain full credit for being one of the ABSOLUTE must pass by uptown restaurants! From the ever-changing seasonal menu to joe knowing what you drink before you do..you'd be a fool to not stop by!! WHO DAT!

This place was featured on Food Network a couple of times, so I had to try it.  

I expected a long line, but the line goes super fast.  The place is always packed, but there's always plenty of seating outside.

Had the 1/2 rack of dry rub ribs with mac n cheese and fries.  Also ordered some drinks at the bar while I waited.  

The ribs is what I expected!  It was fall off the bone good, with the spices not overpowering.  You can see the awesome amount of dry rub the place on your ribs, but the taste was nothing less of perfect!  

Nothing spectacular with the mac n cheese and fries.  The ribs is where it's at.

I'll definitely come back here again next time I visit Nashville!!

Where do I start? The food was so tasteful and fast. Our waitress jasmine was such a delight! She was beyond friendly and truly cared for all her tables. She checked in on us all the time and made sure we had everything we needed! I will be going back only because of her and of course the yummy food!

Before we get into the review of Zia's, let's talk about the outside of Zia's. There are a few curbside tables where diners were eating, and a guitar-playing musician playing for them. And by playing for them, I mean directing a hurricane of sound away from ZIa's wall out onto the neighborhood. We had a wait of about 45 minutes for a table, during which time this ridiculously loud music continued. We actually crossed the street around the corner from the musician to try to get a bit away while we waited for our table because the music was so loud.

Now, on to the actual restaurant:

The service was perfunctory. Zia's was quite busy, but part of going out is the service aspect, and you want more than just your water to be refilled by the designated water-jug-guy. Our waitress was too busy to ask us how our food was, and forgot to bring by a sauce that we requested for our appetizer until we asked a second time.

The food was delicious. If I was breaking things down on serving size, the food would get a 5. Flavor is more like a 3 or 4. The chicken parmigiana looked like it came off the bird version of a Dolly Parton; seriously, this was the largest chicken breast I think I've ever seen. If I had had anything else to eat that day I would have had to take some home. That said, the red sauce was pretty much just tomato, and so it was an enormous, tomato-flavored chicken breast. If there was some garlic or other spices in the sauce, they were't evident. Maybe that's how it's supposed to be, but if so, it made it pretty plain tasting.

Best: Good bread, free appetizer of toasted ravioli because we checked in w/yelp, huge portions.

Worst: Food a little bland, server didn't seem that attentive, music while you wait pretty aggresive.

First time eating here - EXCELLENT!  Took some customers to dinner, everyone had a great time..  Felt the quantity of food was just right- had the 2 meat with 2 sides BBQ, wasn't able to finish the plate and I TRIED!

I would highly recommend, especially for customer visit - felt the price was extremely fair for the number of people we had.

 4 stars do to the wait, had a 6:30 reservation for 14...they were not prepared for our arrival and had to scramble to seat us 15 minutes late.  With a group our size, our table should have a dedicated waiter - unfortunately our waiter, though he busted his butt, was spread entirely to thin.

I wish we'd read the reviews before going, but it was a spur of the moment choice.  My suggestion would be to eat before you go and plan on wasting some money. 

I didn't see much in the way of vegetarian choices besides the beer battered portabella tacos.  The staff was very accommodating when I asked if the mushrooms could be grilled instead of deep fried.  I was told the tacos came with aioli sauce and lettuce and a salad on the side.  My husband ordered the basil parmesan shrimp.

Most restaurants serve portions that are way too large, but Proper has apparently decided to over correct.   My 3 tacos, 2 tiny portabella slices each, were served on tiny tortillas (about 3" diameter).  The aioli sauce must have been applied, sparingly, with an eye dropper and the lettuce contained in the tacos amounted to something akin to one blade of grass per taco.  The side salad consisted of various types of lettuce amounting to approximately a quarter of the volume of a typical small restaurant side salad.  Again, I think the dressing was applied with said eye dropper.  I don't like my food/salad drowned in sauce or dressing, but I do like to be able to taste it.  When I tell you that my entire meal was about 50 calories and contained little, if any, nutrition I am being generous.  I'm not a big eater, but this hardly qualifies as sustenance.  This was on the dinner menu, but it was barely enough to qualify as an appetizer.  The only thing good I have to say about my dinner is that it looked pretty on the plate. Taste...the mushroom slices were under cooked and slimy, the tortillas were horrible.

My husband's shrimp dinner was about the side of a slider.  He described it as three small shrimp tails on a mound of goo.  He fared a bit better calorie wise but we were both hungry and went out for a slice of pizza immediately after.

The food was way overpriced for the portion sizes and we left feeling as though we had been taken.  So if you feel like making a donation to a restaurant go to Proper.

Save your money and go downtown!!!! Worst service ever. We came on a Friday night at 9pm, they close at 10:30. It was not busy and people were coming before closing. They kept walking past my table and we had to continually ask for more meat. What also bothered me was, I felt that they didn't serve us the full selection different meats. I probably had 6 out of the 13 meats. The meats I ate were cooked and seasoned good but one was burnt on the outside but that doesn't bother me too much. Also we had to wait 20 minutes for our check to come. We found our server smoking a cigarette outside walking to the car. I would never come back to fogo de chao in KOP AGAIN! I've been to the one in center city Philadelphia multiple times. Outstanding service!!! They would always check on your table, give you refills without asking and unlimited meats coming to your table. Seriously guys the one in downtown philly has never let me down. I wanted to try KOP because I love closer it but now I know downtown is way better!!!!

Nom nom nom. Was in the Kirkwood area to run errands, and thanks to yelp, learned that O Charley's has brunch. Gave them a call to see how busy they usually are, and see if they take reservations. They don't, but they said they're kinda hit or miss on Sunday mornings, as far as having a wait. 

Pros: Brunch, and fluffy rolls.
Cons: There are none. Seriously.

Their breakfast platter is ridiculous. For $12, you get half a waffle, 2 eggs, breakfast potatoes,and a 6 oz steak. And once again, the rolls. I ate half my platter and was stuffed. Still am, and it's 5pm. And I'll have leftovers for breakfast tomorrow. Also, good strong hot coffee, which is always a plus.

I had to restrain myself, because they have chicken and waffles. I'm going to have to try that next time.

This Panera Bread has improved markedly over the last month!  The service was excellent. Staff seemed more organized and focused on customer service. The manager was extremely conscientious and efficient in the way she organizes the staff. The food and the proportion of food was excellent and good quality. Fresh ingredients.

Oh my gosh! My new favorite spot! Came at the last minute as the menu looked good. Shared the carnitas nachos (with beer cheese) and it was more than enough as a starter. I was full but hubs continued on with the Mt Kilimanjaro burger (more beer cheese!) In between his cheesy juicy bites he would utter "oh my gosh!" He was truly impressed which doesn't happen often. He suggests you eat the burger first and dip your fries in the juices and cheese left behind Beers we liked included Winter Roasted Amber Ale and Red Ryder ale. Victoria was our server and was fantastic as well.

Absolutely loved this place!
Sent with my sister last night. 
I was a little nervous because they close at 10 and we were not getting there until 9;15, but the place was packed and everyone greeted is well, like we were not getting there right before closing. 
Zoe, our waitress, was so fun and helpful in deciding what to have for dinner. We just loved her. 
All of the food was prepared so great and was just delicious. 
Many of the other staff stopped by and talked with us as well. Everyone was just amazing. 
Cannot wait to go back ion Wednesday and get the exact same dishes we enjoyed last night. 
You NEED to go here!

The best BBQ I've ever had! The owner & staff are always very pleasant and the food quality & taste is always consistent! I usually get the 3 meat platter, Pork, Chicken and Sausage, Mac & Cheese or cornbread and collard green that have just the perfect bite to them.  The portions are pretty big for the most part and I always take a doggie bag!
Get the mufallata, awesome they make their own olive spread and has special bread you can't get anywhere but in NOLA!

Went there for Saturday lunch. Ordered the Native Burger. The plastic cups our beverages came in were all chipped around the rim. Come on people at some point you need to throw them away. The booth seat I was sitting in was loose and every time I scooted forward came apart. 

Now let's talk about the food. I ate less than 1/2 of the greasy unseasoned burger, after I removed the lettuce which had become more of a filter / pool for the grease.  5 minutes later I was in the bathroom vomiting. No lie. I've never been sick in a restaurant in my life, until then. 

I don't know what's up with this place but stay away. Stay far away. Dirty,  nasty,  broke down and disgusting food.
BBQ shrimp. That is all. You're welcome.  Seriously. This stuff is so good. I must figure out Iowa yo make this stuff at home. I have never had anything like it before.

I'm really glad I gave this location another try. Years ago I had a bad experience with food and service here and never came back for years. I've recently been back a few times and happy to report food and service is good. I like this location better over the Sierra St. location. Mae Ann location is less cramped and less noisy. They have a nice menu selection, something to please everyone. Food quality is food and menu prices are reasonable.  Pegs will definitely be on top of the list for my breakfast and brunch choices.
Excellent food, friendly bartenders, one in particular, Jentri, is extra attentive, knowledgeable and courteous.  Great experience every time.

This restaurant was awful! I will never go there again! I was planning on meeting about 6 of my friends at the Matador on saturday night for my birthday party. When we got there, not only was the hostess incredibly rude to us, but they said we had to wait for 45 minutes--even though I made a reservation a week ago and there were several open tables on the first floor. When I asked to speak to the manager the hostess cursed at me! I've never in my life been treated so poorly anywhere let alone a restaurant where we were potential customers on my birthday. I would never go there again and will definitely make sure to tell everyone in Wayne that I know about this experience as well.
The service was awesome on a quiet, cold Sunday night. We enjoyed our drinks and our food. The oysters Rockefeller were amazing!

Amazing food! Just mouth-watering! 
It's very hard to maneuver if you need ADA/wheelchair accessibility. It is an older building and they will make it work. It's just a bit tidious getting around. Just a heads up. The staff will help you and are very customer oriented.

Just stopped in for lunch and was so disappointed.   Greek Turky wrap was bland and my husband's turkey burger was not worth the $14.00 price especially since you don't even get fries with your sandwich.  The waitress said we could get fries for only $2.00 more.  Well, for the prices they are charging, a few fries or a small side salad would have been nice.  Won't go back.  Overpriced.

Atmosphere is mediocre, people are very nice, and the food is good.  They are known for their sexy fries which are very tasty!  Definitely should try them if you go.  Their isn't a whole lot on their lunch menu, but from what I've had, it's all good.  We've been there several times for lunch, and even brought our 7 year old who now declares its his favorite restaurant!

Love this restaurant! We had a great time and everything was wonderful. Our server was very attentive and friendly, the food was delicious and came out very quickly and the atmosphere is awesome - dark and moody. But why do they play cartoons? I can't figure that one out.

I'm a vegetarian and there were plenty of options for me. My favorites were the fried cauliflower, brie sauce (soooo good) and the OMG salad.

Also, try the sangria, it's delish!

Excellent grouper & red snapper. Cooked to perfection served with a wonderful herbed butter, not overpowering so you could enjoy the fresh delicious fish. Great creamy vinaigrette on the salad. The key lime pie was the best we ever had! Vinny was a fantastic waiter.

Absolutely fantastic ! I've frequented all of the tridents many times and I'm thrilled they opened one on the north side !!!! I went here for Sunday brunch I had crab cake Benedict , which was absolutely delicious ! The serving size is huge , so unless you have a big appetite it's smart to share ! I also had a loaded Bloody Mary  with a soft shell crab on top ! An adorable touch , he even had olives for eyes ! I will be back over and over again!

Fantastic food! Started with the charbroiled oysters- as the first time ever having oysters, so delicious! Buttery, garlic goodness! Had the bbq shrimp and jambalaya- absolutely delectable! My son is not a fan of seafood, so he had a cheeseburger and said it was the best burger he'd ever had- which says a lot! Definitely worth stopping in- everyone was so friendly and food was fantastic!

I've frequent this particular Chick-fil-A (VOORHEES, NJ) at least twice a week or more and usually do not have a problem.  One time a few months a ago i ordered 12 breaded nuggets and there was a hair in one of my nuggets.  I took it back and was going to get a refund but allowed them to replace it. Well i just ordered 12 grilled nuggets today and when i got home the nuggets were RAW.  i bit into one and it was chewy and gritty and then i looked at it and they were PINK.  i went back to the Voorhees, NJ location and showed them the nuggets and they tried to act like they were not raw.  Then i opened up one of them in front of them and then they finally admitted it.  I asked for a refund and the managers said "unfortunately our policy is to replace the item but we can't give refunds"?????  WHAT????? So you can serve patrons raw food and potentially poison them with Samonella but you can't accommodate them do the right thing and give their money back??  I refused to leave until i got my money back and after 10 minutes of them being rude to me and then i was told "You are not allowed in this store anymore.  Take your money and get out!" they finally gave it to me. I could be poisoned with samonella!! I know have to go to the ER to make sure I am not infected. PLEASE DO NOT GO TO THE CHICK-FIL-A IN VOORHEES, NJ ON WHITE HORSE ROAD ACROSS FROM THE TARGET AND BY THE SMOOTHIE KING.  THEY ARE UNCLEANLY AND DISGUSTING!!
Super quick & large beef brisket sandwich. potatoe salad & baked beans were good but unfortunately they dont have any french fries.

This was my Third time visiting and will be my last.
My family from Europe was visiting on their very 1st day (November 20th) so we decided to give this place one last try only because of the proximity from my house.
First thing, when we walked in trying to get a little bite at 9:15 pm after coming from the airport, we asked the hostess if they were still serving. She gave us a look as if we were crazy to "disturb" her that late. She replied "Well, I'll ask my manager", who was just right there by the bar. Next thing she did was taking the menus and taking us back to seat down with an unwelcoming attitude. (I almost left but we had guests). If I were the manager, she would be unemployed right now, and if I was the owner, both of them (as a Manager, he didn't do his job)
From there, the service was less than good. Our feelings were that nobody wants to be working here.
So now here comes the food, we ordered a vegetarian and Margherita pizza, both which came out raw. The only thing we liked was the lentil soup, that's the only reason I gave it 2 stars...
And just one more thing... when my family left and we took them to the airport, they told us "What a great trip and city!!... except for the first night at the Pizza place!!!"
Girl that answered the phone and at the front register was rude and showed no customer service.  Waited too long for pizzas.  Prices are overrated for subpar service and pizza.

Breakfast was not very good and overpriced. Service was slow and they forgot toast and didn't refresh coffee. Add to that the loud country music blaring overhead and it made for a pretty unpleasant experience.

EXCELLENT service and the food was sooooooo good! We ordered the nachos with fries and tri tip, plus a half order of the meat plate with Mac n cheese as the side. Our server was very nice and brought us a sample of ALL of their sauces which was awesome! I LOVED the garlic bbq sauce. Great experience here tonight!

Great spot at the Sirata resort great views of sunset and the Gulf of Mexico. Food is excellent if your expectations are for a beach Bar casual event.  Harry's is also located on the property for easy bar hopping!
Service was good but the food was not.  Very disappointed considering this is basically the only Chinese place in town.

Cute, hipster place, filled with young people. Great menu with lots of choices. I got the Asian Salad, it was delicious and spicy. It was gigantic! Definitely big enough for two people. Could have used some edamame or something to beef it up a bit. But I liked it. Definitely recommend this place

I was looking for the post office and ran across this little cafe. I did not feel like cooking and I dropped in. It is a nice little place. Big dining area and decorated very festive with local art and for Halloween. I ordered the Open Faced Turkey Sandwich that came with Mashed Potatoes and a salad or soup. I had the salad. It was good. My turkey and Mashed were real and fresh!! The waitress was attentive. The price was about average. Looked at the breakfast menu. Very reasonable. I will drop back in here for sure!!!
One last thing they are not on Rte 19 anymore. They are at 6512 Main St , New Port Richey , FL 34653 Phone 727-845-7305

Seems 30/90 is responsive to customer comments. Our last stop in Sunday evening was an incredibly improved experience. Matt and Josh and Holly really had things under control. Service was great. Music was great. We didn't stay for dinner but the pizza looked delicious.

I ordered delivery, so my review is entirely about the food, which wasn't that good.  I got the Massaman Curry, which is one of my favorite foods.  Unfortunately, the curry was thin and had very little flavor.  The tofu was not cooked before it was plopped into the dish, which is disappointing.  I also ordered the Buddha Dumplings, which were okay, if a bit doughy.  I thought the sauce was way too sweet.

I have never tried shawarma wraps, but thought my first time should be at this spot. I was not disappointed at all. This is located in downtown, close to the Truckee River. It is attached to what seems to be an apartment complex. However, the food is delicious regardless of its location. 
I got the lamb shawarma wrap with two different sauces. The menu is small and self-explanatory with numerous sauces to choose from. I would like a bigger menu though. Overall, cool little spot for some shawarma wraps or salads.

Online reservations weren't working so I decided to email them. They responded very quickly and apologized for the inconvenience and manually reserved for two people on their end. I opted for the outdoor seating. Day of the reservation we were seated immediately outside. The weather was pretty chilly but they had space heaters.

Our server, Michael H, was great! He was attentive and joked around saying that aside from his grandma's gumbo, Cafe Amelie was the runner up. 

We got the chicken and andouille gumbo ($8), shrimp & grits ($13), satsuma pepper glazed shrimp ($11), and the lightly black ended catfish sandwich ($15). 

Everything was absolutely delicious. The gumbo was flavorful and actually a perfect comfort food for the chilly weather. The shrimp & grits was my favorite. I could probably eat it every day if I my body would allow it. I've had grits before but nothing could compare to how they make it at Cafe Amelie. Bravo. The shrimp was prepared cold and came with 5 pieces. Sweet and tangy with a little kick. The catfish sandwich was my other favorite: catfish with greens, tomato, Cajun mayonnaise on ciabatta. The Cajun sauce was a great compliment to the fish. The fish itself was tender and cooked well. 

We didn't have room for dessert but we saw someone try the bread pudding and it probably tasted amazeballs judging from the look on the person's face. 

Amazing food and great service. Although I would like to mention that before we left we wanted to take a picture in front of the fountain and asked the host who was standing with another hostess to take one for us. He picked up something and walked away while saying with an attitude: "sorry, I'm working". The woman looked at us with an impatient look on her face and offered to take a photo. 

Gee...Sorry guys for wasting 3 seconds of your life.

My favorite place to go in Ruskin. This is the old Popi's Place V. Apparently the diner wanted a more local feel to the menu and the name. 

We love their breakfasts and the large pies room they give for dinners. My fave Is their fried chicken sandwich. It's huge, hot and tastes great. 

I've attached the new menu since it's not available online - frustrating.

My father is a WWII Veteran and I took him to Applebee's for Veteran's Day. Applebee's did a fantastic job to honor our Military people who have make huge sacrifices for us. Food was awesome and our waitress Nadine was awesome! Thank you Applebee's!

according to the menu, the chicken and waffles is supposed to have ranch and scallions on it too. this obviously doesn't have either of them. The chicken was flavorless and tasted stale and hard. The waffle wasn't anything special. wont be coming here again

Not sure how it only gets 3 stars. I had great experience. Great tasting bacon quiche and large portion to boot! Service was great. Never been here before but it seems no wait staff is assigned to one person. 3 different people waited on me during my visit. All very attentive to my needs. I'd definitely return!

The macaroni salad was not cooked all the way. Being actually from the islands, thats not how it should have been prepared. The owner clearly doesnt know how to prepare local food from Hawai'i; none of it is actually Hawaiian besides the Kalua pork. What a misinterpretation.

I'm going to say that for me Phil's is the best burger in New Orleans.  The prices aren't necessarily cheap but they're more reasonable than most of the new burger places in town and for a sit-down restaurant with nice decor, friendly atmosphere,and outstanding burgers $9.75 for a meal (plus drink cost) isn't bad.  When perusing the menu there's a page of appetizers but the main focus here is clearly "make your own" burgers.  Once you're seated you'll take a look at the menu and smartly all the menus have a large pad of order sheets inside so you can fill out your sheet and tear it out for the server.  The options are huge and they claim over a million possible combinations - on my first visit my wife went for a turkey burger with roasted red peppers, mushrooms, havarti, etc. and she said the burger was cooked perfectly and very tasty.  I got a bison burger cooked medium rare with a number of toppings and it was also cooked perfectly and quite good although the Creole aioli didn't add much.  For sides we tried the potato salad (very good, with a little bit of heat) and the fried pickles which were excellent.  Also, every time our sodas were empty someone would quickly refill them which is always nice.

9.75 gets you a regular beef/turkey/veggie/chicken/portabella burger with a ton of different topping options and a side that are all included.  Even a fried egg is included in the base price as are a choice of fries, sweet potato fries, fried pickles, potato salad, coleslaw, veggies, etc.  The burger is a half pound of perfection and while you can pay $13.99 as I did for a burger with "premium" meats such as filet, bison, tuna, or alligator you don't need to.  I've eaten at most of the major burger places around town and I can say that Phil's Grill is head and shoulders above most.  Very nicely done.

My family and I came to NOLA to visit a friend and she recommended this place for us to try since we really wanted to get some crawfish while we were here. I'm from Los Angeles & there are a million crawfish restaurants but nothing beats this place. We ordered their tradition style and the Cali style. I personally preferred the traditional style, because it wasn't drenched in oily/butter the way they do it back home, & it was still packed with flavor! SO GOOD. The Cali style you can tell has more butter and garlic, which my family loved. So either way you can't go wrong here. They also have drinks along the side of the restaurant so you can choose something to drink & they will charge you at the end, interesting concept, never seen something like that before at a restaurant. Everything was delicious, I know I'll be craving this again once I'm back home.

Do you like Puerto Rican food?  Do you want a mouth orgasm? Then visit this place.  Food is authentic from Puerto Rico.  Stuffed mofongo is delicious.  If you have never tried this, this is the place to start.  It is basically fried plantains, then put in a "pilon" and mashed together.  Then you can fill it with whatever you want,  chicken, steak, and fish.  Service is a little poor here but that's ok for the superb food you get.  It does get a little chilly since they have the ac pretty cool.  Also give the paella a try another authentic plate that needs to be in your life.

Upped my review this time as it was really busy but service and food was great. However another change at Guppys and this is regarding their hot break and their special mixed oil they serve. It used to be standard for lunch and dinner. Its now ONLY dinner so if you are at lunch you have to ASK for it. Come on Guppy, your business is flourishing. Go back to the old traditional way you used to provide food and service to locals before you became so popular.
Ate here last night.  My first taste of Mediterranean cuisine and I was very impressed.  Food was delicious and the atmosphere is very welcoming.  Our waitress Fallon was great!

Nice roomy areas to socialize with large groups of people. However, the food is really not very good. My fish tacos were bland and the taco shell was limp and flavorless. The guacamole and salsa were very average. Other times I've come I've gotten salad or burgers. I'd recommend sticking with burgers and fries, which are decent. The salads were generic- similar to something you'd get at a fast-food restaurant. 
All in all I'd come back for a drink but never again for food.

Today was my first time trying it because I am thinking about going vegan. Let me tell you,  if all vegan food taste as good as Masala it will be an easy switch. Try it and I promise you won't be disappointed. I will probably be here at least 3 times a week. Don't forget the mango juice

I feel like everyone does pizza, but if you're craving some bomb.com pizza for a legit dinner, capaofitto is the way to go. 
They have created a beautiful escape for not only their cafe full of great coffees and gelatos but also their restaurant serving up some great pies. They have a very accommodating and friendly staff that help make your dining experience enjoyable. 
For an app we started with the melanzane. They tasted like Italian falafels, not really anything I would recommend.  
The caponata and quattro stagioni were great pizzas. We went down the vegetarian route, and had plenty of options especially being able to customize everything. 
And to finish the meal, we had three different flavors of gelato. When it's Capagiro gelato, you can't go wrong.
I think it's an old school Italian Restaurant, the food is expensive but a perfect place for a date, or birthday dinner. If you like veal parm don't hesitate to order it.

Stopped by Los Mayas for an early supper.   The building is quite large with about 120 seats, which were virtually empty when I arrived, but filled up a good bit during my time there.  There are lots of windows with street views that let in great natural light.  It's always good to see any restaurant doing some business in downtown Clearwater, as many streets have become somewhat of a wasteland of empty commercial spaces over the years.

Soon a huge basket of fresh, hot and crisp tortilla chips with a medium heat red salsa landed on my table, all very good and a nice start to any meal.  Order taking was prompt, but as the restaurant filled up my waitress was largely absent from checking in (or even being anywhere I could get her attention) for anything I needed.

Los Mayas scored more points right off the bat for serving up my favorite Mexican beer, Bohemia, in an iced mug, a great way to cool down any heat from the food.  The menu was fairly extensive, with ~25 combo lunches/dinners, 11 different fajitas, 5 vegetarian dinners and 30+ house special entrees in beef, pork, chicken and seafood/fish.

I decided to order a basic meal of tacos, enchiladas and beans, and unfortunately a variety of menu options didn't extend to this platter.  Unfortunately, tacos are only served on hard shells with lettuce and white cheese (no option for traditional tacos with soft corn tortillas with cilantro and onions).  Even worse is tacos are only available in ground beef (ughhh) and shredded chicken, a bit disappointing when any average taqueria in a Mexican grocery/convenience store in Clearwater will offer ~8-10 choices of meat for tacos.   I got both a chicken and beef taco and neither were seasoned particularly well or had much flavor.

My 2 enchiladas also had the shredded chicken, and both were smothered in red sauce, with ok flavor, but nothing extraordinary.  The sauce definitely tasted canned, and not fresh or site-made.  On bright spot was the beans which came with a nice white cheese topping.  The beans were quite good compared to many beans I've had at other local Mexican places.   As the serving portions for the entire meal were large, the value was good overall.

If folks are looking for a basic, Americanized Tex-Mex meal in downtown Clearwater, Los Mayas is passable, but there are far better choices not too far away.   Personally, I'd make the short drive over to Drew St. where a number of good Mexican restaurants/taquerias are serving up authentic Mexican flavors and fare.  See my list here:
gulfbreeze.yelp.com/list/most-authentic-mexican-restaurants-in-pinellas-clearwater

My score on a Pinellas Mexican restaurant scale:

Atmosphere:  4
Service:  3
Food:  3
Value:  4
Thus was a surprising little spot. Loved the food and the Doner Kebab was outstanding and a lot of meat inside. I can't believe I have never heard of this place!

The food is fine but my issue is the gal that I seem to get every once in a while to deliver the pizza.  I am already paying more than enough to have the pizza delivered I only live a few blocks away and they charge more than other places to deliver. The girl that delivers is beyond rude and gives me the rudest lesson on tipping what she thinks is acceptable when she delivers.  I purposely do not order from them any more because of her entitled attitude.

So after taking the pizza back and arguing that "the pizza wasn't burnt" "the small pizzas come out that way" it got worse. The owner manhandled the pizza with his bare hands then threatened me to take the review down or I will keep the old burnt pizza. No thanks. I'll just take my money back.

So I found this place totally by accident.  Out one beautiful afternoon, looking for a place to eat that wasnt crowded with tourists and loud people.  Down a quiet side street we stumbled into this place.  I wish it was busier, because the food was fabulous.  I think they are mostly a bar, but I gotta say the Meatloaf was stellar, like some of the best I have had.  Whenever a bar uses a "demi glaze" in their food, you know the cook has some chops.  Drinks were great, including a wicked bloody mary bar (sadly I am not a bloody mary fan).  I hope that this place stays busy because in a city of knockoffs this is a gem.

Oh, dont be affraid of the entrance.  It seemed a bit like we had accidentally wandered into a strip club, but we didnt.

Great place!! Love these kind of places. Good food, good people and good beer! We had a tough day at the local hospital and came in for some fuel. They noticed we were having a day....so they brought a plate of cookies to our table too. Thank you Deli George!

I'm from a place where there is a chicken wing place on almost every corner. So my expectations were high. 
1. Bigger wings do not equal better. The chicken in this place was HUGE. Larger wings will never get that crispiness we look for in Atlanta. 
2. The hot wing sauce is just that a sauce. It had no depth. Lemon pepper seasoning didn't stick and lastly they had no blue cheese. I must say that the wings weren't bad just not that great.

I came here last night with some friends for dinner.  First off, it's really neat looking inside since it's a restored old ship.  So right off the bat I enjoyed the ambiance.  I got the M.C. cocktail and it was really good!  All the cocktails we ordered were tasty.  The staff were all friendly as well.

Now, the food.  I'm a vegetarian.  There is literally no entree I can eat on their menu.  I'm  used to this however, and I usually order sides or something to create a meal.  But, since it's a nicer restaurant, I figured it was worth a shot to inquire to the waitress about any options they may have.  They ended up making me a gnocchi and vegetable dish.  (I believe it was the scallop entree without the scallops).  It was amazing!  I recently went to two different Italian restaurants that were lauded for their homemade pasta; and I sincerely believe that Moshulu's gnocchi was better than both of those places.  All three of us really enjoyed our meals.  

I do have to mention that they are incredibly expensive.  One of the cocktails we ordered was $15.  That being said, I didn't feel cheated at all.  Everything was really delicious.  Also, they have a private parking lot, but it's $15 dollars to park there.  If that's not a concern, then by all means, have at it. If it is a concern, you can find free street parking around, but you'll have to walk a little bit.   

I would return, but only for a special occasion because of the prices.  This is the perfect place for an anniversary or birthday dinner.

Excellent steak. Comparable to Ruth's Chris.  Large salads.. My son had the Caesar and I had Caprese (biggest Caprese I've ever seen!).  Nice atmosphere, but loud.  I agree with others in that service was very efficient but not overly friendly, which together could lead you to feel a little rushed.

New Orleans isn't exactly known as a Burger Town.  I suppose it makes sense.  It's a town with cheap, plentiful and damn tasty po' boys just about around every corner.  Burgers are kind of an after thought there.  In fact, ask for a burger at a lot of places and you're just as likely to get it on a French roll as you are to get it on a bun.  That's what makes The Company Burger such a revelation for burger lovers.  Hamburgers are what they do.

The Company Burger occupies the same massive, city block sized brick building that houses John Besh's newest restaurant Willa Jean.  It's a long narrow place with a small bar on your right and the kitchen in the back.  Naturally, I turned to my right.  There's service at the bar.  If libations aren't on your agenda then head back towards the kitchen and order there.  The menu is blissfully small, but has some surprising additions to regular hamburgers; a lamb burger and a turkey burger.  I was damn close to ordering the lamb burger.  It was my first time at TCB, though and I thought that I should try their namesake burger.

The Company Burger is made up of two beef patties, American cheese, bread and butter pickles and thinly sliced onions.  Bacon can be added for an additional charge, as can a fried egg.  They also have a Mayo Bar where you can get additions of plain, basil, chipotle, garlic, creole honey mustard or fancy(?!) mayonnaise to slather on you hamburger bun.  They also have house-pickled jalapenos, if you're into that sort of thing.  I wasn't. I declined to adulterate my first burger here.  But I loved the Mayo Bar.  Mainly I love the fact that the word mayo isn't a pejorative term in New Orleans.  Let's be honest. Back home in Seattle call something mayonnaise and people wrinkle their noses and feign disgust. Take the same stuff and call it aioli and the swoon over it!  New Orleanians, when it comes to food, have a better grasp on what's good and what's not and don't get tangle up in a lot of trends names.  My fellow Northwesterners should take a page out of their book.

But I digress.  The burger was terrific.
The chicken tiki masala is wonderful. Portions are large so one order is like two meals. So yummy!  I also recommended the garlic naan bread.  And they have yummy mango smoothie drinks too!

Food is always delicious and fresh! The staff is friendly and inviting and always willing to work with any order customizations. The manager Julie is so sweet- will do anything she can to provide you with the best experience possible! FIVE STARS!

Some of the best service I've ever had! The menu is simple. The food, while not exactly "authentic", was good, came quickly, and was hot. The minestroni soup was five star, and the specials of the evening were really good. An extensive wine list ranging from $25 to $1,000!!!  No problem bringing the kid. They even had a high chair and didn't mind a little pasta on the wall. I would definitely come back! Staff friendly and excellent service!!

This location has struggled to find the right fit for a neighborhood restaurant. On the surface, JP Tavern could be the fit!! However, management should focus on a few common issues I've experienced after visiting a few times. Install sound panels to lower the deafening noise that echos throughout the interior. Create some type of separation between the bar area and dining area. The kitchen is not getting the food out in a timely manner at all. Scallop ap came out fast and hot, but steak sandwich and pizza took a while and was luke warm...fries not hot. And please, don't charge me $10 for half a martini, please pour a real drink. If you have to charge more, than do so! We want you to succeed!!! If possible, find a top bartender in this town and steal him/her away to work at JP Tavern.

So glad we tried Dawn Patrol for an early breakfast. I came to SB with my sister to visit my daughter... this was a great start to our day. Friendly greeting as we entered, and prompt service. We ordered at the counter then experienced attentive staff after we took a seat at a table of our choice. Cool, current beachy decor. All our food was delicious (between the three of us we had the Build a Hash, 3 Egg White Frittata, and the House Cured Salmon, each having the fresh squeezed orange juice, too). I cannot wait to return when I get a chance to come to SB again... I wish we had something like this where I live.

Location is tucked away so it takes a bit to find if you are not familiar with the area, but we had the address so we knew where to look.

My sister and I went yesterday, clean ,great waitress with a wonderful personality, everyone was ,friendly and helpful,the food was wonderful, we really enjoyed it also the dessert is awesome, can't  wait to go back again. I highly recommen going.

Awesome little place. Loved the house white sangria. Yum. Had the grilled calamari - very good! This is a great date nite spot! Cozy and low lighting in the back :) Parking is off street but there is valet too.
Won't deliver to quality Inn kinda upset about this I haven't had a good meal in a week

This is one of the best burger places around, without a doubt. Don't let the exterior fool you. It looks like a dive but I promise the burgers are great. They will actually listen when you tell them how you want your burger cooked, too! I absolutely love the Ground Pati, and if you go I know to you will too. FYI, they start with peanuts in the shell, but they give you a basket for the shells. Don't throw them on the floor, it's not that kind of place.

The place was empty and there were seats available at the bar and I was by myself and I was turned down saying there was a wait to seat at the tables. You guys don't want business? Well there are many options around. I've just decided to go there because it was next to my hotel and I didn't want to eat at my hotel or drive because I was tired but what can I do? I've drove to the other steakhouse down on the road which by the way has many great reviews.  I'm not going to be waiting to be seated in an empty place. Are you kidding me?

This is the best food I have enjoyed so far in NOLA.  I am kinda picky about ambience and cleanliness.  The food is amazing, there is art, nice lighting, and the service is excellent!  So happy I found this place when there are so many wonderful choices in this amazing city!

This place was pretty cool. I found it on yelp, actually. It's in printers alley which is a replica of Bourbon St in NOLA. You can have open cups and beers in the alley. The cover was $10 which is typical of any place with good live entertainment. 

The place was full of 40 and 50 something's. I had the pink panty dropper cocktail which was a little more tart than I typically like and not enough alcohol for $11. We had the catfish bites and the Cajun fries. The catfish bites tasted homemade and were amazing. The fries tasted like curly fries (that orange coating) which were not that great especially for $7.
Fantastic! Done authentic Jamaican style! Delicious! Reasonably priced. Lots of menu options. Staff are friendly and service is good. They also have live music. I highly recommend!
They give you plenty of food , but it's not good, the BBQ Chicken was so hard  I couldn't eat it. I don't recommend this place, food is not that good.

Amazing food and service, we ate here two nights in a row. My guy had the Creole stuffed fish, which was delicious. I had the Crabcake and Shrimp Alfredo, which was the best sauce I have ever had on pasta. Mouthwatering food, including their garlic toast served with the pasta, with panko crunchies. Highly recommend, they will deliver satisfaction!

Very solid lunch as well.

I got the Pork Belly and Blue burger and my mom got the Super Green Salad.

Pro tip: the sweet potato fries are to die for!  You need to order them.  They have a nice kick to them and are thin and crispy.  I wish I had a bunch right now.

The Pork Belly and Blue burger was delicious.  The sauce was really good and the burger (medium rare) was cooked to perfection.  My mom really enjoyed her super green salad.  It was huge and she was full for the rest of the day.  Can you believe that?  Off of a salad!  I would definitely get this dish again.

I got Iced Coconut tea, which basically had an almost aftertaste of coconut.  It was good, but not terribly strong.  If you are craving coconut, this will slightly satisfy it, but I would probably try another tea next time.

I've never had a bad meals here. It's either been slightly above average or really good. Today was really good! I've had some crappy food and service over the last couple of meals from other places and this took me out of that funk. I got the ribs, tacos, and bread pudding. Everything was on point. Bread pudding wasn't too sweet, which I prefer. We ate at the bar and the bartender made a pretty good house Bloody Mary and was good at recommending things that suited our taste of the moment. She was nice, cool, and helpful. I prefer the bar because who doesn't want to sit on a swing while they eat?! It was cute and fun and just an all-round nice atmosphere. 3 other separate groups of diners were also complimenting the staff on their service and their food. Thanks for killing my streak of bad dining experiences (most recently Lucky Buddha)!

We waited 15 minutes before anyone even asked for drinks.  40 minute wait for food after that.  Service was pretty painful.  These guys need some help at the management level.  Similar experience to what we have had before and we hoped it was a one time thing.  Waitress tried her best to manage it but .... hopefully your experience is better.

For some specifics: (if you don't mind the wait)

Fish and chips came with no tartar sauce or ranch

Chicken strips under cooked

Cobb salad ordered and it came with no chicken 

Hoping the food at the theater is better.
For me this is a 3.5 star place. Good burger, not great. Service friendly but very slow. Outdoor seating area in back lacks ambiance during the day as the view is of dumpsters.

This is a great little place and it has great food. It doesn't get 5 stars just because it's so small it's almost uncomfortable at peak hours. Definitely worth it to try out and definitely worth it to pick up food.

Daddy Wad, Diavolo, Paesano, Artiso, AMAZING!!!!! They used to have this sandwich called Liveracce, but the last few times I've stopped by, they had no idea what I was talking about. BRING IT BACK! Chicken livers aren't for everyone but theirs are outstanding.

I love their greasy-ass parmesan potatoes....the best. Paesano's is EASILY the best sandwich shop in Philly. What else would you expect from the masterminds behind the 8th wonder of the culinary world, Modo Mio (across the street)???!?!!? 

Glory in a sandwich roll. That is all.

I usually don't really care for the food at Hooters, but we were craving wings yesterday and were pleasantly surprised! The wings were crispy and delicious! We sat at the bar so the food came right out of the fryer to us which might be the key! Two bartenders served us... one was rude but the other was super sweet!
Great food service and drinks. Moderately priced. Eat in or take out pizza. Dog friendly patio.
terrible service, slow unengaged and food was OK, mixed drinks too expensive.  2 he's for lunch with 6 people.

I'm so glad there's a place I can get Acai bowls. This is a big chain that I used for frequent in California and can't go wrong with them even though there's a billion competitors in California. 

Staff has always been amazing esp the operator and the tall African American gentlemen. Superb

Also I highly recommend the app if you are getting it to go. They are going to just get busier plus the reward structure is very simple and fair in my opinion eg you don't have spend a gazillion dollars to get something back.

Garage is next to it if parking is ever an issue. And it's FREE

We usually go to Sasha's for our neighborhood wine bar experiences, but since their service has been steadily spiraling downwards, I wanted to try some place new. Enter: Vino Nadoz. We stopped in the other evening for an impromptu Tuesday date night. It's a tiny little place, but on a Tuesday it was quiet and cozy. 

Our server was very nice, knowledgable and professional in his wine presentation. We split a bottle of Syrah and munched on the free hummus you get with any bottle purchase. 

My only complaint is that the chairs are too short for the tables, or maybe the tables are too tall for the chairs? It felt a little awkward, and I've never had that issue before! 

Overall though, it was a great little place. Excellent wine, fair prices and great service. I imagine it could get pretty packed on weekends, but we'll definitely be back for another mid-week date!

It was about 3 AM, and the line was very long. They got slammed. When I got up to the window, the staff was very friendly and very accommodating. Quite refreshing for what was obviously a stressful situation.

The food was definitely made fresh for me.  

Love Rally's!

I'm from Elkhart, Indiana and I'm so happy that Rise N Roll has come to Greenwood!

The facility is neat and clean. The staff is welcoming and they even take orders over the phone. Coming from Carmel, I was able to call ahead to ensure I there were donut holes held for me. Did I buy 5 boxes? You bet. I've been handing them out like candy and I'm hoping to send some more Carmel friends down to Greenwood to give them some more business. 

Thank you so much to Kayla at this location for reserving some boxes for me!

Came here with my Stepmom after shopping, as we have done several times in the past during my visits from California. Very disappointed this visit...new name, new furniture, not the same food and horrible service. I knew it was going to be rough when we waited in the lobby for about 10 minutes before being asked if we needed help...the service did not improve from there and the food was super bland. Application of multiple hot sauce options did not help. Tucson has many options for Mexican food and I recommend this not be one of them. You are welcome.

The Legend is located in an east side neighborhood called Irvington. Irvington is named after the author Washington Irving, so you can guess how the restaurant chose its name. 

The Legend offers a menu of traditional American dishes such as meatloaf and chicken, but of very high quality and in a fairly upscale atmosphere. They generally have specials that venture beyond traditional American cuisine. The prices are a bit expensive in my opinion, but you certainly can't complain about the quality. There is a beer and wine bar attached to the dining room, and it is a great place to hang out. They sell a lot of micro and local brews, which are always popular with the patrons.

Ciro's has such a romantic atmosphere, the small booths draped with sheer black curtains allows for privacy  and the compact space makes it feel very intimate. Ive been coming to Ciro's since Fall of 2010 when I first moved to Tampa and it quickly became a favourite date spot & I highly recommend it to those looking for a more unique experience. I truly miss the floor to ceiling saltwater fish tank that dominated the main wall, it was beautiful and provided a nice pop of colour to the interior. 

The ladies have plenty of eye candy thanks to the suspender-clad bartenders. I highly recommended sitting at the main bar where you can observe the barkeep skilfully creating prohibition era craft cocktails. This is definitely not a bar that you're going to order one of the typical bar cocktail, the menu is specifically designed to the 1920's during the time when the US Government banned alcohol. The drinks are always amazing and I think I have almost finished having each menu item at least once. Speakeasies revived the cocktail culture & most are fun to go to. I love that Ciros has remained steadfast with having a password to enter. Although the cocktails are a bit overpriced for most people, once you see the work and cost that goes into creating the drink you'll understand the price. 


The food I always delightful although I am sad they took several of my favourites away. The lighting is very dim which was typical of the era the bar is themed from, so make sure to have a phone Hamdy to help illuminate the cocktail menu. The food Menu is on a lighted book making it easy to see. 

They are always busy so make sure to go online or call for reservations and the password.

One of the better Italian restaurants in the Tampa Bay area. Small, really cozy place. All the waiters and owner are super friendly. When I was there on Sunday a man was providing some great entertainment on a keyboard. 

Excellent wine selection all with reasonable price. Dinner includes bread with a great dipping sauce, excellent bruschetta, a salad and a side item of vegetable or pasta. I had the chicken picatta, which was great and angel hair with pink princess sauce (mix of marinara and alfredo) It was all awesome.

I've been coming to this store for a number of years.  The shopping experience and customer service has been generally good -- with the occasional exception.  There was the time when I placed a 33 ounce ready-to-eat rotisserie chicken in my cart.  It seemed too light to be 33 ounces, so I placed it on the digital scale -- it  weighed only 23 ounces.  When I brought this to the attention of a manager at the courtesy desk, she explained that the price sticker was for "net weight."  I guess the definition of "net weight" wasn't covered in the employee manual.  On another occasion, I had what I thought was a 15 dollar winning lottery ticket, and brought it to the desk.  The employee looked at the ticket and said "ten dollars."  When I asked to look at the ticket, the employee tore it into small pieces, handed me ten dollars, and said "too late."  In the past few months, the store seems to have improved considerably, and I had been prepared to heap all sorts of praise on it in my review.  However, the store still has an occasional stumble.  Yesterday, they had a sale on boneless chicken breast.  At the sale price, there were two different products to choose from:  a brand name package with a sell by date of 11/14, or a no-name package (possibly wrapped in the store) with a sell by date of 11/19.  I went back to the service window and asked the butcher which would be the better choice.  He replied "chicken is chicken."  It's reassuring to know, based on that condescending remark, that we can disband the Agriculture Department and fire all of the meat inspectors.  And that fancy line of eight-dollar-a-pound chicken that Shoprite sells just a few feet from where I was standing can now be retagged at the two-dollar-a-pound sale price.
Good jerk chicken. Good prices. Not a lot of options in the Brandon area for Caribbean food.

The food is decent but the managers attitude ruined it. They were out of wings but didn't think calling would be appropriate in the hour they quoted us. instead they just made an assumption and chose what they were giving us in replace of what we ordered. The server was polite however the management was not at all.

My partner and I ordered takeout from the newly opened Tampa location this Friday evening. We ordered two ginger salads and two red curry katsu rice bowls. The dressing on the salad was forgotten as well as one of the curry sauces for the main dish. Although we were very dissatisfied the food we did receive was great. I know it take a while for a new business to get their bearings but I expected a little more thoroughness from this company after frequenting other locations often.
The tacos were very good! I tried almost all of them and loved the lengua. The michelada was awesome too! Great prices--will definitely go back!

We stopped in here for a quick lunch, despite looking like a very large space it's not super big and there was a bit of a wait.

We started with the jalapeno-bacon rangoons because how could you not? They were as good as they sounded, which made me happy. I went with the Brussel Sprouts Pizza which was delicious and one of the only vegetables I had in Nashville. The pizza was good, but HUGE! I definitely recommend splitting it with a couple of people. 

This place is good, upscale bar food. It's not something I would eat regularly, but is a nice break from heavy Southern food.

I attended a party at Sub Zero with a large group of friends this weekend.  I have to say, service was great, food was excellent and we had a great time!  Drink prices are a little expensive but I plan on going back.  Check this place out, you won't be disappointed!
Oh my goodness, who doesn't love Reading Terminal Market? This place is fantastic. All the food vendors you could possibly ever ask for.
Best vegan food we have found so far wish they were open longer, but for the time they are atmosphere is great.

Best vegan ramen!  Conveniently located off of Alvernon near Swan, with a drive through for contact-less pickup.  Husband had the desert ramen and said it was the best one he has had and he liked the spice level.   Online ordering was super easy and there are online options if you want to add/substitute.  I did not need to change anything - the veggie shoyu broth was tasty, the noodles did not get soggy (their to-go method containers work nicely to keep ingredients dry until you're ready to mix it altogether) and the veggies were perfectly cooked.  Will put this on our regular rotation!

Stopped here on my way to SLO. Read the reviews on Yelp and decided to give it a try. I tried the grilled chicken on sourdough with bbq sauce and it was really good. The chicken was cooked perfect! I also ordered the sweet potato fries and I really enjoyed them. I am really picky when it comes to sweet potato fries and they were really good! My husband ordered the burger and he enjoyed his as well. The prices were reasonable and there was plenty of outdoor seating. Also, the restroom was really cleaned and smelled really nice. I was so impressed with how clean the restroom was. I am traveling with a newborn and it is really important to me to have a nice clean bathroom where I can change him. It was a really nice place and I will definitely stop here again in the future!

I got the house special ( lunch menu) as seen below which also comes with soup!The portions are nice and the price is exceptional for a lunch menu. I really enjoy the flavors and as far as Chinese restaurants in Tucson this is definitely top 3, so you really can't go wrong. The owners are friendly and staff is attentive. If you are on the East side you have to give this place a try. The East side is lucky to have two amazing Chinese restaurants.

Elegant Brazilian offering in Philly that fills any meat craving.  Went there a year ago for a business dinner and was lucky I walked out alive.   The first mistake was being tempted to go to their elegant salad bar layout and waste the space on greens rather than red meat.   Second mistake was being tempted by the great selection of wines chosen for the table that wasted more space for red meat.   Third mistake was to try big portions of anything that looked good.  Big mistake because everything looked great and filled me up.   

You are constantly being attacked by guys with knives (with cuts of meat of course) trying to serve you.   The science is the the mastery of the control cards - RED TO STOP & GREEN TO GO.  You must absolutely always have RED or you will be bombarded with more food than you can handle!  From Filet to Sausage to Briskets, it is non-stop cuts of every imaginable taste and flavor.  You want to eat more and more bc the seasoning and the juicy slices on skewers are something you will rarely see.    This culinary indulgence is not for the faint of heart and can only be done once every few months / years or else risk coronary failure!

I like this Schnucks but the layout is a little weird. The deli and produce are out in this little side section that looks like it was build onto the main construction or maybe they knocked out the wall to the store next door. It gives this place a weird vibe.

However, Kevin at the meat counter is the man. He'll tell you about upcoming sales, explain all the cuts of meat and show you around the place. He even brought me behind the counter and showed me how to trim the tips off of ribs. Normally you'll pay a lot more to get ribs with the tips already removed and you don't even get to keep the tips! He saved me money and taught me something new. You don't expect that in a grocery store. 

The liquor selection is something to behold. I've been to New Hampshire state liquor stores and had less selection. The cigar selection is pretty well stocked too.

Walking by the place I would never imagine me going into it, but when a friend invited me I went in and absolutely thought it was great.

I really liked the atmosphere and all the decor.  Although, the service wasn't the best, but I still enjoyed the place and would go back!

This review is long overdue, have been going here for a year now since i moved to the neighborhood and every time I go (for either breakfast or lunch) it is dynamite, the food is diverse, ingredients are fresh, and the atmosphere and staff couldn't be friendlier.  They have a super list of specialty coffees and smoothies that are all great...
Food is excellent, however it is not at this intersection on the map. It is in the same shopping center as "Valley Pizza" and 7-11.

I love the original Waffles On Maple Uptown. So excited that I waited a few months for the Metairie location to work out the kinks before visiting. You should know that there is more to offer than the online menu suggests. They have a nice selection of Puerto Rican coffees and sides like fries that do not appear on the online menu. I do love that they can make any waffle or crepe gluten free. The restaurant was cleanish. It is a seat-yourself kind of place and there was a lot of turnover when I went that didn't allow for staff to thoroughly bus and clean every table, but it wasn't bothersome. The staff was very friendly too.

I ordered the Peaches & Cream waffle. My boyfriend had the sampler and my friend had the Better Than Feta. We ordered iced coffees and got a side of fries. You pay at the counter, receive a number, and your food arrives at the table. It took about 5-7 minutes for our food to arrive after ordering. 

The Waffles were fresh and fluffy! Mine had fantastically sweet and heavy toppings. My friends savory waffle had fresh basil and was also really good. The sampler plate is fantastic for those that can't decide between sweet and salty, but it is a preset sampler. I wish they'd let you customize because I would have picked different Waffles than what they offered. The iced coffee was delish and the fried were excellent crispy Cajun fries. 

Nutshell: Excellently fluffy post church waffles with decent iced coffee and Cajun fries is a winning combo. Needs to offer a customizable sampler plate.
Great dive bar. My simple hot ham & cheese sandwich was great. Hit the spot after several long nights in NOLA. Biscuits & gravy were what we had been looking for.

They live up to their name, it really was the best truffle I have ever had (Dark Chocolate) selection was everything you would want from a chocolate store. They are only going to be at this location for a short time so do not miss out ! Dress warm in case you need to stand outside for a few minutes as inside is very small (ie social distance ) but totally worth any effort. I am planning a repeat visit ASAP

If I could give a zero, I would give a negative score..I came to New Orleans on business and was staying with someone that lived right by this restaurant. We ordered food the first night i got here, when we went to pick it up the food 10 minutes after the time they said the food would be ready we had to wait 20 min. A few days later we were real tired and hungry so we just ordered from here again. When we went to pick up the food, sorry we are backed up and had to wait 20 minutes when there was not a soul in that place. A few days later we decided to eat there and that was the worst experience. We sat outside and there was no one on the balcony, but they decide to seat us at the furthest spot from the ac when there was no one out there. I ordered a pan seared tuna salad, and he came out and that the cook told them that they do not have sesame seeds and asked if I wanted something else, we were waiting around 30 min as of that point and we were hot and just wanted to get our food and leave. My salad came out and it was well done tuna, we just left. Will highly recommend to go down the road if you are hungry.

Stayed 3 weeks in Tampa on business, ate multiple places... This place was at the top of my list! Pictures from others say it all. Fresh quality food, presentation on point and a generous portion. My coworkers ate inside the restaurant for a more elegant experience. I was all about hanging outside with the locals at the Tiki Bar. I had a Bacon Burger and side salad... One of the best burgers I have ever had! Solid pick with a stunning sunset view.
Not real grouper,Basa.I don't recommend this place to anyone that's looking for fresh food.If you want Sysco frozen food,have at it..Not me...

This place had very friendly and cooperative staff. I ordered pizza at 2am, they were about 20 miles from my location and were very generous about making the drive. The pizza was delicious and I will definitely be ordering from here late night again!
