The Fries were think and absolutely delicious! So fresh, hot, and crispy! The vinegar based cole slaw went nicely and I could have totally made a Pittsburgh style sandwich with the fries/slaw combo! Yinz know what I mean?

They also had a sampler of 5 tenders at 5 different spice levels which I totally would have been on board with for my first trip, but it was only real chicken. Also, I think they had 6 heat levels, but one may have been plain. I didn't look that far down on the list.

They had Boylan soda which was Ok and did the job of wetting the whistle after a long drive. If you're into craft soda, then you'll probably like it.  I'm a Coke Zero snob (trying to quit) so it wasn't my favorite.  Lots of people seemed to be getting take-out too, so it's good for that.

I'd come back here if I was in the area, order the hot and see if they can add some extra sauce to make it wet.  It's a nice fast-casual joint, the staff was helpful in helping me decide as I told her it was my first time.  She said I'd like it and I should call her Nash-stradamus cause she was right.
Great service. The menu is great- I love the banana foster pancakes. Nice and quaint restaurant
Phenomenal place to get authentic Jamaican dishes. If you haven't had the chance to check this gem out, your loss. Thank you Marvin and Cliff for an amazing Saturday afternoon. #onelove

Got the matrimonio, cheese dip and flautas with the mango and cucumber margs. Salsa was so good and the perfect spicy level! Food was amazing and staff/owner was so welcoming and nice! Very clean, nice vibe!! We'll definitely be back!! Ask for the dessert shot ;)

I love a good hoagie and I can tell you that Skyler's is the best in town! They're better than Wawa, Chick's Deli, Jersey Mike's, Gaetano's and dare I say it... they might even be better than Primo's in a way. I decided to try something new and I'm glad I gave this shop a chance. Everything was perfect from every ingredient right down to the friendly customer service! I was even surprised by the low prices for the quality you get. I don't want to give them any ideas but I would gladly pay double. The rolls were perfect and all of the fillers perfectly proportioned. I don't know how they do it but even the onions seemed perfect. I'm not always a huge fan of onions because they can be overpowering and the smell can stay on you. However, the onions here are light, crispy and delectable! I would recommend Skylar's to anyone and I will definitely be back the next time I get a hankering.
Amazing Mexican food and great quality and quantity. Their green salsa is incredible.

Amazing Tapas! The variety of items on the menu is in particularly impressive. Typically tapas places dont' have a lot and I thought it would be overwhelming but it was not.
I had the Temporada Sangria and it was delicious. While it is basically watered down wine it was very tasty.
We ordered 5 items for 2 people:
We ordered the special salad which had watermelon, charcoaled cheese and a dressing. The charcoaled cheese is not for everyone, and it was not for me
ALBÓNDIGAS - This was lamb meatballs with shaved manchego. This was fantastic! the meat was juicy the cheese fit perfectly with the rest of the dish and the quantity was plentiful
ALCACHOFAS Y SETAS - This was the vegetarian flatbread with artichiokes, mushrooms, black truffle and manchego. Delicious.
ESPÁRRAGOS CON TRUFAS - Asparagus, egg and truffles, This was good but had a much milder taste
QUESO DE CABRA - Baked goat cheese with tomato bisque essentially is what this was. I was too full by the time this came out but I did try the sauce and it was delicious. I kind of wish i had saved room for this. 

Overall this place was fantastic! The ambiance, the food and the drink choices are plentiful.

Of all the push-cart dim sum spots in the downtown area of Philly, and yes, my family and I (originally from Hong King) have tried them all, this is the best place! The carts are out seven days a week, and the service here is better than most other places. Not only is the dim sum delicious, so are their menu items - and all very affordable. Definitely recommend Ocean Harbor to friends and colleagues

Yummy pizza, but order ahead or arrive before you are hungry. 
Also, if you don't want a tummy ache and you order a deep dish, ask for half the normal amount of cheese.  It's HEAVY.

I most recently went this past week and their safety measures were great. All the staff wore masks, they sanitized everything during each customer at the tables, they use paper napkins, plastic utensils. I sat outside and was able to socially distance myself from the next table. 

The food was amazing as always. I tried something new- the Grilled cheese with peppers! Omg it was perfect and not spicy, just flavorful! Don't skip the truffle cheese and fries! 

Service was excellent and friendly!

About a month ago, I wrote here on Yelp that I thought I would never eat a worse sub than Primo's Pilgrim, but that I did when I ate Casapulla's Italian sub. Well, yesterday, and every day before that, I would have told you I would never eat a better sub than Capriotti's Bobbie. But today, I'm telling you that Gaudiello's Italian hoagie might just be better.

First off, the sub was delicious. I don't even really like ham, so when I saw how much ham they put on, I was a little worried, but their ham tasted like no other ham I've tried. It wasn't overly sweet; it wasn't too salty; it didn't compete with the salami or provolone. It was so good that at one point I picked it up off the sandwich and ate it straight. I also asked for just a little mayo, and they did just that. I will have to be back to try their cheesesteak. Could it be better than Goodfellas'? I seriously doubt it; but then, I seriously doubted I would have a sub as good as the Bobbie, and I think I did.

The man and woman working were really cool. Talked a little about the Phillies and Eagles. You can tell they enjoy what they're doing; and trust me, they're good at it.

Please go to Gaudiello's. It's in a nice part of town, cheap, they have unsweetened iced-tea, their subs are delicious, and the people are super nice. What more could you ask for from a sub shop? What more could you ask for from a food establishment in general?

Pretty much your average wawa. Good prices, I love wawa coffee and subs.

The location isn't 100% customer friendly but it's ok, not as bad as some not as great as other wawas.

SPOT ON PK PIZZA! The Strom...well...

SO! I live in Royal Run (VERY close to W-town). We got a LARGE mailer from the new PK in W-town, so we decided to check it out. We ordered a large pizza and a Stromboli (first impressions):

1) It's PICK-UP only (hopefully, for now).

2) The prices are not GREAT...but VERY comparable to the other PK's in the area.

3) The staff is EXTREMELY FRIENDLY and happy to serve you! 

....so, the food...

The Pizza: 

YEP! WINNER! If you know what PK pizza is all about, then you know that the Pepperoni and Sausage are MINCED and piled heavy on the THIN crust; they knew this they did this, REALLY GOOD. I would EASILY put this in the TOP 2 PK's I have had around the state (yes, they are everywhere). 

Grade: A (if you understand what Indiana PK pizza is).

The Strom:

Not so much. IT WAS NOT BAD!!!!! HOWEVER, I am SPOILED by growing up with the BEST PK strom IN THE STATE...that is...the Pizza King on Weinbach Ave. in Evansville, IN. 

Grade: C

Some tips:

1) Coat and toast that roll!!!!

2) More: 1: CHEESE 2: SAUCE 3: TOPPINGS!

3) High heat...rest for 60 sec.....then TIGHT foil!!!!!



OVERALL:

We WILL go back. The food is VERY good and staff is GREAT.
Excellent steaks and drinks. The fried calamari appetizer comes with a sauce...definitely a must try!

Where to begin with this review, with such an outstanding experience it's hard to put into words. I've had the pleasure of living in the New Orleans area quite a few years ago but was too young and inexperienced to enjoy fine dining. I'd go to Bourbon Street, eat cheap food and really never think twice. Fast forward to 2018 I'm back in one of my favorite cities for my wife's birthday celebration. Her first time in NOLA and we started with dinner at Restaurant August. Service here is out of this world, Mark and team go above and beyond to ensure their guests are taken care of. From our first course of gnocchi and shrimp étouffée, to dinner of flounder and pompano ending with dessert of cheesecake and rocky road sundae. Each course mouth watering, and perfectly cooked  leaving us wanting more. There is something to be said for great food, a romantic atmosphere and splendid service. Thank you for a fantastic evening our first night in #NOLA exceeded our expectations! Looking forward to coming back again in the very near future!

Good for: margaritas; huge portions; Americanized Authentic Mexican food (meaning, authentic in menu not in flavor; Americanized in flavor, or lack of spice/seasoning/marinade). Guessing this will hit the spot for those looking for something to gnosh on while they drink.
Excellent service. Good chips. 

*Not* good for: those looking for authentic Mexican food with deep set flavor.
This place has the best pizza around!  Crunchy and chewy... quality ingredients. Great tasting sauce. We love this place. Definitely worth the price!

I'm sorry, but I don't understand how anyone can give this place a good review.  

First off, the service was absolutely awful - out waitress was clueless as to what was on their menu, took forever to bring our drinks and food, and would disappear for long periods of time.  There's absolutely nothing "charming" about this place, as other reviewers have commented.  In fact, the back patio where we had our meal was unlit and dirty.

The food was underwhelming.  For everyone claiming this is "authentic" Mexican food, I'd ask you, what kind of authentic Mexican food comes with Mozzarella and Provolone cheese?  I really tried to avoid getting something with these cheeses, but they're on literally everything.  The drinks were absolutely from a mix (don't know what some other reviewers are talking about).  In fact, they were completely out of their standard margarita (the waitress said they had a busy breakfast rush... mmm what?) so the only options were mago and blue - yes, that's right, blue.  While it may be on the cheaper side, I still walked out of there with a $18.00 bill (they charge for chips and salsa). 

Seriously one of the worst meals of my life.
Food was good after we finally received it. This place used to be a lot better that what I experienced tonight.

A tiny restaurant in the back of a wine store makes for some interesting conversations. 

If you are claustrophobic do not come here or bring a group and request the group dining area that is out in the open. There are lots of seats at the bar and a few tables for 2 tops or 4 tops. We're bar people so that's where we went for a light snack and drink before dinner. We went around 6pm on a Saturday which I thought would have been more packed but it wasn't bad at all. 

We were able to find a corner at the bar and ordered the chef's cheese plate special. For the amount of cheese and etc you get doesn't justify the $ amount but ..you are in 'South Tampa'. Regardless, if you're already here you're ready to drop some $ so DO it! I did the Spanish Trail flight and left tipsy (job done check). We always forget that this place is here but venture back to it every couple of years. =)

I love this new cafe! It's right next to the juice bar at the 70/100 split, plenty of parking. 
Have had the Avo smash with poached egg and a flat white. 
Very fun decor, great service, and kid friendly! They have little kid books, kid utensils and kid plates for eating. 
Greatly enjoy the warm welcoming Aussie joint!
The chai tea latte with oat milk is amazing!!! Also, the bathrooms are immaculate, best clean bathroom I have ever experienced in a coffee shop.

I have only tried a couple of things here because the Ancho BBQ Burrito Bowl is awesome and I can't stop myself from ordering it every time! It is a version of a burrito on the menu, but naked, or without a tortilla. They start by layering the bottom of the bowl with cilantro infused rice and then offer you your choice of black or pinto beans.  You can then choose from steak, pork, or chicken. I have only gone with the steak once, the pork once, and the chicken the rest of the time because I thought it was the best of the three. Next, they ladle on the absolute best part of the bowl, which is the ancho bbq sauce. It is the perfect combination of my personal favorite flavor profile-smoky, sweet, and spicy. After that, you can get as wild and crazy as you want and load it up or keep it simple. I usually add pico de gallo, roasted corn salsa, habanero salsa, and shredded cheese. To complement this delicious bowl, I always add a few lime wedges to my Coke Zero that really works well with the flavors. With the great customer service and consistently tasty, fresh food, I will continue to make my bi-weekly visit and probably eat the Ancho BBQ Burrito Bowl every single time.

Had the BBQ buffet... nice smoky flavor.  The pulled pork and chicken was very tasty.  Plenty of sides to choose from.  Priced by the pound.  Really good beers on tap.  Currently enjoying the southern tier pale ale.

We decided to visit this place seeing all the reviews and live music playing on but it was total waste of money and time . Service was so slow- waited too long for bread, food and check. Food was so bad and it was served cold - we were six people and none of us had good experience.

Spice 28 atmosphere is like become intertwined into a piece of art.  Beautiful.  The food can be described has transcedent and beautiful at the same time.  It was delicious. To have an experience like this with my mother is a lifetime memory. The staff was courteous and knowledgeable of the menu and what would particularly make my pallette swoon.  I am in love.  This is a must come back.  If you are ever in the area trust it will be worth the experience.  Oh and the Crispy Thai Red Snapper is AMAZING.

This place is such an amazing hole in the wall sushi place. And a staple in the Pinellas Park are. My fiancé and I have had this as one of our go to date nights for years. Staff is friendly and knew our order after only a few times of coming in. Amazing!
I've been to Cazador a few times now and I make a point to stop in every time I'm in Tampa. The staff and food are fantastic, especially Tallarin Chaufa is the best :)

Come for the Shrimp appetizer, stay for the Awesome music/playlist (killer Blues !!) and blackened grouper sandwich (special) and burger (char grilled and juicy!!) 4star hole in the wall, dive bar slingin' Great food and cold draft beer at really good prices. We were lucky enough to come by boat - they have a small dock-and got advice about the shrimp from a couple just leaving. We got ours blackened and it was the Best shrimp we've had in St a Petersburg area since moving here 4 years ago. Commenting on the great music drew agreement and the owner clued us in on his Pandora playlist ( Blues BBQ )
Next time I'll Uber here and home 'cause food and beer this great needs to be savored and enjoyed for hours. Cheers and Bravo to the kitchen!!!

Excellent service and superb Italian cuisine! The high quality pizzas in addition to an amazing selection of wines makes this place a memorable experience. My waiter Evan was knowledgeable, polite and very helpful in helping me and my girlfriend make our selections. Will be visiting again!

This place is so cool! The walls are covered in creative customer artwork all dedicated to burgers. My fav is the turkey burger with mushrooms and bbq sauce and the fries are deliciously potato filled :-P

Ran in for dinner before an event. I have been wanting to try it for months but hadn't found the right time. They take reservations which makes it much easier. We shared the shrimp cocktail. Jumbo shrimp with a nice cocktail sauce. Not nose burning like other local places. Very good. We also shared the wedge salad. Plenty large enough. Great flavors from the blue cheese. Another guest had the clam chowder and said it was great. I had the cedar plank salmon. Wonderful flavors but slightly over cooked for mid rare. The potatoes and carrots were great. Service was very friendly and engaging. We had a great time.

My boyfriend and I found destination dogs through GrubHub and are loyal customers. Not only is the food always great but the service is fantastic. We recently used the wrong address for our order and although the delivery is fulfilled by GrubHub, Jim from DD, went above and beyond to call them on our behalf, provide the driver with our correct address and then call us back. We got our food 20 mins after we ordered. I'm so impressed I had to leave a review! 

The restaurant is also worth a visit. I rented out a dinning room for a birthday party on a Friday night. The two servers assigned to us were stellar and the owner Sean worked with me prior to the party to organize appetizers and details. The extensive revolving beer selection is always great.
Great food, a little pricey but I wouldn't expect anything else for an establishment in Media.  Staff was friendly.  Would return if I go back into the Media area.

After spending some time to talk my better half into trying out this place for breakfast, I finally succeed earlier this year. Since then, Honey's became our favorite Sunday morning spot.
This place definitely has it all - great food, good service, cool atmosphere, I don't understand why people complain and/or give low ratings.
Yes, after about 8:30-9:00 it gets crowded and you have to wait, but if you read a review on Yelp, you know this ahead of time - either come earlier (that's what we do) or go a bit later in the day....
The service in general is pretty top notch, except one time (out of probably six or seven by now) when we had to ask for refills on water and coffee...
The prices are very reasonable considering the quality of ingredients and the tastiness of the food..
Oh, the food...
Eggs Benedict, various omelette's are all great... but the best part for me are these three:
3. pancake - just perfect
2. grits - this is the only place this side of the Mason-Dixie line where I found grits that I like..
1. latke - just short of my grandma's, but c'mon who can cook better than grandma anyway?
All in all a totally great place!!

With no one in the restaurant, it took them forever to take our order and then forever to plate the already cooked food.  They were out of 1/2 their items. They forgot to bring out the extras that came with the meal.  Very poorly run.   Not returning ever.

Not bad but NOT good. For the price I would expect a lot more. This was our second visit to this restaurant. Both times it was very busy, barely able to walk between tables. The staff though friendly did not provide the best service. The food was okay-not worth the price. Tonight though I was delivered a $4.50 house salad with three pieces of rotten lettuce. I handed the plate with dark, slimy pieces to the server to replace the plate and she made no attempt to fix the salad issue. No bread ever came to the table. When finishing our meal our water glasses were only refilled half way. My Cuban sandwich was fine-Not as good as Beef O'Brady for comparison. Mini Devil Crab basket was good. The flan had good texture and flavor. Considering a sandwich with chips is $10, my Cuban sandwich with salad was $12ish and a normal size plate of shrimp pasta is $22... I would expect better service. 
It is always busy so maybe spoiled lettuce isn't a norm for them. I doubt we will try a third time.

I brought a date here, I wanted pizza. I hadn't been here in a little while, the last time was a year ago when I picked up. They don't have physical menus anymore. We split a deluxe pizza and salad. Were out of the house dressing but I will say the lettuce was fresh. The pizza was disappointing. We ate it because we were hungry but I had to explain to my date that I didn't bring him here for that so he wouldn't judge me. It was bland. Sauce had no taste, bacon was burnt, the dough was also hard, maybe they had forgotten about it. Our server was nice but came for the food so won't be back for the food.

best buffalo chicken cheesesteak.  Best roll,  quality meats and cheeses! when it comes to customer service they are second to none.  I can't recommend this place enough!  make sure to try the loaded cheese fries too, you won't regret any of it.

We took my mother-in-law for her birthday, and let's just say it was the best decision. I've been to steakhouses in St Pete (Rococo, Ruth Chris, etc.) and the steaks at Salt Rock are top tier. 

Now the highlight: the stone crab claws. They were AMAZING. The freshness and sweet meat got all of us still talking about it. Don't miss out on this beautiful restaurant.

WINNER WINNER FOREVER I LOVE THIS PLACE X INFINITY OMG.

Okay, now that I've gotten your attention, I'll tell you why...

But, before I do, let me paint you a picture.  My 4'10 lonesome self walks into Piranha's on a Wednesday afternoon.  Like a scene from a movie, as soon as I walk in, all conversation stops and I get stare downs from every regular in there along with the bartender.  #awkward.  It's dark, it's dingy, and as much as my gut was telling me to leave, all I kept thinking to myself was, "... but Yelp said this place is good..." so I stayed.  Duh.

The bartender greets me in her unmistakable southern twang, whose name I later learned was Dana Marie, and asks if I'm there for drinks or food.  I say both.  I order a beer on tap (I forget which, might've been good ol' Shock Top) and take a look at their menu.  I almost immediately decide on a burger, but I tell her I want to enjoy my beer for awhile.  The 3 to my left start smoking cigarettes.  Yikes!  Smoking is allowed in here??  How did I miss that?!  I didn't want to offend anyone, but just an FYI in case you're sensitive to smoke like I am.  Thankfully, they left, and were replaced soon after by 4 more regulars and 2 newbies like me.

So basically, after a few drinks, everyone at the bar becomes friends.  I had a Fireball shot with them (my first time, apparently it's a Nashville thing?  It's like cinnamon in a shot glass) along with a shot of Jameson.  Neither of which appeared on my bill by the way, and neither did 2 of my 3 beers.  See, I told you everyone at the bar becomes friends.  And after a few MORE drinks, some of them mortal enemies and then bff's right after.  Not even kidding.  It was quite entertaining to watch.  Especially with the 90's R&B (my fave!) + the most random, but awesome, songs ever playing in the background.  Example: It went from Beauty + the Beast's "Be Our Guest" to "Poison" to "Gangster's Paradise" to a bunch of Beastie Boys songs and other good stuff.

But the highlight of my visit... boy oh boy... was that Piranha Burger.  A half a pound of lean ground beef perfectly seasoned with good ol' s+p, topped with melty provolone + CRISPY fries (yes, they actually remained crispy) under their signature cole slaw.  Now, this slaw isn't like your typical slaw drenched in mayo.  It was fresh, crunchy, tangy, and that kick of black pepper just made it the perfect condiment for my burger.  I ate the whole thing.  TIP: If you have no one to share it with, don't bother ordering a side of fries.  They give a generous heap of fries on the burger and let some fall out so it's kind of like I had a side of fries without even having to order it.  One of the best burgers I've ever had because of the flavors, topping combo, and bread... It all just worked.

PROPS by the way to Dana Marie.  She single-handedly held down the fort.  And by that I mean, she was the bartender, the cook, the server (for other patrons as well who weren't just seated at the bar), and the entertainer.  She definitely keeps this place alive from what I observed and from what I was told by the regulars.

This has definitely made it to my list of top dives in the country.  No doubt I will be back next time I'm in Nashville (which I hope is soon!).

Sully's is by far not my favorite place to eat nor would I choose to pay here to eat, but a couple of days ago we were at the Tamarack after seeing a movie at the Summit and bar food it was... 

I wanted to order a drink and I felt like something other than water so I ordered a Greyhound because I love grapefruit.  I wasn't really looking for a buzz or anything but I could see the bartender making it and to say the least, it was a joke.  He used a pint glass and splashed in a tablespoon of vodka then topped the entire pint of with sugary grapefruit juice, I took a couple sips and could drink no more. 

Even though the photo of the chili cheese waffle fries looks great, it was just okay.  I've never had anything here that was good or memorable.  My dad and boyfriend like the bison burger for $8.99.  I had the grilled bbq chicken burger on a pretzel bun with cole slaw.  There was a funny taste left in my mouth either from the thin, rubbery, dried out chicken breast or the soggy pretzel bun.  I couldn't figure it out.  In the menu it said the bbq sauce was their popular homemade sauce but really, it just tasted like Heinz and it was so smothered atop my chicken breast that I had to wipe most of it off.  Cole slaw, ew.  Potato salad, very ew.

The service was weird to say the least.  In the time that we were there we had the bartender seat us, an older lady come over to give us our menus, our main waiter, then another girl asking if we were okay.  While attention from your server is nice, too much can be annoying, especially when you're in mid bite and you have to nod your head that everything's acceptable.  Sometimes we wanted to tell them to just leave us alone and eat in peace.

Awful. We placed the order from the app.. They didnt have our order when we arrived. She said they have had issues with the on line ordering. 45 mins later we finally left with our food. A lady came in after us, ordered and left, and then came back and ordered two more meals and left again as we still didn't have our order. I don't know how it is possible that we had to wait 45 mins for a smokehouse family meal. We will never come back here again. There was an accident that happened right as we were arriving was cleared from the road by the time we left!

Typical pizza spot atmosphere with dark wood flooring & dinning area. When you walk into the place you can see the open kitchen area. 
The pizza was delicious in taste & made with good ingredients. However the middle of the pizza was soggy & personally I don't find that acceptable for the complete pizza experience.
I hope they can take the time to better their techniques & maybe I will try them out again.

On vacation celebrating our 2 wedding anniversary and we actually dined here on our anniversary date. We loved it! Great ambiance (we sat outside in the courtyard), food was excellent, and the service was very good as well. I would highly recommend for a more upscale dinner plan.

I've never had chicken "nuggets" for chicken Parmesan and then the server tried to convince us that a muffuletta sandwich comes on this soft bun
 I tried to explain that it comes on a more dense bread.

This is a great little place.  It is a bit hidden in the corner of the shopping center but worth the trip.  The food is always great from the salads to the entrees. They have some great lunch items including a delicious meatball sandwich.  The service has always been attentive and efficient.

Love this little bakery!!! Everything I've had here is absolutely delicious! Their breakfast sandwiches are the BEST sandwiches I've ever eaten & their cheesecakes are delicious as well. Working in Gretna means I frequent this bakery at least 3xs a week! I'm addicted!

Walking along the tampa river walk, we decided to grab lunch. Perfect for outdoor seating with a great view of the bay. It wasn't crowded at all on a weekday for lunch. 

The mojo chicken sandwich is always a good choice. It's a big sandwich but light in its own way. I forgot to take a picture of the Cuban sandwich Bc we were hungry!  Definitely a good choice as well. Both paired with plantain chips and of course a sangria. 

Columbia "the cafe" is a nice option along the location of hotels on river walk to grab a bite. Will be back.

One of few restaurants open.  Probably because they have done a great job of socially distancing tables.  We felt safe and were able to hear a combo of country and rock live.  Cafeteria style southern food is heavy but good.

Spent happy hour at Aki with a few friends. The hostess was friendly but our server was the worst. First off it was not a busy happy hour. But our waitress was short and obnoxious. Barely checked up to see if we needed anything. But the food was good. Everything came out in a timely matter after we ordered. I would come back but I hope the waitress is friendlier.

Took the advice from a stranger on the street. I guess I should've known better? Mimosas were pretty butt. Should've just got a 40 from the sto and spent the morning with some locals. It gets a star for the food, but only one. Waitress seemed like she was a lil confused. Didn't really connect well. Also somewhat chill vibes? Fever dream? I don't know. Just save yourself the trouble and get some McGriddles or something.

This place was incredible!! Today was my first time trying any kind of African food and I loved it - I got the veggie combo and it was delicious, the injera was light and airy and the veggie dishes were so flavorful! Service was absolutely wonderful also, and you can't beat the price! Will be back soon!

The staff at this location are great, very quick and helpful! There is always seating available at this Starbucks and the Wi-Fi never seems to have issues. Store is very clean and is a great place to get some work done. The store can be a bit cold on the inside, I recommend bringing something a bit warm to wear for long stays or maybe order a warm drink!
This was probably one of the best Chimichangas and Asada Tacos I have had in Reno! I'm always on the hunt for a Mexican spot since I moved here from Texas. I will be back for sure!

I came here a few months ago while I was checking out Tucson for a few months..I loved it..no BS.. just great affordable food...the mesquite steak is the bomb and I believe they might make their own tortillas...they are the store bought crappy kind....I came in today after a successful day at the casino...walked out with fifty six cents more than when I started...woohooo.....it was awesome
.and damn it..I had to order another mesquite steak  taco because the first one was so damn good...i say....do it!

Ignore all the fresh-looking, healthy-sounding displays and signs. This place serves pure crap. I can only guess that their motto is about making money rather than serving food or pleasing customers. To be honest, my only experience is with breakfast. Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice ... well, you probably get it. No three strikes for this place. Coffee is decent. But the breakfast sandwiches are made from prefab, microwaved egg patties. "Country ham" equals 3 slices of deli meat. Are you kidding? You get the feeling that they're doing you a favor by taking your money. Instead, buy something else. You'll be grateful.

Great gem hidden in the French market. Lots of GF and Vegan options. They do disclose that all of their items are made to order so you need to allow up to 25 minutes for your food to come out. Otherwise, the food tasted good and the variety of dishes were great. Probably the only place you could find a vegan & gluten free gumbo in Nola!
If you want amazing iced coffee, this place is the spot! The service was a little slow when it wasn't that busy... but the coffee made up for it!

I ordered delivery from here and 20 min after it was supposed to be delivered, I check the status and it said it was still being prepared... I called the problem line and processed a refund. 

I reordered for pickup and went and got it. I pulled up and they asked me my name. They gave me my food... it was the order that I ordered 1.5 hours ago. Door dash is trash. If they don't have drivers, you don't get your food and you won't really know. I told them I reordered for mobile pickup and it's the same order. They must have either tossed the ticket, ignored it, or have been suuuuuper slow. Probably won't ever be back to checkers. Especially not this one!
This place was ok. The stew was underwhelming. Good fish, service was fine. Awesome view.

The staff are super friendly and fairly generous with the toppings. Overall, the type of pizza is just not my fav (maybe too fancy for my simple tastes?). Got a half cheese and half meat lovers whole pie. The pepperoni/meat used was a specialized fancy dried meat, and the the cheese was ok - balance/ratio was a bit off for me. 

Either way, for those who like specialty pizza, this place is probably going to be great, but for me, it didn't stand out.

I was drawn to the live jazz as I was walking along Bourbon St. Reasonably priced, warm fluffy beignets to go along with a good selection of cocktails and great music. I second that the beignets are better than those at Cafe Du Monde. It was just a lovely experience to sit outdoors, grab a quick bite, enjoy the music and watch other tourists. Highly recommended. All for less than $10.

One of my favorite location of Another Broken Egg. We figured most places were close for Mardi Gras but lucked out when we called to see if this place was open, and they were! Upon arriving we were seated right away (had we had shown up 2 mins later, we would have been waiting outside). Our server Brooklyn, took great care of us and gave us a lot of recommendations. I'm so upset that I didn't get a picture of our food. I ordered the banana foster waffles and devoured it pretty quick.  It was pretty sweet, so next time i'll ask for less syrup. You have the option of getting the banana foster topping on either pancakes, Belgian waffles, or Hawaiian French toast! My boyfriend chose the Benedict Oscar which consist of grilled flat iron steak and crabmeat along with a side of country potatoes. I wasn't a fan of it because the crabmeat smell was a bit too strong for me but the boyfriend enjoyed it! We'll be back to try out other dishes on the menu! The inside of the restaurant is small and crammed They do have a few tables on their patio which I would love to come back and enjoy during warmer weather.

Even though their were plenty of employees and an elderly women was having an issue with the kiosk I was told to use the kiosk. I ended up helped the elderly women finish her order cause I was in a hurry and had to go to work. Once I got my food it was cold and the tortilla was stale.

This new spot opened up last month looking like Starbucks and Caffe Lucce will have some competition from anyone willing to pay an extra $.50-1 for their order. It took over the old bike shop's space at St. Phillip's Plaza and turned it into an open, industrial-type setting. Not the warmest or coziest setting, but there's enough seating and a decent enough space to get some reading/studying done. Plus, you can always take your order to go and wander around the plaza. 

The staff is fairly friendly and the owner was there both times observing and crunching the numbers on her laptop at a table in the corner. First visit, I ordered a plain, hot Americano. The espresso is bold and smooth, and not bitter at all. I'm interested in trying the Fat Americano sometime, as well as some of the food options. 

The cold brew is decent. A little more on the bitter side but had a nice roasty aftertaste to it. 

While it's in the beginning stages, I think it has potential. 

A few small-ish improvements:

It would be nice to invest in commercial-free music as they tend to keep the volume up a bit louder and the ads are distracting. The Americano came in a truck stop diner-style mug, and while cupware isn't a dealbreaker, a hip coffeeshop might want to invest in something more modern. The menu is also very difficult to read. I don't know about the bold, futuristic, block lettering, but it seems like it would be difficult to read for anyone who has eyesight issues.

Good food; nice break from the tex-mix; try the empanada.

The neighborhood is a bit rough, but they do have security roaming around the parking lot.

This is a good solid IHop.  Clean, good service, quick turnover (short wait times), and we've never had a bad meal here.  Always tough choosing between lunch/dinner foods and breakfast so it was really nice seeing that they have added items that combine them both.  Kids love the food and no matter if they're getting breakfast or dinner they have to have the app sampler.  The only thing keeping me from giving this 5 stars is how tight all of the seating is.

While the atmosphere seemed nice, the food left something to be said. We had the long hots, boneless wings, and Tuscan pizza. The long hots were the thing we enjoyed the most but the prosciutto wrapped around them didn't really seem to go with it. The wings though just seemed like frozen wings that were heated up. Service was fine but hard to go back to a place where you don't enjoy the food.

Go at your own risk. The concept of TERRIBLE doesn't need explanation. The nice customer service cannot overcome the damage done by distasteful food with no elaboration, no presentation and lack of culinary technique. Do not even attempt the house wine.
Great place for a Heineken as you cannot go too wrong with that. Not because Heineken is the best, it is because you know how it tastes.
BTY, no cheap. Your money worths more.

I am combining my dine in and take out experience.  The food was great and delicious.  Very flavorful.  

Dining in was pack so my advice is to call in or go on yelp and be placed on the waiting list.  

Take out was quick and simple.  I ordered my food and was able to park right in front and picked up my food.

First time visiting and was pretty excited to try it out being its new to the community. However, I wasn't impressed. We came in with 3 kids and 2 adults. Upon arrival (rear door) we told the hostess 5 including 3 kids. She looked very confused, walked away and came back a few minutes later with an older woman. Who sat us in the dining room area. Our waitress was nice however, the service was kind of slow. We all had empty drinks for a while and she didn't check on us until the end of our meal. The food was nothing to write home about. I got the coconut shrimp which reminded me of the "seapak" brand you get in the frozen food section at the food store. The pina colada sauce was good. The kids sliders where more like meatballs on a bun & the cheesesteak was dry. We probably won't return for dinner, but having happy hour until 7pm with 1/2 priced drinks and apps we may come back just for that.
If I had been able to give no stars, I would have. I have never felt so violated. I ordered a Greek salad and received a bug salad. Buyer beware!

We come here about once a week. We like to sit at the bar as it is a beautiful bar, nice fireplace and decor, friendly bartenders, and always others around it as well. They have excellent drinks and food, there is also activities such as Friday night Karaoke. This is owned separately from the one in Broadripple. Only drawbacks: no gluten free options as our daughter is gluten free and only one vegetarian option. I would like to see them add some of the excellent vegan options the Broadripple restaurant has. I still give it a five star as we love going there.

Found this gem on yelp. The service was top notch. Came in for happy hour. My wife loved the oysters. Were were educated on the various kinds and locations they came from. Great place. We visited twice during our stay in the city. We will go back.

Every time I forget how bad this location is I give it a shot and they never fail to remind me why I never go there.  I have spoken with management on several occasions but it's always the same.  At one point I thought they might be secretly filming people to see their dismay.

This place always gets the order wrong.   I usually get the 12 piece family meal and every time they screw it up.    

Today I ordered 11 piece mixed... Got all mild, asked for no wings and got 4.  Only got 1 breast and 1 thigh and the drumsticks were the size of buffalo wings.

The last time I went I had the same complaint about the size of the drumsticks.  If I find the picture I'll update this post.  

Stay away from this place unless you are dinning in.

I love that they have 2 for 1 burgers for UNR faculty/students! Burgers are great. A bit pricey, but delicious.  Good happy hour.  The service is usually pretty good. They have an upstairs sports bar or a downstairs café for those who want a little more mellow location.  And a great breakfast!

I wanted to give this place 5 stars SO BAD, but it left me very meh. It's cash only, which I read about on here so I came prepared with my dollar bills. There was a line outside the door, and they were able to get through the line pretty fast. My order came up pretty quickly. I ordered the elote, plantains, the avocado,  tilapia and Pork taco. The pork was the highlight for sure. The tilapia batter tasted like it was made in the same fryer as the plantains, which was part of my meh feeling. But it was a cute little local place.

Recently ate here while on a trio to Boise...this place was super convenient to my hotel and in easy walking distance. It was getting late so was just happy to find a place to eat that was open a little later. Walking in in this place has a really cool tiki vibe and reminded me of being in Hawaii. They have a great menu with lots of choices from traditional choices of appetizers , sushi, Hawaiian style dishes.  I asked the bartender what his favorite thing on the menu was and he said he loved the mahi mahi fish tacos. So for me hunger was kicking in and my mind was made up. I started off with some chips and salsa and while the salsa and warm bean dip was super good the out of bag chips were just ok and kinda stale and the reason I removed one star. Outside of that everything else was great. Plus the service from the bartender was a 5 star experience for sure. The tacos where the main star and clean see why this was his favorite dish. The fish tasted super fresh and loved every part. Another surprise was the side of coleslaw that was as well super delicious.  I enjoyed pretty much every part of this meal including the cold beer I washed everything down with. This was a great find and so glad I had the opportunity to try this place out. 

In addition this restaurant is doing all the safety protocols that are being asked...including limited seating for social distancing, masks and extra cleaning. So congrats and thanks for doing all that you can to keep us safe. So whether local or visiting this is a great choice in the downtown Boise area.

I am a HUGE Chipotle fan and this location is an exception to everything else I've experienced. Less than stellar experience.

#1 - I always order vegetarian. I have found meat in my bowl 3 different visits. That tells me that they're dropping meat and cross contaminating in all the food.
#2 - They don't listen to my request. When I say, "a little bit of medium salsa," they just dump an entire scoop. 
#3 - They wear gloves, but they handle the food way too much. i.e. back to #1. I order meet free - they're touching the meat of the person in front of me and then they're handling/ touching my veggies right after that. I HATE IT! Quit touching my food.

We continue to go back because it's the closest to where we live, but I'd happily take a different Chipotle if there was another close option.

Totally worth the wait.  Awesome hostess and servers - great service and the food - hit all marks.  The catfish was perfectly friend and the savory crepe my wife had was on point.  Loved the ratatouille.

I was extremely disappointed by this pizza.  I had been curious to know what they had because they share a parking lot with big mo's.  We ordered the pizza and it was bland.  They were out of wings during the week.  It wasn't good enough to warrant me returning.

April 14th 250pm

Server was great. Food was okay my issue was with the bartender over charging for well drinks. I went up there to ask if there was a mistake bartender charged me 14$ for 2 well drinks on happy hour. Bar tender name is brittaney. 

I am a local and work in the bar industry i know when im being over charged.

This is probably my favorite MEXICAN RESTAURANT in franklin, Tn. I love to come here for queso. It's family friendly. The service is amazing and so are the prices ! I really recommend trying mix fajitas it was delicious!

My husband and I went here after it was recommended to me by a friend. We arrived at about 11:30 on a Sunday and just happened to beat the lunch rush. I ordered the Lucky Margherita Pizza and he ordered the Ode to Dan Russo. Both pizzas were absolutely delicious! My margherita pizza had just enough sauce and a glob of mozzarella on each slice. I also loved the thin crust. My husband thought his pizza had just the right spiciness from the sausage and the sun dried tomatoes were nice and juicy. We will definitely be visiting the Lucky Penny during our next trip to Santa Barbara.

5 star for it's class. Cheap and more importantly delicious. Great fried chicken served anywhere from traditional non-spicy southern fried chicken to mouth, eye and nose watering spicy. Line was long at lunch time on a wednesday. "Damn Hot" chicken was crunchy, spicy and juicy as can be. Came with 2 sides, collard greens were great and not over cooked or overly salty. Pimento Mac and cheese was ok but ordinary. Excellent southern style sweet tea, and a pretty decent beer selection. Most of the seating is outside so on a hot day be prepared to sweat from the chicken and the weather. Fried chicken takes time so be prepared to wait a bit after you order. I'd say it's a must for anyone visiting nashville.
Very slow service and long wait for drive thru. Food tasted worse than a store bought bagel and orange juice was so watered down I actually double checked to see it was orange juice. Overly priced
Greeted like we were VIP's by the owner and her son. Reasonable 10 minute wait or immediate seating at the amazing buffet. Not that hungry today and it's all you can eat. Really tasty brunch.

Food was good but way expensive. I can understand being slightly higher than other Vietnamese restaurants in lower rent areas but not this much. I had spring rolls and they were $4.50 vrs #.00 elsewhere for two. Also, a bowl of PHO Tai s noodle soup was about $4.00 more per bowl! My server was friendly and that helped add the third star here. She for got to refill my water and bring the extra napkins but she made up for it with by being friendly and always smiling:)

Excellent Service!!! We loved the Lasagna, side of mixed vegetables and birthday dessert!  They made us feel like we were the only customers dining there despite being pretty busy.  I was worried my 10-month-old would make too much noise when we arrived.  They loved my little guy and kept talking to him.  My grandma loved the fragrant rose centerpiece and they let her take it home!  All of the staff greeted us and spoke to us.  When we left we were having suchah great time that we forgot our leftovers.  The buser jogged all the way to the corner of Castillo st. to catch up to us and make sure our leftovers weren't leftover.
Ordered ahead to pick up at a specific time. Pulling it out of oven right on time.  Thanks.  Classroom full of kids appreciate it!

Really disappointed today and maybe I expect to much from BBD - I ordered the shrimp basket with onion rings and a side of Ranch Dressing with a Diet Dr Pepper - I got the basket and it was not like I am used to with a good amount of food it was far from that - The onion rings ok - NO Ranch Dressing - Dr Pepper was not diet and I check with the waitress and she had on the order DIET. Once again as I indicated that maybe I expect too much from BBD and I am used a good size portion that makes me full looking at it. Well I will not order any fish related items in the future - I will still be a BBD customer. Oh by the way I wish my waitress would have payed more attention to her station than someone else.

I have been eating here at least once a week for lunch for the last several years, however since they built their new building the menu and the food has changed. They added a lot of new items but they also changed the way they make the food on their previous menu. The price also has increased, sometimes from day to day. 

They seem to be all about money, on many of their specialty items you have to buy 4, such as tostada's or gordita's. When I was ordering tamale's I would ask for verde sauce added to the top, it wasn't a problem, then one day I ate the same tamale's I have many times in the past but when I got the bill it was double the normal price that I had been paying. I asked my server about this and was told that the owner made it into a special and that was the new price. It basically doubled the price of my lunch.

It use to be hard to park near the building for lunch, now parking is usually available, I often park there when I walk to one of the many other places nearby to eat. The only reason I gave it 2 stars is the food is still good if you don't mind the menu changes, price increases and changes in how the food is prepared.

I was extremely happy with my takeout.  I tried the Chicken Vindaloo and my husband had the Chicken Tikka Masala with onion chutney on the side.  All of the food was fresh, bright and flavorful.  Just a hint of spice, next time I could definitely go more spicy.  The menu is expansive with lots of options. They even offer Indo Chinese.  I wish I had photos but I highly recommend this establishment if you're in the mood for Indian Cuisine I'm Carrollwood.

So when I called the guy sounded tired and just not excited about life. So when I went to pick them up he must of been the owner because he looked the part but it must be because he's opening to close the place. I don't mind his attitude though because the wings were so good! I ordered them dry and crispy and the wings stand alone they have their own seasoning which is nice compared to other places. Both the pepper honey and Herb Ranch were very good flavorful I was ultimately surprised and impressed.

I've been there twice now, and enjoy the food very much both times.  The margaritas were also very good.  I've had the Nachos Margaritas and flan, both of which I had no complaints about.  The chips and salsa were also good.  My only complaint is slow service at times.

Had Thanksgiving buffet and it was pretty good. Lots of selection. Turkey, ham and coconut shrimps were delicious, and unlimited champagne was great! It was a busy night and the restaurant was way overbooked. Although we had a reservation, it took about 40 minutes to get seated. However, the staff was amazing, especially the front desk personnel and our waiter. Despite the almost chaotic atmosphere, we really enjoyed our evening and had lots of good food and champagne!
What a great little place in the middle of old historic area. Very friendly staff and great service. The food was perfect. My burger was perfection. I'm glad I decided to stop.

This little diner is a regular slice of contemporary Americana. I always love going to independent restaurants, and this one smacks of small-town charm and honest-to-goodness home-style cooking.

I loves me some biscuit and gravy, and rarely do I find it north of Dixie, especially a good plate of it. The biscuits here were light and fluffy and moist... no hockey pucks here. The sausage gravy ROCKS! Not overly salted, just simply delicious, with a good amount of sausage swimming around, this gravy lavishly coats those amazing biscuits. These are among the best biscuits and gravy I've had up north.

The bacon was perfectly crispy, and a great compliment to my main dish, although I had to order it as a side. The pancakes are light and fluffy, and the french toast is thick and tasty, with just enough of the egg coming through.

I'm generally not a fan of home fries, but the ones here were very good. I asked for them well-done, and that they were, and done well. They had a nice crispness without being burnt. 

The staff is pleasant and the service is prompt. I look forward to coming back for other meals and will follow up when I do.
Fantastic food excellent wine selection interesting location but this place would be super in the Bay Area

Really attractive space -- the dining room is kind of loud, and the bar in the basement is a close, lively place with a nice vibe and live music.  The menu is "comfort food with a twist," and it's a terrific menu with great specials.  Amazing fried chicken, great flatbreads (including build your own), sandwiches, barbeque, tomato bisque and grilled cheese, burgers. pork belly with white beans and collard greens . . .  Superb service, good drinks and a great deck overlooking Broad Ripple Avenue.

Ate hear a few weeks ago on Good Friday.  Got to the restaurant around 6 PM and there was no wait.  Both my wife and I ordered pasta dishes and we shared a salad and dessert.  The food was average in our opinion and certainly not worth the prices they were charging.  Staff was OK, but not overly friendly.  For the price, it just wasn't worth it.

The Munch Factory is my husband and I go to restaurant when I don't feel like cooking dinner. That means, we visit this restaurant at least once a week. The food is always delicious. The chicken sandwich, twin burgers, shrimp and grits, clam chowder are ALL wonderfully made with quality ingredients. The staff is personable and always happy that you came to dine with them.

The only knock I have on this restaurant is the length of time it takes for the food to arrive to the table. I believe it's a relatively small kitchen and if they have too many orders--it takes them quite awhile to get the food out to you. Other than that, it's a wonderful restaurant owned by a young family and I'll support them for as long as they are around.

Keep up the good work!

In town for a girl's trip... We visited many of our normal spots while here ---but, this place is now one of our absolute faves!!! Everything we ordered was fresh and delicious. Worth the drive out of the Warehouse District.

Loved, absolutely loved this place. Would have given it 4 or possibly 5 stars until the fiancée and I went there and the girl behind the bar would not stop overtly flirting with him. It was nauseating to witness. Time after time she interrupted our conversation to make stupid jokes to him (while acting as if I didn't exist), try to get his attention, and even try and get him to taste the ginger syrup. "Here, taste this, does it taste, like, bad?" {giggle}. My fiancée had to physically turn his back to her for her to get the hint that he was not interested. What makes it even more pathetic? Judging by the photo on the menu, she is a the owners daughter. It was rude, disrespectful and obnoxious. We will not be back.

I attended a novac noff event last night at this restaurant not knowing what to expect. Was utterly amazed at the size of venue and its asthetically appealing design very classy yet homey feeling. Great flat screens at bar to watch the saints destroy the dirty birds along with super hospitable bartenders and servers. Now I guess the important things the food.excellent!!!!!! Try the sliders amazing try the bread pudding with sweet and spicy syrup try the debris fries to die for! Will be recommending all over town and to all of out of towers that get in my uber!

The Gulch has truly transformed. And Milk and Honey is a great addition to the neighborhood. I love and hate that it's a short walk from the office. I've been on daily walks and found myself at their order bar grabbing desserts that I shouldn't be eating. But on the flip, its a great spot for lunch. We went a little bit after 11 to beat the rush, and it was still pretty packed from breakfast. Fortunately, we got one of the two open tables. There was some confusion about the menus and whether it was lunch or breakfast, but eventually got lunch menus and was able to order. We split the chicken banh mi and short rib melt and had a side of the kale salad. The chicken banh mi was delicious, but the melt was just ok. Really enjoyed the salad, it was very refreshing. The desserts were good - brought an assortment of cookies to share and most of them were ok, but the brownie was the best! There's a cold bar that has prepared sandwiches and salads. And you can order drinks and coffees. Service was a bit slow, but I believe they'l improve over time.
I was super excited when they opened only to be let down.Just another over priced mediocre doughnut shop. Its not worth the hype.

Visited for dinner on Friday, October 9, 2020. For was great as always.  There are tons of options.  We had the Meat Lovers pizza which was excellent.  What stands out the most is the friendly nature of the service from everyone.  Ryan took care of us and exceeded expectations.  He checked in with us at the right frequency, got our food quickly and offered helpful suggestions.  We also me Amanda who we stopped after seeing her light the lavender on a drink.  She was very accessible and friendly.  This was our 3 trip to this restaurant, and everyone has been consistent.  Great pizza joint!
Very Nice people, Lao tom makhoong is great. Sushi is always fresh and great at as well. Have tried alot of their dishes but usually get Curries or Paht Thai.

Wow! Did other Yelpers go to a different Rubio's? Counter staff were acceptible, although not overly friendly or helpful. The interior was modern and bright, but not at all  clean. We walked by at least six dirty tables, and there was food and used napkins on the floor. We ordered guacamole and chips - which consisted of a very small serving of bland  gaucamole with a plateful to tortilla chip crumbs. Nothing large enough to scoop up some gaucamole. Must have been the bottom of the bag. I ordered the Costal Trio. The tilapia taco had a small piece of fish the size of my index finger. The shrimp taco had 3 small over cooked shrimp, and the Original Fish taco was not cooked to "crispy perfection" - it was mush. Overall looked nothing at all like the menu photo. And the corn tortillas were soft and doughy. My wife's salmon tacos were over cooked, tough, and dry. She couldn't eat them. While I liked the idea of the salsa bar, the small micro-containers (less than a tablespoonful) were pitiful. And what's with being unable to buy a side of chips? Save your money, you'll get better value at Taco Bell.

Outstanding ramen! We ordered the Tonkotsu Red. We've had ramen in Hawaii, San Francisco, and Okinawa. This was far better than any we've had, and it's in Tucson, AZ! Imagine that. Kris our server was a lot of fun and very knowledgeable of the ingredients used in our dish. Wonderful experience. We will definitely be returning soon!

I usually love this place but tonight was no good. It took about 30 minutes to get our to-go food. By the time I got home, I realized they gave me shrimp instead of chicken lo mein bowl. On top of that, the hot and sour soup had a terrible burnt like taste to it. I won't be going back for awhile. Price isn't worth it.

I find Westshore Pizza to be one of the best pizza places around here. The spicy Italian is especially delicious to me. I've always had good service and I like their 2 slices of pizza & drink for $6.00 deal.

I really enjoy Roys whenever Im close-by I just have to have one of there lobster tails. There lobster tail at Roy's is definitely in my top 2 most favorite, also there ribs! OMG they are so good I definitely recommend them to anyone. Also great ambiance love the vibe, also the aloha HR is great

Red pepper fatigue. ..
They spice every dish (we tried) like Kim Chi....
I love the Chi, but every flavor was bitter..hot...red pepper overkill.

Service sucks. ..bad....

Korea. ..this is not your culinary flag. 

I guess if you don't know better,  and service is not important to you. ...ok....

One day Boise will know REAL Korean food...this ain't it.

Peace
Great food,great service.Keep up the good work.Glad you made it through these tough times.

We've been to The Little Lion and it is a great option when you want an easy, tasty meal or happy hour.  We've never had a problem getting in and the menu is full of delicious items - favorites include the full board and the fried chicken.  The cocktails are pretty tasty and happy hour offers some great deals.  1 star off as service can be a little on the slow side but if you're not in a rush, that shouldn't be a problem - just order your next drink when the first one is still half full!
Amazing broasted chicken, the best I've ever had. Their weekdays specials are excellent and their Winger's fries are very good.

After reading all the reviews on Yelp I came in with very high expectations. Though the service was exceptional, the food was a bit lacking. I tried their miso ramen, and it took forever to come out. Granted it was a busy night. There was barely any broth in our bowl and the noodle was not cooked entirely. The broth was rather salty, it felt like it was scooped from the bottom of the pot. I also had high hopes for the black garlic wings, but they were not very warm when they were served. The sauce was again too salty for my taste and the chicken didn't really have a crispy texture. 

Lastly, my friend pointed out that there is only one real ramen on the menu.
Portions were very large and price was reasonable. The steak burrito was amazing!  Will definitely go back.
I tried the BBQ nachos which I thought were really good.  I love this place.  When I am going through St. Louis, I make it a point to eat at either Pappy's or Dalie's.

If I have my druthers, I prefer a straight hotel versus a resort since resorts, in their effort to have everything you need on the property and be convenient for you, end up being inconvenient.  And expensive.  That said, I do love this property.  Fountains and gardens and canals, oh my!  There are a line of concierges waiting to assist with a smile.  Pools (a loud one, a quiet one and an indoor one), spas, a salon, and a pretty good 24-hour gym complete with 14 treadmills, 4 spinning bikes, weights both mechanical and free and more.  My room is spacious and clean with comfy linens, a refrigerator, 2 free bottles of water per day, free internet and the bath area has two sinks, one inside and one outside the actual bath.  The bathroom also has one of those "power" toilets that flush with great force.  Love that!  Love that there's also a lighted magnifying mirror for perfect makeup application (or shaving for the guys).  

My nit-picky complaints would be (1) that the signage in this monstrosity of a property can be a bit confusing to navigate.  Not sure that there's anything that can be done about it though, because of the multiple levels and halls and such.  I'm getting to know my way around quickly, though.  Also, (2) there is nowhere on this property that showed the Pay-per-View Silva vs. Sonnen fight.  Had to go off-property to the Buffalo Wild Wings to catch it.  (3) The gym is way too hot.  Feels like a sauna.  I'm surprised I haven't seen anyone pass out.  

Because this is a resort, again, be prepared to spend lots of money wherever you decide to eat.
Esto es.  Impresionante. Unas. Ricas.  Quesadillas. De.  Pollo. Agregarles.  Chanpinones.  Una. Bebida.   Natural de. Pina. Todo. Fresco.  Deliccioso. Y un.  Precio. Rasonable.   Un buen.  Serviccio.

7/10 would bang again. 
Had a shrimp Po-boy with a side of lobster bisque. The Sammy was good would totally order it again but maybe next time with a little less sauce on it. Just ended up being too much by the end of the sandwich. Bisque was good but could be served a bit warmer. 
Over all would come back.
Randomly came across this restaurant driving home. Best pizza we've had in a long time! Service was excellent too! Will definitely be back and will order take out!

Zahav is always a wonderful dining experience. Delicious and well executed food coupled with simple but impeccable service. Plus, the bartenders are just as entertaining as the unique drinks that they serve. 

Ambiance: Open air space but warmly lit and simply decorated. It's a place that's great for a date, a group, random catchups and everything in between. 

Service: Consistently friendly and helpful. They all seem to really know the menu and whenever I have asked for their recommendations I have always been more than satisfied. 

Food: 9/10 it is always a hit amidst my tastebuds. I think there was only one or two dishes in the few times that I have gone to Zahav that were less than memorable. To highlight the one's that shine in my mind..
The salatim and hummus is unmatched along with their fresh made laffa that accompanies this beginning excursion of flavors into the Middle East palate. Their fried cauliflower and crispy halloumi are one of my most memorable starters there. I also had the best salmon of my life at Zahav. The salmon was quality enough to be eaten raw and was cooked accordingly. Tender and moist with a subtle smoked flavor. I am not sure if this is still on the menu but take this as indication of the kitchen's ability to cook and smoke meats to perfection. 
As for desserts, I am always a sucker for their classic konafi, which is a nice clean end to your meal. 

Drinks: For a complete experience at Zahav, I really encourage trying some of their signature cocktails. If you enjoy your savory cocktails, try their Whiskey Harif which I can best explain as liquified BBQ smokehouse air. Which I just realized may not sound as appetizing... It is made with whiskey infused with smoky peppers so the heat of the drink only hits you in the back of your mouth. It's got a powerful flavor punch so I would not drink this with your meal. 
Another recommendation is to check out the bar for some drinks and other various menu items, the bartenders are friendly and more than helpful if you are tentative of trying cocktails out of your normal range of gin and tonic. 
Last thing... I really enjoyed their offering of a Late Harvest Gewurztraminer which is not as syrupy sweet as most Late Harvests.

I realize at this point I may be sounding like some love-sick Zahav sycophant so I'm going to stop. But I hope you try it and I hope you enjoy it as much as I have.

I've only been to this location three times; but I've been to the other location many many more. Kim Cheese is a solid, American Korean fusion place where their burgers and tacos definitely stand out. 

First off their ingredients are very fresh and high quality. Their beef is cut ribeye so that is definitely a plus. 

Their Tacos stand out of having a little bit of everything, meat veggies corn sauce. The burgers are awesome, they are big, with an egg in it, and very tasty. 

This place has a bigger interior and dining area than the other one and is a much friendlier atmosphere.

No self respecting Italian would eat more than one bite of their rubbery Dominoes style dough. The Cipolla pizza came with at most two teaspoons of cheese. I'm sorry but Pizzaiolo is not world class pizza. World class FAIL would be more appropriate.

Johnny Apples sits at the bottom of Buck Road, just above the stream that runs through this valley into Neshaminy Creek.  It is a surprisingly large house, with bar and dining room running the front of the building, and a nice patio in the rear. It is casual and comfortable.  The beer list is relatively simple, and the menu offers traditional American fare.  We came in for dinner on Tuesday night when there were few people dining, and only two or three at the bar.  It was cool, and it felt great to get out of the suddenly oppressive heat enveloping southeastern Pennsylvania. 

We ordered a cross section from their offerings.  Avocado burger with fries, blackened shrimp with mashed potatoes, and "The best meatloaf you've ever tasted," with taters and string beans. While all looked good upon arrival, none really lived up to our hopeful expectations. The burger was a previously frozen puck that was cooked beyond the medium requested, and lacked taste and texture.  The cheese and avocado registered, but the beef was not juicy, nor flavorful.  Their fries were the type with extra starch applied to make them crispy. They were not to our liking.  The six medium sized shrimp were grilled well and had good taste, but were not "blackened" with enough spice, nor exposed to mesquite coals to bring up the special blackened flavor.  They were well prepared without that, but  for $19 we looked forward to more. Finally, the "best" meatloaf, wasn't.  It was overly dense and baked far too long.  It was dry and burnt in part, making the pockmarked surface look like a rock sample from Mars.  The sauce was overly salty.  The potatoes and beans were fine. 

Could be that we came at Johnny Apples the wrong way.  Perhaps, the apps alone with beer was the way to go.  Nice things have been said about their wings.  Regardless, we experienced a less than compelling meal that would deny a  good reason to return.
Some of the best Chinese in the area. Solid Rangoons, General Tso's and really any other dish is good.

Ordered takeout on November 15. The bartender (Gloria?) was not wearing a mask and was engaged in lively conversation with about 4-5 people sitting close together at the bar. Seriously Crocodile?  This is how viruses spread. I had a similar experience here a couple months ago. Crocodile is a repeat offender.

From reading all the food reviews I placed order for take out. I got the drunken noodles with chicken, Pad Thai, and a coconut bubble tea. The food was medicore nothing really special or flavorful that would keep me running back for more. What I really didn't like about this place is it's customer service. When coming to pick-up my food  there was a young Asian lady in the front whom seemed to be annoyed serving customers. She didn't say hello or anything.  What really made things uncomfortable is the older Asian lady that worked  there was yelling at one of their employees in front of customers. I won't be returning to this place. I really wanted to like this place because it was on the way back from work but I will stick to my usual spot White Elephant for some good Thai food.

This is a serious sandwich shop and if I'm visiting Philadelphia I try to stop by to pickup a sandwich.

I get the Jewish Hoagie with the works. I am never able to completely finish the sandwich and always eat the rest later. It does take awhile to get a sandwich made but if you've got time to kill and aren't too hungry to be impatient it's worth it.

If you're there on a good day there will be free samples of random deli meats and cheeses you'd normally never get (pepperoni cheese anyone?).

This is the spot. It's the type of place you want when you want crawfish, spicy, flavorful, affordable and good. I got 1 lb crawfish, 1 lb shrimp, 1 fried turkey wing, 4 potatoes and 2 big beers. The seasoning on the crawfish and the potatoes was so delicious! Definitely worth the drive. The atmosphere is simple and comfortable and you can tell that people who live here come here.

This place is great. High quality hookah's plus high quality shisha means I am SOLD. The food is good. The drink is good. The service is... strange? I definitely had a waitress on ecstasy. It was awesome, though. 

Never had to pay a cover, but maybe we never went on a Friday. Or maybe we went so much they knew us and waived it. Both are plausible.

Awesome decor. Good times are to be had here. Get ready for some fond memories.

With healthy intentions in mind myself and my wife went for a stroll around Carmel. However rain pushed us into Auntie Em's shop of various sweets. Cupcake, hot cocoa, and root beer float later we left the shop.

Deserts, service, and decor of the place deserve 5 stars. Great place to meet with few friends.

We stopped here on our way through Nevada for a breakfast bagel. I had a garlic Parmesan bagel with plain cream cheese and my boyfriend got a jalapeño cheddar with plain cream cheese. They were both really yummy. 

We got a free blueberry muffin with our yelp check in, but have yet to try it. It looks really good.

They have indoor seating and 2 tables outside. Free wifi if you sit inside.

I think I found my new favorite sushi spot in the city.  We didn't have reservations on a Thursday night, and found that although it was pretty crowded, we were able to get seated in 5 minutes.  The ambience of FS is trendy and chic, the design clean and simple with a high tech vibe.  I love sashimi and the sashimi plate for 1 was definitely more than enough for one person- I actually shared it with my friend and it was still plenty.  The feshness of the fish and the selection was awesome.  The best sashimi- which doesn't surprise me, given the name of the establishment, was the salmon.  Melted in my mouth.  The combination of the food and the fact that it's a byob make this my new top spot in Philly.  The only thing that could use a little working on is the timing of how the food is brought out, but the waiters were super helpful, very pleasant and did not rush us into ordering.  I would go back to FS tonight and in fact, I already know where I'm going for my birthday in September!

Beats Hattie b's hands down! I've never been impressed with hot chicken much but I think it's my new favorite. I got the chicken kabab, it was amazing and the perfect amount, I got mild and it was perfect, I will try hot next time. My daughter got the tenders, they are big and juicy- these aren't frozen breaded tenders, these are big breast quarters cut up, battered and fried. My grandson called them phat tenders and he said phat with a p! Fries were good and I really look forward to trying the chicken potato and maybe the fried hot dog. Don't worry, this place is just a few miles from Beamon Park, you can go over there and walk it off.

What does "oriental food" mean?  In my mind it is one thing- pineapple tofu! 

I'm always a bit leery ordering any type of meat at food trucks.  I love George's crispy chicken sandwich and I'm always willing to try a Bui's hangover special every now and again but for the most part I try and steer clear.  Enter Kim's pineapple tofu!  I'm not sure if it's on the menu or not (recommended by a friend) but every time I go I ask for spicy steamed pineapple tofu with brown rice and it is always delicious.  Well worth the $4.25 they charge.
I highly endorse this place. If your a dog fan, than this place is a must. My fav was the North Carolina dog with Chili and slaw.

Took a chance best decision ever this place is the best the Belushi was amazing and in my opinion fries better than McDonald's!!!
Even perfect cokes or mr pibbs and the place feels so comfortable!!
I'll be coming here a lot!!!!

in a city often lacking in veggie options (I'm not a vegetarian, but I do tend toward the meatless if there is a choice) the sunflower cafe is a breath of fresh air. there are tons of flavor options to dispel the vegetarian=bland argument. just the veggie patty had half a dozen options for dressing it up, from American style to Asian slaw. the sides were delicious! I highly recommend the pad Thai (though it is cold, that was a little weird at first) and the ginger chick peas. oh my yum!! this place is definitely going to become a regular stop.

Went here for a pre-Valentine's day dinner.  We got there a little early, so went went upstairs to the lounge, which was really nice.  There were lots of televisions and different types of seating.  Drinks were pricey, but good and in line with the atmosphere.  Highly recommend!
  Our dinner was awesome, from the different breads, to the really good shrimp cocktail, (don't breathe out through your nose when you take a bite or you'll be sorry : ) to the fantastic steaks(ribeye and filet) and sides.
   I will have to say that the highlight of the experience was our waiter, Andy!  We can't say enough good about this young gentlemen.  He was polite, personable, professional, and accommodating.  He also walked us out and gave us a mini tour of the place, explaining some of the wall memorabilia and it's importance to Indy.  It was very entertaining and interesting!  I'm not sure what they are paying this guy, but it's surely not enough!  That was one of the best times we have ever had in a restaurant and I know we will be back especially for that reason!  Good food, good people and good times!  Oh yeah, make your reservations early, it fills up quick especially on the weekend and ask for Andy!

When it was opened on Manchester street, we were excited. We used to go to the one by Kirkwood, but the distance is a little far. So when they first opened the door last year, we couldn't wait to go.

Everything is the same, everything except the friendliness of the staffs. I am not sure if they were trained wait staffs or Texas Roadhouse was in a hurry to employ anybody's that's available. 

Our experiences at Kirkwood branch were excellent. My daughter barfed there once due to sickness and everyone, including the manager, were very concern and nice and understanding. 

But here in this branch, all we got was unfriendly faces. We paid to eat here, and yet not even a smile from our waiter. My girls and I went to the bathroom and we saw our waiter both times standing by the order machine. We made eye contact and I cracked a smile, he ignored both times. 

I smiled to everybody, none returned. I don't think I am that ugly. Unless you want to talk about race issue here?

Personally I'd recommend Bandana's Bar-B-Q, which's on the eastern side of Manchester Rd. Very friendly staffs.
Best wings in philly hands down. Not too spicy, they are guaranteed to satisfy and to get that wing craving under control

When I feel like going out but also keeping it healthy this is my place.  Their menu is diverse enough to please anyone.  I personally love the pupusa and the soup (doesn't matter which flavour they are all good!).  The bbq pork is raved about by a friend as are the pasta dishes.  Their alcohol selection is a little lacking for me but if you sit outside 64 Growler is next door and....
They also have a reward program you can sign up for and all you have to do is give the server your phone number to track points.  I appreciate that I don't have to carry around a card.  The service has always been great and there is an awesome quaint vibe.

We were supposed to have our room by 3:00, but they didn't have it ready until 5:00. The next morning, we asked if we could check out an hour late but they wouldn't let us without charging us, even after we mentioned that we had to wait hours for our room to be ready. The hotel and casino are nice, but the room situation was a huge inconvenience.

Nice place, great date place. Love the firepits. Would be a great place to watch the game, the outside bar is very nice, 4 TVs. Barmaid is good. Two complaints, the eggplant & crab stack had no crab I could taste, only thing saved it was generous with Feta, & a ladies room with NO MIRROR!  Really? Could spring another 20$????!!!! WTF. Overall it's pretty cool. Oh, and they have Corona, light & reg on tap.... Very rare.
