I've been going here for 10 years and the rolls are all I ever get here, but it's because they are sooooo good. A lil' crispy on the outside, with a sweet garlic coating, and thick and super doughy on the inside. If you're taking them to go, they'll heat them in the oven if you want, so you can have some on the go! So glad that after 10 years, they haven't changed the recipe or moved on to cheap ingredients, they've kept the good stuff!

Something most people in Reno don't know about, "ALL" the fish in Reno comes from the same supplier out of San Francisco. The only difference is how they prepare it. Yes you have to prepare the fish, they don't just cut it and hand it to you. Freshness also depends on the temperature of which the fish is served and some restaurant do it right by serving it slightly chilled but to the point where the fish melts in your mouth. Not tasting icey. With that said, here is my review of this restaurant.

Food-5, I miss Kwon making my Sushi but now he's too busy being Owner. His sushi and roll still lives through his Chefs. Little bit more expensive then other places but they serve Uni! YummY, Kwon also help Rick Shaw start their restaurant, so if you can't make it to this place, Rick Shaw is a good alternative.

Service-4, Chefs are friendly and there's plenty of them, never waiting for anything. 

Atmosphere-4, I would give this place 5 stars but it's always so busy and the little room can get loud.
We came during the Fountain Square festival on a Friday night.   Enjoyed their brews! The server's suggestions were spot on!  I enjoyed the vegetarian wrap & my DH has their club!   Great choices.

Typical sports bar with TV's taking up more space then it should. Young, fun, friendly staff with decent "sports bar" food. Be careful on game days, especially home games since the Dome is down the street. I come here when its less crowded to avoid the wait and madness or want something a tad but better then "hooters".

Vegan-friendly, great service, delicious lunch buffet. The buffet is guaranteed to have several vegan options, which usually includes the soup. The lunch buffet is the jam, and will fill you up beyond believe for under $8.00. The water is the most delicious water ever, I can't even describe it. If you go to the buffet, they bring you naan- if you're vegan, tell them when you walk in and request tandoori roti instead of naan, because that's the vegan option. 

If ordering off of the menu, I highly recommend the tomato coconut soup, samosas, pakoras (friend onions and potatoes), and the aloo ghobi.

Good  was not so good , and the drinks were ridicusly overpriced,  I guess is to be expected on Broadway but I think it's to much , the food price is not so bad , but I personally didn't like the food so much my wife had a BBQ wrap and that was better that my pulled pork sandwich
Good food! Cozy place to eat and reasonable prices. Every dish I've had so far is tasty and a nice portion size. Everyone working there is also very polite and professional

Really good House salad! I got the grouper special and it was good but not out of this world. They give you a basket of biscuits and they are AMAZING! Really sweet bartender who took care of us all night. They have small plates and large plate specials. We came at 6:30 on a Tuesday and there was a 45 minute wait but we were able to find a seat at the bar. We enjoyed the seating
The fire roasted mixed grill seafood was awesome as was the veal cutlets. Their bread was fresh but if you order the steak filet and want it medium rare order it rare because they overcook it.

Went on a whim from VA appointment and was very impressed.  Wonderful grass fed 1/4 pounder with grilled onion and mushroom and choice of cheese with condiments as necessary on a GF bun.  Incredibly tasty with crisp fries.  Will definitely go back.  Nice staff interaction as well.  Very good and quaint lunch spot!

This place gets a 3.5 from me. 
Up stairs it's a really beautiful room... that no one goes to.
Downstairs this place is a mall, made for tourists. I can understand why people don't like it here but as a tourist I enjoyed it. It's got some really good food here too. I loveddddd the Taco & Grill place. If I could find it on Yelp I'd review it. But yeah, it's not really the place you wana go to if you're from St. Louis. If you're form outta town, drop by, you'll find many gifts and memorabilia you can get your friends and family from here.

I came to The Twisted Tail for Center City Restaurant Week with my boyfriend, and our experience was amazing from beginning to end. Our server, Stephen was attentive and knowledgeable of the menu. He gave us great recommendations. The manager, Colleen, was so sweet and accommodating. She checked on us often to make sure we were happy with everything and made the experience even better. The food and drinks were delicious. Every component of each dish were perfectly paired together. I left feeling content, full and ready to come back for more!

Always a perfect dinning experience! Whenever I am in the mood for authentic Italian with a reasonably priced bottle of wine Cafe Cibo is my sure shot. Our server (when she is working) is Debbie. What a warm and inviting woman! It's that true Italian relative who just wants you to be full and happy. The bruschetta is marinated for 72 hours before hitting the table. The caesar salad is so fresh its as if it's been made table side. 
The Chicken Sorentino is off the charts delicious, especially with a nice glass of Chianti. The Veal Marsala and a Chardonnay are a match made in heaven. And last but not least, a double espresso with tiramisu, aaaaaah. :)   That's me, full and happy

This basement bar seemed like my kind of joint.  Soccer emblems everywhere, a good food menu, and an eclectic crowd...

But the one bartender and 2 servers were way overwhelmed.  9 of us sat at a table next to the bar, and adjacent to the computer where the servers rang in their drinks, but nobody came over to us.  We finally went up to the bar, but had to wait a bit to get the bartender's attention.  It really wasn't all that busy... maybe 8 people at the bar and another 20 at the dining tables.  We easily represented 25% of their patrons.

I ordered an Ice Pick... the bartender had no idea what that was.  

My wife and I ordered a burger.  It came relatively quickly and was yummy.  However, two others in our party ordered sandwiches and it too theirs entirely too long to come out.  We're pretty sure that the bartender forgot to ring them in.  

Lots of potential, but I don't know how you understaff yourself on a holiday weekend with an expected 350K people downtown.  Dumb.

I've been here a couple times now and I just have to say that, while the food is delicious, the real star of the show is the service!

Both visits have been to celebrate a birthday and each time my daughter came along.  My daughter is physically and developmentally disabled which make dining out with her a very rare thing; she can be a lot to handle and the feeling of disrupting other diners and staff is not fun.  Both times, our servers made us feel very welcome and at ease.  We were able to use the private room both times to avoid annoying the other diners. 

Every dish I've tried there has been fantastic (we're a sharing family, everyone gets a bite or two!).  I'm so grateful for their accommodation and kindness!

Where to begin.?! Not only was there one one to greet us at the door we waited 10 minutes for someone to tell us it was open seating! I was told the guacamole was fresh... that's a joke! Don't order it! I only wanted street taco. Like the menu says. I was given something completely different and I was asked by the server "would you like the cilantro and onions on the side?" That's the way it is supposed to come! Why would I want it on the side?! Then I was asked "Oh do you want it like it says on the menu?" YES! Because that what I ordered! Like it say on the menu. It gets better. My new plate then came to me COLD! AND STILL WASN'T RIGHT! What the heck?! The only thing going for this place is the 2 for 1 margaritas.
The bartender FINE ASS John was amazing. Best bartender I've ever had! Great stories and even better drinks!! Please stop by and have a great time with the super freak!
Came here for breakfast and had the Louisiana omelette. Can I just say heaven! It was delicious. My fiancé had the crab cakes and fried green tomatoe and said it too was good.

The Ramen here I found a little over cooked, I am not a slow eater and I still found the noodles a little over done. But that said the broth was very goodI went with the spicy Garlic and found it super flavourful.  The atmosphere is pretty cool and a nice change not having my order screamed out, as is so common at most Ramen bars.  Overall it was good ramen .....not great.

I'd actually give it 3 1/2 but since you can't do it, 4 is ok.  What makes it good is it's really nice courtyard for eating outside that takes you away from the craziness and smells of Bourbon St. Really nice staff and the food is good for Bourbon St. fare. Alligator Bites are a must have and their crab cakes are pretty good. Not too many places on this st are worth eating at but this is one.

Oh holy wow. This food made me want to do a happy dance. The brisket was on point. I got a plate with 6oz of brisket, bacon Mac and cheese and candied bacon. My friend had the pulled pork sandwich with fries. I had offered one of the pieces of bacon to my friend and after I had taken a bite of my mine, was sorry I couldn't take that offer back. Luckily she reciprocated with her fries, which were so deliciously seasoned they didn't need any other sauces. 
The staff was incredibly helpful and offered advice, explanations and drink pairings for our meal. 
I cannot wait to go back.

I was really impressed when I came here. I always grew up eating Rita's Italian Ice, so at first I was skeptical when i saw the word gelato, because I feel like nobody else can compare to Rita's. But I ordered the salted caramel with vanilla gelato and it was delicious! Definitely worth going to. And you get a lot for what you pay for which is another plus.

This place is really, really good and may be the best sushi joint in the Old Pueblo.  First, it is owned and operated by a real sushi chef who ensures that all the fish is fresh.  Whether you're looking for some tuna belly or simple squid salad, the freshness and quality are consistently excellent.  Good ambience and service along with some interesting and creative rolls and some tasty noodle dishes.  Be prepared to wait for a table but don't let that stop you, it's worth it.

Papa Murphy's pizza is fantastic really fresh great tasting ingredients and that buttery pan crust is to die for!!! The crew is top notch great customer service and make an excellent pie salads are great too! Definitely recommend Kolb location

I've been to Datz on a few occasions and I've always been quite happy. Once, When I showed up with the lovely Tiffany, we had the 2nd tier to our selves.  

The food was delivered quite quickly, and served up by a friendly waitress. Granted all I ordered was a salad, so it's kind of hard to make that take a long time.. but I'm sure some could. 

Over all, I think Datz is a solid place. I'd go more if it were closer.

Our favorite spot Oro Valley for Mexican Cuisine! Yummy salsa and chips and their spinach enchiladas are the best! Large portions and good guac! Ask for Renee for excellent customer service, he truly goes the extra mile to make his guests feel valued!

One of my all time favorite places. I love bringing my out of town guests here.
Good food, amazing drinks and fantastic views and ambiance 
Casual and fun 
Beachy Jamaican feel 
Love the live music at night especially the steel drums 
Love the outside seating 
Definitely recommend 

The Key Lime Margarita is out of this world!!!

After hearing from a local this is Queen B and Solange's favorite PO-Boy spot I had to try it! This is by no means a tourist spot, so I stuck out like a sore thumb amongst the locals and regulars. They have such a wide variety of sandwiches it's so hard to choose from! I had the catfish PO-Boy, ahhhhmazzzzing! Well seasoned and tender and I loved the bread, soft in the middle and toasty on the outside. The PO-Boy was the size of my forearm...HUGE! The shrimp PO-Boy was really good too. They are very generous with the portions too. We were waiting for a little while since everything is made fresh it took a little while, but well worth it.

Located inside the Ritz-Carlton Hotel, Aqimero is a refreshing burst of Latin American flavors. As soon as you walk into Aqimero you know it's going to be a great experience because the atmosphere is breathtaking! The open space layout is creatively segmented into intimate seating areas, some with live foliage. Classic and modern, Roman columns stand among vintage chandeliers and floor to ceiling drapery sheers.

And the food is just as great as the ambience! My boyfriend and I shared a mix of appetizers and sides that made for quite a feast. We ordered the wild mushroom flatbread, caramelized  plantains, lobster mac and cheese, grilled asparagus, roasted corn soup, and the spicy shrimp quesadilla with lobster dumpling.

We enjoyed all of our bounty - however the soup was surprisingly sweet which we hadn't expected. If you've been out to eat often you know that lobster mac and cheese has to be done right. Well I'll tell you this, Aqimero obviously knows how it's done because it was delightfully tasty. But surprise, surprise the meal frontrunner for us tonight was the grilled asparagus! It was truly delectable  with a smoked flavor that stirs up memories of your best-loved summer BBQ.

And let's not forget the wait staff. They were very attentive and accommodating. Actually, everyone from the manager to the servers was impeccable! Each time they served the table it was done as an artful presentation that held our attention and earned our awe.

This was my boyfriend's first visit and my second, we both loved our experience at Aqimero and plan to return soon!

Ordered large oxtail and bbq wings.  got home and it was the wrong order!  They gave me mac and cheese instead of the wings.

Had to drive back and get the right order.  Do you think they comp'ed for their error,.NO!  Won't be back.

Well had a late breakfast. Friendly staff. Not busy. Which worried me for a Saturday late morning11am. Was seated immediately. Server took drink order. Coffee hot and very good. Order taken . I had a country omelet with rye toast. Butter in the side. Which was real whipped butter. Omelet was stuff of ham , cheese and onions. Hash browns were plenty could have been a little more crispy. Over all would be back if in the area. Rest rooms clean. Services very good.it even had TV with morning cartoons.
Horrible customer service I called in my food I still had to wait 45 minutes this is the second time
way too expensive but offers a nice dark atmosphere for drinking.

This is one of the top 5 places I take my friends from out of town. It is definitely a beer garden-topia. I love that the servers help with recommending drinks that fit your pallet. I just wish the food menu had more selections.
Great atmosphere, small but interesting wine list and cocktails, yummy french fries.

Sorry I hav to retract my statement about this place being the best. Although still very good I found an even better thin crust pizza and byob place in Blackwood called holy tomato pie. And they've been doing longer. Still a respectable 4 star place but my money goes to holy tomatoe

I went when it was empty so can't speak for the wait.

Was a big, big A Full Plate fan so had high hopes. 

The renovation is definitely great. The atmosphere is ideal for a bar. I would like to be at a place like this every night, just on vibe/decor alone. 

My favorite at A Full Plate was promptly ordered: The Turkey Sandwich. They been really lax on the portion of cranberry aioli lately, so I asked for extra! A must. So I got to say, they changed this sandwich a ton which was sad. Used to be a ridiculous portion of turkey and the bacon was curled and crispy, but not it was more just like a slab of thin/fried ham. 
Still an excellent sandwich though, but if you had the previous one from A Full Plate, you could be disappointed.

Other than that,
 Grilled Cheese and a Tuna Melt to die for. The fries also, amazing. 

Order the grilled cheese and tuna melt and split both with your date/friend. You will be so happy you listened to me that you will want to meet me and buy me a free meal here :)

I went here when I was in Philly for the weekend.  My boyfriend did nothing but rave about it.  He was correct in the raving when it came to the food.  The burger I had was delicious and the Caesar salad was incredible.  

The service we had was unbelievably awful.  He said that particular location was more of a lunch spot, but come on 4 servers for 10 tables?  You would have thought we wouldn't have watched our food in the window for 15 minutes.  We saw a server talk over our food several times to the kitchen but she never felt like she should bring it to us.  I have no idea what made them actually bring out our food, but thank goodness it finally came.  We asked for our check three times about 10 minutes apart because no one would bring it to us or come over  near our table.  

The food is worth going and when I go back to Philly I'll probably go again, but I sure hope the service is better.

I should have photographed the food. Every plate that came from the kitchen was beautifully arranged with delicious looking entrees or appetizers. But that wasn't even the beginning. When we walked in we were greeted immediately and shown to our table. The restaurant is nicely decorated with impeccable taste (no pun intended). There was balance in the artwork and clean lines so you felt comfortable and interested to look around. Shelves of wine at the front let you know right away that wine is not just an option but can be a major part of your meal. We ordered an appetizer and then each an entree - a simple meal, yet what we got was art as well as culinary delight. Vegetables were not over cooked so you knew they were top quality. The chicken was perfect and the sauces were spiced exactly as we requested. I had the medium spicy and it was just right- the heat did not outdo the flavors in the dish. 
Yah, we'll be back for sure. I can't recommend this more highly.
One of our favorite meals in Santa Barbara. It's a market style environment and usually has a line around dinner... worth the wait.
Food was flavorful and portioned well so as to fill us up but not make us groggy, service was perfect, and the atmosphere is well designed. Great place.
Insanely good cheesesteaks. My order is always prepared quickly and the service is always friendly. I look forward to trying more

The staff is super super friendly, not obnoxiously so, just perfect. 

Waffle fries, chicken, hamburger and pork belly sliders were super.  My favorite was the pork belly, loved the blend of spice, vinegar and meat.   Had the Cuban libra donut.  It was not cloyingly sweet.  The cream was delicious.   I will be back.   Great ginger beer too.
Love this little gem. Great affordable food and they have GF options. Homemade Italian sauce when you don't feel like making it at home. Thursday is all you can eat pasta night
Very good, very authentic. Similar to Han Dynasty in its menu but I like the food here better.  Give it a try!!
Had a black and bleu burger today w/ Kobe upgrade.  Fantastic!  Best burger I've had in many years.
This probably the worst place in Lakeview. You cannot have a nice dinner across from your guest and hear them. Tried it twice, third is not the charm!

The most incredible breakfast spot in Nashville. This experience was definitely one that my boyfriend and I will never forget. It just happened to be close to the airport and we came in for a late breakfast on Sunday afternoon. Ella helped us ordering and recommended their omelette and waffle bar - their weekend special. After we had paid my boyfriend realized he had forgotten to order coffee and Ella was more than happy to accommodate this mistake. We originally ordered two waffles but after watching Julie whip up some omelettes my boyfriend decided to switch to an omelette which was the best decision he could have made. It was the best omelette either of us have ever had in our lives. Julie was very nice about switching the order and was excited to cook his omelette to his liking.  I have a deadly allergy to strawberries and was worried about cross contamination at the waffle topping bar. I raised this concern and Sunflower went to the back and cut up an entire banana just for me which I was incredibly appreciative for. Julie even tossed the banana slices in the cinnamon mixture that was on the bananas on the topping table. It was the most incredible food we could have ever asked for. My boyfriend said the coffee was delicious. While we would have been extremely satisfied with just the food, the environment made it a true Nashville experience. They had live music with two guys playing the banjo and guitar and singing. The restaurant is located in garages with cool graffiti artwork and decorations all over the walls. 

This was truly a special and authentic Nashville experience. We highly recommend Phat Bites and we will be returning every time we find ourselves in Nashville.

I've eaten here several times in the past. The food is great. Its a northern Indian style of cuisine. I've  haven't been here in a while and happen to be in the area.  I ordered the Chicken Tikka masala. I prefer the masala gravey on the side which they were happy to accommodate me with. However, when I  received my  order the portion of chicken was very small. I  brought this to the woman's attention who took my order. She told me 8 pieces is all you get with the order and there's nothing she can do. Her dismissive attitude prompted me to request a refund. She said she can't give a refund. I asked to speak to the manager. The chef came out and explained that 8 pieces is what normally comes with this dish but he is willing to give me a few extra pieces. I agreed. The lady who worked the front continued to argue with me about the portion size. I brought to her attention that I  was the only one in the restaurant and it was after 5pm.

Stopped by here for a snack and stumbled upon this place. I got a labneh which was surprisingly good. The custard is a bit tart. I chose the chocolate peanut topping which also had sesame mixed in-- it was a delightful mix of flavors. You can also get it in a cone. Would definitely recommend trying it. 
Opening seat concept few other eateries to chose from.
Everything was so good here! This is the place to go on this strip - from the music to the food and the great service. We're on vacation and this was our go-to spot. Highly recommend!!

Oh man where to begin, The first time I walked into PDQ was quite the experience. You go through the front door and it's got a massive vaulted celing, the interior is themed with sort of a modern-retro style. The line usually moves pretty fast and the people at the register are very helpful. All the staff is very kind and cheerful. They have a good selection of sandwiches, salads, and tenders. My favorite item is definitely the tenders. I was surprised the first time I ordered, I had only just gotten my change and was about to go get my drink when they called my name. Pretty Darn Quick indeed. 
The soda machines are one of my favorite things about the restaurant they have 2 of the touch screen ones with all different coke flavors. 
Once you sit down the tables are always clean, and someone usually comes around to check on you and make sure everything is to your liking. 
The food is fantastic, the tenders I get are a good size and always hot. 4 is enough to fill me up, they pair great with the sweet heat sauce. The sandwiches are very good as well, they're well built and filling. The only downside for me is the fries, they're not bad but they're not really anything special either. I prefer 5 guys fries.
I would definitely recommend this place, it's far superior to Chick-fil-A across the street. The prices are similar but you get so much more food at higher quality with PDQ.

Very good Israeli hummus. I decided to come here after a Jewish friend told me about this place. I got the lamb hummus here and it was really good. It is small and there isnt much seating, but its great for lunch or takeout. The hummus has a smooth, creamy texture that I love. The picked veggies and pita on the side help round out the meal. I will definitely be returning!

Best steakhouse in Indy in my opinion. A bit pricey but to be expected and well worth the $$. They have a pretty extensive wine menu. Steak is always cooked to perfection. Atmosphere is very sophisticated and staff is always very friendly!

The food is terrible. I was with a table of over 10 people we each got something different everything was totally disgusting. This is much worse than your typical "bar food". I've eaten a lot of bars in my life, unfortunately, and this one is definitely one of the worst.

The best tacos I've ever had. I went with flour barbacoa and steak, the barbacoa was insanely perfect! The sauce made the taco juicy and paired perfectly with the cilantro and onions. I can't stop thinking about it. If they were open for dinner, I'd go again today. Thank you Mony's for a delicious lunch! My husband got the quesadilla but he wished he had the tacos :)

Wow!  Stopped in for lunch with my wife.
I felt like I was back in Tijuana, MX.
The street tacos were great!
The tacos al pastor were great!
Don't let the store front scare you away!
It's worth every step!!!

we went there with a group of 12 for the super bowl and it was great! they brought in extra TV's to show the game, gave free fries and shots at touchdowns and made it a fun environment to celebrate an eagles super bowl win! I would definitely recommend coming here for a big party.  Food was good - typical bar food of burgers and wings. our waiter David was great even in all the chaos of the game!

Delicious dinner for two on a weekday summer evening.  We especially loved the caesar salad dressing - light and flavorful.  Pizza was perfect.  Cozy and quaint seating.  We can't wait to come back next time we're in town.

Updated review: What a shame. This place has really gone downhill.  I no longer go here because the pizza is usually burnt and dried out to the point of not even wanting to waste the calories. America's Pie is the only decent place in West Chester for pizza.

If someone ever tries to tell you that all pizza is the same, then you go ahead and slap them. Because it's not, and King Dough will show you why. The dough itself is amazing. Its soft and full of flavor. I would honestly eat it plain. Seriously. And the red sauce on their pizzas is incredible. Which is important because without good sauce, your pizza will be trash.

They have a huge variety of pizzas all made with incredibly fresh ingredients. The big boy is loaded with mini pepperonis and sausage. The kalamata olives are ridiculously good. They just take the flavor to a whole new level giving you that bitter taste you didn't know you wanted.

The N do ya punk pizza is loaded with nduja and has a great, flavorful kick to it. The R&B pizza is also delicious. The ricotta cheese makes it so incredibly and mixed with the carmelized onions, I just don't have the words to describe how good it is. 

If your not a pizza person, which I don't believe exists, they have other options. They have salads, wings, and pasta. They even have burgers if your into that kinda thing. They also have a full bar and a nice beer and wine menu. Definitely my favorite pizza in the city.

I've been to engine rose a few times now. They have an excellent selection of craft beers.  To be expected they have many of the same great burgers as engine 9, but they have some great upmarket dishes as well.  Pork wings, short ribs are both done very well. Staff was attentive and friendly.  The only drawback is I can't figure out their hours of operation.

Having just returned from a summer in the middle of nowhere Maine...I have been so excited to return to our rather steady schedule of French food once a month. 

My husband knows me all too well as last night he surprised me with a welcome home dinner!!!! 

The best part of this place is it's size. It is tiny, it is the way a restaurant is meant to be...yet it never feels overly crowded. It always feels just right. 

The owner always remembers us and what we have ordered in the past, which is just a nice little touch as well. 

This time, we were certainly not disapointed. 

John had the pork belly to start and it literally tasted like pork candy. It just melted away in your mouth. I started with the escargot which was delicious, made with leeks and garlic...I suppose it's the summer version of the escargot, which I loved.

For our mains, John had the veal stuffed veal. Veal sausage stuffed in veal loin topped with chevre over a bed of lentils? AMAZING. I had the steak frites, because they make it so well here. I ask for it to be rare, and it comes out RARE!!! I love that because when you ask for rare at most places, it comes out pink. PINK IS NOT RARE FOLKS. 

We enjoyed a beautiful bottle of Cotes de Rhone, which is usually sold by the glass, but we liked it so much that they sold it to us at a bottle price, which was lovely. 

The moral of the story is...if you haven't been here yet, you are missing out. big time.

xoxo

Montes has been up there for best in NE for years it's always Gino's, Montes, Vinces. Montes was my number one but they by default now undercook the pies they started that in the past year or 2. So ask for it well done it might be a little too burnt but it's the closest you get to old Montes close enough for it to be a 4/5. they know it's better in the oven longer cause they tried to give Dave Portnoy a more well done pie in the middle of his review so I don't know why they don't just by default cook it for longer like the way it was.

Absolutely delicious fusion blend of traditional and contemporary authentic Chinese & Japanese cuisine! The service is superb! Margaret Kuo is a mastermind of designing the menu to provide a variety of elegant entrees tailored for vegetarians & meat lovers! The layout of her restaurant is stunning! There are outdoor & indoor dining. When the weather is gorgeous for the day or evening with a little chill, tall tiki torches stands between the outdoor tables to expel some light & warmth. The indoor design is even more exquisite.Everything on her menu is delectable! My favorites are the vegetarian hot & sour shiitake mushroom soup, lobster spring rolls, beef sesame pockets, king of prawn red-cooked in ginger & scallions to name a few! The sushi is fresh & bar none! My family loves all of Margaret Kuo's restaurants. Meeting Margaret Kuo in person is pure joy. She is a delightful conversationalist who imparts much wisdom & wit .  This is MUST go often!
Apparently the outdoor eating area is stuck in 1999 and it's ok to smoke outside. So if you love to top your meal off with some cigarette smoke, this is the place for you.

Best Chinese food in the area. They give good portion size and the food is always fresh. Their combination platters come with choice of white or pork fried rice, choice of soup and an egg roll, so you definitely get your money's worth. I do recommend eating there or picking up because the delivery wait time is usually over an hour. The staff is very friendly and welcoming!

Awesome locale for a rooftop bar. Definitely made for some good people watching. Tiny slice of NYC/South beach in western Florida. Will definitely be back next time I'm in town! (Had a great waitress experience- very funny and helpful with drink suggestions).

I was looking for something to occupy a couple hours of my evening. Because of my affinity for beer, Brett N recommended I check out New World. It was Sunday night and I was rolling solo so I was hoping to meet some folks at the bar to chat with. I walked up there and it turns out it was just me. Pretty awkward to walk into a place and turn right back around so I sat down to have a beer. I'm glad I did because they had a pretty impressive beer menu with a number of things I've never tried. Unfortunately, a couple of them had sold out over the weekend, but as I mentioned, it was Sunday evening. I started chatting with the bartenders and had a few laughs while they were tidying up for the night. They made some recommendations for other places to check out and I even ran into one of them in my travels. Very hospitable on both sides of the bar!

Went in for lunch, had the fried chicken lunch special. I wasn't impressed with the chicken but my friend had a mushroom burger with cheese that looked scrumptious. She said it tasted better than it looked. Service was good. I would go again.

Good food and good vibe.We've been about multiple times and always good! A bit overpriced and I wish they paid closer attention to detail, just little things but when you pay that much you want it to be right. Overall I'll continue going. Tip: they make fantastic juices and their maple tempe is awesome!

Just okay is a pretty accurate way to sum it all up. I took my son here after work one day because we wanted something a little different. It's cool to look at all the rock memorabilia on the walls and it's a pretty snazzy place inside despite being there for almost 20 years now. My service was okay but not remarkable. The food was okay and on par with an Applebee's or Chili's experience. My son ordered mac n' cheese and I was pleased to see something other than Kraft from a box come out on a cool little guitar plate that he liked. I got a BBQ Bacon burger which didn't come with an option to get anything other than medium well. My fries were too close to room temperature given the overall lack of patrons in the restaurant. The items all have a $3-$5 downtown premium upcharge from what you'd pay elsewhere but I understand there are additional costs associated with keeping a mini museum going in a major city. The mix of music they play inside is an okay mix of old stuff and new stuff and there's some merch you can buy if you're from out of town.

Yes Yes Yes!!! 

This was hands down the BEST meal I had during my recent visit to New Orleans. Everything about this place is absolutely phenomenal. Mitch M. said it best. "Wow this was really good. Really good". 

The Ambiance - Upon my arrival, the hostess inquired as to whether I preferred to dine inside or out on the patio. It was a beautiful day and the weather was perfect, so I opted for the patio. Excellent choice. I was seated on the most adorable porch facing the quaint little neighborhood street - Dante St. As I sat outside, I could not help but feel like a true Southern Bell, being catered to hand and foot with true Southern hospitality. This is a cozy yet romantic New Orleans gem. 

The food - Everything I ordered from beginning to end was absolutely magnificent and mouthwatering. As many of the reviewers have indicated, they start you out with the molasses spoon bread that is to die for! It is topped with a warm sweet butter that truly tickles your taste buds. My server encouraged me to order the barbecue shrimp - said I could sop up the sauce with warm bread. I couldn't resist. The barbecue shrimp came out in the most beautiful presentation. It was truly divine. I could not stop myself from eating those plump shrimp and sopping up the sauce with that oven hot bread. Super delicious. Next, I was presented with the most delectable looking chicken covered in what appeared to be the maple sauce, and accompanied by a potato hash slightly covered with an egg - sunny side up. I was not to keen on the idea of my potato being covered by an egg, especially since I had never eaten an egg sunny side up. However, I was quite pleased with the taste - the flavors blended together ever so beautifully. Please do not be put off my this unique combination. The chicken under a brick is to die for! You must try this. 

The service - Dante's Kitchen truly understands the essence of customer service. They wait on you hand and food. What is also very comforting, is that the servers all seem genuinely kind and courteous. They are constantly filling your glass with water, bringing you more bread, etc. You will be taken care of at all times. 

Dante's exceeded my expectations. This restaurant is definitely one of my top favorites. I will definitely make this one of my stops next time I am in New Orleans. 

The FQ is great, but why not drive down St. Charles (or take the St. Car) for a scenic view of the beautiful Tulane and Loyola Universities before having a great meal at Dante's Kitchen? Do not miss out on this special treat.

Sooooo yum!!! Tried a new restaurant while visiting Tucson. The food was super fresh not processed, and service was good. The restaurant is traditional decoration and very clean. If your looking for some good Thai this is the place to come.
Excellent new Italian byob. Homemade pastas. Great food and staff. Had the rigatoni with pancetta. Was great!  Wife had the sesame crusted tuna steak special.

Ambiance: 2/5
Food: 2/5
Service: 4/5
Value: 1/5

i wanted to like it... really. underwhelming but fairly priced... good location for outdoor eating though. 

went with a friend of mine who loves BBQ and high hopes for some delicious food. he had ribs, i had the sample plate. the food was okay, but was lacking in flavor. a little on the dry side. not bad but not really enjoyable either. 

i might be back, given the location and my love for eating outdoors in new hope.

After a long day of traveling, the group of girls celebrating a bachelorette party were ready for some comfort food. With a large group of ladies it can be a challenge finding food to please everyone's taste buds. 
However, when we called in to place our delivery order, the staff were friendly and accommodating to our odd requests.
The Meatlover's pizza was a hit and our twist of Chicken Alfredo pizza was delicious, but next time we will ask for extra sauce on both. 
Also, the small Gluten Free Drag-It Through The Garden pizza was, hands down, the BEST gluten free pizza I've tasted! 
I would certainly recommend ordering from here.
Great Food. fast service. The only con: they are popular and get very busy. Get there early if you want to get a good table, or call in a take out order.
Eggs Benedict was under cooked, prices were much higher than the reviews led to believe one waffle was almost 8 dollars.

I dropped off some passengers at this place. I have been doing Rideshare and drop off at this place for months and giving them recommendations. When I dropped off three patrons to go to their establishment, the doorman would not let me in to use the restroom even though I brought them business. I then called the manager and he had no compassion for me and hung up the phone. The staff is rude and has no compassion I cannot recommend this place.

Came here for dinner after a late flight into town. Not only were we greeted with chips and salsa, but it also came with a little bowl of refried beans. Never saw that before. It was a pleasant surprise. The waiter was helpful with menu suggestions and we even got to try a new kind of dessert.

The food is fantastic and house wines just as good and at a good price.
Ambiance is very cozy and quiet.  Definitely the best higher-end restaurant in the Channel district.
Service sucks and the food is ok but location is awesome!

Hands down the absolute best service and brunch we have had in Nashville with little to no wait! I cannot speak highly enough about the warm welcoming environment and the eggs Benedict were some of the best I've ever had!

Who doesn't love a record shop and beer bar?  Good craft beer selection on tap.  Unfortunately they only had about half a glass of the beer I ordered so they gave me that one on the house and I picked another option.  Staff were friendly.  Would go back when in East Nashville again.

I gave this restaurant a 5* for Chinese as its a rating relative to other Chinese restaurants in Tucson....for this town it is by far the BEST AUTHENTIC Chinese.  The staff is extremely accommodating, feel free to request modifications if necessary, they are very polite and demonstrate a sincere desire to ensure your meal and experience is the best possible!  Additionally the restaurant is very, very clean and so are the restrooms.  enjoy!!

I was happy to see that the Green Heart Cafe left the old haunted theme park for a beautiful new location and building. The food is as amazing as it was at their old location and the staff is the same people that will treat you like family. There is a wait for the food service but only because it is all genuine home made dishes made to order. Will continue to frequent their new location and recommend to everyone I know.

I've been traveling across Canada from Toronto, Ontario and have been to 3 provinces and at least 9 difference Steakhouse & Bar restaurants. This is the FIRST restaurant since I started traveling where I've experienced over the top amazing service and mouth-watering, delicious food!

1. Friendly and Welcoming
Every single person who was on service tonight was welcoming and friendly. I felt like I was sitting in a good friend's home about to be served a home cooked meal. They also paid attention to our needs. One of my friends has a gluten allergy. Devon (the supervisor/our server) happily made sure that he specifically asked the chef to make sure no gluten products were in the food my friend ordered. 

2. Fix Problems
One of my friends ordered Prime Rib but unfortunately they didn't have it available that night. The waitress immediately called Devon over and he spoke to my friend explaining him why it wasn't available and what other options were available to him. I love how thorough they were and how they went out of their way to make sure we were taken care of!

Chop House didn't know this but I've been homesick for some food that I was used to back home so although many things on the menu sounded delicious, I didn't want to order any other dish except the Ahi Tuna- to put it simple, I was feeling picky. I ordered the Fresh Ahi Tuna Pillars and they also didn't have that available but no worries!  Devon spoke to Chef Joe and he custom prepared me a delicious salad ON THE HOUSE. It was so fresh, tasty and so unexpected. I felt like I was in heaven.

3. Go above and beyond
In a nutshell, this restaurant went above and beyond to make sure I didn't leave hungry, my friend had a gluten-free meal and they checked in on us to make sure that our drinks were topped up and our meals were tasting delicious. I was so impressed with the salad they prepared me (I've attached it in the pictures section: "Custom Appetizer Salad Made By Chef Joe") and my other friends (one ordered Buttermilk Roast Chicken with Asparagus Tarragon Ragout and the other Top Sirloin) both said they LOVED their meals! 

Absolute perfection. I feel bad because I didn't have any cash on me or I would've tipped each Devon AND Chef Joe the equivalent of my meal. I will be coming back to this exact restaurant next month when I get back to Edmonton.
The whole line just got yelled at by the hostess for not waiting outside during tropical storm Cindy. Class act. Went somewhere else. Wish I got her name.

Very disappointed. Simple review. Atmosphere too bright, and the tables were uncomfortable barrels that your knees hit. Staff was young and inexperienced with no personality. Food average at best. My son and I had very dry tacos. Very expensive $$$$10 for a white wine spritzer. Taco bell would have been a better choice.

Just a question... what is it with St. Louis people and doughnuts? I don't really get it. Maybe I just haven't found a doughnut place here to convert me, but I not-so-secretly love Krispy Kreme's original glazed doughnut. Yes, I know they're a chain, but they have what Strange Donuts is lacking - a solid doughnut base. 

My husband and I went to Strange Donuts and got four different flavors: maple bacon, chocolate hazelnut, blueberry jam filled, and gooey butter cake. 
++ Maple bacon - it wasn't too bad, but I wish the bacon pieces were larger or that they were more of them 
++ Chocolate hazelnut - the only reason I liked this one was because it had Nutella on it. Who doesn't like Nutella?! 
++ Blueberry jam filled - the filling was great and tasted like they made it in house (not sure, didn't ask) 
++ Gooey butter cake - I didn't like it. Maybe it's because I'm not sure about gooey butter cake yet (I've only had it once since moving to St. Louis two months ago), but if I hadn't already known what I was eating, I wouldn't be have been able to tell what flavor it was supposed to be. 

Again, back to the main issue preventing me from liking Strange Donuts, I didn't enjoy the batter, the actual dough part making up the majority of the doughnuts. It tasted dry and I just didn't like it. 

I like the concept of cool, fun, and strange toppings, but if you don't have a decent base doughnut for the toppings to go on, I'm just not a fan. You can't rely solely on the toppings to make a doughnut a great doughnut. 

With that being said, I'd be willing to come back at night to try a $5 specialty doughnut (which you apparently can't get in the daytime) to see if it changes my mind about the place.
Don't bother coming here unless you have 2 hours to eat. The service is really really slow and it takes forever for the food to come out, and when we showed up it wasn't even very busy!

Bagels are fresh and service is quick. Had the Asiago bagel. Also a good place for a quick lunch. Staff are nice and friendly but a little quirky. Lobby area needs help with cleanliness but maybe they were just busy. Prices fair but not cheap.

Went here the other night for my first time! Had a great meal, started with the calamari then got the tartar! It was very good. The presentation was beautiful and we had great , knowledge waiter, I totally forgot his name though!! 10/10 everything. Can't wait to come back!

Great local spot owned by a family of Dunedin regulars.  Donuts are crisp, fresh, and tasty.  Breakfast sandwiches are delicious and homemade.  Service is on point and filled with that unmatchable laid-back attentiveness that only a true family owned and operated business can provide.

I highly recommend trying "Joe's Special" breakfast sandwich.  Absolutely delicious and very satisfying.

I've lived in Dunedin for nearly my whole life and this has now become hands down my favorite breakfast spot.

Like I said, Maybe this is not the best Korean food I ever had, but in Tucson, as far as Korean food goes this is best you can get and all the 4 and 5 stars rating by all the elites tell you this is the real deal!  

Service always good, speaking from my personal experiences and not to be bragging ..Duke I am as right now. They are very consistent on both areas!!    

And if they can only make them little more spicier and they did it for me....upgrade to 5 Stars!!!!

We were so excited to have a KoreanBBQ place down the street that we could get wings from. Tried takeout once and won't do it again. Overpriced and underwhelming. They have a sushi bar but don't serve sushi. There are plenty of other Korean restaurants in the area.

Not a bad by any means. I tried a diverse range of sushi items that were available and enjoyed each one thoroughly. The food and the water were exceptional. What wasn't exceptional though was the service. The two hostesses working the floor were somewhat slow, and were standing around talking. One started using their phone. They had argued at one point at a high enough volume for the customers to hear ~ THINGS BECAME VERY TENSE AND UNCOMFORTABLE. But they worked it out I guess and the rest of the night was lovely. Good place. I'll try it again. Good for any person or person(s) seeking out a taste of the Far East rolled into sea weed and rice with an explosion of falvor in the middle and on top. 8/10

We love Caddy's! Great place to relax on the beach, huge benefit to other beach bars in that the bar is actually right on the beach and you can walk to the ocean in 2 seconds. Funky crowd with a significant amount of spring breakers / seasonal visitors but a dream in the summer and fall. Always enjoy my time on the rooftop, food is decent too (we've gotten apps, the mahi Reuben and grouper tacos a few times). Boyfriend loves it it's just a lil greasy for me. It's beach food!

I'm pretty sure people go here for the location. The place is always packed.
It is next to the Park! 

There is nice open seating. You can sit out and chat with friends while grabbing a late night snack.  They have a nice cheese plate. My friends tried the dessert. The items on the menu are very french.

You should definitely call ahead or try to get reservations. The place really fills up quickly.

I wanted to like this place - our server was SO nice! Unfortunately, my orange chicken wasn't  cooked and both my mom and  I got sick after we ate there. The food didn't taste bad - it was just "off".

I have been here many times after living in Philadelphia for only 10 months or so.  The soup is hands down the best I have had from any restaurant.  The noodles, broth, meat, and vegetables are all delicious and fresh, and an assortment of condiments allows for the perfect amount of customization.

The little shop fills up fast, but the food also comes incredibly fast.  Unless they are just getting a new batch of noodles going, the soup comes out almost instantly, but even if you have to wait it is definitely worth it.

6.50$ for a huge bowl of beef brisket noodle soup (shaved noodles are my personal preference) and a coke, great deal.
The house ceviche and the grilled vegetables were delicious.  And the fried potatoes with spicy aoli were amazing!  The sangria was good too. I wish there was street parking so I didn't have to valet
We ordered tacos here and while they are huge.  They were soggy. Too much tomato and quac stuff on it. Definitely not a good taco.

First time here. Great atmosphere for a casual lunch or dinner, great burger selection, and really friendly staff. Milkshakes and waffle fries were both out of this world. Will definitely be back when I'm downtown.

Pascucci has worked it's way into tradition for my boyfriend and I. Every time we go to Santa Barbara we know where we are going for dinner. 

The bread served before the meal is delicious, and often refilled at least once for us. They serve the Italian garlic bread with oil, and vinegar if necessary. As for the meal, the food melts in your mouth. I ordered the Siena, which had a baked chicken breast with marsala-mushroom topping. It was a great dish, and I have ordered it more than once.

The restaurant itself has a unique feeling. From tradition Italian mosaic, a waterfall in the back dining area, and a full bar. When walking in you can see the cooks preparing the food, for a full dining experience. 

I am rating the restaurant a 4 out of 5, as last time we went for lunch I felt a bit forgotten. This was only the case with lunch, as at dinner we were provided with great service. Waters being continually filled, bread refilled, and dinner out in a timely manner.

Ummm love this place! I came for story time with my 2 year old and the girl who read the story was totally into the story and got the kids engaged. She also brought toys out to play and the kids had a blast. The potential of this place is amazing. I ordered a chai and the grilled cheese and they were excellent. I can't wait to see everything this place will grow into!

This place is fantastic.  The homemade salsas start the evening off beau-tifully.  The guacamale also seems to be made with the most delicous and greenest avocado's I have seen.  My girlfriend tends to stay with the "al pastor con pina", a marinated pulled pork taco with pineapple, and cilantro.  Better than SPTR's Pork Tacos.  Their are 3 in the order for $7.00. the burritos are classic, huge amounts of marinated pork, chorizo, etc.  The food here is amazing, by far the best Mexican food is East Passyunk.  Stop at The Bottle Shop a block south on Passyunk Ave for a few beers to bring with you and you should be all set.  Enjoy.

It was our first time in Nashville, we are used to high end steakhouse in Dallas. This place has out performed our expectations it terms of quality of steak (tender, crust, warm) you can get your steak extra charred as I had their dry aged cowboy Ribeye. Lot of their sides have truffle seasoning which was amazing. Great mac and cheese. Even for their complimentary bread they bring out truffle butter. We had great experience with their overall service.

First, they were not even close to ready with my order when I arrived. The application said order to be ready within 20 mins. No, I waited 40mins after arriving. So a total on 1 hr to make fried rice and lo mein from the time I placed the order to completion. Not only that but I realized while waiting how the poor the food standards were. I literally watched the lady at the front wipe SWEAT from her forehead, go to the back, try to help by adding white rice into an order but then ...moved the chicken wings to the side of the styrofoam takeout container WITH HER FINGERS before placing the rice in. Then as I looked up , I noticed steamer bins atop a fridge directly under a mold and dust spewing AC vent. Wow I thought, my family may be lucky if we live through dinner. Also saw a prescription pill jar on the counter in the front as well as an open container/drink cup, 2/3rds cup of water. In restaurants you have to have a lid on your drink around food and prescriptions out of reach so that there are no accidents that could contaminate the food. By the way, when I arrived there was a to-go bag sitting waiting for the driver to pick up and take to the customer. That bag sat and did not move since I left. So I waited 40 min for my food. Imagine ordering chicken, allowing it to sit, get cold and start to turn before even arrives to the customer. 2 other baged orders joined it while no driver came to pick them up. What a food poisoning risk. I will never order from here again. Not because I had to wait for a simple order to be ready, but due to the food standards.

While waiting for check in time at our hotel, we went exploring and decided to drop in here for a late breakfast.

We had the waffles & chicken and the "New Orleans". The New Orleans is a plate of 2 biscuits covered in sautéed crawfish, shrimp, onions, mushrooms, and green peppers topped with 3 poached eggs and hollandaise sauce. This was a delicious and very filling meal. I could only finish half the plate!! The chicken and waffles wasn't even close to average. The chicken had no flavor and was over cooked making it dry.

The initial service took a while but the service was great once our server came to our table. The food was out in a timely manner.

They make a beautiful Easter bread, flavorful,  it appears dry, but isn't at all! hey also make a wonderful ricotta cheese pie. Creamy, lightly sweet, perfection! It is a must try! A bit disappointed they don't make a simple NY crumb cake.

This breakfast was OUTSTANDING. We ordered the shrimp and grits and the chicken and waffles. Both were so different and flavorful. The shrimp and grits were decadent with the rich savory jalapeño cheese grits. When you add in the eggs and the andouille sausage...it's just wow. The chicken and waffles is HUGE! The jam topping was a great sweet and spicy accompaniment. I'm in a food coma now.

Bagels = good. Staff = polite but un-engaging. Cleanliness (inside) = suspect; read on.

I have stopped here on several occasions, knowing that they serve good bagels and tasty bagel-based sandwiches. Coffee is good as well...and very hot! Coffee is self-serve from several large urns or air-pump pots away from the ordering station. 

My choice of sandwich on my most recent visit was  Egg White, Mushroom, Spinach, & Cheese on a Green Chile bagel. It was a deliciously savory combination of ingredients highlighted by a nicely spicy bagel. Note, this is not a traditionally shaped bagel with a hole in the middle, but rather a bagel-dough sandwich roll with just about the same chewy texture as a regular bagel. Loved the combination and would order again.

My most critical observations are that staff, while polite when ordering or delivering  your sandwich/bagel/whatever, well ... that's as far as it goes. No other interaction...staff just toils away at their tasks behind the counter, filling orders face-to-face or at the drive-thru, and prepping things in house. That paucity of attention to diners leads to a less than welcoming environment and, as observed after sitting in the restaurant, a propensity for the place to get grimy and down-right dirty in spots.

After I ordered, I cleaned off my own table of crumbs and a liquid spill before sitting down and saw other tables in the same condition. Yet, no staff came to wipe tables or throw away left-over napkins, and in one case (see photo) a basket and trash left on a seat (for the 25 minutes I was there).

Coffee-condiments area was also untidy with spills, etc.

While the parking lot was difficult to enter due to the massive traffic jam of cars waiting in line for Starbucks next door, the interior was not crowded. (This was after the big morning rush, about 8:45 am). Even a quick walk through OR a glance about while delivering orders to seated customers should have been enough to trigger someone's call to "spruce it up a bit."

For this sanitary shortcoming, I nominate poor management. (Five employees on duty during my visit.)

Yes, I'll be back.....I like their products,  but hopefully next time it will be a bit tidier - cleaner.
Their noodle soup was fresh and hot! The service was good and they were very fast. They are very busy and I can see why. I will definitely be back. I love authentic Vietnamese food.

Delicious greasy spoon southern breakfast ...and you can't beat the price.  Although the place is a dive ...it has a lot of charm.  All of the people who work there are extremely friendly and eager to please.  I had egg and cheese on a biscuit with a side of home fries and it was great.!   Will definitely go back here again.

Horrible. If there were three tables filled it was a lot. 
 Had to send a drink back two times because it did not taste right. The bartender finally came over and asked how to make it, as she did not know how to. Finally asked for a different drink. Another person  asked for a drink straight up but received it with ice twice. Food took forever to come out. When it finally did they brought one of our diners  the salad with their dinner. I ordered a cob salad and received a side salad with just lettuce and tomatoes. More waiting. I was very disappointed as I had out of state guests with me. NEVER AGAIN
Stocks has the best baked goods in Port Richmond, the best in Philadelphia.

I love love love this coffee place! Thank lighthouse coffee for that delicious caramilla drink. My new favorite. I usually go to the human bean but not anymore. This local business right here is the one to support. The staff is always so friendly to me, drinks are usually fast, and reasonably priced. I love that they have the loyalty program so make sure you ask for a stamp card if you like to go here often. Everything I have tried so far is absolutely delicious. Green tea matcha shake is one to try as well. I don't think you will be disapointed. I have not tried any hot drinks but I know one thing they definitely got my business.

My experience with this place does not deserve even one star.  My order was delivered with food missing.  When I contacted the store and spoke to a staff member about the missing food I was told they would have a delivery driver drop it off.  An hour later I called back and another staff member answered when I explained I was still waiting on my missing food he said he knew about this issue and when he asked if they were bringing it i was told no they were too busy.  When I asked to speak to the manager Jen she said she was too busy to speak to me.  They were not too busy to charge me full price for my order!  They were too busy to give me a credit or offer me a refund for the gross customer service I received.  I will never order from this place again and I most definitely will not recommend it to anyone.

This is one of my favorite Thai spots in Tampa. The service is super quick, which is always great. The atmosphere is very neat and has a relaxing feel to it. I loved the pho bowl I got the last time I was there. I wasn't feeling great and it was so refreshing and tasty. My boyfriend loves this place, so we are regulars. I don't eat meat and there are tons of meatless options to choose from. I would highly recommend this place for great Thai food with amazing quick service.

Sadly this place did not live up to current reviews. 
Restaurant was dirty, hair in salsa and dirty forks. Salsa they served was warm and tasted like tomato paste. They did have a salsa bar with much tastier salsa. Ordered the fajitas Jalisco. Fajitas had little seasoning and did not come with much meat.  A lot of the meat was the fatty pieces which made less tasty. Prices were average compared to other places. Server was not the friendliest.

This is the best kept Mexican restaurant secret in Indy. Food is delicious and the atmosphere is authentic. I live a block and a half away so I'm a regular. The thought of my fav Mexican hangout being over run with touristas, out of towners and suburbanites makes me cringe but  I feel I have to show some love and respect for La Parada. So what we are talking about here is like Mexican soul food. I mean basic Mexican dishes prepared with so much love and flavor. Add in generous portions and modest prices and it's a glorious food baby for all. Perfect for a working mans lunch or evening feast.

So many times have I been burned by this place. They have big heads and DON'T care about the customer AT ALL!! First time I ever went there, it was over an hour before they closed and they turned me away because it wasn't busy enough so they closed early. Another time I tried to order delivery (which they clearly advertise on their menu) we were turned away because, "the kitchen was too busy so we decided not to deliver". While their sandwiches are pretty good, no place is worth that. I've never seen a place who disrespects customers more than them. Done forever.

We really enjoyed this collaboration between John Besh and Aaron Sanchez. We popped in early one Saturday evening...the hostesses could not have been nicer. Our server was also very helpful and efficient, especially when our little one accidentally dropped her glass of water...she was so understanding and nice. The complimentary fried plantains and chips were served with a spicy roasted tomato salsa...so addictive. Happy hour prices made us super happy...skip the bland and lifeless guacamole. The albondigas, Mexican meatballs, were amazing, and amazingly filling. Get the happy hour portion (3 meatballs)...more than enough for two. The full appy version with 7 meatballs would be way too much. The meatballs were tender, juicy, and oh so tasty.they were nestled amongst melted cheese in a spicy tomato sauce...yummy. The "Mexican street" corn was disappointing...I was hoping for classic elote...this version served up grilled corn cut off the cob, but it was mixed with (too much) cotija cheese and not enough lime juice. I guess I'm just not a real big fan of cotija cheese...I always found the texture offputting...chalky, grainy. 

Oh well, shrimp tacos were excellent, but the most amazing dish was the spicy hanger steak with patatas bravas. These fried potatoes were excellent...crispy, with a real spicy kick. The steak was amazing juicy and beefy, with a deep charred crust on the outside and perfect medium-rare pink inside. Pickled onions helped cut through the richness, and the kitchen was nice enough to pair it with a wonderful chimichurri sauce instead of the usual pumpkin mole (I am allergic to nuts). I would go back just for this dish, since my daughter polished off most of the steak.

Desert choices were a little disappointing...I was really hoping for some sopapillas or churros, but sadly these were not on the menu. 

Overall, it was delicious, and with happy hour prices, very reasonable.

The food and service was amazing! I tried the alligator gumbo and the shrimp/crawfish risotto, both well seasoned and delicious. Our waitress was very attentive but not overbearing and didn't try and force us into getting anything we didn't want. My only qualm is that I do think this restaurant is a little pricey.

Not sure where the high scores come from.  I think people jones for real street tacos in Reno and numb up the scores.  Carne Asada tacos are just not that good,  staff not rude but not friendly, kind of grungy which would be no problem if the tacos are bomb, they are  not.  Still looking for the good street tacos in Reno/Sparks.

BLUF:  Great atmosphere, staff and original options for a meal or snack.

I got 3 sliders; cheese burger, fried chicken, and pork belly.  All were great.  I probably could have eaten a 4th.  Really good and not as simple as they sound.  I also go a black coffee which was good.

Wife got the duck slider which was the special and it was great too.  She also got a sandwich/donut thing that was suprisingly good.  I thought it was going to be too sweet but it wasnt.  It was great (ham and havarti).  

We got the fries with their homemade cheese sauce.  I am a fan of sides; however, the fries were nothing special and the cheese sauce was not very cheesy or good.  I would pass on both next time and just get an additional slider or dessert.

We got the special dessert which was a donut with chocolate peppermint ice cream inside.  Hot outside, cold side, physics destroyed.  It was great.

Place is overall great.  Great helpful staff, cool hipster atmosphere.  Great original food when you feel like something different.  I'll be back.

One of my go to places to taking out of town guests, starting with my sister two years ago.

Excellent food and promp, no-nonsense service is the norm. So of course I love it. 

The food is always a good mix of Staples along with smart, well designed seasonal choices. A mix that allows you to find either something easy and safe, or go for that more exploratory approach.

I love Datz I just wish my visits were more enjoyable! For this visit I took my family but they were not impressed unfortunately. I order the bravacado toast and the guacamole could have used more flavor and less guacamole, the plate looked good but didn't taste nearly as good, I also order a cool drink but can not remember the name but that was delicious! I will continue to be a Datz consumer and try out more plates so stay tuned! @eatwanderandslay

On my search for some authentic-tasting Caribbean food, I came across Jamaican Style Jerk.  I've passed this place a hundred times, but it never occurred to me to stop?  Coulda had something to do with it being attached to a liquor store.  So after reading the amazing reviews, I decided to give it a try.  The location is facing Keystone Ave and has a bright yellow and green awning, so it's not hard to miss.  the menus are laminated and taped onto the sides of a small bank teller-style window.  I assume it's bulletproof.  The menu is fairly simple, but as a first timer, I was a bit confused.  I ordered a quarter white Jerk Chicken.  It was a bit hard to hear the guy on the other side.  Apparently you need to order it with rice & beans, otherwise it comes alone.  I didn't realize this unfortunately so I can only review the chicken.  I did order a side of plantains though so at least I got those!

The chicken is pretty damn amazing.  The chicken had a ton of flavor and was not dry at all.  Cooked perfectly.  I got the hot sauce that came with it and it was hot but not overpowering.  It was served with two slices of white bread.  The plantains were well cooked also.  Advice: if you want the meal with rice & beans, be sure to ask for it.  All in all, this was an amazing experience.  The nicest guys, the best food and great prices!  I'll be back soon to try the rice & beans and explore the rest of the menu.

The beautiful wife and I had the fortune of coming here late on a Saturday afternoon, so it wasn't particularly busy.

The decor is standard dive bar, including missing tiles on the floor, which can turn your bar stool into a homemade pendulum or something.

I'm not sure if they have a printed beer list (I didn't ask, nor was offered) so I did the next best thing and walked up the wall of beer and browsed the cans that way (and in the cooler).  I was impressed to see some items in the selection (Lion Stout!  Get it, it's a great Sri Lankan beer), but otherwise, you get that definite vibe of "bring a $20 and get a bunch of crappy beer."

And reading their website, that's how they want it to be.  Which is sort of a weird motif for me.  Do I really want to pay $2.75 for a can of Keystone Light just so I can remember how crappy it was to drink this back in high school?  And on the flip side, do I really want to drop $5.25 for a can of Guinness knowing for a bit more, I can get a great pint elsewhere?

And they have a really uninspired draft list.  Yeah, this from the guy that freaks out at any place that has PBR on tap, but can places move away from the Boulevard/Schalfly/O'Fallon trio for at least one of their taps?

I think we need to return at night for a Cheap Beer Night and to try their food so I'm in the right spirits (no pun intended).  Until then, they're at 3 stars.

I have never written a Yelp review in my life, but I had to write about how amazing this place is. Never have I had food that made me nearly cry from pure ecstasy. Everything from the sides to the entrees to the dessert is made with love and tastes just like it came straight from Grandma. The concept of this restaurant, the amazing people that work here, and all of the the food make this an experience in NOLA that you should not miss out on. Highly recommend the eggplant and shrimp Jennifer and the bread pudding. I wish I could give this place 10 stars because they deserve way more than 5.

I saw an ad and the sandwich looked good. Dropped in around 2:30 pm and the place was empty, but tables still dirty from lunch. No utensil in lemons (gross). The chicken cheesesteak was good, but not good enough to overcome the generally sloppy appearance of the place. Oh, and they serve Pepsi which is not my fav.

I order huancaina potatoes not to good the potatoes was raw and the sauce nothing close to the real huancaina and watery ; the fish ceviche not fresh lot of red onions on top and the lemon juice was bitter; the chaufa rice with a lot of sesame oil; I want to thanks the manager of the restaurant that came to the table and apologized with us for the mistakes and offered free picarones.

Top notch! 
Anything and everything you could ask for! Mounds and mounds of crab legs, eel, oysters, two kinds of shrimp! Omelette station with whipped cream and strawberries, eggs, waffles, french toast, bacon, everything breakfasty, and then you get to the lamb chops, filet mignon and other delicious foods that I won't ruin the surprise! Save room for the good champagne and yummy orange juice, strong coffee and of course! DESSERT! Get the sticky bun! YUM!

For myself, my mom and step dad (my son dined for free as he is only 2), the bill came to about 113 minus tip. Well worth it.
They're food is good for the price. Don't come here expecting anything fancy, though. The breakfast burritos are delicious. Definitely not authentic Mexican food.

We were highly disappointed in the quality of the food and are shocked by all the positive reviews. We ordered take out and received 2 bland rolls and 2 very disappointing ramen bowls. The miso ramen had flavorless broth with noodles that were no better than a .50 cent pack from the grocery store. They tasted overcooked and mushy. My husbands spicy miso ramen had better flavor; However, both ramens came with over cooked boiled eggs and only bean sprouts. Our sushi rolls came with no wasabi or ginger on the side. The wasabi was definitely needed to provide additional flavor to the lackluster rolls. The only happy guy was our 5 year old who enjoyed the white rice. We will not eat here again or recommend to anyone who enjoys good sushi or ramen.

It's been years since I've visited the Nugget and surprisingly it was very refreshing. Seems like they are doing a massive remodel to their common areas from what we saw. As for their hotel rooms I can't comment because I've never stayed here. 

Huge casino floor with lots of slots and table games with a good mixture of old and new games available. Won some money on their slot machines so I'm already planning to go back in the near future.

We went there today about 1:00 and it was packed. We were greeted and said just to wait a few minutes while they cleared a table where some people had just left. We were sat down and given chips and salsa which was really good.  I ordered the shrimp ranchero and my husband had machaca! Both were really good! I can't wait to go back! Calabacitas were served with my dish and they were excellent! Love this place!

I'm gonna echo the previous review.

Food is always tasty but the restaurant itself is dirty. 

Gang enhanced, dirty, bathroom. A broom that's busted and no real pride of ownership here.

definitely my favorite place to go on a monday night. the beer selection isn't the biggest i've ever seen, but they stock nothing but quality brews. on top of that, you can check the website, and it'll tell you what is on tap at that moment so you don't end up going their and realize they don't have anything you like.

the food isn't the best in the city, but i'm not one to order bar food when i can go get a great slice of pizza at almost any hour in the city.

the selection of games is pretty good. they have almost all of the classics you'd want to see. on top of that, they're all a quarter, which rules so hard. sometimes they don't work 100%, but what do you expect, they're old, and there's drunk people beating on them constantly.

i think my favorite part about the bar is the music. there's not a stupid dj putting on the crap you hear every 10 minutes on the radio, and there's no jukebox filled with crap you were sick of hearing 15 years ago. just a stereo that plays everything from radiohead to slayer, which is everything i could ever ask for. even better is that the music isn't super loud, so i can actually talk to someone without having to yell, which is why i hate going to most bars anywhere.

the bouncers are actually cool guys if you talk to them for a couple minutes. i see that some of their complains about them were "the bouncer looks super serious with his big jacket on and blah blah blah" dude was in the navy for 14 years, he likes to wear his field jacket because it's warmer than any jacket you own, so whatever, talk crap about the dude because you dont like his jacket. you're dumb. the other bouncer is just goofy and pretty cool. i like the staff.

most of the bartenders are pretty cool. i haven't dealt with all of them, so maybe some are jerks, i don't know. i've never had a bad experience with any of them. in fact, the one guy everyone keeps saying is a jerk, i asked him for a recommendation, and he poured 4 different shot glasses full of his recommendations, so maybe you just suck at he can sense it, and that's why he's a jerk to you.

i am yet to attend one of the beer nights there due to lack of interest in the brewery visiting, but i hear they are quite fun times

overall, i enjoy the place more than most bars, especially ones in fishtown,

The store would have been a five BUT the woman at the deli, Ms Smith was so incredibly rude that i had to tell the manager. Smith stared me down because i was was trying to help another customer because of a misunderstanding about the ticket machine. . She  mocked me because I was shocked to be talked to like a piece of garbage.   I can't believe anyone can work somewhere with such a nasty and disrespectful attitude.  If Shoprite decides to keep her, they will lose a lot of customers.  I did tell the manager who was nice.
Fabulous new place! Great eclectic food and amazing south beach vibe with awesome staff. Owners outdid themselves and we will be back soon for brunch!
shitty coffee - I think they forgot to put caffeine in my cafe au lait. It tasted like water. 0/10

I can't rate the food because it hasn't arrived yet. Our order was placed at 7:45 pm. It is now 9:45 pm and still no food. I called twice and the hostess said "sorry, we have a lot of orders". Our expected delivery time was 8:45. The hostess didn't have an answer when I asked why they never updated the delivery time. I would have canceled if I knew I'd be waiting over 2 hours to eat dinner. At this rate, I will be in bed before the delivery arrives. This is the worst delivery experience I have ever had.

I pretty much totally agree with all the 5 star ratings and reviews!  D's is the Real Deal!  I am Jamaican, and quite frankly, also a  great cook, so I can attest to the fact that D's food is authentic and very delicious.  When taking a break from the kitchen and in the mood for a taste of home, I am always happy with his food.  The Jerk Chicken is fantastic, so is the slaw, the Oxtails and Curry Goat. "D" is also a really nice guy, offers good customer service with a smile, and knows exactly what he is doing in the kitchen.  For real authentic Jamaican food, D's is definitely tops in Tucson!

I've heard a lot about this place and I'm kinda upset I didn't try it sooner but thanks to Yelp's Big Night In, I had the chance to. Considering social distancing guidelines I can only speak on service and pick up. I ordered thru the app and within minutes my pizzas were done. Couldn't believe it. 

I ordered the New G and the Dirty Bird. Dirty Bird may be my favorite since I was craving buffalo cheese pizza of some sort. The New G was a bit on the dry side, I'm like where is the tomato sauce? 

Now no one is allowed in the store due to COVID-19 so pickup and delivery are to be done outside. Our pizzas were hot and overall delicious.

Amazing price for really good food. Chicken teriyaki is all white meat and comes with tempura, salad and rice! The rolls are all so interesting and very reasonably priced. Apps are also super cheap and good - gyoza and the seafood one was amazing. Highly recommend this place.
CLOSED for several months now. Looks like it's completely gone out of business. Please update accordingly.
Had the new Impossible Wopper Fantastic favor Have tried several veggie burgers found this to be the Best. Hope it catches on and stays on their menu

My third visit and I can't complain about the food or the service. My shake was fine and the bacon lovers burger hit the spot. As far as how clean it was..... the place was busy the floor was pretty clean and I saw one of the workers come out and wipe the table tops. The manager came out and did one round asking customers if they were satisfied.

This restaurant is near perfection.  Casually chic decor,
