He'd also have to walk another 100 miles to burn off all those oily carbs...either that or keel over dead of a coronary after chowing down on these four bad boys!

Wonton soup still yummy; good broth and some scallion pieces complement the non soggy and pleasantly plump packages of porcine pasta pleasure. Egg roll crisp and decent sized for a FL take out joint. A lot of bok Choi and carrot; little pork. Eh...

Three items ordered to see if they still have it down in the old Doo Wok A Doo Department. General Tso chicken and also roast pork with snow peas. Last one was my go to pork fried rice.  Queen Bee likes the first as a rule and she LOVED this rendition. Pieces of real white meat chicken still a little crisp and packed a wee bit of good heat at the end.

Pork with snow peas also great! Generous amount of sliced pork, along with a nice load of tender, snappy pea pods, along with some bok Choi, water chestnuts, etc in a fantastic sauce. BTW: see those pictures I posted? Those were both the SMALL size!

Pork fried rice was jammed to the brim of the oyster pail. They got it just the way I like: dark, well done and with a load of bean sprouts.  Both of the owners are very receptive to special requests like this. I guess it helps that I know them and they recognize me. 

Last item is that they put up plexiglass at the counter, and even had a mike-and-speaker system installed. There's also a trap door for cash and a bigger one for food bags...no touching or close contact at all. Their small dining area is now totally blocked off by the tables, which are now used for paper goods, sauces and menus. Take it and go! Yay, China One!!!

My ugly steak was everything everyone else said it was ... juicy, tender, fresh, gorgeous!  I'm not much of a carnivore but this steak was amazing. I slathered it with carne asada seasoning and fried it in a tablespoon of oil. There are no words to describe the deliciousness.  Well worth every penny!

I'm currently sitting in the Cheesecake Factory as I write this review, which will also be posted to any other outlets that this restaurant is on for reviews. I called in for pick up at 6pm. We arrived at 6:30 and paid for our order, as it wasn't ready yet. I noticed our bill was about $10 less than it was on another visit we had recently, and we ordered the same exact things. I asked the cashier to verify if we were charged for a Turkey Club, and not just a Turkey Sandwich. He said it was a club....it was not. I asked to speak to the manager over the variance on the bills(order still not received) she took my receipt from our previous visit and current visit. She came back a few minutes later stating that we "lucked out because we were charged for the turkey sandwich and not club. Which was more expensive. Okay that's great. But are we getting a turkey club like we ordered or are we getting a turkey sandwich? She went to check in the kitchen to make sure it was correct, to never return. A few minutes later the cashier came up to us with our order. With the wrong sandwich. So I brought it back up to him so it can be corrected and was told it would be about 20 minutes...FOR A CLUB...a cold sandwich. At this point it was 645....45 minutes after our order was initially placed. As we're waiting for our order, the manager still never coming back, goes up to the podium where the hostess' are, looks me dead in the eye, and walks away. We unfortunately will not be returning to this location. I don't know if management forgot, but we are humans and should be treated like humans. Not like WE did something wrong, when the staff is incompetent. 

Edit: As we were sitting there i asked the manager, who was sitting at the podium, if she could go and check on how much longer and once again, she doesn't come back. A few minutes later she sends the cashier out. TERRIBLE MANAGEMENT. I'll definitely be calling their corporate office first thing in the morning.

Most unfriendly and unhelpful one I have ever been to. Just tried to get a strawberry lemonade-aid. It's not on the menu but they have strawberries and frozen lemonade. But all I was told is they are not allowed to make it. Even the manager must not have enough common sense to be able to make something. I also didn't know they allowed piercings through the lip and gums. Good luck for a Christian bass company.

This place is great.  I love that the quality of the ingredients is good, and that you can customize everything.  We love to come here for lunch breaks and the service is fast, especially given how busy they always seem to be.

I always get a burger and fries and every.single.time I end up saying "why did I get the fries? I didn't need the fries."  But guess what?  I eat half of them anyway because they're delicious. 

Bonus points for those cool customize-you-flavor soda machines!

What's not to love about this place?  I LOVE THIS PLACE!  Great location for any tourists, right on State St.  Cute mom/pop place with a very awesome vibe.  Live blues/band on Thurs, Fri, and Sat.  

You are greeted right off with super friendly staff.  It was a "me" night (Hubby took the kiddies for a 1D concert!) and I noticed people Yelping this place ... Walked in and sat at bar.  Moses welcomed all in and was super friendly (2012 SB award for friendliest place!).  Order glass of Cab ( that became the whole bottle;) of Babcock Red.  Went perfectly with my Poke (spicy and ginger flavored paired well!).  Made friends with Kim (co-owner) who's hubby was the cook (for many many yrs, French trained!)...  Wound up also ordering the seafood special of seared Scallops in coconut curry sauce that was AWESOME!

I want to recommend this wonderful place to all... Great food, great drinks, super nice/friendly staff/owners ... Please eat here -you won't regret it!

Beer and wine available!

4 of us went to dinner... We were seated fast. Waitress was attentive.
Food came in a timely manner.
My friends steak was ordered med rare and came out well done like a hockey puck. They cooked her another and it was well done. At that point she just ate the steak as she wanted to eat with us.  My fish was also over cooked. My wife said her salad was very good. And our other friend was pleased with his meal.
If I could give half stars I would rate this experience a 2.5 stars.
Had better meals here... Meh....

Having this treasure almost  in our backyard is wonderful. We love meeting up after a round of golf, or having a nice dinner. The sunset view can't be beat. Great service, and great food. Our favorites/ specials are the crab stuffed grouper, the burger (lots of sides choices including tater tots), the club sandwich, the seafood chowder (just spectacular), the Irish nachos, onion rings and the quesadillas.  We love coming here.

I never write reviews but I had to for this place. We are from south Florida where we have ALOT of Brazilian steakhouses.. and not just that, we are brazilian. This place is an embarrassment to any brazilian. I can understand why an American may be a little fond of it. Different kind of food. But everything from the hot food bar being horrible and old (we went at 8pm.. not late at all), to the meat being either tasteless or extremely salty. That is when they came at all. The service, aside from 2 servers, were horrible! End of story is that I would give less than one star. And advice you that has any idea what Brazilian food is supposed to taste like, stay far away.
Wasn't my most favorite burger in town, but was a great deal for the Devour Indy 2 for $25 special. We got burgers, sweet potato tots, and beer. My wallet is happy.

This restaurant just opened up this weekend.  I visited on Sunday at noon at their opening time.   The decor is very modern and inviting.  I was seated promptly but did wait a while for the server to come to the table considering I was the only customer in the store.  

I ordered a luncheon special combo.  The beef with garlic/chicken fried rice dish came with wonton soup and an egg roll.  The soup was brought to my table within about 5 minutes and was hot and tasty. I waited about 15 minutes for the entree which seemed a little long since I was the first order placed for the day.

The food arrived at a little more than room temperature which surprised me since I had waited so long and there were no others being served.  The plate was very upscale and the presentation of the vegetables, beef, and fried rice was impressive.  The food taste was about average for a Chinese dish.  The portion was very generous. (I took some home in a good plastic bowl provided by my server.}

The restaurant advertises a free glass of wine to diners over 21 years of age, but I was told they did not have liquor available.  From what I could gather from a worker that speaks little English, the beer and wine delivery did not happen for the opening.

The menu advertises the Daily Combination specials for $5.95 which is what I ordered. (open to 3PM)  The Dinner price after 3 to close is $8.00.  When my bill came I had been charged $8.50.  I asked about the difference and again in very broken English the server said the special pricing was just on Monday through Saturday and that on Sunday the dinner price was all day for the combo special.  Still I was charged 50 cents more.  The point being, if price is of concern, you may want to ask the server the specific price of your meal when you order it.  Hopefully, you will be able to understand the answer.

The staff was very friendly with lots of smiling (partly because most cannot communicate with the customers in English).  I will give this restaurant another try as I live in an apartment building right across the street and it is very convenient when in the mood for Japanese or Chinese food.

You have to try this place if you're in the area!  It's in Chinatown!  They have very many cool desserts that you won't see anywhere else!  It is beautiful inside, and you wait to get seated and place your order.  I had the durian pancake and I liked it.  If you haven't tried durian, I suggest you try it before going to this place to order it lol.  Durian is an acquired smell/taste.  For some, the smell is too strong for them.  Anyhows,  it has a durian inside this "pancake" with cream on top of it.  It was mighty yummy!
Outstanding lunch, brunch or breakfast.  Fresh, unique and fun.  Try their catering too and you won't be disappointed.  We just moved close by and I'm thrilled we can visit more frequently.

I'm just telling ya....our beignet's here AT THE AIRPORT were 10x's better than at Cafe Du Monde. The airport's are light and flakey vs Du Monde which was dense and a little stale - I'm just saying. I know they have a huge reputation and following - but I was truly disappointed when we ate there.

Was excited to try this place out since it's so local and one of the only 24/7 places open around Beach Drive. Definitely not disappointed. The prices are a little pricey for breakfast food but really not bad compared to the surrounding area. Family was visiting and we ended up here for breakfast 2 out of the 3 days. Our favorites were the hangover and the pancakes were perfectly cooked. Cocktails were good and the champagne was fresh. Overall, a good addition to the neighborhood!

Great family treatment, delicious food... Perfect for family or dating. I recommend their antipasto and selection of wine. Coffee is excellent!!!! The pasta and meatballs are yummy. Try pizza on a casual day. Can't say enough :)

Simply amazing, I  can't complain about anything...

5 reasons for 5 stars

Crepes

Pastries

Bacon in a flaky croissant with scrambled eggs and cheese.  Oh my

The staff is super friendly and will  accommodating 

The ambiance is homey.  

I  always recommend people here.  The food takes you away to a more relaxed place in time.

The pork ribs were outstanding. Amazing customer service. Their various amount of food and drink items is awesome. Perfect for family meals. Even if you are alone you can get some mouth watering delicious food.

My first time going there was on Monday for breakfast. The server was awesome! She was really attentive and down to earth. I got the vegan sandwich and oatmeal. Both were awesome. I love that the toppings are no extra charge and unique. Not just lettuce and tomato. The oatmeal was really good. Plus it came with brown sugar, sunflower seeds, and dried fruit. My boyfriend got the pancakes and fruit plate. The fruit plate was delicious. The food took a minute but it was worth it. I love the atmosphere here. It is nice to support farm to table style restaurants.

This Cafe Du Monde is always rolling! Just make sure to ask for fresh beignets if you feel they aren't hot. Other then that, the beignets are always cooked & delicious!!! The store stays tidy, and the customer service is a ten. Everyone is quick and fast on the job, and will get things done in an efficient time matter. This Cafe Du Monde doesnt allow any negativity, or anything that may or may not disrupt the hospitality of their guests. ALWAYS COME HERE.
Comfortable atmosphere, great vintage/industrial style, friendly service, outdoor seating and big windows, and, oh yeah, great coffee!

I really enjoyed this place on my first visit. 
The staff/service was great! Everyone was all smiles, professional and checked on us consistently. 
The location is nice, its not in the heat of BR so its easy to get in and out without all of the traffic on the strip
The food was pretty good, not saying is was to die for but it was better than most and very very tasty. The food did come out super fast so if you order an appetizer i would recommend eating that before ordering your entree. 
selections were vast as most traditional Mexican restaurants are. 
My only complaint is limited parking but that is to be expected in BR. when it super busy you may have to park across the street or in a local business (closed) parking lot. 

I will be back here, very cool spot.

oh p.s they allow for dogs in the outside dining, and they will bring out doggy water bowls!! so sweet

First time here. Pricey for fast food. Courteous service, extra long wait  (25 minutes) because they got are order wrong. Fish was ok, I got the chicken tenders. I got very sick. Total food poisoning. I know it was this food, it was the only thing I ate all day. I wouldn't recommend. Very disappointed.

I went to Mercato last night with my wonderful date after searching Yelp for an Italian restaurant in West Chester. It was awesome!  It is the best italian restaurant in West Chester AND the surrounding area!!  You'll get a great authentic Italian meal on any budget. As it turned out, my date knew Angelo, the owner, from Angelo's restaurant that he sold a couple of years back. Angelo and his wife could not have put together a better restaurant. MERCATO ROCKS from the rustic italian feel, to the fantastic variety on the menu to the wine list to the staff. Erin was our server and she was super great. Dominic brought us our food and made sure we were satisfied. The manager (I feel so horrible that I cannot remember her name!) was super nice and personable. Please support local restaurant owners like Angelo and his beautiful wife instead of going to a national franchise.  The food is sooooo much better and you'll feel even more satisfied knowing that you are supporting local families. Support Mercato, it is a 5 star experience.

6/18/12 Stopped today for the Garage Style Beef Tacos (see picture). There are two in each plate, but it is great that they come with four tortillas (corn) you can easily make four tacos. The meat was tender and juicy. It comes with roasted poblanos and red peppers. The whole package just bursting with flavor. The refried beans area great compliment to the plate. Skipped on the rice as it is not the best or the worst, better said not memorable. The chips and salsa are a good compliment to the meal.

6/18/12 Wow, this place has been open for a while and I had just missed it. It is a must try in Tucson. Tacos is their thing, but do not be fooled. they have excellent dishes too. Int the middle of the desert, a great place to eat fish. I would recommend you try the Tour of Tacos. Include the Shrimp Bacon one and the Adobada one. You will not regret it! Staff is friendly too, great service on the three times I have been there in the last two months. Keep it up guys!

We live nearby and tried it out a few weeks ago.  We had a good experience (tasty food and friendly service) so we are back tonight.  Tasty food and friendly service again! We'll be back again.  Not fancy, but its a comfortable place with lots of quality menu items.  Five star in comparison to some other Tucson restaurants.  We have been surprised by the quality :)

Very nice atmosphere and good food.  Me and my wife happened to pass this place while heading to Jackson square and we returned later on in the day because she wanted to hear live music and I wanted beignets.  We had a sandwich called the Decatur club and an order of 3 beignets.  The price wasn't bad and the food was good.  The sandwich was light and not very heavy and the beignets were fried heaven with powdered sugar.   The band that was playing was excellent and this was a great experience even if mother nature decided to let a thunderstorm form and dump a heavy downpour of rain on us.  I'd gladly recommend this place to future visitors who would like lunch, music and beignets.

I come here for breakfast mainly because I think this is one of the great breakfast spot in IV. 
The store is very clean have friendly service and the food is amazing! 

If you order online you can receive a free cupcake of any choice, which I recommend you doing because the cupcake is pretty pricey. 

This place is also a good spot to study and eat. It does get a little bit loud, but if you're not really studying hard then you should be fine. By the way the restroom is located outside of the store at the back.

I really loved my experience here. I am not a karaoke person, but had enough lubrication during dinner last week to give it a go with 8 friends. I was surprised at the affordability of the private rooms (although granted, I have nothing to compare it to). Drink service to the room was quick and friendly and the bouncer was really nice about explaining how everything worked. Great selection of songs, too. I am, dare I say, a karaoke person now.

The line out the door on the weekends is there for a reason, I got there 15 minutes before opening on a Sunday and still had to take my place in line. Overall they have great coffee, pastries, and menu options. I love the decor inside and the giant windows make it feel so inviting. This is a good place for a breakfast or brunch for an occasion. 

Marche really shines with their sweeter options (pastries, croissant french toast, etc) but I haven't been wildly impressed by their savory choices. Don't get me wrong, I still clean my plate just fine but it isn't my first choice for brunch in Nashville for this reason. If hollandaise took a permanent residency on their menu I might change my mind.

I've ordered a couple times and the food is great. Good delivery time and polite people. Just ordered a burger with a drink and milkshake and I'm disappointed that they forgot the milkshake. I called them after to tell them that they forgot it, and they told me that they would send someone to deliver it. 2 hours later, and they forgot about it.

like how

Whenever we passed this place during lunch and dinner time, there was always a long line outside the door. And we finally got to check out Felix's in an afternoon. 

We began with a catfish Po-boy. The sandwich itself tasted amazing, with the catfish cooked perfectly to golden brown, and just the right amount of seasoning. It looked and smelled amazingly intriguing. I only wished the fries were cooked for longer. Some of them were quite wilted. 

I had always been interested to try out the turtle soup. And to be honest, I was not as impressed as I imagined I would be. The seasoning was quite overpowering. It really didn't make any different what ingredients were in the soup. Adding on to that, with everything diced into small pieces, I really couldn't tell what I had. 

The stuffed catfish had to be the highlight of the meal. I didn't even know catfish could be delicate like this. It even gave me the illusion that I was eating cod lol. Felix's really did bring the piece of catfish to another entirely new level. 

We really enjoyed everything we ordered. What a fantastic meal!

I'll be honest with you.  I've gone to this place a number of times over the past 5 years, and its gotten to the point where you can't get near it on Saturday night, and while its good....it's not that good that I'll wait. It's far too small to accomodate the patrons. i'd just as soon go down the road to Weso's where the food is just as good, if not better, and the noise is not so loud that you can't think.

I got the dragon as a burrito. It was a Saturday at lunch time. To say they weren't enthusiastic or eager to give great service is an understatement. The girl kept joking how she couldn't get the rice machine to work and how she "gives up". So off putting. The ingredients tasted fresh and I enjoyed the fillings of this roll except the shredded lettuce. It just wasn't necessary. The roll was so loosely wrapped that after a few bites everything started to fall apart. I wish I had grabbed a fork so I didn't waste anything falling out! 

They also offer Mexican food, vegetarian, and kids options. I'll definitely be back for lunch during my next Saturday class to see if they have improved.
Ordered 5 pizzas at 12:20pm for a work related lunch. They were delivered at 2:20pm. 2 hours to deliver pizzas 2.5 miles. That's all I need to say.

This review is for the seafood market -- Feby's is the best I've found in Wilmington. Even after moving a couple miles away with another seafood market down the street, I still drive to Feby's to buy seafood, especially mussels. They hand pick the mussels (no mesh bag been sitting on ice), so you really get your money's worth. Super fresh, and virtually all of them open up when cooked.
What an amazing bakery!!! Hilligoss is great for getting donuts on a Saturday morning or ordering dozens for large group gatherings!! I always look forward to donuts from Hilligoss!
Always a great spot to order in or pick up. Whenever I stay at the Circus Circus, I order here and it's ready in 10-15 minutes. Everything is always tasty. Nice staff too

I would not eat here!!! When we walked in the place was disgustingly nasty. but since we were there we decided it would be safe to get ice cream. we got our ice cream and went to pay for it. we had a 25 percent of entire purchase online coupon that was good until august 3rd 2016 so a month left. they refused to honor the online coupon so we paid and left. i will never return to this place and highly recommend no one else does. If i could select less than one star i would.

I've been to Sonny's quite a few times. I always call it the "beat our meat" place.  The staff used to wear these shirts that said "you can't beat our meat" and my dad had to buy us each one. 

When you enter sonny's, don't bother to scope out a seat. Just get in the line to the right of the corner, peruse the menu for a moment and order the Loaded Cheesesteak with whiz. Honestly, get the whiz. The whiz, combined with the mushrooms and peppers, give the cheesesteak a good moist-maintainer. 

Side note: my boyfriend ordered the original cheesesteak with provolone. First half was great, second half needed moist-maintainers. Jussayin.

The fries are fine, but the onion rings looked bomb.  

The last time we were there, one of the women working was berating the other woman working there almost to the point of crying. And it was loud. And public. And we could all hear....it was awkward.

Other than that, everyone's been SUPER nice.

This is probably my favorite chicken spot in Tucson. The customer service was great. Destiny went above and beyond and made sure we were taken care of. Not to mention the food was delicious. Definitely will be coming back.
I don't get the hype.  It was an ok cheesesteak, but not worth the detour off the highway.  I got the wiz, wit, as recommended by Yelp.

A Yelp treasure find!! Great apps, great food, great service and great location. Personally I think of great service first, but the drive to this place is pretty sweet and that's where to start. Not as good as the Colorado mountains, but pretty sweet never the less. Lobster Dip was really nice and my Steak Salad cooked perfectly and excellent flavor. My wife's Cobb Salad with crazy good chicken strip. I'm taking seriously good chicken tenders almost as good as my steak. The chocolate cake was pretty nice as well. All of that and right next door to one of the best gelato place I've ever had

Took a staff member to lunch at the Mass Ave location on 4/30/15. It was busy all over Mass Ave because it was Dine Out for Life (not really relevant here but just a note)

I love pretty much all pizza so Bazbeaux is always great for lunch :)

I gave it 4 stars because the guy working the pizza counter on this day was quite possibly one of the rudest people I have ever encountered. At least he was consistent - he was equally horrible to everyone in line. Seriously - this guy snapped at everyone and basically threw their food at them. I'm used to standard hipster angst but this guy was a total douchebag. Ugh.

We came to Serendipity on Friday.  The waiters were very nice and attentive.  The drinks from the bar were very good!  We were just not too wild about the food.  We had the shrimp in grass skirt and shared the tasting menu in order to try as many things as possible.  We started with the white gazpacho and I found it weird and grainy (maybe it just wasn't my taste), the second course was the lamb baklava which tasted good, but was very sweet and had a herb salad on the side that I found too bitter and the pickles seemed completely out of place.  The third course was the crawfish boil salad.  I enjoyed the corn on the salad, but the potatoes were too spicy and the crawfish were not really seasoned at all.  We ended on a high note, the amberjack fish was tasty and cooked perfectly and the beet ravioli was awesome.  So we ended on a high note for sure, but I will not be rushing back.

Love this place - one of the top two BBQ joints in Nashville and that is saying quite a bit.  Not quite a hole in the wall like Hog Heaven, but a very authentic feel - not as sanitized as Edley's or the new Martin's on Belmont.  Great ribs, pulled pork and all the sides are worth trying.
Amazing tableside guacamole and margaritas! Andy made it a fun dinner out with the girls.

We went to this steak house last night. The service was very prompt, and there was always someone there to refill drinks, take plates, and answer questions. We started our dinner with the Housemade bacon with maple cotton candy. The cotton candy really made the dish, providing the right amount of flavor to an otherwise mediocre bacon. Next, I had the Wagyu Filet Mignon. The steak was tasty, but by no means was it the best steak I've had. The waiter described it as "melt in your mouth tender" but I didn't find this to be the case. Although the steak was tender, a knife was still required to cut, and I don't see how the Wagyu elevated the steak above another beef. The steak was seasoned alright, but lacked the flavor I was expecting from such an upscale restaurant. For sides, we had the tater tots, potato aligot, and cream corn brûlée. My personal favorite was the potato aligot. Think cheesy mashed potatoes. The tater tots were home made, and were also quite tasty, and also had a cheesy element to them. The corn was good, but included jalapeños, an item I don't usually agree with. Desert was mediocre as well. Highlights were the potatoes, service, and free parking. But the steak did not hold up to the standards I had set!

Yuk.  

Dirty bathrooms too!

Take a look at the disgusting pictures of the bathroom. Hear me out: if an establishment that sells food keeps its bathrooms like this, shouldn't we realise that the only reason why their food looks good is because it's in the public view? What does it look like in the back where they prepare this food? If they allow their bathrooms to be disgusting, I bet their kitchen is disgusting too!



ugly ambience inside. 

The dining room would give you the impression that you are in a restaurant that is closed for business at the time... See the picture attached. However, the food is  good and I think two stars is unfair to this establishment as I have eaten here this day and also seven days ago from this day on which I'm writing this review.  

If they get rid of the ugly Saint Patrick's day green walls, and the ugly green booths, and update the decor inside, I think they would be running a 5-star restaurant

This place is great! The food was delicious, the service was great, the cocktails are very creative. Great place to bring friends for a nice dinner when in New Orleans. This place has a female chef that is well known and loved by New Orleans. This place gets busy and it is very small so I would call before coming. I'm not sure if they take reservations but if they do I would suggest making them.

I'd go for 4 1/2 stars if it was an option.  I've gone here with groups and usually at lunchtime.  Pirate's sits in a strip mall across from the Atlantis.  You have to know where to look.  

The pizzas are thick and full of tasty ingredients, regardless of which ones you order.  I went with a group of people who wanted to go again because all of us agreed it was good.

Sidebar:  they also have a limited Greek menu from which I've had the gyro platter and it's good.

Granted, if you're in Reno, you'll want to take in a buffet or two.  But if you want to scarf down some pizza and Italian/Greek fare with the locals, give Pirate's Pizza a try.

I try this place good sandwich and good drinks
My son and I like it 
Price maybe according to the place around there 
But I will try again sometime soon. I recommended this place for friendly place small and cozy's spot.

We dined here last week and the food was decent but restaurant was ridiculously loud. Came back again this week because it wasn't crowded.  The noise level wasn't too bad. Sitting here for 55 minutes and still do not have our food. The waitress has been great knowing we are getting impatient. Oops!  Food is just arriving. Food was good. I had a single burger that was a 6 oz. Good but more bun than burger.

I understand that this place is popular and stuff happens but when I was here on New Year's Eve, you'd think they were a brand new restaurant.

We waited an hour in line because I had family who have never experienced it before. Once seated, took 10 min for our server to come. We and the table behind us ordered at the same time but a table that ordered about 5 min after we did got their food first!

When the table that ordered with us inquired, the waitress simply said "I don't know what happened to your ticket, and I just have to wait for the kitchen to tell me your order is ready."     ARE YOU SERIOUS?

Food: Our pancakes were cold - not lukewarm - cold like it had been sitting on the counter for 5-10 min waiting for the rest of our food to come.

Definitely will not be back when they have a line more than 20 min.
When you're in the mood for a great hole in the wall joint, this place never disappoints! Service is friendly and the portions are generous.

I've been to Kooma a couple of times recently - for sushi in the area, I like it probably the best.  The sushi is good quality, and their specialty rolls are good.  (The scallop roll is GREAT.)  The first time I went I skipped the sushi and had the hot pot bibimbab, which was very good.  I only wish they offered a brown rice option.

The ambiance is hip and trendy - and the crowd, like Lee said, is trendy.  Which to me means, that it's a younger West Chester crowd then other places.   I'll definitely go back again.  FYI, they don't take reservations.

Commenting about their Breakfast.

Few things remembered.

1. Nice View on the pier, you can sip on coffee while looking out to the waters

2. Mellow, family type dining atmosphere

3. The waiter was attentive, filled up water/ coffee fairly quickly

Con:

1. Messed up my order, I ordered hash, but got ham... had to wait till my order was made right... by then I sort of lost my appetite munching on my toast...their hash was made differently than normal hash I am used to... and when they remade my hash it seemed as though they rushed it, and it wasn't cooked well... so I ended up wasting money on something I could not enjoy as I would've liked to....

2. Upon departure, no one bothered to give simple thanks for coming type greeting 

Overall

Food 2 stars
Ambience 3 1/2 stars
Service 3 stars but messed up my order so minus 1 star

Since I was visiting the area, I would've liked to have enjoyed my dining, however it wasn't a great experience in my case. Not bad, but not good.

We decided to try Nada during devour. The salsa trio and guacamole were incredible. I have been holding off coming here due to the tacos not being mix and match. I think this place would be top notch if you were able to pick different tacos - or at the LEAST during devour so you're able to get a true feel for what you like when trying the menu. My fiancé got the hot chicken tacos and loved them. I got the pastor and thought they were okay - I like more exotic fixings on mine like avocado, queso fresco, crema, etc. They're a little bland for the price. The potatoes were pretty good but somewhat unnecessary for a side when you're getting tacos. I think I would give up my side for the option to pick three different tacos. 

We will definitely be back. Probably to try the make your own queso, avocado tacos and possibly fish/shrimp. The salad looks great, too!

I liked my meal here at Buffalo's Steak House and I expect to return frequently. The main attraction was value. But in many ways, the food seemed ordinary. Like it would taste if I cooked it at home. I want more from a restaurant.
For my dinner I got a pork chop and skirt steak with black beans and white rice. It was all nicely done. But nothing had that extra something to make it special: A marinade, a spice or some other flair. The food might show differently if I got another cut of meat, like a T-bone. The white rice and beans were satisfactory but I ended up not finishing them.
For a drink I first got a papaya juice. It was a little sour and didn't quite taste like papaya to me. I followed that with a pineapple juice that was better.
My biggest disappointment came with dessert. I asked the server if the peaches in the peaches and cream were fresh or canned. He said fresh. My dessert arrived with no skin on the peaches and a tablespoon or more of cling peach syrup at the bottom of my cup.
Some of the other dishes look interesting and getting the better cuts of steak and shrimp will allow me to better judge the quality of food.
Except for the slip up on the peaches, service was good.
They had three kinds of beer, none of which I wanted to try. They offered no other alcohol choices.
Update: I went back and this time I got the chimichurri, which is a pork spare rib. The meat itself was a little tough, but the flavor was good. I"m not sure what went into this chimichurri preparation, but it added some nice flavor to the ribs.
Nice decor and a great venue for dinner and drinks. The draft list is extensive and they carry a wide array of craft beers. 10/10 will definitely be coming back.
food was a surprise good food right where we wanted to be and the cost was great thisdoesnt happen in  nashville  very often

I really enjoyed the food.  The staff was pleasant and allowed me to modify one of their specials in order to accommodate my taste.  I tried the spicy sesame sauce and it was wonderful.  I will definitely visit again soon.  This is my new favorite spot for Asian fusion.

They double charged my card. When I called they were not concerned or apologetic. The Macaroons I purchased were dry and hard, and they charged me $3 each (I purchased 6)! This place is overpriced, unfriendly, mediocre and way over rated.

After hearing so much about their brunch. My girlfriend and I went here on a Sunday to check it out. The wall of wine crates when you first walk in is quite interesting and a cool place for a photo opp. We were seated promptly despite it being quite busy. There was a bridal brunch going on in the middle so if you have a large group they can accommodate but would recommend calling ahead to make reservations. The menu is concise but filled with some good options. I got the Fried Chicken Tacos while my girlfriend got the Chicken Biscuit Sliders and we split the order of Crispy Brussels. We ended up trading each other one of our sliders/tacos to each other so we could both enjoy two delicious entrees. Although they were filling I kinda wish the tacos came in three instead of two but luckily they do come with a side. We each got the Jumbo Mimosas which are a solid deal as the cups hold quite a bit and you get to keep them! Our waitress was very nice and made sure to check on us throughout our visit.
Tonoght was our first trip to Chimis. The servive was very good.   The food was was served hot and tasted good.  We will be going back again.

Oh my gosh!!! It was sooooooo good! I had the hot chicken biscuit with potato casserole and my husband had the hot chicken and waffle. Everything was so good and fresh! We did have to wait in line, about 45 minutes, but it was so worth it. We also had an apple fritter, it was awesome as well! We will definitely come back here when we come back to Nashville!

papaya salad, tamarind juice and chilly tofu - fan of all three 
I am sure will discover more there as and when time goes by....

Good not so cheap eat, parking can be a bit of a pain to find but good food compensates it all

They are more than excited to serve water to you, so excited that you have to wait till they finish filing your glass up and only then can you sit on your seat (pun intended) ..was a 1st for me....
I really like Mexican food, but this is the only place that gives me heartburn. So this is a toss up. Great food, but for my escouphogous pays for it lateresophagus

Food: 3
Decor: 1
Ambiance: 1.5
Service: 3
Value: 3.5

Decent pizza with a complete lack of atmosphere. Still worth the low cost.

Got to experience the wonderful flavors of The Mill in DT St Pete. The aesthetic of this establishment actually integrate  parts from a aged mill to give customers that industrial ambience. 

Not only was the restaurants atmosphere marvelous but, the food was also luscious. Severed was the personalized cheese charcuterie with duck bacon, salted bread and other tasty add-ons. Next was the crispy Duck Wing Confit which had hints of sweet pineapple and lastly a nice watermelon juice beverage top it all off. This is definitely the place to be if you like good food and great atmospheres. Overall rating 8.9/10.

IG: CultureCourtyard
Great food and large portions...always worth it! Definitely more authentic than most Mexican restaurants. The breakfast tacos are also great on the weekends!

Fantastic Greek restaurant!  We had the Greek salad, beef gyro, and the moussaka.  All of it was excellent and the portions were generous.  The staff was very attentive and made us feel like family. We can't wait to go back.
Went here for the first time for my parents anniversary dinner. Food was great, very cozy atmosphere. I believe the food quality/service justify the prices.
Great food & great service! The Seafood Mac & Cheese and the Fusion Bang Chicken & Shrimp entrees were delicious. The Cheesesteak egg rolls were fantastic. Highly recommend Star Fusion!

Perfect spot on the beach with live music and a fantastic view! We were there about 2:30 and had a choice of outside or inside air conditioning. We chose inside--Hot--and service was prompt and friendly once we were finally seated. (Although lots of tables open, not enough servers to accommodate the tables.)
I ordered fried chicken sliders (came with two) and seasoned fries. The dish was delivered within minutes and it was DELICIOUS! Large pieces of chicken and the fries were light and crispy. Pricing was reasonable for how much was served. Getting the check, however, took a long time--- probably due to only a couple of wait staff running around like chickens with their heads off :/ They were not to blame (management issue?) and did a great job handling the crowd. I would definitely go back and highly recommend!!

Wow amazing pizza and the beer is wonderful! Will definately be back! We got out of there with 2 slices of 3 topping pizza and 2 beers for $19. Not bad, I would say for the quality, I loved the crust very much and they even gave us ranch! Although the crust does NOT need it! Hopefully will go back during happy hour or before or after an Aces game for the good deals but amazing first experience

I love this sandwich place. Bread is hot and the meat taste fresh. I know it's fresh and authentic vietnamese food because owner  Annie's  mom is cooking right there. My friend Rich and I have business trip to Philly once a year. This is always the first place we drop by. #1 house special is our favorite. Just wish there is awesome place like this in ct.

My wife and I drove to St. Lou from Chicago for a Sunday afternoon Cubs Cards game and found RANGE for post-game. We ordered a straight-up burger and fries (medium rare with lettuce tomato and onion +house-made pickles. It was the best burger we can remember having, period. The fries were pure potato, spiced nicely, hot (temp.,) and the aioli mayo side was awesome. We went with a straight-up burger for the basic experience but the menu is deep with creative toppings and ingredients. The beer selection was vast, local and cold. The service was super friendly. The room is creative and comfortable. Don't miss this place if you're anywhere near DTSL - they put in the effort.

Pretty sure all of the different ways to say "their ramen is awesome" can be found in the existing reviews for this small, bustling treat of a restaurant. They have some lovingly constructed, balanced ramen dishes to suit a range of different palates, and at ~$14 per main dish it won't break the bank. And, yes, everyone should try their brisket ramen because how often do you see a bona-fide matzoh ball in a Japanese dish? 

But the real reason this place gets that 5th star is their staff: Not just because they can handle a hungry crowd waiting for painfully few tables on a Friday night, but because when my girlfriend and I sat down in a bit of a rotten mood (totally unrelated), they noticed. They checked in with us tactfully throughout the meal to make sure everything was okay and that we were being taken care of.  To me that means a lot. 

I've been here before and will definitely be back. Next time you're looking for a hot meal in Philly, try Cheu.
Cute little coffee shop. Their coffee was good. Convenient to stop off on your way to run some errands.

Love this place have to get my fix when coming to AZ. 

Flat pies yum, good beer on tap. Warm chicken Caesar salad (always crunchy romain hearts) and home made garlic croutons... Its a huge salad so best to share if youre having a pie too!

Love that they take their food serious but not life.... 

I would have taken pix of my warm caesar  but ate it all before thinking about it. Do go and yes there will likely be a line.. Its worth it!

Minus 1star sorry ...the ladies bathroom needs some major updating... That tile sink and floor look  and smell pretty wrecked.

First time I went they didn't put the sauce on the side for one of the sandwiches we ordered like we specified. They also forgot another sauce entirely.

The second time I went to pick up an order I placed by phone by the sign they clearly have marked as pick up and waited 10 minutes while others were helped before I had to get the cashiers attention and interupt them as I was being ignored. Within seconds (seriously, less than 5 seconds) they had the order up on the screen so I'm guessing I was the only one with a pickup at the time.

Very frustrating to be ignored by someone standing in front of me as others who were just getting in line were helped first. Not to mention their only choices of bread were sourdough and wheat over the 3 days between the orders I placed.

Wow, this place is great!! The fish tacos were my favorite. Seating is limited, so get there early for a table or just get take-out. Huge selection of taco's, sope's, quesadilla's, torta's, and Thurs thru Sat they have tamales! This is our new favorite Mexican joint in Tampa :D

Being that this place has been on DDD, I was surprised that 1. I'd never been and 2. I'd never heard of it but after my experience, I can see why...

The staff was great: professional, attentive and pretty quick being they make it to order. There is no inside seating, just a few tables in front with umbrellas and tree coverage. Now, being a Floridian, I know what to expect when sitting outside but I don't like being attacked by mosquitos or flies unless I'm at a bbq or at the beach...be prepared for that.

Let's get to the food...

First off, the signage on the building is very misleading. I order the "Roberto Clemente" because on the sign it looked like a regular size Cuban sandwich but with what comes on it. When I got the burger, it was half the size of the picture (I was like...is this it?) This sandwich is Cuban bread with a burger, grilled onions, and swiss cheese. The cheese was nearly non-existent so other than the juice from the burger and the oil from the onions it was very dry, which also killed the flavor because none of the flavor profile meshed. The plus here, it was REALLY hot...literally right off the grill hot. I got fries too which were equally on fire, they also give you a copious amount. The only problem here is it just tasted like I was eating fried oil, no bueno. 

I wanted the "graham cracker cake" as advertised on the buildings menu board, they didn't have it and it's not on their paper menu which makes me think they don't even carry it at all anymore. 

They advertise that they make their desserts on site so I was rather excited to see strawberry shortcake. This is very much a Florida dessert, especially with the fields not too far from this establishment. The dessert itself was decent on flavor but it is certainly not a real "strawberry shortcake" the way you should experience it in Florida. The biscuit was a rock and they use strawberry ice cream (made with Blue Bell, not in-house as advertised) which is a no-no. Ugh. I love small business but I can't support what I had here.

The best place for Indian food ,if you want to try something different Other than paneer or chicken tikka masala.. Must tries
Chicken fried rice
Bombay sandwich
Pastries
Coffee

Worst to try:
Gobi manchurian

150+ mostly positive reviews and the packed dining area I saw the several times I went there won't convince me this is good Vietnamese food.

I have tried different items on the 4-5 times I have been to this restaurant and each time I have been underwhelmed.  The food is lacking in depth of flavor, and seems sloppy in preparation (probably a result of the above noted busy dining area).  I wouldn't call it bad, but I don't see why it is constantly voted the best Viet in St. Louis.  It may just be a result of the clean conditions and location. 

I will say however the service has always been friendly and accommodative if not a little rushed.  It's probably what gets me up to two stars.

I had hit hopes for this place both the bagel and the coffee. Sorry to report it struck out on both accounts. The service at register was great but the order time even though it was fairly empty was super slow. My ticket for coffee and bagel was $7+ which is a 20% premium over Einstein bagels. 

For the bagel I had it toasted with vegetable cream cheese and a tomato. It was under toasted and frankly the bagel itself didn't feel completely cooked, the cream cheese was over powered with some herb, possibly rosemary or thyme?  The tomato was almost frozen and at least a day old. The coffee tasted burnt. I suggest going to Einstein, 20% less in cost and all the way around a better experience. Over rated and not worth the trip.

Waited more than 15 minutes before asking the bar to send a server. He was nice when he finally arrived. Grilled cheese was awful - two slices of deli cheese nowhere close to melted. Tomato soup was flavorful but way too chunky. Had been looking forward to trying it with a friend but won't go back.

About 40 steps from my office so it's one of my go-to breakfast spots during the work week.  The employees are friendly and provide good service.  Bagels are great, nice selection of creative bagel-based breakfast sandwiches.  The Greek B-Eggel is delicious.  Only reason a star is missing is because they have gotten my order wrong a couple times when I've ordered for my coworkers.

This review is for a Sunday 4pm happy hour experience.
I ordered "Two Fish Tacos" which was presented nicely.  However the fish tasted like it was leftover from a previous day that had been boiled or steamed to revive it.  Do you know what old boiled fish tastes like?  Horrible!
I could not finish my meal.......

Actually, I like this place.  The rooms are comfortable, the pool/jacuzzi/sauna are excellent, and the price is lower than several of the other area hotels.  The food's not bad for a hotel, and it's also a minute from the Pennsylvania Turnpike.
I ate here on a Sunday for their buffet. I was very impressed with the food all around & will definitely be coming back to order off the menu.

The best service in Tampa! Makes it even better when the food tastes fresh, is great quality, and reasonably priced for the size of the portions. Always leave happy,  and don't forget to try the mac and cheese...The best in Tampa!

SO AUTHENTIC. SO GOOD.

The falafel is to die for. They were so flavorful and spiced perfectly. I also had the gyro sandwich which was a giant portion for its very modest price. The Lebanese tea was delicious! When I went for pickup, the place was filled with Arabic families - which is always a great sign for a Greek & Lebanese restaurant! The owner was so happy and pleasant. Overall an awesome experience. I love supporting this small business!

Our first time dining in the new location in Carrollwood!!
we decided to dine at the bar, our Server and Bar Tender Elvis was outstanding !!!
Our meal came out quickly, and there was a small miscommunication on our order and Elvis corrected immediately !!!!  Nicole was assisting in the bar area and was prompt and attentive 
   we will definitely be back!!!!  
WELCOME BACK SHELLS

Everyone raves about Drago's Charbroiled Oysters so, OF COURSE, our table of five girls ordered a round of six, thinking that we would need to order more of these allegedly delicious treats.  WRONG!  We were fighting over who was going to finish the plate off since no one wanted more than one.  These little suckers were SMOTHERED in parmesan and UBER UBER salty.   

I shared an entree of shrimp pasta with my girl friend and neither of us finished our half-portions.  Despite it being a half-portion, I had six shrimps on my plate!  I was very excited at this generous helping, but then was quickly saddened when the shrimp tasted like they were boiled and unseasoned with nothing but salt.

The staff was great and accommodating.  Our waiter let me cancel my appetizer when I changed my mind after the oysters.  My glass was always full and they flirted with us (but what waiter can resist flirting with a table full of girls).

If I return to NOLA, I would save my feet the walk and choose a different place to eat.

This review is based solely on my personal experience and reflect my personal opinions.  Your experience may be completely different.

The new Trestle Inn is an inspiration.  They have Go-Go dancers performing most nites of the week starting at 10 P.M. I have been assured that the place stays pretty classy and that all genders are highly welcome. 

The wall adjacent to the main entrance is painted white and is used as a filming screen.  From the bar you are able to watch a variety of tasteful Go-Go and 60s, 70's area film. The establishment has soaring ceilings and is mostly painted black.

My wife and I went to the Trestle based on a suggestion from the folks at Barry's Home Brew. We went down with the intention of trying the deviled eggs.  Unfortunately, they were out.  Possibly noticing our disappointment, the cook offered to make us something special.  

The special dish which he prepared consisted of a variety of samples.  It was wonderful.  The samples included bison meatballs (best meatballs I have every had), ants on a log (which consisted of celery, creamy peanut butter and cherries - soaked in liquor), Pigs in a blanket (small gourmet sausages wrapped in phyllo dough, kettle cooked chips with a really amazing homemade dip, and a bbq Asian dim sum dumpling.   

My wife had a beer and I had a Flower Power Whiskey Sour which was delicious (no bottled sour mix here). The grand total....drum......$10.  

It seems that if you are able to charm food out of the kitchen you don't have to pay for it.  I am very impressed with the staff and the character of the establishment.  My wife and I pointed out the mistake on the bill and they told us that it wasn't a mistake.  We spent the entire car trip home making plans to go back.  

To summarize:  The food is amazing.  The draft list is impressive. The whiskey selection is stellar and the atmosphere (especially after 10 P.M.) is most assuredly awesome. I will be back to the Trestle Inn...probably later this week. I have to take advantage of the 5 - 8 P.M. Happy Hour!
I enjoy Chipotles but this specific location does "NOT" honor military / police discount like the other surrounding Chipotles...1 star.

I've heard good things about this place and I am a huge fan of Korean food.  Unfortunately, Dae Bak did not deliver this time.  I heard from others that it was good and perhaps we didn't order the right dishes.  We ordered the kimchi fried rice and the cold noodles.  Both were not great. 
 The kimchi fried rice had a really odd taste to it that I could not pinpoint.  And the cold noodles were just meh.  I prefer the cold noodles at Koko better.  Next time, I will try some meat dishes and see if this place lives up to its hype.
Probably the only some what legit pizza place that's left in the king of Prussia area. Stromboli's are a great deal and huge. Delivery is always on time and hot, no complaints at all.

This is probably the best place in Center City to watch a sports event or UFC cuz of the t.v.s and that they turn the volume up, but you better get there early if you want to get a seat. You also better be ready to fight for a seat and fight to keep it. Literally. Awful. And, if you take a break between drinks you will be told to 'order or leave' lol. Ridiculous. Also, got sick on the chili.

So... You remember that Seinfeld episode with the soup nazi? Stock's is kinda like that; only with Cake!!!!

The counter folks are less than friendly, the options are less than bountiful but the iced pound cake is to die for!!!

Stock's is closed Mondays FYI.
Meh it's okay. I will eat at the five Guys in Tacoma once a month. Just another corporate chain where everything tastes the same. I find it real unsanitary to be throwing peanut shells on the floor.

Amazing pizza we tried (The Color Purple) arugula and balsamic glaze 
And we had (Onion Brûlée) jumbo lump crabmeat and leek fondue 
They give it to you in a round box that you put in the oven great crust.
  We also had a cheese burger wow served on a brioche roll
Amazing food highly recommend !

The food to us was just okay. We did love the service tho, our waitress was amazing and the girls that bus the tables were super friendly. You can tell its family owned and operated and that's what my husband and I enjoyed most about the resturant. We will definitly try it again next time we are in Indianapolis.

Really great lunch experience here!  Sick as a dog and was looking for some homemade soup.  Their Nicaraguan chicken and rice stew hit the spot!  As good as what I make at home.  The Hubs enjoyed the quinoa veggie burger and a Hoegarten.  Very friendly service, and we were able to eat outside with our dog.  High quality comfort meal and reasonably priced.  Wish they were around the corner from my house, but will definitely go back again!

Favorite BBQ place in the world! The 'Well Fed Beast' is my favorite meal to order with the Brussel sprouts! Huge variety of local craft beers. I always leave with a bag of Scooby Snacks for the pups!
Our new "go-to" Vietnamese restaurant.  Excellent bun (vermicelli) bowls, Pho, spring rolls.  Conscientious staff and owner.

I'm not giving this place a one-star review, because it has a specific purpose and market.
This is my second visit here. The first time, I had a filet and broccoli (I was on an annoying diet.). They were not able to serve me a filet that wasn't pre-packaged with a bacon wrapping (which was soft and not crispy). So yes, they are most likely cooking everything from frozen bags.

We came here because we were hungover and craving pasta. It is, hands down, the worst Italian food I've ever had. I did not think it was possible for pasta dishes to have absolutely zero flavor. I do not salt my food, but I desperately needed to doctor up my dish with parmesan...... which I couldn't really do, because the cheese dispenser was gummed up with moist and old parmesan, with a rusted cap (I opened it up). Yuck.

I had the stuffed shells, and The Ninja had bolognese over angel hair. The meal was served with an appetizer of garlic bread.

Stuffed shells: Cooked well (no mushy pasta), clean-plated, but tasteless. I'm amazed at how their marinara sauce actually seemed to suck the flavor out of everything. It was like eating negative numbers, if that makes sense (It doesn't, I know). It had such little flavor, it turned my palate inside-out and sucked the life out of my tongue. I felt sad for it, like a decorated war veteran forced to clean toilets for a living.

Pasta Bolognese: The same marinara sauce was used, with meat mixed in. I think it was meat; all I could sense was the texture, because there was no flavor here either. The pasta was nicely cooked. This is worth noting, because in Italian cooking, the pasta itself is as important as the sauce, and if it's mushy, the cook should hang up his/her apron right then and there.

Garlic bread: This was great! It looks to have been cut from a baguette, which made each piece smaller than the Texas-toast size we are used to seeing. This allowed the entire piece to maintain its crunchiness. They were crisped and flavored in a balanced way, and we really enjoyed them. I asked for a side of marinara for dipping, but - as I've mentioned - the marinara actually hurt the garlic bread by sucking the life out of it with its "negative number flavor." Adding parmesan (before I opened the dispenser and discovered the nastiness) helped a bit.

Salad: Jut your typical diner salad with a nice vinaigrette. Some of the leaves were wilted. The olives were thrown on as an afterthought, including the canned pimento-stuffed kind.

This place is great for economically pleasing a large group, especially those with children or elderly guests. They do pizza, so perhaps that is their strong suit. This is why they gained a star with me: It's one step removed from Olive Garden in terms of variety of choices (1. pick your pasta 2. pick your sauce 3. pick your protein) and accessible "flavor." There are also options to order a half-order of each dish, which are more realistic portions for human beings. I suppose it's better to appeal to the lowest common denominator than to shoot for specific greatness. They stick with a beige flavor profile, rather than turn the masses off with spices and tastes that may not fly over well with a large group of hungry people with a wide spectrum of preferences.

The service is ok. Each visit, our server seemed either overly confused or like they had been trained in a diner. The wait was never long, our waters were filled, and they were attentive.

I would never embarrass myself by bringing guests here, but if I had to pay for an entire table of people from kids to grandparents, this would be ideal: cheap food with a taste to match the price. Also, they deliver, so I guess that's nice if you live close to one of their chain locations.

Nice looking place right off Egg Harbor Road and really nice people. The problem is the food isn't very good. I ordered the hibachi steak and shrimp and not only were the portions small but very salty. The vegetables had not taste other then the high amount of salt. The price is about average but one should expect better quality. The quest continues for good Japanese food in the area.

After having a good steak at The Mill, I went to Outback Steakhouse with my colleagues. I haven't been to Outback in a while and was curious to try  it again as I love steaks. 

I went for the Outback Centercut Sirloin. Normally, I am a Ribeye guy but the waitress recommended it as an Outback signature dish. I asked for light on the seasoning as I love the taste of steak just seasoned with salt. But I was curious about the seasoning and so I compromised with a light amount. 

Since I joined my colleagues late, the bread was almost over. I was a tad disappointed that I had to remind the waitress about the bread. 

When the steak arrived, what I got was mostly  medium or medium well with a touch of  medium rare in a small portion. 

But what was worse was the steak had a rough texture. Tasted like a very cheap cut of steak. The exterior had a burned leathery texture like it was overdone. The light seasoning ended up being a tiny saving grace because as much as I don't love seasoning, it added some taste to a steak that lacked any on its own. 

When the waitress asked how the food was , she started to walk away right away as if the question was some obligatory "g morning" you would mumble to  a stranger as you pass him by. Next time she came around, I told her about my steak. She kind of did a half hearted "oh is there something you want me to do ?" and I replied, "Not really as I will just finish it even if I am not happy about it" as I dont like to waste food. She seemed relieved I wasn't demanding an exchange and said "oh well, the objective is to finish the steak , am i right?" and tried to pawn her lazy response off as a joke. 

Oh, and the evening parking is bad. It was full and it would be nice if they put up a sign out there that you can park at the Carrabbas opposite the restaurant (I had to call my colleagues to find that out as they were inside and were able to ask the waitress).

Somewhat disappointing. Everything seemed the same when I walked into my favorite Olive Garden restaurant, although the menu changed, the food looked good and the items offered were familiar. So I ordered my favorite fettuccine chicken Alfredo, and was disappointed that it had no flavor. And the chicken was chewy and rubbery. Maybe this is just a one off bad experience, but it sure seems like they've gone down hill.
Place is great for bagels and they open early. Slightly on the pricy end though. There's plenty to choose from on the menu. There's also lots of seating. Coffee was good too.
Goood food.  Goood service.  Enjoyed myself that's all you need to know is the oysters was fresh and big !

Holy Food Poisoning !! 
Last night around 8pm, my family and I ordered food to-go (Chicken Cobb salads and wraps) and by 1/2AM not one but ALL THREE of us were running to the bathroom vomiting and had explosive diarrhea (cute, right ??)...
This was our second attempt eating here, the first was during bingo and that experience left much to be desired, but, we figured we would give these guys another shot... Well, lesson learned. 
Never. Again..

The star rating says it all.  I love Donatos Pizza, but this location is the worst.  They've cancelled delivery orders twice without calling me - there's nothing worse than waiting an hour for a pizza, then calling to find out they aren't making it.  Last time when I called to check on my pizza, dude said the delivery driver had gone home early.  When I asked to speak to the manager, he said she'd gone home with the delivery driver.  Donatos, please fire this execrable staff and hire people who can deliver a pizza.  YOU HAVE ONE JOB!

I la la la love this place!! I crave the chicken schwarma, my boyfriend got me hooked on it, and I say thank you sir. For awhile there I explored the menu, getting the hummus, baba ganoush, falafel, grape leaves, lots and lots of pita bread. Its all fantastic, I'm not a fan of grape leaves and whenever I get the vegetarian plate, the server is always happy to substitute something else in its place. Now onto the chicken schwarma... My mouth is watering just thinking about it. The savory spices on the chicken with just a bit of tang blend perfectly together--nestled in the warm pita bread it makes a perfect meal. I encourage everyone to eat here as often as possible.

This is definitely my favorite of the steakhouse chains that I have visited (Texas Roadhouse, Outback, etc.)

Had the shrimp and crab "Surf and Surf" dip appetizer and it was amazing. Came with a huge pile of perfectly seasoned flatbed. Definitely hit the spot for this Atlantic Ocean Boy.

For my main course I had the 6oz sirloin and grilled shrimp. The steak was average but the shrimp was 10/10, supple, juicy, and amazingly seasoned. I also had the Mac and Cheese (also 10/10) and fries(they were ok).

We shared dessert even though we were massively full. We ended up getting the chocolate lava cake which was pretty good but I wish the lava actually leaked out like it was supposed to .

Our wait staff was very vigilant and right on top of our needs. Constant water refills and checking in to see if everything was tasting amazing.

Awesome experience 9/10. Will be back.

All of your favorite Danny Scordato foods in a fast casual settings! Love this concept. If you've ever dined at Vivace or Scordato's Pizza(before he sold it), you'll recognize some of the menu items and certainly the flavors. Due to COVID, they currently only have outdoor seating and pick up available. Pre-COVID the ordering system was all digital via touchscreens. I placed my order online and it was ready right on time. You can also request curbside pick-up if you prefer. I forgot, so I went inside to grab  my food. Upon walking in, I was greeted by the staff who were all very friendly! My order was waiting for me on a table with my name written on it on the bag. The ordering/pickup process was seamless from start to finish. 

The menu is "healthy Italian food."

I ordered the "Saporito" salad, which is house greens, shaved fennel, grapefruit, avocado, pistachios, ricotta salata cheese with a truffle citrus vinaigrette. The salad is quite good! However, next time I'll ask for the cheese on the side. I found that there was just a little too much of it for my taste. I also ordered the grilled chicken breast as a side protein. 

From the Roman pizza section of the menu, I ordered the "Fresca" as well. Their delicious bread topped with fresh mozzarella, marinated tomatoes, garlic & basil and arugula. It was very flavorful! 

I wish Posto Sano was located more centrally! I'd probably go there more often. It really does offer the convenience of fast casual but high quality food. 

The menu is also gluten-free and vegetarian friendly- from their salads to side proteins (chicken, rotating fish, shrimp, meatballs), panini (sandwiches), flatbreads and desserts- there's something for everyone to enjoy.
The food was great and fast service. Jayme was my server, she was very funny and a attentive.
Terrible experience! The steak was tough and extremely disappointing! We've eaten at many steakhouses in the city and by far Butcher Singer is the worst!

Nice scenery and ambience, BUT! they ran out of their popular dishes at 5pm. Ran out of five dinner items and a favored dessert - churros. Ordered cochinita pibil - not the greatest. It tastes similar to carne adovada. Certain foods have an earthy, herbal aftertaste that is NOT appealing. The Elote side item was good. Chips and green salsa is good. But, we won't be coming back.

Rook hits all the right spots: aesthetics, ambience, service, information, menu, food presentation, and especially taste. But wait, there's more! The chef is a creative designer with a penchant for cool hashtags and rap culture. I scanned previous reviews and many on here comment on the risk-taking, derring do combos he [and/or his team] have come up with.

I arrived to pick up 2 orders of crispy pata [best washed down with an ice cold beer] which I had phoned in just two days prior. Took one look at what everyone there was eating and decided I needed an appetizer. Ended up eating lunch fare which proved to be filling: banh mi and karaage rice bowl. Definitely going back for more. And the crispy pata was a hit at my party, yay.

This place has gotten A LOT better recently.  The menu has been updated and has some new interesting items.  I liked the famous hand roll and the mermaid.   The rice is also WAY better than when they first opened.  The daily drink specials are pretty good too.   

However, the person who spell checked the new menu should have had someone else do it.  Crab (carb) is mispelled like 30 times.  It drives me crazy!

I love Local 44. At one point in my life I was there so much I wished they had stock I could have invested in. The staff has been pretty consistent these past few years and each and every one of them could tell you exactly what beer to drink depending on what you're feeling. All the bartenders are really cool and easy to talk to, and if you go enough they always say what's up when you walk in. The ambiance is real laid back and cool and there are usually some good tunes on off one of the bartenders iPods. As for the food, the burgers are definitely the best bang for your buck. The appetizers are all good but the portions aren't that large, except for the fries which are massive. If you are in West Philly, I would say Local is a worthy stop.
The best poke bowls I've had ever. Way better than Philadelphia's. I come home just for these. They give you such good portions for what you pay. I don't want to give away my new fav place!!

I will never go here again! I called and gave the girl on the phone my order (thin crust, sausage, pepperoni, mushroom, onion) after waiting about 5 mins. I asked her for the total and she sighed told me to "hold on" while i waitied again...she gave me my total and i relpied "thank you" only to find she had already hung up. I get the pizza home and I'm sorry but this is the worst pizza I have ever had....i should have saved the money and the customer service and gotten a frozen pizza. Wont be returning...will tell my friends...oh and Thank you!
5months into the quarantine I was here. Wasn't impressed by the menu. Liked the location and appearance but that was about it. They claim good burgers Nah and the calamari needs help

Let me start off by saying that although I now live in New Jersey, I am originally from Toronto - one of the best cities for Chinese food (same level as San Francisco and Vancouver).

I came for dinner with the family on Sunday since I was staying at the Sheraton for business and did not feel like driving to Chinatown.

I would say this eatery is targeting mainly University students. Some of the dishes were good, while others missed the mark.

First reason for losing stars from me is that many items on the menu were not available that evening. We were disappointed to find out that most of the dishes we were planning to order were not available: crab, lobster, special chicken dish.

Second, we were told that the Peking duck, full size, only came with 4 pancakes...really? Pancakes are made with flour and water, I know because I have made them before! We also were told that they did not serve the duck bones as a second course, so that makes me wonder how much of the duck do you really get? We noticed that other tables around us who ordered duck with rice only got the duck bones part...little meat. Put 2+2 together yourself.

The Green beans with minced pork and General Tao Chicken were good. But the Clams in Black Bean Sauce was missing some heat, had many 'empties', and had sand in quite a few of them. The Crispy Tofu in XO sauce was missing some flavour other than soy sauce and the tofu was not what I expected as crispy.

If you are looking for a good Chinese dinner with rice, I would recommend the extra trek to Chinatown...have not tried their resto there yet, but on the list for next time!
Great pastrami sandwich, and the baked products are phenomenal. Some of the menu items seemed a little too complicated, but I think overall it's a really interesting spread with really good food.

The food is great but the girl behind the counter is so rude to the customer. I guess she is the daughter of the owner that is why she is still there. There are many bad comments about her the way she handles service to the customer. She needs to be fired. I will never go back there again as long as that girl is still there taking orders.
This pizza does WONDERS for your colonic health.  Enough said.
Best Nee York style pizza in The Bay Area. Hands down. After moving back from nyc, I thought I'd never find good pizza again, until I met Big Roman's pizza pie...  I posted pics on google. So yummy.

Great restaurant in prime location. The building has history.... not all of it good. Nice people, very friendly bartenders and servers, not always the most attentive or fastest, tho. Been here a lot. 
I love breakfasts. Their seafood omelet is my favorite! Start your Sunday with one..some grits and a Bloody Mary,  and you're good!
Men's room was built for 1850 size people.

I always have great service from this Taco Bell location! Seriously every visit I have ever had to this specific location, my order is always correct, there is always sauce in the bag, and they're always polite from the time I drive up to the window, to when I get my food and drive off. These workers deserve a raise, thanks for being so kind and working hard!

So I want to start this review by saying I'm not angry. And that I frequent First Watch in Franklin often. So today I decided I would try the Lebanon Rd location as I was in that area. I called and asked if there was a crowd and I was told there was not. So I go and walk in and guess what it was crowded. Okay strike one and I want to say I made  this call and was at the restaurant in a span of 7 minutes. I'm seated  quickly at a 2 top table which is fine for me and my purse. After I was seated I watched others who were seated after me get serviced. I had not met or seen my waitress who made eye contact with me  prior to coming to take my order. When another waitress noticed  me she came to my table and told me that I'll get your waitress. Fine. When my waitress comes she takes all of the cups off the table and tells me she'll be back with the order I placed . 10 minutes later I get the drink I order and then after another 10 minutes she comes back with my water. She had a large table of 6 she was servicing. Once my food came I never saw her again until I put my empty places on the outer edge of my table. She did come and ask if my meal was okay (which it wasn't but I'm not talking about the food on this review). I normally tip well I didn't today because the service was piss poor at best. The Franklin location even at its busiest has never  shirked on the customer service aspect part. I'm always treated warmly  and food is beyond good. I'm not sorry that I will never eat at this location again. I should have taken my business elsewhere for my meal.

Nice wait staff but the guy at hostessing is not great.  Got a bit confused and wasn't overly accommodating.  Overall, it was a fine place to eat before going to gamble but it's busy and therefore, service is sometimes slow.  But not awful.  I'd go back again.  Nachos are good, pretzel as well.  Pretty large bar menu with lots of options.

This place blows. If your a college student with a fake or a degenerate I guess it makes sense to go here but other than that the bartender didn't know what was on tap(that's kind of the job). In addition, we ordered food and the order came out wrong. He proceeded to check his "computer," (you ever look at something you've done completely wrong and you just gotta sell it cause your hung over? This was one of those times), and insisted that my wife was wrong. Yep, she was wrong on the food we ordered. Dude - go anywhere else. Smokey Joe's? More like Shitty Hoes. Also, not the first time this place SUCKED. Last time I got there

The menu is slim for vegetarians, but the couscous that accompanied the scallops I had were   veggie/vegan friendly I think (not sure about butter) AND OMG it was good. My entire group loved their dishes from burgers to sides. Loved the salad of the day which featured tomatoes and radishes.

Dining outside is quieter if you can stand the heat. We did have some other patrons who were... a bit overindulged/never eaten anywhere beyond fast food/IDK. The clued in person apologized to my table as they left. I thought it was funny but not everyone I was with did.

SOLID cocktails (delicious old fashioned) and a good beer list.

This place definitely has potential, but fell short of my expectations.  I stopped by for lunch while in town on vacation and it didn't wow me.  But then again, I'm a bit of a food snob and this place seems to cater mostly to the time-crunched work crowd.  

Everything on the menu looked tasty, but when I got my grilled Southwest Chicken Wrap, it was missing the spicy kick I was craving and wasn't heated through.  

I have to hand it to them, the place is clean and cheerful inside.  The staff was friendly even though there was a line out the door.  I appreciate that they use fresh, local ingredients.  

If I'm ever in town again, I'll have to give it another shot.

Two words, Dim Sum!!!! 

If you are a die hard Chinese food fan like I am, Tc Choy will never let you down. Their food does take a little bit more time and is in the higher price range for Chinese food, but it is TOTALY worth it. 

Always hot and fresh tasting. Always all white chicken in chicken dishes, never that hard dark chewy meat you get from other places. I try to eat something different on the menu every time because no matter what I get its always quite tasty. 

Did I mention they have the best Dim Sum?!?!!!!

Just be aware if you go on Chritmas or New Years you will have to be patient since they are probably the only place in town that is actually open.
Awesome sandwiches. I got the Italian style pulled pork sandwich. Very satisfying lunch!

I believe this to be the best bar in New Orleans. We came for 1 drink and stayed for 5 hours. The bartenders were extremely friendly and very welcoming. This is a memory I will always have with my friends and family as we just had such a great time.
Great food & service at Copelands last night!!  Our server, Amber G., was wonderful!!  Will return to this Copelands for sure!!
