Was so disappointed.  They've changed the menu since we were here last summer. Smaller menu.  Our waitress was outstanding.  We came around 7pm and it wasn't crowded...at all. Beans and rice are ordered extra.....not included with the meal.  That's a surprise.  The chicken was too spicy.  The house margaritas were just...so so.
Won't be coming back
Too bad....cause i loved it here

this is very good so you go get some before i go back and eat it all up yum  yum  !! clean and good and lots of food to eat . when i go i don't know where to start because it looks so big and sooo much to choose.

Just be careful here.......

I went here after getting a travelzoo voucher the beginning of May. It seemed like a good deal. I wanted to make sure that I had a spot on the roof so I reserved a table for 4. I had to put down a $25 deposit to reserve a table but was told it would be credited to my bill.

When we got there they MADE us buy a drink just to go upstairs even though we had reservations. This was not stated on the voucher or their website and I find this very strange.  The roof top deck is nice but nothing special.

The drinks were ok but the bartender and waitress can't make anything right that is not on the menu. Example, I ordered an orange vodka Cosmo and I got orange vodka on the rocks. I had to ask for cranberry juice on the side. If you do go, order wine or a drink from their menu since that's all they seem to know how to make.  Also they serve the drinks in plastic glasses. I know its a roof-top bar but plastic glasses?????

The food is not bad but not worth it in my opinion.

They also add a "service charge" to the bill which is 20% of the original bill.  I always tip 20% and would have no problem with it had we actually had good service.  It took our waitress 20 mins just to take our drink order and there were only 2 other tables there.  Another 25 mins for our food order and we had to flag her down to get the bill.

My real problem with this is place is that they never credited my account the $25. Since then I have called and left a message with an actual person to have the manger call me and I still have not heard back.  I even tried to go through Paypal to have it credited but they said to go through the merchant.  I even stopped by when I was in the city one night to speak with the manger and of course, he wasn't there.

This place has potential but I will NEVER go back because it

Love this place.  Having always worked in Center City Philly I was feeling sad at the food selection when I got a job in Wilmington, but this place is great.  Love the coffee and lattes.  Also, I go at least 2x a week for the Grain bowls and salads.  I highly recommend!

Stayed recently in their " luxurious "  East Tower. Although the furnishings were a little more updated the room was still in need of attention. Their big "pro" was their indoor pool during the winter. They also ran some good deals which got me to try the east tower at typical west tower prices.  Beds were decently comfortable
Price are not reasonable and the sushi rice wasn't cooked enough.  Sushi in Berlin shoprite is better

Great meal - very fresh, delicious veal. Portions not large (but probably good thing). Bread was outstanding. Service was great from time we walked in. Definetly will come back just not on first Friday we had kids banging on glass by our table.

Never had anything but bad experience there.  The lines are always long.  After I place an order, it takes forever for them to fill the order.  Even a cup of coffee took 5 minutes from paying to getting the coffee and I still had to ask about it. Drive thru orders are frequently wrong,  Pizza is cheaper and less time consuming.

I don't get here enough! They were in the process of remodeling their space and it looks to be a very chic remodel. We went here for dessert only, but had to leave a review because of how wonderful our service was! If I remember correctly, our server was September! If that is incorrect, I only remember it was the name of a month. She was so personable and truly cared about the service we had. We grabbed wine with our dessert and she paired it perfectly! The group as a whole couldn't decide and she had the perfect one for us. We ordered a variety of desserts and had a table full of treats! The favored dessert at the table was the chocolate torte. It is unreal along with the Pinot! Sullivan's is a great place for an evening dinner. It's nice to be out of the downtown area and still have a delicious menu to choose from!

Always trying to find new places to try in Skippack and this one was a big winner for me. The service was great, food was amazing, and the price was just right. Beautiful location and building and I will definitely be back again.

Four Seasons was very good.  I was glad to learn they don't add bamboo or water chestnuts (my enemies) which means more room for broccoli! ;)  The sauce they use is much lighter than you'll find in most other Chinese take outs; not thick and gloopy.  

Egg rolls...the less I say, the better.  Wonton soup was acceptable - they offer a large kind of dried noodle to accompany the soup that I've never seen before.

Ribs were outstanding.  Great size, meaty, moist, unburned, with a slight smoky flavor.  Best I've had from a Chinese take out in recent memory.  

Look forward to returning to try additional dishes.
Good selection and options. Pulled pork was delicious. Good choices of sauce too, go with the Honey Badger mixed with Texas fire. Definitely going back.
Great work environment with great coffee and pastries! The perfect mix between quiet and coffee ambiance to help you focus. 10/10 would recommend

Great food and great customer service at this location. Michael, the manager, and his staff run a tight shift. Went here after being treated so badly at the Marlton location. Will only go to this Mount Laurel location from now on in this area.

This place is def one of my new favs!  I never had vietnamese food before and i ordered the paper rice vermicelli wrap thing.  It was soo good.  At first I didnt know how to make it but the waiter helped us with it.  Their food portion is pretty decent and their jackfruit bubbletea is to die for.  I will make random trips to that area just to get it.

Went here twice over last weekend.  The first time I was not too impressed by the food quality but the beer was very good according to everyone that drank it.  

However the second time they let us host a wedding toast after a friend's wedding at the river walk.  These guys are really nice and were unbelievably generous with their space.  They let us bring in our own champagne and cupcakes to setup for the after party of our friends nuptials.  We agreed that people would still order off the menu but what a great group of guys for helping us out after we needed a space and the bar manager at the Silver Legacy cancelled on us at the last minute.

I was super excited to go here to eat. Scratch kitchen made fresh. I love biscuits and gravy. 
Appon arrival parking was a bit hard to find. Which is expected with breakfast places. Was not mad about it, it must be good is what I said out loud.
Walk in and there was only one person in front of me and plenty of seating. There is no hostess You order your food pay for it and  and find your own seat. 
Not what I was expecting but still okay with it. I wanted sausage, eggs and biscuits and gravy. 
I ordered biscuits and gravy with two eggs over med seen there was no sausage option so I went with a side of bacon. (I should've known that since there was no sausage option it wasn't homemade) they called out "our name" pick up my food from.the counterand sit down. My food was like warm, and the gravy was definitely not homemade. Eggs were more on the cold side but I was hungry so I ate as much of it as I could till I gave up. 
A lady did come ask if we needed anything but I was already done. Went to the bathroom and they Were so dirty. I'll never eat here again! Definitely not worth the money! Wish I had a pic of my food.

Hands down the best prime rib in town. Double Eagle all day everyday. If you don't know it's a two bone in cut of prime rib. The hole in the wall ambience really adds character and the waitress have been there forever they are awesome

Wanted something sweet so I went to check out Cafe Marcel for a crepe. I got the fresh fruit vanilla and granola crepe and it was just what I wanted. The fruit was fresh warm and sweet not tart at all, the whipped cream and vanilla syrup tasted homemade. The granola added the perfect amount of crunch to contrast the fluffy delicate crape. Good portion too I  couldn't finish it!

On top of that the service was very friendly and attentive. Even have free refills on iced coffee which more places need to do. 

The crepe and large iced coffee were around $10 total so it's a good price, I will definitely be back to Cafe Marcel!

In town for a medical appointment and wanted something good to eat after a long day. This restaurant was close to our hotel and looked nice from the outside.  We were seated promptly.  When we received the menus we realized it is "Philly restaurant week" which meant they were featuring a  fixed price 3 course menu for $40 person.  Actually was a good deal for us.

We tried the paneer quesadilla and the Gobi (cauliflower) as apps. Both were tasty. We had the vegetarian thali and it was presented very pretty with a selection of korma, dal mahkani and paneer with basmati rice and Raita.  Everything had excellent flavor and spice.  We were not disappointed with the entrees.

The dessert was a little lackluster.  It was a halwa and it was just meh.  I ate one bite and wasn't interested in more. Just cloying sweet with no interesting flavors.  I decided to save the calories for later.

Service was good.  Kept water glasses full and cleared the table in a timely manner.

I wold be interested in trying their lunch buffet if we are back in town during lunch time.

Pros: All of the food and pastries are to die for. You feel like you are in Paris. Also a great space with natural light. 

Cons: No wifi. I was excited to spend the day working here but I won't be able to without the internet.  Also, to use a credit or debit card you must spend at least $10 which is annoying for those who don't usually carry cash and just want to grab a pastry. The customer service at the counter is not that great or helpful and I felt like a burden for asking a few questions before ordering. And finally, the coffee is just not great. Come here for the pastries but if you want a good cup of coffee there are at least 3 other places in the borough that do it waayyyy better. 

Overall, the pain au chocolat outweighs the cons so I would still recommend this place, but expect to be treated like you are in France instead of the US.

Great sushi! Reasonably priced. Small but super cute. My server was wonderful. A little off the beaten path, but worth it if you're in the area. Chef's special roll was so good. The calimari was super fresh, not frozen out of bag. Pleasant surprise!

The best and most authentic Mexican food in the area. Everything is perfect. 

Their salsa is fresh and delicious.

Their tacos are best meal I've had in a long time.

Eaten here twice as each time was great . I haven't dined in yet but look forward to it . I had the estate burger and upgraded to bison . More than I would normally pay for a burger but it didn't fail . Was delicious and worth every penny .

I was really excited to come back to this place after a year of traveling, but it wasn't nearly as good as it was the first time. Not sure if the pandemic had anything to do with the lack of quality, but this was the driest brisket I have ever had. The carver pulled off all the burnt part before slicing.. or chopping? I can't really tell.. the burnt fatty is all the flavor.. the cornbread was like eating a dried flavorless sponge. The corn pudding, collard greens and pork were mediocre. I don't know if it was just a bad day but this went from my favorite brisket to the worst I have ever had. Highly disappointed and shows that their food quality is different each time you go. I hope that if you go, it's on a good brisket day.
Have been going here for almost a decade, delicious food and the nicest staff! They have such great deals for lunch and affordable and amazing sushi :))

Really good Lima beans and fried chicken. Cornbread is excellent and very moist.
Look forward to returning to try the greens.

Eaten at Andrew Michael's in Memphis, same folks. People rave about this place, service was excellent and a good, quality wine list. Food was just so so. 

I love food pasta dishes so maybe my choice was a little too bizarre - ordered the Campanelle which was a pasta with bolognese sauce made with octopus. A little too froo-froo for me and a little fishy. We also had the bucatini which was a little bland. 

Certain you've been to restaurants where they try to hard to be unique ...just wish they'd stick to a more traditional fare. But it was an enjoyable evening none-the-less.
Amazingly delicious, casual environment with great service - perfect for lunch or takeout. Bring the kids - my favorite restaurant!

Super fancy looking thai laoatian restaurant with good food.

Went with a party of 4 and we shared everything. The place is really nice looking and the service was good too.

For starters, we ordered the Chicken Satay and the Laos Sampler (Laos sausage, beef jerky, spring roll, dice ginger, onion, lemongrass served with Laos papaya salad). The satay as good with a delicious peanut sauce. Everything on the sampler was good, i liked the laos sausage the best. The awkward thing I did not like was that it came on a sectioned plate and one of the sections was salad without dressing. It was strange and a waste of food cause that wasn't a menu item and didn't have flavor, was it just decoration?

For the main we shared the Kao Pad Poe fried rice with chicken. It was good with a bit of a sour flavor that I haven't had in fried rice before. The Ratchada Duck was the star of all teh dishes. It was a nicely roasted duck with crispy skin and it was delicious with mango and tamarind sauce. Get it. We also had some veggie dish which was chinese broccoli with some dried or fried bacon. This was nothing special. Not worth getting.

I like their service, attentive and fast.  And the owner comes back to find out how we enjoyed our meal.  :-)  The place has a cheerfulness to it, it's welcoming.  I even saw a customer come up to, who must have been the owner and say that she missed them so much because they were closed for 2 weeks.  To go on a vacation to Thailand!  Nice!  Everyone needs a vacation.  Will be back!

Had 1 night in Philadelphia and I'm so glad we chose zama. Even though we arrived late and the kitchen was about to close, they were so accommodating and allowed us to order without any rush. The food was 5 star all round and I will definitely be returning for the amazing crab cheese spring rolls. Absolutely fantastic would highly recommend

Good place to go and meet up with friends. Prices are awesome. Food is really good. (i love the wings) There are pool tables, karaoke on certain nights. Drinks are well made. smoking is outside on the patio that is tented and I believe heated.
I love the impossible whopper and wish I could get it more often, but this is the nearest BK and they consistently burn it or get the order wrong. So sad.

Their tomato pie is amazing! I got the one that had cheese on the top, and I ate it on one of the benches outside the shop. There isn't a ton of space inside. I got a corner slice, and the crust was AMAZING. I would definitely recommend asking for one if there are some available. I wish I had more time here, so I could get some of their bread. I can only imagine how great it is. 

I also got one of their cannoli, which was good but nothing amazing. However, they had some cookie samples, and those were really great.

Being born and raised in  Hawaii I love my sushi and sashimi, fresh fish is easy to get in Hawaii.  In Tennessee for work  and found morimori on yelp pix looked good, happy hour specials are nice.  Fish is fresh and clean and TASTE AWSOME!!!!!! Yelp has a 10% off coupon I showed my waiter when I ordered but they "forgot" to take it off my bill. Lol I'll be back for the beer and sashimi again

The set up reminds me of a built in the wall food truck. Girlfriend and I have been craving Mexican food for awhile and this afternoon our schedule was open and decided to come here. Upon arrival our order was taken quick and easy, no hassle. We got the super nachos with added chicken meat and the Cali Fries with Carne Asada. I definitely recommend the Cali Fries! Overall, the service and food was amazing, delicious, and fun.

Oh where should I begin... the man at the hostess stands actually rolled his eyes and when we gave our name for our reservation. Tip to him ... leave the act at home.  We are in Greenwood not New York. I'm not sure why he felt it was necessary to act "Supierior" but whatever. 

We were then seated in the middle section of the restaurant where I had a view of something that's looks like an open storage closet. It was just really unpleasant. Then it took about 15 minutes for someone to drop off water to us. We flagged down a waiter who was waiting on two of the four tables in that room and asked about where our waiter was ... with actual sweat drip from his forehead he explains how busy he was. With a huff he took out his pad and said he would take our order. He seemed really put out by our request to be waited on. We just left after that. 

The young woman at hostess stand told us to have a good night . I might mention she walked by our table at least a half dozen times while we were waiting and never noticed we were never helped. 

We had a great dinner down the street at La Trattoria after we left.
Chicken & waffles + French toast for brunch....5 stars for food, location, service, cleanliness, and price

Fast food (literally)! We got our order in no time, with no mistakes, like most Five Guys we've been to. My single-patty cheeseburger hit me right in the spot. The older man who took our order was extremely kind and fast.

Oh, and don't forget, they fill the WHOLE bag full of fries and not just the container!! You definitely get what you pay for here.

Cool Little Dive Bar

Been wanting to stop in Roadside for some time now, and glad I finally did. Met a few locals, met a few bar maids (Sweet Hearts!!) Had a few beers and shots as well. The only down was a loud mouth local that the girls took care of in short order, and had him out in 5 minutes. The only reason I don't give 5 stars is, I was given my ticket and closed out before I could order, usually means time to leave when someone does that, but only 4 beers. Hmmmm......

I'll be back, but need to try the wings, then I'll follow up!!

This place is easily one of my favorite local places and I am SO happy to have found it. It's a cute little speciality store located on haddon Ave. they have a butcher with fresh cut meats and prepared foods available along with various grocery items. Since I've found them, I've been back weekly for their sausages. The chicken and sun dried tomato sausage is literally to die for. Today I got the crab cake, which was my first time trying their prepared food. The crab cake had the perfect amount of crab and wasn't too "cakey". I've had many coworkers and friends try this place out since I have found them as well and everyone has fallen in love. Such a gem of a place and I'll be back for my weekly (sometimes twice a week....) run soon!
This is one of my most favorite places - and it's local! Great food,  outstanding service, a well- stocked bar, and amazing owners that give back to the community. Highly recommend!!!

Stopped by for dinner with friends a few weeks back.  It's a pretty new place it has a comfy atmosphere.  The staff were friendly and our chef was pretty funny.  He busted out a lot of the typical acts (onion fire, spinning egg, doll which pees when exposed to hot temperatures).  He did however pull out a squeeze bottle of rice wine and squirted it into anyones willing mouth.  That was pretty funny.

The meal started out with some salad and miso soup.  The salad wasn't bad and neither was the soup.  Though I felt the soup was lacking.  Some of the miso soups I"ve had in the future had a little more than what this one had.  There was no tofu or nori at all, so it was just soup...and maybe a few scallions.

I ordered a filet mignon and scallop platter.  They came along with your choice of fried or white rice, fried noodles, and veggies.  The food was pretty good, but the "presentation" coulda been much better.  At most of the other hibachi places I've been to, the chef at least attempts to put the different foods on different parts of the plate.  Our chef just kinda plopped everything down on the same spot on the plate.  Not a huge deal, but I like to have all my stuff separate.

Overall, I'd probably go there again, it wasn't terrible but they could def. improve.  Also, I think they're still in the process of getting their liquor license.
Rallys is decent for fast food. I had a stomach ache afterwards, but hey that comes with fast food. Service was quick and efficient.

The service and food was good. The only complaint I have is the sanitation. There were dead flies laying on the windowsill and the silverware looked dirty when I opened the napkin. I'd go back for bar food most likely in the future.  Cleanliness should be their first priority.

The service was friendly, and our cheesesteaks delicious. The portion size was a bit too large for me (My husband and I could have split a sandwich). It was sunny in my eyes eating out front during a late dinner.

Last year we stayed in the main tower. We spent most of our time in the casino here. We kept winning on the slot machines. All the other places we went to, we couldnt even win a dollar off of. Its not all for kids. You just have to stay on the top level where the kids ARENT. Hello. Their steak restaurant is pretty good too!

The Belgian Cafe definitely deserves more respect and props from my previous review.  On Sunday I treated my parents to a mid day lunch.  We splurged on numerous things from the menu.  Bosch Mussels, Pomme Frites, Chicken Salad, Smoked Turkey Cheese steak (Special), and I got the Eggs Benedict.

To start the Bosch mussels were simply amazing.  My parents were ranting and raving about some of the mussels they had in the past in New England but when they tasted these... words couldn't describe the expression on their faces on how much they liked it.  The Pomme Frites with their dipping sauces were tasty as always.  The salad was great and they always are.  The smoked turkey in the special was wonderful.  And finally, the Eggs Benedict which was on top of a Belgium waffle was d-d-delicious.  Normally I would of gotten a beer to go along but not this time.  However, if i had to make a recommendation I would try, "Petrus Aged Pale".  I tried this at Monks and I was stimulated and hooked.

Between the three of us and our splurge the bill was not bad at all.  My previous review said it was kinda pricey but I totally take that back.

7 Stars!

we went to Stella's last Thursday evening for drinks and dinner. There were no dinner reservations left even though many table were cleared and empty so we decided to have cocktails at the bar. we all tried various speciality cocktails and I have to say for $13 per drink, they were the weakest drinks in all of New Hope. The bartender was of no help and just shrugged his shoulders. Its unfortunate that a new restaurant in town has to serve diluted cocktail and will be interesting to see if this location stays open or goes bankrupt like the rest of Jose's former sites. Update as of July 29th - I received a response from Sheri who stated that all drinks are pre-measured and if we were not happy with the cocktails we could ask for drinks without ice.
So interesting that a newly opened restaurant would not simply apologize and say they just opened and are experiencing some growing pains. And just for the record, I prefer my cocktails properly made with ice and not have to repurpose them because a restaurant is incapable of admitting their mistakes. Luckily there are so many other wonderful places to patronize.

I'm glad we found this Mexican restaurant, since moving here we have not found a good place. The food here is phenomenal! I got the chimichanga, SO good! My boyfriend got the beef enchiladas, they had Carne asada, it was good asada. The asada had great flavor and not fatty. We will definitely be coming here regularly. I hope they make it thru the pandemic.

I mainly used to go here because of the salsa they used, but they switched to a habanero type that I'm not a fan of.  The enchiladas and chilaquiles are among my top choices.  The ambience, outdoor seating and margaritas are pluses.

The menu is very Americanized but I still love this place for what it is. Big cozy booths and salty chinese food makes for a pretty crucial hangover cure on weekends, and they have a generous lunch special available during weekdays. If you're looking for Chinese food in NOLA, go here.

One of my favorite and most unique gardens that I've ever been to. Not only do they let you touch and interact with the sculptures, the humor of the curators is something I really appreciate - they'll intersperse Seward Johnson's really lifelike sculptures of people that you don't even realize they're fake until you get close enough to it. The turning famous paintings into sculptures is also an amazing idea (it includes a replica of Monet's bridge, Monet's Woman with a Parasol, Manet's Dejeuner Deja Vu, Munch's The Scream, and many other amazing sculptures). 

The sculptures are so numerous and change relatively frequently that it's worth it to visit every year. The expansion into the Meadow is a recent addition and they change the exhibitions in the buildings every year or so. I easily spend a whole day at this garden.

So happy J's reopened! The cheesesteaks are amazing! If you do not want to deal with the drive into Philadelphia, stop by J's for some delicious Philly style cheesesteaks! Their mozzarella sticks also hit the spot! Fast and friendly service!

I decided to go to the diner with two of my best pals. We usually love this diner more than Collegeville diner. However, tonight we did not have a good experience. My friend and I got chocolate chip pancakes and I got 3 pancakes while my friend only got 2. In addition, my pancake was under cooked in the middle! I also got a side of pork roll-- only 1 piece for almost $4?!!!! We also were never given syrup for our pancakes. Seriously disappointed. We are just some broke college kids looking for some decent diner food.

Yummy is an amazing sushi place tucked into a little strip mall by UNO ... behind the Papa John's pizza.

It's not much to look at, but it is very clean, and the staff is superb.  Our regular waitress remembered that I asked for Uni on our very first visit, and she makes us feel like family every time we are there.  The quality of the sushi is outstanding -- the fish is always fresh and the preparations are perfect.  The special rolls are wonderful, especially the Utah and Whitney rolls.  Tempura is well done, never too greasy.  

They do have a liquor license now, so no worries about not getting sake.  Mmmm, sake.  They also deliver, but that can take some time to arrive.  If you're in the neighborhood, it's a better idea to call in your order and pick it up.  Overall though, I can't say enough great things about Yummy.

The food is very good. But our service was seriously lacking. It took two hours (!) to get from being seated to finally getting the bill. And, we had to flag down a different waiter for it. We kept seeing our guy taking great care of others, but we rarely saw him. 
But, the chicken speidini was excellent. As was the swordfish speidini and shrimp scampi. We had to ask for bread. I've never been to a place where they serve pasta but you have to ask for bread. My father asked for a new napkin and the server forgot, so we had to ask again. For the prices you'd think that excellent service would be a given. Dad felt bad about leaving a lesser tip, but the guy was just so bad. Two hours was too long. Especially with no appetizers or dessert ordered. We probably won't be back.

Not bad but not great. Wings were good. My shrimp papaya salad had 2 shrimps in it. SMH. The entrees, pad thai and pad khing, were flavored to please the more americanized palette. Wasnt too authentic. More like a Thai PF Changs.

A great neighborhood gastropub with a spin. I live very close to Southgate and had been wanting to try it out for some time now. On a rainy Sunday I figured brunch was the perfect excuse to stop in. The space it fairly small with a long bar and about 6 or 7 tables. Great for groups of 2-6 although I did see a larger group in the back. The decor is dark and reminiscent of a pub/Korean soju bar. The brunch menu is concise with a good selection of dishes to choose from. We got the chicken and waffles, short rib loco moco, and deviled eggs. 

Chicken and waffles was a hit. The chicken was flavorful with a crispy cracklin skin. A spicy maple syrup or honey drizzle would have been a great addition but then you run the risk of soggy chicken. And no one likes soggy fried chicken. The matcha waffles were dense and crisp and a good compliment to the chicken.

My short rib loco moco was hearty and rich. You get a generous portion of soft short rib. The rice and pickled jalapenos were a nice offset to the rich egg and meat. 

We were intrigued by the deviled eggs and they were a fun spin on the party classic. The kimchi's funkiness cut through the creamy yolks and the whites were soft boiled.

Overall, I'm a fan of Southgate. It's a great place to take friends for dinner, drinks, brunch, pretty much any occasion.

Went there for restaurant week, food was not as good as I thought as it sounded, super loud, and the worst part?  This couple came in with their dog.
Was not a service dog either.
I'm a dog person but come on, dogs are not even allowed at a fast food restaurant...

Quaint place, great for groups and nice outside seating. Quiche, salads and crepes were "bon"! Our group really liked everything they ordered. Wait staff is just ok, took awhile to get our food so don't go if you are in a hurry.  Life is short so you could order something scrumptious from the bakery first. (-;

The food is pretty good. The delivery service is a nightmare! Every time I order I am forced to wait an hour and a half or longer. I always have to call the restaurant to find out if they forgot about me. Their hours are crap. They used to be open later. But when my food does arrive it's packed neatly and the order is always correct.

LONG time patron of Village. Went there last night , 7/25/19 for drinks and apps on patio.  Had to walk through the closed dining room and it looked dirty. Got to patio at 5:30 and was told by the waitress , as we sat down, that they were out of brisket. At 5:30? Their smoker foods are a specialty. So we couldn;t have the Cowboy Nachos. She then told us that they were out of most of the wines on the Happy Hour menu. My friend asked for the Mondavi Chardonney and was told they had that. Waitress returned to say that wasn't available either. The only wine was House. We had the appetizer sampler and found the onion rings to be greasy. I will not be heading back anytime soon. Seems the new owners don't have it together

This was my first time my girlfriend and I tried Carrabba's... and it was phenomenal. The food was delicious, but the service was even better. We were immediately greeted by the manager, Rafael, at our table as our server, Beverly, was busy with another table. He gave us some great recommendations, two of which we tried. I mentioned it was my girlfriend's birthday, and he said they would provide us with dessert. After our meals, which were perfect, Beverly let us EACH choose a dessert. The service throughout was some of the best I've had in a long time, and this was a clear reflection of the great management. Thank you both for making our first visit special, we will definitely be coming back soon.

This place gets 5 stars for the 10 dollar all you can drink happy hour from 6-8pm on Fridays. By the time that's over, the place is irreparably crowded and it's time to go eat some dinner and chill out.The beer selection is perfect, they've got all the right mixed drinks, but it's just too crowded.

The crowd is 25 year olds. Well, that means college freshmen who are trying to look 25 and that also means 40 year olds trying to look 25, so that interaction is entertaining to be certain. But, if you're looking for a place to hang out and take it easy, this is probably the last place you should look.

Have visited 3 times, and the apparent trick is to arrive before 7am, when the selection is full. Sunday morning slow risers are bound to be disappointed, as I was, when the pickings are slim or none, and if you arrive after 12 noon, the door is locked. The donuts are ok, but then, I was going for "Well, I'm here, may as well get something", rather than, "I gotta have that one". They make what they make, and when they're gone, they're gone. Frustrating be to at the counter, see the one thing left that you really want, and the other customer at the counter cleans 'em out because they're bent on getting a dozen. A buck a donut is high, besides.

I always told my boyfriend to feed me Waffle House whenever I visit Nashville. Since he's the one who introduced it to me (we don't have it in Vegas). I arrived Nashville around 7ish pm and we started driving going to NY. I'm so hungry from my trip, so we Stopped by this location for dinner. Not that busy when we came in, maybe 4-6 people. We we're greeted, seated and taken our drink orders right away. We always order our usual favorite, All star special with bacon and hashbrowns instead of grits, Sausage, egg and cheese hashbrown bowl. Service was good and fast. Food are always delicious. Hashbrowns are crispy on the sides!
I personally like the food although it do it a long time on Grubhub it's delicious and will be my go to Mexican spot for burritos(that's what I prefer to eat)

Best Chimichanga I've ever had! The place was clean and the waitress was very attentive on such a busy day. 
Update: also this place has the most amazing salsa and chips combo that is delivered prior to the meal. Again, the chimichanga was great. This time I had it with a spicier sauce! When in Nashville I will continue to patronize this establishment. Also the server the second time around was just as courteous.

Love at first site - even more so after first bite! 

I absolutely love the decor  - modern and sleek with traditional touches and warm lighting. Seating is comfortable and noise level moderate. Service was impeccable without being intrusive or overbearing. 

We started with (not pictured) crudités and green goddess dip which was goddess worthy - with a beautiful assortment of colorful seasonal vegetables and delicious savory dip. And, the perfectly crisped duck salad with butterscotch pears and a ginger dressing, which was easily shareable. 

My veal lasagne with ricotta, green kale and basil noodles with tomatoes melted in my mouth. It was heavenly and a must try! The acorn squash pomodoro with fresh burrata and tomato sauce was rich and creamy but not heavy. The Brussels sprouts were fried and but not overly (perhaps I delude myself) and finished with a soy glaze. 

For dessert we ordered the cranberry brown butter bar with organic caramel and toasted pecan ice cream. A friend sent us the "Not your neighbor's cookie plate", and it wasn't. A combination of sweet, small delights featuring salted caramel and chocolate chip cookies and other pastries covered the plate and were a nice finish to the meal, along with my freshly brewed espresso.  

I look forward to returning. Aimee Olexy and Stephen Starr are blending their special magic by Rittenhouse Square.
************************
More love at The Love. 

After a relaxing but cold+snowy day, it was love at first sip of my "Very Good Bourbon", with Jim Beam Black, Gran Classico Bitter, Iris Vermouth and Apple Cider. So smooth+soul warming. 

I quickly warmed up and relaxed, and neglected to take photos of our food. My friend and I both wanted to eat fairly light and we shared the Gnudi (the Love's spin on Gnocchi) which was tender and melt in your mouth delicious, made with with sage, Saba and toasted chestnut truffle brown butter sauce. It was so light we could almost forget we were eating pasta. 

We also had the torched broccoli in a house hot sauce. It was delicious and not particularly hot, though I have a high tolerance for heat. And, we shared the exceptional Brussel sprouts with soy balsamic. Hardly health food but not too heavy and worth every fat gram. 

I  the Love.

We have stayed in this hotel previously and was satisfied with the hotel so we booked again.  The size of the suites and the layout/quietness of the hotel were good however we noticed how dirty the rooms and hallways were.  The floors were filthy and the hallways were as well.  Our comforter on one of the beds had numerous hairs on it!  We were afraid to walk barefoot in our hotel room.  The lack of cleanliness made it uncomfortable to stay in the room.  I would not recommend this hotel due to the lack of cleanliness!  I am surprised they passed any kind of state/city inspection.

First time going to Party Fowl and was not disappointed! The fried cheese grit cakes were a recommendation of our waitress T and they were fabulous! Of course, the reason you go to Party Fowl is the chicken and it did not disappoint! T made our experience great! Go there! Ask for T!!!!

Oh, this is actually Panera? Indeed, it's Panera in a new package. Same fattening food, boring salads and bland soups. To make matters worse, the employees at this location didn't know how to wrap our sandwich and then bickered about it or 5 minutes while I stood there waiting. NEVER AGAIN!

My daughter wanted chipotle so I figured it was time to give them another shot. So they have a carne asada option for a limited time. It's a big improvement over the steak I had last time. Much more flavor and not dry. I hope they decide to keep it. All around my experience was better. I do wish they would open up the menu more. There isn't a nacho option or quesadilla (besides kids) on the menu even though they have the ingredients. Also not a fan of ordering on the phone through an automated system but it was accurate. My daughter does like the vegetarian bowl. It's hard to find vegetarian options that she likes.

Great Location, excellent food.
I ate Buffalo Sandwich (Vegan ) my wife the awesome burger.
Both excellent.
The kombucha made at home also great, different flavors 
Highly recommended

i have never in my life left a review online of a restaurant-but i need philly to know about this place. i live in the suburbs & got home really late from work in center city, without having eaten all day. i was super hangry & exhausted, to say the least, so i ordered food from grubhub from night owl (w/out realizing they were in south). they reached out right away to let me know they were wrking on my food & it might take a bit longer to get to me given that i live 40 mins away. they were so so nice, i've never ordered from a place so accommodating-customer service is 100000/10. the food was so good-i got a cheesesteak & fries. it was still warm by the time it got to me & the cheesesteak was seriously top tier. the cheese was melted all the way throughout the sandwich & the meat & onions were seasoned perfectly. i could go on-but you get the gist. would recommend a million times over!

Miss Rachel is beyond talented.  I don't understand how she makes half the things that she does, but her dishes are delicious.  We made reservations a month out for her "Dinner at the Pantry," which she does every Saturday night.  Basically, she only cooks for ten guests and they all sit at one huge-ass table.  Everyone that we met at the event was so much fun and we really had a great time...but I know no one really cares about that when they read Yelp reviews, so back to the food.  I got barbecue seitan tips on top of edamame puree to start.  It was completely amazing.  I really may need to start making mashed edamame.  My partner in crime had the poutine for his first course (yes, still vegan) and it was equally as good.  We both had the mushroom bisque and then I got the lasagna for my main course.  Instead of just plain noodles, she somehow used potatoes in it.  I'm an absolute carb whore, so I appreciated her inventive use of spuds.  Dessert was the cookies and cream ice cream cake, which was so good it should be illegal.  She came out to meet all of us at the end.  It's always nice to see your chef after a wonderful dinner and she was as sweet as could be.  

Whoever said that vegan food isn't good or filling or whatever needs to stop making excuses and try Rachel's food pronto.  I would gladly come back here in a heartbeat.

The atmosphere is very romantic with a great wine selection. The fare is quite good with nice simplicity and great innovative ideas.
Great for a date or a group of friends; the prices are reasonable and the staff very professional. 
I'd definitely recommend if you want to have great italian cuisine.

Favorite place for Mexican ever! Let's start with the margaritas - omg they do not skimp.  They are such a size and while strong enough to give you a nice buzz, you can taste the fruit and just a nice taste!  The chips they put on the table are always fresh and just unbelievable. I could eat them all night long.  I have had many different dishes there and love each just the same as the other.  The taco salads, if you get beef or chicken, they load the meat on.  I never feel cheated or skimped. Portions are large as they should be. They make the guac right in front of you. Fun to watch and OMG the best guac ever! Love , love!

Waited damn near 2 hours for delivery.  Spoke to them on the phone and the broken foreign accent was rude and hard to understand. I've also never had a pizza place in my life just sit in the entrance of a hotel and wait with no phone call. This place shouldn't even be in business ... Costco makes a better pizza.

The wings are great, it's been a while since I ordered them. Over the years they have been undercooked but not this time they were excellent. Happy hour has draft beer and wine on sale for a little over a couple bucks. For a Friday night not real crowded, I say give them another chance.

Consider it a reward if you jog at FDR park and pass by the Cambodian market for "snacks". I absolutely LOVE their chicken on a stick and other treats. Looking at the pictures, I was excited that I could go to Chinatown on my lunch break and have a quick and delicious meal. The sausage is also great. I am definitely going back because they sold out of chicken hearts and I love those, too!

Khmer Grill is located at the Food Court where Halal  Guys and numerous other little stands are located. There is a seating area in the back and what appeared to be private bathrooms.

BEST MEXICAN PLACE HANDS DOWN IN METAIRIE.

My boyfriend and I literally come here once a week.

The best thing is the value.  You get quality large portions all under $15 and cheap drinks too!
The chorizo fundido is amazing.
The enchilas suizas with charro bean soup is perf.
My absolute favorite is the tamales.
The quesadilla dinner is amazing.
The ribeye with peppers is really good also.

The service is always really great and we have NEVER had a bad experience.  Also their side of rice and beans is actually good unlike every other Mexican place I've had.  

Seriously try this place even if it is out of the way.
Yeah its Tex-mex but its definitely the best Tex-mex in Metairie, hands down better than Casa Garcia and the disgusting Carretas.
Great meatball sub! Salads are great too. Don't forget the Oatmeal Chocolate Chip cookies
They have the best tacos and fajitas around.  Services was great. Prices reasonable. Will continue going to this restaurant.

Great authentic Thai cuisine. Will be adding this place to my list of regulars. It's close to home and the cuisine is so good and fresh. The staff are super friendly and attentive. They are clearly focused on the customer! Great customer service! It wasn't busy at all when we went which was a Friday night so we were able to walk in and be seated right away. We placed our order and the food came out so quick as well. Dishes are full of flavor. We ordered the chicken fried rice, chicken pad Thai and spicy beef soup to share at the table. Portion size is big so you can share and still leave full.  The spicy beef soup was my first time trying and WOW was it good. I'm not a fan of bean sprouts or beef but my husband ate them out of the soup. Love the broth. The chicken fried rice was my daughters favorite. Definitely returning here. Actually craving it again.  Lol

The restaurant is very clean and staff is awesome, but there is nothing that tastes remotely Mexican in the food.  Need to have a lack of spice intervention .

Cool  cantina  environment just  needs food to match.

Stopped here on a whim for lunch because we weren't dressed up enough for Commanders. Excellent service and great poboys. We had the roast beef and the fire shrimp and they were huge. A lot of sandwich for $10!

It was my first time going there.
The place was pretty clean and nice and everything seem to be well organized.
The quality of the food was very good compare to the comparable businesses and I found the staff polite and helpful.
Parking wasn't an issue but it was night time and I'm not sure about the day time when it's usually busier.
Overall I had a very good experience and I will definitely go back there again.

Taco bus always delivers on fast, delicious food and this new location offers nothing less. I love the space at this location and there is plenty of inside and outside seating. I would recommend calling ahead to order at lunch if you're pressed for time. Since this is brand new to Brandon tons of people flock there during their lunch breaks.

I highly recommend the guacamole appetizer and getting 2-3 tacos to be able to try different meats (I really like the pork and steak). 

If you haven't been here and you're reading this review....trust me... Go...now.... You won't be disappointed :)

I can't believe I've passed this place so many times and have never stopped in before now. I was ravenous Friday morning after dropping my little person off to school so I decided to stop in for carry out. I got the ham and egg breakfast and a half order of biscuits and gravy. The ham was a nice portion and the hash browns were perfect (not to soft not to crispy) I can't vouch for the eggs because I don't eat them but they came with the meal. The biscuits and gravy were honestly  the best I've had at a restaurant (no one can make it like granny) but they were really excellent. The french toast was okay for me, I prefer mine more eggy but they were still pretty good. I will being going back and may even make this my Sunday morning breakfast spot.
Really nice service; great appetizers & excellent food. Smoked bass dip with ramps and potato chips was really good. Classic dishes brought to life with some new California newness.

Went for Sunday brunch - sat in the awkwardly-sized booths for two. The table was too high/too close and became increasingly more uncomfortable as our visit progressed. We shared the make-your-own mimosas, which were perfectly fine, given the very reasonable price. My friend ordered the The James Brunch Burger and loved it. I had the Fried Green Tomatoes, which were sliced far too thick and were lacking flavor. The Mixed Green Salad was basic - nothing special. I also ordered the Prosciutto & Melon plate, but it was unavailable. Service started great, but then our waitress disappeared. There was a game on, which is fine/to be expected, but there was a patron absolutely losing his mind, screaming and yelling at the TV and made mad enough to contemplate confronting him, because no one else did.

Second time at this location went 
much better, service wise. We tried their experimental/new menu. It appears that they still have their previous menu displayed on their website, so I assume they will release a new version of their menu at a later date. 

We the crab cake balls, which were a very spicy, but still delicious. It was a nice, quiet night with a cool breeze and amble seating space. 

Next time I want to try and have cocktails inside in the lounge area near the front entrance. Would be a perfect girls' night setting.

The first thing you notice when walking into Keen was the décor. We went to the upstairs bar. I'd call it eclectic ski-lodge. Smooth wood and stone bar and bar stools with beautiful color patterns. The woodwork on the staircase was really beautiful. We also popped into the lounge that included a big screen TV, boardgames, and a video game system; it looked like a great place to hang out. The bar tender was nice and handled our allergy needs very well. My wife and step-daughter got burgers which they said were great. I had the veggie burger, which was also great. The long hot yogurt added a nice kick. I also had a nice side of Mapled Glazed Brussels Sprouts.  The beer menu was small, but still had good quality beers. The margarita I had was really tasty.

If you are in New Orleans, you need make the time to go to Acme. The waiting line is always very long but it is totally worth it.  We tried their char grilled oysters which was awesome and way better than many other places that serve the same dish in the area. It is a must if you make it to Acme. Other dishes were good but not the best. We ordered their boo fries, boudin sausage, gumbo, shrimp ettoufee and oyster shots.

YUM!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
great service, I like the lounge club atmosphere which wasn't too loud, and just the way the place was set up.
we got the bread (with cheese on inside) which was very good but the sauce that they provided is what made it amazing. The plantains we had i wasn't the biggest fan of. A bit too fried and not even with the actual dish with the white sauce over it that I wasn't a fan of. We got the cerviche sample which consisted of: Thai Mixto (Crab, shrimp, octopus and fluke with coconut-leche de tigre, mango and tomatillo) which was AMAZING,
Peruvian Black Bass not as great and pretty standard the scallop threw me off and they were just small pieces that took away from the dish. Rainbow (Tuna, salmon and black bass marinated in lime juice and jalapeno with roasted sweet potato slices) was good but more of a dip sorta thing.
Chorizo Sliders were good, sorta standard but if you are hungry it def will fill you up while you wait for the rest of your food.
The mango mojitos were REALLY GOOD. I don't normally like mojitos and i was a big fan of them here. I got the salmon/seafood dish (Organic Salmon Asopado P.E.I. mussels, littleneck clams, rice, potatoes, saffron scented broth) that was really good but a bit on the salty side. It tasted like there were 2 lemons squeezed over it.
The boy got the  Chicken Combo (Marinated grilled breast over "Arroz Imperial" with shredded chicken, manchego cheese, peas and olives) this was really really good it was chicken (a bit dry) but over a paella sorta dish with tons of cheese.

Food was great.. The service on the other hand was terrible. Our waiter paid absolutely no attention to us.  Never came to our table to ask us if we needed anything. Our bill came and we didn't even get a thank you or any words for that matter . We paid and left . Ruined the whole experience .
Great food, great atmosphere, great homemade ice cream. Five stars.

The box lunch is my favorite take out lunch, and it is very reasonably priced.  For $9, I get salad with their delicious ginger carrot dressing, salmon terriyaki and a fresh california roll, plus all the stuff you need to eat those things, including a few slivers of fresh ginger.

We eat here frequently and don't always find the service to be as good as the food, but they seem to be trying harder.

A trip up 95 and through some winding wooded streets will bring you to Peddler's Village. I've been twice in the last few years and, while not my favorite shopping destination in PA, it's certainly a nice reprieve from malls and the like.

Most recently, I came for the Christmas Festival earlier in the month. We arrived on the earlier end -- and thank goodness! The line of cars just trying to enter the parking lot stretched allllll the way down a local road by the time we left around 2 p.m. Nuts!

Even though we were fortunate to avoid that snarled traffic situation, we were there just in time for a flurry of pedestrian activity. And by that, I mean that it was slightly hard to enter, exit or browse some of the shops. Pretty expected in the days before Christmas, but I can't imagine what the village was like later in the day.

I really think Peddler's should consider adding more on-site eateries into the mix. It's great to have so many varying shopping places, but people need to eat! We ended up driving to New Hope for our lunch.

I'd recommend avoiding a trip here before a holiday, but otherwise it's a nice place to stroll and shop away from the city.
Awesome little taco shop. Tried three different meats and all were great as were the salsas.

The restaurant deserves ZERO stars... I made a reservation 3 weeks ahead of time. We found out on the day that they no longer had our reservation in the system (WTH?). We came to SB from Bay Area to celebrate our anniversary. They did not even try to accommodate us.

BYOB and delicious Indian food, score! Very pleasant atmosphere and decent service. Convenient location and always full which is a good sign that what you are eating is A. authentic-ish and B. Delish!!

My wife and I eat here about 4 to 5 times a year. We love the susi and the fun of the show. Service is fantastic and the food is really good (depends on which cook sometimes) but over all great food and we love the yum yum sauce.

Great atmosphere, open, clean with dozens of interesting sports options on the multiple TVs. Finally , you can't beat the Combo Fajita platter for only 8.99! Every bite of today's special from the chicken to the steak was flavorful and well-cooked! Delicious!

Let yourself enjoy this hidden gem!  I got lasagna to test out the place- it was amazing!!!  Seriously- the entree was shareable and so tasty.  The red sauce was fresh and tasty... priced for a working person budget - try Thursday crab night!  You will be really happy

Honey?! Time to Grow our dinner! HA. HA. First time here since moving to No. Libs months ago and it didn't disappoint. Quick, painless, and great flavor. Ordered on a Saturday night, walked over, picked up, and ate within the hour. Their Covid plan is top notch too. 

What we snagged:
-Sweet Soy Five Spice Noodle (Very flavorful, and added some edamame) 
-Spicy Garlic Stir-fry (Also great and SPICY) 

Overall, great space they have down here and looking forward to snagging a salad in the future.

For the last almost decade my husband and I have been together, west shore pizza was our favorite spot for chicken parm. 
It was always perfect with a whole piece of chicken on top which was the reason we continued to visit.
His birthday was yesterday so chose his favorite and ordered it Uber eats since we are out of the delivery area.
When we got it, we were so disappointed. The once large whole breast was now chicken tenders. The cheese was barely melted and it was not warm throughout. 
Not a good way to celebrate a birthday.

Great wine selection and food! Such a fan.
I am a student at the Webster Conservatory and often come here after performing shows late at night and  It always has a nice welcoming atmosphere. 

I recommend doing the wine flights to get a triple taste of different wines, and if you like, get a glass of your favorite or switch to something else. They range in cost from low to high depending on what you want. 
The cheese plates and flat breads I have had are great, but I recommend sticking with the cheese boards as they are the best item on the menu. 

I do however wish the bartenders were more friendly, they seem to not be interested in serving me upon arrival. I even had to ask for a glass of water. But yet, I go back! A nice addition to Webster Groves, a community which is lacking in nightlife.

Shitty service, crappy food and way overpriced for what they are dishing out.  I tried their downtown location and it was the same, figured I'd give The Goleta location and try, same results. Never will I return and this is my third chance and will never happen again!!!

I heard this opened a few weeks back and had to stop in for a pie. I went with the modmini size and chose to make my own. The panic hit once I started actually going down the line and seeing all of the options. I panicked and went with regular sauce, chicken, bacon, and a little extra mozzarella cheese. They cooked it immediately and in about 5 minutes I had my little pizza pulled and ready for me. I added some pepper flakes and oregano after getting my lemonade with crushed ice. The soda machine has crushed ice here which I like, but don't see many places. Overall the pizza was pretty good. The crust was thin and crispy and it came out hot and good. The only thing I wasn't crazy about was the chicken, it reminded me of the chicken they use at Subway. The cheese, and bacon and sauce were all very good. The music was cranked, and it had a pretty industrial theme inside as well. I will definitely come back with friends and make a crazy pizza sometime soon.

Buyer beware! This is my first time giving a 1-star rating and I debated on whether it would be helpful. In the end, I feel I must warn other diners.

To start, the food is excellent. But the service and experience was awful. When my boyfriend and I walked in on a Wednesday night, the restaurant was empty except for one large party (probably about 8 to 10 people). Our waitress was pleasant enough, though not particularly attentive or helpful. When I asked for some guidance on what to order, she basically said everything was good and took a while to try to point out 3 to 4 specialties or popular menu items. It's just really irritating when waiters/waitresses tell me everything on the menu is good. I would hope so, or why else would the restaurant be serving it?

The worst offense was that our food took 50 minutes to arrive. Yes, 50 minutes, despite being an almost empty restaurant! After inquiring with our waitress several times on the status of our order, she came by our with another staffer and they apologetically explained their kitchen was backed up because they had a ton of GrubHub orders to fill. I realize they were attempting to explain the situation, but the fact that they did not realize how insulting it is for a dine-in patron to be told that takeout/delivery orders take priority is beyond me. I relayed that sentiment, which was met with more apologies.

In the end, all we got were more apologies (which I should add were only offered because I showed my displeasure for the wait time!) and nothing else to improve my experience. I will not be back. What a shame, since I thought it was a great neighborhood addition and their food really is delicious.
The best old fashioned cheese on the bottom tomato pie around! It's so delicious, it's dangerous. You can't stop eating it. It's always a treat when we decide to get a Palante's pie.

I was told 7 dollars not 3.99 and I really only went there for the spicy mayo and they gave me the recipes so that was awesome so no need to go back it was 7 not 3.99 and I feel u were messing with me due to old employees I am friends with and you took it out on me cause u don't know how to treat your staff so it stems from you how you act not them it's u there scared to even talk they say you yell at them so owe well that's you

I finally made it to Bahndicted. I am a fan of Bahn Mi sandwiches from my travels in the bay area. Bahndicted has a friendly staff and a very nice space.  

I had the barbecue pork Bahn Mi. It is delicious with nice jalapeno spice and really tasty pork.  The pickled carrots and Daikin are crispy.  This is the best Bahn Mi I have found in Tucson.

Sorry to say that our recent experiences have been somewhat disappointing.  We'll usually get take out and we've now had three experiences were the order was missing a key ingredient--mind you, not that it  was missing an *item* but that (for example) our "ramen with corn" was missing the corn!    The first time we experienced this kind of a lapse (it was an order of spicy noodles where they forgot to add the spicy sauce) we let them know about it later and they were very apologetic (which was nice but did nothing to make up for the "incomplete" dish that we paid for).

So while the quality of the food (when it's right) is high, we have given up on this place as a reliable source for take out food.

A really fancy place in one of reno's casino's and the prices tend to be on the high side. but they have a couple dishes that are to die for.  Their bangkok chicken... the chicken is tender and obviously simmered in coconut milk and the garnishes they add in it.. awesome. I personally require more rice then what they give is a downside for me, but that's my own personal taste lol, no fault of theirs.  the water tastes clean, which is always refreshing and the bread and butter you get while your waiting for your order is quite tasty! the butter is excellent quality.  another dish which isn't bad is the sesame chicken, the best part of this dish is the sauce.. which has a rich flavor. the chicken was breaded and had the sauce poured over it which made it taste a little soggy. the chicken in the bangkok was infinitely better.  the vegetables that came with the sesame dish were delicious though.  The thai pizza they have there is also good, though i'd hold on the peanuts (personal pref). and their tiramisu was alright.  At least 3 of the times i've been there our waiter has been Nino. and he's polite and professional and he's attentive. excellent service from him.
Love all the plant based option - the vegan scramble is a must try, also the big veggie on a collard green leaf! Cant wait to see what the future holds for them!

Local who has ordered from Italian Pie many times from different locations. Ordered the chicken Alfredo pasta to be delivered and I could not believe it but the chicken was thinly sliced what appeared to be deli chicken....weird and certainly not what I was expecting...

This was my first time here and I definitely was not disappointed! I sat inside because the outside tables were too close together and I like my space. The inside was really nice and it wasn't too loud. The staff were very nice and the food was delicious. Also the food did not take long to come out even though it was a Friday night and crowded. It's pricey but worth it. I will be coming back Parc!

I'm not a seafood person but my wife wanted to try this place out. We ended up getting both the charbroiled oysters and raw oysters, shrimp & corn bisque, tuna & avocado salad and the lobster Mac and cheese. Again me not being a seafood lover, I thought the shrimp and corn bisque was ok. My son loved the lobster Mac and cheese. My wife and daughter preferred the raw oysters over the charbroiled, but both were good. The tuna on the salad was great while the actual salad part was so-so. For what you get I thought the food was a little pricey, though it seems like all the restaurants in NOLA are pricey. Also since this location is inside the hilton it is very busy and loud. Our server was nice but it took a whole to get service as well as the wait time to get our food. I don't think we would eat here again.

The hotel is located in the hills above Santa Barbara with 270 degree views of the hills, harbor, ocean and city. The restaurant has a great patio with heaters so that you can enjoy the view during your meal or while enjoying a drink.
The wines and food are excellent. The appetizers are very unique and delicious. The service is excellent as well.
I heartily recommend it for a romantic occasion, or for a meal with a great view and wonderful food. Sunset is the best time to enjoy the view.

We had the lunch buffet which included all the normal favorites including saag, very good samosa, tandori chicken etc. The rice pudding could have used some nuts in it. But the sauces were really good as well as the naan which included some extra flavoring. For Tucson this is a good solid indian food choice for only $7.50 per person.

We've been here twice now and we are underwhelmed. In fact, I doubt we will ever be back. Only had breakfast, but both times, we didn't really like it so we aren't really willing to try anything else. I do like the wolf theme, but other than decent coffee, I didn't really care for our visit. Oh well.

**edited because my husband wanted me to add that he had the stuffed French toast and it tasted sour. It was gross.

Good pastries. 

I enjoy coming here bc they have so many choices (from foods to desserts, to drinks.) The thai iced tea with bubble is probably the best I've ever had. And the size they give it in is pretty large! When I first got it awhile back, before even knowing the size, I was like the price for thai iced tea is expensive, but after receiving the drink and realizing how big the cup was, I was happy!! And their tapioca is always cooked perfectly.

I was super excited to eat here from the Yelp reviews. I am doubtful that this place is worth a trip from Tampa, but if you live in the Riverview area it is worth a visit. The black bean soup was OK, and the Cuban Sandwich was good but nothing remarkable. The friendly and attentive wait staff get 5 stars.

The food here is exquisite regardless whether you're grabbing quick breakfast, coffee break snack or upscale casual dinner. The cocktails are lovely and unexpected in what at first appears to be a bakery coffee house.

Absolutely amazing experience at Saint Añejo! Rarely do you experience a "wow" moment on a hectic travel day. My husband and I flew into Nashville, and found Saint Añejo through a quick search of best brunches in Nashville. We were greeted by friendly staff, including Hunter, Nia, LD, and Teagan, who accommodated us so graciously by storing our luggage in their back room. Huge huge help to us as we were not able to check into our hotel for several more hours. Mykal at the bar was a rockstar! The entire bar area was packed but she took fantastic care of us, checking on us frequently. I will definitely be back!!!

Six tasty brews in their flight for only 6.50 is the best deal in the Show Me Stare. The food was just right, a tender beef melt on toasted bun w/ those round deep fried potato things. Hit the spot. Their beer is worth a visit here if you like brewpub beer.

The pork belly steamed buns are amazing, best I've had. The pho, bahn mi, and fresh rolls are good too. I love all the use of fresh herbs. Decent beer selection. The prices are fair and the service is good. It's definitely my favorite lunch spot on Freret St., just wish they were open on Mondays!

I tried something new, the crispy hen rice dish...it was awesome!! But, the pork belly buns are definitely one of my most favorite foods ever, gotta get them every time!

Have been here twice now. So grateful to have a restaurant of this caliber in Santa Barbara.  It's just an incredible relaxed modern upscale atmosphere with a very inspired contemporary French menu and intriguing wine list. Have tried at least a dozen of the menu items - hard to not reorder the things you know you already fell in love with. Everything has been really delicious. Thank your lucky stars for this place.

Terrible customer service. Went to drive thru, was ignored after 3 attempts to order. Cashier was very rude and when I called to talk to a manager, I was again disrespected and so called manager could barely speak English. NEVER WILL GO BACK

It used to be good. We were here several times before pandemic. Even in Oct 2020, when we came here, it was good. But today, the service was definitely disappointing. Five star to it used to be, one for now.

We've been to different Gyu-kaku in the U.S. so many times. This is the worst experience I've ever had.
We ordered beef tongue, the waiter told me he was not sure if it's available but he will check for me. Even after we finished the lunch and leave, we didn't hear any response from the waiter. 
No tableware after serving salad for 5mins. Eventually got those after our reminders.

Dirty plate, you can see the water and oil stains on the plate.

No empty bowl for edamame shell.

No sauce plate, even after we requested. The waiter told us this was the company's policy. So where do we suppose to put the sauce? The dirty plate?

No miso soup and Japanese chicken karaage for starter, served after reminding at the end of lunch.

No garlic shio cabbage and New York steak. After remaining, we was told that New York steak was sold out. The waiter has it replaced by filet. Garlic shio cabbage served after we almost finished the meat.

No water refills even we finished the first cup.

The table beside us has their tray replaced twice. After our demand, we finally got our dirty tray replaced when we only have one plate of meat left, by another waiter.

We didn't get the QR code on recipes for rewards.

Overall, it is really uncomfortable experience.

I really have to give this restaurant a star because they don't deserve it.  I was sent to this restaurant yesterday to pick up an order.  When I arrived, the food was not ready so I went to the restroom and a worker from the restaurant came in to restroom as well to work on the stall next to me.  As I came out, I noticed there was NO soap dispenser and NO soap or hand sanitizer on the sink.  I asked the worker when she came out of the other stall about soap and she replied, "we out, just use water".  Now she was working on the toilet and she ran water on her hands and I watched her walk out and go back into the kitchen to prepare food.  This is gross and unsanitary!!!! This is also against sanitation policies for restaurants.  I would recommend anyone eating or ordering food here!!!! Employees are working on toilets AND using the restrooms here and they are not using soap to properly sanitize their hands AND they are making your food!  DO NOT EAT HERE!!!  I will try to notify the health inspection authorities because this could get innocent people sick.

Wait! What? How is this place not rated higher? A coworker recommended this place and after work drove through thunder, lightening and rain to this place cause 2 words- sushi burrito! The menu is a 5 step process, pick how you want your burrito prepared with an abundance of fresh veggies. The sushi burrito came out picture perfect and I noticed they also had Baos- which are pork belly stuffed between two soft buns. Sushi burrito was impressively fresh and delish! They also have a "frequent flyer" program, every $10 you spend gets you a punch towards a free burrito. It's only my first time here and I'm already thinking of the ways to maximize towards my free burrito! Lol. The Bao appetizer was good on flavor but realistically, the pork belly was razor thin. I would not get it again unless they fix it to a thick cut like most establishments make it. I thought about knocking off a star but the burrito was such a star highlight, it is still deserving. Hooked on the burrito!

Had lunch with dad today, and I'm slightly disappointed in the ravioli I ordered. Cold, no flavor with no flavor sauce. My dad ordered an Italian sub and it was amazing. The pizza looked great also. I will try again but this time stick to athe basics, as that's probably where the value is

Probably the worst Chinese food. Below average American Chinese food and above average price. Used super aged string beans and the server apologized when we pointed it out. Service is understaffed. I can't believe Yelp gave this a 3.5 review.

I met a girlfriend here on a Sunday afternoon to catch up. The vibe was super low-key. No one seemed anxious or rushed.  The staff seemed like they actually enjoyed working there which is not always the case in Nashville. The decor was pretty cool and matched the atmosphere. It wasn't overdone but still very instagrammable (haha).  We found out that this was the first Sunday brunch that they had since covid ruined everything. We shared edamame (delish). I got shrimp and grits and added an over medium egg on top (chef's kiss). My friend ordered the pork belly hash (which she loved). We also ended up being able to try the Char Siu Baos and the spring rolls. Those were also excellent! There was a mimosa and rose brunch special so we took advantage of that also. 

Everything we ate was wonderful but let me get to the real star of the show: our server, Peter. Peter took a 5 star experience up to a 10 star. He was super attentive and had a great personality. He even took the time to remember our names!  Every restaurant needs 10 Peters! Seriously, he was the best. 

The only drawback was parking. Give yourself extra time to find it just in case the area is busy.
Fork is definitely one of the best restaurants down town!! We love the asparagus fries, Parmesan rosemary fries, tacos, and butter cake for dessert. Hiiighly recommend

Blah Thai. Certainly not the "Best Thai in Tampa" as the sign proclaims! The food was edible, but overcooked and completely unimaginative. I specified "Thai Spicy" and my Massaman Curry was barely spicy at all. I had to dump a ton of hot sauce in it. The place also has zero atmosphere. It's like eating in the lobby of a cheap motel. Definitely will not return and advise others to avoid.

Customer service at its finest, combined with great food and a diverse menu.  Always a good experience since I've been going there the last 2 years.  Misha genuinely cares about her customers and takes the time to get to know them (by name).  The wake-up breakfast wrap is the best!

Point blank it's just not that good. Nothing to write home about. Not worth the calories. Dgb burger was super greasy and surprisingly did not have much flavor. The cocktails aren't impressive. The poutine fries are gross. The Baja ranch dip is gross. The salsa and guacamole is decent but the chips are greasy and not crisp and the serving of dips are small. Fries are soggy. Mudd pie desert wasn't bad but wasn't great. Just overall wasn't impressed.

Being from California I am a bit of a Mexican food snob.  That being said..... nothing so far has beat Rosepepper that we've tried.  The margaritas are delicous, the ecletic decor, the salsa... yum.  Although I don't live in East Nashville, I love this place and we make the drive whenever we can...

This is one of those restaurants everyone says you have to visit.  The story and history are fun, and it's in a great location.
We were happy with the food, but a little disappointed in the selection.  It seemed like there were variation on a few themes and nothing really shouted "try me!".
I ended up with a duck dish that was good.  Someone else ordered the lamb.  As with many places, the chefs suggested temperature was a little too done and dried the meat a bit.  It was flavorful, though.  Shrimp and grits and a dinner salad were enjoyed by our other companions.

(Frequent traveler from out of town)

Delosas pizza is always a busy place and thank goodness they had someone there to help expedite seating. The pizza is decent at an affordable price. My alternative to not wanting to spend double on a seafood dinner.

I just had a delicious lunch at Hangout Ramen.

So as crazy as it seems, the only ramen I've ever had has come from a plastic bag and costs around 25 cents.  Well, as you can imagine, this was a treat.

I was warmly welcomed when I arrived and was given menus right away.  I ordered a hot green tea and Tonkotsu Ramen, which was described on the menu as creamy pork broth and pork belly.  Well, as it turns out it's much more than that. All of the ramen bowls come with corn, bamboo shoots, bean sprouts, fish cakes, egg, green onion and seaweed sheets.

Y'all, this stuff is good. Like solid good.  I loved it and am looking forward to a return trip.  The pork belly was so tender that it was  literally falling apart. The broth was very flavorful and this was really a hearty dish. I have a feeling that when I return I'll order the same dish because 1. that's who I am, and 2. it was that good.

The service was wonderful too.

You cannot go wrong with any plate you order here. Every dish is packed with delicious flavors. We found ourselves ordering the same dishes multiple times because we couldn't get enough! Highly recommend. Excellent service and quality of food.

This place use to have really good food but over the years they have declined. I'm told new owners joined and thats when it all changed. Extremely over priced and wait staff seem to want to rush you through service. In the past I loved the Shrimp Fra Diaolvo with jumbo shrimp and a nice sauce with good amount of heat from the chili peppers. Last time I ordered it I was surprised , no shocked, to find the canned mini shrimp (used in shrimp macaroni salad) along with a few jumbo shrimp and the heat in the sauce was so over bearing almost like they added hot sauce to it.  Bread basket had a few measly pieces that were on the stale side and a meager plate of roasted peppers. Calamari was chewy and can tell it was not fresh.

I really enjoy Antonio's every time I come to eat here. It's too far from me to make use of the carry out side of the restaurant, so I can't speak to that but the sit-down part of the restaurant is excellent. It is BYOB so be sure to grab a bottle (or two) of your favorite vino before going. I've got to admit that I'm pretty boring in my orders. Every time I go I always order the vodka rigatoni because it is the best I've ever had. I have gotten to enjoy tastes of my friends' and family members' meals when they order something other than the vodka rigs and I have never been disappointed. The atmosphere is nice and most times we eat there Anthony is either in the kitchen or making sure everyone is happy with their meals. The owner being a regular presence really helps maintain the standards of the restaurant, I believe. If you're in the area, you should stop in for some delicious Italian food!

This is honestly my first review and first check in. I don't normally review. I just scarf down whatever is on my plate and go on my way. The sushi here is fantastic, and the lunch special at 9.95 runs until 330 daily M-Sa!! Fantastic selection of all you can eat Chinese food , but again if you love sushi definitely come here. I tried everything and didn't die from poison. I am happy!

Overpriced terrible sushi. The rice was hard either pointing to it not being cooked fully or past its use by date. The Udon noodle soup is simply not that. For one they don't use Udon noodles in it!  The chicken in the broth was overcooked also. Service was good however.
