Really good wonton noodles.  We also ordered some fried rice and stir fried vegetables, and much to our delight, the portion is much bigger than NYC cantonese restaurants.  Love it!

This little bar is legit. The bartenders are wonderful.The vibe is spot on. And the Burgers are incredible. Simple and easy . The burgers are not a great big gut bomb. They're well thought out and at the end of the night your full,not stuffed.

My wife an I have been here before for lunch and loved it. The service was awesome, attentive and a bit over-bearing making sure our needs where met. The food was great when we came in for lunch. Tonight, we decided to come back for a dinner date and where really disappointed with the service and the food was just meh. We are not the type to bother people when we know they are busy, but the waiter passed us like 15 times and it seemed like he had totally forgotten us. Very disappointed with the service and food this time around.

Love how you can choose any and how much toppings you want on your personal pie for one low price. Brick oven pizza, thin crust. Instead of pizza sauce I like the butter garlic sauce, lots of cheese, chicken, banana peppers and when done pesto on top. So good. Hubby the carnivore has pizza sauce, cheese and every meat available on his.

I am already an El Limon fan an have enjoyed many yummy and extremely well priced meals in their Conshy location, so I was thrilled to find they were coming  to me in Ambler. 

Menu has a few new additions like fish tacos as a permanent fixture instead of just a special and another thing or two. The interior is simple just like their other location but MUCH less cramped for space. The only place  I can not say this is in the entry way. It's probably the only slight negative for El Limon. Just as in their other location, if you are waiting to pick something up or, even at a busy time, waiting to be seated, there's a huge back-log of people jammed in the entry way! You'd think they'd improve on that in a new location! For me, it isn't much of a bother because their food and their owner's awesome service is worth a little cramping in the front, but I did notice a few people back out of the doorway and decide to go elsewhere after seeing the crowd, not knowing just around the corner was a wide open space and available tables! 

I have a feeling despite that minor design flaw, El Limon in Ambler is going to do incredible business and I'll definitely be giving them mine! If you haven't tried their fish tacos, get them supreme and anything with their chicken tinga. The flavors they've developed in there rivals that of their salsas!

This place is the Mecca for Panzarotti! Once a year or so I declare war on my arteries and indulge that part of my brain that wants to kill me slowly and deliciously via Panzerotti. Since it is a once a year sort of treat for me, I am very much not an expert on Panzerotti, so you can take my opinions witha grain of salt. But I will say it is much bettter than the ones in Cherry Hill or Audobon -

That said, yum!

I have been eating here since I was a kid. They have the best cheesesteaks around. Their prices are great , the service is always great and their always good with their timing. If I had to recommend a place to order take out it would  definitely  be italian family. The owner Tony is a great guy!! If you want great food with great prices order from here!!

This is my new favorite restaurant. The staff are kind and friendly, the tapas are delicious, and the outdoor seating (with heat lamps!) is great. The star was the seafood paella--I came back a week after my first time to have it again.

The good - five stars for the pleasant ambiance and live singer. She was the best! The Cure cover of "Lovesong" was phenomenal! 

The not so good - ZERO stars for the food! Fillet minion was incredibly bland. I actually had to add some salt that's how bland it was. The asparagus on the side was undercooked also very bland. Was it so difficult to add just a little hint of some kind of seasoning?

The so called garlic mashed potatoes had way too much dairy (buttermilk or milk) it was actually quite disgusting and I've never ever used this word about any restaurant food. Our waitress would repeat every word we say back to us only 10 times louder for some reason, some attitude issues as well when we took time to order. 

The desert was served in the shot glass which was nice, but again didn't live up to the presentation. It felt like it has been defrosted earlier.

If you read previous reviews it might seem like this review doesn't belong here but to my disappointment that is my experience with Season 52. I really wanted to like this place as the interior is really beautiful and classy. Unfortunately if you are after great food it's a total miss. The piano girl saved this review from zero stars.

The ambience in this place is amazing. My friends and I came on a Friday night and the music selection was pretty good. I had the linguine pescatore. It was ok but thank God I asked for a side of Parmesan. It really helped elevate the taste of the dish making it smoothly,buttery and salty. Without it the linguine was pretty bland. The Brussels sprouts taste amazing and my friends had the Chile Shrimp dish which they loved. Also, the fried Oreos were better than the chocolate cake. Oh, I can't forget. The drinks were amazing.

This unpretentious little mom-and-pop Italian joint has become something of a tradition for my grandparents and me; they live in nearby Cherry Hill, New Jersey, and every time I visit, I look forward to enjoying a great family dinner at Sal and Joe's.

Food:
This little restaurant, at one end of a strip-mall-style collection of shops, is consistently filled with diners for just one reason: people come for the tasty - and plentiful - Italian food!  Okay, so that's two reasons.  Let's talk about portions first: dinners come with a large entree, a huge basket of garlic bread, a bowl of soup, and a large house salad.  It's hard to beat the sheer volume of food for the prices they charge.  But more important than there being a LOT of food, is the fact that it's a lot of GOOD food; everything that comes out of the kitchen is very satisfying indeed.  Seafood dishes, pastas with various sauces, meats, and cheeses, the fantastic-if-simple garlic bread, and their always changing line-up of excellent soups never disappoint.  And while their pizza is not quite up to the level of the rest of their options, it's still pretty darn good.  In short, Sal and Joe's gives you good food, and plenty of it, for not a lot of money.  What's not to like?

Decor:
Remember when I said the restaurant's in a strip mall?  Well, the interior doesn't do much to disguise that fact.  While not unpleasant, the decor is pretty stereotypical for an Italian-American restaurant, replete with (fake) hanging plants and paper placemats featuring a (cartoon) map of Italy.  Still, they keep the place clean, and the framed photo of the 2006 World Cup Championship Italian team is offset by the cute fresco-style painting of a Venetian scene on the wall behind it.

Service:
The service is not particularly noteworthy, but the wait staff is certainly competent.  Extra points to the bussers, who keep water glasses filled and clear plates with admirable speed and discretion.

Price:
$$

Overall:
Sal and Joe's Spaghetti and Pizza House is a great place to take the whole family for an inexpensive Italian-American dinner that will leave you with plenty of yummy leftovers for the next day's lunch.

So since this place has opened (3 weeks), I've made several visits to the point where they've recognized me as a VIP. Who knew!? So at this point I feel like I can give a pretty adequate review of this place. 

I love everything about the atmosphere of this little spot. It's very hip and welcoming. But if you're visiting during peak times (lunch/dinner) the lines will be long and there may not be a place for you to sit and eat but don't you worry! The wait is worth it and you can always take your food togo and it still tastes amazing!

If you want a spicy kick to your bowl, I'd recommend the creamy miso + mango habanero. (Secret menu??? Maybe.. But I'm a big fan). If you're looking to add some greens into your diet I highly recommend getting the combination of rice and mixed greens! 

Overall, I dig this place. The people that work there are always super energetic and fun. They're very patient and informative so don't be afraid to ask them any questions. The fish is fresh/delish and the abundance of topping choices is the icing on the cake! Oh, and I can't forget about the little macaroon ice-cream sandwiches! Try them out, I don't think you'll be disappointed.

As for the point system: You get a point for every dollar you spend. 
50 points: free macaroon
150: free bowl

Well, I hope you guys enjoy this place as much as I do!

P.S. They accept Apple Pay and Samsung pay! So save yourself some time and pay with your Apple Watch or smartphone!
Food is ok but poor service destroys any positive feelings you may muster. Small drinks.

Ordered mixed fajitas for $14.99.  They arrived at my table with 3 tortillas, beans and rice.  I asked the server if sour cream or cheese came with the meal.  She said that they did not.  I asked for sour cream and got a small dish of it.  She had also brought out a bowl Osaka's with chips .  When I got my bill their wS a charge of$1.50 for the salsa.  I thought that chips and salsa was complementary.  The music was extremely loud for the time of day (11:30 am).  The food was tasty but I will not be back.  I will go to "Don Jose".  Their food and service is much better.

They have terrific food! Went there based on some reviews on here and I must say, they were not wrong. If you're out in the area, you should definitely try it! This is their spicy chicken pizza, absolutely fantastic!

I like the variety of the Pizza Famiglia menu. I like that they seem to double and triple check their delivery and to go orders. Getting home with the wrong food is so disappointing. They have long hours so they can hook you up with noms late into the night. They have sandwiches and options besides pizza, which is what I always get because I don't eat cheese. Portion sizes are great and prices are fair. Delivery is quick.


My hubby is not impressed with the pizza. He eats it, but he says it's typical stuff, nothing special. I've never had their pizza but it looks OK.

The service and cleanliness of this place was a joke. We had terribly slow service. Also our glasses of water reeked of cigarettes. We reluctantly stayed for food because we were hungry. The food was great. Too bad I will probably never go back because of how dirty the restaurant was and how bad the service was. Our waitress literally ignored us the whole time until the end of our meal. Then she was just staring at us while we ate and hanging around our table. Also when she brought our food to the table, she stuck her hand in about every dish. Gross.

Went again, this time ordered a beef arepa with a domino empanada. The arepa was just as good as before. The empanada was also very good, with a very tasty mix of black beans and cheese. It probably could have fit a bit more filling inside, but I wouldn't say I felt cheated at all, considering it was less than $4, yet was still reasonably filling. 

Another great meal, especially with the owner personally serving his customers and making them feel at home. For my money, one of the most underrated cheap eats in the city.
Perfect every single time. Amazing, fresh food. Kind, hospitable staff. Locally owned. There are zero down-sides to this place. ZERO.

not really a plant based menu but I had fun here! the servers were really nice and it was a great way for me to kill time. Pretty good wine selection, and I was more than happy for the happy hour hookah!
Great food, good energy, super service. Never disappointed when I come to the Sparks location.

Question for all those who recommended this restaurant... why? Why did you like this place? Was it the burnt oil used to mix the stir fry? The chewy, unpleasant chunks of mystery seafood? Or perhaps the stale dry rice? 

I will never understand why anyone likes this place. I joked about it being unsafe to eat chicken out of a stir fry with raw mushrooms and onions. Just cause the vegetables are raw doesn't mean the meat would be undercooked, right? Wrong! Three hours later and I cannot be more than a few feet from a washroom. I will never go back. 

This was my experience here:

We sat down. We ordered our food. Our food arrived. Naturally we started to dish it out onto our plates. As we were eating the server came along, said one of our plates was the wrong dish and removed it from our table. The dish that was removed was still pretty full and didn't really look 'touched.' 

I saw her walk into the kitchen with it and less than 30 seconds later walk back out to drop an identical dish onto another table. 

Now, maybe that was enough time to throw our plate away and pick up another one? Or maybe it was enough time to throw some garnish onto our place and take it back out to another? I am not sure and will never know. 

Every dish we had was terrible. The seafood in the noodles was very chewy and tasted old. The rice was not fresh. The stir fry was unevenly cooked. The only edible dish we were served was the tom yum soup.

This was by far the absolute worst Thai food I have eaten in my life. I have never been to Thailand but, I have eaten at dozens of places across the Canada and this was nothing short of awful.

Food here is good. No complaints. Great place to stop if you're heading home, call in to place order somehow this place is always busy with walk-ins and call orders. Again another good quick easy place in the surrounding area.

Everyone in the store is super friendly. There is a good selections of local beers and wines. Perfect store for someone who likes to entertain, there are tons of things to buy. Also a good place to find unique gifts.

What a breath of fresh air. Not many Mediterranean places here in South Jersey but this place does it right. Everything is made as soon as you order and the flavors are amazing. Def one of our go to spots.

Pros: 
- great seasoning on all the dishes
- great plantains 
- good chicken

Cons:
- tough steak
- no desserts

Very very good experience here Sunday night. My companion and I each had a beer flight consisting of four half glasses glasses of beer, great way to try four different beers. My companion had the roasted vegetarian Curry and I had a bibb Caesar salad along with prosciutto and Parmesan fries. Everything excellent including the service.

I went to Pull Up to pick up some meats for a family dinner. The staff was attentive and friendly and greeted me when I entered and offered to help me. There was a paper menu on the counter but a menu above the case of sides was helpful simple, and easy to read.

The sides looked legit but we didn't need them so I just ordered a selection of meat: Brisket, pulled pork, whole smoked chicken, and smoked wings. Everyone liked all of them and the wings and chicken had a great smoke taste.

Friendly, helpful service and great food. Must try.

Love the atmosphere of this place. The cocktails are great, and they serve the best tater totes in town. This is the first place I take anyone who visits me in Nashville. My boyfriend and I came here on our first date, and we've celebrated our anniversary here every year since.

The service was more than amazing. Our server & cook was very attentive & by the end of our stay (we overstayed our welcome, way past closing) I felt like I knew her as a close friend. She took care of us and I know we would get the same treatment again.

The food was more than delicious. I have no other word to describe the flavour that I had been craving for months. I am definitely a regular customer now.

I wanted to dine in. But it was hotter in the restaurant than outside at 85 so I got it to go. Only to find that they apparently don't include utensils for the pasta. Took nearly 28 minutes to get my order out. Truly a disappointing experience.
Do you like noodles, pho, or deliciously marinaded stir fried chicken? Great! Eat here and stop guessing. Gotta catch them at lunch but worth it.

The service was great..super fast..so thwts why i gave it an extra star but tge food wss just ok...no frills or anything special about this place...especially the taste.  I would come back for the roast duck but that's ,about it.  The chow mein, beef broccoli and cashew chicken all tasted exactly the same...was disappointed about that.

The owner here is so friendly and is always present in the store which is so nice to see. He does a lot for the community too. The pizza is tasty and we have also enojyed some other menu items here like chicken fingers and a tuna sub.

The food is always on point but the service is slowly but surely on a downwards spiral.  When I first came here everything and everybody were do nice.  But now the rudeness is out of hand.  There was no one there but me and a friend and I was still rushed to get my order in.  And why can't I choose from one of the 14 beers?  The guy said only four are in stock..
Bibimbot kalbi style + spicy wings + BYOB = a good ass meal. Food is top notch. Nuff said.
Larry's Ice Cream & Gelatos was to live for!! The gelato was creamy and delicious! I highly recommend this place. The service was great and there was outdoor seating :)
It is 1200 on a Tuesday, they are not open, no closed sign. This restaurant is in utter disrepair and disgusting. I have came here once before and felt filthy leaving.

Best in town, the only place I know of in south Florida to get an italian combo. I have been looking for a place like this in florida for years. The decor isn't anything special, but it's right in Ybor and the staff is super nice, can't beat it.

I want to like the restaurant as its literally in my back yard however I have been here many times and have left disappointed every single time. The food is expensive and not of good quality. Ive had sandwich and burgers all which has way to much bread to meat ratios, there drinks are watered down too. Ive had lots of different pasties out of there window and all have been bland and stale. I did have the Hazelnut iced coffee once and it was good. Im also not a fan of the indoor seating, but the outside patio sits on Dakota right in Hyde Park village so its a nice area to people watch.

With the addition of hot new Chef Francisco Pomalaza, Timpano has changed my mind. Outstanding service paired with thoughtfully curated dishes have won me over. Their mussels served dry are life changing. No sauce necessary. The tuna carpaccio is also a must order. So bright and fantastic citrus notes--it's a Rock Paper Scissors situation for who's getting the last bite. Moving on to the Fiocchi--pear and pecorino stuffed sachets of deliciousness that were cooked al dente. Wonderful! And capped off with the osso bucco & veal glazed mushrooms--it was a meal to remember. The osso bucco was fork tender and that risotto underneath still has me salivating. Do yourself a favor and go check out the new revamped menu. Chef Cisco has done magic on this place.

Before I start I should probably tell you I'm from Jersey and pretty partial to diners. Hollywood Grill is a pretty good diner and has gotten better since they've expanded a bit. The breakfast portions are pretty large is pretty good. The service is great, but the waitstaff seems to be put through their paces when it's busy and may forget a thing or two with your order... a couple times, so just make sure you check.

Wife and I had an outstanding meal at The Dandelion this weekend. The environment is all that of a meal at a cozy row home in London, though I have never been.  The roasted brussel sprouts were amazing as was the fish and chips.  My wife thoroughly enjoyed her steam and chips as well.  A great beer and drink selection round things out nicely.  The great thing about Stephen Starr is that you really cannot go wrong. He nails it every time.

Finally had a chance to come try this place out.  First trip I assumed since it was a  bakery they would have items out fresh in the morning so I came around 9:30am. Was disappointed to see barely anything set out. Most was prob leftovers. When asked if they Would be setting out more was told they were being baked atm. So I only picked up a few items and left. 

2nd trip decided to come later in  the day and the selection was much  better.  The hubs who was skeptical at first enjoyed the items and when the egg tarts are good that means its a good bakery.  We shall be back. Too bad it's too far from us we would go more often

We stopped in for lunch to try Convivio for the first time and found the place to be a bit overly cramped with the seating very jammed in so you have little space between tables, which took from the dinning experience.  I realize they have a limited area but it is hard to relax and enjoy a meal when everyone is so crowded together.  The food was OK, but bland, and not what I would expect from a place specializing in Italian food.  The Margherita pizza was very disappointing.  The crust seemed to be from frozen dough or at least very in advance premade dough and was not crisp.   There was no fresh mozzarella, it was a bland cheese pizza one would get at a mid-stream to below average pizzeria, with a few basil leaves thrown on it to try to justify its name.  The sauce was extra bland.  The bruschetta was also bland and the toasted bread was a bit underdone.  We also tried the meatball appetizer, which was probably the best part of the meal and the sauce was good but the meat balls had too much bread crumb content.  The service was good but not great. Overall, I doubt we will be back, there are too many other Italian options nearby that are much better.
Very good food for the price! The Sushi is always fresh and cold! I always come during peak times so the food is well rotated. Just guard your plate because the servers will snatch it from you.

This is a great local Chinese restaurant. They also serve Vietnamese and sushi but would not recommend those cuisines. Their soups are good as well as all ingredients are fresh. We love the hot and sour soup and triple delight

Food was really good (coffee was awesome) you can tell they use quality ingredients. Like others have mentioned, it's really small and kinda awkward to walk into. One small thing, we were a little surprised that they didn't have ketchup.
Really good boba tea. I recommend trying it Atleast once. It's a dessert tea. I could t drink it everyday because like i said it's a dessert tea. But it's great tasting.

I must agree with everyone else this is the worst Taco Bell that I have ever been to. The staff is awful. The slowest service ever. If there is more than one car in the drive thru forget it.  Minimum 20 minutes.

Taking a break from Philly cheese steaks during our extended weekend in  Pennsylvania, friends of ours invited us out for dinner at Limoncello in West Chester.  How'd I like things?

They started us out with  a tomato and cheese bruschetta, which were pretty good!  Orders came next, and I decided on their Margherita personal pizza ($14)

Less is more with this pizza, being topped with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil, the pizza was almost too pretty to eat, but eat it I did!

Thin crust, the pizza crust was really crispy, which is what I like, but sadly, the flavor really wasn't there, at least not like other Margherita pizzas i've had in the past.

Serving size of everything that hit the table were great for the price, and customer service was ridiculously helpful. 

There is street parking here, but there's a few lots around that you can pay for a few dollars as well.  If you're just coming to dine, i'd recommend trying to find some street parking before you pay for a parking lot.

Great ambiance, really nice food presentation, but flavors, at least for me, missed the mark.  But tell me what you think!

Amazing food, suggest everyone should try this new Vietnamese place out! Bun bo hue is full of delicious meat. The banh mi is very tasty as well. I suggest the pork! Will be back to try everything else out

This location has restored my faith in the franchise. When I give this location four stars, it doesn't mean this is the best food in Nashville. It means this location does exactly what a McDonald's is supposed to do. The staff is friendly and jovial every time. In six recent visits I have never received an incorrect order or poorly-presented food. The place is almost always busy but service is consistently prompt, with little to no wait time. Keep doing what you're doing!

Good food, good drinks, and good music.  The front desk guy at my hotel told me to stop by here.  He was right. The raw oysters were great - plenty of liquor.  They overcooked our grilled oysters, but admitted it without our asking and gave us another order asap.  Couldn't have handled the situation better.

My po'boy was great, the two guys who got the fish tacos loved them, and our last guest ordered the seafood combo platter and WOW, tons of food.  Things are a bit spicy, so keep that in mind.  

All in all, if I lived here, I would bring my out of town guests any time.

People have complained about the restrooms, and I guess that's valid.  I won't take a star away because this is a dive bar, and if you're really worried about the restrooms at a dive bar you have bigger problems.

We have enjoyed Stanley for many years.  The location right along Jackson Square is great.  There can often be a wait, check in on Yelp and enjoy a drink in the adjacent togo bar.  We always order the Breaux Bridge Benedict and must say the portion and presentation has declined over the years.  Frankly, the third star was for previous visits, the lack of a fourth or fifth star was due to the constant up sell attempts by the server.  After we ordered our Bloody Marys the server offered Tito's, Absolut, or Ketel.  Knowing this was not a well I asked for the well and got a depressed look in return.  Again she tried to mislead the size of the drink by asking if I wanted one the size of my water glass, which I already knew was a medium, and not the small which I had intended.  Not a fan of the deceptive behavior and can't imagine how the bill climbs on the uninformed.

Excellent Italian food! Fabulous service! The atmosphere is that of a very nice Italian sandwich/pizza restaurant. Extremely clean, too. Nice location in Lansdale with plenty of parking.  My husband and I were in the mood for Italian sandwiches and were very happy with this great find. One of the best Italian sandwiches I've ever had! Overall, a simply fabulous experience.

We decided to give this place a try because our favorite place was closed. There was nobody in line waiting but we still had to wait several minutes to be seated. Once seated we waited several more minutes for someone to take our order but nobody ever came. So we left. The restaurant felt dirty but had quite a few customers. Needless to say, we won't go back here. First impressions mean a lot.
The pork is amazing, so tender and spicy sweet, just what you want.

FINDING THIS PLACE: 
I would have never found out about this place if it wasn't for a local business owner who recommended it.  I was craving some Chinese food and when I made mention of it while dining elsewhere. I was approached by the owner of the other restaurant and he ask me a few questions about things I enjoyed and he pointed out the things he liked.  When I tried the food I will say that it had be returning again and again.  This is the closest thing I have had to New York style Chinese food.  I have tried a lot of places here locally and I have been greatly disappointed

APPEARANCE:  
I have to agree with another reviewer when they pointed out that the boxes in this restaurant do detract from the overall feel of the place.  This is not an excuse but, the flavor of the food is such that I find it simple to overlook this blemish. Although I have never actually seen anyone cleaning the dining area, it has always been free residual left behind by other patrons. Tables and floors have never been found to be sticky or trash-filled.  This goes a long way with me.

MY ORDER: 
I usually get the Bourbon Chicken and the Teriyaki Chicken, in case my readers wondered what I felt was so delightful.

PRICES: 
I feel that the prices here are competitive... no worse or better than you would find elsewhere.

PARKING: 
China Taste shares the parking lot with several businesses, including Publix, so there is never a parking issue.

STAFF:  
I have always ben treated in a professional manner and the service from the employees has always been nothing less than prompt. THAT is very appreciated.

CONVENIENCE: 
I do like that I can place an order and go over and shop at Pubilx, then return and  pick it up my meal before heading home. 

END GAME: 
I often get in a rut and find myself always ordeing the same thing over an over.  This needs to stop.  I just read Tom A's review of the Chicken and Broccoli... Perhaps that will be my next meal there.  

PERSONAL NOTE: Keep up the good work China Taste... and Thank You.

True gem! I've lived in (and frequented the best restaurants) Nyc for years and travel a decent amount for work. Been to Indy only twice now and found Union on an eater list. Everything was absolutely delicious. I had the baby kale salad with banana croutons- simple yet unexpected and so good. Followed up with the squash vegetarian main dish which was easily the best veggie dish I've had ever. Wow. Go Indy!
Not only were they disgusting but they didn't take my order meanwhile I was The only customer in the store and drive through. Absolutely horrible service.

Today, devastation hit our house. We were told our family pet had to be put down.I went to the kids school to pick them up early so they could go to the veterinary hospital and say their goodbyes. The hospital told us we could bring our dog a hamburger and I saw Freddys steakburgers and thought to myself I want her to go out with a great meal in her belly-And what could be better than steak burgers. I had just broke the news to the kids and my son was beside himself. Nothing hurts worse in the world than watching your kids suffer. I tried  to hold it together to order a double burger plain for my dog and felt the need to explain why I was a blubbering idiot.By the time we got to the front window the cashier, who was beyond wonderful told us that the burger was on them and threw in some coupons. At a time when we felt the most broken and in a world full of uncertainty and bad things at every turn, it was a real breath of fresh air to witness such humanity at a time of need! This is our faja enjoying her last meal.

I like Port of Subs and this location has friendly service and the food is good.  It's better than Subway but I would recommend asking for double meet.  Prices are a little high for what you get, but the quality is there.

The only problem I would have is when it's busy they really do run slow.  So if your in a hurry call ahead, otherwise it's a great place to get a sub sandwich.

First, we walked in and wasn't greeted by anyone. It wasn't very busy either. The two hosts saw us walked in looked at us and turned around to do other things before greeting or sitting us. I understand if it was busy and they were rushing to finish other stuff, but it was 4:05 pm and half the restaurant was empty. After 5 minutes, someone came up and sat us but giving us a nasty look. The man behind us got greeted in a friendly way and sat immediately. 
Second, I came in with two other friends and we got exactly three small clumps of bread to share amongst three people. 
Third, the food was mediocre for the price.

WARNING LONG POST AHEAD! :-) Our night was a disaster. Much to our dismay our group of 7 could've made out better eating at the Wendy's next door than dining at Goozy. Arrived at 6:30pm for a friend's bday celebration and a couple minutes in two ladies sitting next to us whispered in my friends ear that they hoped we would actually get our food tonight. Apparently they ordered a cheese plate, drinks (which one of the ladies asked for a refill on her wine that never came) and they also ordered dessert and THAT never came, so they left. Now stay with me it gets better!

We started to worry, and was it warranted! Our sandwiches took 40 minutes for us to get. Sandwiches. A Tuesday night. One of my friends orders was wrong (it happens) and she had to wait another 20 minutes for a BLTC with no cheese! How hard is it to put together such a thing? And another warning: do not get a side salad instead of chips bc all it is-is a spring mix with dressing drizzled on it.... No tomatoes, no cheese, not a single crouton, just lettuce. For a 2 dollar up charge! I would've much rather stuck with the chips and just not have eaten them which is basically what I did with the salad. And my friend and I both ordered the BLTC and there was no "L" on either of ours.... No one had much to say about their dinners. Honestly nothing special. Oh and we ordered dessert in the middle of eating bc we knew we'd have to wait... 

We didn't get our desserts until after 8. Most of them were good. The lemon pudding one was our least favorite. I only ordered gelato... As I was getting near the bottom there was a HUGE long piece of straight hair in it that I coincidentally was pulling out of my mouth as the server came up to our table. Thankfully our server handled that well and didn't charge me for it.

The bread pudding came out with no gelato or syrup on it so we had to track down someone to ask for that. It was just a mess. How do you forget two main ingredients on a dessert at a place known for desserts? 

It's a small place and the tables became full after we ordered yet we were the last ones to get anything. Just seemed very disorganized. Our waitress was nice and apologetic to us after one of my friends finally spoke up bc not only did we wait on our food, but we waited forever for our checks. It was just one disaster after another. 

To make things go a little quicker we decided to each go up one by one to the counter and pay for our meal individually. Another friend was up there and the waitress was ringing her up; meanwhile, the manager (we didn't know she was the manager) asked how everything was- my friend just said "ok" then proceeded to talk to the waitress who was again apologizing... My friend was saying to the waitress that it was just a shame bc we had high hopes for the place. Then the manager got snippy with my friend saying- "Wait a minute, you just told me everything was ok and now you're saying it wasn't?! I need to know these things...." Not sure what else was said exactly, but she was rude to my friend and did not show good customer service. 

Sorry for the long post! So much went on that I just had to get it all out :) it's safe to say that we will not be returning to Goozy.

One of my favourite places to stop for lunch in the South. I get the Jerk Chicken and its the best ever. The portions are large and your licking your plate clean. Also get the beef patty I think it is, cant remember. Even that was fantastic so good it wiped my memory. You are so full after you finished your meal. The staff is super friendly, love to talk.  Its very inviting. The issue is it is by two highschools so it can get pretty packed. If you can go a little early I would recommend it.

This place is amazing! The food is good and the staff is amazing! Everyone is super friendly and fast! I work across the street so sometimes I have multiple orders and payments, and its always a breeze to check out, never a problem! If you come at a prime dining hour, you may have to wait in a line thats out the door, but trust me it is sooo worth it!

I work across the street from here so I come here often. Their sandwiches are delicious - and by delicious I mean I get cravings for their(I never crave sandwiches). The food is fresh, they have a lot of options and a lot of options that aren't just your usual "club sandwich". Vegans!- this place is excellent for you the vegetarian section of the menu has an icon next to it for anything that can be made vegan. The reason it's 4 stars and not 5 is because there is a little wait so expect that. Especially around lunch time there's going to be a crowd. If you have the time though it's totally worth it!

We ordered takeout the other night here and I was not impressed. Since we just had takeout this review will only be about the food. 

Pepperoni breadsticks were ok just a little greasy. They are large and heavy. 

I had chicken Alfredo and it was pretty awful. The sauce was thin which leads me to believe that it was canned or more than likely had too much heavy cream and too little Parmesan. It was not rich and creamy just like noodles soaked in coffee creamer. 

My wife had the tortellini. It was definitely frozen probably Sysco. Not much to say. 

Kids had a small pizza. It was over cooked but tasted ok. 

Food was a lot pricier than I was expecting. 

In all honesty I will not go back.

A delicious, quick, banh mi spot perfect for meat eaters and vegetarians alike. The ingredients always taste fresh and service is fast and friendly. My personal favorite is the lemongrass banh mi (vegetarian) but the chicken banh mi is the most popular amongst my friends.There is very limited seating inside, so be ready to take your order to go!

The food is delicious and the service is fast I really like it there. It is all really authentic and I have only had wonderful experiences there. It had a menu that anyone would like and has a great decor.

Sample ale flight a fun indulgence.  Mushroom Toast a yummy starter. Rich and buttery. Generous Roquefort salad, not shy with the Roquefort. Popular and tasty turkey pot pie. Wonderful comfort food. Brook Trout well rounded with veggies and grains. Authentic not touristy feel. High quality food. Benjamin, our server, was gracious and attentive. Recommend!  Would definitely return.

We love Orchid's sushi, we always find the fish to be so fresh along with the sushi chef also being ever so kind and greeting us. The prices are most certainly a LOT cheaper than most places in Nashville. So we highly recommend this to anyone looking for a bite of sushi.

They are dog friendly and outside seating which is really nice overlooking saguaro national park. Do used to have a great all he tuna sandwich they did away with, I don't eat red meat there's not much for vegetarian's. Hope they bring the tuna sandwich back. Service is fantastic sometimes parking is a challenge but always found a parking spot. I would highly recommend if you're a mediator this might be the restaurant for you.

Great beer selection of course. It doesn't get any better than the beer bible that they present to you. Its like Disney World for the beer lover.
Food.....its good. I mean.....its great. But......isnt  there anything else from Belgium that can be represented other than the one or two authentic Belgian items? I mean, the other Belgian place in Philly (Monk's) is the same way, so I dont have much to compare it to. I've never been to Belgium so its not really my realm. The food is great, and theres a beer style for everyone, with literally hundreds of haunting flavors throughout that brew menu for you to explore. But Im seriously looking for the Anthony Bourdain experience here. Weird me out, PLEASE! I want something new and different, instead of seeing mussels and burgers as the poplular fare.
Perfect for a quick, cheap, and filling breakfast after a night out. Convenient and in walking distance of Rowan's campus. I wouldn't go there for anything but breakfast though.

Absolute deliciousness!! Came to eat on our last night here and so glad we did! Our server, Cassidy, was wonderful! She recommended dishes that truly did not disappoint and was so good with our two little boys. The guacamole is the best I've had in years! Every single dish we ordered was just delicious! Highly recommend it!
slightly expensive for the quality and portion of food, but it's alright overall, the chicken bowl is pretty good

Mediocre at best. Tibby's was a disappointment. The entire restaurant was unbearably loud. My husband and I had to shout to each other to be heard. Our waitress asked us to repeat almost everything we said. We both ordered Shrimp Creole. The menu described it as large,natural shrimp.  However, what we received was more along the lines of the $5 bag of frozen shrimp from Walmart.  The rice was terrible and reminded me of boil-in-a-bag or microwavable rice.  The dish was quite bland and easily forgettable. The service matched the meal. My husband finished his drink before the meal was served. Halfway through, I went to the bar to ask for a refill for him. The food runner who delivered our food must have ran through an obstacle course as my food had skilled over the large rim of the bowl and onto his tray.

Don't order online here unless you like to get random toppings on your pizza. Ordered spinach and pepperoni papdia and got sausage and green peppers - ordered a small pizza with black olives, green peppers, Canadian bacon and mushrooms - got a sausage pizza with green peppers and no sauce. 

Go here if you're just not sure what kind of pizza you want and just let the staff decide!
First few dinners there were excellent, then Chef changes and not so good. Now another Chef change and at the price level reluctant to try again.
Just tried this place for the first time and would say it was good, but wasn't impressed with the Grouper sandwich.

I love this place. A cool, dark respite from the Arizona sun with a slightly goth vibe. Very friendly staff and a television over the bar that plays horror movies all day and night. Good drink prices, pool tables, and all kinds of creepy but fun decorations. Apparently they host burlesque shows and other special events. I can't wait to go back.
Absolutely authentic Colombian food! The Arepas were so juicy and the repostería... finger licking good! You must come and try their food, you will not regret it!
Amazing place.  Great food friendly service and reasonable prices. Number one breakfast spot

This is a chain restaurant which is below par in terms of quality & service. Their food is stale & not fresh. We ordered their Chicken Biriyani & Chili Paneer with Noodles. The glasses & plates had a bad odor owing to it being cleaned with a damp cloth but adjustable considering i regardless wipe my plates with a wet wipe. Food arrived in 6 minutes shocked but happy as myself & my wife was starving. The Chili Paneer was Paneer just put in a hot wok with some chili sauce when in reality that is how we make it was not given any time to suck in the flavor. The biriyani was basically rice & a piece of chicken put later in it.  To summarize everything was a drag & tasted horrible. The supervisor or the lanky gentlemen who apparently controls the operation noticing we haven't ate anything inquired what might be the reason on our response his agitated comeback was this our cuisine & everyone likes it maybe this flavor is not our cup of tea. Well looks like it is & wont be heading there soon. Reminder this was our 3rd time there & all the previous visits was consistently bad. Please give the Dosa nights on Thursdays a miss as they are leftover Dosa mix from the previous 5 days which they cant keep further as it is will be too sour & which you will notice is almost unedible on Thursday. 
Cleanliness - 2
Ambiance - 3
Service - 2 
Quality - 1
Size - 3

They were recently shut down for 2 weeks on inquiring i was told their AC wasn't functioning but the reason was not that but something with regard to fines (Not Municipal) but i don't want to say it here owing to it having nothing to do what the whole purpose of this review is.

Jasmine deserves a raise!!!! She delivered the food while we were moving furniture into the apartment and she helped us carry in the heavy stuff and was super friendly about it. So above and beyond customer service! Thank you Jasmine!!!!!

My fiance and I are new to the Oldsmar area, so we've been checking out different restaurants in the area to try and find our new favorite. We stopped by here on a Saturday evening and it was actually really slow. We were in around 6:30 and it wasn't even half full, which was surprising because the place next door had tons of people outside on the patio and waiting to get inside.

One thing I did like was Salt Rock's extensive beer selection. They had quite a few beers on tap, and I tried one from Miami Brewing Company that had a mango flavor that I really enjoyed. I opted to get the Oldsmar Bacon Burger with truffle Parmesan fries. I thought the burger was decent, but I got no flavor of truffle or Parmesan with the fries. Not sure if they brought my regular ones by mistake or what, but they weren't that great. My fiance got the Shrimp and Grits and was expecting, ya know, shrimp and grits (according to the description in menu). But got a bunch of peppers and onions in addition (which was not indicated in the menu), and he does not like either of them. So he had to pick through everything to get all the peppers and onions out of the grits. That was pretty disappointing.

Overall this place has a pretty decent vibe, and the wait staff is very friendly. I have heard that the Sunday brunch is really good so we might come back and try that. But my only suggestion to them would be to indicate on the menu if there are additional ingredients in certain dishes so customers can be fully aware of what they're ordering.
Been here a few times.  Food is excellent. Great staff. I got the seafood pasta  went back a few nights later and has the spare ribs.

I circled around this place and finally found it, talk about being elusive. Opens 24-hour is just awesome, unheard of in where I live. Adequate selection, not great, I'm spoilt living in CA. 
Lots of outlet to charge your devices. Aromatic cigarette smoke sweetened the air. Price is okay.

Went the other night and it seems where the Covid has destroyed buffets this has actually improved their operations !

The fresh piling hot pizza was behind glass with a spunky helpful server to place what ever you wanted on your plate .   Salads were remade icy cold fresh and crunchy truly delicious .   Tables were spaced place was immaculate truly better than before !   Hope they continue to succeed !

Wow.  Hungry kid and it took over two hours and two minutes gone calls to get a pizza delivered.  We live about two miles away.  

We were literally going to be when it finally arrived.  I am beyond disappointed.  This is a staffing and management issue.  I paid 50 plus to wait this long for a barely warm pizza that the app said was a n the delivery process for over an hour and a half.  How is that possible?  

Dominoes you are fired.
Fun time good food.   Beers are still in the works, but worth a visit.  Enjoyed their fries and the cider mix was delicious

I never wrote any review for any restaurant before, but for Amalia's cafe I'm doing it. 

I love this place !!!  A very friendly ambiance. I love the people over there. 

I went there several times, I used to eat and enjoy Falafel (sandwich or platters) and the Middle Eastern cookie or the delicious tiramisu  cake (Yes ! the tiramisu is amazing !! )

I recommend this restaurant for all people (Family, group of friends or lovers).

We finally have a great Middle Eastern restaurant in south Philly !!!

We returned to Pia's again on this trip...twice.  First time we stopped in for a glass of wine and stayed for another fab dinner...we tried the gnocchi appetizer and scallop entree specials. The owner introduced us to a new yummy red wine and discounted the bottle since it was new to the list. The owner and staff were friendly and attentive. The second visit was nice...Pia seated us and brought us the wine list. We enjoyed the mussels and a glass of wine...all tasty.  One issue....bartender handed us our check without offering us another beverage or dessert, felt a bit offensive.....

The food was delicious, we also had the monkey bread, I didn't get a picture of it because my boyfriend had 1/2 of it gone by the time I got the phone out because he liked it so much. Definitely worth a stop if you are in the area!
I take this everyday twice a day...uggg!!!  It's not that bad though, I can do at least 30mph at 5pm and that's flying compared to LA standards.

STOP!!! Lord have mercy!!! Please avoid this place. I have been to many of the establishments even in south Florida to the one in Brandon which me and my family LOVE and I'm trying to find the GOOD in anything I just experienced. First of all the unfriendly customer service by the Asian guy was kinda a shocked knowing everything that's going on in the world you would think he would want business but NO! It seemed that I was bothering him by ordering my food. The prices are a bit expensive for what you get if you ask me. I ordered a lb of snow crab legs first of all..FIRST OF ALL it was a mess the bag was not good. The corn was probably the best thing in the bag I thought it came with shrimp for the price. A complete rip-off it's cheaper to go to publix or Winn Dixie and order from the seafood part. I will NOT be back. Especially at this location AVOID AVOID AVOID

Walked in for an early dinner.   Updated Asian décor.
Large restaurant was empty at 6:30 on Saturday night.  Okay, no big deal.

We started with the tea smoked baby spare ribs, and that was the best thing.  Might even go back there just to take some out.

For the rest of the meal we had  Happy Four (shrimp, beef, scallops, chicken)  no biggy.
Chicken and Cashews, ok. You can get this anywhere.  Pad Thai Chicken.  Again, anywhere the way this was made.
Basil and Veg fried rice.  The rice was fried?  More like white rice with additions.

The food was okay.  I think we had too much chicken on the table for my taste.
The negatives were the attitude of staff.  Snobby?  Off Standish?  Condescending?  Can't place my finger on it.  May have just been our waiter?

Had to ask for water, duck sauce, refills on tea.....

By the time we left at 8:30 more tables were taken, but the place was not full.

They have two large separate rooms with doors that can be closed for parties of  8to about 12 people???  That might be a plus to some.

I usually don't write reviews unless it's a highly positive or negative experience. In this case, I'd love to make note of the Honor Bar's service. I've been here a handful of times since its opening, and have had nothing but pleasant experiences throughout. Tonight, I came for dinner. My favorites here are the burger, French dip, and Thai steak noodle salad. 

Tonight, I ordered the burger, but I like to request the coleslaw that's usually in the burger, on the side. It's great slaw, but I find it cools down the burger quicker than I enjoy it. When it arrives the slaw was on the burger as well as a separate side. I mentioned this to our server, Ben, and he was quick to correct the mistake. Just a couple minutes later, the manager or maitre'd came to our table about the slaw. This was a very easily misunderstood error, and was perfectly fine with me- but when the bill arrived they took off the entire burger! 

The Honor Bar went above and beyond my expectations and I will continue to bring them my service. Check them out!

santa barbara shellfish company wow great seafood very fresh and tasty try the uni with scallops wow the uni was really fresh still alive and moving on top of the fresh scallops wow some thing u must try it was so good that i end up getting 2 uni the grill lobsters wow fresh from the water then grilled some tasty stuff very very tasty the steamers clams wow also really fresh and tasty plus they got a good selection of craft beers check them out santa barbara shell fish company good eats yelp on yelpers
Arrived around 5:15 for a drink and quick dinner before an evening meeting - great service, delicious entrees and the half-price drinks made for a five star early dinner.

Only giving this place a 1 star as a zero is not allowed.  Ordered online on 9/19 and arrived to learn they were closed.  Okay, I get it --- Lack of help and that is a very sad state of the economy, but not any fault of Burger King Fishers.  

Two days later and my over $12 visa charge remains.  Called the location directly and was told to work with the third party administrator I ordered through.  I ordered on Burgerking.com.  Should they not take care of my credit... automatically without my calling????     Yep, I was irritated and was told by the person I was talking with that she told me how to handle it three times.  Wow, not impressed.  So, she hung up on me..

Called Burger King corporate --- never offered an apology but assured me I would have a credit.

Called my credit card, and first off, offered an apology for the issue and she assured me I had a credit.

Sorry folks --- know it sucks out there, but if you don't take care of your paying customers you won't be in business much longer.

I was looking for place close to hotel where I could get a fun drink and dinner. The moonshine comes in many different flavored and drinks were perfect for hot summer evening. Our dinner was served quickly and waiter continually checked on us. Ribs were different from what we had expected but were good. Atmosphere was unique casual and fun
dined in the first weekend it opened and have ordered 3 times since then for take out. each time there was an issue with food items being messed up or missing. now my guac is bad. not good svc.

I went there with a group of friends  for lunch this week. Great food, great atmosphere, great service, I love this place. I've been to this restaurant to see the jazz on the lower level and it was a great experience.

This place looks like a dive from the outside and a bit form the inside but they put a lot of energy where it really counts in putting out some flavorful food.  I usually stick with some standard simple dishes when exploring a new Thai place and they delivered with a nice coconut soup and decently spiced drunken noodles.  The service was adequate and they kept my drink filled.  Overall it was some decent Thai food at around the current price point most of the other places are running.  Overall it is a decent place on the Wank to grab some Thai food.

Came on 10-26-2015 - Monday Nite football.  Service was terrible - a bunch of people filled the bar while the game was on- suddenly we noticed people leaving.  That was about the same time the waitresses were seen on their cellphones and just standing around talking to each other-then they got our draft beers wrong.  The bar emptied - in the third quarter.  Then we were told the Miller Lite on draft ran out!  Then we were told the waitress messed up the bill.  Wwwhhaaat??
It's just too bad - the bar is nice - and they got like 15 TV screens.  It's is mismanaged!

We try and brunch here as much as possible.  The mega-mimosa is awesome as is are the Bloody Mary's.  Their food is absolutely delicious...from the Southwestern Omelet to the Salmon - you cannot go wrong.

We had a Groupon so my wife and I went for an early Greek dinner. Hostess was friendly and sat us right away. The booth was clean and comfortable. The first negative was the fact that the menus had crayon and dried food all over them. Service was really good and the server seemed very knowledgable of the menu even though, as we found out, she was fairly new.  

For drinks throughout dinner I had the Zeus Red beer and the Zeus-a-rita. I thought both were outstanding!

We started with the calamari. It was possibly the best calamari I've had. Lightly battered and fried perfectly so that it retained a bit of the chewiness of calamari without being tough. It was served with a cocktail sauce and a very good tzatziki. A good start to the meal. 

The entrees came out and they were huge! I had ordered the lamb and beef souvlaki which came with roasted lemon potatoes, vegetables, rice and pita bread. The skewers of lamb and beef were cooked perfectly to the point of melting in your mouth. The sides were also good but there was SO much food it was a little overwhelming. A good thing if you like leftovers. My wife ordered the lamb chops with the same sides. Her lamb was a little fatty but cooked to perfection.

For dessert we ordered the baklava and greek parfait but our server told us they no longer had the greek parfait. No problem, we'll have the baklava cheesecake instead. A couple minutes later the server returned to let us know they were out of the cheesecake as well. To their credit, they comped us a chocolate cake dessert to make up for it. The baklava and chocolate cake were pretty good. Not crazy good but pretty good.

Overall, a pretty good experience. We would definitely do it again. Opa!

Having lived in Hawaii and California I tend to have high expectations when it comes to sushi. That being said Chiba is okay.  We dined here for an early dinner and ordered off the happy hour menu. Prices were cheap for many items.  The catch? Some portions are small. The California roll $3 looked like one roll was cut in half to make two.  Very well then, we ordered four California rolls. It might have been six, we lost count. We tried the steamed buns with chicken katsu, ribs and duck.  It was also cut in half. They were pretty much bite size apps. The chicken katsu was the best.  Side note: Steam buns or bao is a Chinese dish served with duck. Good fusion idea I suppose. The sashimi trio $8 consisted on three small pieces of fish (salmon, ahi, and yellow tail.). I wouldn't recommend the sashimi trio. The avocado cucumber roll was good but also small.  The steak yakitori was okay. The marinade was a bit overwhelming for me. It would make a good rice bowl. The highlight of dinner was the blueberry tempura bread pudding. Sake was okay. I think next time we'll try ordering off the main menu. 3 1/2 Stars!

We loved this!  The food is amazing.  Prices are phenomenal - I had the stuffed chicken breast.  Just fabulous. 

Atmosphere is great.  Fun to look out over the airport.
I will be back

I've tried most of the burgers on their menu and this is by far my favorite burger place in St. Pete. I moved from Chicago where there is some amazing food and I'd say Engine No 9 burgers could win in a contest!

Armella
3 mins · Edited · 


.

Went to dinner last night at Grapeseed on Macklind. I was disappointed. Front staff/owner was unwilling to seat us at a table for 5/6. They wouldn't join 2 tables and the only available was not being offered to us until our 6th person showed up. We were offered a table in the bar in front of the door. No reservations are taken, and even though we were the 2nd party to show up when the doors opened with 5 of our 6party, our request to be seated early so we could order drinks and appetizers were ignored.. When we did get seated, the waiter was good.  Not a good venue for conversation- it was very loud. Food was average, appetizer Parmesan puff with local mushrooms came out cold, Shrimp and gits were tasty, but should be served with an extra plate for shells and shrimp heads,  and he forgot our ordered dessert-a flourless chocolate cake. I had 1 cider and my bill was $46.25.  I am reviewing for myself, but  I am pretty sure all the others will not return.

Ok. As a pizza lover here they do it right.  I've ordered to pick up a couple of times and the pizza has been flawless. Let me be clear the pizza is great. From the brick pizza to the ny and there appetizers. Fried cheese ravioli to there Nutella pie.  Oh boy so good.  

Now for my only complaint are the Flies, I'm cool with swatting 1 fly away but multiple.  My wife doesn't want to eat in house because of this. We have been there twice with family and friends and it's the same deal.  Please fix this and you will get my 5 .   

Let me say it again the pizza and appetizers are really great.

OMG best donuts anywhere. If you love donuts worth at least an hour drive. They've been around forever. Sweet fresh wonderfulness. Great coffee. One of my students works there and they even think it's great! The chocolate cake with chocolate icing is mind numbing. Please go and get at least a dozen. Very reasonable and they have killer coffee. This is donut Nirvana !! I forgot... the jelly stick is sick!!! eat it at your own risk.
Good food Best tacos home made tortillas and the fresco natural fruit waters is a bomb

The Brunchery, Valrico
Still an excellent spot for breakfast.  But I'd like to leave a note of suggestion to the owner Kevyn Farley.
I came in today for breakfast, the selection of which I thought would be new and exciting , if not adventurous.  I saw the ham & cheddar" crepes on the menu board.  So that's what I ordered. What I got was nicely prepared crepes as described but it was served with a "honey-mustard" sauce.  Couldn't eat it!  So I sent it back.  The server returned a short time later with what looked like what I ordered but after the first bite it was apparent that someone had merely scraped off the honey-mustard sauce and sent it back for me to eat; thinking perhaps I wouldn't notice.  I did.  I then asked for a couple of scrambled eggs and that was that.  A word to the owner about "culinary license". All you had to do is list the crepe selection as "served with a honey-mustard sauce" and I would've picked something else.  I sure that the crepes as you served them represents an "avant garde" breakfast offering but it was an unpleasant surprise to me...  I remain a loyal customer and regard your restaurant as an excellent breakfast spot but hope you will take this friendly criticism in the spirit in which it is offered.

Used the Yelp app and found this gem. 
High standards met. Easy menu very fast service conveniently close by with plenty of outdoor clean picnic table seating, food was spot on. I'm sure all the other reviews have equally conveyed the same sentiment. Restroom was clean and stocked. My new favorite place in ballast point. 

Food 5
Ambiance 5
Service 5
Location 5
Value 5

1/21

This restaurant is located in a strip mall area with shared parking. It was tough finding a parking place but we didn't have to walk too far.  Craft Street Kitchen had a great covered patio area for outside diners with heaters for colder evenings.  We had a table indoors, however.

We were seated right away at a table for two. Interesting bar/restaurant combo. They had high-top bar tables or regular table and chairs. The place was busy. Our waitress, Rachel, was awesome. Quick to our table to take our drink orders. She reviewed the beers with my husband which included a variety of craft beers.

I ordered the "Not Your Mamas Meatloaf" ($13.95) - it was AMAZING!! Served with honey glazed carrots and mashed skin-on potatoes, I was extremely pleased with my choice. Hubby selected the Angry Pig sandwich - their version of pulled pork with coleslaw and fried pickles on it. It was served with potato salad. Hubby said the potato salad was excellent. I had a taste of his BBQ but wasn't thrilled with the flavor. He said it "grew on him" as he kept eating.

The manager came to our table to check on our meal. When she found out is was our first visit to Craft Street Kitchen, she brought us a certificate for a free appetizer for our next visit. Sweet!  Overall, our total bill came to right at $33 with the two entrees, a beer and soda. Reasonably priced, in my opinion.  We will definitely return (Gotta cash in that appetizer certificate).

One of the worst bars I've ever been to.... if I could give them zero stars I would. Drinks were horrible and the people who worked there were extremely disrespectful especially to women (the owner and a bouncer with a bald head). Save your time and money! DON'T GO TO THIS PLACE!

Great ambience, the food is delicious, and the location is convenient. We absolutely loved the pork belly French fries. My lamb sandwich was also very delicious. I was pleasantly surprised. We can't wait to go back for the chef's specialty.

My girlfriend and I went to lunch here on a Thursday, brought a bottle of wine, and sat in the little outdoor seating area on a beautiful day.  

The shrimp ceviche we shared for an appetizer was DELICIOUS, served with plantain chips and popcorn, which our waitress told us to toss into the ceviche as we were spooning it up.  YUM!

We each had a salad for lunch, mine with grilled, marinated shrimp, and my friend's with lump crabmeat.  Both salads had delicious homemade dressings (perfect portion drizzled over the top) and were plated nicely.

The breadbasket which I usually say no to came with a mushroom Chimchurri sauce on the side, and WOW was it good!  Mushrooms, olive oil, fresh herbs, garlic, I think we ate an entire loaf of bread with this stuff!!!

I highly recommend this for lunch, and I'd like to stop in for dinner sometime...I'll definitely be back.

Listen, I'm a foodie & these Gouda grits hit the spot! I worked on my computer over an hour...wonderful food, iced mocha is good & tried the blue eyes lemonade! Legit. Everyone was so nice & I will definitely be back.

Everything was wonderful!  Dinner was delicious, and the eclectic atmosphere was lovely.  Just enough choices in sushi and all meal options without being overwhelming. After 7 provided free parking for a visit to the Fox, which was just a short walk away.  Lovely surprise venue for a fun evening out!

We came around noon on a Tuesday. It's a little pricey, but you definitely get what you pay for! The food was full of flavor. I had the sandwich and soup of the day and my boyfriend ordered the Butter Chickpea with naan. I also ordered a Chaga Chai and my boyfriend ordered the kombucha (Purple Ginger was available that day). 

We left extremely happy and full. The food was wonderful.

The interior is cute, not my personal vibe, but overall cute and comfy:) 

Our waiter was a delight as well, she described the sandwich and soup to me multiple times (I forgot) with patience and made sure we were set.

My daughter and I just spent a week in Philadelphia. Every day we walked from the hotel to Sabrina's for a great breakfast. After trying various dishes, I settled on the tofu scramble.

I eat eggs and other animal products, but there is something magical about the tofu scramble -- a great mix of flavors, vegies, and protein. 

And it comes with the most amazing home fries. And OK toast. Their tea selection was limited (at present) and their coffee was decent.

I liked the goofy atmosphere and the servers were first rate. Too bad it's not in Seattle.
Finally found a place to get my fish taco fix.  This is the real deal. Corn tortillas, crispy fish and all the fixings.  You must try it especial. You will not be sorry.

There were a bunch of 5 star reviews of this place so we stopped in on a week night to give it a try.  I was exited by the menu. In-house charcuterie, foie gras, sweetbreads. As the meal progressed I said "5-star menu but something's missing". It turned out to be flavor that was missing. Had 7 meat and cheese options and other than the lamb bacon everything was bland. No salt and pepper on tables and yet they do not have a pepper mill anywhere in the place. Dry and over cooked duck with an odd tasting rice dish. My wife enjoyed her seared tuna, but I thought it lacked a cohesiveness (included a rice dish and eggplant mole). Tasty components but not a dish that worked together. I went from 4 stars down to 3 and didn't go any further because our server was excellent. Not an inexpensive place for a $155 dinner I expected way better than we got. The effort is going in but the execution of the kitchen was lackluster. I don't think we'll be giving them another try. Too many good restaurants in St Pete for that.

The sampler was good, the mashed potatoes were good, the chicken fried steak not so much too much breading and the chicken looked and tasted rough. I came for fried chicken on Tuesday's and Sundays (I heard) but after ordering the waitress came back to say only for dinner on Tuesday I got there at 2PM. I used the stall bathroom and my feet began to slide out from under me as if I was standing on grease. Online menu stretched and blurry, kind of pricey... Our waitress seemed afraid...
Every time I visit friends at UCSB I stop here. A location is opening right by me so it will be nice to have an alternative for the once a week outing to Chipotle.
Good place for lunch or dinner. Always good service, sometimes they run out of the special but that must mean people love it. Great strawberry chicken salad. This is one of our favorites.
this is my best italian pizzeria il love the food and owners... fair price and good quality and clean plac

*If you love good quality sushi, you MUST check this place out*

I like to go on a date with my boyfriend to Sagami at least once a month. They have really good quality sushi/sashimi. Overall, their food isn't overly saucy compared to a lot of sushi restaurants. We personally really enjoy that because it makes us feel not too lethargic and bloated at the end of the meal. Their rice is seasoned well and is similar to omakase quality. If you like sashimi/sushi, i highly recommend getting the Chirashi. You get a lot of assorted sashimi with rice at the bottom.  Each sashimi taste so fresh and pairs really nicely with the rice. 

Our favorite rolls are the Soft shell crab roll, Hamachi Maki, Unagi Tobiko Maki. But do note that they're on the smaller side. 

Our favorite sushi pieces are Salmon, Tuna and Scallop. You must try their Scallop sushi. It's our tradition to always finish our dinner with the Scallop because it's that good! 

This place is also BYOB so bring your favorite pair of Sake :)

Incredible experience. GM mike was great as well as his staff. Very accommodating and helpful. Food was excellent. Every dish was fantastic. Wine was good. I had an awesome birthday dinner there. The beet salad was so good.

Avoid at all cost!!! While waiting for my food, I happen to look on the floor and it was a mouse going about its business in the dining area. I immediately called the manager over and informed her of what I just witnessed and to cancell our order. I wish I could give this restaurant zero stars but unfortunately I cant!!

As salad works go (they are a local chain of custom-tossed salad and panini shops) this Doylestown location of Saladworks (near the K-Mart) really isn't bad.  My little one & I order the same salad every time - and she loves it.   It's about $9.00 after tax but is way big enough for an adult anbd a child to share.

As with all the saladworks, they also have sandwiches (panini) but I don't care for them.  At least at the D-town store the lettuce is usually fresh and crisp (and NOT brown) and the ingredients are in good, cold, condition.  The high school gals (and a few guys) who work here are well mannered and friendly.

NOT like the crappy ones in Center City.

I am happy that Saladworks exist as I do not eat traditional fast food like burgers or subs.  Home of the $8.00 salad (or $9.00 for the one we get).  Do you want white or wheat (roll) with that?

For anyone who is planning on making a trip here to N'awlins, this is a must do on your trip!

Jimmy J's Cafe (JJC) is a casual cafe that takes pride in being "N'awlins' Funkiest Lil' Cafe" and I completely agree.

Whenever a place offers their breakfast menu all day, you will immediately pull my heart strings and have me beating with excitement.

I first came across this place during one of my first visits to this great city. While I was staying next door at the Quarter House, my siblings and I needed some food to help out with the Bourbon St. Hangover many have experienced. Luckily we found out they actually delivered to our condo and we immediately took them up on their offer.

Flash forward three years later and I'm still coming here every time I come to NOLA.

Their whole menu is amazing and impressive; seriously, from their salads to dinner options nothing has left me dissatisfied (or anyone else I know who has been here).

My absolute favorite dish here is their Monte Cristo. The exact name of it is the French Toast Monte Cristo in case you're wondering. This gooey goodness consists of two perfectly slices of French Toast, with an amazing center of ham, cheese, and bacon. Dust this bad boy off with some powdered sugar with a beautiful coat of some savory syrup, and you have one of the most mouth-watering dishes I have ever come across.

The staff here is awesome and always have a smile on their face. They have no problem answering and questions you may have about their menu. For those of y'all who like to have a drink with your menu they have you covered. You can order sangria, mimosas, wine, and beers here!

This is a cafe so keep in mind that seating is limited but I've never really came across this being an issue. Make sure to also take a look at their wall art it's pretty epic and the artist they used to make it is very talented.

My family, friends, and I absolutely love this place and it is worth the trip every single time.

Adios everyone I gotta go and finish stuffing my face with this Monte Cristo now.

Ohhhh all I can say is that this place had some of THE BEST fried chicken during my time in New Orleans ! Chicken is so juicy and crunchy and fried to perfection. You're also able to get a daiquiri to enjoy while eating or on your way back to exploring the streets of New Orleans!
Pass on Shulas' Bar and GRILL. Go with their Burger stand.

Visiting Nashville for the weekend and was taken here by family as this is supposed to be a Nashville staple (plus I'm a sucker for fried chicken and biscuits). Dropped by on a Saturday around 1pm. We had to wait for about an hour before a table became available (we were a group of 6). Here's my take on this establishment:

1. Service: Our waiter was superb; friendly and explained everything to us. The lady who greeted us at the entrance and took our names down was not so friendly. 

2. Food: I got the Loveless fried chicken with two sides (turnips in liquor and caramel sweet potato). The fried chicken was yummy, but by no means the best I've ever had. The sides were mediocre. Sweet potatoes were way too sweet and soggy. Turnips were fine. 
Their biscuits are really good, but I personally preferred them more with butter or dipped in gravy. The gravy was great. Not sure what the hype is about their preserves... tasted good but nothing amazing?
Portions are good. 

3. Price: Good value. 

4. Aesthetics: Casual and cozy. Bathrooms were nice and clean. One thing I noticed when I first sat down was that there was some kind of food on my chair (and it was wet) which I had to clean up (and of course, I chose to wear white jeans just that day, haha). 

Would I go back? I personally don't think the wait is worth it. The food was good but not mind blowing and definitely not worth waiting 1 hour.

Great service. Great atmosphere. Great coffee. Validated parking. That should be enough, but Yelp is making me tell you more, so here goes: it's a great little spot which appears deceivingly small from the outside. Inside there's a large area for seating, a (music/performance) stage, and a bar where you can sit and enjoy. I was merely passing through so didn't stay, but I found out from the gentleman behind the counter that they were going to be hosting a sorority party of some sort that evening and that they'd hosted bachelorette parties and weddings as well. Impressive.

Multiple issues with my pizza
First, my order was not correct with two requested topping left off. Second, there was too much cheese. It all slide off the pizza. I had a pile of cheese and grease in the corner of the box.  Last Poor quality ingredients, ingredients were not fresh, and lack taste. I tried to recheese the pizza but the crust was so thin and greasy the whole thing was better off in the trash. The second star is a mercy star due to covid. Do yourself a favor and go elsewhere.

Heard the wings were amazing here which is why we decided to come eat here. I don't recommend any of the other food. I got the Cajun sampler and it had no flavor and came on a paper plate for $10.99. Im not picky but I ate the jambalaya that was over cooked and left the rest. The wings were decent but not the best wings I've had in Nashville by far. One of the beers we got was pretty flat. Cool place to drink, good selection, and decent service but I would recommend eating before you come!

Had the best pad Thai and fresh rolls I've ever had at pad Thai house yesterday! The food was so good and clearly used very fresh and quality ingredients. I'm sad that I only just discovered this place now after so long of living in Boise. It's so good and everyone working there is so kind and sweet, especially Sandra! If you're looking for amazing Thai food for great prices, definitely come here!

I was really rooting for this place to be good.  It's in a cute converted residential home with great ambience.  That's probably what that service fee is for.  (Service fee: a 15% tip is automatically included and you can't opt out of that, just letting you know) What fell flat for me was the baked goods itself.  The layered pastries like croissants, turnovers, and danishes were pretty underwhelming.  Good bakeries can sustain the quality way after it comes out of the oven.  Everything was so overly soft.  Similar to a texture of that complimentary danish you would get from a Motel. And the dough isn't rich of a buttery taste.  It felt like there was lacking flavor and texture all around.   I opened up my croissant and there was no honeycomb structure to be found.  It was filled with air.  And you'll notice coming in the bakery seeing many collapsed pastries.  Granted, the service was great. The workers are super sweet and kind, but if you came here looking to be blown away by good baked goods, you won't get that.

We had 3 sandwiches and sides for a event at my apartment building. Wait time for food was reasonable, especially since there was a constant and steady line. Me and my girlfriend split both the chicken caprese and pulled pork. Caprese had good  thick slices of mozz, tomato and the basil spread was great. Nice roll too. Pulled pork was better than expected and not overly saucy or sweet. Meat was cooked nicely and flavorful. My son loved the chicken and waffle sandwich. Said he would want to get it again. Mac and cheese was nice a cheesy, liked the texture. Maybe needed a little salt. Fries were good.

I found the breakfasts overpriced and haphazardly prepared the service less than average the place a bit disheveled. The outside is dominated by table hogs passing judgement with about as much worth as my two cents here.

Not the greatest experience. It wasn't terribly crowded but we waited an hour for the nachos, (our appetizer) and they were tasteless and not worth the wait.. We had a nice table on the deck which was pleasant but very tight, and the food was so disappointing. The crawfish were too spicy for our taste. After all that waiting, we left disappointed and hungry...

Las Palmas seems to be under new management.  They have made some changes to the menu and changes to the dishes.  They should have left "well enough" alone in my opinion.
