That being said, despite some minor changes, this is still my favorite lunch-time mexican restaurant in Brentwood.  Be sure to try the 'LP Special'.

I came in to get lunch with my colleges from work. First I notice that the lady taking our order was not nice at all. Second I notice that after I paid her for my two slices of pizza & soda she and her staff where touching the pizza with their bare hands. Disgusting!!!!  I couldn't hold it any more after noticing how many times she counted money and continue to touch the food. Along with her staff that also was placing topping on the pizza with her bare hands. I ask her why do they work with the food with no gloves on and her Priceless Response was we don't wear gloves here! She stated to me if I didn't want the pizza I didn't have to take it. I was beside myself on her attitude along with the poor service and Disgusting way they handle the food!!!!  I will NEVER return to the Place ever! Now in days so many people getting sick and so many germs around the last thing they can do is put gloves on if they are handling other people food. They didn't even WASH their Hands! DISGUSTING!!!!  She hates her job and careless of giving good customer services to customers! Shame on them!!!

Gerst Haus is a fun dining experience and has tasty food, if you like German fare. However, the Gerst Haus is less about the food and more about the atmosphere.

The atmosphere was fun with a tuba, drum and accordion trio which doled out some fun musical ditties and sang happy birthday twice. Watch out for the forced chicken dance. It can be irritating.

The staff, from the front door to our server, was aloof and seemed very disinterested in us. Our server didn't want to offer suggestions or even explain what the different items were. Perhaps it fit with the "German experience". Vee don't care vat you like. Just order somesing. So authentically German, that I felt like I was in the motherland.

This place used to be a Boston Market. I feel the need to tell you that for some odd reason. 

Meal still comes with a salad and a smile. The homemade dressing is da bomb. Your plate will be able to feed a family of 16 in Africa. You will leave full and satisfied and with a doggie bag. I mean, you can PUT. IT. DOWN. if you don't leave with a doggie bag, you should feel ashamed.

Love the cannolis too. Definitely a great place to go in my old home town.
Pizza and wings were delicious and delivery was right on time! Awesome!

The waitstaff was nice. The Fajitas were not. Dry and unseasoned. I can't speak to their other menu items, but this is one of those places where you get to throw your peanut shells and other garbage on the floor. Gross.

Absolutely ridiculous. Sitting outside for 20 min. No one came to greet us, let alone get our drink order. I went inside and talked to one of the servers, tall blonde guy, who was not really pleasant either. Finally this little adorable kid comes out, he's absolute joy to have to serve us. So he fixed the situation for us but other than him this place is u professional, people are rude and I'll keep you posted on the food.

Very romantic restaurant with the exceptional service and great food! 
They have indoor and outdoor sittings, outdoor fireplace and beautiful garden. I've been there about 5 times and it was always great experience!

Yes, the wait is usually long but good things come to those who wait...
I've been to both the center city location and south Philly location. My go to is the creme brulee French toast!

I've also tried the kitchen sink, the chicken and waffle eggs Benedict (without the benedict, just plain egg), and the cookie dough french toast. They are all mouth watering. The cookie dough french toast isn't for the faint of heart though, I felt like I ate a huge desert instead of brunch. 

Also, I've tried their fruit lemonades and they were also really good.

I stopped at the end of a Saturday night to get some late dinner at Lil Sum Sum in the Piazza Pod Park.  Then waited about twenty minutes for my food.  I did hear people in the park saying how they love the mushroom chicken dumplings, however my shrimp shumi were raw like sushi and my fried rice tastes like steamed rice with no flavor.  I will avoid the Lil Sum Sum and recommend no one eat there.
Had a good buffalo chicken wrap and others at my table had a good breaded tenderloin and grilled cheese.  Would recommend.

Kristin and the staff at TGIF (Cherry Hill NJ, rte. 38) saved out night. After the terrible experience at Zinburgers we ended up here. Best decision ever. Food was good, drinks were great. Service was outstanding.

Excellent BBQ. I had the pulled pork sandwich and the brisket chili, and I couldn't have been happier. The pork melts in your mouth. It's tasty and moist, and there's enough meat on the sandwich that it filled me up. I was worried about the BBQ sauces, which were thin (liquid-ey) since I'm not a fan of vinegar-based sauces, but the house sauce was superb. Great atmosphere. Great food.

This was our first visit to Bagger Dave's and overall enjoyed the atmosphere and food with excellent service. Our waitress, Jenny, was friendly and very attentive. The decor is comfortable and keep simple with a train motif.  A full size railroad semaphore signal stands in the main dining area with a large scale model train circling overhead. Woo, woo!

The pick your burger and topping list is perfect for pickey eaters or folks with food allergies. Husbands' burger was tasty but overcooked for him.  My salad topped with chili,  BBQ sauce & balsamic dressing has a good flavor but leaves your lettuce standing in a pool of liquid. It appeared to be a combination of liquids from the chili and the dressing. Next time I'll order both on the side to determine which is the problem. 

Their version of homemade cola is nasty, overly sweet and I couldn't drink regardless of how many lemons I added. The waitress was terrific warning me I wouldn't receive a Diet Coke and removed from our bill when I returned. We'll return in the near future to try other items on the menu.

We were sat at the long table down the whole restaurant. We didn't like being that close to another set of people dining. Waiters were good, owners and managers checked on us. It was really loud couldn't hardly hear my boyfriend talking and we couldn't have a private conversation like we needed to at lunch. Good was alright, but we didn't think it was just omg amazing.
I've been ordering take out from here for 5 years now.  The food and service is consistently good.

My boyfriend took me here to celebrate our anniversary and I was surprised to find out that this place has been around for quiet some time.  This is probably the only steakhouse that I've been to who uses real butter! The flavor and fragrance is soooo wonderful! However, the appetizer wasnt at all memorable so I've already forgotten what we ordered. Furthermore, I dont know if it was the time of night or what but in order to go to the ladies' room I had to walk through the kitchen with all the staff gawking at me. Plus I was walking in brand new high heels and the floor was a little scary.

The food is decent and fairly priced, but honestly, I prefer New Harmony. I once came here for an event and ended up getting really awful service. Our party was basically rushed out by the owner, who got into an intense verbal altercation with members of our party. I realize this was just one negative experience, but it prevented me from even going back.

what a nice surprise! So convenient to CBD and Uptown. Big benches out front. and then there is the food. Extraordinary variety of interesting dishes, all scrumptious.  - many you have never had before. The owners are the chefs and the servers, so you get really good service. and keep room for their custom ice cream! wow. the best ice cream around! we go to or by Fat Boy regularly on our bike rides!

The portions are huge! Small salad = big salad! Big salad = 3 can eat :-)
If you are looking for a Paleo Meal, this is it. They serve huge salad portions and their dressings are amazing. Local Business with great food.

This place has everything.. I went there for the first time to pick up random ingredients for dinner one night on the way home from work. I walked in with wishful thinking and they ended up having everything I needed. I browsed around to see they had A LOT of awesome food, and now return quite often on my breaks from work.

Quintessential "I want fairly greasy pizza but to hell if I'll get dominoes" place. I have to say... the Stromboli is the actual winner of the menu (sorry 'za). The cheese situation, guys.. at times, I thought I was eating a mozzarella stick. So, you CAN have it all (pizza, mozzarella stick, daily veggie intake (?)) 

Important to know: for TAKE OUT be prepared to wait. This is not the typical 15-20 minutes. This will take approx 40 mins so plan your appetite accordingly

I went to Panda Express for my free Orange Chicken from T-Mobile. I haven't had Panda for years. Surprisingly, the food is pretty good. There was a line of at least 10 people, but the staff moved pretty fast. The chicken and rice were pretty good, the noodles were decent.

I went here a few weeks ago and called in my order.  The woman who took my order indicated that it would be ready for pickup in 15 minutes.  I arrived at least 20 minutes later only to find out not only was it not ready, but I had to recite my order 2x.  I finally picked it up at least 20 minutes past the time she indicated it would be ready.  I complained to an older Italian looking guy with white hair but suspected he was just a driver.  The lady was very rude, dismissive, and unapologetic.  I don't think I will return.  The food is good, but not great to deal with rude, inattentive, and uncaring customer service.

Whenever I am hungry for Indian food I always come to the Taj Mahal. It is delicious and Sohail (the owner) is always giving customers a warm welcome. I have been 4 times and every time I had a wonderful eating experience. Definitely try the food.

The food here was ok but definitely not exceptional. The waitress was nice but the food took a long time to come out. Coffee was just ok. I probably wouldn't rush back here with so many options in town. There was nothing to make it stand out...

Akar was an amazing find. My mom is vegan and gluten free and we were able to find some excellent options for her and myself. They make amazing food that is full of flavor. We would go back again anytime! Staff was kind and helpful and the heated tent is perfect even during this colder season. Definitely a recommend!
Just very yummy food.  Everything on the menu is wonderful.!  Wonderful sauces too....and that Crack Pie is YUM!!

Headed out to this place on a Sunday afternoon to grab some dinner.    I was excited to check it out after hearing some good reviews from a couple friends.   I'll try to be factual in my review here, because there are several things that need some work.    I'll preface this by saying we went for dinner and not for beer.

1) Upon arrival the parking lot was packed and it was obvious that many people were enjoying the large outdoor patio.  It's a nice addition to a building that has sat idle for years and years, waiting for it's next tenant.  

2) We chose to sit inside and our party of 5 was taken to a X-wide booth at the very far reaches of the seating area.   The booth was plenty big for 3 on each side.   The hostess gave us all menus and a laminated beer menu with the available brews marked.
3) We waited nearly 10 minutes for a server to appear, which was WAY too long in any case, especially given the fact that it seemed like she only had about 3 tables.   By this time, we had all decided on our meals but we ordered drinks and an order of pretzel nuggets & cheese dip.

4) Server returned with drinks after about another 5 minute wait, and took our orders.  One person in our party ordered the Chipotle Burger subbing in the black bean patty for an extra $1.  

5) Pretzel nuggets arrived shortly thereafter and were average at best.   They were cold, and gave the impression that they were just standard frozen pretzel bites that were reheated & tossed on the plate.   The cheese dip was also unremarkable, I struggled to find any distinct flavor (cheese or beer or ??) but just couldn't.  I've had this appetizer at other brewpub/restaurants and they usually go out of their way to have fresh pretzels and a relatively strong-tasting cheese dip to stand up to their beer selection.   This version did not justify the $7 pricetag.

6) Entrees arrived about 10 minutes later, delivered by (not our server).   The previously mentioned Chipotle Burger arrived with the bean patty as ordered, but without all other toppings and without fries. It was sent back for correction.  Other ordered entrees included the standard Chipotle burger made with cow,  Brisket sandwich, Grilled chicken breast, and soup/salad combo.

7) Server stops by after #6 and asks how we like everything.   She was unaware of the mistake and runs away without filling our drinks.

8) By all accounts, most of the food was good, it came out hot and was pretty tasty.   The beer-cheese soup was indistinguishable from the cheese dip that came with the pretzels, save for a lone potato chunk hiding in the bottom of the bowl.    Dishes with fries could use a little "presentation",  a single flat layer of fries on the plate next to a sandwich looks like it was just thrown on the plate without any effort to make it look good.  The fries were good though.

9) Server made one more trip to deliver the bill.  We paid and left.

If I was to summarize the overall experience, it would be:

- Food was generally good and a good change up from the standard offerings
- Service was very slow and needs to improve to attract return customers
- Prices were generally fair (except for the $7 pretzels, probably should be $4 or FREE)

I'll try again sometime when I'm in the mood for a beer - based on the other reviews here they seem to have that going in the right direction.

Went here as I have been wanting to try their wings as the reviews rave about the .  I'm always looking for good wings.   This was not the place.   Ordered the hot honey, bourbon and hot.  Total of 20 wings to taste test.    Hot honey wings came and the only thing that was hot, was the temperature.   There was hardly ANY flavor.   Same with the bourbon and Hot.   Asked for the "hurt me" sauce.   And this literally was all butter and few dashes of hot sauce.  No joke.    My ranch dressing was spicier than this.   Cuginos wings are way better.  Even Pirrones wings are better.  Salad and dressing served wasn't cold.  It was weird as you expect to have a cold salad.    Beer was good though.   So that's why 2 stars.   If you are looking for good wings... Hooters or Cuginos is close by.

On a lazy December afternoon I ordered the green chicken curry to-go through Doorstep Delivery. The curry nicely spiced, veggies fresh, and chicken good enough. The portion size for the price was about right-commensurate with quality in my opinion. Love having a place like this just around the corner from our condo on Mass Ave. I look forward to going to the bar and checking out the jazz.

Went for the Cuban at lunch, and came back for the pulled mojo pork, beans a as rice for dinner. Awesome! Don't wear anything that attracts odors. It's small inside, and you'll come out smelling like greatness (mixed with BO).

We were just here 11/24/19 - a little bit skeptical but it amazed us! The Calamari was okay, but the rest was great! They have a happy hour menu ask if it's available. the crawfish spinach dip was AmaZing! Order the taste of NOLA, creole combo and the crab boulettes! You can never go wrong! We will surely be back at Mr.Ed's! and our Server Meldra was the icing on the top! She was amazing!

This place is really good. Lots of variety, they had 3 different types of veggie burgers and a lot of topping options. I had Guadalupe (I think) and it was amazing as is, but even better with pickled jalapeño. Everything had lots of flavor! Be careful with the build your own burgers though, all the toppings and options can add up and get pricey. Your better off ordering one of the ones already on the menu. Overall really really good meal.

If you want a southern hole in the wall, authentic breakfast place, come to Coulis. I ordered pancakes, and I was able to add blueberries and bananas to it. The pancake was a very generous size--added fruits were delicious. Price was great! Decor was fun. Staff was super attentive. The place was busy but there wasn't a long wait which was great for a weekend morning! Great experience, definitely going back!

We love Brother Doug's!!  They are always our go to when we are trying to figure out dinner or want something good and fast.  Their thin crust is yummy.  We also love how they are open and honest with their customers.  Most importantly how they help others by offering free pizza!

This was an amazing breakfast place, food was amazing and our waitress Tracy was supper amazing. The build Creole omelette and the grits of the day was our favorite.  Great service, great food, clean place didn't have to send anything back such a plus. I would recommend this place to everyone to try out.

Of course Nashvillians would rate this place five stars. 

Dry, unseasoned tacos. I appreciate fusion, but this wasn't it. Still in search of excellent fusion Mexican food!

Friendly service and good food.  Megan was an awesome server.  We had the Cajun red fish, pecan salad with grilled chicken and filet with mushrooms & onions.  My Red Fish was missing the rice which Megan quickly corrected and it also had a little too much sauce covering the fish, but the fish was excellent.  The others said their filet and salad was great.  I would definitely recommend this place.
Brought the chicken and waffles, the chicken was fried to perfection. The Potatoes (home fires) were also tasty and well seasoned.

I'm going to start off by saying that I am not a HUGE fan of barbecue. I usually go for anything else before I say "let's get barbecue", but I was out with a friend and he wanted some, so we ended up here.

Boo Koo is located in the back of Finn McCool's bar. There's no separate entrance, so you are going to have to fight the crowd in order to get to the back and place your order. Once you order, you can either get your food to go, or sit in one of the limited seats inside or outside.

I decided on the Cajun Cuban, which is Boo Koo's version of the traditional Cuban sandwich. I don't know what makes it "Cajun", but it was really good. It tasted like a typical Cuban to me. It might not be the best I have ever had, but I would order it again. I also really liked how crispy the fries were that came with it.

I would give this place three stars for dining in and four stars for take out. Why? Because of the smoking. I just can't enjoy my meal while smelling cigarettes and it was cold and rainy the night we were here, so sitting outside was out. Also, they have a video golf game located right in the small dining area and the guys playing it were SUPER loud (screaming and high fiving- typical frat behavior) and chain smoking. I would suggest ditching the game entirely, or moving it away from where people are trying to eat.

My husband and I ordered chicken wings and ribs, unfortunately for us it was waaaay over cooked, let's say burnt and then we don't get celery that should come with wings and my husband didn't got his side of baked beans. I would never order from this place again. And btw this is not smoked it's just cooked on the grill.

This place is noted as one of the best seafood restaurants in New Orleans!! It certainly lived up to the reputation!! Service was superb! Our waitress, Racheal was outstanding; she was very knowledgeable and attentive!! Our appetizers of Oysters Rockefeller and Gator Bites were fantastic!  Our entrees were just as good; Taste of New Orleans, Gumbo, Red Snapper, and Seafood Pasta were all savory and filling! Dessert!!! Bread Pudding with Ice Cream and Creme Brûlée! Yes! For our first visit, you can rest assured we will be back!!

Every time we're at South Shore we visit VC.  This place is where we eat.  Great Jerky, and the BBQ pulled pork sandwich is wonderful.  The Cold Slaw and the beans are great too.  Homemade and fresh.  It's just a fun place to have great food.  We go off season so there's never a wait, even if there was, it would be worth it for the food.  My husband loves the Jerky and is trying to find their website to order more, but guess they don't have one.  He'll call them as he says it's the best jerky anywhere.

I came here on a cold, windy afternoon (January 5). I didn't know what to expect being a first time customer.  To my delight, my expectations were met and beyond.  For starters, they give you unique pretzel rolls which had a surperb texture.  As extra credit, they go beyond by serving their loyal customers this delicate, tasty cheddar butter crafted in their kitchen.  It was worth the three blocks it took to walk there.  The food was served in a timely matter.  The waitress was perfect in her top-notch serving skills.  She was speedy to always refill water cups in excellent fashion.  I ordered the beef brisket.  This was the best beef brisket in Indy.  It had a winning flavor which included these adorable onion straw things as a boost.  The aroma was great to flirt with my nostrils.  I loved this beautiful experience. I will definitely be back.

So very mediocre.  I can barely remember being there a day later.  I came to the Concord Grill with my little girl since Mom was out with friends.  I would describe it as a slightly upscale tavern with a very 80's feel.  By the looks of it, lots of regulars with dentures.  Several TV's, including a big screen front and center.    

I tried the grilled chicken salad.  NO way would I ever prepare something this bland for myself:  lettuce, a bit of cheese, two slices of tomato and some cold cubed grilled chicken that smelled and tasted a bit like gas.  My daughter had mac and cheese, which was shells in a bowl with a blob of something like ballpark nacho cheese dumped on top.  It was up to us to stir it.   She liked it.  Then again, she's four.  It came with fries, which were quite good.   I had a beer, she had a soda.  The bill before tip came out to $19, which seemed kind of high given the amount of effort expended by the "chef."  They claim to have the best burger in town (Concord?)...I'll never know.

Servers were attentive and friendly.

If your car breaks down in front of the Concord Grill...try Schottzie's across the street.  I've been there once and it wasn't impressive, but it's still probably less meh than this place.
We loved it!  Crab cakes were delicious and the blackened halibut was the best fish I've eaten in Idaho. Not fancy, but the staff is friendly and the food delicious. Even gratis sherbet after dinner.

This was our second trip trip Sacred Pepper. The service is always great, but this time the service and food was exceptional. I've never had a steak as good as the one I was served tonight. Christian was our sever and we could not have asked for better service. It's nice to find a restaurant that has great live music as well. We will definitely be returning.
Delicious food! Quick service! Definitely fresh food with different choices then the regular breakfast diner!

I wanted to update this review because it's now become our little neighborhood bar, even though it's not in our neighborhood. It's near where we work, so we stop there on the way home a lot. We know everyone when we go in, everyone is super awesome and friendly and we never get bored there. We've made legit friends through Sly Bar, and really, isn't that what a neighborhood type bar is supposed to be about?

Well, the wife and I stopped in last week for our first visit. Having read the reviews ahead of time, it as great to see the operators there read them too!

The pickle slices are bigger, significantly so. 

The Classic (We both had them, and had them upgraded) was plenty warm enough, and buttery enough as well. DRIPPING with lobster. Last thing I'd want is to have them re-heat the meat and toughen it up, rendering it inedible.

Lobster bisque was great, loaded with meat. Frankly, it was enough for two after I thinned it out a bit(Post travel home warm-up) with whole milk, and then sherry, bien sur.

Sadly, I cannot speak to the Salad style, as neither of us had ordered it, but will agree with reviewers that red onion is an overpowering flavor for lobter. Might I suggest adding it at the last moment-yes, I know that's labor heavy but.....this way, the onion won't meld into the meat and take away the succulence.
The staff was super pleasant, and the customers faithful.

 The store is now behind it's original site, but fits in perfectly(I LOVE the Colonial Seaport Blue of the Place, fits in so well with the historic nature of Yardley) and the seating sufficient. We sat outside.

I'll let you know how trip two goes!

Loved the experience- great drinks, great service, cool atmosphere, and not as crowded as a typical bar in the area. 

Downside: full of cigar smoke and once it got crowded, the dress code thing kinda lacked. The guy next to me was wearing a flannel, cowboy boots and a dirty ball cap ...

Whatever it was fun I'm totally going again

We decided to try Shelly's cafe for Saturday's Brunch. The Cafe was small and cozy cafe. It had a pleasant, soothing ambience. The staff was friendly and helped us to decide the order. We first started with drinks which included Orange Juice and Hot Coffee. For brunch we ordered Veggie Omelet, Tampa Omelet and Shelby's Pancakes.
Hot Coffee: The coffee was good and hot. 5/5
Orange Juice: We thought It was a tropical orange juice not fresh orange juice. This was only our complain. Rest everything was fine. 3/5
Tampa Omelet: Tampa omelet was healthy and fulfilling. Omelet was provided with english muffin and Potato chips. We loved the omelet. 5/5.
Veggie Omelet: Veggie omelet was also healthy and fulfilling. Both the omelets were amazing. It was served with potato chips and white bread. 5/5
Shelby's Pancake: We loved the pancakes it was amazing. 5/5
We loved this place. This was our first visit and definitely not the last.
Very good food! Great Service! Great Variety in Menu with awesome execution and at a good price! I would highly recommend and know we will be back!
This is a solid 3 star.  We got takeout, bolognese, caprese salad, and dinner salad.  All were solid for your typical american italian restaurant.

We were drawn in by Great outdoor sitting and good crowd.  The tacos were below average.  I had the salmon, tequila chicken, and the fish taco.  The tacs were not fresh and the tastes were nothing special.   For that price I recommend driving down to Sopapillas.  You will get much better food, service, and a great outdoor seating!

OK, so, I think I saw Patton Oswalt here today. Breakfasting with his parents. (Either that or it was a Patton Oswalt impersonator. I'll let you decide based on the joke to come.)

So, he's talking kinda loudly and telling a story about getting some food with a "caramel duck fat sauce". He says that upon completion of the meal, the waiter cracked "Here's the... BILL" (emphasis mine). So, he claims, he shot back, "You quack me up."

Anyway, so, a little bit later, Patton Oswalt's mom starts hacking and I see something fly out of her mouth and across the room. That family quacks me up.

All of the above did not interfere with my enjoyment of my delicious omelette.

Some truly fine wait service as well. 

That's all, folks.

Bought take out from here last night and I gotta say it wasn't bad at all. The lo mein seemed a bit weird because I was expecting bigger noodles yet tasty it was.The fried shrimp is also unusual but very good and the beef and broccoli and almond chicken passed. Its not what I would expect in Cali.but then again I'm not IN Cali. Would revisit.

Take out is available during Covid. I wanted to try multiple items and decided to give this place 3 stars. Some items on the menu are really good and some items I wouldn't order again. 
The hot and sour soup had too much vinegar in it. 
The pickled chicken feet left me super thirsty, and it was a bit slimy. I have had this at other restaurants and it's not supposed to be slimy. The beef chow fun was okay. I have had better and I have had worse.  The scallion pancake had good flavor, but it was a little soggy. Since it was take out, then it wasn't freshly eaten when cooked so that is just the covid environment of take out.  The beef tendon chili sauce dish was super good. 
I would like to go back and try the other items as certain things were really well done. 
Service was friendly and quick. The order was ready in 15 minutes.

A lot can change in a couple of years and this place certainly has. The food here is downright bad. Disgusting fishy grouper tacos that are undercooked and down right gross. Why do they have to add mango or other sweet foods to food that should be savory to begin with? I don't get it. Maybe it's a Florida thing. Don't get the vegetables on the side unless you want ice cold zucchini and yellow squash mixed with onion and a fistful (YES A FISTFUL, you read that right) of pepper on top as seasoning. The servers, while ok for the most part, are just going through the motions. This place used to be great. Clearwater beach used to be great. Not anymore. Go somewhere else far away from here to avoid the lizard people and bums walking on the streets. This will be the last time I come to Florida for vacation. It's gone to the crapper as a whole.

The customer service is extremely lacking here. But that's not what I'm actually rating today. Wife, daughter and I came in here after a long day of driving to California and back to help her mom move some stuff (7-1/2 hours). I ordered the 1/2 pound Swiss and mushroom burger, wife ordered the 1/3 pound Swiss and mushroom burger and daughter ordered the hot dog. 
She enjoyed the hot dog. I guess that's the one plus. My burger had zero flavor. They completely left off any seasoning. Wife's burger was bland too. Now for the really bad part. She has been on the toilet, extreme stomach ache for two days. I sure hope she gets better soon.

Delicious food!!! As a former New Yorker, I've found it difficult to find moist, flavorful grilled jerk chicken... until now. I cannot say enough great things about the jerk chicken. Not normally much of a sweet beverage drinker but I really enjoyed the fruit punch (red top). Love that the food was presented with a smile. I live about 20 mins away and am sure to become a regular. Can't wait to try other items.

Try it.... you won't regret it.

Sept 8, 2018 update:
Still tasty, truly a 5 for taste... best in Tampa but seriously 8 wing pieces, from a food truck, for $9 + $1 tip. WTH??? No bueno... Should've checked before I left. I may have to rethink this spot... smh

My husband and I shared the corn waffle with the sweet potatoes with duck confit and bacon. The waffle was good, there was not much duck confit in it but it was well prepared. However the price was high. We paid $34 for the waffle, bacon and 2 coffees. Good food should have a reflecting price but I feel this was excessive. I don't even know if the duck was free range.

Delicious coffee, terrible wifi.  If you only want to read, I suggest headphones if twangy pop country distracts you.  

The staff is really nice and helpful.  The tables have fresh-cut flowers.

I order from here offer, since is closed to my house and they deliver. The first time I got the delivery the food was ok, and the service was not great either. The second time I ordered delivery the food was amazing, the rice was fresh and the food was really hot. The girl that delivered was very nice and polite. 
When I order and pick up the food is good, but sometimes I feel is a hot and miss situation.

Like all the other photos posted here of the sage chicken and bacon waffles, I decided not to show the same thing and just give my review. I died and went to heaven and Jesus sent me back....good laawd this was off the hook. The chicken was super tasty and not overwhelming with the flavor or sage. Very moist and just plain delish. The waffles were nice and crispy and it had bacon inside (my favorite). Prices were more than fair. Service was good. My picky son didn't like the fresh pressed apple juice and I was going to just pay for it anyway but the server brought him oj instead and didn't charge us for it which was nice. I will be back here before returning home Thursday....thumbs up

I drive by this place at least four times a day every day, and I finally stopped for lunch. They have a BOGO deal on sandwiches, but you have to buy a high priced Styrofoam cup for a fountain drink or fries. I ordered the Philly cheese steak and it was average. The Asian woman behind the counter was rude as I've read in other posts, and the owner Dino cooked the food. Dino made up for the rude cashier, welcoming everyone and going out of his way to give the customer what they wanted. He even greeted the regulars by name, and while I was there a steady flow of regulars came in. He knew all of their names and orders. I gave an extra star for Dino. I will be back to try the gyro.

My honest opinion, the place is overrated, I know some natives to New Orleans might disagree. 

Dirty tables and the Bignets are very doughy, but Cafe au lait is fantastic.

Check out the location in the French quarter "for the experience"

Having opened just over a year ago, Aqua Prime is bringing elegance and modern flair to the Steak & Seafood scene in Largo. For comparable prices as other surf and turf joints, this restaurant is making waves. We arrived during peak dinner time and luckily were seated right away. They have both an indoor and outdoor dining area. If the weather is holding up, opt for the outside seating. AP provides heating lamps so even if there's a breeze you're not too chilly. Surrounding the dining area are beautiful hanging glass lights which really up the ambiance factor. It's welcoming and classy.

What I really love is that AP offers up complimentary warm pita and homemade white bean hummus. So different from what I'm used to, and SO delicious. It was a great starter to an even more fantastic meal. They offer a "sunset dinner" if you arrive between 4-6pm which provides you with a salad, entree and dessert for $14. That's a pretty great deal if you ask me. 

I ended up ordering the 8oz. Top Sirloin with mashed potatoes and the House Salad with Citrus Vinaigrette. For starters, the salad was fantastic. Very fresh and I was glad to see they didn't skip on the leafy greens. And I really loved the citrus dressing. As for the Sirloin, it was top notch. My steak was cooked to perfection (medium rare) and the mashed potatoes were creamy/smooth. I enjoyed every aspect of my meal and was thoroughly impressed.

I was also able to try the Curry Seared Scallops. Interesting, right? I don't think I've ever seen those flavor combinations before. But let me tell you, it works. The coconut curry sauce elevated the scallops to another level and packs a flavorful punch. If you're hungering for something more "out of the box", this one might be for you.

Aqua Prime, you have impressed me. I was blown away from the elegant atmosphere to the risky as well as classic food pairings. Next time I'm in FL, you bet I'll be back.

Pretty good for the price. Not amazing, but good. Ordering at the counter and fixing your own drink makes it feel like fast food, but definitely better than fast food. (No tipping needed:)!
Cornbread bowl was good. Not very deep with veggie soup, but it's listed under "snacks" so I wasn't expecting it to be huge. 
The hubby got shrimp dinner. Shrimp were shrimpy, but he said they were pretty tasty. 
The kid got a hotdog with mac n cheese. He ate every bite. 
I rate 4 stars because it's good, easy, family friendly, and very reasonably priced. 
Oh, and they have 8-10 bottled beer selections!

This a a cute little restaurant with great customer service! The restaurant is very clean, and my food was neatly boxed. The tacos are just delicious. I tried the 'No No No' taco along with the jackfruit tacos. They were both equally delicious, in my opinion. As someone that's been transitioning into a vegan lifestyle, I'd say that These taste better than regular meat filled tacos. I ate the tacos before I could snap a picture. I only wish that this place was a little closer to Noblesville, lol. I'll definitely be returning.

I honestly can't put my finger on it.
Nothing about this place approaches spectacular.
However, it is.
Good coffee, food, staff, and atmosphere.
Only drawback - cash only!  I'm a plastic man living in a plastic world - c'mon baby, meet me halfway.  I don't like the tease!

Otherwise, it delivers all you'd ever want in a coffee house.

I've ordered lunch from here twice last week and their to go system leaves a lot to be desired. What should be a quick option for lunch isn't, whether ordering online ahead of time of time or placing the order there. The first visit we actually ordered there and sat in the small waiting area. We watched as others came to pick up orders that were not complete or simply not ready. Seemed to be a bunch of confusion and possibly too many workers in the back/kitchen and not enough employees bagging orders up especially during lunch hours. We waited 30 minutes for our food. While their lunch specials are great, if you're in a rush or on a timetable, this isn't the spot. The next order was placed online, and we were given a time to pick up. Order was not ready upon arrival. There was still another 15 minute wait past the initial pick up time. No complaints about the food, just the timeliness of the service unfortunately.

We were living several miles outside of town in Crystal Springs, FL, and could not find any place that would deliver to us other than Dominos. I searched many times and called a lot of places, but just couldn't find any restaurants willing to deliver..and we were very tired of pizza. 

FINALLY, on one of my google searches I found Tokyo Grill & Sushi...and I am so happy that I did!

I called and they said the would deliver, and within 30 minutes we had a DELICIOUS meal which smelled amazing. The driver and the person I spoke with on the phone were very friendly (great customer service), which was a nice bonus.

The food arrived hot, and was well packaged, with no spills.

We ordered salmon, teriyaki chicken, california rolls, and the fried ice cream.

The teriyaki chicken was a nice large serving plus rice, and tasted DELICIOUS.
The salmon was just fair, I did not feel it had enough flavor, but it was ok.
I did not sample the rolls, but my husband gave them his full approval!
and last but not least, the fried ice cream was SO GOOD. absolutely wonderful.
My only complaint being that there was one small cube of jello inside the fried ice cream, which I am sure was an accident, but a little odd!

Overall great experience!

Delicious! We had a Vanderbilt tour and needed to do an early lunch- lucky for us Union Common is now open for lunch at 11:00am!
The short rib brisket on homemade biscuit with a side of Mac and cheese was so good. My daughter had the chicken salad croissant which was great- it was almost like egg salad and chicken salad together. The fries were thin and crispy.
For dessert we had the cheesecake beignets with grilled pineapple and caramel- warm and yummy.
The service was spot on- Kristin was super friendly and helped guide our choices with her thorough knowledge of the menu.

I went here during opening week where they were offering a free taco. So in their defense they had just opened, it was almost 11pm, and it was crazy busy. With that said the waitstaff did not come to our table once we were sat for at least 15 minutes. It took another 20 minutes to get our food. I never recieved the soda I ordered. The taco's were pretty good though if not a little overpriced. I heard that after this first week they did close to re-train employees and a lot of people I know have visited it and enjoy it a lot. The atmosphere with all the graffiti was really cool and I will definitely given them another shot someday!

Lets start off with the positives. The place has a nice charm to it and the service was good. I believe this is the type of place that if its a burger or deep fried,you will love the food. Trying to be somewhat healthy, I ordered a tenderloin grilled. It was the worst one I have ever had. It was dry and cold. Wife had chili which she enjoyed. Like I said, if you want it fried,this is your place.

I was very impressed by the number of pleasant and friendly people we were greeted by.
   From the door man when we walked in and shown to the elevators to the roof, to the waitress, bartenders, and manager. We were greeted and made to feel welcome. 
     Bravo
   360* boasts beautiful views of downtown St. Louis.  Overlooking Busch Stadium and Ballpark Village it is a great place to take in a game without jockeying for an armrest or sending your anxiety through the roof. You can gaze out at the river through the arch, or watch the masses make their way through the city park after the game. Each side has some spectacular to offer.
  I am really looking forward to meeting friends and family here for an occasion. 
  Will be back.

Convenient location from the downtown canal walk, that's why we choose this restaurant was due to location. 

Excellent server, really wish I would of gotten her name. It is so unlikely of me to do that! 

Cocktails were amazing and food was even better! I ordered the shrimp and lobster pasta. It was a bit pricey for the amount of shrimp and lobster given.

Fabulous food, fabulous service and fabulous setting.
We went there for a special occasion, my 75th birthday.
It is a Four course menu , expensive, but Totally worth it.
Highly recommend

I'm officially never going back to Boston Market until they put apples back on as a side.  Everything is just bland and feels semi warmed over.  The chickens are fine but you can get rotisserie chicken anywhere now and the prime rib isn't available until dinner time. 
This location was a bit awkward- I stood in line for two minutes watching people do prep work.  I was on the verge of asking directly for help when a manager strolled over to start taking orders.  
It's all fine to get a hot meal and won't leave you hungry.  There's just a lot more that could be done without much trouble.

The atmosphere and presentation of meals are excellent. 

The majority of the food was really good as well. We had some seafood (the crab cakes weren't my favorite) and a burger which was really well sized. The dessert was really good! They have a trio sampler and we enjoyed all that came with that. 

Our only complaint was how slow it seemed to be to get food. It wasn't that busy and it seemed we sat for long periods of time waiting. 

Prices were decent. A little expensive for appetizers.

We have not dined here but I am giving the poor rating
based on their reservation system.  I made reservations 
early in week for a Sat night requesting a table on main 
floor.  We were notified the afternoon of the reservation that the only tables available were upstairs.  They have known for 2 months that all the tables were reserved on the main floor by a large party.  We should have been advised of this when the reservation was made so we would of had the option to make reservations elsewhere.
Poor management.

Great place! Tasty food. Great value. Friendly staff.  Three of us stopped in when we were in town from Orlando. We couldn't decide what to have, so opted for the "Boodle Fight" platter FOR 2. It was monstrously big. 
To be clear, the food is waiting in steam trays. It's not super "fresh." But it doesn't really detract from the food. The flavors are amazing. 
A couple notes- this is not a fancy place. Plastic utensils and foam plates. 
 But it IS immaculate. Don't be dissuaded by the simple exterior. 
There was fun old classic light rock playing. 
 Drinks are CHEAP!
The sour soup was also really good. 
If we lived in town, we would certainly be back soon.

Such a cool little place. The food is really great and they offer a lot of daily specials. Mr Joe's is one of those "going back in time" places. The staff is so welcoming and friendly. This is the type of place that makes South Philly so special.

First of all, the beer. 
The draft list always has a variety and you're bound to find something you love, they also serve Chester County wines if you don't drink beer.

The food.
In my opinion the most important part. The food is consistent and delicious. There is no freezer in the establishment, so you know everything is fresh! You can never go wrong with their brewery pretzel or handcrafted burger! They also have menu additions that change daily; leaving you with new options everytime.

Thirdly, the service.
Victory, like all other restaurants, can get very busy. The service can be spotty. I've had very attentive servers who were spectacular, I've also had servers who seemed to forget about my table. The bartenders are always great. The managers are constantly roaming and checking in. The service could be better though.

Lastly, the building itself. It has a rustic charm.  They have outdoor seating in the warm months; but it is by a busy street. They have a view of their small brewing setup; which is very cool! The place is always clean and orderly.

Sidenote: they also have a small retail part that sells six packs, kegs, clothing, and glassware

My date and I were so glad we chose Repeal while eating out for Devour Indy! It is certainly the greatest deal during Devour, and its food was so amazing that we will both be back to try Repeal's normal menu. Location is adorable, located in the heart of Fountain Square. Amazing slow-cooked BBQ, with a plethora of other options, and exceptional service - recommend!

I give this place zero stars.  I have worked in food service for 10 years - I ordered two 20oz draft beers during a happy hour that listed 16oz beers for $3.50.  When we got our ticket, they charged us $12.75 per 20oz beer = $25.50.  I talked to the manager and said this was unreasonable, at least drop it down to charge us two pints a piece ($15 total).  I told her I would not tip the server, which sucks.  She said she would take care of the server and there was nothing she would do.  Only after telling our server we would walk out with out paying our tab would they fix our tab.  What a joke.  DO NOT EAT HERE.  WORST SERVICE OF MY LIFE

Every once of my being tells me that I shouldn't like this place.  It's not at all like that usual restaurants that I frequent and it certainly doesn't fit my personality.  But, good food is good food and nice people are nice people.  

This place is simple and, for the price you can't go wrong.  It's typical American food and, if you're into sports you'll be thrilled by the EXTENSIVE collection of memoriabial (sp?) the Pub has.  The owner and  manager are personal friends with many of the Philadelphia Flyers, so don't be surprised to see some celebrities slipping in for a bite to eat.

As for the clientel, it's your typical Voorheesian yuppie crowd.  Just ignore them and you'll have a great dinner.

I placed a call in order tonight, which ended up being a good idea because when I went to pick it up the line was out the door.  It took them a while to get my order together, but the staff was friendly and prompt when I requested a missing item.  

I had the chicken breast plate meal, medium heat, with coleslaw, mac and cheese and I added the potato salad.  So glad I added the potato salad -- it was the best of ALL the sides.  I also ordered a peach cobbler and it was good as well.  

The chicken was moist and overall pretty good.  Not too greasy which can be a problem sometimes.  I would like to go back on a Sunday and try the chicken and waffles.
This is an amazing restaurant! Low key, classy, great service and fantastic farm to table food . Loved it!!!

Waitress was snippy and could have cared less if we were there.  Food was so so not bad but not worth going a second time.   Seemed to cater to people that come in everyday but if you don't it seems like your not worth their time.  Kind of sad.   You can't build business that way.
Great Deli and I love all the artisan cheese and the most helpful staff when I came in to shop for my clients Rob and Sheryl Lowe.

Great place to hang out with a pitcher of beer and just have a good time with your friends. It's not so packed like some of the other local bars. There are a few things that I miss being in Southern California now...and Bittercreek is at the top of that list. The atmosphere is just perfect.

The Basque seasoning on their food is also wonderful. I miss it

Don't let the parking lot fool you. The wait is always reasonable even on Friday nights. The food is great (try the beer cheddar soup) and everyone has fun. Get an app BC the food wait time is kinda long but other than that it's all good.
raw roast beef, i ordered a sand which to go. Got home ate half of it and realized i was eating RAW roast beef.
This one of my favourite diners. Great portions fast service and friendly workers. Their potato soup is the best hands down. Will eat there again and again and...

I just moved back into town & Denny's must be under new management. We used to go there all the time & although it wasn't horrible, this visit was great! We were greeted by an amazing enthusiastic smile & our server was super friendly & attentive. The food was much tastier than ever before. Whatever you guys are doing right now... Keep on doing!!!

Good food, and the prices are reasonable, but I think there is room for improvement.  Once my cheesesteak had a random slice of bacon in with the meat, another time I got a my salad without the chicken I ordered with it, stuff like that. You can't beat the 2 slices with a soda for 3.99, and it's nice that you can buy half of a cheesesteak, but I would suggest checking your order before you go for accuracy.

Big cudo's going out to Mike, that guy went above and beyond tonight. We ordered a meal for three, designated driver went and retrieved the meal, meal got home without one item. Called the manager, who happens to be Mike, Mike says, where do you live. Mike brings  the missing item, plus a desert to us!  Smart business move. Atta boy Mike. You will be receiving  more orders from us!!

Definitely the best sushi in the neighborhood. Used to go to Wasabi and Megu just to satisfy my craving with satisfactory level sushi. Although Megu used to be an overall decent sushi experience the quality of the sushi and their food has gone down considerably.
I have only tried this place for pick-up but I can't wait to try their dine-in. They have great lunch and dinner combos of sushi and other japanese meals at a great price. Their fish is fresh and their rice and overall sushi and rolls quality is great.
Although I have only been there for pick-up the ambiance is modern and clean, while the staff seems attentive and cordial.
Although this place does not compare in service and quality to upscale sushi restaurants, it is definitely the best sushi restaurant in Mount Laurel at great prices.
We had a corporate event here and had a great time! Great view, good food and great service! We will be back!

This might be my favorite Marriott yet.

Every staff member I encountered was super nice, From Kevin the bellman to the housekeeping staff.

It seemed like every time I stepped off the elevator there a complimentary snack waiting for me. Donuts & coffee in the morning, cheeseburger sliders in the afternoon and pretzels in the evening. It's a nice welcoming touch and everyone in the lobby always seemed so happy. 

We also had a lovely dinner party in Shulas steakhouse and the staff there was also super friendly.

I left off one star because the ventilation system in the rooms, not just mine, I checked with family members I was traveling with, is a bit of a nightmare. It blows really cold air, then really hot air day and night no matter what temperature I chose. 

I wish I had another reason to return to Conshohocken because I'd love to stay here again.

Other Marriott properties (I'm looking at you Westchester County Marriott) should take a lesson from these guys.

I had the pulled pork sandwich.  He had the pork shoulder sandwich. They were good and the staff was very friendly and helpful. The cole slaw was yummy.  She let us have a taste our first turnip greens.  Thank you!

Ordered the general tso chicken and and the lo mien noodle with chicken. 
The lo mien noodle is pretty good. The general tso chicken I threw out after trying a few pieces. Very fatty and one was very tough. Would not recommend to others

Party of 6 for a little celebration was well-received. Food was amazing and we shut the place down.  The crab was fresh, the sushi was delicious, and the owner was very accommodating! Will go to this gem again and again.

We had hibachi dinner for 7 people tonight.
It was a disaster from the time we arrived. Although the restaurant was fairly empty and we had a 6:30 reservation, we waited 15 minutes to be seated. The service was slow and rude, we waited almost 30 minutes to have our order taken.  Then we waited again until the hibachi chef was finished with another table before he started our table. Why? Was he the only one there? We finally got some food an hour after we sat. We have eaten hibachi many, many times. This chef seemed inexperienced and the food tasted bland. This is the last time we will go here.

Overall a disappointment. The bouillabaisse was just ok. A little chloriny tasting. The duck was overcooked. Special appetizer was a crawfish cheese egg thing that was sort of like a quiche. It was good -- not great. Crust was a little pasty instead of crisp.

Normally I would give pasta house a 4 star review but my Meatball sub from the O'Fallon store was disgusting. I swear it was taken from leftovers. It was not meat balls but looked like meatloaf covered in onions with next to no sauce.. Unfortunately, it was a take out order so I ended up throwing it away.  The side salad was excellent which is why they are getting a 2.

On a side note this is another hit or miss place when it comes to pizza sauce on my pizza.

Ate here last night.
It was the 2nd time we've been in. Our waitress was either VERY new to the food service industry or not well trained.
She did not know the menu, had to go back and ask the kitchen if they had mustard for the pretzels after first informing us they did not, she came back with 2 kinds.
When asked if the shrimp and fish for the tacos could be served grilled, she said "no,the chef doesn't like to do it that way or be asked to." When we gave her a puzzled/questioning look, she said "well, if I catch him in the right mood he might." She then said she would let us know. 
She never came back to the table until she brought our meals out.
I had not decided between the fish or shrimp but she took it upon herself to bring the shrimp tacos, she never asked what I wanted for a side and so it was served with chips and salsa. 
The shrimp was grilled but placed in the tacos, covered in sauce with the tails on! 

My fiancé ordered a grilled chicken sandwich with cheddar cheese and lettuce.
She brought that out with the beer cheese dipping sauce and no lettuce.
When he said he had ordered it with cheddar cheese and lettuce, instead of bringing it back to the kitchen brought out 2 slices of cold cheese to put on his sandwich and still forgot the lettuce.

She then never came back to our table until we flagged her down for the check.
We also had to get her attention for refills on water.

Our first experience was great and the food was good! This experience may prevent us from going back.
One our favorite places to have cioppino. It's the best we've ever had. It can be a long wait and reservations are not allowed.
So so good! We've had several things and have been impressed by all. Clean, nice place.

Great place to eat the service is awesome and the food is amazing fresh is the best.And my hubby and I have been here 4 times and love it each time, they have the best burgers in town. Stop bye and check them out it is worth the wait and time and the price yum.

I am originally from Texas and a Mexican food devotee.  However, I do not eat a variety of choices. After visiting several of our local fares, this was the only one to cook my specific choice (cheese & onion enchiladas with sour cream sauce).  Ever time I go there, they are consistent in the quality and service.  They are very friendly and in feels like my local hometown Mexican food restaurant.  It just feels right and the food is amazing.  My son tries something new every time we go and he has always enjoyed the choices and quality of food.  We like going there!

THERE WAS HAIR IN ALL THE FOOD. We ordered 3 plates and split between 5 people, we found hair in the chicken, peas, and when asked about the hair the waitress replied "everyone where's hats and hairnets, I don't know where the hair came from" granted she gave us a piece of chicken but terrible customer service. There is also a service fee of 4 dollars per person, when you share a plate. Overall bottom of the list for food in Nola.
Last night was my first night there. We ordered chicken alfredo, linguine with clams, and appetizers calamari. The food was good overall good experience.

The food here is much better then the reviews lead on. The french fries with garlic were amazing. I also had the shrimp and grits and thought they were flavorful. Only giving it a 4 star because the environment was dull starting with the hostess. It doesn't have a very exciting atmosphere as it leads on. Food is great, I recommend it for that reason.
Food was great when it finally got delivered. Bread, wings pizza. Not too hard for a wing and pizza joint.
I love the Korean tacos! So close to my home. I can hardly get home with all the tacos. The green apple slaw? Just the best!
Amazing fish tacos!! Got chips and beans when we walked in. Refreshing drinks and great service!!

it seems that the quality of the food and service has gone down lately. The rice noodles smell like playdoe and sometimes they mix up the broths in the pho. where is the freshness and taste I am accustom to? I don't know.

This Taco Bell is so awful.  Nothing is worse than working 12 hours and craving Taco Bell then getting home and realizing they completely screwed up your order yet again. You say no beef.... they put beef. You order chips and cheese? You only get one or the other; never both. Go through drive thru and order something that requires a utensil? No worries... they won't give you one.
Alex and Mikey made our night absolutely amazing. So kind and went the extra mile for my friends birthday. Thank you

I was very disappointed with my visit to Pêche this evening.   The food was mediocre. My daughter had the Steak Tartare appetizer.  The oyster aioli totally overwhelmed the flavor of the tartare. This dish should accent the flavor of the beef, not mask it.  My dish was a grill tuna. This came with, with a sautéed green, apparently kale. Again the accompaniments masked the the delicate flavor of the tuna.  My wife ate baked drum which she said was acceptable. This is the only reason the review received two stars.  

In a seafood restaurant, I would expect that fish dishes would be more than merely adequate, at the best.  At the prices this place charges, they should be spectacular. 

The poor performance of the food was well matched by the poor performance of the waitstaff. 

Overall, for a restaurant that dares charge $50 a person, including a glass of wine or beer, this is not anyplace I would recommend.

Worth the wait and the chaos! The peacemaker benedict is brilliant because then you can try two! I opted for the Chicken St Charles and the Shrimp Boogaloo because it seemed like the signature choice. It's now verified that tomato, egg, and shrimp are not my favorite breakfast combo, but worth a shot. Everything else was amazing. Super jealous of the banana fosters French toast and stuffed French toast that my friends had! The bacon is thick yet crispy. The breakfast cocktails are generous - mimosa are lightly colored and bubbly and bloody Mary's are perfectly spicy. The service was super friendly and accommodating but a bit slow and frazzled. 

Life hack: get on the list through yelp to make the line 15m instead of 90, and get a drink at the bar up front while you wait!

Been here twice so far and both times were very enjoyable. Wings are really good, and pretty standard burger too. There drink menu is awesome! The smoked piña is an amazing drink! Way different then anything I've ever tried. Happy hour is pretty sweet too, $15 margarita pitchers. Score!
Yaba Daba Dooo! love this joint!  Beers are yummy and a nice crowd

It's my first trip back to Philly in over 40 years. The line moved swiftly and you have to be ready to order once you arrive at the window. It can be intimidating at first. I ordered "wit" onions & provolone. I found the bread to be a bit dry and chewy. Onions could of been sautéed a little longer. Out of my 3 steak stops, I am sad to report this stop ranks last.

So this replaced Pompei if I remember correctly. And to be honest they get points for a clever name. FYI the actor is Pesci. The floor level areas are nice, well decorated (cool curtains hanging down, main dining light fixtures). Looks like a decent place to grab a drink at the bar. There's also a more "exclusive" or at least gives off the notion of exclusive upper area in the back. It gives you some options since it's slightly more intimate depending on what you're going for on a given evening.
The food is great, especially the Goat Karhai, Nihari and the Naan. The service has always been top notch, as well. One of my favorite places to go in the Indy area
My son got food poisoning here and the manager refused to reimburse more than 10% of the meal.  We will not be patronizing the establishment again.

I've recently been here twice in two weeks and each time the quality of my interaction at this pub has been really great. How do I describe this place? Well the food would be something like Mexic-Asian-Mediterranean-Fusion-Philly cuisine. For example, you can get Cheesesteak Eggrolls or a Quesedilla sandwich... you get the idea. The burgers looks really juicy too, for straight American pub food.

Beers are not really expensive, contrary to someone else's review. Cheap stuff may appear expensive, but I think it's because they want you to buy the better stuff which is VERY reasonably price. I start with a draught 16oz Hefeweizen for $6.50. Is that really expensive? Try getting that a Monk's for that price. And that is one of the more expensive beers. They have Victory on tap as well as other national micro-brew beers. And yes, they will pour Irish Car Bombs and Jaeger shots.

The two bar tenders on Friday nights are very friendly and with the group that I go out with (the Philly N Crowd) have their orders ready without even asking.

There are a lot of HDTVs in this place and there are two pool tables in the back. No smoking and the decor is dark with a series of circular booths lining one wall. It's a little bit in need of a cohesive theme, but the place is clean and fun.

It's a little bit off the beaten path if you're in Olde City, but a nice place to spend your late night if you don't want to shout to hear one another and have a few more drinks and eat something interesting.

You cannot beat the convenience and food if you are going to an event at the Straz Center. We walked in on Saturday, which happened to be during Gasparilla and the restaurant we planned on going to was packed with a long wait, but it worked out perfectly. It is about $44 per adult for a first plate buffet, an entree of your choice and a dessert of your choice. The buffet was fabulous! Meats, cheeses, salad and some soup on the end and everything I had was great! We had the prime rib and the chef special, which was veal with Brussel sprouts and cous cous and both were very fair portions. And for dessert I had the peanut butter cheesecake and my boyfriend had the chocolate mousse one and both were terrific! 

We sat at the bar since we walked in with no reservation and the service was mediocre. The drinks were great though. We ordered our entree and went to the buffet I sat down with my plate and my boyfriend was still getting his and the entrees were brought out and placed next to us so we sat with 2 plates the entire time. Then getting a refill was a little difficult. For desserts the bartender pulled out his phone and for a full minute was clicking on things trying to pull up a picture of the 4 desserts of the evening. He showed us on his phone pointing out each one and they all sounded great, but he was getting Twitter updates and such the entire time. There should be an iPad with the picture owned by the restaurant that employees can show guests if they want them to have a visual. At the end we sat with empty plates for 15 minutes before we could get the attention of the staff to ask for the check. 

I assume service at a real table would be better and I would go again since the food was great and the convenience of already being at the straz center was also a huge plus!

Simply awesome! Not sure about the issue with the place being overly crowded as I had the opportunity to give them a try at 8am last Friday before starting my new gig here in Boise. Searched yelp for the local breakfast places and there were several ranked qute nicely. We chose Goldy's.... fortunately. OMG this place is off the hook. The staff was wonderfully friendly and accomadating. We ordered an omlette and oatmeal that were both great. But the awesome surprize was the homemade blueberry scone. I'm a scone snob. That's right! I've tried so many variations all around the country, the best being at a cool little market/bakery on College Ave in Berkeley, CA.  But this scone at Goldy's was wonderfully unique and scrumptious. It was perfectly flackly with the middle lined with an amazing warm blueberry filling. I'm looking forward to getting back there very soon!!!

Sunrise Lanes...ahhh where to begin....

Let's start with problem numbero uno- SHANE. He has absolutely zero customer service. The customer is always wrong! His attitude is as if he enjoys upsetting people who spend money in there. I don't understand. From being moved from one lane to the next, to needing 7 people for 2 lanes, to denying every common request imaginable... He always says he's the only manager on shift. It's the closest bowling alley to my house, but I'd rather take a 20 minute ride to Ten Pins lanes from now on.

Love this place mid-day, late afternoon or night! Great atmosphere with friendly service. Food is always served prompt & hot. Menu has excellent variety for all age groups and pallets. Reservations accepted or walk in and seat yourself in the lounge/bar room. Also a great place for team meetings, employee parties & employee social events!

Friends from NYC suggested this place so we tried it out and it was really good. I'm all about the crust but the sauce was amazing and the toppings were perfect. Seriously this was a really good pizza and I don't even crave pizza but maybe now I will.

Super good. I want some right now haha. The money you spend is worth it here. The gyro plate is amazing and you can choose your side and you get a drink. Very satisfied and super yummy. It is also quick.

I find myself eating here at least once a month. I also enjoy hanging out watching a ball game now and then with my buds. My regular order (and all out favorite without question) is the Hot Chicken Chunks and fries. I don't eat fried food much at all, but when I do I enjoy the lightly breaded and perfectly spicy chunks of white chicken breast meat chased with a cold mug of beer!! Getting hungry just thinking about it. See ya there.

Good little museum but we do feel it is over-priced. They had some great memorabilia, clothing, hand-written letters from Cash and history about his acting career and timeline of his music career. Bathrooms were clean and it was nice and cool inside on a very hot summer day! Gift shop is very over-priced.

Great service by Mike by the bar tender! He was very personable and informative about all the beers available. I tried four 4 oz samples and especially loved the Conshohopfen Hull Melon Helles. But all the imperials were awesome too. Can't wait to come back and try more beer and food.

Never a bad visit with In-N-Out  I just wish there was one closer to my house. Love me a double double animal style with some hot peppers  what they do with COVID cleanliness is absolutely amazing. Lastly- the customer service is always on point!
The Oysters OMG sooo fresh and delicious. Located near a variety of boutiques. The drinks are amazing and the food is to die for! If you are in Tampa this is the place to visit! Enjoy!
Very cute, reminds me of a Trader Joe's. They have the best smoothies! I recommend the Pineapple Express.

WOW! This place is great. I had a bad experience with Birria Tacos at another place when I first tried it, so I just figured I didn't like it. But this place definitely changed my mind about Birria tacos. The broth was so flavorful! Very reminiscent of the flavor of tortilla soup, but darker and slightly thicker. I also got a bean and cheese papusa and it was also delicious. 10/10. I will definitely be returning.
THE best Barbados taco I have ever eaten!  The salsa flight with freshly fried tortilla chips amazing-wide variety of flavors & heat! Great atmosphere & woman owned.

Lived in Reno while going to UNR, and I'm sad I didn't discover this place until my junior year of college. BEST. CHAI. EVER. Chai's are my go-to drink, and I'm a bit of a Chai snob, having tried it almost everywhere, and Bibo makes the best chai I've ever tasted. So delicious, and I always crave it. I've tried several other drinks and bites besides the Chai and everything has been delicious; especially their quiche and cranberry bagels! Having Bibo before a study session, or morning class made my day even better! Staff got to know me because I would come so frequently; Maren and Mark are the best! Will miss this place after graduating and moving from Reno.
Incredible food great atmosphere and great food at a reasonable price!  If you are looking for Chinese food you have to try Linh-Nam!  A+

When you go to South Philly to eat authentic Italian you need to get over niceties and concentrate on the food. I ate outside on the sidewalk. We had the fried Calamari which had tender pieces of meat and was lightly breaded. I had the Gnochhi Romano (in a pink sauce) that was amazing and fresh. My company had the Dante's Signature Special which was Linguini in Marinara. Everything was delicious. Despite the normal unfriendliness in South Philly their restaurants stay amazing. I would definitely go back to Dante & Luigi's again.

The food was amazing along with the awesome belly dancers. The ambience of the restaurant was very appealing as well. The food was reasonably priced, however I didn't enjoy the baklava due to the fact that I have been to Istanbul and hands down the best baklava. Overall, would recommend this restaurant.

Highly recommend this mexican restaurant. I am always not a big fan of mexican food, but this place was so good! Love the restaurant atmosphere, friendly staff, and delicious food. They made guac in person. The guac was a little spicy, and I just can't stop eating it. The lemonade was fresh-made as well. I enjoyed it a lot. For the entrees, I got steak & sausage with rice and sauce. Outstanding! Overall, I had a great experience here! Will definitely come to eat again when I visit Tampa next time.

I was curious about this place after passing through Lakeview a few weeks ago.  I'm a little hesitant to go out to the burbs when there are so many good places close by, but it looked cool and I wanted to give it a shot.  Unfortunately, I just found another reason, not to cross City Park Ave. 

The Good: 
The space was very well done. It had a patio feel very similar to the Bulldog, only here its a tequila bottle fountain instead of beer taps. There was lots of reclaimed wood, intricate brickwork, a bejeweled motorcycle, glass garage doors overlooking the patio. The service was good considering that the place was packed. We got our drinks and food pretty quick. 

The Bad: 
The food was a disappointment. It had great presentation, but in New Orleans, fancy presentation doesn't count for much if it doesn't taste good. It wasn't bad, really, but it's on par with Tex Mex at any major chain restaurant. The ingredients seemed fresh, but not really put together well. I never realized how good Juan's was, until we came here. For dessert we ordered the churros...what a joke. The waitress came back with a full size plate that had 6 french fry sized "churros" on it. They were stacked up log cabin style around some chocolate sauce. I tried my best not to laugh. One of the worst $5 I have ever spent. 

Now, they haven't been open for too long, so I don't want to slam them too hard. Maybe they need some time to get their recipes straightened out, but for now I'll give them 1 star for the food and 2 for the atmosphere.

This place will always be my favourite for when I'm craving tacos! Their quality has always been consistent and I love how the restaurant isn't a "gimmicky" Mexican restaurant. It's quite trendy and I love the use of community tables. I typically order the Al Pastor + chips and salsa, and it always has me leaving with a full and happy stomach!!

Wow I can not say enough about this place. It never let's you down! The food is top notch and they have a great menu but if u don't like that they have make  your own menu! The tea here is awesome and the atmosphere is relaxed. They always have the games on the tv. 

That being said even though I love this place there are a few cons. The food does take a wile most of the time. The seating is a bit camped. Also if you do have a small child it would most likely be a messy venture for the whole family. 

Even with these cons this is, in my opinion, the best burger joint that I have been to. It has something for everyone and is a treat every time I go.

This place is awesome! The guy at the counter was super nice. I got the gyro combo with cheese fries and my friend got the donut burger (with one patty) with cheese and bacon and cheese fries and it was so good! The donuts and pastries are awesome as well! We will definitely be back very soon!

This is, by far, my favorite bar/grill in Tucson. Everyone is friendly, and the food is always delicious!  I love the margaritas, too! The mac and cheese and crab cakes are my favorite menu items!: If you haven't been here, you are missing out on a Tucson gem!

We stopped by for lunch on a Saturday afternoon in early spring. They had the propane heaters on outside on the deck so it was a nice are to hang out in and watch the hockey game. We ordered a salad and the Ropa Vieja. Both portions were generous and neither of us finished, we had to box up the extra to take home. The salad was well executed and was very fresh. The Ropa Vieja was pretty good, the beef was well cooked and flavorful, the accompanying fried plantains were very good. The sauce on the rice was not great, it tasted like canned or jarred tomato sauce. Not bad, just not anything I would write home about.

The service was polite and didn't keep us waiting. Decor was cute, and unobtrusive. it's pretty obvious this place is better at night than during the day. 

Overall a good experience, decent food, polite staff and a good atmosphere. Next trip to New Hope we will try something else.

Without a doubt my favorite lunch spot!  It is the one place that is ALWAYS on my "bucket list" when I come home from school.  Great place to have a long lunch date with your Mommy :)

Great food!  Amazing menu and daily soups are ALL delicious I swear.  

If you're there before 11AM...I promise you that the OATMEAL will change your life.  One of a kind delicious stuff!!!

My favorite smoothies in Arizona! 

It is rare for me to be able to enjoy a sweet, creamy smoothie because I have to sub out the frozen yogurt. Usually my smoothies have a texture that isn't quite as satisfying but not at Smoothie Shack! They have a delicious soy substitute that adds an amazing, decadent sweetness and velvety texture that I've missed so dearly in smoothies.

If I could, I would get one of their Go Bananas with Soy every morning. (I also love that they're open late!)

First the person answering the phone was being an ass. I simply asked if they were open (it's Memorial Day) and she said , uh yeah. I answered didn't I?  

Meat in the duk guk soup HORRIBLE. Both me and my lady agreed the meat was not edible. We mentioned to the waiter and then the owner/manager came and explained to us in korean that the meat is perfectly fine. Lol. We told her no it's not but that's ok. Really didn't need her to explain if we didn't like a dish we ate our entire lives growing up. I didn't tell her that I literally spit the meat out onto my plate lol. A lot of places freeze the meats in Saran Wrap and then microwave it IN THE SAME PLASTIC. Thus the incredibly poor taste. I won't accuse them of doing this, but if I was placing a $100 bet....

Sushi was good. The side dishes were good. Service from our waiter was good. I think he felt bad we still got charged in the aftermath. 

But All was not lost. They didn't take off the soup but instead gave us 10% off the soup not the bill.  LMAO. Needless to say wont be back while there are better options and management in Tampa.

Let's get the embarrassing stuff right out of the way: I didn't know the restaurant was associated with THE Kingsford, as in the grill-makers, until I had parked and was walking in. True confession... And also true: this place is good! 

It was quieter than I expected on a Saturday night, but then again-we ate early (6:30). We also ate in the bar, so I missed watching the open kitchen/grill master technique, but that's just another reason to go back. There's also: tremendous cocktails, great live music, sweet servers, lots of free parking, convenient location (at Westshore Mall, in the old Mitchell's location, next to Besito) and hands down, the best chicken sandwich ever! I had them leave off the tomato, onion and aioli and it still packed a huge flavor punch with fully melted and gooey Muenster cheese and crispy bacon (four big pieces). The chicken was juicy and cooked to perfect "doneness"... and that bun. I'd go back just for the bun... truly.  And oh yeah, great fries! Salty, crispy on the outside-soft on the inside. Yum! 

So yeah, I'm going back! We'll eat in the main part next time (there appears to be lots of seating). We'll look for ya. (I'll be the one with the watermelon margaritas)

Whew I am ill and do not get out much. My sister bought me one of the dishes I love from Drake's Place Bri's pasta.  It was delicious as usual.  I ate until I was full then ate some more because it tasted good 

My compliments to the chef. If I had gotten a salad with the house dressing.  I would have eaten entirely to darn much.
