Something happened after they renovated... the past three online orders have taken anywhere from 45 minutes to an hour to fill and had to wait on the tiny booth chair while people crowded around the entrance, trying to be seated, trying to get by. The extra spicy chicken tikka masala is now more like mild, used to light me up. And... they raised their prices! I would suggest heading to Gandhi Cuisine of India a short distance away. More comfortable, cozy family reastaurant.

Friendly atmosphere. Great sushi and sashimi. Good quality fish with impressive cooking technique. Seared sashimi gives you extra dimension of the fish.

Try mix and match sushi platter. Their combinations in each bite is very well executed.

The Deck is a great place to unwind and dine.  Great views and vibrant, attentive staff.  For that special evening, family gathering or to be spoiled, make reservations for the Moshulu's inside dining.  Dinners are fresh and filling. Brunch - coupled with live music - is like a destination experience.

I had the margarita pizza and it was outstanding it had fresh basil and fresh mozzarella and the sauce was very good. It was super hot and crispy and I had to take half of it home couldn't eat it all. Then when the waitress brought me back my to go box she also gave me a few samples of their homemade gelato I ended up getting a pistachio for myself and a pumpkin spice for my wife both of which were also delicious. I would highly recommend stopping in if you're in the neighborhood but you ruined it does take a few minutes to get your food as it's made to order.

This place is by far the best breakfast! In my travels to Nashville I am so glad I got to eat here. We had the Bonuts and lots of other amazing dishes. They were all to die for. If I ever come back I will be hitting this spot more than once.

Pizza was very good. Garlic knots are delicious and different.  Loved their antipasto!  Looking forward to returning  to try the Italian dinners. Patty is a wonderful server, you can tell she love the owners and everything they put out. Forgot to take pictures., next time.  I  am so happy we have a neighborhood real italian restaurant,  small but comfortable. As I said, can't wait to return.

Service was good but waiting time was ridiculous
One hour on waiting list, one hour for meal, and had to deal with missing items on plate from Kitchen.
Waiter was very polite and friendly.
Food was really tasty and bill was reasonably priced

Of the big Italian chains, Romano's Macaroni Grill is easily my favorite.  I don't think I've ever had a bad dish here.  But the real standouts for me are the Lobster Ravioli and the Pasta Milano.  I could eat either of those any day of the week.  As for appetizers, the calamari and spinach artichoke dip are hard to beat.   And their tiramisu is hands down the best you will find in a chain restaurant around here.  Oh, and they have excellent, excellent bread.  

Macaroni Grill definitely isn't the best Italian I've had in my life but when it comes to chains, it sure is.  Bottom line... if you're looking for consistently good Italian food on the cheap, then Macaroni Grill is your best bet.

Food is good I had fried cat fish. Friends had seafood pasta which was very seasoned.  And Marco lobster which was  hearty but a little bland. The creole seasonings good so ask for it on lobster if you order that. Hot sauce on fish as it was a little bland. I would recommend because the oysters Rockefeller were the bomb! And William our waiter was very nice and accommodating even during a busy day.

The only reason i gave it a four was because of the food but the attention I got from my server was one of the best I have had in a long time. Paola made my morning entertaining and enjoyable. I've been here before and nothing compares to other waitress who are just rude and disrespectful. I think I would go back to this place just to be served by her, she makes the food taste better. Thanks again Paola and hope to see her soon.

Dined here this weekend to celebrate my best friends mother's 60th birthday. First let me just say I was really impressed by the restaurants following covid guidelines with only 25% capacity and well spaced seating. The servers Also wore both face masks and face shields. Service was great. We had a server in training but he did really well and we kept encouraging him throughout the night. Now onto the food. We shared a seafood tower which included cocktail shrimp, crab legs, crab claws, and lots of butter/cocktail sauce, and some type of hollendaise. Between 4 ppl it was barely enough to go around but I've dined here before and knew the portions for this would be slight. The seafood itself was super fresh and tasty. For my cocktail I ordered the berries and bubbly which is a cute little drink with dry ice smoke. It was also pretty strong so that was a plus. For my entree I got the lamb chops and the table shared lobster Mac and cheese, garlic mashed potatoes, and roasted Brussels. The sides are generously portioned for sharing (2-3 ppl can share one). We skipped the dessert but I did see a neighboring table with the warm butter cake and I will most definitely be back for that!

Been here several times and service is always slow. But since the food is OK and tibia the only place in the mall you can get a table during lunch, I keep coming back.
Not sure what the whole excitement about their meatballs is. They are ok. But  that is all. Decent fries, ok sliders.

This place is awesome! My boyfriend and I stopped in to get a quick bite to eat and we ordered chicken burritos and they were delicious. Danny was amazing he welcomed us from the start served us personally and was very caring and attentive. Try the pupusas!!!! Deeellicioussssssss

First visit and I was not impressed 

The space is beautiful 

The drinks were great (try the Pecan Old Fashion)
 
Service was spotty, server would go missing for  periods at a time. It was not a busy night and we were right in the middle of the restaurant so we were hard to miss. 

I had the Osso Bucco and was not impressed 
It was small, came lukewarm from the kitchen and was just a step above bland.

Deserts were better but not enough for me to return.

I arrived about 45 min before closing and decided to try out the bar specials.  Justin is a great bartender.  I asked what kind of wine would pair well with my meal,  he made a suggestion and even asked if I would like to try a sip first.  He was a great conversationalist and made me feel as though I was a regular.  Ask for Justin if ever in the bar.  And the food was nothing short of excellent even though they were closing up shop soon. I will definitly be recommending Drunken Fish to my passengers, and will be returning myself.

A little gem!

The food is excellent and service was great. 

They also sell some common Chinese dishes just in case someone in the family doesn't like Thai. My daughter is one of those people so it is good that they offer more so we can dine in as a family.

I highly recommend to anyone.

The only negative is the location, parking can be hard to find at peak hours.

It appears my last review did not post (operator error?!)  We just had a great night at this unique winery in Plainfield, IN. Lisa did an outstanding job of getting us started and the fantastic team of Joy, Terra and the great Michelle made the night even that more incredible!! Try the Teroldego for a great red wine! And if you are lucky enough to get the "private" bar, you will totally be VIP at this fun spot!

Excellent meal. Excellent server. Wonderful evening!

Loved the House Plank - it was just right for four to share as an appetizer.

My filet was perfection, and the lobster risotto we ordered to share on the table was wonderful.

My only request is to please change where the red wine is stored; our bottle felt chilled when it was brought to the table.
Don't go. Just don't. Too many tourists, too loud. What I ordered looked like someone threw up, the rice was old and undercooked.

Terrible experience. Think it's starting to go down hill. Ordered a hoagie that was awful. There was hardly any taste to it and the bread was stale. The lady making my hoagie tried to sass me and I didn't appreciate it. She gave me a nasty stare too. Don't think I'll be back.
I eat here every time I visit my brother The service and food are always exceptional I will continue to eat here every time I visit.

Absolutely delicious, great customer service and experience.The steak tartare with truffle was tender,fresh and a very generous portion. The escargot in a green maybe pesto sauce it's a must try. The Delmonico was outstanding, grill to perfection.Last but not least the amazing dessert room, what a great atmosphere and so super cozy.We had the Alaskan, I can't recommend it enough, delicious flambé merengue in a mix of different liquors. moist cake and the best ice cream in Tampa bay their macadamia ice cream. 3 layers of decadent flavor but not too sweet.

Fiance and I ate there for the first time and loved the decor- wood, initmate feel. But thought the food was a miss. Started off with the deviled eggs (nothing to write home about, my mom makes better) and the cobb salad which was so salty it was inedible- and I love salt! For entrees I had the prosciutto pizza which was decent but not mind-blowing and fiance had the ribs. Ribs were cooked perfectly with a tasty sauce but the cole slaw and cornbread fell flat. There was just nothing super special about the dish. The dessert however was the highlight- apple cobbler with pepper ice cream. So unique and a party of flavors in my mouth. If the rest of the dishes were at that level, this place would be awesome. Unfortunately though the ice cream alone is not enough to warrant a return visit.

Now this is the definition of a gastropub. The food is adapted from owners food truck days to be some delicious invitation to dining. And don't forget a great take on mixed cocktails. 
What do I suggest? Everything. Take your pick. Decide what meat you're  in the mood for may help lead you in the right direction, but there is absolutely no wrong direction. 
The stinky buns are NOT stinky. They are a little sticky and a lot amazing. Even, surprisingly, actually shockingly... The zucchini one was superb as well.  
Just stop reading and go and enjoy.
Excellent service and great food! We had the duck tater tots, baked cheese, strawberry salad, and brisket... Everything was fantastic!

Bad service.

Greasy tortilla chips.

Worn seat cushions.

Annoying Spanish speaking television shows blaring on small flat screen TV.

Sour facial expressions by staff, and loud talking coming from small kitchen.

Cold food that was supposed to be hot.

Bland tasting food.

Etc.

No way Jose.
If you like spicy food tell them to make it Indian spicy. Talk about kicking it up a notch!

If you're looking for a lunch that will be filling, tasty, and still easy on your conscience, you should stop by Elaine's. She has put so much effort into her shop and you can truly taste it. We stopped by here on a whim and it was such a great decision. There is tons of variety and what we had tasted great. It was a good stop to add to a weekend in St.Louis.

Gah I love Hank's cheesecakes! My one niece has been known to request these for a birthday cake, yep she is definitely my blood. Hank's is like a slice of cheesecake heaven.

My fave thing to do is get a sampler and enjoy a vast variety. Plus the portions are small and you can semi convince yourself you are not going to turn into a whale after scoffing down two different varieties while eying a third. The texture is perfect creamy yet solid, dense yet somehow not too heavy. They are not overly sweetened or fake tasting like mass produced cheesecakes which rocks. The crust, mmmmm, perfection.

For my money amaretto caramel, tiramisu and mocha macadamia are the way to go but really you cannot go wrong whatever you are craving. Evil but angelic all at the same time, you gotta give Hank's a whirl.

This place was horrible.  We went for lunch/brunch on a Saturday morning.  We were literally the first customers in the door.  It took one hour to get our food (pancakes and hash).  An hour later my kids received burnt black pancakes and my husband received hash which reeked of A1 steak sauce.  The waitress was not very friendly and clearly the cook is a complete novice.  Oh, and one of the bathrooms was out of order and the other was devoid of soap or toilet paper.
Good taste, but too oily. Friendly staff and nice and clean interior, with Bollywood music videos always playing on TV.

Reservation was made about a month in advance for an early dinner on the weekend.

Nothing to complain about. The winners that night were the frog legs and the suckling pig. The creme brulee was the best I have ever had.
Lots of variety of sushi, seafood buffet is really good, frog legs variety of shrimp & fish, crabs smell strong-didn't try them (I like crab). I would go back.

Real diner food! On our way home from a hospital visit in Danville we stopped at Waffle House. Seriously haven't been to a Waffle House in close to 20 years. I love real diner food served in a real diner. Our server Hannah was super friendly and did a great job. Bacon, eggs over med, and a waffle was a great way to end the day. Too bad it's so far from home. All the staff was very friendly. This was about 8:45 on a Thursday.

Some of the best food of our first- time trip to NOLA in a relaxed friendly lively setting.Starting out with tasty cocktails (iced tea with vodka and fresh mint from their garden),we then loved our entrees, baked fish fillet with crawfish etoufee and braised short ribs, really excellent well-prepared dishes.

The service was beyond good,  very kind and thoughtful. We went there in the first place because we wanted to see Zydeco night at the Rock n'Bowl next door, and I just bought the show tickets on line, without realizing that I could have gotten a discount by eating at the restaurant and buying the tickets at the door. That was OK with us, one of perils of travelling and not knowing stuff, but the staff at Ye Olde were concerned enough about our not being able to get the discount that they called the manager of the club (owned by the same people) and asked them to give us free drinks. We were then met practically at the door of the club by the manager who directed us to the bar and served us our drinks. So sweet! No way did they have to do that, just generous customer service. Zydeco night was fun too.

Food came out 45 minutes late was okay. Seagulls are everywhere so you'll have to fend off your food constantly from them. Staff doesn't grab food when it's done and this is where the birds come in and create a mess.
THE BEST tacos in Tampa!! Been in Cali over 15 years and these are the closes do yourself a favor by trying the al pastor with pineapple!

My boyfriend and I had a delicious meal here over the weekend while visiting New Orleans.  I have been to Italy 3 times, so I am always looking for authentic Italian food, and The Italian Barrel definitely fulfilled this requirement of mine. It is a very small restaurant, so even though we had a reservation, we had to wait a little bit for our table to be ready.  However, I will give credit to the restaurant for not charging us for the Cosmopolitan I had while we waited.  Once we were seated, I browsed the menu and knew exactly what I was wanted: the Porcini and Truffle Ravioli.  Truffle is one of my absolute favor flavorings, so I knew I had to try the ravioli.  To start, we shared the trio of polenta, which I greatly enjoyed.  I'm a fan of bleu cheese; however, if you are not, you should know that the Gorgonzola polenta is quite strong.  The bread and olive oil and balsamic vinegar were also tasty to munch on before our entrees arrived.  The ravioli was delicious!  I could tell that the pasta was made fresh, and I was especially pleased that I could really taste the truffle.  My boyfriend had the seafood linguine, and he really enjoyed it.  While enjoying our dinner, I ordered a lemon drop, and our waitress put a hint of Chambord in the bottom of it, which made it even better! I would definitely recommend this restaurant for great Italian food, just be sure to make a reservation.

Horrible experience with this location. We placed a pickup order really early in the morning to be picked up at 5pm on Mother's Day, when we got to the parking lot for the curb side pick up, we where waiting for over 30 minutes and no one came to check on us to get our food. We called the store multiple times and confirmed the food was ready but no one came to my vehicle to assist. We finally got the attention of one of the workers and he was extremely rude! We asked him if he could get our order and he said we're busy and will have to get back to me. At this time I was really frustrated and decided to cancel our order, we again called the store and asked for a manager and waited on the phone for over 25 minutes to get the manager and when we explained our concerns he was really rude about canceling our order and hung up the line without apologizing or letting me know if and when our money would be reimbursed. I'm not one to write bad reviews but this was unacceptable and it ruin my wife's Mother's Day. I will not be returning to this place and letting all my friends and family know of our horrible experience.

I still think they struggle with consistancy. Last 2 visits were cold and hot (just an expression, not the food). But when they are hot, they are really hot!

Over the weekend, I just ate the best bacon cheeseburger I've ever had. And I've been around the block quite a few times! I like Red Robin and Steak n Shake for burgers but whoooeee this place smashes them to pieces! Give it a shot - you might catch them on a good night. If so, you may have found your new favorite burger place - it is now mine! 

Also, the sweet potatoe fries were killer good (does that even make sense?) I'll not order regular fries here again. Slaw was pretty darn good and the service was slow put very enthusiastic and friendly. In their defense, they were very busy - we waited 15 minutes for an open table and they have a pretty big dining area.

Throw the dice and give them a chance!

Concord pizza has been around forever! It seems like a staple in the area. I couldn't remember why we stopped going there until our experience tonight. I ordered the small pizza special over the phone and placed the order to pick up. The menu stated that the pizza would contain pepperoni, sausage, mushrooms, onions, green peppers, tomatoes, and olives. I picked up my order to find that the pizza contained 0 of the listed toppings. Just cheese. I walked back inside and showed them the menu I read the description off of - management told me that they don't have an online menu and that the one I read was inaccurate. They handed me a physical copy of their new menu and told me they would not add the toppings to the pizza and the physical menu was the only one I should go off of. I took it and left with the cheese pizza. When I got home, I took a look at their physical menu, the ONLY menu they offer to find that the description of their pizza special contains all of those toppings! What in the ?!?
Fantastic mole.  This is real mexican food.  I can't wait to go back to try more of the menu.

Bruce Dogs is simply amazing. I have eaten some mutant form of the hot dog all over the world, and this one is hard to beat. Bruce is an upstanding guy, very personable and friendly; A "give you the shirt off his back" kinda guy. He's a worldly dude and is sure to give you a great conversation with your dogs (free of charge).

The food is simple, but that's what makes it so fantastic. All-beef, kosher hot dogs and polish dogs, at an insane price. Here's the secret: his homemade chili and special salad he puts on top is to die for. The perfect amount of spice and flavor. The contents are a closely-guarded secret, but they are divine. The recipes he uses are a reflection of his culture and are a true treasure of Tucson.

Fold-out tables and canned soda top-off the experience. Perfect for a quick dinner, drunk-munchies, or just the borderline-intervention fix you crave after you have one.

Do yourself a favor and head down to the cart and order two Bruce Dogs, just as he makes them, nothing more, nothing less. You're welcome.

Visited Beachbum Berry's Latitude 29 for the first time on February 21st, during a week-long vacation to New Orleans.  The bar is located at the rear of the Bienville House Hotel, facing North Peters St.  I was favorably impressed with this place!!  My brother and I came back two more times that week, and got well acquainted with Sam the bartender.  Also met bartender Brad, who is also a cool guy. During my three visits I tried the Nui-Nui, Latitude 29, Hell in the Pacific, Rum Barrel, Mai-Tai, and Oaxacan Sour....all were EXCELLENT cocktails, mixed to perfection and beautifully garnished by Sam!  The bar has great tiki decor, and is a relaxing place to hang-out and meet people while in New Orleans.  Thumbs up to a great tiki bar experience!!  Definitely hope to come back again sometime!

What a great new addition to downtown St Pete!  Asian-fusion restaurant with unique twists on classics.  

AMBIANCE: The decor / interior is what first caught our eye as we walked by this place, it's so cute + classy. Open air environment with an open kitchen. Perfect place for date night or a dinner celebration with friends. I'd also like to sit at the bar one day soon to try out their cocktails! 


FOOD: 
We ordered several appetizers + entrees to share between the 2 of us: 

Chicken Papaya Lettuce Wraps - comes with 2 large lettuce wraps each stuffed to the brim. These were so flavorful, and to be frank, quite filling! They also tasted very fresh.  I'd highly recommend these. 

Spicy Pork Dumplings - Very tasty! These were my fiance's favorite. They had a kick but weren't overbearingly spicy (for us). 

Steak Yakitori - This was the one thing I could do without. The steak had little / no flavor, no sauce or seasoning (didn't seem to have salt & pepper either), and I understand it's yakitori but for the price it really wasn't worth it. I'd probably pass on the yakitori options altogether next time in favor of the more fusion style items. 

Chicken tacos - These were my favorite! Turmeric chicken with a chipotle mayo - typically I don't prefer fusion tacos as I really, really, really love Mexican tacos, but these were absolutely incredible. SUPER unique flavor + very filling. Would recommend! 

Bi Bim Bop - The Bi bim bop was also incredible + very filling. The steak was mouthwatering and I loved the kimchi. The egg was a bit overcooked but not a dealbreaker. 

PRICE:
Besides the yakitori I thought the prices were very fair for the portion-sizes. We left stuffed with a little bit of leftovers, and a bill that didn't break the bank.

Next time I come I am excited to try their wings!

We decided to try Charlie's yesterday evening (Saturday) and I am so glad I did!  The restaurant is nice, was not crowded when we arrived, so our table of 4 adults was immediately sat.  Our waiter was prompt in taking our orders and was friendly.  We tried a few appetizers and a total of 4 rolls: veggie, California roll with spicy crab, spicy salmon, and the sweet potato roll.  All the rolls were delicious I would not change a thing.  Our group also had a few Sapporo's which were on draft!  We will definitely go again!

I bought the Homewrecker burrito with ground beef. With free chips and salsa thrown in, it's a better deal than Qdoba. It even had a self-service salsa bar, which is awesome, though. Unfortunately, it didn't have any Habanero salsa, which Qdoba does have.

And that's w/o the drink, which comes in one of those digital vending machines, which have tons of Coca-Cola products, that you wouldn't normally get at any other fast food joint(yet).

The place was very clean too. The staff was nice too.

Another problem is that I'd have to go all the way downtown in order to eat there.

All in all, I'm a fan.

Vegetable Tempura here is pretty good. The Tofu Pad Thai is delicious as well. Be careful ordering anything with chicken though because sometimes it tastes "off." I figured once was just a fluke, twice was strange, and three was a pattern. So, I steer clear of the chicken now. Also, if you're ordering something with mushrooms like my husband did, they might be from a can (it was obvious).

The service is great and they're never too busy. I really like that.

Oh Stew's I can't believe I haven't reviewed you.  This Jersey girl loves a great everything bagel with lox. Stew's is my number 1 spot for when that craving kicks in.  Everyone who really knows me, knows I'm a stickler for awesome customer service and Stew's gets an A+.  Even during the morning rush they still manage to greet you when you walk through the door.  

As soon as you walk-in the aroma of the bagels greet you.  I love all the bagels, but my go to bagel is always an everything bagel with lox and cream cheese.  I get everything on it, tomato, onion (wish it was red onion) and capers.  Eating this bagel brings back fond memories from my childhood going to deli with my mother.  I remember we would always get Lox and bagels while we also would to purchase great garlic pickles for later

If you ever want a great bagel this is the spot. They are closed on Mondays and hours of operation 6:00 am - 1:00 pm. They also have delicious linzer cookies which are great with a cup of tea or coffee.

I am from New Orleans, with that being said, this is not real New Orleans food!  I got the shrimp and lemon-vodka pasta and fiance got the shrimp and grits.  The food was VERY bland.  They did not even have salt and pepper on the table for us to atleast give the food some flavor.  If you want REAL new orleans food go to Deanie's or Lil Dizzy's on Esplanade Ave. This was a big waste! This place gets 1 star for the Hurricane we got.

Our absolute favorite restaurant in Nashville!   The menu changes daily and produce is from local area farmers.  The building was a service station in the 1930's, which gives it a lot of character.  We have never been disappointed!  We love the cheese plate when it is available.  I usually order a steak of some sort with a vegetable side.  Plus, the sangria is amazing!  Great restaurant!  Make reservations!
The food is good. The service is okay. The carpet is usually dirty. Cops show up to pick up the illegal workers about every 90 days or so.

The have the best fish and chips. The staff is very friendly. Food is so fresh. I love their food and the freshness of ingredients that they use. Whenever I'm in Santa Barbara visiting this place is a must. Last time I was there I had their food twice this should explain how good they are

whoaaaaa...we finally have a top rate, fairly priced indian food buffet brunch!...i could eat there every day..its food for the soul...dahl was some of the best ever...the kheer from the heavenly planets...the chicken tiki, i could eat  4 ever...check it out...first class n very clean...this is what the mainline has been waiting for...see you at lunch!

Ok so I've been lazy and haven't updated reviews lately. So this is a culmination of ordering from Not Just Pizza. I'll start with the cheese pizza order. Not just pizza delivers a very good pie. It's most similar to papa johns pizza if you want a comparison to a large pizza chain. That being said, the crust is great, the sauce is delicious and the cheese is flavorful and plentiful. (Oh not to mention, all of their pizzas come with a cup of (while not home made, specialty garlic sauce) So if you love garlic and butter I'd suggest that you try out Not Just Pizza. Their homestyle pizza is excellent. It comes with a thick layer of cheese on the bottom with marinara on top. I've also ordered their cheesesteak and buffalo tenders, which compared to their pizza were pretty average, but still very good. I also ordered their buffalo chicken pizza which was a white pie with buffalo chicken and it also came with garlic sauce. As other reviewers have mentioned their buffalo items aren't very spicy. So if you have a good tolerance for heat you may need to add some hot sauce at home to get their buffalo items at the right spice level for you. If you have a low tolerance for spiciness then fear not of their buffalo tenders nor their buffalo pizza you will enjoy it. That being said, Not Just Pizza is a bit more expensive than some of the other local pizza joints north of center city. As you can see from my recap below. Overall, I've only ordered not just pizza from Not Just Pizza once.... and it was average compared to their pizza. So my suggestion is that they change the name to "Just Pizza.....and some other things" Haha just kidding. Solid pizza joint and one of the best non-high-end pizza places I've encountered. A solid 4 stars.

A Nashville staple!  Don't let the long lines scare you away, they typically move pretty quickly. At any rate, once you get inside, you'll be glad you stuck it out, because their breakfast is among the best in town.  To be fair, at the end of the day, they're just serving pancakes - but as pancakes go, these are the best you'll find.  

They offer a ton of options, many of which are pretty elaborate.  Fair warning: don't come here with a packed agenda.  You will be far too stuffed to do much of anything after a full meal.

First time late this morning, one other person there at the counter. One table occupied outside. A couch around three sides of a coffee table by entrance, then two other couches with table farther back. About eight tables with chairs on middle of floor. Simple menu with one side breakfast other side lunch, each side about ten items. Breakfast items mostly omelet, plus waffles and breakfast sandwich. 

Ordered Sicilian omelet consisting of mild sausage and ham plus provolone cheese, which includes generous tasty potatoes and two slices of toast plus thin orange slice. Gigantic two-in-one coffee cup was not refilled. Although omelet did not appear big this dish filled me for hours, $9.98 including coffee. 

A colorful mural being painted along one wall, musical instruments atop tables and assorted works of art on other wall. Pleasant friendly lady I assume is the owner was the only server, so was busy attending all that walked in steadily during my visit. Lunch prices reasonable, will try that next.

Love their appetizer sampler/combo thing. But only when it's to go. They just make it different, and it tastes better. Also the quesadilla in the app combo is prefect full of cheese, but the actual quesadilla meal, has little cheese.

When it comes to the Best of the Best. This place is Superb! My girlfriend and I went here for my birthday and it did not disappoint. It was the Best! The staff were Friendly and the Service was the Best. Check them out!

Do NOT go if you are actually hungry. Very little portions, large price, and mediocre service. There is no bang for your buck at this restaurant and the food is nothing special. The restaurant was overpriced and I will not be going back.

I'd rather go to Carmel Kitchen and Wine Bar 10/10 times over, where the drinks are delicious, the food is spectacular, and the price is more than fair.

Fresh ingredients, thoughtfully prepared, excellent service, small portions.  My only real issue is the portion size... If I order a soup, salad and entree, or a 5-course tasting, I'm expecting to leave full.  Not overly full, but full.  The last several times I've dined here, I've left hungry. And the cost is significant. If ingredient cost/portion is an issue, this could easily be solved with the non-proteins.  ie. more sides, starches, vegetables.  Love the restaurant for the flavors, but I find myself passing it over for this issue.

We got takeout for lunch one day on the road.  I wish I could have hung around this cool little place.  I got a pork dish which was insanely good.  We also got a Cuban sandwich which was killer.. I want another right now!
The food is excellent, especially for the value. Their delivery absolutely sucks and is typically very very late.
The food is awesome. The people are really nice, even if there's a language barrier. Best Mexican food I've had outside of Texas.

The pizza here is okay if you're really hungry.  They have lots of different toppings available by the slice, but the pizza just isn't that great.  The pizza isn't thin enough to my liking, the crust is big and doughy and the people don't even put it in the oven long enough to heat up.  The sauce is thin and watery and sort of has a sweet taste to it. 

I'll only be back here when I'm really hungry and too lazy to walk anywhere else...or if I'm too drunk to care.
I love the food, sauce, friendly atmosphere.  Pasquales has a soft spot in my heart. Try it!
Great tasting chicken wings. Great friendly service. The boba drinks are  perfectly chewy. Very flavorful. My favorite wings are garlic chicken. You cant go wrong.

My problem with this place isn't unique for restaurants in Nashville, which I consider a culinary wasteland. That problem is consistency. Go one time and get a great meal. Go back and order the same dish again and it 's absolute crap. That's a deal killer for me where restaurants are concerned.

Stopped in today,I could've stayed home and ate the tire off my car . The food was cold,the seafood was bland and I was there a hour and all they put was five crab legs on the dinner buffet....if you're hungry and this is your only option save your  $15 and look for roadkill

Came to Santa Barbara for the weekend and wanted some good coffee. I got the Nitro Cold Brew - OMG! It was soooo good! You don't need to add anything to it! I tried it first, but made the mistake of adding a bit of cream - the cream ruined it. My husband got the chai latte, which was also very tasty. Now if you're in the mood for a really tasty baked good, try their cinnamon roll - we asked them to heat it up. Went really nicely with our beverages.

Great food, nice quiet atmosphere,  friendly staff.  6 of us and not a complaint in the bunch.  Could use a few carb friendly items on the menu, but I managed.
Very nice bar to enjoy a cocktail before or after your meal.

I came out to Reno to visit my parents. I found this hole in the wall restaurant searching on the internet. Initially I thought the wait would be long considering there was a lot of people waiting, but surprisingly it only took no more than 10 mins. Their customer service is superb! I ordered the Hawaiian breakfast & two French toast with bananas. My husband ordered the steak & eggs. Their food portions are perfect & the food was nothing short of amazing!

Sports.  The common denominator.  The great equalizer.  Part of the national patchwork that makes this country so great.  Equally great are the sports bars that we flock to to celebrate such patriotic events of fandom.  In the Indianapolis downtown area, nowhere is greater than the Kilroy's Bar and Grill.

This place is thee sports bar downtown.  It's conveniently located but minutes walk from Banker's Life Field House or Lucas Oil Stadium.  With great seating options and a bar that knows how to serve your ale fast when the crowds start to surge, you're bound to have a great time.

I like to meet my buds down here before or for the big game and enjoy some tastey eats along the way.  To be honest, anything BBQ is very good.  The Brisket Chili is my go-to on a chilly Sunday, and their local beer selection is pretty good.

True to any respectable sports bar, plenty of TVs for any direction you are looking.  Most times, the staff are more than willing to put on whatever game you want on the nearest TV - given the Colts aren't in the playoffs or anything.

Bottom line: great place to pre-game before heading to the game (and paying those stadium beer prices), or to meet the guys or gals to enjoy the game with a cool sports bar atmosphere.  Things are bound to be good.  Cheers.

The restaurant is filthy. If we weren't so tired from driving all day we would have left. There is food and paper all over the floor. The silverware was dirty. The wall of the booth looks like it hasn't been wiped down in a very long time. The food was good, not great not bad. The manager should really step it up.

I tried this last week just because my friend got a new job there and has been working there for a couple months now. Honestly, it was really good. No complaints, they just put a little bit more rice around it to fill you it.... which I guess is a good thing because it's a little more expensive than some places. But all in all, I would def go again, but most likely on a date. lol
Had a hardy breakfast. Large selection and verity.  Little crowded but service was prompt and the coffee was always full.

This place is known for its seafood, but I had the Chicken Alfredo which was an excellent choice via the waiter's recommendation. The seasoning and flavor placed on the chicken was better than any type of Zatarin's that I have ever tasted. I ended up eating every morsel as it was just that good. The mood was very nice as they played a mix of musical genres overhead and in the background. I also noticed a patio of which they allowed for food service as it appeared many patrons were enjoying their meals in that space. I wish I could remember our server's name as he was excellent. I will definitely be back with again with others to enjoy this experience.

Just as the review says- A_OK. I wasn't as impressed as I was hoping I would be. The food was fine, the service slow but fine enough, but that's really it. The chips I read a lot about, they didn't wow me. The Thai Soup I had was OK, but nothing to write home (or extensively on Yelp) about. So it's a decent enough spot if you're in Carpenteria to check out, but don't go in hoping for more than what you'll get: A pleasant cafe experience.

My coworkers and I have stopped here for lunch a couple times now, and the waitresses we've had have been nice and so accommodating. We have eaten outside on the sidewalk both times, and there's a good mix of sun or shade spots, plus they have a few umbrellas available. They bring out chips and salsa, but try the queso too! 

Each time I've gotten the carnitas tacos & they've been great both times. Portion size is good for lunch or dinner, and the sides of beans and rice have been filling too. The rice on this most recent trip wasn't as seasoned as the first visit, so that was a bit disappointing, but the flavors in the carnitas are mild yet authentic, a good balance for someone like myself who doesn't handle spice well. They also fill them mostly with the pork, and just a light topping of veggies, so you're definitely setting what you pay for. My coworkers have gotten enchiladas and fajitas & always clear their plates or take home leftovers, so I definitely recommend those too. 

Parking can be hit or miss; there's a small parking lot out back, and street parking down the neighboring roads, but otherwise you may have to park further away and walk a bit since the street itself is closed to vehicles to accommodate outdoor seating.

Dined at Sullivan's for my Anniversary. The meal started off excellent with the appetizers but fell extremely short on the entree's for both my husband and I. Certainly not worth the amount we paid for it. The Calamari was superb! My husband described the cheese steak egg rolls as an explosion of flavor in his mouth. They truly built us up. Then a complete let down for dinner. His $50 steak was overpriced & bland because he chose not to have any garlic cream topping. My shrimp stuffed crab had no flavor & was room temperature. We were very disappointed. The salad was good but the key lime pie with raspberry topping was a let down as well. The picture on their website of the key lime pie looks nothing like what was served. For those prices Sullivan please do better. At this point I'd never recommend your restaurant. Service was nice but it didn't make up for the very expensive, bland meal.

Messy hoagies that fall apart and already look soggy when you unwrap the foil.  The flavor was non existent and the bread tasted a bit off, like if it's stale.  The line is big for idk what reason as the food wasn't great.  The competitor across the street tasted wayyy better.

Good place for seafood  good music  and every waitress ive have had always been nice  
Gets pretty crowded but they are fast

A-OK for Italian in our area. I think I expected more from That's Amore based on recommendations I'd received from family. 

We started with the Endive Boats. They were alright. My aunt had raved about them, so I was thinking they'd be the next best thing, but they were sub-par at best. Their balsamic was ridiculously sweet and syrupy - more so than it should be.

I had a salad, so I'm not going to judge my review on that. 

My cousin had the steak. It was slightly rubbery and fatty. My husband had the spaghetti and meatballs. The sauce lacked any flavor and the pasta was BEYOND overcooked.

For dessert we shared cannoli's. They didn't taste homemade/fresh at all. More like they were purchased from a bakery 3 days prior.

Great portion sizes and the service was superb. It is tight quarters in there, so be aware of that if trying to go with a large party. 

Not sure I'd go back. With all the fabulous Italian that's around, I'd go to other restaurants first.....

Everything here is wonderful. Handmade pasta, a few amazing dishes done perfectly instead of 59 items done like "eh, that was decent." The restaurant catered our wedding and we've been getting compliments on having the best wedding flood of the year for 6 months straight...and our inlaws are all tough to impress. Eat here. Fungi sauce, meatballs, the rigatoni, everything is so on POINT.

New and town and decided to give BJ's Nevada Barbecue Company a try. On my first visit I ordered the Kick Ass Fries and I wasn't disappointed. A platter filed with home cut fries, covered in cheddar cheese, pulled pork BBQ, BBQ sauce, and sour cream and chives served on the side. This dish was amazing, but I couldn't eat it all! A lot of food, fabulous price, and superb taste. 

The service was awesome! Very friendly staff! 

Will eat here again, and again, and again!

Today (1/9/18) was my first time eating here and it was awesome! Would definitely recommend this to anyone. I had the French Omelette with grits and chronic bacon on the side. You must try the chronic bacon!

Ugh, what a disaster. I am leaving one star because the pizza was decent but the service was appalling. If this place is busy slammed, the guys turn into nasty assholes. One of the workers called my husband a dick twice. Totally inappropriate in front of teenage girls. Not much fun at this place.

Got the lasagne as a takeout and Mac will fill in later on the items. The vegan cupcake is scrumptious for a vegan and the V steak is soot on.  Only reason I gave a 5 star is for the taste service and quality. For having very few items on menu it gets a 4 ;÷)
We continue to have the best experiences here, love the whole staff!! They are all so sweet and helpful, our absolute favorite day to come here is Taco Tuesday!!

I've always liked Red Lobster until we ordered take-out for Christmas dinner to enjoy at home. We ordered take out for 6 adult meals and not one was right? ($195.00 cash) We even tried to make it easy by ordering the same thing for most of the meals. Not one steak was cooked beyond bloody rare and too tough to chew. Every plate came with 2 baked potatoes. Instead of butter on the side, the containers were filled with mashed potatoes to look like butter. Instead of sour cream, they supplied all of us with cocktail sauce. Even the lobster was like rubber. Most of it tasted good, but the whole dinner was ruined by cooks/kitchen help that were either un-trained, incompetent, didn't care, on strike or some other vile reason? I'm not sure and can only speculate the reasoning behind it. I also noticed a lot of giggling and facial expressions between employee's as I waited for my order to be completed. Maybe you should check your security cameras,  evaluate and weed out some of the employees that worked Christmas Eve 12/24/2015 at this particular location before they drive you out of business.

Hummus is a must, picadillo empanadas and umami mushroom burger are delicious but the best by far is definitely the baklava. Not being able to lick the slate clean feels like a waste. Anyone who's tried this knows the feeling. Order the baklava!

This place is just awesome! Relaxed cozy atmosphere with great local service. Every menu item I've tried has been delicious! Breakfast, lunch & dinner. There is a bus stop out front that some creepers hang out at but the entrance is on the side/back so your ok :)

My new go-to coffee shop. Love the cappuccino here and they always have a good bite too! No matter if I need a quick breakfast or brunch or just a pastrie to hold me over they've got a selection including gluten free/paleo pastries which taste great. I have brought my family here when they visited from out of town on three separate occasions and all thought they had good service, coffee and food! The atmosphere is cool, hip yet elegant and very easy to enjoy being in the space. Thank you to the owner for choosing such a great location and delivering consistent good service and food/coffee!

I work in the area so my coworker & I wanted to place an order to go since we only have a 30 minutes lunch break.
We called this place about 30 times for about 15 minutes (between 2 phones) and no one answered!
I am so disappointed because I wanted to try this place, as it WOULD have been my first time, but now I do not care to even give my money to a business who can't pick up their phone.

Ok I just love this place! I can't find anywhere that has enchiladas like these! You build your own and one cheese enchilada with beef red chili and one with green pork chili is the ultimate combo. Love the hot chicken taco as a special. The service is always great too. I especially love sitting at the bar!

Fantastic lunch buffet for a great price!  Staff were very polite and accommodating.  There could've been a wait during lunchtime traffic but the staff were on top of their pre-bussing so people came and went with ease.  I plan to eat there again when back in town.

Used to order from here almost once a week. Even after we moved to a different neighbourhood we went back to this location because the closer one was bad. Never again. They haven't gotten even one of our orders right in the last five times. We've taken to asking for a manager just to place an order because the staff that answers the phone was always getting it wrong. Usually minor things but in the past two months they've fed me meat in my strictly vegetarian order three times. Were horrible about trying to resolve the situation too, said they'd deliver it but didn't know how long it would take. Didn't want to give me a refund, only store credit. Will literally never eat there again, and we were one of their most loyal customers. 
I even told them how seriously ill I could get as a result of eating meat, they couldn't care less. 
Worst. Location. Ever.

Vesper was an excellent choice for a Restaurant Week meal.  The whole experience was enjoyable and isn't that what dining out is all about?  We all tried and shared so many items off of the Restaurant Week menu that it is hard to comment on everything.  We did begin with a raw seafood sampler that was not on the special menu but included oysters, crab meat, and shrimps with various sauces.  A good beginning!  Now to the Restaurant Week items themselves.  The warm rolls and salads were fine, the entrees for the most part didn't disappoint, and there was a choice of chocolate or cheesecake for dessert.  I thought the lobster ravioli could use some more seasoning and the spaetzle that came with the tender braised short ribs was too dried out but the scallops and roasted Brussels sprouts were right on.  Service by Rocco was both efficient and very friendly and we enjoyed a couple of good bottles of dry Italian wine which added to the dinner.  In addition to the food and wine, there was an excellent singer from Northern Ireland providing music.  (He usually sings on Wednesday nights and has a nice repertoire of songs that he covers.)  The general manager John also checked in with us....especially to aid in the wine selections.  All in all, Vesper was a really good Restaurant week choice!

Let me start by saying that this rating would easily be five stars had I seen any effort to request or enforce mask-wearing or social distancing. For those of you who don't care about those things, see this as a five star rating as the beer was great and the live music was high quality, at least what I heard of it during the minimal amount of time I was inside while ordering my beer before retreating to the large patio. 

I saw one food server wearing a mask. Not a single bartender was wearing one nor were any customers other than me and my friend. I understand not wearing them at your tables or stools while drinking, but not even when ordering? There was a distinctly too cool for public health measures attitude to the place. We are so fortunate to have our businesses and bars back open. It would be nice to not blow it as Texas did, but it's exactly this type of place that will drive us all back indoors.

There are several bars on the Morgan Ford strip in TGS that are taking varied but conscientious approaches to reopening in order to keep their staff and customers safe. I will be spending my money there in the future.

If it were more consistent it could easily be a 4 star place.  They have great staff and an excellent selection of items that cover everything from the traditional to more adventurous. 

Their cookies are better than the pizza (I know - right?!). 

The garlic knots are good or dreadful - no telling.  Sometimes they are a sublime combination of garlic and bread perfectly cooked and perfectly tender.  Other times the garlic is soooo bitter they are like small acrid balls of yuck.  

Generally speaking the pizza is really good.  The last few times we have had very inconsistent sauce.  Tonight the sauce was so salty the slices were actually ruined.  This has never happened before - but lately the sauce has been of varying degrees of saltiness.  We asked a good friend about this tonight (a true devotee)  and they said they had a similar experience last week. (We decided it was the sauce and not the cheese since the marinara with the garlic knots was also too salty)

they didn't get this popular with all of these issues so I'm hoping they work out the kinks and get back to basics!

Table for four on a Saturday night. Almost everything perfect. 
We started with some tapas; the bombas, elotes, gambas and the queso and charcuterie.  I really can't say enough about everything. It was perfect. 
For entrees we had the chuletas, the lechon, the scallops and the fish was the grouper. Being Florida people I was surprised that mother mother ordered grouper in Tucson, but it was very good. Tasted fresh for being so far from home. 
The chuletas were great, a bit on the thin side and the fries they were served with came out limp and soggy. They had some extra oil from being dropped in a cold fryer so the salt stuck a little too much and pushed them towards salty. Better than under salted. This is really the only complaint at all. 
The deserts were flawless. The capirotada was packed full of figs and goat cheese. The flan was the best I've ever had and this is the only place I'll order from here forward. 
I hope Contigo sticks at La Paloma. It's about 4 minutes from my house and is probably the best thing Tucson has going right now.

I really enjoyed my meal. Nothing special or unique, but well done traditional Lebanese food. The chicken kebab was great - exceptionally well seasoned and not overcooked (unusual for chicken kebabs!). And the kibbi was AMAZING. Almost got an order of those to go.
I love the couch tomato! But man oh man are they expensive. But hey business is business. It's super good pizza

I've always wanted to go to IndeBlue and finally had a chance last night.  It was a last minute plan and I'm so glad I went!  IndeBlue is gorgeous inside, very classy.  My friend and I ordered martinis and a bunch of small dishes to share.  All were wonderful, absolutely delicious.  The service was great too.  I had not seen my friend for a while so we were catching up.  We took our time after eating to have a few more drinks and we did not feel rushed at all.  Overall, a great experience.  I will be back again and again.

VEGAN REVIEW:

While in NOLA, my brother, who is not vegan, went to Cafe Du Monde for their famous beignets. I tagged along and, of course, became instantly jealous and decided I needed to get my hands on vegan beignets. After a quick search on the trusted Google, Seed came up. 

Fast forward to later that night...we were standing by the doorway waiting to be seated. There were two waitstaff members running around but no one stopped to acknowledge or greet us. We were finally seated and before I could just order the darn beignets, the waitress who seated us walked away! We probably sat for 15 minutes waiting for someone to take our order.

When the beignets arrived, all was right in the world. If Cafe Du Monde's beignets are fluffy pillows, these beignets were tempurpedic pillows. They weren't dense by any means, but they were very flat. I can't compare them to "regular" beignets because I've never had any but they reminded me of donuts. They weren't overly sweet. My brother, who had the beignets at Cafe Du Monde, said the Seed beignets tasted the same but the texture (fluffiness) was different. Otherwise, he said they were practically the same! If that's not a good review, I don't know what is!

Overall, thumbs up for vegans wanting beignets. It's a bit pricey at $7 for 5 beignets, but it's okay to splurge every once in a while! Service was iffy but when we did interact with our waitress, she was very kind.

The first time I went to Founding Farmers with 3 of my closest friends, it was an amazing experience.  From the check in time all throughout the dinner service. Food was amazingly well prepared and served.  Although they were out of some items at 730pm.  I went there for the impossible meatloaf but couldn't resist the chicken and crab cake. My party loved the pretzel dish app and even ordered another one while we waited for our dinners to come out.  It was kind of long but we had plenty of time to wait that night.  I can see some people would get frustrated waiting 30 min for dinner but we enjoyed the non rush feeling.  Overall a great experience which would have been a 5 star night.  
   The second visit was about 3 weeks ago when I raved about this place to another friend And we decided to take the trek and goto dinner here. The wait for a reserved table at 830 lasted til about 915 (unacceptable wait time for two people).  The front desk never even offered us the bar area which I didn't see the first time I went there.  I only knew about it when I made a complaint to another patron sitting there. We were already 20 min in on the waiting in the lobby.  Finally seated we immediately ordered drinks. The server came out again to take our order.  We ordered the chips for an app and man they were fresh and awesome.   I will def order these again. For my entree again I couldnt resist the chicken that was so good last time, and my friend ordered the scallops.  Well what a difference in the entrees from the last visit except for the wait time.  Finally the drinks came out after mentioning to the runner who brought out the chips.  We were  third way though them when they came out.  On the plus side, we did have water at the time so it wasnt that bad. This probably saved us a few bucks on ordering multiple drinks:) .  Ok so the chicken was really dark inside and it had a lot of fat on it.  The donut was pretty good.  The scallops were over cooked according to my friend but he didn't want to complain or get a reorder.  He just choose only to eat some of it and I had to cut the chicken open to find any good pieces.  The breading on the chicken is really good so I ate most of the breading off of the chicken.  
Btw The veggies were done well on my plate although I felt like there could of been more. 
After the main course I ordered an espresso since we were worried about dessert here, we decided to go elsewhere in the huge complex that Founding Farmers is in.   I was told by the waitress they only served doubles.  Hmmm that is interesting but I agreed. When it arrived it came in a nice cup shaped like a shot glass (not glass).  I asked this is a double to the runner and she said yes it was.  I have ordered many espressos in my day and this was def no double in other restaurants.  It was def one serving for sure. I looked at the bill and yes they def charged me for a double.  
   All in all,  this place has potential to be a 4.5 to 5 star for sure.  I hate giving 2 stars here because that first dinner was so good but the second dinner was really terrible.    Needless to say with the many choices for food out there I may not be back.  I'd I do and the experience changes I will def change the review.  As of now 1 good service  out of 2 times I cannot recommend this place as of yet.  If you are in the area and feel like rolling the dice go ahead and hope you had what I had the first go around.  Good luck.
You cannot go wrong. I had ribs. Wife had the filet. Food was delicious. I would recommend. I usually eat at the casino but this was a nice change.

First of , Jayden needs to be fired immediately. Caused an argument inside the restaurant that caused a 30 minute delay. When I received my order from Jariah or Tabatha, who by the way was taking care of all the drive through, because Jayden wants to be a baby. My nuggets were not in my bag, so I went back inside to request them. Asked Jayden to please help me with my order and his words were: "Oh, I can't help you with that", like REALLY?!!! Why are you even working here? Every other worker was excellent, but this Jayden character needs to go. This was on October 18 around 8pm, everyone on the line was aware of useless Jayden. DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME WAITING FOREVER HERE,  two cars in front of me left the line,  an it seems that is something that happens a lot.  There's many other delicious fast food restaurants around the area,  don't waste your time here, the incident cost me to loose my appetite.

I recommend if your able to sit in the diner, than sit in the diner. It's just the full feel of La Teresita. 

La Teresita is a Tampa staple. If you are not from Tampa than I suggest you stop in for some Cafe Con Leche and some Cuban Toast. Dipping the bread into the coffee is the best. 

Their Cuban sandwich is not the best in Tampa but it is better than most and still hits the spot. The Yuca Fries are really delicious. The Ropa Vieja or Piccadillo and Rice are my constant go to. So yummy!
I absolutely adore this place. The decor, the friendliest owner, the food (simple menu), its clean and I love the smell of the baked goodies.

This was by far the most frustrating experience. So my husband has been wanting to try this sandwich, we get there they are out. No big deal. So I order a tender meal with red beans and rice, orange soda no ice and ranch. Get to the window they dont have any coke, not what i asked for then it was they dont have soda. so ask for tea they dont have any tea. Ask what they do have, they have lemondae. They put extra ice. Get my food no ranch, bbq sauce. Ask for ranch she has to go to the back to get it. We leave... realize I have mashed potatoes not red beans.
Came here an hour before it shut to satisfy my dessert cravings post dinner. Had the Acai bowl and absolutely loved it. Filling and healthy, the perfect meal/dessert. Love the decor as well.

LOVED brunch here! The coffee from the french press is to die for, seriously. I drank the large to myself. Get the one sold as "fruity flavoring"...so so good. 

I ordered the french toast which came with a small scoop of ice cream on top and delicious chocolate cherry topping. It was fantastic. I don't normally put syrup on my french toast/pancakes anyways, but this needed none. The BEST, however, are the potatoes. Get them with the gravy and such...oh man. I could eat those every day of my life. 

Also, being BYOB with additions to your drink, I thought, was a really creative touch.

Our waitress was extremely helpful with our menu and coffee choices. The service was attentive and not overbearing. 

The restaurant itself is adorable.

We ordered pizza for delivery. They sold  our pizza to another customer and had to make another one for us. It took an hour and half to get our order.
When we received the pizza it was a crust with a tomato sauce on it. No seasoning, no garnish. Looked like something kids baked.
This was the worst pizza we ever had.
We called the them to complain and the manager was very unprofessional and rude.
This was the worst pizza experience for my family.

TL;DR-- you can do better. I had heard good things about El Charro Cafe, and was really excited to have dinner there with my husband and another couple. We had made a reservation for 6pm, but probably didn't need to, as it was Tuesday night and there were plenty of tables. This is why it surprised me that the service was so terrible. 

The hostess was very nice, but it took our server forever to take a food order after he brought our drinks (margaritas, nothing to write home about), and he had a hard time understanding us. The food arrived after an acceptable amount of time, but our dishes were not exceptional. I had the carne seca chimichanga, and it was ok. My husband was disappointed with the carne seca platter and the cold tortillas that accompanied it. No one checked on us during our visit, and we weren't offered any drink refills until we were already finished with our food and ready to leave.

Not a good value for the price. I take no pleasure in writing a cool review, but I would not recommend this place. I am sure there is much better Mexican cuisine in Tucson.

It isn't fancy but it's a good diner. I had a breakfast special with 2 eggs, bacon, hash browns and toast. It was good but nothing special. The hash browns lacked any flavor which was easily remedied with a little ketchup. The toast was amazing. It looked like it came from a local bakery.

I really like this place.  Great vibe; great atmosphere, great patio; great Asian food.  Prices reasonable for Nashville sushi ($50 for 2 glasses of wine, edamame, and 4 rolls).  My only critique is that sometimes the clientele is a little young because it's so close to Vandy and Belmont.

PM is a triple threat:  good food, good service, good atmosphere, good prices.   Alright, that's 4 things - go eat here!!

Based on reviews we stopped in for dinner on a Sunday night.  They we're busy, but the wait time in the line was reasonable and moved along quite quickly. We chose a 10 inch Hawaiian, lasagna, caesar salad, and cheesy bread. We took a while at the counter deciding what we wanted , the young lady taking our order was very patient and didn't rush us. Our food was prompt, the servers were friendly and upbeat. The lasagna serving was huge, would feed two easily. The 10 inch pizza would feed two with a small appetite or one with a large appetite. Our order with drinks totaled about $30, we had enough leftovers to have a second meal out of that. A great restaurant, good food and large portions.

LOVE!!!!

Shocking that I haven't written a review for Midway Pizza yet, after at least three visits. I think I might have been in too much of a happy haze when leaving that it totally slipped my mind.

So I grew up eating NY Pizza. It's in my blood to either shun the thick crust, or, like a child who is deprived of sugar, fall head first into the candy bin the first chance she gets... or make that the deep dish. Yep. 

You're not going to hear any quibbles from me as far as "true" Chicago-style deep dish or not. Whatever the hell this is, it's friggin' good, OK? I love that the staff sort of warn you when your eyes are too big for your stomach. At lunch, I had every intention of ordering my own small pizza and was practically laughed out of the booth. Especially when I admitted that I don't really like leftovers. 

But Midway doesn't only shine when it comes to pizzas. Their salads are fucking phenomenal!! Those polenta croutons are just outstanding... the tastiest croutons ever (I rarely get excited about croutons). If you're looking to keep it light, you can't go wrong with just ordering a salad in here because you won't be regretting it when your friends' laden with cheese, sauce and toppings pizzas hit the table (OK, that might be a lie, so get a salad and share some pizza).

Meat lovers: the menu is dominated with pies that would tempt even this vegetarian. 

Vegetarians: there are many options for you, too. Lovely combos of veggies and sauces. I like to make my own because I'm 

I've been for lunch, an early dinner and then a late dinner. Nice late night crowd there and a fun crowd at night. I pretty much didn't want to leave. I mean, late night pizza while you sip wine into the midnight hour? Sign me up.

PS. I feel like it's no coincidence that I see the awesome owner, Steve, all over town. It's like this message from god that I need to come back and get some pizza here, soon.

Still a solid 4 star -- still one of my favorite BYOBs, but still yet to allow me to give that 5 star, ah!! 

It is one of the only upscale restaurants I re-visit ( I often like to try new places) , but I have enjoyed Matyson enough in the past that I've gone quite a couple of times in the last couple of years

Service was fabulous -- our server knew the menu well, including the specials and was obviously well trained and versed. Checked on us appropriate times, and even brought out a candle lit pistachio ice cream for my birthday since we were too full to order dessert, sad face.

We ordered the $14 special for appetizer: homemade pasta stuffed with mushrooms, and served with escargot. I personally enjoyed the escargot at Sbraga more.. (sorry..) but I loved the pasta/mushroom thing! 

I got the Chilean Seabass. My biggest complaint is that it was salty salty salty. But the biggest compliment being that it was seriously, perfectly cooked temperature wise. That flakey fish falling apart with the slightest fork touch.. and right into my mouth. I just wish the seasoning wasn't quite as heavy.

My partner got the seared duck breast which was seasoned well, and perfectly cooked to a medium rare -- no complaints here.

I do LOVE their weekly changing menus . Looking for the right one to spark my interest to go back again

Food is delicious, but some of the staff is incredibly rude and not customer focused at all. This behavior completely detracts from what would otherwise be a favorite restaurant, and turns it from a spot we would recommend to one we warn others away from.

This place is phenomenal! Our waiter was perfect. Food was amazing and the drinks were delish. On top of this the prices were not over the top either! Highly recommend Frenchys thank you for the great experience! Also, the hostess was very sweet and personable. Just great over all!

We chose this place as our New Year's Day, boy I am craving a huge burger location.
If I were to pass by this place in a car I would never think about walking in.

Based on some Yelp reviews and closeness of its location, we decided to try it!

When you first go in, you enter in the bar, its small but has a decent amount of bar tables. There was a large group taking up most of them. So I noticed they had a secondary semi-separate dining room. We sat there.

I had read reviews of slow service, but we sat down, had our drink order taken right away.

I KNEW we were getting fried pickles after seeing a photo on yelp. No brainer on the appetizer. I chose the South-side burger and my buddy chose the Cheeseburger.  I made a special request for my side to have both waffle fries and regular seasoned fries. They accommodated my request and notified that I would still have to pay the additional $1. Worth it to me so I can try both!

The fried pickles came out and they were delish! They are chip style, and came with a different southwest style of sauce vs just ranch. I enjoyed it and saved it for some fry dipping!

Our burgers came out and they were HUGE! I piled my optional LTO on top of the already high burger with onion straws, and bbq sauce. Cut it in half and dove in.

It was cooked to my perfect medium, pink all the way thru. It was delicious and exactly what I needed after a night of a few cocktails.  The iceberg lettuce had an enjoyable crisp when biting into the sandwich. I even heard my buddies crisp as he took a bite.

The fries were great too. On my next visit I plan to stick with just the regular seasoned fries. I liked them a lot better than the waffle fries which were very large.

I ended up taking half of the burger/fries home as I could not finish it!

Only reason I didn't get it a full 5 star is it needs a bit of remodeling. It looks like they might be in the middle of some, with spackle on the ceiling and half torn up floors in the back of the room.

Below there are some great reviews on what a zep is and why you need one. I'm simply going to explain that no one does it better than Lou's. 

A war rages between Lou's and Eve's the other zep location in town. While I would never turn down an Eve's zep I do believe that Lou's does it better.

Again, Lou's gets a 5 star and Eve's would get a 4.5 star. Both are great I just prefer Lou's. 

The crew there is top notch. Park in the back. 

There is a Lou's II which they opened up in Trappe and for some reason they can't replicate the sandwich from town.

FINALLY! A nice restaurant in Nashville that actually enforces a dress code. I came here last week in a nice suit but had a flat cap on. I was pleasantly surprised when the host asked me to remove it and informed me about their dress code. My biggest complaint about Nashville restaurants is that even the "nicest" of places, most people will be in flip flops, cut off shorts, "wife beaters". (maybe the other M Street restaurants will take a step in this direction)

The over all atmosphere/decor is absolutely amazing and well suited with the staff being very friendly and knowledgeable while providing great customer service.

I had a couple of cocktails that I would rate 5 stars, both on price and overall quality.

For a starter, we had the Edamame which was really not good at all and give a 2/5. I'm not sure if it was cooked incorrectly, but it was extremely hard/woody. The seasoning/flavor was fantastic though.

We sampled numerous rolls and sashimi and they were all very fantastic and would rate the taste a 4/5.

As far as price, I'd also rate that a 4/5.

If you like Sushi, you probably won't be disappointed.

Very disappointed!!! I ordered a steak fajita, the steak was so overbooked, trying to chew it was very unpleasant. The steak was tasteless, it does not appear they used any seasonings in its preparation. The guacamole was so runny... So strange for a Mexican restaurant.... Our server was a very pleasant young man, unfortunately the chef is terrible!!

I can't say too many good things about this bakery. 
Where do I start?  The pot pies? Best I've ever had. Rich buttery crust and simple but tasty fillings.
The pastries? I love their cupcakes (try the red velvet). I also love the chocolate brownies. i am a believer that you can't put too much chocolate in brownies. Well I don't see how you could put more chocolate in these. Superb!
I also enjoy the signature cookies. They are terrific with a cup of coffee. 
I recently had a turkey sandwich and soup from the cafe. It was terrific and I would definitely get another.
Definitely my favorite roast pork in town, their sharp provolone is awesome. For the best steak, you've still got to go to dalessandros in Roxborough.

We got married at the Riviera Mansion in July and had a wonderful wedding. We looked at so many venues in different locations and styles. This place captured such a great mix of what we were looking for and we couldn't have been happier. 

Enough cannot be said about the staff at the Riviera Mansion. They are so accommodating, kind, efficient, fun and patient. Breanna, the sales and events director, is fantastic from start to finish, answering questions, checking to see what she can do about any special requests, and making it easy for you! It feels like she cares and isn't just doing her job. Eli, who is the food and beverages director, was amazing. He took such great care of us and was so patient and good at his job! Gustavo was also so wonderful to us. He was so lovely to all our guests, gave us great marriage advice, and treated us like family. He even helped us with dismantling our arch! You really get the feeling that they want to make everything work for you and help make your wedding day as special as possible. 

We had such a great time at the Riviera Mansion and our guests loved the charming venue. The outdoor lawn area for the ceremony is beautiful with the large tree as a backdrop, it has a really special feel to it. There are so many great places to wander to from the patio to the living room to the library to the dance floor, there is just so much character there. 

We loved getting married here and can't wait to go back and visit in the future!

Alright just left here and wish I could give ten stars to LUIS I would come here everyday to interact with him. Our food was taking longer than usual and he chatted with us while still getting his work done and was so pleasant we didn't even realize our food was taking long. He was great!



Super great service every single time
Everyone is sooooo kind and cheerful

Food is delicious of course as well

I had such high hopes for this place! The restaurant itself is clean, sleek and modern. Unfortunately, the food isn't living up. The pizza was cold and really bland. The breadsticks were average at best. The service was friendly but very slow. I do hope they can turn things around.

This place did not disappoint. We were attempting to get breakfast at another place and the line was to long. We didn't have high expectations for Rise but they really surprised us. It looks like a fast food restaurant and has some seating upstairs. The biscuits were so soft and buttery. The chicken was perfect. All served in a neat little box with eggs, cheese and gravy. So good!
Wonderful chicken, I am a wimp so I get it without any spicy sauce.  Still has great flavor!  Very good ranch!!!

Excellent food! Great variety. I was with a party of five everybody enjoyed their meal. It gets crowded and tables are hard to find at peak times. Don't let that dissuade you as it is an indication that it is a good place to eat. It's casual and there is no alcohol served.

OK... I don't usually write 5-star reviews... but really, what else can you give to a local icon? Are you looking for the best sandwich in town? Well, you'll find it at Vid's. Nothing fancy here, just great food, freshly made...  and does it ever taste good! Whether it be a grilled or specialty sandwich.. or a hoagie, salad, or side order, Vid's won't disappoint. And don't forget to grab a deli pickle out of the barrel and a slushy boost to go.. take it all home and enjoy. Check out their menu on line and call ahead to avoid the wait... and prepare yourself to enjoy comfort food at it's best.

I went here while visiting my family, and my opinion may be a bit biased since my cousins work there, but still...a review. I ordered fish and chips which was good a bit salty for me. The fries are pretty damn good though. The portions of food were very generous, which is always a good thing. I believe they sell breakfast 24/7. What more exactly can i say lol it's a small cafe in idaho. Would i recommend this place..yes i would.

Paris baguette was one of my favorite bakeries in the Bay Area, and I was thrilled to find that Philly had one too. Once you enter, you can take a clean tray and tong and start collecting all the bread you want to purchase. I love their milk bread displayed near the entrance -- the slices are thicker than your typical American store bought bread, and with it, you can make the softest and fluffiest sandwich or toast. I also never leave without some custard filled bread and curry croquettes. They also have the prettiest whole cakes and roll cakes with the perfect light sweetness. Their drinks are also great too; the sangria peach ice tea is flavorful and refreshing on a hot summer day. 

The place is very clean and spacious (also has a clean single bathroom), but it gets pretty loud and crowded, especially on the weekends. I would bring earplugs or headphones if you're planning to do work or study. Also, a lot of the bread is often sold out if you come in the evening, and unless it came straight from the oven they can be kind of cold since the display case doesn't keep the bread warm.

Everything on the menu is delicious.the lunch specials are a great deal.its kinda hidden behind ritas water ice..im glad I found this place years ago..favorite sandwich is the pulled pork on a keisar roll.yummmmm

The food is pretty good. Staff always seems inexperienced and the restaurant is always cold. Last few times I've been in the place was dead and yet they still sat me right near the door next to a window. Amateur move. Then of all places to seat the next table they seat them directly behind me, and these were BIG people. I was unable to get out of my seat without having to ask them to move which I'm sure was quite embarrassing to them and I'm very small.  They should seat people away from the cold windows when they can, especially when there are a ton of booths far away from the door. The restaurant has plenty of potential to better itself.
In need of a coffee before a long drive up the coast after a beach day. The only thing better than the roast were the people who supplied the energy and the drinks. Highly recommended!
Great lunch spot! Prices are great on both main dishes and sushi! Friendly servers and excellent food every time I have been! The sushi chef is very creative!

Signed up for yelp just for this review. I wish I could give 0 stars. Horrible service. Tried the place for the second time. Sat for 30 mins and only got 2 glasses of water. No servers came over so we decided to leave. Carluccis is right up the street. I suggest going there for Italian.

This place is really good, and the only reason it's not getting five stars is because there are one or two places in nola I'd maybe go to before here. Great flavors, occasional exotic ones, nice thick rich texture. And friendly people behind the counter.

OMG. So good!!!!!

Went here on a whim on a Friday night. The original place we were going to go was completely full and we decided not to wait. Went on yelp to find someplace close (since it was freezing out) and saw that Garces was only a few blocks away. I figured it would be packed but we gave it a shot. The hostess told us that the restaurant was booked for the entire night but the full menu was available at the bar. Thankfully there were 2 seats open. The bartenders were really friendly and attentive.
