Big menu and the servers are friendly and sometimes mix up the language, part English and part Spanish--funny!
Love the donuts. So big and delicious. So many options it's hard to make up your mind. The pretzel dough twist was yummy. Very good service too.
great sandwiches from fresh ingredients and the best brownies and cookies (bite size and chewy). Salad and soup was just OK, and for the people that like Mate, definitely a must go to.
Mediocre food. Slow service-if they decide to bring you what you asked for at all. And there were bugs crawling on the cart where napkins and silverware were stored.

i miss the delivery by people on bikes and skateboards.  the delicious salads and desserts, and also the first place i ever saw where you could pump your own additional syrup into your sodas.  Pepsis with 3 shots of vanilla would get me through a finals studying session, as i recall.  
if i remember right, they kept screwing with the menu and messing everything up-so hopefully things are back to what they should be.

Not bad at all, the meat was pretty good, but I don't think it is in the same league as Fogo de Chao.  My favorite meat was the spicy chicken.  The first helping of lamb that I had was pretty great, the second wasn't anywhere near as good.  The whitefish was pretty great.  The steaks were often the meat that I preferred the least, which is a shame at this type of establishment.  I did like that they roasted pineapple the same as the meat.  This needed to come around more often though, as it complimented the meat well.  

The meat did not come around as quick as my last experience with a Rodizio.  I think there is a bit of inconsistency in the service and food here, if they can fix that, it would be a much better experience.  

The polenta fries were good, and I liked the greens and bacon from the salad bar.  Some of the salads in the salad bar were a bit of a waste for me.  The cole slaw was one of my favorites from the salad bar and complimented the meat well.  

I had a couple of caipirinhas which I would recommend as your drink for the meal.

I normally do not write reviews unless I have a terrible experience, but needless to say our experience at IJJI 4 was the exact opposite.  We were greeted by a nice, young lady upon entering, who graciously walked us to our table.  She also served as our waitress and made sure to thoroughly explain all food items.  

The manager/owner (?) also helped and was very enthusiastic.  We were there after close time and he made a point to let us know to take our time.  Our experience was great!  Great food, great service, we will be back for more!

Came in around 9:00 on a Friday night and the place was as dead as a doornail. That should have been the first clue to run. We chose hibachi and were seated a hibachi table where an employee was sitting at the other end wrapping silverware and staring at us. We sat there for easily 10-15 minutes in awkward silence, and nobody bothered to even take our drink order. A chef kept staring at us from the kitchen door window. The whole thing was so creepy and awkward that we got up, left, and took our business elsewhere.
Great neighborhood spot on Frenchman Street. When I went there were jazz musicians on the street playing which made a great vibe.

I was decorating a wedding at Celebrations in Bensalem last Sunday, and we had a few hours to waste until the reception was over so I could reclaim my props.
 Instead of driving all the way back to Philly we decided to go to The Golden Corral and have a long leisurely dinner there.
 It was anything but that!  My friend John and me are two big guys, and walking through the lot, we saw a lot a big people hanging around holding their bellies. We past a group of people from India when one of the guys said "There's no food left, go home we ate it all!" Then it dawned on me, this was an eating competition. Upon entering you are a place in a starting gate, after you pay, someone may as well shout over the PA system-" And they're off". 
Dozens of Adam Richman wannabes take off and start piling  loads of food on to their plates. I was entranced. It was pandemonium,  the skinny people were trying to stay out of the big people's way, kids waving big fluffs of cotton candy,  and a smattering of food snobs looking like they were headed for a colonoscopy.
I started with a plate of nachos,  they had some nacho chips and ground beef and salsa right there but I had to go on a search to make it more authentic. Atop the chips,  I sprinkled fresh Cheddar cheese and added the hot beef topping in order to melt the cheese. I went over to the salad bar and added chop scallions and sliced jalapeno peppers,  then I found some sour cream next to the baked potatoes and I finished up with some sauteed mushrooms. When I was walking back to my table, the crowd parted way staring at my plate with envy. 
 This went on for 3 hours. Me trying to turn ordinary food into something more edible. Our server was great, I really prefer this place over the Asian buffets in Philly. And if you work at it you can get a decent meal out of all of the ingredients provided by the Golden Corral.

I've really tried to like this bar but it has no atmosphere. Maybe, I've just been at weird off peak times but I just don't get what all the fuss is about. The decor is pretty cool, I really love the roller garage style doors, I feel like I'm hanging out in the fire station. And, the Jameson's bottle light fixtures are very cool. But the atmosphere guys? 
I have been for drinks, and the waitress didn't know what I was ordering when I asked for the only red off the menu. I've had food here twice and it was just ok.
I ordered the fish tacos but I've definitely had better. The only saving grace was the garlic and parmesan fries which were really tasty and the portion size was large. 
They also make a point of not giving out the wifi password. So take note, if planning to use it for a business meeting.

I've been ordering Lunch/Dinner from this restaurant a few times a week for months. I probably spend a good $2-300 here a month. One of my favorite lunches is the Unagi Don, which always has the unagi completely covering the rice neatly.

Today my Unagi Don lunch arrived via Uber Eats delivery and it had about 50% the amount of Unagi as it used to and it looks like a mess. 

The picture attached is of the meal before I touched it at all. This is what was given to me.

It clearly looks like the chef who put it together tried to make up for the fact that he didn't want to add the amount of unagi the previous chef did or even the amount he was supposed to.

I called the restaurant, and they confirmed he is a new chef and didn't add as much Unagi. He said "Yes, it should have 12 pieces now". I sent him a picture of my meal and asked him if he could find 12 FULL pieces of Unagi. 

He said no. 
Of course not, because there is MAYBE 6.
No refund was offered, no replacement meal was offered, no "next time you order" deal.

Just no.

Malay Thai Kitchen, I'll bring my business elsewhere if this is what you're going to be serving. Go find your old chef, you need him!

I want to talk about this place all the time, but sometimes I hesitate.... 1) because I am not sure if I should say "mah-kee-mah-n" or "mah-kee-man" (as in MAN, I sure is hungry) and 2) I don't want it to get over-run with people. 

No matter, perhaps I shall head over there again to ask the staff... because I will  just take any excuse to go and indulge in their delicious selection of creative rolls that explode crunchy, spicy, creamy avocado-y, savory, sweet, tangy flavors in your mouth.   

Personally, I am a fan of spicy crunchy things so some of my faves include the sixers roll, the mcnabb (def the roll, ambivalent about the football player), the viking (VICTORY~!) roll, and the yellow stallion. 

I like the Spider roll here, but it's not one of my faves. Definitely a solid offering - upside, you get 6 pieces which is more than most sushi places, but downside is it's smaller. IMO, when the softshell crab is that small, you start to lose the flavor of the crab and get more of the soy-based sauce and/or avocado. 

Lovely things: BYOB, attentive and friendly staff, speedy food delivery, takes rezzies, relatively inexpensive for sushi and they don't rush you out. 

Sushi aside, I really enjoyed the agedashi tofu - Makiman's version of this dish comes with a LOT of bonita flakes. However, the dolsot bibimbap was just okay. There was so much sesame oil mixed in that towards the bottom 1/4 of the bowl, there was a pool of spicy oil drowning the remaining veggies and rice.

"A Hockey Bar in Indianapolis‽" You can imagine my excitement when I heard that there was a bar just for fans of (arguably) the greatest sport on earth in a city that generally only really gets excited by balls that bounce on hardwood or spiral. 

Unfortunately, I was kind of disappointed by the "hockey" aspects of the The Sinking Ship. Compared to most bars, where I have a hard time getting even Blackhawks games on the TV (let alone my Avalanche), The Sinking Ship is a vastly better place for a hockey fan to hang, but something was wrong. It honestly felt like a hipster pub in a good hockey city (Detroit, Chicago, Pittsburgh, Denver, Minneapolis...) Other than the hockey on every TV and some team banners, nothing really screamed "Hockey Bar". You could tell that most patrons weren't there to watch the games, and some even complained. No one was cheering for their team and there was no fan atmosphere created. For what it is in Indy, it's a hockey bar, but it could do a lot more to foster a hockey atmosphere. That being said, the waitstaff had no problem with us staying at our table for hours to watch all 3 periods.

That's enough complaining from a hockey fan that misses hockey... lets talk food and beer.

Food!

Do yourself a quick favor, and look in the categories on the top of this page. See that, "Vegan"? Yeah, it's not a mistake. They actually have vegan food including burgers, sandwiches, Mac and Cheese, and hot "wings." My vegetarian friend was ecstatic with all the choices.  I had the club sandwich which is literally a 3" high stack of meat on 3 pieces of bread. It was pretty good. Fries are pretty tasty too.

Beer!

Most of the beer selection is bottled, which isn't a problem, especially since the beer list is 30+ beers longs and they're all pretty cheap. The tap list is all local craft beers with 6-9 selections. The waitstaff seemed pretty well versed in the flavor profiles.

Overall, I was disappointed about the "Hockey Bar" aspect, but I did enjoy the food and beer. It's a good place to catch a game, but I'll come back for the food, not the hockey.

The food is spectacular. I had the best chimichanga ever! They also had great service! The food appearance is good the taste is great definitely a top 10 places to in Erwin New Jersey!! Right now I am chowing a great quesadilla.
What an idea, focus on the tater tot, hey it works. We stopped for a latenight snack, got the tots and left happy as could be. Simple place with good service and great tots.

Horrible alleged gastro pub, nothing to write home to mama about here. Burger seemed synthetic, wings way over cooked, rolls of sandwiches stale and crusty. pizza was gross, bland and undercooked and flavorless. spend your hard earned cash elsewhere.

Just found this little gem of a place yesterday and we stopped by again today lol. It's so good!  The man that took my order was super friendly and nice, you definitely felt welcomed. Yesterday, I got the Montreal Steak bowl with brown rice, caramelized onions, charred corn and sweet Thai sauce.  Sooooo delicious!!  Today I tried the Jerk Chicken bowl with all the same ingredients as yesterday. I asked for just "a little jerk" lol because I was unsure of how spicy it would be. It was done perfectly and now I can't decide which I like more.  If you are looking for  some fresh and healthy food, then this place is a must try!!

So I'm updating my review because the manager emailed me after my first review. They obviously care about providing good service. Also, we went there for the Abita Pub Crawl a few weeks ago. The place was totally packed but it was a fun environment and the bartenders were much more helpful.

This particular location needs a HUGE revamp on staff. The food out weighs the customer service that I've experienced on two occasions from the Assistant Manager Trayishary Goordon it's very unacceptable to be verbally attacked each time that I've encountered her at this location, she's extremely unprofessional and rude and Has no respect for her manager Jacque whom is very sweet and helpful as much as she can be whenever I've had an issue with the staff member however it does not excuse the behavior of this staff member. I frequent this location almost every morning before heading into work and try to avoid ordering if I know she is on schedule. I definitely have taken my complaint to higher ups in regards to this person and will continue to take it further if need be to ensure my safety as well as me being treated as a frequent customer the CORRECT way!

Saturday afternoon and the place was barely half full. Waited over 15 minutes for a server to come over. During that wait, witnessed another waitress pick her nose while taking another table's order, and we saw two other  tables waiting for their plates to be cleared and a check to be delivered. That should've been when we took the hint and left, but we were starving and didn't want to go back out in the cold to find another restaurant. 
Wish I could say it got better from there, but it didn't. My food was lukewarm when it finally arrived. After 2 hours, we were ready to get out of there but it took another 10 minutes to get the check. 
What happened to this place?!

Devil's Den is one of our local restaurants, and I've always enjoyed it when we've been. The drinks were good, but the food was only okay. We have been for both dinner and brunch; the service was fine and the beer menu is extensive. While the food is nothing special, it's still a solid place that I would recommend.

We had to make a stop on our way up north. It was a wonderful experience. The manager and staff are all super friendly. Also, very welcoming. The restrooms and tables are kept clean. The manager made sure that the lines were spaced out and receiving their orders. Thank you to the staff for providing us with excellent service. We appreciate you.

Friendly staff and a great option to check in ahead of time using the Yelp app.
We were able to just walk right up, give our name, and have a seat.
As an added bonus, the yelp app check in provided us a free mimosa.
As for the food, it was ok. I had scrambled eggs with french toast, where I was a bit put off at the interesting bread choice. perhaps it is just that I like my french toast simple, and not a fan of gourmet fruit flavored bread. My mate had the biscuits and gravy, and the same, he was not overly impressed, and made the same comment that the biscuit tasted odd, though he did not go into depth on the specifics.
Very interesting site to see the wall writings and staff was prompt and friendly. Though as my pallet is much simpler than this, I am not certain I would return any time soon. Nothing bad to note, just not my flavor.

Sausage pizza was delicious!  Cheese plate and humus came out after pizza but they said the food comes when it is done.   Great restaurant for a Hilton.  Too bad the DJ wasn't working the elevated stage!

I have been visiting the Arnold Syberg's about 3-4 times per week since they reopened and report that the food, the service & the staff are all 5 star. I bring relatives, neighbors and clients and never have to worry about the experience they will have. There is only one thing missing and that is Maria. When the restaurant opened Maria was my first contact. She is the reason I believe that I am their best customer. She was transferred to Helen Fitzgerald's and I  have been there  three times looking for her and she is nowhere to be found. I have a 62 oz jar of M&M's for her. That was our agreed upon treat for her for making me feel so at home at Syberg's. So, Maria, let me know where you are so I can present you with your treat. I was a bartender at Hodak's for 27 years and I Know what an awesome manager looks and acts like.
Zwickel Ron

Five stars because this place serves wonderful, homemade food, with great service.

 The husband and wife duo who run the place are so friendly and accommodating. 

Everything had simple but delicious, clean flavors. Eastern European comfort food without being too heavy. A nice break from high end BYOs, and an overall great dining experience with a very modest price point.

Delicious and nutritious blended drinks/smoothies! Definitely worth going back to whenever you're feeling for a little something extra after your meal. The power greens definitely hits the spot by balancing the sweetness from the fruits and the organic tastes from the greens. Absolutely wonderful!

Fantastic Place!  Believe the other good reviews and go here. I was passing through town on my way to Salt Lake City and found this place on Yelp.  I ended up stopping again on my way back through because it is delicious, fast and easy.   You order at the counter and there are several tasty tacos to choose from.  The great part about this place is that you can mix and match your choices.  Both times I ordered the picadillo and the bbq brisket.  I was not too keen on the fish tacos and neither was my husband so the second time we stopped by we knew not to get them.  They aren't terrible but we feel the chicken and beef tacos are way better.  Husband got fajita chicken and the beef texicano tacos which he loved.  We also ordered chips and queso.  The queso is amazing and has a bit of spice to it.  One order is enough for two to share.   Orders come up about 5 minutes after they are placed which is awesome if you are short on time.   Three tacos is enough to fill me up for the afternoon.  Husband usually orders 4.  Overall, excellent place that we wish we had here in Washington!

Beautiful porch or courtyard dining. Great outdoor music. The food was average. We felt rushed by staff.  The building and setting are much better than the staff and food. Can not emphasize how nice the place is.

I love coming here every time!!! Delicious tex-mex, great margaritas, great atmosphere. Make reservations on weekends; it can get pretty crowded. Service is top notch and the workers are great to interact with. Great for a date or a girl's night out.

Impeccable service, and equally impressive food.

Mouthwatering:
Lobster Bisque 
Filet Mignon, Lobster side
Creamed Spinach with breadcrumb topping
French Fries

And the grail of all that is amazing:  The Peanut Butter Cup

The food was good, but the worst service we've ever had. We frequently visit Copeland's and the service has been disappointing the past couple of visits. We waited 30 minutes before getting any drinks, our appetizers never came out with our meals, and our server was very rude. Our drinks never got refilled, so we actually had to get up and go to the bar to get more. I have never been anywhere in my life where the service was so bad I had to walk and refill the drinks myself. Our server had a very bad attitude and starting arguing with us about how it wasn't her fault the service was bad. To the managers credit, he was apologetic about the situation and attempted to help, but arguing with customers is a very poor way to gain business. We won't be back and certainly won't recommend it to anyone unless something changes

Yuck!! What's wrong with their food? I got honey chicken and my daughter got Broccoli chicken. We ate of about a 1/4 and both started feeling nauseous. We threw away the rest. I don't know if the oil they cook it in is old or if it's the chicken but something made us sick. Waste of money! Never again!

The chef is amazing and the service was right there on par. In the beginning the hostesses greeted punctually and the service was warming. To conclude our evening, the experience and the food was SPECTACULAR. i do not usually use caps but the food was warming and remember-ful(if thats a word). To go along with the front of the house hospitality. My family and I enjoyed ourselves for the holidays and expect many families enjoying the same! Mark is great and so is Da Soli.

The only reason why I gave this place one star is because there was no other option. The first time I went there the food was ok however the service was horrible. The girl at the front desk had a horrible attitude. She looked extremely annoyed and miserable. She rolled her eyes several times while taking my order. I was in disbelief. I wanted to ask her if she was having a bad day but I opted out because I didn't have the energy. I got my food and left. The second time I went She was there again. Me and my friend felt the energy upon arrival. You could cut it with a knife. This time I decide to walk out. Customer service is everything and she is a representation of this establishment. She is horrible,  therefore They lost a customer. 2 customers to be exact!

Welcome the new age of BBQ or just Q. This food done right with a fun atmosphere. Just a hop skip and a jump away from downtown Dunedin, it's a great destination. The food is great, the staff is friendly and did I say the food is great?! My wife loved the fried pickles, kids loved the ribs , smashed potatoes and deep fried Oreos and I loved it all. Right next to a brewery so you really can't go wrong. We will be back!

Good ol classic Cracker Barrel. Food is nothing fancy but it usually has some new special and a good deal. And who doesn't love a place that has breakfast all day! I got a new item on the menu today. The biscuit French toast. I liked it! Black berry jam was a treat! But the bacon was a little too thin- could have been thicker. I like that the portion sizes are just right. No waste of food or leftovers. The server could have come sooner to ask if everything was ok. Everything else was good.

We did delivery through seamless and it was wonderful. Portion sizes for dinner were huge. We will have plenty for another dinner. Lemon potatoes are a thing of beauty and really lightened you a otherwise starchy carb. Dip trio is a must and we enjoyed the spanakopita and chicken gyro platter. Baklava was delicious and hefty portion of that as well! 

Can't wait to try the fresh fish on the weekend and some of the lighter vegetarian options soon.

Hands down one of the best quick service restaurants in town. Fabulous, high quality food made just the way you like it. If you are not in the mood for a burger then try the wings or cheeseburger egg rolls! Fantastic food, hard working and kind owners will make you glad you stopped in for lunch or dinner!!

Excellent service is the first compliment I would give them. Jordan, our server was attentive and friendly along with everyone else in this establishment. Food was delicious, unique, presented beautifully and the decor is open, inviting, luxurious and comfortable. Perhaps it was because they weren't that busy on the evening we visited, but we were doted in by the entire staff. The location is perfect for any event in downtown Nashville, but absolutely perfect if you're attending any event at the As end Amputheater because you simply walk across the street and you're there. And you can't beat that happy hour price of $10 for 12 ounces of wine......that's three glasses folks!

Dinner with a party of nine this evening. Staff quickly arranged seating and promptly took drink orders. Two had burgers, rated good. One, crab legs and sirloin. Rated very good. Ribs, preceded by wedge salad, excellent. I had a new offering; beef filet with crab meat and bernaisse (sp) sauce, cooked medium rare as ordered. Very good. Two others had steaks and they were well-prepared, with good baked potatoes. Our waitress was excellent (sorry, didn't catch the name). She was attentive, got orders 100% right, brought extra condiments promptly, and got five separate checks exactly right. 
So, I am upgrading my last review.

I think everything about Butcher and B, the food, service, and atmosphere was outstanding. The only negative is the parking which can be a real challenge. I'd like to knock off one star for the parking, but everything else was so good it is worth the hassle

Discovered this place in Tempe circa 2001. Excited when they opened in East Tucson. Divorced in 2012 when they, obviously, could not get it together in Tucson's north location. The place is way to busy with inexperienced staff! Food pricing is fine when you can get in and get service, not so much when you have to wait an hour. No reservations accepted but we noticed a woman at a table for 6 commandeered her space for over half an hour while she waited for her party and we were sent to the bar to cool our heels? No plan. No more business from us:( Tucson has lots of options. I suggest you look for any one of them and pass on Oreganos.

So good! We sat outside and the space is so lovely! The trees keep it nice and shaded so even on the warm morning we were comfortable. The food was good. My little guy had a biscuit and gravy which he devoured. We all split a French toast and it was just enough sweetness. I had a basic scrambled eggs and toast with fruit. The potatoes that came with it were so good as well. They came with onions and peppers, I could have made a meal out of them! My boyfriend had coffee and he enjoyed it and j had a couple of mimosas (always a good choice!). If/when we make it back to St Louis this place is on our must visit list!

Smokin' Betty's delivers some of the best food in the neighborhood.  We stumbled across Betty's on a lazy Sunday afternoon and were blown away by the food.  The Betty burger was amazing, 1/2 pound burger stacked on a confit pork belly, topped with avocado, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, a roasted garlic aoli and an egg sunny side up (don't knock it until you've tried it- it's life changing).  Not to be outdone, the Tur-Duck-En Burger was also outstanding.  If you took thanksgiving dinner and put it into a tasty burger bun and topped it with sweet potato ribbons, you would not be far off. Simply Delicious.    

Definitely give Smokin Betty's a try. You will not be disappointed.

No! Pizza is supposed to taste good hot AND cold.  This pizza tastes like ass cold.  Yeah, I said it.  It tasted horrible.  

We ordered the "Rustys Special" which comes with  pepperoni, salami, mushroom, olive, onion and sausage. Anchovy or bell pepper on request. We got both the anchovies and the bell peppers as well. The ingredients were not evenly distributed so whoever was making this pizza did not do it with care.  The anchovies were extremely salty and basically, this pizza was just sloppy.   I would say the delivery was slow, maybe about 45 minutes and then also this pizza is best when it is hot. It wasn't BAD..just not great and for the price? No.  There is better California style pizza out there.
Loved this bar.  Wish it were in my neighborhood. I would live there. Cool decor, great bartender and friendly patron.

A must stop when I visit my parents. I've been going since I was a weee lassie. I remember the original owner taking the orders and always saying hi to my dad. (I think the current person who takes the orders is his son.) Hands down best taco de adobada and lomito suizo. The tamal de verdura is really really good which is what I ordered and a taco de calabacita. Since I have been going for years, I know the routine as far as ordering. But I do wish that they had a menu outside, either at the window, so newbies can check out the menu instead of holding up the line at front. Other than that, it is as good as it gets and a must when in Santa Barbara.

As far a Asian buffets go this place is great. it's not to expensive. The food tastes fresh and you get quite a variety. The Decor is very welcoming and impressive for a buffet. I would go again for sure.

This is the 2nd time I've ordered from Tony's. It's was the Best gluten free pizza and cheesesteak I've had.
Delivery was fast.

Delicious milk tea, small food menu for a little pick me up.

This location even has a drive through in case you don't even want to get out of your car.  Though the interior is nice and cozy, so I don't see why you wouldn't want to get out and spend some time here.

I was excited, because I read in another review that they have a list of the top ten drinks.  I expected it to be like the place I went to in Claremont, CA where there was really intriguing drink suggestions that you could tell others had ordered and made popular.  Here the list is basically like "milk tea with tapioca".  Nothing more than the basics.  It wasn't like oolong tea with almond milk, half sweet with jelly and pudding (I completely made that up so don't order it thinking that it will be amazing).  Even though this is a good tea place, it's hard to compete with CA.

I ended up going basic with a coconut milk tea with tapioca.  I was overwhelmed with the menu and decided to just go with the tried and true.  I also got calamari, because I was hungry.  Most of their food options are fried.  The picture shows the calamari as lightly fried.  Do not be fooled, it was very fried.  It was like onion rings fried.  It was good, but I could feel my calories clogging.  The milk tea was fantastic.  I felt like I could taste the fullness of the cream.  Again, I could feel my calories clogging, but since I don't do this often, it was worth it.

There were a couple of people hanging out here on a Saturday around noon.  This seems like a good place to hang out for a couple hours and enjoy a drink.

Food was mediocre. Double cooked pork was not "double cooked". The crispy salted shrimp was good. The service on the other hand was appalling. They had the guts to tell us to tip more than written as we were leaving, making the situation very awkward. Feel offended and put off.

This was our first time visiting this location.    LINDSEY, at this location, treated us as if we were common trash off the street.   
We were setting at the bar having drinks and evidently, we were sitting a local's 'spot'.  He made it known he was upset he couldn't sit there.  
Lindsay came over and said to close out our bill if we were waiting for a table.   We were not.   
Never been treated this way in an establishment.  
We will NEVER be back!!

This place is amazing!! Server was absolutely wonderful! She gave us a bunch of places to check out while we're here on vacation!! 

LISA MARIE IS THE BOMB!
Called in an​ order and it was done at the time they said it would be. Egg rolls are the best around here.

So it's a dive bar but the atmosphere is cool and the jambalaya was really good. Add to that a couple of cocktails and it's not a half bad day. 

The bowl of jambalaya was just enough for a quick bite of you're not too hungry. Otherwise go for the larger size or mix and match with a few other items. 

Crowd was a mix of tourists, locals, and dive bar regulars so interesting for people watching a bit. We sat at the bar which was probably the best place to be able to enjoy the full scene. 

I'd be back if just for the jambalaya. Give it a look.
Great for lunch, brunch or dinner. The only thing is if it's not busy the servers will not be in a hurry. So make sure you have time.
Great food. Had spinach and pizza balls. Def craving more. Rare time food was worth more then I paid for it at an events

The salmon tacos are pretty good! But if you brown and cheap, make sure you go happy hour only. They have a nice view on top of the boats so call in for reservation but they weren't too busy at Friday 5pm
mega hoagies with nine different meats and the best black and white shakes (besides chink's) in the city....need i say more.

I tried the seafood bruschetta. It was served on huge sliced bread. It also had imitation crab meat and no octopus. Not so great. I also tried the fried pork belly which was served laying flat on a plate and wasn't fried. I've had much better. The 303 cocktail was delicious.
The menu is small but focused on quality. Not expensive, but awesome. The Lamb Chops and the Cornish Hen were to die for
The Spinach Salad was really a side salad, not an entree! The chicken was good, but seriously not enough food for $12

I'm a fan of Eds' pizza.  The one slice of pizza is about the size of 2 or 3 of normal pizzerias.  It is delicious.  I have had the cheesesteaks, they are good, but you have to ask for extras "cheese, mayo, salt/pepper etc. or they taste pretty plain. The wings are large and pretty tasty, they are fresh.  You have to ask for salt/pepper though.  The salads are huge, I especially like the tuna and grilled chicken.  The hoagies are fresh and they have all the toppings you would want, peppers, oregano, pickles etc.  My two quarrels with Eds, and why it lost two starts are 1-cleanliness- there are often flies in here and the windows are stained, the floors and tables are usually not clean either....#2 ordering time- if you order anything other than a hoagie or a salad (i.e., something cold) be prepared to wait...the waits are really long...
Everyone must try at least one slice of their pizza though!!!

Sahara Grill is a middle eastern restaurant that is a informal, less pricey restaurant. I came on a Thursday night around 8pm. The ambiance is not upscale but quite regular and plain - almost too much so. It was half full when we arrived with 2 people in our party.

We ordered the Tabbouleh ($6) as an appetizer and I got the Chicken Shish Taouk ($15). Water came in small plastic clear cups. The tabbouleh was decent. It came with pita bread and a small salad. Honestly the salad wasn't great and was just very plain. I seemed to be complimentary, which might be why it was so plain. The pita bread was a little cold and not soft when it came out. I did like the tabbouleh but perhaps they could have added other flavors too? Maybe I don't like this dish itself, but perhaps there could be more tomato and other ingredients in the ratio between veggies and parsley.

The main course had some parts I liked and some that I didn't. I did enjoy the roasted parts of the dish - the zucchini and the chicken had great flavoring and were smoky and spicy. They were really both grilled the right amount just to be crispy but not burnt. The chicken came back pretty tender and had a nice orange-ish color too. This dish also came with rice. I wish the rice were a little hotter and less mushy. The tomato that came on the place was also huge and could have been cut to a smaller size.

Overall I think this place is decent but I will probably not come back as I want to try other restaurants and I think greek places like Kanella Grill though a different cuisine, serve sort of similar food done better.

Finally, the service. The waiters were friendly but we didn't ever get water poured until I asked, so my cup was empty at a point. They were nice though.

Avoid at all costs if you're trying to come for the morning or lunch rush. The line goes out the door. Other than that, it's tumbleweeds in there, which is great for small meetings. Food is typical for Panera, but they have an enclosed room in the back so it helps with some of the noise.

So this evening I decided to order delivery. 9:18pm I placed my order. Food arrived at 10pm, something strange was that they have 3 stages when ordering through the mobile app. Order received, order being prepared, and order on the way. The order confirmation came and it immediately jumped to order on the way within 5 mins. No way could a half rack of ribs, roast beef and a baked potato be cooked in under 5 minutes. When it arrived? As I had suspected it was all stone cold, the bun was old. The potato seemed microwaved. It was not even edible. They also gVe me 1/2 rack of back ribs not side ribs as I ordered. It was as if they gave me someone else's leftovers because they close at 10. Extremely disappointed with this delivery.

I've been to this restaurant before and the servicer was so so. But the last visit, the service was horrendous. And considering that the food is not to die for, they should at least give you better service. We will not be going there again..

Not worth the wait, and I don't mean outside...  We waited 15-20 minutes at the bar for a dozen oysters on the half shell.  They were small, flavorless & below average.

The place is totally mobbed with tourists and the quality has gone done since our last visit.

By comparison, we then walked down to Desire Oysters, were served immediately and their oysters were awesome.

Don't waste your time at Acme.

Great place always welcome you by name.  Sushi is delicious!

I like that when you go to Asuka, Kim, Vicki & Gary know you by name and always go out of there way to acknowledge you & chat.  Their food is delicious & the service is great!

Outstanding food & service

Im giving this place a 1 star review. I hate giving places these types of reviews because they should be reserved for the absolute worst of the worse.

We arrived on a Wednesday around 10:30AM. Walked in and were seated immediately. We were seated at a small table in the very back by the kitchen. We sat there over 15 minutes and not one server acknowledged us or attempted to take our order. 

During this time we had multiple employees walk by us. Not one stopped. After waiting we decided enough is enough. We got up and left. The person who seated us gave us an awkward goodbye. Like they knew the reason we were walking out. 

We were so excited to try this place. We were very let down and disappointment . First impressions are everything. I dont know if we will ever go back. I know they are fairly new, but I hoped that someone would've seen us and stepped up.

love Pa Pa food ! Pad Thai with tofu - the best. And the tofu soup. So many dishes are wonderful. You won't be disappointed. Oh and Yelp - while antecdotal - 17! other positive reviews have been posted that have no reflection of the initial reviews from 2011!.  The whole point of Yelp is not about just who advertises with you - but real reviews. Why are the positive reviews not posted here for  Pa Pa? Interesting question in manipulating reviews...disappointing!
Friendly greeting at the door and promptly brought samples of 6 different dishes.  They were all wonderful.  Went for the lobster bisque and shrimp po boy.  It was delicious!!  Loved this place.

As the name would suggest, Sub Zero has an unbelievable selection of vodkas. I mean, they've got it all. They also have really, really tasty sushi. Aside from vodka, they have an extensive selection of cocktails, beer, & wine and they can mix you up all sorts of mixed drinks (even sans vodka). I've been on weekdays and I've been on weekend nights and it's almost always pretty full. If you're looking for a place in the CWE to go drink for cheap, this certainly isn't it...but if you're a liquor/cocktail connoisseur and you're looking for a classy place to get your drink on, then you should definitely go.
Japanese tapas and ramen....yes, please!! Everything we had was great - seriously! Good food, attentive service and a fun atmosphere. Can't go wrong!

The staff is always friendly when we go. The interior is nothing spectacular but the food is delicious. The curry dishes are just excellent. My favorite is the massaman curry with chicken. My mouth is watering just thinking about it.  Also try the curry puff appetizer.
Love this sweet little spot. Cute atmosphere and the food is always delicious. One of the only places I've found that serves eggs Benedict. (My favorite!) One of our go to places.

PRICEY CHAIN RESTAURANT WITH THE FEEL OF A 
WELL-HEALED, BIG-CITY INDEPENDENT LANDMARK

Maggiano's, located on 86th Street just east of Keystone Avenue on Indy's Northside, is a chain, test restaurant with the feel of a well-healed, big-city independent landmark. 

Great surroundings. Above-average service. Tasty recipes. 

A few negatives to expect: 1) Seating is not their strong suit, even with a reservation. 2) You will pay top dollar for the nice decor, ample staffing and quality food. 3) Not all Maggiano's servers are created equal, so identify one who gives good service and request them. 

$50 w/o tip ($60 total) for two chicken picatta dinners (no soup or salad... just chicken breasts and a small bowl of angel-hair pasta), one drink and one Diet Coke is a bit salty even for the Keystone @ the Crossing area. 

A note to the MANAGER and OUR SERVER.... When your guests leave, and you're chit-chatting with one another, and the guests take the time to thank you and say goodbye, AT LEAST TAKE TIME TO ACKNOWLEDGE YOUR CUSTOMER'S COURTESY. IT IS YOU WHO SHOULD BE THANKING THEM AND SAYING GOODBYE.

Good food, fast delivery. Food has been consistent, I always know exactly what to expect when ordering. Delivery people are always super nice. They know us after so many years of ordering from them so they always make sure to put in enough fortune cookies for all of our kids. 

We pretty much always rotate between the same few meals, which includes beef and broccoli, general tsaos, jalapeño chicken PFR, pork egg rolls, and boneless spare ribs. Would recommend all.

I have never written a review for anything before, but had such a pleasant experience. I was visiting my uncle and we were looking for a place to eat. There is an app I like to use called Spotluck that randomly selects restaurants in the area and gives you a discount. This app is highly recommended. Even if the restaurant is not selected, you will still receive a 10% discount. We landed on Marokko and it was wonderful. The place itself is beautiful, really well decorated, and the ambiance is very calming. We ordered the Mezza Marokko and some Hand Crafted Tea. Initially, I wanted to order the Mezza Mediterranean, but the owner/chef insisted otherwise. We did not regret the change. The Taktuka and Grape Leaves were some of the best I've ever had. When we were done, the owner/chef brought out a Kale dish she was hoping to put on the menu (free of charge). It was equally delicious. For my main dish, I ordered the Tajine Agadir. Which is great, because I am a Vegan/Vegetarian (recently introduced cheese and eggs into my diet). I would definitely come again. The only thing I would keep in mind, is the chef/owner makes the experience very personal. Taking orders, refilling pita, and getting the check are not done systematically. But all you have to do is ask. I cannot wait to come back and try the desserts!!!!
Good food, great drink specials, friendly staff. Definitely the place to go in Redington Beach.
Such a super cozy intimate place!!!! Amazing alcohol selection super top shelf!!!!! Great bartenders!!! Super service!!! Pour ultra heavy! Really great place to chill and drink and socialize

Kinda disappointed to see how empty this place was. The food and ambience was great but I'd say the prices for Nashville were a bit high. Probably why we were one of two tables seated at the restaurant when we left at 8pm. 

The burger is insane. Without exaggeration it was probably one of the best burgers that I've ever had. With that being said, the lobster in the sliders is artificial. Yuck! 

I'd go back but I'd also encourage the owners to really look into how such a trendy new spot could be as dead as it was. Worries me that they won't be in business long if things don't change.

I'm surprised to say I was just lukewarm about my meal here. 

The turtle soup drizzled with sherry had a distinct beef flavor to it. I can't believe I'm writing this...but it actually reminded me a little bit of the canned beef pasta I had growing up. I was totally confused. I also don't eat this often and can't say it's a top pick, so take that with a grain. 

The shrimp remoulade with fried green tomato, egg, and lettuce went very heavy on the lettuce and very light on the remoulade, with just a sprinkling of hard boiled egg. This just didn't come together, especially since the tomato and shrimp are piled on top of a precarious tower of shredded lettuce with a schmear of remoulade at the edge of the plate...you have to deconstruct it to eat it and even then like...am I dipping? What's expected of me here?

Entrees fared better: the Andouille Crusted fish (I think it was trout that night) was delicious. It's heavy, despite the lightness of the fish itself. The texture isn't crispy, the crust is soft, almost mushy. It was more dusted than crusted. Still a good flavor though. Sitting in beurre blanc (butter, shallots, cream), drizzled with aioli, with some string beans and brussels sprouts thrown in underneath - by the end I was actually eating them just to break up all the rich heavy food I'd had that day, and they were cooked with a nice char to them. 

The Shrimp Tchefuncte is served in a Creole brown butter sauce called Meunière, and the fresh blue crab meat upgrade that came with it is an absolute must. The crab meat was one of my favorite items, so fresh! The shrimp were good, at this point in the meal I was beyond full and losing steam, so my memory is failing me. 

Service was very sweet and the atmosphere was lively. They do the flambe bananas foster table side which I absolutely could not fit in, but watched in awe as other tables received theirs.

This was my first visit to The Gaslight. The service was very attentive and friendly. The interior is more spacious than I was expecting. We were seated in a nice bay-window type of seating. We started with a goat cheese assortment and really enjoyed it. My boyfriend loved the GSLT Burger. I got the pulled lamb sandwich. It would have been great, but it was extremely soggy and soaked through the bun. My biggest recommendation would be that the bun be a harder roll rather than the very soft one they use. We didn't have a chance to get dessert, but the choices looked good. We plan to return for dessert sometime.

Small, cute, perfect for an afternoon coffee.  Only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because my Americano was not impressive but we like everything else. Cute decor, staff was nice and food was good!

Was taken here for my birthday, what a great treat it was. 
We ordered the Firecracker Shrimp and a wild onion appetizer. For dinner we ordered 10oz ribeye, seared tuna, ribs and a filet mignon. All the main dishes were all done to perfection. The shrimp were very large and delicious. Service was fast and knowledgeable on the menu items. 
Very nice clean place and good place to go for aged steaks!

Tried the Aztec (sweet & spicy grilled chicken w/ bacon) and the taco beef Mexico City today.  Portions were large, the food was excellent.  Of course I thought the prices were a little high, but that's because you're paying for real food and not animal byproducts like at Taco Bell and other fast food joints.  Will definitely be ordering from here again.

Having never been to a Piccolo Pronto before, I went in expecting an average thin crust pizza that's flavorful and quick. They accomplished the quick part in spades. Unfortunately, the sauce was thin and bland, and the crust was a non-event. The garlic knots were under cooked and too much dough with too little garlic. Even the pre-packaged brownie managed to be unappealing. Too bad :(

One word: YUMMY. This place was a lucky find. The burger I had was the best burger I've had in several years. Very juicy. The fries were very good too. Prices are cheap for all that you get. Worth trying out if you have never been here before. If I lived near The Spot ( which I don't ), I would eat there all the time!

The bouncer here is rude, unfair and unprofessional will humiliate you when you did nothing wrong. This is not the first time this happens. Check other reviews.  **Manager never reply to my email. No apologies no nothing.  This is the email I wrote to the manager.  It's been weeks so I thought I should share this. 

I'm writing to you because I had the worst and the most humiliating experience at Opa on Friday July 15. First, I would like to tell you that I'm one of the most loyal customer there. I've been here uncountable times since the place opens.  I participated many events in the past, happy hours, sips, hosted surprised birthday party for a friend and brought over 20 people and even countdown on New Years with you.

This past Friday night I went to Opa with a guy friend. My friend happened to know two guys that sit at the bar so we sat with them. I ordered a drink and we took one shot. We started talking then they started to become rude to me. I raised my voice but it wasnt that loud because no one else looked up or even notice.  The bouncer came and asked me to keep it down.  I said sorry.  People that was around there said to me that I wasnt loud and dont know why the bouncer was giving me a hard time. I continued my conversation with two rude guys to clear things up with them before I moved on.  About 5 mins later the bouncer came back again and asked me to leave.  He said I disturbed everyone there and I have to leave now.   I told him these two guys should leave because they were rude to us and Im trying to defence myself.  The bouncer said they are his friends, they are regulars, they have right to stay and I am not. The bouncer didnt listen to what I have to say then threat to call cops.  so we left.  We are so confused why I was being treated like this. Two people happened to walk out at the same time I escorted out. They felt bad for me and saw what happened.  I did nothing wrong. I was sober. I wanted to start a night at Opa. I go out 3-4 times a week all over the city and never once have any problems. I always respect servers, bartenders etc. I always tip well since I used to work in the industry.  I felt so humiliating and embarrassing.  I don't think I want to step into Opa anytime soon.   Hopefully those two guys will no longer be your regular and have better type of people to be your regular.  As long as this bouncer guy there I will not step in and I will make sure no one I know will go here. I don't want people I care about have to go through like me.   I'm sorry I have to write about this.  I love this place. Other than this situation. I love your food, your drinks and the service.

Incredibly disappointed! Was looking forward to trying a new restaurant. Terrible Steak Frites! Undercooked French Fries... overcooked steak smothered in a bitter sauce that couldn't be wiped off. Service was disappointing as well. Wanted to send the food back to be fixed but our waitress didn't check on us until we were almost done eating. Lots of staff walking around just not that interested in all the tables full of people. It was very strange! Was so happy to have a new place to eat... maybe it was just an off night.

Was in town from Florida on a two week road trip.. Wanted to eat at a local place and this was it. Arnold's is southern cooking at its best. Fresh and made with love. Yes it may be cafeteria style but well worth every moment. The staff made you feel welcome and at home. This little spot is always busy and constantly had a line but well worth the stopping. We surely will be back.

Ok, so my husband and I have been going to Leaning Tower on and off for 30 years!!!  Moved back to the area a little over a year ago and have ordered at least a dozen times...typically very good.  Well, last week we ordered 2 veal parm subs...hubby doubled the meat on his...subs were delivered on time...however they were so overcooked and in old oil they were a dark brown...dry no flavor...very disappointed!  We called they apologized and said they'd give us a credit for what we spent...around $20...so last night we decided to order pizza...again we've ordered dozens over the years...requested 1/2 pepperoni and 1/2 with green peppers and onions chopped rather than slice and to please make it as thin as possible.  Clerk recognized we had a credit and applied so it was a wash...perfect.  Pizza arrived on time and hot...sadly all the toppings were on 1/2 the pizza so 1/2 was just cheese...not a biggie could pull the pepperoni off and put it on the other half...problem was the pizza crust was thicker than any time we've ever ordered.  Did not bother to call back.  Not sure if it's a change in ownership, management or just not caring...it's sad to see what used to be a prime "go to" go so wrong!
I looooove their pesto veggie flatbread.  Please don't ever get rid of that item!!!  Delish!  The staff is always fast, polite and accomodating.

Nektar is a beautiful wine bar right in the center of New Hope and the views are gorgeous. I prefer sitting towards the back of the restaurant upstairs and outside if weather permits. 

They have an eclectic wine, beer, and whiskey selection. I prefer noshing on small plates and that's pretty much their whole menu. I had the octopus, which was tender and perfectly cooked. The bacon wrapped dates are wonderful. Finally, the Korean wings are the perfect blend of sweet and savory with a little zing. It's a great place to go with a medium sized group, girls night, or a date night.

We had a party of six this evening. Everyone was pleased with their pizza. Better than Blaze was the consensus. Limited selection of  beers (would have liked a dark beer), but pizza was good, if you like crispy crust. The herb-butter application prior to the sauce is a good choice.  Big benefit is easy parking - unlike Blaze in IV, where we just don't go when school is in session. 
All-in-all a good basic place at a reasonable price. Servers were good and conscientious, and place was clean and well-maintained.

Hidden treasure! Awesome service, delicious food and extremely affordable. I love the vibe in the back.
Hope this place sticks around it's great for the area

Great bagels, which is something that this area has been missing for as long as I've lived here.  If you want butter on your toasted bagel, I would suggest getting it on the side, unless you want enough butter for 6 other bagels.  Can take a long time to get the food if you eat in.  Overall though, I'm excited to have them here and wish them many years of success!
Not worth the money. The pizza was average. I ordered a Hawaiian pie (ham and pineapple) and some slices barely had any toppings. Super greasy and the crust was on the burnt side.

Always great food,service and atmosphere!We live in Orlando and this is our go to place to get away!  Been coming since it opened and never been disappointed!  My food has always been delicious.  Their boats are having trouble getting stone crabs, which would have been my first choice, but the Kay-Lyn Grouper, sautéed vegetables with grouper over rice, was over the top tasty.  I'm a huge fan of Tarpon.  It makes you pleasantly feel like you've entered something completely different. Keep up the great work, Rusty Bellies!

Homey cow amazing. Food great prices great selection of beer great service and excellent food!
I definitely recommend

This was the worst experience I've ever had at a mexican grill. The chicken was not done and I'm pretty sure there were bones in my meal. I would not recommend ever going to this place if business. They were not that busy but service was horrible. I'm a firm believer of always having a full glass of any beverage and they lacked at that.

First time visiting and would definitely go back. The wife and I wanted to have some Indian food with our son before he goes off to college. Upon entering we quickly realized that you order from the digital menu in the wall. Simple as 1,2,3. Pick your protein, curry, toppings, etc. I had the lamb rice bowl and topped it with the Spicy onion (not too spicy), cucumber, tomato, and mint chutney. The wife had a Naan pizza with tandoor chicken masala, corn, and cilantro. And last my son had tandoor chicken and rice with vindaloo sauce. We were all well pleased with the food and the quickness we were able to get in and out. Excellent food, service, and staff! We will definitely go back.

Amazing burgers and wings! Ordered the black and bleu burger, regular fries, Chicago's best burger, old bay fries and old bay rubbed wings. Wow! Everything was fresh and delicious. Came out fast. Owner super nice and personable and will give recommendations if you'd like. Looking forward to going back and will order something different, just so that I can try out more on the menu! Enjoy!
Best ceviche in SB. Creative, fresh, delicious, generous...Their tacos are also epic. One of my favorite lunch spots in a town with dozens of great options!

Ordered the Ohana breakfast to-go for this morning. Very yummy! Service was quick when I arrived to pick up. Food was fresh and hot. 

The decor has a very Hawaiian theme (to be expected)  and is on the more relaxed but intimate side. No pics this time, I'll work on that when I return. 

The macadamia nut syrup on the pancakes was fabulous, and the pancakes themselves were so fluffy and substantial. Lotsa yum!

Can't wait to go back for more, and now that they're so close to the house, I expect that will be sooner than later!

We only had four days in Philly but I am so glad we found Barbuzzo. Small plates, nice wine and beer selection, amazing mixed drinks. Yes, I loved the Old Fashioned. Also the sazerac.
Surprisingly the highlight was the pizza, made in a wood fired oven with figs and I forget what. The crust was perfect.
We came back the next night for happy hour that starts at 10:30. Made for a rather late night.
Sitting at the bar was perfect- all the action is right in front of you. Yes it is small, near the oven it is warm, but what fun.
Nothing fancy, nothing pretensions, just awesome pizza and wings. Delivery is always fast and friendly.

I am very picky about MY Birthday Cake...two different types of icings are offered-my husband likes one and I LOVE the other one.
Every baked good I have bought their is great (be-careful about how you store, things do dry out quickly here).
I have even reached the point of always buying double, my husband's coworkers scarf the treats up (even those watching their weight...sometimes calories are worth it).

Went here for dinner and arrived in time for the early bird special prices! 

This place felt like a homey Olive Garden. Decor was honestly a bit dated and tacky but at the same time it was super comforting and warm. The sort of place you take your grandmother to. 

The early bird menu (served until 5:30) consists of most items on the regular menu and the prices are discounted about $3-5 per item. And it all comes with freshly baked bread and salad or soup.

The bread rolls were delicious!! Light and fluffy, hot and steaming, perfectly crispy without being too hard. I would seriously come here for the bread alone. They serve it with some garlicky dipping oil. 
The side salad with Italian dressing was a big hit among others in my party. It was okay, your basic lettuce mix with a piece of cucumber and tomato and onion. The dressing was nice, not as vinegary as most Italian dressings. 

For my main, I ordered the Frutta de Mar- mussels, shrimp and scallops in a spicy, robust tomato sauce over pasta. The portion size was huge! Plenty of seafood too. I thought okay, ok just leave at least half the pasta noodles, this is way too much food. But the sauce was so tasty I ended up seriously overeating. They ask if you want the sauce hot or mild, I chose hot and it was actually a decent level of heat! I was quite surprised since most honey places like this tend to cater to palettes least tolerable to spice. My only complaint was that this sauce was a bit heavy for a tomato based sauce. I could taste a lot of butter, which made it delicious! But I would recommend asking if they could use less. Others in my party loved their dishes which were lasagnas and eggplant parmesan.

For dessert I had the tiramisu which was nice and light. Not the best tiramisu I've ever had but pretty damn good! 

Overall I enjoyed my meal here. Go here for solid Italian food.

Whenever it's a nice day in University City and I'm going for a walk there is a magnetic pull that draws me to this place. One of the main reasons that must be is how much value you get for your dollar, especially when you order the larger sized meal. I'd say that you get so much value for the large size that you should just get that even if you want small (no one says you have to eat it in one sitting like I do).

My problem is completely a personal failing. I want to try something different when I go there, but the jerk chicken, yams, and collard greens have been so good to me that I don't want to try anything else. One day I'll find that courage, but not just yet.

I've seen some complaints about the speed of service, but I've never had a problem showing patience for food. I know how they operate and if I really wanted something faster I could have just as easily gone some place else. The food is definitely worth the wait. Just make sure to stay active after eating this or else you'll find yourself falling into one of those food comas.

This place is a hidden gem! The food is great, the service is friendly and the way they pack your food is taken with care. Drop in if you're in the area. Got a large oxtail, rice and peas, collards and Mac and cheese. everything was delicious. My new Jamaican spot. I'll definitely be back!

Top of my fave place to eat in Madeira Beach area.   Let's face it a lot of the restaurants are similar in their offerings.   This one was clean, good service and had great calamari, fresh salads, Dungeness crab & wonderful lobster Alfredo.  We went early before the rush at around 530.  No line.  Tasty tasty.

3.5 here 

First off my expectations were high since I made our reservation in early March for late May. With that level of difficulty I figured it would be packed. There were a bunch of empty tables. Our server was excellent. Some of the other staff seemed a bit snooty and certainly trying hard to be cool. The bar runner had suspenders and a handlebar mustache. 

Food was excellent, not as complex as one would expect from a place like this. Drinks were amazing. 

Bill was $175 with four drinks before tip. A tad overpriced but it is in a great location.

The food was sub par, the service was horrible because we were left without service for over twenty minutes when we were about to leave. The Edwards location was so much better and we will be going to that location next time. Very disappointed

Went to try Hana Tokyo again last night and DAMN, I really like this place!  They have the best Spicy Tuna roll in town and the bartenders are awesome!  
There is something about eating Sushi, having drinks, and watching a movie, all without having to drive anywhere.  It really does not get any better.
Fries are fantastic. Oils definitely not Sunflower or Safflower. Unfortunately always packed means your in for a longgggggg long and longer still wait.

Went for a weekday lunch and it was delicious! Artichoke appetizer, salmon sandwich and BSC salad with salmon was delicious.  Everything tasted so fresh and summery- light but satisfying.   Local wine was so good, I never knew Idaho has such great red wine! We finished the meal with their signature butter cake--- which was heaven. Our waitress was sweet, attentive and timely. Highly recommend Fork!

Yeah ambience at this place is really really cool. It's good for groups it's also good for small couples. The drink specials are really nice and very good options as far as draft or a bottle beer hey Siri read text message
I got food poisoning and the food didn't taste correctly and everything had a weird spin to it

This was place was yummy. Not as good as the second meal I had down in NOLA. But I'd still recommend it. 

It's hard to recommend dishes here because the menu changes with what's fresh. I started with the Tuna Tartare, which I have had before at other places. This was the first time I really really enjoyed it. 

For my main dish, I had the gumbo (which I've never had before, so I couldn't say how it was compared to others, but I LOVED it!) and the spinach and goat cheese salad which was fresh and yummy, but compared to the flavors in my other dishes, it was boring. :-)

My dining companions really liked their meals as well... check this place out!
Amazing food. Every. Single. Visit. Grab a Cuban sandwich and head over to Green Bench for a beer!

Started off a bit rocky but overall the food was good and the place was clean!

I had purchased a Yelp Deal ($20 for $15) and printed it per the instructions. Upon presenting it to the Cashier, same day of purchase, she looked at me confused and told me that they don't take "those". I had explained that it was purchased via Yelp and it was that particular restaurant. She then went to go find the manager/owner, and after some discussion between them on how to ring up the voucher, the issue was resolved. The owner/manager seemed slightly confused as how he was going to register the deal and asked me to see my phone, which was literally the same as what I had printed out for him. Personally I think if you're going to offer a deal on Yelp you should make it a streamlined experience for the customer instead of an awkward experience. 

I was a bit hesitant on ordering any food after reading a review about how another fellow patron has gotten violently ill due to bad produce. My two friends and myself did not experience any discomfort and the food was good, albeit a little overpriced compared to similar restaurants.

Confirmation of the lack of staff (2) as denoted by other reviewers did not slow down our service during this particular visit. There were 4 other tables not including our and the food came out relatively fast, roughly 10-12 mins. I wouldn't have expected it to arrive sooner to our table as it would probably signify that the food has been sitting out.

The waitress doubling as cashier was very nice when she brought us our meal, and the manager doubling as the cook was quick to server out our food all of which came out within 5 mins of each other.

All in all I would come back here again for the food and quick service.

Loved the interior and vibe of this place.  We came for lunch but I would want to come back during happy hour.  The decor has a very authentic irish feel.  The food is pretty good as well, we got the chicken fingers as appetizers and I got the crab melt sandwhich was was very tasty.
The atmosphere was great! The food was amazing! Huge portions very filling. I would most definitely go back here again and recommend it to anyone visiting New Orleans.

Another great find in St Pete! Great Latin foods, groceries and reasonable prices. I found all the Cuban goodies I was craving. Yay! The owner is very friendly, and not only makes you feel welcome, but almost like you are part of the family! I am so glad they made the move to St Pete! I highly recommend this market!

Got the "The Big Kahuna" Cheese Steak, Giant Size, today w/ $2 off coupon that came in the mail. Sandwich is $13.95 before tax ($2 discount = $11.95). I would say at that price point it's pricey, and the meat and cheese were decent, but not, "Big Kahuna". As with all sandwiches here you also get that East Coast bread, the kind that tastes unique and different, so it helps add value.  

This was my first time for the Cheese Steak, and today, I enjoyed the sandwiched. I added lettuce, tomato, onion and light mayo, and that's what really completed the sandwich for me today. 

Overall I with the $2 discount, the good food prep, including very, "Fresh" tomatoes today, and the excellent and unique chewy bread, "Today" I was a Fan, and would get this sandwich again!
Delicious ramen, friendly service. Portion is just enough for you to be full. I really loved their black garlic ramen. Very rich and flavorful. Finish the meal with their Mochis.

Great place, reasonable prices. The toasted raviolis are the best I have had. Wife got deep fried chicken livers( I hate liver), they come served with cocktail sauce which I thought was strange. However I was talked into trying them. I was reluctant but surprisingly the cocktail sauce takes away that nasty liver taste. They were actually pretty darn good. I would eat some of them again.

I went in today on Christmas Day and Britney was the only bartender on. Me being a bartender, I know how stressful it can be. She never lost her cool and she never forgot what I ordered. Definitely coming back because of her alone.
One of the best low key bars in west Chester. The food is great but we mostly go for the late night crowd. Great beer on tap and the machine that you can put money in and play music you pick!

This would have been 2 stars except the dessert was perfect.  Came her for the groupon 4 course tasting, 2 for 1 for $50. Well, I'm glad it was only $50...left hungry and needing some FLAVOR!  

Bruchetta was VG.  Appetizer was Roasted Peppers (VG), and some bland mushrooms in broth (BLECH, awful).  Primi was Gnocci (OK) and Linguini in bolognase (Flavorless).  Entrees were Salmon and Leeks (awful bland) and sausage and Brocoolli rabe (better, but still way too bland).  Dessert was Limoncello, ricotta cheesecake and chocolate mousse, all heavenly.

It was way too hot, and the chairs terribly uncomfortable.    Service was Very Good.

Will not be back...even though it was OK.  There were certainly things on the menu that looked very good....this but a Chef's Tasting is NOT a Prix Fixe.....it should have knocked our socks off.

(Ok, I can't bring myself to give it 3 stars....2.5 stars)

yum yum and double yum this looked like a fancy dig. i felt a little funny being slightly dressed down as the interior was well laid out and beautifully decorated. ample seating and the italian food was awesome!


this is a great place for celebrating that special night out or to cozy up with freinds for a casual evening out. its one of the few places as a sit down place other than a bar thats open late if  you dont want to hook up but just want to chill and get your grub on.  i love the ambiance and the coziness, not to mention you can still dress casual or get decked out.
The oysters were amazing and the service was great.  Really enjoyed my experience.  Definitely will be back.
Love their margs and vegetarian enchiladas! My friend got the shrimp fajitas and loved them as well.
This is my favorite place for BBQ. I love it so much that I made sure they catered my wedding. I recommend everything on the menu, you will not be disappointed.

I'd been looking forward to this opening for awhile now. I'm a big fan of poke and a restaurant like this would make a great addition to downtown Tucson. 
So imagine my disappointment when I couldn't even finish my meal. 

I wanted to try something new so I ordered their burrito. The rice was over cooked and mushy. The ahi tuna was gray and had a bite. 

The worst part was their "house sauce." It was sour and made the burrito inedible. 

A recent opening isn't an excuse for food being this bad.

Cant say anything bad about this place! The service was friendly... they are only open for takeout right now. We tried their chicken maroush and philly cheese steak hoagie.. both were superrrr yummy. The maroosh is definitely their specialty, i have never had it like this before, it was too good

My husband and I had dinner at this TGIF's. First the sound was deafening, apparently a bartender contest.  We were seated on the other side of a partial wall.  Our waiter was pleasant enough, took drink orders - just 2 Coke Zero.  He took the dinner order - husband had the Jack Daniels burger, I wanted the petit sirloin - 6 oz cooked medium & a double order of broccoli - I was pointing to the doneness chart.  After about a 10 minute wait our dinner arrived.  Husband's burger was fine.  My steak looked like it had been dropped on the plate with grease all over.  I cut into it and it was well done and dry.  Trying to find the waiter was Impossible.  I got up and asked another waiter. About 15 minutes later the second steak arrived.  A manager delivered the second one.  He asked me to cut it to make sure it was the way I wanted it.  Unfortunately the meat did not have time to rest and all the juices poured out.  The manager made a comment that sounded like something would be compensated.  Nothing was done, very disappointed!

What a wonderful place... Perfect combination of a high end but comfortable dining experience.  We had the brunch and my husband ordered off the menu... Both good and I find priced right for the quality-- love seeing the owner behind the bar!

Despite living in Clearwater for over 25 yrs, I hadn't been to Einstein's before.  Wow, what have I been missing!  The store is located on Gulf to Bay right across S. Arcturas Ave. from Burger King.  The store is spacious with a lot of seating.  I was immediately greeted as I entered the door.

Einstein's offers a lot more than just bagels.  They have pastries, sandwiches and both lunch and breakfast items.  I opted for a Blueberry Bagel and a delicious Greek Yogurt Cherry Pastry.  I had my bagel sliced then toasted.  It was full of blueberries and it had a nice bite to it but wasn't too dense.  The Cherry Pastry was so good that I immediately felt guilty after eating it.  My total bill was less than $4!

The staff was friendly and speedy.  The store was clean and airy.  I will definitely be back real soon!

I seem to be struggling to find a Mexican restaurant in Nashville that even slightly compares to the Mexican food I'm used to in California. It seems as if every Mexican restaurant in TN gets their food from the same food supplier. It all tastes exactly the same. The chips, the salsa, the margaritas, everything! 
I was simply not impressed.
Great food, great service! A great place to eat with all sorts of vegan and vegetarian options
Horribly organized. Here's why-- lines as long as Black Friday lines. Waited 45 minutes to get drinks and food. Don't come here to eat or drink. It's not worth the wait.
Best burgers in St. Pete that I have had so far. The staff is very friendly as well. Great craft beers as well.

I am a traveler from NY and I keep coming back to this dim sum restaurant every time I visit Tampa. I'm usually satisfied with this place and that is the main reason I keep coming to this restaurant. However, This is one of the worst experiences I've had in a restaurant.

1. FOOD was not great today. I would expect Sundays to be busy so there would be more carts for Dim Sum. Our server told us that the cart will be over soon. It took the first cart of Dim Sum 20 minutes to come. Then, 20 minutes later, the second cart came around and it was the same cart with the same food! I am hungry and I wanted Dim Sum for a variety of food-not eat the same thing. I've waited 15 minutes for the other cart, and our server said it will be over soon. By the time the other big cart came, there was almost nothing left in the cart! Definitely not happy about that so I made a complain to our server that there is nothing in the carts and I need to see a menu to order dim sum because waiting around for 40 minutes to get dim sum is ridiculous. I ordered a XO rice noodle and when she gave it to me, it wasn't even hot. Only the plate is hot. I wondered how long it had been out in the cart for. I wanted my food HOT! 

2. SERVICE WAS DISGUSTING TODAY. Beside the wait time for food, our server is so RUDE AND NASTY. When it was time to pay, we handed them our credit card. However, I was told that the credit card machine is broken and they asked if we can pay cash. We told them no and NO ONE FROM THE RESTAURANT INFORMED US "CASH ONLY!" before we sat down. So how do they expect us to pay? Am I suppose to run to an ATM that's like a few miles away when it is their fault for not letting customers know that they are only accepting cash for the day. Next, our server decides to write our credit card information down and told us to give our zip card so they can charge us when the machine is fixed. I THINK A NORMAL PERSON SHOULD KNOW NOT TO GIVE YOUR CREDIT CARD INFORMATION AND CVC CODE TO SOMEONE ELSE BECAUSE WHAT IF THEY USE YOUR CREDIT CARD AND PUT A CHARGE ON IT. MY SERVER TOLD US IN A NASTY, RUDE TONE, "SO THEN YOU RUN TO THE ATM TO PAY FOR THE BILL". This is clearly not our fault. Our server does not have to be so rude to customers. We refused and waited additional 30 minutes to see the credit card machine works again. We had no choice but to let them write our credit card number down because the machine was still not working. We will definitely have the restaurant held responsible if we get any other unauthorized charges.  

We will not be coming back anymore! I'm sure there are better restaurants with BETTER SERVICE. 

Disgusting place I've been to so far.

Some GREAT sweet tea!  The only place that compares is Maxine's.  I got the quarter chicken (dark meat).  Very good.  There is a different flavor to their breading, but it's quite good.  The sides are pretty big.  A colleague and I split the horseradish mashed potatoes and we didn't even finish them.  I love horseradish, so they were awesome.  But even if you didn't, the horseradish wasn't overpowering.  It's a great place for lunch.  It was very crowded (a testament to the quality of food).  However, we had no problem getting a table, and received our food very quickly.
Awesome!! Best donuts I ever had!! Fresh and reasonably priced. Everyone was so friendly and professional. Only place I'll get donuts from now on!

I miss Moose and Deer bantering on television, so I thought that I'd visit Montana's and see how they're doing. Didn't see them. However, I did see this South Edmonton operation at full scale 'kid's are in the house' mode. 

It was Tuesday - Kid's Night! We brought four. Four kids 5 - 13 years old, and 4 adults. This could have been a restaurant challenge, but Montana's was ready, and did a great job. Every table had children, and the staff kept up to the sugar fuelled, over-energized room full of kid's trying to get the balloon artist's attention. Now, my version of hell would be making balloon figures at warp speed for a never ending stream of highly motivated children. The Montana's balloon expert kept up to the challenge. He kept the young ones captivated, while the oldsters checked out the menu. Good selection of ribs, burgers, and all-you-can-eat ribs. The service level from seating to check was really smooth. Our server was Diane, and she was a pro. The entire floor staff kept the room at a positive experience level. Lot's of table-side birthday recognition, and kids wearing the Viking horn helmet feeling very special. I was impressed. How many times can you get the entire staff to clap and sing the birthday banter, and keep it fresh and fun? About 8-9 times before we left. Yikes.

The restaurant was decked out with lots of logs, a  lodgy woodsy motif with canoes, classic Evinrude boat motors - even a vintage truck suspended from the ceiling.  The food was good, and no complaints at our table. I had some draft beer, and it was cold and crisp. The kid's pops came continually, and we never had to look for Diane, she was always  there even though her section was holy smokin' busy. The check came at just the right time, about 12 minutes before our 5-yr-old crashed from the sugar high (3 mini ice cream cones topped it all off). We paraded out, and overall felt very well taken care of. Someone else paid the tab, but it seemed that the little kids ate off a menu that was either free, or just a few bucks.
