If you run out, don't expect them to refill it for you without you having to ask.  This also means that sometimes your entree may arrive before your appetizer.  Because of this, I've gotta dock them half a star.

Decor is plain, but clean.  Because of some of the disclaimers in the first two paragraphs, and also because even though their food was great, but failed to blow me away, I sadly have to round down this place to four stars.  I really wanted to give this place five stars, because it doesn't deserve the current rating it has.  I hope they can change up a few things so that can change my review to five stars the next time I stop by!

Excellent.   Thought we were going on a simple ride down the river but in addition we were entertained by a smart, funny, interesting historian.  Charles delivered in every possible way and made the ride memorable.  I learned so much.  Thank you, Charles!

Literally the best fried chicken I've ever had! We waited till we got home to eat it and it was still crispy after an almost 30 min drive home. I got mild cuz I can't handle a lot of heat and it was perfect for me. Just enough heat to give that kick! So flavorful, I have to go back before we head home. This is the only fried chicken I've ever picked clean. Highly recommend this restaurant!! 

Also bought a piece of strawberry cake and it was also very good. Oh and cherry on the sundae...we met Tom McGowan on our visit, he was also eating there for the first time. Super nice guy.
You need a CLEARWATER location...asaps!

We stumbled into Cuba Libre while walking in the area. We were pleasantly surprised with the Spanish decor inside and the precautions they took under covid pandemic. The food was amazing and we found ourselves transported to Cuba when we took our first bite. Our night was highlighted by the Paella Marinera, the maduros, tostones and pineapple guacamole. Let's not forget the mojitos. Wow!!!!
The food overall isn't too bad if you like an extreme amount of salt. I don't. I've had their breakfast & lunch options & always way too much salt. I won't go back now matter how hungry I get.
Great food. Our server Chris was awesome! I highly recommend. I had the crab cake pasta, very good. Also, the pecan pie was excellent.

I agree with some of the other reviewers that the feel of this place is very much like having a bunch of high schoolers serving burgers.  Don't get me wrong, they're all super friendly just a little awkward.  Like when the nozzle was off the diet pepsi fountain machine (bonus for having both coke and pepsi) and the worker grabbed a nozzle from another one with his bare hands without washing either his hands or the nozzle and moved it to diet pepsi.  The decor is very sparse.. as in, there is none.  Color on the walls and absolutely nothing else. No pictures, no menu on the wall.  You're supposed to know to pick up a menu when you walk in and order at the counter.  A little awkward.

The prices are pretty high, a large onion ring was almost $3 and came with half a basket of pretty bland rings.  The burgers were decent and I liked the available options.  All things considered though, I prefer smashburger.

Probably the best place to get tacos in Trenton. The portions are great and the prices reasonable. I highly recommend the Carnitas tacos, they're my all time favorite. The location is usually never packed so service is very attentive. Be warned that the establishment seems to be family owned, so there may be a language barrier for non-Spanish speaking customers.  If you dine-in you get chips and salsa as an appetizer.  Another tip: if you get tacos ask for the "hecho a mano" tortillas which means hand made, they will charge you an extra dollar but the flavor is incomparable to regular flour tortillas.
Best brisket sandwich ever. It didn't even need sauce! Moist and flavorful and less than $9! Highly recommended. Our waiter was amazing too! You rock, Eddie!

Walked in the door and the staff was so welcoming and nice. We ordered 2 of the shareable platters (4 types of nachos) and literally EVERYTHING was delicious. Even the kids enjoyed their kids nachos. Definitely recommend!
The beignets are fresh and made to order. This makes for a bit of a wait but it's worth it. Better than Café du Monde in my opinion. They also have live music which is nice.

Melt in your mouth deliciousness! I was shocked that this place wasn't more crowded, though I see where the college kids hang out -- nearby chain restaurants that aren't nearly as good! 

Get with it kids, it's best food in the block! Brilliant taste that will leave you craving more :) UCSB campus hidden treasure.

Service was poor unprofessional.  I was told sit at anywhere I like.  No one brought me menu for long time.  Finally someone asked me if I need a menu.   I asked for to go gumbo and a side dish, when the waiters brought over two tiny cups of food, I was speechless.  She knew I was ordering a dinner not two side dishes.   I did not even bother to make any comment.  I should took previous reviewers advice.
Great place. This is one of my go-to Chinese places. They are always very quick and  the food is never disappointment. The prices are a bit on the expensive for what it is. I recommend this place.

Burger was very good. Our server Megan and the hostess (who's name i failed to get) were very nice. Just attentive enough and both super sweet. My only disappointment was my drink. Long island ice tea wasn't made well even so the experience was good enough that i can't wait to visit again.

Wow. Deciding to update this review was tough! The main reason I'm doing it is because I saw they added a Yelp Check-In offer that gets you a free refill on their drip coffee or a free additional shot in your espresso drinks! 

Coffeebar used to be my secret nook where I could hide out and not see a single person I know all day long. It was a place where productivity was available in mass quantities, and a whole lot of work got done!  Since Coffeebar opened its doors this past year though, I've watched it get busier and busier, seen friends and colleagues discover it for the first time, and realized my secret spot isn't really a secret anymore. 

Regardless, I still love this place! The staff is super colorful, the food and drinks are delicious, and the vibe is something you can't find at any other coffee shop in town. And while I may run into quite a few people I know when visit, it's about the only coffee shop I know where work trumps talk. I love that. 

The Dirty Chai Latte is not to be messed with, and is my drink of choice. But their French Press is delicious too. 

I'll never abandon this spot, but I've started coming here knowing that I just may not get the spot I want, or worse, have to seek other arrangements. I'm ok with that. I can't hog the place all to myself, though I wish I could!

If you are craving something really sweet, like REALY sweet, then this is the place. They have a lot of chocolate verities to eat (and to drink). 

It was a different experience, but not my thing. 

If you are not into a chocolate-mixed alcohol, avoid. Their wine collection is very limited and cheap brands.

Berns is great to check the box to say you've been there and had the experience. It's good to know the cellar has plenty of great options where money is not an object. You go here for the atmosphere. You go here for the who's who. All the steaks were ok. I don't think they have the best steak. You may cringe when I tell you where I think the best steak in Tampa is. Probably not somewhere you expect. Take visitors here so they can say they've been, but I think there are much better places to have an excellent steak.

This place is consistently amazing. I own a couple of cafes and I am absolutely amazed by the speed, accuracy and professionalism of this location. They didn't ask for my rewards membership during this visit but I am still super impressed with the staff. Great job guys, great job.
Came here for lunch at the bar on Saturday.   Had some faves from next door:  oyster Rockefeller and crabmeat Maison. Delicious. Did not try the steak. Recommended.

AWESOME FOOD! 
Happy Staff eager to please!
Sooooo many options to satisfy the appetite !!

Jalapeno peppers are HOT! 
Hot sauce bar is definitely very cautious.... the 'super spicy' was not.

I come here a lot. . They have good slices but the best is when you get a whole pie as everything is fresh.  Absolutely delicious. . The prices could a bit less for the pies to better compete with the other pizza places around there

Public Greens has a lot of appeal for health-concious Monon trail users. The menu contains several salads, soups, proteins, and grains- mostly fresh and healthy. I love that you can choose 1, 2, or 3 items to make your own meal. However, because everything is individual, forming a balanced meal can get expensive. I had a simple salad, grilled chicken, and farro. It was healthy, fresh, and locally sourced. It was also $14 + tax. The farro was flavorful with fresh canteloupe and a yogurt sauce. However, my simple salad was just greens and balsamic and the chicken breast was, well, just lightly seasoned chicken.  Yes, I ordered these "plain" items because I was trying to create a well-balanced dinner that wouldn't completely negate the long bike ride I'd taken to get there. The "mission" of this kitchen is hungry kids- so it's hard to get too upset at cost effectiveness. Public Greens is a great stop during an active afternoon on the Monon, I just wouldn't recommend it for normal evening out.
Wonder atmosphere! Great place for breakfast. Food was wonderful, the beer biscuits and gravy are yummy.

Well I eat here quite a bit and buy lots of people food from here but the ridiculousness of the drive thru is unbearable. Sometimes it's works other times they have people outside taking your order or they ask you to drive up to the window. Either way they somehow manage to screw your order up. If you don't check it before you dive away you'll be pissed, cold fries and everything. If I want to go in I'll eat inside. I really can't see this location lasting.

The place to go for breakfast

Oysters and eggs, on a Benedict dish with creamy side of grits, is much, much better than  bacon and eggs

Plus it is served on toasted French bread instead of an English muffin

And you get a side salad of greens

Plus, the coffee is great

Even though the sign up front said the lunch buffet was $ 8.99, we were charged $ 12.99 and told the $ 8.99 was the weekday price.  Had we known that, there's no way we would have eaten there. They clearly displayed a price of $ 15.99 for Sunday because it included crab legs. There are no crab legs on Saturday and the lunch buffet is the same on Saturday as it is Monday through Friday, so why pay $ 4 more?  Also, drinks aren't included, so two of us eating cost $ 32.10.  There's no way I would ever pay that for lunch at a buffet.  The food definitely wasn't worth the price.

Finally made it to the namesake of my mother' s birthplace and my former home. Apparently the owners are from Romita, Guanajuato...regardless of where the owners come from, the food is great!! I went with a group of 4 other people and we shared food. We ordered tacos dorados ( chicken , asada, potato, and beans), gorditas ( beans and asada), tacos (asada) , and tortas ( adobada). The food was great, especially the tacos dorados, tacos, and gorditas. My favorite meat was the asada. They have a few salsa as part of their salsa bar..Also the staff was great. The woman who took our order was very nice. Although it's a bit pricey, it's worth it.

8/16/12 update : I had a chicken torta today and it was amazing! the pasilla chile in the torta is a great touch...I usually don't order tortas or burritos since i like trying different meats ( i usually get a few tacos) but my friend told me i had to try the chicken torta...great recommendation!
Literally the best. Always. Never too salty, always flavorful, my fave takeout ever. Loveeee su xing!!!

My wife and I stopped for dessert on our way home from a cornhole tourney. Jessica was great! It did not hurt that we were the only two patrons in the restaurant. As always the pie is awesome! I had the cherry and my wife had the chocolate/peanut butter. Most Village Inns are pretty good with food and service. Keep up the good work!

YAY!!!! So happy they finally moved into an actual restaurant! GREAT food... everything  on the menu is great! Only negative comments are the fact that I went in one day really wanting a slice of margarita pizza, only to find that this isn't possible. I was then left with the choices of a single slice of cheese or pepperoni or a pizza bigger than me.

A great restoration to, what it looks like, an auto garage.  The menus gives you plenty of options.  Many complain on price; however, we don't see an ocean nearby so it's reasonable.  Try the fish and chips as it was plentiful for its price.  

The fries are great and the ceviche was good.  The lobster mac and cheese is okay but preferred the fish and chips.

I loveeee this place. We usually order to go since the place is small but we ate there couple of times too. The portions are big and very tasty. The owner, Frank is one of the nicest people I've ever met. He always gives us extras or free smoothies and drinks. Speaking of smoothies, absolutely delicious. He uses all fresh ingredients with honey and green tea, the result is an amazing smoothie.  You have to try this place.

GO HERE! It was so delicious, the atmosphere was great as well (although it felt like there was no AC for most of the night). We've dined at their two sister establishments, Vedge and WizKid (which is right next door) as well. For drinks we started with the house ginger beer (not sweet enough) and the Oaxocan Sunrise which was delicious.  We had the corn and avocado salad, which was pretty good but gets rated down because we had to add so much of their house hotsauce for it to be better. Next were the Kung Pao Cucumbers, which were more peanut saucy- less Kung Pao-y, still excellent, just not expected. Next we shared Tofu Bahm Mi Tacos. Next were the mie Goreng noodles, yummy but definitely WAY on the spicy side. I can handle my spice way better than most, but these were hella hot. Go for it if that's your thing. This were the biggest disappointment and I definitely wouldn't get them again. The tofu tasted over marinated and should have been baked or fried. It had a green chile goddess dressing, which was confusing but tasty. I didn't taste the green chile at all (the food of my home town). Lastly for dinner we had the mushroom shawarma, this was delicious and our favorite. We finished with dessert: Halo Halo. It was yummy, and I loved the adzuki beans in place of the traditional ones.  I also got the Amari Amore, which was either a super dangerous drink because I couldn't taste the liquor, or they forgot. Good either way.

Was here for brunch on a Saturday.  Staff was super nice and did a great job. Street parking, though somewhat limited. 

This was day one of the brunch menu. Note the options are limited to what's on the menu. There were no deviled eggs and no desserts offered.  

The drinks were plentiful and the guests that partaked enjoyed them immensely.  

On to the food, in my order of favorites, all was delicious. 

Chicken Fried Brussels Sprouts.  Definitely a winner and must order. Everyone enjoyed.  A unique take with the fried chicken breading. It was delicious and each could've easily eaten a full order. 

Brunch burger. Wow!  I love burgers and this was a great one.  The flavors were amazing. Perfect burger flavor.  The one request would be to put the ketchup on the side.  

Crispy Breakfast Potatoes.  Some of the best. Super crispy but not hard and burnt!  Inside was tender and tasty. Lots of flavor. 

Maple Bacon CinnaRoll.  Not too sweet, not dry. Definitely one of the best rolls.  More sauce next time would make it even better!

Blue crab and bacon dip.  Lots of crab. Tasty. Requested not bread though, it was a huge serving!

Mac and cheese. I'm not a huge Mac and cheese person but it was definitely good. 

Original CinnaRoll. It was good but the Maple Bacon was even better.  We got this one and either I ordered wrong or they heard it wrong. Regardless they made it right, gave us the Maple Bacon one, and we got to try both!!!

A great restaurant all around. Every dish was delicious. Highly recommend!!!  I can't wait to return!

This place, located on Manchester, has such great food and I had never been here on a Sunday morning... until recently! I had not expected to have such a long wait to order food (line was going out the door!)- while it was easy to get frustrated with the wait, I think this just speaks more to how great the restaurant is. The line moves fast and once the food is ordered, it comes relatively fast.  There is ample seating but if you are a big group, it may be a little challenging. The food itself is amazing and ample for the price we pay. I got the typical chicken and waffles dish with a side of mac and cheese-all of which was so delicious! I finished the mac and cheese within seconds.  I've been before and have loved the food every time.  The price is very reasonable and this is great for all size groups and very family friendly.

Yes I'm giving it 5. The owner really does quality work and ingredients. Which is always welcomed to see organic being included more and wish other places would follow suit.  

Had an affogato with almond gelato and it was great. Just quality all around. Great strong espresso with out bitterness. The gelato is definitely tops and the flavors are very prominent. Like he doesn't hold back in ingredients in making them. Tried a lot of the gelato and honestly all good. I'm a big fan of Angelo brocato but I think I might have found my replacement due to the use of quality organic ingredients. Had the blueberry gelato for dessert and it was soooo good! 

Had a piadina which is an Italian quesadilla and it was good. I think I would have rather the breakfast one on a crepe instead though. 

Will definitely be back and will work my way through the menu. Awesome quality place and very cozy modern!

As a true New Yorker, me and my fiancé love for Halal food is pretty high. We also have pretty high standards for halal food, since it definitely a go to drunk ppl food in NYC. Since we are trying to minimize our meat intake, this vegan halal truck caught our interest. The gyro box was sold out but we went with the gyro and fries and it was Amazing!! Also the lemonade was definitely made with love. The white sauce was flavorful and the gyro meat was well seasoned. We are going back to try to the box. I would definitely give this truck a try if you ever catch him usually outside of vegan international. Also the owner was pretty friendly and polite.

Some of the best sushi in all St. Pete! I normally always get the Tampa Roll, Mexican Roll, and my new favorite is the Volcano Roll. The Volcano Roll has the most flavor I have ever experienced with sushi and it is topped with crab. I also recommend the Sexy Man. That is the second most flavorful and is topped with eel sauce. Also go on Tuesday nights, they have a 50% off a bunch of sushi rolls. Service could be better though, it seams like you have to ask for the check when you are done because it seems like they will never bring it.
Food was great. Somewhat pricey but worth it. Small menu. Didn't really like the open layout and bright lights but staff was nice and food was spot on. Would recommend for sure.

Saw this place on TikTok and wanted to try it. 

Came on Labor Day and the parking lot was empty at 12:15... but we tried it anyways, everything was very fresh and our server was very helpful and polite. 

We tried the tuna appetizer, potsticker sampler, 2 rolls, and chicken fried rice. There was 3 of us and we had plenty of food.

Enjoyed Azteca on a Thursday night with friends. I didn't catch happy hour, but that's ok. We ordered delicious guacamole that was made table side with fresh avacado. The bartenders were kinda slow, but still got the orders correct. Thursday night is also karaoke night!

What a great find!  Groceries, supplements, prepared foods, and not a mega chain! This became our go to store during a recent visit. They had everything we need and it's the kind of place that creates good cheer in addition to good service. We will be back!

Wicked expensive - but the food makes you not have a problem with paying the cost. They have reasonable prices until you realize that you need three to four items per person to make the meal. Given the quality, it's hard to complain. Just.... bring your bonus and ENJOY!

This Brew Haha location is getting killed by the Starbucks across the street. I walk by the two on my way to work, and I cannot remember a single morning that Brew Haha had more patrons than Starbucks.

The problem is that Brew Haha is slightly more expensive than Starbucks, but the quality of coffee is just about the same. Brew Haha's lack of a rewards/loyalty program is really the thing that sets it back. Starbucks has a nationwide following and a decent program by which its customers get free/discounted things. Brew Haha has nothing of the sort. 

Wilmington is a city full of transients, so of course people choose the tried and true Starbucks, where they spend slightly less and rack up a couple stars towards their next free beverage. It's no longer good enough for Brew Haha to just be a "local business." Sure, they will still get the hipsters and the Delaware-for-life population, but Starbucks will continue to get the rest. 

Brew Haha must change or Starbucks will run it out of Wilmington. There is a new Starbucks opening up on Market Street, and I predict that it will cannabolize the profit of the Market Street Brew Haha in the same fashion as the Delaware Avenue location. 


P.S., I realize it might not be in the budget because of what I have described above, but Brew Haha needs to get some damn air conditioning.

Loved the food.We got the fluffy peanut butter and chocolate  pancake and some grits. Everything ordered was delicious and cooked to perfection.The grits were amazingly creamy and the pancakes were perfectly airy with each bite. So if you are near by it is definitely worth a visit

An experience has to be pretty bad for me to give one stars, but honestly I would give zero to Ella's if yelp allowed. We had heard good things and were eager to add a new restaurant to our roster. My family are Tampa natives who eat out regularly - my parents have regular restaurants they frequent all over town and have never had a single problem with one. I live in NYC now and am used to brusque service during busy hours - it can be part of the charm. But we had an absolutely horrible experience at Ella's with the hostesses and manager. The only waiter we interacted with was very nice so clearly all the service isn't bad. But I have never been treated so poorly by management at a restaurant that I left holding back tears after watching the management treating my family disrespectfully over a simple miscommunication (on the part of the hostesses) by the rude manager. The food may be great (we didn't stick around to find out), and I love supporting Seminole Heights businesses, but I will never bring my business back. At least not until they hire a new manager. Perhaps we caught him on a bad day, but it seems a bizarre career choice with someone with no people skills to speak of. We left and went down the street to the Refinery, where food and service are always both impeccable.

Wildly unsafe as far as covid goes. Non of the bartenders wearing masks. Packed room with no social distance. One out of three servers wearing masks. Mangers with maske around their chins. Just ridiculous lack of safety.

Awsome... as a very picky Venezuelan eater I can tell you this is real, traditional and delicious Venezuelan food.  Good representation of our cuisine.  Brought a  diverse group of friends (different nationalities) and they all love the arepas, patacones,  cachapas and tequeños.  Cheese was fresh, fillings are delicious ... A+++ :-)
I have already submitted this info via the Cracker Barrel web site.

Is it strange that this was our best overall dining experience in the city? We read about this place on Yelp. Great oysters, etc. etc. We walked over, and saw neon signs inside, heard loud music on the sound system, and figured it must be a tourist trap, some kind of South Coast Hard Rock Cafe. When our alternative turned out to be closed, we went back. Boy was that a good move.

The oysters here are just incredible. I know oysters are oysters, but here they're briny-fresh from a local farm, shucked perfectly, and come with a spicy/tangy cocktail sauce that I wanted to eat by itself after the oysters were long gone. Toss in a light, crispy catfish sandwich, friendly, knowledgeable service, and I'm permanently sold.

It was simple fare, but it was done so, so well, and it didn't cost a whole lot neither.

My husband and I came here while on a visit to Nashville. Someone recommended we go here.  It was late, my musician husband just finished performing, and we were hungry.  The wait to be seated was going to be 45 minutes, so we decided to order takeout and my husband ordered a martini while we waited for our order.  When the hostess charged my husband's card, I noticed the amount seemed awfully high. I asked to see the breakdown of the charges, whereupon we noticed we were charged 20% on the entire bill for a tip.  I asked the hostess about this and she nastily replied that all orders are automatically charged 20% tip and it says so on the menu.  Well, it's incredibly dim where where we stood near the hostess stand, and we had to squint to see the menu, so no, we didn't see this written policy on the menu. When I pointed out that this was a takeout order, she rudely snapped back that it didn't matter and tried to shame me by nastily asking, don't you tip for service?? Yeah, actually I do, and generously, too, and contrary to the assumption the hostess made, I have worked many, many years in the service industry so yeah, Miss Attitude, I do know all about the importance of good tipping, but I don't tip 20% on takeout when I am not receiving any table service, and I certainly don't when I am treated so incredibly rudely!  Our whole time in Nashville, my husband and I met the nicest people and had stellar service at the places we went to, but not this place. In fact, it left such a bad taste in my mouths that I feel the need to warn others. This place SUCKS!!!!

First time dining here on a fine Saturday afternoon. I'm quite impress with their fried shu mai and soup dumplings. First bite in the fried shu mai, my first reaction was wow. So many flavors and haven't taste anything like this. It was bomb. Soup dumplings was really good too. I wish there was more broth in it but other than that it was very yummy. 
We also ordered house stir fry noodles and the beef soup. The house stir fry noodle was pretty good. Didn't stand out much but one of the items I would order again. As far as the beef soup, flavor was okay. Only down side was the beef. It was a little too dry for my liking. 
Overall, my first experience was good. Customer service was good. I would definitely come back for the fried shu mai and soup dumplings! They were my fav! Yum!
It's a Sonic. What can you say? I pulled in, ordered a cherry limeade and got a cherry limeade. Service was fast and it was happy hour so I got a large for a little over a dollar. Win.

Q: Why did the tortilla chips start dancing?
A: Because they put on the salsa! 

The only thing mentioning in this review is the salsa! They hand make it in front of you and create the spiciness as ordered by the customer! Everything else is so-so. 

5 stars for the salsa!
3 stars for the food.

Yeah, this place is pretty awesome. My go-to pizza spot in Nashville.

I got a slice of pizza. On the menu, it lists 3 basic by-the-slice pizzas, but you can ask about others that aren't on the menu. I got one that had bacon on it & some other stuff (but I mean come on, bacon is the most important part anyways)-- but it was so good. The 'special' slices are about a dollar more, but it's worth it. My husband had the Zeus stromboli-- and oh my was it amazing! It was just overflowing with toppings and cheese & the dough was perfect. & their sweet tea is also good here.

Love this place. Friendly service, awesome food & decent prices. Lunch specials under $10. Just be warned- it gets packed!

my son, my mom and myself went here last night before seeing Blue Man Group. This was a gift to my mother from the two of us. We picked this place because of its location right across the street from the theater. It was really crappy weather, and didnt want to have to bounce all around town, so i consulted yelp and this is what i found. 
it starts with the reservation. the gentleman who answered could not have been any nicer. i tried to make it for 5, but he suggested we do 430, so not to rush thru our meal to get to the show. he was right. we made it to the show with a few minutes to spare. the same gentleman greeted us when we arrived. so sweet. 
my son hates "fancy" places. to him, this was waaaayyyy over the top. but he's 18 and prefers tgi fridays or some kinda chain. whats he know? 
the decor was kinda cool. the octopus legs coming out of the ceiling was a lil strange. but the running water wall treatments were soothing and neat. now the service. i love when a server can rattle of the features of the day with out stuttering or having to read it. im impressed by that. she was friendly, but not overbearing. only came to our table when we needed her. the food was great. we had some aps, i had the lobster rav. and i think the sauce was actually better then the rav. if thats possible. my mom had scallops and fresh veggies and the boy had some type of crab w pasta. they modified the sauce for him. giving him just a garlic and oil because again, he doesnt like fancy. 
everything was great. since we all stuffed our fat faces, i was the only one who got dessert. i HAVE to when im out. no matter how full i am. i need sugar to end it. so, grand manier creme brulee it was. tasty lil mofo. 
all in all, we were all impressed, fed well, and felt comfortable. broad street is never a place i ever think to hang. but im looking forward to checking this place on a fri or sat night when they have live music. for cocktails and a nosh!

A friend know how much I love my Bun Bo Hue that when she stubble in a restaurant all the way in Kenner, she knew I would drive there just to try them out and yelp my experience. So here it goes... I ordered two togo Bun Bo Hue since I was passing thru from shopping. Hands down my newest favorite place for Bun Bo Hue in NOLA. The broth was perfect. It has the taste of lemongrass that I like and enjoy from a bowl of Bun Bo Hue. For proteins, you get sliced brisket, thin slice of pork and blood cubes. They didn't have pig feet which I really don't care for it anyway. I do have a problem with their choice of veggie and herbs. A typical BBH would have cabbage, cilantro, onions, banana leaves and mint. What we got was chopped Roman lettuce, onions, bean sprout and some limes.  We did not even got any hot sauce or shrimp paste Togo in our takeout. Lucky enough I'm Asian and we always have those on hand..lol I might have to order again  the next time and buy some cabbage to add to  my BBH. To me cabbage is a must in a bowl of BBH.

For a place right in tourist central, Merchants is solid. Good food, nice service, and hip atmosphere. Note to future self: do not order the tater tots alone! They're massive!

Lots of great people watching if you can snag a table by the windows!
I love the torta here. The one with the friend jalapeno.  I think it can get pricey if you go very often but the food is good.  It taste fresh

Cute little bakery in downtown Franklin.  I have never eaten their lunch or dinner here, just some bakery items.  Everything that I have ever had from here is amazing.  The cookies, pastries, pies, and breads all taste wonderful.  There is a pretty big variety of sweets here to choose from, and the service is always friendly and fast.  I would love to come her for lunch in the future.  I am sure that it will compare.
Food was decent. overall environment is very unsanitary and NOBODY has a mask on. Lady was coughing and making food. Man was digging in his ear. Not a hairnet in sight. Would not recommend this one.

While out walking the day before, we noticed a sign in front of Edley's that said it was open Saturdays for breakfast. So, the next day being Saturday, we tried it.

We arrived just as it opened. The ambiance wasn't quite cranked up, as you'd imagine. There's a bit of a strange methodology here. You get seated, but you order at the counter and pay, and they bring it out to you. It's a bit awkward, especially at the end when it's time to tip.

In any case, the breakfast menu is a brief but interesting. I had the Nashville Nasty, which is a biscuit with some chicken tenders and sausage gravy. My wife has the biscuit with beef brisket, egg, pimento cheese and their red and white sauce.

The sausage gravy is really good, the chicken is tasty and biscuits are the kind that are crunchy (gravy negates that quickly). My wife thoroughly enjoyed hers as well, though she thought the pimento cheese was too strong.  The brisket was excellent. We ordered a glass of OJ and a glass of milk, too. These are large glasses for just two dollars. We were both quite surprised at the amount you get. And it was good as well.

All in all, I think this is an excellent place for breakfast. The food is certainly worth the trip and is inexpensive, yet delicious.
I wish I could of got more pictures. (My phone died.) But the place was phenomenal. The atmosphere was the bees knees. We will be going back. ASAP
Amazing food! Amazing service. I will return. Thanks for the great customer service.  The food was amazing. This is a NO staple: if you don't visit then u didn't visit NO! Yummy

BK? Why are we going to Burger King? Yeah that was my first reaction when my friends said they wanted to get Mexican food at BK. Haha. This place is my favorite place for late night Mexican food. Everything on their menu is very cheap and authentic quality. Their jamaica is thirst quenching. And the environment is very family friendly. I prefer going to this BK location rather than their original location which is located in a dumpy park of the neighborhood.

Cons:
-Slow service. 
-No glove use by kitchen staff
-Meatball/Spaghetti: sauce too acidic, and way too much of it on plate
-Bread was just....ok

Pros: 
-attempted to amend for slow service by providing complimentary dessert
-cheesecake was very good
-friendly staff
-Clam linguini was quite good
Beers were good. Got a sampler (I'm all about variety). Bartenders were very friendly. Got busy late.
Good, fresh, fast. The roll it like a burrito and press it like a panini.. Mine was too dry.. Get extra tatziki

Always been a fan of Indian food and this is definitely one my favorites places to eat at in Reno! I ordered the Saag Paneer and Matar Paneer along with the garlic and aloo naan! Everything is very tasty and the portions are huge. Staff is friendly, caring, and they make sure you're well taken care of. The restaurant itself is cozy and quiet- highly recommend Royal India!

I happened to go here for dinner on the day that Joe Biden was announced as the winner of the 2020 election, so my boyfriend and I got to enjoy a view from the second story of the building as people played music and danced in the streets. The inside dining environment was romantic, dimly lit, and tables were spaced over 6 feet apart. The wait staff was attentive and friendly.
We split the cheese board appetizer and loved it! It comes with a card that lists descriptions of each cheese on the board so you know what you're eating. For our entrees, we ordered the Ricotta Ravioli and Pulled Brisket Fazzoletti -- both were fantastic! We finished out the meal with the brownie skillet.

Other notes:
- The building is wheelchair accessible. 
- The bathroom was very clean.
- Multiple staff were attentive to our table.
- There were multiple menu items that looked great, so we will definitely be going back to try something new!

My first time here was for Cinco de Mayo and man was it the perfect spot. The server was awesome he always checked on us and made sure we were taken care of. First we got a pitcher of regular margaritas and they were great. Then we had a pitcher of passion fruit and pomegranate margaritas and they were bomb. As for food I got the Chile queso and it was great cheesy, salty, meaty, richness served with some crispy tortilla chips. We ate pretty much the entire bowl so worth it. 

As for my meal we got a bunch of different offerings to try. I ordered the duck quesadilla ORANGE BRAISED DUCK CONFIT, JACK CHEESE, GOAT CHEESE AND PINEAPPLE - SERVED WITH HONEY CHIPOTLE VINAIGRETTE. Man oh man was this good the duck was tender, the goat cheese was rich, the honey chipotle vinaigrette perfectly complimented the dish. 

I also tried a some of the open face carb and shrimp quesadilla that has jalapeño crema and if you like spicy that is the way to go. The last thing I tried was the pulpo ceviche and it was refreshing. 

They have so many options I need to come back and try a few more.

You order at the counter and the food is brought to your table. This place was packed with a line out the door. It's one of the tastiest Mexican meals we've had in a long time. My wet steak burrito was filled with flavorful carne asada. Most places just pack their burritos with beans and rice but not this place. My daughter had enchiladas and she said that they were the "best ever!". It's definitely worth the wait. It's too far from the Hilton Santa Barbara Beach Resort, which is a plus.

We stopped here to have dinner after pur ghost tour. It's right off Bourbon St. So, we even enjoyed the walk on Bourbon street afterward. It was recommended to me by a friend.

The food was quite delicious. We had 1/2 dozen oysters, blackened chicken, and blackened bayou duck. The oysters were fresh and yummy. My boyfriend said his chicken was delicious!! And my duck was fantastic. It's a different style of cooking duck than I'm used to, but the duck was tender and full of flavor for the blackened spices.  Finished off with the chocolate Kalua mouse cake. It was good, but not much Kahlua flavor detected.  Also, my boyfriend got a double shot gin &tonic, and let me tell you, they are NOT short changing you. It was definitely a double! Yummy!

Most notably, I have to give kudos for their service. Not that we experienced any bad service here in NOLA, but the staff was just on top of it and so friendly. We were seated so quickly. Our server, Jordan P, took such good care of us. She was so friendly and made great food recommendations!  The manager, hostess, etc- everyone welcomed us and made sure we were having a good time, without being disruptive.   

We definitely recommend stopping in here!!

Excellent food!! Attended a shower and they were very accommodating for a vegan meal . Food was delicious. I returned a few weeks later and was not disappointed!! My new favorite place.. and I am from Wilmington.

(NOTE: after I wrote this I got a message from the owner telling me they were using disposables due to COVID and were returning to real dishes next week).  I am not a bacon and eggs fan, but a friend picked this place so I was glad to go with her. I had scrambled eggs and toast which was good and my friend loved her food. My problem is they use non-recyclable plastic plates, cups and utensils for dine-in meals and styrofoam for their to-go. It is a very popular place so imagine how much landfill, non-eco friendly trash they are generating daily.  I will not go there again. There are too many other local places that have good breakfasts that care about the environment.
I love this place. Though I miss the dining room, the Pizza still has same great taste. I think its one of the best in the area.

I have had a long and passionate relationship with Govinda's.  I've been going there for many years, and I feel blessed after each and every meal.  I've heard that the cooks chant over the food as they prepare it, and that's what makes it special.  I make at least two trips to the buffet on each and every visit.  The fare is simple, healthful and tasty.  The presentation is buffet style.  The experience is stellar, with an aviary, koi pond, patio, fountain, etc.  I ate brunch there today, and still feel full and well-nourished after midnight.  It's a little odd when an old Indian lady pulls a chair from your table, drags it to the corner, and proceeds to mediate while you're chatting with your companions.  But it's all part of the Govinda's experience.  As is the shopping, whether for prayer flags, Buddha statues, posters of Krishna, incense, or tie-dyed clothing.  Exit through the gift shop!

Traveled into Ewing to stop for the night from Maine to Virginia. Not knowing the area, tried to locate a place to eat close by.  We also were traveling with my son and his family- 2 small children- who had been in the car for 10+ hours.  Lo and behold- we found Marsilios. My husband called and asked about availability and outside seating.  When we arrived, there was some discussion about our reservation (information was not relayed), but after a brief conversation, we were assured that a table outside would be offered, and we were handled graciously, seated quickly and immediately attended to professionally.  The order was taken and OMG was the food fantastic!  Every order was delicious and pleasing to the eye-- the kids scarfed down their Ravioli Alfredo and pronounced it the best food they had had all week.  The adults ordered a range of items and all of them were super good--best Italian I have ever eaten.  Service was prompt and friendly--and I wish I lived closer so I could become a regular at this restaurant.  If you find yourselves close by- do yourself a favor and eat at Marsilio's.

Tried the hot chocolate, a few cookies, and the sweet corn muffin. The hot chocolate was interesting, they make it with ganache. It was frothy...but I prefer my hot chocolate thick. The cookies were not so good, way too dry. The corn muffin was pretty good.

The definition of insanity is repeating the same behavior and expecting different results.  I want to like this place because they are so close but man.  We tried it again for lunch because my wife had a birthday offer from them.  We walked in around 2 pm on a weekday and no one greeted us until I found someone.  The server was good and very accommodating.  I was stunned by the menu prices whoo.  I would say no less than $17 per head for lunch and that's just getting started.  I ordered a chicken Philly and ended up with a steak and I don't eat steak.  The server did say to me that I ordered the steak not the chicken!  Sure I did.  Anyway about 20 minutes later,  the chicken Philly was delivered and had what looked like a  black remnants of burned grill grease.  It was horrible.  I did not send it back but left quietly.  

I'm done.  You shouldn't have to take out a line of credit on your house to eat a below average subpar meal.

Nice sports bar but smoking is still allowed in here. If you're not a smoker you might be put off by the smell.  


The beer is good.
My favorite pizza, now. It is outstanding. Great blend of  favors. Crispy crust and great cheese blend.

Uhm, 2 stars for the food. The pork bulgogi was like carnitas style meat which was weird af, definitely not traditional in Korea. It also didn't have like any flavor. I also got the seafood tofu soup which was tasty, but I'm not sure if it's they use chili oil cos literally a layer of oil just sitting on the top. The banchan was alright... the kimchi way way too sour usually means it's old. Prices are pretty pricey for not great food.

This spot is definitely one of my favorite ones. The food variety is amazing and very delicious. The owner always comes around to make sure we have all what we want.  The staff are super friendly and make me and my family feel very welcome all the time. I definitely recommend Los Agaves restaurant. They are Pura Vida!
This is one of the places I have to go to for breakfast when I'm in Santa Barbara. The view is spectacular, the food is delicious, and the services is as always great.

Great beer, of course, and everything else was surprisingly well put together, fresh, and tasty. 

Sausage, kraut and red potatoes were memorable. Felt like I was in some exceptional restaurant on the Rhineland. Wife's ribs were also good; And even my older daughter's grilled cheese sandwich was special (who woulda thunk it?) 

Desserts were excellent too - not too sweet and with good ingredients, which is amazing for St. Louis.

After a long wait and to incredible fan-fare in many cities, Poke Burri has finally come to Tampa! Poke Burri has locations in Atlanta, Raleigh, Houston, and is coming soon to Charleston, Jacksonville, Denver, and Philadelphia. Tampa's Poke Burri is located off West Kennedy Boulevard & North Hale Avenue, 2 blocks from Lois Avenue, in a Plaza next to Chicken Salad Chick, & Take Three Cafe in South Tampa.

Poke Burri serves ginger miso salad, crab salad, Spicy Tuna nachos, Pork dumplings, spring rolls, sushi donuts, 5 types of poke bowls, 6 types of Burrito sushi rolls. For a limited time, Poke Burri is serving sushi corn-dogs, and 2 types of sushi pizza. 

The Sushi Pizza came with Salmon, Marinated Ahi Tuna, cucumbers, edamame, eel sauce, Spicy mayo, & masago. 10/10 

The Spicy Tuna Sushi Donut came with spicy Tuna, eel sauce, Spicy mayo, and tempura flakes and unfortunately was stacked on way too much rice. Half the rice would have been sufficient. 7/10 

The Sushi Corn-dog came with crab salad, sushi rice, rolled in panko & deep fried, topped with eel sauce, Spicy mayo, Wasabi, & furikake. the sushi corn dog had a little too much rice, although way less than the sushi donut. 8/10   

Poke Burri has released limited-time offerings of some unique instagram worthy, buzz worthy, photo worthy, dishes but they can be hit or miss. If you want to be sure to get something great, get the poke bowl or the sushi pizza! 

The Indoor dining area is pretty minimalist and  consists of just 5 small high-top tables adorned with adorable small bowls of succulent plants but with no booth seating options which gives the place more of a casual earthy atmosphere.  There are 2 tables on the patio for those seeking some fresh air. Take-out & delivery is available as well. 

Poke Burri's Off-Menu, Past Seasonal items include Baby Sushi Donuts, Sushi Sandwiches, Tokyo Fries, Baby Sushi Burritos, Poke Shooters, Matcha Baby Beignets, Crab Croquettes, Kimchi Ariancini, Match & Ube Ice Cream Sammies,  Poke Puris, Fried Ramon Carbonara, Jalapeño Arancini, Poke Pineapple, & Fried Oysters! I look forward to seeing what the next crazy instagram-able food they can come up and trying more off their menu soon!

We went for a dinner on Friday night at Al-Sham Palace. We were confused whether to have food inside the restaurant or to take-out. But seeing that all the Covid19 guidelines were being followed we decided to have food in the restaurant. For dinner we ordered Eggs with Vegetables, Shish Tawook and Shish Kebab. The service was pretty quick. First we got the salad which comes with the entree. The whole order came in around 5 minutes. The food was amazing. Best part was Shish Tawook. But there is one suggestion. With Shish Kebab i ordered lamb and i believe lamb can be cooked more as it was hard to chew. Rest everything was amazing. Loved the dinner.

Visited on Friday, 3/25. 
Basic (At least that was my impression after eating brunch here)

I was with my mom and grandmother (they had dined here before for breakfast and liked it) and wanted to try this place out for brunch. We were seated immediately and given menus. They cover the basics for breakfast and the typical salads and sandwiches for lunch. They only have one soup which changes daily so you have to ask what they're serving. Luckily on Friday they had Italian sausage and tortellini soup. I ordered a cup of that and half of a corned beef sandwich. My mom ordered a grilled cheese sandwich and my grandmother, a greek salad. 

Our wait time was normal. When we got our food it looked good and the portions were big. My soup was good and it tasted homemade (I was wishing I had ordered a bowl). My half-sandwich was just meat on dry, toasted bread. I asked for cheese on it and I figured they would MELT the cheese but no, they just slapped a sad, cold piece of provolone on it. There was nothing on the bread as far as a condiment either which I thought was weird. I took two bites of it and brought it home for my dogs who would appreciate it. My mom's grilled cheese looked like they literally put two slices of Kraft American cheese on the bread and called it a day. She said she liked it though so okay....My grandmother's greek salad was huge and piled high with lettuce, spinach, onions, and feta. She was happy with it and I would say overall, it was an okay experience. Service was not that great but of course that can be a win or lose situation. I would give this place another go.
Hidden gem!  Great food and service is fantastic!  Gnocchi is amazing.....and can't underrate BYOB.  Highly recommend and unlikely to disappoint.

I really love this restaurant because the food are so tasty! Especially i love the spicy curry powder chicken. The overload ribs tastes amazing as well. I really love this restaurant!! It's clean, and the waitresses are nice. Highly recommend!!!

This spot makes authentic Mexican tacos! Amazing food! Their lobster tacos are so tasteful! I like everything except for the way we were treated one time by a staff member!  Overall I would recommend this place!!
Try this place out!

A buddy and I were in Reno for a "Mancation" this weekend. We stayed at the Sienna (Great hotel) and after checking out Sunday morning we asked the valet were we could get a really good breakfast. He offered up Pegs. We ended up getting there about 11'ish and the place was packed. We took the last two spots at the counter and were greeted by tons of happy faces and very happy/helpful people!

The wait staff was wonderful. Very knowledgeable and couldn't do enough for us. After looking over the menu we both decided on the chicken Fried Steak and Eggs. One of the waitresses overheard us and said that we should get it "her way".  We asked what that was and she told us that they put grilled onions, diced tomatoes and some extra seasoning on top of it. That sounded perfect so we both took the leap.

AMAZING! It added the perfect  amount of flavor and variety to a dish that I have had hundreds of times in life. Again....AMAZING!

The crowd was very diverse and happy.The kitchen was right there so you could see what was going on and it provided and nice little show to watch while you waited. Food was served surprisingly quick considering the quality and quantity.

This WILL be the place I for for breakfast when I am in Reno from now on!!

I tend to order from Pinocchio's a lot when I'm staying at my bf's apartment in Media for the sole reason that it's pretty much the only place open after 9:30 on a weekend night in the whole town (with the exception of Iron Hill, which I think serves food until 11?). Their pizza is just not good. The crust is too thin and if you get any toppings on the pizza, it immediately   falls apart from the weight of it. I've tried the everything, BBQ chicken, plain cheese, and margherita pizzas (beware this one has pizza sauce on it, not fresh tomatoes). None of them have ever given me reason to try them again.  Which is kind of weird for a pizza place. Their cheesesteaks are decent, as are the wings and coconut shirmp, but for as large as their menu is, there are very few things that I would order again after trying them. I've heard the beer garden is cool and stocked with a large selection of beer, but for food, I wouldn't recommend coming here before 10 PM and sober.

Came here again while in town visiting. This time I ordered the chile verde breakfast burrito. Apparently this is the recommended breakfast item that they're known for. It came packed full of meat that was busting with flavor! Once again the abuela in la cocina didn't disappoint.

Yo te amo La Carreta!
Expected something spectacular after the reviews of hot chicken. Had princess and it was just ok.

Was not a fan of their cheesesteak. Their wiz sauce was mustard based and it was not terrible as a sandwich itself but mustard is not the flavor one expects or wants in a cheesesteak. It was overwhelming and not good.

My friend and I made last minute plans to go to Cuba Libre for happy hour on a weeknight. Honestly, I wasn't planning to make a full meal out of our happy hour outing, but that completely changed after glancing around at the dishes our neighbors at the bar were getting. Everything looked so delicious!

First off, you are required to sit at the bar if you plan to order off of their happy hour menu. Ideally, we would have loved to sit at a table, but the bar ended up being just fine. The bartender was nice and friendly, although the service was pretty slow (more on that later).

We first started off with a glass of red sangria which might have been some of the best sangria I've ever had. It was very fruity and sweet but definitely packed a punch. My original plan was to call it a night after just one drink, but it was so good that I ended up getting a second. My friend got a white sangria for her second round and said the red was far better than the white.

As for food, we indulged in a variety of different small plates including Shrimp Cóctel, Pineapple Guacamole Cubano, a Churrasco Slider, Chicken Croquetas, and a few empanadas. All were really great but my personal favorites were the empanadas and the guacamole! The pulled pork empanada that I had was extremely flavorful, fried to perfection, and served with some kind of dipping sauce that I loved. It was quite filling as well! The guacamole was fresh and had chunks of pineapple which offered a sweet taste to this normally savory dish. They were served with plantain chips which I really enjoyed. The plantain chips weren't nearly as crisp as a tortilla chip would be, but I really liked them nonetheless. The presentation was also superb. 

The small plates are only $5 during happy hour which is an awesome deal. If you want to try a bunch of different things, I would encourage you to get the sampler. The sampler allows you to choose any seven small plates for just $31. That's what we did and it was a really good decision. I left completely stuffed and I was able to make this my dinner for the night!

As for the service, although it started off well, it was on a downward slope as the night went on. As happy hour came to a close, the bartenders became less attentive and we had to flag someone down numerous times for water refills and our check. Our corner of the bar was filled with dirty plates and our first round of empty drinks.

Still, I was very content with my overall happy hour experience. In fact, my friend and I have already talked about returning! The specials were great, the food and drinks were solid, and the prices were very reasonable. Hopefully everything stays up to par next time and maybe there will even be some improvement in service!

Three quick tips:

1) Food is very tasty and plentiful :)

2)  Food is, perhaps correspondingly, overpriced.

3)  Almost a cafeteria ambience.
Wow!! Eight people in our group, and everyone had a great lunch. I may have to come back tomorrow. For non beer drinkers, the blackberry cider is great!

This is one of the most reliable restaurants I have been to in the greater Boise area. I am a huge fan of Asian-Fusion style food, and this place is one of my favorites. Happy hour specials are terrific (try the calamari and the lettuce wraps!) for both food and drink.

Let me start by saying that this place is about two steps above PF Chang's in terms of quality. While the price and variety is comparable (maybe slightly more variety and marginally less expensive), the real motivation to return comes from the food itself. 

Here's what I have had great success with, and would highly recommend to anybody visiting (especially if you like spicy food):

1. Calamari appetizer -This stuff is the bomb.com. It comes with a creamy/spicy sauce and some lemon wedges on a bed of cabbage slaw. Boom-shaka-laka. It's terrific.

2. Lettuce Wraps - These are probably the best lettuce wraps I have ever had.

3. Blackened Chicken and Pork - This is a dish I ask for extra spicy. Like extra extra spicy. I think they put something like 6 thai chiles (chopped) in my dish. It comes out of the kitchen on a sizzling cast iron skillet, and it was so spicy that half the restaurant and the entire kitchen were choking on the fumes. I feel bad that it was such a spicy cloud of steam, but at the same time, I am not sorry because it was so delicious. It was so hot that i was tearing up. It's hard to get food that's spicy enough to do that to me, so I am always very appreciative when I find some. The flavor is spot on, too. The broccoli is tender, the other veggies are perfectly cooked, and the chicken and pork are very flavorful.

4. Seafood Hot Pot - This is another one that is nice and spicy. It comes with a great variety of seafood (mussels, scallops, shrimp, salmon) in a creamy curry soup. I recommend the brown rice with it. It's a little pricey but well worth it.

You should eat here. You will not be disappointed*.


*I can't guarantee that, but if my experiences are anything, you're going to be very satisfied.

My husband has been dying to go to this place but I was a bit skeptical. From the outside it looks fine but I just kept thinking it might be some kind of greasy diner spot. However I was totally wrong and I'm glad he convinced me to try it!

The inside space is not super large but they do have plenty of seating in two separate areas which make it feel nice and open. When you walk in a hostess immediately greets you and helps you find a socially distanced spot. I was impressed with their friendliness and the quickness with which they served us despite being somewhat busy.

We were waiting for friends and had arrived quite early so decided to order an appetizer. Simply because I like to do things a bit different and go for vegan if possible I ordered the loaded tater tot's but with items from the menu that don't normally come with it. I was impressed and surprised by their willingness to make this special order for me. Plus when it came out it was absolutely delicious! I had them put sun-dried tomatoes and some aïoli on top of the tater tot's and I can highly recommend. The tots themselves were not greasy but cooked to perfection and just the right amount of crunch.

Once our friends arrived everyone quickly ordered hamburgers and my husband got a veggie burger. The number of options for toppings for your burger is quite impressive for such a small place. They also have a variety of kinds of fries between waffle fries loaded fries thicker fries etc. so there's plenty of choices. As soon as the burgers arrived the table got quiet because the food was so good that no one wanted to let it get cold! 

We were impressed with the taste of the burgers the quality of the items and the friendliness of the staff. It was a simple spot inside but very clean and well-maintained and had a kind of fun casual atmosphere. We will definitely be going back to try other options!

Unfortunately I think this restaurant is falling victim to the labor shortage. Based on the reviews and history I was expecting so much more. The chicken that came out was lukewarm at best and was overall greasy. 

I was fortunate enough to get my food. The table next to me waited over an hour, and when their food came out it was so cold, they literally ate just a couple bites of it, called it uneditable and left it all before walking away. I have literally never seen anything like that at a restaurant before.

I recently went to the Omni Nashville for a bachelorette party and was really blown away.  For starters, brunch at Kitchen Notes is a must.  The servers are so friendly and the biscuits and grits are to die for.  We went to the spa, which was an absolute delight.  The quiet area is so peaceful, I could have stayed all day!  But what really put a cherry on top for me was the nursing room.  As a new mom, traveling can be really tough.  The nursing room was a quiet, comfortable space where I was able to pump in privacy.  All in all, I was very impressed by the hotel and its staff.

So disappointed with this restaurant.  The decor is really cute & we had an awesome waitress but the food was not good.  Ordered fried chicken which was undercooked.  Also noticed the customers at the table by us, return their chicken sandwiches for the same reason.   The shrimp in my pasta was overcooked, was like rubber.   For dessert, we got cheesecake with chocolate dipped strawberry topping.  I hate to even say this but it was the worst cheesecake I have ever had.  The topping was a chocolate sauce with mushy pieces of strawberry...not what I expected.  Also, the collard greens were not rinsed well, every bite had crunchy dirt/sand.   I make collard greens at home, you have to wash them really well.  Idk what happened maybe it was just a bad day but I won't be returning after that experience.  Only thing I loved was the cornbread, my Bellini & the bacon app.  Such a shame...the restaurant has a lot of potential but they really dropped the ball with their kitchen staff/chef.   Was excited that they make everything from scratch & buy from local farms.  I hope they improve.
Service too slow! I will never come back! Was not happy... It was a poor experience for someone from out of town
Had shrimp po boy and fried crawfish appetizer. My husband had the beef po boy and really liked it. The service was friendly and fast.

I dined here for a 2nd and 3rd time on a Wednesday and Sunday night.  
Best. Food. Ever.
Last week I tried the barbeque shrimp, the Caesar salad, the drum, fried chicken and duck entrees, and the crème brulet trio, the molten (or something like that) cake, and the key lime bread pudding.
I honestly cannot say that I've ever had better food.  You could die happy after a meal here.

*Also, at each NOLA experience, the servers have been not only perfectly attentive, but their personalities have left us talking about them long after the meal.
Nashville hot tots are delicious, and all three of the burgers I've tried have been very tasty as well. Definitely will be coming back.
Excellent food, great service. Can't wait to come back again. Drinks were also great and balanced.

Having been to Shake Shack in California, I was really excited for them to come to Indy. I love their fries! But unfortunately, both times I've visited, everything I've ordered has been cold.... except for the milkshake?! Twice, I received cold fries, a runny, not super cold milkshake, and a lukewarm shroom burger (and I wish they just had a veggie burger or a black bean burger!). I'm giving this 3 stars because I want to believe  Maybe Shake Shack just isn't all that, though?

came in around 9, the place was less busy than I was expecting but exactly what I was looking for. got the caprese sandwich and the strawberry-Gorgonzola side salad, both of which were incredibly flavorful and delicious. super fast service as well.

WOW! Where do I begin...Now I haven't looked through all of my reviews but I don't know if I have ever given a 1 star review until now. I tried to give myself an opportunity to be away from the situation,as to try and be as objective as possible...but I'm still pissed. Trust me I'm not the one to call people out on being discriminatory but I have got to call a spade a spade. Now please take a look at my history before you just write me off, I have never made this accusation before and I take it very seriously. 
I initially wrote it off as being just lazy, maybe a little disinterested in doing their job. Mandy and Katie couldn't even muster a hello or welcome when we first walked in and had to be called over to our side of the bar to even THINK about wondering what we were there for. Now let me say this again, We were there at least 5(I know 5 minutes doesn't sound like that much but there were only 9 other people in the entire place and they walked back and forth in front of us at least 10 times tending to their needs) minutes after we sat ourselves at the bar before we had to personally request an audience. We ordered drinks and asked for the menu and we quickly asked if we wanted to start a tab. Now I didn't think to much of this because we WERE sitting at the bar but then realized other patrons weren't asked to do the same and they made NO indication at all that they wanted to eat.
Once we ordered drinks we had to wave over Katie again to take our app orders and our dinner order. Now this became a little game because not only is their website wrong but also they are terribly short sighted when ordering inventory because they didn't have what was on their recycled menus provided to us. So let's say we went back and forth at least 3 times with a 5-6 minute interval between knowing if they had it or not.
Now the not greeting us and general lack of service/pure rudeness could be all attributed to employees not giving a damn about their job on a Tuesday night, but you running my card beforehand when no one else was even asked for theirs is just plain outright ignorant. Once I noticed that I couldn't wait to get out of there. Luckily cooler heads prevailed and I didn't just walk out and I also left a 15% tip. Since I was in the service industry back in college I KNEW that waitresses never get the reason why they got crappy tips. They always think, "that's why I don't like when "those people" come in. It's never their fault, so I decided to go the high road, plus I knew I had Yelp! To come home to. Now I know some businesses read Yelp and get upset when someone bashes their establishment but I am all about open discussion but there are some things that shouldn't be tolerated and I'm glad that I have Yelp to do that.

Everyone at our restaurant LOVES this place!!! After a long day working, we order the 28inch extra extra large pizza for everyone to share and believe me, one slice is equal to 2 normal slices!  We have tried the meat special, pepperoni, veggie, broccoli/tomato, and combo pizza (half/half) all of them delicious!! 
Normally we don't stray from the 28inch pizza because its never failed us but one day we all got different items off the menu. A few of us got cheeseteaks, panzarottis, fries, and assorted sandwiches...all good. There was one small mistake on one of the orders and they were not only prompt in correcting it but corrected it in a friendly manner.
Their delivery service is both quick and courteous!
If I could, I would order numerous of the 28inch pizzas for a party even if there was an extra charge for deliveries to NJ!
I tried taking the leftover pizza in my car once and the box wouldn't even fit in my car!!
I'm surprised there aren't more great reviews, love this place and will continue to order!!!

Quite possibly one of the best places I've ever eaten at. The food was amazing. I had the Cesar salad, and I swear - how do they make the Cesar salad so amazing?? It was fantastic. I also had the chicken - so delicious - and sampled some of my friend's seafood meals. Great wine selections too. Definitely a fan. Wow!

Had the fried pickle appetizer. For lunch,  fried green tomato BLT. I added a fried egg  and it was served on sweet jalapeno corn cakes.   Perfect balance of sweet and savory. 
Dreaming of my next visit.

I happened to stop by India Grille,  conveniently located across from the mall.  Daily Lunch Buffet Special.  Average Food.  Naan Bread Fresh, nothing special.  Service Very Good.  Price, Ok.  Beats McDonalds.

I've always loved the idea of this Coffee Shop: an Old Church (that still actually holds service sometimes) turned coffee shop to fuel visitors of the SLU Medical Campus. 

As a medical student, I find myself here often for a quick lunch during the day. It's a great place to meet up with friends, whether on purpose or by happenstance if you're a SLU student. There is plenty of seating, both indoor and outdoor. The staff is friendly and helpful. The coffee is very good and they offer the traditionally wide variety you would expect in a coffee shop!

The only reason they are not 5 stars is that I have sometimes had an inconsistent experience with the food. Usually it is really good and makes for a great lunch. However, I have found, once or twice, that it doesn't taste as good as it usually does. I could not tell if it had to do with when I went during the lunch hour, but I was not too pleased. My go to is the grilled chicken chipotle sandwich with a side a chips. Very delicious and very filling. 

Love the concept and the convenience of this coffee shop!

My favorite tacos in town is here. The flour is soft and warm. I had salmon, shrimp and crispy pork belly. The best one for me is shrimp. The crispy pork belly is a must because all of the review mentioned this menu. I mean it's tasty but not what I thought I would be .. but still good. Another menu I have to mention is potato with the sweet sauce. I didn't try any drinks but they look good. The place is beautiful. I wish I went there in group so we can have the pretty corner. Once you step in you will know where exactly I was talking about. Next time I will get salmon and shrimp again!

You must place the restaurant on your list of places to visit.  They have the beat breakfast and lunches in the city.  This is mediterranean food mixed with an infusion of American but every dish is fun and a nice change of pace.  The owner who is always there is the nices person you will ever meet and will make you feel like you are eating at a warm family member's house.

This place has terrible service. When I came here with my family: it was not busy. There were 3 other tables with people seated at them; and those groups were not large. We ordered our food, but it took more than 20 minutes for everything to arrive to the table. We had to call out to a waiter three times to get extra napkins, utensils, and drinks: In fact, we ordered a prime rib at the start and it took 50minutes for it to arrive! Oh, and the shrimp balls tasted awful! Their only saving grace was their tea. That's right: tea. Their tea was great, delicious, hot, and infinite. It's sad when your tea is better then your primary entrees. I would pass on this place if you hate waiting.
The food and libations were delicious. Fried chicken with waffles was my order. Crispy and hot and delicious. Elegant look inside and smiling friendly wait staff.

The food is horrible.  Had the fish tacos. It was overloaded with some kind of green dipping sauce. The fish was super dry and over cooked. The so called New Orleans style orster wasn't that. If you ever had it in New Orleans you would know, and this wasn't it (no where near). Our server took more time flirting with co-worker than tending to her table. If you do get the fix to go, ask for Meliene. I notice her tending to her table and even our when I was there. It a tourist trap spot. Enter at your own risk.... oh the gater bites was great....

I wanted to eat Chinese food in Chinatown and found this place with so many reviews, many of which were very positive.
I put the address in my phone, pretty big sign, so it wasn't too hard to find.
Our server was not too friendly, but I wouldn't call her rude. I have never had oxtail before, so I just had to order the oxtail noodle soup. Our food came out pretty quick.

The soup was unlike anything I ever had before. I would compare it to Pho, but had less strong broth, different noodles, and lots of bones (meat was still attached to the bone, so I had to eat around it). As long as you are aware of the bones, they are big enough to easily eat around. The meat was extremely tender and flavorful. The noodles were a wonderful consistency. I liked it without adding any condiments, but did add chili paste, just because I like extra spicy (I think that's what it was). I remember it being somewhere around $8, so a great value for the price. My friend got a hot vegetable noodle dish and said it was very good.

I had a wonderful experience here and would definitely be back if in the Chinatown area again.

The food and service was really good. Both 4 stars. I just think that breakfast food should be at a lower price or the portions should match how much you pay for. And at about 12 dollars the chefs medley with 2 pancakes just seemed overpriced. I am from Ohio so when you spend 12 bucks on breakfast it is really a feast.
Been here three times during lunch and once for dinner. Nothing but great things to say. The service was great music was great and the food was great! My sisters and I really enjoy this spot.
Truly the most perfect melt in your mouth steak I have ever experienced. Service was quick and impeccable. The ambiance was nice and understated. I loved every aspect of Harry and Izzys.

This place is the best for happy hours! Prices are low and the drinks are yummy & strong. The service is fast and hospitable. Along with this, the overall design of the restaurant is fun and comfortable.
If you are in this area and a student, it's a great option for food and drinks during happy hour. If you are into tequilas and mezcal, they have a great variety with a range in pricing. They also have flight options so you can compare and contrast various types. 
I would definitely recommend for a good snack and delicious margarita!

We love Chef Mike's!! It is one of our favorite places to eat when we are in the area. I work in the area and this is a great place for a quick "nicer" lunch. The house poppyseed dressing is fabulous so get it for any of the salads...you won't be disappointed!

We went for a birthday lunch recently and my coworker got the daily special. It was their bratwurst with sauerkraut. She was amazed. When they showed up, she said "there is no way I can eat all this" and sure enough, it was too good to not eat every last bite.

The burgers are fabulous here! They also have a great local beer selection for after work hours. It may seem a little different going to a restaurant off the highway in an empty strip mall, but it really is great. You will be glad you tried it!

The only reason this is even getting 3 stars is because of our amazing server... big shout out to Trish!  We planned this event several weeks ago, we are a local Meetup group (YEG Beer Lovers) and we booked about 40 people. We were promised an entire section with 2 servers but on the night itself we had only one server (who was also responsible for several other tables) and it was the playoffs so the bar was packed - GO OILERS!!  We had expressed concerns about service in advance (due to personal  experience and previous reviews) but were assured by Ken that all would be taken care of...it was absolutely not.  There was only one bartender on duty all night - SATURDAY.  PLAYOFFS.  OY.  Orders  were delivered quite  slowly and food was greatly confused and often delivered without utensils.  People attempting to order directly from the bar were refused and told to order from their server.

The bar has over 100 beers on tap but you have to download an app to see them all.  The noise levels were very loud, it was impossible to hear anyone over the sound of hockey/band.  It's  too bad, there is immense potential in this bar but because of the slow service and disorganization we will not be back.  Our server did the best she could but the whole evening was set up to fail.  We would have been there until closing but because of the delays most people had gone by 10pm.  It's really too bad ...

BISCUITS Y'ALL. 

Need I really even say more?

Fine, I will.... 

Be prepared for a bit of a wait to get in (you line up), but they run a smooth operation and service is lightning fast! And the biscuits are SO WORTH IT!

Must try:
-Bonuts (biscuit donuts with a blueberry compote. I swoon just thinking about it!)
-East Nasty (fried chicken & biscuit. Straight sinful)

Get on out there and go. BISCUITS, REMEMBER?!
Good, simple, cheap... What else do u need? Oh! Cheap beer!!!!
Delicious salsa, I love the chicken enchiladas with white sauce, and great service. Although the decor is dated the food and service is the best. My new favorite!

The decor and overall appearance of this eatery is welcoming. Friendly service too. However the take out quality of the food is not worthy of 4 or 5 stars.  I ordered the chicken livers and although you can't go too terribly wrong breading and frying they were very salty. The fries were put underneath the livers and were soggy and dark. Dark meaning that the potato itself was dark in color and not from over frying. I will not be back.

Delicia is one of my favorite restaurants in Indy! I love being able to walk there from our home too! I have loved everything I have ever tried at Delicia, but I will highlight my favorites:
- The cocktails and the wine list: The cocktails are always fresh and flavorful, and I am impressed by the wine list. We always seem to choose a Malbec or a Red Blend because they bring out the flavors nicely with the rich and flavorful foods!
- Queso with Chorizo & Guacamole appetizers: Truly delicious with the complex flavors. I love the slight spice of the queso and the guacamole has so many fresh flavors with a surprising crunch! The chips that come with the dips are delicious, even just on their own!
- Duck Empanadas: One of my favorite restaurant dishes in Indy. Seems like high praise, which it is! Trust me.. truly amazing. The myriad of flavors is consistently impressive and is always so tasty!
- Churros: A must have. The perfect way to end any meal.

I enjoy all the Hofbrauhaus' that have opened up (and of course the original in Munich). I was in the area and wanted to get a 'stamp' on the HB shirts that list the locations, but unfortunately they weren't aware of them. That's OK, it's still a good place to visit and enjoy their fine beer.

This location is a bit smaller than others, but location is good and relatively close to the ballpark. It's worth stopping after a day game or before a night game.

The staff is friendly and the food is good. I enjoyed my time looking around this location (it's the newest HB in the States I believe).

If you enjoy German cuisine, music and beer, you'll definitely enjoy this HB!

My post is a bit late but we went for lunch almost a month ago. The waitress was great also attending the bar. Had a grapefruit flavor beer she suggested and it was great. Flat bread pizza was delicious. Great service. Thanks

So glad La Botana opened a second location further East. Expect the same delicious food and giant margarita deals. Too cold to enjoy their patio right now, but it's Tucson and a couple months will change that.

Great sushi! It's affordable and reasonably priced. However the customer service is either okay or just plain terrible. Can't ever say I was impressed with their service, food for sure!
