The prices were pretty cheap for center city and after eating there I see why. The food was generic and not very tasty. 

For starters we got Por Pia which looked like typical spring rolls which didn't have very much taste. We also ordered bbq spare ribs they came cut which I like because its not as messy, but some of them were kind of cold like the hadn't been in a microwaved long enough to heat them all up, not very appetizing.

Than for entrees we ordered salt and pepper shrimp and drunken noodles. The shrimp was pretty good but there were probably only like six or seven medium sized shrimp on a bed of lettuce and I got a side dish of brown rice and the drunken noodles were pretty good nothing really stood out with either dish. 

The waitress was ok but did not refill drinks until I flagged her down.  Overall this was a blah experience, so many better places to eat I would recommend skipping this one.
Great varied menu. Friendly and helpful service. Very good prices. I recommend especially for beginner sushi eaters.
Fantastic experience, great addition to the Qtr. everything was fantastic, especially soup dumplings

Great sandwiches. Amazing beer choices.Great place for neighborhood get togethers, beers with friends or lunch with the kids.  Love this place. 

The chicken salad is not loaded with mayo which should garner six stars!

So I was a little skeptical trying this place after getting let down by one of the neighboring restaurants. Also we have not had to order on our phones using a link provided with a QR code before. It was surprisingly more user friendly and COVID deterring than a normal set up. It did take a while to get service and there was not a lot of people. I only saw one server though so that seems like a business scheduling problem opposed to customer service. The main course was okay, the appetizer had some of the most tender steak I've had in a while. The rolls just weren't anything special.

Solid 5 stars!  Amazing bahn mi cafe, with multiple varieties of banh mi, desserts & drinks.  I enjoyed a vegan bahn mi with tofu and an iced green tea and it was wonderful.  The bread is fresh baked and crisp, and the portion sizes are excellent.  Staff is friendly and helpful.  I highly recommend

We returned to the mockingbird this year after enjoying our last experience. At first I was a little worried and shared some concerns about the hostess' demeanor. But I'm so incredibly impressed with the response to my feedback I shared. The manager brought our table a round of champagne as well as a hand written note apologizing for our experience, and then personally apologized as well. I'm so impressed with their response to my feedback. The food really is wonderful and the way they respond to negative experiences in order to make it right is rare in this day. Go support The Mockingbird and you won't be disappointed, I'm confident!! We have to support businesses that provide great food, environment and respond well to feedback.

This place is cheap, fast and pretty tasty. I read the other reviews about the restaurant being shut down from the old location because of health violations, and that's inaccurate. They had a fire, needed to move and planet organic took possession of the space. The service is quick, and can seem curt. Don't let this dissuade you if you need cheap, fast food. The servers are friendly, but tend to move fast.

It's been two years since I've been there and they got better with age!!  We went on New Year's day one of the busiest days.  They told us it would be a few minutes for a table we were seated within seconds.  We asked for chocolate milk the waitress said they just ran out of milk and asked for another option.  She ran to the store to get milk and made us it!  They said the kitchen is backed up and food may take longer than normal and we got our meals within minutes.  Ryan the owner came out and conversed with customers for a few minutes.  Honestly the best breakfast / lunch / brunch place on the island!  Can't wait to go back.

Great service. We ordered the soy garlic Korean fried chicken, beef bulgogi and the beef bulgogi with hot pot soup combo. The fried chicken is the best Korean fried chicken around in my opinion, it's flavorful, crispy and juicy. Highly recommend that as a starter or to go snack. The beef bulgogi came with rice and it's a pretty healthy portion of meat, the only complaint we had was that we wished it had more of the marinate flavor. The combo had a half portion of bulgogi. The soup was flavorful and came out piping hot which I loved. I also ordered an egg to crack on top for added goodness

I always crave me some Mexican food. This restaurant immediately caught my eye with their amazing outdoor seating.

Unfortunately, the weather rained on my parade the day we had planned to dine here. Being that majority of their seating was outside, we had to resort to their bar area. The staff were super nice and respectful here. I love how they left us some privacy and didn't stay around the bar at all times. 

We ordered the Burrito de Desayuno with Steak add-on ($16), Asada Tacos ($12) and Al Pastor Tacos ($11). The tacos were scrumptious! I was caught off guard by the spiciness of the Carne Asada tacos (there's peppers!), but the AL PASTOR! So so good. They gave fatty pieces, and included pineapples. The pineapples really take the icing on the cake in making these tacos taste so good. Salty with a slight tangy sweetness made me wish I ordered two of these. 

We were unfortunately not a fan of the Burrito de Desayuno. It was not a dish I tried before. I guess I didn't read into it, so I was surprised to see a smothered wet burrito. Yeah, I think I like my burritos dry. With the beans and eggs, I taste the "desayuno" aspect of it, and it tasted very hearty and healthy. There weren't many meat pieces and if there were, they were really tiny. 

Overall, I would love to come back for their beautiful outdoor seating! Highly recommend checking out.

Good authentic Chinese food, BUT completely unprofessional. Not only did the waitress just put our food only the table but didn't ask if we wanted something to drink instead she had her headphones on the whole time. As well as being rude when we we're curious about what was good. On top of that our bill was just tossed on our table like a frisbee after waiting for it for a lengthy time. I understand people work for a living but it's no way to be treated as a customer...Not by just this waitress but the ENTIRE staff. I would only talk about this place as a funny memory or something I'd remember as my worst restaurant experience, not to recommend.
Excellent service and food is great!! A must try here folks!  Very delighted with the fresh fish and prices are also good! Prime Rib is also a great meal!

The staff is always so friendly here I've even had full conversations with a few of them in that short two minute period of choosing my toppings on my burrito bowl.  So friendly, helpful, and hard workers!  The food is always fresh here because its always busy.  At lunch time there could be a wrap around line to the door. But, it moves so quickly because I'm telling you the service is awesome! Parking can sometimes be tricky. I also love that you can order online and when you get there its waiting for you and you can skip the entire line. Great feature.
Went out with my husband for a special occasion and it was delicious and staff was friendly!

Krueger's is one of my favorite downtown spots. They make a mean drink, have a terrific atmosphere, the burgers are on point. I typically get and highly recommend the bacon burger. I usually get it with no bun and use the mustard like sauce on the side. That's just because my body doesn't like carbs but I still want a burger! Then I usually order a small kale salad alongside the burger. I'm always super satisfied. This is one of the first places I want to go when quarantine is over and it was one of my last nights out before all this started. If you haven't yet, just try it! You will enjoy!
Decent food for the price. No complaints or compliments. You need to ask for the $5 deal menu otherwise they don't give you. Biscuits are very greasy!

Mother's Day brunch...We had a great time!  Mom got the Opah special from the night before and loved it.  I had a strip steak which was, of course, perfect.  The kids and grandkids got all kinds of brunch stuff plus we had 6 of each oyster - and everything was delicious!  
The bar, oyster bar and kitchen crew were terrific.  Everything came 
out cold or hot, as it was supposed to, and were very courteous and patient with 
our grandkids.
Please tell everyone thanks from our family to your family and the staffs' families.  We had a great time!
See you soon!

Wow, this Lonestar Cowboy Chicken is amazing! This sandwich will have your mouth watering and wanting more.  It came with a side and dipping sauce. Of course I got the Potato Wedges and avocado ranch. We also had to try the Pig & Hash even though I was a little skeptical. Let this serve as the new review of the Pig & Hash. THE PIG & HASH is out of this world delicious! It had a nice serving of chive hollandaise on top and a finger-licking good pork shoulder under a sunny side up egg. Now add a mimosa and you have a perfect brunch meal! I'm so glad we decided to stop for a quick Saturday brunch. This place is so underrated! Looking forward to coming back.

This place was absolutely amazing, the food was PHENOMENAL!! We came as a group and intend on coming back before our trip is over. The peacemaker was AMAZING the pork n chicken were both very flavorful. The bbq shrimp and grits and cane butter with the biscuit OMG!!! If you have never had grits these will change your life!! The banana French toast praline was absolutely amazing!!! I got the French toast batons and they were absolutely amazing and flavorful!! The only down side was the wait BUT the turnover wasn't terrible we waited about 40 mins.

Wow. Just wow. The food is too good and the vegan cheesecake is one to die for. I tried the Veg Out and my non-vegetarian husband tried the hummus wrap. I can't think of words to describe how luscious the food was. Please please try it for yourself! This is one place that meat lovers and vegans alike would enjoy like anything! Also, the packaging was given in eco-friendly degradable boxes and cutlery made of plant-derived starch. Feel good place!!

If I could give this zero stars I would. Went in today for lunch and ordered an appetizer along with 2 meals. After a long wait the wrong appetizer was brought to our table. We told the busser where he replied that he was just the busser. Our waitress Maria never returned however the appetizer we order arrived several minutes later. When we asked the busser he replied with 'well she said you were eating it so...' Our meals arrived several minutes later...when the bill arrived we were charged for two appetizers and two meals. When I approached the service counter the busser again acted oblivious to the situation when I asked to speak to the manager. When Maria arrived she continued to argue with me about paying for both appetizers. She was so rude. I asked her why she thought I should have to pay for her mistake and she refused to respond. I asked for the manager or owners number and she refused just pointed to the menu. I asked-do they not have a phone number? Where she again refused to respond. I'm in the food industry and this level of customer service is ridiculous-being made pay for something that we never ordered and then receive attitude for it. I will not only never return but I will tell everyone I know to steer clear of this awful establishment. All in all customer service was AWFUL, the wait was way too long, and the food was subpar.
Food is slap yo mama and yo grandmother good lol! The place is always packed so I would recommend going either very early or very late! Like if they close at 2. Go at 1:50 they stop seating at 2
Great food for cold weather. Cool atmosphere. Kind of cramped seating but it works, its worth it .

The best ribs I have ever eaten. Dry rub is absolutely delicious. The meat is tender and the sauce is just perfect. The sides are pretty good but all I could do is focus on the ribs! Our first stop when we come to Nashville

2 times for breakfast and both great. Breakfast taco is banging
...and who in this part of the country had shrimp and grits? Can't wait to try their lunch

A Nashville go-to for many tourist. I luckily live here and was able to go during the week meaning there was NO LINE! This restaurant always has a line, sometimes even before they open. 

I ordered a omelette, which you could choose up to 5 toppings. This came with a side of pancakes, which is what they are famous for. 

Their pancakes are so good, if anything, do get the pancakes. They are fluffy and super warm, top it off with their warm syrup and you are in Pancake Pantry heaven.
One of my favorites. Cioppino is great on a cold evening. The view can't be beat. The service is decent and the drinks are pretty good. All in all, a staple.

Been going to El Minuto for over a decade. Moved out-of-state for a few years and finally landed in Phoenix. I would love an authentic place like El Minuto anywhere in the valley. Finally made it back home and stopped in to see Teresa and wasn't dissapointed.

For those who think El Minuto is "Amerimex for the masses" or not original enough, El Minuto has been cooking the same great stuff for generations, the same way. If this style of food has now been "Americanized," it's only because all other places have copied El Minuto's winning recipes, and they all try and taste like El Minuto. I have never left El Minuto unhappy, and I have never left it hungry!

Feed the kid first.

I went in with my wife, daughter, and buddy. The adults ordered lunch, the three year old ordered french toast. Our food arrived, however (and it was clear since we were seated next to the open kitchen) the kids' lunch wasn't even started. It came a few minutes later, and she didn't care because she got some of my fries. 

The food was standard Sysco/US Foodservice fare. Nothing special. You're better off hitting a casino and letting the gamblers susbsidize. 

Finally, I hate the use of the flag as decoration, the print under the glass of our table was filled with 'em. Dripping ranch on ol' glory ain't cool. 

With so many great options for breakfast in Reno and Carson, I really don't get this place.
Great spot for reasonably priced, healthy food the whole family will love. Plus they support the GiftAMeal program, and give back to the local community.

It took a while, but I finally got to eat here. Great food in a simple, clean and neat setting. I tried a steak, chicken and fish taco and they were very tasty. I will return for another meal. You should try this place.
Food and service were very good!   Love the fresh salsa and chips they give you when you sit down.   Margaritas are tasty too.   Very close to the Exton Septa/Amtrak station.

We stopped in on our way home from The Athenaeum at the recommendation of a friend.  It was a cozy establishment with so many great menu offerings; from subs to salads, pasta, calzones & specialty pizzas. Wine and a variety of domestic & import beer is also available. They also feature a deck in front if you prefer outside dining/

We ordered the garlic bread with cheese & salad to start, along with an order of spaghetti & meatballs, a 16" Datsa Luau & the 10" Datsa cheese pizza for our main course. 

The hawaiian pizza was the perfect blend of ham, pineapple, green peppers & red onions, I was glad we chose it.  Don't leave without one of their homemade cookies. The peanut butter was mmmmm good. We'll definitely visit again!

The roast pork is moist but flavorless. You definitely need cheese and maybe some bitter broccoli rabe to add some taste to it. The pork is too wet so it makes the bread really soggy.

The cheese steak on the other hand, that's one of my favorites. It comes on a nice sub w/ sesame seeds. The sesame adds a lot to the taste.

Was recommended by a few Uber drivers not being from around here that it is a must visit.
Worried that it may be over hyped, I have to say Cochon definitely delivered from atmosphere to tingly tastebuds by their unique food options . Would def recommend for anyone  heading to NOLA.

Good sweets. Standard prices. The food seems like it hasn't been sitting.
It's a great place to go if you need quality sweets for an occasion very quickly.
It's the only good bakery in the community, and I'm glad they are here for us.
Good food, cool atmosphere, good cocktails, and friendly service. I would definitely recommend giving them a try.
We had dinner after a show, wonderful ambiance, great food and fantastic service. Highly recommended.

I wanted to like this place when we stepped in and it was a small little diner. The food we ordered was good and everything the guy grilling was making looked good however... the service . We walked in with no acknowledgement at all. We sat at the little bar stool area right next to the waiter and still nothing. We weren't even given menus... so we had to ask the lady next to us to see hers. Eventually the waiter asked for our drinks which all we got was water & it sat on the counter while he complained to the guy cooking about another table. After he just dropped our waters, he didn't even ask if we were ready to order. He went to the back, came back with silverware & started putting that away. We had to tell him that we were ready to order which when we did, he told us to give him a second. Finally, we got our food and when we did, we just asked for to go boxes because we were just over the whole situation. 

Hopefully, if you decide to go you'll get better service.

This is quintessential New Orleans!  Reminds me of old New Orleans were you would find the so called hole-in the-wall neighborhood eatery in every neighborhood through the city. But now seem to be hard to find! The place is nestled in between the homes and local convenience store. It has a take out window and a sit down table service around the back side. Going inside the place was full of mismatch plates and eclectic decorations up on the walls and tables which is totally local and totally New Orleans. Being that it was freezing cold and lunch time.  I chose the Gumbo. You know it warms the soul!  The gumbo here is the classic dark roux chicken and sausage. Was very tasty full of flavor. Had a little spice but not to much. I like it spicy. So I ask for Tabasco. Which they had. Eating gumbo with Crystal or any other hot sauce is a sin in my opinion! I will not eat gumbo without it! The gumbo came with potato salad.  And man ooooh man is that potato salad awesome.  It set the flavor of the gumbo and was paired perfectly with each other. The staff was very friendly and the food was served quick and correct!! I'd say if you want a local feel to your New Orleans trip or you are a locals looking for old school New Orleans come here. You will not be disappointed!

A great find in the Warehouse districts.  Everything on the menu sounded amazing, the staff were friendly and killer drink menu.  Get a passion fruit caipirinha and you won't be disappointed.  Vegan-friendly too!

Pizza was amazing (we got the CWE and formaggio - fresh ingredients and crust had great taste) but had to give 4 stars for 1) no wine list or alcohol served - cork is in the name! The waitress said they were finalizing their wine menu, and offered mocktails (juice) instead - no thanks. 2) for the size of the pizza, seemed slightly over priced. Also previous reviews mentioned you got a glass of wine with your pizza, which would offset the price difference - but no wine to be had. Would have been fine paying for it - but not sure if they don't have their liquor license or were just unprepared to open.

This is one of the best places in French Qtr. Came highly recommended from the NOLA PD who you know always know the places that treat them right! We found this place based on their recommendation and so glad we asked them for a place to eat on a police budget but was nice enough to take your wife. This place was it! We will return :)

I tried searching for the best burrito in Philadelphia and decided to give this place a try because of all the reviews.

 I must say I was slightly disappointed considering all of the great reviews this place received. The Burrito wasn't bad and it's better than the other fast food burrito chains like Chipotle or Qdoba, its just that it didn't have anything really special that separated it from average to good. 

The ingredients were tasty but the tortilla didn't taste that fresh, then again maybe its because I went there at 2pm.

I love this place....

I always go here for the best cheese ever you must stop here if you go to Philly this is a must do...  The building is lovely and historic and the staff is always friendly...  

It is small so it is cramped but so worth it...

It really is fresh and delicious. Much better than their competitors. Got wings, fries and a chicken sandwich late at night. All of it was fresh and really good. Hope the food quality stays consistent. 5 stars.

Very friendly staff greeting at the door. I was solo so I opted to sit in the bar area. Ordered a strawberry margarita, and not too long after I ordered a gentleman came with salsa and chips. They were pretty good, a little spicy but I appreciate that in my salsa :) I had already looked at the menu previously to arriving so I ordered promptly. The margarita was very tasty and strong. I had a decent buzz and it was pretty refreshing. I ordered 3 tacos the surf and turf, htq rib, and the other was chicken (sorry I can't recall the name). They were all pretty decent, my favorite one was the HTQ for sure.  My least favorite was the surf and turf, I didn't care for the dunk sauce personally. A few gripes that I had (and also preventing the 5 start review) the seating arrangement/ aesthetic at the bar area. I sat at the end of the bar a party came and sat right next to me. I scooted over but couldn't help but feel like we were on top of each other. I haven't gone out to eat a whole lot during the pandemic so it made me anxious to say the least. With me scooting over another party sat on one of the tables attached to the bar so I felt like I was intruding in their space a bit as well. Also their was a small nat/fly flying around that got on my chips and salsa. Some of the staff didn't have masks over there nose (which I am fine with l because I know that it circumstantial). But all in all a good experience and I'll be back to try some different tacos!
Awesome food, great menu and drink selection.  Local beers on tap! Atmosphere is fun and the Staff are super nice.  Excited for this place to be in our neighborhood!

This is my favorite restaurant in philadelphia 
I eat more than 3 times a week!!
Best chicken in Philadelphia

This is my first ever Yelp review, because this place is awesome! It's such an incredible addition to Magazine Street. It's so refreshing to have such delicious healthy food in such a convenient way. Super excited to become a regular here! Good stuff!
Great service, and great drinks!! Can't go wrong with any of their signature cocktails. Great place to relax and socialize.

Update: below the line is our first trip to Woodfire and above is our most recent, tonight:

Woodfire has improved in the last 90 days. After giving the restaurant a second chance tonight we had a more solid experience. 

We were sat immediately and were asked for our drink order.  Wine was great, scotch was great, same as before. 

Ashley was our server, and she did a great job. Attentive, friendly, and well-informed. 

I had the bourbon-barreled Atlantic salmon, which was cooked well and tasted great. The hominy cake worked with the maple-balsamic sauce drizzled on the salmon. Definitely recommend this. 

My wife had the special - cioppino. The scallops were cooked perfectly. The shrimp was tasty and it had about 12 mussels, cooked very nicely. When it first came out there were fried leafy greens that were crispy and buttery. Amazing. Unfortunately as they made their way into the dish they lost that crisp but not sure how that can be avoided. She only wished it came with a sopping bread other than the sweet house zucchini bread to enjoy the broth, because there wasn't really another way to get the broth other than a spoon.  

It was our 3rd wedding anniversary and we took a chance spending it here. They made it special. 

I hope they rotate the menu every quarter or so. Thanks for listening to feedback. 

----------------------------
First visit: 

Atmosphere is nice. Warm ambience. The bar was small but that didn't hurt the cordiality between all of us. It was full. And that's a good thing.

We had reservations at 6:30 PM. We arrived at 6:30 PM and were sat 20 minutes later.

Drink selections were good with the exception of beer. I think they would do better to get a few more craft beers. They had really good wine and of course some good scotch. As far as drinks go though, prices were high. 

We ordered the appetizer tasting plate, because it sounded great based on the description the server had been given from the chef. When it arrived it was a disappointment. It wasn't what it was touted as. The different elements of the charcuterie plate did not relate to each other. In addition, the server told us the plate would come with a pimento cheese. What that ended up being is a pepper jack sliced cheese. 

I had the ribeye which was cooked very well with nice mashed potatoes and a grilled broccoli. My wife ordered the Oyster mushroom and grits entree. It was disappointing to say the least. The mushrooms were too large, and not evenly cooked. The sauce was a marinara, which did not complement the dish and wasn't on the menu description. The garnish on top of the mushrooms, marinara and grits was broccoli, pickled onions and corn relish. All of these together accumulated to be something that didn't make sense at all. The menu said this dish was served with asparagus and oven dried tomatoes. These were not on my plate. Be wary of what you see on the menu, because it's not necessarily what you'll see when it's brought to your table. 

The service was really good, and the atmosphere was nice. It just seems like you could drive 20 miles to downtown Nashville and pay the same price for much better food. This is of course with the exception of the steak, which was ok but not $28 good. 

We will go back one more time. We support local businesses in Mount Juliet and MJ needs all the local business that it can get, especially on the north side. I criticize only because I care about what this is trying to do and I see the potential for what it could be. The prices simply need to reflect the quality of the food. If Woodfire wants succeed, it needs to up its game on creativity, execution, and flavor profile.
Visiting from Texas and tried Vernons. Everything was delicious ! Pear cobbler is sooo good
Perfect little breakfast/lunch spot. Love going there in the summer time and sitting outside. Always big portions

I went there specifically for the bison burger.  It was big, thick and juicy to justify the slightly high price. Service was prompt  (not many there, but more in the bar area) and good. 
As for bison burgers,the health food meat, as it has 2x the protein and 1/6 the fat of regular hamburger.  Patrick's is on the high price end, along with Mike Duffy's, Krieger's has a lower priced one and best price I have found is the Trainwreck on Manchester.  Buffalo Brewing on Olive has a good one.
I get mine for $4.15 a lb at a slaughterhouse in Illinois and never buy it at Schnuck's or Dierbergs for $9.99/lb.

There's your bison burger run down.

Came here for taco Tuesday! The drink special is really good and the tacos are cheappppppppppp! Get here early bc it gets super packed if you come too late. So pretty much, leave work and come straight here!

My mother is handicap and has a service dog and walks with a cane. I called to make an 8pm reservation. The manager wanted me to come at 5 so we would not be in the restaurant at their busy time, even though her service dog goes right under the table and you would never know the dog was there. Since it is illegal to turn away a service dog from a restaurant,  he said he could put us upstairs at the 8pm time....telling me my handicapped mother had to go up stairs to eat. Not an accommodating or welcoming place at all. Maybe the management should educate themselves on diversity and hospitality.

Amazing Indian food!! 
I had a great experience dining here. The atmosphere was great, and once we ordered our food came out promptly. The menu is quite extensive so ask your waiter questions, and what they recommend; usually what they recommend is excellent. 

We started with panner naan, with cheese and spices, which was fantastic. 
I had the mango butter chicken, which was absolutely delicious. The best butter chicken I have had. The mango sauce comes on the side, so if you don't want it to sweet you don't have to add it. 
My friend had the lamb butter masala, which had great flavour, but I found the lamb to be very tough. 
Our entire bill was ~$50, and it was worth every cent for the amount of food we got. 
I will definitely be back!
Awful service.  Didn't feel welcome at all. Waitress had to ask us what we ordered when getting the check. Jessie the bartender treated our group like shit. Burger was passable.

Wow. I can't believe I was born in Reno, and this is my first time eating their food. I ordered via Postmates and I was unsure of what to expect. 
First of all their menu is super vegan friendly. I also called the restaurant to double check some items, and ask for recommendations. They recommended the curry puffs, and I was not let down.  In fact, that might be the best thing I've ever received from a Thai place.  I ate all six. I have no photos to show for it, because I could not stop eating them, dunked in that sweet slightly spicy sauce. Mmm mmm mmmm.  I also got the Tom Kha coconut milk soup. I asked for the lowest spice level and they delivered. My experience with Thai is that I tell them mild, and it still burns my mouth. Every item tonight was exactly the perfect level. 

My avocado curry did come with some fish in it, which was a let down, as I couldn't taste it due to an allergy. It looked pleasing, and the app refunded me right away. I do think it was a mistake & will try ordering it again. 

If you order from here, I recommend getting your own portion of curry puffs, because I would not share mine with anyone.  

I will review the spring roll tomorrow after I eat them for lunch

Hmmm not there yet - someone else booked for me - would rather be at the Omni in the French Quarter - this is cool ish but looks worn out and trying too hard - will report back to see if they take care of me or pretend - if it were The Bowery Hotel in NY I'd know it was luxurious but funky looking - this looks funky full stop, hold the luxury

This restaurant was part of the Sirata Beach Resort I stayed at for a wedding. We received some drink offers so we headed down. We arrived in time for happy hour and ordered a margarita and a glass of wine.

We checked out the menu and were slightly shocked by the prices, but hey, it is at a resort type place so that can be assumed. I ordered the coconut shrimp and my husband ordered a club sandwich. The 6 measly shrimp came out gallantly attempting to make the best out of the wilted lettuce presentation they came out on. They were ok but again, there were 6 of them. 6 tiny coconut coated shrimp which tasted an awful lot like the coconut shrimp you can buy frozen at the grocery store. They were an appetizer portion but the price for those babies was out of control.

My husband's food was so-so, not bad but not good. The bill came and none of our drinks were priced according to the happy hour specials however, the service was so slow the entire time we were there than we just paid and ran out to enjoy the sunshine as quickly as we could. I wish I ventured off of the Sirata campus to get a more reasonably priced, better tasting, better priced meal.

Sadly will never go back. Dined in for the first time tonight. Ordered drinks and apps to start. Halfway through our fresh guacamole appetizer we found a long black curly hair. We let our server know and he took it from the table, we said we did not want another one brought to us. The next visit to our table was our server bringing our food and letting us know he did inform the manager and was told he would take care of it and also he wasn't sure what that meant for us. The manager never came to visit our table, never acknowledged us at all. The server was very apologetic and if I was him I would not be happy that management didn't help him out by speaking to us. Our check arrived minus the guacamole and with some sort of discount that the server was sure of...10% maybe...
The lack of management responding to the situation is the reason we won't be back. Clearly they did not think it was a big deal. Hopefully losing customers isn't a big deal either.

Clean, great selection of healthy foods and unique drinks, reasonable prices, and yes, the tofu hoagie is THAT good (and I am NOT a sandwich person!) Not your average convenience store. I hope this place always stays this good.

One of my favorite places for breakfast, but my work schedule and their hours of operations don't match up. Typically, I can only eat here on Tuesday & Wednesday. I do take advantage of that as often as I can, but I really love their Biscuits & Gravy Breakfast. It is only offered Friday-Sunday and I start work at 5 AM, so no go for me. So, when vacation time comes around, I am here for a hearty B&G Breakfast. 

Their Biscuits & Gravy Breakfast comes with two cheddar biscuits topped with homemade sausage gravy, two eggs prepared your way and hash brown potatoes. These biscuits are soft, flavorful and the combination of cheddar and sausage milk gravy is a winner for this farm boy. Today I had my eggs fried over hard with the yolk broken, how I got on to this kick is beyond me. Their hash browns are good, I'd like them to be a little crisper, but they still make this a stick to your ribs breakfast. I added a side of bacon, it just makes the morning meal complete. 

For a restaurant bottomless cup of coffee theirs is pretty good. The service is always attentive and the ladies are friendly and make your dining experience very relaxing. At times there can be a long wait for tables, but they don't rush you out. If you have no patience for waiting, I suggest you download No Wait app on your smart phone, it is a valuable tool in time management. 

Will I come back? Yes, during the week I enjoy pancakes or Benedict and when I have the weekend off, it will always be Biscuits and Gravy. 

When: November 11, 2016
Why: Birthday Breakfast - B&G
I thought the service was good but the food had no flavor.
Excellent brunch. Service was friendly. I will definitely make a point of going back next time I'm in town. It has a great local feel.

Great, great bagels with nice service and prices!! 

So happy to be recommended to eat here. Sad I don't live here to get the stamp card or else it would be full in a week! 


Thanks Blue Sky :)

Horrible service today which will result in losing a regular customer. I come here at lease once sometimes twice a week and always have had great results. Today no. The unfriendly girl that takes orders to start. I asked for double toasted bagel. My bagel comes out barely toasted at all so I send back to please be toasted dArk she rolls her eyes at me throws bagel in trash in a spectacle of a way. I get my new bagel which is now black as coal and now I'm just mad and I got my money back and will never return. Learn customer service and learn how to correctly fix orders when wrong

We stopped in for lunch on a Sunday. Lineup was out the door, but moved pretty quickly. Everything on the menu sounds absolutely mouthwatering - there are a lot of items though, and the ordering process was a tad confusing for a first-timer. Food tasted amazing. Indoor and outdoor seating. Loud-ish atmosphere with lots of neat decor to look at while waiting for food. We'll go back anytime we're in St. Louis!

Three words: MOO SHROOM BURGER. 

Amazing!! Great service too. We visited during lunch time. It was fairly busy, but we got a table and placed our order quickly. Food took a while, but it was definitely worth the wait. I highly recommend this place. Great ambience for a meal with friends.
freaking love this place.... Great food and tons of choices.  why go to chilli's across the street, when you and get better food here for about the same price?

I wouldn't recommend this place. I ordered a birthday cake for my husband a week before I needed it and on the day of my husband's birthday, I was suppose to pick up the cake but they called me 30 minutes before I left and said that they did not make the cake. I already paid beforehand and the baker Don was supposed to make the cake and promised that it would be ready in time for the party, but i guess they forgot about it. And the lady who called to let me know about the cake said it was his fault for forgetting about it.  In addition to that, the cafe wasn't that clean and it had poor customer service.  Overall, it was a horrible experience and I personally wouldn't go back.

I'm a sucker for a good Singapore noodle dish.  So, based on a previous yelp review, my table ordered this, as well as their combination pho, and crab ragoon.

Beginning with the crab ragoon, it was the worst version I have ever had.  The filing was liquidy and tasted like they added crab juice instead of actual crab.

The Singapore noodles were very disappointing, to say the least.  It tasted like something Panda Express would make.  No curry, no spice, just over heated oil.

Lastly, the pho.  I kind of knew what to expect, since I have already tried it at the Pho Festival.  The broth was really good, the noodles were good, but the meat and beef ball was just okay.

From a service standpoint, they were very understaffed.  It took about 20 minutes just to get my tea offer.  However, when I informed the very apologetic waiter I was in a hurry, the entrees came out fairly quickly.

Overall, I give it 1 star, adding one star for the pho broth, which is up there with Doung Phong and Pho Tau Bay.

The food was okay usual; however, the server was not attentive until it was time for us to pay the bill and receive a tip. Due to the poor customer service of our waiter, we did not order a dessert and we reflected our appreciation via the tip. 

Note we visited the restaurant during non-peak hours - there were many vacant tables so the waiter was not busy or overworked since there were not may people sitting in our area. 

One other thing... On the day we visited, the restaurant was cooler than the outside, the temperature outside was 66 and raining (brrrr). Next time I plan to wear a winter coat into this restaurant.
There is only ONE Satco!  Nothing else like it.  Love it, Love it.  Been coming here since it opened 20, 30 years ago.  Still love it.

Popped in one Sunday afternoon for lunch.  There was a line, of course, but it was actually tolerable and did not extend down the street.  I can't say that I would wait in that sort of line for this place despite all the hoopla.  No malt challenges for me - thanks.

The first order of business was acquiring a delicious malt - chocolate banana to be exact.  It took me no time whatsoever to polish that off.  Next order of business - lunch.  The carnivorous girls order the monstrous and infamous heart stopping BLT.  Jesus.  That is a heart attack slipped between two pieces of bread.  We opted for the egg salad sandwich.  It was not too shabby - creamy and delicious texture with good flavor.  

It has the original architecture inside (or at least I assume), which gives it that old-time ice cream parlor/diner appearance.  The venue is small with very limited seating, which does not help with the capacity constraints.  Has that old school feel, which I liked.  There is also a barrage of candy patrons can buy along with homemade ice cream.  

Not exactly sure how to comment on the staff - they seemed very busy and perhaps a bit frenzied, which limited the idle chit-chat.  The food seemed to take longer than usual.  It was average-above average as far as price.  I can say that I am glad I was able to experience it but not sure I would ever go back.

I am allergic to tomatoes and this is one of the few restaurants I have seen that has great pizza alternatives. Their pesto pizza with red bell peppers instead of tomatoes is out of this world. We have repeatedly gone to this place despite the fact that it is over an hour away!

We ordered drive through, but our card didn't work (our credit card's fault). So we ordered thru website. The website charged our credit card but didn't give us the order number. Luckily, we had text alert and Luckily the manager accepted the charge alert from our phone. The food is good. I just wish they still offer green beans.

I enjoyed the variety of beer and the sour beer. The staff was well informed and guided me well with the selection of beer. The food was tasty and well cooked. I had a burger and it was ample. I will definately visit this place again and try more variety of beers.

This is such a cool place right on Main St in the Arts District of Carmel.   The staff is super-friendly and very knowledgeable about their food.   If you don't know what to order (there are a lot of items on the menu), you can request a sampler platter to help you make your decision (just be sure you don't get too full!).   My favorites: pulled pork, chicken & sausage gumbo, chicken courtbouillon.

And no Cajun restaurant is complete without serving Abita beer.  They stock 2 of my favorites: Turbo Dog and Purple Haze.

Don't forget to order the classic New Orleans sweets....beignets.   They don't have chicory coffee; however, they did brew a mean pot of French Roast for me with Cafe du Monde beans.

I had my first 'real' cheesesteak experience after recommendations from multiple people to come here (along with a few other places). It honestly lived up to all the hype, as it was simply one of the best I have ever had. 

What took away from the 5 stars:

1) Cash only
2) The person who was preparing the sandwiches was extremely rude. Every other person in there was nice though. 
3) Line was ridiculously long (but it moved relatively fast).

Overall, it was a pleasant experience. I got it to-go since it was really cramped in there, so I couldn't really speak on the ambiance of the place because the seating area is in the back covered by the wall. I probably wouldn't return (not because of this place) because I want to try other places and I'm only here for the summer.

Stopped in here, after walking out of an other place.  Due to non service.  I'm pretty impressed . First off we're talking midnight.  But this is bourbon St.   The server Karen, was great! Bless her for working Christmas day. Supply and demand streets are packed.  We ate oysters and po'boys. Ever thing was perfect. Pricing was right in line for the area.   This place deserves a try at any hour, and even better after midnight.

Fantastic place. Great lunch menu, but equally ideal for happy hour after work. I personally like the veggie burger with cauliflower mash. But enjoy the bowls as well. Location, music, staff and patrons keep this pace in my top 5.

Absolute worst experience ever. We waited over an hour for the food to come out. The owner Mary is very stuck up and rude. Our food had been sitting in the window for over 5 minutes. When our food was brought to the table it was warm and soggy. When my friend ordered food to go there were no fries in the box and the owner said "well that's the waitresses fault because she's new" I'm sorry but that's not how you run a business. Then when we were cashing out we told the owner Mary about our terrible experience she copes an attitude and told us that it was all our fault. Video was taken of everything please go look on their FB page.

Very fresh seafood!  Great taste-good size portions.  Service was good and restaurant was very clean.  Shrimp tacos , ceviche and shrimp cocktail was top notch!  Look forward to having it again!  And yummy bean dip comes with the chip and salsa!  Homemade flan!

Great choice by my wife. This is our go to spot when we are in the area. Great food / Great Margaritas!
Give this place a try you won't regret it !

Consistently great food, good location and cool atmosphere. This is the perfect place for lunch during the week especially during the summer because of the outdoor seating. All of the food is locally grown and their daily specials include different seasonal fruits and veggies. They are vegan and vegetarian friendly but also have a good selection of meat dishes providing an experience that anyone would love.

Listen I don't give 5 Stars I mean not because nobody deserves it but I am here because as the food goes..I was impressed! I must say the building is in need of renovations but the food..o..la..la. Magnificent! You Have to get the Bruschetta. It's an experience in your mouth. So pleased we found this little Italian Gem!!

We love Jake's Pizza! We always order the thin (cracker) crust. Tonight we ordered 1/2 meat lovers & 1/2 veggie to please everyone...and it did. We love it with regular mozzarella but provel cheese is also available. Yum!!

The restaurant seating is not managed well, we were left waiting although there were seating options and they don't take your name and invite you to sit at the empty bar, salads are decent I ordered a kielbasa sandwich and it was great! Came with awesome mustard and good fries, my Wife ordered a crab cake and it was not traditional at all some crab, lot's of filler, batter dipped and deep fried. Might be worth a visit but not worth being a destination!!

One of my all time favorite spots! Great service, great food! If you like "mom and pop" diners this is the place to come. Saturdays and Sundays are busy so come with a great attitude! Relax and enjoy!

This is probably my favorite place in New Orleans. I am a very picky eater and the menu had a few items that caught my eye. The fried grits are amazing, it was my first time eating grits. For my entree, I had the crawfish etouffee - it was beyond delicious. The serving size is satiating. For my drink, I had the watermelon mojito - it was SO refreshing.

My partner and I are pleasantly surprised that we've never heard of this place before. They opened right after hurricane Ida and I was just so preoccupied with other dire needs I was just frequenting the same places on my days off. 

So today I went about Yelp trying to find new eats. As always I always prioritize finding new Asian cuisine foods and saw that this place was opened relatively recent and decided to check them out.

We came at 2:00pm on a Monday and there was no one here but us. We ordered the jian bing, the spicy beef noodle soup, the pan fried shrimp pork and egg dumplings, the bao, and the sichuan chicken.

Spicy beef noodle soup: wow! The broth is really good! It was such a great mouthful of soy-base soup broth and a hearty serving of wheat noodles with braised beef
And bok Choy. The chilies were a nice pop-in-the mouth with each bite and really was flavorful. Everything was lacking in terms of spiciness but I'm Thai and I love everything of mine to be fire. I added more chilies that they have on the table. 

Sichuan chicken: they stir fried this with sichuan peppers, jalapeños, and ginger. The dish lacked a little salt so we sprinkled some on and voila! Perfect. Chicken was nice and crispy and very tender inside, the fresh jalapeños was a nice bite from the subtle sweetness of fresh peppers, and the ginger had a really nice aroma that resonated throughout the entire dish.

Jian Bing: the Jian bing was so unique. I've never had jian bing like this before, but it's also a regional difference as China is such a large country. It was filled with some type of fermented bean curd type sauce and a crispy wonton skin wrapper inside. Definitely worth a try!

Bao: the texture of the steamed buns were exceptional. It had a nice bite and chewiness to the bread but it was also moist and soft from the inside. The fillings shrank and left small pocket holes but they were filled with the juices of the filling. Win win win! 

Shrimp, egg, and pork dumplings: amazing! This dish was one of the winners. Crispy on the outside and amazingly succulent in the inside. The flavors were phenomenal. I made my own soy-sauce vinegar on my own plate and dipped these in there.

The service was very prompt and we were in want of nothing. The owner came out and greeted us and we felt really welcomed. Really glad we took the chance and tried this place today! 

Overall solid 5/5!

Only went once but Good coffee and a big variety of menu items. I wish they had a few "regular" lunch sandwiches, like simple grilled cheese or ham and cheese. Even just a burger in a bagel w/o all the extra toppings, but I've heard good things about what they do offer. Looking forward to trying them again.

Um, no plat recognition? No tv reception and upgrade to a room next to the ventilation for the restaurant? No DVD remote control? Call to ask for one and it never arrives? The inability of this hotel to staff the front desk when there are 10 people checking out?  Mushy bananas and molding oranges in the fruit basket that serves as breakfast? I think this place really sucked compared to the W on Poydras. Would I stay there again, probably not. I did write a nice letter to the GM, but my guess is, it never made it passed the dude that was too busy lighting candles at 6:30 am to bring mood to the W instead of checking out guests.

Location is great if you are partying in the Quarter, not so hot if you are working in the CBD.  I stayed once, never again.

How to begin? We stumbled upon this gem, looking for breakfast for our jet-lagged selves. C'est un délice! The menu is a plethora of irresistible delicacies. The croissant options alone were amazing. I settled on the "hangover", an omelette stuffed with a melody of cheese, corned beef hash (who'd have thought?), tomatoes and smothered in the worlds best hollandaise. My children chose crepes, French toast and amazing toppings. My best friend chose the eggs Benedict, served on a croissant, with a side of grits. All of it was delicious! Nathalie, the wonderful owner, visited our table and we discussed cooking, France and she showed us pictures of the original building and owners. She was delightful! The whole experience was amazing and we plan on going back tomorrow (a first for us on vacation!). Please visit this amazing place. You'll thank me!

The drive-thru line is always ridiculously long sometimes you wait up to as much as 10 minutes before you can even order and then up to another 10 minutes to receive your food. Management here seems very disorganized and lackluster. They seem to be very lackadaisical with their employees

I've been here for both brunch and dinner and was very happy with both.  Loved the halibut and vegetables it was served with.  A lot of flavor and more interesting than a typical fish and vegetables entree.  Menu is great for a group with options for different tastes including several vegetarian.  I know this is picky... I was sitting in one of the only seats where you can see the entrance to the kitchen.  My only advice would be to clean up that area a little bit since I could see paint coming off wall near floor from water damage, Home Depot bucket or anything else placed right by saloon type doors.

We have been Desert Museum members for many years. Therefore we have eaten here for many years. We ate here this week after not for about a year. The food was terrible! I'm so disappointed. The green chili cheeseburgers taste frozen and not charbroiled and the green chili is now tiny pieces, when before it was large strips. We couldn't finish them. The kids ordered cheese pizza kid meals. The pizza was so bad they didn't eat it?! No kid meals either-they used to come with animal cookies, etc. but now it's a horrible 'pizza' and drink. I can't say how disappointing this was and now we will choose to eat elsewhere before we visit the museum.

I am a huge Hyatt fan, however our room was definitely not the cleanest. There was dust on most surfaces and multiple hairs in the bathroom on the floor and sink when we arrived and water damage on the ceiling tiles. Also, 40 dollars to valet for a room that cost 150 a night seems quite steep. The lady who checked us in was very kind, though and the valet gave good suggestions on places to go.

The food is WAY overpriced for the quality. It was $12.99 for one order of orange chicken and $12.99 for one order of lomein noodles. I ordered two orders of the orange chicken, it came with white rice, then order an order of lomein noodles which came out to be $42 after tax. It wouldn't have been awful in price if the food was actually good. The chicken was dry, hard to eat, and over cooked. The noodles smelled awful and tasted just as bad as the smell. The rice was dry as well! 
Overall, I won't be coming back here. Maybe if the food was better I would, but I'm not wasting my money to find out.

My first visit to this brewery/ restaurant and I'm close to being a fan. We were here to celebrate a friend's birthday and it seemed like all 12 or so of us were satisfied with our food and experience. 

It is a large and open space, both dining room and bar area, with some outside seating available as well. If I were to revisit( a good chance I will) I'd probably opt for bar area, especially during happy hour since those specials are not offered in dining room. Trish made the reservation for our group and ran into one glitch, the day of the event our 5:30 was changed to 5:00 by the restaurant. This was supposedly to accommodate another party at 7. We were not rushed out when that time approached but we also saw no sign of another party. 

I first perused the beer offerings, there seemed to be at least 10 on draught and some earlier offerings in cans. I selected their blueberry Hefeweizen and enjoyed the crisp flavor on this warm night, even though little to no berry taste came through. I would probably try something else next time. The food menu was possibly too large( in my opinion) with sandwich, pizza, apps and entrees offered. I was very hungry and 75% of the menu appealed to me, so I went to our excellent server Frank for his advice. He suggested a few dishes and I thought my beer choice would pair nicely with the pan roasted chicken entree. It proved to be good advice, a nicely cooked Frenched breast with the skin crispified served with what seemed to be local asparagus and mashed potatoes. The fowl was tender and juicy still, the pan sauce was lightly citrusy and herbed, it was good but could have been better if reduced and thickened. The mashed were ok, and probably the weakest link in the dish. I had an add on Caesar salad that was fair and overpriced( as add ons go) at $6. Trish went with his advice and ordered a shrimp and scallops special, she loved it and I have to admit, they are sourcing quality crustaceans.

Most others in our group ordered burgers and we heard many good things. Surprisingly no one else tried any beer. We brought our own bday cake and were not charged a plating fee. Beer aficionados should consider joining their reward program, for a $15 one time fee you are entitled to a special glass that holds 22 oz for the price of a pint, along with other perks and incentives. Great place for gatherings, let's go with 3.75 ongoing research Yelps

Menudo so good makes you wanna slap yo mama and whoever else is close! Stopped into my new fav lil spot after traveling from Anderson on my way to the workstation. As always I'm greeted with a smile and a bit of nice convo from the owners daughter. What a sweetie. This place ceases to amaze me, and the homemade tortillas DELISH.

My friends and I had brunch here today and everything was fantastic!  The server was nice, knowledgeable and took great care of us. The bread basket is a must order and all of our entrees were delicious. We never felt rushed and though we were the last table remaining when they closed.

Salt + Smoke is one of the better places for BBQ in St. Louis!  It's meat and sauces are delicious and even the sides are good.  I have had the beef brisket, pulled turkey, and I even think the pulled pork (at a previous visit a few years ago).  Everyone raves about the sides too.  I have tried the baked beans, chili, green beans, and some others.  Each one was surprisingly tasty!  They do a great job with their baked beans by giving them a meaty and smokey flavor, which is different.  The majority if most baked beans at BBQ joints are usually sweet.  

The brisket is probably one of the better briskets out there.  You can choose if you want fatty, lean, or burnt ends.  I chose the lean and it was still tender and full of deliciousness!!  I recommend trying the brisket and even the chicken was good if you want a non-red meat, healthier option. You can get the meat in sandwich form or on a platter, plus they have a few vegetarian burger and meat burger options! 

You don't have to worry about sauces either!  They have sweet, spicy, mustard, and a few others to satisfy all taste buds!  They also do a seasonal side (at least while we were there).  

For anyone who loves BBQ, Salt + Smoke is definitely a must try in St. Louis.
Ice cold beer in frosted glasses and great food at an affordable price.  What more could you ask for.  Definitely a good option in Wesley Chapel.

This place has good food if you like waiting, ive been there 3 times & have waited 1:30 at least sitting at a table twice & today Mother's Day takes the cake!!!! I understand it's Mother's Day, today we called @ 4:30 pm & was told our order Baked Ravioli, Ziti Alfredo & Veal Parmigiana ready @ 6 pm, daughter went to pickup at 6. After several calls We went up to find out what was taking so long!!! A friend of mine also ordered @ 4:30 & got his food @ 6:30. We got our money back @ 7:45, THIS PLACE IS A JOKE!!! We will never go back EVER, I need to add to this. People just do you know this review isn't sour grapes, every time I've been here, the Service SUCKS!!! The food is okay, but certainly not worth the wait or the attitude you get for the lousy wait staff!!! Avoid this place at all costs!!!

I'm not a huge donut fan, but I enjoy one every now again. I decided to try SDs to see what the hype was about.   After tasting them, I think I know why SDs receives so many mixed reviews. 

They look so much better than they taste. Period.  You walk in the small shop and it's so pretty. Bright colors, decorative toppings, fun names, but has anyone noticed it doesn't smell like donuts?  It's missing that sugary sweet aroma. 

I ordered a campfire, blueberry cheesecake, and a dozen powdered holes (except that when we counted them to divide for the kids there were only 11?.)  All the donuts were fine. The s'mores was my favorite, it had a good chocolate cake base. I couldn't taste the graham crackers crumbs though. The cheesecake was really sweet and had a good filling/donut balance. The holes were dry, but I don't expect much from them anyway. 

Overall, I'd eat them again if someone put them in front of me, but I'm not stopping in myself.

Sooooooooo good. Great service. Want to go back everyday. I ordered the peppercorn steak and it was really really good. I tried their signature blueberry lemon cocktail and that was really good as well. Tried their strawberry basil and wasn't a huge fan but it want bad. Their Flemings potatoes was probably my favorite side dish offered at any steak house. I've been to many of the steak houses in the city and never been the Flemings before but I'm glad we went. The highlight that puts Flemings above the others is their attention to detail like the complimentary parking, Coat check and the car being brought to you by the time you're outside the door. You don't see that kind of service in a lot of places so it's great to see how much they are thinking of their diners. Can't wait to be back!

I have been to this restaurant often. Love the wings and love the fries.  The bar is in the middle and very busy. When you first enter the restaurant they greet you to see how many is in your party. FYI - Tuesday - wing night. 
Tuesday very popular with the young ones and believe me people park where ever  they can. Food is good and so are the drinks. 
I have personally tasted the wings and burgers. 
The waitresses are very friendly and accommodating. 
I would recommend this restaurant to all.

Every time I'm in STL I have to go here. Brews are the best and very well balanced. Nothing over the top and out in left field.
Food is always delicious and portioned perfectly. I've even thought of moving to STL and in the Grove so I can enjoy UCB all the time.

Exactly what I was looking for! A local place with good vibes. Not too loud and crazy, even on a Saturday night. Extended bar with a few tvs. Local beers and a great menu; seafood heavy. Ordered to-go food and it came out quick. The lobster grilled cheese was so good and worth the $16.50! Big chunks of lobster. It also comes with a side item and a small portion (it was more than enough) of lobster bisque for dipping.

I think I may have found the greatest bar food ever....the buffalo chicken nachos. Ooey and goey and covered in bleu cheese. Heaven! Happy hour prices are great, $2 Finlandia vodkas and the tables outside are great for people watching. If you're looking for fine dining this is not where you want to go, but for bar food, cheap drinks and a fun atmosphere Green Iguana fits the bill.

Bought a coupon from Restaurant.com.  The place is relatively nice, and pretty clean. The restrictions on the coupon were such that you had to buy $50 of food. With my wife and I, I figured it was a good deal and we could order deluxe roll . Service was quick enough, but I was miffed because the wat-staff had the gall to add an 18% gratuity onto my bill. This was not a restriction nor was it posted anywhere. I just figured she wanted to make sure I didn't stiff her because of the coupon. I quietly paid and left. I will not be back.

This is our favorite place to eat breakfast and lunch in Sparks and in the entire Reno area.  The Applewood bacon is to die for.  All the food is fresh and carefully prepared.  The servers are accomodating friendly and courteous.  I once had a dish that was too salty which they took back in a most accomodating way and replaced immediately with a delicious unsalted replacement.  Smiles and apologies abounded.  The American as well as Mexican choices are incredibly varied with just about every breakfast possibility..steak, shrimp, pancakes, french toast, veggie omelets, Spanish omelets, you name it,  including a delicious huge yogurt fresh fruit salad.  (which I ordered)
If you are hungry, this place is a MUST GO TO!

We have experienced many restaurants along the way from Kemah, Texas to Nashville. We have to say that  Fox's Pizza Den in Nashville was exceptional in so many ways. Not only did they have an outstanding selection of gourmet pizzas and additional Italian fare, they were pet friendly and were more than  happy to accommodate our fur baby to sit with us at their small but very 
cosy restaurant. In addition, they offer pick up and delivery to the surrounding areas. If we liv d here, this would a permanent place to go or order from. Would recommend this establishment to everyone.

A staple in South Tampa. We went for a morning walk and ended up in Soho for breakfast (needed energy for the walk back:). Great atmosphere inside and out with others waiting to be seated. Very hospitable staff. Ate outside as it was nice and cool. Server acknowledged us immediately. We ordered The Goat (omelette with goat cheese, sautéed spinach, topped with fresh avocado and The Carnivore (omelette with diced ham, turkey sausage, crumbled bacon, scallions with cheddar cheese). Both meals came with two sides: 1) bread: bagel, toast (multi-grain, rye), or English muffin, and 2) grits, home fries, fresh fruit, or oatmeal. Drank coffee (delicious) and H2O. Servers work together to ensure satisfaction (great teamwork) by offering refills, etc. Very reasonable prices.
Nice spacious, renovated restrooms.
Haven't dined here for many years before this morning; much better than I remember!
So glad we dined at Daily Eats!
And yes, it gave me the energy to make it all the way back home (we even took the longest route:).

This place is great! We had not been until tonight. Ryan, our waiter, was super helpful and gave us a clear rundown of the menu - and what he would recommend. My wife got fish and chips, and they were delicious. I kept it simple and tried their bacon cheeseburger. It was the best burger I've had in a long time. We will definitely be back!

OK so I heard about this place from a coworker and he said it was the best in town. So I had to try it since I thing Bodacious pigs is the best. First impressions is that its nice and clean, its different, the people are friendly and sweet. Its more of a close to fast food order and dine vs being seated and ordering your food. When we walked up to the ordering line, the lady was really nice and gave us a sample,  she gave us a full rib which was really nice of her and it was the end rib which was dry but flavorful. I really like the ends of ribs so I enjoyed it. So the meats are ordered by weight, 1/3 lb, 1/2 lb, 1 lb, etc. My brother and I decided to order kind of a sample platter to try the different bbq meats. We ordered a 1/3 lb of pulled pork, 1/2  of tri tip, and 1 lb of baby back ribs since it was pretty good. I also ordered a 1/3 of the smashed potatoes, 1/3 of the red potatoes, and also an order of sweet beans. Once we paid for it, we got our drinks and I tried lemonade which was ok, your typical lemonade, but the sweet tea was the S@#t! It tasted so good my brother and I got some to go, the flavor reminded me a Thai tea without the milk. We got our food pretty quick, less than 5 min. Now my brother and I both agreed, the one thing we wished was a  little bit better was that the food was hotter, it was warm and some of it was cold for the meats. Our tri tip didn't taste like it was smoked, all I could taste was the black pepper. It reminded me of just eating a prime rib basically and I wish it was more well done. The pulled parked had a little bit of smoke to it but it tasted more like chicken to me, I tried it with the Bama sauce, which was ok, the Memphis had a honey mustard sauce taste, the KC was pretty good when mixed with the 7. Thats one thing I do like about this place is the many different types of bbq sauces they bring in. I thought that was awesome to bring in flavors from the south and midwest. The ribs we got were ok, we got half a rack which is a pound of ribs, I didn't see the penetration of the smoke ring on it as much and I felt like the when you bit into it, it didn't come off the bone like it should. Each bit should have come off the bone clean. The smashed potatoes were warm but really good, lots of flavor from the bacon, cheese, sour cream, and chives. My brother had the red potatoes and he said they weren't very good so I couldn't tell you what they were like. The sweet beans were very good, again it was warm not hot, I loved the chunks of pork and the different types of beans in it. It had a nice mix of thick, chunky and beans. Again, some people may like their food warm, but I like my food hot, this is just my take on how food should be served. I would definitely try this place again and intend to try the other types of meats available. I do think the prices are a little high as our lunch meal cost around $60 for two people.  It could of been a lot less if we had just focused on maybe one meat. We were pretty full and had to take some of the food home so be careful when you order. The atmosphere is pretty nice also as there is a air balloon basket right in the center.  Bodacious Pig still gets my #1 but don't sleep on this place because I think they are cooking something special here and it will only get better with time.

You are always greeted by everyone when you walk in the door. A little to much. Erin was are server tonight, why so happy and really projected her voice. The food is very average. This was our second time eating here, sorry to say our last. The soup had way to many shells in it. Made it very hard to enjoy. Burger was just average burger. I could have gone across the street for a more enjoyable burger. 

Sorry Bobby you haven't hit the mark in the restaurant business.

Pizza and meatballs were very good.   Artichokes were too deeply fried.  Grilled calamari was good, but a ridiculously small portion even for tapas. Cocktails were expensive .   Fun, casual place to hang out if in the area.  Great view with outdoor seating.

Tonight for dinner. First time at any Pi for dinner. Upon arrival, 6 p.m., told of a 10-minute wait. It was less than that.

I was the only diner who had ever been to pi, so I had a lot of 'splainin' to do! I told all what salads and pies I'd had and how we shared large pies, then left everyone to their own devices.

I got the small blt salad ($6), as did my niece -- Romaine, red onion, banana peppers, bacon, cherry tomatoes, parmesan cheese, with peppercorn ranch dressing. Her husband got the small caprese ($6) -- fresh mozzarella with sliced campari tomatoes and fresh basil, drizzled with EVOO and balsamic vinegar. My sister got the small pi'oneer ($6) -- Romaine, Volpi salami, cherry tomatoes, artichoke hearts and kalamata olives with house-made creamy italian.

EVERYBODY stopped talking to devour these lucious salads. Ryan exclaimed enthusiastically to the freshness of the ingredients in the caprese, and I think he won that salad war. That caprese looked divine!

Katie and Ryan decided on the large deep-dish south side classico ($22) - mozzarella, sausage, mushrooms, green bell peppers and onions. Server asked if they wanted sauce, because the thin-crust doesn't have sauce. This being deep-dish, she suggested sauce. And she recommended the red sauce, so that's how they went. What's interesting is the sauce is ON TOP of the toppings.

My sister and I shared the large thin-crust east loop ($21) - mozzarella, pesto, chicken, mushrooms and onions.

Again, chatting stopped upon pie delivery. Everyone was astounded at the combination of tastes on these pies, including me, since I'd not had the east loop. That pesto was a major flavor success.

Service and delivery were deliriously beautiful, thanks to cheery and helpful Jona.

And diet Dr Pepper was available! Cheers for that!

Parking was situational, but traveling west on Delmar just before the Pageant, I espied a spot on the other side, so pulled an awesome U-ie in the middle of Delmar, stopping traffic just briefly. Then corked my minivan into a parallel spot the size of a VW. Got major props for that from everyone. Yea me!

When we left, the place was packed with waiters . . . and I mean PACKED! Glad we went early.

This food is about as Americanized and bland as you can get while still calling it Mexican food. I would not recommend this place if you are looking for a remotely authentic experience.
It would be a fine place to take kids though. It's cheap and family friendly. And for the adults, a strong margarita doesn't hurt.

Take some extra effort and find this place! It's down the stairs and definitely worth it. Six picnic tables and some bar seating. First impression is underwhelming and you might have your doubts, but sit down and start ordering food. Seafood is what they do best and pretty much takes up the whole menu. Everything was great. Shrimp, grouper and chicken tacos were good. Fish spread with some Cajun butter to top it off was an awesome surprise. Crab legs and shrimp were worth it. Service was fast and friendly. Menu is small but straight forward. Super glad we found this little place. Not crowded at all on a Saturday night.

Most likely one of the worst dining experiences in my life. Took 1hr 45mins to receive our food with multiple patrons who came in after us receiving there food before us. You would think that by sitting at the bar and only having a party of two that the service would be quicker.. but nope! Can't even blame covid conditions on this experience. It was purely a lack of customer service and inadequate capabilities from the staff that ended in cold food, no silverware, and not even a fully comped meal. We had to bring up the fact that we still hadn't received our food to our server twice before we finally received our cold food. The cause they gave.. they had given portions of our meal to other tables. Absolutely unacceptable. And then we didn't even receive the courtesy to speak to a manager. I will never dine at this establishment, EVER AGAIN. Absolute TRASH service!

Good service,  good salad.  Went on a Tuesday when they had a special all day salads for $7.  Also at this location if you are an LA fitness member you get 10% off on the regular price.

I normally go to the Conshy location but these guys are much more generous with toppings and dressing.  The guy at Conshy watches his workers like a hawk.

I really enjoy this resturaunt.  So much so that, I bought 8 yes 8 Groupons for this resturaunt.  For lunch I like the french onion soup and the Cibata Turkey sandwich and for dinner the mussel frites are excellent with any of the fish.

If you want some delicious tacos, this is your spot! I am always on the hunt for the best taco joint and I finally found it in Clearwater. The Oink Oink baby tacos (pulled pork) and loaded waffle fries were a huge hit within my party. We likes how the restaurant was low key in a sense you place your order inside and then they bring the food to you. No dealing with a server all night or waiting on the check. Can't wait to come back and try more!

I ordered BBQ Shrimp, also boiled shrimp and Craw-fish, and you cannot forget the oysters!! 
I love the ambiance and the friendly staff in this place, it's also a nice area for site seeing since it's in the great location. 
I would highly recommend this place I can't wait to go back to NOLA!!

They got a new chef and the new menu sucks. The end. Brennan's has unfortunately dropped off for me. The food was just terrible. The chicken was tough and honestly inedible. The oysters lacked flavor. The fries were the only thing people at my table enjoyed food wise. The drinks were good so if you are coming here to enjoy the courtyard and a drink then it might be worth your time.

I'll start with the positives...the food is always good and the server are really great at their jobs. The negatives...The floors near the sitting area closest to the kitchen are always greasy and slippery, The host at the front are not very friendly, They close at 10 or 11 PM but won't sit you if they don't want to take any more tables (regardless of what time it is), You have to make a reservation to get a guaranteed seat no matter how pack or not they are, some guest are super loud like loud to the point of you hearing their whole conversation ACROSS the restaurant (so if you are looking for a peaceful place to eat this is NOT it).

You really can't go wrong with cheap, fast Viet food for those nights you're too lazy (ahem, busy) to cook. While I prefer Nam Phuong in Philly, the taste difference isn't enough to make me cross the bridge every time I want Viet food.

Their spring rolls aren't as flavorful, but I think that had to do with me dipping it in peanut sauce rather than fish sauce (my preference). Will try asking for some next time. I especially liked how my bo luc lac dish came with veggies cooked with the meat, AND that it wasn't a crapload of rice with small pieces of meat.

Can't wait for winter to roll around so I can try the pho!

Adriana's is only open for lunch and has really good sandwiches. There really isn't a whole lot else to say about it. It's definitely worth visiting and it's awesome. You'll have to stand in line for awhile and if you're ordering for a group it can take awhile, but for the best Italian (and other) sandwiches in the city, its well worth it.

This was a beautiful little cafe find! I had the spinach crepe and my friend had the beet salad. We shared a scrumptious cheese plate. Portions were tremendous. This a little off the beaten path which can make a restful respite from the NOLA hub-bub but well worth it for delicious food at a more than reasonable price.

I'm a yuppie.  I fully admit it.  I drive a crossover SUV, yes, it's foreign.  I prefer to eat organic and local, too.  I visit the Farmer's Markets and get Green BEAN delivery.  I'm lucky to have an income that allows me to be choosy about the food that I eat.

That being said....Earth Fare, you out cha damn mind! 

Where in the world do they get some of these prices? Like I said I go to the Farmer's Market, I shop often at Whole Paycheck (er, foods) and buy a goodly amount at Trader Joe's as well.  There are very few items at Earth Fare that are similarly or priced for less than the other places I shop.  Example: over $4 for a bag of organic, frozen strawberries.  I get those at TJ or WF for $2.79.

Also, when I went in there, there wasn't a head of iceberg lettuce to be found.  I settled on some of the bulk greens, only to have them die 2 days after purchase (whomp, whomp).

Enough of the badgering, Earth Fare does have some redeeming qualities:
Now, I have signed up for their email and text coupons and some of them are really good and enough to get me in the store.  
The Carmel store carries beer and wine and they have a decent selection.
They carry almond flour in the bulk section, which I can't find anywhere else in Indy.
They have some new and different brands that I've not seen before.
The meat counter was staffed by a very nice and knowledgeable butcher.  The meat is good and they have a good selection of fresh wild caught fish, local/organic meats, etc.

So, while Earth Fare will certainly not be replacing any other store as my 'go to' market, they are close and I'll continue to check it out from time to time, especially if I have a great offer on my phone from them.

Fun place to sit, surrounded by giant aquarium filled with all different kinds of fish but food wasn't great. I mean it's in a mall so I wasn't expecting five star restaurant but the prices in comparison to other places in Nashville were pretty steep. My son loved his grilled salmon and my husband said his fettuccini with chicken was also good. However I had fish tacos that looked like they were left under the warmer for 20 minutes. Rice dried out and inedible and beans and sauce for tacos had a gross dried out film across the top.

The service was very slow. It was not busy at all and the server forgot our water and offer no apology. We order 12 pieces wings and took about 25 min. Again, no any sorry to our table. I gave two stars was because she refilled our water once but never return except the time when she brought our ticket. The food was ok. Won't be back unless have to.

We order more than usual because of the reviews. Didn't live up to the expectations of the other reviews. 

We order:
