Husband and I went for an early Valentine's Day dinner.   We have been hunting for a bottle of Pappy Van Winkle for the past six years and had only just found out that Woodwork had some.
He finally tasted it and said it was just how he imagined (so the hunt continues)... huge thrill for him.  
The drink menu was amazing - tons of cocktails and wine options.  
We shared the frites and brussel sprouts to start.  The frites were covered in parmesan and delicious; I could have eaten three orders.  
I ordered the ragu.  The thick pasta noodles were perfectly cooked and the sauce was flavorful.  My husband had the fried chicken.. by far the best he's ever had.  The slaw salad on the side was also really good.  

By far one of the best meals we've had.  
Drink prices and food are high but comparable to any other restaurant of this level (high!)

Solid breakfast food. I can definitely understand why there's a whole patio outside of people waiting to eat. We tried the breakfast sandwich with ham and shrimp and grits. Everything was delicious and well cooked in true diner fashion. The food was filling but not overly heavy or greasy. The breakfast sandwich was my favorite of the two. It had a really great combo of eggs, ham, avocado, and tomato. Substitute fruit for hash browns and you can even convince yourself that you're healthy! Would recommend this place over Sambo's.

It's very unfortunate, my husband & I were so looking forward to enjoying a beautiful day having drinks & a meal. We were celebrating my new nursing job in the area the plan was to celebrate with food & drinks. I picked this as my go to place. We walked in to inquire about seating and mask wearing etc. We were told to wait outside to be seated etc so they were aware we were outside in the sun in 80 something degree weather with masks on too. We waited and waited for a good 10 mins, no one came over to seat us. We left; I have to say very disappointed. It wasn't like it was crowded either. Well we enjoyed great burgers from Outback Sincerely, Tina & Derrick Floyd

A good snack cake can be hard since the trans fats ban but, in case you didn't know, Tastycake's bakery/factory is located right here in South Philly.  
So damn good when fresh these things are--I seem to have developed a nasty little Crimpet habit.

First time here tonight with my family and i must say that it's Delicious food that tastes authentic.
The family that owns this place runs this place and is doing a great service for all of us locals.
I'm very pleased to have good food so close to home.
 We will be back!

I gave this McDonald's a 5 star rating because I LOVE surprises. I drive through every morning at around 8:42 and I am out by 8:44:50. My very first morning I was just shocked at how quick they were, there was no drive through line and I got my $3.45 bag handed to me so quickly that it almost was like I never even got off the main road.   But then I got to work. And I opened my breakfast. Well, now it was my breakfast. It must have began as someone else's pick?
The first day I essentially got chocolate milk when I took a sip of my "small coffee with 1/2 and 1/2 and 1 Splenda." Yesterday I got no sausages in my burrito, so I allowed myself to have dessert! This morning, I was able to learn that I like black coffee (I think my half & half order was taken to mean black coffee mixture?) But anyways, it's the unknown that I crave. Shishito peppers on the menu? I'm in every.single.time. Remember those candy Airheads? I'll buy the white ones. White shark bites? You're not sharing my pack. The 90's puppy surprise, where OH MY I can't believe my eyes! I got 5 puppies inside! (You bet I did.) The unknown is a HIGH.

And what do I love more than a mystery? I'll solve that one for ya: It's BREAKFAST. I love breakfast (all types). And I don't love waiting in lines. I also like friendly people. So all in all, what more can I ask for? I've found myself a trick-or-treat-esque daily morning high where I can buy WHATEVER I want, excuse me, whatever I *get*, simply by digging through my change stash & performing one simple *POP* of my arm out the window. (Pro tip: leave arm extended out the window between checkpoints A (pay) and B (collect food) for ultimate efficiency).

*Sigh of morning happiness* I just feel like it can't go wrong. Everyday is a new, and the very worst is that one day I am given the opportunity to try a McGriddle.

We are new to town and this was the first time we were there.  Food is ok.  Sevice is nice.  Bathroom is  not great--no paper towels and very little TP when there with my 5 year old that always has to check out every bathroom...ughh.  The dining area was a bit cramped as well.
  The day we were there, it was 100 degrees and there was no AC, so it was not a very pleasant experience...  Our food was ok., but not as good as our favorite greek restaurant back home in Toledo, so I think we will keep looking....
The Pitas were the best I have had..so light and tender.  
The waitress was bending over backwards to compensate for the lack of AC, but the food was just ok other than the Pitas.
Might try again on a cooler day and see if our experience is better, but I think we will check other places out.

We were so excited when this place opened in the shopping center across. We ordered at 10:55 and that open at 11 AM. One cheese burger, one double stack,  one burger, fries, and a caprese grilled cheese. They told us 25 minutes, but I got there at 11:15 and it was ready. Everything was ice cold.  The fries were soft and soggy.  They gave us 3 cold single cheese burgers. The caprese grilled cheese REEKED of old rancid cooking oil and the bread was soggy and greasy. We called them three times and they didn't answer the phone, even though when I went to pick it up,  the place was empty. Had we gotten a response when we called back,  I never would have written this review.

-------Update-------

I am happy to say this place has greatly improved! !! We gave it another try and our second experience was excellent! This is now one of our favorite lunch spots!
Great food, amazing service and so much fun. Great place to hang with friends. It's super clean and friendly!

Really good food, super tasty! The chef here is top notch! An unexpected environment, but worth a try if you are dining in the Wash Square area! A limited menu at this point, but high hopes this place takes off!

Great Service with good food! Went for breakfast with my wife and college-aged daughter. The menu is quite varied. My daughter and I chose the Mardi Gras, hers was the omlete, mine was the scramble. Maybe the best scramble I've ever had. Mine had crawfish, shrimp and bacon. They do not skimp on the ingredients. Every bite had one of those ingredients. Really good. My daughter liked her omelette version and my wife enjoyed her avacado/salmon toast as well. Mine came with an English Muffin and potatoes, both okay. Would have given 5 stars except for the Orange Juice, which was listed as "fresh squeezed" on the menu and was far from that. What does get 5+ stars was the service, CB was our outstanding waitress and Michelle was the manager. Would go back just to be served by CB again. Give it a try.

So for 3 Friday's in a row we have dined and dined well with a superstar of a server in Victor in the cozy bar area and the food has been prepared picture perfect. Still not sure how diners can bring kids(noisy and unruly kids at that) into a bar area. If I can't carry my handgun in a bar area you shouldn't bring kids into a bar area but that's a whole different subject. My beautiful wife and I start with wine, breadsticks and a bowl of Alfredo sauce that is nothing short of
Liquid crack rock addicting. I envision them serving it by the glass one day. Ha ha. I highly recommend the chicken and shrimp Carbonarra. Just an excellent pasta dish. Warning! Be prepared to be wheeled out in a pasta and breadstick coma with a full belly of fine italian fare. We also highly recommend our server Victor who tends graciously to your every dining and drinking need. It's been a great 3 weeks of italian atmosphere and food and hope to continue our streak.  MANGIA !!
Tasted good but I got food poisoning. I'll spare the details but while the music is fun and the staff is nice, don't get the crab.

Dinner: SUNDAY ROAST

Any other time: gotta do TEA TIME

Dinner:
Came here for Valentine's Day and had an amazing experience. The oysters were slacking on the meat so definitely don't recommend those but the cheese platter is immaculate; the homemade crackers/biscuits, the chutney is phenom and the cheese obviously great.
My boyfriend and I shared the Sunday Roast which had amazing flavors; the horseradish butter was to die for. The yorkshire pudding was baked perfectly. I definitely recommend medium rare, medium was a bit tough.
Everything was perfect, I have nothing bad to say.

Tea time:
Came here with some girlfriends in the afternoon, got the 3 tiers and some teas to sample. It was so fun eating finger sandwiches and little pastries while drinking tea. Definitely recommend for the experience as well as the phenomenal finger foods

Went there last night for my son and my birthday dinner (our birthdays are a day apart).  Really great service and delicious, healthy food.  Everyone in my group was very impressed. I was given a choice of complimentary desserts (cheesecake, sopapillas, or deep-fried ice cream).   I had the cheesecake and my son had the deep-fried ice cream and they were both incredible. If you were in the Sparks area maybe give this family owned place a try!
Dirty...dirty...dirty! Stay away from this location. Get your Popeyes somewhere else. Posted health score of 86....but I'd say it needed a 40.

They don't mess around on the portions, our half order of the stuffed french toast could have fed a family of four.

I really enjoyed my huevos rancheros. They weren't really huevos rancheros but their take on the classic was really tasty nonetheless. Rather than soft tortillas with rachero sauce and over easy eggs it was more like an egg tostada thing and it was great.

Their regular coffee is bomb also.
Everything about this restaurant was just okay. There wasn't any wow factor. The service was just okay, wasn't bad okay. All they down to the steak, it was all just okay.

I always get great service and great tasting tacos when I go here.  The food is great the drinks are called the seats the comfy and there's free Wi-Fi and sports on television, greet place for trivia too.

Great no frills place for ribs. The ribs are some of the best in the area. We ordered a rack and it barely fit into the box. Lots of sauce I would describe as Alabama style.  Right across the street for Barley Moe Brewery.
Absolutely loved I Love Sushi! Went twice while in town. The rolls were incredible fresh. The service was excellent. Highly recommend the chicken teriyaki and shrimp tempura bento box!

I love the atmosphere and the mug re-fill program. and the fact that it's next to Backyard Bowls. Unfortunately the coffee just isn't up to par with any of the incredible coffee shops around town. When I have a good cup of coffee, each sip is a treasure in its own. I found the coffee to be a bit thin and burnt, and I didn't get that nice whole-body warm feeling; rather, an "off" kind of zippiness that left me not satiated. But if you are more concerned with atmosphere and "free" refills than quality, this is a great spot. I almost feel bad writing this review - I'm sure there was a time when the coffee here would have been considered top notch. But we've come a long way here in 2020!

My son is in the icu at renown and I needed comfort food, that delivered.  Who would have ever thought of a place that serves only Mac and Cheese?  I need to thank them personally for it. 

The menu is rather small, which means not being overwhelmed with suggestions. Which when all you want to do is eat your feelings is good. I went with the smoked Mac and cheese with some chicken, and order of toasted ravioli and a slice of chocolate cake.  I have so much food left over that I didn't even have to bother with ordering a dinner.  One think I did opt in on was the extra sauce, do this. It will take your food journey one step beyond, and you deserve this. The mac and cheese was so full of cheese that it was stringy. The toasted ravioli arrived at the hospital still crunchy and the cake..... wow! 

I will be trying this again one day. When we are not hospital bound.

Very cute place. LOVE the atmosphere. Look behind the bar where the chefs cook in front of everyone with fresh ingredients. Also, look at the pastries at the counter near the door when you come in - you can order those from your table but they aren't on the menu. In fact what we wanted (eggs, bacon & toast) wasn't on the menu but our server said it was called "the little bear" and it just didn't fit. I feel like they will work with you to have the meal you'd like! Get the bottomless coffee, it's just as good as the chemex or others, cheaper & bottomless. Although, after our chemex coffee, she topped us off with bottomless. 

Server was super laid back. Maybe a little too much, as we didn't get our coffee for a while & didn't have spoons for a while either. Stirred coffee with a knife ;)

Went with a friend, but the hubs wants to go and try the tea soaked chicken. So we'll be back!

i have been buying cakes from Anne for almost 10 years.  Her Chocolate Zucchini Cake is something from the gods.  A moist masterpiece of chocolate and creamy white frosting.  Her Strawberry cake tastes like it was just picked yesterday.

Anne is simply awesome.  Super friendly. She loves what she does and her positive attitude is intoxicating.  She is an incredible part of the Nashville foodie scene.

Let them eat cake!  The whole thing.  Anne only does wholesale and whole cakes.  So grab a gallon of Hatcher Family milk and a fork.  

Her muffins are unreal as well.  The lemon muffin, is my favorite, for sure.
Completely went downhill! New owners? The staff seems miserable now, the food tastes different - my last order here was so disappointing I'll probably never come back.

Found this little spot leaving Reno.  Getting to the location from Boomtown was a bit iffy.  There is a narrow and windy road that takes you to the town below.

The building is a small tavern style.  As you come in,  you are greeted immediately with smiles.  While waiting to be seated, I already notice one of the employees preparing a batch of fresh squeezed orange juice.  That's a big plus! 

The menu is simple; enough items to select from.  At the top of the menu, it says entrees come with complimentary mimosas. Another big plus! 

I ordered the chicken fried steak and the portions are big.  I couldn't possibly finish my serving and didn't have enough room to order desert.  Needless to say, completely enjoyed my meal.  They fried the steak perfectly well.  Crispy on the outside and the cut of cubed steak was enough that it did t come out dry.  The country gravy was thick and very flavorful.  

I will definitely come again and would recommend this place.

Visiting from Virginia and my wife and I happed to find this great French cafe. We have come back every day both for coffee and pastry early and amazing sandwiches for lunch. A real found treasure. Wish we had one in Virginia Beach.

one of my favorite brunch places in sb but i've found that it can be hit or miss with the service. it can get a bit busy on the weekends so i recommend making a reservation online. my favorite things to get here are the shrimp & grits, cinnamon roll, and the banana chocolate croissant. i really like how all of their ingredients are locally sourced and organic. i've had servers here that were a bit slow, which is surprising because there is almost always a wait. the ambiance of the place is nice and i think they are expanding into more indoor seating which is a plus!

Best Asian style noodles I've ever had! Went there with my family and we were all in love. The hand drawn noodles with peanut sauce was amazing and if you get any soup please make sure to add the marinated egg. Can't go wrong...

Fun and eclectic place with plenty of outdoor seating and occasional entertainment. Wings and pub food very good. Great bar atmosphere also. One negative is the parking. There isn't much, especially true if your handicapped

AMAZING Italian restaurant in every way possible!

Beautiful interior - first floor is a coffee / bar / grocery store with interesting and super cool things from Italy - condiments and sauces, pastas, chocolates, sweets, snacks, coffee, etc - wish I can buy everything here! Upstairs is an incredibly beautiful dining area with a retro vibe. The skylight adds to the whole Mediterranean charm and you can watch the scrumptious food made in an open kitchen. 

Now on to the food - WOWOWOW!!!

First of all, in addition to the already well-diverse regular menu, they have a special menu that changes every WEEK to celebrate the 52 cities of Italy! It was Elba when we went - so of course we had to find out what this amazing Tuscany city has to offer!

All the dishes were just DELISH!!! Flavorful and yet all the ingredients shined through! It was my first time having gelato that accompanied savory dishes and I was totally blown away!!! The gelato was savory with hint of sweetness and the gelato texture added a phenomenal sensation to the dish - just when I thought gelato couldn't get any better, it did!!!

And of course we had to get the famous gelato as well - again very good, even the wafer was delightfully crunchy and made a good match with the gelato.

Service was super friendly too- our waiter was so nice and patient and explained everything on the menu to us. Very attentive throughout the meal.
This place rocks, the staff is friendly and the Thai food is surely the best in south county. My suggestion is the spicy basil, pork or chicken at a 2.

6 of us went here for lunch. We ordered our food and a couple people upgraded the sides to salads for $4. The salad was a small ramekin of lettuce with no toppings or dressing.  We played a game of uno we didn't play any other games and we each got a $5 charge for playing a game. I know it says on the menu they will charge you but I think they should wave this fee if you order food and drinks.  My chicken on my Cesar was dry with no seasoning and the tomato soup was most likely out of a can.  The grilled cheese was good but for the prices I could have a much nicer meal. We love the concept however we payed $30 for a game of uno.  We left very upset and disappointed.  Might be fun for a date night but definitely a rip off.

I ordered two pizzas for delivery and the order got screwed up through the online system. My pepperoni/ sausage was registered as a cheese. The delivery was 30+ minutes late but when calling them, they offered to refund me on my credit card or via store credit. I chose credit card. After we enjoyed the pizza, there was a knock on our door. Someone from New Wayne was standing there and they told me their system was down and drove back to refund me in cash to make it right. 

The pizza was good but the customer service was even better!
Good food but would like the customer service to be improved : faster and to be more accurate

Great lunch spot. We had the crab soup was it was very good. The server worked really hard, but it seemed that they were short on staff. Our Triple P sandwich took a while to come out, but it was great. The bread was the highlight.
The pickle bar is great, we totally eat a bunch of pickled peppers, dill pickle and regular pickles. 

Just one thing, that is my personal pet peeve, why stairofoam cups? 
They are bad for you (http://www.drweil.com/drw/u/QAA401095/Is-Styrofoam-Safe.html) and bad for the environment (http://greenliving.lovetoknow.com/How_Styrofoam_is_Bad_for_the_Environment).

My husband and me have yet to make it to the lunch buffet. I have read some reviews that said the service was not good for supper. That has not bee the case twice now. We love the service, prices, authentic food, and clean restaurant. What a treat to eat here.

Okay we have been here before so we know how it works and we know we like it.  After a long day in Boise the wife and I needed a quiet place to relax and have some wine.  We saw what was on tap at the bar and decided to just go for glass service and not the self serve portion.  We found our big comfy chairs and the server came over right away.  I ordered the Chardonnay and the wife chose the Viognier.  Both were to our liking and we settled in.  It was warm inside and cozy.  I really like this place.  Now some will say it's pricy but the prices are in line with any bar.....and you can try a lot of different wines before choosing a full pour.   Come in.....try it out.   It's a nice addition to Boise

OLIVE Garden I love this place my soup, more soup than Zuppa Toscana, My date plates came out smelling like dog, Which is really nasty I worked here before so I expected way more out of this place haven't dined here for about 3 months but it was date night and it was time to choose ! Maggie she was a great sever to start the kitchen I feel was rushing orders which is not cool, an to take it back when we was greeted at the door the sever didn't ask us would we like a booth or a table she just brung us and a crowed area and sat us an the middle of a lot of loud guest not there fault but I feel like this place rushed us and they don't take there time Maggie did bring me out a great soup we sat in another room which was great Food was awesome after that Maggie apologized for all the things that's did occur other than the list of those things Maggie made our experience special thank you Maggie but sorry we will not return to a Olive Garden for a very long time .

Heyyy Yelpers,

My babe thought my post wouldn't be complete if I just added a picture of my Smoked Wings and not the St. Louis Ribs. It's true. I can't front on the ribs cause' they're pork and I don't eat it. However, I heard they sell beef ribs on Saturday's....You know I'm there! Yelp!

Anyways....Everyone who had something from Adam's Rib & Grille tonight enjoyed the food too **** much lol

Do you wonder how much they enjoyed the food?  

I'll tell it....(lol)...The food was so good...everyone's sleep, including  my NEIGHBOR. Yes, I like my neighbor! She's alright with me. I got her a platter too. 

I know what you're thinking...why I'm not sleep? I'm a swallow from being there, but if I didn't write this review.........you wouldn't be able to prepare to go there tomorrow. So, you're welcome!!!!! Lol

Anyways, get yourself what I call "THE SPECIAL" AKA 
Three Meats + 2 Sides during your initial visit or every time you go! Each platter is served with a cornbread muffin. The many choices are as follows:

Meats: St. Louis Ribs, Smoked Chicken Wings, Pulled Pork, Pulled Chicken, Beef Brisket, Fish and Smoked BBQ 1/4 Leg Chicken

Sides: Collard Greens, Green Beans, Potato Salad, Macaroni and Cheese, Candied Yams, Baked Beans, Coleslaw and Fries

Run there.
Walk there.
Catch a bus.
Catch an Uber/Lyft.
Catch a train.
Ride a bike.
Ask for a ride (just not from my neighbor. She's My friend hahahahahaha)
Fly there.
Row a Boat...quickly down Philadelphia Pike lol

JUST DO IT and compliment the Chef.

Please don't forget to TIP..........

Peace and Chicken Wing Grease,

Food Junkie J

average thai restaurant.  if anyone knows of any better ones please do share bc I am a big fan of thai food.  ive been to thailand, and cant seem to find a place in philly that serves authentic  (or close to)  thai food.

i have been here twice, and the first time I enjoyed my entree, but the second time it was a disappointment.   The first time I went I had the green curry - good flavor, and the right amount of spice, but everything else ive tasted has been overall subpar:  

Appetizers-
-spring rolls- 
-isan style pork sausage- ok
-tom yum soup- lacks flavor, broth is thin and just not right
-chicken satay- the chicken was slightly overcooked but the sauce was pretty good

Entrees
-snapper falling in love- did not fall in love w this dish, lacked seasoning
-fish w/ garlic and sweet chili sauce (i thnk we had the snapper)- the fish was cooked right, but the taste was off.  

Drinks
thai iced tea- good!


I love the area the restaurant is in, and the service is really good, but I cannot get myself to go for a third time after my second experience.  If you do go, do try the curry, it was what I think is the best tasting dish on the menu (it is pretty good!)

Call me a snob, but I wasn't expecting a good seafood place in the mid west. The Bristol serves mostly fish in a swank, steak house atmosphere. You're surrounded by lots of dark wood and upholstered booths. Service is friendly and attentive. 
 
My coworkers and I ordered the fried calamari as an appetizer (a yelp check in free special). It came with fried slices of jalapeño, tiny fried carrots (actually I'm not totally sure what the thin orange things were.) and two dipping sauces. It was good. 

I like to drink wine with my seafood. Bristol offers a lot of their wines by the glass at an affordable price (about $7) 

For my entree I had the crab cakes with roasted potatoes and asparagus on the side. The crab cakes were grilled not fried, and had a soft texture with a lot if meat. 

Overall a nice, though expensive, dinner. I'm not sure I would be a regular if I was paying the bill, but I certainly enjoyed my crab cakes.

My favorite place to go for soul food hands down!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Amazing food every time and 2/3 times was take out. The tea taste like they use honey which is amazing, not positive but it is goooooddd! The waffle also has a unique flavor to it that stands out!!! 
The chicken and waffles is one of my favorites! New to reno but I'll be by at least once a week!

We visited Rise'n Roll knowing about their very much loved and praised caramel cinnamon donuts aka "crack" donuts. While the line was long, it did seem to move fairly fast. And there's much to look at and browse for while waiting for your turn - like cinnamon rolls, noodles, jams, cheeses, and more!  

We did enjoy the donuts we got, but I was slightly disappointed that there weren't more options for kids. The only ones with sprinkles had a caramel icing, and the ones with plain chocolate icing had a filling.  So my kids didn't take more than 2 bites of either and they don't like the caramel cinnamon so this spot might just be more for grownups!

Nice vibe... good Italian food.  The wife always gets something different, but I always gravitate to the cannelloni.  Not a huge wine list, but really good selections.  We're not dessert people, but we have been tempted once or twice.  Still enjoy an after dinner espresso (served with a lemon twist, of course).  The place is small enough to get good personal service.  There is not a bad table in the whole place.  I think it's the same management as Il Bel Lago in Creve Couer.  We always get Carmelo... he makes us feel welcome and always give good advice on what's good.
Fast and friendly service keeps me coming in to pick up dinner. Falafel is a great treat! Fresh and healthy Greek salad is a must. I love the chicken gyros!

When it first opened up It was AWESOME! Now not so much WHAT HAPPEN! I ordered and asked for it to be cooked medium I said "I know some people don't like their meat pink but I'm ok with it". I got it to the table and it was like a hockey puck, and they changed the potatoes. Potatoes, used to be when they first opened at this store, were liked mini potato wedges (awesome) now their like a thick French fry ( under done and not crispy). I gave them a second chance after this and it was the same. Sad right down the street from my home. won't go again waste of money.

Awful service, and bland food!!! We wanted to order chicken salad, but they said they ran out. A few mins later, the owner came in with bags of rotisserie chickens from Shop Rite!! Now we know, it's not homemade chicken!!! What a joke!
One can not say enough good things about the Ale.   From the atmosphere to the drinks to the food (the wings and pizza!!)  to their incredible staff -  this is the place to go!!

The first place I have visited in Philly. It is massive and events, special exhibitions are going on. 
First time we went there to watch " Korean " special exhibition. We actually booked the restaurant there to try their Korean themed tasting menu. Food was Asian fusion dish which wasn't too refreshing to us anymore but the venue was pretty and we enjoyed our meal. 

The museum was very impressive. They have amazing art as much as other major museums in other city and definitely less crowded than them. You get out of it so much. My mom is artist and she said it was amazing and had wonderful time with me. I am glad I got to check out and I do know I will have to make regular visit to this place.
Love the atmosphere at New World. Sit outside, enjoy a live band and relax. The pizza was great and there is a fantastic beer selection. Check it out!
Both times great food and beer. Burgers are phenomenal but not big at all :( beers are flavorful!

This place is so cool! We came here after a work meeting with some out of town co workers and had the best time. Drinks, food, and karaoke! The karaoke room is $20 for 30 minutes but if you're with a group it's worth every penny! The service was AMAZING! Our server Brian was on point all night and made sure we had everything we needed. The food was better than expected. I had the Lobster Ravioli and it was different than expected but so so good! Highly recommend this place!

I ordered sushi and sukiyaki beef, they were horrible, sushi wasn't fresh and tasted awful, rice in sukiyaki tasted like it was cooked a week ago.  Horrible experience, will never eat Edo Japan  food again.

All of us in the office were craving carbs, so we opted for the best sandwich shop in Reno, of course! The four of us all tried a different sandwich, and everyone was super satisfied. The sourdough here is crave-able, and they have tasty sauces that really complete the flavor profiles of all their high quality proteins. Admittedly, even the Green Acres (vegetarian sandwich) looked too good not to try, in spite of the carnivore in me. We were all working, but each of us really wanted a 10 Torr... I guess I'll have to come back on a weekend for that lavender lemonade my boss can't stop talking about.

I tried their proprietary dessert bar, the dream bar, and that thing, paired with a glass of milk, would alone be worth a trip here.

Keep of the awesome work, Urban Deli! Reno loves you!

Thai Thani has really gone downhill over the years. My last Chicken Pad Thai there was completely dry and flavorless. I like the waiters and bartenders there, but my experience with their dishes has not been great in quite some time.

Ordered a family diner which is supposed to include a whole chicken, beans and rice.  On more than one occasion I got home and opened the box to find one breast and a mix of thighs, legs and what appeared to be a back.  The chicken is often over salted and over cooked.  The yellow rice is the worst I have ever had.  How in the world can you mess up rice?  The beans often are mostly liquid and the beans are missing.  The last time it happened I called  800 number (corporate headquarters) on the receipt and was advised that someone from the Brandon restaurant would call me.  Ronnie (not sure since I couldn't understand his message) called and advised me to come back to the drive through and my entire meal would be replaced.  I went today and gave them my name but was advised they could not replace the meal.  Ok, I guess you can lose a customer forever over a $12.00 chicken meal and that is fine by me.  No great loss for me.

The good: My falafel burger wrapped in lettuce was REALLY good. I don't even really like burgers, it was damn good. Everyone at our table of 8 enjoyed what they had. They can cook good food. 

The bad: The place was overly crowded and very loud. Our server was obviously overwhelmed. The worst part was they started packing up our things and  seemed visibly annoyed that we hung around for a few minutes after.

Haven't been here in over 5 years saw a groupon and thought it would be a good excuse to go back. Big mistake! Margaritas were a terrible pre-made mix with zero tequila (mad at myself for not sending back and at least getting a beer).  Service was non-existent. I asked what flavor margirtats they had and the waiters reply was "what do you want."After an awkward pause I replied "blood orange" and he said he never heard of it. Place was dead empty at 8 on a Saturday night ( it was a sign) and it took forever to get two drinks. Guacamole was bland and not fresh. Burrito was terrible... It was what you got in the cafeteria at college when they had Mexican night. Let me not forget to mention the filthy dirty bathrooms!!! And the dirty menus!! Overall poor service, bad drinks, cheap food and dirty  restaurant . Too many better GOOD Mexican choices in the city for me to ever go back here!
My partner and I can never get enough of this place!  The only thing I want to say about Suzy Wong's is BBQ pork spring rolls!!!

The way this restaurant is set up was efficient and different and fun. We went for breakfast and was told to order debre that might not of been the best choice because my friend ordered a ham omelette and it was picture perfect. My husband ordered eggs and ham and the ham was to die for. The biscuits with the raspberry jelly and the muffin and coffee couldn't be beat and the pricing was normal. I loved it there!!!

Last night was our first visit to Mi Linh after hearing so much about it.  In short, it was terrific and lived up to all of the expectations we had.  The food was fresh, full of flavor and arrived piping hot.  The best Vietnamese we've had in St. Louis.  The people and the service were outstanding.  Very warm and welcoming.  The prices are very reasonable.  A great value and we will definitely make this one of our frequent dining spots going forward!

Honestly, pizza is mediocre at best. Not worth the lactose intolerant nightmare I'll face later. However not the worse.

Started off with the cheese bread. It was honestly bland and the marina sauce that came with it didn't do much to salvage it.

As for the pizza, it looks better than it tastes. It was just overall really doughy and lacked that wow factor for me. There are other pizza places out there better than Cappy's. 

Wouldn't recommend this place but it's definitely not the worst and I would come here if all other pizza places were closed lol. As for the service, my waiter was super attentive and kind and I have no complaints in how long the food took. Only about 15 minutes.
The best thing we have done in NOLA. Ship is a fun, smooth ride with good drinks & food. The tour guide Charles is amazing. Just hearing his presentation is worth every penny.

We came to Blue with another couple in our neighborhood for a date night. We made the right choice; the atmosphere was awesome, the drinks were delicious, and the sushi was stellar. We got there in time for their happy hour, so our meal was very affordable. We got a pretty variety of rolls to sample the menu. Cabo, Roja, Pretty in Pink, Hawaiian, Lion King (I think that's right). Regardless if I got them all right or not, they were all outstanding, try them all!! What I appreciated the most was the wide variety of sushi rolls. Oftentimes, when you go to a sushi restaurant, they only have a small selection of "specialty" rolls; not the case at Blue. 
The atmosphere was very sleek and stylish, great place for a night out without kids. It's inside the Ironworks building, so we ended up "bar hopping" around the building, which was great cause there are so many great spots. We'll be back soon for sure, and highly recommend!

We tried this place today for the first time.  Great diner breakfast and reasonable prices. Hash browns and home fries.  Now home fries are ok, but hash browns are the best. I had a redneck Benedict and the poached eggs were perfect. The dining room was clean and bright with Route 66 decor. Our waitress was great. She was quick, informed, funny and helpful.  No empty coffee cup!  I saw fried chicken on their special menu. We need to try this too
Food's always great everytime we dine. Live the multitude of choices on the specials menu. Service is a little slow.

Used to be a regular well almost bc of the reasonable prices and decent food. Well today I went as a party of 5 which the 5th person was my two year old and they charged us automatic gratuity On the bill on top of the tax. Needless to say I won't be back for a while. The food was ok but the prices aren't worth the food. I'd rather go to rock and sake and pay the 90$ plus bill.

It's not pulp fiction, Yellow Belly, a hometown Santa Barbara casual restaurant actually serves a delicious Royale with Cheese! I also recommend their outstanding grilled cheese with creamy tomato basil soup. 

The ambiance is comfortable, with two outdoor seating areas, the friendly wait staff is genuinely, pleasant and impressively attentive. 

Located in a quiet neighborhood, it's no surprise Yellow Belly is popular and often bustling with the local residents, enjoying one of the best menus Santa Barbara has to offer.
Decent food, nice atmosphere but the service is usually slow. Word of advice order as soon as your server comes to the table or it will be awhile before you see them again.

Saddened to write this review because the food here is really good but it is handled in a very unsanitary manner. I have been there several times since they opened and the past few times I've been there I've seen the employees mishandling the food. This last time the  guy with curly hair that wears a bun was wearing gloves at the  cash register. The customer in front of us was having trouble with his card so he grabbed his card with the same gloves. He then  checked us out, touched his face, then went back to preparing food with the same gloves on. I was really put off by this behavior. I wouldn't have been as  disgusted if he was simply spooning food into  plates but he was actually handling the food with his gloves. Unfortunately this is not an isolated incident, on another occasion one of the girls who was preparing food came to the register  to check us out. She took her gloves off and stuffed them
In her sweater pocket and when she was done took them out put them back on and went on to prepare food again. I really dislike the idea of my food being  prepared with contaminated gloves so sadly I will not be returning which is a shame because as I  mentioned the food is good but the employees need better training.

Place is fantastic. The broth is very thick and meaty. the noodles has a good texture. the meats were fresh and tender. The buns, oh boy. those are delicious too. just a very tasty mix of meats and seasoning on a fluffy bread.

Very friendly staff helpful too!!  Delicious food!!!!

The chicken shrwarma is delicious awesome kufta and steak was tender
Great meals, great service, great presentation.  Top quality food at inexpensive prices.  what more could you ask for?
I have tried a different dish every time I've come here and I've NEVER been disappointed.  Way to go Metro Diner!

Patois is a super cute, local restaurant located in the heart of Uptown. I have been meaning to come here for years, so restaurant week 2021 provided a great excuse to finally go. We did the pre-fixe menu and got the gumbo, salmon beignets, pork chop, and rice pudding. The gumbo and beignets were excellent. The pork chop was super flavorful and came with great sides. I ate the leftovers for lunch the next day and they were just as good then. The rice pudding dessert was very light and refreshing for a hot summer night. The frozen watermelon drink was exceptional and I am usually not a big frozen drink person. I went on a Thursday night and it was busy, so I definitely recommend making a reservation.
Super slow service. Had to repeatedly ask for drink refills. I would not go there again just because of the poor service

This was the worst pizza I ever had, flavorless with a cardboard crust.  The garlic knots got hard as they cooled, as if they had been microwaved too long.  I would definitely not recommend this place if you have a craving for good pizza or garlic knots.

Wow....I didn't have high expectations, I thought Fried Chicken is Fried Chicken wherever you go,  Boy...am I wrong, their Chicken is so moist, so fresh, nice & hot out of the fryer, built in Spicy flavour, not oily, love their Mac & Cheeeese, a short walk from Nordstrom Rack
Fantastic restaurant with fantastic staff. Very friendly and accommodating for a special event. Everyone loved the food and they were on top of everything.

Went for lunch and to celebrate my sister's birthday. Everything we ordered was amazing; salmon flatbread, Italian flatbread, cheeseburger, tomato soup, salted caramel eclair, and mango creme brûlée. Not sure what all the hate on other reviews is about. Place is a little noisy, but in a fun way. And the setting couldn't be more beautiful. Great use of a historic building.

It's no wonder this place is empty- the employees have the music turned up so loud that I can't hold a conversation at the table. Obnoxiously loud music & overpriced $4.09 hamburgers will keep me away.

Excellent BBQ.  Found this place on yelp on my phone on the drive home to St. Louis  from Atlanta. They have a drive through, which was perfect (though the massive pulled pork sandwich was hard to eat in the car).  Spicy BBQ sauce was great too. Cole slaw on the sandwich was a new thing for me.  But very good. Don't knock it till you try it. 

UPDATE: the owner just sent me a thank you note for my review!  Just for that I'm upping my review to 5 stars. Looking forward to hitting up Jack's next time I'm in Nashville!
Phenomenal food, service, and expansive menu. Spectacular establishment, highly recommend.

Delicious pastrami at a reasonable price! Food was definitely worth the wait. Lots of options for chips too!

Nice seating outdoors. Surprisingly nice restroom available outdoors as well!

Not sure why the rating was going down. Still love the ramen, though not much on the service. The price went up by a lot too compared to last time we came (6 months ago).

Will definitely come back.

Cheap and delicious banh mis. Their bread is delicious and has the perfect crunch to it. Super small shop, so once you order they do have a sign that request you wait outside. I recommend calling ahead to place your order. They do have a special of buy 5 banh mis, get 1 free (great deal). I typically get their Vietnamese ham hoagie and it's delicious. It's pretty big and overall such a great value. The pate and their bread really makes it something special. Their fried spring rolls are pretty great too. Remember to bring cash since they don't accept card. They don't really have definitive hours listed, but when I went on a Friday they said they close at 7pm.

Really wanted a good, comforting (aka fried) roll with eel tonight.  Was recommended the spicy scallop tempura roll and it did not disappoint.  I didn't have time to sit down and eat so I got that, along with an eel avocado roll to go.  Prices weren't bad ($16 for both) and the rolls were well-prepared and tasty.  It wasn't very spicy but I didn't mind.  The service was very friendly and fast.  Will be back.
The best vegetarian restaurant in Edmonton, hands down. Awesome food, nice and clean inside, pricing has creeped up a bit with portion sizes slowly coming down, but still remains on top. Love it!

Very comfortable dining room, prompt service and varied menu.  Out of Pinot Grigio early Friday night, settled for a Sapporo. Combination plate of sushi, sashimi and a roll was fresh, tender, and garnished attractively. Will be back.

This was my favorite restaurant in Reno. Everything always had a great mix of flavors and I was excited to try the daily specials. Sadly, they have a new executive chef and things are not the same. The new menu claims a few of the old staples, however they were obviously something different. The food was ok, although be warned the hanger steak for $14 only had two small pieces of meat. After my last visit I knew something was off and so I came home and tried to google if they had a new owner. Our waiter confirmed today that they have a new executive chef. We will probably still eat here once in a while but it's not the same.

I like City Barbeque. I have had their meet sampler, ribs,  green beans, corn side, baked beans, and banana pudding. My favorites are beef brisket and pulled pork and green beans even though the beans are not fresh. The sauces are on the side like some southern restaurants.

This has a always been one of my favorite restaurants. I'm surprised it doesn't get better reviews. I visited here multiple times over the years (philly and AC) I've always had a great time and wonderful service. The staff is very kind and friendly. The food is delicious! I Recently had the lunch salmon was cooked to perfection - crispy on the outside but tender inside. I ordered a side of plaintains and they were best I've ever had! I also really enjoyed the guacamole and plantain chip appetizer but it could've been bigger. The best part about this restaurant, however, it's definitely the ambience. Absolutely love it here feel like I'm on vacation! Atmosphere really takes you to old Havana. I highly recommend this place and will def be back!

SO GOOD!!!!!!!! 

So as Tacos go in general you have to really do a bad job for me to not like them... However the staff here pushed this to a 5 star review. I called for take out on a Friday night. My friend have given me her order perfectly but I was unsure of so many things when I called. The guy on the phone was really nice, told me a few suggestions and even had me knock one thing off the order because he didn't want me to overspend/over order and not think it was good value. 

When I got there they went over all the choices with me, gave me a bunch of extra sauces to try and even wrote a recommendation on the togo menu for next time. 

All of that before I even ate!!! I had three different tacos, pork al pastor, carne asada and chicken. They were SO big! They definitely didn't skimp on the portions and I would suggest two to any person of a normal hunger level. I ended up having to use my fork and eat the filling on the chicken taco because I just didn't have any room left. We also split the queso and guac and those vanished pretty quickly.

Unfortunately I am not a big fish fan and that is their MAIN featured dish, however my friend had them and said I could add to my review that they were the best thing she had ever had in the taco category and wanted to try other things on the menu but couldn't ever justify not ordering them. If that isn't a glowing review, I don't know what is!

Worst service and food I've ever had. The bartender was rude and very slow. It was a Saturday at about noon with 8 or so people at the bar and it took 20 min before I could order food. Then when I got my food it was very bad. I ordered the shrimp po' boy and the bread was a French baguette that was stale and hard as a rock, the fries were just as hard, and the food didn't even taste good. I will never come back here.

Good, but I do not think that this location makes their cupcakes fresh every day. These look like they are a day old and shipped from The NY store every day or something. Never the less, Hubby and I ordered the boston cream, apple crumb, princess and whatever flavor the Samoa Girl Scout cookie one is. Samoa and Boston cream were my favs. Hubby really liked the apple crumb. We got a sugar cookie for
The kid and gave him half of it. I'll be back, but early in the am to see if the quality is any better
Listen to the music coming from across the street and get the shrimp creole!! Great place to take a break and sit upstairs on the outdoor seating. Will definitely come back.

This was one of my favorite restaurants - with an extensive menu, great service, and great food. 
I think it's changed hands or it's changed chefs. My last visit was disappointing - dishes that I'd long ordered here that were always prepared to perfection were quite different - even the presentation which had remained the same for years was different. The service alone remained the same - very attentive waiters - but the food was not the same. 

I hope this was a down night - this was a deservedly popular restaurant for many years.
So glad they are open again! We go here frequently and have had various pizzas...they're all good! It's a favorite place to go for our family. It's lovely in the warmer months to sit on the patio. :)

We had dinner here for the first time on New Year's Eve. Great location and ambiance. There was an area set apart for a private party. A couple actually got engaged at dinner while we were there. Cocktails were inventive. Wine list was ok. We got the "chef's tasting menu" even tho when i called to ask about it (as it says on the online menu), the person I talked to said there was none. There is a chef's choice of menu items of 4,5, or 6 courses although you can choose certain items you really want/don't want. We let her choose. Cabbage salad was not bad, strong on the balsamic vinegar and squash pieces were too big. Quail and figs a little overcooked. Sturgeon also ok. Nothing was really memorable tho. Prob won't go back except for drinks.
One of the best Middle Eastern restaurants I have ate ever - they serve real Hummus and Baba ganush- the meat is superb and the offer great service- go there and you won't be disappointed!!!

We had a lovely Saturday brunch/lunch at Dandelion.  Reminded me a bit of the Spotted Pig in NYC.  Pimms Cup pitcher was excellent.  Tomato gazpacho was perfection and along with our salads we shared the decadent mac and cheese which was gooey, cheesy, hammy deliciousness.  Very cute atmosphere and service was fine.
Great tacos! I got the al pastor pork tacos and I have to say, top 5 tacos of my life. Just wish they have you more but hey the flavor alone is worth going back.
I love this place!  It's a great sandwich, fast fast service they hand you your order within seconds!
I placed a $55.00 order and got Szechuan chicken it was very bland not the least bit spicy and the chicken was undercooked I ended up throwing it out very disappointed in this place

Been eating here for years now, and it is probably my favorite indian restaurant.  

My recommendations:

-- Don't do the buffet, it's good for a beginner new to indian food, but I find it much better to order off the menu

-- Chicken Tikka Masala (best I've had in TN)

-- Vegetable Khorma

-- Garlic Naan (not the regular naan you find on the buffet)

If you're new to indian food or jaded by it, just try those three dishes here and enjoy the incredible flavors and taste that are about to hit your senses.

We've always had great experiences here on the hibachi side and on the dining side of the restaurant. We've also been here for numerous birthday celebrations because our kids love it and they get a free dinner on their birthday.

Our experience was so sublime. We love to dine out as a couple and are often met with mediocre to really poor experiences that make even the positives seem blah. This restaurant delivered in every way. The cocktails are unbelievable, we were teetering on ordering wine and their selection is lovely. We just could not get enough of the cocktails. The service was impeccable. Mitch was our bartender and was the best mix of present but not overbearing. He was extremely knowledgeable, kind, and attentive to our needs. We felt welcome throughout the entire experience, and the hosts were ridiculously hospitable, prompt, and kind. The food was phenomenal, every dish blew us away, but service on this level is hard to come by. In all, this restaurant is doing it right. All the minor things that make dining out slightly unenjoyable, this restaurant is killing in major ways. Kudos, we can't wait to be back.

This place is great! We always get the same order and it's always delicious. The staff is friendly, especially the young man at the counter! During covid the restaurant has had very safe guidelines to follow which we appreciated when picking up.

I tried many times to get here - Father's day the place was packed beyond my desire to wait, the next time we came the power was off and they had to close, and finally the third time was a charm which was lucky because I was not driving back there a fourth time.

I was not a huge fan of the beers they produced, only had a small sampling of their offerings, however I'm willing to give them the benefit of the doubt as I've run across many breweries and pizza places that didn't start particularly well due to scaling and ended up great. (making 100 gallons of a beer and making 2,000 gallons are different beasts and I respect the attempts to get it right)

What I am a fan of is their hummus/pita combo and a pizza that included a lot of pickled items. The hummus/pita was amazing, and the other thing which I nicknamed racoon trash pizza when my wife ordered it ended up being surprisingly good. Also had a basic marg pizza as I recall and it was ok but not memorable as the pita/hummus/racoon pie.

For the covid times the staff took care it seemed. There was an office party of some sort hosted in a separate area where not one trash pizza was given about distancing, but not their fault I guess.

Great happy hour pricing and when the weather is great is nice to sit outside!

This is a regular for my friends and I on a Friday night. The sushi comes in huge portions and is pretty good. I also recommend trying their entrees for something lighter.

Sometimes during happy hour it gets very busy and service is slow. There tends to be a lot of lingerers who hang out after dinner and cause a wait in tables. Finally, they charge $3 for carbonated water from a well - if it isn't sparkling San Pellegrino or a like item it should be free.

Excellent pizza!  A great New York style. They have smoked mozzarella (scamorza) cheese! But in limited quantities. So it's a good idea to call first to see if they've got it that day.  If you've never had it... be warned. You'll never look at pizza the same way again.  The place is a hole in the wall. But their staff is a bunch of great people and it really reminds me of a Brooklyn pizza joint. 
Whatsamattawidyou?!? It it ain't the tables and chairs you came to eat... it's the pizza! And boy do they have pizza.

Had the paella.  The unfortunate issue was that there were 5 orders of paella at my table as I was plated last I got a fuck ton of broken schell bits in my meal. Look dude at 29$ for a plate of paella I think I deserve not to have a dish that felt like he chef smashed a porcelain dish into my meal or maybe here's a better idea DONT FUCKING COOK ALL THE PAELLA IN ONE GO AND FUCK A CUSTOMER! Go elsewhere.  Fuck this place.

Arrived on a very rainy day so we used the $8 valet parking and well worth not having to hunt for parking and then walking. Met our friends for dinner here. Not their first time but it was our first time. Really liked all the food we tried. Ceviche, brussel sprouts, empanadas, yucca fries, pork pastor, etc. Everything tasted great. Thinking we'll be back again soon.
We used to go here a lot when we lived in Edwardsville. The quality of the food has gone down over the years, but the frozen margaritas are still great.

This review is strictly the food. The heavy metal atmosphere was horrendous (as someone who hates metal music) and the employees were very intimidating with all of their tattoos and piercings; however our waitress was super nice!! That being said, hands down best burgers ever! Meals are kind of pricey but you get huge burgers and a large portion of fries (also delicious). I also want to mention their fried pickles. I am a sucker for fried pickles; I get them wherever I go. These are By FAR the BEST i have ever tasted. Crunchy. Flavorful. I def recommend you try them!! Overall, we really enjoyed our meal and will probably be back sometime soon.
Delicious pretzels! Tasty dips to accompany them. I highly recommend the salsiccia pretzel! The ladies that work the counter are always friendly! Prices are good for a snack or lunch stop.

Hubby and I were on a mission to try three restaurants famous for their hot chicken. We were working our way up from mild, to medium, to hot. Unfortunately, our last stop was Party Fowl. That's not to say it wasn't good. But hot was spicy! Our server did warn us though to be fair. If you are into HOT food, this is the place for you. We had a side of coleslaw. They really need to work on the coleslaw. It tasted like they took cabbage and stirred in mayo. In addition to the hot chicken, we ordered the Chicken Liver Bam Bam. Chicken liver is one of my favorite food. And oh my gawd, that was the best.

...These were by far some of the WORST cupcakes i have ever tasted!! I went there on a Sunday afternoon. They still had plenty of cupcakes, which probably should have been a warning. They are a decent size with decent frosting, but thats where the positivity ends.  I bought a strawberry cheesecake cupcake and was informed that  it was only a plain strawberry cupcake with cream cheese frosting. The same with the cookies and cream cupcake..plain chocoalte with cream cheese frosting...thats it. I only took 2 bites of my cupcake. It was horrible...i blame Cupcake Collection for turning me into a cupcake snob. These cupcakes tasted like they came from a box and the frosting tasted the same....i have honestly made better at my house. It was totally not worth the 2.95 for basically box cupcakes. Be warned these are only plain cupcakes with the "flavor" coming from the frosting. I suggest if you want a good cupcake go to cupcake collection or make pay a little more for Gigis..because these are a waste of time

I had the 2-way with Pulled Pork & Brisket with an extra 1/2 rack of ribs. All were really good but the 2 way is really for one person. The Cole slaw, coward greens, & baked beans were good. The sweet potatoes were ok. The spicy BBQ sauce was the best sauce.

I was looking forward to visiting this location after being to a couple of other Tin Roof's in the past. I got there and the first bouncer immediately put his hand on me and did not let me go in with my group. After getting past him, I paid the hostess my cover and then the second bouncer wouldn't let me by either. I think it's incredibly rude of these men to put their hands on a customer for no reason at all. I was very disappointed with my overall experience.
Love this place. Told the owner they should come over to Continental Ranch. Now that they closed Roadrunner coffee, we need a place over here! They need more seating!

Decent place, nicely decorated with a nice wait staff. Came here for dinner a few times with friends before we started our dart league across the street at the bayou. Good beer selection. I always get the chicken quesadillas which are really good. Overall nice place to come with your friends to hang out. If you like dancing then head downstairs.

Long time Tampa pub that moved from Davis Island to this larger location. Always great service and well above the avg pub food. Solid menu and traditional English fare. Get an extra side of the curry dip when you can - is great with everything there from the wings to the seafood.

Of all the restaurants that come and go, The Black Sheep is an absolute favorite. The chef and staff provide an incredible and personal dining experience for their guests with their thoughtfully curated menu and selection of wine. My expectations are exceeded every time! The location is walkable to everything downtown, yet avoids the noise of State Street by offering an intimate and authentic atmosphere.  If you are visiting SB or entertaining guests, this is the place to go!

Friend of my been going here for years so it became a regular place when we need a quick dinner, food seems A-OK and staffs always very friendly and attentive...so even the food wasn't too impressive. I have no problem having dinner here.

This supposed to be hummus bow. But most of the time I only have falafel. And I notice most the time when Busy they don't give my hummus bowl proper. Ok quality, but I still go because it is close to my office . BusinessOwner pls change you hummus bowl picture with this because it not what we get.

Sunday night - Karaoke night - good night. 

Extremely crowded - got spilled on (guy offered to buy me a drink but no worries) - yet I still had a great time so there ya go. Might have been more the crowd I was with than the drinks (cheap and more beer oriented) but oh well - McGillin's wins in my book.

Delicious. Seriously some of the best food I have had in a long time. Farm to table, fresh, lots of flavor, you could tell the chef put love into this food.

Atmosphere was great, waiter was fantastic, hotel that this gorgeous spot is in was amazing and trendy. All around GREAT place. Must try it! 

Oh I had the salmon. YUM.

Went to Camellia Grill for the first time last week since August 2005 (a few weeks before that bitch Katrina tried to take out NOLA.

Best for Late Night after a night out in Uptown.

Camellia Grill is one of those New Orleans institutions that's off the main tourist path.  Lines like I remembered but definitely worth the wait.  This was one of those places that New Orleanians thought Katrina TKOed for good...but the Camellia Grill following signed petitions and did everything they could to revive Camellia Grill.  Thankfully, they decided to reopen after originally deciding not to in the aftermath of the hurricane.  If you went to grammar school in NOLA/Metarie/Kenner this was definitely a place you hungout on your nights out.

Service is top notch.  There is always that certain New Orleans flair you get from the waiters that makes the place popular among the uptown locals and tourists.  It is what Southern hospitality is all about.

Food is your typical breakfast/diner food, but the main difference is there is that certain lovin' everyone puts in making this place standout from a Waffle House/Denny's/IHOP.  Best yet....they use Blue Bell ice cream products.  You haven't had real ice cream until you've had Blue Bell....that extra ounce of trans fat is what it is all about.

Long live this NOLA institution.

We went to Carmine's to celebrate one of our co-worker's Birthday. We were a group of 12. From the time we got there until the time we left it was over 2 hours, we had to eat our food at speed record to get back to work. That was the slowest service I have ever had in a restaurant. The food was not impressive at all either, the water was warm and with no ice. They never ask once how the food was. I will NEVER go back.

I've been looking for a place like this for the longest time now. Number one it's close to my house, number two the ramen is amazing. The ramen will make your mouth water. Also the service is good. Overall this is a good family restaurant!!! I had the Tonkostu Shoyu the pork belly was very well cooked!!!!!
Great place to listen to great music, best pizza on the beach. Not to mention Ally is the best bartender on Treasure Island!!!!

It's pizza.  Hard to really screw up, equally hard to really blow me away either.  This is apparently a local chain, not that bad really.  What makes this location interesting is the location next to the boardwalk as well as the old lighthouse it's built into.

The kind maitre d' greeted me at the door and found me a seat at one of the few tables in this small café.  It was so small that he had to use my table for pitchers of water and tubs of dishes as he cleared other tables.  But he was really nice about it.  I recommend the Fleur-de-lis omelet--green peppers, onion, provolone and bits of sausage, covered with a mildly spicy red sauce and crawfish.  This came with wholegrain toast and fried hash browns.  The bloody Marys with bacon-infused vodka and full strips of bacon swizzle sticks looked amazing--it was just too early for me to indulge.

Given we dined at a beer and pizza place but didn't get beer or pizza, the establishment gets 3 stars for the following reasons:
The food we had (cheese curd appetizer, salad, and sandwich) was just okay:  The cheese curds had a thick & hard breading that all I remember is that the breading was too hard and not that the curds tasted good.
The salad portion was huge, but nothing special.
The sandwich was decent (grilled cheese with pepperoni), although I felt there were one too many pieces of pepperoni, and by one too many I think they could be reduced by 50% easily as the buttered bread plus pepperoni juice makes for a very greasy sandwich.
Next visit we will have to try the pizza, the people around us seemed to be enjoying what they got and they had a fairly sizable beer selection too.
Nice atmosphere, food was good but the steaks were extremely small for the price, too expensive for what you get, save your money and go somewhere else

The wait was not bad for a Saturday night. Staff was nice and courteous the whole time even though it was extremely busy. Drinks were good, we had mojitos and a "pain killer", great flavor, but maybe too much ice. We sat and were greeted immediately by our waiter that I couldn't understand his name cause it was so loud due to live music. By the way, the live entertainment was excellent. They played a little bit of everything. We got our appetizers in less than 10 mins. The actual food took a little longer, about an hour I would say. I was not mad cause I was in good company, drinks and amazing music, what else could you ask for. The sunsets views from this place are also a sight to see. The main entrees were not to die for though. I got the fish tacos which were extremely seasoned, not spicy, that would've been acceptable, but too salty you could not even chew it. I took the fish out of the tacos and it was fine. After a long wait I didn't want to change my entree. Hubby got the crab cake which was ok, not awesome. At the end we got the Key Lime Pie and that was extremely good. I would definitely return to this place, but I would probably just eat appetizers.

I checked out Prep & Pastry with my boyfriend for breakfast and was simply WOWed. I'm a huge french toast fan and man oh man did they have an amazing plate! I almost got the Banana Foster but decided not to last minute in fear it would be too sweet. A woman at the table next to us heard me talking about this after I ordered and told me I should have ordered it because it was too good to be true. Let's just say I can't wait to go back and test it out! 

The ambiance of the restaurant is quite comforting. The decor is quite cute and homie. The service also added a lot to our experience. Rose took care of us and was more than sweet and helpful! She took the time to ensure a great first experience. 

A few friends of mine have also visited and informed me the patio is puppy friendly! I guess that means I'll have to wake up and get the dogs there early so we can beat the heat and try a few more dishes!

I can take it or leave it. This place has been around for a very long time and has its loyal supporters just like any steak shop. I unfortunately got a steak that had a lot of fat and was stringy. I'm willing to give this place another shot bit for now I can only give them 3 stars.

What really turned me off about the restaurant was the waitress I had, I think her name was spelled Alesha. Everything was going okay enough, I never complained or anything, but Alesha just handed me my check and literally (not exaggerating) did not even look at me, did not thank me for providing business to the restaurant, I got nothing out of her. I ordered two cocktails, one starter, two entrees, and then I sold my friend on splitting a dessert. I'm generally a polite person, and I always like to treat staff with respect and not ask for too much. I was polite and didn't say anything extraneous from what I would like to order.  Alesha also kept oversharing about her life to us, about saving up to travel to Asia, which was super strange. Did I mention, she literally (I'm meaning literally and not as an exaggeration) said nothing to and did not look at me when she handed me my check for a relatively large order? I would not recommend to any of my friends to try Gray and Dudley because Alesha's behavior really, really made me feel kind of crappy for the rest of my night. The food was okay, a little pretentious. The jalapeño shrimp pasta was pretty bland and their "impossible" burger was a little mushy. The pork shank, however, is actually as great as everybody says it is, and their cocktails taste of good quality. But still, none of that is worth it if I have to deal with the weirdest disrespect I've ever had at a restaurant this year, and I do eat out a lot.

I love cafe amelie for its atmosphere. The menu is nice too. Perfect bistro option in the french quarter. They do seem to have weird hours however. Sitting in the courtyard is my favorite but inside is also nice. It has an overall french feeling, in a quiet, beautiful setting.

Was really let down by the customer service from both the hostess to our waiter. We went the day after Mardi Gras, so maybe everyone was just 50%. I had the ribeye topped with fried oysters and Mom had the crabcake fettucini alfredo, which was on their website menu, but not the actual menu. Overall, the food was just ok, the portions were really small to the point were it was a little pathetic. For example, the steamed vegetable that came with my steak consisted on only 7 pieces of cucumber, squash, etc. I'm not a picky person, but this place really let me down.

I live next to a relatively decent pizza place and still prefer ordering from Dom's, paying the delivery charge, waiting for the food, tipping the driver. I think that should say something about the food!

They've had consistently good pizza every time I ordered. The toppings were generous. Their salads are always delicious and huge. The croutons (homemade, I think?) are my favorite - like little crunchy garlic bread cubes - and I usually hate croutons and toss them aside.
The only critique I really have is that I wish the pastas were better sauced or came with an extra side of sauce. The spaghetti was practically dry when I ordered it with chicken parm and same with the spaghetti & meatballs.

As a lazy phone-shy weirdo, I appreciate that I can order online too. Browse all my options at my leisure.

What an amazing experience!!!
Phenomenal food, Exceptional Chef!
I would drive from Atlanta to
Always love Bru Burger. Great food and great drinks. Especially like the Bru Margarita.
Incredible place for breakfast. Read other reviews for the process as it's communal. My daughter and I love the atmosphere, the food and the workers were great. It's trendy in a subtle way.

I'd give 3.5 stars if I could.  They accommodated us as a table of 10 on short notice around 8 last Saturday night which I really appreciated!  We'd waited for a table at the Palms across the street & finally gave up.  (Turned out we could talk better since the Palms had live music start up not long after). 

The servers were attentive & worked to brings drinks/bread quickly as we had little ones getting hungry.  The calzones were a hit, I had a burger I enjoyed.  Others had pasta dishes and were pleased.  Did not try the BBQ.  A locals, laid back spot & I'd go again.

I come in here 1-3 times a  week since July and order the most simplest order which is 1-2 double cheeseburgers with ketchup only. They always get it wrong literally every single time! Then I have to wait about 10 more minutes to receive my new burgers and then I don't have time to eat since I only get a 30 min break and takes about 10 min to drive here. Nice people and all but the people that cook don't know how to read and they should take a reading test before getting this type of job. And also the bathroom has the worst hand dryer and no paper towels.

A dining experience you want forget.  A reservation is needed and the dress code is enforced... just don't wear shorts, flip flops, or A shirt.  The lunch was wonderful and don't miss out on the 25 cent martinis at lunch...Limit 3 but that is enough.  After lunch take a stroll through the Lafayette Cemetery across the street.

I was in the mood for oysters and stopped in for a snack.  The restaurant wasn't too busy at the time, but there were quite a few people sitting at the bar.  I sat at an open stool and looked around to see if I could find a menu.  There was 1 bartender behind the bar but she never greeted us.  There was an unpleasant smell as I sat there that never faded away.  After about 20 minutes of waiting, I left to find oyster elsewhere.  The great thing about the French Quarter is the options available.

It's a build your own poke bowl. Topping selection is great. You can get 2 different meats, and they have a large amount of sauces. Ingredients taste fresh and for those that can't make up their minds, they have recommendations

We have a lot of places in Camden County to drink specialty coffee. Some even roast their own beans at scale. So why should you care about this one? What sets this one apart from the pack? I'll tell you why: their espresso.

First a bit about me...I mostly review Asian (especially Vietnamese) restaurants in the area but every so often, I find someplace that gives me pause. And this is one of those places. Plus, I am a coffee nerd.

That said, let's get to the heart of the review...Their background roots are coffee and their baristas are trained by Square Mile Roasters in the UK. Anyone who knows anything about coffee, knows them and their co-founder/Managing Director James Hoffman. Their beans? They use Intelligentsia and during the holidays they get the aforementioned UK fellows beans. 

So they are using quality techniques and great beans. Plus, they are pulling these shots with a beautiful Victoria Arduino White Eagle Digit and Mythos II grinder (if I'm not mistaken). 

Oh, and I grabbed a hot latte (delicious!) and some Intelligentsia espresso beans. They have some tasty looking pastries and a wide range of drinks that give me an excuse to bring family and friends next time. Lastly, they have a beautiful, welcoming farm house-like interior with plenty of space inside and out for groups or a pleasant date with your significant other.

My only regret is not finding this place sooner...but I'll make up for that in time. See you again soon!

I visited the Trestle Inn for an event, so I can't directly comment on the venue except to say that the bartenders are snappy and sling well-blended drinks. The space is dimly lit, cozy, and intimate. I don't think it's the best space for large events, though, as the bar and back room are pretty narrow, making it difficult to navigate the establishment when it is filled with 100 or so people.

I know what you're thinking.....why does this random pizza place have such a high rating??? Allow me to enlighten you.
1) The bread is absolutely delicious. And they give your oil with fresh herbs for dipping...FRESH HERBS!
2) The entrees are just as good! I had the stuffed red pepper....No other stuffed pepper will ever compare. Cooked to perfection....filled with homemade meatballs and mushrooms....don't even get me started on the meatballs!
3) Perfect pizza! From the crispy crust on the edge to the amazingly delicious topping (highly recommend the chicken, meatball, and ricotta).
Do yourself a favor and grab some food here.....bonus: they have take out!

I just can't even express how disappointed I was trying this place... It has been highly recommended by friends a few times, but we never made the time to check it out. 

I was craving some really good sushi (expectations too high) so finally decided to go. When we walk in (with a baby) they say sit anywhere... Then we pick a table and sit, then they say oh no come sit over here, in the back... (Now I can only assume, don't know for sure... But they wanted to put us next to the other baby.....) I was kind of annoyed but I get it babies are loud and ppl go out for peaceful experiences.

The staff was great, one woman was obsessed with my baby (please note I'm not super friendly and usually don't like ppl bothering me or my baby) but it was sweet, she even snuck over some rice and tried feeding her (though my baby wasn't trying to be friendly either lol and wouldn't eat from her) I do appreciate the effort.

I am spoiled and I like my spicy rolls, topped with some jalapeño. And the menu was just kind of boring. I picked out popular rolls via Yelp and still... Just wasn't feeling it. 

My hubs liked it, but not enough to come back... 

Off to the next sushi place.......... Open to suggestions.
Very good and excellent service.  Lots of options and some gluten friendly. Only negative is price.

I went to this cafe on my last morning in New Orleans. Wow I really missed a treat on my other days in the city. My breakfast was amazing. The atmosphere was good. It's a country theme with heavy rock music being played. The food was amazing. We had the French toast and the shrimp and grits. I highly recommend this cafe.

Though does not have a fancy look from outside, the decoration of this restaurant inside really gave me a warming impression. If you choose to sit beside the window during sunset, you would experience a sense of extraordinary tranquility. However, I ordered the last item on the seafood. They gave me one fried oyster, two fried fish, several fried shrimps plus lots of inedible salad and fried stuffs. So, I am very satisfied with the atmosphere but not the food.

This is on heavens buffet. I go here for the maple coffee alone. The five and dime is great but their biscuits and gravy are even better. I went in on a Friday morning around 9:30am and it was not too busy. I ordered the biscuits and gravy with 2 fried eggs (can't recall the name) and it was prepared well. It basically was enough food that I didn't have to eat for the rest of the day.

Hard to believe you can find great gastropub food in the culinary desert of Delco, but here it is. The truffle mac and cheese is superb, the burgers were perfect and the homemade potato chips were pretty spectacular. (Try the soups.)

The only complaint I had was that the dining room was a little cold. (hint, hint) Other than that, a dining experience equal to anything in my favorite Fishtown pubs.

New staff everytime who aren't educated. Slow service.  Product is not consistent. I got a pitaya bowl and it was like soup. They offered me a straw and blamed their coolers - for roughly $7 this was a waste of money. Won't be back.

En absolut förstklassig restaurang. Allt ifrån atmosfären till betjäningen och förstås maten är i en liga för sig. Här är det gourmet mat men utan sedvanliga höga priser. Stämningen här är lugn, avslappnad och trivsamt. Samtidigt lågt ljudvolym i en smakfullt och sobert inrett lokal. Det gör att det passar romantiska middagar såväl som affärsmiddagar eller bara en lugn avkopplande måltid helt alena (som jag har nyttjat stället vid ett av mina två besök här). Har ätit middag här två gånger, så det bildar utgångspunkten för mina erfarenheter här. En något begränsad men väl genomtänkt och lockande middagsmeny. Det känns som om alla kan hitta sina egna intressanta maträtter.
