Några säkra lokala specialiter som kryddstark kyckling och tjocka fläskkotletter blandas med mer exotiska rätter som benmärg (serverad i benpipan) och shrimp & grits. De ovanliga rätterna inbjuder till att våga tänka utanför sina egna konventionella ramar och prova något helt nytt. Serveringspersonalen tar sig gärna tid och beskriver ingående vad de olika rätterna består av och hur de tillagas. Och som nämndes tidigare så betalar du väldigt rimliga priser för väldigt hög standard. Skönt med den välkomnande och avslappnande attityden här. Kanske inte helt självklart på ställen av så här hög klass. Andra jämförbara ställen som jag iallafall normalt förknippar med stel trist stämning och nedåtlåtande attityder från personalen.

Ordered food to go for me and the wife my enchiladas where a soggy mess and they didn't give us a fork too my wife's taco salad was a soggy mess Gordon Ramsay would be upset at the food and the way it was prepared.

Wow. This restaurant is brilliant. For starters, the food was phenomenal and the service was pretty good. At first, they said there would be a ten to fifteen minute wait, yet, they seated us only two minutes later, to our surprise. 

Their garlic bread is to die for, despite the fact that it'll leave you with garlic breath for a day or two. It was a wonderful dinner for me. I ordered the rigatoni vodka, which was absolutely delicious and I daresay that they had the best vodka sauce that I've tasted in quite a long time. It was rich in flavor and the consistency was just right. 

Food: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Wait: 5/5

Overall rating: 5/5

That makes three times now I have eaten at Kanella: for dinner, for the special Valentine's Day menu, and for brunch. Not once have I left feeling anything other than completely satisfied with the both the food and the general dining experience.

 Kanella's menu is simple yet inventive; as it is Cypriot cuisine, do not expect your run of the mill spanikopita/ moussaka type Greek fare. Brunch was such a refreshing change from standard brunch food- the haloumi is not to be missed. 

I'd highly recommend both the meat and vegetable dishes I was served and I can't wait to get there for lunch!

The service was extremely uneven. The entree came out before appetizers and we had to wait 20 more minutes before the second entree and another 20 minutes for the third one. Disappointing despite of other raving reviews.

De la Vina is lucky to have this restaurant open.  Los Agaves was getting too popular on Milpas and many times I would see the line out the door.  Santa Barbara needed at least one more.  Now with this location, hopefully lunch crowds will not be a problem.  

The parking in the area is a little tricky.  They do have a parking lot for about 10 cars in the back but you have to drive down a narrow driveway to get to it.  The street parking can be hit or miss.

We got there around 11:45am and beat the lunch crowd which shows up just after 12.  This place is not has busy has the one on Milpas yet.  I think they have more dining too, plus a few tables outside.  Same set-up as Milpas, order at the counter, get your own drinks and salsa, and then sit where you can find a spot.

The food here is great.  I tried the Chile Tres Queso off of the special menu (see picture).  It was beautiful, I almost did not want to eat it.  It was perfectly cooked with the cheese melted and the chile not mushy.  My friend got the chicken burrito and was happy with it.  She was only able to eat half because it is so much food.  It is a good item to split with someone.

The service was fantastic today.  They came by at least three times to see if we needed anything.  Chips were on our table before I could get my drink.  Everyone is so friendly.  I love coming here.  I think this will be the Los Agaves we will be going to in the future for lunch.

I was recommended to go to this Indian restaurant. I must preface that I'm half Indian half Italian, so my taste buds to Indian food are very sensitive.

My friend, Arvind, is also Indian and highly recommended the dosa at Chennai.

We went with our whole family on Sunday evening and had a very pleasant experience.

The food is delicious, prepared fresh, and the service was very nice.

This has become my favorite pizza place in Tampa Bay. I wish we had more locations around, but happy to see the Westshore location is still open. 

Their tomato sauce is delicious. It's flavorful and the perfect thick and rich consistency. The mozzarella compliments the sauce, not overpowering. The crust is the perfect thickness, not too thin and not too doughy. It has just enough crunch, have never had it go soggy. 

They have SO many toppings. It's actually quite hard to decide which to get because they all sound amazing. On my most recent visit, I added fresh garlic (always a must, as it adds the perfect tang to compliment the sauce), roasted sweet red peppers (brings an added sweetness in comparison to the savory flavors), and mushrooms (which were cooked perfectly). 

My hubby had the Margherita pizza with pepperoni and fresh garlic. Their pepperoni was also flavorful, and I love the basil they use! Some places add it on top of the pizza after, but at Grimaldi's, it seems cooked, and I really enjoyed it that way, much to my surprise. So I think I will be adding that to my favorite toppings list.

We ended our meal with an original cannoli and that was perfect as well. The cream wasn't too sweet, great consistency...smooth with chocolate chips for a bite. And the shell wasn't stale, it was crunchy and fresh tasting.

Their prices are average, not too expensive. And service was exceptional. Our waiter, I can't remember his name, was so sweet with our two kids.

I can't wait to come back!

We had a funeral luncheon at Terra Nova and we were very pleased with our experience.  A separate room was reserved for us and we paid a flat rate per person (of about $17, plus tax and gratuity - a total of about $21.50 per person) for a full buffet luncheon.  For the funeral luncheon, you pay for exactly the number of people who attend, but at least 30 (minimum). The luncheon included rolls and butter, coffee, tea and soda, 3 main entrees, a salad, potato and vegetable side, and a small dessert.  There is a cash bar for those who wish to have alcoholic drinks, but if you wish to pay for alcoholic drinks for your guests, you can do so for an additional cost.  There was a server behind the buffet area dishing out the items for our guests.  All of the food was very tasty and perfectly prepared.  Our guests seemed very happy with the food. The room itself was elegant looking, clean and nicely furnished.  It felt classy. Service was friendly and fairly attentive, although I did hear a comment that nobody came around to offer coffee or tea with dessert. (I didn't notice that as I do not drink coffee or tea).

Aside from that, my only criticism is that there is only one dessert choice (ice cream with a fruit topping) for the funeral luncheon.  While it was very tasty, it would have been nice to have a couple other traditional options, for example cake or pie.

All in all, we were happy with our experience and would recommend.

Sitting here on a Saturday night. They bring our dishes out piecemeal. In fact my main course was delivered 25 minutes ago and my date's dish is yet to arrive. In all this time no one came out to explain the delay. I had to wave down the waitress. She made the excuse that there was this other large party. No apology. She is not rude. I think she is poorly trained. Finally, the young owner comes by and asks if everything is good? I tell him the place is disorganized and the staff poorly trained. He sincerely apologizes, comps the late dish, gives us free dessert and insists on sending us home with another complete lamb dish. I have to give him credit. He was sincere in his apology and showed it in his actions. Finally, the food is pretty good. The lamb in the lamb shush kabobs was perfectly done. Pink in the center and juicy.

My company ordered from this business and the food was late. Our third party we go through trying calling them but no answer, we tried calling them no answer so we ordered from another company. Well after an hour of waiting the food arrived along with the back up company we ordered from. I ordered the curry chicken with cabbage. The rice was not done, the cabbage was a little chewy and the chicken was bland meaning there was curry seasoning on the food but seasoning within in the food. Sorry to leave this review because we were all hoping this food was going to be good but big disappointment. Well I guess back to Jamaica Jamaica again.

I had a delicious meal here. Lots of vegetarian choices. I really liked the flat bread I had. I have come many times as this place is yummy! I can't wait to return in the future. Kind of a small menu in my opinion, but everything I have tried has been excellent!
I had the squid lunch special.  Two problems: 1) Virtually no squid.  2) Virtually no taste, despite a few hot peppers.  All for a mere $14 with tip.

Comfortable relaxed atmosphere with pleasant efficient service. Fresh sourdough bread was wonderful, but the whipped herb butter tasted like margarine. Salad was excellent with real blue cheese and flavorful tomatoes. I opted for the blackened salmon, and although it looked blackened it didn't have the spicy kick I was expecting. Roasted corn was excellent, and rice pilaf was just the right amount. Overall a pleasant night out, but probably won't return unless it's happy hour or some other incentive.
Fantastic family owned business. Food is excellent and service immaculate + price that cannot be beat! Highly recommended, best Cuban sandwich in the area.

I've visited here a few times for their root beer [a few years ago, not up to date on their current menu] in a growler, and more recently for beers. I've had canned versions of their beers and I was hoping for a better taste. Boy was I disappointed. It had the same metallic can taste and was bland with way too many hops. I wish you had something with variety like sun king. [Tried railsplitter both times for even reference]. The root beer was alright, but I'll be sticking with my 2 litre from the store or making my own. I wish they had more variety, as someone with a few food allergies, it's hard for me to find a beer! 

Come to find out today in the pogo circles as well that the owner said one thing than did an opposite, and then an employee lied about an event which got a leader in the Indy pogo industry banned from the premise for leaving after not being served for 90 mins; I will not be returning or buying any product from any bar or grocery store for this incident and my above review.

Hands down the WORST restaurant I've ever encountered. Employees are rude, Careless, and work on their own time even pre covid. Even the managers do not take the time to make a customer happy who has reached out. Will not be getting my service in the future.

The food is well above average for a place in 'Fat City'.  The restaurant is clean and the staff are very informed and friendly.  Prices are good for the quality and the owner Mike Gowland is a great guy to talk with.

I don't normally write reviews but I feel like I had to share. Overall the service was good but the food was ehhh. The Mac and cheese was super salty. The mixed veggies were good. The creamed spinach was average (I've had way better) and the steak was average as well. For the price, I wasn't impressed. I had the filet (medrare) that was nothing special. My bf had the prime rib. I tried it and liked it better than my filet. I honestly won't be back for the price. Call me spoiled, but I'm used to Berns steakhouse and Charlie's.

All day I've need in awe over my $7.95 salad that was AMAZING!! I ordered a Romaine and gorgonzola salad but substituted the romaine for kale and it was incredible! It was so filling I couldn't even fit and finish all of it. I was worried for the low price that I wouldn't be full, but it was quite the opposite!

Sooo good. A local recommended this place because it's girly and they have bottomless mimosas on weekends before 4pm. The food is rich so you won't need very much, my friend and I shared two appetizers and that was plenty for us with a drink. The go-go bites are amazing! They have spicy cheese and an amazing dipping sauce. The "best advice" and "froza" drinks were very good, and reasonably priced. Plus it's adorable so if you want some cute Instagram photos, this is the place.

Since I work nearby, this has become my go-to place for picking up spices and beans. The prices and selection are right in line with other Indian markets in the city. Whenever I am there I can't resist buying a few alloo tikki, pakoras, or samosas, all of which are tasty, well spiced, and vegan. If you have similar dietary restrictions, just ask questions and the staff will help you.

Ok...so this place will always be special. Here's why:
My wife and I will be moving to Philly this summer. We were in town during spring break to check out apartments and stuff. This is sort of the first restaurant we went to after signing our lease for what will potentially be our home for the next few years.
Anyways, I digress....

The place has a very cozy, intimate feel, mainly because of the lighting. The bartender whipped up the most amazing Key Lime Martini I have ever had...so definitely a good beginning to the night. I ordered the Pasta Bolognese which was delicious. I also shared stuffed mushrooms with my wife...not 5* but definitely 4. All in all, a good date/family restaurant. Btw, it does get pretty warm, especially in the back section (which is nicer)...so prepare to peel off a few layers.

The food was served hot and tasty even though I was in towards closing time.  The staff was extremely friendly and were smiling the entire time. They even checked up to see if I was enjoying my meal. This was one of the better Boston Markets that I have visited.

Driving through the area in a motor home. We came in for lunch an we're pleasantly surprised with the restaurant! The food 5 stars! The service 5 stars! The atmosphere 5 stars. Plenty of parking! Very reasonable price. We left full and completely satisfied!!!

Was in town for the Chris Stapleton concert.....and yes people who like country can also like French food! :) I chose this place from Yelp....looking at the decor online I figured anyone that has that much design talent and attention to detail will do the same with their food. 

All was wonderful. We had to get their early to sit at the bar (4 of us) and whittled away the 2 hours we had by consuming seriously delicious food. Beet Salad, French Onion Soup amazing. And the champagne we ordered on the advice of our barstool neighbor was amazing.

Can't wait to visit Boise again - Petite 4 will be on the list. BTW Chris Stapleton was A-mazing.

Slow hand has some of the best servers! Matt the bartender is my favorite. He makes the best drinks. They have some of the most unique dishes in West Chester! Their atmosphere is amazing with all the lit candles. It's my favorite place!

So this place is under new management so i was willing to give it a try again but once again it was below my expectations i oder a stake and a corn patty with cheese (arepa con queso.) The food came to my table cold the stake was like shoe leather. I wished them all the best but i will not be returning here .

Absolutely fascinated with this place!! After reading reviews I thought it might have been overrated. I have not been to Greece nor have I tasted homemade Greek food, but this food was amazing! Everything -- from our appetizer to the dessert 

The ambience was also bright and welcoming. Every detail inside was Greek-themed. Beautiful place! Will be returning

My wife and I just finished the Sunday Brunch Tour, which was our 3rd Indulge Boise Tour. We've been on the Saturday Farmers Market Tour and the Booze n' Bites tour. I can just say, if you are visiting Boise or already live here and are curious about Boise culture and cuisine , Indulge Boise has you covered. We visited 5 different establishments, from iconic to avant garde, sampling a signature menu item from each, great concept. The food part aside, we met some fantastic people and had a great time! Highly recommended, we have given these tours as gifts and will continue to do so!

The Post is officially my favorite sports bar... especially after tonight. I'm pretty sure at least half of Cardinal nation was crammed in there wearing their red, screaming like a bunch of freakin' crazy people... So amazing...

There are so many TVs at the Post that there's no way you can't see whatever game you're looking for, and the best part? THEY PLAY SOUND. There's nothing worse than watching a big game and listening to a bunch of top 40's pop hits. The service is steady and friendly, and I've just never had a bad time here. 

The 20% off your food you get when you check in on Yelp doesn't hurt at all, and their menu has something for everybody. Wings, nachos, burgers, chicken fingers, pizza, even a good veggie burger... typical bar food but kicked up a notch. The drinks come strong, as well. The best part about tonight is that the bartender would occasionally pick up the microphone to cheer on our team and bash other ones we didn't want to win... made it fun and pumped everyone up even more.

This is my go-to sports bar, no doubt. And with that I say... WE WON THE NATIONAL LEAGUE WILD CARD!

I eat lunch here every once in a while and the staff is helpful when you are as indecisive as myself. The pasta bowls are good, I usually just make my own and put whatever I want in it. They're peach tea is super tasty! It's very sweet so sometimes I cut it with unsweet tea. I've had a salad from there too and it was good but I wish it had a little bit more greens. Costs usually around 7-12 dollars depending on what extras you get or drinks.
Love The Mill! Great drinks, great atmosphere, and THE BEST Charcuterie in town, hands down! Please maintain the quality!

Got the spare ribs, they were way over cooked. The ribs resembled jerky. The brisket was fairly dry but had decent flavor. We liked the hush puppies and mac. Would not recommend but we may have had bad luck.

Went for my hubby's birthday. He loves Italian and enjoyed it. They were packed but our server made us feel great. The meal was delicious. I got a spicy shrimp dish and my hubby got chicken parmesan. There was enough food for two portions so we had leftovers. I loved the pistachio ice cream our server brought over to celebrate. I would return.

Let's start with the good. The food and flavors are excellent. 

The bad, even when not very busy, we went through two waters before they were able to take our order. For some tacos and a tostada, it seemed to take quite some time for them to prepare. 
Chips and salsa (enough salsa for about 25% of the chips) salsa that was there was good, but not $7 good. Never been to a sit down Mexican restaurant that didn't include chips and salsa. Once the meal was eaten, again, took some time to get their attention for the bill. Then, the bill. You can eat at the nicest steak house for the price of their tacos, chips and salsa. Good food, but it is obvious either the rent is outrageous, or they are trying to retire next year in a gold palace. Prob won't go back as there are many more affordable places with similar flavor.

We had a good experience. Staff was friendly, our burgers were really good, and the shoestring fries were yummy too!  

Thanks

My husband and I had a very enjoyable meal at Barbuzzo, but we had to yell directly in one another's ear, seated right next to each other at the bar, to hear each other. Barbuzzo is *incredibly* loud, even on a Wednesday night being seated at 9pm. So despite the scrumptious octopus, wonderful fresh cheese, and lovely mushroom and pesto pasta, we won't be going back. The restaurant was packed (literally - the tables are inches apart), and some may find that "cozy" or "intimate." But intimate to us means that we are able to have a conversation without being distracted by diners at adjoining tables yelling at each other. It's such a shame we'll have to look elsewhere for that because the food at Barbuzzo is really good.
Ehhh. Food just wasn't good. Ordered a "chicken Philly cheesesteak". All it was, was ground chicken with some type of sauce. No cheese. Tasted like a sloppy joe. Drinks were also flat. Gross.

The best tuna sandwich in America. I had to do a job at the prison and can't go to Philly without stopping and getting a Tuna Sub. The breakfast sandwiches are fantastic as well. I haven't even tried anything else for lunch but the tuna because I don't live close and if I get there I have to have the tuna.
Dude; this place is bomb. Family owned and authentic. can't wait to come back. The service was  wonderful and the food Was fire. In. Love with Iozzo's.
Service was not the best and the craw fish was average, but the alligator tail was yummy.
Six of us came in for dinner and all left happy! Great service, great food. A hidden gem!
I dream about their french toast. I think it changed my life.

So yea the food is just not really good. The wings were over cooked and dry. The ribs were meh and kinda dry. Sides were no not good. My dad said his pulled pork sand was good, but he was just happy I brought him back dinner. Oh cornbread was yum but can't really mess that up. I'd say go to Local Bbq next time instead
First time at the Blue Comet. Burger. Amazing. Onion rings. Lovely.  Cosmo. Perfect. I'll be back.
Ichiban is the best hibachi chef!! He was so funny, friendly, and food was great. If you ever get the chance to have him as your chef take it :)

Wow!!! Such great food and drink!!!! This place had amazing food and service. The ambience inside is beautiful and it's overall a great time! We went on a Sunday night and it was packed so I'd call ahead. Parking was also a tad tricky because the lot was completely full! Lol
Between our entire party we all had a little bit of everything and loved it all. I don't think you can go wrong on their menu

This place is gross. Took over 25 minutes to get my food, there was only 1 car in front of me. The quesadillas looked like shit. You guys have one job to do. If I'm waiting for my food for that long it shouldn't come out looking this lousy. Complete BS.
It's all about the curry here!  Their soups aren't the best, but as far as spicy Thai deilciousness goes...possibly the BEST I've ever had!!!  I'm pretty obsessed with this place!

Recently went to Kumo for dinner. The experience was solid. We went midweek with a party of 5. 3 of us were getting hibachi entrees which allowed us to be seated immediately. The chefs cook with class and humor. Made for a delightful evening. I would eat at this location again in a heartbeat.

Surprisingly, this place is clean even the bathroom. It gives me a vintage but yet  classy vibe.  I really wasn't expecting this. But im a satisfied customer. From the front desk, public bathroom and the hotel hallway very clean. This was a last minute trip and reservation on top of that.
Such delicious Indian food!  The food is consistent and Happy is the best and most professional server I've ever encountered.

What can I say about Brocato's? Except... OMG those stuffed potatoes are what make me kick every diet I've ever tried down and curb stomp it. 

Ok, maybe that was a bit graphic, but seriously. Stuffed potatoes. I had the good fortune to try them because of some office/food thing and... I think my life changed from that moment. I've tried to go and try other things but the stuffed potato is so large that it fills me right up and I just can't deny it in favor of ordering other foods! 

However, I did bring my friend to try the other foods and he was not lured in by the delicious promises of the stuffed potato. Thus, he ordered a cuban and deigned it satisfactory also. I'll definitely have to try other things at some point.

Word of warning. Call ahead and place your order for pickup. This is not a place where you can just go and order food as it is always packed every time I've heeded the siren's call of potatoes. However, I'm sure after you try their food, you'll see why it is always busy.

Ate here for the first time and ordered a Tempura Bagel Roll, a Torched Salmon Roll, and a Crunchy Florida Roll. All 3 were amazing. Paid about 30 bucks for the 3, so pretty average prices for specialty rolls. Will definitely be back to get these again as well as others that I hadn't tried yet

Food was really good, we will be back.
Tommy and the rest of the staff were extremely helpful. We tried everything they recommended and it was good.

Let me state for the record we usually dont do fish town but since the #noeaterrepeatery2013 is in full swing we decided to  cross that barrier and mingle with the dark side of the city.

We arrived to a pretty decent size bar it was a monday but this place was in full swing.Service was great the entire time and the menu options offer something for everyone. I was sad to see that at least 3 beers i wanted to try weren't up yet so i opted for a snap and cider. 

We started with those infamous pretzel nuggets. They were everything , everyone claimed them to be. truth be told i would come back for just them. I opted for a salad since i had just done an hour of brutal cardio and leg work. The hazelnut and gruyere salad was pretty large. The salad came with a generous helping of nuts, though not so much cheese atop butter lettuce.The dressing had a nice creamy balance but i was thinking it should have been sweeter to offset the fatty cheese and nuts. 

I can honestly say that i would eat here again. Apparently brunch here is amazing and the staff was super cool and the atmosphere seems low key which i need more of in my life.

I got tacos and gorditas. I want to say gorditas are like pupusas, but the gorditas are a flatbread cut in half and stuffed with meat, lettuce, tomatoes, and sour cream. Where as the pupusas are the thick flatbread with meat and cheese inside, but not cut open. They were full of flavor and adding the salsa they gave you gives a little kick. The el pastor tacos are sooooo delicious. Tastes authentic. Their food and customer service is 5 star. Theyre very friendly and will greet you once you walk in.

Just a Chicago girl, living in a lonely world. That lonely world, of course, being Nashville, TN. There are plenty of "Italian" restaurants around, but if you're looking for authentic Italian food then your options are extremely limited. I have longed for the days of the Little Italy I left behind just a couple of short years ago and today, it was like going home.
 
Today, we made our way to Coco's Italian Market, our 3rd stop in local Nashville eats. We arrived around 2pm, purposely avoid the lunch rush. Given their parking situation, this seemed to be a good idea. Once inside, it was very easy to forget we were still in Nashville. The wonderful smell of baked goods, coffee, and pasta surrounded us as we were seated. Family photos of a traditional Italian family laughing and cooking together were on the walls, Frank Sinatra was playing on the sound system and across from our table sat four men laughing and talking as they casually enjoyed bread and wine. For a small time, I was home.

Our waiter was extremely nice and attentive. We started our meal with the Antipasto plate and some fresh bread. The meats were delicious, the various olives with bleu cheese crumbled on top was a nice sample of what to expect on the olive bar in the market, and the vegetables were crispy and spicy. We forced ourselves to stop eating the platter in order to have room for other food.

I chose the Tortellini Elliston as my main course. It was a perfect blend of cheese, sauce, and spinach. I actually kind of regretted eating so much of the appetizer because I couldn't finish all of the tortellini. My husband had the Penne al Fresco. He enjoyed it, and I found the chicken in the dish to be perfectly cooked. It wasn't a dish for me, but I know that others will love it. 

For desert we had a cannoli and the tiramisu , two must haves when you plan on reviewing an Italian restaurant. I was surprised that we weren't offered coffee with our desert, but I will know for next time to ask for it. The cannoli was hands down one of the best I have ever had. It seems like all too often, places go overboard on the sweetness and you end up with something you can't finish due to all the sugar. That was not the case here. The tiramisu was good enough to make me drive in 5pm I-440 traffic to eat another piece. 

Outside we played a short game of Bocce ball. It was a scorching hot and humid day in Nashville so we couldn't give it our all, but it was fun at any rate. 

Overall, this place seems like it would be a lot of fun in the evenings and it's great for a long relaxing lunch filled with good food and good conversation in a relaxing environment.  Thank you, Coco's Italian Market for a wonderful experience!
If you want rude service mice droppings and ants in your food this is your place. Stay clear very dirty and unsanitary.

My go to fast delivery spot! I have never had a Chinese delivery spot call me back to make sure they have my order correct until I started using this place. If you are looking for Chinese with fast delivery use this place.

This piece of history is a must to experience. Every poboy you eat from here on out will be compared to this and unfortunately they will never even get close. The line you may wait in will be so worth it. The soft shell crab poboy was amazing.
Pretty good steak (had the Sirloin).  Cooked right and the usual trimmings (spuds and bread).  This place can get loud (bad acoustics) so be aware.  Worth the stop when in Tucson.

Amazing!! I use dominos to cater to a lot of my work events, and this location might be the best. Extremely friendly staff. And there's a deal going on where you get any two items for only $5.99 each! You have to try the artisan pizzas -- the spinach feta is to die for. And they have GLUTEN free pizza for all my SB health freak co-workers :)

On the look for another great Mexican restaurant in the Tampa Bay Area and all I keep seeing is Tex-Mex chains. They have the capacity of confusing people about real Mexican food with Tex-Mex and of course as a chain the capacity of filling up their place and destroy smaller businesses. The location is nice and restaurant is beautiful  but I wasn't impressed with their food or drinks. I understand they are new but they should know better about execution have a few already. Ordered the baja fish and chorizo tacos and they were bland and flavorless. It is just another new young crowd spot that can care less about real food. Tampa really need to step up and support real places not chains. I will continue looking for another great real Mexican restaurant in town, but in the meantime I will continue visiting Catrinas on Macdill which has the best authentic tacos in town, home made chorizo and real fresh Mexican not processed food like others.
My friend and I always order pork soup dumplings. It is a staple and the service was consistent. Even during this virus, very hospitable and hardworking to make sure orders are accurate.

Love breakfast at Cup Cafe! I have been here multiple times, always sat at the bar, and have had great service! Austin and David were both awesome bartenders. Sat and did work, great coffee and Fruitopia for breakfast were delicious. Will definitely be back!

Not a good value for money when compared to other nearby offerings such a mccallisters and owners. A small Asian chop chicken salad with a side of fruit (they sell their leftover cut up fruit from previous day and it is not eligible to be a side) was $11. A small salad and a cup of day old strawberries! No drink included in that price. The chicken was tasteless and was some kind of layered patty which peeled open like an artichoke when I put my fork to it. Made me wonder how many chickens were used to make that patty! I don't come here often because every time I leave I feel like I've been screwed. I like the concept but not the quality of food for portion size and price point. Today, once again, confirmed a nice LARGE salad with chicken included in the price, a large drink and a cookie for $2 less is worth the journey to the competition just down the street.
touristy but good food and fun people   nice location on beach. personally i would go to one of the other frenchies for food and here to drink.  consultant and good.

I read about this restaurant on Yelp. I was looking for something healthy close to the quarter. The reviews were right. The crab cakes were amazing! I enjoyed speaking with the server who was the owner's brother and a retired NOPD officer. Along with great conversation, I enjoyed a great meal. As others have said, it's not the cheapest meal you can get in the quarter, but that wasn't what I was looking for. If it is, you should grab a slice of pizza and a huge ass beer from a hole in the wall and be on your merry way. I was looking for something delicious, fresh and healthy, and that's what I got. I got the crab cake poboy and a coffee for $20 (not including tip). I would go back and would recommend this place to anyone. This is a counter service place - good for takeout or a few in a party. Probably only has 5-6 barstools. I didn't have to wait, but it would be worth the wait if there is one. If you have a group or kids with you, get takeout and find a nice spot somewhere nearby to enjoy your great meal!

I have eaten and many places in Nashville, and this by far was my most enjoyable experience ever. Went on a Tuesday evening around 9pm and the ambiance was perfect. Ordered the German town strudel, which was amazing. Never had cream cheese that way. Roasted chicken for my entree', and what seemed to be like an apple pie soup, with a scoop of cinnamon ice cream, for dessert. 

Feel bad for not remembering the dessert name, but I kid you not, it was the best dessert i've ever put in my mouth. The pie was served warm.  Didn't feel rushed by the staff at all, and they really cared that my first time eating there was a memorable one. The table I was sitting at, had a really good view of the Nashville skyline. I thought this was more upscale, as far as in the dress code, but seen others in there with jeans and a t-shirt. Just don't look sloppy. Top three favorite restaurants in Nashville.

I previously visited Bar Taco in Atlanta & was excited to dine at the Tampa location. The restaurant was busy and there was a short wait but once I was seated the food began to flow. There are a variety of tacos, all small & mighty delicious.  I ordered the falafel, duck, cane asada & portobello mushroom - all the tacos were excellent. My favorite by far was the duck - the meat was perfectly marinated. The service was also excellent. I look forward to visiting again soon.

The catfish was great! The red beans & rice was delicious, it just didn't have much sausage in it.  Shrimp poboy was full of shrimp and delicious! Big helpings. Our waitress was the only one working but only a few people in the place.

The chicken wings themselves get five stars. They were some of the best I have had. Perfectly fried to a nice crispy texture. I was not sure I was going to like the fact that the sauce is served on the side. However, I liked that I still had all the taste I would've had if the wings had been mixed with the sauce, but I did not have messy hands afterwards! I highly recommend.

The Reuben sandwich was quite good as well. I normally do not like fresh-cut fries, but these were actually pretty decent.

I should also say that the waitstaff was very good.

I definitely look forward to going back and trying some other items on the menu.

Wow! The people on the neighborhood app "NextDoor" were raving about this place, so I had to try it. Hands down, the BEST fried Fish Platter I have EVER had. It was so light and fluffy but flavorful. The Baked Macaroni & Cheese was amazing. The Candied Yams were a little dry, because all the sauce settled at the bottom but man, they were so well done, and not slippery/slimy lol. They were out of potato salad, so they refunded my card for the cost. Thoroughly enjoyed my meal. Soooo good. Great sized portions!

Great spot. Recommended by our Lindsey our concierge at Wyndham. Had the Crab and Crawfish Bake as an appetizer. It was fantastic. I then had the  Fresh Drum with a Crawfish sauce. It was delicious also. My date had the Crawfish ravioli and it also was fantastic. All of these items were suggestions from our attentive Waiter Jonathan. The Manager came by to ask if everything was OK and to see if we needed anything. We also tried the Red Velvet Cheesecake. This is definitely a place to get great food, friendly service and have some drinks. Nice quiet place.

So the food is average, I mean burgers are good but slightly overpriced. Beer is cold, and fries are hot!   Problem is staff, bunch of rude waiters and waitresses with no personality.  I am literally ordering my food from a person with the personality of a dumpster fire.  

Now the helping had that bring your food are are amazing. But the waiters and waitresses that deal with people should be trained or maybe not deal with people.  Wash cars?  Mow lawns?  Maybe bus tables.  But please for the love of God, stop working with people!

So basically this is the best authentic Mexican food in Philadelphia. The tacos are amazing and burritos are as big as your head; life changing and $7 or less. How can you beat that!!! The service is so nice AND they are open late. Yup, this place rules. 
Ps- try the guac

We were in/Eagle visiting my wifes family and they suggested we go to Bardenay for dessert and drinks.  We get there and sit near the bar area.  The whole purpose of our visit was to try the carrot cake which we heard was the best around.  When we get around to ordering we find out there is no carrot cake because their distributor did not deliver any that morning.  Of course I was disappointed but oh well, I end up ordering the pineapple upside down cake.  My wife and her family that was with us decide to order a bottle of the Moscato D'Asti to share.  The pineapple cake comes and it is dry and disgusting.  My wifes uncle orders the chocolate cake which comes out looking like a Ding Dong except with out the aluminum foil.  When the wine comes, instead of one big bottle, we get two small bottles.  Why, because we are told they are out of the regular sized bottles.  We were specifically told by our waitress that we would only be charged for the one regular bottle size since it was their fault they were out and had to give us two smaller bottles.  Of course when the bill comes we are charged for the two smaller bottles which is significantly more than the one regular bottle that we ordered.  We remind our waitress what she told us and she goes back to talk to the bartender.  Ends up since we got 4 glasses instead of 3, we get charged for both bottles.  Does this make sense?  The waitress doesn't seem willing to adjust our bill even though she assured us originally that we would only be charged for the regular bottle that we ordered.  Instead or arguing we just pay he bill and leave, wasn't worth it.  Needless to say we won't be going back next time we are in the area.

Beautiful! It was one of the nicest outdoor rinks I've ever been to. I live in SF, so I love the Union Square one when it's in season. 

The arcade area was smaller than I'd expected, and seemed to be catered toward children. But the large open area with the fireplaces, jenga, alcohol, and open tables was amazing. Super cozy! And everyone was so friendly in there!

The ice skating side with the locker rentals, on the other hand, was another story. The skates were outdated, tattered, with the laces all ripped. Every encounter with them for size inquiries, or questions of any sort, were either ignored or responded to with such attitude that we finally decided to just suck it up and skate with the deficient skates we were given. (bummer). This ended up cutting our skating time short, because our feet hurt so bad. :(
Excellent Charbroiled Oysters.  Everything on the menu is superb!  Great local New Orleans restaurant with flavor, atmosphere and service!  A "Mid City" Gem!

Went for dinner with family. Good food, excellent service, decent ambience. Vijayawada biriyani was really good. 

Visited again for their Sunday banana leaf buffet..Excellent food..excellent variety of dishes of chicken, goat, egg , fish and many veg items..They serve you at your table unlimited food and the service quality is superb..highly recommend their biriyanis and sunday buffet.. Will update the post when i try their other items but very happy to find this place
Amazing food and drinks! A must visit if you are ever in New Orleans! Look up for Sarah when you are there, she provides some really good suggestions for food.

Place had a great vibe the minute we walked in. Staff is super friendly. We ordered a bagel, english muffin in which both were buttered perfectly. The cream cheese muffin was reallly good (we took one to go) Also, We are from out of town so had asked what kind of fun stuff their was to do. The woman(owner) gave us a great list of cool things. To put the cherry on top the coffee we ordered was GREAT! Thanks for excellent service!
I love this place! So happy to add them to our Sparks options. The owner Sunil is very friendly and helped us decide on our selections. Definitely going back soon. Yum!!

Please do not go to this establishment. You will spend a lot of money for a very low quality experience. The service is below sub par. In my personal experience it took 30 minutes to be sat for our scheduled reservation, and then another 40 to get a drink. Mind you that you only have 3 hours at the establishment. We made a reservation for a private party and then shared the minuscule pool with three other groups. The level of incompetence shown my management and staff proves that this place is over hyped and only gets booked by word of mouth. Don't go - you can find better. 

Staff ruins the entire experience. Management needs to do better.

Melt has some good points, and bad. I think with some work, they could be amazing. Our service was pretty bad. We waited a long time for water. We ordered mimosas and bloody mary's, and our server asked us if we were ready to order food. We said yes, she said OK, and then walked away. We didn't see her for another ten minutes. That was a little odd. I had the blueberry waffle, which was great. My friend had the wake and bake, which was delicious, but the presentation was a bit lacking. I think the prices for the food are awesome; my waffle and mimosa came out to around $10. The decor is fun. They don't have alcoholic drinks on their menus, we had to ask about them. Also, the menus are just pieces of printed paper that were kind of dirty and had water spots. Lastly, the bathrooms were AWFUL. I really hope they work on a few things. I will go back, because I want to try some of their savory dishes.

Incredible food! We had the charcuterie board, the pork belly, and the duck. Each dish was absolutely delicious. The service was amazing, prompt and honest staff. The ambience was nice - the lighting was romantic, the layout of the restaurant is a bit odd. We sat at the front by the street, but the room felt like an add on (tough to explain). In any case, we would go back as the food was amazing!

Came here and got a variety of sandwiches and meals.  Tea and coffee selections are nice.  I'd say the only downside was that the food took a while to get to us because it seemed that there was only one person cooking.  And maybe limited seating.

The jamon sandwich with egg was great.  Love acme bread!  With the cheese boards, if you get the two item one it's chef's choice.   Overall pretty tasty!

So I walk in for a quiet dinner by myself on a work trip. I saw a few negative reviews, but didn't think anything of it given how many people have had a positive experience here. 

But y'all must be crazy to think this place is good.

Don't bring me my soup and tell me the tempura is coming out soon. Why would you make me wait while I stare hungrily at some noodles?

No one likes too-crunchy vegetables in their udon soup. Broccoli, store-bought white mushrooms, and snow peas are a cop out.
 
Don't use the same chairs at the sushi bar that you use at your tables. Sushi bars are chest level. No one likes being infantilized by having to lift their shoulders and arms just to be able to grab their food. 

Their soy sauce and/or fish made me feel sick. This was NOT fresh. I got the $23 sashimi platter and was presented with salmon that was fairly gelatinous. The tuna was almost melted, and tasted like shark. I would call it almost mercurial, but there's nothing interesting about bad food.

It's disingenuous to call yourself a Japanese restaurant when you can't even make an udon bowl right.

Come here with an iron stomach.

Love their full stack of buttermilk pancakes, their sourdough bread and home fries (browned potatoes with the skin on) Stay away from the item with cheese. I have gotten take out the past 3 Sundays, it is becoming a habit.

I have to say, they do have the best Bun Mang Vit. My usual are either their Pho Dac Biet or Bun Bo Hue. My mom start ordering the Bun Mang Vit and I had a taste of it and I'm hooked. Bun Mang Vit consist of Thin, springy rice vermicell noodle. Cut up duck meat, bamboo shoots and side dish of fresh lettuce, cabbage, and mint. They also add pig's blood congealed into maroon, tofu-like cubes to their Bun Mang Vit. It's a simple bowl of yummies...BUN means vermicelli noodle...Mang means bamboo....Vit means Duck.

Can't believe I forgot to review this place when I had such a good time!

Walked into this place after being turned off by Snug Harbor and d.b.a. and we happened to be there the night that Young Fellaz Brass Band was playing. We effing love brass bands and were psyched to know that we had stumbled onto a show. They did a bunch of pop covers including Lady Gaga and they change it up as music comes out. These guys are young and adorable and I would pay to see them anytime.

The only downside was that this dickhead from Staten Island got way too drunk and rowdy and kept distracting us from the music. The bartender yelled and him and got the situation under control, but unfortunately didn't kick them out. On behalf of the other boroughs of New York, I apologize (we don't really like people from 'New Jersey Island' either.)

Happy Hour 4-7 PM.  Half price appetizers and if you play the machines your drinks are free.  

Great to get top shelf drinks (can't get those on the floor), not as crowded as the casino floor bars.  Appetizers are yummy and  come from the restaurant next door.  Food service is always pretty fast and the bartenders are always pleasant.

Plus.. live music most nights starting at 6PM.

incidentally, if you have a Peppermill Players Card, and you are a local, you get 20% off all purchases in the shops and restaurants.  Not a bad perk.

First of all please warn people that the salsa is more chipotle sauce than salsa. Our waiter was so obsessed with one of the waitresses that he couldn't even keep his eyes on us long enough to get our drink order ready. I guess they had a blonde children of the corn kinda thing going on. Yikes. Which is surprising since there is several mgrs on the floor. We know this bc we asked a lady mgr for salsa to go w our chips once again bc our waiter was preoccupied with a girl. Then when we left it was a total hang out session of teens at the door. They should b working on the floor rather than all the mgrs. makes more sense. Will not return.

The only reason I go to this place is because you can drink outside. If it wasn't for the patrons and the fact I can bring the dog here while having beer with my friends I probably wouldn't go to the bar at all. It takes forever to get a beer, even for the patrons who frequent the place. 

Haven't had their food nor do I think I will every try it. Beer selection is okay and their prices are fair. The place has a good ambiance and is worth a try.

Me and my boyfriend went to the Fogo by King of Prussia mall. The service was fantastic! I like this location because it's more updated than the one in Philadelphia. Before corona we would love to frequent the salad bar there and all you can eat meats. As always, the food and service is excellent at both places.

It's good, but they shouldn't advertise as an ice cream/froyo company. I mean, I showed up with my two friends looking for ice cream. They only have one flavor of yogurt and it's Greek yogurt, which means it's sour. I got a little dish with caramel sauce, which took away from the sour a bit, but not enough for it to be considered proper froyo dessert. The yogurt is interesting, to be sure, and I'm glad I tried it, but it's not for me.

I love this location.  I come here every few weeks.  The amount of food you get for the price is great.  The quality is great, too.  Never messed up an order, always quick to prepare even when the location is busy, and always friendly when I pick up.

I recently ordered through Yelp and was required to select a spicy level but didn't want any heat.  I added a note to my order that I don't want heat and they prepared the accommodation.  Thanks!
The cafe upstairs is amazing and the wide range and selection ikea has for home improvement and even for restaurants is exceptional.

Oh boy. This was my first time having a cheesesteak, and I was so excited that I got up very early to make sure I got there right at eleven when they opened.

I was clearly too excited. I ordered the nine inch cheesesteak and small fries. It was a little slow, but I figured it must be worth it, since it was a cheesesteak, right?

Wrong. My cheesesteak was cold at the ends, the meat had little to no flavor, the cheese did not enhance the flavorless meat one bit. The best thing abour the cheesesteak was the roll, which was excellent. The fries were pretty tasty too.

Next time I want a cheesesteak, I'll plan a trip to Philly instead.
One of the best! No matter how crowded it is, the lines move quickly w friendly service. Its always clean and food fresh, restaurant is run very efficiently!

I get sushi here at least once a week. This is one of only two places in NOLA that has good (not okay, not average, not edible, but good) sushi. 

I have not had anything like the eel sundae before, but I have gotten it nearly every time since I first ordered it. The salmon martini and ocean pyramid appetizers are awesome, too. I'll typically get either two of those appetizers for a meal, a lunch special or early bird dinner. 

The prices are reasonable, especially for lunch and early dinner. This isn't like the places that charge $7 for a salmon roll that's all rice. You get actual good food for your money.

delicious food. awesome 22oz agave beer.

outside seating and it's off busy washington so you can relax a little bit.

warning, street construction at the moment so it's dusty and loud at times.

Good customer service, the lobby is pretty tiny, and I enjoyed the glass window into the kitchen. The burgers were delicious; didn't try the fries. There wasn't much parking available. I might drive thru at this location if I'm ever in Nashville again. Stopped by late evening - 11 pm. There was a late party crowd which I didn't mind. The line was to the door but the service was fast.

Celebrated our Dance Choreographer and Mentor's birthday at this lovely place. You won't going to imagine that this little plaza have this gem. This place is simple but elegant. Our service was very nice and having big group she had the patience to wait for the rest of the group to arrive and to present their menu. 

They served bread while looking at their menu. Got undecided because everything is amazing, I ended ordering the Tagliatelle Alla Vodka. Our server guaranteed that I made the right choice. And to tell you honestly I DID! The pasta is made fresh and the sauce was creamy and rich with flavor. 

The service was amazing, they made sure that everything is well served as you pleased and the food is spectacular. This place is a GEM! Hands up and definitely will come back for more!

Kudos!

I am pretty new to Korean food. I was excited to try this spot for lunch today, as it's near my neighborhood and reviews seem positive so far. 

Impressions: the space is nicely decorated and clean. Large windows meant natural sunlight. Staff greeted us with smiles and our server CJ was attentive and swift with water refills.

I had the beef bulgogi lunch box, which came with a ton of food. My friend ordered the tofu and mushroom bi bim bap. We were both satisfied with our meals although she said hers was a little greasier than she prefers (I don't know the difference).

I look forward to exploring more of the menu here and I hope to see it get decent business in this location.

this family operation is amazing. i've come several time snow and the quality is consistent- great crawfish, good prices, and everything is well spiced.

the boudin is good but on the mushier side, the smoked sausage is straight up amazing. 

worth going out of the way for!

I am from the south. The collards are real. Buddy and I had the quarter chicken each and split a side of the collards and Mac & cheese. The chicken is really good; it is a little bit spicy. Good service.
Hospitality = GREAT!!! A Cozy off the street local authentic flavor, you'll love it!...
My boyfriend and I aren't the best at holding chopsticks, but the food is still worth it! So delicious

Vegan food can be really good if it's made right. This place does it right. I had a little snafu with the service, but it could be overlooked because of the excellent fare. I love Nashville Hot Chicken (NHC), the indigenous dish of the city. Typically I would describe vegetables as rabbit food. So, for you to say - "You have to try the seitan vegetable protein patty, surrounded by even more vegetables, mimicking NHC.", I would say you're Outta Your Mind like Lil' John (It's a song for those that don't know. Laugh. It's funny.) That said - You have to try it. It is really freaking good!

I cannot say enough good things about my great experience with a luncheon at the Valley Green Inn.  The luncheon was held on short notice and despite just two days notice went off without any issues despite my miscalculation on start time (we ended up arriving 30 minutes before my estimated time) and my underestimating the number of attendees by about 25.  Maggie was great to work with, although I think I stressed her a little with the underestimate on attendees, sorry about that Maggie.  The setting was wonderful, room comfortably accommodated the nearly 90 people we had in attendance and everyone commented on how delicious the food was.

Thank you again Maggie for making the luncheon planning and execution the easiest thing I had to do that week!

I ate at Island plate for the first time today and it was great. I had the Hawaiian BBQ chicken lunch. Delicious and way more food than I could finish. I have yummy leftovers. 
   The staff was super friendly and the chef came out to make sure that everything was the way I wanted it. I will definitely come back.
Very cozy restaurant with excellent freshly made soups, salads, sandwiches, wraps, pastries, and more. Must stop lunch destination. You will feel comfortably full.

If you love to pay a premium for an average steak then this is your place. The prices at this Outback keep rising every few months. The food is good, not great, the service is great but the owner of this franchise is just continually raising rates to overcome the lack of patrons and it's pushing more like me to other restaurants that give you more value for your money.  This is not Fleming's or Morton's but the rates are getting close. Of corse today I come in for the commercial that offers steaks and lobster for $15.99 and of course this proprietor isn't on board woh that.  It's Tucson !   It's $3 more than advertised.  If so we're the franchisee'. I'd kick him to the curb.  He markets and promote as Outback but doesn't offer or charge what moray other Outback's do.   It's cheaper in Phoenix for the same menu.   

I'm done with this establishment.  So many others with better food for for money.  Actually Texas Roadhouse the other day was a better tasting steak for less and more food for your money !!!  Oh yeah !!!!   So I've waited and waited for the raxknof lamb to come back.  Well, now it's $25 and instead of a "rack of lamb" I got 3 small chops for the same price.  3 !!!  Wasn't even full after my meal and now my favorite has been reduced to a meal for  seniors or a snack for the rest of us.  Lol.

Our hotel was on St. Charles, so it was really close to Jimmy J's Cafe. We walked in and was greeted by a friendly bartender/hostess/takeout person. The restaurant is tiny and every table was occupied. We waited outside for maybe 10 minutes before a table opened up. Our waiter was wonderful. All the servers were wonderful, actually. My husband ordered the fried shrimp & oyster po-boy and I had the French toast Monte Cristo. The food came out promptly and it was good. By then the line had started to form outside and we realized how lucky we were to have avoided the long line (we were there right at 9am on a Friday). We had a very nice experience. Service was friendly and prompt. The food was very good (not super special, but good). Overall, we thought the visit was special. I would go back again and try some of their other offerings.

Our first time and we had an amazing experience! The Service, The Food, The Atmosphere! A+
Loved it and will be back for sure!
Eli & Kevin Sulton-Rivera

I ordered online through grubhub.  I agree with the other comments about the long wait as it was .5 miles away.  Delivery guy was nice but not a good experience.  I live in Dobson which can be a very tricky complex to figure out so I wrote really great instructions on the order.  The guy gets there and calls and asks if Im going to meet him out front.  Actually sir, if I wanted to take the 3 minutes to get to my car and the 2 minutes to drive to the front of the complex, then I would just go pick up the order. No biggie, maybe hes never delivered there or he was new. Completely ignored the instructions which were printed on my receipt.  Then he gets through the gate and I spend about 10 minutes on the phone with him trying to help him find me, he was one of those guys that would go left if you said right, and up if you said down.  Nothing is more irritating then being on the phone that long knowing your food is getting cold and its so close yet so far. But again, he was nice.  I get the food and its hot! Score 1 star there.  I ordered buffalo tenders and spaghetti Alfredo.    The buff tenders tasted like a tangy bqq sauce, Im pretty sure it was majority bbq sauce in their buff recipe,  I thought that was extremely weird and highly displeasing. And here's the extra salty part and then ill end my long rant.  I wrote in the instruction box no onions on the salad that came with the pasta.  I know most of these salads are already prepared so no biggie if it comes with them, I usually don't eat it anyway, but someone actually took the time to add EXTRA onions to the salad and went a step further to throw onions in the bag that held my napkins and plastic ware, just chilling in the bag.  Come on dude really? Were you that butt hurt I tried to save you a waste of onions?  It's was beyond overkill, it made me worried they might have tampered with my other food. I would not recommend this place nor would I order again.  Be wary of notes on the food,  its apparently  a big deal to them

Whenever I want a casual-yet-classy atmosphere and a great happy hour, there's no question -- Armitage it is. I've never had a bad glass of wine or a bad meal here. The menu changes often enough to stay fresh and seasonal, but they keep the classics available: the spinach and artichoke dip and the ahi tuna sliders are standouts of deliciousness.

The service is friendly and non-obtrusive, the bartenders are cheerful, and I've noticed a lot of the same faces working here over the years, which to me speaks of a well-run establishment. The ambiance is chatty, relaxed, and with good seating options -- long tables for groups, regular tables, and some too-comfortable huge leather sofas.

Armitage is a wine bar, so the real test is in the wine list, which is stellar and reasonably priced. I've seen the same wines across the street at Fleming's for at least $2 more by the glass. Armitage always chooses a good New Zealand Marlborough region sauvignon blanc by the glass, which I love.

Sundays are a great time to go, as there's live music at 8 and happy hour starting from 4pm onwards... and before you know it, you've been sitting there drinking and talking and eating for hours on end. 

Highly recommended.

This was such a disappointment, and total waste of a cover charge.  Upon entering you have to walk up a bunch of stairs.  If you could see the inside from the outside, you wouldn't bother.  It's dark, barely any walking room, no dance floor, and we only saw one waitress.  The song they sing for a woman's birthday is completely vulgar.  I'll never go back.
I was really excited about going.  The dueling piano bar in NOLA was one of my favorite memories.  The one in Nashville is just....bad.  Don't waste your money.

I think this will be a staple breakfast spot for whenever I visit Philly. Great atmosphere and super friendly staff. The coffee is fresh and smooth. Of course, the breakfast sandwiches are amazing well. Just everything about it was nice and cozy. I can't wait to return!
Sat at the bar and enjoyed chips and salsa, and a blood orange margarita. The atmosphere, customer service and food was fantastic! A+.

2nd visit to this "mom and pop" restaurant, and I still love the food. I do want to point out that they've  moved a little further up the street since my last visit, however this is great because parking is so much better at this location  Thanks again for this homemade meal!

i went there awhile back and got a huge surprise along with my Beef Kobidah a dead COCKROACH, DISGUSTING, GROSS EWWWW.... the owner kept telling me it had fallan from the cieling, which I clearly knew it was straight from the kitchen grill because it also had spices on it YUMMY han??  dinning area might look nice but kitchen, you now know it, when i was leaving I glanced by kitchen the owner and cheff had started cleaning it....

Waitress just slipped on a wet floor and hit her head. 
THE BASTARDS FIRED HER because she couldn't get up to serve a customer. 
Please, never go there unless it's to beat a manager with a mug.

I absolutely need to give this place a buncha LOVE!  

Pro Highlights: delicious sushi on the cheap; the 3-roll special; super sweet staff; to-go (I'm-too-full-to-finish-all-my-sushi/edamame) packaging; anything with their tempura shrimp in it (*drools a lil*..mmm :)

If-I-Have-To-Find-Fault-In-Something Cons: this is really minimal (really), but it was a little warm in there (it was mid-April, and definitely more comfy outside than in).  Also, hearing the microwave *ding* was clearly how a soup or edamame was heated up - everything was delicious & I totally don't really care - but maybe kill the sound on the microwave to keep it on the DL..shhh..

Details:  
So this place used to be 'Yamaki Sushi' which was 'meh' on atmosphere, but the staff was nice, the service was quick (for a take-out lunch), and their food was tasty, so it was fine in my book.  The Tempura Shrimp roll was utter 'crack' to me..I'd have dreams about it and (even if I was in the midst of low-carb-diet-stoopidness) would need to break down and get that for lunch.  Everything Pro has maintained in Machi Sushi!

But WOW!..What a nice surprise!..I was bringing a few friends to what I thought was going to be the 'meh' atmosphere Yamaki Sushi for a bite to eat before we saw a show, walked up and saw the new sign and decor - again, WOW!..it looked beautiful - new stylish decor, seating, layout (it's small, but has a pleasant comfortableness).

There were 4 of us, we all got different rolls (the 3-roll special is just the most wonderful idea - cheers for this offering) & sides, and everything had a picturesque presentation, the server was so so sweet, wrangled our bottles of wine, and kept our table clear of those in-the-way empty dishes, but wasn't clingy & *ahem* "overly-helpful" even though we were the only ones in there at the time.

I got two of my three rolls as the shrimp tempura roll..would it be silly to get all three as shrimp tempura?..nah, I think not - it's that delicious.  To have a brief shrimp-tempura-moment, Machi doesn't leave all the un-edible shrimp bits that are a pain in the arse to eat and/or dig out of your mouth & teeth. No crunchy shrimp tail garbage, no weird, awkwardly large pices to eat that are.."decorative"..just tasty shrimpy shrimp & rice &..was that cucumber?..I dunno..I was focused on shrimp. Yum!

We were served at a good pace, and because you can actually get full on the 3-roll deal (especially if you have a side or two), me and the boyfriend had left-overs, which the super sweet server packed up with such care, it really made an impression.  You know how a left-overs take-out bag is usually just 'stuff' tossed in containers randomly?..well ours was packed with care, included chopsticks, extra ginger & a small container of soy sauce - well schucks! That probably cost a few extra pennies, but was really nice & a definite extra reason why I absolutely (& have) recommend this place!  

Go here, eat, smile, and support this lovely establishment!

I am hungry and I need food. I happen to stop in an Art Gallery and I asked rhe gentleman who had the best food around the area. He said Oceana. So I decided to check it out. I figured the food here must be great because there was a line out the building.  

Once inside I decided to order the shrimp alfredo pasta. That dish runs you about $19 a plate. I love pasta especially from a cajun restaurant so I was ready. Once my food came out I was so disappointed with the way it looked. I felt robbed of a true pasta dish. It was more sauce than anything else. I am sure I injested more alfredo sauce than noodles and shrimp. I have definitely had better. The bowl was so shallow. I don't think I have eaten out of that kind of bowl since I was a child.

I must say, I'm pretty happy I waited for another visit before reviewing because the ratings would've been quite different. I think I knew what to expect and how to order properly the second time around, and that made all the difference. Not to scare any newbies to Korean food however! 

First time we walked in for lunch and were seated immediately. Second time we made reservations for dinner for a party of 8 and sat in a private room in the back made for large parties! It's a really great place for a big family feasts! Sharing here is super fun! Highly recommend for a different big din with family and friends! It's more like an experience that way! 

Their banchan (appetizers) are given very generously. Their zucchini is fantastic and definitely my favorite. Kiddos loved the seaweed and the fam all went nuts on the fried whole fish. My Korean sister in law says their kimchee is some of the best around. 

I started with a steaming tofu soondubu (hot pot) which I did have on my first visit and absolutely loved! Filling, flavorful and spiced just right. They'll ask you how spicy. Best to go weaker. You could always add hot chili oil. Vegans and vegetarians, let them know and they will make yours with veggie broth instead of oxtail broth!!  

Hubs also had a soondubu, curry mushroom and was very happy with his as well! The addition of the curry made us a little weary, but it actually went together rather well. He asked for it sans some veggies and they obliged, no issue. They are very accommodating here! 

We also had the Veggie japachae (fried noodle and veggies) which was very good! A simpler dish with great taste and a good option for the kiddos! 

The fam LOVES the La Galbi (beef short ribs)!! They couldn't get enough and speak about these often. They're given with scissors, in large chunks, and in larger portions. A big hit! 

After dinner we were asked if we wanted the water rice which is basically the burnt water left in the clay bowls the rice was cooked in. It's traditional and is supposed to help with digestion after a meal. I tried it and just couldn't do it. Everyone else at the table enjoyed it very much. Try it once I guess? 

We were able to bring our own cake for a duel Birthday. Maybe consider Dubu for your next celebration?!

Service was absolutely incredible and even the owner made it a point to stop by. 

It was such a great night and made me very much look forward to another visit real soon! 

*It's easy to miss when driving down Cheltenham so keep your eyes peeled. The sign is smaller and coming back around is a pain. 

**Play area for wee ones too!
Great breakfast!! Had the loco moco... Felt like I was back in Hawaii. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Would definitely come back again if we travel through Reno.
Came in from a flight from Virginia. Wanted some plant-based food and was blown away. The Vegan Panini was beyond my expectations. The staff is so welcoming. Loved the whole experience

The waitress wasnt the best but she tried, thats all I ask.

The food was great. From the redneck eggrolls (they were fried with bbg in the middle cheese and something else) very tasty.

I had the ribs with fries cole slaw and texas toast. It was done well.

A good experience.

Atmosphere was nice. Told us 15 minutes to be seated faster. Place was crowded. Waitress right away. Placed our order. Waited for 35 minutes waitress came back to tell us our order was in the pan. We are starving at this point. She didn't offer an apology or a discount.  We walked out. Can't tell you if the food was any good.

Great cafe for chilling out and having a healthy meal (get the sauces on the side, hold the cheese) or snack by the lake. They have a small variety of wine and beer, so it's a great spot for "date night" without having to drive anywhere if you are a Waterset resident. Good variety of panini sandwiches and crepes! They don't have a fryer, so not the place to go if you're craving French fries.

This cafe is inside a neighborhood, so it has a country club feel. :)

I had heard good things about this restaurant and it was even better than what I expected! Our waiter was friendly and helpful. The food was delicious. We started with the Mango Crab Rangoon and spicy edamame, which puts a fun twist on classic appetizers. I had the Blue Crunch roll and my friend had the Hot Popper. Both were creative and very fresh. There were so many unique rolls I can't wait to go back and try. Great selection of sake. I will definitely recommend this restaurant to others and I am planning on going back in the near future, especially on Sundays when they have drink specials and half price sushi!!
This place was just horrible. The buffet and tiny, and so was the selection. Food was inexpensive but you get what you pay for.

There was a lot of talk about the ramen noodle soup so of course I had to try it.  I decided to order the chicken paitan and oh my! The first sip just that warmth felt it down my spine. All the herbs and mixture was perfect perfect for a cold day in Fl. The bowl size was decent size filled me up.
 Customer service was great do not have any complaints in that department definitely had my food ready fast.
At age 63, I've had more than my share of ribs and brisket so when I say this is the best I've ever had, that's something. And the people working it are wonderful.

Technically it's no longer The Other Green Line, but I guess that it's one of those names you can't escape once you decide to use it. The Other Green Line was the cafe that they closed down in favor of renovating another bigger spot, and calling it something like "That Other The Other Green Line" would be pretty damn confusing (and would ironically be something that I would probably do).

Now they just call it Green Line Cafe which is equally similar to the other two and pretty plain. But you realize how significantly different it is the moment you bask in it's hugeness and check out a show. 

Just Clarifying -

The Not So Other McThrill

Go for happy hour and have half off pizza and drinks. The pizza is worth paying full price (nice crust that is soft on top, but crispy on the bottom with the right amount of sauce, and super high quality cheese), so thats a wonderful deal.

Mona's was recommended to me by a couple locals I met back in Chicago. I was so focused on where to get poboys but these guys insisted, so we went.
It's a really cute place on Frenchman, attached to their middle eastern store which is a great way for them to bulk up business. 
We loved our server, oscar. Honestly he probably gave us the best service we had during our whole stay in New Orleans.
We got the veggie grape leaves and a little meat pie to start. 
I love grape leaves so I was super happy. They give you this thick yogurt sauce that was really good too. 
Then we split the half and half plate, with chicken shawarma and gyro meat. They give you the warm pita and you fill it yourself with the salad and meats. It was so good. I love being able to control my portions. The lamb/beef gyro meat was so good! I really hope they make it in house. Flavor was great. The shawarma was flavorful and yummy too. Really enjoyed this place, and glad to see it was pretty busy.
Ordered online, food was at my door in 10 min flat. Subs were awesome. Will be a repeat customer.

This place is just gorgeous. I was blown away by the ambiance, the decor, the view, the drinks, the food. XIX has the whole package. My pomegranate basil martini was to die for. There were lovely little seating areas where us "happy hour-ers" could cozy up with our drinks and settle in for some good conversation. The mushroom risotto was a bit al dente for some of the folks I was with... but it was just right for me. The fried asparagus spears and the calamari were de-lish.

I would definitely return here, especially if I were out to impress someone.

Very disappointing breakfast today. Not very busy, I guess everyone was out shopping during Black Friday. I sat at counter and was surprised to see that several orders had to be remade. Having been to locations in Jax several times and this location 4 times previously I was not alarmed. My order comes first notice that bacon was not crispy as I requested. In fact I told her to tell them to burn it. Anyhow I still dug in...one bite of eggs ice cold. Took 5 minutes for waitress to return by this time I had enough. Paid my bill and left. When I paid my plate was basically untouched. No comment about to go box. I actually ran into 2 friends in the parking lot who were headed in but they went to Jimbos after my story. I left and went to wawa where I got a scrambled egg bowl with warm eggs. I am so disappointed in metro that I will have to think about ever going back. F on food today and D- on service. Get it fixed metro.

Food was delicious and even though the restaurant was really full I got seated pretty quickly.  Although the wait staff was not overly friendly and kind of slow taking our order, the food here def made up for it!  I ordered the chili chicken, extra spicy, and it was really really good!  Came with some white rice that was warm and fresh.  All the food around the restaurant smelled and looked amazing!  My friend too ordered the chili chicken and shrimp fried rice!  She said the rice was good as was her chicken.  When we finally got the bill, it was written in another language so we had a little bit of difficulty deciphering home much each of us owed, but mostly figured it out!  The took our payment super quick.  Would def want to go there again and try more of the food!

We've celebrated our anniversary here. The foods is average not so great compared to other high demand restaurant that we've been to, the service is very nice and friendly. The prices is a little pricey but only if the foods is great then I wouldn't mind about the price if it's worth it.

You want this!  We came here without expectations and were blown away.  

First, it was very clean and well maintained.  Clearly the management is on it.

Service was friendly and attentive.  Our waitress, Rosie was awesome. She gave us options on the menu to suit everyone in the family. Rosie anticipated what we needed and made our experience here great. 

The food was the biggest surprise.  Get the fried chicken. Just do it!  I'm not sure I've ever tasted a better seasoned chicken, even at fancy restaurants. Portion sizes were generous and everything worked great together.  Chicken & Waffles were clearly the star. 

Overall, Metro Diner is well worth visiting. We certainly will next time we're in Tampa.

Ulele is one of the coolest places in the South Tampa/Downtown area. A very different, eclectic menu with the best appetizers and side dishes! The Pulpo Carpaccio is unbelievable! Great indoor/outdoor seating. A nice place to bring kids in the earlier hours as parents can eat outside while the kids play in an open field.

Highly recommend sitting outdoors. Service was good too. I got the shrimp and scallop linguine and my wife the pork chop. The linguine was bland and waaaay overpriced. The pork chop, however, was among the best I have ever had. I also had a Bloody Mary that was good, not great. I would also suggest skipping the salmon nachos, meh. We will be returning because I want to try the pork chops for myself.

I have been searching for wheat bran at all the regular stores...Publix, Walmart...I didn't realize this store wasn't far from me and was so amazing.  I found it on yelp, called and they had it.  Short drive and not only did they have it, they had 3 brands to select from.  I will be back for healthier choices in food.  Customer service was great.   Thank you.

I didn't feel like the food was authentic at all. The chips were old, thin and not crunchy.  The salsa was ok in taste but had huge chunks of canned tomatoes, not fresh ones. I ordered a regular burrito and it looked like an enchilada. I even asked the waitress if my order was correct.  The burrito only consisted of carne asada- no beans, rice, pico de gallo, etc.  Sour cream and guacamole is extra, but I didn't care for that. 

Service wasn't that great either, but very nice staff. I had to ask for utensils and napkin. I guess I was spoiled with good quality Mexican food back home in California because I didn't taste an ounce of it here.

Was very disappointed. Oxtails were not done and the gravy was sweet. First West Indian eatery I have seen since visiting Reading Market so I was really excited and looking forward to my choice of lunch.

Never have left a restaurant so upset and disappointed in a experience. Took over an hour for food on a Monday night with a half empty restaurant. No apology no excuses, just a simple lack of caring for the service of their guests. Food was good, but it's not worth the long wait, lack of service, and utter disregard for guests.
