I am in love with Frazer's. I have had nearly every item on the menu, and I absolutely LOVE that they have specials with various local items. My favorite is the fish special over the feta mashed potatoes. 

The craft cocktail menu is extensive, and there is something for everyone. I really love the soda pop fizzle. It's sweet, but not too sweet.

Not only do all of the dishes and drinks appeal in taste, but they are also visually appealing. 

If you are in the area, give it a try. The price point will also depend on how many items you have. If you go with a date, you each get an appetizer, two cocktails, and two entrees, you will surely spend close to $100 with tip. Trust me... this place is worth every penny.

Excellent service, fair prices food was delicious. We had the seafood Caesar salad for the appetizer and it was very tasty full of shrimp and crab meat We also had two  entrées the scallops are which were broiled in butter and the sides were excellent they cook the vegetables were absolutely delicious.  The other entrée was crabcakes with a Romalade sauce.   The rice & veggies were also perfectly cooked & tasty.  Too full for desert so next time we will start with desert.
Amazing food, atmosphere and service. The steak, potatoes, Mac & cheese, baked beans, etc are amazing.

I ate here about a month ago for dinner and was hesitant to return for lunch but was pleasantly surprised! I had the veggie tempura and the Green Sesame roll which was delicious. Service was friendly and I'd definitely return for lunch!

We did the cemetery tour! It was a great tour and our guide was great! It is a long tour so on a hot day it could be rough in direct sunlight for older or younger ones. We were very happy with our tour!

Endless array of awesome food to choose from. You can get cooked, made to order, fresh from the seafood or butcher counter, and produce. Tons of great sweets and desserts. Also great Amish stores for goods and foods.
Perfect place to grab a tasty breakfast. Popular and staff attentive.

Yum!  Seams sort of ridiculous to say but it's the first thing that comes to mind when I eat here......

Today was my second visit and it exceeded the first.  One might wonder, how can a strip mall tamale place be in Yelp's top 20 Indianapolis restaurants? They execute!  Now, this is coming from a gringa from VA but I love spicy, authentic flavors.  

For those of you, planning to visit, when you go to the counter, the list of available tamale varieties is on a screen to the left of where you order ( do not count on what you might find listed on the online menu), We enjoyed the chipotle beef and the chicken verde in a banana leaf.  They are so big you ALMOST don't need to order anything else but as we only get though town sporadically, we added a fish taco, spicy beef taco and a side of black beans.

I'm so full, but so happy :)

We went on a Saturday night.  Despite having reservations for 7pm for 6 of us we were not seated until about 7:45.  Service wasn't great.  The food is delicious, but given the service and options in town I won't be rushing back here.

We came by on a slow Saturday after bachelorette and got Erika as a server. She was fantastic and made the difference between just a cocktail on the way home and the perfect end to the night. THANK YOU!

After reading good things about the chicken salad on Yelp, I was excited to try out this spot for lunch.  Upon arrival, I realized there were many versions of chicken salad and elected to try the Apple Walnut Chicken Salad in a wrap.  I found it a little unsettling that prices were not listed anywhere, so I was surprised when my wrap rang up for $7+, which was a little on the high side...at least you get some fresh grapes with that.  I would have liked a little more salt in the chicken salad and a lower price, but it's not a bad option if you need a quick lunch.  I will say that the pre-made sandwiches look delicious in the deli case, so I will probably be back to try one of those.

This is by far my favorite restaurant. I LOVE breakfast food, so naturally I love the food here, but the customer service is unbeatable! You are always greeted with a smile when you walk in and the servers are unbelievably nice throughout your whole visit. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great dining experience.

Red Velvet Pancakes. (Enough Said)

Also the best bloody mary I've ever had. Obviously go with the Bacon. 

This place gets busy on the weekends, and does not take reservations. You will probably wait if you don't get there early. I assure you the wait is worth it. 

The portions are HUGE. My girlfriend had the red velvet pankcakes and ate about a 1/3 of them. I got the salmon benny, and the amount of salmon that was on there was ridicouls, more than I have ever received anywhere else.

Best Thai food in the area.

The White Elephant is a small, quaint restaurant located in the Rockledge/Huntingdon Valley section of Montgomery county,  It's located in a shopping center right off of Huntingdon Pike where there is a Giant and Crunch Fitness right near it.

Everything on the menu is phenomenal especially the "Pad Thai" (I'm a weekly visitor). More authentic than those Thai spots in the city.  The prices are reasonable and affordable, and you don't have to pay for parking!  Very friendly staff, and the service is fast and efficient.

Please do yourself a favor, and a pay a visit to the White Elephant.
If you are hesitant trying Thai food, try the White Elephant. Just try it. Open your imagination, trust your gut, and thank me later.

Extremely unprofessional and inappropriate staff and management. My waiter was beyond rude and immature. I literally feel like I was dealing with a 6 year old. He was annoyed when I asked for a description of the seafood dip. He rolled his eyes when I complained that my cup was dirty. When I complained that my food order was made incorrectly the waiter sighed. I complained to managment and he suggested that he give me the check and I leave.  The food that I did recieve, guac, was under seasoned. It says a lot about a Mexican restaurant that cannot even make guacomole. I would suggest going to Buena Vista, food there is much better and staff is polite. I'm surprised this resteraunt survived the pandemic.

I loved it here! The place is very cozy with friendly waitstaff. I came here for brunch with girlfriends. We all ordered something different and loved each of our dishes. I highly recommend the juicy crab cake sandwich, fried chicken sandwich, or seared tuna club. I will be back!

We went there last night 4/11/2018.  We were seated right away and our order taken.  Than the constant interruption of at least 13 times during the meal by the waitress, manager, food servers, and the assistant manger, interrupting our meal asking what we needed,  how we were doing, how was the food, or I'll bring your check right over to push us out the door.  Did you want desert? Our food was cold from the constant interruptions.  I finally stood up and asked aloud,  "if your trying to ruin our dinner you have!"  What a joke, this place needs to be closed, the building bulldozed and a new restaurant built on it ashes.  I guess I missed the banner on the door on the way in, "now hiring immediate opening for wait staff."  If you see this on the door turn and run away.
Was in philly for work and went there for lunch , they had a very limited menu . Picked a falafel sandwich and it was so delicious !! Would highly recommend to try it !!

Duelune has opened a new location on the corner of State and Cabrillo. It has a beautiful patio perfect for enjoying an Italian meal. The branding is my favorite but the pappardelle bolognese is hard to pass up. He food is fresh and authentic- don't leave without tasting the tiramisu- the food and service are top notch

I was not impressed with the service nor the food. My colleagues and I went there for lunch. The FIVE of us were seated at a booth more suited for four-- purses, winter coats and all. Just a few feet away, a table set for six sat empty. Why? 

The food was very average. I can make a better omelette and hashbrowns at home. And apparently their definition of a "toasted" english muffin means slightly warmed with a clump of cold butter on it. 

I won't go to this restaurant.
Great food, good service. Order from Gino's all the time. Reasonably priced. Best pizza in the area.

Probably some of the best  Mediterranean I've had. Shrimp and Koftka were excellent, as well as their hummus and butter sauce. 

4 stars only because the service was really slow, especially since we were the only table the entire time we were there. We actually had to find our waiter a few times to get drink refills. Maybe they're more responsive when they're busy...

This place is awesome. Not much to say about it other than that. The whole shop is run by a group of white women who make some of the best damn tamales I've ever had, if not the best period. I've lived 30 minutes from the mexican border my whole life and still never had tamales this good until I found this place. Every time I went to and from school at IU i would stop here on my way to or from the airport and pick up a big bag of tamales. They keep very well. I like the spicy ones and the ones wrapped in banana leaves the best. 

Two tips:
1. Call when they open to reserve the best kinds cuz they run out of the best ones quickly
2. Always check the cold tamale list for super discounted tamales that didn't sell the day before. They reheat quite wonderfully.

This is a great Lunch spot, much more than just soups! My company has recently relocated from Downtown Tampa to Ybor City and Stone Soup is fast becoming one of the favorites for lunch. The Ybor Chili and "Thai" Me Up are two of my favorite soups on the menu; they also have great Pork Tacos and Sandwiches. I haven't found anything I don't like yet, and look forward to continuing to explore their Menu.

This place is so good! 
We tried several sandwiches and loved them a great deal.  They have inside and outside seating. 

Fries get one to share for all!

I'm a foodie and I don't eat fastfood. I found this restaurant on Yelp under "gastropubs". This was one of the best food experiences I have had in a while. I came in for a burger but got the pork belly tacos and garlic parm tater tots. Best meal ever! I also ordered the Elderberry Sour ale. Delicious!! The staff was very professional as well. I will definitely return.

The pho ...I get 12a....is superb!  Its like comfort food your mom gives you when your sick. .the broth is excellent. ..service excellent,  don't forget to get their bubble tea which is a smoothie type drink with big tapioca pearls inside...lushious! Great service,  they need to crank the ac up a bit its always a bit warm in there...great bang for your buck! I go about 2/3 times a month there...I'm probably the only one who checks in I guess! Haha!

Martin's is the place to go in terms of Nashville barbeque. It is NOT a tourist trap, it is the real, local deal. If you're with a group I recommend going with the sampler so that you can try a little bit of everything. 

Brisket, ribs, and pulled pork, and sides upon sides (broccoli salad being my favorite!). This food will leave you feeling what I call "southern satisfied," aka way to full. 

The line can often times seem overwhelming, but the staff members get through the line fairly quickly. Regardless, the food is absolutely worth the wait. They offer endless drink options, a large dining section, a rooftop patios, and game tables up top. This place is fun and filling, one of the greatest dining options available downtown.

This is a hard review to write.  The music is 5 star without a doubt.  Though the rest of the bar and restaurant is easily 2 star, if not worse.  First, the bad.  There is a half rectangle bar with a poor selection of beer, booze, and wine.  The bartenders seem to be rude, forgetful, and not very well informed on what is going on.  The restaurant area is nice, but the food is really generic.  Some seafood, burgers, etc, that you can find anywhere in the area.  The separate music hall is immaculate however.

If it was not for the font bar/restaurant area this place would be awesome.  I reserved my tickets over the phone, and they were very informative in what to expect.  A great venue for music.  The acoustics are top notch, there is not a bad seat here.  The balcony is perfect.  Ellis Marsells is a gem.  Delfeayo Marsalis sat in and stole the show.  Really world class music.  I wanted to just review the music venue, but it would be disingenuous for me not to grade and mention the other halves mess.  Go see a great show, avoid the rest.

I've eaten here many times both for take out and dine in, most recently last Friday night. 

I've only ever had their pizza and it is probably in my top three favorites in the area. My only complaint is that they don't use fresh mushrooms. But they don't skimp on the extra cheese so that always wins me over. They also very thinly slice their peppers and onions which I think is ideal on a pizza.  It isn't New York style it has a thicker crust which is why it will take a little longer than most places to cook. We always get the Queen' special which is basically a supreme.  

As far as the restaurant, the staff has always been nice and the place itself clean. It isn't the cheapest pizza you'll order but I feel you get your monies worth here.

PS - they only serve beer and wine. 

Also, I've seen coupons on their website from time to time. Worth checking out before you go!

Avec le Gumbo, le Jambalaya et l'étouffée d'écrevisses le Po'Boy est une spécialité à goûter absolument si vous passez à la Nouvelle Orléans
Parkway Bakery and Tavern est un endroit de choix pour ce faire.
Le lieu est agréable et l'ambiance festive bien qu'un peu bruyante.
A faire absolument.
Amazing oxtail best we ever had including philly. Mac and cheese is amazing too! Love the chef/owners always so nice.

We were 4 indians, we went there 2130 hours, restaurant website says it closes at 2200. The lady who served us told us we had to order everything we wanted because they closed the kitchen at 2245! While we were eating, the one man started to vacuum annoying our experience. We did not get a water refill once. We ordered dessert and while we were enjoying dessert and a conversation, we were asked multiple times if we wanted our dessert packed!!! Highly annoying! Then while we finishing our dessert they turn the lights off a few times hinting to us that they are trying to close!!! Worst service ever. Chefs are Ok.
Awesome for families. Fast. Amazing food. Clean. Good vibes. Bomb sweet tea. Overall perfect!

So amazing and fresh and yummy! Good energy vibes, comfy seats. Local and organic ingredients YES!
Best bang for your buck--huge portion sizes (Im talking giant market veggie salad with tempeh for $9.50!) very affordable. Especially considering ingredients are of the best quality and the most responsible sourcing.
 Go wild for wild cow!

I'll start by saying I'm not an avid reviewer but a big chipotle customer. I am mustering up everything to give this store one star. They used to be great but over the past 6 months the have had the worst service of any chipotle I've seen. Rice is dry and clumpy, staff is very unfriendly and does not take instructions well which ruins the order. 

Most importantly, I strongly feel that if you charge me extra for certain meats, I better get a normal portion, and it seems that they start skimping out at the end of the day to avoid running out or making it or whatever the reason may be. I have had to ask for double meat last three times, being embarrassed to ask them to give a real portion.

The staff seems to be new every time I go in there, which creates a lot of inconsistency and has ruined the last dinner I'll order from there.
Lots of other chipotles around that would get it right. 

I highly urge everyone to skip getting food here

I only wish I could give Latin Twist Cafe 0 stars. This was our second time visiting. The first time featured really slow, inattentive service but food was worthy of a second chance. We went in to place a take out order on an admittedly busy Saturday evening. I stood in front of the register for at least 10 minutes -- directly in front of an employee taking orders. She was dreadfully slow and rather rude to a senior citizen paying for her order. Not once did any of the numerous employees acknowledge customers waiting to place orders. This despite all serving and food staff standing less than 2 feet away. It is not my practice to beg an establishment to take my money. I walked out without ordering and I shall not return. Service here is nonexistent.

What a disappointment. Very little of this meal was worth praising.

We originally had a table inside (which was as gorgeous in person as the photos show), but opted to sit in the covered area outside earlier in the day due to a time crunch. The Elysian Sour cocktail was probably the best part of the meal. The fritters were also very good. Besides those things, the rest of the meal was fine at best.

The riccota was good, though a bit simple and expensive for what it was. We opted to go for the extra bread (a $5 charge) upon being recommended to do so by our server. When the two modest pieces of bread were brought with the ricotta and we inquired as to where the extra was, we were told that was it. The bread was good, but for pretty standard bread coated in butter/oil, it felt like a complete ripoff to have to pay extra for it. The pieces are so small that you effectively are forced to get the extra to eat all the riccota. The shrimp and grits were fine, though I've always been bothered when shrimp heads are left on when you're paying a decent amount for the food. In something like shrimp and grits where it's a fairly messy meal, you have to either lose some of the meat or reach into your meal and get your hands dirty in soupy grits. Either way, I was fishing antennae, guts, shells out of the bowl while trying to eat it. Some of the heads were smashed when it was served which is pretty unappetizing. Staff was fine, though I did witness a lot of drinks losing their liquid as they were carried to the tables.

The outdoor atmosphere was a huge step down. While not totally the restaurant's fault since it was outdoors, we were surrounded by flies the entire meal. Some of them made their way into food and drinks while we were eating. There were at least ten flies on our table and plates and glasses on several occasions. Having fans could be helpful. Additionally, despite being covered, there was a hole in the cover that led to a pretty steady stream of water coming down onto me, forcing me to move. It was a real bummer, especially because we had earlier acknowledged how we were pleased with the outdoor arrangement.

I had no expectations of this place, as I had not previously heard of it, but it was really a letdown. It seems to attract a certain type of young, hip crowd, but there is just so much better food in this city.
Hands down the best donuts & coffee in STL! My go to is the pecan caramel! ! The staff is always so friendly and the donuts ALWAYS fresh.

Very very poor food quality. We came through drive thru yesterday day and very slow. Cashier was in a rude moody attitude. Today we did mobile order here they messed our order up so bad. Do not recommend at all.

Great local seafood with very fresh fish. When we got the bill we were surprised that it was so fairly priced.
Seemed very busy with very pleasant staff.

Besel replaced the pipes in my newly purchased 1958 house after a leak. They responded immediately. I highly recommend them. The work done was amazing. They showed up on time. Left everything clean. Did their best to minimize disruption to our lives. The work was done in the promised time frame   Dave, Steve and Sean were professional and knowledgeable. Working with the owner Mike and George was so easy. We will use them again for any plumbing needs. I would rate them higher than five stars if I could.

Wow!!! Everything was on point. Sat at the bar like I normally do and had the chicken sandwich which was so delicious, (better then Popeyes). But what made the experience the very best was the service! Julia was so attentive to my every need. Way to go Capital!

First, be aware that this restaurant has about 10 seats at a counter, plus a few outdoors. Chances are you will have to wait to get a seat. Based on the line standing over your shoulder, you feel some pressure to order, eat, and go. Not a place to leisurely take your lunch.

The menu is the smallest I have ever seen in a restaurant: About 4 grilled cheese sandwiches, fries, tomato soup, sodas in cans, a dessert or two, and a couple of sides, plus a daily special. I knew they specialized in grilled cheese, but expected a dozen or so varieties, from 'plain' to exotic. Not so. 

Now the good news. The food was excellent, both the grilled cheese and the fries. I had the caprese sandwich, and my wife the daily special. We both had a soda, and shared an order of cheese fries. The fries were really excellent, and for me, if I go again, I will omit the cheese on them, as they are 'seasoned' fries and really excellent without the cheese.

With tip, it cost $29, which to me is a little high for 2 meat-less sandwiches, one order of fries, and two 12 ounce cans of soda.

Will I return? Probably. My wife LOVES grilled cheese sandwiches. But I am not rushing back. Grilled cheese sandwiches are pretty easy to make at home, for a lot less money. Five star quality, but minus a star for lack of variety, sodas in cans, and price.
Ok food but maybe I would order something different next time   Did not care for the breaded shrimp general tsos

Food was average at best. I know this was a buffet but the selection of items felt incomplete and uncomplimentary of each other. Service was terrible, in terms of a server with a terrible attitude, speed, and price. The only thing I gained was learning not to eat here ever again.

LOVED this place. Popped in right after a crossfit class and it was the perfect food for refueling. I love the build your own now concept and the staff was quick to give recommendations as it was my first time here. Quinoa and kale salad was bomb and so was the BBQ chicken. I wish they had a spot in CA. I was telling all of my friends back home about it!!!

One of our stops on Reno Brew Bike. Actually it was our 1st stop lol

Ummmmm well we kinda had to wait a while to order our drinks and being that we were on a time frame that was not convenient. I guess even if we were not on on a time frame waiting to order is never convenient.

Once we did order our drinks and noticed my wine glass had lipstick marks on it NO BUENO    I didnt have time to order another drink or get another glass....

WARNING Once you eat here you'll be turned off to your usual sub shops! Authentic fantastic Italian foods and deli.  Food done so well it leaves the rest in the dust.   Once you have a meatball sub (my usual) you'll taste the superior ingredients and not bother ordering a meatball sub anywhere else. 
A blessing in the neighborhood.

This is similar to the chain Mitchell Seafood.  Very good quality food accross the board.  I also  had a real friendly bartender on this day.  He served me quickly so I could get on with my day.  Cheers!

How is it possible that every roll here is always amazing. My favorite are 1. Happy feet 2. Lava Roll 3. Black and Gold (which are all pictured along with rock n roll) and then I also love the monster roll. I'm convinced any roll would be great here. I liked the Baton Rouge location more but now NOLA has all the same rolls. Great service, nice ambiance. Good but expensive drinks. Can be a long wait if it's a busy night.

Gave this place 2 stars, only because the location was somewhat clean and the employees were nice and helpfull. We did find just not one piece of hair in our food, but two. The manager refunded the one meal that had the hair, but nothing else. She said "sorry", but that was all. We should have went somewhere else.
Super experience. Dined here 3 years ago, again this week. Even better than the first visit (in my memory). Service was as good as it gets!

I'm wife and I had breakfast there this morning. I had a ham and veggie omelette with crispy hash browns. Erna had your standard bacon and eggs.
Very tasty. Their orange juice is fresh squeezed you can tell and the coffee was quite good. Prices were right and I definitely would recommend them.

I go here every time I visit St. Louis. The gyros and Greek salad are AMAZING! I can't get enough of it. The portions are great and delicious. I find it slightly expensive, but I am a fan! I hate that they are not open on Sundays.
Lovely restaurant and great food, reasonable prices.  Great experience all round

We went here for drinks on Friday afternoon.  We sat at the bar (I guess you can only sit in the restaurant if you're ordering food).  The bar and restaurant and beautiful (love the somewhat Caribbean/Latin decor).  We had mojitos... many different flavors to choose from; all good.  Drinks are about $10-12/each (normal for a mixed drink, I suppose).  Would have loved to get food, but we had dinner plans already.  The food others were eating looked and smelled so good.  Service was quick and attentive.

I've been here a few times and basically came for the outdoor seating and change of scenery (we live in Manayunk and typically go out downtown). Don't think I'll be going here anymore seeing as my opinion on this place just goes down with each visit. Shame too, this place has a lot of potential as far as its location and atomosphere.

The first time we were here was for lunch during a weekday. Service was slow, but we weren't in a hurry. The pork nachos were great and it was a beautiful day for me, the boyfriend and our 2 pups to be out and we all had a really nice time together. But that's where the greatness ends and sadly I don't even think they have the nachos on their menu anymore. 

Second time we came with a few friends. Again, slow service and the food is nothing to write home about. Had the octopus and margherita pizza. Meh. That's really all I have to say about that.

Last night we considered going here just for a casual, outdoor dinner. They changed their menu and their entrees are basically ALL overpriced pasta dishes. What the heck?! $16 for spaghetti and meatballs?? How do they sleep at night?? I'm a pretty novice cook at home, so when I go out, I like to get something I wouldn't normally make at home. Pasta dishes are generally easy as heck to make and way overpriced at almost any restaurant. You get more bang for your buck ordering a meat dish, which this place is seriously lacking. Both entrees and apps look like uninspiring, run of the mill food for twice the normal cost. It's like they're not even trying. And can we talk about the Arugula salad? $12 for greens, pine nuts, olive oil and vinegar I noticed? Get over yourself.

First visit here while on extended thanksgiving holiday due to crazy blizzard in the Midwest. Love how my hometown is coming up in the foodie scene. This place has exactly what you would expect great selection of beers on tap and bottles paired with terrific food. 

My friends and I tried the ahi tuna, cheesesteak dumplings, Brussel sprouts, chili, steak pear and Brie flatbread and a burger. 

The tuna was perfect. Was a little skeptical of the dumplings because $11 for 4 seems a bit steep but they were delicious and our waitress did not steer us wrong. Personally I didn't care for the spicy ketchup. As a cheesesteak fan with regular ketchup the spicy wasn't for me. Brussel sprouts were amazing. Crispy, bacon, cheesy Parmesan dip just delicious! The flat bread was good. My friend enjoyed her burger too. The house made chili was perfect for the cold evening though I wish it had been served hotter. Overall great experience. Friendly timely service. Good place to meet up with friends.

I always get first-class service, tasty smoothies, and a smile at The Juice Merchant. James, who has served me a few times and remembers me, gladly made me my "usual" at 5:59pm - right before closing! Made my night. Cheers to James, and to The Juice Merchant.

My parents said the food was good but I unfortunate didn't get to eat when I was there. I ordered my meal but I could not eat a certain ingredient because of medical reasons so I asked to not have that. When my meal came, it had that ingredient in it. When I said something my waitress replied, "that's just the way it comes." That's totally understandable I just wish I would've known ahead of time so I wouldn't have ordered it. So my father ate his meal along with mine and all I had was water.

So many beers to choose from. We ordered the caprese salad for an appetiser. So good. We sat in the back with the individual TVs at each table. Extensive burger list. I got the burger with mushrooms (Demi-God) -delicious. Not cheap- $13.25 each. The sweet potato fries were good. Would have given 5 stars but the atmosphere wasn't amazing. Would come back.

I was told to not leave Nashville without stopping here for brunch/lunch so here we are!

Southern comfort food. Check. Warm and friendly. Check. Happy tummy. Check!

Reservations are highly recommended thru Opentable! It gets extremely crazy packed and who likes to wait in line with a growling stomach?!

For the table, we ordered fried green tomatoes and fried pickles for appetizers. These did not disappoint. Both were perfectly crispy and flavorful.

As for the entree, we ordered the chicken fried chicken which is the boneless fried chicken with gravy on top. It was delicious! Super flavorful. Got mac & cheese on the side and I highly recommend that. It was probably one of the best that I've tasted! We also had ordered the Nashville's signature Hot Chicken Sandwich with mac n cheese also and it was just perfect- juicy, flavorful and a huge one in size! Def fills you up southern style!

Our server goofed up on splitting the check and ended up charging us extra which was a bit annoying and time consuming, it wasn't that hard to split right in the middle of two guests.. 

Regardless, we'll definitely be back!

On a recommendation I tried this place and it to inviting and delicious. I ordered their Monday special of Chicken Parmesan sandwich on Texas toast. This was incredible and delicious, I would order it again.

This is one of the more fun breakfast experiences I've ever had. My BFF had been talking up the Camellia Grill for months and months, so it was on top of my list when I came back. 

We went here for breakfast. First thing to know is that you should expect to wait when you go. It's a small 50's-reminiscent place that mostly seats their patrons at the counter.  But I guarantee that it is worth the wait. It is a diner that serves greasy food, surely there are plenty of those elsewhere, you say? Wrong! The servers are what separates this place from other greasy spoons. They are HILARIOUS. Let me repeat that: H-I-L-A-R-I-O-U-S! And they were never mean-spirited about it. They're just real characters who elevate your diner experience to a different level.

I had the omelette and my cousin had a burger. While good, I think they were just a smidgen better than standard diner fare. But the milkshake... LOVE! Couple that chocolate cherry milk shake with an avalanche of compliments from the staff? I was in love! (Hey, I am only human! Good breakfast served with a hefty side of compliments is ALWAYS appreciated!)

I plan to go back here next time I am in town. For greasy food, hilarious people, and (hopefully) more awesome compliments!

Stopped in for a quick breakfast and was so suprised. The food was amazing. We both had the fats domino omelet. Filled with local Chesisi ham!! The table next to us had banana nuts pancakes and shared some with us...omg yum!!! Can't wait to come back!!!

I would not call this a memorable meal (in a good way)  but for the price it should have been. 

Lost one star for stale rolls, not enough butter and only two bread baskets for nine people. 

Lost one star for stuffing us so tightly in a corner, my arm kept hitting the wall when I moved it.  It was like eating on an airplane.   Waitstaff could only serve from one side so food had to be passed over the heads of folks on the other side of the table. 

Lost a star for under cooked crab cake and gnocchi that was flavorful, but very gummy. Tasted like dough had been overworked.

With so many other good choices in Phoenixville, I think I can safely say we will not be back.
Great happy hour! Our server was awesome, the clam chowder is really good. It's in the mall , but the restaurant is beautiful and overall it was a really lovely happy hour experience:)

Disclaimer: I've never had the pho.  I've only ordered sandwiches and fresh spring rolls here, and been very pleased, particularly at $3.50 and $3 respectively last time I visited.  The fresh spring rolls are really large and come in an order of 3, and after forming an addiction to them at SE Asian prices, I can never understand how or why they routinely go for $2 each at most place.  That's why I like this place.

As for earlier mentions of displeasure with the service, I hear that.  I would have given it four stars if not for the fact that twice I've been given completely wrong change at the register.  Be sure to pay with a card, and expect what is often an unnecessary wait for what should be fast food.

As cruel fate would have it, I had an insatiable craving for chicken biscuit/ chik-fila on a Sunday! My boyfriend and I frequent Fresh Kitchen on a weekly basis and Better Byrd is located right next door. BetterByrd is part  of the Ciccio restaurant group that includes Fresh Kitchen, Ciccio Cali,  Green Lemon, Lodge, and Daily Eats. That being said I knew  better Byrd would deliver.  I get that BetterByrd is trying  to differentiate themselves as a fried chicken joint but the next thing that could have made them a tad better in my book, was if they had biscuits!  Their thing is chicken and mini donuts. They do have breakfast sandwiches but use English muffins.

I got the "FriedBYRD"  which comes with Peruvian slaw and I opted for Nashville hot sauce as my chose of sauce. My boyfriend got the "Hot Chick" which is a play on Tennessee hot chicken, with "Merican" slaw. My boyfriend tried mine and I tried my boyfriend's. We both agreed that both were quite similar but liked the Peruvian slaw one better. The American slaw is a  sweeter than the Peruvian  slaw. Because my sandwich wasn't  standard made with the Tennessee hot sauce like my boyfriend's, mine only had a small amount  of hot sauce added on top. My boyfriend's fried chicken breast was covered all over with the Tennessee hot sauce. I wish mine was covered all over  like his. My boyfriend doesn't usually like coleslaw because he prefers tangy to sweet. So, for that reason he like my "FriedByrd" better.

Both agreed the chicken filet was juicy, breading seasoned well and  breast moist! There was just enough breading and wasn't too heavy or thick. Not too much extra breading crunchy chunks on filet. All the things I hope for in a great fried chicken. I hate it when the breading takes over the chicken breast so much that you have to bite thru a couple of times to get pass breading  before getting a good  piece of chicken meat in a bite. Personally, I do like sweet n spicy version of Tennessee hot chicken. Where there is use of maple syrup or honey plus a hot sauce.  So, I was hoping for some sweetness in sauce without a slaw. But like I said  the hotchick" was just a play and made no  promise in description to be the real deal. 

Reason enough why I would come to BetterByrd rather than Chik-fila... sweet potatoe fry option! I'll eat a sweet potatoe fry over a white potatoe one all day every day!The only way to get me to even eat a  tator tot is to make them with sweet potatoe. I decided not to go all out and get the creamy maple dip that usually comes with them. I just didn't want to feel like blah after eating so much fried food and carbs, so I decided to draw a small line on indulgence there, in an effort to have a somewhat productive Sunday after brunch. Tators were good but because they're tator tot fries, they weren't amazing for me. I would love it if they just had regular sweet potatoe fries. 

The fresh  unsweet mango iced tea was amazing. I took an extra cup to go and would just stop in just to get their fresh brewed tea. They also had cold  chai tea as well  as offer craft sodas which is cool considering most "fast food" joints offer just regular coke and Pepsi products. Not usually one to get wings but I would love to return  to try their wings.

Raw - the sushi & sake lunge from 12 & Sansom - opened a 2nd branch inside Boyd's Department store on the mezzanine level.

I just had lunch there today and for $13 it very well may be the only thing I can afford at Boyds!

Less of the snotty attitude, too.  Much quiter and more refined.
I had a yellowtail bento box and the sushi and all of the elements (miso, salad, gyoza, and spicy tuna tartare) were all top-notch.

I'll be back soon!
Love this place, huge sandwiches, great quality, great service. Lunch specials during the week are unmatched by anyone!

This place is the real deal. Russell's on Macklind has been on my bookmarks list for over a year now and the other day while I was out in South City I thought to myself, "why not?" and I am so glad I did! 

My bf and I arrived right around lunch time. I was worried that the line would be crazy, but we were able to walk right up and place our orders. I had to look over the menu for a minute, but when I saw they had a chicken salad sandwich I was sold! I ordered my sandwich and the bf ordered his, I think he got the Chipotle Chicken Club. We each ordered a drink and of course I had to try a chocolate chip cookie. We paid for our meal and were given a number to place on the table so they could find us. 

The place was pretty crowded and so I was lucky to be able to find a table for 2 up front. I think there were a few larger parties there that day and so lots of tables were taken up by groups. As we were waiting I noticed the place was getting busier. The line was finally forming and I was so glad we got there when we did. 

After about 10 minutes our food was brought out to us and looked delicious. I really should have asked for a fork since my sandwich was falling apart and it was hard to eat with my hands, but whatever. I didn't care about being messy-it was that good! The chips were crispy and they gave the perfect mount on the side. I really enjoyed the food and the service was great because we had someone come check on us about halfway though the meal and they even provided us refills so we didn't have to get up and wait in line-score! I knew we both enjoyed our meals because neither of us left anything on our plates-fresh and delicious sandwiches were eaten. 

I really wanted to order 1 of everything from the bakery, but I guess I will just have to find time to go back and try out some new stuff. I am so glad I gave this place a try and I really can't wait to go back and order something else. Just thinking about it is making me hungry! Do yourself a favor and go there now; you won't be disappointed!
Great food, cool atmosphere. Went with the southern fries, and butterscotch root beer

This is not the place to eat if your a foodie! The morale/customer service here is horrible...food Is rich and highly seasoned with a mediocre atmosphere. "Southern Hospitality"  is non-existent! Poor pick on our part....will never visit again!
I love, love, LOVE Sa-Wad-Dee! They have the best Thai food and sushi in Boise. Heading there right now to eat. Going to order the pineapple fried rice and some sushi. Mmm

Best damn grouper sandwich in Pinellas County!! Stopped in on a whim with an appetite for seafood and was very very pleasantly surprised. Seafood market with lots of fresh seafood for sale. The surprise is, they do a fantastic job cooking seafood if you want to sit down and enjoy it on site. Friendly service and very clean tables. We will be visiting again, and again, and again!!

Lets just say, I've had better Italian food. I had such a high expectation before coming here with all the rave reviews but the food failed me...Overall, it was just ok. My carbonara was almost Alfredo like. They even used the wrong kind of noodles. 

The tiramisu needs improvement. It tasted like it was bought at Costco. In fact, Costco might even taste better. The spumoni tasted like it was store bought as well. 

The only thing I like about the place is the location and the building's history. There was ample parking in the back of the building and service was good. Our server was friendly and so was the hostess. They give you warm bread which is a plus and they have a decent selection of wine and champagne.

Let me preface this review by saying all events are factual to the best of my prior sober knowledge. 
It was an oddly sunny and warm day in Santa Barbara (that's a joke because it's always sunny and warm here) and, like any red blooded American, had credit cards burning a hole in my pocket. I decided to stroll along state street, trying to find things to bring my credit score down. After realizing I needed a refreshing high alcoholic beverage before I could carry on, I remembered Satellite is known for their amazing Spritzers (and by known, I mean I've had one there before and it was really good). I find the place after inquiring better, more knowledgeable locals than myself. I walk in and the place is packed. I usually find myself sitting at the bar (I really did, more on that later) so I spot two seats with a person at either end. I decided the unsuspecting gentleman with no baggage...physical of course, was my best option to sit next to..the other patron had obviously maxed her cards out and took up a good bit of space with her many shopping bags. I quickly realized after ordering my spritzer, making an odd comment about this gentleman's butter, that he was in fact the British, male version of myself. I'm not sure I can even properly review this place because we were laughing so hard and long that our brains never got a chance to decide if what we were eating/drinking was good or not. BUT, I can assure you that the location, ambiance, staff, and hipster powdered soap you'll find in the bathroom, are all reasons I will be coming back. 5 stars for unknowingly uniting me with myself. 

P.S. will be back for Blind night in the future.

My boyfriend and I love this place for impromptu date nights.  Last night we revisited and sat at the bar.  The place is cute, quaint and well decorated.  The drink selections are great for a small local restaurant and the price point is in line with other comparable restaurants.  They change their wines and drink specials frequently so there is always something new to try on the libations end.

Two of our favorite dishes are the goat cheese baked with a red sauce and their BBQ shrimp.  OMG.  Those shrimp.  They are served in a cast iron dish with a butter and cream based sauce with a hit of Old Bay seasoning.  They are to die for.  Cut up the shrimp and eat with spoonful of the sauce.  Yum.  My boyfriend and I crave this dish and I even tried making it at home after Sauce Magazine posted the recipe.  It's really spectacular.

Steven was a friendly and attentive bartender.  We will continuing visiting this establishment if it stays the same quality and I don't forsee that changing anytime soon.

People reviewing this are buying into unnecessary hype. Overpriced, snooty employees, and mediocre food. 10$+ for a tiny piece of toast with avocado smeared on top? The food is average - the Acai bowl wasn't made correctly either and had the wrong consistency. People really buy into unnecessary hype. No combinations that are inventive or new.

Yes, they really do have great horchata! There is no indoor seating but it is so wonderful outside in the Mercado courtyard. The last time I went I remembered it was super hot and my friend and I stayed and chatted forever. The owner/employee(I'm pretty sure the owner) was so nice and kept filling our ice water to keep us cool. Great place to grab a bite during lunch or at night.

We had a very enjoyable late afternoon brunch. Enjoyed awesome service, great food and great drinks. Beautiful rustic atmosphere. The banana bread French toast was amazing. We also enjoyed the apple fritters and the huevos rancheros burrito. Definitely will be back!

Their serving time is super super quick while the food is still good. Their dishes also serve more meat compared to other Korean places I have been to. The only things I don't like about this place is their small parking space and their small side dishes. I am a big fan of Korean bibimbap, but I don't really like the bibimbap at Gogi(maybe it's just me:))

Had an absolutely delicious brunch here. Our server Nicole was so sweet and enhanced our experience. We ordered the brunch punch which for our group of 6 was served in a punch bowl for the table. We had a lot of plates between the 6 of us and everything was made to perfection. Nothing was a miss.  We also enjoyed the beautiful space and ambiance.

I've been going to KC's since I turned 21, on and off.  At first it was just because I lived in stupid Horsham and had nowhere to go that wasn't Gavin's (don't ask).  Then it was because my Dad LOVES it there for his fav key lime martinis and delish bar food.  Now I go there because it's between where we live (Gulph Mills) and home (Horsham), and they have awesome bar food and you never have to wait to eat.
It's one of those places where you order something so ho-hum sounding as a "chicken wrap," but then you get it and realize it's awesome and you want 5 more.  It's a place that puts jalapeno peppers on their french fries (with fried onions!), and actually puts that on the menu.  It's one of those very consistent spots that never lets you down.  The crowd varies from just-turned-21 neophytes, to old people, to familes.. You really never know what you're going to get.  I would NEVER go there to check out the singles scene, I don't think it exists there.  But it's good food, it's easy, and they have a nice beer selection.
The only issue might be parking, which is limited in the little lot they have, so you might have to do street parking, but it's Ambler, so it's not exactly going to be far away no matter where you end up parking.
I highly recommend the hot pepper fries (Alley fries, I think?), and the chicken fajita wrap.  They also have really good specials :)

Chef came out personally to announce that there were no more tater tots. :( He offered cheesy fries or gravy fries, instead. When my homies asked for both, he not only obliged, there was da-bris roast beef on top! 

Chef went off-menu; gave me the best fries I've ever had!

Very good, a bit of a change of pace from your run of the mill Mexican restaurants.

Can't beat the $1 tacos on Taco Tuesday.  They also gave us free chips and salsa on our first visit.

If your on the west side and are looking for something new check them out.

Excellent Lunch menu.  Great variety.  Food is fresh, nice presentation, delicious.  

Outstanding garlic cheese fries.

One negative: coffee just not hot enough.

We placed our order at 11:50 AM through GrubHub with a delivery estimate of 12:30 - 12:40. The food didn't arrive until 1:15. The delivery driver had two dogs in his car, which is unsanitary and exacerbates my allergies. The bag of food was literally dripping from the bottom and when I opened it, I saw that the soup we had ordered was smashed and the broth had leaked out. We were also missing the honey mustard for our chicken fingers. When I called and asked for a manager, I was told that he'd stepped out to the store. Possibly the worst service I've had anywhere. I absolutely will not be reordering.

Everything you could possibly want to eat and more. 

This is hands down the best place in Philadelphia to go shopping. Fresh produce for bottom dollar prices. Meats galore that are butchered specifically to your liking. Cheese that stink o so good. And a culture that is just perfect. Whether your a tourist or a local this is a must see spot in Philadelphia.

Pumpernickles is situated a stones throw away from Langtons sandwich bar and you could make a case for a visit to both. Pumpernickles just like langtons makes a large range of sandwiches and is good for a breakfast sarnie or something a little lighter in the afternoon. Pumpernickles though , from its' name to its decor and signing seems to have a touch more class than Langtons does although the taste of both places produce is very similar. Pumpernickles advertises that it caters for parties and buffets something which as far as I'm aware Langtons does not do. The staff in Pumpernickles are pleasant and the service is quick for waiting customers who often want to grab a quick sandwich and go. Pumpernickles seems to be the slightly more upmarket version of Langtons but unlike Langtons it does not have any outside seating although the shop is slightly larger. I would recommend the BLT at Pumpernickles as I tried it and found it to be perfect, it is a great establishment and one which will provide a top notch barm.
It is only natural to compare Langtons' and Pumpernickles but except for the fact that one caters for parties ect and the decor is different you'll find very little difference and my advice would be to simply visit which every you are nearest to at the time as neither will disappoint.

Get the falafel sandwich with harissa and the Turkish coffee shake and never look back. Literally don't think twice about your order just do what I say. A couple months ago I stopped for the first time on a Tuesday for lunch and got the falafel salad (rookie mistake) and the coconut tehina shake. Someone told me the coffee shake was the only way to go and on a Sunday evening I found myself there ordering a falafel sandwich and a coffee shake and it was perfection. No further details necessary. Just do it.

These used to be my favorite steaks in the city, but my most recent visit 9/30/20 I found them to be dry, under-seasoned, and disappointing. It's our tradition to get these on our anniversary, as we came here on our first date but I'm not likely to return and would rather start a new anniversary tradition. Sad.

Don't order delivery! We ordered delivery from their website. Around the time we were expected to receive our food, we received a phone call saying it was ready to pick up. After we explained that we in fact had ordered delivery, we were told they had no one available to deliver our food so we had to pick it up. We received an apology, but no offer of a discount or compensation.

When I went to pick the food up, I was greeted by someone who was only halfway wearing a face mask (nose out) who didn't bother to keep 6 feet away from me. Other staff were improperly wearing masks in the same way. Our food was not back in the kitchen, but sitting on a table in the middle of the dining room where tons of maskless patrons were eating. The main reason we had ordered delivery in the first place was to avoid having to make contact with potential Covid carriers, so it was upsetting to see so many protocols being violated.

Bottom line: (1) If you can't deliver, don't let people order delivery! At a minimum, call us *before* preparing our food and charging us. (2) Coronavirus kills, stop endangering your customers and wear your masks properly.

This place was phenomenal! The vale parking makes for a quick and easy entrance, & the wait for dinner hours wasn't too bad. The food was the best I've had yet around here & at a very fair price. I ordered the lobster bisque (definitely recommend), & the lobster ravioli. The coconut shrimp on the kids menu is generous and although it sounds silly even the french fries impressed. The service was just as wonderful.
The only thing I wouldn't recommend is the moscato peach sangria, not my favorite. 

I'll be going back in the future! One of the best places around St.Pete .

After a bit of a rocky start our experience did get better.  Probably closer to a 3.5 experience. 
We had reservations for 4 and 2 of us were there and they wouldn't seat us so even though several tables were open we forced to make our way to the bar and awkwardly stand around while we waited for a drink - it would have been much better customer service just to seat us and let us start ordering drinks and apps. 
Once we were seated everything was much better. Our server was great - she was super friendly and just the right amount of attentive.  All of the food was really good. We started with the fried green tomatoes, biscuits, and tartare. You can't go wrong with any of these.  My friend and I shared the short rib meat loaf and under the brick chicken. The root mash with the chicken was not my favorite - it didn't have much flavor and surprising I felt the same way about mashed potatoes with the meatloaf. However the meatloaf and the chicken were very good.  If I had to pick one next time, I'd go with the meatloaf. 
The coconut key lime pie was the perfect dessert. It was light and full of flavor.  
I'll definitely come back - I still need to try the fried chicken!

I went here last weekend to celebrate my friend's birthday. It's located at the Le Meridian building which used to be an old courthouse & thus, the building architecture is gorgeous. I was very impressed by the ambiance of the interior as well. 

I went in early and while waiting for my friends, decided to try their Moscow Mule which was fantastic! 

After my friends arrived, we were promptly seated as we had a reservation made for our party. We immediately noticed that it was Saturday evening and the place was not very crowded at all. In fact, there were only a mere 3-4 other families besides us. 

The restaurant advertises itself as upscale French cuisine. However, my friends complained of not having very many French options on the menu, if at all. I ordered the Roasted Chicken and our order came out after about 20 or so minutes (service was slightly slow). The chicken was well cooked & crispy but tasted extremely bland & rather plain. There wasn't much seasoning on the inside at all and it was definitely not worth the price tag that it came with. The thyme gravy tasted good but the chicken did not seem to be completely marinated with it. My friends had similar experiences, including a friend who ordered a Filet Mignon but wasn't satisfied with the taste at all. 

I will prefer to go to other "French" restaurants in the future.

Awesome place. Great service.  Food was awesome.  We had the Baked Breaded Chicken Breast topped with spinach, fontina, and roasted red pepper sauce. Served with mashed potatoes and grilled asparagus.  Very reasonably priced.
Staying in Clearwater for a few days my husband wanted a good steak our last night.  Not disappointed the steaks were EXCELLENT !  Service was also top notch!  We will go back !

I don't review here much so it has to generally either really bad or really good for me to do it. 

I have legit just had the worst chicken parm sandwich and the worst buffalo wings I've ever had. I've had some really bad ones in my life time as well lol. 
The Chicken Parm I asked for American Cheese instead of Mozzarella. They just decided to put no cheese on it. The chicken tasted undercooked and horrible anyways. The sauce was terrible. 
The chicken wings this soft horrible batter. Horrible buffalo sauce. Also the picture showed it was grilled buffalo wings. 

Anyways if even one of the items would have been decent I wouldn't have posted. I don't want to judge a place off a few items but these 2 are pretty safe items.

I got the Zinburger with kobe beef and truffle fries. My girlfriend got the turkey burger with sweet potato fries. Both sets of fries were ok. The truffle fries had a certain decadence to them, but I wasn't overwhelmed by the flavor. The turkey burger was one of the better ones I've tasted, though it better be for the priciness. 

The Zinburger almost lived up to expectations, though next time I would probably skip the kobe beef due to its softness - I could have used a little more firmness to offset the cheese and onions. Still it was flavorful and cooked correctly medium-rare (as kobe-style beef should be).

I might be back again, though I'm not chomping at the bit to do so. Still, if you're into burgers, this is really a place you ought to try out.
We had our pizza delivered this time & as always the pizza was very good. We ordered a pie & subs always good. Definitely worth checking out

I'm from San Jose and it's hard to find GOOD sushi bars that aren't ridiculously expensive. My besty and I came here for their lunch AYCE and we never had to ask for anything specific - they asked us what we loved in general, and the feast began. They are awesome!

Had the SeaBass today. WOW was that GREAT! The flavors Steve puts together are fantastic! This place is a MUST TRY! They have something for everyone, and the prices are very reasonable, especially for the quality of the food. The staff is friendly, and helpful. The parking can be an issue, but there are places near by that you can park.

An authentic Japanese kaiseki experience in downtown Santa Barbara with the freshest of fish and vegetables, many sourced and flown in directly from Japan. The service is attentive, the presentations elegant, and the tastes sublime. This is a talented chef and a delightful experience.

One of the best perks of working in the French Quarter is the proximity to so many of New Orleans' best restaurants. I met my friend Marcia for lunch at Bayona recently. Chef Susan Spicer is one of the most talented chefs in New Orleans and I was excited to get back there. We opted for patio seating on a perfectly gorgeous October day.               

We were a little early for our reservation. Co-owner Regina Keever was on hand to welcome us. Once seated, our server Jane and her team took our drink order and introduced us to the menu. Jane was professional, informative, and fun. She knew the menu well and her recommendations were spot on.
                                             

We both started with the golden beet salad: perfectly roasted baby golden and red beets on a bed of thinly-sliced fennel and arugula. The salad was divine!

For an entree, Marcia ordered the scallops. Served in a creole sauce with quinoa, the scallops were perfectly seared. I got the sweetbreads with sherry & mustard sauce. The sweetbreads were the best I've ever had! Wonderful combination of flavors and textures.
                      
We were celebrating Marcia's 40th birthday so we just HAD to have dessert. Wise decision. We chose the flourless chocolate cake (pure deliciousness!) and the ginger-peach sorbet & ice cream (a fantastic fall dessert).
                        
The lunch prices at Bayona are reasonable: salads and appetizers range from $6-$9 and entrees range from $14-$16. The dining room is lovely and romantic. Dining al fresco this time of year in Bayona's courtyard is a quintessentially New Orleans experience! Brett Anderson agrees and rated this courtyard as one of the 8 that beckon in fall in the Crescent City. Whether you choose to sit inside or outside, the food, service and ambience at Bayona ensure a terrific dining experience.

(Pictures available on "Native Palate.")

First things first. The food is absolutely 5 stars. The atmosphere is 5 stars. The service was terrible. This was my first visit here so definitely not going to slam them for it. However it took 35 minutes to get our food. The waiter never checked up on us or apologized for the long wait. Communication goes a long way when your waiting longer than anticipated. We will return for sure. Hopefully the service is better in the future.

This is only about the bacon #3 crepe. I thought the flavors of thick cut bacon, goat cheese and oven dried tomatoes went really well together but the crepe left something to be desired. 

First off, there was so much crepe vs. filling drama. I wish that the cheese and tomatoes had been distributed a little more equally to have more of a mix of flavors.

Second, the bacon, which was delicious, was really thick and impossible to cut with my butter knife at the table--I know, why cut with a butter knife? So I asked the server for a sharper knife but none was to be found in the restaurant. 

Third, the crepe was folded too many times so that again, there was tons of crepe and not a lot of filling.

None of this has to do with the flavor, but rather the execution of the cooking. I am willing to go back to give this place another try, I'm just staying away from the crepes!
We liked the food and the staff was super helpful for first time visitors but felt it was overpriced for a burger place.

Disappointing food and service. Waited over an hour for our food to arrive and the place was not busy at all. Also, the food waffle and waffle sandwich that we order were both bland and uninspired. It is nice to have a waffle place in St. Louis, but the quality and service were lackluster.

The burger is just magical. We ate a ton of other food but this honestly was the stand out. Wine recommendations were perfect.

Service is a bit lacking but maybe they are just going for a bit less personal, invested feel, it just felt a bit unwelcoming at times.

We got an egg dish in tomato sauce for brunch that was mouthwatering. Was a little bummed that the cacio eggs weren't actually with the sauce! but they were the best scrambled eggs I have ever had.

GET THE CINNAMON ROLL.

I have been to this location quite a few times and every time the quality of the food and the service was impeccable! They serve authentic Mexican at a great price. The service is always good and we've never had a bad meal here. Next time we will try some drinks so we can review those as well.

This place is 5 miles from our house, so we're regulars. This year, we are eating outside on their expansive patio, and it is delightful. Food is good, better than the average brew pub, and the beer selection is excellent. Try the milk stout! Yum! Highly recommended.

I like the bento box lunch special. I've also tried a few other things which were quite good but tend to take a while to come out. The water they serve seems to taste like it has residual cleaning agent in it so avoid that. The service is always really friendly and I like the atmosphere, it's great for people watching out front or sitting near the window.

I'm a tourist from Texas and was told to try IMO'S pizza because it was a true blue St. Louis pizza made with PROVEL cheese.  I was not I'll-advised in the least!  This truly was the BEST pizza I've ever had in my entire life: thin and crispy just like I love!  The people were exceptionally nice and made me feel right at home!  I only have two tiny complaints: 1. The pizza was round yet advertised as square and I wanted a new experience...2. I was unable to purchase just a slice.  The smallest portion I was able to purchase is an 8"
With that being said, after I tasted it, I didn't care what shape it was!  It was mouth-watering!  And the size??? Well it was so good that I just over ate!!

Delicious 'home cooked' food by owners - Ray & Tammy. Slightly out of town, but if you have your own transport, definitely worth a try if you want to taste some cajun and creole food.  The neighborhood could be a bit quiet/slightly rough, but the friendly atmosphere once you step in makes up for all the concerns/worries you may have.
Very affordable and very delicious.  This is no fine-dinning ... just down to earth good food.
Will definitely recommend it to all.

I was visiting from NY and staying near by. I decided to check out this spot after finding it on yelp. I have to say that the Donuts here are amazing. My favorite has to be the Nutella donut. The other flavors were great too. 

Aside from their amazing donuts, their customer service is exceptional. We were helped by a kind gentleman and we were rung by a young lady at the front who was also very kind. 

I will most certainly stop by again next time I'm in Philly.

Second time eating here. Its now my favorite restaurant in reno. Eclectic food that just delivers rich flavor i cant imagine creating myself. Nothing bland or ordinary going on here. Its a show to sit at the bar and watch them create. Foodies in reno or visiting, you dont want to miss this.

What a dump. Should have checked on Yelp firs!

Rude host should have been a give away. Server was completely incompetent. Cutlery was dirt and food terrible quality. Food came out the kitchen at random, cold and tasting terrible. How do you screw up eggs? Complete incompetence. Worst food we have had in a long time. While place feels skanky! Avoid, avoid!!
Amazing Food. When my boss comes to town from Philadelphia, this is always my first choice to bring him.

A highly anticipated meal that did not come up to expectations.  The mid- day menu is drastically cut back, making "choices" difficult.  Not wanting one of several wraps on offer (and wondering how a wrap is either "modern" or "fusion") - we went with a flight of starters - their hummus (okay, honestly, 10 stars on the hummus. FABULOUS!) - "flash fried" artichoke hearts - and their pot stickers.

Okay, it was going on 3:p.m. and shifts were changing, I get that.  But once my honey got her (wonderful, rounded, very tasty glass of white Burgundy) wine, and I got my "deconstructed" Bloody Mary - also a hit and highly recommended - I noticed that my drink was missing the stuffed olive garnish.  TRY and find the/a server...  Okay, finally got that corrected, then arrives the food.

Already talked about the hummus and if you miss that you are missing a small bowl of heaven.

Flash-fried artichoke hearts are a must miss item.  Fried is correct - but if those are house-made art-hearts I'll eat this review.  Flash those right back to the kitchen, along with the out-of-a-jug sweet chili sauce. This is NOT what I was expecting from Mosaic.

Now let's talk about the "Suckling pig with shaved celery and Thai peanut sauce" pot stickers. To the server who asked me how everything was, I herby apologize for being so brutally honest when I told her "these are horrible.". I try to be more objective, and kind in my remarks.

However, whatever the unknown goo was inside those pot stickers, it was insidiously tasteless.  "Horrible" was accurate.  Just don't go there.  To the pot stickers, I mean.  Oh, and shaved celery, in my world anyway, isn't a big old celery stalk sliced lengthwise in 1/2" thick slabs and pulled out of an ice-bath several hours later.

I have heard many, many good things about Mosaic from people who know and respect great food.  Alas, our experience today will not affirm those thoughts.

I have dined at this restaurant many times, but an finally getting around to doing a review.  Beginning with the apps, I have sample every app, at one time or another, and they are all spot-on.  My favorite is the crab ragoon, which is the best I have ever tasted.  Regarding entrees, my usuals are the combination pho and the variety of vermicelli bowls.  They're pho broth was excellent.  I would put it in the top tier with Doung Phoug, Tan Dinh, and Pho Tau Bay.  

The one area that is in need of improvement is the limited menu.  I would love to see some bacos or some other Vietnamese fusion items.

With serious competition in the New Orleans Vietnamese cuisine realm, this restaurant continues to stand fiercely competitive.

We ate brunch at 47 Scott.  They had $3 mimosas, y'all.  I got mine with grapefruit juice, because that's my obsession lately.  Perfection in a glass.  

I got the grilled cheese (three cheeses, incredible) and tomato soup.  There was also a hot chili sauce for the sandwich, and it was soooo good.  Seriously, I'm still thinking about this sandwich.

My sister had a beautiful salad that she really liked.  We haven't dined there for dinner, but we wouldn't hesitate to come back for brunch.

Expensive. But if you go during brunch/lunch they do have early bird specials and drinks. I had a pomegranate  martini, it was delicious and strong. For entrees it was coconut shrimp and some type of mahi with stuffed crab. 1st the mashed potatoes were perfect. Awesome flavour, fluffy, smooth, just perfect. The best mashed potatoes I've had ever. The coconut shrimp was ok. I thought it was overcooked a little. The mahi dish had a light delightful sauce on it. That was really good. They have an area fro large groups overlooking the dock. very relaxing. Solid place to eat and I highly recommend here.

The Columbia Restaurant in Ybor City is one of my favorite Cuban restaurants in Tampa and a must visit for any new-comer to Tampa!! Open since 1905, it is Florida's Oldest Restaurant  and the world's largest Spanish restaurant. Although it is named the Columbia, it features traditional Cuban food.  For soup, I like their Gazpacho Andalucia and Cuban Black Bean Soup. For salad, you can't go wrong with Columbia's Original 1905 Salad. Columbia's Ropa Vieja for $20 is one of my favorite dishes. Originally introduced to Cuba by Spanish sailors, the name means old clothes because the beef is shredded, sauteed and simmered with onions, green peppers and tomatoes.  If you are looking for something to go, their cuban sandwiches are an excellent choice! Columbia's Paella A la Valenciana, featuring clams, mussels, shrimp, scallops, calamares, chicken, pork, onions, peppers, tomatoes, and Valenicana rice and is also a great dish. For dessert, I recommend the flan or Brazo Gitano Cien Anos. I highly recommend calling ahead and getting reservations for the flamenco show which is nightly Monday through Saturday and a must see.  Even if you don't want to see the flamenco show, you should make reservations because this place can get busy and you might be faced with a long wait if not.  I highly recommend getting a $21 Sangria or Margarita pitcher. The Columbia's Sangria is awesome! Service has always been fairly quick and courteous.  Decor is classic, elegant, and historic. Street Parking is limited in Ybor near the Columbia.  There is a pay lot behind Acropolis a block down the street. I was surprised to learn that the Columbia is no longer solely a Tampa treasure. The Columbia can now also be found in Clearwater, Sarasota, St Augustine, Orlando, the Tampa History Museum, and the Tampa Airport.

Anyone who gave this place bad reviews doesn't understand pizza.  It was absolutely delicious!!!!  The dough was fluffy and fresh, the cheese and sauce combo was perfect, and best of all.... delivery only took 17 minutes from the time of order to the knock at my door.  Totally impressed by that.  If you're home, hungry and want some tasty pizza this is your spot.  *Note, it's not thin crust pizza. Somewhere in the middle of deep dish and thin crust is where you'll find this dough -- at least for the Medium size.

What a nice surprise and a welcome addition to the lower garden district. I went for lunch and the food was innovative without being weird, flavorful without the ingredients competing for top billing. I had the louisiana crab in the beggars purse and it was by far the best I have ever eaten!
Also, to be able to sit outside and not be sitting close to the street but in a nicely appointed, large brick courtyard just put it over the top for me and insured that Dijon will be added to my list of go-to places to eat out.

I normally only write positive reviews but I feel compelled to write this one after a situation we encountered last night. There was a bug in my salad. Our waitress saw it and took it back. She told us it was probably from the lettuce. I told her I couldn't eat a salad after seeing the bug. I asked for my salmon from the salad & cooked vegetables. When we got our bill we where charged for the vegetables. After thinking about this and overcoming the shock of having a bug in my food we are quite disappointed that our meal wasn't free or at the very least our drinks free. It's going to be a long time before we are back if this is how your staff is trained to handle these situations. The waitress was very polite and I realize she doesn't have that authority so I really don't blame her. Unfortunately you have now lost our business.
We had lunch here before a concert one Friday recently.   Very busy but the service (Janelle) was excellent, as was the food.   Will definitely return.
so happy I stumble across this funky little spot. They have seating outside, full bar and awesome menu! I'll be back.
Excellent food and service!! Grace was an awesome server!!! Great for lunch!! Will definitely try for dinner! Bottega salad and grilled chicken sandwich was delicious!! Great menu!!

We have enjoyed this restaurant for years but the service and atmosphere have changed. It seems like they really just don't care.  We even mentioned to the manager about the service and quality issues we had and he acted like he had little to no training, had no ideas for making us feel like he cared if we returned or not, etc.  Sad to say...I'm such an Aussie.

What a great little stop.  Then service was fantastic.  We only had margaritas and queso.  The queso is very think but pretty tasty.  Their salsa is more like pico and less like salsa. The margaritas was good but could be a pinch stronger.  Overall I would have loved to try more of their food as the people next nous had what looked like fajitas l. They smelled awesome and loos great.

I have been to this place so much since I moved to town that I got a bit sick of the food. Still, a must go place in town, especially for visitors. Unique southern experience and I love the communal table concept. The food is very good, the menu never changes though. i have tried brunch and lunch. Brunch is by far the best experience there. It is wort the long wait!!!
Fresh out of the oven biscuits, delicious fried chicken, the corn pudding is my favorite!

This place has changed. The people are super friendly, the food is awesome and the prices are reasonable. I have been coming here for quite some time, and they have definitely improved their service and food.

If you're looking for a lively restaurant with cool ambiance and awesome dessert this is a great place to go. 

We came with a group and the staff was kind enough to let us hang at the bar for a drink before we sat for our reservation. The bartender allowed my husband and I to try a few wines before we made our selection. We didn't really care for the choices but made a selection anyway. The wine was pretty pricey at $15 a glass when it was just okay tasting. 

Then we sat at our table and we had a great time with our friends talking and enjoying the scene. Our waiter was nice but a little pushy with recommendations. The bus boys were all very kind and friendly which we appreciated. We tried some appetizers we had the shrimp, tuna tartar and meatballs. The shrimp was salty, tuna tartar lacked flavor and the meatballs were bland too. We then got entrees. I had the sea bass which was a special and it was cooked perfectly. It was butterywith a melt in your mouth texture. The pistachio topping didn't really do anything for it, nor did the potatoes that accompanied the fish. My husband had the salmon and had the opposite experience. His Salmon was dry and the vegetables that accompanied it were very tasty. I can't recall what his topping choice was for the fish but it had an Asian flavor. We aslo tried the brussel sprouts which were tasty, the tater tots which we're just super creamy and the Mac and cheese which was again, like any other cheesy mac and cheese, nothing great. 

We had a few desserts for the table to share. The cookie was my personal favorite with the warm undercooked soft texture of the cookie and the cold ice cream. I'm not sure what the ice cream flavor was but it was vanilla with some chocolate chips in it and it was pretty amazing. We also had the carrot cake which was also very tasty with good bold flavor. The donuts were my least favorite but they had some bacon pieces on top to give it a little creativity. The donuts tasted like your average cinnamon sugar donut so I'd go for the other desserts over this one. 

I loved the layout of this location and the open kitchen. I'm not sure if I'll be back to try it again but I had a great time here either way.

Recommend for any Korean food lover. In from out of town and starting looking for Asian food places to eat. Came across this place while in Fishers and decided to give it a try based on the Yelp reviews. We were not disappointed. Really good food, try the veggie pancake, and good service. Small but quaint place but you will not be disappointed.

The service is less than acceptable and the food is bland and boring.  It is bad enough that the weight is lengthy, but then when you get the food and it tastes like cardboard, you are truly less than impressed.

This place reminds me of an old roller skating rink, it's a really weird room.

But it works.

It was a bit hot in there and the kitchen was backed up. It took a while to get our barbecue chicken pizza which was nothing great but nothing terrible either. Also had the hummus platter which was decent but was not going to win Philly's top hummus platter 2009 award. 

But no matter. The comedy was very comedic, and the beer was served cold and fast.

And that's why I came. 

I WAS TOTALLY ROTFLOL

john oliver makes me LAFF
Great sushi! However, if you are getting a to-go order......be aware it will take MUCH longer than they say it will. I live nearby and this ALWAYS happens. Be prepared to wait.

Not much for the vegan To choose here. Also kind of pricey for a breakfast foods. I ended up getting some thick-sliced toast with fresh jam and a cup of coffee. While their homemade raspberry jam was delicious, and they did bring me some complimentary PB, I was left hungry and somewhat disappointed. Wish there were more decent vegan options on 4th ave!

My first meal in NOLA and I was not disappointed. I agree these are excellent po-boys. I had the shrimp, which is sauteed instead of deep fried or breaded. I looooove the sauce. Only downside is the bar in front is pretty seedy. I wonder if this place has ever thought of opening up their own separate location, with better visibility and less smoky atmosphere.

But hey hey, don't let the dive bar out front deter you. These are really good po-boys and worth trying...mmm, if only I could go back to NOLA and have more!
They have the BEST coffee and the BEST customer service I have ever had. I was highly impressed with this quaint place.

I'm in the middle of my lunch and already looking forward to the next take-out order.  

Nothing much surprising on the menu, but the familiar dishes are done so well. Complex, well-balanced flavors and serious heat if that's what you want. I'd say 7 is the highest you'd want to go on their heat scale if you wish to sweat but not be debilitated. Even then.... 

Have you, too, become jaded by the local offerings, Indian and otherwise? Banjara should restore your belief in tastiness.
1st time here, was was better than expected. Great service, drinks were fresh and tasty, tacos are small but full of flavor! Key lime pie was off the chain

I work at the mall so praise the heavens I didn't have to pay full price for what I received.
