I wanted to try this place after a rave review from a good friend and he didn't even mention that this place is vegetarian/vegan. I went for the first time with another good friend - a hardcore carnivore. 

We ordered 3  items between us and each plate was both brilliantly presented and absolutely delicious. While I normally eat a vegetarian/vegan diet, I was not only satisfied, but absolutely amazed at the attention to flavor and texture that these dishes provided. Many vegetarian restaurants tend to be bland and boring. Not the case here! My friend said that the meal opened his mind to the possibility of 'good vegetarian food'. He didn't miss not having meat/dairy one bit. We both agreed that the pulled mushroom sandwich was dynamite!

We did go a bit overboard with our ordering as each plate was a good portion and we also got beers and deserts. While this meal was a bit spendy at around $90. I think even a hungry couple could get away for under $50 after tax/tip.

The service was very friendly and helpful. The atmosphere on the patio was also very nice.

Very turned off by how rude they were. We called before leaving since it was fairly late and they are about 30-40 minutes away to verify that they were indeed still open. Upon arriving, we entered and people were inside eating. We sat down and waited. A gentleman came out and said they were closed. I stated we called and were told they were open, he came back with a "who did you talk to?" Does it matter who I talked too, no one gives their name when you call. He followed by saying they closed ealy cause it was dead in there, yet they had customers eating!! No, "we are sorry for the inconvenience", nothing what so ever!!! Just rude and very passive aggressive!! 

So we walked out feeling very disgusted, and went to 55 South again, they remembered my husband being related to Elvis, which was funny, and got us a table right away and we were treated with respect and awesome service!!! I will not be going back to Papa's after being treated like my business was nothing...

FYI: Maybe your business is slow and dead because the way you treat paying customers!!!

My favorite Asian  restaurant . The design of the restaurant is fantastic! Hot lover roll and crunchy trigger roll was surprised me. Shrimp Pad Thai has amazing tasty!  Hello kitty  is my favorite drink .

Impressive & friendly service.  Solid menu. Great drink options.  They command a price, but it's worth it.   A nice option in the new KoP.  I had the tuna steak - great job chef!  Sides & apps are wonderful.  Everyone loved the meal.  Thank you!

I think some of the review were's are a little hard on this place. This is a local Tucson institution. The staff was extremely nice and the food is basic barbecue. Is it the best barbecue I've had in my life-absolutely not. But going there is also an experience. Like pentacle Pete's where they cut off your tie - this place encourages you to graffiti the walls with a sharpie. A lot of people were enjoying marking up the wall. Our food was pretty good and the portions were outstanding. Again it was basic barbecue. Nothing crazy flavorful. But about what I expected. I'm not sure when I'll be back. I wouldn't avoid this place either. I think you should try it if you're in Tucson for a while.

Family and I are fans of everything Ivan, was excited to visit the new Midtown location on Cheney (now live out of the Reno area). Easy parking, beautiful open decor - love it! Hostess was on our reservation, put us at a very nice table. Ordered a pineapple mule and Chardonnay, both were delicious. Waiter was great at checking in on us, bringing water. Our first course, butter leaf salad is a favorite of the kids - must try! Entrees, could be amazing but fell short. Duck Breast was severely undercooked and gamey - even after re-cooking it was not good. My scallops were cooked beautifully but over salted, way over salted. The plating was gorgeous on both - just not up to par. Our waiter did take care of the duck breast, very much appreciated and unexpected.

We will come back and give Midtown another go - staff was fantastic, loved the ambiance. If anything for a cocktail!

Very small portion. 18 for fajitas, not enough chicken or beef for 2 small tacos. The waiter was also surprised at the portion. This would be 8 at any other Mexican restaurant.

UPDATE...I talked with the manager when leaving who gave me a gift certificate for the meal.  He was quite apologetic and insistent when I initially declined it.  Said he would address it with the kitchen. Good guy interested in making his restaurant better.

This is a pretty trendy restaurant in a nice area of St. Louis City. I came here on a Saturday where they only serve breakfast and brunch.  I would have liked a few more brunch options that were more Lunch than Breakfast, but overall they had a great and tasty selection of meals to choose from.  I did find that based on the food portions for the costs, it was a little pricey.  Having said that, the food quality was very good.  I had their Omelet and it was very delicious but it would have been better if it came with a side.  The décor of the building is very nice and you may want to wear something on the nicer casual side of your wardrobe.  They have both indoor and outdoor seating options and a bar area. 

Also, if you are a fan of whiskey, they pretty much have it all.  We came here for my brother's birthday and he ordered one whiskey drink where they literally blew smoke in a container with the whiskey to add flavor to the drink!  If you're into your whiskey drinks then this is a must place to come eat and drink at.

I came here with my mom on a Monday night not expecting anything to rave about, but I can honestly say I would rave about this place all day! Great place to get a beer and eat some food. I came here before a couple years ago when they fits opened, it was nothing spectacular, but since then they changed the whole building and added another section onto the original building. They have a wide variety of foods ranging from seafood to pasta, to burgers, wings, and delectable finger foods. My mom got the Turkey Burger on a ciabatta roll with a side of sweet potato fries. I got the British Burger with a side of sweet potato fries. We both enjoyed our burgers and they were cooked to perfection. They have so many drink specials for everyday of the week and also a lot of beers on tap! They also have a lot of variety of micro brews which I want to try next time I go there for happy hour! Kudos on the customer service and I will be back again!

We went there on Valentine's Day (had reservations). So glad that we called a few days before to confirm we were in the books because we were not! Also sad to be seated upstairs, the ambiance downstairs seemed much better. Service was good, but not excellent. She just had many other tables to wait due to the holiday. Our meals were fantastic. I had a special homemade ravioli stuffed with fava beans and topped with a creamy lobster sauce and slices of blood oranges - DELICIOUS! I crave it just writing about it. My boyfriend had the brisket flatbread which he enjoyed. Calamari appetizer was excellent. Can't wait to visit again!

A fun little place that I was glad to find because it offers some veg* friendly options - and there simply aren't that many in Reno! It's now on my list of places to visit when I'm in town. The tomato bisque is tasty and the veggie grill sandwich pairs nicely with it. I added a beer, enjoyed it all, and left with a smile on my face :-)

Proof that people from Buffalo (and New Orleans) intimately know how to make stick to your ribs crave-worthy food with gourmet touches. The buttery lemony grilled shrimp, addictive garlic bread, creamy red beans, and dark roux gumbo were orgasmic. The environment was colorful, honey, welcoming. These folks take pride in their food and serving it to their community. This is the kind of restaurant I want to pretend is my neighborhood restaurant, and being here makes me feel like it is. From one Buffalo transplant, this place is the real deal!

Fun and yum

Family and I stopped off at El Charro for lunch.  We had a table quickly and or waitress, Bri (?), was quick with drinks, chips, and our orders.  She was very kind to our kids, as well as in describing what things were.  She even brought out a sample of a dish so we'd know enough to decide to order.  Excellent touch!

Food was good, drinks were kept full, and Bri checked on us regularly.  Everyone at the table liked what they had, especially the steak soft tacos and their burrito.  One knock: the salsa tastes a bit like pizza sauce.  Still edible, though.

Went back tonight for the dinner special and it was excellent and we were greeted by pizza Paul himself !  Dinners were sooooooooo darn big I brought home more than half  a platter . New wait staff is very courteous.

I typically order out from here for sushi. It is typically very good and comes within 30 minutes. I have had some experiences where it has taken over 80 minutes for delivery. The food whether Chinese or Japanese has been of good quality every time!
I've continued to eat at Santucci's over the years, and its still just as good.  I always just get a plain pizza.  I absolutely love the crust, too.
Always good food decided to stop at the "tiki bar" on a Sunday for a few.  Bar tender very nice cold beer what else  can you ask for?  Outdoor tvs for watching the phils
Best bang for your buck Mexican food in the area. Staff is very friendly and it's 24/7 what's not to love.

I found myself at this spa by purchasing a group-on certificate. I had a 90 minutes massage . At no point was i asked what kind of massage i wanted, via swedish, deep tissue or apparently Thai Stretch. I was never asked where my trouble spots were either. I am assuming I had a swedish massage. It felt like i spent 90 minues having oil rubbed on my body. This was a waste of my time and money. I suppose I should have requested a deep tissue but I do not think that the responsibilty was on me. I was never told what they offered. This is a new place, They have a lot to learn. Also, I was given water to drink in a white styrofoam cup. I think a  glass with some lemon in it would class this place up a little more. That being said, it was very clean.
Came back here for lunch after several years of not working in the area, still some of the very best Mexican food I've ever had. Getting the tacos a la carte is great.

Totally forgot this was here: need to add it to my mental list of regular restaurants in the area. Thanks again, Yelp.  Solid fish and chips, lovely atmosphere, and a plentiful beer selection. I had a bit of a sore throat, and a hot toddy hit the the spot nicely. The service was a bit spotty, but friendly, so I'll excuse them for being unexpectedly busy, it happens. Hope this turns into a regular thing for me.

I was recently driving cross country on a road trip from Charlotte, NC to San Diego, CA.  We found Tucson Tamale on Yelp and decided to stop in for an extended lunch break, on the last day of our travel.

I want to make sure there is absolutely no mistaking what I'm saying in this review, so I need you to do something.

Listen to me.  LISTEN TO ME.  Turn off your phone, your TV, your ipad, anything that is distracting you from reading this review.  Right now.

These are - bar none - the best damn tamales I have ever had, EVER!  I sampled 3 of the staff's favorite tamales for lunch, and was blown away by the quality, flavor profile, and variety of each!  They are so damn good I would be willing to drive across the country all over again to get another one. 

And here's the kicker -- if you don't live in Tucson, they are more than happy to take your order over the phone and SHIP you a box of frozen tamales!

This place is an A+ MUST VISIT for anyone with a tongue in their mouth.  Whether you're into mexican food or not - vegetarian or carnivore... go! Try everything!  You won't be sorry!

I don't know how to explain it but this place is so good. The tuna don volcano style is addicting! So fresh, so tasty and just delicious. The seating and accommodations are nice. On hot days they turn on the mist even if you do choose to wait outside, which you could wait in your car if you have a big problem waiting outside. The food always comes out very fast. The staff is friendly. The only complaint I have is I wish they would add a salmon don to the menu, but it's more wishful thinking than complaining. And the only other off putting thing is if you do choose to eat outside be ready to be absolutely swarmed with flies, not sure if this is something that can be prevented but definitely eat outside at your own risk.

Geno's beats Pat's. This was very clear to my whole family. We were about to head back home so we grabbed a cheesesteak from both locations. We tried both and came to the conclusion that Geno's was better. It wasn't the best cheesesteak I ever had but it was fun to try both and judge!

We were looking to have a decent brunch before leaving Philly since we were in the area we found this place through yelp. 
Upon arrival we had to wait about 20 minuets we had a total of 6 people, no biggie we waited by the fireplace nice seating area. 
Once seated we stared w drinks Arnold Palmer & some water not bad. 
For my main dish I went with the Hawthorne burger nice piece of meat seasoned well topped with some blue cheese, avocado, fried egg & garlic aioli sauce comes w fries. 
Very good burger always enjoy the egg & avocado combo good fries a bit salty but not bad. 
My friends enjoyed the French toast very good small dish w some fruit the Crabby Dick was delicious great tasting crab cake good combo with the egg. Good as well was the Chorizo quesadilla nice twist with this dish. 
As for the restaurant itself nice small location, warm  welcoming decor. 
Our waitress was nice & attentive prices are decent in comparison, we enjoyed our meal.
Taco and beer are good but the service is fantastic. Our waitress Brandi B was spot on! Definitely one of the best in the business... EVER!

My wife and I eat here often.  We really like the food.  We also like that the service is always good and the staff is friendly.  It is nice sometimes that it is not crowded and that you can go there on a busy Doylestown weekend, and usually find an outside table with no reservation.  This is a BYOB which is nice as well.

They will cater to your individual tastes so if you like it spicy ask for it spicy.  If you like it mild ask for it that way.  I like mine spicy and my wife likes hers mild, and they satisfy us both.

Finally where else can you eat in Doylestown, have a good meal and leave for less than $40 for 2 people.  We love Cross Culture.

Corner 17 has some of the most delicious hand-pulled noodles I have ever eaten. The staff is friendly and accommodating. The food is fresh, and you can ask for no MSG. I recommend the pan-fried shaved noodles and the fluffy ice for dessert!

If you like hot sauce then this is your place.  We got the large Cheesesteak with Sweet and Sassy sauce.  The sauce was hot.  Amigo Dan likes hot and he didn't like it.  My biggest complaint was the price, $17.  Ironically my buddy Tim likes hot and challenges so maybe I will take him for the hot pizza challenge.

The jerk wings and the jerk chicken pasta are amazing.  And the drink options are endless. The vibe reminds me of Seacrets in Ocean City, Maryland. I would give 5 stars but the service is poor.  My past 3 times here I waited over 45 minutes for my food. But other than that no complaints.

Eat here!! Our best meal in Tucson since we have been in town. We are in town for a long weekend  and had an amazing brunch here today.  I had the Commoner's breakfast and added bacon.  My husband had the Chiliqueles.  Both were excellent.  We also had Bloody Mary's with a stout beer back...some of the best  I have ever had!  Also memorable - the smashed Yukon potatoes (boiled whole potatoes that they then fry and lightly salt)  and from scratch strawberry preserves.  

My only regret is not coming here for dinner based on the food and service we received today!

I tried the 3-course brunch. turtle soup with sherry, catfish and bread pudding.
Everything is yummy! And the waitress recommended the biscuit as side, it smells good.

This resturant is cute and quaint giving your hungry drunken belly exactly what it needs. Weather it's a quick salad and a margarita or burgers and margaritas , either or the margaritas ( mango) are the way to go ! Not pricy and yet perfectly perfect for a quick date or simply just a fast bite after the pool.  Two thumbs up ... ps I feel like I'm sitting in an air conditioned resturant In Little Tijuana

The service was the most outstanding part of our visit. The pizza, however, was a bit mediocre. We ended up paying $55 for 12" deep dish, one beer and 2 glasses of sangria (including an 18% tip.) It didn't feel like a fair trade once we left the building. I ordered ground beef and green peppers on my half and was left wishing I had also ordered cheese, as there was barely an ounce of it on the pie. If you're prepared to drop half a bill on pizza, make sure your expectations are proportionately average.

Over a year later, I still give this place 5 stars. This is based on 15+ visits. This may seem excessive, but it is the #1 option near my new home, and it is a REALLY good one.

The green beans, the burgers, the BRUNCH, oh my gosh, the brunch. The daily specials which are always different, exciting, and reasonable. I love the constantly changing beer selection, and most of all, I really like the people that come here. This place attracts a great crowd, and please, let's keep it that way!

Never had a worse dining experience than this!  Went to this location last night to celebrate my birthday with family. Was seated at separate tables.  The table we were seated at had no silverware.  When the waiter brought our salads we told him that we had no silverware, he said he would bring silverware.  Ten minutes later still no silverware, and waiter nowhere in sight.  All we could was sit there talking and only looking at our salads.  When he came back to check on us, we told him again we had no silverware and he acted like it was his first time hearing it.  Another 10 minutes still no silverware.  Finally instead of him bringing the silverware he sent someone else with it.  This person only just put the silverware on the edge of the table as opposed to placing the silverware at each individual person. Then the dinner orders took forever to come and he would lie repeatedly that they had other orders go in before ours.  I know this is a lie because the people that he was referring to were seated 45 minutes after our orders were put in.  Then took forever to get the check.  This restaurant was dirty, unorganized, and smelled of garbage.  Turned my birthday dinner which should have been a special time into a nightmare.  I'm done with this location, and after this incident it's not likely that I will visit any other Red Lobster!!!!!

this was a good last minute brunch find for us. we miscalculated timing of when we needed to leave for the airport given saints traffic, so we bailed on our reservation and headed around the corner to Luke's. 

Server was very nice and the brunch menu had several appealing options. i enjoyed my shrimp and grits though could have used a larger portion (maybe it was just bc we had eaten nonstop during our trip and my appetite was extra big). i ordered a glass of prosecco that was just ok and my friends both said their bloody mary was just ok as well. 

overall was a good, quick brunch stop near our hotel before leaving town.

Great place very friendly and nice selection sandwiches soups and salads to choose from...I had the Turkey and Swiss on wheat very fresh very good no complaints. Definitely will be a repeat customer.. If your looking for a good sandwich give them a try oh and the chocolate chip cookies are good to

I love Northbrook Marketplace! I live about 5 minutes away and I love going in and seeing all that they have. Their apple cider donuts are a must have, as are their homemade tortilla chips. They also have amazing ice cream. They have some delicious treats and a cool barnyard feel.

Great breakfast spot. Even better because they have different variations of eggs benedict. I got the crabby benedict. Egg was cooked perfectly and generous hollandaise sauce drenched on top. Home fries were delicious too. I'd recommend picking the home fries over the hash browns. The portions are not huge but not small. My black coffee was ok. Not as strong as I'd like but no sour taste. Service was friendly and my coffee never hit bottom. The food took a little time but I was in no hurry. The venue was well lit and clean. I don't know about you but I don't like eating in the dark. I will try the chorizo benedict next time!  

There is a small parking lot and there were a few spaces when I went but I can imagine parking being difficult if this area becomes popular. It shares a parking lot with a new Vietnamese restaurant and a few other businesses.

Decent takeout chinese. I just got an order of Sesame chicken. Mostly because I was too tired and lazy to look at a menu for too long, and it seemed like the right thing to get. That, and an order of egg rolls. 

The portion was large, and the taste was decent. However, the menu said it would be spicy and it was not spicy enough for my taste. But still good. 

The egg rolls were good, but a little on the thin side. And the sweet and sour sauce was less like a sauce and more like a pudding. Very thick, but an okay taste.  The prices were reasonable as well.  (8.95 for the entree and 2.40 for two egg rolls).

Overall, this may be my new go to for chinese takeout when I am tired, hungry, and just want something quick.
Authentic Mexican food and it is very good.  I love the homemade tortilla chorizo tacos.  The queso dip is also very good.  If you want real Mexican food, give it a shot.

i live 2 blocks from the place i was really excited when i heard about it. both times i got the steak and eggs.. first time the steak was thick and tasted pretty good.. 2nd time it was thin and small like a strip steak.. it was ok.. i really like the hash browns but its very disappointing that they give you about about 3 bites.. they could easily give you 3-4 times more.. eggs were cooked as ordered.. first time they gave me toast but no hash browns... which  they fixed right away.. second item i asked if toast was included and they said yes, but i got no toast.. (got hash browns)  so they did bring me some toast.. i think at the price you are paying they would give you both,, they have really good toast its thick sourdough bread.. 

wife got the CHICKEN ASADA SALAD (2nd time)
menu said avocado and it only had a few tiny pieces through out.. we only found 3..  steak was good but the tortilla strips were gross.. dont know if they were old or burnt but they killed it.. salad was big.. but if you say avocado it should atleast have 1/4 of a avocado.. 

first time i paid 100% second time i used a daily perks coupon and saved $10.. 
we drank water and bill still seamed high..  i really hope the owner reads these reviews..

This is a predominantly Russian market. They have a huge selection of fresh produce including some things you cannot find at a regular supermarket such as pluots. They have fresh cheese, meats, olives, pickles as well as a bakery with a variety of fresh bread and pastries. Their hot food counter seemed like it went on for a mile with many dishes I've never heard of but definitely want to try.  Grocery items are plentiful with a majority of products from Europe. Their chocolate selection is unbelievable. Everything we bought was superb. We will be back!

Terrific staff and good food! The highlight of the meal was the corned beef hash. It was exceptional!!! Biscuits are huge, buttery and have a crispy exterior. Poached eggs were good. Costa Rican dish was good as well.

Was excited to try this place!

http://www.thatgirlallie.com/468268132/soobak

Can't say enough about our experience at Chandlers. We went there for our anniversary. Best decision ever. The waiter was outstanding. 
I am not a fan of raw oysters... but my husband convinced me to try them. We had the kumamoto oysters. OMG ... they melted in your mouth.  They came with several sauces that were to die for.
My husband and I both got the 6 oz filet with a side scallop.  The filet was perfectly cooked for us... medium. The scallop ... what can I say... it too melted in your mouth.  
The entire experience was outstanding. Will definitely go back . Highly recommend!

Loved this stop! Fantastic, flavorful, and interesting tacos.  Very happy with the food and menu options.  

Fun atmosphere.  Good service.  Decent margaritas.
I love it super cheap food im just not felling the mexican part of it its really modern just not felling the mexican vibes but over all the food is amazing

This is a mixed review based on 4 experiences here.  All were 18-inch, take-out pizzas.

The first 2 visits were amazing!  The first being just pepperoni and the second a supreme.  They were really great and easily deserved 4-stars, with terrific crust, tasty sauce, and plenty of toppings.

On my 3rd visit, upon arriving home I discovered my pepperoni pizza was way overcooked and the bottom was burnt.  Ok, everyone is entitled to a mistake.

On my 4th visit, again the bottom of my pizza was really burnt.

Those 2 burnt pizzas plus tips equals $45+ down the drain.  Eh...

I think they may be the "victim of their own success" here?  They can get crazy busy and when they do, it is obvious that their quality suffers.

I'll try them again in a few months, but I'm going to check if the bottom is burnt before I leave.

*  Also note:  The parking situation at peak dining times here is no fun.  If they have not already done so, they should designate a spot or two for people picking up To-Go orders.
Great find in UC. Finally a good restaurant in this space. Trout delicious - will be back for the burger. Drinks excellent. YES

Visited Louie Louie last night for my birthday and things could not have been better. Candace was our server and she did an impeccable job. She was friendly, knowledgeable and had great recommendations. The food was better than I could have imagined. Every plate better than the next. In addition to that, I felt very safe considering COVID, the restaurant was very clean. All the staff properly attired in what CDC and local guidelines as. Cannot wait to return.

Love! Love! Love!
The food is always delicious. The portions are generous and too much for me to eat in one sitting. So, take a friend and an appetite. I appreciate it being pet friendly, but my dogs are too wild. Great addition to Germantown. Oh, if I could make one suggestion, they could post their hours on the doors.

The pork chop! The veal tortellini! The prime rib ravioli! The steak! The pasta... and more pasta! If you want authentic homemade pasta this is the place to go! The cheesecake is a piece of heaven, and another little piece of heaven is the eye candy behind the bar... Three letters.... Ivo!

Have been trying to catch a taco Tuesday for the longest. Seen Panchita's on Yelp and didn't think much because I had them before but I didn't really remember how they taste. So we head in and get seated quickly which was great, the waitress knew the menu very well and gave great service. Only gave 4 stars because the chorizo wasn't as hot as I desired. I'm sure I'll be back here soon, the tacos are $2 also! Well the basic ones.

Visited tavern on a Friday afternoon for lunch and had a great experience! 

Without a reservation, we were able to walk in and be seated immediately. The atmosphere was really cool - they had a big open bar and a section of indoor/outdoor covered seating. They had plenty of tvs, making it a great spot to catch a game.

We started with the chicken nachos which were delicious. Two of us split a turkey blt on a pretzel bun which was also pretty tasty. And our last friend had the short rib Benedict which was very good as well!

Overall, a casual spot with good bar food and a cool atmosphere!

Your typical Asian food stall, roadside or at a food center; tastes EXACTLY like home. I got the beef rendang, tempeh and tahu telur over rice with an extra serving of belacan chili. It's 3x what I would pay in Singapore, but I gladly parted with my money.
Chips and salsa are a must! Korean tostadas were perfection but the nachos and corn were average. Great atmosphere and will definitely be back :)
I have dreams about the falafel sandwich. Pro tip: add feta! Their mint tea is caffeinated and should not be missed. Also, endless refills.
My blackened catfish pro boy was very flavorful and filling! The fries were crunchy and also really good. My husband got the seafood platter and it was a lot of food.

We never had anything quite like this and thought we would try something different. I can not tell you how happy we are that we did. The place is cozy casual with lots of windows. The food was amazing. I mean the apps, the entrees and the desert we all delicious. The server knew the food and the menu well and the floor manager stopped by and talked with each table for a while. This is a great choice for those tired of Applebee's, Champps, PJ's and alike. Go here, have an open mind and enjoy the flavors of this great Greek food. There is something for the light eater, the vegetarian, the meat and potatoes person and everything in between. Make dinner a fun sharing experience instead of just shoving the same old thing in your face.
GLUTEN-FREE!! It's always a struggle to find gluten free for us Celiacs!! Buckwheat crepes were AWESOME!!! Was a REAL TREAT... Excellent food, clean, and friendly. FIVE *****

The food is amazing but the service is horrible. Unless you have 2+ hours for a long dragged out dinner don't go because you will be hangry waiting for food. The mofongos, chuletas can can, fried steak, empanadas, fried pork chunks are always good. We have tried going on different days and times and we still get slow service. The last time we went we placed our order as soon as we sat down and it still took 2 hours and 15 minutes to get our food. They need to hire more servers and cooks. We have started to try other Spanish restaurants in the area because the wait is too much.

Stopped in for lunch to this place where I hadn't been in many years. It was just as I remembered it! I had the fantastic Thai mussels that were the best I've ever had. So flavorful and just a tad bit of spice. My teen son enjoyed the beer battered chicken strips. Service was excellent even though they were busy.

So, we had to try the new talked about crub on the east side! We had the spinach dip which was fantastic we didn't care for bread it was fried and very crispy.  They brought out pita and chips in its place.  AMAZING!  I had the talked about mac and cheese and didn't find it as amazing as everyone has said. It was really greasy!  My fiancee loved his food! Cheese Cake to end was perfect! Alround great will be going back in hopes of updating to 5 stars.
Great food prepared to the spice of your liking. Try the spring rolls. Friendly staff. Will definitely return.

Once again, and a year later at HH and CWT....one year anniversary and its as good as day one!  Christina's Philly based sandwiches rock the house paired with great Chilly Water Beers...the Chocolate Blonde tapping today was awesome beer....

The Liscio's bread from Philly, the authentic meats, the love bestowed on mere sandwiches is amazing and it translates to scrumdillyishness...the extras including pepper shooters, cucumber dills, Pats original Philly Pretzels or CRINKLE CUT FRIES loaded are unique and excellent and are must trys.  Venture out and try the Cheesesteaks or cold hoagies, you will not be disappointed...

Eat Local, Play Local, Live Local

JC

You know how occasionally you are surprised by how great a place is, and then you are reluctant to share how good it was because a) you still want to be able to get in and b) how could it possibly have been so good?

Well, that is what our stay at this hotel was like. I booked it after checking the other two hotels we usually stay at, because this one was considerably cheaper for the dates we wanted. Plus, it included breakfast every morning!

From the moment we got there and interacted with the friendly and efficient front desk person, to the morning we left, everything was wonderful. The one exception was a drippy shower faucet that took 3 days to fix - but as long as we kept the bathroom door closed, it was fine.

The food at the breakfast buffet every morning was different and good - with pastries, fruit, eggs, biscuits, bacon, and potatoes, just to mention a few items in the rotation. In addition to the two complimentary bottles of water in our room, there were also bottles available in the tiny workout room.

Our room was good sized, with a comfortable king bed, and was made up promptly each day.  We were a pretty good distance from both the elevator and ice machine, so it was nice and quiet, with the exception of the door slams from the occasional inconsiderate guest.  I love that the hotel only had 5 floors, because it made the wait for the elevator very quick. 

Located the perfect distance from the French Quarter, with the cool style of an old building that has been charmingly modernized, we would definitely stay here again.

Unfortunately my wife and I did not have a great experience.  The food was mediocre and over priced.  We had reservations and they sat us in the garden area next to the line of people that wanted to go down to the bowling alley.  They don't let anyone down to the bowling alley and  the place itself had a door man out front that would only let you in if you had reservations.  I would go here for drinks and that's it.  Great ambiance around the bar area, but overall this place was disappointing.
Fantastic ambience and the best coffee in Philadelphia. The chai latte is incredible. Try the caneles and the donuts.

This place is a gem. Alex was extremely helpful with the menu.  Great brew selections, wings were fantastic. Dry rub was phenomenal. Let's also not forget that they have Mathoo's Egg Rolls. These things are amazing. Great place to watch the games. Perfect mid-week spot for those that don't like large crowds. Definitely be back. Was a great great spot.

This is a fun place for pub food and free music on Friday night. Joined friends for burgers, wings, roast beef sandwiches while listening to the wonderful John Train and his band perform two sets every Friday 6-8. 

The downstairs is a bar and restaurant as is the upstairs where the music happens. The wait staff is excellent. Someone had dropped cash on the floor and the waitress went around to all the customers and asked if it was theirs! Amazingly no one claimed it! Restores my faith in humanity. 

The food was quite good, big portions. 

I highly recommend going there, especially on Friday evening.

Waiter was a great waiter, however food was horrid. Were 8 year loyal eaters at iron hill and king of the hill members since back
When voorhees opened. Cheeseteak egg rolls were greasy, the nachos werent the same and the chicken sliders were like a fast food chain but worst! Maybe we got you at a bad time, but this was rough.

It wasn't the best Italian food I've ever ate, but it was really, really good. It wasn't the fastest service-I went through the drive thru-but quick enough and my good was hot and fresh. I was on my was to the grocery store and could t go hungry. So I swung into this Fazoli's on impulse. I see this store doesn't get high reviews because of things like no longer handing out unlimited breadsticks or other strange reason not related to service or cleanliness. My main reason for 5 stars...I got a really good, filling lunch for $5.49 and the lady at the window was friendly. No glitches. 
   I would rather wait a minute than have immediate service and be given old, barely warm food that had been sitting around. 
   It's probably a limited promotion, but they run it often. I ordered the $5 lunch. It included 2 reduced size versions of your choice of several entrees (or an entree and a salad) with 2 breadsticks and a drink. I got the penne marinara and a slice of cheese pizza. The marinara flavor is better than some of the higher end Italian restaurants in town. It's thick without being too tomato-y (is that a word?)--and its vegan. The cheese pizza is decent. Better than frozen pizza. But for the price, not going to be too picky. Their breadsticks are really good. I'd prefer them without all the butter, but that is my personal preference. They will make them for you plain if you ask and want to wait. I usually just pick off the side with the butter if it's too much  because I'd rather not wait. 
   The location isn't to bad to get in and out of. If 10th street is back up, you do have the option of the back alley the runs behind the store and dumps onto Girl School Rd. 
     I didn't go inside on this visit, so I can't attest to the cleanliness inside. The parking lot was clean and the restaurant has accessible parking. It has always been clean when I've ate here in the past. However, that has been quite a while ago. 
    If I am in the area, I would eat here again. The food is really good, the staff is friendly and the price is right.

I met this guy about a year ago on a flight from LAX to TUS.  We were chatting about restaurants in Tucson and he told me I MUST try this place along with the bar in the basement.  I bookmarked it, and finally tried it this past weekend.  

I booked a table for six, we had 2 birthdays in the group -- only one that would openly admit it.  We were immediately seated and attended to by this amazing server.  I say amazing (even though I can't remember her name) because she was on top of everything and did it all by memory... never wrote a thing down.  She checked on us the right amount and took great care of us.

Cocktails on deck for the evening that were big hits - Boy, Don't You Look Nice and Vodka Smash.  They were both divine, and I believe I had at least two... could have been three Boy, Don't You Look Nice's.

Our table ordered the Brussels, bacon/egg, and truffle fries starters.  They were demolished in less than ten minutes.  We ordered a couple of salads (the chopped was the bomb), pizzas, and several different pastas.  All of the food was prepared beautifully, tasty and devoured.  I must say though the big hit at the table (thankfully two of us ordered it) was the Vodka Sauce Rigatoni.  I seriously could have just eaten an entire bucket full of it.

Our fab server closed the night out by bringing over a tiramisu with a candle in it for my niece.  Super awesome and sweet... the gesture AND the dessert.

I work literally across the street from Angeletto's and never heard of it until about 20 minutes ago when a medical student had her boyfriend drop off her order. The aromas coming from her plate were in every bit teasing, so when I asked her where the food came from, that's when she shed light on Angeletto's. She said the only problem she had with them was that the food takes forever to deliver.

So, seeing as though I am having a slow day at work, I decided to give them a call at 2:16pm. The young lady who answered the phone was very polite. I originally ordered the Chicken Parmesan on Italian bread and a side of fries, which are an additional $2. I told her that this was my first time and that I was open to any and all suggestions, and she suggested that I order the Chicken Carbonara wrap. It's basically roasted chicken breast, bacon, mushrooms, green peppers, mozzarella, and their "homemade" Alfredo sauce. Throw in my fries and a Snapple tea and I am good to go. My order came up to $14 (and tax). I am still waiting for the order as I type this. It is now 2:21pm. I will be back to update after the food arrives! *fingers crossed*

**UPDATE**

My order was delivered to me at 2:40pm.

Everything was hot and good. I am not a fan of mushrooms and I couldn't even tell that they had them in the wrap. They weren't overbearingly big. I am satisfied and I can say that I will be ordering from Angeletto's again in the near future!

Good sized portions. Food was well packed and stayed warm enough in the take out bowl that I didn't need to reheat the wonton soup once home. The green onion cakes were nicely raised and had a good crisp and taste. Decent spring rolls too. I did get extra noodles added to my take out that I didn't expect but actually came in handy. I used it with the leftover broth & veggies for soup the next day. 

I believe skip the dish does the deliveries but I was in the area so I went in person. Like all places I've been in for picking up food, masks are required, hand sanitizer is at entrance, line spacing well marked out and no in restaurant seating during this third wave. I'll be back to order different choices another day as they had preset meal options too.

This place has great NY style pizza. The crust is the right thickness, with a nice chew.   The sauce is spot on, fresh tasting and the cheese is perfect.  Pizzas are always cooked perfectly to order and have a wonderful color with browning on the bottom.  The original wings are really good and unique to Mama's.  Staff is efficient and friendly even when super busy on Friday or Saturday night.  They do offer lunch slices that are good for quick orders, but a fresh pizza is worth the wait.
Great food, well presented and great service. Loved orange chicken. Definitely will be back again.

When the facade of a building crashed into Singha it crushed much more than just the restaurant. It also crushed my dreams of Thai spicy cashew chicken. I realize that may sound a little dramatic, but I loved that dish. For the past year I have tried many different versions of that dish, but none came close to Singha. 

The new version of Singha is completely different. The staff appear to be all new and the building does not have the funky charm of the old location. I visited one day right when they opened and was seated with no issue. As my meal continued I saw the restaurant go from half full to completely full with a wait for a table. This all happened in a matter of a few minutes so make sure and come during off peak times.

Service was friendly and prompt just like the old location. The only thing I missed was the old staff who would remember that I really did like my food as hot as they could possibly make it. It always takes a few trips before servers at a Thai place accept that you can handle that level of spice, but I am pretty convincing. 

The food was good. Not as good as the original, but my cashew chicken had hints of greatness. I wish it had been a little spicier, but that will come in time. It also seemed as if the sauce was not as rich as the old version, but I still thoroughly enjoyed it.

The entire meal took under 30 minutes which was impressive considering how busy they got after I was seated. Street parking was a pain, but that won't keep me away.

If you miss Singha, just want some Thai food and you've only got a brief time, head to Singha.

The best reasonably priced Mexican food I've found in the area. Not a big restaurant feel, more of a fast casual place. I been back multiple times and haven't had anything I didn't love. I would recommend the whole menu if I could but the nachos so far have been my absolute favorite.

Down to earth, extremely friendly Indian restaurant that offers incredibly good food at very reasonable prices.

We go to Gagan Bistro very regularly (sometimes weekly during Fall/Winter) and have never ever been disappointed in any way...

Probably the best Indian food (to my taste in the area)...

If you've never had Indian cuisine before, I highly recommend their lunch buffet for $10....

The crust you expect.  

I like this place for lunch.   Two one-topping slices.. 5-something   

Stick a fork in me.

Went here for lunch today and ordered the spicy chicken bento box. 

I have to say I was not impressed one bit. The chicken was barely warm, the rice was bland and had the consistency and taste of old dry rice that was left out since last night, and the edamame was freezer burnt. The only enjoyable thing was the gyoza that came with the bento box. 

There are way better options in the area, including Chix and Bowls and Mt. Fuji that destroy this place in value and taste.

Came here on a holiday weekend that was very busy. We were seated in the bar area. Got the Tagliatelle con Funghi Misti and that was pretty good, nice mushroom flavor and noodles were good. Husband got the ravioli stuffed with prime rib. There were only seven of them, and they were small so we both thought it wasn't much for the price we were paying for them. Overall, I'd say that everyone seated at the bar loved the bartender. That's probably where all the reviews are highly rated for. He's very engaging, personable and makes you feel at home.

Top notch.  During this crazy pandemic, they serve not only great food at reasonable prices, they serve the community. Great specials, ample portions and the most consistent restaurant in Santa Barbara.  Try them.

Been here several times and it gets better every time!  Fantastic service and unbelievable drinks.  My favorite is the Mexican chocolate martini.  The desserts are great also, and grab a cheese platter too.  Get the famous, incredible, totally delicious Cinnamon and Stout Beer Shake!  Can't wait for spring to hit the patio!

I'm so unbelievably disappointed right now.  As I read the reviews for this place my anticipation grew more and more for a absolutely amazing pizza.  I looked at the various images and finally settled on one that I was going to try.  It was a bit expensive, but I figured it was alright to treat myself since I haven't really treated myself in a while.  

I ended up ordering the Truffled Ribeye pizza.  It sounded so amazing and going based off the image posted of it by another reviewer, it LOOKED so amazing too!  I ordered it couldn't wait to try it, was expecting one of the best pizzas I have ever had.  Then I got it home and took a bite.  Overcooked.  Dry.  Tasteless.  I can't even begin to describe how disappointed I was.  I didn't even have the motivation to take it back, though it's about a 10 minute drive from my house anyway so it's not right around the corner.  I tried another slice just to see if maybe just the one slice was an utter disappointment.   To my dismay the 2nd slice was just as bad as the first.  I occasionally tasted a bit of caramelized onion, but outside of that it tasted like the box it came in and was overwhelmed by the flavor of overcooked crust.  Awful.  Truly awful.  $21 down the drain.  Would've been $18 down the drain if I was able to use the 15% off coupon on my actual food (you get the coupon for signing up for their website's reward thing).  Sure I was able to use the coupon just fine, but all it did was cancel out the $3 "web charge" that they apply to your order total from using their website's ordering system (seriously?). 

So disappointed right now.  I read these reviews and I just don't get it.  Was my experience a rare mishap?  Or do people really just enjoy overcooked tasteless pizza?

Very authentic Ethiopian cuisine. Great for groups too! Lots of meat and vegetarian options. We were so excited when they re-opened after getting ousted from their previous location.  Won't find anything like this in Reno.
Fantastic seafood and one of the best views in town. This place has a great patio and bar. Sit upstairs for sure. Generous pours and super delish plates.
Great place owned by a viet couple. Friendly, clean and quality food. Try their pho its unlike any other I've tried in philly. Recommended!

168 Cafe is a new Chinese restaurant located on Virginia St. behind the Black Bear Diner and across the street from the movie theater.  The food is really good and a good value too.  Check out 168 Cafe before you hit the movies!

This place is worth going too for great ribs, creamy mac n cheesiness , sweet and savory baked beans , mash potatoes are worth having . Green beans had a great smokey taste . Only thing I  didn't have the corn bread and there was no 
"home made " desserts 
Don't  forget your free hand rub

I feel forced to write a review as it seems this place is not doing so well and my experience was nothing the like. We came in on a Friday afternoon to our surprise it was not overcrowded and busy. The Crab Cheesy Biscuits where fresh and always a favorite they where outstanding. Our salads where also fresh but a little too much dressing. Our dinner was outstanding in hot plates and of course another fresh serving. We ended up taking home half of it and the portions are generous and the Biscuits are endless. I am really sorry to see many bad experiences in this restaurant and will come back to verify my experiences.

Delicious food, friendly and accommodating staff and comfortably spaced atmosphere!  

Delicious apple walnut muffin with my two eggs, and others in my party enjoyed the hotcakes and omelettes.

Can't say enough nice things about the waitress(Angel);  from her patience when waiting for our large family to get ready to order to paying close attention to my nieces' food allergies, wonderful experience!!  

Also the manager made sure our party of 11 including one chair just for an infant had plenty of space!

Definitely will enjoy breakfast here again!

Bring a sandwich. Food was good but portions were so small. Ordered calamari and we got 4 pieces! 4!! Entree's were also great but small portions again. Great atmosphere and good food but just not enough food for the money.

We only came here for the live music, apps, and drinks. Love music was awesome but the food wasn't anything to write home about (green beans were extremely greasy). The cocktails weren't bad but I'm not sure they were good enough to return for.

We love bonefish! The specials they have right now are particularly amazing. I got the Kung Pao Shrimp. But my favorite part of the meal was our appetizer: the Shrimp Caprese Dip. It was amazing cheesy goodness. We pretty much licked the thing clean! 

This location is still practicing COVID safety measures! They are still spacing out tables and they replace a new paper table covering on each table after a table leaves.
Lobster roll was great. View was nice and our server (BRANDON) was very cool.  We would come back.

Kept hearing about the wings. Get the wings get the wings blah blah blah. So finally I caved. The Eagles were beating the Patriots the other night and I felt festive so I ordered takeout. got the "I dare you" flavor, expecting the basic "we pretend these are spicy" traditional wings to satisfy my craving. My girl got a black bean burger and really good fries with cilantro I believe. The fries and burger were good but the WINGS. OH WOW! Spiciest wings I have ever had in my entire life. I loved them. They were insanely hot. Finally a place owns the spice level that they designate their wings. I will be returning for them. Thx landmark!

The takeout traveled well.

If I have advice to give it is this: GET THE DUCK! Sooo good! Duck quesadilla and duck tacos are a must! You definitely will be disappointed at how small the quesadilla is but the flavor is amazing! Other faves include Baja fish taco, black beans, tuna poke, and mojo pork tacos. Wish they had a location in St. Pete but the duck is worth the drive across the bridge.

Dirty place. Dirty employees. Dirty.  Just dirty. Clearly we are not fans. Employee on cell phone then grabbing food. Drink area had dirt build up like it is never wiped down.  Crumbs visible around food prep area.

9pm on a Wednesday and it is obvious the staff do not want you here.  Breaking down the bar, scrubbing floors,  ignoring the bar patrons.  Does the Central West End shut down at 9pm?  I was turned off by the customer service.  I drank my beer, ate my pretzel (which the staff forgot more than once to place my order), and left.

I will start of saying I eat a lot of Sushi, and am sort of a picky snob when I travel. This place gets 5 stars for just being damn good, I will get there. In Reno, we have options mostly of all you can eat or late night casino rolls. We all know over time the rolls here have shrunk, decreased in quality, and establishments just cannot keep up like the used to with ayce. Since 399 has a small app menu, we decided to get lucky 7 (near our home) apps and muscles, and 1 roll to compare. It seems like they focus on the Maki, I love that. 
I ordered 399 on their website where they had a few more options and one or two rolls at a different price (5.99), it was so easy they even texted to confirm within minutes. We ordered 9 rolls from 399, the total was $48 and they had 10% on their website when ordering online for pickup so $45 plus tip for 4.5 rolls (when you add it up since their rolls are 4 pieces, not 8). 
Oh man oh man, this is my new spot. EVERY single roll was huge, loaded, and any roll with crunchy on top is A GOTO. We compared it to lucky 7, not even close. Normally we can each do about 4-5 rolls and some apps for ayce (trust me we have hit double that) and we did not even finish half of our meal. Paired the gorgeous  rolls with loads of muscles, krab mix, avocado, edamame, and more from Lucky 7 which was perfect. Comparing the the lucky 7 roll, it truly was double the size. Look at the soy sauce packet.... 
3 499 rolls would be plenty for a nice dinner with some apps. 4 would be a full dinner, 5 would be stuffed. Don't believe me? Check my pictures.

I had a really good experience here last night. It was my boyfriend's sister's birthday and we had a table for six. The dining room is small and we were the only ones there for most of dinner.

Mom ordered a bunch of appetizers -- won tons, dumplings, scallion pancakes and fried tofu. I tried everything but the dumplings and the food was so tasty! I'm a vegetarian but I'm not big on Chinese food, so I didn't know what to expect, but I was pretty happy.

Next, we ordered several entrees and shared them. We got both the General Tso's chicken (fake chicken made from gluten) and the sesame tofu. The dishes are really similar, so if I had to do it over again, I'd pick one or the other. I did like the tofu slightly more than the Tso's chicken, though. Both came with a ton of broccoli, which was perfectly steamed. We also ordered a noodle dish and a few others. As you would guess, we had a lot of leftovers! Veggie Lovers is a BYOB and we brought wine and beer.

Perhaps the best part was that we let them know ahead of time that we were celebrating a birthday and they provided us with a really gorgeous cake. It was small, enough for six people (maybe eight if the slices were smaller) and it was light and airy angel food cake with whipped cream, melon and strawberries on top. I'm assuming it cost extra -- the owner went out and bought the cake somewhere in Chinatown. She also gave us two birthday balloons! Veggie Lovers is a great place to have dinner and an even better place to celebrate a birthday. We'll be back for sure!

I really REALLY wanted to give this place five stars because the food was great, only problem is (and I know it's a small place) it took 30 min to get our order. I ordered the Marinera, wife the Chicken Parm, and daughters a Grilled Cheese.... i know this won't catch the attention of the owner because it's a 4 star but I will come back Mr Owner and maybe just maybe I'll upgrade you to the 5 star place...
Best spot for breakfast food - I got the scramble with kale, mushrooms, Gouda cheese and bacon. I'm also gluten free and they have plenty of options including toast!

I wont lie, I had the best steak of my life here.

I ordered the garlic herb crusted prime rib with garlic mash potatoes. While spending that much on a steak might seem nuts I have to say that every steak I've had since has just left me sad by comparison. The baked onion soup and sweet potato pecan pie are not to be missed either!

I can't wait to get back to Indy to get to this place again. Service was top-notch and the food was fantastic.

One of the best meals I had during my time in Tucson! I love thai food and this was highly recommended to me and it did not disappoint. 

I got the Drunken Noodles - the flavors were so good and I loved the stir fried green beans mixed in with the peppers and delicious sauce. I had beef with mine, but I think this would be great with chicken too. 

Also have to shout out the staff - the owner came by to ask me how my meal was and mentioned several of her waitstaff were working their first day. They did a wonderful job! I didn't have a reservation, but they were able to seat me outside and were great about checking on me to see if I had everything I need. 

If you like thai and find yourself in Tucson, definitely try this place!

Bartender to the left of bottom bar tonight 7/1, as absolutely horrible. He was so rude to me. Ordered me the wrong drink when i said it correctly and then refused to serve me after i corrected him. Don't come here. Trash ass establishment.

When friends were visiting Clearwater Beach last week for only one evening, we wanted to pick a place near the beach with good food and a relaxed atmosphere to allow us to catch up on the latest news amongst us.  Clear Sky was a perfect selection.

After a very long and eventful day, our friend and her young daughter were famished, so we ordered Cheesy Bread (dough sticks with mozzarella, marinara and pesto) and Black & Bleu Potato Chips, and both were surprisingly good.  My friend and I ordered the same Blackened Mixed Grill, which was shrimp, scallops and fresh fish all grilled and blackened to perfection, and not overdone at any level.  My wife ordered Blackened Shrimp & Gouda Grits, and she loved it.  Our young friend ordered an individual pizza with her favorite toppings, and it was so tasty we all agreed we would have been satisfied ordering pizzas all around.

Zoey, our Server, was fantastic.  She was bright, fun, very efficient and struck up a nice tact with our now worn-out little friend.  She suggested a Pumpkin Bread Pudding plus a warm Apple Pie ala mode that were both awesome and topped off a wonderful evening.  An excellent time in every respect!

Great local hang or destination.  Can get a little pricey but so can anything else wonderful and indulgent.   I enjoyed the pear and cured ham flatbread, great.  Joseph was a great server and trusted his opinions and knowledge of the menu.  Only complaint, please bring back the delicious " unnamed dessert" -which I affectionately call the  Puddin' Hole.

NOLA is one of the best dining experiences I've had in New Orleans. The food was outstanding and the drinks were great. My only critique would be the time between courses was somewhat slow, but the servers were all great. 

I started with the wedge salad with bibb lettuce. The bibb was a nice change. The dressing tasted like french onion dip, which I love, and the potato chips were a nice, salty crunch on top. I also ordered the fried chicken - which just might be the best I've had. I substituted the sweet potatoes for the potato hash. Amazing. I will most certainly be back. 

NOLA will go on my top 5 restaurant list in New Orleans.

Corned beef sandwich good.  Chicken noodle soup ok, little thin noodles.  V busy lunch, so we had to wait in line for a table.  Waitress god, but register problems to get our check.  A bit disorganized.  The decor is gray, kind of bland overall even being new.   $43 for 2 for lunch w tip.

Very unwelcoming. New hostess needed. Not a good impression to walk into a restaurant with someone rude and unfriendly at the front. We've been here before and to other BJ's locations but purposely will never come back to this one! Others have much better service.

Probably not a place I would have ever ended up, if it weren't for the UYE lunch crowd.  I mostly thought I was going for the company, because I'm not a big fan of the bird food group.  This place made me a fan!

I ordered a pulled chicken sandwich with sauce on the side and steak fries.  Less than $10 and the perfect amount of food for me.  The chicken was really smoky and delicious.  I didn't really use the sauce because the flavor of the chicken was so good it didn't need it.  I tasted the sauce though, and dipped my fries in it because it was too yummy to be neglected.  The steak fries were like I like them - crispy on the outside with a soft center.  They have several side dishes that I probably should have tried and will try next time, but it was just a fry kind of day.

The man who served us (owner?) was very friendly and patient with those of us who didn't know what to order.  He also kept up with our drinks and brought us anything we needed while eating, even though it is an order at the counter kind of place.

Are you F'in kidding me?! Landmark of an institution or greasy goodness! How can you go wrong after honky tonkin all night on lower Broad.? I've done my share of playing many a show down there and THIS is where everyone ends up and for good reason.
 They are on it! Well for what your taste buds are screaming for at 3am. There's a satisfaction and guilt that co-exists when dining here. Sure,you know about all the things that are bad for you,but dammit,it just tastes so f'in good! And really,that's all that matters. Breakfast served up in such a way that the bathrooms behind the grills don't even matter. If they do? Well, you're in the wrong place.
I don't eat sushi. But my husband loves it. And I love this place because it has also a great variety of noodles, chicken and beef plates that are super fresh and delicious.

Food continues to be very tasty; service is slow, especially for lunch time when you need to get in and get out. Gluten free options are limited and need a larger protein portion. Deserts continue to astound. Nice place for a quick bite/snack, but lacking just a bit for a full meal.
Milagro is always a great choice when my wife and I are craving Mexican food.  Wonderful food and service!

What have I done?!? I have found this bakery and nothing will be the same. While under quarantine, I noticed a pecan pie IG post for Easter. I went ahead and called ahead and ordered! Then I mentioned I hadn't ever walked in, and asked what else I could add to support. They mentioned their donuts so I said give me a dozen and you choose. It was a blind tasting and it was so good!  
I wanted more today, so I called and picked up, added the cinnamon rolls, and extra donuts for my father and Neighbor... I recommend giving this place all your money bc you will never stop. I'd recommend Loyalty points or a members club bc I know I will be frequently purchasing. I recommend Mocha, Apple pie, the Crunch donuts! The pecan pie was delicious! 
Please visit this place!!!!
Extremely over priced, quality of ingredients is high but every time I leave I'm disappointed in the food/experience.

I need to be fair and update this review.  I've been back to this location since and the service has improved immensely.  The servers are well versed in the salads they are making, they are better at handling the rush and they are MUCH friendlier.  Honestly, made the trick was to stop accepting cash (haha jk).  Whatever it was, it's working and I'll definitely be frequenting this establishment again.

I first found out about this place while I was having a dinner with a big group of people at the scottish arms (across the street from the Juniper), which is another cute place btw - has a very good whiskey selection there. 

First visit to Juniper was right after the dinner. We all walked over to grab a nightcap / dessert. We ordered a bottle of Pinot Grigio and an apple pie to share - and it was an excellent choice to end our evening.

I really wanted to try their dinner menu as well, so I revisited this place for a nice dinner. I would recommend that you make reservations ahead of time, just to be on the safe side and since they do take reservations, but weekday nights might be ok without except for the friday.

we ordered couple of small dishes to share and one large plate to also share. My eyes are always bigger than my stomach and this ended up being a plenty of food for me and my boyfriend, but you can probably add another small plate or do two large plates and a small plate for dinner for two.

I highly recommend (and I would definitely get this again) getting the plate of southern country ham; it comes with the flat bread and 3 diff styles of ham. They all have unique textures and taste and goes very well with pickled peaches. 

I wanted to try the fried chicken, but since we were getting a steak for our large plate, and already got a ham plate, I wanted something that's on the lighter side so we ordered chicken fried mushroom. It was very delicious, if you love mushrooms like I do, this is a very enjoyable dish. pairs well with the kimchi and black garlic aioli. 

for our main course, we were debating between the pork chop and the beef steak (mkt price - $24 that evening) and we ended up doing the steak, which was an great decision but next time we will try something different because I'm sure everything is delicious here! 

Our server was very attentive and made the whole experience even better and that's always a nice thing. I highly recommend this place, just go and check out at least once, you won't regret it.
I has order Lunch menu ... Bento Box come with Salmon Food look very nice and Test Excellent I will return back ti try another Menu in this Thai restaurant

We stopped here for lunch on our way out of town. I'm glad we did - the food was pretty good. The buffalo shrimp started with tasty shrimp and a mildly hot buffalo sauce. The very thin breading was helpful to not drown out the sauce and shrimp tastes. Their house salad was a good size and was tasty as well. Excellent french fries - I wanted more. The prices were pretty affordable, but remember you are sitting right there on the patio looking at the gulf so the experience is helpful when considering the cost too. I would definitely recommend for a lunch or happy hour spot on the strip!

I enjoyed the Geechee Girl cafe. I like to support local businesses and having this restaurant in NW Philadelphia is important to me.

The decor is nice, the service is very attentive & the food is good. Generous portions, well seasoned (except the cornbread, which tasted predominately of flour, for some strange reason) and fresh ingredients, Geechee Girl is a local gem. Patronize this restaurant!

Such a great breakfast spot! We got lucky and walked right in but there was a line out the door the whole time we were there. We ordered two of the Benedict's but all the food being served around us looked amazing.

This was our second trip New Orleans, we visited here on our honeymoon last fall. A tour guide suggested had suggested it, and it was absolutely amazing! There was a line out the door, but that's not uncommon for New Orleans, and usually all the best places have a line out the door! Definitely worth the wait. I got a fried shrimp platter, and my husband got a catfish platter I believe. Holy moley, so good!!!!! As I'm sure you already know, the seafood in New Orleans is otherworldly and so unbelievably fresh. The batter was crispy and well-seasoned. We sat at the bar and were watching some of the prep cooks shucking oyster shells, so it really made the atmosphere of the place extremely authentic. It's down-to-Earth, dirty, delicious Cajun fare!!! The price tag wasn't bad either! Check it out!
Such a great experience! The food and service was amazing! We had Tristan as a waiter and he was GREAT! We will definitely be back.

This was a horrible experience. There is only one gentleman I recognize. The last two times I have come it's been new staff and this time we found out that it's the owners daughter who was our server and she was extremely rude. It's a mom and pop Business. I use to eat at this dosa place weekly and since we moved we have not come as much. But the recent two experiences has been the worst. And this was in March and today. The server says only her family works there and that's an exception for the few people I know from before. I complained about the thali and pav bhaji being spicy. When we have come in the past it was always mild. We told the server and she said we need to request that because it's all made ahead of time.  We never had to do that before. It's the same meal we ordered for years. Clearly, the cook is different and the service has gone down hill. I liked talking to the guy who always helped us and wish he was our server.
Highly recommend this little place. The portions and taste is phenomenal. So happy to find a place this quality

After not being in their delivery area and if I was it would be at the $15 for 5 mile level.  This place is in the AMC movie area, do not plan on getting a parking spot. Plan on getting ruded to by teens while walking to the restaurant. I called for carry out. I ordered small size for beef mushroom (oops sorry just mushroom because that's all we got) house fried rice and egg roll. There was like 4 pieces of beef, the meal was bland and had to add soy and pepper to get flavor. Price not worth it and taste not worth the trip.
Horrible service. There were only 4 occupied tables. Didn't even get menus for 20 minutes. After 30 minutes we finally just walked out. Only 1 waitress working and she's terrible.

Went here with a group of friends some time back.  We all thought it was pretty meh, at most.  I had an earl grey and scotch cocktail (cannot remember the name) which was alright.  No one was terribly impressed by the food, and I had the worst mussels in my entire life.  I did not eat more than a couple of bites.  This place is getting two stars, because the staff seemed friendly and nice.

I've been here a small handful of times, and have yet to be impressed.

Last time I went was a few weeks ago with my family. I met them there and arrived 15 minutes after they did. Not only did they not have their drinks yet, but the server hadn't even come by to say that he'd be right with them. Another 5 minutes or so went by before our server came to the table. We put in our drink and app orders and my dad and I got a glass of Cabernet and a manhattan. While the kids drinks came right away, we had our appetizers before my dad and I had our drinks from the bar. Our server was also nowhere to be seen during our meal unless it was to run our food or drop off the check.

The service is mediocre at best, and the food is nothing to rave about. I definitely would not recommend this restaurant, and will not be coming here again.

I have heard good things about this place before and when I saw the owner on Chopped I decided I had to give it a try. I went with a friend who had also never been and we both really enjoyed everything.

My visit was for lunch. I would describe this place as definitely being gourmet but with a laid back New Orleans vibe. The interior is clean and slightly upscale with white table cloths. They do have seating inside and outside which is great for people like me who like to eat outside. For this visit I ate inside because it was hot outside. 

The service was spot on and we received and a roasted red pepper soup amuse bouche which I thought had an unusual texture but really good flavor. My friend was not a fan.

My friend and I both ordered the smoked wagyu beef brisket with 'garlicky' parmesan fries. I also ordered a Stone IPA beer, which is one of my favorite beers, and I was impressed to see it available because I hardly ever see it available. My friend ordered a mimosa and she really seemed to enjoy it.

Overall the wagyu brisket was very tinder and very tasty. Everything was amazingly flavorful and the fries were some of the best I have ever had. This place is not cheap but overall it is with it,  I will definitely be back!

I love the decor the food is average but the food for the price leaves a lot to be desired. I don't get why salsa and chips are not complimentary. We paid for the chips and salsa and added a side of guacamole, I'm glad we added the guacamole and for the grand total of about 6 bucks it was worth it. We ordered the shrimp and grits tacos, the Baja fish tacos and the sweet plantains and ended on a sweet note with the sundae. I'm all about unconventional ways to mix up food but it should make sense in your mouth. The shrimp and grits just doesn't make sense with the added pineapple I don't like my savory with sweet. It comes with three tacos, no beans no rice just tacos. The Baja fish is tilapia which is pretty mild in taste by itself, it becomes much more enjoyable if you add the sauces provided. The Baja fish tacos comes with two tacos. Let's just say I'm still hungry 65 bucks later.

I am definitely adding this place to my normal rotation. It's clear that it is a family restaurant, frequented by lots of regulars. I was there on Friday night and it seemed like almost everyone knew each other. The inside is a little tight, but not as claustrophobic as I thought upon reading other reviews. They also have a back patio, which I did not get to try out. I got there a little after 8:00 and the dinner rush was dying down a bit, but it was still a little hectic inside. The hostess was wandering around the restaurant with a clipboard trying to keep everything organized.

This is a place I could definitely take my grandparents to and they would feel comfortable. I say that because there were a ton of old people there, the food was good, but nothing fancy, and it was CHEAP. Almost everything was under $10, including meatloaf, fried chicken, double cheeseburgers, and pulled pork sandwiches.

I went with the pulled pork sandwich with fries and a tiny side of mayo coleslaw. I hate to say this because I'm positive they spent hours smoking that pork, but it almost tasted like something I'd get in a school cafeteria. I think it might have been the bbq sauce that was slathered on it, though, because they few pieces I had where I could really taste the meat were really good, but overall I just couldn't taste that.

My husband's cheeseburger was really good. It reminded me of a cheeseburger you'd get at the carnival. And that's a huge compliment in my mind. Fries come with all the sandwiches and they are super crispy and really, really yummy. 

There were two homemade desserts - blackberry cobbler and pineapple upside down cake - and of course I had to try one so I went with the cake. I don't think I've ever ordered this out anywhere, but it was good. Tasted homemade.

I got a gander at the chicken pot pie at someone else's table and it was humongous! It it tastes as good as it looks then I'm sold. I'm also dying to go back and try the grilled cheese and wings.

It's a bar with awesome food (and lots of veggie options) and it's covered in photos of adorable dogs. What can be wrong with that? We had the veggie cakes (omg delicious, fried goodness) and the goat cheese salad (they even fried the cheese, naturally), and my one drink put me on my ass at 1 in the afternoon. They are on Restaurant.com (even better) and the $5 drinks on Sundays are awesome.

Really original and delicious cajun food. This is our go-to spot for warm, inexpensive food. I actually really like the new location: great beer, lots of seating, and usually a decent spot to park since it's on the north end of Mass now. They know my husband because he comes in so much and always throw in a drink or some free bread, the folks that work here are really cool and helpful. They'll also let you try some things out and I really enjoy that there are always at least 2 vegetarian options!

Best hot dogs in Santa Barbara by far! Favorites are the Chicago, Hawaiian, & Santa Barbara dogs. The deep fried Oreos are divine. Always get great service & consistently fantastic food. Check out Dave's - you'll be back for more!

This restaurant may be little, but expect big things from it. The food is great, the owners are friendly and from what I saw on my visit, it's the kind of place as a regular that you can order "the usual" and be met with cheerful banter, not confusion. Definitely going to be a new go-to spot for Asian food for me.

I love the Blind Pig! Great draft selection and the food is great! I recommend the wings and thanksgiving balls as starters or munchies. The wings and french fries are some of the best in NoLibs for me, but I don't like super hot wings so I can't speak to those... I have also tried the sandwiches and entrees with no complaints from me or anyone I was with.. this spot doesn't get too crowded so it's great for a last minute decision for dinner or drinks.
They have gluten free buns and awesome burgers paired with music from my childhood, hard to beat it.

Went here to grab takeout on our way to visit friends.  We ordered a chicken dish and some type of flat steak.  Both dishes were very cooked to order, and were healthy portions.  There was so much that we had an entire chicken breast left over.   One dish came with rice and beans, and the other came with french fries and beans.   

The prices are very reasonable.  I have no comment on the "dine in" service as we only went in to pick up our order however, when we ordered via phone the staff was pleasant, the order was ready when they said it would be, and the order was 100% accurate.

Great place, great food, reasonable prices, what else can one ask for?  We'll definitely give this place a try when we're in the neighborhood agin.
What can I say. It was wonderful food,  service was great and my meal was outstanding . It was an event that I'll never forget. Must go back again!!

Came here on Saturday around 10AM. Viet breakfast? Yum! It's located on Park Blvd right by the railroad tracks. Just look for the bright yellow building or you will miss it! There is a rear entrance as well as a front entrance. Pretty nice space inside to accommodate a lot of guests. We were the only people in the restaurant so we had our pick of where to sit lol. Our server promptly brought menus and waters for us. He was very friendly and helpful with the menu.

I ordered #140 which was the rice vermicelli with everything (dac biet), my husband ordered a large pho, and my son wanted the special fried rice without veggies. We also ordered a taro boba tea for him (YES! They serve boba tea too!)
They have A LOT of menu items. Main points being the different kinds of pho, banh mi, rice vermicelli and broken rice dishes. My son said YUM to the boba tea. He said it tasted good and the boba were nice and chewy (fresh). Our server even came by to ask if the boba tea was sweet enough, I'm guessing he would have remade it if we said no? Appreciated that he asked though, awesome customer service!

My bun came with grilled shrimp, ground pork meatballs, ground shrimp, and egg roll. The noodles were fresh tasting and not hard/dry. The vegetables in it were fresh looking too and not wilted/brown. It was tasty and I didn't share because it was so good lol! My husband's bowl of pho was HUGE. He said the broth was very flavorful and he amazingly finished the bowl. My son's fried rice was good too (I snuck a bite). It came with Chinese sausage, spam, grilled pork and scrambled eggs. The rice was not greasy and tasted good. It wasn't bland or too salty.
