LOVED Sampan. 

Yes, there was a long wait even at 6:00 pm, but it was definitely worth it. Plus we just got drinks and small plates at the bar while we waited.

The food was fantastic, and the service was really nice. Pork Bao Buns and Cheesesteak Dumplings were phenomenal.

Was meeting friends here for the rare dogfish head event.  Grabbed a table then went to the bar for drinks, plenty of room at the bar. Saw 4 different staff members behind the bar, one of which was clearly a manager. Proceeded to be ignored by all 4 staff members.  Made eye contact with the manager twice, yet she continued to dry glasses. The rest of the staff continued to keep their backs turned to us. Had polite conversation with the guy next to me while still waiting to be served (I'd like to add, I and the other 2 people I was with were completely sober and quiet individuals, so there was no reason not to serve us). Another guy at a table walks up to the bar and the bartender turns around and goes to immediately serve him. By this point the manager and 2 other staff members disappeared but another bartender walks up and first bartender tells him to serve us. Finally!! It had to be about 10 minutes by now! He gives us our drinks, I give him the money and he tells me it'll be a minute because first bartender is now counting out his drawer. So I wait a few minutes and nothing happens. In the meantime, my other friend, who I was meeting shows up. After talking with her a few minutes, I realize I still don't have my change. I asked the bartender what's going on and he says first guy is still counting out, then asked where I was seated and promised to bring me my change asap. After nearly 20 minutes I finally got my change. Don't go here if you're in any kind of rush!!!! The 2nd bartender (black beard) was very polite and the only solace in the entire place. Oh and as I went to the bathroom I saw where the manager disappeared to; she was chatting it up with a table clearly of regulars. Coming from someone who's in this business, I was very disappointed and will not be back. It's a shame too because the place was cute.
Food was ok. Service was good. The rolls fell apart a lot the night we went to eat. Other than that, pretty cool.

Mee so hungry.  Great authentic Sichuan menu and some Americanized dishes for the less enlightened.  Typical Chinese restaurant decor with exceptional food.  Handynasty without the hype and prices.  There is only one other Sichuan restaurant better and you will need to torture me to get the name because I don't want it overrun by white peoples.
We had the 2 specials, the flounder and scallops. The entres were awesome. The scallops were cooked just right, not over cooked like other places.

My sister and I tried beignets in a variety of locations during our trip, and we liked the ones here the best. They're softer and larger than the ones at Café Du Monde, and I liked the atmosphere here better.

We eat from this restaurant a couple of times a week.  Spicy chicken , brown rice, and vegetables!  Freshly cooked, hot and delicious.  It's about time Sunset Point Plaza got something worth visiting.
Awesome new place. Great service, great food and the Dole whip margarita is a must have!!!

Small place but full of friendliness and charm. The people here are great. They make you feel special. Food lives up to it too! Hollister is a whatever street, but if you happen to be here, this  place is worth a try!

I was surprised to find a true Vietnamese spot so close to Willow Grove Mall, and one that was quite busy at 2:00 to boot. The crowd was split evenly between (seemingly) Vietnamese people and gringos like me, which assured me of Pho and Beyond's reasonable authenticity.

Regardless, the food we were served all had the characteristic Vietnamese extremely fresh, subtle flavoring I've come to love. We started off with the vegetarian spring rolls (which I'm fairly sure are also vegan). These struck a great textural chord between the toothsome wrapper/noodles and crunchy fillings. The flavor was pronounced mint and basil, with a savory-sweet kick from the peanut sauce it was served with.

I opted for the pho deluxe while my vegetarian dining companion got the tofu fried rice. The fried rice had all elements (rice, veggies, and tofu) cooked properly with a subtle, rich flavor in the background. My pho's broth had a great, meaty flavor without being too heavy or salty. The quantities of meat, noodles, and garnishes were generous, and the dish as a whole was a nice combination of rich broth, fresh herbs, and savory meat. Non-adventurous diners should go for a simpler pho though, as the deluxe version has some gnarly beef tendon that isn't for the faint of heart.

The ambiance and service here are above average, with reasonable prices and ample quantities. Furthermore, the menu is quite vegetarian and vegan friendly. We will definitely return when the mood strikes for Vietnamese.

Of course I had heard of this 1 million times but it was my sister who reminded me while we were in Ybor city that there was a hamburger Mary's and to my surprise you'll never guess who was there working in the restaurant the very famous Amy Demilo!
Anybody who knows anything about drag queens and all that good stuff especially in Florida they know that she is a total legend I remember back in my early 20s seeing her shows in Fort Myers

If you were going to go here definitely go here on a night that Aimee is there or an afternoon I'm not sure but it's definitely worth the site just to see Aimee you have no idea how beautiful this woman is! 
The food was good but I really wasn't even paying attention to the food to be honest my family at fun now it's a cool place

It was metered parking out front and we didn't really have a problem we came in for lunch and I'm glad we stopped in

The service here is great, but the food is beyond bad. For 10 bucks I got a coke, a handful of chips, and a soggy bowl of tasteless chicken and watery sour cream. No seasoning, no salt, not even fresh. I'm literally sitting here eating and contemplating my life choices because of how bad it it. 

Take the risk and just go to Chipotle.
So not worth the price. Over priced, mediocre food, slow service. Use to be a fav, just returned back for the 1st time since we began outdoor dining. Don't need to return.

I hate writing negative reviews but I had a terrible experience here. All the servers were foreign and did not understand English at all. I went with 3 other people and I felt horrible because it was my suggestion to go there. 

The management was very disorganized. We had 4 different servers try to take our order and each of them kept checking on us to the point of being obnoxious. They were out of 3 different types of wine. We tried one that was promised to be good but was much more expensive than we had wanted to pay. The server struggled to open it, broke off the cork in the bottle and then proceeded to spill wine all over my shirt and pants. I was nice to the waitress and told her not to worry about it (she looked like it was her first night and she was about to cry). 

Another server came up and apologized and asked if we'd like a free dessert. We agreed but asked that they please wait until after the meal. 2 other servers came up and asked what we'd like for dessert. Annoyed, we ordered something and again said, "please bring it after our meal." 

10 minutes later, our dessert came out. Really? We had to laugh at this. Then our appetizers: we got a crepe and the beef tartar. I would not order either again. Finally we got our dinner, I got a fish dish and the side veggies were huge chopped carrots with no flavor at all. The fish was mediocre at best.

I called to speak to the owner as I would rather tell him how he could improve than leave a bad review. He was a nice French man who apologized and gave me a gift card and offered to clean my pants. This was 3 months ago and they still have my pants. I've called 4 time since and they're promised to have the manager or owner call me back but have not.

I do not even want to go back there to my gift card.

I miss when it was Epiphany's! At least they had a fun bar with great cocktails!

Amazing food! I ordered food from here on Uber eats and as it was walking into my work everyone could smell the food and asked... "is that Bodega?" You know a place is good when people can smell it and instantly recognizes the food!!
I ordered a takeout Mushroom Risotto. It was extremely salty, may be the cook forgot and added 2 or 3 times the salt needed. After one bite, I couldn't take it anymore, I had to trash it.

My husband and I have wanted to try it since moving to the area and finally did it! Didn't disappoint. We both got the strawberry shortcake sundae and while the shortcake tased slightly freezer burnt, it was delicious. I'll definitely be returning to try out more flavors!

I love this location even more than the downtown location. The staff is always super friendly and the food is fresh and delicious. Good drink specials and entertainment on most nights too. Very quaint atmosphere and dog friendly (outside). Love this place!

If you're trying to find tasty, authentic Greek eats in Tucson, this is definitely the place to go. This is a locally owned business started by a family from Chicago (the motherload of awesome American Greek food), so you know it's good. Don't be fooled by the My Big Fat Greek Restaurant is right down the road. Pappoule's is less expensive and just as good (if not better). I recommend the Gyros Platter, and don't forget to slather on the Tzatziki Sauce. Opa!

Mesa Verde had amazing vegan food! We shared the BLTA and Street Tacos, both were delicious. The tacos were beautifully prepared with tiny flowers and chives on top, a yummy mix of beans, jackfruit, tomatoes, and jalapeños as the filling, and a tasty tortilla as the base. The BLTA was also amazing... the layers of bacon tempe, avocado, tomato, horseradish, and bread created an extremely rich flavor; it was so good that I wish I had one right now! As we were preparing to pay the bill, the owner came over to us and insisted we try a small dessert... our waiter brought out a beautifully plated dish of vegan baklava and vegan vanilla ice cream drizzled in a fruit sauce. The incredible dessert and generosity of the owner made our meal at Mesa Verde thoroughly enjoyable and a very memorable dining experience.

This is an Italian place with a small bar but a good size area for tables. The show football games there and they have a pool table. It is directly behind the FedEx store across the street from the atrium area of the convention center. 
The food is ok. Not great but not the worst either. Given its location it is great for people attending meeting at the convention center. I had 2 slices of pizza, an ice tea, and a side of meatballs. There are 3 meatballs to a side and they are good size. The people were friendly and the food came out quickly.

I love this place. The food was good, the service was great and all the staff was very friendly. I used the Yelp app to reserve and by the time we arrived, we were seated right away.

The prices were good as well. I plan to try the other Ruby Slipper locations on my next visit.

The barista was not polite over the phone nor in person. The coffee, espresso, and chai latte were not good. The coffee was bitter and weak. The chai latte didn't even taste like a chai latte, seriously. The tofu wrap was pretty decent. The vegan pumpkin woopie pie made up for a lot of it.

stopped in for to go dinner. Not many peeps but a bar and Italian food ! ordered penne with marina ...came with soup and bread. Speedy, polite service. Certainly good tasting marinara, the bread was nice and yeasty warm.  The place could use some updated decor but not terrible. Will visit again, if even just for the bread and drinks !

Friday night. Full staff. 3 tables occupied. Cannot get a waiter or waitress to take our order to save our lives. Apparently, huddling over each other's cell phone takes precedence. Maybe the service is why it was empty. Nice job manager. I'll take my $200 elsewhere.

My go to hoagie spot. Special Italian with prosciutto has never let me down. I hear they have good burgers but I'm not switching up after 25 years. 

1/15/19 - Update - This place is still 5 star food, super friendly and quick service.

3rd visit in a year.
1st visit: met friends there for drinks. Arrived to get the last pint off a pitcher and they had several before me. Was told we all were cut off and no more beer for anyone, even after the waitress acknowledged I just arrived. Dumb move. Understand dram shop laws, etc. 

2nd visit:  Met friends with girlfriend for Sunday lunch. Waitress brought our beer to the table and spilled a full beer on my girlfriend. Their answer was to give a free beer! Didn't even offer to comp her meal or anything, instead she gets a beer while wearing one. 

3rd visit: went today and was told sit anywhere. 80 degrees and sunny so we sat at the patio bar beside 4 other people. After 13 mins no one acknowledged us till we picked up our keys and started leaving. Was told by the bartender they were trying to raise the garage door on the bar. If she can say that when we are leaving, could she not say that when we sat down?

Will never go back. 3rd strike means they are dead to me.

Tonight's dinner deserves zero stars and a refund. The bun on the turkey burger was "cold" . It certainly came out of a cooler. The turkey meat was not fresh. Tasted like a warmed hockey puck. The caesar salad was made up of a cup of wilted romain, some odd tasting cheese and a quarter cup of water that was still left on the romain from rinsing. We shared an order of calamari . This dish was disappointing as well since it was reheated, in effect twice cooked with an excessive amount of oil on the plate. I left most of the food on the plate and gave a good tip. The waiter took the untouched plates away and did not ask if anything was wrong. It was unfair to be forced to pay for this meal. The food and the indifferent service leads me to advise to avoid Marathon.

My mother and I stopped in for a late lunch on yesterday, 10/1/18. We were greeted​ by Lauren who took our drink orders and promptly delivered​.​. I would not have known that she was in training until our actual waitress Trina came to watch over us placing our order. I ordered the bacon wrapped shrimp as usual, which were delicious! My mother ordered the fried shrimp platter. Upon delivery, she noticed that they were not as they would normally appear. The manager came out and apologized​ that they had been cooked in the child's bland batter. We were given a free dessert for our next visit. All three women made sure to keep checking back with my mom after her new plate arrived. Overall was great customer service! Sidenote: we were caught off guard by their daily pep rally. Made for great laughs.

We always get the supreme and it's delish! Favorite pizza in the area. There is one girl who works the register who often gets orders wrong so I have to make sure I over clarify my order if need be, but the pizza is very good!

My husband and I call this place the Triple B. We went here last year on father's day (our anniversary) 6/21/2015. Upon arrival, we were told there was a 15 minute wait. We signed our names on the clipboard provided and sat on the bench outside. There is no waiting area inside. The place is a house converted into a restaurant and parking is located on the street, when available. Triple B offers flavored water while you wait. Our water had watermelon, oranges, and rosemary in it and it was refreshing. We were given two complimentary bite-size biscuits with pecan butter to start and it was good.  For an appetizer, my husband and I ordered the Jamaican wraps and they were delicious. My husband ordered the fried Andouille sausage hash cakes, which was very dense and I ordered the grilled brie waffle with blueberry compote. The tables are small and close together (at least what we observed in the small room where we sat). If you are claustrophobic, this might not be the restaurant for you. I liked the small town feel inside the restaurant and I liked that our food did not take that long to come out. However, I was slightly disappointed in my choice. I felt that the waffle and brie and blueberry concoction did not come together as smoothly as I would have liked. This is unfortunate because their menu is so different from others in the neighborhood, and they are open on Mondays when many places are closed. Our food was not bad by any means, but it wasn't fantastic either. My husband and I will come back because of their ever-changing menu.

Service 4*
Price 5*
Food 4*
Location 4*

This is a heavily biased review, because I am obsessed with kale, and this is a kale-promoting restaurant. Oftentimes nutritious, healthy food that's prepared at a restaurant is either drowning in soy sauce or tamari or is just completely unexciting and flavorless. Cafe Hey has a very respectable kale salad, great coffee, good soups, and decent sandwiches. I'd definitely re-visit.

I don't know about their other desserts, but I am not a fan of their vegan cookies...they're too dry and crumbly. Then again, I've been spoiled by Central Cafe & Organics in St. Pete - the best vegan cookie I have ever had!

What a charming out of the way little gem. Delicious, fresh and generous portions, everyone in our family of 4 enjoyed their meals. LOVED the Indian fry bread and homemade buttermilk biscuits. The omelet with Bacon, cheese and avocado was perfect for my more restrictive keto diet.

This place was good for a quick bite to eat before heading to a show-- the menu is small and simple, and the burgers are pretty decent. Service is fast and efficient, but decidedly casual, somewhere between a Five Guys and a Steak and Shake experience.

Out door dining was a great experience at Zaytoon. Each table had a  fire pit in the middle of the table which was great when dining in the evening. Lots of trees surrounding each tables giving safe separation from the next table. Super friendly staff with family atmosphere.  Most importantly, Lebanese/ Mediterranean food was delicious! Amazing Chicken Kabob, Vegetarian Plate, garlic hummus... and more.

What a disappoint this mac & cheese was from Kings Ribs on Georgetown Rd! We've been working 7 days a week at my job and my shift wanted to have a pitch in. So i purchased 3 dishes: mac & cheese, rib tips and green beans, to show my team how much i appreciate their hard work. I spent $125  out of my pocket (no company card) for this bs!! You can literally see the milk just sitting in this runny/disgusting mac. the manager didnt want to compensate in no type of way. Just a "sorry about that" thanks for your money though. So do not ask why black businesses dont get supported when this is how they do their own people that try to support them. I will never eat a King Ribs again! What an embarrassing dish for me to serve to my people and i spent my hard working money on this.

I've eaten here at least 50 times. The food is always delicious. Cheesesteak is delicious, and so is hot n spicy chicken. Only flaw is the service is bad sometimes, but I'll give it 5 still for being reliably good

It was my first time at EFC, overall the food was good but nothing to write home about. I ordered the Tartar Tuna which was accompanied with wanton chips drizzled in wasabi aioli. The atmosphere was very relaxed & comfortable. Our server Whitney was very helpful in giving recommendations & knew all about the food. All in all it was pleasant.

Classic American diner decor. Service has always been very good. Burgers and chicken sandwiches are very good. Free refills on steak fries and drinks (including nonalcoholic specialty drinks). I recommend the Chicken Bruschetta "burger" and chili burger (both include garlic fries instead of regular fries, which are also unlimited). No coupons, however if you get the free Red Royalty card, you get a free appetizer, 5% off all purchases, buy 12 get 1 free burgers, and a free burger on your birthday.

So what's a guy supposed to do when his buddy's fiance is in town? You take her out for steak dinner in a restaurant themed after the wild west of course. After taking her to the upscale and date-like Pizzeria Vivace (awkward?) the night before, this sounded like a perfectly  un-romantic place to go.

Dinner at Pinnacle Peak was definitely a memorable one, it was casual enough to keep things platonic and also interesting enough to ensure a good time. The whole plaza is built to look like an old western town/fort which definitely got me into the cowboy mood. 

Before we even entered the restaurant, we were immediately greeted by gunshots. Pupils dilated, adrenaline pumping, muscles tensed, I was ready to do whatever it took to hide behind the human shield that was my friend's fiance. Luckily, it was just their nightly stunt show and I wouldn't have to call my buddy up with some bad news.

After having my life flash before my eyes, we entered the restaurant and were seated immediately. The ambiance of the restaurant is definitely one of its finer points. It conveys a very casual and friendly atmosphere. In fact, it's so casual that if you are caught wearing a tie, it is cut from you and hung up on the wall as a warning to all other ties who may dare enter. With hundreds of cut ties hanging from the walls, you can be sure they follow through on their promises.

I had their signature cowboy steak and my companion had their filet mignon. Overall the food was good. Not terrible, not great, but good. I felt that my steak was a bit on the dry side, but definitely still edible by my standards. My friend felt similar sentiments in regards to her filet. Along with their meals they also include a side of beans which were quite good. I'm not particular fond of beans, but my stomach enjoyed the flavors of the beans at dinner and then my nose enjoyed them a few hours later.

Mission success. Me and my buddy's fiance were fed and had a good time feeding. Pinnacle Peak's food isn't great, but it is a different and unique experience I would recommend everyone to visit at least once if in Tucson.

So I'm not saying that Pinnacle Peak isn't a great place to take a date for dinner, I'm just saying that gunfire doesn't always get me into the mood (sometimes it does). That's why it was such a great place to take my friend's fiance. We had a platonic dinner and to top off the un-romantic night, we ended up watching the highly sexually-charged movie: Black Swan. (awkward.)
Got my cheese burger animal style no lettuce and tomato,xtra pickle. Love it, just wish the hamburger patties were bigger. "Where's The Beef!" Great service that's for sure.

My go to spot for take out sushi.  The have a large selection of food to order on the menu and there are specials posted all over the restaurant.  My favorites include sashimi, rainbow roll, and the dragon roll.  They charge for miso soup if you take out, but it's free if you dine in.  The atmosphere is your typical mom and pop Japanese restaurant.  They have beer, wine and sake available.  Cheers!
Yummmmm! Cute little diner with great food! Our server was quick and the food was cooked to perfection. Great spot!

Went there with my fiancé right after he proposed :) He reserved a cute little table for us on their patio - the restaurant has great ambiance. However, the food is mediocre for the price. The drinks were pretty bland and our entrees tasted like they were from a chain restaurant. I had to send my seared tuna back because it was cooked all the way through. The waitress apologized and asked if I would like a refill on my martini. I took that as a comped drink for the error, but no - was charged for that and had to wait for my mediocre tuna. All in all it was not worth the money.

We also dined at Commander's Palace, Brennan's, and Antoine's - highly recommend those!!!

Great place for affordable sushi.  Had a good experience ordering all you can eat buffet and found the quality to be pretty good considering the price. Very nice server.  Will return for sure.  Would be great for a large group.

Would love for this review to be higher. After all, the food is quite good, service is solid, prices are reasonable, and the location and atmosphere are better than fair.

So why only 3? It may seem trivial but to me it nearly ruins the place: The super cheesy MUSIC they play!  I like to think I'm open to all different kinds, but one thing I can't abide by is the cheesy pop-classical crap that is Andrea Bocelli, that only marginally talented operatic tenor (the blind Italian one... You know who I mean) that only 50-year old housewives and people with no taste like. His music is campy crap that is poorly sung when compared to any REAL tenor, and every time I've been to Gnocchi it is all they play!  Honestly, I'm being generous giving you 3, Gnocchi.  Play real opera, play Frank, but until I walk past and here ANYTHING other than that Bocelli pablum coming from your speakers I will not step through your doors again. It's unnecessarily ruined my meal there enough.

I have never been to Panera before, but received a gift card and decided to take my two children for lunch. When we ordered, I told the cashier we have never been there before, thinking he would explain the process or make a suggestion. No, he was too busy laughing and joking with the cashier next to him. I ordered a kids meal and then my daughter and I got a half sandwich and a cup of soup/salad. The cashier never asked me if I had a rewards card or even if I wanted one. Over $38 for one adult and two children to eat. That's insane! If I'm going to pay almost forty dollars for lunch for two kids and myself, I'm going to a sit down restaurant where they bring your drinks and food and clear your plates! The bread was so hard that our teeth hurt after from chewing. My sandwich was mostly onions, barely any cheese and three slivers of steak. My son said his mac and cheese was good and that was about the only positive comment made. Panera is overrated and I have never heard anything good about it, and now I know why.

These are the best doughnuts I have ever had in my life. Even my friend, who doesn't normally like doughnuts, liked these. And let me tell you, it has been a feat to have finally found a doughnut that she likes.

First off, these doughnuts are insanely cheap and are given to you fresh and warm. Service is fast, and it's enjoyable to watch the staff make the doughnuts while you wait in line. For flavors, we tried the pumpkin spice and the apple. The pumpkin spice one was perfectly flavored with subtle hints of cinnamon, the dough was fluffy and chewy, and the cream on the inside was generous but not overwhelmingly sweet. In fact, it was actually mindblowing how the doughnut could be so fully stuffed with cream yet still be less sweet than the ones from your typical chain doughnut establishments. The apple doughnut was of the same quality, perfectly glazed and fluffy, stuffed with delicious apple filling. I wish we had tried more, because there were so many options to choose from and every single one of them looked amazing! With the quality, the taste, and the price of these doughnuts, this place is an absolute must-visit while you're in Philly!

Two stars for ambience and acceptable wifi. The staff acted very snooty when I kept requesting different things. They have no sugar replacements available and treated me like I didn't deserve their coffee if I wanted to put splenda/ stevia in a breve. They were out of the two menu items I requested, and then informed me that they were not a starbucks... which I actually take offense to considering Im from Seattle and the coffee that the OG 'bucks had was significantly better than the garage roasted beans these guys were improperly grinding. 
They act like they have the best coffee in town, when I have been to truck stops that have compacted a stronger espresso. 
The ambience was cute... but pretty uncomfortable to actually sit in and work on- driftwood does not make for comfortable, functional furniture.

I was with my family doing some shopping at Christiana Mall and we decided to eat at this place.  I have eaten here before, but I ate at the one in Lawrenceville, GA.

Anyway, the waiter that I had was not good at all.  He could have done better.  The food was ok, but the one in Georgia was much better!

Small venue. I would definitely recommend this place for an intimate date.  The food is phenomenal. I never would have found this place on my own. So keep your eyes open while you are driving.  The customer service is great. I definitely want to come back and explore the entrees on their menu.
Had the Cuban sandwich, which was delightful. A classic and made with great authenticity. Highly recommend this choice and establishment!!

Went here with three other friends for the first time last week. To sum it up in a nutshell, I would say it's an upscale version of Earls with slightly better food.  We went on New Year's Day and it was completely packed.  Your not allowed to reserve but the restaurant is split into two - half for the dining area and the other half for the lounge area (which is first come, first serve seating).  The wait was 30-45 minutes in the dining area so we snagged a seat in the lounge area instead.

For the food, we mainly ordered some appetizers/entrees and shared.  My buddy and I split the halibut soft tacos ($14) and fried calamari ($12).  Both were decent but there were only 2 tacos in total!  Another friend and I split the yam fries ($8) which were pretty good but when I thought about it, $8 is pretty friggin expensive for a side order.  As well, she ordered the spicy chicken ($11) which she said was good.  My last friend ordered the teriyaki chicken rice bowl ($16).  

All in all, the food was basically what I was expecting (nothing exciting) but it's decent for a chain restaurant.  Good to take with friends who are picky eaters or that aren't to adventures when they go out and eat.  Or it would be a good place to go for drinks and the eye candy. Hahaha.  We were there catching up for a few hours so I can't complain as the waitress was super nice (we were there for 3 hours).

It's more of a trendy place to be seen.  Nothing I would rush over to go to if your a foodie.

Yup, it's definitely a "Hip" place for "Hispters" to look "Hip". Unfortunately, they placed all their efforts on the vibe and not in the products. They are VERY proud of their offerings, however, given the price.

I can't speak for their coffee, however, because my blood pressure situation doesnt allow me to have caffine, and THEY DON'T OFF ANY DECAFFEINATED COFFEE OR ESPRESSO!!!! All I could have was some decaf Plum Tea, which was actually fairly tasty but not anything close to what I wanted. 

I can speak for the decor. It's in what appears to be an old jiffy lube type garage. Hard walls, high ceilings, VERY echo-ey and loud. The furniture, again, is designed to look cool, but is absolutely NOT conducive for comfort and conversation. The side tables against the walls have a huge cable attaching them to the wall. They cut right through your line of sight to the person you're sitting with. WTF? 

So, if you're a poser and want to appear like you should be in L.A. instead of Nashville AND you have money to burn, go here. Otherwise, stick with the MANY other great coffee places in Nashville like, "Edgehill Cafe", "Bongo Java", or "Portland Brew".
You have to see this place..... such a great vibe and just off State Street. Breanna was THE best host. Come out and get good beer, wine and they have live music and even karaoke!

They are quick and deliver to ucity? Nice!! The food was really yummy, the guy got the general tso chicken and I got general tso tofu. It wasn't the crispest tofu ever but the flavor made up for it! The lack of insane wait time was phenomenal as well, I typically expect to wait hours for grub hub food but this came before expected delivering hot food and crunchy tempura veggies. I'm in!

After hearing great reviews from my peers, I finally gave this place a try on a friend's birthday. We came during dinner time on a weekend but already had a party table reserved. We were able to be seated right away and promptly were served asking for orders and drinks.  This is where the promptness stopped. After about 30 minutes of ordering food we were left hungry and not until several more reminders to 3 different servers, we were given our food . The food itself with the sauce bar I would give itself a 4/5 especially since it it all you can eat, but what brought it down was the service and the lack of attention. In the end, my friends and I ordered about a round and a half of food. I felt disappointed with that because we were paying $20+ for an all you can eat meal, but did not receive the service we were paying for.  I felt a stern "please hurry up" attitude in conjunction with a lack of attention for service. The silver lining of this establishment though is their check in on Facebook to get a free ice cream deal.

10/30/2019: My coworker recommended the hash browns for breakfast and it did not disappoint. It's not mashed, cut up, or shredded. It's more like smushed-like if that makes any sense. Get it with cheese, add some salt & pepper, and enjoy.

Delicious chicken! I had the tenders, medium heat. They were spicy, but not too hot to handle. Perfect heat. Most of our group got mild, and they said they were just a little spicy. The people were so friendly and we were so glad we stopped by to try Nashville hot chicken!
I've come a few times for the lunch buffet (9.99). It's decently good food but not spectacular. Clean, well-lit, comfortable, convenient.

Wonderful food and wonderful service!!! We came because of a recommendation and everything was wonderful! The waitress was very knowledgeable, the food came so quickly, and the atmosphere was perfect. Will definitely be returning!

Note: This review is strictly for the buffet.

I have stopped by New Delhi on only a few occasions, and each time I remember why I don't go out of my way to go here. The restaurant itself is quite large and pretty clean from what I've observed but...

The food is just above average. I have Ekta just around the corner form my house, so that is reason enough to never leave my neck of the woods. The food here, while acceptable and well-cooked, is lacking. I don't taste the careful attention to detail and almost scientific blend of spices/flavors that draws me to Indian food in the first place. 

Strangely enough, one thing that I do LOVE here is the mango mojito. It is delicious and at a more-than-reasonable price. I also like the fact the the buffet comes with dessert. The desserts themselves are forgettable but I appreciate the effort.

I've never sat in it, but the outside seating area seems nice and the wait staff is fine.

What is sad about this review is you would think I would learn my lesson.  The first time I went to this location it was a horribly slow experience.  Another time I showed up early in the morning and was told "we are short staffed so unable to take orders."  This time I went late night and was told a list of what they were out of and asked if I still wanted anything.  I proceeded to place an order.  During my long wait at the window (only 1 other car in drive thru so no reason to be so slow) I noticed extensive filth on the interior.  The lobby was closed however, the tables were loaded with soda cups.  The fry area had do much grease caked on it and in the center an area that looked like someone had scratched a good layer off down to clean metal...yuck.  The floor looked like it hadn't been swapped or mopped in a long time.  Finally every experience there is lacking in the customer service.  The food, which I did not finish, was not what i ordered and not good at all.  I have finally learned my lesson...will NOT be returning.

Update, friend and I spent 24 hours violently ill after sharing a burrito from this location.  Still recovering.

Worst service we've ever had. We have a 2 year old and we're looking for the server on multiple different occasions. I never saw her running from table to table, just one other table and ours. Towards the end, my son was, rightfully, getting restless and I ordered our deserts to go, and our check, in case we had to wait another 30 mins for that. At one point I saw our drinks made, up at the bar, our server no where to be found for over 10 minutes. She came by and I said "I see our drinks up at the bar". The real thing was, at the end, when we were scrambling  to box things up, some guy, maybe a manager comes up to my son and I and asked us to wait outside because he was "echoing". I let him have it right there. I told him the REAL problem was the slow service and when you have someone with a toddler, you want to make sure they're not waiting too long. My son has been to 5 countries and eats out 2/3 times a week and we've never had such bad service and disrespect, at the end with the manager or whoever he was. Don't go there, not worth the money. Also, they didn't even offer to help us box up anything. She seemed real busy but never looked like it. For example having food or drinks in her hands, or approaching other tables. Seriously disappointed.

Coming from Pasadena , we decided to go to this place for breakfast . Really sweet owner and her donuts and sandwiches are very good.
Great taste with a great price

Excellent .....food & service!!! management on top of their game. Need to watch this team in action. Greeting customers ensure fast service. Love the boating facilities with dock masters to assist.  We visit every-time were in town from North Hernando Beach. 

Can't wait for stone crab season just around the corner... Cold beer & crab ...gotta love Fl.

We had a pretty straight forward experience. We dined in we got our food quickly and were in and out within an hour. Staff was very friendly and helpful with recommending gluten free options for me.The red beans and rice was gluten free and very very good. My husband loved the fried creole wings. I would highly recommend this spot and return again. It was within walking distance of our hotel on Canal street and we spent about 75.00$ total. The decor was not great, but we were in and out and service and food was good. Staff was very very friendly!
This is probably my new favorite Italian Restaurant.  Pasta was perfect and be sure to order the Lemon Mascarpone Cake
The down town restaurant is closed and the southside says it is closed for renovations. Does anyone know what is happening/

Excellent service at the bar.  She was busy with a full house but was kind and provided excellent recommendations on a beer flight and to go with the vegan burger and add fries. Being from CA I wanted to sample local beers and was not disappointed! Great reason to venture downtown!

Still the best charbroiled oysters to be found!
Everytime I think about seafood, visions of Drago's Oysters haunt me.  I can never be there and not go to this place.  The seafood gumbo is lumpy good and the striped bass was so fresh.  Just about everything you can think of getting here from the sea is prepared perfectly.  The place is so good they opened another one on the Riverwalk in town.  This original location has been the inspiration of the Croatian family turned New Orleaneans and they have taken the discipline of Mediterranean fishery and fashioned fanciful fish fritters, fries, and fillets! Fantastiko!

Came here on the way to SB Bowl concert. Parking  is not so convenient and difficult to fine. You'll inevitably have to wait in line but the wait is so worth it. We had special, tacos, cheese enchiladas. All were delicious, including homemade corn tortillas.
Amazing onion burger special today, served up in a low key atmosphere with great service. I believe i have found my new favorite lunch spot.

They have a wide variety of tacos to choose from very creative menu and there is soda machine does not include Coke or Pepsi products which is definitely a change and a plus.   Their location is a bit off but let's just say for example they were in the heart of Manhattan this location would do over $2.5 million of business,however it's in Wesley Chapel LOL
I love Bern's! I've been going there for years. The best kept secret is sitting in the bar and ordering "off the menu"! Chicken sandwich, steak sandwich and an unbelievable burger.

Cava is an experience. Cava is delicious. Cava is Santa Barbara. This Mexican food restaurant is by far the best in Santa Barbara (and most expensive). There is not one item on the menu them doesn't taste spectacular. The food is cooked with care, and to explain what I mean by this is impossible as one must go in and see to understand what it means. The staff is extremely kind and they have valet! The restaurant is clean with a Spanish revival atmosphere. I have had no bad experiences at Cava. I recommend all to give it a try and stop on by.

A true neighborhood feel. Great food at reasonable prices. The best part is that you can compliment your meal with your own bottle of wine. They're also kid friendly which is a plus. Reservations highly recommended

Such a disgusting excuse for pasta. This place is horrible. The calzone my wife bought was terrible too. I'm gonna make it a mission to make this business go out of business. That's how disgusting the food is.

Ordered 2 tacos and Moby Dicks Bloody Mary's. Service was excellent, Daniel V was prompt and efficient. He brought our food quickly and was attentive without be overbearing and intrusive. The tacos were good and so were the Bloody Mary's but they seemed to be a bit light on the vodka...maybe that's because we are use to pouring our own drinks due to covid (and you all know we pour differently when it's for ourselves). Nice patio area, beautiful view and relaxing.

Super easy review!  We came for the 'all you can eat' Sunday buffet ~ $24.95/pp.  

I've been to one other of these and this one was done differently.  Instead of starting out with some rolls, etc., as they are prepared, ALL of your choices - made on a literal check list of categoried selections - come out  ALL at once!  Talk about alot of food and pressure!  (esp since you're charged what you don't eat!).  

We borderline overdid it!  

Our sushi was fresh and just beautiful!  I liked all but one of my choices.  Everything else was delicious.  

We both enjoyed the green tea (icy) icecream for dessert.  Very good and of course, palate cleansing.

The server was nice but not overly so nor attentive.

The decor was plain and a bit dark but I loved their large and clean fish tank w/ colorful Parrot fish and others greeting you and saying goodbye.

This was a fun experience and we're now armed with a game plan for the next visit - there w/b one!

The ONLY good thing about this place is the games and alcohol. The game technicians are extremely friendly, the rest of the staff not so much. No one seems to know answers to the questions that they should know answers to- hostess' sitting on her phone and chatting with the servers, seating customers at filthy tables. Rude attitudes when asked to move to a new table. I'll only come back for the games. Food is horrible, we ordered the pretzel dogs and chicken fingers kids meal and they came out cold with fries. I'd rather the kids eat McDonalds next time, I just couldn't believe how poor of quality this food is, so glad we skipped an adult meal. 2 stars is generous. I would give 5 stars for the games and the experience with the games alone. Best to come on half price game Wednesdays! Especially during the weekday, it is quiet and enjoyable!

Omg, I'm so happy a friend recommended this place! I've been coming to Clearwater regularly for the last 5 years and struggle to find true celiac friendly places that I can feel good about eating at.  This place is amazing! Try the "amazing coffee", its a blend of espresso,  oat milk,  and maybe a few other things.  It just opened so he hasn't named the coffee yet,  so I did!! The hubby had the albacore tuna, and loved it.  I had the Alyah's smoothie,  crazy good.  I Love it that it's all GMO free,  so many options for those who are vegan as well.  I'm in love!!

I don't take the time to review a lot of the places that I visit for dinner, but this time I just had to. Rock Bottom Brewery was recently recommended to me by an employee of the establishment, when I was in town visiting my daughter and son-in-law. The wait at all of the other restaurants in the big city was outrageous, so my wife Shelly reminded me to give Rock Bottom Brewery.

There was an open table at the bar, so we got right in. The service was fantastic. Best of all, the jalapeño pretzel sticks were just dandy. I need to take my daughter here sometime soon. Will definitely be coming back.

Finally made it inside for a bite! We loved it! The food was so good and the waitstaff and owner were so nice! We sat in the back part but there is a bigger area in the front and a couple picnic tables outside. After the first couple bites my girlfriend immediately brought up how she was anxious to come back and try some of the other menu items that she noticed. We even made a plan to get some wings for takeout one night this week since it's not far from the house! So happy that we have another great restaurant to hit up on the WestBank and especially in Westwego! I so look forward to returning! Maybe we won't be so antisocial and sit in the main dining area next time! haha 
Ps I love that it's right over the levee made for a nice little walk after getting our tummies full!

Best Chinese food in this area! Closest place that is on the level of deliciousness of Kum Fong is in Chinatown in Philly... Recommend the Singapore Rice Noodles, or the Homestyle Chicken. Wonton Soup and Egg Roll are a must and the Crab Rangoons are an excellent starter.

When I'm in the area to visit my son, we often make a trip over to Handel's.  Their ice cream is fantastic.  Nearly as good as Nuts About Ice Cream in Bethlehem, and that's saying something.  Lots of flavors, but I seem drawn to the chocolate ones, the more chocolate the better.  Prices are decent, service is fast and friendly.  Not enough seats outside, but then ice cream doesn't last long enough to sit really!

Had to update my old review to bring their review up a few notches! I recently got an awesome Groupon for Tango--spent $52 for 10-person room for 2 hours and $50 to spend on food. I reserved the room from 8-10pm on a Thursday night and we had such a good time that we stayed past midnight! The room was quite reasonable outside of the Groupon--$50 per hour and since there was at least 10 of us, we didn't spend too much extra. The cost actually got comped because we spent so much on drinks!

The actual karaoke was fun. I really like how updated the system was--we were able to find top 40 hits. Although they do a good job with the music, the actual program was not very intuitive. I did appreciate our server taking the time to give us a quick tutorial--if she hadn't we would've never figured out that we had to search artists by initials and not their name. Some people in our group came late and didn't hear the tutorial and couldn't figure out how to use the system. Other than that we were able to adjust the sound accordingly and skip songs when we realized we didn't know them as well.

Food: pretty decent. I have to say we had a difficult time spending the $50 over the course of the 2 hours because skewers and appetizers are reasonably priced. We tried a variety of skewers from rib eye, fish balls, lamb, chicken, Japanese sausage etc. I really liked the rib eye. We also had Crab Rangoon, which was pretty good. We also ordered all of their sushi rolls--Spicy Tuna, Alaskan, Crunch, Spicy Kani, and California-- (they had a special that night), which were very tasty. We ended up going over the food by $20, but that's okay because we really enjoyed it. Drinks were decently priced--this is where we spent a lot of our money on.

The outside room seemed pretty packed on a Thursday evening, so people must have been really enjoying themselves in the main room. Overall, I'm quite pleased with my latest experience here. It's a big step up from the last time I've visited!

Very good and consistent food truck on campus. I used to get their Mocking burger, but since going vegetarian I've switched to the Portobello burger and man, is it good! Tots are another good thing here, and I've had their cheese fries too. Both delicious and definitely enough to share!

I am from southern Illinois and every chance I get, I stop by Legrands for a "Jackie's Special ".  The highlight of this sandwich is the thousand island dressing but the delicious pickles are the star.

Let it be known that I liked the previous tenant of this corner, Rothschild's Antiques.  They were chock full of weird goodies and taxidermied animals, but you can't eat a giant Kudu...

What you can eat are tacos.  I really enjoyed a leisurely lunch at Gringo.  The space is bright and airy and I like the blue and yellow color scheme and lights over the bar.  You can bring your doggies if you sit outside, so naturally, I took a table near the window I could spy on them.

The salsa that comes with the complimentary chips is great and has a really nice flavor.  The chips were good as well.

I tried the pescado (fried), brisket, and pastor tacos.  Maybe these aren't the cheap and authentic tacos I can get just about anywhere in Chicago, but I also wasn't expecting that.  My companion tried the squash and mushroom tacos and the Gringo salad (he got a lunch special) which was very tasty.  

We washed this down with a little afternoon margarita action.  I also had the paloma.  Beer list was a little heavy on the Mexican style brews for my taste, but duh, that's no surprise and just a personal preference.  They have other stuff too.  

I'll totally be back next time I'm in town.

LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS PLACE!!!! I'm very lucky because I live right down the street from RIM and can go there anytime I want. Rene is awesome and makes the best chocolate and coffee around. If you like your coffee watered down, burnt, flavorless, and hidden under syrups and powders then go somewhere else. This man is a artiest and connoisseur of the coco and coffee beans. Yes the prices aren't dirt cheap but for the quality and experience of the ingredients and Rene it's worth every penny. Anyone who has a bad word about the place has been brought up on Starbucks and doesn't know quality when they taste it.

This could really by a special place.  It has all the potential in the world.  However, our experience on Saturday afternoon was a bit of a let down.

We were excited to see we could sit outside and take in the fresh air after attending a Spring Training baseball game.  An easy menu to figure out, decent seating, and some creative drinks.

The young man who guided us to our seat liked his job.  He was happy and cheerful and singing along to the tunes on the radio.  It was nice to see.  However, we ended up with a young lady server who hated her job.  This made our experience less than positive and ended up costing the business money.

As she came over to greet us, there were clouds of weed smoke that was coming from somewhere.  We all kind of laughed.  But she stated that "I have smelled that all day and I have a huge headache!"   Ok, fine but please do not take it out on us.

The food we ordered was good.  An elderly lady (owner?) came by to check on everyone and she was friendly and fantastic.  Our young waitress would return to the table only to give us our final tab.  We each had one drink.  We had planned to stick around for a few but we were rushed out by her.  There was no shortage of seating.  She just used no common sense and rushed us out with the check.  She ended up costing herself money from a less than normal tip, and the business money for not serving more drinks.

This place could be special.  But the quality of the service by the waitress just made it another average experience.

This  is the best place to eat in Oro valley. Always great food and service. If you have any issues they fix it immediately. Food is local and very tasty. I love the selection of beers and my wife loves the wine. 
Best place for happy hour too. Great Sunday brunch. Don't wait just go there and try it!

We came here for a bachelorette party and it was fantastic! Our waiter was incredibly knowledgable about the menu and had a great personality. We had a group of ten and everyone's meal was just as he described and very tasty. I would come back here in a heartbeat! I had the shrimp & grits- loved them. Do yourself a favor and go here!!

Second visit to New Orleans, second visit to this place.  Conveniently located near the River Center Mall, this place has not disappointed.  Ice cold beer, great local drinks (for those adventurous types) and the food is great.  Had the Gator Nest as an App, gator and crab in a hush puppy ball, served over fries with a great Remoulade sauce.  For the main course my wife and I split the Bourbon Street Combo tasty combination of snow crabs, shrimp, sausage, potato and corn.  Great seasoning on everything with spices and herbs.  Served with a side of drawn butter and a tangy cocktail sauce for dipping.  Ravane was our server and she did a fantastic job.  Very attentive and pleasant, made sure we were taken care of.  Awesome job Ravane.
I love Ooka! Great sushi, great hibachi. They give lots of food and all of the chefs are very entertaining. Beautiful decor and lovely restaurant overall.

Incredible ribs with an even more incredible server, Melissa is great!!! She is always a pleasure to see and really amplified the experience. The rib dinner is a wonderful deal, I highly recommend it.
Delicately beautiful thai cuisine. Reliably authentic thai with a local twist. Ask for seafood availability. Order a few extra soups.
Great place for BBQ.  Meats are very good and great selection of tasty sides.  Don't leave without trying the carmelitta bar for dessert.  Best ever!

I can totally picture this in NYC.

Sleeping with Jannus Landing in the heart of Downtown St. Pete, this tiny pizzeria can be easily overlooked if not for the constant vigilance of people eating at its counter and outside tables as well as a sign boasting a 4.99 lunch special (two slices and a drink). 

THE PIZZA? The smell inside is pure pizza (also serves calzones, sandwiches, salads) with toppings costing extra. No need-- the cheese alone is a transubstantiation of a pizza god on earth. My big slices always bleed oil and pizza juices. The cheese melts in your mouth and isn't tough to chew. Although very thin, the crust is crispy-- but not to the point of splintering your lips. Pepperoni-- no doubt good. Another Joey Brooklyn's favorite topping-- roma tomato and basil-- the basil smell cut through the sauce and added subtle layers of flavor, but the tomato got lost in flavors and only added to texture.

For what you pay, that's a big delicious slice (especially when you consider the Downtown St. Pete lunch options). The workers ooze friendliness, smiles and are eager to help. Another mild complaint was wondering why my arm was sticking to the counter.

Grandma's Cookin'
Worth the slight higher price good portions to.  It's always busy on the weekends/Sunday

This used to be one of my favorite places to visit when I come out to Nashville. I waited over 20 min for breakfast - poached eggs, turkey sausage, fruit and biscuit. The sausage was cold but was most concerning is the lack of care/service by most of the team. When I mentioned anything about the time for food the team seemed bothered by it. Which is why I did not mention anything else.

Best Pho and Bun I have ever had! Tried so many spots but this is the number 1. Not only is the food amazing, but the service is great as well. The staff is very friendly and helpful!! I would definitely come back over and over again! I wish I lived in the area cause this place is a gem!

Grilled mushrooms? Not so. Soggy flavorless mushrooms from a jar or can ruined rather than enhanced the burger and made the bun so soggy it fell apart. The burger itself seems adequate but nothing to rave about at $5 for the "little burger". Fries are tasty with the skin on - hot and fresh. Little burger, little fries, small tea -$10 was too much for this meal that lacked anything to get excited about. Love the rock and roll playing overhead but the volume is so loud it makes conversing impossible without yelling. Staff seemed friendly and efficient.

My wife and I ate here, found the food and drinks to be below average, and subsequently spent the night with acute belly ache, which was not a very pleasant experience at all. We did have good service from our waiter, however. I noticed  also other Yelpers reporting sickness after eating at this restaurant. The manager swears that the cause of our sickness was not his restaurant even though it does seem like a big coincidence to me that we got sick right after eating there. 

Afterwards, the manager offered to comp us on drinks, which I thought was nice of him, although we still remain apprehensive about eating there again so are quite unlikely to return. To be fair to this restaurant, others might very well have a different experience, but our experience was quite poor. For health's sake and for their future patrons, I do hope that I can encourage them to double check hygiene standards in their kitchen.
This place has the best drinks in town - by far! I had a martini and a blueberry hill, again it doesn't even compare to other bars in Nola. And by the way Sadie (bartender) is the best.
Great food, great prices and best biscuits and gravy in Holy Cross.  Angie's list campus restaurant now open to the public.

I've been here a total of three times and thought the food was OK if anything. I've tried their burger and it wasn't that good. I've then tried their breakfast food and that was OK. However, Last night I ordered a crispy filet sandwich (I know... why order that at a diner) and it was pretty bad. The fish was very thin and tasted like its been frozen for a long time. Their service isn't bad on week nights when the college kids aren't around but don't expect a lot during the weekends. Overall my experience here is sub par and would only come back if I was starving and had no where to go during the middle of the night.

This place was disgusting and I honestly don't know why it's open other than the fact that there aren't many bars in Doylestown. It was filthy, trash and food all on the ground and dark because the lights didn't work. The tables were so close together I felt like I was on a date with the people next to me. Our waitress was bad. I don't complain about waitresses because their job is tough but she didn't remember anything and she wore these nasty furry gloves, God only knew how many germs those things carried and they were on our plates. The food was good,just good, and the only saving grace, however there was limited options and everything came with weird chips. This was a one stop spot for me for a friend's birthday and needless to say I won't be going back.

1st visit = 3 stars, but 2nd visit = 4 stars. Turkey burger both times, so take this review with a grain of salt if you think I'm weird for not getting beef.

Burgers: "Burnt cheese" was a real winner, although I didn't realize they'd put mayo on it by default. Ugh. Definitely enjoyed it a lot more than my Sriracha egg special that I had on the initial visit. Wish the burger was just a bit thicker, a tiny complaint that was shared by a person in my party who got the cow burger.

Sides: Sweet potato tater tots were disappointing! Not crunchy enough by any stretch of the imagination. Waffle fries were quite excellent, however - crispy and seasoned perfectly. Just about as good as waffle fries get.

In summary, go burnt cheese + waffle fries ... it's a killer combination.

This is my second concert at The Ryman. And any chance you get to see and artist you like...DO IT! 

I love shows at the Ryman because the venue is small and intimate. There aren't really bad seats in the house. The artists that typically perform here aren't huge on lights, smoke, and/or pyro. Just stripped down performances with the vocalist and his/her band. The Ryman will always be a Nashville staple and you have a chance to make it, you'll definitely see why it belongs in Music City.
Awesome happy hour with drink and food specials. Service was on point. Very clean. Great vegan options. Brussels sprouts taco is a must have and blood red margarita was delicious.
The service was amazing! Charles was great! The lettuce wraps are my favorite. Not so impressed with the pad thai but that's okay, the crispy honey shrimp was so good!!

Just a great time overall.  The food was incredible--the waitress sold me on the Big Time Booze Burger (the whiskey sauce just killed me) and the drinks were fairly priced, especially considering how strong the Rum Runners were (notice the plural).  Additionally, the waitstaff was accommodating to a bunch of twenty-somethings, and let us sit there for about five hours (we ate lunch and then sat and talked for about an hour, then drank for another three).

Really laid back, and the music, though kind of cheesy (one-man guitar covers), wasn't so bad once you drank enough :)

This place is awesome. A true taco stand. The meats are amazing and you can ask for a sample of anything you are curious about. One of the main guys is kinda awkward but he's really nice. The Horachata is yummy. 
They don't use nasty wilted lettuce, they use cabbage. It is SOOO much better, but just be aware and read the menu so you don't get mad about it. 

Order ahead if you need it in a hurry because they cook it by the order instead of keeping it nasty under the heat lamp.

I placed an online order at 6:50  got there a little bit early before my order was supposed to be ready at 7:15 (gladly I did). When I get there they are closed. So I ask one of the employees about my order and they start saying that they close at 7. I literally have to put an attitude on to get my food and they didn't even want to give me my money back. Literally they told just this one time they were going to make an exception for me. NOT MY FAULT you all are taking online orders and don't say you close at 7 on  your website. BBQ was cold and not even good
Fantastic, authentic curry. Absolutely delicious and just the right amount of spice. Can't wait to come back.

Spicy pork bowl no flavor, only salt! And just little bit food. Some of the chips are not cook good. Queso is very bland and not worth it! I don't think I will go there ever again , QDOBA is much better!

Horrible!!!  Staying in the Indy area for the weekend.  Wanted a delivery by good pizza place.  Hotel staff recommended Big Kahuna's because their flyer was on the desk.  Restaurant was 5.2 miles from the hotel.  Since we aren't in the city, 5.2 miles seems to be a reasonable distance.  It's right off the expressway.  One hour after we ordered I called to see where our food was.  The manager said they were just really busy but my food was being cooked.  Would not give me an estimated delivery time.  I said I could come pick it up, but she said that would not speed things up. My food was delivered 90 minutes after it was ordered.  Stromboli was some type of cold mystery meat.  Soggy fries.  Cold cheese sticks and pizza.  I understand the fries, but thre rest...  When I talked to an assistant manager, she couldn't understand why we would order from a place "so far away".  10 minutes (Mapquest) does not seem that far.  She did not offer discount or refund.  Understand why they are open until 4 am.  Looking for the drunk crowd that doesn't care.

I got the crab cakes and the fried shrimp platter. Both were amazing. The shrimp platter came with hush puppies and french fries. It was A LOT of food.   I highly recommend this place. Everything was so good.

Not sure how this place got 4 1/2 stars.  Our worst meal in NOLA and the most expensive.  So disappointing.  Everything was bland and basic.  Starting with the cheese bread, something my 15 year old would have made.  The soup was bland.  The Eacargot was all bread and mushroom and no escargot.  The duck and the filet tasted like pre-made cruise ship food.  The bread pudding and cheese cake didn't even reach frozen grocery store quality.  Worst part of the whole experience is that we wasted one of our meal times in NOLA on this.  Tip, stay away from Bourbon Street when wanting a quality meal.

This BYOB NEVER disappoints me and it just seems  to get better. It has a wonderful ambience and is nicely decorated. The owner and some of the staff are from Turkey so the food is very authentic. The lamb chops are delicious. I have tried several items from  the menu and always enjoy the food. The kabobs are awesome. This is a great date night and also wonderful for a group of people. The appetizers are excellent for sharing. Now on Fridays & Saturdays they have a beautiful woman who dresses in a traditional Turkish costume and serves a wonderful tea from an ornate pitcher. The desserts are excellent I highly recommend the kunefe. Kunefe is a syrup soaked cheese pastry with shredded phyllo dough. It's basically an extra delicious baklava. There is a small private dining area in the back that may seat 15 - 20 people. Not exactly sure of the amount of people it will seat but it has an adorable straw/thatched roof.

Return trip to The Fountain on Locust converts this once cynical diner into an admirer. 
This time I went on a weekday, during the lunch hour. There was no wait for the table and the server, Ann I believe, was there immediately to give me a menu and take a drink order -- a sugar free black cherry phosphate, which was very good and thirst-quenching. I ordered their version of a grilled chesse -- there's comes with hunks of apple in amidst the melted cheese. On the side a Stutz Salad, with warm, soft goat cheese. 
All around a good meal, but not great hence four stars not five, in a beautiful restaurant that was brimming with people who all appeared to be enjoying themselves.
The piece de la resistance was my view of their emblematic fountain out front festooned with encircling greenery and bursting with inviting vitality. 
From the outside, once your meal is done, take a moment to stand on the sidewalk and take a backward glance at the simply stunning facade of The Fountain on Locust. 
More like an Oasis on Locust. 
Highly recommended.

AMAZING! Fast service and great ramen. My boyfriend and I decided to check them out last Saturday. We both got the tonkotsu ramen and were not disappointed. The noodles has a nice bite to them and the broth had lots of flavor. And don't even get me started on that pork belly.... The place is small and close quarters as they have community tables. They also have seating available right at the ramen bar. It can get quite loud, but as long as you are aware of these things walking in you'll have a good time.

The food taste fine but for the price point (higher than average) it should be awesome. I would rather drive to Craft Street Kitchen in Oldsmar. For example, Mother's flatbreads are about half the size of Craft Street's and Craft Street actually has more flavorful flatbreads. I think we also got a sandwich, but it wasn't memorable.
Jill was a great server! Quick service, very knowledgeable and kind. Would love to have her every time I came. Great food, too!

If you are looking for stale nachos and boiled "chicken", you have found the perfect place. We ordered the smoked chicken nachos and was given a plate of disappointment. I'm pretty sure the chicken came out of a can. It was cold and watery.

One of the better Pho spots in the area, extensive menu that includes pho, rice platters, appetizers, vermicelli etc. The food was pretty good, the service friendly and the atmosphere was clean and modern. We'll definitely be back.

Ok for a quick bite. Nothing special about the food.  A bit pricey for what you get. The anbiance is nice, with a large patio and seating area.  When it gets too hot they have ample indoor seating.  Seems to be a very popular place since the parking lot is always packed.  I personally didn't find the menu or the food to be that impressive.
Always good food, any hour of the day. Fast service, seated quickly, priced well.  Out of all the diners in Hamilton, this is the best one by far.

Disappointed.  

The food is good.  The service is poor.  Monday night during the All Star break, the Home Run derby is on tv, I figure Joe Buck's might be a pretty decent place to eat and watch some baseball festivities.  Wow, was I wrong!  This place is dead!

The bartender took my order, offered me another beverage only once during 2 hours, I had to flag him down for a 3rd drink.  My food was delivered by a cook, so its likely it sat in the window for a few minutes before being delivered.  I also observed other tables flag him down not only for placing orders but for another order of drinks or refills.  Seriously, maybe 3 tables, 6 people total.  

This is why Joe Bucks is dead on a Monday night during the All Star break.  The service is poor!  This is a celebrity sports bar, I'm a baseball fan, at least pretend to want my money.  Also, sometime around 9:15 the phone at the hospo stand rang for a good 3-4 minutes, no one, including the bartender and a server, bothered to answer it.  

I really wanted to like this place more than I did, but the service completely killed my experience.

I visited this place two times. The food is average but a really great beer selection. It is selfi service for food an drinks.
You really get a beer from all over the world. Also some German beer specials e.g. Bamberger "Schlenkerla" (smoky and taste like a bacon)

We love Mr. B's! After our fifth visit it's safe to say this is one of our absolute favorites! From the waitstaff to ambience to food, it's wonderful! It's upscale but the dress code is only restricted to no sleeveless shirts for men. There are a lot of dining options in New Orleans but we always choose to come back to Mr. B's!

Hubby and I ate dinner here dinner. The restaurant is located in the Opal Sands Resort (2nd floor). These were the best scallops I ever had. Best to make a reservation because we noticed several waiting for seating after 7pm. Our Yelp reservation was at 6:30 (no wait).

Well for starters my apologies for not taking any pictures. But I can do nothing but brag about this place. We were seated right away and drink orders were taken. The waiter asked if we had ever been there before and when we told him no he gave us many opinions of the different foods and drinks.

 We placed our order and food was prepared to our liking and quickly.  Our drinks never were empty and we were checked on often.

We definitely will be returning to Charleston's.

What can I say, back again and sat at the bar again and amazing!!! This is my place STL!! Wow! Great food paired with a great caring staff that always knows us and amazing food! They always know what is great as they eat the food! Ask... they are amazing!!! Thanks all for the usual amazing service at the bar... Carmen u are a star and an amazing sommelier with incredible taste! 
I could walk in and have u order the entire meal/drinks and your famous manhattan !! Wow! The best in STL!!! Thanks Farmhaus!

I've been here a few times and was pretty satisfied but I won't be returning after my last visit.
My friend and I went around 6 on a weekend night and there was one other couple in the restaurant. Our host was pleasant and attentive for about the first 5-10 minutes. 
We ordered the bleu chip appetizer and as always, it was delicious. While we were waiting for our entree the staff were either having very loud and inappropriate personal conversations across the bar and dining area, or they disappeared completely. 

We split a seafood entree (we asked the waiter if that was okay when ordering and were told yes), it comes to the table on one plate and he brings us another empty one and says, "It's pretty messy so I figured you guys could just split it up  yourselves." ...how does this make sense? Whatever, we split it up and there were shells throughout the entire dish. 

We wanted dessert but didn't bother staying. Between the appetizer, split entree, and glass of wine our meal was about $45, and for that kind of service it was absolutely not worth it.
We have always had the best service and food regardless of the location.   Highly recommend the salmon BLT, Kale salad, Mediterranean platter, wings, etc.  It is just a great go-to!
I love coming hear one of my favorite places to come I would say I come there every week just to buy boba the workers are very nice and respectful and make sure everything is sanatized

You feel the old warm charm as you enter this fine establishment.  An old converted Victorian house, now home to a delicious lunch and dinner spot. Filled with antique character expect fresh oysters, delicious sandwiches (like the roast beef) and or the steak salad. Lunch will run you $15-$20, but seeing a menu that doesn't have the word "cheese steak" on it sometimes is a welcome change.
Best biscuits we have ever had.  Food was definitely worth the wait. Real friendly atmosphere.  Ask for Owen the waiter,  he will treat you like family.

I ordered the Farmers Market personal pizza as my birthday entree one night for pick up one night when my wife and I didn't want to cook. It was a great choice full of veggies, delicious cheeses, and a crispy butter bread. We were almost full even though we shared the pizza. I could see myself ordering this again if I ever find myself at an Uno for dinner again. The service for pickup could be a little better so I'd have to say 3 stars overall.

The service was bad, ordered a appetizer and the server brought the salads out first, spoiled a romantic evening and when she brought the appetizers she threw it on the table. The food was OKay, Won't be back to the one in Boise
Oyster's both ways! The Chargrilled Oysters come with fresh French bread so you can soak up all of that buttery goodness and Oysters on the half shell are equally as yummy.

This was a late night option after work.  We were seated right away after arriving around 10pm.  I wanted a cheeseburger but not fast food.  I've been a big fan of the Jack Daniels menu options for awhile.  We also had a $5 coupon from the Discover Indy book.  So our 2 Jack Daniels entrees with water (I gave up soda months ago) came to $20 before tip.  Not a bad price for a sit down place.  Quality & service were fine, no issues.  Satisfying meal & relaxing after the long workday.

Walked in to eat onThursday night at 530.   Sat in the restaurant with 3 other groups and never had a waitress for 15 minutes come to the table, so we walked out sitting in the front of the restaurant by the two hostesses standing there


Done

4/5 go ahead and try it on a sunday night.

so i almost never ever walk into anything inside a hotel in nola. it's just like *crickets* as an option.

but a colleague was in town from DC, and his newly networked friend told us about ms. germaine on sunday evenings. well my golly, it is a treat. she is so good, it brings to life a quality of new orleans (albeit staged) that really does feel like a good time. dooo doo dooooo do ba ba ba pa pa shhhh haaa zing! she'll do a set every hour or so, so just if you come and they're not on stage or she's midway, stick around for another round. the drinks are a little pricier by nola standard, but with her show it' worth it.

A Wonderful Experience, but you should come with a healthy appetite because you will definitely Leave feeling very full!  Great wait staff, Great Food, however this is one of the noisiest restaurants in St. Louis/St. Charles.  The restaurant is an open-air type and it is always packed with people, parties, etc.  Definitely a Happening Place in West County, but again, come Hungry and you'll leave Happy :-)  Giving four stars only because of the noise.
Packed and loud, but the patio is it's wonderfully redeeming quality.

It's ok. Party of 10 people . 8 adults 1 baby 11 months old and a 4 years old girl. Company party on February 25 2018 , This place the host try to charge for baby 11 months old as a kid meal !!! Really ? if you don't mind the service on top of 20% charged automatically On your tickets and  you Get charged on your second mimosa.!!!! OYSTERSCATCHER   ITS WAYYYY SO MUCH BETTER QUALITY SERVICE AND FOOD . Well  I guess you get what you pay for!!!

This place is remodeled with new owners who truly care about the quality and service. They listen and make changes where needed, including finding the right fit for staff/cooks. They have worked thru the new restaurant struggles very well and really put out the best breakfast and lunch from a small local privately owned establishment. Everything we have tried has been fantastic. Nice to find a place that cares about what they do and their customers.

I've lived right by here for many months and I can't believe I never went until today. We got the grilled cheese, chicken & Mac + cheese, biscuit with jam, and some desserts to go and everything was phenomenal. The biscuit has to be one of the best I've ever had, and the grilled cheese was delicious. The service here was also so quick and upbeat. Will definitely be going back regularly!!

This place is amazing! The owner and staff are so nice and helpful. My husband and I were doing our own Philly "cheesesteak" tour and LOVE the one here. We were telling the owner how much we liked the jalapeño jam and he sent us home with a container of it! I really can't wait to go back and eat here again.

Love this place!  Always friendly and prompt!!! No waiting an hour for your check.  Love Taco Tuesday! The other day I literally order 50 right before they closed, and the owner and chef were totally cool about it!! How many place would do that?!

I recently went to Mikimoto for the first time with a friend the other day and I am so glad I have discovered this place. I had an amazing experience so I decided to order delivery from them partially to see if they maintain the standards they have in their restaurant for delivery orders and partially because I am addicted to sushi.

Like I have said in many of my reviews, I am a tuna freak. I ordered the spicy tuna roll, the (plain) tuna roll, and the snow crab roll without asparagus. Everything looked and tasted amazing.

The box was nicely organized and the rolls were well formed. I like to put any delivery sushi I order in the fridge for 20 - 30 minutes before I eat it so I can be sure it will be on the cooler side. Not saying that is necessary, it's just something I always have done. After that I tried my fist roll and it was amazing, sooo delicious. They also gave me at least 6 or 7 soy sauces even though when I eat sushi at home I use my own soy sauce. Now I have a bunch in my kitchen drawer in case I ever run out or need some to go for some reason.

I respect this place even more because they are consistent regardless of whether you are dining in or getting delivery. I have to say there are other sushi places in New Orleans that have failed this basic test that I used to like a lot.

If you are a sushi fan and haven't tried Mikimoto yet I recommend you do.
