We stopped in for Sunday morning breakfast on a beautiful morning. We were promptly seated by the window. We ordered coffee the Benedict poor boy sandwich the omelet sandwich. Our orders were typed in to a phone/tablet (not sure which) by our waitress and were quickly brought to the table. The poor boy eggs Benedict sandwich was delightful. The eggs were perfectly poached and the Hollandaise and Ham were present in perfect amounts. The staff was very friendly and answered any questions we had. This was definitely one of the best meals we had in New Orleans!

Wonderful fabulous place to eat! The food was wonderful and the service superb! Absolutely love taking to the family and meeting daughters and wife. If you want a new taste of Thai please check this place out. You won't be disappointed from the appetizers to the fried banana dessert amazing!! Our more favorite Thai place!
Lived down the street from May's for the past year and I will definitely miss this place.  Love having a place where you walk in and people know your name and your usual hoagie order.

Why would you go to dunk when you have Fray's!? The donuts are better, the coffee is better, and the service is 10x better. It's low key but not gross like some DD's. I love their egg and cheese on a plain bagel and sometimes I'll spring for a chocolate cake donut. If you haven't been you need to!

Plates are best to share so order a lot of medium plates to try everything! 

Unique flavors, and fun spin on Asian classics!

Solid home style diner with good food, great prices and exceptionally friendly service. I had eggs over easy, bacon, Cajun potatoes, and two pancakes plus a milk and an iced chocolate latte. My boyfriend had pancakes and sausage with coffee and milk. No complaints here. If you wanna eat where the locals do and do it on the cheap, this place is for you.

Spectacular food. A little out of my usual lunch but definitely  a terrific place to go. The tea was like a milkshake and the soup definitely  hit the spot. If you care to experiment with out of the ordinary flavors. This is the spot.
Excited that Char is open in Nashville . We went tonight for the opening . It was Awesome . Can't wait to go back !

I was trying to find a decent Italian hoagie. This wasn't it. What I got was several pounds of cheap cooked ham along worth questionable cheese and salami (looked like they might have been left out all day), questionable looking Banana peppers, onions, so little lettuce I wasn't even sure they put any on it.  The sheer amount of ham was just overwhelming and disgusting.  I don't usually leave reviews. Ur I picked this place because of the other reviews and they don't really reflect the quality of this place at all. (Maybe the fries chicken is really good and fresh, I can't speak to that)

I've been going to this restaurant since opening and their service has improved quite significantly. The ramen is good and the noodles weren't clumped like last time. The service is pretty quick now. The only downside is that it is really pricey but other than that this is a good ramen shop. I recommend Tonkatsu Red Ramen and Takoyaki.
This location runs hot and cold. Sometimes they nail it, sometimes they fail  spectacularly. Today was a fail. No lettuce, tomato or Mayo on a deluxe quarter pounder meal.

Where do I even begin? How about $30 for 4 tacos.. and some chips and salsa. My husband ordered steak tacos and the steak was still frozen. Sub par food for a high price. My chicken taco wasn't bad and the salsa had a good flavor but overall we had a bad experience. We actually went to Taco Bell after we left and ate great tacos for $7.
Very disappointing. Food was awful and manager was beyond rude. Wish I could give zero stars.

I was going to start this with giving a 4 star review only because of the very high pricing on the menu, but I think the atmosphere and customer service I've personally received made it worth it. They have an amazing clear soup and small salad with a good dressing to get you started, the saki is great, and the filet mignon I think is incredible. No complaints at all, and the show they put on for you when you go is amazing. My 5 year old baby sister begs to go nearly every single day. I'll always go back as long as it stays the way it is.
Friendly staff. Good service . Average food. Country fried steak and eggs and spinach a feta flatbread. A little different than standard breakfast fare.

Finally decided to try this place for dinner after reading all the buzz. Went on a Thursday night as Happy Hour was winding down. The bar was packed. It's tiny so even 7 or 8 people at the bar will make it seem crowded. 

We skipped the bar and went right to our table for dinner. Started with a big bowl of mussels. We considered ordering two apps but our waitress told us the mussels would fill us up, especially with the bread for dipping. She was right. I can't remember which variety of mussels we had but the broth was delicious. 

For our main courses, we had read about the skate wing being the popular dish so we ordered that and also ordered the monkfish. The skate wing did not disappoint. The ultra-cheesey parmesean sauce packed it with so much flavor. Definitely worth the buzz. The monkfish topped with chorizo had a bit of a southern flavor. It was great. 

We both really enjoyed this place. It has a neighborhood feel to it. Can't wait to go back and take advantage of the happy hour deals.

Customer service was really good.. 
but the chocolate raspberry cake was too sweet and creamy that you can't even finish a small size of it.. it is good but not what I am expecting for an austrian desserts. . But will definitely try another cake thou..

Every time we come to New Orleans, we make sure we come to the Italian Barrel.  From the minute you enter the door, Joshua Talley makes you feel like a special guest ensuring you get the table you wanted and a great waitstaff.  The atmosphere is not quite as intimate as one would like but the food definitely makes up for it!  Please try the crabmeat salad which is absolutely the best salad j have ever had! (Share it because portions here are huge.) Enjoy!!

This is a great restaurant to know about. The other fans have it right--great late night sushi. And the tee shirts are cool to sport if you are a fan. One great appetizer to order that will surprise you with its deliciousness is the EGGPLANT MISO YAKI. It's a like a succulent eggplant donut. The sauce on it is incredible. I've ordered it at dinner with folks who are not even eggplant fans and they almost fall over in their chairs over how good it is. Don't die wondering--give it a try!!

I've always loved Bojangles chicken, accuracy and speed of service. Not sure what happened today though.  35 mins in the drive-through with only 2 cars ahead of me, received dried up, cold fries, 3 pcs chicken instead of 4 and received the wrong drink

I wanted to experience a great beignet & I got to.
Im telling you, the couple of beignets I've had in other parts if the US were, trust me #GUTBOMBS. As in, I don't need to eat a deep fried DOUGH BLOB for the extra carbs. I imagined a little chew to the crust & LIGHT & fluffy inside & bamm- DONE.
(Oh, and I'm glad we didn't end up getting them at Café du Monde bcs, as others have confirmed, their's are meh.]
These were JUST THE TICKET the night before we leave.
Thanks Beignet Café, I'm 5 lbs heavier & it's all your fault!

I got the blueberry croissant and the spinach quiche. They both were tasty but I would've liked if they didn't just microwave the quiche and if they toasted the croissant instead of leaving it cold. There was a nice little courtyard outside, but it really only had a skylight. I did enjoy the food, it just could've been better served.
Amazing food and Service. Loved every moment. The Oso Busso was so amazing. Will come back and recommend to everyone

Cool little specialty grocery store.  If you're looking for something organic, or something homemade from a mom and pop shop you'll probably find it here.  The bakery is excellent, the stir fry bar is cool, and beer and wine selection is very ecletic.  Here's the kicker, it's not crazy expensive either.  It only get 3 stars for it's lack of variety and selection, but like I said "specialty grocer,"
What a rip off! Just got the $12 menu from Nathan's. Undercooked fries, small drink and two of the smallest corn dogs I have ever seen!

This place has officially taken over as best pizza on St. Pete Beach! We have quite a few great pizza places here on SPB but this place is amazing. Friendly and courteous staff. COVID-19 happened just as this place was opening but they are still making it...they are that good and so glad they are here. 

Kathleen
Loved it support Black business great prices and food can't beat it  I had the hot chicken with bang bang shrimp one ..definitely coming back

This is exactly how we wanted our Chinese food to taste.  Everything was delicious! The hot and sour soup had the perfect taste and the crab rangoon were great.  Our main courses, beef lo mein and cashew chicken, were also delicious.  We told our friends about this restaurant and they can't stay away! They also have the friendliest staff you will meet! We love it!

This is honestly the worst Olive Garden I have ever been too. It was awful. On a 1-10 it was a -10. The time it took to make my food was 2 hours! I ordered shrimp pasta and they forgot the shrimp. Then I asked for the shrimp and they brought it 20 minutes later and it was cold and tasted absolutely terrible. The actual pasta was very mediocre making this Olive Garden trip a waste of my time. To top it off the waiters were very inconsiderate and slow to bring you what you needed.  SO DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND DO NOT COME TO THIS OLIVE GARDEN. IT IS SO BAD!


Ok this is another victim of this awful experience. It was the worst restaurant I've ever been two. I absolutely hate Olive Garden. My pasta was dry and trash. The service was booty and they were rude. I'm never going back. I hope u look at this and never go back to Olive Garden.
Wanted something healthy for lunch, we happen to stumble on this place! Very clean, very fresh! We loved it we will definitely be back!

This is one of my favorite places to eat, the Zingers are really good although they usually need extra sauce on the side. One problem I have is almost every time I come here I order French onion soup because I love French onion soup, but sometimes it is way too salty.

I'm saying goodbye to Viva and will never come back again. The customer service is unfriendly and slow. This last trip, the gal at the counter overcharged me. When I told her what the price was on the their sign, she told me that they had increased their prices recently. It took a long time to get my food; when I started eating, I found a large, sharp piece of plastic in my taco (see my photo). There are too many taco/burrito places around town to have to resort to coming here. I strongly recommend going elsewhere.

If I could give this place 10 stars, I would! Fantastic location on the water. We walked over from the Marriott on water street for dinner. We were a bit early for the reservation so we went over to the outside bar and it was still happy hour with $5 drinks, including Tito's! For dinner, we all had fish and sushi. I had the macadamia crusted swordfish and it was fantastic! We sat outside under a cabana with a ceiling fan to enjoy the waterside view. Kids liked that there is a gelato shop next to the restaurant. Great place to dine with the family. Lovely service staff.
The atmosphere at this restaurant was phenomenal and the food was awesome. Serving staff was attentive without hovering and my drink was never empty. A true Chinese meal!!
soooo good! prices are reasonable. customer service was great. very clean. and a good happy hour deal, 4p to close daily

The line for dinner is 45 minutes wait. Fortunately they are only one block away from the Canal Street where we can wait and watch the parade. They will assign you a buzzer. And the buzzer range is about 1 block. 

This restaurant is recommended by our taxi driver. He has indicated the local love this place. Tonight we have order Crawfish étouffée and Seafood combo. The seafood combo is the fried shrimp, catfish and oyster. The coating is Louisiana bread coating with dry coat. The cat fish and the oyster is killer in this dish. The cat fish is fresh that do not smell fishy. The fish is soft and tender. The oyster in New Orleans is different and soft after fried. The chef did a very good job. Normal fried oyster is a bit rubbery but the chef here make it almost like raw oyster soft. 

The pre-meal items came with the broil potatoes. The potatoes are inch in diameter. They broiled and coated with spicy salt spice that I could not guess what spice. It is good. The crawfish came with salad with sweet vinaigrette dressing. A bit sweet for me but is good. 

The Crawfish étouffée is one of the New Orleans must try item other than Gumbo and Jambalaya. This is a gumbo soup base material with rice and crawfish. This crawfish is broil alive and the shell is removed. The crawfish then added to the soup base with rice. The dish has more than 30 crawfish tail. This is a good dish.

This is by far the worst service ever.my sister's and I wanted to enjoy lunch together. I ordered the fish tacos and my sisters ordered the hot wings and voodoo pasta. All of it came out luke warm .I informed one of the managers. She simply said sorry about that.the kitchen manager came out,we told him what happen to our food and he offered us to take some thing home,we declined and he said well let me know if you wanted something .after talking to me sisters we decided to get chocolate cake.then kitchen manager came out aggressive and said "I thought you said you didn't want anything else ". We decided to leave and will never recommend this place for food.dont waste your time

Absolutely love the space, love the poutine with the fried egg on top I had for lunch here. Planning to bring some out of town friends in here for drinks next weekend. 

Parking around the area, not great.

Definitely a great place for tourists. The decor and colonial feel is a perfect to the Old City neigbhorhood. 

After a few years of working in the neighborhood, I finally got to check this place out for Restaurant week with some co-workers.  The waitor was a little too serious for my liking- I don't know if he was just playing the part ( he was decked out in colonial get-up) or if he was just having a bad day. The food was ok- nothing special or making me want to rush back, especially for the price I do like how the menu relates to the time period for the most part. The drink menu does as well. 

I would take out of towners back here for sure but I'm in no rush to get back there myself.
Wait is a little long but it is well worth it...I recommend calling ahead with your order if you don't want to have a long wait...

Great ambiance. Cheese plate is good. Scallops small plate is awesome!! Pork belly is dry and very disappointing.  Our server disappeared and we had to actually get up and find someone so we could pay our bill and leave.  That was disappointing.

Nice location by the water. Came at around 2pm and the bar area is full on a Tuesday. The seafood bisque is good though it doesn't have chunks of seafood which I prefer. Wings are tasty and well bathed with sauce, yum!!! Service is good.

If you're looking for good brews and American food, look no further! The menu has a host of burgers and salads that are both delicious and well portioned. Pricing is not bad either. My husband has tried quite a few beers there, moderately priced, and enjoyed them a lot. There is a big selection and a good variety. And the best part is taco Wednesday! $1 tacos that taste great 5 to close. That's our new favorite date idea. 

The only downside is the size and small amount of seating. On Friday evenings, don't be surprised if there's over an hour wait. Now that there's outdoor seatin it my be less packed but it's very popular indeed!

La Fia is a cute, quaint spot in Wilmington and worth a try if you are in the area or looking for an alternative in Delaware to larger chain establishments. It seems to be busy for dinner so make a reservation if possible. 

Some unique menu options... The dates with blue cheese and pistachios were so good!  The Poached pear salad was good as well.  I would have liked to try the risotto but opted for a salad with sides instead.  Maybe next time!

We sat the bar for happy hour and crushed the $8 menu. Happy hour daily til 7pm! I've been before and loved the steaks but even bar food was amazing. Bacon cheeseburger & filet flatbread was so good!!! Plus molten lava cake! Great service servers were super nice

Okay, giving this place five stars might immediately make you think I don't have great taste. And I know, the food here really doesn't warrant this high of a ranking, but I'm taking a lot of other things into account. It isn't a fine restaurant. If you are looking for a place for a special occasion, this might not be it. But for a bite to eat and a beer, this is the spot. 

Fun decor, warm and inviting atmosphere, excellent, happy staff, and the ever-present J.P. (owner) are all plusses. The food is good, consistent, solid, with lots of choices. I really like J.P.'s chicken because I am on a special diet and it fits it, tastes delicious, and is a bargain at $11.95. It comes with a nice salad and garlic bread. My husband and I usually pick a bottle of wine off the wine wall, which is ingenious. The wine is very well priced (I think we paid $10.95 for a Grothe Chardonnay), they will re-cork and let you take home whatever you don't drink. 

However, really the reason I am giving this place five stars is the people. Let's face it, Reno is in trouble. We need to support each other, because nobody is coming to bail us out. An important way to do that is to support local businesses that give back to our community. The Pinocchios are a wonderful local family. They are the heart and soul of the Moms on the Run fundraiser for breast cancer research. They give wholeheartedly to this community;  their time, their energy, and most assuredly their money. It is because of this that we spend our money there. I understand that I vote with my dollars, and that this is the type of place that needs my vote. My money stays here in my community instead of being shared by stockholders that most-likely spend their money somewhere else. 

Thank you Pinocchio's for both providing a great eating establishment, and for giving so much to this community. I support you, too.

Now I've been going to this place for years and I remember it being delicious. It's been a couple since my last visit so I thought I'd go to the best place to get Tortilla soup in all of the county. It sucked. Actually disgusting. What is it? Toilet water, some tortilla, and a couple pieces of chicken? So on top of that, I got their Baja Style shrimp tacos. There were literally two pieces of shrimp. Two. Are you kidding? Step up your game guys. Also thanks for the stale chips. It really warmed my heart

After listening to all these compliments about Amada, I was excited to try this place. 

Temporada white wine sangria. 
Mixto cheese plate: Aged Manchego (Truffled Lavender Honey), Fresh queso de cabra (Balsamic Strawberries), and.. forgot the 3rd one....
Spanish Octopus and Braised Pork shoulder Flatbreads, Lamb chops and Prime Sirloins: MUST TRY! All of these were delicious. Would definitely come back for these. 

Some things I didn't like::
Garlic Shrimp - not a big fan since it was too salty for me
(i think) Escalivada -  none of us enjoyed it. EH-

I've been to Tinto, Amada, Chifa and Village Whiskey..and I like Amada the best - I think the portions were actually more generous than Tinto and Chifa (surprisingly ;)  ).

I have driven, walked and passed by this place so many times always wanting to go in. Today I had the opportunity.

The decor is awesome, the setting inside is small and intimate. 

I walked in and there was live music and the place was jumping, what could be better....

Had to ask.

I ordered 2 sandwiches to go and while waiting over 40 minutes multiple people came in after me and recieved their meals and drinks. It seemed as though unless you knew the people working you weren't an important patron.

On a normal day I would stay and enjoy the music and the endless cup of coffee, today I couldn't wait to leave. The service was horrible. 

Food was decent. Maybe I would visit this place again, not sure.

This is wholeheartedly my favorite Italian restaurant in the city! No one else seems to get it right like the Italian Barrel does. The atmosphere is romantic and cozy, the staff feels like family, and the food is incredibly authentic. I've been four times in the past 7 months and each time is the same consistent, wonderful experience time and time again. The French Quarter finally has something worthwhile to visit.
Over a 20 minute wait for our food inside.  Order was messed up!  Chips tasted stale, chicken in our quesadilla tasted old, and the burrito's had an overpowering amount of cilantro in them.

What a nice little place for good Indian food. We went during lunchtime and they were serving a buffet. It was a good selection of typical Indian dishes and not too spicy (for those with weak tastebuds). 

The service was great and the atmosphere reminded me of a little cafe in Agra that I had visited. 

I can't wait to go back and order off the menu.

Been passing this place a good while, finally had a meal there after work.
Amazing. How'd I miss this place?? Excellent atmosphere and wait staff very friendly and all look happy to work here. 
I had the corn empanadas and chickpea soup. Delicious!! Tasted my sister's wings, terrific!! The salsa for my empanadas was superb. The strawberry margherita was excellent. Truly great first experience, will go again for sure!!
Note: parking is more than adequate,  vegan and vegetarian options, happy hour specials AND not just at the bar and very good prices for the plentiful being served.
And florals at entrance, beautiful.

If you enjoy fried and savory food, you MUST try WEPA! It's difficult to find authentic Puerto Rican food in the US, and WEPA is the real deal. 

I ordered the chicharrones de pollo, which is essentially fried chicken with a crispy pork rine skin. It was delicious but extremely heavy, so make sure to go there hungry! The tostones were also perfect. They were just the right balance of salty and crispy. 

Overall, it was incredible, I can't wait to go back!

Everyone from checkout to pickup was wonderful and cheerful, and my hoagie and drink came out great. Except I ordered a Shorti, was almost given a Classic, and the lady supervising the young lad who made my sandwich made him take it back and cut it in half (or whatever the appropriate size is) when I was literally about to reach for it. 
Like don't waste food, you can give me extra that's fine!!

Best place for breakfast!  Very tastey, filling, and a great variety to select from. I had the build your own omlet, which had sausage, shrimp and crab meat. Was delicious. We also had the crab cakes benedict. It was very good. We wish we would have came here for breakfast our entire trip. Would highly recommend!

Nice place.  They have a good selection of craft beers and a great happy hour when it comes to alcohol with $2 draft drinks.  Food selection could be better, however.  The one unique thing about the place is the old 60s video compilation they project onto the walls.  It creates a nice vibe and is absolutely mesmerizing (especially if you are drunk or high).  I'd be sure to come back.  Also,free whiskey tastings every Thursday from 6-8 PM

Awesome! I love this place the burnt ends are to die for, and very reasonable prices for the quality of food that is provided. Make sure to get there early or be ready for a wait. But it's absolutely worth it because the food is killer some of the highest quality ribs iv ever eaten get them as a side order to a meal. This place is a tourist hot spot and it's obvious why! 

Cheers!

I tried the Tues fish tacos. The fish looked good and was cooked well. The only negative is the seasoning that was put on the fish. It was like a lot of cajon spice. To much of this spice ruined the taco. To bad because it had a nice presentation other then all the spice cooked into the fish so I could not take it off.  Nice that it was baked and not fried. Maybe use a different spice? More cabbage. I will try again to see if it changes. Good price. $4.99 for 2 tacos and beans. Wonder if the chicken tacos have the same spice on them? They offered that instead of the fish.

Important aspects of what makes this restaurant excellent are the food, service, atmosphere, prices, and location (considering there's nothing like it in Fishers)

Food
There hasn't been one thing I've had that was undercooked, over seasoned, bland, too tart, or disappointing. Sure, you can order the sliders and fries and get yer burgs and fries fix, but what makes the place special is the rotating "seasonal" side of the menu. More adventurous and creative, these plates give a window to the true talent in the kitchen that other restaurants just don't have.

Service
After being greeted with a smile and directed toward my table, iceless ice-cold water is delivered to the table posthaste. Every server seems to be crushing it with knowledge of the wines. There are a LOT of wines on the menu and how they keep track of them is beyond me. Please, I encourage you to sit and ask, "Well I like ______ (cab, sav, chard, merlot, malbec, rose, blends, etc). What's a wine or flight I should get?" You will be genuinely impressed with what is suggested. Also, it should be noted that the GM might make a visit to the table, which seems like a no-brainer, but is comforting and hospitable nonetheless. The bartenders are fun to sit and chat with if you sometimes go lone wolf for the night like I do. often. please. be my friend... lol

Atmosphere
Collins glass chandeliers, check. Cork wall, check. Repurposed wine crate wall, check. Suspended hexagonal wine rack above matching hexagonal booths, check. Pickle barrel wood floors, check. Barn wood ceiling, you get the point. The place looks and feels warm and inviting. I only wish it was larger. MORE GIVE ME MORROORRRREEE... ok I understand it's inside of another building, but gee whiz I wish they had a private room (maybe future location(s)?) The bar is gorgeous with their 20-some premium wines on display in their super fancy wine stations which keep the wine from oxidizing for 90 days or something like that. Just go inside and check it out if you're not hungry.

Prices
Hey there Elite '17 yelper saying things are just too expensive, I see you. Hey you bruncher that doesn't like the $2 mimosas... They $2. Hey, otherwise nice person that gets upset and angry and posts on yelp about how $80 is too much for dinner. I just don't understand the world of yelp sometimes. If you tell yourself, "Ok I don't want to spend more than $50" it can be done at ANY restaurant in Indianapolis. ://end rant. Louvino's wine and food menu makes it easy to decide how much to spend on both food and drinks. As far as expensive wines, they have some of the most competitive prices in the state. Small apps are all under $10, Risotto and Brussels sprouts salad are $10 (and amazing), and all entree-ish plates are $10-$16. Even the more expensive Charcuterie is a great price under $25. For a restaurant with $200-300 wines available, it's really nice when you can walk out happy under $40 for 2 people.

Location
Fishers is growing and building more every year. As far as more restaurants like this one, it has yet to be seen, but until that day... There's no other place like this one in the area.

LOVED Harvest!  I could not have asked for a better experience.  The atmosphere is warm and cozy, and the servers and staff were very attentive and knowledgeable.  I also love how the chef uses local ingredients and alternative power for his restaurant.  Very cool.

I had the beef tenderloin special, which was melt-in-your-mouth fantastic.  Cooked perfectly, atop a bed of delicious garlic mashed potatoes and the best spinach I've had in my life thusfar.  Around this was a cabernet glaze, which worked absolutely perfectly with the tenderloin.  Heaven!

If we're getting super picky, the spring greens salad could have been a bit more flavorful, but the herbed-goat cheese toast that accompanied it more than made up for it.  And the greens were totally fresh, so it really didn't matter.  Like I said, only if we're getting super picky...

My mom had the scallops, which had great flavor.  Unfortunately, we didn't have room for dessert. (Kicking myself over that now.)  But that's just one more reason to go back and try more of Harvest's seasonal delicacies!  Oh, and some of their cocktails.  They had a huge cocktail menu that looked freaking fantastic!

Another successful to go order from Goodwood! We first tried goodwood at their Boise location while house hunting, and now that we're here in meridian, we had a craving and placed a to go order! The food was great and lasted us 3 days! We got a full rack of baby back ribs, the 3 meat combo with burnt ends, a sausage and chicken, loaded mashed taters and beans, and fries. Everything was delicious. Loooove Goodwood! Will be a regular stop whenever we crave bbq!!

An awesome Asian bowl place, kind of like a chipotle concept. It was awesome and super filling. I got the chicken bowl with fried egg but you can also customize your own! It was a lot of food for what you pay and I'll definitely be back. Go here if you're super hungry and feeling some Asian food!
Busy on Friday and Saturday nights, I've always had good experiences here. Last summer a bouncer took my cousin's fake id and tried to sell it back to him via Facebook message, very weird.

I had never had Indian food before and was a little skeptical, but this is some of the best food I have ever had.  I went with a group of friends and we tried several dishes, all of which were fantastic.  I would definitely recommend this, whether or not you like spicy food or think you like Indian food.  Yum!

What a fraudulent establishment. Went there for the UFC PPV, got charged $10 for cover, then when it came time for the PPV, it looked like they were streaming it. 

If I wanted to watch the PPV on a crappy Internet feed, I would have stayed home. 

Bush-league, fraudulent establishment. I will not go back.

Great service from the time we walked into the bar. August was our server & she was so nice. Everyone was kind & helpful. We didn't eat there but the menu looked good. Definitely on a place to come back to next time we are in town!

We've been here before and tho the service was lacking, the food was great.  Went tonight and there were 3 occupied tables and about 8 empty.  We stood for a few minutes without anyone coming out from the back, and finally sat down. We timed it for 7 minutes with no one acknowledging us, so we got up to leave.  Someone did finally come around from the back but he made no effort to see if we were OK or to ask us to stay - just watched us walk out.  We went next door to Mi Casa and had a good meal with great service.  The windows of Caffe Italia were filthy, and the interior was as dismal as we remember it being.  Something needs to change - because the food is too good to be in a place like that, with such bad service.

came here on a whim on a saturday afternoon. the wait wasn't too bad considering we wanted an outside table (they have about six or seven) and the food was great. i ended up with a bowl of clam chowder, which was amazing. they had giant clam pieces and plenty of it! i also ordered a shrimp ceviche with a corona. great size with lots of shrimp and chips as well. there is cabbage at the bottom of the bowl, so don't be shocked when you first see it. one star taken off because we had to ask for salt and lemons twice before anyone got it to us. oh, and the outdoor tables are definitely waiting for, especially around the time when the sun sets. we got to see sea lions and even dolphins! great relaxing atmosphere.

I actually like the pizza here it is certainly an every once in a while kind of pizza. NOT ALL THE TIME! But that is about all I will eat from here! It is not clean enough for me, you can clearly see that. People are not exactly the friendliness(which is hard to find) But the steaks are so greasy and the wings... ehhhh. We order a small personal pie and than go next door for our wings, steaks  and fries from Wings To Go. Call ahead to both and its a quick pick up!

Went on a BUSY SATURDAY! The wait was over an hour long but wanted to really check out the place. Hung out at the bars with my friend and we played some card games and talked with the bartenders. Holy cow, I have met some pretty friendly, witty & funny bartenders but I think Pieces takes the cake. Their bartenders (all of them and their bar backs) were very knowledgeable about the place and the drinks. Helped my friend picked some great cocktails and shots! They were very funny (not just nice funny some were witty and it made the night more fun) and they always made sure we were taken care of. They were also very relaxed, for a busy bar-top and place, all of them were relaxed and comfortable. If it were me I would be stressed with making drinks I don't think I would have been as laid back to have a short conversation with anyone. I was truly amazed by the service we received by the bar crew. 

Overall, this place was great, the reason I put 4/5 is because by the time we were ready to leave, we were still on the waitlist so we never actually got to sit down. Nothing wrong on any staff members end, it was a very busy night, but I don't know how it was being seated or that experience. I do plan to return with a bigger party! 

***you can join their current waitlist through yelp!***
When we come back home this is a must stop. I love the muffuletta. Great company!! Great food!!

There isn't much of a market here. It's really just a place to stop for lunch. I guess they do catering and delivery as well.

My first impression walking in was not good because all the tables were dirty. I did find some clean-ish counter space to sit at by the window, and eventually a staff person removed the trash and trays from the dining area, but no one ever wiped the tables down the entire time I was there. So I had to eat surrounded by crumbs. The floor looked like it hadn't been swept in a few days either. Not very appetizing. 

I ordered a small one-topping pizza with side salad. The salad was swimming in provel cheese. I'm not anti-provel, but no one needs that much cheese on a salad. It was half lettuce, half provel with 1 cherry tomato and a roll. My pizza was more like a medium size and it was swimming in provel as well. I was pretty much in a provel coma after eating here. The pizza is thin crust but oddly bread-like. I sensed it contained a lot of butter or shortening. I prefer the drier, more  cracker-esque Imo's crust.

Most people who stopped by seemed to be ordering sandwiches and got their orders to go. The messy dining area doesn't exactly entice anyone to stick around.
Burger was salty. Patty not cooked enough. Parking lot full but restaurant was empty. Service was fast. Price a bit strong.
This is a wonderful hidden treasure- smoked bbq at its finest! signature sauces you'll want to take with you! they offer other food than bbq but thsts what i csme for.

The food was amazing! their potatoes are perfectly seasoned! And just everything was delicious! And the service was really good too! Their owner came up to us and made sure we were more than satisfied with everything and was very welcoming! definitely coming back here more often!

I've been meaning to stop by for breakfast for a long time. This morning, I found myself in MidTown with some time on my hands and decided to treat myself!

The restaurant is comfortably appointed and provides a country style ambiance.
As well as a menu with some really intriguing egg dishes, they serve coffee from Wood-Fire Roasted Coffee Company, one of my favorites!

Today was the first day of mandatory masks in public. All the servers were very nice, friendly and accommodating, while I tried to remember to put my mask back on while speaking to the server...

I went with the Gromelt Bene. LOVED the strong sourdough bread base with the delicate cheese, hollandaise and perfectly cooked egg, topped with a sprinkle of bacon. It was delightful! The side of sweet potato home fries was a nice addition to the plate. Side by side with a generous mug of coffee, this was really a terrific breakfast in a trendy MidTown location. 

I know I will be back, whether to sit in or order out. There are quite a few more items on the menu I need to try!!

Probably not the best Mexican food I've had in St Louis, but this is a seriously good attempt.  I've usually only come here on weekend nights and it has almost always been extremely crowded.  It's not that the wait is terribly long, it's just that there really isn't enough space for all the patrons.  Service is always pretty decent.  I find that they are generally quick, friendly, and pretty attentive. 

The food here is a hit or miss too.  They do give complimentary child and salsa.  While the chips are decent, I'm not a huge fan of the salsa - it doesn't have any heat to it. :(. I had the Yucatan Chicken the first time I came and didn't really care for it.  It was really dry and flavourless.  The second time, I decided to try something different - the California burrito.  I think I found a new favourite here!  It's got chicken and tons of yummy roasted vegetables.  Plus, there was enough for me to take home with me for lunch the next day.  Also, the friend I came with ordered an horchata and let me have a little bit of it.  While she really enjoyed her drink, I personally found it a little watered down.  Ahh well, maybe it'll be better next time.
Excellent beer selection and a solid burger.  Everything else was just eh.

Went here for lunch after taking my finals and it HIT THE SPOT. I had the chicken club wrap with fries and a tangerine beer. It was amazing. First off, the fries were the best I've had in a LONG time. They were hot, crispy and had just the right amount of seasoning. Second, the wrap was amazing. Plenty of chicken, bacon and avocado and not too much lettuce. It was perfect. The folks helping us were very kind. We had asked for ranch with the meals and they delivered the food with extra ranch just in case we needed it. All together it was amazing experience. I will be back!
Came to Philly for a conference and had my first mea here. It was great and the guy ( the owner??) was very nice. So I would definitely recommend this place. They treat the food serious :) - Vivian

The waitress saved their review from me. The first time I came it was a Saturday night and my husband and I waited at least five minutes before anyone even acknowledged us. I figured it was because we chose to sit outside. The second time we chose a table across from the bar (very comfortable seats and beautiful ambiance next to the fireplace). We were waiting for ten minutes and no one came to us. It was a Thursday afternoon around four so it wasn't at all that busy. I had to stop a waitress who was helping some people next to us. (I felt horrible because it was a group of ten or more people). But she was extremely apologetic and so sweet. (I'm pretty sure her name was Kia, definitely ask for her when you visit!) She took our orders immediately and continued to take great care of us even though we weren't even her responsibility. I thought to myself that this girl gets things done! We ordered wings as an appetizer, I had the ahi tuna and the baby greens salad. (Kia recommended I add the ahi tuna into my salad versus ordering both dishes. I saved some $ and it was delicious). My husband had the crab cakes which we always great. The food is superb here but they just need to get on top of taking care of people sooner. Or hire a few more Kia's.

This is kind of a hidden treasure. I have driven by many times and finally went for a coworkers birthday. The inside was dim and reminded me of a romantic steakhouse. I was pleasantly surprised at how good it was and the great service we got. From the outside you don't necessarily get that impression.

Came here for brunch with girlfriends after night out. Maybe it's just me but I have high expectations from Bruch places/food, I think most people do. There is nothing majorly wrong with the place. We were seated quickly, servers were good, we bought the 1$ per person water ... just coz. I ordered the chorizo taco, expecting eggs and spicy sausage i.e. chorizo. My expectations were high coz apparently the ingredients are locally sourced and the chorizo is house made. What came out was scrambled egg with meat in soft taco.... no flavor to it. IDK when I order chorizo I am expecting something spicy or at least with some flavor to it. I would not call what I got a chorizo, they should simple remane it. It wasn't a bad experience, I had great company, just a sort of mismatch with expectations. 
Will probablt give it another chance.

(3.5) ~ Good overall food & service

MY TAKE-OUT MENU:
* St. Louis Ribs = (3.5) good...these are meatier than baby backs, but still "fall off the bone", and they're "wet" style (vs. dry), but could have used more sauce...
* Cornbread Pudding = (4) very good
* Bianco Mac & Cheese = (3.5) good, but I like mine with some crust(for texture;)  It is Penne Pasta though;)
* Cornbread = (3) ok

NOTES:  It's set up mainly for Take-out, but there are some seats inside and a couple of picnic tables outside.  The Metered Parking is free after 6pm.
Delicious food and excellent service! Thank you all for being so accommodating and patient. I will definitely revisit...
Right off main, was able to walk right in and met the whole family! Amazing people, better food.

We love this place!  I'm not a golfer but my husband is a golf nut and we both have a great time!  I love the sectional couches so we non-golfers can relax and hang out while the golfers hit balls.  Drinks are pricey, food is ok... but it's fun for the whole gang!
Super fresh tacos and you can't beat the price. They even have vegetarian options if that's your thing :-)

No complaints about the food. Just like his shack, the BBQ is very good as were the onion straws and slaw. Couple things I would like to see changed. Except for beer and wine, all other drinks come from a self serve fountain which does not offer regular ice tea or club soda. Sweet tea for me out of a dispenser has never been something I like. You place your order at at the counter and the servers bring it to your table. People were very attentive to make sure all the food was meeting expectations.
Smell of of beer is pretty strong when you walk in the door, but it is clean with lots of tv's. Love is BBG ribs and brisket so will go back.
Great local place. Wonderful atmosphere. Amazing food!!!!! Love the location. Our family has this place as a regular dinner stop! So glad Ciccios is back in Tampa Palms. Been eating there for years!

Went to Shells with a party of 12. Called an hour ahead and the table was ready when we arrived. Everyone enjoyed the food and service. I had the blackened grouper with the big easy topping. The fish was fresh as the topping/sauce was perfect. Don't forget to check in on Yelp to get a free margarita.

Awesome people, friendly atmosphere, great drinks and amazing in-house made food! They have a menu but will accommodate anything you want as long as they have the ingredients! 6 TVS with 6 Different channels. You can watch sports, news and movies all at the same time!!!!

Simply the BEST donuts anywhere.  The creme donuts are loaded with rich filling and the glazed have more glaze than donut!  Worth the trip - fresh baked and terrific variety.  Worth twice the price they charge.

Went here on a Friday night with a friend, and really enjoyed the food! We had a Groupon and will definitely be coming back! 

The food: 
1. They have happy hour every day and specials, so we had a beer and a glass of wine ($2 off), as well as the bacon wrapped dates ($2 off apps)
2. We split a pizza (sausage and kale) and a Mona's salad (small was enough to share; had Gorgonzola, dried fruit and pistachios). 
3. If you like thin crust pizza, you will love Mona's! 
The service:
1. Our waitress was nice and prompt in filling up drinks 
2. We did have to wait awhile for our pizza and our waitress forgot for a second that we had ordered it, but everything else was pretty prompt.

CASH ONLY!

Walked here before going to a show at the Electric Factory. It is almost completely unnoticeable if the words BURRITOS wasn't on the side of the building. From the outside, it looks like you are going into someones apartment, then when you walk in, you think you walked in the wrong door, but...this is Jose's Tacos.

I ordered my normal burrito from any Mexican restaurant. A steak burrito with everything on it as well as an order of guac with chips. The guac was very smooth and tasted very fresh. I enjoyed it thoroughly. However, when it came to my burrito, I have had better. It wasn't bad at all, but it wasn't something I would crawl back to either. The portion size was perfect for $7 and everything was fresh.

Would I go back to Jose's Tacos? Yes.
Would I try another Mexican restaurant in Philadelphia first? Yes.

PS, I Love You. They also let me charge my phone in the kitchen area, which was extremely needed, so the staff is very nice.

Went in for lunch today, was not a great experience.  The server informed us that they had no iced tea or coffee because their machine broke and they were waiting for it to be fixed.  I asked for a Sprite or Ginger Ale and was told they only have Coke or Diet Coke available.  I cannot drink either.  We ordered and waited.  We watched as our waitress, who had long hair that was not restrained, as she delivered a table their food while carrying the tray on her shoulder.  Her hair was ALL over all the plates on that tray.  I almost got up and left then!  The table did not notice and we were concerned about our food being delivered like that.  Thankfully she just carried our 2 plates to us.  The restaurant was so hot, like the a/c was broken and the manager kept walking through the restaurant talking on his phone while it was on speaker phone.  That was really distracting and annoying.  He also did not stop to check with any of his guests.  The food was good, but we are not sure we will come back due to the other things we noticed.

Sals Special wood fired pizza was good. They charge extra to have the pie cooked in the wood oven. The only negative was the charge of $3.00 for extra sauce, and the pizza wasn't saucy. So three stars and we will try one of the 50 other pizza joints in the Burg next time.

NOT PALEO!  That is an out and out FABRICATION.  THEY HAVE NOTHING ON THE MENU THAT IS PALEO and NO GLUTEN FREE MEALS.  They have SOME Paleo ingredients, so they can tear apart a menu item, and for the SAME price they can give you less than HALF a dish at the SAME PRICE to make it Paleo....

And they have good, not great, food.  Worse, the place is incredibly pretentious and extremely overpriced.  Tiny tapas at entree pricing. Worst wine pour I've witnessed in many years.  A good wine place would call their pours a taste.  This place would be overpriced in Seattle or New York. In Seminole Heights it just screams I eat here to be seen and appear chic. This is the second time I have eaten here...there won't be a third....

Oh, and they have clearly paid for their name to come up on Yelp's search engine when you type in Paleo or Gluten-Free.  AGAIN, THEY HAVE NO PALEO DISHES WHATSOEVER and nothing gluten-free either...!  

YELP SHOULD REMOVE THEIR PALEO AND GLUTEN-FREE CLAIMS, AS THEY ARE LYING ABOUT THEIR OFFERING....

Terrible service combined with the worst hamburgers in creation make this restaurant a place to avoid. 

Plus the salads were awful:  soggy and tasteless. 

Perhaps the beer they serve there is terrific; the food and service, however, are horrific!

Should have gone to Chili's next door instead.

Good service and was happy with the food.  I found the menu comical - one page with food, one page sharing the people that worked there, and 9-10 pages for drinks.  My son said they have the name wrong and it should be called "Sips" as you have more drinks to taste than food.  Fried cheese Kurds were good, but were more like small mozzarella sticks vs Kurds.  They were accommodating and let me make a reservation for a small party when I mentioned it was my wife's birthday.  Will go back, but leave the kids at home.

AMAZING. The food is delicious and the service is incredible.  The overall vibe is awesome.  They even have a little outside patio in the back.  I've almost lived in the area for a year now and can't believe it took me this long to get there.  I can't believe the have lower than 5/5 stars.

When I'm in the mood to relax, enjoy a glass of wine and a great burger, this is the spot - especially when you can sit on the patio and enjoy the Mass Ave vibe.  My fav is the Provencal; it is absolutely scrumptious. Be sure you have time, because you will most likely have to wait for a table, but it IS worth the wait.

After leaving a horrible restaurant, Wakin Bakin was here to save the day! Great service, great menu selections, great food! Love the atmosphere and the food! No pretention like some other Nola spots.

I wanted to like Murphys; I really did. First visit was decent; the steak and wings were good, the ribs were average. We decided to give them a second try...mistake from the beginning. The hostess stood in front of me sorting menus while I was trying to see how long the wait would be. After sorting her menus, she then told me she would be right with me after seating some others. Finally, after finishing up her other important tasks, she says we can be seated immediately. We got seated only to wait 15 minutes with no acknowledgement whatsoever. Needless to say, we left! I politely explained to the hostess why we left and received a half-hearted, "I'm sorry." LOL...I doubt it. They may not miss our money, but we wont miss their average food and inconsistent service.

Wow what a difference from V&Ts. We waited a while to go there after they opened to allow some time to work out the "kinks".  I guess we needed to wait longer because the total experience was awful.  Food was slow and my chicken parm was over cooked.  Asked for extra sauce (when I ordered) still waiting to get it.  Shame we loved V&Ts and didn't mind waiting because the atmosphere and the food was worth it.  Not anymore the Grumpy guy at the counter seemed bothered when I spoke to him.  Waitress was friendly but, seemed overwhelmed.  It was slow but, she seemed to be doing everything while the guy at the counter did nothing.  We won't be going back since we can better Italian food (at better prices) at many places in the area.

I'm just gonna start with WOW, I had planned with starting with more but due the the drool I have on my phone from basking in the sweet, sweet aroma of Pine State take out in my car, I had to pace myself. I've come here several times now, it's actually the only breakfast joint in Reno I've found myself eating at more than once. It's amazing, it's comparable to stepping off the streets of the biggest little city and into the kitchen in the coolest spot in any town in the south. I mean they have fried green tomatoes for cryin out loud!! There isn't a single item on the menu that I'd turn down. If you're a pine state owner, the only thing I'd say is, hire more people to be on-call when more of us Reno folk figure out just how damn tasty this place is. It's New Years Day and they were slammed with online orders, so there was a longer wait than what I typically endure, and I was given one of their bomb as fuck, mouth puddle inducing cinnamon rolls, an extra side of their taste bud rockin friend green tomatoes complimentary for the extra waiting time. If you don't try this place, you are robbing yourself of a David Copperfield like magic of a culinary experience.
Came here for lunch with some coworkers. The lunch menu is pricey and the Cobb salad is not worth $17.00. Bar service was great. 2 and half yelps. Cool decor
Another yelp find in St. Pete. Great spot for brunch and the service was exceptional.

This place has changed Ownership many times in the last 5 years

I think ALDO's is best but Amy's not so much.   How hard is it to make a pizza?   I mean for real?

A Friend gave me a bite of his snack and a slice of butter bread. Omg, I knew I had to go.  This place takes 1 hour round trip to get to however I made the journey.  I pulled in and much to my surprise there was a drive thru!  I used my friends receipt to try and order, however got the wrong thing.  I think things happen for a reason because the ham and cheese cachito I received on accident was much better than what I was trying to order.  Nice job guys!  You have an awesome place, and great food.  Yes I will make the drive again and yes I loved your food. It's very Homemade, and that's what this Midwest girl likes. :) If you are reading this and go, also get yourself a cafe c/leche w/ sugar. Tasty tasty. I give you five starts! I think I should take a point away for being such a drive, but again....I think your worth it!

We had the shumai, salmon avocado something and the drums/wings combo. The shumai was good but its too small for an appetizer. The salmon avocado something was good and I could finish the whole thing. The drums and wings are pretty tasty and delicious I could keep eating, eating and won't stop. Would definitely comeback and recommend to friends.

I've eaten at Joanie's restaurant prior and have always enjoyed the pizza. Today I purchased two pizzas from the to go location and was extremely disappointed. It was like eating cardboard so we threw the majority away. I do not recommend Joanie's to go but will try the restaurant again.

This is a great place to have breakfast anytime of the day. Went recently to meet some family driving from Texas to California and this made their quick stop easier. Plus it has everything you need for travel as a truck stop, including showers if necessary.

Enjoy this landmark while it lasts. It used to be in the middle of nowhere... the first thing you would see as you entered Tucson from the east, but the neighborhood is changing fast.

P.S. Get the apple pie... just one though as it is big enough to share with many!

We had this young guy as our server that was super nice and attentive, even though he was the main server on the that day.  He recommended a few good items for us to start with.

I loved their Spicy Fried Lemon Grass Tofu vermicelli bowl and their Shaken Beef. I found that these two dishes were really flavorful. The wings are also really delicious. The two sauces that come with the wings compliment each other really well. 

My least favorite part of the meal was their Pho. I found the broth to be a bit bland for me. The Pork Belly Sliders recipe seemed to change. I remember the flavor and texture of the meat was different than how I had it last time.   I found my Avocado Boba Tea to be a tad too creamy and sweet, but I enjoyed it nonetheless. I also found the frying oil to be a bit old. My egg roll came out really dark and oily, which is an indicator that it was not fried in fresh oil. It was still tasty though.

Not-so-clean diner offering a limited variety of over-priced dishes to those that think they praise Russian food (with or without due reason).  

We walked in to see about 6 uncleaned empty tables just hanging out by themselves.  Waitresses hanging out elsewhere in the corner across the piano.  Truth to be told (and credit given where it is due):  waitress did clean one of the tables (5 more to go) a few minutes later following our request but ironically used her nails to clean some stains on the menu.  ... Proletoriat ...Gross...      I think state health department needs to visit this place.  Chairs, tables etc are so cheap, even basic diners do it better.  Waitress is pushy.   For sure my appetite went down to 0.00%.
.  
The only thing that is Russian here is beer and attitude.  Former you can always find at a regular store at 25% of a price and the latter can be avoided by going elsewhere and having a superb dining experience, which is exactly what we did.  We ditched this place with much pleasure and had a great time at Sapporo Restaurant (great food, presentation and entertainment) just on the other side of the mall.

OK... so I'm really on the fence about this place.  As a Texan living in Tennessee, I'm always on the lookout for smoked meats.  Smoked meats are magical.  So I should like this place, right?  Well I do, mostly.  The atmosphere is great.  It's a great place to watch a game that may not be AS crazy as another sports bar type situation.  The prices are reasonable and the smoked wings and thighs are wonderful.  My issue is with the menu.  You eat wings with your hands, but they want you to add a bunch of toppings.  Not just sauces (saucy hands are part of the deal!) but toppings... like pineapple, tomatoes, and cheese.  All the toppings come on top (duh...) of the pile of wings.  So how are you supposed to eat them?! The table is a hot mess of pineapples and jalapeños by the time you're done, I just don't think it works. (It really bugs me, if you can't tell)

You can get the thighs chopped up with the toppings on it, which is better.  I understand the flavors.  It just fails in execution. When they were a food truck, they would just bring plain smoked wings to events.  They're awesome. Get them plain, maybe a sauce or seasoning. Don't be fooled by the flashy toppings! haha

The cocktails are super good and I'll continue to come back.  I just won't get toppings on my wings...

M and I met two friends here on a Friday night for food and drinks. It was a 30 minute wait for four people which ended up being only about 10 minutes. We were seated in the back room and proceeded in checking out the beer list. I went with a Dogfish Red and White. It was really good -- strong, but went down smooth (I am not a beer aficionado, obviously, haha). 

I got the Monk's Mussels (Gueuze, fumé, garlic & parsley), which are served with pommes frites and an awesome, very slightly spicy mayo dipping sauce. The fries are SO GOOD. I love fries that are fried dark like that. The mussels were also very good, perfectly cooked, although I wish the bread served with them was crustier. It was a soft roll, so it got super soggy as soon as it was dipped in the broth. 

For dessert, M and I got the peanut butter cheesecake and it was delish. Our friends got the chocolate covered creme brulee which was also good.

Service was friendly but slow. It didn't really matter because we were chatting the whole time, but those that have someplace to go probably wouldn't appreciate it.

FBD rocks in so many ways... Great breakfast for starters... Their jalapeño cheddar bagel is homemade and wicked hot but in a smokey delish way. Their falafel wrap is the bomb....their cold brew coffee ..o...m..g!!
Don't miss out on this fabulous breakfast and lunch spot located conveniently by my favorite auto mechanic  the auto clinic I just realized r- I need to write them a review -

This place is right on the beach and we were seated next to the glass wall that separates the beach from the restaurant. The service was fast and they kept us happy. Carolyn ordered an appetizer which was oysters Rockefeller, she loved them. I ordered the clam chowder and it was great, Carolyn and Gail got the Ceasar  salads, they both said "Mistake" the dressing wasn't good. Should have ordered clam chowder. The bread was fresh and good. I had the king crab and steak, both very good, crab was very moist. Carolyn had steak but was so full that she did not eat much of it, took it to go. Gail had some kind of penne pasta and said she loved it. Bottom line: Good food, nice view, not very fancy, the price is a little expensive. our waitress was kind and efficient. I would return and recommend this joint.

I'm not really a beer person, but their beer selection is ridiculous.
The mussels were pretty good. My boyfriend had the chicken & apple sausage. The servers & wait staff were friendly. I probably wouldn't go out of my way for the food, but I would definitely go back if I happened to be in the neighborhood.

I have eaten here a few times and get take out for their wings pretty regularly. The wings are great if you get them well done. I have also had the nachos which are so good! The French onion soup is also very good. The only thing I didn't like was the sliders which I only ordered once. Overall this is a solid place

Came here for the Sunday brunch Drag show with a group of friends. The drag show was fantastic. The Queens doing the stage show were very entertaining. The performers were playing throughout the venue and walked every area where customers were. there were very few men considering it was a gay drag show.... maybe a dozen. The food was quite good: seafood, steaks, burgers, pizza, pizza, salads,  nachos. Drinks were good too. All in all it was a great afternoon out.

A Mediterranean gem off the beaten path you don't want to miss! Their specialty is the "Doner" (see dinner menu #37, 38, 39). It is essentially the meat you often see on the huge, spinning, vertical skewer in the kitchens of Mediterranean restaurants; but this skewar has thin, alternating layers of beef and lamb all cooked together. Lamb has a very strong taste (which I don't particularly care for on its own), but layered alongside the juicy seasoned beef, it tones the lamb-y taste down and it adds a nice flavor. I ordered #38. It was juicy, flavorful, and I received a liberal portion of meat (probably close to 1 lb of meat)! The white rice has a nice buttery flavor as well. My plate came with a green Turkish pepper which I was warned was spicy.

Oh, and the service was excellent! Ask for "Jackie Chan" or "Dr. Oz"!

Try their Turkish tea and Apple tea for a nice finish!

The standard burger is a solid burger, nothing to write home about.

Do yourself a favor and order the roasted chicken sandwich. Although, it may be a little salty, it tastes like a little piece of heaven.

I came for dinner, but it looks like a great spot to grab a beer and they have an excellent beer selection.
Great Sunday specials for the hoagies.  However, the rest of the week is a bit of a chance.

A nice place for a date or family dinner. A nice choices of menu items. Most meal are large enough to share.  Be warned the pizzas are large, but fantastic. My wife order one think it was a personal sized pizza based on the price. The staff is very pleasant.

I *loved* this place! I ate here late on a Tuesday night in early January and the dining room was still full. There were two of us and the wait to be seated was not bad at all. 

The food was great! I highly recommend the shrimp and alligator sausage cheesecake appetizer. It had a nice, soft consistency and was so delicious that we finished it pretty much as it hit the table!! 

For entrees, we ordered the Shrimp Etouffe and an Alligator Steak special. The entrees came with two small house salads with a fried oyster on top, a nice surprise! The shrimp entree was really good, but I found the alligator to be a bit tough, I may be sightly biased though as I don't enjoy alligator in steak form in general. I always find it to be tough that way. 

Food aside, the decor alone makes this place worth the trip. The ceiling above the bar is covered in framed paintings, the walls and ceiling in the dining room are painted with a scene from the bayou. There is not an inch of the place left undecorated and I loved it! 

I highly recommend Jacques-Imo's. If you're traveling, as I was (from NYC), this place is a must see! And, it's right next door to the Maple Leaf bar where you can catch some great music if you're able to shoehorn yourself in the door!
Love this location. Great customer service. The staff is always so pleasant and helpful. Thank you for not being an ordinary chain experience.
good for midnight snacks

Friendly workers and very attentive. Honestly Bagels are not the best, but decent. They have a good variety with a unique French toast bagel. Great cream cheese! Make sure that French toast wrapped in another bag. Powder gets everywhere! I am a fan of the coffee. Honestly their breakfast sandwiches need an upgrade. Overall I will continue to come here because the bagels are decent enough, good coffee and friendly service. It is usually a toss up between here an Manhattan Bagel.

This is a diner in a strip mall. If it looks and feels like a diner it's a diner. But who cares. How's the food and service. 

The food was really good for a diner. I had the broiled shrimp scampi over rice. Most restaurants offer scampi over some sort of pasta. Even though the menu is extensive like a diner and they have Italian dishes with spaghetti it wasn't offered with the scampi.  No biggie give it to me over rice. Wow. Color me impressed. First off the shrimp was butterflied and as fresh as any you would find ANYWHERE.  Secondly it was broiled which produces a different taste than grilled. I would definitely order it again and again.

The service was good almost like a diner. Recommend
Food was amazing and The service was good definitely recommend this spot in Santa Barbara

Went with my family yesterday for lunch. We will never go back again. The food was not good at All and it's very pricey. And the manager came around to ask is how it was and told him the truth. His answer was really that's the first
The food was very good. The Service we had was only OK. He was forgetful and it took about 30 minutes to get a beer 15 minutes to get Lemons. The other servers we asked for help they was great.

Tonight was the 2nd time I've eaten at the Prasino. Great food and the waiter was very nice and polite. The calamari, mussels, salmon and Raspberry Napoleon (dessert) were AMAZING!! Can't wait to try something new next time!
Update: owner reached out the very day to offer refund. Happy about their prompt action. Very much appreciated their professionalism and effort to solve the problem.

DEFINITELY my go to spot for non-American food!!! I find that I crave this place sometimes. I got the Lamb Shawarma on Gyro Bread which I actually had to physically look at once I took my first bite because I couldn't believe how good it was, fried calamari which was super crispy outside and moist inside..didn't care for the dipping sauce though, Combo Platter which was yummy and served as lunch the next day and Baklava. Boy oh boy is their Baklava good!! I've been to other places where they give you this miniature piece that is supposed to be dessert but theirs is HUGE! not to mention the quality is far superior than other places I've tried (I've eaten a lot of Baklava in my day). Overall, DEF worth the order!

Located in the back right corner, deep in the swamps of the Audubon Zoo, the Cypress Knee Cafe has a great atmosphere.  You can eat outside besidee the gators or inside in the AC. 

The crawfish etoufee and the red beans and rice are delicious and spicy. Overall, the local options seem to taste better than the generic items.  The burgers and fries are typical and remind me of a cafateria.
You get a free refill of your soda with your cup and receipt.  

Sometimes I come to the zoo just to way here.

Love this place before a lightning game. Wings may be best in town. Only complaint is the chairs, they always get my back jammed up! Great service, staff, and food is consistently delivered out. Highly recommend !

Yesterday me and my wife went to #oldgranitestreeteatery and I give it 8/10 my favorite thing was the customer service, everyone working there was lovely. We had the St James Redheaded Stranger and St Archer White Ale to drink and #beercheese and date spread, prosciutto and blue cheese  #brushetta to eat which was tasty and unique. The date spread prosciutto was better than I expected, and I dipped it in the beer cheese which complimented both. #happyhour #happyhourreno @ Old Granite Street Eatery
Super fun place for groups of friends - plenty of games, funky appetizers and strong drinks. All makes for a fun (and potentially) wild night out.

As I sit here and wait for Arbys corporate to contact me about my experience with your employee calling me a p*ssy *ss b*tch as well as telling me to go f*ck myself screaming out your drive thru window for all to hear but nothing yet. show's the dedication to customer service they have.

Two things are very NOT ok. First, they did not warm the plates up when they served hot dishes, which is totally unprofessional. People knowing something about cooking should understand what I am talking about. Second, the session they used to keep customers' jackets and coats were  as chilly as outside. Imagine when you finish everything, walk to the exit, your coats are soaked in the temperature of 14. Your dinner end up with shaking.
As for the dishes, they are just like 15 well prepared assignments submitted by top students. They demonstrated techniques, creativity and attentiveness. But viewed as a whole, there is no a wow factor for me. I cannot pick one of the most impressive dish to mark the memory. Many dishes share a common ingredient that had strong and distinctive taste. And there are many kinds of tubers in the dishes. So you would have an impression of repetition.

Love this place! The amount of meat you get on your sandwiches is so filling! They treated me so well and made sure I was satisfied. The spicy isn't too spicy either but adds a little kick to the food.

If it weren't for the fantastic views, the place would be a 3 star. But being that it is a rooftop bar and the view is spectacular, we are sitting at a 4 star. The drinks were good, but not great. And the food was adequate, but nothing to really write home about. The oysters were actually pretty great, but everything else felt safe and lackluster. The drinks were average as well, but this is still a great place to meet friends or someone you are trying to impress because of the great service and atmosphere. Make sure you make reservations otherwise it'll be pretty difficult getting seated.

My family and I have come to Island Way Grill for the last 3 years and it has been one of the places we have looked forward to eating the most when we visit. Unfortunately this most recent trip will be the last. I will note that we have always gone for Sunday brunch which is a buffet which they are highly regarded for in the Clearwater area. The food in the past has typically been well above average for a buffet but this most recent time it was a bit of a let down. The biggest issue I have with this place is there set up for the buffet...it's an absolute nightmare. There are no clear lines and where they have the buffet set up is a main thoroughfare for the restaurant which clusters up that entire area. I wanted to point out that we only go to the Sunday brunch because I believe this is the only buffet setup they have so this may not be an issue except for on Sundays. The restaurant itself is really nice and love sitting outside on their deck. I wouldn't say don't eat here but I would suggest maybe avoiding their Sunday brunch buffet.

The setting, in an opening of the bluffs on the beach, is amazing enough. Then you get a couple of outstanding craft cocktails, and it gets even better. Then you finally get seated and order...just wow. We went on two different occasions and could have easily had dinner here every night of our vacation. The food is among the best we had during our stay, and the service is top notch. Plan on a full evening, as it is very popular and you will have to wait for a seat. But order a couple of carry-out cocktails from the bar - maybe even an appetizer- and enjoy the scenery and atmosphere while you wait.

Came by to meet with some friends who were also visiting the area and by complete coincedence we run into friend from back home, Sarah T. She works at the RubySlipper on Canal St, gave us great service per usual and the food suggestions were excellent! She reccommended The Miami Slice and it was awesssssome!!!!! Get it with breakfast potatos and a bloody mary :)

Honestly, I was not expecting much when I entered this establishment today. Was starving and too lazy to drive so I decided to walk over. Place is clean, service is just meh. But my ox tail and rice was awesome. Will be back.

Having been on the quest for the best Pastrami Reuben in America for most of my life, turns out that I didn't need do all of that testing in NYC, Palm Beach County OR the entire Northeast, because the BEST pastrami on the planet is RIGHT HERE in Tampa????? I cant even describe with words how tender and  delicious this was! It's like I didnt even have to chew it! And the potato salad? Equally legit! I'm FLOORED. I could totally see this place on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives...its THAT good!

First time at this hotel was really impressed with the over all appearance and cleanliness of the hotel. There are several restaurants in the hotel we were looking forward to trying. First night we ate at the stake house it was defiantly not worth the money steaks were over cooked, side were good but nothing great. Second night we had a late dinner at the cascades cafe it wasn't good at all. I had the sushi that was probably my first mistake... But there wasn't much on the menu to be honest for a late night dinner they need more sandwiches and easy food. Quality of food was mediocre for sure. The pool outside was closed and the  hot tub was broken. Indoor pool not heated and no whirlpool inside very disappointing for the size of the hotel. Our room was clean and service was good. I defiantly expected more out of this hotel.
Yum yum yum. So good. Prices aren't bad and super great comfort food however I may be slightly biased because I love cheese. Service is good and I have yet to have a bad experience.

I usually don't review fast food locations, but I am going to make an exception here this time. Let me start by saying first off that the quality of the food was fine, no doubt about it. It was, for the most part, up to what I consider to be the fairly high standards of the Wendy's corporation chain. And while I don't eat here on a super regular basis, I probably do manage eight or ten visits per year. Now with that having been said, this was my first experience at this location, and it involves only the drive-thru. I cannot speak to the inside service, the cleanliness, nor the bathrooms. I don't know the condition of the chairs, the soda machine, nor how well the supplies (such as straws and napkins) are kept. So:

Wendy's is in the middle of the "BBQ Pulled Pork" ad campaign right now, and as a true fan of both BBQ and of Pulled Pork, I thought that I would give it a try. I pulled up to the ordering board and perused the menu. After a moment, I was ready, and I ordered. I asked for the Cheeseburger/BBQ Pork combo meal, spicy sauce, Coke for the drink, and a small chili. The pork burger is a single cheeseburger topped with their new BBQ pork, and comes with your choice of smoky, sweet, or spicy sauce. The combo comes with a side of fries and a drink. 
The speed of service was fine, and as always, I verified "One burger, one fry, a chili and my drink" before leaving the window. It was about eight minutes or so to the hotel, and on to my dinner. Now as I stated earlier, the quality of the food was fine overall. But I was sadly disappointed, to say the least, in three of the four items that I received. The Coke was Diet Coke. The small chili turned out to be a "super-small chili", in that it was only approximately half full, and while flavorful, it contained very little of the "meat, bean, onion" part. It was mainly liquid. Was this the bottom of the batch? It was around 8:10 pm, and perhaps it had been emptied during the dinner rush. As a final insult to my almost $10.00 meal, there was no BBQ pork on my BBQ pulled pork burger. The main thing I had come in here for, was nowhere to be seen.  I was certainly not jumping up for a 15 mile round tripper just to resolve the missing pig product dilemma I now faced. The bun was correct, and delicious, so it's not like I got a regular cheeseburger by mistake, they simply forgot to put on any pork. The only porcine item in sight was Wendy's PIGtails on the bag. Bummer. The produce was excellent, the meat cooked and seasoned properly, I just missed the BBQ Pork station in the burger line, I guess.

So will I try again to hit the BBQ Bonanza at Wendy's? I'm sure I will. But I will look closer next time, or maybe I'll just find a time where I can dine in, and I can assure myself that I get what I came here for.

I took my friend and his wife out to this Hooters location yesterday for a Memorial Day lunch.  As I've always been a fan of Hooters wings, I was not a fan of the service.  Upon arriving, our server didn't even introduce herself, nor seem personable at all.  We were served incorrect drinks based on our orders, and didn't even get an apology.  My friend's wife asked for blue cheese for her wings, and was served with ranch.  She asked our server again to correct it, and got nothing but attitude.  We asked for the manager, and he wasn't even apologetic.  The food was great, however I'm more prone to continually visit a restaurant that has great service over the quality of the food.  If you like great service, eat elsewhere.

My family has been coming to this restaurant for over 20 years. I started eating here in a booster seat and now I pay the bill haha.

The all you can eat buffet is pretty cool. The crab, shrimp, and the chicken selection is fairly decent, but what makes me give this place 5 stars is the amazing server who has been here for THE ENTIRE TIME. He is outgoing, friendly, and very at tentative. He might as well be my uncle since I grew up with him over the years. Thank you for the amazing memories, good food, and good company. We always order tea to have with our fortune cookies. I guess it's a tradition that I can't break. I will be back! Thank you Yen Ching!
-Tej

Went here on a Saturday night for drinks and snacks. We sat at the bar and were acknowledged relatively quickly. The drinks were good as were the parmesan potatos and buffalo wings. Towards the end of our evening we had some difficulty getting the attention of the bar tender so my friend whistled at him. The manager (I'm assuming thats who she was considering she never said that) came from around the bar (where she was sitting with customers) yelling at us "DONT WHISTLE AT MY GUYS, WE ARENT DOGS!" We said we didn't mean any disrespect just trying to get his attention and she continued to yell at us the same thing. Needless to say she was very rude and ruined our experience there. First time and it will be the last time. She could have approached us differently, unprofessional for a "manager."

Hello everyone!

Wife and I visited here during our food tour of The Delmar Loop. We were given a St. Louis rib for the food tour. It was delicious, it had a flavorful rub and literally fell of the bone as you bit into it.
