We ended up ordering the brisket fries and mac and cheese and split the pulled pork sandwich, which did have a poor slaw to meat ratio as someone else mentioned and was kind of bland, and we were both covering the sandwich with sauce to give it some more flavor (it was also kind of dry).  Also, ribs are no longer on the menu as an entrée, although you can get them in one of their bigger meat combos.

Maybe I'm just remembering my Restaurant Week experience too wistfully, but I don't think I'll be back again, which is a shame, because I went into work the next day raving about it  in January.  The appetizers are still great, but the entrées and à la carte style leave a lot to be desired.
The food is always amazing especially the ovals and drinks are made right! The service is always great. Highly recommend you visit!!!
The only good thing about this place was the sprite! The food is DISGUSTING!! How do you mess up rice?! It's the easiest thing to make.
literally has everything u want... pho... boba.... authentic viet food..... bakery... all in one place... and everyone is always so nice and the food comes out asap!!!!!:)
Why are the tables so disgusting and dirty this time?? I know they are busy because they are one of the few restaurants in the area open due to the tornado and storm but come on, this is disgusting.

I saw this place on Indy Patch about a new upcoming restaurant and this was their 2nd location. The review was about it being very authentic Mexican food. Coming from California I couldn't wait to try it. I was in the area, and on my way home  back to Plainfield. I am going to start with all the positives so you are not discourage reading this, and not go try this place. The food is very good and fresh. The steak fajitas has nice chunks of steak, with onion, tomato, and peppers. Alot of places you go to the strips are so thin, and shriveled up. This was cooked perfectly. I also got Al Pastor tacos they have the meat on a Skewer turning and looked really good. This came out on corn tortillas with onion and cilantro. Which was really good and authentic. The taste was good and had that pineapple pieces with the meat. Tacos were $2.99 each. I got a side of guacamole for$6.99 it came with chips, but the taste was a little sour, and that's usually caused by the tomatoes being overly riped. The worker there said also if they put too much lime juice will make it taste bad. I wouldn't get it again. The scoop was very small and not worth the price. Lastly, I got the Al Pastor burrito of my gosh very good and a big traditional burrito. It came with the meat, rice, beans, and avocado. 
They have a great open salsa bar where you go and pick out what salsa you want. They have 6 different salsas with different heat levels. Carrots/Jalapeno, and mixture of onions. 
Here is where the 4 stars happen which I am being generous because it should have been 3 and I would go back months from now and review it again. The dishes did not come out all at the same time. One guy which is the owners father in law takes the plates to the table. We got the fajitas, with no plates to share the dish. Plus you don't eat it out of the stone dish. I went to get my own plates. We waited and waited. Halfway done with the fajitas I had to ask where is the beans, rice,  Al Pastor tacos, guacamole and chips. We started getting the dishes after asking slowly one dish at a time. We were very frustrated. The beans were home cooked but way too much salt. The rice was good could have been more fluffy. The burrito I had a bite, and we packed up the rest to go. The burrito looks and taste amazing. The owner Adrian came over, and I gave him my feedback and frustration with everything. He said they were busy. I told him no you weren't busy. There was tables, but the place was half full Sat..night at 630-7, and no-one was waiting to be seated at any time. I told him that the table next to us was on a date and his burrito came out, and they waited so long that he split his burrito with her and took the other one home once it finally came out. It's very dysfunctional and they need to get the timing and all the food together or within minutes from one plate to the next. He said they have only been open a month and the Noblesville location has been around for years. I will go back because the flavors are amazing. Hopefully, he will get the changes made quickly. He is in a prime location in Fisher's. Not sure if others had this same situation happen to them. Hopefully the owner notices so people want to come back.
My favorite place to visit when I am visiting my neighbors! All of the there are my friends and old neighbors that I have known for over 20 years! Great food and music! What a awesome Irish pub!
Love coming to eat here. The oysters are great. I always get them raw. My family and I are always well taken care of when we go!

Hubby and I were staying across the way and begged him to take me there (he's never been!) Great happy hour and phenomenal service by Matt the bartender! $5 apps include shrimp, meatballs, scallops, ahi tuna, and lamb chops! I think we ate the entire menu and moved on to the dinner menu! Get the lobster flatbread and the shrimp n grits was enough to share. Drink recommendation? If you like bourbon, go for the New Old Fashion, topped with a rock candy stirrer. Dessert? Go for 3 shot glasses, not just 2!

Again, The Lemon Bar has exceeded all expectations. I just recently went again (yes, I am a regular) for their Galentine's events. I had so much fun. 

One of the head decorators at The Flying Cupcake led the session. They gave you three cupcakes and she taught us a different technique for each one plus added decor items. Everything was themed around Valentine's. They also brought out their new love potion drink with dry ice included in the cost. Additional drinks were discounted for being a part of the event.

I would absolutely do this again for any and all holidays. It was a total success for them in my opinion.

Incredible rolls! I'm not usually a fan of over the top rolls with lots of ingredients but we had the M80, the white ninja and the Mexican and they were all great! The sesame rolls were tasty also, but the accompanying sauces were not. Definitely coming back here, great little divey sushi place with a fun menu.

First time trying Charlie's ( I know, how does this happen in Delco!) and will definitely not be the last!! From the guy who took my order to the burgers and fries we ate, everything was fresh and filling. Can't speak to their shakes as we didn't order any tonight, but that will be on the next order!

Was excited to try this place after buying gift cards at Costco.  So we finally went on a late Saturday morning right before 11 a.m.  There were only 3 active tables when we got there, a nice outdoor seating area, but nobody was seated outside.  After being seated we sat for about 10 minutes before we saw a single server, saw three of them all at once but none of them came over to our table, by now a 4th table had been seated.  A waitress goes over to them and takes there order, again, we just sit. FINALLY our waitress comes over and asks us what we want to drink, well by this time we decided it was probably best to just order our food at the same time.  We sit another 15 minutes waiting for our drinks, are you kidding me?  So now we've been here 25 minutes just sitting....so we drink our coffee, we watch the table of 4 who came in after us...about 10 minutes later...here comes our waitress!  Yay!....with water?!  She asked us if we wanted water refills?  It's now been 40 minutes and my blood is boiling and my boyfriend was getting tense too....he finally asks where the food is and the waitress tells us it should be out soon, SHOULD BE OUT SOON?  Meanwhile table 4 is about halfway done eating.  We only ordered eggs Benedict, nothing earth shattering!  So we just left, starving, went to Wawa and ate Sizzlies....thanks AVENUE KITCHEN for a really shitty morning!

Loved Asia! Service was excellent and food was amazing! Bacon Bloody Mary awesome, omelets cooked to perfection. Will definitely be back soon!
#teamasia
Made a reservation for my friends birthday and wow. Best decision we have made. Staff was AMAZING, food was DELICIOUS. Couldn't of had a better experience!!!!
Food was excellent service was great very well priced for the amount of food you get excellent place to stop before and after a river cruise shopping right next door can't wait to come back
Great food! Love everything I have tried here. Cunningham runs a great restaurant and executes their concertos well

Solid pub. Minus the lack of bartenders with accents, it's accurate. The beer selection is pretty good and the food is tasty. The menu reads like most standard British fare, but it's a bit fancier and tastier than most bog-standard British pubs. I was psyched to find they had a pub curry and it didn't disappoint. Give this place a shot.

Brixx33 is a lovely quaint atmosphere! The food is always fresh & excellent.  Dan is excellent at pairing you up with the perfect wine for your palate! 
Always a lovely evening when I visit.
Excellent food and service. One of the few healthy options in NOLA. Try the Esmeralda Salad, clean food with great flavor. The mango and cashew juice are good too.

If I do not want to make my own meatballs, I go here. I love their meatballs, whether they are on a sandwich or on top of pasta. Nothing but great food and service here, every time I visit or call for a delivery.

We purchased a groupon to give this place a try. Let me say that I've been doing group ons for a couple years..and I've had some good ones, and some not so good ones. This was..was an almost great one!  I had the three meat combo special, and chose the chicken (forgot the name but breaded) teriyaki beef and Kailua pork.  I was offered slaw or Mac salad and I chose to order both. The food was really good...except I didn't like coconut in my slaw, so didn't eat much, and the macaroni salad was generic store bought, or tasted like it, so I didn't eat it. I like the meat..and they served steamed rice so that helped. I ordered iced tea which they said was brewed but it had a slight old taste. My husband ordered the three meat also, had both kinds of pork and the chicken like mine. He loved the chicken as well..and said the pork was ok. He didn't like the slaw either. Let me say that the slaw would have been super terrific without the coconut. It was called pineapple slaw..so we expected the pineapple..just not the coconut. Coconut lovers will love it. The cabbage and other ingredients as well as the dressing were good. My husband also did not,care for,the iced tea.
The staff was very friendly, and the place seemed clean in general . The atmosphere left something to be desired. We bought the groupon after reading the menu and the place in general, that it had pool tables and such, but discovered that they moved and no longer offered those options.
I asked the counter person who took our order, and she said they didn't have enough business..which is sad because the food is actually pretty good, good portions..and we will go back, so we hope they get some new life. 
If you haven't tried it..you should. If you have, and haven't been back in awhile...you should revisit them.
Local business..rather give them my money than a franchise or chain

I was looking forward to eating here today with my family. It was closed so we had to dine at the Mexican restaurant which was a major disappointment. Next time how about update online that you will not open.
Just had their salad & pizza delivered for the 1st time and everything is amazing. The food, service & delivery time was great. I'm so happy I finally found a new pizza place.

I honestly come here for the bread!!!

Hands down the best bread!!

THREE WORDS: TOMATO BASIL BREAD!!!

If you haven't tried this bread you are SO missing out.

WI-FI is great, never have a issue. My man loves the salads and soups and I have to admit the soups are pretty yummy. French Onion is his fave!!!

Not big on coffee but he states it is pretty good!

Girl at the window had an attitude from the get go. ("Amber" )Let me order and pay for my food before she told me it would be a 10 minute wait for fried chicken at KFC...? I would've happily gone else where but that's okay I'll wait. So in anticipation for my wait I asked for butter & jelly for my biscuits but apparently there's a 10 minute wait on that too. So instead of enjoying my biscuit, I'm writing this review. 
 

*waited 20 minutes

Amazing restaurant. I think I honestly found the greatest waffle in the world, and it is here! Also the Bloody Mary bar is amazing and all their dishes are just so packed full of flavor and the presentation is amazing.

This was one of the most phenomenal dining experiences that I've had in my life. We made a reservation for 6:15 and were seated immediately upon arrival with warm welcome. Jeremy was our server and promptly brought us a bottle of water and poured us two glasses. We decided on a bottle of New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc and began with the mussels in a saffron broth via recommendation; they did not disappoint. Chef Kearney stopped by our table towards the end of our starter to hear our thoughts and you could see her genuine enthusiasm for food. She told us she created the recipe twenty years ago and we ended up taking home the rest of the broth because it was so delicious. Jeremy also suggested the burrata dish and the fire roasted octopus so we chose those as our second course. The burrata was wrapped in shaved zucchini with tomatoes, olives, and toast. The octopus was extremely tender and melted in our mouths with the chorizo, while the white beans and kale balanced it out quite nicely. What really surprised us was our third course, the blue crab spaghetti, which had a thoughtful, residual heat to it. The crab and asparagus were cooked perfectly, the noodles were all dente, and the mixture of evoo, grated cheese, and butter made it even more decadent a treat. We finished off the meal with the toffee cake by Jeremy's recommendation as well as the sweetened goat cheese, strawberries, and cognac. The toffee cake was INCREDIBLE. I also got a cappuccino which was frothy and delicious which balanced out the sweetness, although I didn't even need it. The dessert came out with adorable china plates and spoons, and gave it a very European feeling. The service was top notch, the food was outstanding, and the setting was elegant while still approachable. Our waters were never even close to being empty, our wine as well, and we were remarked with silverware for every course prior to the food arriving. I highly recommend this establishment and I am considering going back tomorrow and every day after. Thank you Oak and Ola for a lovely evening and for setting the bar high for Tampa in regard to fine dining.

I stopped here to have lunch with my family.  The waitress brought us room temp tap water in a cup with no ice & no straw.  I had to ask 3xs for a straw.  We ordered & I wanted pork fried rice instead of reg fried rice, the waitress took issue with that.  I told her I didn't care about an up-charge that was fine, I just wanted pork fried instead.  Then I requested my spring roll not to b Shrimp bc I'm allergic & she was strange about that.  We got our food n ate.  I was not impressed the food was ok.  The pork in my rice was fatty & just not good. My veg spring roll had nothing in it no veggies.  Everyone's food was mediocre.  Next thing we know a party of 10 walk in & guess what they get..... lunch special menus.  We were not given that menu or option to view it when we were seated.  Had I paid less for my mediocre food & service I might have not been so upset.  When we asked the waitress about why we were not given lunch menus she said " you need to ask for it".  Since when is it my job & not the waiters job to ask them about specials.  Any other place will inform you about special either for lunch or of that day.  I will not be going back here & I don't nor will I recommend it to anyone.
Excellent food. Excellent service.  A must to stop at while traveling thru Delaware!   Also the prices are phenomenal as well as the margaritas!

I'd been wanting to try this place for a while and finally got the chance tonight :) It did not disappoint. While we only went for apps and happy hour drinks, we were so satisfied. The drinks were strong, the meat pies are homemade and fantastic, but what really makes this place is the service. We sat at the bar and immediately felt like family. Richie took great care of us and the rest of the staff hung out and offered recommendations as well!
Very cool French Quarter spot off the beaten path. We can't wait to come back for a meal and enjoy their entrees and their lovely courtyard.

Before I say anything, the fact of the matter is that this place just isn't convenient for most of Delco. Heck, I've lived here for most of my 40 years and never set foot back here until today. As previous reviews have stated this place caters to the surrounding workers. But my curiosity finally got the better of me after driving past the sign I don't know how many times in my life. 

First impression, the place is cleaner than I thought it would be, and the people who work there are very nice. You have to appreciate that. 

So one bacon egg and cheese on a long roll, order of home fries, and cup of coffee later for $10.25 and I'm ready to call it pretty good. Everything was fresh and well made. Just not overly special. 

And I will be the first to call this out. So, if you get the platter with a bacon egg and cheese omelet with home fries and toast, it's $6.50. My meal was basically the same order with the long roll instead of toast for $8.25.  I felt like the other guy had just as much as I had. Heck I think his omelet might have been bigger than what I had in my roll. I definitely had omelet envy. 

But I won't hold hard feelings. They're too nice to dislike, and in the end the food was just good enough.  Just try to order the right combo for the price.

I was really psyched to get some Puerto Rican food. I've seen this place under the El, and wondered how it was. 

I had a friend tell me it was decent, so I went there one day.

The girl at the bar was very sweet, but I just really couldn't get over the flipping around on the prices. I felt like I was right back in Puerto Rico having to scrutinize every bill to see what they slid on there. 

The receipt was not itemized, so I really came out unclear as to why my meal was 4 dollars more. The meal itself was pretty amateur. The cerdo frito was ok, I guess. The rest of the sampler, the quesadilla was soggy and amateur. The tostones were tostones, and I just expected so much more for close to $15. The fried chicken were like little rubber balls. The presentation was bad too. They through it in a styrofoam container that I would get at a papi store for $4.


The food alone would be 3.5 stars, but the fact that they are still handing out menus with false (old,) prices is what got me. It would have been one thing if she handed me the menu, and let me know in advance that the pricing was off due to pandemic inflation, but they were very "islander" about it, and handed me a mystery bill with no explanation. Slick and slimy.

The neighborhood is changing - you guys can charge $15, but you gotta be on point, and up front, and step your game up in general. Sloppy!

Eeeeew...the wings were the lowest quality. The interior of the wings were black, seemed to have clotted blood and there was significant structural damage to the bones themselves. I can only imagine the poor chickens these wings came from...scooped up the sick ones and sent 'em to Pizza Baron. Also the portion was the weakest ever. Been going there for years and this was the fewest wings they have ever served...as soon as I picked up the box, I could tell they hella skimped! Which was ok this time since they were so gross. I've seen poor wing quality here before...took a significant break last time and came back a year later to find the quality was back up. Not  right now...more like cancer wings. 

Ordered a double batch of fries...they were good but a wimpy portion too. They are cutting corners here at the expense of the food quality and portion size. Lastly I ordered heavy sauce and got wings that scarcely had enough sauce. 

To bad...I hate the disappointment of giving in to the seduction of junk food and having a poor experience. New (cheapskate) owners? Baron...get it together yo!

[Updated June 2018]

I still think Lilly's make the best tacos in town.

Try the grilled onions with jalapeños for $1 - a tasty addition to your tacos.

Arrive a little later to avoid the crowds. 

Consider trying some of the other meats (beyond carne asada) you will not be disappointed. Also, take the time and go through the different bottled salsas, you'll find just the right one.

My recommendation: lengua with onions and cilantro, the red salsa in the bottle, a squirt of the dark salsa in the bottle, finished with a dose of fresh lime and a dash of salt. It's like being transported back to a market in Mexico City.

The actual building is really nice and the rooftop is awesome. I cannot speak to food or anything beyond the drinks and live music, which were both good. As with every other bar in Nashville the drinks are super expensive (though not expensive than any of its neighbors). There was live music upstairs when we visited and it wasn't too busy so it was a great experience. Bathrooms were clean which is also a bonus!

I work across the street so have frequented Nelson's quite a number of times. I'm able to grab some hearty, high quality sandwiches and paninis.  You can get a little fancy with prosciutto or artichokes paninis.    

It's staffed by a group of very diligent men and women.  The lunch rush is crazy so I'd recommend getting here early, or just picking it up in the morning.  To avoid the wait sometimes I'll just grab a soup and piece of bread, their soups are pretty good though.  The place also moonlights as a mini grocery store, so you have quite a few things you can grab, they have a wide selection of chips and not just Doritos.  The only minor gripe is some of the drinks are on the pricey side but that's about it.
Great location. However the price is slightly high for the quality of the product and service. I would compare the pastries, iced coffee and service to one of those airport grab and go stops.
Not a bad cheaper casino buffet -- about $8.99 with a player's club card.  There's usually enough decent food to choose from.  There's always a carving station, and the staff is pretty friendly.

This is one of our BR favs! Quick and casual. Always tasty! D had the Korean Lettuce Wraps and I tried the black bean tacos. Both were flavorful and filling.  We also split the roasted Brussels Sprouts side. More yumminess. When weather is warmer, we'll be back to enjoy dinner in the deck overlooking the canal.

5 starts for our server alone.  Dabrielle, you are a gem. You took our party of 9 in stride. Not only providing amazing service, but you constantly had a smile on your face.  

The food was very good. Everyone had something  different.  The hotdog was humungous and amazing. Burgers were good. Beers were huge.  The trifecta is an amazing option for those who are indesicisive.

I had been living in the area for about 5 years and never went here. One day I decided to go because I heard they have breakfast. So me and a few friends went and to be honest it was not as good as I thought it would be. The service was okay, they were nice but my omelet was not hot. It wasn't even warm. If I ever do go back I just get their wings and pizza next time

I highly recommend the green curry and the sticky rice. 

I thought the (medium) green curry had the perfect amount of flavor and spiciness. There wasn't that much meat or veggies but it comes with a lot of rice. I personally like having more of the curry sauce itself (so that I can drown my rice in it). 

I love that you can get sticky rice as a dessert by itself because most Thai places I've been to only have it with either mango chunks or ice cream. The grouper fillet with basil sauce and the pad thai were also very good. 

The tom yum soup was too sour for my tastes, but I'm not usually a fan of tom yum soups in general. The satay chicken tasted more like regular grilled chicken and the fried banana's batter and honey overpowered the actual banana taste.

Server was so nice and friendly. He probably thought my family was weird. My parents spent the entire time focused on their phones whereas my brother and I were the ones actually paying attention to the food and interacting with him.

Only thing that I don't love about this place was the noise level; I felt like I was at a bar. I almost had to yell my order to the server at times for him to hear me. It's fine if you're with some friends or your SO but I felt like it wasn't very fitting for a family dinner.

The restaurant was also very accommodating when we asked if we could have a half order of the fried banana with a full order of the sticky rice (instead of half of each).

I also wish it wasn't street parking. We came on a weeknight so parking was pretty easy. But I may not want to come on a weekend and have to deal with finding a spot (trying to find a parking spot can make me somewhat anxious). Granted, the spots are huge so even if you do have to parallel park, it should be pretty painless.
Ted used to own Oreland Pizza years ago and the food was good then.....now its great!  Rolls for steaks are outstanding and the pizza is still very good.

Outstanding service. Food is some of the best in Media.
 Other breakfast venues in the borough need to take note.
Pancakes, French Toast BLTs, Pineapple stuffing ham sandwich, Brown Sugar and spiced thickly cut bacon and Fair Trade coffee set the pace for a very good menu.

I'm hooked! I want to go back and try everything on the menu. The wings were insanely good. Pho was deep in flavor. Staff was super attentive and on point. They were also really good at accommodating to our 2 1/2 year old which is always a plus.

Upon recommendation of a couple of the staff at one of the Cooking School locations in the French Quarter, we stopped in to Drago's late in the evening to try the broiled oysters. My husband also ordered a mojito (which he enjoyed very much) and a spicy praline parfait (vanilla ice cream in a thin fried pastry crust, topped with a wet pecan topping). The dessert was good, but for $10, I would have expected something with a little more panache than ice cream and topping in an edible bowl. The oysters were certainly a standout. Our server was friendly and attentive, even though we were only there for an extravagant "snack." So yay, we are definitely fans. Husband is now back at the gym burning off all of those extra calories from our caloric escapades in the Big Easy.

I will start this review by saying that we eat at a lot of upscale restaurants. This is a new restaurant - they are trying to be upscale serving tapas - totally over priced for the quality of the food - they are in a great location but if they are going to charge the prices that they are charging the food quality needs to be better and the sizes of the dishes would need to be regular serving sizes.
One of my favorite places everytime I visit Reno. Cioppini and oysters the best. The restaurant is on top of the of the middle of the road. Love it.

We came here at the recommendation of our neighborhood website. It was easy to find and not a far drive at all. Decent parking. Loved the atmosphere and decor. Service was great. Attentive without being pushy. Great specials. Food came out in the right time frames, not rushed. Bruschetta was amazing, Caesar salad and bread was OK. Croutons on salad looked store bought, not homemade as I would've thought. Our dinners were pretty good and huge servings, (so that means two meals for me :)) Prices were reasonable too! But still not our fave Italian spot (Cafe Cibo - that one is pretty hard to beat :/).

The spot to get a bowl of gumbo! It was my first time,  but I'll definitely be back. I got the Mumbo Gumbo and was definitely satisfied. The shop is a cozy spot with limited seating, but if you have the time, try and visit. Chef Ron himself walked the room to make sure everything was good which I love. A great place for all

first of all, drive thru being closed is super inconvenient. also i don't understand why you guys can't make food properly. it's a fast food place. it cannot be hard. like how are you gonna give me a famous bowl with no gravy??? like thanks for the dry potatoes

Hank is a really interesting man who learned how to smoke meat in Texas.  This man is a Pitmaster!  

The best smoked corned beef on the planet is to be found at Hanks. Delicious brisket, too.  Make sure you get the potato latkes and slaw. You will enjoy everything you order here. 

Interesting selection of sodas and fried pies. 

Takeout or eat in your car only.  There are no tables. 

Hank's is a must whenever I'm in Indy.

My wife and I had a coupon here from the Entertainment Book; since it was so close to our house, we decided to give it a shot. We both ordered the sub sandwiches (I had the meatball sub & my wife got the chicken Parmesan sub); I will admit that it was a great sandwich! I really liked the atmosphere because it made me feel like I wasn't in the south, for a change. We will definitely be coming back here, as the price is very fair.

Like other reviewers, I was initially a bit put off by the decor (it really is a market) and they don't serve alcohol. However the food was AMAZING they ask beforehand and spiced exactly to our specifications, authentic and delicious, plus reasonably priced (they accept credit cards). The staff was very gracious and friendly. We will definitely be returning! In fact, I cannot wait to go back. YUM YUM

I'm employing the same standard for this place as I did for Slyce. The food is good (very good) but the service is bad. You can get good food and better service someplace else.

This place has the standard Mexican restaurant decor. Vibrant colors. Couple of flat screens. Pay at the register. 

The menu is confusing. There was something like 30 or 40 different dinner combos offered on a menu that was difficult to read and not in any particular order. Could you not just list what you serve and have the customer pick two or three items to make a combo? Must I choose combo #32 and hope it comes as indicated on the menu?

Anyway, poor menu aside, the waiter wasn't very interested in doing his job. Now that I think about it, the hostess was just kind of sitting around too and wasn't interested in seating anyone.

Drinks were good. Food was excellent but the presentation was lacking. Basically, mi abuelita cooks the food and brings it out. Everyone else here just kind of hangs around.

Shop around before coming here.

The owner is very polite, if you are looking for Russian food you should go there, all fresh and not expensive for a grocery store at all, people who work there are also nice with customers , didn't expect that I will visit the Santa Barbara and find Russian store there , 

Five stars , excellence

I've eaten at Clear Sky Cafe 3 times now, once for brunch, once for lunch and once for dinner.  The most recent was dinner on Mother's day.  
The food and service were good.  Everyone had some kind of seafood, with the Diver Scallops winning for best seafood, and the potstickers appetizer.  They were both excellent.  Everything else was good.  The only disappointment was the Lamb Kebab appetizer which was ground lamb, dry and lacked flavor.  
I was impressed, Clear Sky Cafe is known for breakfast and brunch, but they do a very good dinner as well.

Great Italian dinner great ambiance! Hostess was wonderful! Recommend to make reservations. We yelped for an Italian restaurant we came here! Great choice! Everything we ordered was excellent dinner to desert! Service was great! We will definitely come back when we visit!

Good food and what appears to be authentic Mexican. The menu is somewhat limiting but good enough. Portions are small though and prices are way high. I get that it's a premium to eat in Main Street in new hope but 60 for 2 people to eat lunch seems like a double premium. Good fresh food though - all the pork dishes are good and the beef tacos excellent. Not sure i can go back and pay $17 for 2 steak tacos though - and then $5 for chips and salsa...

Warm and efficient waiters with fresh tasty salads in Clearwater beach.  We were impressed with our fabulous find while walking.  The Spotted Donkey is bright and clean.  The best service and menu here.  Loved the place settings which made the food seem festive.  Great salsa.

DO NOT STAY HERE if you like a nice place.  The furnishing look 40 years old, the POO BROWN carpet is a trip hazard as it has waves in it from being loose.  The bed is as hard as a rock, in fact I am wondering if it is just a box spring.  They only give you 3 hangers.  I called, thats all you get is 3 hangers.  The dining room table is BIG TIME wobbly/broken.  They had no paper towels or sponge to do dishes.  Called office, they do not provide those items.  There is no bathroom vanity, just a very small sink.  This morning we woke up at 4:am and it was 55 degrees in the condo, no reason why.  When we went to bed it was 70.  Tried to heat the place up, but it is slow going, it stopped heating at 65 degrees.  After reading about another person who stayed here and encountered mold, I do not even want to take a shower. The balcony is SMALL and the chairs on it are small and uncomfortable.  I give this resort a 1 star.

The food at this place is amazing. If you like pulled pork sandwiches then this is a must. Best one I've had in a while. Location is a little small but more than accommodating. Great part is that they deliver to Figueroa Mountain Brewery.

Netcost is an awesome place for grocery shopping. I travel around half an hour from Southern New Jersey to visit this location. 

There are two Netcosts in Philly and this is the newer one. It is clean and bright. My main reason for the trip is the prepared foods. Although I am a South Philly Italian, I have an affinity for Eastern European food--and in particular, syrniki. Syrniki are Tvorog Pancakes. Tvorog can best be described in western speak as "farmers cheese"--somewhere between cottage cheese and ricotta cheese. They are sweet and sinfully delicious.

Netcost's syrniki rock, as do all the prepared foods, including the "sweet" beet salad, sauteed cabbage, and all types of prepared fish, chicken, rice, all types of olives, soups, cutlets/meats, and salads that can only be seen to get a good description. Words fail me.

I have never seen such an extensive tea and honey aisle. Most labels are in Russian, but if you look hard enough, you can generally figure out what it is--if not, grab an employee and they'll help you.

Their deli case is stocked with salamis and kielbasa, cheese, and lunchmeats. But the magnet to many souls will be the smoked and dried fish. Admittedly, I did not know what most of them were, but if they're ever sampling, I'll test it. 

As an Italian, I've always thought Italy to be the pinnacle of the baked goods craft. But the tortes, sweet "dessert" pierogi, sweet baked I-don't-even-know-what-they're-called goods are not to be beaten by any culture. In the back left hand corner will be baker racks--buy everything you can from these usually three racks. 

The second reason I make this journey is for the frozen pelmeni. I buy pounds and pounds of these and return to Netcost once my freezer is empty of them. My favorite are the Siberian. Try each and every variety. They also have a Halal version.

Their fruit and vegetables are always high quality, and like any other market, certain times of year are better priced than others. I have scored some really good deals on mangoes and tomatoes, but not on my latest visit which was 12/22/17. They have vegetable and fruit varieties I have not seen in any other market, and for some reason, they have a ton of different apples. I noticed many different colored carrots on my latest trip.

I cannot say enough good about this market. If there were one complaint, is that the hours are a bit odd--they are open 9 to 9. The late opening is a bit rough for me, but if that's my only complaint, that's certainly a win in anyone's book.

Heard they remodeled and theres new
Ownership, so thought we'd check it out considering used to have awful employees there and figured sonce new ownership, fresh new faces. Place looks really nice until I saw Nicki Pratt walk up to us. I cannot believe this North Valleys gutter rat works there again! She is so rude and an absolute horrible person, one of the reasons why we stopped going into Sneakers was because of her. Last I heard she got fired because she was stealing. How could they let her back? Maybe the new owners dont know. But we will NOT be returning because of her.
Best barbeque in Reno. Cooked to perfection. The sauce is the right amount of sweet and savory. The full rack is amazing.
Great food with great service.  Right inside the Harrah hotel.  Food is a huge amount so bring your appetite.
Great quizzo on Monday night! Deb's the best. She's the owner and so sweet. Definitely my favorite bar in NoLibs.

Excellent location, classy, modern decor, nice lobby, valet, a separate bar area for both indoor & outdoor by a warm cozy fire pit.  Really impressed w/ the food as well.  

All of the servers were efficient & nice.  Eric was our server.  The pretzel bread was delish.  Drinks came out immediately.  Shared the entree, Scallops w/ English Peas , Parmesan Risotto, which was very tasty.  The scallops were perfectly seared & the risotto was also cooked well, but it had too much 'cold slaw' on top.  I scooped it aside, extra peas would've been better than this odd mixture on top of such a savory warm risotto.

The Lamb Chops were cooked perfectly & delish!  Ended the meal w/ the Carrot Cake to-go.  I love the cream cheese frosting, however the slivers of coconut or carrot in the layers of the cake were too much.  Don't think I'll eat Carrot Cake for awhile. 

Overall, I will be back to try more entrees & sushi, which Eric recommended the unique popular 'Prime Roll.'  The Teriyaki Salmon w/ Sticky Rice & Chilean Sea Bass also look tasty.

We had a very good experience at Blush. We went in for a late snack/ lunch, the sunny terrace appealed to us, as did the lounge menu. Our waiter emphasized that it was happy hour time - get one of the chosen snacks, get one free. So we ordered 2 flatbreads for sharing, one with Brie, bacon and mushrooms, the other with dried figs, rocket and Gorgonzola. I found both to be well sized, tasty and original. We only had iced water (loved the slice of cucumber they served it with) and sodas so I cannot comment on cocktails or wine, but we both appreciated the free soda refills on this hot afternoon. Overall it ended up being great value for money for a light but tasty lunch. Blush would probably be a very cool place for sunset drinks and bites - when I can imagine a fills up a bit more.

We recently ate here after several years! They had some great choices on a Prix Fix menu for $39... Shrimp cocktail, soup or salad and delicious filet mignon! The service was attentive . Our server Brad made sure we had everything the way we liked it and helped with some suggestions! A wonderful meal! We will go back sooner rather than later!

Had the NY Strip steak and it was cooked perfectly and on point. Came with a side of veggies. I ordered a Cesar salad and their great fries. It was very good. They give you bread to start out and it's warm bread with a soft butter. It's a higher end restaurant so it is a little expensive BUT you are paying for what you get. Waitstaff was great and had no complaints about that drinks.

AWFUL. I have been there more than once, and it was never great but ok. However the most recent time we went was the WORST EXPERIENCE I have ever had at a restaurant. We were sat and no one ever came to our table, I had to go get them, she got us the wrong appetizer, the food was awful and cold, everything took forever even though the restaurant was empty!!! The waitress was just terrible, I had to go find her several times. We almost got up and left and I wish we had! At the end of it our check was wrong and I never complain but when I did finally talk to the manager she didn't even care and did nothing about it. She didn't apologize or offer any kind of restitution. On our way out I did see that waitress was eating at a table, that would explain why she never came to ours!

Walking around the streets of New Orleans led us here and it was a good experience but not necessarily the best food. Not knowing all of the mom and pops places in the area we saw this and headed in. The service was great and friendly and the menu had lots of options listed. I ordered the jambalaya and it was sadly a little underwhelming. Not what I expected when I think of jambalaya from Louisiana. It was super dry and seemed to be the last of the pot. I won't give up on this place I'd like to have the opportunity to try it again on a different day.

Words don't describe how unexpectedly fantastic our family found this place. We were looking for a great sushi place and looked to Yelp and discovered one of the best in Tampa. My wife, 3 kids (all under 12) and I throughly enjoyed all aspects of this place.  

We felt that everything from the understated decor on through the food were exceptional.  We found the potstickers were excellent, and the "Out of Control" roll were but a few of the outstanding selections we found on the menu.

My kids asked to make this a regular family hangout.  

We will certainly be back.

The hostess (wearing many hats as well) working the weekend of 1/22 is PURE JOY. She made every morning lovely and we felt completely safe during the current climate. The food is beyond delicious and made with love, thank you team Josephine Estelle! Cannot wait to return and I will sing your praises to one and all!

Zesto's is consistently great and fast.  We tend to order their pizza and their wings which are both great but we've ordered cheese steaks, gyros and fries and they're consistent in their quality.  If you're looking to be impressed this is the way to go.

This visit was a huge disappointment! While this was our second time here, it was so awful we walked out. We were seated right away at a booth right behind the bar area. Neither of the bartenders were wearing face masks while making drinks and handling items behind the bar or washing their hands. That's disappointing with everything we are dealing with right now. 

Next, our server was awful. I can't even say who, because we were never introduced. He literally ran to and from our table and we couldn't speak or ask him anything as far as drinks were concerned.

When he finally arrived and stayed for us to order, he advised us that at 4 o'clock they were sold out of the Spaghetti-n-Meatball. Okay, so next choice, Biscuits and Crazy, then. He said and I quote, "Oh no, I'd advise against that. I'm really good at making it myself and it just isn't up to par so I want you to know what you're getting into." 

Okay, well literally everything we wanted he had issue with other than a burger, however, we didn't want burgers for dinner. We wound up leaving and going elsewhere for dinner. At this time we are undecided if we will be back.
When they said country breakfast, I didn't realize they meant feed an entire country!  It was great!

Fried chicken heaven!!! Why pay $15+ for subpar chicken and waffles at a restaurant when I can get 16 pieces of sumptuous chicken pieces for $20 at Popeye's and incorporate them into my breakfast, second breakfast, elevenses, luncheon, afternoon tea, dinner AND supper? This is fried chicken at its best. 

I come here twice a year. Each time it receives a standing ovation from the Middle Earth.
The brisket and the ribs are really good. I like the mild sauce over the spicy and I usually like spicy sauce...

Very rude manager. We have a large party and asked to move our table a little back because of a pole blocking us from half of our party we got permission from our server and then got yelled at by the manger. Terrible rude management. NEVER coming back.
Just had a party for 16  there last night.  The service was excellent and food delicious. Thanks to David and Joe for a special evening.

Picked up food here for the first time last night.  With the exception that they did not record our order correctly, and we received cheese bread instead of garlic/cheese knots, everything else was outstanding.

My wife ordered the meatball sub and was thrilled.  It was more than enough for two meals, and the entire presentation was fabulous!  Tasty meatballs, great sauce.  I ordered Dave's Sausage Bomber...it was completely over the top delicious.  The combination of onions, peppers, cappicola, sausage, sauce and cheese was incredible.  The bread was perfect, crisp and chewy on the outside, but tender and soft on the inside.

We will definitely be back.

I thought the food was good. Since we had never dined here before, we thought we would take the opportunity to try some small plates and come in for restaurant week. 

Everything was certainly cooked well. The scallops were very tender with a nice sear and the salmon was also seared and prepared nicely with orange, lemon and lime citrus. Dry aged sirloin was spot on and the sides of mash and green beans were good. Were these meals exceptionally good? I wish I could say yes. 

The service itself was top notch, what I expected. We decided on a bottle of wine with dinner and our server had us use the iPad to help select our wine. A definitely new and fun experience. You can choose by varietal, food pairings, region etc. He was definitely on top of refilling the wine and coming around at the right time to ask how the food was and if we needed anything else. Although, my opinion about the server himself is my own...seemed very mechanical, hardly smiled.

Espresso cake was the perfect size for its amount of creamy, chocolatey, richness.

I am a really big fan of this Starbucks location. The staff is friendly, efficient, a little quirky, and they are already starting to remember my order (despite my only becoming a semi-regular about a week ago). 

It's also one of the biggest, most wide-open Starbuck's I've ever been to, which makes me very happy. I'm used to going to Starbucks and struggling to get a spot at one of the four available tables. This location however, has something like 12 round tables (seating two to four people) , 10 large lounge chairs, a bar, a long table with lamps and several side tables. And there appears to always be available seating. 

If you're the kind of person who enjoys doing work or reading in a location outside of your office or home, this is a great place to go.
Now acceptable breakfast place menu  is all some also they have a best coffee we will back

One of few indian restaurants that I think serves authentic indian food. Food was great we ordered garlic naan(love it), spicy seekh kebabs- it is made of ground lamb serve sizzling, I like it but I wish they serve it with a dipping sauce but because we ordered curry goat which we request to be spicy also I dip it in the curry sauce aaaah so good. If you like spicy food you can request it to be spicy and they will not fail you to the kick you looking for. Service is fast and they're nice people they refill our rice and ask if everything is good. Defenitely going back.  The only thing is, I wish they wipe the restaurant, its not dirty but its dusty. But food wise. It was delish!!!!!

The spice level here on most dishes is not for the faint of palate. Your tongue will surely tingle, particularly if you order something with their special Hatch green chile sauce.

That said, they do offer American breakfast offerings, which will not set your tastebuds aflame. But why would you want to do that when you can get a pile of hash browns, machaca, green chile sauce and cheese... all sitting under a couple of eggs fried to your specs. Once you pop the yolks  and put the first bite in your mouth, your nose will run as much as the yolks.

But eggs are not just for breakfast here. You can get any kind of enchiladas with a couple of those babies right on top.

There's all the other usual suspects on the menu: burritos, tacos, tamales, quesadillas, rellenos... even stuffed sopapillas and burgers. But the star of the show here is their green chile sauce. If you can take the heat, that's definitely the way to go.
Mmm... Got the shrimp tostadas and the spicy pork burrito. Waay better than ordering my mexicano off the grubhub. I shall be back

Update: I wanted and did actually love this place in the beginning. Not sure if the quality of everything just went down or if they are just EXTREMELY inconsistent. Either way not a good thing. The most recent time I went the food was inedible which is very sad to say. They need to do some more training of the kitchen.

Kimball Musk did it again with another great Indy restaurant, this time more fast casual. The space is beautiful and I love how they incorporated the buildings history into the space by including the old sign in the dining room area. The restaurant is definitely family oriented with a kids menu and games. It's more causal than his other restaurant, hedgerow but the quality of food is great. Serving sizes are also very good. My favorite part though is the outdoor seating. They have a great front deck area and of course plenty of parking. Perfect place for a causal lunch or dinner on a nice summer d

I love their albondigas con ajillo (garlic meatballs) which is served in a gravy, with some deep-fried potato cubes thrown in.

What's great about Guido's is the two different menus they offer simultaneously: Spanish (tapas menu) and Italian. Sometimes one might be on the Hill, but not be in the mood for Italian. Guido's offers just that.

I suggest going here with a group when you don't know what to eat. Although the Italian menu looks pretty standard for St. Louis in terms of Italian food, it's quality and comes in large portions.

I've been a huge Mongolian BBQ fan for...  wow...  now I need to date myself...  ummmm...  35 years.   Over the years, Mongolian BBQ places have been pretty much all the same, mom and pop places, and then a few mall places popped up here and there, all pretty much the same.

So we end up at this place and see how you turn a Mongolian BBQ into a Franchise type chain, and it was really cool.   They have way more options in the meat and sauce dept. than other MBBQ places do, and a good addl. menu option assortment.

Great system, good service, good prices.  And as with any Mongolian BBQ place, if you don't like what you had, it was kinda your fault, since you chose the ingredients.

So I am not a fan of chain type places, and the fact that they call . their waiters "Warriors" is a little cheesy to me, but I have to admit that I really do dig this place and will be back!
2 words.  FOOD POISONING.   It took 25 mins to get our food and there was no one in there.  I will say the food was good but worth gastro cleansing.

I enjoy every meal I have had from cannolis. A few of my favorite items include their blt salad, pick a pair and their boneless wings. They have the best creamy Italian dressing of any other Italian place that I've had. Not to mention, it's a great atmosphere and a good place to have a small gathering in their back room. I recommend going here!

So, everyone claims that these are the best bagels in town.  While I haven't tried them all, I can't really give this place a great review.  I can see how others really like the bagels here.  They're not really to my personal tastes, but I can't really slight them too much.  They're just not for me.

There's three problems that I have with this place that make this place not 'my' bagel shop.  First off, the bagels are somehow lacking for my tastes.  They're not bad, but not great.  The mix that they use for the "Everything" bagel has far too much rye in it.  The bagel's dough seems to be a bit bland somehow, although I can't figure out why.  The flavored bagels are generally pretty good, but nothing I tried really stood out to me.

I am also not a fan of the way that they make the eggs for their egg and cheese bagel combos.  This is a big point for me, as one of my most favorite things in the world is an egg and cheese bagel.  They fry the eggs like a short order cook would at a greasy spoon, and then fold the pseudo omelet up onto the bagel.  I'd rather the egg not be cooked that fashion, but more like how most other bagel shops get their eggs - that spongy mini block of eggy goodness that's about 1" thick and even across the bagel.  These eggs aren't like that.

Lastly, the price.  They're way to expensive for what you get, IMHO.

I'd give them a two star review if it weren't for a couple of good redeeming qualities.  The place is super inviting.  I spent a while reading out in the sun in front of the place, and it was very relaxing.  Also, the staff is great.  Very friendly, very attentive, and they all had great attitudes.  On the few days that I've been there, they all were absolutely impeccable. 

Also, there's a pretty creative menu of stuff to toss on the bagels, as well as a slew of other non-bagel related items on the menu.  I'm sure I'll get back to this place at some point and try them.  However, when the sign above the door say's "Jack's Bistro and 'Famous Bagels'," the bagels had better be better then what I had there!  It's like going to a store that claims to be the world's biggest flower shop, but the store is no bigger then my living room.
The cakes are over priced and not worth the money. Wait staff is wonderful but my favorite waitress Stacy is gone. She made the experience worth the taste of the sub-par cakes.

Just had Quesa-D-Ya's for the first time today.  I ordered the traditional chicken quesadilla.  It was MASSIVE and loaded with ingredients, which was great.  It was crispy rather than mushy and gooey, even after driving for 10 minutes, which was a pleasant surprise.

The taste was good, but it was quite "plain" tasting.  It really could have used some pico or salsa as the dark salsa included wasn't very flavorful.  The amount of cheese is also quite skimpy.  

These guys are less than a mile from my house and I will definitely give it another try, request some sour cream and/or pico and update my rating/review.

Food is good I had the mixture of everything in a seaweed wrap and it was delicious. It's huge and can be shared by two people but I ate it all that's how good  it was .The place is clean and the staff are nice and accommodating. I recommend this place.
Bunless burgers with all the veggies. Quick "emergency meal" on those nights when I just can't get it together to make dinner.

Omg!! You've got to be kidding me!! We went there Saturday oct 5th at 10 o'clock at nite. They close at 11:00pm. Waiter was quick to get our drinks and order at that time. Only two tables going at that time. The other table check out so it was just us. 40 mins after we put in our order, again only ones that are trying to get food, a grey haired man came and stood by our table and looked at the tv and asked if the Rays May win. We said we hope so and my girl said how bout someone giving me more tea and how bout our food. Again we are the only ones there. There was already, not good yelling was coming from the kitchen. He went back then there was more yelling. I decided then it was time to go!! We didn't want our food spit into cause of the problems they obviously have. Haven't been to this place in 3 years cause last time there they tried to pass off top sirloin steaks for filets. Again you hate to complain cause they will spit in your shit. I know meat, I was a butcher. That's why we weren't there for 3 years and will never go back and advise anyone not to go there. And this is the original Outback!! What a shame and a joke!! All involved should be looking for a different line of work. Oh and to make matters worse after we walked to my car they wanted me to come back and get our food that was already boxed up!! You've got to be kidding!! I wouldn't feed that shit to my pets and WONT be back ever!! Go to Long Horn on N. Westshore. Never a prob. Great service by people who know how to treat people no matter what time!!! And ALWAYS right!! This place is a joke!!!! Please thy Long Horn!! Enough said!!!! Manager. Don't send me any coupons or whatever!! Your BURNT!!!!

Pretty much once a month (or more) I crave pizza that I am either too lazy or too unskilled to make. I love making my own basil/mozzarella/red sauce pizza...but sometimes I want a pie that has a little flair.

There's newer pizza places in Indy and Carmel that someday I just might try...but for now, I'm perfectly content with Puccini's down the street.

When we go, it's always busy (dine in and carry out) but the staff never seems frazzled. Their newish bleu cheese wedge is fabulous, they have an ok beer/wine menu, and though we've never had their pastas...they look incredible.

As for pizzas, we pretty consistently order the Campfire (onion marmalade -- I could drink you), but the Veg Head is yummy, too!

They have calzones and a daily lunch special.

Really impressed with everything here from start to finish. COVID precautions were done well, with hand sanitizer at every table, mask rules enforced, and tables set a good distance a way from each other. 

The food was great. Between my husband and I, we tried 7 different tacos, each one was better than the next. Great flavors, very well executed. Our favorite was definitely the Buffalo Chicken Wing Taco. 

The highlight of our experience was for sure our server, Montana, she was excellent and had a fantastic attitude and gave us great recommendations. We will definitely be back!

Pretty good ice cream. It has a very soft texture, natural fresh ingredients. No mix-in flavors - the ice cream itself is flavored. Nice people working. They don't make their own cones - they are laser focused on making their ice cream great. The store has a nice courtyard that is dog-friendly.

If I could leave this restaurant and experience a one star review I would. I wanted to order local during this pandemic to support our local. Not only was Tammy rude on the phone as we placed the order, she was SO rude when picking up our order. We let James the manager know how rude she was and he defended her with "she is stressed by doing the online orders herself." Neither cared about customer service and ruined my lunch experience. Will not ever support a Tazikis again and I recommend you not going if you're expecting a friendly staff.

Went there to get lunch today.  It was almost empty, yet the people that worked there did not turn around to acknowledge me.  When I interrupted them, they seemed annoyed.  Service is a "1". I walked out so cannot rate the food.
This location  makes the best tasting pizza that I have had from many different Little Ceasars locations.  It always

Ordered the steak and frites and started with the French onion soup. Highly recommend both. Really cool cocktail menu too---loved the Vanilla Old Fashioned. This restaurant also fit perfectly into the cute little town of Zionsville. Ambiance was great given that they retrofitted a hotel (Auberge is French for hostel).
Super dee duper service and super dee Duper food...no issues at all even the restrooms were super dee duper clean!
Fantastic food and great service. Can't wait to go back! Octopus with ham hock grits were especially awesome.

These guys were super accommodating to my wedding party and I.  We chose this as the spot for our rehearsal because we wanted to do something were everyone could get fed well at a reasonable price that fell within the budget of my new hubby and I.  With a group that has a propensity for drinking, pizza and beer was an obvious solution!  The initial allure to choose precinct was simply because the Channelside location was within walking distance of our rehearsal at the aquarium, but as I began to discuss my plans with the shop owner it became evident the variety of reasons why precinct was a great choice: 1) great food - read the other reviews, this is good pizza!  2) great service - the owner was incredibly responsive via email, made special accommodations for my group, when we got there everything was set up, and the wait staff was prepared with my pre-order and totally on top of it! 3) great price - as a local I am familiar with the expenses one can expect when dining in Channelside!  This place was great, much less for a group to eat at than say "Thai Thani" or "Tina Tapas" or any of the other places around the corner.  My big dinner went swimmingly because of the work an planning that the staff put into my event, and everyone really loved the food.

They yelled at us for sitting in. Reserved table after telling us to sit anywhere. The rest of the dinner was equally disorganized. The apology we received was pretty annoying because it wasn't for the miscommunication but rather for the fact that the reserved table was never used after all. The food was overpriced.

I've actually grown to like Carl's Jr. I never thought I would but this location has won me over! The staff are friendly, patient and efficient. The food is pretty good when you compare it to other fast food. The burgers are tasty and have a ton of fixins'. They recently had a 2 burgers for $5 deal and I was very surprised at the size of the burgers! Very filling and great value.

This location is very nice. It has a bunch of different seating options, clean and bright, high ceilings, and two TVs playing sports in the corner. Of course they have a drive thru, which I've never used. 

They have a yelp check in offer for free fries and drink when you buy a thickburger.

Food was served very fast and fresh. I wanted something a little healthy- a salad- but the crispy chicken looked too good to pass. White meat, nice portion, hand breaded. I had the honey mustard dressing (creamy and a little tangy) and they gave me the choice of having it mixed in or on the side. Everything tasted good, though a little more flavor in the breading wouldn't hurt. Plenty of seating inside and out. Staff is very attentive- even cleared my food tray when I was five. I will be back again.

Honestly stopped here for a bathroom drink and then customarily ordered a drink. They had a chalkboard outside that said their special today was a watermelon elderberry sangria, and I couldn't resist. It was a great and light break from the other drinks! The staff was friendly and helpful.
Fettuccine Alfredo was second to none. Absolutely amazing. We had a large group with kids. The staff was great with us.
Love this spot to watch the games on Sunday. tv's everywhere and a great atmosphere. Love the variety of tap beer selection!

They are swamped during weekday lunches.  So even though I waited 17 minutes for my take out order I'll definitely be back once they have time to figure everything out.  So glad there is this location rather than having to drive all the way to Metairie.

Why can't I give this restaurant 0 star? The Chinese waitress is so rude. She gave me the wrong takeout food and asked me to walk one mile in the storm to give it back. They had another good Chinese waiter but he had left. I won't suggest any friend to go there because of their terrible service.
This is one of the best diners in New Jersey. Breakfast all day and open 24/7. Great friendly service. Excellent Greek and other salads. Extensive omelette choices. Great coffee.

Good for what it is. A little breakfast and lunch spot. Really good biscuits and gravy and good eggs and such. I was happy this was going in to have a new breakfast spot. I wish we could get a good brunch spot in Brandon though!!!!

After two years and numerous visits, it's time for an update.

Magasin is now my "go to" for Pho when I am uptown, mainly because it's close to wherever I usually find myself and it's amazingly good. I have tried all different types of Pho at this point and I would have to say that the Filet Mignon and the brisket are a couple of my favorites. Another new discovery is the avocado spring roll which is fresh and crisp and delicious, especially if you aren't in the mood for a seafood roll. The staff is always super friendly and there has been no issue with any wait the last few times I've been.

I have taken to eating outside, when it's ncie, since there are tables and although you are just on the sidewalk, it's nice to watch the world go by. The cucumber green tea is still one of my favorites and is the best flavored tea that they have.

Sometimes, less is more. No other sandwich shop exemplifies the beauty of simplicity as Cobby's does. No fancy, out-of-the-world, crazy sandwiches here. You want a simple BLT that isn't full of a bunch of crazy crap for a good price? Try Cobby's.

I've tried most of their menu items and my heart always goes back to the turkey avocado with sourdough. That was my dinner tonight. YUM! My tummy still growls just thinking about it. The bread is absolutely delicious! Always fresh, as are the ingredients. And there's always just enough meat in the sandwiches. I do not understand shops that stuff as much meat as they can into their sandwiches - I might as well go to a steakhouse! Cobby's does it right. 

I've come here several times now and I'm always sad to see how quiet it is. I don't think the community appreciates this family owned establishment enough. My husband and I were super worried they'd start closing shop completely after the Broadway location closed. I'm glad this location and the Chinden one are still hanging in there. 

I highly recommend and encourage you to give Cobby's a try. Not only are you supporting a local business but you get a wonderful meal for a great price!

I was impressed by the beer selection here. The prices are reasonable, staff friendly, and on weekdays around 6p it seems pretty laid back. 

I am not typically in manayunk, but it's definitely somewhere I'd return for a drink. 

We didn't get to try any food, and only had a couple beers, but our condo with the bartender was good. We had a nice quickie before our event at manayunk brew pub.

Simply amazing! The Étouffée with blue crab & brown shrimp is hands down my favorite dish EVER! It's THAT good. The chargrilled oysters are also amazing. The bf ordered the grilled ribeye and was super satisfied with it. The buttery sauce added to the juicy flavors of the ribeye & the grits complimented the dish well. And you get fries on top of that! Holy moly! Needless to say, we were stuffed with all the deliciousness in front of us.

Was a little annoyed at first with a long wait, but was well worth it. Also they kept handing out free samples of gellato so no complaints! Had the triple threat sandwich and was huge portion that tasted so good almost made myself eat it all at once. The breakfast sandwich we got was good too but pretty hard to mess that up. Now for the highlight, dessert and drinks! Spicy bloody mary was one of the best I have had. Mmmm bacon...we ordered a handful of the truffles and all were great. You have to try the PBJ! Can't wait to go back and stuff my face!
Went there for large cuts of beef and pisco and they delivered. The food and staff were amazing.  Our server Hannah did an excellent job.  We will definitely be back.
The food is wonderful!  My nine year old sums it up best "Mom, this bread is so good I am even eating the crusts!".  My favorite place to eat in all of Nashville!

My husband and I ate here recently, and we had no sooner gotten home than he made a mad dash for the bathroom.  He had a dish that had shrimp in it - one of the "bowls" that is served in a cast iron bowl.  I don't think we'll be going there again any time soon.

SAK PASE.............. I have been searching for authentic Haitian cuisine for almost 12 years in Tampa and I am pleased to say my search is OVER!!!! 

This little food stand is located in the food court area of the flea market (gate 1- follow "OPEN" bright neon sign- straight ahead) off Fowler Ave, which doesn't give you the most reassuring feeling that you're about to have the best tasting meal, outside of your mama's kitchen, but stay the course and you won't be dissapointed. 

On any given day you'll arrive and see a cluster of patient patrons awaiting their orders. Most people call in their orders beforehand, as there' can be a BIG lunch crowd.  Carmelle's culinary champ has to be their Grios (fried marinated pork chunks)  which is perfectly cooked with a HUGE serving of salad, fried Plantains with rice & beans.  All plates come with piklis (official spicy HOT Haitian slaw). Word of caution, please pick up your plate with both hands or you will lose everything.... It is that heavy!!!! Their goat in creole sauce is also good. You can order chicken, turkey, oxtails, legumes, & seafood (Conch AKA Lambi.......CRAZY).  

If you're Haitian your prayers have been answered. If not, I invite you to sample what food from paradise tastes like. You will not be disappointed, rest assured!!!!

A very underrated pizza shop that is tucked away in a small strip mall in Marlton. It has got to be one of my favorite pizza places around South Jersey. It's a good place to stop in to get a quick slice of pizza when you're on the go or on a lunch break. I've had pizza here before and you can't go wrong with their pizza, especially the Grandmom pizza and chicken bacon ranch pizza. The service is really good and the servers/counter people are really nice and friendly. They do delivery as well, so I can order and get my food without having to leave the house. Definitely give this place a try!
Pleasantly surprised by the quality, service, and pricing. I came here for dinner expecting standard Pho and walked out recommending this place to anyone that crosses my path.

For bar food, this place has a good assortment. Bathrooms could use a bit more attention & they started a "give silverware only if the patron asks for it" thing (which is really dumb in my mind). 

As a person who doesn't consume a ton of burgers, I actually appreciate their roasted veggies, they're surprisingly good! Lemon pepper wings are my fave soo, it's the default when I come to Hooters.

One of the worst service experience.
I ordered egg roll and the pho.
Egg rolls came out covered with burn crumbles all over and very drak color of the shell and you could the content pretty much black color as if it was almost burned or at the least fried in the last drop of over used burned oil and I could not posssibly put it in my mouth. When I was explaining that Im concerned things are too burned, the owner lady walked up and snatched the plate away from me without saying anything. I did not know if they ate bringing another one or not. Only after I grabbed my waiter later he said they are not making another one ans would take it off my check. 
Absolutely rude, not communicating, disrespectful of their customers.. 
the only reason I came was because the neighboring miss saigoin restaurant was flooded but I think it's worth a wait compared to this place if I want to spend any money for pho and walk out feeling happy :(

Plaza Aztecs is a great Mexican restaurant that is well deserving of a five star rating. The portions are HUGE and the prices are great for the amount of food you get. The chips and salsa are some of the best out of any Mexican restaurant in Pennsylvania, and there is a huge selection of meals to pick from. Seating and wait time is almost never a problem, and I've been here at the emptiest and busiest times (which means, I've been here a lot). Definitely eat here if you get that Mexican-food craving and happen to be in Exton!

Visiting the area and found this on the way. Great location, easy to find. Saw great reviews and some not as good, some I must agree with. The menu has a good variety of Mexican options. 

The Horchata is delicious and refreshing but it's one of those things if you drink too much of, you'll get full from just that! They serve complimentary chips and delicious salsa. The sopes are pretty big, fuller than I usually see. The flautas are served with a tasty green sauce and side of beans - I typically don't eat beans by itself so that was different for me and these beans were completely flavorless. The carne asada tacos were tasty and served with yellow rice made with mixed vegetables and a side of beans. The portions are great and the prices are definitely fair! The service was great, clean restaurant, very attentive and the food came out pretty quick. 

I'd love to give it 5 stars but the flavor part of the food needs some more love in there, especially the beans, please!!

Alberto's is a great little spot in the French Market area for freshly prepared food. Try the Muffaletta, the Sangria, or really anything. It's good food, properly seasoned, and very tasty. Service is polite but not speedy: it's freshly prepared, which is a good thing. Enjoy!

My boyfriend and I are traveling and with us being veg we really have to search. I found this place and we were more than impressed. We were in town for a week and as I am typing this, we are here for pur third time. Everything is great. The vegan wings are insane. 10000% recommend this place

Sad to say, but this is the best place at the A Gates to eat. High priced sandwiches, disinterested staff, just now seeing customers gathering at the register while 2 of the staff are carrying on a personal conversation. I travel frequently though more airports than I can count , and the STL Airport is one of the worst on food quality and customer service: why is that ? 

Of course, you could venture to the Budweiser Tavern a few steps away and have even worse quality food and the same customer " service".....such a shame for a city as large as STL to have these airport problems.

Come here all the time! Foods great and the employees are friendly! I come here sometimes 3 times a week the pizza is great and every kind I try is great all the specialty kinds and the normal food menu is very good I love coming here!

My cousin brought my wife and here while in town for a few days. Man was it great. We got turkey and brisket, along with a number of the sides. They were all excellent. The service was good. The ambiance was nice and casual. Would definitely go back when back in Nashville.
Food Was Just Plain noting to Write Home to Mom about I have had Much Better

Reminds me of NYC Little Italy in old days.  Quality food at affordable prices made and served by good people the old school way. NYC needs a place like this.  My go to for excellent meal every time I'm in town. Grilled veal chop is outstanding.  So looking forward to dinner tonight!!

We are from out of town and have a daughter at butler U. We are always looking for new places, but this restaurant is easily one of the best in town. The service is exceptional, the menu is creative, there are ample veggie options and the food is consistently delicious. The avocado toast with an egg is thee best.

This is by far my favorite resteraunt in Philadelphia! Our dining experience from start to finish was superb! Be sure to try one of the side plates, the polenta. The setting is much like an urban farmhouse. My oregano fettuccini was exquisite. The farm fresh flavors just seemed to burst in my mouth like the fireworks on the Fourth of July

Located on what I THINK is the outskirts of Cashville,.. Uncle Buds is awesome! The place was packed but my food was still ready in 20 min.  I got the chicken/catfish combo and was pleasently suprized with the meal. Perfectly battered and fried and seasoned wonderfully!  The sides were incredibly seasoned white beans, huge hush puppies, slaw and potato wedges.  My ass was waddling after finishing all that grub. Keep it up Uncle Buds!!!

Try the Troy Roll served table side on the patio by Jasmine.
Tremendous service and presentation.
A Tucson Gem!

An excellent local BYOB! We've been coming here for probably about 10 years. The atmosphere is cosy and trendy and food is delicious.  There's a hibachi section and a regular dining section.  The sushi is excellent, in taste, presentation, and variety. Arguably the best in the area (both cooked and raw). Rock n Roll is one of the best rolls I've ever had!  Unfortunately it was a special which I could never get again :( Please bring it back! Soups are also good. Try the Nabeyaki Udon.  I also like their veggie dumplings and shrimp shumai.
Great food every time I come here! Delicious and the prices can't be beat for the large amount of food you get. The Bandejas are fantastic.

Horrible waiter service. Cold pastrami sandwiches... Dry beef brisket. Messed up our order... 

Went there withe the sole purpose of comparing to Katz deli in NY. Katz is better hands down! 

Famous fourth street? Why?

Despite only rating it 3 stars in my previous review, I've been going here pretty regularly. I'm not sure why, but it's flaws are easily forgivable. The substitutes are good, and I've learned to love them as well. 

Recently, I've been going here for my pre-work coffee. And instead of a coffee & croissant combo I get elsewhere, I get a coffee & canele. I'm addicted!

Eekkk!! I use to really like Taylor's Pub. I went there last night with a group of friends and I guess they changed their menu a few times. They're food is AWFUL and it's severely overpriced! Also, they're beers are super super pricey = 6.50. You can go to the brewery and get the same beer for like $4-5! I don't plan on going back here again!! If you're looking for a sports bar, go to Scotty's or anything else.
Loveeee. Crave this place at least 3 times a week, with no shame. They're great. I always ask for more cabbage than rice in the spicey tuna Poke bowl :)

I love a nice Cuban sandwich, so when I heard all the great reviews about this place I had to go check it out. It is a tiny little hole in the wall and could be easy to miss if you were looking for something a little more substantial. 

Putting that aside, this place is great. Right when I walked in I felt welcomed. The staff was friendly and inviting. The owner was verging on chatty. He asked what we'd had at other places and what we liked. 

I got the standard Cuban sandwich because its one of my favorite things out there. I also got a side of the bean soup because I love a well done bean soup. The Cuban sandwich was incredible. Meat was tender. There was tons of flavor packed into it and the sandwich was a great size. The bean soup was just ok. With such a flavorful sandwich I was expecting some spice or something to kick it up. Sadly it was pretty boring. 

The owner was awesome and hooked us up with some Cuban coffee just so we could get the full experience. The coffee was like a sweet and heavy espresso. It was wonderful and I'd be down with drinking it regularly.

The Bacon wrapped burrito is killer as is the Carmelo- basically get asada anything and you'll enjoy it.

TIP: CASH ONLY!
