As for reviews complaining about the servers only speaking Spanish- what the hell do you expect, you're getting authentic Sonoran food from a Mexican food truck. Learn some basics or look at the giant menu and get your order ready before you get to the window.

I really like Barrio's selection of beers.  The Blonde is a crisp, refreshing beer that tastes great after a hike. The Hefeweizen is also tasty. Several of its other beers are available in my local grocery store in Sierra Vista.  But nothing beats a visit to this old warehouse on 16th Street.
 
I took my friend here on a Friday afternoon after a walk in the mountains.  It was around 5pm and the place was crowded.  We sat outside with our two dogs.  There were four other dogs on the long and narrow patio.  I had a Mocha Java Stout and he had an IPA,  I ordered a Diane burger (mushrooms, onions, Swiss cheese) and he had a Reuben sandwich.

The burgers are to die for.  The meat is made to order and juicy, the fries golden brown. The grub is as good as the beer!  Our server was busy with the customers on the patio and service was prompt.  So was our food.  My friend really enjoyed his beer and food.  He now agrees that Barrio is one of Tucson's top five brewers.

The restaurant is huge by brewpub standards.  What makes this place so inviting besides the beer and food is the ample, free parking.  Dogs are allowed on the patio.  There is also free wifi.  The restaurant is a few blocks west of Park Avenue which is accessible from I-10.

This is a great place for drinks, new brewery choices and great food. The real plus is they are next door to Drury Suites a great hotel at exit 67 on I 65 south. We are happy we made the stop here for both. It's fun when you find a great place on weary journey.

I absolutely love this place! My mom and I  were craving some fry bread and we had heard of this place before so we decided to give it a try. Their salsa is delicious and fresh. They have a yummy sweet cinnamon tea! But my all time favorite and go to here is their red chile breakfast plate that comes with a popover! So delicious!
The French toast was amaze balls, great bloody Mary's and the grits were to die for!!!

Great food with a ton of beers from all around the country.  I love this place and eat here often.  Try the muffelata, you won't be disappointed.  Same with most other things that I've tried.  

The staff has always been classy and get you taken care of pretty quick
Great place for a quick lunch on the Anclote river. The counter lady is not very pleasant but the food is good, and you can't beat it for a quick lunch
Stopped in for a quick pie and was pleasantly surprised- nicely seasoned and thin, crispy crust. Want to try the grilled cheese next time!

I took my boyfriend's advice for once and ordered the first thing on the menu (he believes that's typically the best item they offer), and it did not disappoint. The egg noodles in the mie komplit were perfect cooked and tender, and whatever sauce they use was super flavorful and delicious. 
I didn't really understand what to do with the soup/broth that came on the side, but the waitress told me she typically leaves it separate and uses it for dipping/sipping. We also ordered an order of the lamb skewers which were equally as yummy and tender! Definitely recommend this place. A hole in the wall with affordable food but very clean and fairly spacious as well.

The only thing I got here on previous trips were the frozen drinks, and of corse on my last trip there the machine was being "serviced" -sigh-of corse.  This is a Happy hour place and fills up,
I think I would be happier if they never have a guy playing guitar again, as it was much much much too loud.
Lots of children in the dining area on a Friday night, not sure what the lure was.
the menu is ok, I typically order the same things when I go
Traffic usually sucks getting there, too!

Hidden gem in Downingtown!  If you want authentic and delicious this little place is the place to go.  Dining room is comfortable, warm and intimate.  Plenty of chips and delicious chips to start and the best guacamole ever!  Burritos are huge and the sauces are bursting with flavor.  Tacos are the real deal!

This place gives me the best bohemian vibe straight out of the movie RENT. There's mix match chair, couches with quilts and throws on there. There're board games for groups and books for single. I felt like I walk right into my hippie best friend's home. Now the food was even better! I got the quesadilla with the blue corn chips. Did I mention mostly everything is vegan!!!!! This is a place where after you finish eating, you don't feel in a rush to leave. I really wish I could give this vibey divey a 10

Not really a fan of Poke but my friend urged me to try it here. I actually really enjoyed it. When I've tried Poke before, the place had soggy  looking fish. It was also hard to eat (chewy).  Here is was tender and flavorful. Definitely try this place out
Everything you want in a breakfast place.  Food is great and cheap.  Bacon, eggs, biscuits & gravy, etc...  The Denver omelet is one of my favorites.

My Bride, Gina & I traveled to Santa Barbara for our 1st year anniversary weekend. We decided to enjoy a casual dinner @ Cadiz,  which hosted our wedding reception lady year. Messina,  our hostess,  recognized us immediately & we received a very warm, personal greeting from her. Justin, our waiter from last year provided excellent service for our anniversary celebration. 

We enjoyed California bruschetta, lamb albondigas meatballs, a Mediterranean salad & Gelato dessert. Everything was served at the perfect temperature & was delicious.

Cadiz is an excellent restaurant with a superb, friendly & professional staff.

I went on a Thursday with 3 adults (including myself) and two toddlers. We were able to get seating quickly and service was prompt. We ordered wings, a Caesar salad, and a pizza to split, as well as drinks. Food was delicious, but took a little bit longer to arrive than I would have expected. The pizza was great and I loved the wings. Fun, funky location and a great atmosphere. It is a little dark in there after the sun goes down, but not overly bad. I'd definitely visit again and maybe try some other things on the menu
This was easily the best food I have had this vacation. They have a great fries and a burger. My only "complaint" is they did not offer a sampler of each of their fries.

So many good reviews of this place left me thinking it would be an ok place to eat. Boy was I wrong. When people say friendly staff, I guess you'd have to consider a "hello", "are you ready to order" and "enjoy"... Friendly. I was never asked how my sandwich was. Which was sadly absolutely horrible. This is my first time visiting this place and I can not say I would come back. If the waitress had asked me how it was I would have told her I was exceptionally dissatisfied. I took one bite and asked for a box to feed it to my dogs. I would have thought she would have thought it was weird that I ordered a sandwich and took one bite and boxed it up. I ended up eating the remainder of my daughters kids meal. Maybe their breakfast menu is better but I can't say I recommend the lunch menu.
Wayne, our server was awesome!  Great ambiance and food.  Definitely worth trying to find a parking spot to check out Ernest and Scott :)

It's sort of like walking into your grandmother's house, if your grandmother is a wealthy alcoholic taxidermist.

I met Laura S. and a few other friends here for dinner and drinks on a Thursday night.  The place has about 8 different rooms on 4 different floors and the decor (down to the plates) is crazy-British-grandmother chic. 

I think we tried most of the menu. I won the ordering game with the pork belly ($14) - it was crispy/melty/rich/delicious and big enough that I couldn't finish it.  According to the rest of my table, the burger was good but not great (but it was served on a giant cutting board, so bonus points for presentation), the rabbit pie was decent, and the fish and chips were mediocre. For the appetizers, the parsnips and fish cakes were not a hit, but my friend was happy with her beetroot jar and beetroot-cured-salmon. The bread and butter were both delicious.

Authentic British Friend (TM) was happy overall but was pretty outraged that the place serves macaroni and cheese, which apparently is as authentically British as baseball and apple pie.

All and all, the price-to-quality ratio is on the high side, but the place is A-OK. If they get cider on tap (and price it accordingly), they'll earn themselves a solid 4-stars.
Love it here. Food is great. Service is friendly but sometime slow because they are busy but food is worth waiting for. So far my favorite place in Chinatown

Went in for the lunch special posted online.. turns out the price is different then what's posted online, no big deal but that was the reason I came in and also for the cheesy bread which is completely different now... so disappointing.

Wow is all I can say. Who knew you could run into a deli and get like a five-star meal at a quarter of the price. Everything was delicious they were  Six of us so I was able to try the Poboy's, Sue but there was homestyle chicken and green beans. The french fries with cheese oh my gosh. Love to the Gumbo. Definitely will go back when were in the quarter.

Went to Roux thinking it was going to be an awesome experience. Unfortunately their take on Cajun food to me fell flat. The atmosphere was awesome but the food lacked a lot of taste in my opinion. The Boudin balls were the star of the show but the chicken and sausage gumbo was bland and the crawfish etouffee was passable I wasn't blown away. I had those during appetizers. I then had the seafood Wellington which again was bland. The service was okay but I think our guy was new and couldn't count and be out us threes of things when there was four of us. Hopefully he will get better. All in all I would go back if a group was going but I can see why they are in the top 50 restaurants and not the top 10.
Amazing sushi! I just recently became a fan of sushi and this Is by far one of the best places to get it!! Friendly service and great vibes. Would recommend anyone!!

So delicious and great presentation! My friend and I had a lot to catch up on so it took a few minutes for us to order and the server was very patient with us. We ordered crab rangoon, apple blossom roll,  summer roll, orange salmon roll and spicy girl roll.  All of them were so good. The Summer roll was very refreshing after the spicy girl roll. The apple blossom roll and spicy girl rolls reads like they would be very spicy but they are about a medium. The heat leaves pretty quickly. Everything was great and the server was super attentive, we'll definitely be back.

Yeah, yeah, yeah, I got it, it's a chain, but when you need it most, it's there for you just like it was there for us. The thing is about chain restaurants is that they offer consistency and we knew what to expect. My family and I were hungry and tired from all of the Mardi Gras festivities and wanted to grab something to eat, so we could head home immediately. Thankfully we beat the lunch crowd, so it was pretty slow and we got serviced quickly. We ordered the Lobster Stuffed Shrimp and the Bang Bang Shrimp Tacos - both yummy and filling. They give you bread, too, so watch out! Total carb overload, but so worth it! Our server was super nice and was quick with everything.

It is a very popular spot for tourists and it is really cool to watch the pro roll the cigars live in action. 

Amazing array of choices and if you like cigars, this is a place to check out!

*Excellent* Texas-style barbecue with no pretensions at all.  I grew up in Texas, although I haven't lived there for decades.  This place takes me back to my childhood.  

Since my favorite barbecue meat is sliced brisket, of course that's my favorite. :)  But the other meats are good. In particular, if you're a hot link fan, try theirs.  Good cole slaw, especially the spicy version.  And the barbecue sauce (available by the bottle as well as for the meal) is wonderful.

We went to Cochon a couple of days ago for dinner, and I found that I actually prefer Cochon Butcher. Granted, they are two entirely different categories, but I actually enjoyed the lunch of sandwiches more (and then of course there's the price differential).

My favorite was the muffuletta. It's great to have a sandwich with all these mixed meats when each one is sooo good! Some of the meats were a bit crispy, too, which only made them better. The olive spread, cheese, and everything else came together into an immensely tasty sandwich. Because there were so many different flavors going on, I preferred the regular hot sauce to the sweet habanero on this one. I also tried a bite of the pulled pork sandwich and the pork belly. The former was pretty normal but very well done, and the latter was more inventive and also quite good. However, the muffulleta was my favorite, maybe partially because it is so novel to me - it also made me not want to eat any other ones anywhere else!

We tried the brussels sprouts too, which we wished had been crispier, and the mac and cheese, which was exceptional. I usually don't order mac and cheese - I like it just fine, but it's rare to find one that's really worth it. This one definitely was.

I'm going to try some beef jerky, and we couldn't resist buying some of the bread and butter pickles too! The desserts seem great as well - I tried a baked good just called "pb&J" and it was fantastic.

This place has so much potential. My sister first brought me here when I moved to Nashville 5 years ago. She told me about this amazing cake donut with vanilla icing pressed in coconut flakes. They only had the cake donuts when we went but they offered to dip it in the icing and top it with coconut as they do every morning. So, when I came in just last week, I sort of expected the same experience. When we went inside, they had just a handful of donuts and we asked if they could make the coconut donut. The guy looked at us like we had sardines coming out of our ears and said they only did that in the mornings. Ok, disappointing but no big deal, we'll jut get different donuts. We picked out several donuts and left. When we opened the box and tasted them, it was like these donuts were at least a day old. They were dry, stale, just not good at all. 

If Shipley's would just make their donuts fresh, they would be unstoppable.

please taste your food or have someone to sample it before SELLING IT to the PUBLIC! 

in my experiences with brown sugar over the years, it has been quite hit OR miss!

Picked up food from here a couple of weeks ago for the family and it was OK! just OK! I was very excited because they offer vegan desserts. And the cake really shocked us, it was quite moist and flavorful, more so than our dinner! we wished we had gotten another slice or two; but quite THANKFUL 4 what we had!

Ok, fast forward to today: the food was quite blah! tried the vegan carrot cake which tasted like someone poured their perfume in it. the plantain were not ripe and more like chips. the soya roti, well, it just  added disappointment to ourselves after traveling to 3 different festivals that weren't FESTIVE AT ALL with three hungry small children looking and hoping for good food and vibrations.... 

peace & libations

I have never been this disgusted in my life. You hired a so-called manager that's extremely disrespectful to his customers. Place an order for my staff at tmobile two hours ago call back to see what was going on the young man started yelling at us asking us to call a different location. I asked to speak with him a Manager and he said he was the manager he said he didn't deliver in our area but I asked him why didn't he call two hours ago but he just said what the fuck at home got And hung up on me he does not deserve a job I will never ever call you guys for any kind of work event I will not even give him one star!!!

This place is awesome! We had a large party and they put us where we could all chat away. The white pizza is incredible and you can get practically anything gluten-free! Talia was our server and she is the BOMB! She is sweet,personable and everyone had a great time because her attentive service was so spot on. I think that for a group of 10 people it truly doesn't get any better than this!

I went to Charlie's a Sinner a couple of months ago and I forgot to write a review til today! As far as I remember, the drinks were tasty and not that strong. Also the food menu offers a lot of different vegan/vegetarian dishes. I remember I particularly really enjoyed eating the Korean Styled Tofu and the Maryland Style Crabcakes. I definitely need to visit it again!

The most consistently outstanding food around. Our family has been enjoying Vallartas for years and the food quality has always been nothing less than fantastic.. Service is always solid. We are at the point in life where we are trying different entrees every time we go.. One warning, the frozen margaritas will put a grown man down... Ignore the 1-3  reviews, the food is 5  tasty all day long.

We were in Clearwater for a conference in May and took a chance on Yelper reviews and had a late dinner here. Everything was delicious. We ordered a pasta for my son and a pizza. The crust had a beautiful snap with a soft airy center and the ingredients were fresh and flavorful. We followed up with the gelato. I am embarrassed to admit we went back two days later when friends joined us in Clearwater. We ordered pastas, salads, pizzas, and of course the delicious gelato. Even two months later my kids keep asking to go there for dinner and gelato. They have ranked it as one of their all time fave places to eat and I have to agree. If you haven't had the chance to stop in for dinner then do it now!  Save room for that gelato because it is heaven!
Great turkey club.  Great pasta and meatballs.  A good place in the neighborhood.  A little pricy though sometimes depending on what you get.

Great service and great food. Grant it it was not busy on a late Saturday lunch (2:00) so there were not a lot of crowds. We ordered the dim sums and they were actually larger portions we are used to in other Chinatown eatery. Service was great again there were nobody there so they took care of us. Will definitely visit this place again next time we are in town.

This is the 4th time I have eaten here and the food was good as always. The warm tortilla chips with 2 kinds of salsa are very tasty. Soft tacos are great, steak quesadilla was very good too. The service was the best. Our waitress was attentive and helpful. The guy who brought drinks and water kept our chip baskets and salsa bowls full, The friendly service and good food made it a very pleasurable meal.
The food is always fresh and hot. Five star service team. The toughest part of eating here is deciding what to eat. It all looks delicious.

Went Sun at 2:30pm, they were taking down brunch & the place had few customers. Our server was very nice & we ordered right away. Suddenly the placed filled up. Our food was slow coming & in fact came after those who came after us. I ordered the Pulled Pork dinner on waffle with sides of greens & sweet potato pie. The waffle was Burnt, the crust of the Sweet Potato Pie Burnt & they brought green beans instead of the greens I had ordered. Showed the server, who brought another waffle (ends still burnt), brought some greens & took the burnt pie crust to show the manager. She apologized as did the manager, Really???? Had the manager used his head, he Should have taken the price of the Brunt food off the bill. This has left a really bad taste in my mouth. My friends & people at the tables on both side of us witnessed this as well. They likely lost many customers due to the way they handled this...This was without a doubt  the worst meal I have had in a very long time & the way it was handled added to the disappointment. Word of mouth is the best advertisement a business can have, They just got very bad advertisement and word will spread, as I tell friends, who will tell friends, who will tell friends reaching more people..Their managers need training in how to correct problems when they arise and be sure the customer leaves feeling like they cared...

Boy oh Boy!!! If you haven't had the opportunity to feast on one of these delicious dogs....then you surely are missing out! And let's not even mention the yummy fries and the out of this world dipping sauces....I am forever a fan of Underdogs...I ordered the Marrakesh and had the curry mayo dipping sauce with my fries, and I had no complaints at all.  I can't wait for my next dog!

If you like hot dogs or sausages....hurry....I said hurry!!! and get on down to Underdogs to satisfy your lunch craving you won't be disappointed.

Raising your eyebrow yet?

A vegan giving a Wendy's 4 stars? 
Well, I'm not exactly ordering chicken sandwich or a Frosty but I can appreciate ordering a small side salad and plain baked potato (with chives) for when I'm on the go!
For just $3.05 (including tax), I can attempt to eat in my ride as I dart to and from meetings... fun, right? I also appreciate that they offer the "little things" like croutons, low fat pomegranate dressing and for those who eat dairy: lowfat sour cream. 

You can actually eat a healthy and affordable meal if one must take the fast-food route. I don't try to make it happen to often but when I'm in a time bind, this is a great way to stay in check.

Props to their staff too. No kidding! They always get my order right and are efficient.

We really wanted to like this place after hearing the chef was nominated for a James Beard award.  We love the restaurant itself - the upstairs bar area and outside not the downstairs part (too small and smoky from the kitchen).  The servers are very nice, very knowledgeable and did a great job both times we were there.  Unfortunately the food fell short of our expectations.  The chef let the food speak for itself but in my opinion a little too much.  I kept hoping for more seasoning or herbs - something to brighten the dishes but it didn't happen with several small plates and dinner selections.  The tomato soup was amazing but I'm pretty lucky - my husband makes wonderful soups and it tasted a lot like his.  We'll likely try it again but wish we had been blown away.

Add steak to the rotisserie chicken salad and its a home run. Tap list is pretty good. Bottle beer list is better than many. Atmosphere is nice. Price is what you would expect for the style of establishment. I'd come back.

This is a buffet. It's divided into five islands. There is a huge salad bar, dessert bar, sushi/sashimi/udon bar, traditional American cuisine (prime rib, right down to pizza or mac & cheese), Chinese, and Asian. 

The food quality is generally very good. There is a lot of seating, and for different sizes of groups ranging from two, thru many booths, to large tables. It's all buffet, all the time. 

Some of the offerings suffer from batch preparation. The snow crab (not king as listed elsewhere here) is overcooked, but not bad. Same goes for other offerings like the tuna sashimi which had been frozen too many times, and was grainy in texture.

The sushi maki rolls, however, are pretty good, and there are some imaginative rolls, too. The American-Chinese and Asian Islander (fried banana, kim chee, tasty mackeral) were pretty good. The dessert bar is good, as is the salad bar. 

But they're not excellent. The variety is very good. Few people would be unhappy here. Wait staff is attentive and plentiful, and even if the parking lot looks full, there is probably space inside; seating is huge-- even though food rarely ever runs out. No single thing is excellent or extremely memorable if you're a "foodie", but nothing is awful, either. Just very good. There is something here that will satisfy almost everyone but the most orthodox vegan. Warning: this place isn't really vegan compatible unless you're into rabbit food.

Yet again another screw up as usual lately. They delivered half my order. I went back again after my last bad review. Only because it is close to me. Well that was a mistake. Oh and the previous response was they were looking into the issues. Obviously they did not.

Music was not only bad, but deafeningly loud. Management refused to lower it when asked. Great waitress but sucky management. Would be 1 star, but the amazing waitress *Shannon* deserves a star herself.
Always loved Cafe Bistro! Ever since it opened, it has been one of our favorite spots. Staff are very helpful, and friendly. Food is great and you can always get a seat. Great environment.
You simply have to try out Ava's for some Incredible food at @avaslowcountrycuisine. #Seafooddirtyrice #seafoodboil

delighted at philly's ramen renaissance, i HAD to try ramen boy even though i only had 10 minutes left till i had to be at work. coming from nyc, i didn't know when i'd be back again! the waitstaff was super accommodating, being as i told them i was short on time. the waitress brought me my water, & menu immediately and put my order right in with urgency, which i thought was nice of her. it was about half full at 2pm on a wed afternoon.

i ordered the tonkotsu (ramen boy classic) since it's my personal favorite. who isn't in love with pork?? the broth was tasty enough, but didn't have enough depth to last the whole meal. it started getting bland mid-meal. the egg was nicely soft boiled which was a plus! i get so annoyed when i get a hard boiled egg....i know, i'm crazy, but i love me some soft boiled egg in my ramen =) and the noodles....i can't quite describe it but they had a funny texture. unlike any ramen noodle i've had. it felt al dente, but maybe it wasn't fresh ramen? i can't put my finger on it, but i know i didn't like it. it really brought the dish down for me. and another minus- no hot tea at the end. it's just one of those nice touches i've grown accustomed to after a hearty bowl of ramen- a nice, light, steamy mug of green tea to seal the meal. so i gulped down some ice water, and ran off to work. i will most likely be back to try the rest of the ramen on its menu. hope for a better experience, as i love to see philly's food scene thrive!

Omg, this is the best food! We came by and picked up a takeout order on Saturday and 4 days later I can't stop thinking about the food. I had the chicken breast with sautéed peppers, onions and tomatoes. My chicken was tender and so full of flavor  as were the veggies. It came with Spanish rice and beans and they were both delicious also. My husband had the steak over plantain with a fried egg and avocado slices. He loved his meal also. I got an order of fried plantains as an appetizer and it was huge and delicious. I also got a pama margarita. Soo yummy!
Passing through and found this stop for lunch. Everything we wanted, GREAT food, a beer and a VIEW!  Will be here for sure next time we are in the area!!!!
Always a great pizza with family friendly service. One of the beat in Tampa. Crust always had a great crisp with flavorful sauce.

Wow ! My Somtam pu pla-ra was hands down the best I've had here in NJ. Browsed thru the Thai menu - they have all the Esan food and everything else I crave for! Seems like I'll be here a lot ! My mouth is burning but I'm loving every bit of it !

I just went to FUEL with a $10 for $20 dollar Groupon Now deal (sorry yelp, groupon's deal was better, but you can only use it between 3PM and 5 PM) We sat outside and I have to say, i love their menu. It was hard to decide what to get. Our server Chad was attentive and knowledgable about a lot of my random questions. Love that it lists calories AND the Weight Waters points.  Smoothies were good; just an overall nice variety of sandwiches, drinks, wraps, salads. Great go-to spot for lunch. I will certainly return.

Drove out here from University City based on a recommendation from a friend. The place looked pretty cool and relatively busy for a Wednesday night. 

I ordered the smokey chicken pizza which arrived pretty quickly. It was cool to see the chefs working on the pizzas right behind our table and I especially loved the tomato cans as stands. I could tell that this place had a personality to it and it was nice to get away from the typical University City restaurant scene. 

The pizza itself was delicious as expected. Thin-crust but still saucy and cheesy enough that I was able to fold it and really enjoy each slice. I didn't realize the smokey chicken meant that I was going to get thinly cut chicken breast slices instead of cubes/pieces which is more usual as a pizza topping. I would probably order something else knowing this now but the salsa verde still made the pizza really delicious. I'd come back here again.

This McDonalds rocks. I've never encountered friendlier employees and customers of any fast food restaurant in St. Louis! I walked in the other day for some oatmeal and a coffee and everyone was nodding, smiling, tipping their hat at me -- this place deserves to be next to a Home Depot. I'm going to make it a point to come back next time I'm hungry on Hanley.

Lots of parking, too, and easy on/off access to the road. Just a good setup in general, here.

I love the vegetarian tacos!!!! They always taste amazing!  Glad to have the option!  They already have a great rotation of craft brews!  Also who doesn't love Arcade games!  They just added pinball machines over the last few months!!!!!!  It's always a fun time!  Plus they have $1 tacos on Monday!!!!!
Excellent service, a wonderful owner and employees. Absolutely amazing pizza and food in general. 5/5 would definitely recommend if you're in Philly.

It's a terrible thing this shop isn't closer to Horsham. Nothing can beat duck donuts' deliciously decadent cake donuts! 

Fast and efficient service with fresh, hot, perfectly baked and tastefully topped desserts. These are super rich, so beware of scarfing down more than 2 in one sitting - you'll love it at the time, but likely regret it shortly after. They're obviously best fresh, but you could zap it in the micro for 7 sec the day after if any still linger in the box. Enjoy! 

Personal Fav: chocolate with rainbow sprinkles (or "jimmies" for you Philly folk)

I have been eyeing this place for a while. Ever since my friend moved in down the street, I knew I had to visit this place.

They have 14 different beers (they don't always have the same ones all the time). They brew all of their own beers. They have a nice variety, and I liked everything I tried. The cream stout was probably my favorite. They also have a good food menu. We weren't getting a meal, so I can't vouch for that. We decided to share some fries. They have all different flavors and dipping sauces. We ordered the truffle oil and parmesan with chipotle aioli. They were really good! Perfect crispiness. I thought the prices were really reasonable as well.

The bartender was really nice. She gave us tastings of any beer we wanted, and was very attentive and accommodating. My friend and I both said we wanted to come back and try more beers!
This place is a grate. Went with my dad and got the hart attack. Basically everything that you could have for breakfast in a wrap. Defiantly going back

Such a great bar!! The server was incredible, so friendly, he had so many great recommendations up his sleeves, and everything was so tasty. Plus, the cup they serve their pina coladas out of have ruined all other glasses for me, so I'll definitely be back soon.

Solo diner - walked in and got a spot on the balcony outside. Seconds after sitting down there was live music on the street right below me. It was amazing!! The Cajun pasta was delicious. The bread pudding was good, not great compared to another restaurant's nearby. 5/5 for the experience/atmosphere. 4/5 for the food.

New restaurant. Great food. Went with my office colleagues, tried the king crabs and snow crabs. Oh boy they were delicious. The gravy was the best!
Would love to visit again. I hope this restaurant is successful.

Quick Note: After closing briefly, Pho Hoa did indeed reopen at a new location (1308 Manhattan Blvd.), just down the street from its old location.  It is currently open for business!
------------
My girlfriend and I visit Pho Hoa almost every time we are on West Bank.  The food is affordable and delicious and the ingredients are always very fresh.  I have been to quite a few Vietnamese places, both in Louisiana and in other cities, and I feel confident in saying that Pho Hoa is great. 

The soups are excellent, but if you are looking to change up from the usual pho, I highly recommend the noodles with grilled pork.  The seasoning on the pork is perfect and the meat is cooked so that it is nice and juicy with loads of flavor.  

It's probably also worth mentioning that there are always a lot of Vietnamese and Vietnamese-American customers eating at Pho Hoa--a further sign (if you don't believe me) that it is a legitimately great place for Vietnamese food.

We have tried to get in to the place with a larger group and the wait is just to long. But my wife and I went on Sat night about 7:30 and while it was packed they got us in pretty fast. We ordered a glass of wine (Chianti) very nice and a cheese starter - wow the cheese plate was fantastic. We ordered the Sonny Boy (Tomato Sauce, Fresh Mozzarella, Salami, olives) it was thin crust at its best not too much sauce and the Salami was wonderful. One of the best pizza's I have had not too crisp but not droopy just right. Talked to the owner at dinner and he was happy to hear we liked it. We will be back.

Whenever I land in New Orleans I need to visit this place. People working here are so friendly, attentive and helpful even chefs. The most importantly FOOD is AMAZING! No wonder the restaurant is always busy and long line to get in. Needless to say I highly recommend "Royal House" is must visit place in NOLA.

I give Molly Macguire's Pub 4 stars because I love the atmosphere here and the great quality of their beer.  This is a real Guinness served in a proper glass with the right nitro mix and necessary storing and serving temperatures to be certified by Guinness (that's right, there is a certified Guinness by Guinness and there are only a few locally).  The food is good but it's the great atmosphere that makes this a 4 star.  Best part is when you stumble out of the bar you can stumble up the road and stop in and say hello.  Maybe we'll go grab some drinks!

Absolutely love this place. The food is delicious and the outdoor set up is really cute. I also love that the cafe has a shop attached with unique items and they even sell some of the jams you can get with your orders. The bread pudding is a must!
Great service, nice workers, clean dining area, and quick response time! But let's be honest...it's a Starbucks, so that's to be expected!

Went here almost a year ago and really enjoyed it. The people working were happy and the menu had so many wonderful sounding options. Went back this week and sad to say both of those have changed. Menu is pretty limited and basic breakfast options. Nothing fun like before. Got a seasonal coffee, the pumpkin spice, and sad to say it's a sad excuse for pumpkin. Really want to support a local small business but when things fall short it's hard to want to come back.

Slow!!!! One car in the drive through, expect a twenty minute wait. They will get something wrong in the order which is funny because McDonalds corporate should have systems in place by now (been in business almost 100 years) that prevent any human errors and speed things up. Parking lot looks trashy, weeds everywhere and overfilled trash cans. They should bulldoze it and put up a new store.

One of the worst restaurants I've been to in a long time. We picked this restaurant because it's in a nice area, and looked elegant with its large open windows and plantation-style decor. Unfortunately, the food and service missed the mark. The food was eatable at best and disgusting at worst. I had the seafood gumbo, which was fine, but nothing I would eat again. There were very limited vegetarian options (like many other restaurants in this city). My friend ended up ordering 2 sides: the potatoes tableau (without the ham) and the creamed spinach. They cost $4 and $5 respectively, but even at that low price, the portions were ridiculously small, like smaller than the palm of my hand. And the spinach itself was inedible. They prepare it with a licorice-tasting liquor called Herbsaint. I'm all for adventurous eating, trying the local flavor, etc---but this was a total fail. Dessert wasn't as gross but still not-good. I had the "hot" chocolate pot de creme. It's basically cayenne infused dark chocolate custard topped with marshmallow fluff. The custard itself was oddly bland and chalky tasting, and the marshmallow fluff was frankly gross.  I couldn't even eat half. Starving Vegetarian friend had the chocolate banana crepe, that she shared with another friend. The two of them also couldn't finish it because it simply didn't taste good and wasn't worth the empty calories. Now on to the service. While cordial and friendly, it was slow, especially when we were getting the check. Granted, we were a group of 11 and made an arduous request of individual checks. But mistakes and general slowness resulted in an hour long wait to pay the check. Go somewhere else.
Excellent ceviche and chile relleno. Strong  margaritas, appealing setting. Efficient, patient service. Worth a stop!

As good dry rub as you are gonna get outside of Memphis. The pulled pork looked solid, but I think this is a rib joint. Even the sides were outstanding. Ate with Adrian Peterson and some Minnesota Vikings (in town for the Titans game tomorrow), so that was cool, too.

I don't normally bother reviewing fast food restaurants but the local taco bell is an exception.
2 things you h he ave to watch out for here, drive thru wait times and a lack of condiments put into your order at the drive thru.

I came here about 6pm one evening recently and wound up waiting 20 minutes in the drive thru line.  I could've gone to a sit down Mexican restaurant and gotten served faster.  Beware, if you pull up and see only a few cars parked from indoor diners but the dt line is really long, move along.  Go someplace else.  This taco bell seems to have too many issues with speed of service whether dining indoors or drive thru.

if you actually do get an order, make sure you are crystal clear on the type and condiments you want. , Telling them you want some mild sauce or even verbalizing by saying you want a bunch of sauce isn't enough for these guys.  specifically tell them how many packs of sauce you want else they will short you.  And check the bag too.

Ahhh...I had a date here once, with the man of my dreams.  The food was great (I had the duck), the service was excellent.  I let the waiter recommend the wine and he did a great job. We had dessert and pretty much closed the place down.  I'd highly recommend it.  It was charming and quiet and easy to get lost in one's company.  Perfect for a date.

The fries are skinny and crispy, the buns were not stale, the chicken was fried correctly. The menu is pretty small and the sauces don't really vary much but as long as they keep doing it right I'll keep coming back.

Yummy yum yum yum. Fantastic meatloaf sandwich.
The cornbread is really tasty. Mac & cheese is very good. Plenty of parking

Oh Blenders, how I miss thee!

I'm not quite sure how healthy you are, but you sure taste good! Love the Banana with Chocolate-- tastes like a milk shake! It's better than Jamba any day.

What do you think about opening up shop in SF? Contact me :)

The food was great and entertaining but the service was SUPER SLOW and HORRIBLE. Especially if you order something that's not on the handmade noodle list or on the bubble tea list. My boyfriend and I went here (on a not too busy day.. it was moderate) and I ordered the shrimp handmade noodle with the watermelon bubble tea while he ordered the sweet and sour chicken with steamed rice. My order came 15-20 min later and I waited an hour for my boyfriend's food to arrive. I just found that ridiculous. On top of that the servers weren't responding whenever I try to speak to them and when they do they say "ok" before I even say anything.  My boyfriend also speaks fluent Chinese and when he tried talking to our server in Chinese, the server had a bit of an attitude. 
Personally this place is not worth the price for me.
I really love their Tom yum.. it's to die for. They're great with my nut allergies too. Food is excellent and the servers are kind.
Food was alright. The wings aren't too good and the service is alright. We would not return

Went once and it was great service with exception of the hostess who had the personality of wallpaper. Food was good but not very big portions. Little expensive. Probably won't be back anytime soon.       Servers were great.

Fun little spot tucked away in St Ann! 
They have LOTS of options for both food and desserts. Donuts, ice cream, sandwiches, gyros, cheeseburgers, donut cheeseburgers, fries, cheesecake, cannolis, tiramisu, lots of sodas and other drinks, and more. It's big place inside with lots of room. 9 booths and at least 5 more tables. 
This place is family-owned and the staff are friendly and helpful. 
Excited to visit come back & more often!
Nice location and atmosphere inside. Great service and delicious food! My favorite is their Tom Yum soup and Shrimp pad Thai!
Always excellent! I usually pick from the fresh, new items offered and am never disappointed. Wonderful addition to Brandon cuisine.

I've always been in love with Capital Tacos, so can we say I mentally did a happy dance in my head when I found out they were opening a location in St Pete!  I was over the moon when I received an email to attend the Soft opening 7/20/18.  The location is in a great area in the same location of Metro Diner on 4th Street.

I had to order my favorites of course the delicious  catawampus and ace high carnitas.  My taste buds were very happy to be enjoying my faves.  I'm so glad they are now located in Pinellas County.  Even though it was a soft opening the staff was very friendly and accommodating as alway, service with a smile.  I have alway liked that every Capital Taco location the staff is always look they enjoy their job which makes every visit enjoyable.  I will be returning very soon!  #keepitcapital

The service is awful. I went with a group of 7 people on a Saturday night. The place wasn't crowded at all. It takes a long time for anyone to come take your order. The food was OK, typical bar food. It took so long for the waitress to bring us more beers that we just started going up to the bar and getting them ourselves. Then after 10 pm they have a horrible DJ set up and play. Save yourself the time and go somewhere else.
The ambiance is casual and inviting and being it was my first time they allowed me to sample each before picking my meal. The offering is a great mix of savory and sweet and can appeal to all palets.

This review is based on holding a small wedding reception in the Wine Library, 50 guests.

When my wife and I decided to have our wedding in Santa Barbara, Wine Cask was one of the first venues we contacted.  From the start of the planning process to the event date, everything was incredibly smooth.  Jennifer and her team went above and beyond every step of the way.  Each time we brought up a concern or a question, Jennifer provided options and solutions right away.  The best part...not once did she ever bring up any added costs, it was always, 'sure...we can do that!', or 'we haven't done that before...but let me figure it out and get back to you'.  It was honestly like we hired a personal coordinator for our wedding.

We dropped off all our decorations and settings the night before the event, and they handled everything else.  We didn't have to bring any extras, ie flowers, candles, vases, etc.  If you're in the midst of planning a wedding, you'll know how much all these little things can add up!  If they had it in their inventory, you were welcome to use it. 

Once they had an idea of our vision, theme, and decorations, they just took over and staged everything to perfection.  At the end of the night, all our guests were extremely complimentary of how everything went, including the food, ambience, and service.

Jennifer and her team even followed up after the event to ensure we were happy and everything was to expectation.  We did have some minor billing issues, but I think some level of that is expected, especially in the midst of the chaos.  However, once these items were raised, her team did their best to resolve it...and again, going above and beyond.

In the end, my wife and I feel pretty lucky that we found the Wine Cask to hold our reception, especially since we planned it in 3 months.  If you're planning to hold a more intimate-styled reception in Santa Barbara, we highly recommend checking this place out.

Really wanted to like this place. Cute little converted house made for a nice neighborhood setting, the menu looked very good, and the front of house was pleasant and attentive. But man was the food mediocre. We shared an antipasto that was a mix of good and bad- cheese and veggies were tasty, prosciutto was fine, but the rest fell flat- some tasteless mortadella and a puzzling non-descript salami-like meat that looked like a muted pepperoni but wasn't very flavorful. The entrees were worse- both served with unforgivably overcooked pasta and a mixed vegetable medleythat obviously came from a freezer bag. My veal was very chewy and my wife's chicken didn't look much better. We didn't try the deserts.Not sure if we just caught them on a bad night (other reviews seem mixed) but I doubt we'll be back- bad food at relatively high prices (food was ~$70 before tip; it's BYOB). Again, the menu looks great and the staff was nice enough, so maybe they can fix things.

This has to be one of the best places to eat in St Pete! The food is super fresh and the quality is terrific. Great flavor, authentic food and a clean, chill atmosphere. Def recommend checking this place out. They have great vegan/vegetarian options too if you're lookin for that. I don't know anyone there or have an affiliation but had to say as an outta towner with high expectations for food, this place is legit.
Apparently they can't make a simple vanilla coke. It's honestly hilarious how much they mess up

Me: "Hi, I'd like to place an order for delivery, pretty please."
St. Charles Tavern: "I don't know where you're from, but it's Mardi Gras and a parade is passing. We don't deliver today."
Me: "Actually, I live on the parade route, and the parade passed three hours ago. But I understand not wanting to drive today. That's why I'm trying like hell to get something delivered."

And then we all had a good laugh. But seriously, I totally understand not delivering at all during Mardi Gras . . . but a girl has to try, right? 

On a regular day, the food's a'ight. It's not the greatest food I've ever had in my life, but what I have had is solid. And I have to be honest . . . the thought that I can have chicken fried steak drowning in country gravy can be DELIVERED to me during a wicked hangover episode is what gets me through the day sometimes! (and their menu says they deliver city-wide, which is pretty bad ass)

So . . . three stars, because it's not the greatest food in the whole world, but it'll conveniently give you your greasy fix and cure what ails ya!
Bland Philly steak sub par bread also asked for a turkey hoagie and i  went home too see they packed me a toast with turkey n coleslaw very normal not close to other places in town !

One of the worst Chinese you will ever have. A forgettable experience to say the least. The fried chicken that my daughter put in her plate both had feathers (more seemed like hair) sticking out. The manager, a not so pleasant character, explained that it is the fault of the supplier and that the restaurant is not really to be blamed. The Chinese section (serving noodles etc.) had most of the items served stale. They used to have ice-cream in the dessert section. Now you press the handle and out comes yogurt. The stick chicken, one of my favorites, was smelling rather stale too. The chicken smelt like it had been cooked a few days back. And this is on a Saturday morning where these restaurants generally serve fresh food. In fact there were other customers complaining about the food too. I have moved to Malvern with family last August and has been going to this buffet ever since mainly for my kids. I think this place is going down fast. It used to be rather decent a few months back. Experiences in my last few visits here are nothing but full of disappointment. Time to look for another place. My suggestion to you all would be to definitely avoid this joint. Especially for families with kids. It is unhealthy here.

Tempered was a great spot for a solo lunch on a Saturday afternoon. I was greeted as soon as I walked in, and asked if I'd ever been there before. The shop itself is a great space with a wonderful feel. I had a frozen hot chocolate and the Geneve sandwich. It was all very tasty, and I'm definitely interested in trying the other options they have. I also left with an assorted box of truffles that I'm excited to dig in to soon.

This is great Pho.  Wonderful fresh spring rolls and great Pho broth.  I had a wonderful lunch today.  A small bowl of Pho here is plenty and only $6.00. I would recommend this Pho house to anyone.

The servers English was broken but she did tell me the broth was made in the restaurant daily by her husband.

If you want an ungodly amount of salt in your food.. this is it! Prepare to be served food doused in sickly sauces and oil. Yes its cheap, yes its fast... and yes you will get sick if you traditionally eat very healthy and then end up here for a meal. If you have an ironclad stomach and rarely get sick from eating gross amounts of salty foods cooked in oil then this is the place for you! The only thing I ever get here if I am forced to eat here is a bowl of steamed rice.. and some shrimp entree with no sauce or sauce on the side. Even their healthy options here are oversalted or smothered in sauce.

It's mostly likely closed now for the season, but when it was open, I loved it! I went twice while it was open. Once with my husband and the second time with my co-workers. Both times I ordered the strawberry pizza, and both times I LOVEd it!! The pizza is not what most would think. The "crust" or bread part of the pizza is more like a sugar cookie and the "sauce" is like a strawberry cream cheese filling, followed with their fresh strawberry's on top for the toppings! UH so good! Definitely worth the wait for when they open again next season.

I really should have read the reviews. The place was ok. We went for Sunday brunch. The brunch was $45.90 for two people before tax and drinks. 

There's a plethora of items to choose from + the owner was cooking omelettes per request. 

My only complaint was the bacon was burnt & cooked too hard. I ordered some fresh bacon not cooked as hard. It literally took over 30 Minutes for me to get the bacon. 

The place is a house turned restaurant so it does have that small intimate feel to it. 

Nice outing but the food wasn't worth the $60 total we paid.
Unique and amazing beers! Great atmosphere and service. The pretzel balls are really good here too!!

Ordering was very easy at the counter. The guy at the counter was super friendly I didn't get his name ‍.  The decor is super cute I love the wall paper. I got a latte and it was amazing first ones to try them. For sure will be coming back. The breakfast was very tasteful and I wish I could have finished but the serving size was too much for me.
Great food but the space is small and we got stuck with a table in front of the kitchen, so not the best experience until the food arrives. But the food - everything we ordered - was fantastic.

It is as awesome as it gets! I cannot wait to visit again. We went for my boyfriend's birthday, a self-proclaimed foodie". He was in heaven. The service was fantastic and they were some accommodating with celebrations. Food, drink, service, ambiance. We will return!

Toast 101 is another relatively new breakfast/brunch/lunch restaurant in Tucson.  We had about a 15 minute wait for a table today around noon, but they had benches outside for the purpose.  The decor is open and airy, with something of a sports bar vibe.  They have a good beverage/libations menu (separate from their food menu), mostly geared to brunch drinks (mimosas, micheladas, bloody marys , etc), but the description reflected some thoughtful originality.  We opted for the chicken and waffles and chilaquiles.  The chicken and waffles were excellent with a bite of spiciness in the syrup, nice light bubble waffle and a perfectly crispy, boneless chicken breast.  The chilaquiles were copious and very good (according to my spouse, who did not spare me a sample).  Service was excellent, with the hostess wiping off our table immediately when she noted it hadn't been done, and our waiter answering all menu questions completely.  He also only removed used plates and glasses after checking with us each time (I really like that).  We will definitely be going for a return visit to try the lunch side of the menu and to further explore the breakfast offerings.

Well disappointed is an understatement. Three of us had the same thing and it was not good as  in not eating it. Spoke to the manager he asked how everything was told him that it was horrible asked why told him it was completely like beef jerky all of the meat was so over cooked that you could barely cut it with a knife. He did not care whatsoever... I guess if I drank a bunch of margaritas at least I would've had something to show for the evening but I didn't.

The food in this place is amazing! I highly recommend the Porketta. It is a pork tenderloin sandwich that is extremely well made and tastey. Although it is only served on Friday and Saturday it is well worth the wait!

On arrival I was happy when they brought out a large decanter of salsa and a small container of bean dip with complimentary chips.  The salsa was rather unremarkable and sadly rather bland; while the bean dip was rather bean tasting.  My combo plate with a taco, burrito and enchilada all pretty much tasted interchangeably the same and uniformly bland.  It wasn't bad but it wasn't all that good either and just was an overall very bland meal experience.  I probably will not return as the food just lacked in the flavor department.

OMG! ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS!!!! I went in for the first time, around 20 minutes before they closed. I felt bad about that, but I was treated very nice anyways. I was expecting the regular type of tacos. I asked for the classic 'beef and cheese' and they didn't do that.  I was a little disappointed about that. BUT - little did I know, I was about to have one of THE BEST eating experiences. I am a very picky eater, so the bartender let me have them made however I wanted. I got 3 of the Fried chicken, added cheese and got the INCREDIBLE lime sauce on the side, since I wasn't sure if I'd like it or not. Then, I got 3 of the pulled pork, with BBQ sauce, added cheese. I also got a lemonade. My total was $26.76. I thought that was really expensive... But thought, it had to be good for that price. So, I open up the box and dug in. Took my first bite of the BBQ pulled pork and I was almost in shock how delicious this was. I couldn't tell you how many times I made the - "mmmmm" noise. I'm not even kidding. The meat was definitely high quality, no doubt! It was juicy, tender, everything about it was good. I then tried the fried chicken, I put a little bit of the lime sauce on, took a bite, WOW. "mmmmm" I ate two of the chicken tacos and one of the pork tacos. I REALLY wanted more of the pork, but half of the order was for my special friend. That REALLY felt like a sacrifice! Lol. Not even kidding. I picked him up from work and started handing him tacos as he was driving. His reaction was the EXACT same as mine! It was so funny. He did the whole "mmmmm" thing serveral times while stuffing his face, just how I did. He said a couple times how fantastic it was. AND the tacos weren't even that warm by the time I feed him and it was STILL delicious. I don't understand how some of these people on here have left bad reviews. I am born and raised from Nashville, TN - and The Local Taco is definitely in my top 5 of places to eat....and I've eaten pretty much EVERYWHERE here in Nashville. Who would have ever thought, A TACO PLACE?!?! My review may be over the top here, but I am by no means over-exaggerating! I mean what I say and I'm all about high quality food. This place is 5 stars. If you don't like dealing with problems from servers - then get your food Togo! I couldn't believe that one man's review on here, complaining about flies outside! Well take your butt inside and eat! YOUR OUTSIDE DUDE! It's nature, there's bugs. I will for sure be back to this place. Yay! Thanks Local Taco! Worth every penny!
Good Italian food in NOLA.  Nice decor and service.  A tad expensive, but I'd consider a repeat visit if I was craving Italian and wanted a go at their tasting menu, which sounded delicious.

I have been a BWW customer for a long time and just moved down here. I called in an order for pick up and was put on hold for approximately 10 minutes. Then after all that wait someone finally answers again and asks me to be on hold again, to which I reply that I have already been on hold for 10 minutes and the BWW employee replies "I don't know what to tell you lady, I am with a customer". So apparently, I am not a customer because I am not at the store?!! 
I hanged up on this very rude BWW employee and called Buffalo Wings and Rings, which by the way is closer to my house but I didn't know it, and guess what?!! A very nice employee answers the phone and takes my order right away. She even hangs up with a "Thank you and see you soon!" Well, needless to say that Buffalo Wings and Rings has my business now.

Females workers are very rude. I know that's a strong accusation but I have visited this location countless times and experienced this treatment. They seem as if they don't want to work and a simple bowl is difficult to make. I've even sat and watched them interact with male patrons and seen a obvious difference. Their portions are always bigger! Literally paled high and a pleasant experience is always given. I spend too much money at this location and I'm tired of this shit! Grand is closet to my house however I will now take my business elsewhere!

Went to Morning Glory with my hubby and daughter for a Monday morning breakfast. Walked right in, sat and had the best service and food imaginable. The coffee is served piping hot and in metal cups - really cool!
We had traditional breakfast- eggs, bacon,scrapple, home fries. All were perfectly cooked and hot and delicious. Can't go wrong here at Morning Glory! Can't wait to return. Little tip: go early in the week and you won't wait !!

I generally assume that most restaurants here in Santa Barbara are overrated, so I was slightly skeptical at first. However, this is a place that truly deserves every star it has and I'm so glad I came here for lunch.

This is a really cute storefront, managed by super friendly owners who serve delicious food (quickly) at a very fair price. What else could you ask for?

The bulgogi is delicious, as is the spicy pork. Out of the two, I think I preferred the bulgogi because the spice on the spicy pork was a little underwhelming. If you're looking for spicy, get the spicy rice cakes, as those were satisfyingly hot.

I'm definitely looking forward to going back and trying some of their other options. What a great restaurant to have just a few minutes from home.
Best breakfast! I love Mings. Friendly and fast service. Whenever my friends or family are in town I bring them to Mings for breakfast.
Great service.  The food is flavorful and good portion size.  I got the carne asada, it was great, tender steak and all the fixin's.  You will not be disappointed by stopping here.
Enjoying a delicious and well-crafted Pimm's cup (not sorry about the unoriginality). Not eating as of yet but the options look and smell great!

Fantastic place. Vegan or not you should check it out. Had the special which was a fried tempeh sandwich with ham on a donut bun and the buffalo tempeh sandwich. Both sandwiches were fantastic and filling. The chili cheese fries were also a wonderful addition. It was all great. I don't leave reviews often but this place deserves one. Check it out.
Great experience. The loaded and BBq potatoes were delicious and just what we needed. The manager Trish was very friendly and welcoming. we will definitely be returning!

What can be said that has not already been included in the tons of five star reviews here? This place is amazing! OMG YUM. Boyfriend works nearby and had gone a couple times for lunch and kept telling me how good it was. We decided to go last weekend for a late dinner. My advice is definitely go hungry!

He got the five-o (pancetta, pineapple, peppers, cheddar, mozz, marscapone, & ricotta w/ smoked chili oil/bbq sauce). I got the duke (bbq pulled chicken, applewood smoked bacon, corn salsa, cheddar & mozz w/ smoked chili oil/bbq sauce). WOW. First, the staff is so friendly! Second, the calzone was HUGE LIKE THE SIZE OF MY FACE! Boyfriend and I decided to cut ours in half and share. This was a good idea! Both were sooooo good, but I think I liked the duke better - the ingredients were just perfect together! I will definitely definitely be back and can't wait to try more :)

This is my all time favorite Boba tea house in Tampa. The quality of the drinks they serve are always top quality! They have a small food menu, & a few games that you and your friends can play while chilling out. I make sure I try to visit at least a few times when I'm in the South Tampa area. Sadly I don't live near here, or I'd probably visit every day! Definitely a must try for anyone looking for good Boba tea in the Tampa area.

Really like this place and the view. Have been here a few times. However, this last time they really made me think twice about ever coming back. The long blond hair hostess was absolutely rude. We were waiting for the last member of our party to get there. We arrived early so we could get a table on the patio to view the ocean. She said we couldn't be seated with an incomplete party. We explained they'd be there shortly, we wanted to order an appetizer but were told to wait. So, annoyed and irritated, we did. When our third person was 10 minutes late, we came back and said that we weren't sure if she was coming. She reluctantly said we could be seated. However, she had an attitude and complained about us being an incomplete party. She should really treat customers better.... main reason we're there is for the view, they are not the best restaurant around.

I want to start by saying that I initially posted a negative review about this Mahana Fresh about a month ago. My review was based off of an unfortunate customer service experience. But, after my review, Corporate reached out immediately and the owner himself texted AND called me! Not only did he call and profusely apologize but, he comped two bowls for my husband and I.  He is an amazing guy that really appreciates his customers and the support of his new small business. This is the kind of place that deserves and earns our support. 

He wasn't combative or argumentative.. He heard the issue and immediately made it right. That's a good business owner!
Since we've been back the food is amazing (as always) and the customer service has been top notch. If you're in the area I highly recommend Mahanna!

We tried this place based on previous Yelp reviews.  We went on a Saturday night and had the dinner buffet for $6.99 per person.  It's vegetarian, but very substantial.  There were about 6 entrees (including a tikka masala, korma, spinach, potato and peas) plus a couple side items.  Everything was hearty, hot and delicious.  (Except the naan, which was just OK.)

They also have a full menu, including Indian chaat (like street food, often called Indian snacks).  The only other place in St. Louis that has chaat is Gokul (on Page Blvd, also vegetarian).  There are some chaat dishes on the menu... we tried dahi puri, which I enjoyed more than pani puri.  They also have some ingredients on the buffet that you can use to make your own chat (like Delhi chat)... I didn't remember the combination so I asked the server and he was happy to help me.

Overall, we thought Raj's was a little better than Gokul... more hearty, quality food and nicer atmosphere.  The other customers were all Indian couples and families (except us), so that's a good sign.  

We will definitely go back.  Great food, inexpensive.

Good to support local community businesses, but actually took a drive from Long Beach, CA to try this spot out.

Atmosphere: Typical fishery market but this one is quite compact. Right near the pier.

Food: We got several items at this spot. 

01. Marinated baby octopus: This was juicy, tender and full of flavor!

02. Tuna Poke: Nothing special, typical of tuna poke, a little bland.

03. Fresh Uni (Sea Urchins) in shell: Very sweet and succulent!  

04. Blue point oysters: Tender and slightly sweet.

05. Smoked Salmon: Always on point, with a hint of smokey and salty 
notes.

06. Calamari salad: Typical flavors of other common calamari salads.

07. Sashimi: Very fresh!

Service: Great service, nothing to complain about.

Tip: Only 04 guest in the shop at a time, due to the pandemic... Masks required as with any other shop in California...

Stopped by for lunch when we were walking in the neighborhood. What a great spot! Really friendly and accommodating owners and team, with a great offering of groceries and ingredients for a fairly small space. 

Most importantly, our sandwiches (Fig and Pig, Caprese with Prosciutto added) were delicious. Wish we lived in Fishtown so we could go more regularly--a lovely, tasty neighborhood spot.

We just sat at our table for 50 minutes had 4 servers come up to us asking if we ordered a drink and never got served. A manager came up to us and apologized but didn't offer anything to make it up to us. Terrible service and experience. Just a waste of time

This is my new go to place to grab coffee and at times get some work done.  

The Vietnamese Iced Coffee got me thru a few days last week and I look forward to that coffee getting me thru many more!
Absolutely delicious ! Incredible desserts. Ordered hot teas and a round of desserts and each one was perfect. I recommend the chocolate chip beignets with scoop of ice cream.
I went into this Starbucks recently and was impressed by the friendly staff and quick service! Definitely my favorite Starbucks location in town!

M.C. Hammer would vouch for this award winning Cuban sandwich making shop. He'd where his parachute pants and say U can't Touch This Bc it is 2 Legit 2 Quit!

He would then order a cubanada, pass it over to Bo and Boon and say, take one down pass it around, 97 cubanadas left to go down their bellies!

This place is great. Our server was funny. We sat outside bc we had our doggie with us. We people watched. Oh so interesting. Inside is local artsy fartsy art on the walls. Loved it. Cool place!!! They also have a wide array of soups and sandwiches and I scream, u scream we all scream for ice cream!!!

Got here at 9:00 pm on a Saturday evening after a long day of watching volleyball tournament at the convention center. We looked on Yelp and decided to try this place because it stated it closes at 10:00 pm. We were greeted at the door by the hostess who nonchalantly told our party of 3 that the "kitchen is closed". Really? On a Saturday night and the place was not empty. We were looking forward to trying out this restaurant. Unfortunately I can't rate the place on their food but I will definitely rate them on their sucky customer service and false advertisement. Zero stars!

squirts.  Two pizzas, salad, wine and water.  That is what my wife and I had this evening.  Both of us had major stomach issues when we got home.  Have no clue what it was, maybe the draft water they made us fill ourselves.  Have you cleaned that line lately?  Something was bad, we won't be back....ever.

I have lived a few blocks from this place and always pass it but tonight I finally took the leap and entered. The ambience is awesome, great throwback music, great service and over all cool vibe... Oh yeah the Mac N cheese is tits!!! I also ordered the chipotle chicken and bacon sandwich which I had to wrap up for lunch tomorrow because I grossly underestimated the size of the Mac N Cheese... Will def be back in the near future.

The service was great. Food was good, not great. Limited menu. We were seated in the atrium, crowded atmosphere, which might feel better on a sunny day and the plastic walls are up.  When a place has a strict dress code and a good reputation one would expect more.
The food is pretty good here! I had the harvest omelet with hash browns and a biscuit. I went during lunch time on a weekday so it was not crowded and the service was rapid.

Authentic Szechuan food. Really didn't expect such great food in the inland Reno.  
Will come back again

Nice menu for a pub.  We ordered the cauliflower appetizer, it was great. I would go back for that alone. Very friendly staff, we went on a Saturday afternoon for lunch so the place was not super busy, busy enough though.  We had a chicken sandwich that was okay, but there where enough other items that if we are in the area we would go back and try some other things.
The best sushi in Philadelphia. Try the Bronzino roll or the mad dog roll for a treat. Beer and cocktail list is good too.

I LOVE THIS PLACE! I go here often because the food and the staff is always on point. The food is always fresh and spicy just the way I like it. I usually order the kimchi pork tofu and it's addicting! The manager knows my face and the wait staff gives excellent service. There is always a short wait time but it's worth the wait! Go here and any other Korean place would not compare. Just a little sad they don't have BBQ but the galbi dish makes up for it.

Let's just say, I'd come back to Philly just for this restaurant and probably would plan to eat here for more than one meal. 

I've never had any Lebanese food before so I don't have a lot to compare to, but everything we had was unique and had its own types of flavors/spices. We ordered the cruller kouign amann, cruller,ZA'ATAR + CHEESE and egg flatbread, kafta kebob and shish taouk. 

It's very rare for a restaurant to have every single item ordered taste amazing, and I think that is what differentiates this restaurant from others. 

My favorites were the kafta kebob and the zaatar flat bread with the egg. The seasoning on the flatbread was nothing I've had before, salty yet very nice herbal flavors. 

The Lebanese chai latte was very pretty and had a nice floral after taste. This place is a must if you're visiting fishtown area!

We had the Collegeville Deli cater our Italian Family reunion of almost 100 people. Everyone raved about the food - chicken piccata, roasted potatoes, roasted veggies, baked ziti and Caesar salad. The pieces of chicken were a generous size and tender, the potatoes and veggies tasted fresh and were roasted to perfection, and the Caesar salad was crispy with a delicious dressing. I would highly recommend Collegeville Deli to anyone looking for a caterer for their next party!

We stayed at the attached hotel for a few days and went to the Red Owl for a few of our meals.  The food was really great! I had the hamburger and my husband the brisket.  Both were delicious. Our kids had fish and chips and also wonderful.  My son one day had the kids steak and it was really enough for a adult. A great meal with great service.  And wonderful desserts and coffee as well.  We really enjoyed it!

I don't know what the hype is about this place... but it was sure a lot of people here compared to other coffee shops in the are.

So, if you want to go a place where there is a draft of people, this is the place.

The chairs are really uncomfortable, they are made of hard wood.

My friends ordered Coffee and said it sucked. I had Hot Chocolate and actually thought it was the best I had in a long time.

Wireless Internet and plenty of places to plug in your laptop to charge.  

I ended up going to a coffee shop next door that had more comfortable seats.

And one thing.. CASH ONLY!

Best BBQ in New Orleans, hands down. Also probably in the top 15 for the country. Some of the best brisket i've ever had, and also some of the best pulled pork I've ever had. As a BBQ connoisseur, I've had better ribs, but they're still fantastic. But man, the brisket and the pork here are just incredible. Almost laughable how good it is. Huge portions. Great everything. Love this place.

This was our second visit to the Inn at St. Peter's.  Tonight's meal exceeded all of our expectations.  As before, the cream of crab soup was incredible.  Ample crab meat in a velvety cream .  I could have made an entire meal on just the soup.  My wife ordered ravioli with lobster and spinach in a creamy sauce.  The ravioli were cooked to perfection complimented by the lobster, spinach and cream sauce.  I had linguini in a lobster arrabbiata sauce.  Plenty of lobster meat and the arrabbiata was spiced just right.  We topped off our meal with an espresso chocolate cake which we shared. The meal was exceptional and the cost was modest.  We will definitely e going back.
Cappuccinos worth mentioning. The princess biscuit with hot chicken was very tasty. We also ordered a side of biscuit gravy to go along with it.

I am a BIG fan of the Flying Saucer. They are the craft beer drinkers heaven! When you belly up to the bar, you will find yourself in front of 40 plus awesome craft beers on draft. I also wonder, how many penny's make up the backslash? They offer great tasty brews from local breweries and beyond. 

They also have a good menu which compliments their beer selection well. I shared a pizza pie, nachos, and the jalapeño poppers which I could not get enough of! 

Oh my gosh these poppers were awesome! The best part, they are wrapped in bacon! I highly recommend the poppers with a nice cold light bodied Pilsner. 

The staff is very knowledgable. It is alway a plus to walk into a bar with such selection and the stuff be able to help you find just what you are looking for. Their uniforms are also fun!

My husband and I decided to try out this Thai restaurant that just opened up down the street from us.  We normally prefer another place called Jasmine tired but decided to try something new just to see. 

Food: I ordered the fried rice and my husband ordered the pad Thai. Compared your other favorite restaurant we weren't too impressed with the food. It was of ethnic descent but didn't feel very authentic. Also the prices typically range $10 and under for Thai entrée of fried rice or noodles and these were over that price.

Service:  The waitress and the staff at the restaurant were very friendly and very pleasant.

We do have a favorite Thai place in the local area so not sure if we would come back here but if you are nearby and do you want Thai food it is a place that you could go.

Despite saying this place opens at 4 (with no qualifications) it does not. The bar opens at 4 and the kitchen not until 5. We arrived not knowing this at 4:25 with our teenaged daughter, so we asked if we could just get a table, a drink and wait and were told no. Suffice to say, we left. So this is a service rating, not a food rating.
Best buffalo chicken Stromboli (or pizza). Cheesesteaks are amazing. Hands down best pizza in Bensalem.

I was thrilled to find this place within walking distance of my new house when I moved here. It was the best god damn latte I had ever had. I even went back the next day to make sure. My only complaint is that they aren't open on the weekends.

My husband had their chicken sliders last week at work with his coworkers. He came home saying I just HAD TO HAVE ONE. "Chic-fil-a who? Popeyes who?!" 
We went today! I ordered it as takeout around 12pm and didn't get my food until a little after 1. BUT we came during a lunch rush I believe and this place seems very popular! So if you plan on ordering food online or calling in I'd do it an hour in advance if it's around lunch time! 
And with me being the hangry wife I am, I started eating my slider in the car! And it was hot, fresh, and delicious!! The slaw is bomb and so are their cheese fries!

I'd say it's more like 3.5 stars. After reading some of the reviews about how the wait staff was unfriendly and food often came out cold, I was a bit concerned about what my experience would be like. 

My roommate & I arrived around 7PM on a Friday night for dinner, and a friend of hers joined us shortly thereafter. The place was fairly empty, maybe only about half full, which was somewhat surprising. 

Positives: 

- Our waitress (I believe her name was Mariah?) was one of the best waitresses I've had at any establishment in a long time. She was incredibly helpful with her recommendations of beers on tap and was just an awesome, friendly person. Far from the poor reviews other patrons have given the waitstaff. 

- My dinner: I ordered the chicken tenders, which were amazingly good. They were tender, juicy and perfectly fried. I ordered honey mustard to go with them (which they apparently make in-house) and it was a great combo for both the tenders and fries. I'm STILL thinking about those tenders!

Negative:

- We ordered the sundried tomato & basil flatbread as an appetizer and I wasn't particularly bowled over by it. The cheese seemed to have a bit of a rubber consistency and I couldn't really taste much of the sundried tomato element of it. It definitely came up short. 

By 9PM, the place had filled up and was packed for the live music that was about to begin. We stayed for about an hour into the set and the crowd seemed to be into it, but it wasn't music I have much knowledge of, so I'll abstain from giving my opinion on that. 

All in all, it was a much better experience than I thought I might have, given the other reviews. If you go for dinner, I HIGHLY recommend the chicken tenders, but avoid the sundried tomato & basil flatbread. I'll definitely be back (and hope to have Mariah as my waitress again)!
El lugar es hermoso. Aquí celebramos  nuestro primer aniversario. Muy fresca la comida de mar. Recomendado

Presentation 10.  Taste 2.  Icining 5.  Sometimes just because it looks pretty does not mean it tastes good.  Over priced.  The more we travel, esp. In cities, we find this.  So, no more when we are in the city.  Small town bake shops taste better.
B Line is a very cozy restaurant. I enjoyed a delicious meal and drink and I will definitely be back, but I will save room for dessert next time. I highly recommend it!

First time ordering from Rize. Never again will I pay $34 (with tip) for a small mediocre pizza and a rather boring house salad.  The driver forgot the dressing.
