Very tasty breakfast brunch. Crepe and juice for the SO, and the delicious crab cake benedict for me, with the best cheesy grits I've had. Endless coffee, friendly attentive service. Absolutely recommend.

Love this place!  I just wanted a simple poke bowl without a lot of stuff so got salmon on sushi rice with a little bit of spicy mayo and topped with a garnish of green onions.  Basically like the simple sushi rolls I enjoy eating.  Was super fresh and tasted great.  

I also had a good iced milk tea (no boba for me!) that was just a little sweet (they call it 1/4 sweet) and that was perfect.  

The space is new and everything is nice.  They play fun music and all the folks who work there are super friendly and helpful (there was a cutie working there when I visited :)).  Fun atmosphere to hang out with friends or just to grab a quick bite.

Really enjoyed my visit to PokeMee and I'll be back next time I'm in Santa Barabara.

We came here as we came across it last night after eating at the restaurant next door. We walked in and looking forward to try the pizza, and they told us that they are closed when it's 25 min before closing. They said that we can only do take out which we are here for a vacation and so we wouldn't want to go back to the hotel room and eat take outs.

I love this place! The owner is so friendly and makes a genuine effort to get to know his customers. Cold brew on draft and Vietnamese iced coffee are both great. And as a vegetarian I've only tried the tofu banh mi. I'm no banh mi expert, but it's delicious. And only $5 for a great, fresh, filling lunch. 

Bonus: delicious, cold water readily available at the counter and treats for your dog friends! Glad to have this place in the neighborhood.

I used to love Panera. This place has fast and efficient staff. The food quality is good and the bakery is diverse. All that aside I probably won't come here anymore. The menu seems to get less appealing every time I come back. It all started when they got rid of the asiago bread. Why would you get rid of that?! It was your best bread! Anyway, if it comes back; I'll come back. Until then, adios!

If you're looking for a nice comfortable place to relax with great food this is the place to go. We got the trio to share,  amazing! My wife got the grilled chicken salad and I got the char grilled oysters again,  amazing! We finished off with a delicious bananas fosters bread pudding... over the top great! Our server was incredible... he made the night special,  thank you Will!!

Soledad and her husband had the night off so the kids ran the show.  Service was as slow as could be and we found the food to be mediocre at best.  Too pricey for this to be excused and you could sense the disappointment from the other diners that were present.  The experience takes a major hit if Soledad is not at the wheel.

I just went to this place and the food was not good, plates are really small and expensive i spend $34 on a breakfast and i only had 2 shakes and 2 steak and eggs also bread sticks and they said you get 3 eggs which you never do and you dont even get a stake is like 3 little pieces thats it! Not worth my money

Amazing!
We had Frank as our server.  He was awesome.  He has a serious exterior but gave perfect polite professional service. 
We ordered the gumbo as a starter.  It was great. 
The main entrees were cooked to perfection.
I had the gulf shrimp and greens.  It came in a nice cast iron small serving pan.  The shrimp were a good size cooked perfectly.  The greens were fresh and bright green. The sauce was so delicious.  I was thankful to have bread to soak it up! 
My husband got the red fish.  It was so flakey and flavored amazingly.  It was served on top of a vegetable potato mix.  
The atmosphere was a nice relief from the noise of bourbon.  
The entire evening was great and memorable.  
We will be back and we will be sure to ask for Frank.

Good coffee overall. Great that you can do mobile ordering to pick up as this location stays busy. Seats and tables were all pretty dirty so I didn't stay to eat here. Coffee was decent but one of our lattes was burned.

This is one of my favorite pizza joints in Tampa.  I'm a regular at Channelside and love stopping by for the ocassional slice or fried ravioli. This is several notches above Pizza Hut and Papa Johns. My only complaint would be that the service is sometimes a little off. You wait for good pizza, but keeping the sodas topped off and checking in regularly with your patrons is a must.  I wouldn't say the service is bad, just that it could improve a bit. But the food is outstanding so that's what matters. Oh, and don't forget the garlic knots. Addictive!

Another plus is they do local delivery, so if you are staying at a nearby hotel, they'll bring their pizza goodness right to you.

I'm a fan!

I love Aladdin's so much!! They are one of the only authentic middle eastern restaurants in all of sb county and my favorite place to eat in Isla Vista by far!! I was so sad when I thought they closed but I hope that the temporary closing is what is actually going on!! Amazing quality food and kind staff.

So I tried the place in Wayne and was not super impressed. Since I was working in Phoenixville today I decided to give the original a try. I was surprised to walk in on a Friday in Lent and find the place empty. I grabbed a table and ordered the special margarita with the buffalo mozzarella with half anchovies. Once they started cooking the pizza it was done in just a few minutes. The wood fired oven and "kitchen" is right there in the front of the restaurant so that is pretty neat. I was able to watch them make my pizza which was pretty neat. 

About the pizza: It was the fastest I ever got a pizza from oven to plate! It was piping hot of course as you would expect. The pizza was very thin and the dough was good. I have read other reviews that complain about the buffalo mozzarella being watery and watering the crust/sauce down. I see what they are saying, although in my case eating the pizza right away it had little effect. If I was ordering take out I could see it getting soggy eventually. The sauce was pretty good, the fresh basil I think makes the pie.  

At the end of the day my experience was better than the visit to the Wayne location, however eating there vs take out makes a difference. This was good simple pizza made with good ingredients. I still have a complaint that they do not have a website that you can see the menu. I also stand by the fact they are pricey for sure! A 12" pie for $15 could be hard to swallow for some. I did see some facebook posts about specials on certain nights which make the pizzas WAY more affordable. 

Final thoughts:   I would eat here again if I was in the area but I wouldn't consider it a "destination" pizza place. Especially considering I see review after review mentioning that the place closes hours early all the time.
I received a half rotten salad tonight when I ordered delivery. I have a picture of the completely BLACK lettuce that the kitchen staff OKAYED to go out to a paying customer. Absolutely disgusting.

Wow!  A classic- inexpensive- breakfast with home cooking twist!  The special (Cajun eggs benedict) was so inventive and flavorful. So glad I could steal off my husband's plate. Wonderfully nice staff.

I have NEVER been so upset with an establishment.  I have been to xfinity a million times, and while I know covid has given restaurants many rules the staff was incredibly rude. We made our reservation for 6, and they did not let us sit at a table for 6, though we had more of our party coming. The woman rolled her eyes many times and shook her head while we just ate our meal. Service was awful. Will NOT be back even when things are normal, which upsets me because I have friends whom work there. Terrible, terrible experience. Whoever is hosting (Middle Aged woman, curly hair) deserves to be fired.

Went for a small dinner/snack on 4/8 after walking from the Cultural Trail. We initially were trying to go to Chatterbox and sit outside, but it was too hot with the sun beating down on us so we finally made our way to Louie's Wine Dive, eager to sit inside.

I had my service dog, Quest, with me. Whenever I bring Quest into a restaurant or anywhere public, I always have his vest on that clearly identifies him as a service dog and have his gentle leader around his nose so that he's well behaved. We walked in and were greeted at the host stand, and they had to "check" to make sure we could sit inside. The restaurant was nearly empty so it wasn't like there was a question as to why they were "checking". They told us we could sit anywhere, and we chose a table by the window.

The menus are laminated, and there's nothing wrong with that. But my menu felt like it was dirty or had some type of residue on it. 

I eventually settled on their chicken tacos and a glass of a more full body red wine. The chicken tacos have a slight kick to it, but I don't mind that. I knew that Mass Ave isn't exactly going to be kind to the wallet and don't mind paying more for quality food. The wine was a nice, full body wine that you can take your time with.

Finally, as we were eating, they sat a rather large group behind us in a nearly empty restaurant. While normally this wouldn't be a problem, this did create several chances of him nearly getting his tail stepped on and I think this could've been avoided if the hosting staff paid attention to the scenario and sat the large group somewhere else.

The food and drink are not bad, but the atmosphere and hosting staff leave a lot to be desired. If you're wondering why this wine bar is nearly empty when other bars and restaurants are packed along Mass Ave, it is because of experiences like this.

can i say..these crab fries are amazing!

i thought for some wild reason it came with crab but it doesn't. =( but the seasoning is amazing!! it gives it a whole other flavor, i dont know what they put on it but tis delicious. the cheese dipping sauce that comes with it completes the whole experience. i love chickie and petes crab fries!
Small diner with booths and a wrap around counter .  Food was fine; service good.  If you want breakfast at any hour or basic comfort food this is the place for you.  I'll be back again.  CASH only.

Pinewood exceeded our expectations. They do not take reservations over 8 people unless you want to sit in a private dining room away from the main area. I was hesitant at first to book because of that, it being a $500 min, and the fact that we had to have a set menu. Our party couldn't have been happier with the service, food, and drinks. Brussel sprout salad, white cheddar Mac, fries, and the bramblin man drink were all amazing. We were also allowed to play our own music in the room which was awesome. Our waiter even gave us a list of a bunch of his favorite places in the city, which i thought was really nice.

Starbucks espresso is awful, in fact its not even real espresso.  BUT... this location has a Clover Machine (one of only 2 in the state of Florida) which is one of the more perfect methods for brewing coffee.  So if you like brewed coffee this SB actually has terrific offerings with their select beans, just be sure to ask for the Clover.  And its only a $.30 premium over their regular crap brewed sludge.  But if you want quality espresso you're still out of luck.

The food was good - we ordered oysters on the half shell, a bone-in rib eye and the lobster mac and cheese. We've been trying to eat at this restaurant for years but was never successful getting in because they are usually booked several days before our visit.  We were looking forward to our dinner experience.  

It looks like a typical steakhouse and the ambience is nice, but the staff did not feel welcoming nor did we feel attended to.  The food was good, particularly for the price, however our waiter (Larry) made us feel rushed. Although he never said "hurry up", his energy was definitely reflecting that and that could have ruined our entire dinner experience.  However, there was a very nice waiter's assistance (is that the appropriate name?) who assisted Larry and was very friendly. 

I'm not sure if we would ever eat at Sterling's again based on the wait staff and hostess. Sadly we were treated better in the casino cafes than we were at this high end steak house.

Food tried:
- Bayou Black Bean soup ($4/large)

I had the pleasure of trying Circle City Soups as part of the Shakespeare at the Yelp! event last night. I'm not sure which Chef was running the booth, but I had the even greater pleasure of trying the Bayou Black Bean soup. Now, I've had me some black bean soups. I used to eat them in the dining hall back at college, and they generally made a pretty respectable soup, and their black bean wasn't half bad (wasn't my fave, but it wouldn't kill you). 

That black bean ain't got nothin' on this black bean. I mean, damn.

Spicy, smooth, and piping hot, it was absolutely, as Trevor G. and Benjamin H. before me note "the best soup I have ever had".  It was even good COLD, and I think cold soup is about as illogical as clothes for pets (they have fur for a reason, don't they?). I would not hesitate to recommend Circle City Soups to anyone, even my enemies, so they can be jealous that I tried the soup for free. 

I eagerly look forward to heading back to the city market to sneak past Circle City Sweets to the corner where the chef wears a Sun King Brewing shirt under his whites (I wonder what beer they use in the beer can chicken?), to make my tastebuds do the cha cha again.

I've been coming to this location for years and I've got to say we were completely disappointed this time around. I used to say this was a really good location but this experience has changed my mind. The customer service was okay but the food was absolutely terrible. 

First they forgot an entire meal (no biggie we just had to go back through the drive through and get it and they threw in some cookies for the trouble) but oh my god. The food was cold. The cookies had a terrible aftertaste and the chicken nuggets and onion rings were mostly bread. 

The only good thing about the meal was the drinks. Don't know what happened but it'll be a while before I go back to this one.

I have to say I shied away from this place for a while because it gave off a big corporate feel and I didn't think there brews would be as good as some smaller local places....I don't really like the weird color chart they have going because there is way more to beer than just color. But...there beer is actually pretty good. I got to try a few different kinds and I enjoyed each one. 
The food here is also pretty yummy. The price seems fair for what you are getting on your plate. Its flavorful and sharable if you want to share. haha. I love looking at a menu and thinking, "man I can't wait to come back and try this!"
The service is friendly, fast and helpful. Some things on the menu can always be confusing when its your first time at a restaurant, its nice when there server seems knowledgable about things. We actually came here from a different restaurant where we had been waiting to get served for over 20 min....after waiting that long we just left and came here. Man what a difference. 
All in all its a clean place, with good service, good food, and great beer. 5 stars because I'll be back.

Out of everyone I've talked to, Hiroba was the #1 recommendation for sushi in Reno. It is my Japanese teacher's favorite as well. Beware that it is always packed, and they don't take reservations. The staff are friendly and greet you when you enter. The quality of sushi is quite good in my opinion. I especially like their sake and unagi. There is all you can eat option as well. A fair number of people do leave quite intoxicated. They have some interesting items on the menu, so be sure to try something new!
The burgers are legitimately amazing, and the beer selection is great, but I don't know if it's worth the long waits on weekends.

This place is top notch. We were looking for a great margarita place and we found a gem. My fiancé and I have been here 3 times, each time trying something different. The food is a 4 out of 5 in my opinion, but the other aspects elevate anything that may fall below the "best." They start you off with excellent fresh chips and salsa that give me the vibe of a great Tex mex spot in San Antonio. Again, can't say enough about the margaritas. 2 of our 3 servers were beyond helpful and just a friendly face who made the meal enjoyable. Best dish I've had are the enchiladas (sampler that gives you 3 different types). Not sure if they have a happy hour, but I think tonight is the night to find out! Highly recommend Lumbrada.
This place is misleading as it's not actually vegetarian friendly unless you're okay with an expensive basic salad. Also, for all the biscuit advertising, they only serve them at weekend brunch.

I am giving a no star cause I went to the bathroom and it is filthy. The service is horrible. The time me a d my boys sat down she o ly asked me one time how we was doing. That is because she had to bring our food. I will not come back here

We have tried this place twice now. Both times the food was horrible. I would consider myself a connoisseur and have had wings almost everywhere. These wings tasted like they were microwaved. The sauces don't cover the wings and have very little flavor. The wrap we tried was a good size, but didn't have any flavor because it had no sauce on it whatsoever. We ordered their garlic Parmesan fries they were cold and tasted like yesterday's microwaved fries, also with very little flavor. It's very disappointing considering they pride themselves on their wings. Like I said I tried it twice, would tell others to avoid at all cost. FYI, Pizza Hut next door has better wings.

Stopped in on s Friday night and this place was jumpin ! Very very busy even with a reservation in place we still had to wait about 20 minutes. All of the staff was in top form and working hard to take care of their guests, food coming out all looked great. We had miso soup, 5/6 cut rolls and some yuzu to drink. All of the fish tasted nice and fresh and everything we had was on the better side but nothing really stood out ? Our server was great and we will be back at some point. Definitely worth a try and better than most sushi places in the area.

Great friends, great food and great music. My brunch experience was out of this world and I am still in a food coma from my decadent cannoli French toast and Bellini. The bar was crowded but I always seemed to have a fresh water and drink in hand! Thank you guys!

Tried Addis Nola last night and loved it! Great food, great staff, and satisfying all our Ethiopian food cravings! We had the veggie platter, lamb tibs, and special kitfo. All were good and especially with Abita Amber, the closest to Ethiopian beer on the menu! Really loved the food and the laid back, welcoming vibes! Will definitely be back again.

I went to DiMeo's for lunch with my boyfriend. It wasn't very busy and they told us to seat ourselves. Nobody came to our table to give us menus and eventually I had to go up to the counter and ask for them myself. STILL nobody came to our table. Two other people walked in after we asked for menus and sat right behind us. They were given menus right away and the waitress proceeded to go to their table and take their order. She then walked away and came BACK to that table to verify something who their order. By that time we were so aggravated that we called out and told her we were ready to order. She walked away and didn't come back. We finally had enough and walked up to the counter to return our menus and leave. The waitress claimed she didn't see us which would have been an ok excuse if we weren't sitting directly behind the two people that walked in after us and got served and if the guys behind the counter didn't see us waiting there the whole time. It doesn't matter what their food tastes like their customer service is the worst I have EVER had. I won't go there ever again.

Randomly found this while on a day trip. The reviews said to stop in, so we did. The hot chicken was fantastic, both the bone-in pieces and the tenders. The slaw and baked beans were great. (Mac-n-cheese- not so much).

His special sauce for the chicken was fantastic. The owner was very kind! We will be back!!

Fantastic food and service! My son has severe allergies and this is the only menu I have ever seen that lists all the allergens. The food is definitely on the pricier side but for the ambiance (sitting outside in the glorious Santa Barbara sun), the creative menu and the thoughtfulness of the service, I would give it a five stars.

A wonderful, warm and welcoming restaurant cabin style for your dining pleasure. Talk about a hidden gem in SB! 

Came to this restaurant in celebration of the holidays. The service was very good and our waiter was a humorous one. The man made a variety of jokes and provided some entertainment for the evening. 

The decor was like any cabin: complete with formerly live animals nailed to the wall staring right back at ya! 

Our group shared an appetizer platter, which had Stuffed Mushrooms and Pasta Marinara. Yummy! For my entree, I had the Stuffed Chicken with Vegetables and Garlic Mashed Potatoes. Wasn't bad, but hearty and tasty. I was able to save almost half a plate as leftovers. I also got to try a few bites of the Crab Ravioli, which was rich, creamy and flavorful. 

Bonus: the bread given at the beginning of your meal is just delicious! Soft and bites full of yumminess.

Okay. so. I am not all about chain restraunts. 
That being said, I used to absolutely LOVE fridays for a quick, artery clogging meal. They have fried mac & cheese bites which are SO freaking good (though, add the word fried to anything dealing with cheese and I'm up for the challenge). 

My boyfriend and I decided to go there last night, because I had a coupon and it was quick, easy & realatively inexpensive. Four things that gave the night a chance for survival. 

So, we get there, we're seated in a booth in the bar area. There was a PIECE OF FOOD on the bench! The boy of course just brushed it off--that should have been the first indication that something was wrong..that should have been my run for the hills signal. So, we sit down and order our drinks. Blah blah blah everything's fine. 

We order an appetizer. As I stated about a paragraph and a half above this sentence, I'm in love with the mac & cheese things but I wanted to try something different. We ordered the parmesean crusted quesadilla appetizer. Chicken, sausage, bacon, cheese, some balsamic reduction, crispy. Sounds great. Well, they get to the table, and the tortilla itself is so soggy! Ugh. Didn't complain, at this point didn't care. I was starving and my main concern was eating. So, I choked it down. The flavors themselves were okay (pretty generic, whatever. I'm not expecting a Steven Starr restraunt here). 

We both decided we were in the mood for shrimp. So, Friday's shrimp is what we ordered. it comes with french fries. delicious. I'm game at this point. 
Shrimp come out. Look delicious. Bite into it, it's like biting into a pocket of OIL!!!! The boy, who eats absolutely everything and never complains spits his into his napkin and I almost throw up. I try one more for good measure (maybe it was in too long? something?)  No luck. ugh. So, we send it back (I feel bad at this point, but for cheap food please at least make it fatteningly deliciousss!) I get the bruschetta chicken pasta. my fave. put balsamic on it, I eat it and this stuff is caked in it. 
My pasta sauce: watery
noodles: nasty
chicken: ugh

IN CONCLUSION: 
I threw up in the parking lot 
I think the chicken made me ill. 
The wateryness scared me (spit?) 

the boy liked his sandwhich though. wow. yay. 

Never going back--at least to that one (the one in willow grove was good last time i was there)
My go to Chinese place. Nice small family owned place. My husband and I have been going there for years now and we have never had a bad experience. Food is always fantastic.

Tried doing takeout from the Salty Lime Cantina three times. Every time was a disaster including late food, cold food, and given the wrong order to take home. Shared these bad experiences with the restaurant via its website five days ago and have yet to get a response. Their take out menu is now in the trash and we will move on to other, better functioning and more responsive dining options.

A great place for a fantastically instagramable dessert. The blackberry buttermilk ice cream is really good. The mint chocolate ice cream uses real mint leaves and is not bright green full of dye. The chicken tenders were so so, but the burger was good. The BLT was ridiculously filled with bacon it made all of our mouths water. 

All of the freak shakes are out of this world. The one with cotton candy was my favorite.

I've been here three times and every time I go, they have Great beer, decent food.
The chicharrones are amazing, the pub wings are good, the Cuban sandwich, the pan con bistec sandwich, the flank steak and ropa vieja are all decent. 
The service is OK. The first couple of times we went our server was pretty good. We went last night and sat at the bar and the bartender was a terrible server.  If we go back, definitely won't sit at the bar.

Me and my entire family (and extended family) have been ordering from Old Roman for years! I'm talking about when we first started ordering pizza from here I was just a kid too short to see over the counter. The pizza has not changed in the last 30 years!! Perfect every time, and great service. The owner is super friendly and also asks about my family. Really has that mom and pop type of feel. Their baked spaghetti and chicken cheesteak are also really great. I think we order take out about once a week or at least every other week!

I'm usually very picky about where I eat. I surprised the hell out of my husband when I took him here (it looks a little dirty tbh) However, their food is delicious. I go there at least once every time I go to Reno. 

The bean burrito and quesadillas are my faves, but I've never had anything bad there. I wish they had them in Phoenix!

Lerua's has been around for almost 100 years - it's a Tucson staple.  I can't believe it was my husband's first time there today.  I had the green chili mac with Hatch green chilies and barrio bread crumbs - I was literally saying "wow" after every bite!  It wasn't too hot as you might expect with the green chilies, the amount of cheese, chilies, and bread crumbs were perfect! Chips and salsa were mild, but so perfect.  My husband loved his chimi - there was a lot of beef - both dishes in fact were so big that we had more than enough for both lunch and dinner!  The beans and rice were just like my husband's Mexican grandma's.  Service was spot on!  The price is excellent for what you get!

I need to first start with the fact that I am not a fan of poke.  We only went here for my husband who LOVES poke.  I was blown away by how delicious it was.  All I can say is GO!!!  You will not be disappointed.

The music playing in the background was very nice and I liked how the waiters were able to handle all twenty of my friends. I personally tried their fajitas Del Mar and enjoyed every minute I spent eating that meal. Even the tortillas, guacamole, rice, and beans hit the spot. I would've given this restaurant 5 stars but the waiters could have been nicer. All in all, if you want the good Mexican food, I recommend el maguey.

This is our favorite sushi place. Not just in Santa Barbara - anywhere. Bummer they don't take reservations, but you can always put your name on the list and get a cocktail at good lion while you wait. Everything is fresh and delicious, especially the specialty sashimi's and anything with bluefin tuna.

I have traveled to NOLA many times over the years with my former wife and then with my current wife. I discovered Melba's a few years back with my current wife. The food was excellent but the overt Racism exhibited by some of the female staff really upset my wife. I am White and my wife is Hispanic, the staff who I am speaking of were African American. I was born in Detroit so I am quite accustomed to working, living, socializing with all races of people. I can roll with bad attitudes but these women were really racist towards White Males. I am a retired Fire Officer, tall, muscular, and I don't get intimidated by anyone. My wife wouldn't let me go back again and I now see that she was right. I don't need to pay my money to be treated that way. We won't visit Melba's again and I discourage others to steer clear as well!

I think this is the best Thai in the Philly area.
I've searched high and low all over center city for delicious drunken noodles... and FINALLY found House of Thai Cuisine!

Always fresh ingredients, big portions, super friendly service, AND it's a BYO.
A perfect place for date night or a meal with friends.  If you love Thai food-- definitely check out this place!
This place has improved over the years. I had pizza from there not long ago and it was awesome. Used to not be so great.

We chose this location because they offered delivery however we wouldn't have had we known in advance the promised one hour wait would actually be a little over two hours. The food was still warm when it arrived but it lacked flavor. We had pizza, wings and two pasta dishes and the wings were the highlight of the spread.

Noodle spot located towards the end of Delmar loop. The service here is fantastic and I think they've made Asian food easier for people unfamiliar with it to try. You order and pay at the counter and they bring it out to you. The staff are really nice and come by to check on you and help clean up the tables. 

We got the nudo ramen, chicken pho, and beef pho. I liked all of the dishes. The food was flavorful and portions are generous. I am especially grateful that they have reasonably priced kids meals. Kids usually only eat noodles and meat and that's exactly all that's in the kid noodle bowls. 

This was one of my favorite spots in St Louis. I'd definitely come back for ramen or pho and highly recommend it! There is street parking and some parking may be available in a side lot.

I am sitting here in the lobby of Chima now.  Where I have been sitting for an hour in spite of having a reservation.  When we walked in, they told us "10 minutes" and kept repeating that line.  Management must be either totally inept or totally unconcerned.  Our party is now all on their phones to find somewhere we can go to just eat instead of celebrate my wife's birthday at Chima.  What a shame.  I've been here before and enjoyed it, but they need management and systems badly.  I won't ever be coming back, unfortunately.
Fast delivery, large portions, decent food. I ordered beef lo mein, and it was huge! It was good, but it was kind of sweet, which I am unaccustomed to with lo mein. But it was pretty good.

Worst customer service EVER. Ordered online through yelp only to be told by rude Randy that they didn't have order even though they really did. Kept asking me if I just wanted a refund. Then he was rude the entire time I was waiting for the food talking loudly about me in front of all the next customers. Then when I asked for a refund that i no longer wanted to wait for his food I was told he gave me refund but no receipt to show it. I demanded receipt and then manager tells me they can't refund me because yelp has to so Randy lied to my face. When I asked him for Manager number he laughed and said "ok i'll give you my sisters number". Now I know why he acts the way he does. I will never step foot inside this dishonest place again and I will make sure I am refunded for the food i never got! I don't care how good people say the food may be, the service there was horrible.
Wow! We already wanted to come back here before we even left! The happy hour is amazing! The oysters were soooo good as well as the small plates menu! Will definitely be back!
This restaurant is one of a kind and the food is very tasty! Service was great too!

ZERO CLUE as to why this place has 2 stars as a total of all reviews??? Also not sure as to why people are having bad experiences when I've been multiple times and everything was excellent.

Just so everyone knows. I am PICKY. I don't mean picky as in I don't eat anything- it's the simple fact that I actually eat anything AND everything. From snails to Indian food- so that's why I always expect really really good tasting food when I go places because I know what good food is.

That being said- this place has been nothing but consistent and really really good. I'm not sure what people are ordering but everything I've had has been good. I really like their fried spicy shrimp appetizer. Also their chips and salsa are always good. I usually get the fish tacos, the ones with the purple cabbage. They are soooo good. I do get them on flour instead of corn which a server was kind enough to recommend once. I've also had their drinks and dessert. I get the Rosarito. It's a creamy sweet and tangy margarita that is out of this world. I love their churro dessert. The prices are reasonable and it's VERY consistent. I haven't ever had anything that was really greasy. For someone coming here expecting authentic Mexican- well then I could see the disappointment but this place doesn't seem to be known for "authentic" food. It's MUCH better than on the border or any other place like it.

Give it a shot for sure!

Friendly service and the food came out fast. I got the crunch roll and it was good! This is right in the harbor walk with a good view. Lots of foot traffic going by. Would be fun to order here and take it to the beach!

This is a cool spot to smoke and the staff is nice. But on a recent trip they literally had very few cigars. Maybe 10 brands. I read where they had 300 so I was disappointed. Nice layout, drinks pricey. They do not serve food.

Great selection for college kids and late night eats 
Also fab to get delivery and they will add things like lighters or tp if you ask nicely! Love them and the nice guys working tonight...updated below.  They refused what I just claimed above so sorry to mislead you

UpdateWorst service ever on a large items totaling three dollars of which I had already over tipped and accountant for a special notation asking if they could be paid for that way. It was refused even though it had been done before and I was told I was a liar that that could've been possible. 

I don't make it a point to pay people to call me a liar when I know exactly what has been done for me before I have it in the notes. The manager was rude and argumentative even though I pointed out that not only had it been done before but that it was a pretty small price to pay to keep a customer that was placing a very large order regularly from them. 

Didn't matter to him at all all he wanted was his cash in hand. I told him if he was willing to get a terrible review for three dollars then that was a fair exchange and I will only be ordering because the guys to cook the food are usually in a good mood and do a decent job and the place has a wide selection of items available but not enough added to the menu that you can order everything you need without going to the store. 

So now that I've been giving a completely distasteful feeling and I'm hardly even hungry anymore except that I have not eaten in almost 2 days due to traveling across the country with the time difference jet leg etc. and this is my first experience back home with food ordering for $50 plus order?!?! Grrrrrrr!!!!

I'm extremely unsatisfied with their ruination of my faith in their ability to run a mini mart/delivery properly, and that it took me 10 minutes on the phone only to be forced into paying for something that I already paid for in the extra tip. 

Telling me you're not the owner of the business over and over again is not an effective tool for customer service assistance. I understand not everyone has clout to make whatever changes they want but if an action is already prior performed, I don't really want to hear that now it can't be again in less than a few weeks later. 

Pretty much spoiled my entire evening to have to deal with that whatsoever and I thought I was receiving a phone call from the delivery to be outside not to just be discussed over again, $3!!!!!  I should've canceled the order but I'm too starving to bother. Sorry been enough time that it should've been cut and delivered if they weren't so busy dealing with everything else and trying to call me about pettiness. In no way did I penalize the driver either as I said my temp is going to be lower and I added additional I didn't ask them stiff the driver for me to get free items? I said I'll pay U this and u allocate it. Because it's run through Santa Barbara menus app I have to complain to them that they were unable to help me probably because of their system so now it's two companies involved in the problem and I run a local business review Instagram about sb... it's all nonsense. It's too bad they're over run with drunk college kids and I'm not one so it doesn't sit well with me to be treated as some bother.

Even though it's a good 20 minute drive, the kids and I decided during the coronavirus lockdown to get takeout from Ravanelli's.

In an effort to ensure quick service, only a limited menu of their popular items are available, but that didn't seem to affect business as there was a constant flow of cars while we were there.  It was great to see so many people supporting them.  

Since we were not able to get through on the phone to place an order the very friendly employee working the window happily took our order and had the food brought out to us when it was ready.

We got the family special of rigatoni in meat sauce with salad and a fresh loaf of bread. It was great as usual.

Each time I've been to Boogaloo I have always enjoyed myself.  Sadly I've never gotten a chance to sit on the swings at the bar and end sitting at a table or in the rear car seat. Boogaloo offers an array of drinks selections and food, though I've never eaten there.

The down side to Boogaloo is that it is rather small, so when it is crowded, you'll know it.  And because it is such a small place, when the masses come, ordering can take some time.

Boogaloo is a great place to go if you don't feel like spending a lot on what you're drinking and if you're in the mood to listen to a nice selection of 80's music that will accompany you most of the night.

We got takeaway from this place on a dark and stormy night. We had a night of netflix and chinese ahead of us. I was even thinking some chilling might occur. 

This is what we got:
Royal Ribs
Kung Pao Pastrami
Yaka mein

I've never thought food from a restaurant was disgusting. Until I took a bite of those royal ribs. and then a bite of some of the kung pao pastrami. They were, indeed, disgusting. The smell was nasty and the taste matched. If it wasn't takeaway, I would have returned the food and left.  The ribs were overseasoned. Very overseasoned. The bbq sauce was overpowered by the seasoning. The spice combination did not smell edible. The pastrami had fermented beans in it. I didn't expected them and nor did my mouth. Yuck. Eek. Methinks not.

The fortune cookie said "don't seek advice from a fortune cookie." and then on the back it said, if i want another fortune, go to secondfortune.com 

After literally throwing away the food, and then reading that snarky fortune cookie, I flipped out at my SO for suggesting we get other food from this place. She got angry because I got angry at her. I got angry from eating bad food. We didn't chill that night. Thanks Red's.

If you do end up going here since your officemates are intent on trying this place, get the Yaka mein, it was alright.

April 24th, 2017. A date that will live forever in my heart as, dare I say, my first religious experience. Everything here is what an ideal BBQ restaurant is in my eyes. The employees are knowledgeable, polite, and clearly know what they're doing. Service was fast and efficient and we got all the food for a party of 14 in maybe 20 minutes. The atmosphere was fantastic. Clearly they have forsaken the tired idea of a gimmick to just serve top quality food at excellent prices. Of their food I have nothing but praise. The Broodwich, a specialty, ranks easily in the top 5 BBQ dishes ice ever had. Pulled pork, store recipe barbeque, Hawaiian toast style bread and Mac n cheese. God is real and his presence is felt in that kitchen. I'm considering moving to Idaho exclusively to eat here. The only criticism I can find for this holy bastion of BBQ is that there was not quite enough meat in my sandwich. A passing complaint. My week is made.
Decent food at a good price.  My wife and I stopped there for lunch one day after passing by for years.  The lunch portions were perfect.  The food was not outstanding, but it was decent.

It's all you can expect from a upscale bar and more - the drinks are amazing, the staff is super helpful, and the price doesn't break the money. What more could you ask for. I've been to The Edge Bar multiple times and every experience is unique and enjoyable. I can't wait to take more friends her and share some delicious drinks and food!

First time I went, it was pretty decent. However, last time I went the food was terrible and more than half the people in our group got sick later that night. For the food, the prices are definitely on the pricier side. There are several other Thai places in Nashville with both better food AND better prices, such as Peter's Sushi and Thai, and Thai Phooket. Not planning on going back.

Civitas lives!

Wait a second, so you're telling there's a place in the downtown center for:
*Civic Expression
*Face-to-face business transactions with store owners
*Peaceful Assembly
*More specifically to: get a haircut, have a shoeshine, eat a crepe, drink fresh juice, have a burrito, buy a burrito, eat a pizza, have a beer, take home a growler of beer, have fresh baked goods, and the list goes on & on. 

And then you're going to tell me that over the next two years... renovations will happen to maximize space and utilize the original Market Hall and tear down the more modern, cavernous brick West Hall to create more park/green space? Oh, and then add a Bicycle Hub? And then slowly wean taxpayers off the costs. Damn, Gina. I'm in! 

On a standard Tuesday, I saw: people laughing, meeting, relaxing, praying, eating, announcing, working, sloth-ing, playing and, in the end, playing their part in our volunteered duty of being a city -- together.

I've been staying here for quite a few years but will never stay again. I've had problems with the hotel staff before and also problems with the buffet restaurant. When I complain, it falls on deaf ears. Always! 
Nothing is ever resolved and never an apology from the staff and never a resolution to my problems.

My recent stay was on the weekend of the barbecue blues and brews fest June 2017.
They handed me a coupon book which was outdated and expired in April so it was no use to me. I asked for one coupon book that I could use that hasn't expired and was told they didn't have any.

They have raised their rates quite a bit over the years especially when they have a special event like the barbecue blues and brews Festival that I go to every year. I paid around $310 for both nights for their cheapest standard room.

I also stayed an extra night Sunday. When I checked in they told me I had to come in every day preferably in the morning so they could re-key my card. That makes no sense to me but they told me I didn't have to stand in the regular line, I was told to stand in the VIP line and they would take me right away, and ahead of those waiting in the standard line.

When I did this I was not taken ahead of those in the standard line and was completely ignored by the staff behind the counter. I saw them glance up at me once or twice but then they went and helped the other people in the other line like I wasn't even there. I am 60 years old and it was my birthday weekend and although I sport long hair, mustache and a beard I was treated like a second-class citizen and ignored by everyone. 
I left the hotel and immediately emailed the hotel staff as I went for a morning walk and then I I called them with my complaint and was transferred to three different people including one supervisor. When I went back to the hotel there was nobody in line so of course I was helped right away but nobody was sympathetic to me and I was offered no apologies.

The following morning the same thing happened and I was ignored again so I left again and repeated the same process that I did the day before. I was told by the woman/staff member that she saw me standing there but said that if she would have taken me first, then the other people in the other line would have been mad at her. I told her this happened two days in a row and she not only took one person ahead of me but both times she took three people ahead of me and not only that but they came in after me and I was standing in The VIP line.

No apology, and she even talked down to me like a second-class citizen again. Although I am 60 years old and she was maybe 30 to 35 years old she treated me like dirt. That's supervisor was standing next to her and she didn't offer any apologies or help me at all. Their customer service is Horrific and inexcusable and unacceptable! and I will never return. 

Now the problem with the buffet restaurant a couple years ago. If I was staying at the Eldorado Hotel on my birthday weekend as I normally do and was treated to the buffet by my brother and his wife. They had finished eating and we said goodbye to each other and I remained at the buffet to finish my meal. I looked up and I was surrounded by three restaurant staff members who asked me for my receipt. At the time, I again sported long hair, a mustache and a beard. When I told them I didn't have the receipt because my brother had paid for me and he had left they didn't believe me and they escorted me out of the restaurant and would not listen to what I was saying to them. I also tried to provide them proof that at least I could show them my  hotel key card so they knew I was not trying to get one over on them as they were suggesting, and snuck in to have a free meal like I was homeless or something. As they were escorting me out of the restaurant my brother and his wife were walking in again, just to see when I would be ready to join them in the casino. I explain the situation and my brother show them the receipt. No apologies. They did tell me I could grab another plate and get something to eat. So I did and my brother left with his wife. Approximately 15 minutes later as I was in the middle of trying to eat my meal, again, I was confronted by another restaurant staff member asking for my receipt! I tried to explain the situation that just happened and they wouldn't give me the time of day to hear my explanation and insisted that they escort me out of the restaurant! Again!!!.
I can't tell you how angry I was the first time, but the second time... there was fire coming out of my eyes. And I was escorted out of the restaurant and told her not to return. I complained by phone and by email and again, no apology and no words of remorse or sympathy's by the hotel staff. And neither me or my brother was offered a refund for the meal that was paid for.


If you go to this hotel, beware!!! I will never return and I would suggest you steer clear of this hotel, it's restaurants and it's casino.

I grabbed lunch before my flight on Superbowl Sunday. I ordered Red Beans and Rice. It was horrible!!!! The worst red beans and rice I've ever had. It tasted like they dumped a cup of vinegar in it. The sausage was pretty good.

I had previously tried this restaurant after seeing it on my home from work every day. It was obviously good enough to revisit. Let me break down my experiences.

Atmosphere: 
Mr and Mrs Crab is situated on Highway 19 just north of Gandy Boulevard. The place was packed both times I went. The first time was during a weekend so I expected that the busy state was due to the day of the week. Boy... was I wrong. My wait was shorter but it was still very busy. 

As you can imagine a place as busy as I described is packed with tables and it is very loud. I sat at the bar both times because it was the first available seat. The customer service is excellent and the service was prompt. Both times I was waited on my a Bartender by the name of Jaime. 

Food:
I ordered a boil that included 1 pound crawfish, 1/2 pound clams and 1/2 pound of sausage.  The boil comes with red potatoes and corn as usual.  I requested the Mr. and Mrs. Crab sauce/ seasoning and I requested it be extra hot. 

The seasoning was adequately spicy. The taste was decent but definitely not the best boil I have ever had, I think adding a bit of thyme and white pepper would be amazing . I would say it is about #4. (Side note the best is at the three legged dog in New Orleans.)

I wish the sausage was in bigger pieces. They slice the sausage into thin slices before they boil it which takes the snap out of the sausage. 

The crawfish was good but the heads were not as juicy as last time. The clams were soft and held the most spice. 


Cost: The bill before tip was approximately $26

1lb crawfish $12.95
1/2lb clam $6.95
1/2lb sausage $4.95

$24.85 plus tax

I recommend this place if you are looking for a good boil. I will try their fried shrimp and boiled crab next time.
It was good the BBQ seem to take longer than we though make sure you order things that would cook fast.

The first time I went to 131, I was more or less apathetic. Maybe I was having a bad day, maybe I wasn't super thrilled with what I got, but my parents kept going back over and over again. I had to be missing something.

The ambiance is pretty relaxed, the people who work there are all friendly, and the average patron doesn't make me want to rip my hair out. Major points on the last one.

I've been back twice in the last month or so. And I'm glad. They start off meals with fresh warm bread (served in a big beer mug of all things). One time, we even got some fancy spreads to go with it (I remember a roasted red pepper hummus that was yum, and some kind of pate... that never was my cup of tea). I always opt for a salad to start with. It's nothing too special in terms of veggies, but the mango vinaigrette is always interesting.

Main courses - the prime rib is perfect. Perfectly prepared, and spot on. The entree that really got me sounds a little overworked and maybe a little pretentious in the land of Outback and Carabbas, but it was so worth ordering - pan roasted herb chicken breast. It came with sweet peppers, tomatoes & garlic with grilled romaine, crispy potatoes & red-wine pan jus. I was never big on grilled romaine until getting this. It all just felt "right." Plus the chicken was super moist and flavorful.

I'm always iffy about restaurant desserts but my brother decided he wanted crepes suzette. Out came the cart and portable stove thinger, the sugar, the alcohol, the fire... I know it's a little gimmicky, but the end result was so so good. I wish the fixed menu on Christmas allowed for that as an option so we could have had round 2!

Pricing is a little on the higher end, but they have an early-bird menu if that's more your style.

Cool place with an eclectic flair.  The decor is part Caribbean, part old college rental house... If that makes any sense?  Brick walls, bad conditioned wood floors.  On the flip-side any place with an enormous mirror, adorning a quote from Bob Marley, gets extra points in my book.  The food is good and interesting.  I don't think it is the type of food I would walk around telling others about but I was satisfied with the taste and quality.  If you want a tasty beverage try the Strawberry/Mint Crush.  You cannot have just one drink.  It is really really good.

Tried this with a Groupon because we were in the area.  The list of beers was nice but agree w/ George D. ... the food items were 'wanting' for selection / appeal.  Husband had the Club which was so nondescript he didn't finish it.  I had the Reuben which was okay but not stellar.  Service was okay but a tad slow.  For the price (w/o Groupon) could've found MUCH better fare.
Very good bloody Mary's. The several times we had brunch it was good. I would give 5 stars, but it is crowded with a small bar.

Food is pretty decent. Go for the frites and the burgers!  However our server Lisa was pretty inept. We ordered burgers with frites. She overcharged us claiming that we didn't specify what type of frites we wanted so she automatically gave us huge baskets even though there is a burger and frites special. When asking her about it she got really defensive and confrontational.  Also, on a separate occasion, she forgot to place one of our party member's orders. So come here, but stay away from Lisa!!

A wonderful cafe with great service and delicious small plates. The lump crab appetizer is served in a refreshing watermelon-tomato sauce. The baked Asiago crusted on top and bottom has just the right consistency.  I topped it off with the malted chocolate mousse- a sinful treat. I will come back next time I am in town.

I'm sorry, my friends have been telling me how good Rosarios is for a while.  I cannot disagree more.  I went to Rosarios with 8 friends and we experienced just about the worst service I have ever had at any restaurant.  We ordered water and drinks and 15 minutes later our waitress comes to take dinner orders without even bothering to consider that we were dying of thirst.  I had a $10 "top shelf" margarita which was well below average.   If you go, at least save yourself $4 and don't expect a rita in line with an "upscale" mexican restaurant.  The food is overpriced and everything came out cold or lukewarm and lacking in spice or zest.  We actually asked our waitress to warm up the queso appetizer we ordered and she brought it out "warmed up" and it might actually have been colder than before.  I was just befuddled by the whole experience.  I will never go back.  Rose Pepper has much better drinks and La Paz has much better food.  I'll say thank you b/c I just saved you $50 and a really disappointing dinner.
Love this place, the food is great, the staff is friendly, and the athmosphere is pretty good - typical italian.

Went here to be a DD for a friend's work party last Friday.  What the actual f*ck?  The opening band was horrible beyond words.  By the time Dirty Muggs rocked the house, half of the party was too drunk to serve, but that didn't stop our server from bringing 4 more buckets of beer and rounds of shots.  

Go here if you want a blend of NoCo ghetto and West County trash: too loud, tasteless, yet nonconfrontational, until you nearly get run into by the pot smoking driver as you sweetly tell her to turn her lights on.

So nice we ate there twice.

Was visiting Safety Harbor for less than 24 hours and ended up eating here twice: once at dinner and again at lunch. The food was excellent both times. Both times we had to order the fried pickles. Perfectly crispy on the outside with a little burst of vinegar/pickle when you bite it. The ranch dressing that they are served with was a little on the bland side but that did not take away from the deliciousness. My friends both had the veggie burgers with avocado and I had the turkey wrap with bacon and added avocado for dinner and then the buffalo chicken wrap for lunch. The wraps were sizable and tasty. The sandwiches, burgers, and wraps come with your choice of sides. I tried the fresh fruit and the onion rings. The onion rings were better for obvious reasons. They also had a nice selection of vegetarian and healthier options to choose from. 

The ice cream is clearly fresh and fabulous. Try a sundae, milkshake or scoop. You won't be disappointed. My friend ordered the chocolate peanut butter shake on both our dinner and lunch visits. 

The atmosphere is very chill. The tables are all outside on a covered patio. The sides can be pulled down during rain or cold weather. Great happy hour specials and live music. Fun place. I will be visiting again!
Amazing food and drink and they make foods that are not spicy .The cocktails a good and great price

We tried this place for a lunch - well just because it was freezing cd and we had no idea of where to go else having Sabrine's full and all booked. The Sunday lunch was not that good as I wanted. Just 2 eggs on portion of nachos with small amount of sauce. Apparently it is just a bar and place for drinking and snacking. Don't go for branches there.

I recently had lunch delivery from Michael's on a very rainy day in KOP.  I was excited that they had bagels with lox on the menu as I LOVE a good bagel with lox.  Unfortunately this was the worst lox I have ever had.  It was so incredibly salty that it was inedible.  I actually had to throw it away it was so bad.  And at $15 for a delivery of bagel with cream cheese, lox, capers, and a diet Snapple, that loss was quite painful.  Really too bad that a Jewish deli had such bad lox when you can easily go grab a decent bagel with it at Manhattan bagel, Brueggers, or even Wegmans.

I'm from NY and the one thing I'm in shock in Tampa about is the lack of decent Italian food and pizza. I was referred to Nabruzzi's by a coworker and I'm very happy I was. The service was excellent, you could tell the food was freshly prepared and the prices were great. The vodka sauce was great, they do their own spin on it and I liked the toned down flavor of it. The red sauce was a bit too tangy for me but that's  a personal preference and you could taste the freshness, so I don't take any points away for that. We had a great night with great food and we'll definitely be back, hopefully to try the pizza and dessert next time.

My girlfriend and I went here to celebrate our anniversary and it was wonderful! They food was beyond delicious, after 4 courses we were stuffed! Beyond that the staff was just incredible. Our waiter Stephan was incredible, he made the experience so much more amazing, definitely great at what he does. I was really happy that everyone we encountered was LGBT+ friendly and didn't even second guess that we were on a date to celebrate a special night (this is rarely the case when we go out we usually get sisters or roommates...) all around very impressed and cannot wait to go back! Thank you for a fabulous experience!
Cheap, bad food, and terrible lighting. If you want the typical China Buffet done right, just go to Bellevue.
Good food, fast delivery! Sandwich was fresh, perfect for lunch- would recommend this location!

Living at the shore I have my local favorites; Tony's Baltimore Grill, Carluccio's, and Express Pizza.

Number one son last year had me try a leftover slice of pizza from Bruno's and since then I had been dying to try a fresh pie from the place.

Last week we drove over and ordered a Margherita  Square pie and it was is new favorite It deserves way more than 5 stars. The perfectly cooked pie was perfectly crisp on all the edges, the sauce and cheeses used were top quality. 

The place is a little out of the way but the taste was more than worth the trip. 

This will definitely not be my last visit to BP.
BBQ chicken pizza is the best i have had so far! BBQ sauce has good flavor and like the cashews on the pizza. Nice thin and crispy crust too

THE WORST RESTAURANT EXPERIENCE I HAVE HAD, IN EVERY WAY! 
1. Waiter seemed angry to the point that made us uncomfortable. He was constantly rolling his eyes at us and scoffing at everything we asked. 
2. The bartender did not know how to make our drinks but instead of asking how gave us a syrupy icy drinks that tasted like cough syrup. 
3. Starter salad clearly had been topped with sugary sweet pre bottled dressing
4. The veal was almost impossible to cut through and completely drenched in a grey gooey sauce. It was soggy and the sauce had a strange fishy flavor that made it the first meal I have ever not been able to eat (I am actually not picky at all). The fettuccine has the same problem, the only flavor I got from the sauce was rancid and fishy. In my opinion pasta with cream sauce shouldn't be that hard to screw up, I was worried about the safety of consuming the sauce because it literally tasted rotten. 
5. The fried ravioli filling was confusing...It was completely Grey and like other reviews say, indiscernible between meat or cheese. This dish was the only one that I could make it through. 

I truly do not get how this place has ever received more than one star. I am not a picky person and found this food literally inedible. It tasted like a garbage disposable and our waiter seemed like he wanted to punch someone in the face.

Very difficult to get a bad lunch at Teds.  it is just good steak. The service is professional and the management seems to hop around trying to smooth out the normal hiccups of a busy lunch crowd.

hands on management is best and especially when the servers trust the managements server skills.  the best management is what comes up through the ranks.

Across the street and within walking distance from The Peppermill Resort-Reno. 
We decided to try Ruby River Steakhouse, it's close to our hotel and full of good Yelp  reviews. 
Upon entering we noticed the "old western theme" which continued to the ultra dark dining area where we were seated. No Joke: We removed the lamp shades to view the menu! We also removed the lamp shades again when our dinner arrived, because Its nice to see your food. I ordered the ribs which I wouldn't recommend if you enjoy or know good bbq.  My friend ordered the garlic butter steak,  which was loaded with so much butter the steak flavor had zero flavor. The Parmesan cheese baked tomato, sounds good on paper, but that's it! 
Our waitress was attentive, although the food was mediocre at best. I typically post pictures of our food choices although,  zero from this evening were worthy due to the lighting or lack there of.
.

Great local diner. Good breakfast. Lunch and dinner are typical diner favorites. Food is tasty. Diner is clean. 

However, the hostess/Cashier has always been cold, snippy and short with her greeting. Not typically what you want to see when you are going to dine out. Need someone more friendly or at least smiles and makes you feel welcomed.

Spent the weekend in Philly and Mixto was in the neighborhood of our hotel. We were really looking for convenience and ended up having a nice dinner. 

We started off with a pitcher of margaritas (yum!) and plantain chips with guacamole (ok, not great)  For entrees, I had a pulled pork dish. The meat was a little tough, but the sides were good. My sister had the Argentine steak, which was terrific. My husband had something with shrimp that he seemed to enjoy. 

It's a great place if you are a big fan of Latin/Cuban food (I'm not) or if you are just looking for a lively, fun and festive atmosphere.

Okay last time I was here we sat out in the patio and I got gum stuck to my pants the manager was so sweet and caring. I was so embarrassed but they made me feel good about how the situation was handled.  Today we came back my daughter loves the vegas roll and I like that it's on their happy hour. I gotta say that I do love their happy hour. So for a single mom who her kids love eating sushi happy hour is the best. So far I haven't had any issues with a long wait for a table. My only issue on this visit was the flys but hey they are every where, and my chair spot I got bumped a few times with the ice bucket and the glass skate carrier but Chesney was so sweet and nice attitude with kids and she paid attention to us. My kid is on a wheelchair so sometimes it's hard finding a good table that is not gonna be blocking the way. So today was a good experience.  I do love Kona Grill I do wish you guys bring the pesto pasta back tho.
This little bar has such amazing food! The wings and onion petals are a must!!! Every time I've ordered food here it completely exceeded my expectations!

A Mexican restaurant that makes frankly the worst tasting tortillas I have ever had. They do make a good Margarita but I would not recommend the food. I gave the place four tries on four separate occasions and they are consistent.

Went here with the wife. Got the BBQ chicken pizza. Nothing life changing. Wife got pasta of some sorts. Pretty decent. 
However, I should re state wonderful customer service. Host and servers were very kind and for a chain they do have great variety and a great drink menu. That alone should be worth at least one more try!

When Frothy Monkey has a line out the door, the coffee overflow customers come to Portland Brew. It is large and has plenty of space for people to hang out or work, and they offer your typical coffee shop fare with some food too. 

I stopped in for an iced coffee, and it was OK, but they don't offer soy or almond milk on the additions bar. That's a big bummer. Most places offer that! Otherwise, an OK place but I see why most people go to Frothy Monkey.

Went to the five factory today with my wife for Sunday breakfast. They had a breakfast buffet for 1099 each person are you Kinney including coffee and juice.  They had a lot of good items scrambled eggs bacon sausage links and pattie tator tots pancakes waffles sausage gravy and biscuits then danish scones fruit salad warm cobbler juice coffee and tea.  All these items were fabulous and home-made you can't go wrong.  They have all kinds of pies and cookies and cakes there are fabulous.  You can also go online to get a discount coupon. Best thing is it was not overcrowded and keep everything full.

I'm so glad great Basin opened a new location. The Sparks location limited my visits, it was just out of the way. The food is good. I've enjoyed every micro beer I've tried. Try their fried zucchini yum, yum, and their amazing home brewed root beer.

Amazing sushi.  Yellowtail was super fresh and the special rolls were amazing. I had dinner here with my daughter and we went nuts on the special rolls.  It's hard to say what was our favorite: caterpillar, Hawaiian, or zipang.  My daughter went from cucumber roll to sushi to sashimi.  It was that good.

An Uber delivery order: 

A rather awful experience last night with this burger joint. Quality control must of taken the night off. Both the chicken strips and French fries were burnt and cooked in burnt cooking oil. Nothing golden brown about our order whatsoever. I want my money back !!! Shane on you for letting this go out the door. Never mind the customer!! 

I repeat:  I WANT MT MONEY BACK ...

Well, seen them here for awhile and wanted to try something different. Since you always see the ads on TV we thought we would give it a try. I ordered the lunch special, catfish and 1 side my wife ordered the shrimp and linguine. I'll start with the appetizer biscuits they were in texture not bad but were they salty I mean water drinking salty.  I asked for butter to tone it down but that never got there till our lunch arrived. So I'll start with the catfish it looked to be fresh well fresh frozen with a batter that came with it frozen. Not pan fried, deep fried, but maybe quick oven baked.  Not terrible tasty either.  It came with sour cream and butter for the baked potato, which looked nothing like the picture, neither in size or shape.  Here's where it goes down hill.  The sour cream was not real sour cream. How do I know, I'm allergic to artificial/chemical replaced food products within 30 seconds my tongue got that weird taste feeling and my eyes started to get that sleepy look.  The butter also had an additive to stretch it out.  How much money can you save for not going real 25 cents maybe 50 cents.  My wife's lunch the shrimp linguine was below average she took most of it home as a second meal bad sign meaning will it make it to the table or trash can.  All in all when you compare your lunch to, we should have gone to xxxxxxx for lunch, then that speaks a lot in it self.  So as I finished the rest of the day waiting for my swollen  eyes to come back to normal I'll say this "BEEN THERE DONE THAT".

This is literally the slowest drive thru I've ever experienced. They average about 1 car every 10-15 minutes. The food is decent but definitely not worth such an extreme wait. They need to figure out a solution to the wait time pronto!

Finally got by to check it out and enjoyed the Franklin burger. Fries perfect, though my husband's were a bit too salty. He had the Duke and quite liked the burger. He plans to try the Hatch green chili burger next time. Corona nicely chilled with biggest lime I've ever gotten with a beer. Definitely will be back.

Baked goods plus bar plus food= "It's Friday Friday! I love it

So I got the Siren Song: spiced rum & fernet branca. If you're a scotch drinker then you'll enjoy it. Abs got the Gimlet: Navy strength gin and house made like cordial. 

Don't let the "navy strength" fool you. Mine was much stronger. I got the bakery burger. It's 100% pure angus beef, cheddar and more goodies you'll have to see for yourself.

This place is legitimately cozy. It has the feel of a small bakery with a bar. #EnoughSaid If it was closer I'd come here a lot. The bartender are extra cool and there are also a lot of board games to play. 

The amount of tasty sweets is unbelievable. So many cakes, so many cookies. Please do yourself a favor and visit the bakery bar. I swear you will not regret it.

Great menu, excellent food, friendly service, great prices! Winner all around. I had chicken rice noodle soup and loved it. The other members of my party (6 total) had different dinner menu items and all their selections!

Wow.. Amazing.. No second doubts for ones who know the taste of Momos in India and are dying to get that taste.. 

Best part, It's right in front of AMC Castleton!!

Went here with a group of 10 and although we had called ahead with reservations nothing was ready for us when we arrived. They did manage to join some tables together to accommodate us. The group seemed to be a bit much for them, but I will say I loved my shrimp and fettuccine Alfredo. It was just the right size portion for lunch and came with a salad and delicious garlic bread. It was very busy that day for lunch and I hope they do well. I look forward to a return visit.

I was looking for a great place to celebrate the first friend I met when moving to Austin, Tx. She was coming to my city and we hadn't spent any quality time together in at least 12-15 years. So, we experienced Dickie Brennan's Steakhouse for the very first time, together!

We were enthusiastically greeted and escorted to the dining room, which is below street level (I didn't know this was even an option in NOLA). Our table was positioned sort of in the middle of the room, which I enjoyed because I love to see what's going on, what other people ordered, etc. 

The ambiance was rich. Dark walls, light floors, stellar staff! This place, just being in it makes you feel special! Our service team and management were incredibly attentive, water glasses always filled, and never (not even once) did we have to look for them. 

We were promptly treated to an amuse, which was quite delicious! Then it was game on! This menu, while carrying some very traditional entrees, as well as steakhouse fare, was also packed with a few surprises. Not one to conform to the norm, I branched out...

My appetizer was bone marrow topped with escargot. So. Incredibly. Decadent.!!! I just savored every bite. It was rich and delicious, gelatinous and fatty - as it should be!

Now how does one follow up with fat? How about duck cooked in duck fat? It was an evening of pure indulgence, and I went for the confit of duck leg with duck breast. It was so incredibly perfect, bursting with flavor, juicy and delicious - just as one would suspect! Washing this all down with a beautiful Chateau Montelena Cabernet Sauvignon was the proverbial icing on the cake! 

Did someone say cake? How about a 7 layer sweet potato doberge cake with a king cake eclair on the side? This sugary dynamic duo represented all that you dream desserts would be. And the perfect sugar high to end an absolutely PERFECT dining experience. 

I can hardly wait for another special occasion, so that I can celebrate it here. 

Highly recommended! If you come here and don't love it, then you don't know how to eat ;-)

First visit here after seeing it featured on Tucson Foodie.  This resturant is run by the same family that ran Lerua's on Broadway, so we entered with high hopes.  We were not to be disappointed.   Upon entering we were immediately greeted by both the bar tender and a very pleasent young lady, she ended up being our server and immediately seated us.
The online article mentioned that the place had recently been remodeled, and it definitely showed it without taking away the charm of this mid-sized resturant.  The elegant old style wooden long bar takes up the left side as you walk towards the dinning area.  They don't serve liquor, but they do serve wine and I saw 12 different pull handles for beers, seemed to have a good selection of local brews on tap.  The dinning area was a little brighter than the bar as there are several tall windows to let in a lot of natural light.  Our server brought out salsa and chips, then immediately took our drink orders and promptly returned with the drinks to answer any questions we had about the menu
The chip and salsa were very good.they use the same table salsas that Lerua's used.  I ordered the La Bandera enchiladas (one each of beef, 'chicken, and cheese).  My wife ordered the cheese crip with carne seca along with a beef tamale.  The food came out quickly and everything was absolutely delicious. We even ordered a dozen of the beef tamales to take home.  I can't believe we've lived in town for 25 years and never made it here before, but this just may be a new go-to place for us

I know, who goes to the culinary capital of the world and eats at Saladworks? My parents, that's who. 

We did some touristy stuff and then looked for lunch. In a pinch, it works. Clean, fresh salads.

Great ambiance, great food and great service. Would totally recommend. Food came out quickly and tasted fantastic. Our server was very attentive, nice and friendly. She suggested their Banana Foster French toast saying "it is an experience you must have," she was absolutely correct. Our party loved it here. Overall would highly recommend.

I enjoyed the Neighborhood Bar & Grill!

Food was good and inexpensive as were the drinks.  Washington Apple shots were delicious and so were the Long Islands and Blue Hawaiin Margaraitas.  The bartenders, Brett & Matthew I believe his name was, were great!  They were friendly and attentive.  The bouncer/doorman, I think Bryan, was sweet as well.  This creepy old man kept harassing me and my friends and Brett and Bryan made sure he was thrown out.  Thank yaaaa for that.  

I believe that creepy old man had a glass thrown at him by a fed up patron.  That's karma for yo ass!

Lol, Santa Barabara.

Everybody enjoyed their meals. The salmon I ordered was cooked very nicely (which, unfortunately, is uncommon at even nice restaurants). Wine is half off on Tuesdays and that was a nice surprise. Seemed a little pricey ($90 after tip) for 2 entrees and a cheap bottle of (half price) wine. Service and food were great, just a little expensive. I'll go back...

Food and drinks were great. We were a party of 4.  We did the fried green tomatoe, buffalo cauliflower, sweet potato tots and cornbread appetizer. All of it was great!  We ate them too fast to take a pic...lol. Entrees outstanding. The restaurant was close to empty, but our waitress was super slow-annoying!!  This could have been 5 stars, but the slow service could not be ignored.

Everything here far exceeded my expectations. The chef is an artist who clearly takes pride in his creations. Everything was not only delicious and flavorful but it was also so beautiful. I will definitely recommend to all my friends.

Great experience! Our waiter Eric was wonderful and the food was amazing as well as great pricing for lunch. I got crab bisque with half shrimp po boy. My in laws got the Cuban sandwich and my husband got the Jimmy po boy and gumbo. For dessert we shared creme brûlée and bread pudding sundae.
For a jimmy johns extremely slow, I have to repeat my order multiple times and even then it's been wrong on most occasions. Very conveniently close to my school is its only saving grace.
Great food & fun history - check out why it's called 'Gigglewaters.' There's a small theater to watch movies that has a food/beverage server. Fun outdoor seating or indoor seating near a cool bar.

First, they tried to seat us in an empty "wine" area.  Then, when I said I'd prefer to be where people are they took us to another small empty back room.  I had two young kids with me...but I stood my ground and we were sat in the main dining area finally.  There's no kids menu, which I expected.  My friend ordered the wedge salad and it was nice looking but the bacon was burned.  I ordered the French onion soup but it was overly salted and had too much tomato flavor in the broth.  I didn't even eat half.  Then we ordered broccolini to split with the table.  It came heavily covered in red pepper, even knowing we had kids.  I normally love red pepper but it was even too much for me.  The truffle potato tasted nothing of truffles, at all.  Finally, the trio of filets was a huge letdown.  The "scampi" that comes with it was a single flayed prawn.  One.  And the sauces were on top of each steak instead of on the side as we expected, so you couldn't decide what you liked best...or avoid them for the kids.  Their menu could use a LOT of revision for clarification.  We are used to fine dining and this was a huge disappointment.  Avoid.

Indo totally lives up to all of the hype! You walk in, and the atmosphere is on point. Edgy, but not off putting. The service is amazing, shoutout to Jordan for being so awesome and for  guiding us through the menu! 

To drink, my husband went with the expat, a mezcal drink, and I went with a whiskey cocktail. I can't remember the name, but is was very balanced. We both loved our drinks!

The menu can seem intimidating, so ask questions! Our server Jordan was so helpful in helping us pick out dishes to try. We started with two nigiri: the salmon belly and the seabream. Both were incredible! The salmon belly was rich and buttery, and the seabream was so unique and fresh. We both agreed that the seabream was the best thing we ate! 

For small plates, we went with the gyoza, the isaan hamachi and the lobster thermidor. The gyoza was good! Not our favorite dish of the night, but still good. We had no idea what to expect for the isaan hamachi, but Jordan said we had to try it, and I'm so glad that we did! Along with the seabream, this was our favorite dish that we tried. It reminded us of ceviche, and was so delicious. The lobster thermidor is so decadent! It was warm and delicious, and you just feel so fancy eating it. 

Instead of dessert, we decided to do another round of nigiri. Jordan chose the cherry trout. Also phenomenal!

Indo is pricey, but it is so well worth it! We will for sure be back.
