List goes on and ends with dark brown rancid fried bananas . Litterally seemed like dumpster stuff they fried- they should be arrested for this

We came here during our trip back from San Francisco.
Environment is good as it's by the sea, at the beach.
Food is just ok, we were attracted by the sea urchin pictures on yelp, well... that didn't meet our expectations, probably because of the species, not as sweet as the ones in Japan, but a bit bitter. 
Oysters are fresh and sweet.
The fish dish ( Grilled seabass) was good. Fresh and tender.
However the seafood pasta was also a disappointment as the scallops are bit sandy and the fish are not fresh.

Hit or miss. Customer service is not great here but usually the food is tasty.  Today the steak didn't taste fresh, it  lacked flavor, the chicken was over-cooked and chewy and both items I ordered were served lukewarm.  

Had this been my first experience I would not want to return. 
First impressions usually lead to another visit. Consistency in taste and preparation is the key for repeat business.

At first I was suspicious about this restaurant receiving so many 5* reviews in such a short time- but all the reviews are valid and true. This place is truly amazing. From the service, to cleanliness to the freshness and taste of the food, this sushi restaurant is beyond excellent. I have been here twice and will definitely return.

The food here was amazing! This was one of my favorite meals while traveling to Nashville. The staff was also very friendly and helpful. I recommend getting something with the sausage. It's great! We went on a weekday so it wasn't too busy, but we heard it can have a line out the door so be ready for a wait.
Excellent. Excellent. Excellent. The tongue is my favorite and pork is my least favorite (maybe slightly too dry, but still good). Priced right, quick, and delicious.

Game changer! times 2! 

Carmen's take credit cards and they offer take out if you call ahead. So glad I work nearby now.

I've done happy hour here a bunch of times and always left satisfied, but wow, you truly can't beat El Rey's lunch special. They do chips and salsa, an appetizer, and an entree for $10. I met a few coworkers here for lunch promptly at noon -- we were seated before the rush. Booths are cozy and the place is dim, but not dark. I love that the chef's seasonal selections are included in the lunch special menu, so I opted for a watermelon salad and jerk chicken tacos. The watermelon salad was perfect--fresh, bright, lots of feta. The jerk chicken tacos were also great--stuffed, with light fruity flavors. Service is fast during lunch, so we only spent about an hour.  Servers are knowledgeable and attentive to gluten allergies. Overall, great experience.
Used to be one of my go to sushi spots, but it has gone progressively downhill.  Quality of sushi is not great, but service remains good.

Great atmosphere and friendly staff, but food just wasn't good. The steak was burnt, and I ordered it medium. It also took almost 40 minutes to get our food. Finally, the bread they serve is very dry and crumbly.
Just like the original...! No major changes in their menu form then old days in Ybor City....! Good Cuban/Spanish food at reasonable prices..!

I got the Infinite cheesesteak.  It came with a bowl of soup, chips or french fries, coleslaw and the pickle. I paid the extra dollar and upgraded my french fries to onion rings.  $2 endless cup of unsweetened iced tea.  $12 well balanced big complete meal.  I'm on a diet so I did not get the Strawberry Shortcake that looked amazing.  The cheesesteak by itself, Mesa Mesa.  It looked like an Infinite Diner made roll.  It was a good roll but maybe too crusty for this cheesesteak.  The meat was okay but the amount of meat was the weak link of this cheesesteak.  It comes with fried onions, green peppers and mushrooms.  The green peppers dominated.  The cheese appeared to have been put on top of meat while it was on the grill and then flipped into the roll.  My plate had some grease on it but I don't know if that was from the onion rings or the cheesesteak.  The woman that waited on me was wonderful.  I'll be back to the Infinite Diner to get breakfast.  If you are with me you can get the cheesesteak.

I guess I have never had a problem with Jose Pistola's because I know it's not a Mexican place.  Yes -- they serve "Mexican" food, but we all know it's an American interpretation of Mexican and that's okay because the food is pretty yummy for what it is.  Ever try Chinese food in India?  Same deal.  I don't think anyone tries to claim it's "authentic."

In any case, this is a great place to go with friends after work.  Comfortable seating, good beer selection, and nachos big enough for four to share.

Overall, I like this place.

Two things I'd try to avoid:
1. The bathrooms -- they're above the upstairs bar and don't seem to be cleaned very often.
2. The vegan chili -- for some reason, it tastes like an Indian curry.  Don't get me wrong - I love Indian food, but not when I order chili.  According to the waitress, they figured they'd "add some extra spices since it's vegan and all."  I find this absurd.

Went for lunch on Friday... service was SLOW at best.... almost like our waitress forgot about us and I think we were her only table.  Restaurant wasn't busy at all.  1st plate of
Bread that came out tasting stale, 2nd plate of bread was much fresher.  Spaghetti and meatball was ok, could have used more sauce.  Husbands mushroom ravioli was very rich and heavy but flavorful.  May come back, just hope
Wait staff is more
Attentive.
Love this place!! Great food and fast service!! We got the boys root beer floats and their famous fried chicken!  My kids loved it!
Great Thai food option in south county. Delicious massaman curry and papaya salad.

So, if I could give a zero star, I would. Called yesterday to price stone crab claws. Was quoted 16.99/lb for medium. Great! I asked if it would be the same price today. Yes. Awesome. Fought my way downtown during a seafood festival to buy 4-5 pounds of claws. Now I'm being told $20/pound. WHAT? I tell the lady behind the counter I was quoted 16.99/lb. she tells me every shipment is different and won't honor the price. Wow. Thanks for nothing. Yes, I can afford the 20/lb, but why should I give them my patronage? Bait and switch. Now 3/pound more. Never ever will I come here again.

Went for lunch today. Haven't been out for a while because of COVID. They have 12ish outdoor tables, all at least partially shaded. It wasn't busy. Our servers were great, and wore masks and gloves. We felt very safe. 
The food was lovely. We got the insalata misto to begin, house salads, entrees, and a dessert to share. $50, plus tip. That's reasonable for the quality and quantity. Also, it's a BYO, so we brought our wine.  The appetizer was good+, as it offers a nice assortment of cold foods. The salads are standard, but fresh. I love the creamy garlic dressing; my husband liked the house balsamic. The bread they give you covered in tomato sauce tastes delicious, and you'll probably eat too much of it. My husband got the veal meatballs and spaghetti and loved it. I got shrimp and mushrooms in a red blush sauce over cheese pasta (forget the name). Though on the heavy side for a hot day, I really enjoyed it. There was enough there for me to take half-ish home (I ate all the shrimp) and take to work for lunch later in the week. We split the limoncello mascarpone: light, lemony, creamy, sweet. 
To note: With an entree, you get soup or a salad included. Their soups are good, too. It was just too hot today ...

Goat Tree is a casual restaurant underneath Hotel California with some grab and go options or quick service sandwiches and salads (and some other brunch items, your usual cafe shop drinks, and a few pastries). 

You get a number once you order and then they'll bring your food to you which is easy!

I got the wild arugula salad to go with tofu. They give you the salad in one container and the tofu in another which is nice so the salad doesn't get soggy, but also felt weird getting a slab of tofu in a box. The salad was HUGE (very arugula heavy and asparagus/strawberry light), but still good. 

I'd say it's a little pricier for such simple food that isn't unique to the restaurant or town, but it's a great quick service option if you just need to grab something easily.

I liked this place.  Our waiter, Robert was stellar!  As recommended by 4 locals, I had the Loaded Chicken Black Bean Nacho for $7.73 (the other dish I was told to try was the Lucayan Salad for $7.78).  The topping was very flavorful and a good portion size, however, they use the (think ball park circa 1980) old-style, thick round corn chips.  I felt it really detracted from the dish. 

 I WILL return with 'Mr. J' Next time I plan to order the Beans Plus Three! for $6.32. P.S. I love their pricing! (see my menu photo)
New to Downtown Indy. Stop where you are nd go eat at Giordano's downtown Indy.

three stars because, i've never sat inside & had a meal so i can not rate on service and their atmosphere inside but, i do go through the drive through & their bbq baked potato + all sides are sooo good! try it out if you're in a rush & need a drive thru but not drive thru quality food.

I stopped here for the first time this morning.  The sweet man at the window made my day!  He was kind and friendly and looked me in the eye.  That's hard to come by these days!

I got a White Chocolate Mocha that tasted just as good as the one I normally get at that other place.  If you've ever wondered about that tiny house in the parking lot off of Manchester....go! You won't be disappointed.

This place is fantastic. Food and service are top notch. 

We had the 4 piece falafel appetizer and each had a classic gyro. All of it came in GIANT portions and was very, very good.

There was only one girl working in front and I assume a cook or two in the back. The girl was very nice, attentive, and smiled frequently. She also apologized when we had to wait for her to answer two phone calls for To Go orders. Our food was prepared quickly.

I will definitely be back to try their lunch buffet sometime!

This is a wonderful place to eat. The atmosphere is perfect. They have great service and really good food. It's very popular so it may be a little hard getting a seat but the dog have a bar if you have to wait for a table.

Yum! This is the breakfast/lunch place you are looking for!  Everything was fresh, perfectly seasoned. They make the bread in house, sell beautiful cakes and the coffee is super tasty. All locally sourced and environmentally-friendly. Go now - with just two weeks under their belt - this place is going to be discovered and busy. Enjoy!
Interesting set up. Full crowd. Very noisy the whole time. Friendly and informative staffs. Excellent Chai!
Probably the best macarons I've ever had. Sucre who? lol the teas were amazing as well! Super friendly staff. Can't wait to go back and try more of their drinks

Oxbow is cute. My boyfriend and me really liked this place, the one gentleman that serves tables has always made our experience amazing. The younger girl however dissapoints. She says sorry for the wait nearly every time shes at the table, brought me cold food with a hair in my French toast, a latte without the vanilla I asked for, and watched her sneeze and cough behind the counter without even caring about where the sneeze went. If you're sick you shouldn't come to work. The owner was not exceptionally nice about my dogs either. We probably won't be back, one too many times.
We love this place and it is the best Mexican food in STL. Reliable friendly service and just the best food.

There's no reason to go here.  Awful salsa and chips, truly terrible.  I'm hesitant to give it one star because those are reserved for the truly mindblowingly awful joints that will give you dysentery.  The menu is really expensive and it always seems dead in there.

Perfect meal from start to finish! Great waiter and attentive staff. We shared plates- started with lamb meat balls and shrimp hush puppies which were both wonderful. Also shared beets with labne and pistachios- there was some unpleasant texture- it was maybe hard quinoa but flavor was great. Carrots with ricotta and dill gremolata were outstanding. Spicy broccoli was complex and delicious. Short rib was great but I didn't taste any notes of mole. Scallops were perfectly cooked- rice and coconut milk based sauce completed the dish. Sticky toffee pudding was rich and delicious and the huckleberry mess was the perfect combination of sweet and tart, soft and crunchy.

We always love our trips to Far salmon. Whether it's dine in. Or take out, we never end up disappointed. As such this is our number 1 date spot. And our favorite sushi spot. It a reliable, fresh, and tasty all the way through. Start with the edamame and finish with as many rolls as you can handle!

Mothers day 2013. Tourist trap! We had confirmed our reservation with Cafe Del Rio before we drove Mom in from Yerington, the owner, seemed frazzled why overbook such a small place.2 servers. We waited and waited finally we got our food it was cold the slow server never came to check on us.  We saw her check other tables she must just have forgotten?  We liked the live entertainment blacks ants on the cheap plastic table cloths.  The ants liked the service.  Not us!

We were craving some Italian while keeping it downtown, so we ended walking down to the Landing to hit OSF for the first time.

Decor - Very nice.  Historic building, lots of dark wood, low key lighting.  I think they managed what other chain places wish they could.

Started off with the tapenade.  A bit oily, but still quite tasty.  When i saw it was being served with flatbread, I expected pita, but instead had matza-esque flatbread.  Nice touch.

Salads - dropped the extra $1.25 for the Caesar.  It was decent and had more flavor than others have said, but you'd be kidding yourself if you thought it was handmade.

Entrees - I went with the meatloaf and my wife hit the lasagna.  Both met expectations.  And thank goodness, no Provel!  As part of the meatloaf entree, I had a side of the spaghetti with mizithra and browned butter.  It was interesting -- extremely sweet.  Imagine butterscotch or toffee spaghetti.  That might be a bit too dramatic, but it is sweet.

Dessert - hey, free ice cream, you can't beat it.

Wine - dropped $20 for a bottle of Mondavi cab.  That retails at around $8-10, so the markup wasn't anything too horrible, especially compared to more upscale places.

Service - we were promptly seated and our server was attentive but not overbearing.  We were taking our time making decisions and he recognized that and did not rush us.

One thing to note - the entire place is non-smoking.

If we could give 1/2 stars, I'd probably bump this up to 3 1/2.

Hands down my favorite steaks of all time.  Their rolls are what does it, they are out of this world.  I live in Center City surrounded by "Philly" steaks and I would take Champs any day, any time over all of them!

BESY KEPT SECRET IN SOUTH TAMPA!! If you have not tried this place, you are REALLY missing out!  Their breakfast is delish!! The cappuccino is excellent and the staff is wonderful!  The prices are super reasonable also.  Can't wait to come back!!

The Red Light mussels are to die for! The buttery, spicy, garlicky, and "mussely" broth was sooo freakin good I kept using one of the shells to scoop up for slurping. 

Served with fries, bread, with some sort of Sriracha/chipotle mayo.  $17 + tax + tip. Nice amount for two people. 

Can't wait to go back.
I LOVE this place. The food is great, music is awesome, the view is relaxing, and the drinks fun! I'm from indiana, and I try to visit Ukulele's everytime I come to Tampa.

The P in PBE actually stands for pretzel. Do not sleep on the crab pretzel. It is straight fire and probably one of the only ways to get me to eat artichoke. It is also quite filling so definitely call in some back up for this bad boy. 

We also ordered two 12 inch pizzas. Montgomery was good, it was topped with nicely spiced sausages and pepperonis. The shue was very good. The sweet bbq chicken was a nice balance to the salty and spicy Montgomery pizza. 

We ended up taking half of each pizza home because the crab pretzel was just that filling. Next time we will opt for two 7 inch pizzas but there is not way we are skipping out on the crab pretzel.
Been to many subways. This is the cleanest and best managed. Guys who work there are great. Nowhere better in Indy or Carmel area.

Yesterday was my fourth and last visit.  When my sushi came, the tuna was discolored and stunk like rotten shellfish.  I asked the waitress, May, so very nice, to ask the sushi chef to come to my table to taste it, because I surely would not.  He came over and said he was "ashamed" that the kitchen would serve such garbage.  I told him I ate there last week and the sushi was exceptional and asked him what had changed.  He could not answer the question.  I just had to leave, it was disgusting.  I will never in my natural born life ever eat there again.

This is one of my most favorite Thai restaurants In Santa Barbara. The pineapple fried rice is incredible and so is the yellow curry. The flavors are divine and mouth watering. The service is courteous and the food portions are perfect. I highly recommend this restaurant.

We found ourselves randomly in Ambler and hungry. Forest and Main is closed on Mondays,  so we yelped the Feedstore.  It was great. They just opened in December. The fried pickles were for real barrel pickels. We got lemonades, the pickles and two burgers.  I upgraded my fries to be Mediterranean (olive tepenade, garlic butter, and feta) to go with my regular burger. We also tried the burger with cream cheese, salami and a pepper jelly.  We wished the jelly had a kick to it, but it was good. We took home leftovers. The burgers were cooked perfectly, and were juicy and delightfully messy.  You can park at the beer store or (closed) bottom dollar across the street. There are a few spots behind it, but there are also residences back there, so read the signs. There was a yelp deal which was worth downloading.

Nevel fails to disappoint. Food is creative and tasteful and the atmosphere is hapnin'. This place is always busy and it's no surprise why: a lively crowd, great decor and fabulous food. While not cheap, the portions are generous and the flavor, preparation and presentation divine. Really a great value for what you get. A chain restaurant that still pays attention to details and gets it right.
This is my favorite sushi in town. The sushi is great..I love the mermaid and my kids can order from the coffe shop menu. The crab and shrimp are delish too.

I have been to this place twice and both times were pretty good. 

The service is awesome. The waitress was running all over the place to make sure that everyone had refills.

The sushi is bad. Stay away from it.

The tacos are like philly cheesepork and may be the weirdest taste you ever experience. Not bad......Not good........Different.

They have some of the best wings in Nashville. This is a great place to visit if you are in the area.

I came in for lunch. The bartender, Carly, has the perfect recommendation for a drink. If you like moonshine, there is plenty of options. Beer on tap but definitely good choice for a variety of cocktails. 
For lunch, I had the chicken breast sandwich   It's made with corn flakes which brings great texture and crunch. The chicken was moist and not dry at all. It's was advertised  with horseradish mayo. Order extra on the side for dipping or more flavor.  The lunch menu  is really a great value. 
The wings are really nice. Moist and flavorful.  Cooked well. 
Really a nice place to stop by.

TERRIBLE SERVICE!  Our waiter was literally grumbling to himself the entire time and said he validated our parking, but he didn't. We went in to grab a beer and get our parking validated. This was a bad decision. 

The table behind us couldn't get his attention and finally walked out on their check. Usually, I wouldn't be ok with that, but I had watched them wait 20 minutes trying to get his attention. 

We got an app and two beers. The food came out quickly, but the beers took forever. And only one beer came out. If I hadn't been paying attention to what he grumbled to himself, we would not have known he knew we were expecting another beer. He grumbled quietly that the keg needed to be changed. I understand that, but he did not communicate that well at all. Also, I was a waiter for years. If I have a delay like that, I bring the customer a water and have two back up choices that are similar for the customer to switch to.

Even on a busy Saturday, Portillo's staff rocks with efficiency and friendliness. People are walking in droves to enjoy lunch. The staff here never misses a beat. 

Tables are a little hard to find but the bar seating is available. 

We were seeking a light bite and created our own pick two by sharing the chopped salad and Big Beef. 

The chopped salad is my fav menu item. The Big Beef was a new item for us. My husband loved it and it was plentiful and stacked with beef. My tastebuds wished for a little cheese and mayo (but I don't need the calories & fat).

Solid 4 stars. Prob a 4.5
Friendly staff and fast service.  Food is reasonably priced and good.  The burger was flavorful, shepherd's pie delicious and cheese pizza --- yummy with a super thin crust!  Would eat here again!

WOW!! This place was amazing! I took my daughter here for her 21st birthday upon recommendation from a good friend and was blown away! They brought us out infused water right off the bat and it was crisp and refreshing.  We ordered the humas platter and our enjoyment continued. I had the raw fettuccine and my daughter had the burger. The fettuccine was like nothing I have ever tasted! The noodles were made of zucchini and were covered with their version of vegan Alfredo sauce. The dish was rich and filling and I had enough  to take home for seconds! I even managed to get a bite of my daughter's burger, which was no easy task seeing as though she was devouring it at break neck speeed. It was moist and tasted great also!  Of course we had to order dessert.WOW WOW WOW!!  And that's an understatement!  We had the avacado mousse with chocolate and raspberries and the cashew cream dish.  They were both AMAZING!! PEOPLE THIS PLACE IS A MUST TRY!! Thank you Friedas for raising the bar on vegetarian cuisine in St Louis!!!

Gourmet grilled cheese for grownups and kids alike.

- Perfectly balanced flavors in the Flying Dutchman
- All the kids loved the mac & cheese grilled cheese
- Accommodated our group of 20 in a small, private room with a couple of hours' notice

I love the vibe of this place!! I've only had the opportunity to sit inside but the outside area is super cool with live music, bar and lots of tvs for sports. I only have had the Poutine Fries and Cheeseboard(twice) and they both were AMAZING. I went back the following week for another cheeseboard. The 3 selection option is perfect for 1-2 people and we got the 5 selection which we shared with 5 people which was perfect! I definitely plan to go back to this place. Recommend making a reservation!!

After a long work day and being stuck in a 3-hour traffic jam, I decided to swing in here to veg out and grab some grub to wind down. Because of the traffic I was in a crappy mood, so I came in with an edge. Anyway, I sat at the bar and got waited on right away - service was great.  Then I ordered the burger with the Jack Daniel's sauce - woah that stuff is good.  The burger itself is nothing special, however, the Jack Daniel's sauce is what makes it.  After all - it's a chain restaurant burger.  Long story short - it was a solid experience and for the top service I gotta give it 4 stars.
Taste is good but they barely give you any açaí. My entire bowl was granola. I think their issue is that they put granola at the bottom and top so it's barely any açaí when they put it in.
Great dish! I got the burrito and it was more filling than I ever would've imagined. Also the steak actually tastes like steak.

First time here. Food is not all that great. Very typical roast pork/duck. Every waiter here hates their job. Walked in with a group of four, and the the lady told us to wait , someone is leaving. Then the waiter comes out of the dining room and strictly says"there are no seats!" A good ten minute wait, we take a peak into the dining room and there are three empty tables. And look what we found? A cricket in our vegetables .

This place likely has the best pizza in New Orleans. The food taste excellent and the service was great. I had a cheese slice and a spinach feta roll. My crew also had a variety of pizza by the slice and also liked it. The price is reasonable and the food is great, there isn't much more to ask for. Definitely check it out, it will remind you of home slice in Austin
Came here for dinner and the sushi was horrible.  The ramen may be good, I can't speak to that, but I would not order sushi.  None of the sashimi or rolls we had were even slightly appetizing.

This little bistro in the Nevada Museum of Art is a hidden gem. In addition to being a nice place to have a little glass of wine and a snack, they serve lunch and have a dinner tasting menu. 

They have recently began a weekend tapas menu for happy hour, which is a nice way to sample some small plates. They change the menu regularly to keep it fresh, and the service is good.

I have no idea how this place is rated so high! Maybe I went on an off day but the rice was soggy, the tuna was fishy, the sauce was minimal so the bowl was dry, and the inside of the place looked a bit of a disaster (should've taken that as a warning!). The tuna was so bad I had to throw the bowl away. Overall this was one of the worst poké bowls I've probably ever had. And I've had a ton (all around the country) so that's saying a lot. The icing on the cake is they upcharge you for things like avocado and crab, so I paid $15 for this very disappointing bowl.

Hey, it's OK.

Had a bit of a Sushi-Jonesing the other night and yelp directed me to this place.  It was good and not overpriced.  Having their own parking is a plus but I can see where those spaces would fill up quickly (with Land Rovers and Benzes) on a weekend night.  After negotiating my way past the beautiful people, I was seated at the sushi bar.  Funny, I was the only one there.  Doesn't anyone appreciate the at the bar experience and checking out the fish personally?

I went with some Uni (shock there, huh) and a sushi/sashimi combo platter.  I'm guessing the old guy might be the owner but he was slightly annoying.  "Hey buddy, large Sake for big man".  Whatever dude, I'm only 5' 5" tall. The Sea Urchin was fresh but a bit too much rice.  The combo platter was plentiful and nicely presented.  Good stuff but nothing to blow my socks off.  The chefs seem to be just going through the motions rather than interacting with the customers and offering suggestions.  Who knows, maybe they don't speak english.

This is my favorite wing place, but I have to say the service here at this new location is HORRIBLE.  The staff is very friendly, but it just seem like they have very limited training.  You constantly have to tell them everything you need, even the obvious.  And the food comes out VERY SLOW.  

I was very excited for this new location on the westbank, but looks like I will just be coming back here for to-go.  If you plan to dine in, you have been warned.

Ate here tonight with a couple co-workers, we're all from out of town. Thought we'd try this place as a local option. Atmosphere was very nice, older home turned into a restaurant. They use fresh ingredient from their garden, which was awesome. Organic options, and local beef. 

Service was quick and friendly, though it being a Tuesday they weren't terribly busy. There was also local entertainment, the band was pretty good. Though is louder in the main dining area, so if your looking to have conversation probably not the past place to be seated. There were rooms not near the band so if you are looking for something more quiet and romantic, still a good option. 

Food was great and flavorful, and cooked perfectly. Didn't have desserts as the entre was plenty. Also, drink selection was very good, no shortage of choices. 
Definitely would recommend to anyone.

Awesome food. Love Dan Dan noodles like everybody else. The place is beautiful bubbling with energy and the servers are really nice folk too. My kinda hot food. This time around I tried the spice level 10 fish which I didn't quite like. But I loved everything else, space and people included, hence I am ready to let it pass.
Han is one of my go-to's for sure!
Oh and remember they do not serve dessert!

Ok food.  Lots of customer service problems.  I tried to order online on the "we now have online ordering" button, but it took me to a page that said "online ordering coming soon" :(  So I called and placed an order for pickup.  When I arrived, I went to the pick up counter, but was told I had to get in the ordering line to pay.  It took at least 10 minutes - kind of defeats the purpose or ordering ahead.  I asked the cashier about it - she said they too have asked management for a solution to this, but they won't do anything about it.  When I got home, the had forgotten to put in the green juice.  Not a great experience :(

Cute study area with decent coffee.

We stopped by here just to get a quick pick-me-up. I must say that it's a really well lit and spacious coffee shop with enough plugs for those who want to camp out and do work. The cold brew wasn't something to rave about​ even though it's the most popular coffee.

This place is everything. They need to make a location in NJ. Or maybe I can just go to Nashville every year. I ordered their iced turtle latte, sparkling blackberry lemonade, and the Gail salad. The salad was probably the best salad I've ever had. The coffee was excellent too. The lemonade was unique in that it was carbonated. I really enjoyed eating here. Service was a little slow but that did not bother me since the staff was so unbelievably friendly and outgoing. I've been craving to return here since I left!
Great Sandwhiches and awesome beer selection. The potato salad is delicious too. So many good samwhiches I have a hard time trying to figure out which one to get! Gotta try them all.

WONDERFUL! The food is genuine, homemade Italian cuisine. The service was phenomenal!! We were a party of 10 and we called 30 minutes before arriving and he had the back room open for our entire party. Thank you Verducci' s!!!

I really wanted to like this place. Not only was it my first meal in New Orleans but I was ready for my first real meal in more than 24 hours. And so many excellent reviews. 
What a disappointment. The service was meh. One anecdote among several I could pick from: never before was I asked if I was interested in dessert while still in the middle of chipping at my entree, nor was the bill dropped on my table with my plate still half full; I assumed the shift was coming to a close but was wrong.
The food was average at best: the ceviche, bland and very small; the chips, greasy and turned soft; the crispy fish, very smoky. OVERPRICED too, which is the reason I retracted a third star. Louisiana cuisine has to be more than that.

great place.....i love this restaurant...i get good service and great food. the ladies here are so nice and that they are so welcoming. i come here alot and so does my family. they have really made this a popular hangout in lutz. i am hoping they have continued success in all that they do. thanks guys, for being awesome !!!

LOVED IT!!! The service from Jennifer was top notch! She was so friendly, attentive and pleasant!  Ambiance is amazing-could have spent hours looking around and admiring the decor.  The food was delicious-we ordered some appetizers, entrees and drinks. Everything was wonderful, we cannot wait to go back!

Believe it or not, I had never set foot in Joey K's until recently, although I feel like I've eaten at every other restaurant on Magazine, at one point or another.

We decided to go right when they opened, in order to beat the lunch rush. I love the decor with a room full of Simon's artwork- it all felt very New Orleans. We started with an order of onion rings and I decided to get the 4 piece chicken meal which apparently comes with two sides.

The onion rings were great! They were battered nicely and the batter actually stays on when you dip them into ketchup. That had a good "bite" to them and they were sturdy and good. The chicken- wow. So, with the four piece order you get two wings and two breasts. I made it through a breast before I was calling for a box, so that I could snack on the rest later. The chicken is juicy, falls off the bone and I like that the batter has a good crunch to it. Green beans is their "given" side and the other side I chose was mashed potatoes. The green beans were tasty and I could tell that the mashed potatoes were homemade. Excellent!

The food here was wonderful and I'm eager to return. If I decide on the fried chicken next time, I might skip the onion rings, just so I have space for more than just a breast!

One of the best chickens I have ever had. Flavorful, tender and moist, it is everything you want from your chicken. I was sorry I could not have more as I already demolished half a Dinic's roast pork sandwich when my uncle offered me some of the chicken he got from Dienner's.

Next time I am in Philadelphia, I will make sure to stop by again.
Bait and switch, can you believe it. Who reads the small print, really. A gift card that you don't accept  for to go orders. You should be ashamed of yourself. I won't be back!

1. COLD as ice crystal alligator appetizer...sent it back!!!!
2. Long wait for our orders to be taken.
3. Worst food ever in Bourbon St.

I've been many time to the nada in Cincinnati so I was uber excited that the restaurant made its way to Indy. 

Get the Rojo Sangria. It is by far the best Sangria in Indianapolis.  Beware, it's strong! Especially the fruit. 

I've tried the salmon and pork belly tacos. Only downside (compared to a restaurant like Bakersfield) you can't mix and match the tacos. Go with friends and each get a different taco so you can share!
Food was very good. Happened upon it on March 10 while walking. Glad we stopped. Great atmosphere and they played good music. Will definitely go back there for the chicken.

If I could give us a zero star I would. We drove all the way from trafalgar indiana Which is over a 4550 minute drive. We get there and we get seated. We can go up and get some food and it all looks like it's been there all day. We also went around 530. The lady on the phone told me the dinner price was 8.99 on the phone Per adult and kids 3 and under are free 3+ kids were 4.99. We kept having to go up and get plate after plate because everything we tried was either extremely hard or dried out nothing was fresh. We had to get up and get our own drinks because no one really ever came back over to help serve on us if you had to ask for some thing they seemed irritated and mad. After a little while the lady brought us her check. Our check was $70. They charged us more than what they told me on the phone. When we told them we didn't think it was fair for what we were paying for all the food that was all dried out and have been there all day. And that's not what they told me on the phone before we came over. The lady then got mad and acted like she was going to grab my card out of my hand because I didn't think that the service was good or the price. She then got mad at us and took off five dollars. I will never refer this place to anybody that I know. And will never be going back again.
Good simple fresh griddle burgers and fries. Nothing else, just hot fresh quality burger and fries.
Every sandwich and salad we've ordered from Snarfs has been delicious. Great value, super flavors, and fresh ingredients.

I attended Harry Potter weekend and ended up eating Japanese.... not very "wizardly" of me, but at least there was no wait. 

I sat at the sushi bar and had a delicious meal starting with the steamed shrimp dumplings with ginger ponzu.

We then shared the Dynamite, Firecracker and Red Phoenix rolls.

Everything was fresh and delicious and the service was great. This was a lucky find!

Food was great but the service was slow and apathetic. I had the phat Albert burger and it was great. My girlfriend had the shrimp and grits which was also good. However, service took forever and the place didn't seem like it had a big lunch crowd.   Waitress forgot my ice tea! Three stars for the food but if you have schedule to keep forget it. Three for the food.
Ordered beer battered fish and shrimp. Food was ok I've had better. Not a fan of skin left on fish

I'd say it's safe to say they won't be open for very long...
yay... another overpriced "artisan" pizza place. /end sarcasm.
I wasn't at all impressed by the quality. the taste was similar to that of a frozen crispy totino's pizza that you can get for $1 at kroger.
add to that, the pretentious cane sugar sodas. not great if you don't like soda. instant tea? seriously? it's 2016. get brewed tea already.
my friend and I were there for 2.5 hours on a saturday catching up and I never once saw anybody  come out to clean tables or fill the parmesan shakers and our table was dirty to start with. plus, the "cane soda" area was messy and unkempt.
peace out...

We are staying in the area and wanted to walk around Media after dinner. We decided on a whim to walk in to Iron Hill to try out some local beer. My husband got a flight and I got a Philly Special. Beer was good. Service was not overly friendly, as we would have liked to know more about what we were drinking, but it was still satisfactory.

My son took me here for mother's day. 1st visit & we had the boise, the prince & the yellowstone rolls. the yellowstone was hands down the best of the three & will absolutely get it again. i like the prince. the lemon juice was an interesting addition that worked for me. my son did not like it. the boise  was the first time i liked eel on a roll, but not a preference for next time. it seemed to have a bit much going on. my son said his drink tasted bad, but couldn't tell me what was going on with it, he had a sprite. the staff was very friendly & willing to provide service. i do hope they will have a happy hour or an all you can eat sushi option at some point. just can't find that in boise. the restaurant is clean inside, but has sake boxes stored out on the floor behind an end booth. i get it's a smallish location,but that just seemed unorganized to me. over all a good experience. food & service good. didn't give me a wow factor, but will return soon.

This local restaurant is terrific.
Hrs for dinner limited to thur thur sat. but food & service is great. 
Chicken marsala, lasagna &chicken parm are very good along with free glass of wine. It is byo. Balance of wk is 7am to 3pm and lunch menu is also very good. Would recommend highly prices are reasonable.

Lunch last week on a return trip from Philly.  Nice looking place just off Rt. 73 between Berlin and Marlton.  Very nice inside, was greeted promptly and seated in a booth on the Berlin side.

Very complete menu with lots of choices.  I got the Chicken Florentine in a cream sauce.  Very good and cream sauce is very rich.  A good amount of food for lunch.  Wife grabbed it from me about halfway through so I wouldn't stuff myself.  Glad she did - great lunch next day.

Wife got pasta with white beans in a white wine sauce.  She loved it.  Pasta and beans are a favorite.  

Cup of chicken escarole soup was only minus.  Chicken was tough and stringy.  Broth and rest of soup was excellent.  Very good heated rolls with lunch.

Waitress was very kind and attentive. We had the coconut shrimp as an appetizer which seemed overcooked but the sauce that came with them was tasty.  Blackened grouper sandwich was good as were the sweet potato fries. Also ordered the steamed bucket (crab, clams, mussels, shrimp) which was good. Nothing was knock-your-socks-off amazing, but nothing was bad either. The view outside would probably be amazing during the day, but we went around 8pm so we couldn't see much. Lots of cocktail options but not much for drafts. Decent selection of bottles ranging from wheat beers to IPAs.

Absolutely delicious. I've tried sandwiches, pepitos, and arepas so far, and they've all be excellent. Delicious flavors, friendly staff, affordable prices...all in all a great and welcome addition to the Mt. Juliet/Hermitage area!

Easily the greatest restaurant in Pinellas Park. I cannot say enough good things about this place. The service is always fast, kind, and accurate. The food is always fresh and incredibly well portioned. Don't be surprised if you're the only one there who doesn't speak Spanish; I think that only speaks to the authenticity and the staff will usually have a bilingual employee to help you out. 

What are you still doing?! Go try this place! 

P.S. I highly recommend the burrito mojado!

Great "Scotty's Brewhouse" spin-off concept...really nice, chill, easy, CLEAN place to hang out in Broadripple with friends or before a night out. Tons of TVs, but seating is semi-limited so there may be a wait for a table. Free popcorn while you wait. Get the pepperoni stuffed breadsticks, Hummus pizza & a Double IPA....Mmmm! Support your local businesses!

Very disappointed to see this Raleys turn into a snobby health food store. No more Diet Coke, no Lean Cuisine, no Activia yogurt. This was my go to store, but not anymore. I'll be heading to Safeway on Steamboat Parkway, when it opens May 17. Bye, Raleys!

They have a happy hour every day, enough said.

Bacchus is relatively new. When my boss chose it for our holiday party, I was perplexed. I had never heard of it before and I'm pretty good with knowing most notable Tampa Bay restaurants (it was my job for two and a half years). I felt validated when I was walking, trying to find it, and two lovely ladies who asked me where I was going (I looked super lost) had no idea this place existed either...and it turned out we were across the street. 

Now that I know this place exists, I can see why it's my boss' favorite place for a date night. It has happy hour every single day (even on the weekends) from 4-7 p.m. and it consists of a variety of cheap appetizers ($4) and drinks. I could make a meal out of the happy hour! If this place was closer, it would be dangerous for me. 

The charcuterie options are very good. I didn't take pictures, because I was trying to not stick out at my first holiday party for my new job, but I was very impressed with the spread. My favorite, by far, was the truffle cheese. It did not skimp on the truffle. The slices of cheese were pretty large and I selfishly took a whole slice of the truffle cheese and enjoyed every bite. 

The flatbreads were also very good. I had a mushroom one that I enjoyed. 

It is a smaller restaurant. We were off to the side which isn't the best place for a party, because it is so narrow, but I can see it being lovely just for sitting. 

I also found out that they packaged the remaining food to give to my boss the next morning. I really appreciate that they do this to prevent food waste! 

Since it is DTSP, you have to pay for parking. Luckily this place is super close to the Sundial parking. It was $5 and I was set for the evening.

If you have a girl's night or a date night and want a nice place to go, this is your place!

Great burrito version of pick your own ingredients like a few sandwich chains.  I Love the black beans.  Everything was perfectly tempt so that the sour cream didn't melt but also didn't cool my burrito.  That's a real tough thing to do.  I loved all the selections and since my child has a tomato allergy it was wonderful to know the staff was willing to go out of the way to ensure she got a great burrito without issues.

Let's start by saying, if you haven't been in before, you should definitely stop by and try one of their burritos or fish tacos for lunch.  I usually get a chicken burrito to-go but today I got the fish tacos and wow, they were yummy!  Burrito is perfect size for lunch, filling and the price is right.  All of the ingredients are sourced locally and everything is noticeably fresh.  Nicole and Joe are extremely nice and welcoming every time I come in.  I've been grabbing lunch here a couple times a week now.  This is the perfect burrito joint I was looking for (they have much more than just burritos, I just always order one).   They also have fresh sausage from Mitchell and Geno's.  I haven't personally tried the sausage but I'm sure it's as good as everything else they offer.

Such a sweet and refreshing way to start the day with a berry bowl. Me and hubs shared the bowl and were fighting for the refreshing goji berries :) The goji berries were definitely worth fighting for #simplepleasures in life :) The decor/ambiance/servers were quite active and lively. They were kind to keep my forgotten hat on their chair and give it back on my return in the evening. Will definitely come back!

This is a little hole in the wall right down from the hospital that has indoor seating and take out. Not much parking is available.

I'd been fighting something viral, so was looking for some good Asian soup. We both had the meat soup, (Special Combo eye round streak, brisket, tension, and meatball, as described in the menu) fit $9.50, spring rolls for $2.99, and Vietnamese iced coffee).

It was takeout, so they gave us the meats separate from the broth. I over heated the soup and ended up overcooking the beef, which I like medium rare. The portions are huge and have the usual pho vegetables and peppers you can add to taste

The older lady who waited in us was very nice. There was a bit of a wait, so I had one of their iced coffees to kill time. They have a wide variety of coffees and bubble teas you can enjoy while waiting.

This restaurant has changed ownership. Remains to be seen what the total impact to the menu will be, but already I have not always liked the substitutions and changes.  

So please disregard my previous review!



Best brownies in town!  One of my favorite places to eat in Goleta, with a variety of sandwiches and a daily soup that is listed on the website.  Try the Huevos Rancheros (add avocado and sausage!), or ask for the off menu Martin Special (salami sandwich) that is so grease ball delicious you can't even.  Split the difference and sample the soup or a half sandwich paired with one of their many salads.  They also cater and do a daily Dinner to Go. 

Plus, the staff are fantastic and always take good care of you.  

Pros: Parking, coffee, good food.
Con: Closed Sundays--sometimes I forget!
Amazing food and Amazing service! They know what they are doing! It tastes super authentic and you get that good home cookin meal you always are craving! I will recommend this place to everyone!
BLACK OWNED AND BANGING!! This is a very cute restaurant with awesome prices. The food  was hot and fresh. Service was great.

Very rude. The girl that works the register seems to hate customers. Their food is horrible lately. They do not care. Found a rotten bug in food and they refused to give a fund. That is bad business practice. Eat there at your own risk.

I attended the Chauhan High Tea in July with some girlfriends- so this review is for the High Tea only and not the restaurant in general. We are planning to head back soon for dinner to try the regular menu. The High Tea was amazing!!! There were two rounds of small bites- savory and sweet! My favorite part of the savory plate was the Tandoori Deviled Eggs and my favorite item on the dessert tray was the Pistachio Macaroon- although all items were delicious. There was 7 assorted teas to try and I think between all of us, we tried each of them. I loved the unique assortment of teas- from a chocolate mint tea to an earl grey. I always prefer Earl Grey blends, but was surprised to find I really liked the almond cookie green tea! I highly recommend going to the High Tea- its a little pricey but worth it! Don't plan to fill up on food though, the trays are small bites, not meant to be a full meal.

Great atmosphere, very popular. Great choice of beers. The burgers truly are fantastic!!! Don't forget to get the sweet potato fries! Great selection Wurst as well! Wait is worth it or dive into the bar.

My guy was craving "breakfast for dinner" and some how, we ended up here.  Since I wasn't craving breakfast for dinner, I got the grilled chicken salad with the honey mustard dressing.  The good news is that they served the dressing on the side, so not too much or too little.    

My guy got the steak and eggs and also pancakes.  He said the steak was not very good (yes, I realize we were at Uncle Bill's and this review is for UB standards, not Tony's).  The hashbrowns that came with the steak and eggs were way undercooked. The pancakes were decent, but it is really hard to mess up pancakes, don't ya think?  They are served with whipped butter and actually smelled so good that I had to try  'em. Not bad, at all!

This place really needs a facelift on the inside and out, but then again maybe the original decor from the 1960's is part of the charm and makes Uncle Bill's the memorable experience that it is today.  

On the way out, I noticed they had a couple magazines, so I picked up a Ladue News (did not expect to find this here) and also Feast.  I had never read Feast before and now have a few new places to try. So the trip to Uncle Bill's will lead to more Yelping :)

I visited Tony's and sat in the bar section with a friend. I really liked the space and loved that there is a lounge area in the bar. It took a long time for someone to greet us, and honestly the service lacked all night. I felt like for the price and restaurant the service should match, but maybe it was an off night. My friend and I shared the Jumbo Lump Crab Cake, which was very delicious and a really good portion. I loved the Mustard Aioli served with the crab cake. For dinner I ordered the Oven Roasted Chicken. I wasn't really in the mood for steak and I love crispy polenta, so this was the choice for me, even at a steakhouse. I also tried the brussels sprouts, they were good. I really recommend the Raspberry Mule to drink, it was delicious.

This isn't my first time here but I needed to leave this review. It may be a little cramped, but It's a perfect breakfast/brunch spot. It's conveniently on the corner and has a very pleasant ambiance. Every time I go in for tea or coffee I'm greeted with a friendly smile. I have not had the food just yet, but I will be back soon. No off street parking, but that's what comes along with spots in the quarters. Great place and I can't wait to come back.

A diner with a menu full of winners. The breakfast is fabulous with huge portions at unarguable prices. One of the only places I know where you can get a decent cup of coffee for less than $1. The chicken and biscuits with gravy satisfies my wife better than I can. Each pancake is hubcap sized and perfectly light even with blueberries enfolded. Benedicts, omelets, bacon, grits, hash browns, eggs, sausage etc. are all worthy any time of the day.
Lunch and dinner are both equally delicious and desserts are awesome. This is a precious gem in the treasure chest of Hyde Park. My only wish is that it be open all the time , Mr. Gonzmart.
We got the salmon Benedict and several omelets.  We loved everything we ordered.   I loved the fresh fruit.   We loved the vibe of the place too.

Delicious tapas! Even though there weren't a huge number of items on the menu, there was great variety and we loved everything we ordered. Crab cakes, cheese plate, green beans and I could eat the potatoes every day! The drinks were interesting and pretty reasonably priced. Our waiter was really helpful with recommendations and guidance about portion size and we ended up getting a good amount to eat and not spending that much money. Would love to go back!

I love this place! I've been a customer since before the renovations, and I've got to say, I love the new book nook and how open the whole space feels. 

Dessert-wise, this place is incredible! Their cakes, fancy coffees, and ganache hot chocolate (ganache hot chocolate!) are absolutely to die for. Super rich, and while the cakes are expensive, you get pretty hefty slices. My only critique in this area is that, with the tiramisu at least, they go way overboard with the alcohol. Maybe I came in on a bad day or something, but that was a tiramisu-like float. It was drowning in alcohol in the worst way. 

Their savoury food is also low-quality. I've never once had savoury food there that I could force myself to finish. But the desserts and drinks are so, SO good that I can still give it a strong 5 stars!

Sushi Garden has now been removed from my list of go to restaurants. I use to come here all the time with my friends for some cheap sushi and happy hour specials! Today we decided to get some late night sushi. We sit down and noticed the menus have changed. Sure enough, Sushi Gardens happy hour is now a complete joke and waste of time. With a whopping 3 rolls to choose from off the happy hour menu, the cheapest one comes in at $8 for a Las Vegas roll. Mind you Las Vegas rolls use to cost $9 on the normal menu (now even more). There alcohol prices are just a dollar or two off normal prices now. The best part is even the staff of sushi garden thinks these prices are a joke. There so many other places you can get sushi and alcohol for so much cheaper. If your on a budget or not looking to spend $50 on some sushi, this restaurant is no longer for you. I hope the owner reconsiders these new prices because until they change, I bid sushi garden a long farewell and suggest you the same!

I just left this place and when I got home dumped the bag out on the counter to separate the order and not only was all my packages soaking wet but a giant cockroach fell onto my counter out of the paper bag and ran under my cabinets where my dishwasher is. I have tried calling the store and no answer. I'm calling corporate in the morning. Because they are now currently closed.
Love this place, the pho is so tasty, it comes out very fast and its so cheap!

Solid five stars from the time we entered until we departed.  This team didn't skip a beat, their world class service and perfectly executed food orders.
Out family party of 5 had a requested a quite tables to accommodate conversation, and we were seated in a nice round corner table.  I'm sure it was larger another for 7-8, but for 5 was great.
Out waiter Ricardo is a real pro.  Knowledgeable, humorous and on task.
Salads were fresh and tasty.  Steaks cooked to perfection. The Cowboy Ribeye is a monster and I cleaned it up!  Fillets were perfect as well as the BBQ Shrimp on mashed potatoes.  We ordered sides of creamed spinach and sweet potato casserole.
All entrees and sides are served on 500 deg plates and sizzling when delivered.  Your food is truly hot throughout the time you eat.  Nice touch!
The wine list is substantial and has something for everyone.  Personally I don't buy expensive wine, and a place like RC won't carry a bad wine.  We chose the Qupe Syrah which was excellent at $42, and worked great.

I really enjoy this little spot!! As soon as you walk in you're greeted by a lovely display of all their bakery goods. Like the most decadent cakes and pies you've ever laid your eyes on. The dining room has a warm cozy fire place in the winter and in the summer the patio is just gorgeous. The food is always spot on. The whole experience overall is something I always look foreword to and would recommend to anyone who hasn't been here :)

Although Pei Wei isn't my first choice for Asian cuisine but when it's the closest thing I have when I am in the Westshore area, I will take it! I ordered the Chicken Pad Thai there and for some reason, I enjoyed it more than I thought I would. It is a good mix of flavors but you can tell it's not Thai authenticated Pad Thai flavors but it was still good! I always enjoy getting the Pad Thai at Pei Wei and is probably the only thing I get as everything else is kind of iffy. Service was okay, I had take out. Order, take and go! This visit was good.

I will forever love this place! Great food and the atmosphere is impeccable. Emmy husband and I had our wedding brunch here and all invited were pleasantly surprised. The buffet is great, their homemade drinks are great, and the alcohol drinks are wonderful! I highly recommend Founding Farmers to anyone looking to eat consistently good food

Man, I love this spot!! My girlfriend and I can never go wrong with the traditional Cuban. The mojo sandwich is also very tasty. The chicken Parmesan and meatball subs are a cheese lover's dream .

This is, by far THE BEST sandwich spot in Ruskin and the surrounding area!

Oh, and get the tater tots. Trust me.

Pretzel rolls were amazing, however they could use better dips or sauces to go with them. Food was good, a little slow coming out, but worth the wait. I would like to go back again and try more items.

Alex was excellent!! We have dined here twice now and have loved every bit of our experience, but Alex really was fantastic and made our evening very fun and special.  They have the best Moscow Mule in town!  I highly recommend the food and drinks here and will definitely be back!

I love this place! The food is so fresh and delicious! Its my family's new spot. Their baked goods are amazing. It's great to have such a wonderful local place to sit and enjoy a meal. Breakfast is bomb, lunch is as well. Give it a try and add a pastry to your meal. You'll thank me later!

I don't think I can even begin to tell you how much I love this place.  LOVE IT.  Homemade sausage sandwiches.  Real homemade italian sausage.  My father started taking me here when I was a kid.
The owner is almost always there taking the orders-- and I would guess it was her family working.
Be warned.  If you plan to go there for lunch get there early or...well you will be screwed.

A fun story-- a friend of mine and I went--  a man was opening up shop near her and came in to ask if she would be okay with this.  She looked gravely serious at first and the guy got nervous--  and then with a huge smile she leaned back and said "Of course!  Good luck!"

Great place.  Great place. Great place.

The coffee has always been good here but their other drinks, whoa! My husband and I had two sips of our mango smoothies and refreshers and our eyes almost bugged out. So much sugar! My husband promptly disposed of his as he couldn't drink it. I was able to scarf mine down as it was my only drink with dinner but again, why do they need to be soooo sweet? Also, they got rid of my beloved strawberry toast :( so sad. Service is good, space is clean. Environment is industrial meets suburbs. Overall: will only be purchasing coffee drinks from here on out!

I used to go to Il Posto for breakfast on a regular basis. I endured the rude person behind the counter until I couldn't take it any more. Now I take my business elsewhere where the people are friendly and they welcome me! What a relief. So glad I made the break.

I called to arrange for a party of 8 for 6:30. That request was fulfilled. Some of the party had burgers. I had the roasted turkey with gravy and mac and  cheese. We waited a long time to get our food. My meal was cold .When we mentioned it to the server, he had the manager step in. The manager immediately brought me out a hot plate of turkey and mac and cheese. So I have mixed reviews. I have eaten there before without incident. I'm a tough critic when it comes to my food

The food was great and the service exceptional. The restaurant was dimly lit, white tablecoth, well dressed servers and..... multiple Tv's with sports on??? 

The place seems to have an identity crisis. Everything about it (even the prices) scream fine dining but the televisions speak "sport bar" 

I don't know that I would go back..

I am in shock by the service at this school Cafe. Every workers eyes were glossed over and red like they all shared a fat blunt before working. It was truly embarrassing on there part. First I walked up to the register and asked for hashbrowns she said OK 10 minutes later a woman came over holding up a frozen chicken nugget looking like they told me that was what I was going to get. Next I asked for a fountain drink and she said oops I already printed the receipt you're going to have to ask for that at the front. Next my friend ordered he asked for a chicken and bacon sandwich only and the woman asked if he would like bacon on that as well. I couldn't help but spit out laughter. It was like they all had some sort of drug party before coming to work. He giggled and completed his order next my friend asked for pancakes with four slices of bacon she paid yet only received two slices of bacon. There is six people on staff yet it took 15 minutes to get some pancakes.  I am embarrassed to have this restaurant next to my living hall and hope to have something done about this. If I could give this place no stars I would have.
Basically was mocked and picked at for the amount of gas I was putting in my car one night, by an employee. Otherwise, love WaWa.

Nice modern decore.   Booths and wood trim.  Dance lounge music.  Staff all tall and slim, appear to be selectively hired.  Beef dip had the heavy bread which is hard to eat and dip.  They should put in more meat and use a lighter bun.  The house greens had head lettuce hidden in the bottom as filler.  Decent wine and beer selection.  Staff were friendly and accommodating.

The staff is super friendly, and the pita is delish!!! I loved the spinach and cheese closest thing to my mom's  highly recommend this place for when you are craving traditional Bosnian, or something delicious

Food was good but not great. I had the shrimp po boy which was slightly spicy. The rolls was hard on the ends to point I could not eat them. The drink we ordered bubbled and was delicious. The taste of new orleans was good. The grilled chicken and side was good. Staff work ethic was excellent. They hustled and were fun. The bread pudding was good. It has raisins. The line outsode was about halfway down the block. We got seated within 25 minutes. Line went fast. We got to see a band march down bourbon street while waiting. A lady with an elaborate costume and some stories to tell for a few bucks walked down the line. If you take a pic be prepared to give anyone doing the same some money.

Was planning to go to Yardhouse. However due to the Eagles playoff game the wait was well over an hour. We explored other options and found this attractive space attached to the same enclosed mall.

Turns out this place has Happy Hour 7 days a week. There is quite a bit of seating in the bar area to choose from. We (2 of us) were seated at a high top table for 4.

Quite a few specialty cocktails (several versions of martinis), beer and wine on special. We got the Margherita Pizza, Cheesesteak Egg Rolls, and Roasted Pear Salad from the Happy Hour menu. Also got the Ravioli Formaggio off the regular menu. All was delicious.

Attentive service and nice décor added to the experience. If in the area again, I would definitely consider returning.

I really love this place for a number of reasons. The food is delicious. The buffet is affordable, really super tasty, and with a huge amount of variety. 

The staff are amazing. Very friendly and attentive. They make you feel like part of the family. The owner will wave at my boyfriend and I when we walk by, even if we're not coming in.

I am highly gluten intolerant, and I have never gotten sick from this place. That is hugely important to me! When I first came in, they went through the menu with me and told me the things I would be okay with and the things to stay away from. If I ever have questions about something on the buffet, they are happy to answer and that seriously means the world to me.
Great breakfast, convenient, fast and friendly service. Located inside the Reading terminal.
This place is amazing & delicious!!! I loved the carne asada & my husband loved the fajita chicken taco. We also loved the man at the front desk. So kind & welcoming!

So...my overdue review of this highly lauded sushi icon in Philadelphia. 

I wish I could give it 5 stars because I love good Japanese and fusion food. 

I came in expecting the stars, but was only transported to the clouds. 

I'm vacillating between three and four stars.  Were this not as expensive as it was, I'd easily give four, but for the price and reputation I, frankly, expected more.  

Now, my wife and I did have a good time, and enjoyed our food, but not enough to command the 450$ tab.

I did the top end omikase menu, and my wife, being petite and not as hearty an eater went with a hand chosen selection of options from both the regular and seasonal menus. 

Out of the plethora of dishes I sampled in my omikase experience only two or three were what I would call knock your socks off excellent...the rest were just good. When I'm eating the iron chefs offerings, I'd expect to be wowed more than that. 

I almost wish I had gone with hand selections myself, as did my wife.  As her dishes all, save one, were very, very good. They were also all kitchen menu items interestingly enough. 

Service was very good though, I will give them that.  Our server made thoughtful suggestions on beverage pairings, and timed our different meals well so we were on pace with each other. The only gripe was that he maybe pushed the most expensive options to add to his bottom line, but I can't really fault him as the 24$ a glass sake was good enough that I ordered a few glasses...ha!

Overall a three and a half star experience for fine and exclusive dining. 

Anyhow, I am glad I finally tried this icons establishment, because I like to have experienced the best...but slightly disappointed to say there are a couple much less expensive alternatives i know of and frequent in the sushi arena, which have just as fresh and high quality fish and rice as a much more reasonable price. 

I must inject a bit of childish muse into my review as well.  Morimoto, consider a slightly less phallic center table light fixture please, or make it removable.  

The more inventive dishes are the reason to come here in my opinion, and I may return again to eat just those. That future experience may elevate my review to four stars...we'll see.

Vegan pizza & Spaghetti was delightful... will be returning soon!! Went during the week, late in the evening and it was busy but not too congested. Not sure what it would be like on the weekend! This will be a fav spot for my love & I. I eat a vegan/plant based diet & he is Lactose intolerant. It was refreshing to enjoy pizza without the tummy aches.

I don't like drive-thru starbucks; they are noisy, have a lot of extra commotion behind the counter; making it much more distracting if you are trying to do read, write, homework, think, relax, meet, etc. 

With that said, the energy is great at this location.  Hail to the management for hiring really well.  Everyone seems to enjoy each other, and are very service-oriented.

Parking gets very tight...it's a BUSY location.

I was looking for somewhere quick to grab dinner and this location did not disappoint. 

Customer service was great. The person working the register was very nice and double checked that I didn't want toppings on my Cheesesteak (because they were free!). 

We sat upstairs where there's a decent amount of seating available. The food was brought to us and it was great. The waffles fries were crispy and tasted fresh, and the Cheesesteak (as pictured) was good quality as well.

Scott waited on 8 ladies this morning for Sunday brunch! He did a great job serving.

The mimosas were yummy and the banana bread French toast was a great serving size and rich. 

It was very good, but wasn't as crispy or eggy as I expected. Maybe that a personal preference. I do recommend getting something like bacon to help cut the sweetness of the French toast.

I wish the coffee had a little bolder taste as well. 

Overall, I highly recommend 1799! The ambiance is nice, the decor is beautiful, the service is great, and the food is really good!

One star, only because the food was good, the SECOND time they brought it out. Super SLOW...was there on a Tuesday night, took over 15 minutes to get someone to take our drink order, waited another 20 minutes for an appetizer. When the meal finally came out, the cheese was cold on a warm burger. When we asked the waiter to melt the cheese he actually asked us HOW we would like him to do that....is melting cheese that difficult?!? Not a cheap place to eat and normally don't have this much of a wait. Never quick but I mean this was a TUESDAY night. The Manager saw the plate brought out for a second time and never made his way out to us to even ask what happened. Won't go back to this Chili's EVER again.

This is my favorite Thai restaurant in Saint Louis and I am so sad to leave it! The service is functional and while nothing special I have no complaints.

The food is always excellent. There's a great variety of both spicy and non spicy food, and the portions are generally perfect. They're also well priced. 

The food is also nice and light, and you can come away feeling good - unlike competitors like Thai country cafe.

Just stopped in to pick up an order.  The service was horrible.  They took my name and left me unattended for ten minutes without telling me anything even after I asked what the status was.  It should have been ready before I arrived.  

The woman ahead of me placed her order and a few minutes later they told her they were out of different items.  Then they magically found the items when she threatened to cancel.

Food was ok, nothing spectacular.  I would not come back

$1/slice happy hour, yes ma'am!

Thin crust, sauce is well seasoned, evenly spread cheese, wide variety of toppings, fast service...maybe not with a smile, but I'll take it... and nicely priced.

Greasy, but disgustingly good greasy, NOT inedible, "I feel like death" greasy. A few extra napkins and I'm good to go.

Def coming back.

okay, whoever gives this place one star is buzz-kill!

the line does suck, of course, but it's not their fault that the chicken is so darned tasty.  and the staff is always super nice, gracious and apologetic about the wait.  no snobbiness here.  

had the crispy harissa chicken which was amaze-balls, and the garlic chile which i personally wasn't a fan of (too spicy) but my friend loved.

donuts are great too - love the pomegranate nutella tahina donut.  the sugar spice donuts are fantastic too, but truth be told i couldn't exactly tell the difference between the three different flavors.  whatever.  i ate them all anyway.

Found this Gem on Yelp looking for Nashville's best fried chicken. Did not disappoint. Came in on a Thursday  to find out that fried chicken was only served on Monday's.   Khalil Arnold (one of famous Arnold brothers) overheard our disappointment and took the opportunity to get a customer for life by offering to fry us some chicken. I asked when, next Monday?  And he said it would be done in about 20 minutes. Wow!  While we waited we had fried shrimp, pinto beans, teriyaki brussel sprouts, Mac and cheese, a hot roll and cornbread and last but not least fried green tomatoes. Everything was so good. But the fried chicken had the perfect amount of spices. It was enough to know it was there but didn't burn you up. We recommend anyone traveling through Nashville go just a few minutes out of your way and support the Arnold family & this local business. You'll be glad you did.

Wow wow wow! Newly opened and I couldn't be happier.  New Sushi restaurant with poke dishes too! My friend and I had steamed tofu, edamame, best friend roll, spicy tuna and super clam hands rolls! They have Thai tea and tasty wine.
I can't wait to come back and try more things on the menu! Try this newly opened mom and pop restaurant! I'm excited we have a new fabulous sushi place to frequent!

I love all of the Cunningham restaurants but this one is a favorite next to Bru Burger. I love their house made salad dressings and the campfire fettuccine is delicious. Tonight I tried the horseradish encrusted sirloin which includes salad, chefs vegetable and baked potato. They have a special menu if dining between 4-6 for $12.99 which is a great deal.
This continues to be one of my favorite restaurants. They have made some updates to the menu which include the Bruburger Mexicali burger a nice addition. I also love their house salad with the white chicken chili for lunch or dinner. The service and food are excellent time and time again. If you sign up for a VIP card after $1000 they give you a $100 gift card to use at any of their restaurants.

Quick service, Stellar dishes!
This is a go to for Real Food!
(Low carb)
A hidden gem, so don't miss it, downstairs from where the Pneumatic used to be;)

Combination boil. The food was really good and the service was decent. They forgot the corn cob sides on everyone's plates.  Would have been five stars if the waitress would have taken something off the bill for that oversight.  Guess she just wanted a smaller tip?  Loved the crab legs!

While the ramen was delicious, it wasn't the best I've ever had. The broth was mild but flavorful at the same time. The waitress messed up our order slightly, she didn't write it down at all and gave extra corn instead of extra noodles as asked. 
The portions are about the average size for ramen shops, generous and hearty. Two large slices of pork, but two fish cakes (bonus points for that.) The soft boiled egg was perfection. 
To-go containers are nice plastic, almost Tupperware type cups. 
Will be returning.

If you're looking for a place to watch the Blues or Cards game alone or with a friend - this is the place to go. Huge flat screens at the bar and in the dining area. No worries about not being able to see or hear the game. Very few customers ever sitting on the bar side of the restaurant. Kerri is great - she lets us turn the game up real loud and is always there to refill beers. Also a great stop for a midday break/lunch . Calm, welcoming environment. Fries are amazing - breaded in a beautiful way and just the right crunch. Moving out of state soon and we will miss this place.
Wasn't impressed with this place! Service is horrible food is overpriced and bland. I don't see how this place has so many high rated reviews.

Went in with my cousin who's a california resident I'm visiting from Florida food was good only complaint I ordered a mean tai which Harry's I hear is famous for drinks and I never got it so after 20 min I gave up then after dinner I said something to the server and all's he did was say I'm sorry and said that happens sometimes so I was disappointed and then he forgot to sit the check which he corrected had they remembered my drink or not been apathetic when we told him would have been a higher rating

This place is amazing. Totally low key vibe, they play great music., have amazing oysters. Bloody Marys the best I've ever had. All the food is beyond delightful. And the service OMG. Ask for Frank to be your server. I've never encountered a more sincere, personable and warm server who absolutely cared about whether or not we were enjoying ourselves. A MUST GO!

Can I just say that hands down the best Italian food,  good pizza, whatever you want to call the cuisine. But it was absolutely delicious! We ordered a large veggie pizza, some mozzarella sticks, and onion rings! My dad ordered pasta and it was simply amazing! God bless the Caputo's if you are in the area, do try it, it's a hidden gem, not to mention everyone was so nice!! I'm so glad I passed by and chose this joint!! Highly, highly recommend!

Newest sushi restaurant in town.
Lobster Roll: 4 stars. I would have given this 5-stars if it wasn't $21. The roll was really good but not good enough for $21. 
Godzilla Roll: 4 stars. Solid roll. 
The ultimate spicy tuna roll: 1 star. This was disappointing. Very bland roll and ground tuna had no taste. 
I was looking forward to order Hamachi Kama (yellow tail collar) as an appetizer but they were out. I'll come back to try that and also to give a couple of other specialty rolls a chance. 
I really wanted to love this place as it is located only 10min from my home. However, my 1st impression isn't that great. IMO, Umami Sushi in Lutz is still the #1 sushi restaurant in the area. This is probably take the #2 spot. That's not saying much as all the other sushi places in Wesley Chapel, Lutz, and New Tampa are pretty mediocre. It's unfortunate that we have to go to Tampa to get some really good sushi. The only exception is Umami Sushi in Lutz but that is still a 30min drive from home.
Build a hash has me feeling some type of way. Best breakfast brunch place on state street

I found this restaurant/bar on Yelp and decided to give it a try. Boy was I in for a treat. I ordered the street corn, a blood orange IPA and No Bull Beyond Burger with fries. The street corn was the best I've ever had. The burger and fries were great. The beer was good too. I can't wait to come back.

Delicious food. Great service. We're so full. Gotta rest a bit before dessert. Yum!
My daughter loved the beef on fire and Vietnamese coffee, while I went with a classic Pho beef combo. Che Ba Mau for dessert.

This place is not too known by many people, but I gotta say I love it.  The menu is a good size and the food is good.  The owners and staff are really nice people.  I normally order take-out, but it's a decent dine-in spot as well.  I enjoyed this place.

My group went here and ordered the pulled pork plate and sand which and the brisket plate. We all strategically ordered the sides so we got a little of everything.  The baked beans were like nothing I've ever ate. They weren't glopped in thick sauce but still had a lot of flavor and spice.  The cole slaw and potatoe salad were homemade and good. The Mac and cheese was a little over cooked and the noodles were mushy but still tasted cheesy.  The only real complaint is that the place is kind of gross. There's 4 picnic tables on and inclined concrete floor inside a screened in gazebo basically. We didn't eat there but the food was just what we were looking for.

Wow! Talk about a treat!  I love the concept of Bailey's Chocolate Bar.  Although typically you would come there craving dessert, they also have a fine selection of cheeses and hot food for you to try.  Their wine list is very respectable and then of course: the desserts are awesome.  I tried a bunch including the chocolate inebriation, the bailey's bar, and the blondie.  The blondie I'd have to say is my favorite.  The atmosphere is dark, charming, and elegant.
Great service and an interesting selection of fare.  I'll go back but I'll be paying closer attention to the prices .. pretty expensive but that's Nashville now I guess.
