If you haven't tried the lobster roll.... you're missing out! Great atmosphere, great customer service and complementary valet parking!

Wow! Had no idea what to expect here. We really thought it was a simple hot dog place- it was awesome! Great character in the ambiance AND the menu! Loud brass band right outside the door, but we honestly loved that. The food was on point! I told the bar tender to surprise me and he did not disappoint- really great hot dog with delicious fresh toppings and a great chipotle ranch. Good stop if you want a change up from the usual NOLA cuisine. Ordering is a bit of a hassle though as you have to go to the bar, despite the counter right in the entry way. Sometimes flagging down a bartender just isn't something you're in the mood for on empty stomach. We watched a lot of diners go right to that counter and stand, waiting to be served before being redirected. Will definitely be coming back and bringing friends!

Headed here with high expectations and left unsatisfied but not upset. 

Menu looked amazing and the server we had was delightful. I started with the escargot because it's not often it's on the menu. It was soaked in butter and cheese; which was expected, but there was not taste to them at all. Even the butter didn't have much flavor. So disappointing. Was looking forward to having that great escargot taste. 

My entree was the Grouper Francaise. Really nicely cooked and breaded. Was fried and battered perfectly and topped with asparagus. It was ... really good. the accompanying vegetables were bland and unseasoned however, taking away from the overall experience of the dish. Like I stated I wasn't upset, just left feeling like I didn't get what I was coming here for. 

You be the judge which is worse; Being unsatisfied and wanting more; or upset that it wasn't good. Sometimes the former is the worst.

Super yummy! Came for lunch during the week and got shrimp pad Thai and it was sooooo yummy! The waitress was very nice, our food came out relatively quickly, and the service was very attentive--checked in on us a few times and refilled waters promptly.
It only lost a star because I wish they offered different amount of spicy-ness/heat to the meal. 
They have great lunch specials, $11-13 for appetizer, soup, and meal comes with rice. And at the end of lunch they gave us a little donut dessert (just a bite size), but unexpected and the perfect sweetness to finish lunch ! And I highly recommend the pad Thai. 
Can't wait to come back!
The epitome of hipster places. Always a fun environment but the neighborhood is pretty sketch. Go in a big group for a lot of fun but don't expect great service.

When it comes to Irish pubs, we're tough customers since we always compare everything to our favorite, JK O'Donnell's.  The Claddagh is no JK's, but it's a perfectly good alternative.  The Fish & Chips was surprisingly good, and overall ambience was decent.  I'm not going to go into great detail on this one, since I can basically summarize everything by saying that this is a reasonable "Americanized" Irish pub/restaurant, and leave it at that.
I was on my business here in NJ and feel like to have seafood for dinner. I am so glad that I found this restaurant because the seafood was super fresh and good. The pirate sauce was so good.

Honey's was crowded but my party of 2 were seated quickly. The space is tight. The food is delicious and came out of the kitchen hot and fast. I ordered the 3 egg omelet with mushrooms cheese and veggie sausage. Great choice. They only take cash for payment. Waiter was attentive. All the other food looked great. I will return to try the French toast. The portions are on the small side but it was just enough for me. The food is seasoned well.

It's so sad when you are in such a great food city like Nashville and you waste a meal on a bad place. The coffee is bitter, the food was subpar at best, and the service left much to be desired. If only the food was as good as the place was cute because man, what a time that would have been.

This place rocks! The hotdog made me feel like I was in Coney Island...a NY dog made to perfection. My wife had the Stockbroker, I had a Texas Tommy, my son had a burger. They all came with amazing fries and the food was absolutely delicious. I'll be going regularly...you have to try this place!!

Good burger and fries selection...lots of options, which I like, nice meat selection and I dig the gluten free bun option...but wow...quite a bit overpriced: 1 bison burger, 1 lamb burger, fries and a beer; $40?! Burgers were good but not screamin' ...lower the price and I might be back more often. Juicy's and Little Nugget are better for the same $ or less.

Came here when we visited Tucson. They messed up on our eggs Benedict order big time. The presentation was nice and an ideal setting for brunch because of the quaint environs, but that was it. It's just OK. 

Or maybe the server and cooks were having an off day that day, hence the 3 stars. I'll cut them some slack for now.

I don't get the bad reviews. I thought the pizza was solid. Better than any of that flat pizza that most St. Louis people seem to fancy. Pizza had great flavor. Waiting staff was very pleasant. It took a little bit to arrive but that's ok. It was fresh. I'll definitely come back and try the pasta because it looked really good

I tried the combination plate with a chicken tostada, enchilada and taco with double beans.

It was pretty bomb. I got it to go so the chicken juices made my tortilla soggy, but atleast it was juicy!!

Acero's corkage policy is $25 for the first two bottles and $50 for each bottle thereafter...then they automatically add a 20% tip on the corking fees.  This is the most expensive I have encountered in any city.   A group of 8 of us were at Acero this weekend and the waiter gladly uncorked 4 bottles of wine we brought without explaining the corkage fees.  When the bill arrived it showed $180 dollars to uncork 4 bottles of our own wine.  If you want your guests to order your wine, just let them know in advance and they will gladly order from your menu.  Punishing them with hidden charges at the end of the meal is the wrong way to go about it.
Good food and great draft beer offerings. It can get busy and tight, but there are a few great outdoor seats to grab while you wait for a table.

Tonight was our first night in Nashville and this was our first dinner spot, and we couldn't have been more happy with our experience! First off, The atmosphere here is so warm and welcoming. From the kind and friendly servers to the coziness of the outside dining. We had the herb roasted chicken, the grilled grouper and the Thai curry mussels, and everything was absolutely delicious! Truly some of the best food we have ever had! We will remember this spot in the future for sure and be back again soon!

My first time driving TO a Pretzel Factory store rather than getting catering or a box at work.  This one has a tight drive through which was awesome for my compact car!

I finally tried their cheesecake bites and it's a good lunch for one or snack for 2 or 3.  It is a very good pretzel cheesesteak but if you want a cheesesteak it won't really satisfy.  The spicy weiner pretzel had a good kick and I think they gave me extra free pretzels on top of the minis I ordered.

Price can't be beat and the taste consistency is solid.  I was in and out in 2 minutes.  Adding to my rotation list.
Kyle was my server and did an absolute perfect job. Food and flavor was also spot on. 5/5 will be back.

For a quick, inexpensive work lunch this is the place to go. 

Their combos are around $10 and include soup and salad. What I like about this is that they offer the onion mushroom soup. I'm not a fan of miso soup, so this option is a nice touch for me. Their roll selection offers the standards like the Tampa roll and the philly, but they also have some unique creations too. 

I've been here several times and it never disappoints when I have a sushi craving.

4.5 stars - you'll see many tables full of friendly white hair folks and extremely skinny legs all around (so random, yes., but look around and you'll agree). The menu is varied, the food strikes a balance between good and value!  Super friendly staff. The mussels were served in a good sized portion but the mussels themselves were small. The 2-
4-1 happy is legit includes Tito's. We ventured to many other places in this isle of tourism and liked Conch the best!

Boise Fry is consistently my favorite burger spot in the Boise area. The burgers always taste fresh and are not over thought. The fries are some of the best I've ever had. I'd recommend the classic burger or the vegan burger and you can't go wrong with any selection of fries you choose. Make sure you sample the blueberry ketchup!

So good! Super cheap! We were a little hesitant going here for the first time. We weren't looking for a long sit down romantic date, just something to pick up before a show. This was perfect. Really great tacos. Fast service. Friendly staff. We will return!

Went to Makiman Sushi for the first time a few days ago, and now I am just wondering when will we go back again. It was very good!

To start I wanted to try their clam soup, but they ran out of it, so I went with the pork dumpling soup, expecting something kind of boring (even though I still wanted to have just some soup). Well no, surprise...great flavors, dumplings were delicious, the broth was so tasty, overall best dumpling soup I have had so far. We also had some seaweed salad, felt fresh.

Then we had some rolls. The salmon avocado cucumber roll, simple yet very tasty. Out of the fusion sushi rolls, we had the Ne Viking roll and the Menabb. Both superb.  We usually keep it simple when eating sushi, but the menu is so extensive, that I am willing to take a risk and try other stuff when we go back.

The place was packed (thanks to living social) yet service was efficient and very friendly.

Will definitely go back.

I had no idea that this place was owned by a celebrity chef. I came here on a whim after eating dinner and headed home. Passing by, we decided to check it out. Unfortunately for us, the place was booked solid. The hostess apologized that she didn't have any availability tonight and wanted to see if we wanted to wait for an opening.

Almost immediately, a lady in glasses and grayish hair smiled and came over and see if maybe we would be interested in dining at the bar, even though it was completely filled.  When we couldn't find anywhere to sit at the bar, the lady re-approached us, and offered a series of other wonderful recommendations in the area that we could try since we couldn't get seated at a table or a bar. She gave us a brief introduction as to why they were such a busy location and that the company has a few other fairly similar restaurants. She told us how she absolutely loved working there and enjoying the great food at the other restaurants as well as that one we were at.

Before we had another minute to think about it, she asked to see if we were interested in dining at the end of the bar. We advised her that we already ate and was looking for dessert only. She immediate gave us some fabulous suggestions on popular desserts and offered us to get the Gateau Basque, because she's been eating it for years!

The waitress at the bar greeted us and was incredibly nice. We had a small discussion about oysters and where they were from. We ended up getting a dozen oysters. Although the PJ Oysters weren't anything too special for me, it was still very fresh and delicious. I think I'm biased because I'm a big fan of Kumamoto (which they have) and Shigoku. As mentioned above, we ordered the Gateau Basque, which was basically a vanilla sponge cake with creme fraiche and Louisiana berry marmalade poured on top. It was incredible.

As far as desserts go, that was the highlight of all the desserts we ordered in a week's timespan in New Orleans. Before we finished, the lady in glasses came to check up on us again. She was very nice and asked to make sure that we enjoyed the food. She told us that she'll check on us again before we leave. But we didn't get to say goodbye! She was probably busy making sure the rest of the patrons were having a good time.

The staff here is worth recommending on coming here to New Orleans. The food is great, and the service is incredible. We had a stunning of a time, thanks for the Southern hospitality of Luke.

Solid deli in CWE! I went here in the late afternoon and was the only customer. I got the Reuben with corned beef and a gooey butter cookie. The Reuben came out right away toasty and pipin' hot (so hot it even deformed my plastic take out container lol). The sandwich had the perfect proportion of corned beef, sauerkraut, and 1000 island dressing. The gooey butter cookie was indulgently delicious! All this for $10 - you can't go wrong!

Amazing vegan food!!! Ordered multiple 1/2 sandwiches and their southwest bowl. Everything was phenomenal. Texture, flavor, balance, superb. Worth the drive if you're in Tahoe. We enjoyed it so much, that we had to come back 2 days in a row. Really sad that we can't take the chef home with us to Portland.

The Pint Room gets extra credit simply by its birthright:  It's located in a place I love (Main Street, downtown Carmel) and it's somewhat trendy.  The problem is that it violates one of the unspoken rules of Carmel/Westfield/Zionsville dining:  There's just nothing here that separates it from the pack.  For me to become a repeat customer, there needs to be something on the menu that I come back specifically to that restaurant to have again.

The first few times this happened I let it go, (maybe there was a new person or something) but this is getting annoying. I go to this location often since it's so close to my house but it seems like driving further might be worth it just to get a full bowl and the mobile order right for once. It's so disappointing getting home to see your bowl is missing things or half empty.

*UPDATE
Went back again... all the lights were on, the smell of warm baking was welcoming and the chocolate chip cookie was AMAZING. Still not fully sold on the cupcakes, but the cookie is worth coming back for.

I can totally understand why vegans and others with dietary restrictions would go nuts over this place! It's nice to really not have to worry about what you're ordering and they have all the ingredients listed next to each items.

For me it was ok. Honestly, we thought it was closed when we walked by at first because it looked so dark on the inside. The girl who was working really didn't greet us at all when we came in (unless you count standing at the counter and looking at us as a greeting...). I ordered the Samoa cupcake. For a cupcake with no refined sugar it was almost too sweet for me. The icing was good, the cake was really good, but there was this layer/filling that put it in the "in the almost too sweet" category for me. 

Also, would be nice for to-go cupcakes to have a small box instead of a bag. I lost some of my icing in the bag on the way home

Good to know the place is around though! And definitely somewhere I'll remember for friends with dietary restrictions.

Slowest service ever! Went in around 5pm. No one was there. I ordered beef pho, girlfriend ordered shrimp fried rice. People of 4 came in and then 3 more couple came in. 10 minutes went by and we just gotten our water. So did the other people in the restaurant. 20 minutes later, I got my small pho soup with barely no meat in it. Starting to miss my California pho soup. Shared what ever noodles we got in that soup. 15 minutes later , we got the large plate of small portion of shrimp fried rice. 2 of the couple left. Noticed the table beside us got their food 10 minutes for 1 entree and by the time they were done eating that, their next entree came 15 minutes later. We all just laughed. Should of gone to  Hardees! Paid the over priced  food for the small amount and noticed that only one guy was cooking. HIRE ANOTHER CHEF!! Never again going to that place.

The Draught Horse isn't nearly as bad as you'd peg a college sports bar out to be.  They've got a decent selection of drafts, and the drink prices aren't nearly as high as they could be.  

They do some awesome fried pickles, and the Asian Sesame salad I had here a couple weeks ago was surprisingly delicious - huge strips of grilled chicken, veggies, crunchy rice strips, and a great dressing.  My boyfriend's cheesesteak, however, was less than desirable, so avoid those and go for other sandwiches or burgers on the menu.

The atmosphere is anything but comfy - it is a sports bar, after all.  It's not a bad place, just not something I'd go out of my way for unless I'm around Temple's campus.

Craving some seafood when strolling down the Stearns Wharf. Came into this hole in the wall seafood restaurant. Got the New England Clam Chowder in bread bowl and a cup of the Seasonal Bisque. The clam chowder was fresh, unlike the smell of the pier, it has big chunks of fresh clams in it which was delicious. The seasonal bisque was good as well. Definitely recommend the clam chowder. You won't be disappointed.

Everything was delicious! I got the sweet Dutch with fruit and my husband got the special pork belly hash. The sweet Dutch is a mix between a crepe and pancake, very very good. Food came out quick and everyone was friendly. Will definitely be back!!

So it's been a while since I've been here, and I was really looking forward to trying something different on the menu.... 

I ordered takeout of grilled chicken with rice and salad (not worth $14) , and a dish that's basically fries with pulled chicken cheese and sauce on top ($10). MISTAKE....and pretty inexcusable. Cooks should taste their food, and fries should never go out undercooked. What's worse is when fries go out undercooked soggy and swimming in watery juices... NOT HAPPY. 

These folks do a delicious chimmichuri (sp?) sauce, and I like it on pretty much everything. Today they weren't on their game I guess...

** I've had 5 Star meal / service here. **

Damn folks if you're anywhere near Scott AFB you need to give these folks a try!! I ordered for take out the pulled pork & pulled beef over rice and it was delicious. The chimichurrie (sp?) was AWESOME, and their homemade hotsauce was some of the best I've ever had! Also tried a couple empanadas and those too were on point. 

There's a pretty big menu so I look forward to my next visit.. =)
Amazing place and amazing food.  Really cool environment that the entire family can enjoy.  I would highly recommend!!!

Working from home, I've tried just about every place that delivers around me. Pizza Hut and Dominos is always easy to order, and while it cures your hunger it just isn't great. I decided to The Crazy Italian and wasn't expecting much, but I have to say it was much better than expected. The pizza arrived warm and it was perfect. It wasn't soggy and the toppings didn't slide off. It was perfectly done, not over cooked or undercook. I will definitely order again!

Always a go-to when I'm craving sushi or something light and healthy but filling. I love that I can get something just a little but different every time I'm there. The spicy crab is always a must! They also sell Broad Ripple Chips so it's a nice side item!

3 strikes yer out. The worst service ever! I figured we'd try one more time, didn't matter. It must be a requirement to ignore your patrons to get a job at this place. Lord knows why they are busy. People must like being ignored!

More like 3.5. Sandwiches are great here. The bahn mi was amazing. So flavorful and great bread. The brisket sandwich was very heavy and tender.
Onion rings and fried potatoes are just okay. I was surprised by everyone's rave reviews.
Onion rings were a bit bland, tough I like the batter they used.
The fried potatoes were nice and crisp, but they weren't mind blowing or anything. The stock sauce with the potatoes was tasty. Got TONS of potatoes with one order.
Limited seating.
Friendly service. Food came out quickly.
Felt awful afterwards from all the fat and fried food, but that's my own fault!
Overall, I would definitely return for the sandwiches!

If you are looking for fried chicken this is the place!  King of the coop is top notch in my book; their chicken is crispy, seasoned well, and not oily.  French fries are different than what I am used to, but also damn delicious. The hush puppies, pickles, mac n' cheese were all fabulous as well.  My only note would be the collard greens could use bacon or smoked ham.  The only regret I have is that I live close and am concerned about the future of my waist line!

While visiting philly ate here twice, got the effin hot the first visit very tasty but too hot for me but realize that this is a very popular sandwich just be prepared.  On my second visit I tried the block minus the provolone which I love but being my last day here I wanted to get the whiz.  It was very good the meat is lean shredded can't go wrong with either sandwich.

We ordered delivery and thought the sandwiches were just ok.

Ordered 2 lemongrass beef sandwiches delivered. The meat was so overwhelming sweet had no taste of lemongrass, they put so many jalapenos, way too much heat. Scarce on the cilantro and daikon/carrot. They cook/toast the bread not traditional as I know it.

Disappointed..
Great place for a quick meal. Food was good and fast. Has a good variety of food. The pho was flavorful and would recommend
This Pho is super greasy and the mint and sprouts I was provided were not fresh. Super average compared to noodle city. Disappointing.
Great food! Delicious bbq in a good neighborhood

My 200th review Yay!!! 

Never did I think I would get the chance to try this world famous BBQ. I thought the only locations were in Memphis but apparently there is one in Nashville just north of downtown. 

When arriving, I decided to get the two meat dinner. It was a bit pricy at $16 but I wanted to get the chance to try both Ribs & Pulled pork. 

I will say the BBQ in general has perfect texture. The ribs were perfect in the sense that they stuck to the bone just right and came right off as I pulled them off. The pulled pork was perfect in texture as well. So why do I give this place three stars? 

Simple. the sauce is HORRIBLE. Being that I am a KC BBQ Connoisseur, I judge wet BBQ harshly as wet BBQ is what KC is famous for. I asked if the BBQ came dry so that I could judge it on a different level, but apparently it came wet. 

The sauce is vinegar based and poorly favored. Oklahoma Joe's, Jack Stack, Gates and even BRYANT'S has better sauce. 

I will try this place again in dry method and perhaps edit the review. i'm sure my wife will be both pissed off to hear I ate here (we see it on food Network all the time) and happy due to the fact the sauce is vingar based (Filipino's and their darn vinegar fetish!!!)
We both had a filet mignon.     It was 3 pm. Service was great and the steak was perfect. No waiting.

We are a family of 5 foodies, we love Indian food, and we think Tamira is up there with some of the best Indian restaurants in the United States. By now, we've eaten there half a dozen times, and we have never been disappointed. One time, there was a misunderstanding on one of the items ordered (it's unclear whose fault the miscommunication was), and the owner took care of the problem, by expediting the dish we had ordered, apologizing profusely, AND comping us the dish that did not match the order. 

Some of our favorite dishes are the Saag Paneer, and the Biryanis. And there, we noticed how completely different the Lamb Biryiani is from the Chicken Biryani, which each dish is carefully, individually prepared, rather than use the same sauce for several similar dishes. The rice is prepared in batches small enough to ensure perfection.

I found the owner very welcoming. We complimented him on the food during our first visit, and thereafter, he has never failed to welcome us to his restaurant as if we were family. 

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

PS: Wev'e not tried the buffet.

First time here. We had never been to NOLA before but this place was recommended and did not disappoint. Vanessa & Don are the bomb. From the moment we walked in, they were extremely welcoming. Vanessa treated us like she has known us and helped me (super indecisive) make the decision to get the pulled pork and brisket. Did not disappoint. Try this place out.

Meh, just your average touristy-buy-a-t-shirt restaurant.  Go somewhere that doesn't have a gift shop.   

Great view of the bay though

The best hummus in the United States, friendly service, bustling atmosphere! Very simple, delicious menu. Not a ton of room so be prepared to meet someone new and don't bring a huge group! The beet hummus and kidney bean hummus was great. Good spot for vegans and vegetarians.

This was a strong like but didn't love it experience.  I will say from the top that we had excellent service--very friendly and patient in explaining the menu to my large group (there were 9 of us) so that we all could order things that fit our various dietary needs (and we had a lot of dietary needs). There were some amazing things, the bloody beet and the purple garlic soup were standouts, but the chicken I had was a little too salty, and not as exciting. I'd definitely be interested in going back and trying out some more things.
This is embarrassing. I ordered the NEW Shrimp Salad. This is what I got- 3 mini pieces of shrimp on top of lettuce. Never ordering from here again. I am very disappointed.

Walking around looking for somewhere to have brunch and I spotted Monty's. Walked in to a rustic decorated bar/restaurant where something was smelling real good! The server was friendly and the food hit the spot. I had the shrimp platter with fries. The shrimp.were small and heavily breaded but tasty. Nothing special but nothing bad either.

Terrible service. Not sure if it was racism or what but my mother, aunt and I had to ask to be served. And when we were served the waitress had an attitude and was rude. When we left the hostess smirked like she was happy the black people were leaving. My family and I are not confrontational but we felt VERY unwelcome and will not be returning ever again. We also will be telling all of our friends not to patronize this business.

Came here because this was my bfs favorite breakfast joint. We used to go to the cortaro and silverbell location which has since closed. I will definitely be coming back to this location specifically because of their server Sierra. She went above and beyond to take care of our needs and we can be a difficult bunch. The food was also delicious. Sometimes service is everything though. :)

I been there on Monday they have promotion haft price of oysters. It's wonderful . And we had fried alligator bowdin the pork fried were so yummy.they had nice staff. Recommend to join the restaurant on Monday dinner. You will get quality prices and quality foods. Absolutely perfect for tourists to found the good seafood

Nice people but slowest service ever. I ordered a coffee and a bagel sandwich. I got my latte right away and it was great but I'd say the average wait time to get your food was 45 minutes to an hour. GM was really nice. Did her best to make it right. I'd still choose somewhere else

I had a good experience for my first time at bishops collar walked around the corner from my place on green and decided to pop in and see how the food was.

I got a chicken cutlet sandwich which was a recent addition to the menu with a side of fries and it was great. Hot bun perfect honey mustard. Very good for a brisk but sunny day. Washed it down with a pint of guiness and enjoyed some of the nik-naked they had behind the bar.

For 16 bucks I left incredibly happy and satisfied.

Staff was friendly and knowledgeable a good neighborhood watering hole.
I like that they had water stations for the conference goers.  I was able to stay hydrated.

Sadly, the quality of products and service is not what it once was. The deli, in particular. Today I bought a slice of pizza. The dough was raw. Really raw. The pizza guy was nice, told me to wait 6 minutes for next batch. 20 minutes ah and I'm still waiting. Is this an amazon thing?

You will not be disappointed by this restaurant! The couple that owns it are super sweet and everything I've ever ordered from here is made with fresh produce and ingredients. 

Some Good Notes About Pacific Thai: I've only eaten inside once (I usually get take out) and it has a quaint and tranquil ambiance that I truly enjoyed. Their Sa-Teh Chicken appetizer has very well marinated chicken that is juicy and moist and comes with a homemade peanut dipping sauce. Does not disappoint! I ordered the drunken noodles for dinner and the fresh veggies they used were not over cooked. There is nothing I hate more then mushy veggies so on a high note, their veggies had a nice little crunch to them and the noodles were cook to perfection as well. For dessert I had the Pacific's banana. Again, done very nicely. My only wish was that the coconut ice cream have a little bit more of a coconut flavor to it.

Some Not So Good Notes: This is not a reflection of the restaurant but the parking lot is a freakin joke. Forget trying to park in the front if it's a Friday or weekend and it's even difficult to find parking in the back lot. 

Bottom Line: Great bang for your buck here and everything is made to order, fresh and comes out quickly. You will never be disappointed.

The place to try BBQ in Nashville. 

You pick your meats (Choices: ribs, brisket, chicken, turkey, sausage, pulled pork); 
you pick your sides (from beans, potato salad, etc.), 
get your drinks (beer is cold), 
you pay your money. 
The sauces are in jugs after you pay, and you get a selection here, too - 
Tennessee (vinegar based), 
Carolina (mustard based), 
Texas (tomato based), 
Kansas City (smoky, my favorite of the bunch), 
XXX-911 (a spiced up mix of TN & TX), and 
Music City White Sauce (horseradish base).

When we went, the meats were tender, and the sauces (at least some) were heavenly. A delicious experience, but I understand it can vary, depending on your taste in meat and sauce. 

Note: "cafeteria style" is a generous description. There is a huge line leading from the street to the counter, where there is one guy to give you your meats, another to dish out your sides, and sweet gal with a smile to take your money. Very bare bones. Not fancy. Just good food. Extra seating upstairs if the few tables in front are full.

Very loud inside if you're with a group of people and you want to have a conversation while at dinner this is not the place for you service is very slow to say the least but food is good make sure to make a reservation if you're going on a Thursday Friday or sat cuz the wait gets outrageous
I love this place.. falafel and tahini sauce are the best.. must try their tea and it is complimentary

Came here at 6:30 on a Tuesday night - just my son and I. First time here. Place was fairly busy. Got sat right away. After about 10 minutes - a waitress came by and asked to take our drink order. My son and I ordered soft drinks - she brought it out within a few minutes. She tells us that she is not our waitress and our waitress will be by ASAP. Another 10 minutes go by and the waitress finally comes to our table - keep in mind we have now been here for 20 minutes and the waitress only now comes to our table.  She apologizes and explains she was held up at another table. Kind of a lame excuse but whatever. My son and I order. Food comes out relatively quickly (perhaps 15 minutes later). Son and I both ordered the Alfredo. It was good. Wouldn't say great - but above average / good.   Rating based on slow service. Breaking it out:

Service - 2 stars
Food - 3 stars 

I think I may have gone on an off night based on the excellent reviews so I will try them again in a couple of weeks. Hopefully it will turn out better and I will update this review at that time. 

Aug 10 - decided to try again. Keep hearing that the pizza is amazing. Son and I arrived at 5:30. Got sat right away. This time - waitress came to our table within a minute or so and got our drink order (already a huge improvement from last time) she came back a few minutes later with drink. She brought bread and oil dipping sauce (last time bread only no oil). Ordered a pizza and son got the Alfredo again. 

Pizza came out first. Starting eating it and it was good. After about 10 minutes - the Alfredo still wasn't out. I asked the waitress and she seemed surprised and went to check on it. Darn! Was looking like this was going to be a stellar visit too!!! She came back in a few minutes and dropped off the Alfredo. From the newest experience - here are my updates
Service -3.5 (would have been a 4 if not for the issue with the Alfredo)
Food - 3.5-4. I thought the pizza was great but the Alfredo was too soupy.

Good food. A little loud. They had a band outside which added to the noise. Portion sizes are enormous. If you order nachos YOU WONT NEED ANYTHING ELSE!  Lots of drafts to chose from. Fun place to go and prices are very reasonable. Wait staff really friendly especially Michelle.

This is probably the greasiest , cheesiest , tastiest most delicious sandwich  you will ever eat. Grilled cheese should be a food group... there are so many different types of grilled cheese sandwiches and The Grilled Cheeserie serves only the best. I came in because I saw it on every food network show and I was so happy to see that the staff and manager were friendly and excited to talk about the food! You really don't need any side dishes because the sandwich it's self is so filling but if you do get one the tots are amazing!!!!! OH and make sure you get their fresh made lemonade it's addicting and SOOO refreshing !!! My Goal is to try every sandwich on the menu... wish me luck!!!!

Nice job, Ikea.  I dread visiting you because you're usually filthy, your customers are rude and never get the funk out of the way, and your service is even worse.  But I have learned my lesson: just go on a weeknight.  

The store didn't look like a bomb had gone off, your bathrooms were clean, your fat free frozen yogurt was only $1 and was TASTY, you actually had the chair in stock that your website said you had in stock AND an employee was kind enough to assist us.  Also, the person who checked us out was very pleasant AND awarded us a 15% gift card based on our purchases speedily (that bad boy was $45!  I thought it would be one of those - "go to our website, do this survey, enter to win" bullshit that so many companies are doing these days, but nope - we checked out, a dude was there and took less than two minutes to process and hand us our gift card!).

THANKS IKEA!  VERY NICE!

The fried mahi mahi was divine. I definitely plan on getting that again. The pulled pork nachos were irresistible. The serve was good too and the waitress was very entertaining. I plan on making the trip back for the food. It is definitely worth it.

Really cute restaurant, nice servers, and pretty good French food. Classic French cuisine - French onion soup and frogs legs. Prices are surprisingly reasonable. I was pretty disappointed by the wines by the glass but the cocktails were good.

I'm torn on my review here.  The atmosphere, food, and extracurriculars are awesome here.  I'm just not a huge fan of the drinks, which is the main attraction.

I have been here a few times.  Twice on regular days and once for the Blueberry Festival.  The Blueberry Festival is a lot of fun and they have live music, activities for the kids, and lots of delicious food.  It is a great family friendly event.  On regular days, this is still a great family friendly spot with a playground, berry picking, and a huge outdoor patio on a pond.  It is a great spot to visit with family of all ages.

As for the drinks, the wines are SUPER sweet.  I like some of the beers, but some of them have had an odd taste.  If I were to come back, I will definitely be going for the beer over the wine.  The atmosphere and food are worth the drive for me even if the drinks leave something to be desired.
It's a fun place on a Thursday or Friday night, but I'm not exactly sure what they're grilling. 15 year old kids that try to get in using their library card?

My favorite place to eat fresh fish in Santa Barbara!! The staff is very welcoming!! Our waiter Peter was awesome today!! He was so friendly and accommodating!! Thank you Peter for a delightful experience!!

I have been to this place 5 times in total, the food was great but the service was lacking. However, in my last visit, the service was the worst and most offending that I have ever received in any dining experience and I will never be going back to this restaurant again.

Here's what happened:
- I walked in with two other people and it was relatively busy - which was no problem, I don't mind waiting. We were asked to wait, however, two other groups of the same size that came in after us were seated right away and we had to flag down a waiter to remind someone that we were still there 15 minutes later

- When we were seated, we had two different servers ask us for our drink orders, which took 10 minutes to get. Even then, they messed up one of the drink orders.

- After taking our order, we were essentially abandoned. We had three different servers ask us if we wanted water and then leave without doing anything. We also noticed that tables that were seated after us (I'm talking 15 - 20 minutes after) were receiving their orders and we still hadn't received anything. After about an hour of waiting, I flagged down one of the servers and asked about our order. They said that they would look into it and magically our starter salads appeared. The excuse that they gave us was that the dishes ( two lamb chops plates and a lamb loin souvlaki) took extra time to cook. I would have accepted an apology for the misunderstanding of becoming lost in the shuffle, but the server LIED about our order by giving us that lame excuse. Further, after we got our food, a different server gave us the same lie about why our meal took an hour to get to our table. 

- We asked for our check and they gave us a bill containing items that we didn't even order. 

We informed the manager of our experience and even then, it seemed that they were only interested in blaming someone else in the restaurant and not fixing the problem of horrendous service. As a customer, I have never been so insulted by anything before as being lied to. The service is horrible and it appears that the restaurant has no interest in fixing it. The food is good, but not worth this horrible experience.

1st time here but will be back again! Service was great and everyone loved their food. The lamb dishes are great. Dinner for 5 + 2 appetizers beverages and THE BEST baklava I've ever had! Was $100. Just sorry it has taken us so long to visit.

This used to be our go to place for pizza, for a date, for family dinner with the kids, the pizza was great, the service was great, we never had a bad meal there. We went all the time, at least once a month. 

Until, this past week. something changed. I heard the chef changed, and you could definitely tell. The prosciutto pizza had too much prosciutto, the gorgonzola and fig pizza had too much gorgonzola, the ratios were all off. The calamari appetizer had much less calamari and much more tomato/olive salsa,  It was very disappointing. I hope they get their act together. In the meantime, we will take our business elsewhere while they figure it out.

I love NuYalk pizza. I've been coming here each time I go to Reno, even when it was over on Moana. The pizza is fantastic. Always hot, always tasty. Good quality toppings and cheese and just the right amount of grease to keep it shiny and yummy. Tons of tables and I've never had to wait long. Parking is easy too. One thing I actually love about this place is the RC soda. Haven't seen it for years and it's better than Coke or Pepsi in my opinion. 

Good price, good food, good staff.

Contrary to what many say, I was not impressed with Thunderbird. IMO it's very overpriced for what you get. I ordered the chicken and waffles. I should have read more closely, I just assumed it would be a normal chicken and waffles, wrong. They use pulled chicken not fried chicken. Overall that whole entree was really bland and left something to be desired. My husband had hot chicken, by far the better of the two dishes, but half of the meal was biscuits! More slaw and meat please! The cocktails were good. I would recommend cocktails and the pimento cheese as an app. Other than that, there are many other places in Fountain Square that would be better for a main course.

Excellent setting & delicious dinner
Service was personalized & outstanding
Ann & Hollis

Solid little place with good quality food for extremely reasonable prices. I often order delivery from here through Grubhub, and several times the staff has had to call me to clarify things on my order, or apologize for not having something (like french fries for my kids, which they no longer offer but were still listed on the Grubhub menu for a little while.) They were so polite and offered numerous replacement items, and then still threw in a little more than what we had agreed upon. They always get my order right when I make special requests for the food. The food is always hot and fresh, delivery is *always* a little earlier than estimated (it helps that I live very close though,) and the delivery guy is always so nice. Seriously, where else can you get a giant plate of tofu hibachi with lots of "yummy" sauce and a salad for $7.95? Hibachi of any kind at any other place is town is nearly twice that. The sushi is always good and fresh, and I love love LOVE the ginger dressing they give for their salads. It may not blow your tastebud's minds (my hubby always orders extra teryaki sauce to give things more flavor, and I order their yummy sauce) but the five stars is for the fact that it is consistent, fresh, affordable and the service is top notch. I've probably ordered from them a dozen times now and have been extremely happy each time. Great place!

The other night I went out to dinner with my husband and 6 other friends. We arrived at prime time and had to wait. This was fine, the wait wasn't terribly long.  We were seated, and our orders were taken. The server was very pleasant and efficient, especially when having to deal with a large party.

When the orders were brought to us.. one of our parties was served a steak that was supposed to be Medium Rare. What he got was well done.  He capitulated on flagging the waiter down and asking for it to be redone.  In the end, he did just that.  The server apologized profusely and the steak was taken back, mean while the rest of us ate our food. 10 minutes later, the steak was returned, a new one, it looked and smelled amazing, but when he cut into it.. it was almost blue.. it was -that- rare.

Two times his steak was wrong. So third time's the charm. Of course my friend was worried that it was going to be spit on or something else, but when they brought it out the final time it was passable. He did end up taking much of it home because the rest of us were done.  

The manager came over to the table to present the checks, he casually handed my friend a card for a free Appetizer, but there was no money taken off for the steak. It's not that he wanted it free, after all, he didn't even speak up on it, but if you mess up twice, there probably should be a bit more compensation for their trouble, especially when he didn't get to eat with the rest of us and was forced to watch us. 

Not a good first impression at all.

Denny's is a Denny's is a Denny's is a Denny's.

They are useless except for two things:

1) Really good breakfasts any morning you don't feel like cooking.
2) Really awesome breakfasts any time after midnight.

I couldn't tell you a single thing about any of Denny's regular food.  Not their burgers, not their salads or sandwiches.  I have no clue about their soup.  And while they look delish, I've never eaten one of their desserts.

However, I have their entire breakfast menu memorized and committed to heart.  Any Denny's you go to is going to have the same stuff.  There is really no difference between Denny's, nothing to make one stand out over the other in terms of food.   However, some have better cooks than others and some are definitely cleaner than others.  This Denny's is one of the clean ones.  

What always surprises me is when people rate a Denny's on Yelp, they act like they are tragically disappointed, like they were expecting to eat at the Four Seasons with white glove service and a Michelin rated chef.  It's DENNY'S, for heck's sake.  And, to take pot shots at what people are wearing, how their hair and make up looks and making fun of their profession...it's just tacky and classless.  You want to complain about food or service, knock yourself out.  But when you decide to utilize Yelp as your only way to have some passive aggressive fun at the expense of others, well, your opinion no longer matters.

All I know is that any time I have come to this Denny's location, the food is always hot.  The coffee is always hot.  The people are generally friendly, so long as they are not dealing with the antics of your random 17 year olds making a mess, hurling spitballs around at each other or carrying on like some newly freed chimps from the zoo.  

April H. was our server to our party of six and she was quite lovely.  We did have a dirty, stained mug which she promptly swapped out without having to be asked.  She brought more than adequate amounts of ketchup, creamers and syrup to the table.  We were being a big loud and rambunctious, hyped up from a concert my son had just performed in but she remained polite and even laughed with us.  All our food was very good, warm and satisfying as breakfast can be at 3 am.  

Three stars for this Denny's because it was, indeed, A-Ok.

Folks... My company told me about 3 month's ago that I would be travelling to St Louis. First thing I thought about was 'hey, great BBQ!'.
Ended up at the hotel here in Galleria, hungry and too tired to try navigating St Louis.
Looked up BBQ joints that delivered on yelp!, Found Andre's (good reviews) and gave them a call. 
Andre answered the phone and then delivered my order himself!
Everything I could ask for in ribs...tender, moist, juicy, and flavorful!
This was my first experience with St Louis ribs, however, I think I got lucky and found near perfection the first time around.
I would recommend Andre to my best buddy (without hesitation)!!

Kanella is a wonderful BYOB option and has a few tables outside for outdoor dining.  A really great option if you're into Greek food or just want to try it for the first time.  I ordered the Ortiki, which is 2 semi boneless quails served with barley, mushrooms, grapes, and jus.  Note the "semi" boneless quails do have some bones so you'll probably use some of your fingers in addition to the fork and knife.  Not that that's a problem.  I very happily tried to get as much tender meat as I could from the dish.  

A fantastic place to dine.  Good service and outdoor seating will be even better once it gets warmer.

The 'All You Can Eat Dinner' option is totally worth it if you're using the Groupon deal. Otherwise, everything is overpriced and mediocre in my opinion. 

I usually come here when I'm super hungry and craving unlimited but simple sashimi. If you're doing All You Can Eat, remember you can order anything from the menu in addition to the items on the conveyer belt! My favorite small plate is the Yellowtail w/ Jalapeno. 

Service starts out alright and quick in the beginning, but it ends up slowing down later when they underestimate your ability to eat more. I've had to wait for long periods of time to order something else off the menu several times. The servers are friendly, but the place is definitely understaffed.

I would recommend going at least once to see if it's a good fit!

I have since tried their white hot chocolate and it was the right choice to warm me up on a cold day.  The shop itself is quite small and fills up rather quickly because most customers opt to sit down, but if you're lucky and love to meet new people (as I do), someone will gladly agree to let you share a table :)

My absolute favorite! Best fried shrimp I've had in my life. We usually get (I go as many times as possible when I'm in town) the crawfish tails, fried shrimp, bbq shrimp and fried pickles. It's all so f*ing great that we can never narrow it down to fewer dishes!!

Tried Palace Cafe for the first time since moving back to New Orleans.  The space is beautiful.  It used to be an old music store and has tons of space.  Before you leave try to visit the second floor that has a full bar and murals to pay homage to our musical legends.

Now for the food.  My girlfriend Clare and I enjoyed a couple of small plates and some wine and French 75.  They were out of the meat pies but to my luck, we ended up order the smoked tuna.  OMG!!! It was smoked tuna on a bellini with creme fraiche and fresh dill.  The taste was unbelievable.  A must try if you have not had this.  We also ordered shrimp toast. This toast is not to be compared to the Chinese fast food shrimp toast which is always a little oily.  This toast is crisp and lets the taste of the shrimp just shine through. 

Last but not least, our server "Eugene" who likes to be called Gene was on point with the history of New Orleans and places to visit.  He also has the history of the food being served.  He was not only a great server but a delight to listen to with his stories.  I would recommend you ask for him personally.

All in all, a great place to eat.
Been up with my husband for almost 5 hours now with violent food poisoning from the bacon topped pizza. 10000/10 would not recommend.

I have been here many many times for Quizzo and had a very enjoyable evening. Quizzo is usually pretty crowded. They do a decent job assigning tables, but they could use another host - he abandons his post to collect the $1 per player and leaves many groups sans table. The service can be hit or miss, which is a byproduct of the crowds. 

Very good draft list that rotates pretty frequently. They have complimentary peanuts by the door. I've only ever had cheese fries & the quesadilla. Both good bar food. I do not recommend the buffalo chicken tenders - you will get 4. Not worth the price. 

I do have to say that this is very much a college crowd. They don't do a very good job of enforcing any sort of hourly minimum or food requirement for tables. So you'll see 3 people squatting at a massive table that could hold 8, with a half pitcher of beer and no food. To be honest, that seems to happen a lot, which is pretty inconsiderate.  But I digress. Quizzo is great, most everyone is friendly, and it's a good place to watch the game.
Very cool place with unique food to our region! everyone in our party of 7 enjoyed their meals and drinks.

My husband and I originally intended to go to Wine Cask, but ended up in Intermezzo.
This place has a cool vibe, great wait staff and food to die for.
We are definitely coming back!   Meeting friends from LA here to catch up, drink a little and eat little. Can't wait, this place is awesome.
Yeah, the crispy cauliflower is so good, crazy since I hate cauliflower, but theirs is so yummy, a must try!
The best gyro place in town, their prices are reasonable and the food is great, quality and quantity

I have only been here once for lunch so the 4 stars is based on limited experience. I had the chicken enchiladas which were delicious and filling enough for a small to moderate appetite. I also had a side of fries which were also very good and well seasoned. The staff and other patrons were also friendly. The decor is simple but elegant and fitting for the neighborhood. Prices were reasonable for lunch. I would visit again to try more of the menu selections.

My husband and I had to try this place because it had all good reviews and let me tell you everyone was right this place has great food at a great price, its not fast food but good quality food, the alaskan cod sandwich my father got looked amazing!!! The Burger was cooked perfectly and the seseme bun did it for me it was grilled also, it was so yummy!!!  I truly hope Ernies stays around for a while because its hard to find a good burger around here

Best thing about the place is the beautiful aquarium and a very cheerful waitress.  Grilled oysters were teeny tiny.  Lobster roll has a decent flavor but is also on the smaller scale when compared to a traditional New England roll. I will give them another chance by trying their boiler combination platters.  The experience can only improve!

Everything we have is great. You can't go wrong. 

It's a great family owned place were the food is always fresh.
Hardly 3, mediocre to the max. Nothing impressive from unsatisfying food to slow inconsistent service.

Disappointed.
Despite signs on the door asking customers to wear masks none of the staff were.
We left. Can't risk it.
Sad we couldn't try the food
Also note they have a chicken sandwich on their menu but when asked about it they said no as if they never had one. If you don't offer that item , why is it still on the menu board?

Have been here twice.  Food and service nothing less than outstanding
  Both are breakfast and lunch were great.  Expect the usual 30 minute wait on Sundays
Management helped us get the best deal for our money as we did not want the usual fare.
Couldnt ask for more.

I live right next to the Market, and today I went in for the first time in several months. It should be noted that I don't consciously avoid it, but I tend to forget it exists despite living a block away. It's just not part of my periphery for whatever reason. I wish they did a better job of marketing to (and for) the neighborhood. A newsletter/flyer stuck in my front door once a month would go a long way in reminding me that it's not just for out-of-towners. That said, I was pleasantly surprised to see a couple of my quirky neighbors getting coffee. At 9am, it seemed half local, half AirB&B-ers. 

I had some time to kill, so I initially walked over in search of a nice breakfast and to sit for a while with a book, but the breakfast choices were few and uninteresting [to me] so I grabbed a coffee and sat for a bit. 

The folks at Coast Roast were wide awake and friendly, and the guy bussing tables was as wonderful as I remember from my last visit(s).  As I was sitting, I saw a few folks walk in and assume the bakery was the coffee shop, which probably gets annoying when you're selling delectable little treats and people just keep asking you for dark roast (& you have to point them to the next counter). 

My only real gripe for this visit is that the lady at the counter to the left of Shank (the one with Dirty Mac etc.) was super grumpy and clearly didn't want to be there this morning, so I avoided the one place I would've grabbed breakfast from and went across the street to the Co-Op for some overpriced fruit instead :-)

Obviously this is too personal, but I can't believe they have a super ultra big book with the songs you can choose and sing, and they don't have Soda Stereo.
For those who don't know it (gosh) it s an internationally well known and so awarded band from Argentina on the 80s and 90s. Some say bigger than INXS, Tear for Fears, etc. 
This band is absolutely the best rock that All America (without taking USA into account, of course) have had. And it is not just me who thinks this, but all countries of the continent.
So, it is so bad that they have ricky martin, enrique iglesias and shakira and not Soda Stereo.
Im from Argentina, so, maybe my opinion does not count to many of americans, but it will to other Latinoamerican countries.
Really poor list of spanish songs.

Excellent Irish Pub/restaurant. Excellent Scottish eggs, Guinness pie and shepherd's pie and they know how to pour a Guinness. 

The live music is outstanding. Mr. McNamaras is not some mediocre Irish folk song fan, he's the real deal. Him and his band sound every bit as good as recordings of Darby O'Gill, the Dubliners and the like. 

It is pricey by Applebees/Chilis standards, but well worth it when you consider the whole experience. Two of us got an appetizer and 3 drinks total with our meals and it came out just under $70 with a tip.

Beware! They do not send rice with delivery orders. Let me be clear, they didn't forget it, they do not include it with the overpriced, overly spicy food. What kind of Chinese restaurant doesn't include rice? Red braised pork is horribly dry. The Kung pao shrimp has no flavor, but a decent amount of shrimp. 
Seriously, who sends out an order without rice?!?!?!

Found this BYOB gem a while back.  Not too much to look at from outside but quaint on the inside.  We order out/dine in at least once a week - standard favorite if we don't want to cook ourselves.

Food is really good.  Think between my husband and I have tried most things on the menu and haven't been disappointed yet.  Favorites are lobster ravioli, farfalle gorgonzola with sliced chicken added, penne abruzzi, calzones, florestina pizza, panini sandwiches, eggplant with veal sausage topping - although not a big fan of the pasta & sauce that is served on the side (sauce is a bit too sweet for my taste).  Balsamic salad dressing is addictive.  

Only thing I'd change - ask for oil/parsley combination that comes comes with bread on side since bread can get over saturated from sitting too long and quality of cappuccino depends on server making it.
Always a great time and the food is comfort J love my community and seeing someone I know and love at every visit

We stopped in for appetizers and dessert.  Both were phenomenal, but the place was uncomfortably warm.  We, as well as the servers, had sweat on our brows.  This was a night when the wood grill was NOT in use.  We asked about the heat and the servers told us it most likely will get worse as the temperatures outside warm up.

Great selection of healthy options.  I always get a bowl every time and it has been flavorful, fresh, and plentiful.  Daughter and future son in law was  visiting with me last time I went.  They loved it as well.   Great healthy & quick option in the hood!
BEST RESTAURANT IN NEW ORLEANS!!! The service was AMAZING and the food was even better! Definitely recommend!!
Ribs and fries. Bomb as f***. Might have a long wait but it's worth it for the first time.

The dessert buffet here is the best! The food I have mixed feeling with.

I went for lunch/Brunch on a Monday and there was pho, variety of meats, omelette/egg station and a vast variety of desserts. The quality of ice cream was great (I had the hazelnut, coffee w/chocolate and dark chocolate) (2017)

I also had the weekday dinner buffet and it was ok. The best dishes were the beef rib, prime rib and fish with lemon sauce. The dessert was still the best thing they had as they had the best dessert buffet variety in Reno. Some stand out items were the espresso creme brûlée and tuxedo (white and milk chocolate). 

I didn't like that the guy serving the pho wiped the heating bowl with a wet towel that was left on the counter. I had the pho a year ago and thought it tasted better last year. They had a variety of meat at the carving station but the meat looked like it sat a while. Although the prime rib still very good, the center of the slice was a bit dry.

A local restaurant that gave great service and the incredible food.
We live in bywater and some friends took us here. We will definitely be back. My wife got the steak that was perfectly cooked. Our friends got the catfish, and there niece got the grilled chicken. I orders the original stuffed bell pepper.

Each entree was delicious. The catfish I tasted was one of the best I have had.
Although this a little off the normal restauarant row near the French Quarter. I have found the hidden secrets are the best  food in New Orleans.  They are in the process of getting liquor license so call ahead we were able to bring our own wine. 

Great atmosphere, family owned and run restaurant, they know  how to do New Orleans food right and the prices are about half of what you would pay in the quarter.

They deliver to the Bywater, and surrounding areas up to around 5 miles.

Just over the St. Claude bridge in holy cross neighborhood. 

 The bread pudding was amazing as well.

Local, Fresh and delicious. I dare you to try it.

Support the local community and taste the amazing food, you will be pleasantly surprised.

Quality food every time. I don't claim to know what authentic Mexican food is like, but I'd like to imagine it's something like this. I've had the chips and guac here, the fish tacos, and the steak and yucca burrito. All of it has been really awesome. The chips were crisp without being too greasy, the fish tacos were not fishy at all, and the burrito was quite possibly the best burrito I've ever had. It was well constructed with a good mix of fillings. I'll definitely be coming back many more times - and bringing my friends!

Ate here today for the first time.  Took about 10 minutes for a waitress to come over, but that's ok as the menu was new to us.  They had many early bird specials and a senior menu.  The early birds are pretty good prices.  The salad bar was fresh and when we got back to the table our soup was there with water.  I enjoyed the soup., as it wasn't very salty.  The waitress was pleasant and then brought our food over.  She checked back (took her  a little while) to see if our food was ok, which it was.  We took our leftovers home.  Dessert was included so we took the tiny piece of cake home with our leftovers. Drinks were included also, but I did read a no refill policy which was fine with us.   PARKING...........lot is very small and congested.  If you are able to park on Rhawn and walk, do it. (Unless you are there in the middle of the night).  We will be returning.

I've worked around the corner from here for a year and a half and I'm kicking myself in the ass for not coming in sooner. The staff is friendly and accommodating, the food is fresh, and the tea is awesome. What more could you ask for??  Keep doin what youre doin.

Without a doubt, as a lifelong Mt. Airy resident, this place is simply hands down, the best restaurant in Mt. Airy and could very well be the best in Mt. Airy and Chestnut Hill.  Hurry and come because the rumor is that the place may close this spring.

Where else can you get escargot appetizers rich in buttery taste, butternut squash soup perfectly melded with hint of pear, and fennel sausage tenderly flavored?  The meat dishes were just perfection:  rare filet of beef with peppercorn, duck perfectly seasoned and a terrific rack of lamb.

We went on a night when there were more empty tables than full - really a huge tragedy given how good the food is.  I write this review really to encourage others to come out to one of the best restaurants in Philly - and we eat out a lot.

What is holding it back?  Well, the place is pretty pricey - entrees are $25 to 30 each and the place is only open Friday and Saturdays so it is closed more than open.  Still we think it is worth it.  And it is BYOB.  Come on your birthday or anniversary so you can celebrate an exceptional restaurant.  You won't be disappointed.
Love the burgers!! The rest of the menu is  typical bar type food, but very decent. The people are always so friendly too..

Exceptional service via the drive-thru on Friday, June 1, 2018.  Have been to this McDonalds in the past and the service was terrible. Great greeting at the intake in Drive-thru. I was asked directly how I was doing. I was greeted via the speaker with a "smile." I was also handed my food in a courteous manner. Fries were freshly prepared and hot; diet dr.pepper was thirst quenching! Great job team! Please keep up the great work!

Nice place.  Pleasant atmosphere with open and airy rooms.  And  helpful and pleasant waitstaff.  I had the large Greek salad and it was very nice.  The Feta cheese was fresh and tasty.  Jennifer had a Gyros and shared some of her Pita bread - it was warm and toasty and excellent with my salad.  Would definitely come back to try more things.

Nice place, and food looks good...However, we were asked to LEAVE or pay their dinner price before 4:30pm. Here's what happened:
- Went in at 2:29pm (as receipt confirms)
- Were seated and eating appetizers by 3:00pm
- By 3:30pm they remove all their food to prepare for for dinner.
- Floor manager, Greg Mccleary, asked us to rush and leave, or he would charge us for dinner. Wow... first time something like this happens to me. I politely asked him and his supervisor to let us stay or give us a refund... both requests were denied. 

Horrible business practice. They should notify customers about this "rule"... maybe they should even put it on the receipt. Will never come back here.

I wanted to have a Thanksgiving meal on Thanksgiving and I had decided to place an order of 4 plates to go to take to work. Since I was working that evening, I had my wife call and place the order and go pick it up. Now, the menu online says that you green beans, sweet potatoes, turkey gravy dressing, turkey, a slice of ham, choice of dinner roll or corn muffin and a slice of pumpkin pie. I had asked my wife to get the corn muffin all 4 plates. When she placed the order and she requested the corn muffin, she was instructed you get what we give you. My wife didnt want to argue because I had to leave for work before our home meal was going to be ready.  She picked up the 4 plates, she had to ask for plastic ware and she had noticed that there wasnt any ham on any of the plates. She brought there attention and again she was told, you get what we give you. As far as the food goes, what i had gotten was pretty good but I was real disappointed that I couldn't get  the corn muffin and there was no ham. My wife didnt want me to go without so therefore she took the order as is. When I woke up ti get ready for work, she had informed me of what happened.

Honestly, I expected so much more from the steaks, considering how much I paid.
I mean their food is pretty good, but not worth the price.

Their appetizers are amazing, especially the Scallops served with apricot chutney, holy cow were they good, but 2 pieces for $20??

All their appetizers are actually really good, so are their salads, and bread, but their main thing is steaks, and that's where I was disappointed.

2 people, salad, soup, steaks, and dessert, plus tip, $210......never again...

Post Covid - this place is still delicious!!!! The fresh shrimp spring rolls were delicious and fresh!! 

Pho broth was still one of the best in the area. Pork Vermicelli is still good and egg roll was crispy. The steamed pork bun was good, but I prefer a steamed round bao. 

Service and food was great as always!

I've read the reviews, both here and in other media. I gave the restaurant time to get it's groove before my first visit and made reservations for a Monday night so it wouldn't be overly busy. You know what? Believe the hype. The food was nothing short of stellar. The bread is off the charts-I found there to be plenty of bread for the appetizers and would have been glad to pay for more if I needed to-it's that good. Started with the warm ricotta, so creamy and delicious. The beef tongue with root veg mash and salsa verde and even convinced the GF that tongue is delcious! Pork Belly with lentils and a sunny egg...the list goes on. The house cured meats....Braised octopus...La Bestia pizza... Perfect zeppoles to end the meal along with a fantastic tiramisu. The wines were fairly priced and well thought out. I don't understand the negative reviews for portion size. If you want big portions of Sysco food, go to a place that serves that stuff-this is exceptional food, the bulk of it being made in house (you can even see the curing station for the Chef's salumi next to the custom wood fired oven) down to the mustard. The attention to detail is amazing and I can't wait to get back.

We found this place on a trip to New Orleans a few years ago. The food here is fantastic and the portions are big. It is very reasonable pricing especially for the amount you get. There's an older guy named "D" that helps clean tables and find you a seat. He is worth the visit alone. His Katrina story is fascinating. We have never had a bad experience here. We make it a priority to eat here every time we are in New Orleans. Usually more than once a trip. Their sign says "New Orleans best kept secret" and it's the truth. You will see a line a mile long outside of Mothers for more expensive food that doesn't taste nearly as good.  Eat here now!

This restaurant is perfect for people for everyone, regardless of whether they want to share food or not. The portions are a great size for two people so it makes a great place for groups. People can order what they want and take home leftovers or order some for a group and try a little bit of everything. My group for 5 pizzas and each one of them were delicious! They are well balanced and artfully crafted. There is a good collection of drinks, so you can find anything you like. The ambiance is nice and is not too loud. The lighting is very nice, not too dim and not too bright and the tables are set up well. Our server was excellent and the wait time for the food was reasonable! Overall, a great experience!
Good food. Went there for dinner on a Thursday night and there was a 20 min wait. Their parking lot was also full. If you are in the mood for Mexican this is a good place to be. Loved their salsa.
Always a delicious meal! I've been coming to Mark Pie's since I was a kid. You can't go wrong with scallop fried rice!

Amazing dinner!  I have eaten steak from so many top tier restaurants and I would put this steak up to them any day!!! Staff was fantastic and very kind as my 16 year old son and I had a mother and son date night. We will be adding this place to our must eat list!
Fun environment and great for groups. I'm huge into French fries and the French fries here are so good. The portions are big so you're bound to have leftovers for later.

How can you ruin a taco and burrito? Ask Fuzzy's Taco Shop because they have the recipe. It was incredibly disappointing food. We ordered the tempura fish tacos and burrito and I would describe them as edible. There was absolutely no flavor and I'm not sure whoever came up with the recipes had ever tasted Mexican food at all. 

There are some good reviews and I'm assuming these people took part in their bar because that's the only way I would be able to eat this food again.

My favorite local Thai restaurant. I typically always order the Viet or Lao styles of food however. Pho is super good as well as the Thai style soups. This place had great food with fabulous flavors. Be ready for a wait as they have become a local favorite.

The sandwiches are fabulous; my only complaint is that they don't have the brisket as at Reading Terminal. But that made me try the roast beef, which was excellent, and the pork, which my husband has been raving about for years. Now I know why. I feel badly that this renovation is going on next door; wonder how badly it affects business. I'd be really pissed at the landlord if I was them. But the food is great, you just have to know it's there !
The tri tip sandwich was very good. It was smoked just right, and the Au ju dip was very unique.  Great meal overall. Sat outside, great weather just helped the overall experience.

All 3 bartenders I dealt with were great. Fun, prompt, attentive. Don't always get that in most places. Had a burger and fries, it was mediocre. Not too upset, the price was fine and it's just standard bar food. Beer selection was decent, not great, but they did have some craft beer choices for a snob like me. Biggest issue was that the TVs at the bar are almost directly over your head, went for a football game, my neck was sore by halftime. Also didn't appear to be on the HD channels.

We had a friendly greeting upon arrival by the manager, and she checked on our meal. The walleye was delicious, but the mushy crabcakes did not hold together on the plate. Also the blueberry cobbler was mostly blueberries without any pastry dough.
$5 for a subpar grilled cheese? You can only choose between French and wheat bread, and the cheese tasted cheap. Not worth. It's just a greaseball.
They have the BEST chips!!!!!    Quick delivery!!!   More vegetarian options would be nice.

Pizza, dip and Nutella calzone were all excellent and fresh. Great service with owners taking pride in customer service and the product that leaves their doors. Would recommend and will return.


Brandini does paninis
Awesome food !! Have gone there several times...their Seaford is spot on every single time !!

First time here.  Ordered the pulled pork combo.  DRY, DRY, DRY!!!!!
Was able to eat it when doused in the "smokehouse" sauce.  In my opinion, kinda expensive for bar b que.  $6.99 ( I believe) for the pork.  Another $3.00 for one side and a drink.  With Jazzy's across the street, and Hank's not that far away on Dale Mabry, I won't be back.  Should have been a sign to me, when at 6:00pm there were more employees than customers.  $22.00 for 2 pulled pork combo dinners-I can get better.

Love Ocean Prime!!! Last time I visited one was a few years ago in Orlando when I was attending a work convention and have been dying to go back! When I looked up restaurants near our hotel, I was so excited to see there was an Ocean Prime less than a mile away.

We walked in without reservations around 7:30pm on a Wednesday night and were shortly seated. We started with the Tuna Tartare which was flavorful and fresh. Next we got French Onion soup, first time I've ever had it, but my co-worker said it was one of the best French Onion soups she'd ever had.. For mains, I got the Chilean Sea Bass which was delicious and I'm a sucker for anything with truffles. My colleague got filet (which he said was one of the best steaks he's had in a long time- it's also grass fed beef, which I think is tastier than grain fed) and my other colleague got crab cakes.. Unfortunately the crab cakes were kind of a disappointment... They were flat like pancakes. We didn't send it back, but I wouldn't recommend it. We finished with a carrot cake which was light, fresh, sweet, and had small pieces of coconut throughout- highly recommend! 

Minus the crab cake, it was wonderful dinner. Great staff and we learned they are opening an Ocean Prime in DC in the next few months and one in Reston, Va next year.  Can't wait to be able to have an Ocean Prime close to home!!

Stopped by for lunch after eyeing it by my office for months.  Place was very clean.  Food was very good.  Got a burger, which was huge and tasted very good.  Only complaint was the bun crumbled after the first bite, so I had to eat the burger with a knife and fork.  May be a good idea to cut it in half first.  But it was very good, fresh not frozen.  Co-worker got the bbq pork on bun and that looked very good.  His bun fared better than mine.  Service was great too-very attentive.  There were a number of people there for lunch too, so that's always a good sign.  Next time I'm going to try the grilled chicken salad.  Lady next to me got that, and it was a big salad and looked great.   I recommend this place.

Well today the Casual Clam was not up to snuff. We always split a Seafood Sampler with Sea scallops and always more than enough food. Today the waitress in training didn't enter the order correct so it was not made for two. Second the clams were overcooked and tough with no flavor. The answer was only one cook today. No excuse if you can't put out a consistent product you will lose customers.
We came here with our teenagers for a late lunch. Everything was freshly made and so delicious - nacho, fish taco, seared tuna, and fajita. Sauces are amazing. I am so glad we came here :)

So, we decided to try this place on a whim. We were driving to Costco and thought let us give it a try.  Well, I will say, this is the absolutely last time we will be here. The menu options are limited. Service is slow at best. Our apps were pretty good, but when our food arrived, we had to ask to have the empty plates to be removed. 

Our beverage glasses were empty for over 5 mins, we needed to ask to have them refilled. It is a really noisy place, the food is just ok.  For what we paid for the 4 of us to have dinner...not worth it.  We will not be back.

UPDATE:
If you're looking for an ideal brunch experience, check them out. 
They have great options for all eating habits. The drink options are vast and creative. Outside seating with heaters and personalized booths. Seating is by reservation only.

What do you get when you cross a French chef and an Italian chef: Coquette's.  Eclectic and French. The antipasto was fantastic.  Smoked salami and duck liver balls.  My daughter and I split an excellent Wagyu beef and interesting pork fusion dish.  Fantastic wine list. Try the 2012 Cab Franc!  If we left any!

My expectations weren't to high when I walked into this place since it was just a small asian fusion place in a strip plaza but I was stunned by how good this place actually was. To start off with, I ordered some spicy chicken sushi rolls up front which came here before my ramen. I was surprised by how spicy and crunchy it was. I just expected some chicken in a sushi roll but it was actually pretty good. That got me in the mood for the ramen that came up next. The ramen at first looked kind of different ramen you got in some asian store. The noodles were smooth and tasted good, especially paired along with the soup itself. It had some egg and beef in it making it seem like the ramen had effort put into it. Now the ambience was not much seeing how again, it was in a strip plaza. But it was kind of quiet and I liked it that way. Overall, I definetly would recommend this place if you're stoppping by and want some quick asian fusion food to eat!
Mom and I had the Kasha and bowties the other day......best I've had since Coney Island in the early nineties !!   Will definitely go back for these !

Chile rellenos in the Tucson Area rated according to the Homeland Security Advisory System with three word descriptors.

Filiberto's: free meat chunk. Green

See photos.

What a great restaurant find! Four of us on a girls night out took a chance on Gringo last Saturday. Service is EVERYTHING in the competitive restaurant market, and our server and her manager, Nick W., seemed to anticipate our needs before we knew them. Maybe it was the sangria talking, but that street corn in the cob was to die for. Highly recommend the brisket taco. Check this place out and make yourself a regular, that is what I plan to do.

Oh my deliciousness!!! Went here last night at the last minute with my friends...they had a reservation for 5, but the staff was very gracious to change it to 6 at the last minute!!  I have been dying to try this place after walking past it about 43 times.  FInally, I got my wish. 

The owner is such a sweet, friendly man and greeted my friend, who made the reservation, by name.  He sure knows how to run a restaurant.
