While the atmosphere is whimsical and beach the food is awful and way over priced. Cheap plastic wear, really, to eat blue crabs??? That's nuts! When I asked for real utensils they brought me a pair of scissors!! I'm not joking! The crabs were AWFUL so I sent them back! Coconut shrimp was pretty good. Most of the employees were rude and not professional except for the bartender, unfortunately I don't remember her name. I would never ever return to this establishment.
One of the best savers ever the food is so good I always order the Little Mexico plate  has a little bit of everything but so far all the food is good and the drinks

Me and my girlfriend stayed there 12/28/13.  We awoke to find a mystery brown substance on the duvet about the size of a silver dollar .  WTF?!?!  Obviously the maid did not wash it, awesome.   Then we hear loud squawking coming from the hallway.   Mind you its about 8:00am on a Sunday.  Come to find out its the maid yelling about her crappy life to another co worker.  The squawking is perfect because we are both hungover.  This goes on for 20min.   My girl also finds peanuts by the tv stand and hair in the shower.  We complained to the front desk, but got no apology or "will take care of it" attitude.    I dont care about decor or modern furnishings if the room and staff are crap.  I have had cleaner, nicer, and more give a sh*& attitude from staff at a Holiday Inn.  

Take it from someone who travels A LOT,  find another hotel.

Dinner was amazing...  started with the  Boudin Balls with a Garlic Aioli and they were so good.. wanted to eat more.  The  Steamed Mussels with Collard Greens & Crispy Grit Crackers were great.. I think I could eat the greens all day.   Also had the  Fresh Cut French Fries with Garlic Butter & Parmesan Reggiano which my friend said were to die for.

For dinner I had the an Seared Duck Breast with Duck Ragout, Pappardelle, Fava Beans & Preserved Egg, the duck was perfectly cooked and I really enjoyed it.

My friend had the pplewood Smoked Scallops with Roasted Baby Squash, Tarragon Roesti Potato & Sauce which was also amazing.

The only problem was we had so much we did not get to have the Krispy Kreme Bread Pudding which was good in a way.. just means I have to go back !
Amazing food, service and atmosphere.  Next time I'm sitting the at the bar and ordering there.

We arrived after six pm on a Friday when the restaurant was quickly filling up, but were seated quickly. Our server was attentive and, despite some difficulty with the English language, anxious to get the order just right. Drinks came to the table quickly (a half-pitcher of lime margaritas was only $7.99), and food took about 20 minutes, which was fine since the salsa was medium-spicy, and chips kept flowing. Dinner plates were huge -since I have photos taken at La Fonda, I can say that my plate of Cameron Yucatan was larger here - and everyone had enough food to box for the ride home. My tablemates commented on the bright and cheerful décor.  Good eats, good value, good time.

Has those really good, fat oysters (their "cocktail sauce" (?) is much better than the regular stuff you get elsewhere). Their chargrilled oysters are pretty good if you don't like yours raw. Service is quick and efficient. Their soup of the day is always crab bisque.

Im giving a 5 star only on the only dish i had. Now based on that i am definitely comong back to try the sushi. The ramen i ordered is the best one yet i have found in florida. The flavor was really rich and oh so creamy. Noodles cooked pretty good. One thing i wish i wish they were fresh made noodles. The service is good. Im one of only 5 people so... the establishment is big. Sushi bar is decent size. Chef behind bar was funny and friendly. Im sure i found my new number one Japanese restaurant.

Hands down one of the best dinner experiences we've had in a while. We were in town for a wedding and we were referred to Santa Barbara FisHouse by multiple people when we asked where to find awesome seafood & steak. We were immediately greeted by the hostess, and requested to be sat near the far right of the bar near the cooking station. We had Michael as our server and were even greeted by the cooking station staff, Leo. Michael was so welcoming, very polite, and helpful. My girlfriend and I ordered the Fried Calamari, and New York Steak w/ Scallops and vegetables & the Ahi Tuna w/ vegetables. The food took a little bit longer to prep than anticipated and Michael was so sweet & offered us a glass of wine split on the house for the wait. Leo also surprised us with a small clam appetizer (wish I could remember the name) for the inconvenience, which was unprompted & so genuine.

Between the quality of the food, the top notch service from staff, and the location, this was by far the best meal we have had in a very long time. Keep doing your thing, SB FisHouse. You guys are amazing and we will so recommend you to all of our friends & family who drop by SB in the future.

Also, Michael & Leo should be cherished employees. If your entire team is as genuine as those two, the surrounding restaurants are in trouble!

Thanks for everything.
-Lexi & Ash

Really great ice cream parlor! Friendly service, delicious treats! Restroom need to be checked regularly though, and the cleanliness of the parlor wasn't to a T but the quality of the ice cream was delicious! Cookies and cream ice cream is gone ! :)

Copa was the hot spot when it first opened, but after years of serving delicious margs to drunken fools this place has really gone downhill.  

The food is OK. I wouldn't say it's the best, but it's not terrible and reasonably priced. 

I have to say I'd prefer to eat here than wait in a line around the block at Jim's across the street- that's for sure. 

The margaritas are still delicious though.

This place should get 5-stars just for being the only player in Carmel's not-quite-that-bustling nightlife scene. If you want to party past 9 PM in this town, you go to Meijer, Get-Go, or The Quirky Feather. The bakery foods that they have are quite delicious, and the vibe of the place reminds of college-town coffee shops from a past life of mine. It's not something that Carmel has a lot of (it's most definitely the only spot like this), but it's one that well needed and appreciated by those who know it's there. 

The staff is friendly and fun as well, make sure to leave them a tip for a job well done.

Despite what their name says, it's more meh than bam, except maybe the price.  2 dogs and some tots for $18.  Buns were ok, more or less the same as a decent store-bought.  The dogs themselves were bland and more than a bit tough, toppings were bland (I got the Wisconsin cheesehead, you'd think that'd be flavorful right?). The tots we got were the bacon ranch ones, again, basically store bought tots, a good amount of bacon, but it was pretty rubbery and tasteless. Overall it's ok for a quick dine and dash, but for the price I'd suggest elsewhere for sure.
They have the best Mexican food around.  You'd have to go try a Mexican restaurant in Fairmont City area to get such delicious food.  Either that or actual Mexico.

Just moving here from Las Vegas, so far this is the best ramen place my wife and I have found. Really friendly and tentative staff. The menu is great, never had spicy shrimp wontons, and they didn't disappoint

I think there maybe new ownership here as I saw the former partner from a place in Sparks. There is a noticeable difference in the staff. The beauty is that my go to menu items are still available. Don't miss the vaquero burrito or rolled tacos. 

Food         8/10
Service     7/10 (free refills would be nice)
Salsa Bar  9/10
Prices        7/10 compared to others in the area

Cleanliness in the restaurant is pretty good, the bathrooms not so much.

My husband and I just moved to Tampa and we've been looking for an all you can eat spot....glad that we found this place! It was super clean, the service was great, and the food was delicious! Also the AYCE price was $2 cheaper from what we normally have in Colorado. There was a wide variety of appetizers, sushi, specialty rolls, and ice cream flavors. They also have a bar for alcoholic drinks. They looked so pretty so we definitely have to check those out next time. We had a great experience and we will definitely be back!
I have only gotten food delivered. Everytime the food was great. It came as described, hot food hot cold food cold. The driver was a really nice guy as well. Overall great value for the money.

Best Chinese food in Boise. Shocked this does not have 5 stars. Twice cooked pork is my favorite dish. Beef with black mushrooms my second favorite. Third is beef and broccoli. All their souls are delicious as well.

Basing the review on my only experience, hoping to make it back to the St. Louis area sometime soon for another shot so I can satisfy the creole junky in me. Don't recall name, but I tried the andouille sausage/pork burger and it was excellent. The marmalade gave the sandwich a great twist. My fiance tried the beer battered burger and was disappointed. Separately, the ingredients were tasty, but everything put together was a greasy mess. There also was hardly any cheese sauce to be found. One thing I wish was different was portions/menu setup -- be nice if there was a side gumbo option (or a gumbo/sandwich combo) rather than having to pay $9 just to try the gumbo.  Really wanted to try a sandwich and gumbo, but wasn't going to drop $17 to make that happen.
I can see why it closed! We use to fly into this Airport just so we could eat at Elephant Bar.  The last time we went it was horrible! Poor service and the food was worst then Denny's.

Food is great!
Our servers Brooke and Brad were great!
Brad deserves a raise. Super on the ball and witty!  I like him. Good job. GGGGGRRRRREEEEEAAAAAATTTTTTTTTTT!

Their Bánh mì is one of the best sandwiches I've had in over a decade. Fantastic and worth the drive. Also had a decent pho.

My recommendation: go for the pho and have a sit down lunch meal (house made lemonade was good).

On your way out, grab the Bánh mì from the next door bakery. Take it home and let it sit in the fridge for an afternoon. Enjoy for dinner.

I want to like Nuvo Burrito more than I actually do.  I've now been there twice, and am always made very anxious by the creative extensive menu - what should I get, what should I get?!  Everything I've had has been good and fresh - but not amazing, as I feel the food is lacking something that makes it burst with flavor.  The chicken, though very good quality and very well cooked, is kind of bland.  I just thirsted for MORE when I had the Ozark burrito today.

I've also had the Heart of Dixie burrito, the one with sweet potato and coleslaw in it.  Two things I love a lot.  I remember it being.. just okay.  I recall the coleslaw being a little too tangy - usually proof of a coleslaw not prepared in-house.  

Maybe I'm just ordering the wrong thing.  Plenty of folks are raving about the pulled pork, which I've never had.  I've also never had a drink at Nuvo Burrito.  

Despite my complaining, everything at Nuvo is REALLY fresh.  The salsa is great, the guacamole is great, the veggies and cheese are great, and the chicken has been really well prepared.  It's just not blowing my face off with flavor like I wish it would.  

I suppose I'll go again, I'm just not going raving mad looking for excuses to eat there.  And it is a bit on the expensive side.
Ordered carry out. Got the shrimp parillo.  Great taste very low carbs.  Shrimp was grilled, saw it right in front of me.  I really love this place.

Went for brunch before a show. There were seven of us and none of our dishes had an flavor. The best thing was the cappuccino and yogurt with granola and fruit. I could have had yogurt at home.  Everyone that got eggs Benedict got hard boiled eggs instead of poached. The polenta cakes had no flavor. My friend got the cannoli waffle which sounds good but tastes like cardboard, no flavor. The spinach and escarole was missing from other 2 friends crabby Benny.

Ok where to begin.  Ordered a voucher through Travelzoo for 4 people.  Entrees up to $23 were included.  Of course, the galbi is $24, and instead of allowing us to pay the $1 difference, they refused to honor it.  So, the voucher was really pretty useless, and the cost of just ordering the entrees and appetizers at menu price was the same as the "deal".  Very underhanded. I understand they are trying to attract new customers, but this is incredibly shady. Voiced our displeasure to the owner, and he just smiled and said "so sorry". Owner ended up refunding the cost of the voucher to us, so we picked up our belongings and left quickly.

Also, charging for kimchee? Really? Being Korean American, I find this completely ridiculous and laughable.  Words cannot describe how disappointed we were with this place.  Make the short trip up to Fifth Street in Olney and grab some real Korean food, not this new age, hipster b.s.

Yeah! Really nice atmosphere and the service is really friendly but a teeny bit slow. They are super good with allergies or diet restrictions and they have really unique, delicious entrees which includes a lot of seafood and a few veggie options.

Try the grapefruit rose wine, yum!

I found out about Three Boars from a friend of mine who did the carpentry work throughout the new restaurant (if you're looking for a carpenter: Laker carpentry). The decor is fantastic with a muted wood finish which gives it a beautifully warm and inviting interior.  

The space is small, but guarantees a level of intimacy you'll be hard pressed to find anywhere else in Edmonton.  The beer and whiskey menu is fantastic and sports a number of my favourite local beers including AlleyKat. In total they have 30 or 40 bottled beers and beer cocktails. They have 6 taps with at least 2 committed to local beer and another 2 to microbrews.  They have a number of classic drinks like an old fashioned and these were expertly prepared by the bartender.  He was friendly and knowledgeable about his product and was quite willing to offer suggestions.  I had a 2 oz Red Breast Irish Whiskey and an Alley Kat Black Dragon IPA.  

While I didn't try any of the food, the menu looks fantastic and is based on a tapas style plate sharing idea. While I was sitting at the bar Downstairs I struck up a conversation with part-owner and general manager Chuck. He enthusiastically told me the history of Three Boars and their plans for the future.  The idea was inspired by the Vancouver restaurant scenes commitment to small quality restaurants that pop up in local areas and they plan to create a group of restaurants throughout the Edmonton area. 

I'm really excited to see how the owners of Three Boars change the restaurant scene in Edmonton.

I really like this place for a bit of good homemade bar food, strong drinks, and friendly locals atmosphere. Once you are a regular, they'll make your drink as soon as you set foot inside. 

Frank's frequently hosts the top pool league teams in the area. Bring your A game because the regulars will crush you on the two coin op bar tables.

Friendly staff and really good food. I am not a huge sushi fan but i really enjoyed the sushi there. My friend is very picky and they were very patient with her and pretty much made her a custom noodle soup.
The only thing I find funny is the name if the restaurant. They could have been more creative..lol
Hands down the best Chinese food around. I always call in my order and when I get there it's always ready and hot. Staff is very friendly and smiling.  You can't go wrong with the place.

Tasty food and nice service :)
Their triple flavored hot pot is really good - loved the tomato soup!

I am a Chicago-native and grew up eating Portillo's. This review will be mostly for people in the area who are unsure of this new eatery and would like to know if it is infact "the real deal".

Value:
As far as bang for your buck goes here, you will have a difficult time finding anything like it nearby. The quality and care that goes into your experience here is apparent. It isn't "cheap" by any stretch of the imagination but it is DEFINITELY NOT over-priced.

Food:
This category is near and dear to my heart personally and as far as eating out goes, Portillo's constantly comes to mind as one of my all-time favorite joints to eat at, hands down. My personal favorite is the Italian Beef and Sausage Combo/Dipped with both sweet and hot peppers. When it comes to eating REAL Chicago cuisine, I'm certain you won't find anything like this place in the area. (Don't leave without trying a piece of their Famous Chocolate Cake)

Service/Concept:
Portillo's is a very successful fast-casual restaurant that offers it's customers the full Chicago eatery experience. They have no shortage of staff, no shortage of space, and certainly no shortage of phenomenal food, straight from the streets of Chicago.
It's a typical wing, beer joint where the waitresses wear tank tops and short shorts.

Went for lunch....such a limited lunch menu.  My wife went for the burger which seemed like it had been previously frozen.  It wasn't terrible, just a little rubbery.  If you ever ordered a burger from Omaha Steaks (which are shipped frozen) that is a fair comparison.  I ordered the lobster roll which was a disaster.  Chewy lobster soaked in mayo and served on a toasted hot dog roll.  It lacked flavor, seasoning and it was ill concieved. Fries were decent.  Nice view.

Easily one of the best meals I've ever had. We received a gift card for our anniversary and decided to try it out. Awesome atmosphere. They have an extensive wine and drink list if you enjoy a cocktail with your meal. We started with the calamari which was amazing. Crisp, not chewy at all and was served over lemon dressed arugula. My wife got the scallops. They came atop sweet corn risotto. My wife didn't offer me a bite so it was obvious she loved it! I had the strozzapreti which was fresh pasta, chicken, spinach, mushrooms and pine nuts and it was delectable! We finished off our meal with Italian donuts. This place was fantastic - we will DEFINITELY be back!!!!
Tasty food at LA prices. But the people watching will let you pretend you're on vacation as much as the pricing.

I have made two visits to Surrey's, once for breakfast and once for lunch, and I enjoyed both visits.  For breakfast I ordered the Heuvos Rancheros.  The dish had good flavor but a little too much mole; it overpowered the eggs.  My husband ordered the mango stuffed french toast...to die for! Fresh juice was great!  

When I went for lunch, I ordered the crab melt and I would definitely order it again.  I was pleasantly pleased with the significant amount of crab on the sandwich and it had a great sauce on top.  Service is friendly.  The host was very friendly to me and my husband but he seemed to be a little pushy with other customers and bit too concerned about turning over the tables.  My guess is that this attitude was fueled by the long line out the door...expect to find a line on the weekends.  Overall a great experience and I will definitely be returning.

I didn't realize The Tap was located right next to Mass Ave. Walked in on Sunday around lunchtime and nobody was here. It was about 20 degrees though so maybe the cold is keeping people away. Ordered a cranberry turkey club sandwich and fries ($10), which were great! The meal comes on a narrow plate for style so it's about impossible not to spill your food all over the place. 

The bartender was really nice and attentive. The server from afar was gorgeous. I tried not to stare at her from the bar like some kind of creeper...I don't think I was successful though. Sorry, pretty server.

Great selection of beers on tap (around 30 or so). I like this place, but I wish it were cheaper. My bill for lunch and two beers (Urban Chestnut @ $5.50 each) was $23, which is more than I would like to pay.

Amazing food, incredibly nice staff, and a great beer list. Love the Bollywood movies playing on the big screen.  Vegan dishes and super-convenient when downtown. Don't go here if you are in a hurry, but trust me it is worth the wait.

Much better than last time. Food was yum, hit and ready within ten minutes even though I ordered a lot. Inexpensive! The best deal is definitely to buy your meats by the pound.. Wish they would have packed some tortillas in there for me, though. Also, the lamb stew is as good as everyone says it is. Don't take my word for it, though- they offer free samples to back up their product.

YET another first time user...as a local small business owner..and a NATIVE Nevadan...these are the types of cookie cutter chains that make going out  to dinner a WASTE of time and money in Reno...FIRST, the waitress wasn't nice, rushed us through the process ((she knew it was our first time in), AND was talking about us to the other waitress?...SECOND, we attempted to navigate the ingredients, but there was almost none in each container?...and when we told the waitress, she said "would you like me to take your bowls and fill the entire area so you can go back...and NO she wasn't serious...her tone was VERY condescending...THIRD...the cook could barely speak English!, seemed very perturbed with us...and he is asking US questions?...so then we get the food...and FOURTH it is just OK at best salty? etc....and the lettuce wraps were  DIRTY?...seriously there was dirt still on the butter head lettuce?...and MIND you there was maybe 10-15 people in the WHOLE place? I have been in RENO for almost 50 years and would never recommend this to my enemies (if I have any), let alone someone I liked...and the management must SUCK there cause the help sure does...btw this WASN'T my first rodeo with a Mongolian style restaurant.

Grabbed a quick dinner here with a friend before seeing a movie. They have a lot of beers to choose from and I rather enjoyed the two I tried. I also enjoyed the burger I ordered. Really, the worst thing here was the service. We were one of maybe four tables at the time and our waiter was still MIA whenever we needed more to drink, checks, or anything else. He also didn't have a great grasp of the menu when we asked questions and then blamed it on corporate changing things all the time. So overall it was a fine meal, but staff that know what they're talking about and are around to talk about it would really help.
Very much love the Gyro combo plate. Tasty meat, excellent sauce and an all around great value

Our food was good but kitchen time was very slow. We tried calabacitas scramble, hamburger, and an eggs/sausage (cajun) plate. Cajun sausage was quite good with some kick. Eggs were fine along with potatoes and toast. Burger was good, as were refried beans. Other items were average.

The most notable thing about our 12:45 Sunday brunch was the cooking time, about 20 minutes. This seemed to be a factor of one cook doing all cooking with occasional waffle help from a server. 

I think the summary is: walk in, count the patrons, look into the kitchen. If two people are working the griddle or teaming up, or if there are fewer than 10-12 customers, sit down. If not, head elsewhere. There are plenty of good breakfasts in Tucson at similar or better prices and without long cooking delays.
I love the fruited challah bread, it's not offered everyday but I can call ahead and order it for the next morning. This place is my go to bagel spot if I'm buying bagels for a group. Nice place.

I was going home from work and had a sudden craving for Pho. After a quick map check, I found Pho Hoang to be closest so I decided to try it out since there's always crazy traffic heading to my usual Pho restaurant. 
  This place is easy to get to since it's near I-75 and the Selman Expessway (on 301).  It's tucked away in the back behind Navy Federal Credit Union but not difficult to find. It looks small from the outside but it actually very roomy. The restaurant is nicely decorated which provides a very comfortable ambiance. 
   I rolled in at about 3pm so service was quick, but I have a feeling it would be relatively quick even during busy hours. The servers were courteous and checked on me at the right moments. 
  I ordered a Pho dish (of course) and it was at my table impressively fast. I tasted the broth which was just perfectly hot and then....BOOM!! That's all she wrote!  It was incredible!!! The meats were tasty and perfectly cut and prepared. The sprouts, peppers, and mint leaves were so fresh you'd think they're growing their own. It was simply an amazing meal! I didn't look up from my meal, except to acknowledge my server a couple of times, until my bowl was empty. 
  I found my new favorite Pho restaurant and would strongly recommend Pho Huang to everyone, especially all Pho lovers.
Been here a handful of times and always good. Wish the bar area was larger but all in all a great place.

You had me at wine flights!

Just finishing up the security checkpoint and I see this wine place, had lots of time to kill so wanted to check it out and try some wine. They are known for their wine flights and they also sell retail wine for you to take with or drink there. BEWARE!!! What I found crazy tho... was that if you ordered a bottle and drank it there, they charge you $12 for them to uncork it. Whyyyy... 2 glasses basically equaled that bottle but for $12 service fee... UGH wish that wasn't so. But it was. Anyways... we still stayed a had a glass each and also ordered a cheese plate.

Had the Tempranillo which was good and I did like that they gave Tasting notes to make it feel like a real wine tasting. The cheese plate was also good, came with toast, nuts and a sort of jam. Service is great and I did like having this option instead of your usual fast food service that you find at the airport. The menu had lots of other great options for food too so definitely something to check out!

If I'm at this terminal again, I would most likely stop here for a flight or a glass while I wait for my flight!

Not particularly a coffee shop that stands out, but the vibe was very quiet and relaxing. It was a perfect study spot for me and my friend. 

Come for the coffee, stay for the kind barista who looked after my laptop charger for 2 days. :)
Fenwicks has great coffee from Bongo. The Monte Cristo is delicious. They have excellent, thick-cut bacon and the beignets are on point!

We had a few hours to kill in Reno waiting for our flight so found this place through Yelp.  We were completely impressed and will now make this part of our annual tradition.  The pizza was fantastic...thin with an awesome sauce that was the perfect amount of sweet.  The toppings were delicious and I'm guessing pretty high quality as opposed to buying on the cheap.  The place was casual and friendly.  The owner was great and after chatting for awhile it was obvious he's passionate about Pizza.  I also loved having a full bar in the place with very reasonably priced tab beer.  I wish this place was in San Diego.

Thought the mediocre reviews might be unwarranted because some said they really had a great experience but damnnnn the service really is SLlllooooooowwwww. Our main course legit took 55mins to come out- guess they started cooking it from raw when we ordered it. The happy hour dishes we got were NOT GOOD. We got the green bean fries, veggie burger and mussels. The mussels were ok but the other two were just not good!! The green bean fries tasted odd...... Like there was baking soda in them or something bitter and the veggie burger was actually just a black bean patty that was mushy and odd. 

The server came 3 times to tell us that the main entree would come out shortly..... 
We had finished w the happy hour items and the plates were just sitting in front of us for 30 mins while he did something else.

I was actually SHOCKED that there were people coming into the restaurant during the 1hr 10mins we were there. 

It was pretty empty on a Friday night by ritten house square- which should tell you a LOT. 

Would not recommend going.

While the Quarter has turned from ghost tours to ghost town, it is important to support our food purveyors during this time of crisis. Popped into Bevi's on Carrollton for 10lbs of crawfish. At $3.99 per lb I can't complain and when my wife and I started to dig into them with a "few" Ambers it did bring back a sense of normalcy at l least for a moment.

This is my favorite grocery store of all time.  It's like a better version of whole foods with an insanely good selection of wines (some pretty hard to find stuff) and cheese.  Be sure and get some pixie tangerines when they're in season.
The pizza is so good. The sauce and crust has so much flavor. Im never disappointed. They are also very clean. As I waited for my food I saw worker wiping down everything and outside door handles.

Everything was so covered in olive oil.  Both pasta dishes (I got the pesto with ricotta, my boyfriend the spinach & sundried tomatoes), the side of broccoli rabe, the garlic bread, even the house salad.  It's stomach turning.  Wait staff was good.  I don't think I'd go back though, to be honest.

Very disappointed lately. We thought we found our go to pizza place. But another disappointment. Another night pizza was not cooked all the way. In addition to Pizza we ordered cheese fries but when getting them out of the bag the lid was not on properly and they fell to the floor so I called and was told I would have to pay for another. I couldn't believe what I was being told. THEY DID NOT SECURE THE LID AND AM AT FAULT! NEVER AGAIN.. We where good customers ordering frequently and would not complain even when the rolls where not fresh, pizza burnt, or when the order was not correct. Good loyal customers are hard to find.  Well Fabio you just lost us and all over a few fries. And if you are reading this skip Fabio's and continue looking.

First time here tonight and was very happy. Even being pretty under the weather I really enjoyed myself. Since it was New Year's Eve there was a prefixed menu which was beyond amazing and was reasonably priced. Every dish they brought out was better than the last. The only reason I didn't give this restaurant a full five stars is because the dessert was a bit of a let down since the appetizer and the main dish was so great.

Mixed feelings about this place which is very disappointing as I just moved in a few blocks away and was hoping this would be my "regular" bar.  Poor customer service last night particularly at the bar, as we were denied any food from the bar menu because of the time we came in (9pm). I explained that I was interested in the bar menu because there were more vegetarian options and the bartender without compassion pointed out the whopping 3 items on other dinner menu that I could choose from (one had an egg in it, so really only 2 options for some vegs). Not vegetarian friendly at all.  I had checked the website in advance and it is not clear what time the bar menu is available. It's a shame because the drinks were good but I will not be back.

Unique wine/beer bar with a fun and relaxing atmosphere! The owners/staff are attentive and very friendly. The cheese, meat, and hummus platters paired well with the great wine and beer choices. The music was great, too! I will definitely go back! This is a welcome addition to downtown New Port Richey!

I have stayed at The Nugget probably 15 times over the years. Kids always enjoyed the indoor pool and everything and everyone so helpful and friendly. The last few times I have been there alot of money has been put into the property. You can put as much money as you would like into the property  but if you employ rude, unhelpful staff your wasting your money. I dont appreciate paying for people to be rude to me. So stop wasting your money on making the property nicer when you should be spending it on customer service classes for the employees. That will be my last visit.

We were so excited for this, but you definitely pay for the spectacle of eating on an old boat. Food prices were high for how small the portions were, let alone quality not amazing in taste. All in all, not worth it. If we're paying $50 a steak, I want to be full and satisfied. We were far from it.

The food is okay, but very franchise. I wish I'd gone to an authentic restaurant for fresh food at a much cheaper price. Bill for regular bowls and one sweet tea- $30. First and last time for us. If you like franchise food, you'll like this place.

I'll preface this review with the fact that I hyped myself up for months before finally checking this place out....
It was not as good as I envisioned it in my mind, but it is still a solid place to drink and eat. 
 
Pros:
The pizza was pretty good. Nothing special but the ingredients were really fresh and the toppings were the highlight of the pie. Cheese and bread take a back seat here allowing the fresh tomato, basil and meat toppings to really stand out in every bite. 
The beer here is made in house and they offer about 6 unique flavors. I had the Seasonal sunshine draft. Think of a Blue Moon with stronger hints of citrus and rosemary. Very easy to drink
The service here is good, the servers seem knowledgeable. 

Cons:
The ambiance here is laughable. The interior is sparse and kind of dirty looking. The outdoor seating is ok. But realize that this restaurant is in a area that is slowly undergoing gentrification. During my dinner a 300lb female "crackhead" with a Don King afro walked behind my table looking for cigarette butts. 
This place is also frequented by hipsters or goth people. Whatever they are known as.Think Mad Max and the ThunderDome. They are interesting to look at, but their clothes tend to look somewhat dirty so it kind of affected my appetite. 

Overall I rate Dock Street Brewery a solid 3 out of 5. Good Food and Good Beer. But lacking in some areas

My favorite of the many solid Greek restaurants in Tarpon.
Lunch special Gyro is huge.

Death By Swine and the Pickle Rick are my two favorites.
Lots of folks talk about their pizza, but I can't bring myself to pass up the delicious...and sizable...sandwiches!
Plus, Dan is a good guy and even held a fundraiser for our charity organization. 
Small shop, big sandwiches, HUGE following!!!

Sarita's Grill is a small, local gem on Freret. They serve chips & queso free with every meal and the queso is awesome. I ordered the pork taco & the fish taco. They were both hearty tacos and I was quite full after. My friend ordered the quesadilla and it is extremely large. Service was very fast at Sarita's Grill and it has a very casual vibe. I highly recommend Sarita's to anyone looking for a casual, delicious meal. The prices are also very reasonable. I will be returning soon to try our their happy hour!
This spot is amazing. The food is so fresh and you can really tell it's made with authenticity and love. It's a must try, once you do you'll be hooked.

Best pancakes in Nashville, hands down! We got the blueberry pancakes, sausage and cheese burrito and the avocado breakfast taco. The avocado scramble in the tacos + burritos was soooo good. This place is a hidden gem, but every single thing we ordered was amazing. Couldn't recommend more!!

Best. Subs. Ever. I'm originally from DE, so the best day of my life as a resident of Indy was the day Capriotti's opened. If you want an authentic east coast cheese steak, DO NOT GO ANYWHERE ELSE, OR I WILL HUNT YOU DOWN AND KICK YOU IN THE SHIN. The rest of the subs are also amazing, they don't make a bad anything. So happy they're here.

I'm from out of town and this is a really great intimate restaurant, I hadn't even planned to come here if not for the reviews. Everything is all really good and authentic. Service is great, I'm going to be here for a week and will definitely be coming back.

The atmosphere is wonderful. The hostess had so much flare and personality! Everything you would expect from a Peruvian cuisine. The food was packed with flavors ranging from spicy peppers to anise. I will definitely come back when I'm in the area!!

We are in St. Louis for the first time from Chicago. We bookmarked a few restaurants we wanted to visit. We decided to stop here and we were happy we did. We did come in around 3pm, we were seated right away. They were not too busy. The kids had the chicken fingers, my husband-Carolina Bison. I had the the chickpea veggie burger. Everything was great the food and the services. Justin our server was very helpful. Glad we made this our first pick. Oh yea the ice cream was tasty too!

We had such a bad experience here we left without even eating. The second we walked in the room was a thousand degrees. All the workers were sweating uncontrollably and the table, booths, and menus were excessively sticky. On top of that, we waited for at least 10 to fifteen minutes before we were greeted by a waiter and it was 15 minutes after that and we still didn't even have coffee. The table next to us sent back a glass of water because there were 'items' floating in it and on top of it all, a SPIDER ran across my menu. (Not a joke) After noticing not one of the surrounding tables had their food, we decided to leave. No thank you Denny's. The workers were nice and friendly but the atmosphere and cleanliness needs some serious TLC.
The pizza was really good. We got a cheese pizza slice so we could do the philly taco with the cheese steak from Jim's and the pizza sauce was good and sweet and combined greatly with the sandwich

It's ok got the pho ga. The  broth was kinda on the light side not very flavorful, I do like to add vegetables to mine and they did a great job with that lot of broccoli bokChoi carrots mushrooms. Over all not to bad I kill mine with hoisin sauce and Sriracha anyway. I also got the roast Sandwich was a little surprised the meat is cold but the bride was nice and toasty

I hate giving a bad review, but considering the cost of a meal here, I need to warn other unwary diners. First, Holdrens, PLEASE train your staff.   I think I am less upset because we had a gift certificate and actually laughed at how terrible the service was; food was average and probably better at Chilis.  There are a bunch of inexperienced college students running around.  It is not their fault. They need to be TRAINED! You can't expect to charge someone over $100 for a meal and have that kind of service.  My ribeye was fatty and not cooked as I had requested, I got the wrong side and sat without food while my boyfriend's food got cold. Our dirty appetizer plates sat at the table the whole time, our water was never refilled and we were never even asked if we wanted another glass of wine until after our to-go box was brought to us.  I mean just terrible!!!! Having said that, the Cabernet sauce on the filet was delicious, as was the grilled artichoke and asparagus.  The garlic mashed potatoes were so bland--I've had better on an airplane.  Again, Holden's, PLEASE train your staff!!!!!!

Passed through Nashville on the way home to Chattanooga & stopped by here on a whim. 
Here's my summary:
1. Sweet atmosphere/interior. Pastels, plants & cool upstairs seating.
2. Food=delicious. Extremely unique & tasteful. Wish I would have taken a picture ‍ I got the leavened waffle and it did not disappoint! The only thing wrong with it is that it was gone too soon. Highly recommend. I also got their orange juice which was $3 for a small glass but it literally tasted like I was biting into an orange (made in-house). My husband got the yogurt & granola & I honestly probably ate half of it  very nice portion size & extremely filling! Topped with peaches  
3. I didn't get coffee but my husband got a cappuccino. It was delicious! My husband knows way more about coffee than I do & he said to him it was 8 out of 10. We were very surprised to find out they didn't do pour overs. 
4. COVID protection was all in place & it was a very clean, friendly environment. 

All in all, we will definitely be coming back if we get the chance.  Very cute spot for a little brunch date or for several hours of study.

I came here with a group of friends and I must say the sushi is excellent. Living in Reno and experiencing many all-you-can-eat sushi places, Hinoki stands on its own. Service was very fast and plates were coming out left and right as my friends were staring in awe of the delicious sushi. The prices are comparable to other places, and you definitely get more than what you pay for. My only recommendation would be to add some artwork throughout the restaurant, as it seemed a little plain. However, service is good and the food is quality. You won't be disappointed.

Stopped in for lunch on the advice of a friend. Had a lunch special of beef lo mein. The hot and sour soup was very good, so I thought I was in a for treat. Agreeing with another reviewer, the lo mein sauce was a bit too sweet for my taste. The fried rice was over cooked and mushy. The egg roll had a metallic taste which was off. Overall, I won't be going back.

They are so extremely cheap and stingy when it comes to condiments. Not sure why, considering they make a fuck ton from college students day in and day out. I went in and ordered a meal with zuchinni fries and they gave me no side of ranch. I went up an asked for some and the woman literally told me i had to pay extra for A CUP OF RANCH. And sometimes when you order food for delivery they include dipping sauces and sometimes they dont??? The workers are very rude and hesitant when giving things like extra sauces as if it comes out of their paychecks or something....

Okay huge fanatic of Colombian food.... So because I`ve tried so many different styles and taste of Colombian food around the world, I`m a tad picky as you shall say. I gave this place 4 stars for a few reasons.
1. A tad confused on why they have 2 of the same place right next to each. 
2. My arroz con pollo was so-so, not my favorite. 
3. Empanadas were not as fresh as I would like them (luckily we have one of those small oven toasters at work)
Overall my experience was pretty good, I did take it to go because judging by the look of that place it was hard to get a lunch in. I will probably try something else when I go back like the protein platter is what I call it. I did like the fact that there somewhat of a bakery attached and their breakfast menu looked amazing. I am excited to go back and try it again, just this time around it was okay.

I ordered the pasta special of the evening--a twist on a traditional bolognese dish. 
*Venison Bolognese*

Ground venison. Very soft flavor, was not gamey in the slightest.  I could actually tell that it was venison, and I mean that in the best way possible.  Absolutely delicious.

Pair this tasty bolognese with a nice Italian red, and you've got yourself one of the most satisfying meals in Indy.

Delicious, just delicious.

Will definitely be back.

Watched the Eagle's game on a Sunday here with several friends. It was the perfect amount of crowded - enough people were there for it to feel lively, but you didn't have to shove past people to walk to the bathroom. I like the layout of this place - when you walk up the stairs to where the hostess is, there's a long stretch of a bar with tables to the left, with plenty of walking room space in between and to the right there's a section with larger tables and booth seats. 

I'm a budding sports fan and there were plenty of TV's so you could watch from any seat. Our waitress was REALLY fast and attentive and the food comes out REALLY, really hot. FYI. Drinks were medium-level strength and the food is good for bar food. We had chicken fingers, chicken wings and a burger with fries. 

I don't have anything 'wow' worthy to say about this place, but nothing about it was disappointing either! I did appreciate the fast service and attentiveness considering how many people were there.

Well, if you're going to eat here, don't order through Eat24. It CLEARLY states that the 1/4 burger includes bacon and cheese. When my burger did not, I obviously, asked why. "That's extra" he says. After several minutes of back and forth I finally decided it wasn't worth the hassle of the drive back (especially to pay for what was supposed to be included). I also ordered a fountain drink. He asked me if I'd prefer a bottle to which I responded "no, I'd prefer the fountain drink". He tells me he doesn't think they have any tops for the cups. All in all, the food is ok, but not worth the price and DEFINITELY if you're not even getting what you thought you paid for.
Best Philly Cheese steak around! In town visiting tried a few locations. The staff is super nice, the facility is very clean, and the food is delicious!!!

Good food, decent prices, and quick service! The place is a bit small, so finding a seat at lunch hour is probably difficult. We visited around 1-2 in the afternoon, so it was almost empty. They also offer take-out services, which is great! Definitely worth a shot; my pulled pork and ribs were delicious.
OMG amazing service amazing food and atmosphere! Had a great lunch and time! Our waiter Spring was lovely and attentive and the host Matt literally set it up to be an awesome experience

This place is awesome.  Tortillas handmade, enchiladas have a ton of flavor, and my favorite was the vegetable tamale.  The workers are extremely hospitable and nice, and recommended me the perfect meal.  Will definitely come back again!

if you want unhappy waiters who are not interested in service and overpriced food, this is your kind of place.

we came here because we wanted a bar with tvs to watch the election results tonight.

but...i mean, seriously, a server who can't describe their food?  and shakes their head passively when asked what they liked from the menu?  bad signs.  at least fake some enthusiasm.
  
oh wait, how about the $3.50 that they tried to charge us for bread (when we both ordered entrees)?

or wait, even better yet, on the menu, it said my  "crispy sea bass" was supposed to come on a bed of polenta...and instead it came with a curry sauce and rice and bok choy?  now, i may not be craig laban or some other food critic...but i do know the difference between rice and polenta.

yes, i should have complained.  instead, i was so angry, we paid the bill and left as fast as we could (so i could come home and yelp and save people from the disaster that this place is!).
Amazing. Awesome service, wonderful sandwiches and just a charming deli on the water. Highly recommend the Cuban and the chipotle chicken Gouda sandwich.

So glad I heard about this hidden gem! Stopped in on Saturday night with a friend. Line was pretty long but once we ate the tacos we understood why! For 3 $ 4 bucks you get nice size tacos which are so good and very authentic. Topped with a bunch of yummy toppings.
Great steaks and other foods sophisticated atmosphere very friendly staff we enjoyed our lunch and the prices are great

Seated at a booth in the bar following nice welcome by the host. Bartender (Tim) also greeted with a smile and was "first rate" throughout dinner. In addition to being friendly he knew the menu, preparations and, as a result, made good suggestions...much appreciated after driving 900 miles that day. 

My selection was simple (Alfredo with chicken) but it arrived quickly, looked good and was tasty. The restaurant was clean and the staff appeared to function well together. Overall a great choice for someone who had no idea where to go but relied on fellow Yelpers.

This is one of the better burger joints in Delaware county. There are a couple zacs locations all over delco but this is the original. If you are looking to eat in beware there are only 2 tables this location is more of a takeout joint. 
 As far as the food goes the burgers are always fresh juicy and cooked to perfection. The patties are on the smaller side so I would recommend a double. Shoe string fries are very good as well.
 Service is really good! Friendly staff that works quickly so you never have to worry about a long wait. I would definitely recommend this as a must try burger spot

I walked in on a Monday afternoon after running some errands. It was pretty much empty besides 1 other table there. I was greeted and sat by possibly the owner? I'm guessing. He was very nice and comforting. 

As I looked on the menu I saw they had a hot chicken sandwich so I definitely wanted to try that out. Thinking maybe it's really good and it can be my quick close to home hot chicken fix instead of driving all the to Nashville for Hattie b. It was $8.99 and comes with fries. 

Food came out pretty fast and was still hot on the plate. The fries were so so. I'm not much of fry guy anyway. But the sandwich was pretty dang good. I finished it all and it's not as good as Hattie's but definitely worth getting again.

It was kind of pricey maybe wish for that price I could of got an extra side like cole slaw or something, but I can tell why the menu is kind of pricey. Mainly because the lack of customers they get so they have to have the price up in order to make money. Which is reasonable, maybe the more people that come try this place out the better it'll be in return.

TLDR: But overall my experience there was good and the Hot Chicken Sandwich is a definite must try if you like spicy chicken!

We came here for my mother's birthday. We called ahead of time to make a reservation and asked if they do anything special for birthdays. Turns out they do! They actually decorated the table and had a special menu with my mother's name on it. For dessert, they brought my mom a plate with a piece of chocolate truffle and happy birthday written on it. For reservations of 5 or more, they require that you call to make your reservation instead of doing it online. Beware there is a $20 charge per person if you don't show up to your reservation. The interior of the restaurant was unique and definitely had the feelings of a upscale restaurant. Since we came during coolinary month, they had a special going on that offered an certain appetizer, entree, and dessert for the price of $39. There were 3 appetizers, entrées, and desserts to choose from. As appetizers for the table, we had the tempura fin wings and the barbecue shrimp. People in our party who did coolinary had either lobster bisque, tuna tacos, or the royal red shrimp as their appetizer. As entrees, we either had fried soft shell crab, wasabi crusted wahoo, or the mackerel. For the two individuals who didn't do Coolinary, they had the New Bedford sea scallops and chicken breast as their entree. The desserts that we had were pecan pie, carrot cake, and sorbet. Everything was amazing! I loved how certain dishes had a Southeastern Asian flare to it. We all really enjoyed the food. The seafood was super fresh. Soft shell crabs were a very good size. Food portions were solid. On top of all this, service was definitely one of the best I ever experienced. The waiter and the others who helped always made sure that we had everything that we needed. Waters were constantly refilled. Empty plates were always picked up in a timely manner. I cannot rave enough about this place. It definitely can get expensive but I would definitely recommend it for anyone who is celebrating a special occasion and are in search of fresh seafood in the downtown area!

P.S. If you are looking for Cajun/Creole food, this would not be the best option to go to.

Not a bar person, so I come here for the food. I'm giving 5 stars to the Mermaid Tavern for the amazing truffle fries and customer service. It's 4.5 stars for food and service, but .5 stars for the apparent ghost (ha). My friend and I sat at the bar for a couple of hours and weren't sure what to order. The bartender was very helpful and let us sample a couple of drinks before deciding on some beer. The stand out of the night were the truffle fries. We ended up ordering an order for each of us! I haven't been back to the Mermaid Tavern since last year, so I'm overdue for another visit. The Mermaid Tavern is like everyone's neighborhood bar, even if they don't live in Seminole Heights.

I cannot say enough good things about Bacio! Last Sunday, my boyfriend and I were calling around for an Italian restaurant that would seat us (it was about 8:25pm and most closed at 9:00pm). Thankfully Bacio is open until 10:00pm and when we arrived we were the only ones there and the owner had stayed open for us! The owner was so pleasant and hospitable. The food was incredible (he cooked for the two of us and everything was fantastic! After our meal he even brought us complimentary deserts! When we got our check we made sure to give him our compliments and thank him and he jokingly said "No problem, I am happy you came! Just know that this one-on-one service is harder to provide on a Saturday night at 7:00pm." We all laughed and thanked him again - We will definitely be back to Bacio (maybe on a Sunday night at 9:00 though).

Overall, this is a fantastic gem of a restaurant. Just know that it is small and remember to be patient if you go at a busy time :) it will be worth the wait!

The food is the best in Broad Ripple!!! I've never been disappointed when I eat here! The food and drinks specials are awesome! Half priced apps at certain hours wed-fri! 

Plus the night club downstairs is so much fun!!! Some of the best DJs in Indy! My friends and I always have a great time!

At first glance, great prices for lunch specials and common sushi. The rolls come stuffed with ingredients, but the quality of the fish was quite questionable. Super fatty, odd textured salmon rolls as well as super fishy yellowtail. The lunch special comes with a soup or salad though, and that's a deal you can't beat for 13 bucks or so! Favorite roll was either the spicy white tuna of the eel avocado. The salmon I probably wouldn't get again, just because the quality was odd.

Pizza tastes great. I've been going here since I was a teen. I've had my orders messed up numerous times though. Missing toppings or not well done. Heck 2 times I've had 2 pizzas undercooked which should of been well done. One time they rushed because I called at 7:30 not knowing they close at 8... why not just not take my order? They need to have better quality control and read the tickets better. A whole pepperoni pizza with half sausage should have pepperoni on the whole thing and sausage only in half not half of each.

This place is amazing!  My new favorite, hands down, and I've lived in SB for almost 30 years now.  The food is incredibly reasonably priced, and the quality is evident.  I have dined here once, and went back again recently for cocktails (they have their full liquor license now I gather), and will definitely be back many times in the future.  The menu is all local fresh ingredients, mostly bought at the local farmer's market (so I'm told), and has great variety.  I wanted to try everything!  The gnocchi with lamb ragu we had on our first visit was amazing, as was everything else we had. I love the honey and cheese appetizer thingy.  The cocktails were a-mazing as well.  My fave was the Arsenic and Old Lace (tangerine juice, lavender infused something, and vodka).  Yummy.  I also like the old movies playing on the framed TV's (their "wall art")!

We received excellent service both times (though to be fair on the first visit we were one of the only tables there, as it was apparently their first Monday open).

As for Di M.'s comment regarding battery-powered votives - say what you will, but these are an environmentally conscious option to which I've seen many restaurants switch recently, and they're not cheap (I've looked into them for a restaurant I worked for that was changing over to being green).
Great calzone! The sauce was perfect blend of spicy and sweet! I had the Beet It salad - super yummy mix light on the beets. If you love Calzone don't miss this spot ! Good prices too!

Ended up here on a whim after a trip to IKEA. Short wait (due to pandemic restrictions), but that's to be expected these days. Once seated the waitress was very attentive and the food came quickly. I got the eggs Benedict and my wife got a frittata. Both meals were delicious.
Extra points for the kids pancakes actually being kid sized, which is surprisingly rare.

Had an amazing night with my lady here! 

Service was amazing, dang near bordering on overboard and yet never going over the line. Whatever we needed, it seemed like there was always someone right there. The 3 person jazz band was great (very talented!). They gave us a very sweet moment, without making us feel like that we were being called out to the whole room. 

Food was very good! The escargot was prepared in a way I've never had. Might have actually made a fan out of lady! Overall, our entire meal was fantastic! Obviously a more expensive place to dine, but the food and service is great. I'd love return on my next visit!

This is my favorite sushi spot in the metro area hands down! The restaurant has a very cozy feel. I always get the sweet wasabi roll. The portions are very generous. They also serve you complimentary miso soup and salad with delicious ginger dressing. When you dine here make sure to try the OMG roll! It makes a very hot entrance ;).

Red curry with tofu + veggies - the curry was very flavorful and spicy.  Nice balance of cooked tofu and veggies.

Drunken Noodles - husband was not a fan at all.  I tried a bit and it was extremely bland.  We've had better versions of this at other Thai restaurants.  

Service was friendly and fast.

I used to really like this place but it has gone down hill. I've been to other Ruby Tuesday's and had great experiences but this location different. 

I ordered a white sangria which I've had at another location and thought it was great. So I get it and it tastes awful. So strong and no flavor, just tasted like hard liquor which isn't the purpose of a sangria. 

Salad bar is a mess and looks like it hasn't been touched in hours. 

I ordered a prime burger, my girlfriend ordered a regular burger and when they came out they were the same patties. And honestly I've had a better burger at Burger King. 

It's outrageously priced for low quality food and drinks.

The burgers and breakfast items are OK, but the fries and buffalo chicken is great. They have any sort of fries you could want, cheese fries, curly fries, buffalo fries, buffalo burrito fries, etc. Order ahead of time as service takes ages...

Michelle, our fav waitress was not working Saturday. Cara, hope I spelled it correctly, did a wonderful job of satisfying crowds of patrons! 
Brisket & Caddy burger were exceptional as always

The atmosphere in here is electric! The food is rustic and delicious.  Have the Cuban Sandwich if you aren't sure what to get. It's amazing!

I would also recommend their Eggs Benedict!

My favorite time to go is around brunch time in the spring when the upstairs windows are open and you can see the beautiful blooming trees.
The quality of the food and with the promptness of the service, I have to give Asian Spice 5 stars...hope this helps

Im not sure going to this place witch i searched under BUFFET is the place to go to when ur being served in a card board box really??????
Next u get a kid size drink????? What??? 
So u ordering 20 drinks before u get your Food not Good at all .....
Do they give Papper Cups as well????
My husband and I love this restaurant. Our favorite breakfast. Great awesome food and wonderful service.

We have  has been going to Mikimotos for 10 years now.  We think it's the best sushi in the area.  Honestly haven't had anything else on the menu.  No need because the sushi is so fresh and delicious.   My biggest complaint for years ....It's FREEZING!!!  Doesn't anyone, management or staff,  notice that everyone is eating with their coats on and blowing into their hands???   Tonight, no kidding, everyone had their coats on, the hostess was slumped over with her arms wrapped around herself and the woman next to me put her parka on and said "I'm freezing!" How can you enjoy a meal if you're too cold to eat??  It really shouldn't be that difficult  to set the temp at an average comfortable setting.  Is it? The frigid temperature inside may keep us away from some of the best sushi around.
Very bland food and lacked flavor in everything. It's a place you want to fill up the stomach and leave immediately.
I ordered the seafood salad and it was amazing. I tasted my friends potato soup n had a hard time giving it back to her. Will visit again soon!

I've been here several times during work lunches and they never disappoint! Outdoor dining is spacious and it's a very cute restaurant with great service! Wide arrange of food and everything was extremely delicious. Highly recommend visiting this place!

Went to Red Robin today , March 27,2011.  Absolutely terrible. We sat in the lounge area, because the restaurant was really busy.  We waited at least 10 minutes at a very dirty table waiting to be cleaned. Still NO SERVICE. So I walked to the bar area to get service , at least to wipe our table down , after I told the guy at the bar I sat down and waited another 5 minutes and no one came.  We watched other tables being served and staff walking by totally ignoring us. We now waited a total of 15 minutes at a dirty table, and having no one come to take our order.. I will NEVER go back ,,and I could care less about there greasy burgers.  I'll sooner go any where else where my business is appreciated. With un-friendly staff, and further more staff that could care less if your there or not. I will make sure that everyone I know, is aware of the way they treated us. Simply put
I'll never step foot in another  Red Robin EVER!!!
Absolutely fantastic food and great atmosphere. Some of the best service I've ever had.

Super fast and really cheap.  This is a family owned spot with connections to the eastside - and being a local teacher - almost all of the staff will stop in when we have long nights.  Never had a bad experience here - and they're always happy to see us.

Alex provided us with attentive and friendly service at the bar. We did the 4 Tapas for $29 and that was more than plenty to be shared between the two of us. All four Tapas were superb and served promptly. You could tell they were made with fresh, quality ingredients and with care. The location isn't convenient for me personally so I will not be a regular customer; however, for those who are nearby, I would recommend Skyline Kitchen & Vine.

Been going to Pi Pizzeria as long as they have opened the CWE location.  The pizza is simply amazing and delicious salads too.  The location is at 400 North Euclid Avenue in the Central West End - located right on the corner - across the street from Herbie's!

Been stuck on the sausace and pepperoni pizza, but they have all kinds of specialty pizza.  They are known for the corn meal crust and it is really delicious.  The crust makes any pizza "over the top!"

Had some wonderful servers over the years and the started sitting at the bar on Friday nights after a long week - different atmosphere and much more social at the bar too.  

I'm the only person in St. Louis that really doesn't like all of the specialty carft beers these days - I like my old reliable - nothing better than a 38 degree Bud Lite or Bud Select.  Guess I'm getting old.

If you have never been to Pi - you need to go today or tonight - probably some of the best pizza that you have ever swallowed!
Good pizza and fast.  Very friendly workers.  Nothing original or special.  If you've been to Mod pizza it's virtually identical.

Thanks to fellow yelper LydiaH for setting up this Philly UYE.  We stopped here after our museum visit for lunch.  The establishment was small but comfortable.  The menu is a focus of typical bar food and belgian fares to complement their extensive craft and belgian beer offerings.  They had the Russian River Damnation on tap which is one of my favorite pale ale.
I opted for the Dogfish Theobroma.  The beer is based on chemical analysis of pottery fragments found in a Honduran archeological dig thought to be one of the earliest known alcoholic chocolate drink.  The flavors were profound.  A wonderful herbaceous fragrance with a subtle sweetness and a strong chocolate finish.
The provencal mussels (moules) was good albeit not authentic.  The sauce was creamy and lightly sweet but I didn't taste any indication of a white wine reduction.  The meal came with a side of fries that was savory with their mayo based dip.
Overall, it was a pretty good spot to kick back and enjoy some really good beer and even better company.

You have to try this place for there biscuits and gravy! Oatmeal and pancakes. I'm talking mmmm mmm
Good.. this place can get crowded sometimes there can be a wait but it's worth it. They bring out a carafe of coffee and water. My friend had the egg skillet and it was delish also.. cheesy..eggs.. potatoes and veggies. How can a person go wrong!

We happened to be on this side of town for business. But really hungry didn't want to sit down and make a deal out of it I love churches Chicken. Let's do chicken oh yeah so we got a big box of thighs and legs and coleslaw. The lunch was perfect we had and just the right amount there really isn't any comparison from churches to KFC it's apples and oranges. Churches isn't full of grease and it's fried crispy. KFC is greasy but some people that's what they want. I live in OV so to find a Church's was very exciting. As I said in my tip the people are very friendly here they're happy to serve you the place look clean. And what more would you want I vote Yes

Terrific seafood restaurant. I have  Eaten here dozens of times and never been disappointed. The food is great, the staff is attentive, And the  Reasonable prices are more than fair. Casual  Clam  is definitely where the locals go to eat fresh seafood. Do not miss the New England clam chowder it is world class.

Square on Square has really cheap lunch specials..soup, rice, and veggies for under 10 bucks.  Their egg drop soup is delicious and the service is very quick. Portions are large too. Their mixes vegetables are great, as is the sweet and sour chicken.  It's conveniently located right near my office so it's a go-to Chinese food stop for me.  Nom Nom.

Oh my gosh, we haven't been here in a year. Stopped in tonight with friends.  Waitress and food was good as we remembered.  HOWEVER, the live music is unbearably LOUD.  You cannot even have a conversation at your own table.   We asked if they could turn it down. Even just a little.  Nope.  Won't be going back.  We will head over to Tres Amigos next time. The point of going out is to have a good time.  We couldn't wait to get our check and leave.

Just okay IMO, the sushi selection is very blah and the food is on the same level as a walk in Japanese restaurant. It could be so much better. Anyway try the soft shell crab sushi roll it's great and you can eat the crab shell.
It smells delicious as soon as you come in to the nice, bright restaurant and it's always been delicious food, pizzas burgers and donairs. It's all so good.

First time here and only second time eating Thai food. It was okay. Portions were very small but so was the price. Massaman curry was rather bland even though I ordered it hot. Soup was good. Service was very fast and friendly.

My mother and I took a quick trip to do some Christmas shopping in downtown Franklin last weekend. Upon recommendation, we decided to eat a quick lunch at Gray's on Main - we were thoroughly impressed! While we didn't get an entree, we did opt for two of the appetizers on the seasonal menu that had just been released. Though there are fewer options on the menu than anticipated, we were blown away by the bacon wrapped goat cheese-stuffed figs and the pimento cheese balls that were accompanied by a house-made moonshine reduction sauce. Delicious and so unique! The host mentioned they often have live music on the second floor and I have no doubt it's a fun place to hang in the evening! Highly recommend and can't wait to come back!

having lived the last 10 years in California I can say that this place had good sushi.  It's best just to tell the sushi roll makers what ingredients you like and let them do their thing.  The food its a bit over priced for NOLA but its a tourist trap and lots of college aged/young professionals are there nightly.  The alcohol is very overpriced so don't go there to hang at the bar all night.

Had the poorest service experience I can remember this afternoon. I came in alone with a reservation, and the restaurant was about 3/4 full. My waiter was polite, but the last thing he said to me between 1:00 and 1:35pm was, "I'll give you a minute to look at the menu."  Yes, he disappeared (not just from my table--from the whole dining room!) for 35 MINUTES, so long that I flagged down another server and just gave my order to her. When my server returned, he apologized for getting caught up with the large party at a nearby table, though he had not been helping them either.

I half expected I might get something comped given that when I asked for the check, I had been there for over an hour for an order of a fried chicken sandwich (which was the sole reason for the three star review), but no, I paid even for my cup of coffee.

I have been to the Gaslight 3 times now, and I will come back again one more time, but the lack of attention on the part of the waitstaff galls me.
great food and great service! We tried the wings, meatballs and got half of a philly pizza and half sausage and peppers ... Everything was great!

Highly recommend! Went here for my best friend's birthday dinner, and it was excellent! The food, drinks, and service were all great. I love Indian food, so I've been meaning to try it out--I'm so glad we finally made it! We ordered a few cocktails, naan, samosas, paneer makhani, and saag paneer, and all were so good. I was pleasantly surprised by the reasonable price point, too.

Best wings in the area without a doubt, especially the garlic Parmesan 
Bar area quite lively good selection of beers
If you want a bit more peace and quiet go upstairs or to the right bar

I went there for a Sunday brunch.  The place was not overly crowded, but they were understaffed and the service was extremely slow. I ordered a mimosa and a classic Eggs Benedict. The Mimosa was slow to arrive and even though I was nursing it, it was gone long before the Eggs Benedict arrived. The key to a good Eggs Benedict is the hollandaise sauce and there was so little sauce on it that I can't even form an opinion. Basically it was poached eggs on a slice of ham and an English muffin. The eggs, ham, and english toast were fine...  To top it off, the drink menu did not list prices, but they were making a big deal out of the fact it was "Happy Hour," so while I should have asked ahead of time the $8.50 price on a tiny mimosa was a shock.

What made it frustrating was that I always had to work to get someone's attention after long waits. Even after I paid with my credit card, there was a long wait to get my card and bill back and then they didn't even bring a pen. I feel bad because obviously they are under staffed, but as a patron is was not a good experience.

Because I eat here way too often, I couldnt forgive myself for giving this place 3 stars so I had to up it.  The craving gets real which already shows that I enjoy this place more than I thought I would. :)

It's an absolutely amazing dining experience!  I'm not saying anything further to jeopardize losing all future confirmation times.

No really!  It's very rare you experience a no-menu environment and simply waiting for food to arrive.  

The restaurant leaves a very positive lasting impression!

(We occasionally visit Florida throughout the year and have been here twice.)
Had the chicken pad Thai and it was amazing! Everything was so fresh and the wait time wasn't long at all. Definitely going to try more of their hot dishes and the poke bowls too!

Ordered the flatbread Chicken,Sandwich and Ham which I guess then ran out of it but instead of letting me know they just gave me a sandwich. Doesn't it make more sense to just tell me they didn't have it and to order something? So lame not a fan of Panera

Pretty good, we found this place on Groupon and got a great deal. I love Brazilian BBQ and was craving a place that was cheaper than Fogo de Chao! I believe that the dinner for two Groupon was taken down but I would still go back. They came around with different chickens, sausages, cuts of steak, and a fish selection as well. The salad bar area was very neat and clean and included hot sides as well as cold. Service was great, its located in a really cute area, but just make sure you bring your appetite!!!

I made reservations for my whole family here for Mother's Day brunch. My family was visiting from Hawaii and my sister said that this was her favorite spot they we ate at all weekend! She said that the flavor here is just something they don't have back in Hawaii- and I agree! The atmosphere was so light, airy, and hip! The kinda place where you'd really be remiss if you didn't snap a pic every time you came in! 
We started off with the fried pickles, fried green tomatoes, and lavender lemonades! My first time EVER trying fried pickles and green tomatoes, and it was so yummy!! The texture was crispy but the inside was still juicy and a little bit vinegary. Hit all the notes! My only wish is that I should've asked if they could have added alcohol to my lavender lemonade! 
I got the Sho Mercy, which is their waffle griddles, honey- dusted fried chicken, apple cider bacon, and spiced pecans. Let me tell you about their apple cider bacon- it is sooo crispy and delicious. If you order a dish that doesn't have bacon on it- do yourself a favor and order a side of it! 
My dad is on a keto diet and got the honey-dusted chicken with a side of their peach coleslaw. My dish also had the honey-dusted fried chicken, so I can attest personally on how delicious their chicken is myself! 
My mom got the Cast Iron Pork which is slow-cooked pork shoulder in duck fat, seared in a cast iron wok & glazed with sriracha honey. I had a few bites of this and it was very tender! I probably wouldn't order this myself, but still very good if you're in a pork chop kinda mood! 
My sister had the sweet and spicy fried chicken which had a lot of great flavor! I had some of the leftovers a few days later, and it is was still good then! Between the honey-dusted and the sweet and spicy- I'd go with the honey-dusted but that's on preference. 
The kiddos in our family got the French Toast, which was a mother's day special and the country fried chicken and waffles (added bacon after trying a bite of my bacon). 

All in all, this is a great trendy brunch spot. Come here, get some good food, drinks, and pictures!

If I could give it no stars I would it took an hour for us to get seated and 15 more to get our menus. The only acceptable part was our waitress who was very nice. The table was cramped on account of them scooting another seat in after they realized they miscounted our seating. They sushi was ok but you could get better at the Harrahs buffet (no joke it wasn't that special for the price).
Great new place on Oak. Boudin balls and oyster toast was great. And the fries were very uniquely seasoned (in a good way!). Will definitely be back.

Amazing food and a great Reno eats gem!

Always wanting to try somewhere new, the family and I decided to dine in at Fat Cat Bar & Grill on a nice Friday night while in town. We arrived mid evening to a mostly quiet restaurant, so we pretty had pickings of where we wanted to sit. Since the outdoor dinning was completely open in the back patio area, we decided to sit out there and enjoy the night. After looking over the menu and talking to the waitress I realized Fat Cat is a very, "Farm to Fork" style restaurant like it is where I'm from in Sacramento. Hand crafted burgers, 100% organic, grass-fed beef from a local ranch, turkey and beyond meat patties, fresh greens for burgers on request, gluten free buns, local beer options. This is what you can expect from their overall menu which I like.

My girlfriend and I ordered drinks for ourselves, her the Frisky Kitty and I got an American Mule. And we all shared the Mac & Cheese which was delicious. It's their version of the classic with Parmesan and white aged cheddar, topped with Parmesan and panko bread crumbs. So it was both gooey from the warm fresh cheese, and crunch when eaten with the top layer of panko bread crumbs. My youngest loved it so much he ate most of it. For our actual meals the boys each got the kids cheese burger and kids chicken tenders meals which were well sized portions. And I had the Cowboy burger which comes with sweet-smoky hickory BBQ sauce, bacon, a jumbo onion ring and melted cheddar. It's definitely one of your "knife" burgers as you'd have to unhinge your jaw to eat it without cutting it in half first, lol.

Overall we had a wonderful night here, the back patio was really nice as the sun went down and the lighting came one. The service was awesome and the food for great...I'd definitely come back here when in town.

Went twice shortly after their opening and near Christmas time. Great experience the first time, fine experience the second time. Excellent, attentive service both times. I'd go again. Highly recommend the burrito azadas. They'll bring you more salsa if you ask, but I wished they would have just brought us a big bowl of it from the start, rather than very small individual bowls. We had to ask for more multiple times.

This was my first time and the food was really good! I can't wait to come back. Their breakfast menu is for champions and you can't really go wrong when ordering. Hands down one of the best pancake spots I've been to. I gave it a 4 star rating because the grits could have been a lot better and my hash browns were a bit cold... but other than that it was a pretty solid experience. I wish there were locations closer to north jersey

This pizza is amazing! Our kids loved it too! We had the lasagna pizza followed by the most amazing pistachio & chocolate chip cannoli and can't forget salted caramel gelato. All so good! I can't wait to take another road trip in this direction, because we will always stop here!

Haveli had been open 3 weeks when my wife and I decided to give it a try. The decor is bright and clean.  The staff was extremely warm, friendly, and very helpful, but it's the food you really want to know about.

The food is some of the best you'll find in Reno-Sparks.  We are used to fairly small dishes in most Indian restaurants, so we ordered the Rashmi kabob, Malai Kofta, chicken biryani, the variety bread basket, and Gobi Manchurian for an appetizer.  This was a mistake.  The portions are huge and the food was amazing.  We stuffed ourselves and still had plenty to take home. 

The food has layers of flavor, arrived quickly, and was perfectly spiced.  The kabob was juicy while cooked thoroughly. The Kofta were light and fluffy swimming in a creamy tomato sauce thickened with cashews. The Gobi Manchurian is cauliflower very lightly breaded and fried then accompanied with green peppers, onions, and tomatoes. Phenomenal. 

Others have mentioned the little call button device. At first I thought this was an interesting gimmick, but it allowed us to enjoy our meal without unnecessary interruption. This is a very clever addition to the table.
