Truly fabulous small plates, great service, fun bar (there is one in the front and a quieter one in the back). Highly recommend their sushi and sashimi. Great, funky spot for a drink or a meal. Great live music even on week nights, check it out.

The host initially said there was a wait for outdoor seating and we were directed to sit in the corner where the staff rolls napkins and wipes menus. We were then advised that a table outside had opened up and it would be another 5-15 minutes while they cleared it. (?) After we were seated outside on the pretty cool patio, a busser dropped chips and salsa and the owner delivered water. There seemed to be several servers on the patio but none ever came to take a drink or food order or even say hello. We waited and drank the water, but remained unserved. The chips were fine and the salsa was standard. Service was nonexistent and we cut our losses. We walked across the street to Pueblo Solis and were served wonderful food quickly and professionally.

Go early.  We went at 7:30 and did not have to wait at all.  Every time that we walked past later in the day, the line was ridiculous.  That being said, his place is worth the wait you may have.

The milk punch was really good: think less creamy, boozy eggnog.  The Bananas Foster Pain Perdu was why I went, and I was not disappointed.  It was delicious and a lot.  By the end of the last slice, it started to feel like Man vs. Food.  This was the only breakfast I had in New Orleans, and really the only one you need.
I can't say enough about the innovation of the new menu!!  Tacos.... "Braised Beef" enough said!!
Great year for apple buzz!  Service is always goods food is always consistent. A local favorite.

I love this place, I came here by accident and I ended up getting the best vanilla ice cream in this area, the lady was so generous she gave me a free pizza, and oh my God their pizza is so delicious ... I recommend this place to anyone that I try to get a good ice cream and get pizza definitely will be back
Had Pho with flank and soft tendon.  Broth was quite bland.  Price is right.
I tried the Italian sandwich and it was delicious. It reminded me of the original sandwich at Schlotzsky's Deli, minus a drive to Ohio. I'll go back for sure!
The breakfast is delicious. Their chocolate chip pancakes are the best in town. Everything is made so fresh, and is cooked perfectly. The pricing it very reasonable, and is a very nice enviornment.

Came here with my family on a trip from SoCal.  Between the 7 of us we ordered enough food for an army.  The gumbo was DELISH!  My kids LOVED the Mac n' cheese. The jambalaya and roast beef Po boy were just okay and the pork chop was no Bueno.  However,  the fried catfish and shrimp Po boys were so good we went there twice in 4 days! If you like Po boys this is your spot!! When I come back to NOLA this place will definitely be on my list! If the porkchop had not been so bad I would have given it 5 stars.
Best bakery in the St. Louis area. Their cheesehorns and pecan pies are amazing!

It's a shame a big company like Bob Evans can't afford to have competent management at this restaurant.. 

Came in on a Sunday morning restaurant was 70% filled. Sat at the counter and had to ask (after 10 minutes) to get the counter cleaned of the previous patron's dishes. Counter was finally wiped off.  Another 5 minutes passed before I had to flag down a waitress to ask for some coffee.. it was brought to me, but I had to ask for a spoon and cream.  Another eight minutes passed while I passively waited for a server to stop by and take my order (the wait was in vein!), I ecentually asked for a server to take my order. 20 minutes  now passed, since I sat down. Food arrived after an additional. 10 minute wait. I then had to ask the lady that put my food in front of me, if it would be possibe to get a coffee pot refill, silverware, some more cream and a napkin. Finally got to eat. Food quality was average at best.

Overall, it was a terrible experience.

This place was recommended by a friend as a bar with better than would be expected food. I will give it that, though the bar is not impressive. No cocktail menu, few spirit offerings for mixed drinks. The draught would probably be the way to go, but we were not in the mood for beer. 
Food was delicious. I ordered a French onion soup and the trout lunch special. My fish was cooked beautifully and served with a large helping of veggies. The soup was piping hot and delicious. Served with tiny breads which were just lovely for soaking and eating from the soup bowl. My spouse got the whole channel catfish special, fries, and a small Greek salad. I enjoyed their dressing. The catfish was delicious, but I never find that navigating fish bones is worth it. 
We sat at the bar. It definitely appears to be a neighborhood favorite and most tables were filled with people for Saturday lunch. While bar staff was nice, she was erratic and pulled in too many directions. She did not write down our order and had to come back to clarify it. We were not the only bar seaters she had to do this for. (Not writing down orders is a personal pet peeve of mine however.) The manhattans we ordered were mediocre and we had to ask for water with our meal. She was stressed: managing the phone, to go orders, and duties of servers working the dining room. Not really the vibe I prefer when eating and drinking at the bar top. 
We will likely try this place again as we were curious about several other items on the food menu. We will sit in the dining room if it is busy and we will order beer.

Meat is very tender and juicy and the sauce is great, one of those secret family recipe deals. It's a small place and can be cramped with only a few people in there but it's worth it! If you love BBQ than you need to try this place out!

I absolutely love this cafe. It's bright, airy, clean, trendy and has an insane amount of games in good condition. They make great espresso drinks, lattes (coffee and tea) and teas. They have a selection of pastries and desserts. The staff here are always friendly and polite. Best of all they have beer and wine! I usually stop by here for a hot drink and to people watch in the sunny windows. I have yet to play one if their games but the game selection is STACKED. During the weekdays it's nice and quiet and there's plenty of space.

I had never been to a Brazilian Steak House before, but this was just as I would have expected one to be. Nothing was too impressive, and nothing was a miss. The salad bar was nothing special, had a little bit of everything; but we were smart enough not to fill up. 

Men walk around with meat on a stick, and if your chip it facing up with a 'yes'- they will come over and introduce what they have before putting some on your plate. with most cuts of meat, you are able to choose how you want it (well, well done, raw, medium, etc). We were impressed with the quality of meats considering they are in the open are and served from table to table. 

Our one mistake was taking seconds of some cuts of meat because even tasting others! We were there for over an hour, and as we were walking out; they were coming around with meat we have not even had a chance to taste yet. Amature move on our part!

I would like to go back, maybe with a bigger group, or during the week. The cost was $45 for Saturday night all you can eat; and I feel I could get a much better 'meal' some where else for half the cost; but you can't beat the quantity and variety offered at Na Brasa.

We returned to Jasmine on a cold rainy Thursday night. We were greated and seated imeadiatley.

Service was friendly, personable, and attentive; excellent!

Hot tea, cabbage, and noodles with duck sauce were delivered promptly. New dinner ware and plating! Nice!

Everything was delicious! We shared fantailed shrimp appetizer. Both of us ordered wonton soup and a combo dinner. The rice was so fresh! Presentation and portions  were excellent. We really enjoyed our dinners.

The dining area could use a refresh.

Will be back!

Went in to get a smoothie at around 3:30 on Saturday. Person working there didn't acknowledge us while making a smoothie. 3 minutes went by, still nothing, my friend then goes to the bathroom, comes back 3 minutes later, and still nothing. She's instead chatting with what appears to be an off duty employee. Very obvious she sees us. So, we leave, without so much as a word from her as we walk out. Never had such horrendous service from one employee. Obviously not representative of the Jamba Juice, but still incredulous at what happened.

Been to Finney's Crafthouse two times so far. The first visit I ordered the carne asada crispy tacos, coconut shrimp and the raspberry smash. The coconut shrimp were delicious and the raspberry smash was a refreshing drink. Sugar rimmed to balance out the raspberry. However the tacos were soggy and not crispy. Second visit, I ordered the New York style pastrami sandwich $12 and I loved it! The sauce and pastrami went together perfectly and overall the sandwich was mouth watering! If the review was solely based on the food I would give it 5 stars however I'm giving it four stars for the service. Waitress named Rylee took our order and disappeared. She refilled drinks for the tables surrounding us but never came to check up on us or ask if we needed anything. We had to track her down to ask for the bill and even then she had attitude. Wish the waitress could've had better customer service it would've made the experience more enjoyable.

Having been to Sezmu a few times in the past I was excited to make it my birthday destination. 

However, this time was different. I called earlier in the day to make reservations and asked what their corking fee was because I wanted to bring a special bottle of wine that they did not carry. The woman on the phone said that it would be a $20 flat fee. Fine.

I do have to say that the food was excellent. 

But...then the bill came. Instead of charging the fee they had advertised on the phone they charged us $25 per bottle. They also charged us more for a desert than what it was advertised for on the menu. We discussed this with the waitress and she said she was new and got another waitress that has been there for awhile. She told us we were wrong and then she changed her story saying that we had been loyal customers for awhile and that it why what the corkage fee used to be so they would change it to $20 per bottle.

Come to find out earlier in the day we had talked to the chef's wife. Therefore, that evening we called the chef and told him the story. At first he was defensive and pompous but he said he would check into the matter. The following day he called and apologized and said that they had been having trouble finding a good waitress and were planning on firing her. I don't know if they did, because I will never go back. I felt insulted and cheated.

The steak at La Trattoria is arguably better than at the fancy steakhouses downtown!! This is a family owned restaurant with fantastic service and AMAZING food!! Right in the middle of beautiful downtown Greenwood, you are sure to feel right at home and to relax as if you are on vacation. My family often comes here for special occasions and anytime we are craving wonderful steak and pasta! Also, my boyfriend will never stop raving about how great the salad is!

There we are, debating where we should eat on Speedway because there are so many good choices centrally located, and it dawns on me that my wife has mentioned more than once she would like to try this place.  In fact, it only dawned on me because she was doing it again at that very moment.

I was leery, because the name itself sounded dubious at best.  But alas, we enter on Saturday night and my skepticism quickly turned into deep admiration.  Something magical happens at May's - this is truly a unique experience.  Very rarely does anybody pull off this kind of audacity and succeed remarkably.  Lemme explain.

The atmosphere is quite welcoming for all types.  Love the TVs, love the hard wood, the chalkboards, everything.  Anybody could feel comfortable there.  The service is quite attentive, maybe to my surprise due to their youthfulness, and they genuinely recommend and consult.

Let's just say that everything we had was great, the Burger on the Pretzel Bun, the namesake Chicken and Waffles, the Totchos - generous portions, freshly prepared, and great flavors.  Furthermore, the prices are amazingly fair in every way.

PLEASE LOOK AT THEIR MENU.  Right now - open a new tab and cross reference.  This is the unique aspect.  Pabst in a paper bag?  Kool Aid packets?  Braised Bologna?  Cheese Jar?  Shrimp and Grits?  HOW can you pull this off???  With spectacular gusto and bravery.  I think of a Willy Wonka recipe of 1 part ghetto, 3 parts angel's harps and 2 parts nuts.

Yet it combines to a really great flavor, and I have to say, there is nothing else out there like this place.  I dig it so much.  Please check them out, bring the family, bring your drunk uncle, bring the starving student - whoever, just go enjoy.

The main reason for the 4-star rating is the service.  We were greeted enthusiastically by everyone we encountered on our way in, and between the hostess and the lady that served us, absolutely nothing was lacking in the customer service area!  I would give them 5 stars on customer service alone.  Friendly, checked on us often, great appearance!  Made us all feel like we were regulars even though they knew this was our 1st visit.

The space is nice inside, and we were able to sit on the patio.  There was plenty of room on the patio, and it did not feel overcrowded like some outdoor spaces can.

For appetizers, we tried the BBQ bacon-wrapped shrimp poppers ($8) and the Pizza Dough for Dipping ($4), and both were really good.  Our server said the shrimp was her favorite, and we could see why.  It came with 8 pcs, and while you could choose other sauces, the BBQ sauce was very good, and I would get that again but more so if the price came down $1 or $2.  The Pizza Dough is basically pizza slices with no toppings - just dough - and comes with marinara and vinaigrette.  This was good to get an idea of the taste of their unadorned dough, but I probably wouldn't get it again, only because it's too much bread for one sitting considering the size of the pizzas.  This app came with about 6 slices.

OK, so then the pizzas arrived.  They are pretty good sized; they use medium-sized boxes for to-go orders if that gives you an idea.  After a 1/4 share of the appetizers, I was able to get through only 3 slices, leaving plenty for another meal later.  I did the Make-Your-Own with garlic sauce, mozz cheese, chicken, mushrooms, and artichoke hearts ($9 basic + $2 chicken + $1 ea for veg = $13).  Some sauce choices were tomato, garlic, and BBQ.  Cheese choices were mozz and bleu.  They also had standard pizzas, which my friends ordered.  One had the Canadian bacon and pineapple "PiPi" on BBQ sauce, another had the jalapeno and chorizo-laden "Gringo Starr," and I can't remember our 4th.  All pizzas were quite tasty - a very light and crispy dough, fresh toppings.

And while I didn't have a beer, I'm very interested in their draughts from local breweries and look forward to coming back to try those - although a $6 price for draughts might limit me to only one.  On this visit, I had Iced Tea ($2.25).

So my only complaint...The menu is small.  I'd like to see a little more variety here.  I'm not sure if this menu we saw at lunch is the same as the one for dinner, but I think it is.  There was maybe a single steak and single seafood offering, a few appetizers that might double as entrees, and maybe 6 signature pizzas, and a couple salads (the small Signature looks good for $5).  The signature pizza choices seemed ok, but none of them struck a cord with me in particular.  I'd like to see more variety in the pizza choices, too - maybe some unique takes on some classics.

They did have a bacon cheeseburger special, which has ketchup, mustard, and lettuce on it.  It sounded ok until the ketchup and mustard.  But I'm sure they'll have other specials in store.

We also checked in via Foursquare and Yelp and viewed the Facebook site.  It would be nice to see some specials or coupons or something, utilizing the internet/electronic media.

No outdoor dining was offered. We dined inside and was impressed by large distance between tables. I was also impressed that hostess kept guests outside until seated. Tried the Filete Culichi  (creamy green sauce).  It was really outstanding, the menu did not say it was sea bass, but the waitress let us know after we inquired. I think that would be a selling point for most.  Margarita was great too. This has been my favorite meal thus far in Tucson.

Update:  So I thought I would get myself a pressure cooker to start cooking healthy on my own since I got a stealing deal on it.  Well tonight I went to the Hiddenp Grill and decided to pick up the Beet, Parsnip and Ginger soup.  Never mind about opening the box to the pressure cooker!  Damn that soup was F'ing good!!!  That is the best
darn soup I've had in town, let alone it being vegetable.  I thought the salads were good but geez soup was amazing!!!!

Viet cuisine proliferates the land.  Provincials as we are, coming to larger urban areas always offers up splendid Viet diversity.  That's right, kiddos - it's not all about Pho and Bahn Mis! 

Saigon Deli wins in that it provides a down-home "greasy spoon" feel with a more-than-adequate deli case with the hard-to-get good stuff!  Looking for banana-leaf wrapped sweet/sticky rice?  Check.  Pickled chicken's feet? Oh yeah.  Take a walk "on the wild side" and forgo your standard Pho / Bahn Mi / Bo Kho / Bun Bo Hue orders and explore the other stuff.  Grilled pork chop / rice dish for breakfast is where it's at - topped with a fried egg and what could be better?

Tallahassee has a solid Viet-to-Gen. Pop. ratio, so I'm not at all slighting my home town.  Once we get the demand for this next level stuff, we'll be here too.

Rejoice, good citizens of Tampa and environs.  Looks like you're pretty set in the Viet category.

Worst of the Worst. This place is the biggest waste of money. Service was horrible and the $44 filet oscar was over cooked. Got there 1 hour sooner than our reservation and was told that we had to exactly wait until for our reservation time.1/4 of the restaurant was empty due to the snow, sleet and rain. Still had to wait for our reservation. 45 minutes later my wife complained because walk ins were getting seated before us. Thats when the hostess said we could sit at the lounge tables.  We told her, we already waited 45 mins and had 15 mins to go before we can be seated. Why didnt she mention this when we first walked in. Food was not worth $160.  Other alternatives, Library, Outback, Mortons. Stay away from this place unless you like terrible service and well done steak.  One plus was that our vehicle came up pretty quick from valet. Thats the only upside.

This place was very good. We got the carnitas "tacos autenticos" and the meat was tender and it was generous portions. The prices were very reasonable. They also had a free salsa bar. (We went on a Saturday for lunch) We will definitely be back!

First of all, I wanted to sit outside, but the tables and chairs were all chained and locked together. I assume they forgot to set them up in the morning, but I went there a second time, and saw that they were all locked together that time too. I guess they don't really want people sitting outside! 

I ordered an iced soy latte the first time I was there. It was huge, but it didn't taste very good. And it was kind of weird how fast they made it- I ordered it, and it was ready before I even put my debit card back in my wallet. I'm pretty sure pulling espresso shots takes a little longer than that! Maybe they had the shots pre-made or something. Gross.

The second time I went there, I didn't order anything, but my friend got a coffee and she said it was good.

Tampa Joe's has catered several of our office events and each time, their food has been a big hit! 

The lasagna has a waterfall of cheese and is very meaty! The shrimp scampi is moist and delicious with the right amount of shrimp. My coworker really enjoys the spaghetti and meatballs. She couldn't stop raving about it! And, the Bow Tie pasta with chicken is pretty tasty as well. The cookies are sooo yummy, too. I've had Snickerdoodle, chocolate chip, and my favorite oatmeal and raisin! Mmmmm... man, this review is making me hungry!

After hearing so many people RAVE about this place, I thought it was just okay. Definitely had better cheesesteaks elsewhere, but I'm also from Philly so I may be a little picky about how my cheesesteaks are made. The onions made the bread super mushy, which is what ruined it for me. Plus, I wasn't a big fan of the atmosphere. It was kind of anxiety inducing what with everyone packed in so tightly and no where to really stand without being in the way. They also didn't have fries, which was kind of a bummer as I always enjoy my cheesesteak with a side of fries.

Came here last night in a group of 5 after Fourth of July fireworks to get something quick to eat. Our visit only lasted about 10 minutes and that was only because our waitress took that long to attempt to take our order after talking at the hostess stand directly in front of us. The first person in our group said she didn't want anything but was just sitting with us while we ate and the waitress immediately said she couldn't sit here unless she ordered something. WHAT? Were we supposed to tell her to stand outside while we all ate?? Rather than making $40-50 on the rest of us that were eating, they made $0 because of this "policy." The back of the menu does state in fine print that there is a $5 minimum per person but that doesn't make it right. I've never heard of anything like this but it seems like horrible business logic and extremely rude to your customers to kick them out while the rest of their friends eat because they have to pay $5 to sit in a chair. Also, it was after 10PM and the restaurant was 2/3 empty so it's not like she was taking up any needed space. We'll never return and I'll make sure I let everyone know they have literally pay just to sit down here. Gross.

This is as good as it gets.  This is the Best McDonalds in St. Louis.  I've lived here for 20+ years and visited them all over the city and surrounding municipalities. Clean, Fast, and they do not skimp on product when you're ordering ice cream. I don't think they've ever messed up my order. Really nice people who seem to enjoy working together.
Fancy restaurant makes pizza with too much cheese! Two stars.

We had high hopes but left disappointed. We started with two empanadas. Definitely not cooked to order. Mine was warm outside but cool in the center. We also had a morcilla (blood sausage) and it was bland. My girlfriend had a churrasco and it looked nothing like the one pictured on their front window. The one on the window looked like it was chargrilled. The one she received looked like it was cooked in a George Foreman grill. It barely had any grill marks. It just didn't look appetizing. The chimichurri sauce was bland too. Definitely, not as good as our previous visits.

Tin Roof became a go-to lunch spot for the BEST CHICKEN TENDERS IN ALL OF NASHVILLE. No foolies. The accompanying crinkle fries are just divine.

The service is pretty good overall, although there is a completely incompetent and rude b that works on Fridays and is usually on the new side. Brunette, ponytail, sour expression: avoid her at all costs.

The quesadillas are also amazing (the shrimp is very bland, so can't recommend that one). The Shroom is probably my favorite, but the Buffalo is good, too.

Do not order the nachos: TR does not have any ovens in the kitchen, so it's cold ingredients on chips. That ain't nachos, people! The hubs and I ordered them once and sent that sorry sh*t back.

Went to TR once at night, on a Friday. I was told it got stupid busy by 11, and that is a minor understatement. The crowd is young (I am not), so let that be your guide.

Again, best chicken tenders in town, if that's your thang.

You'll find a small but well-rounded breakfast and lunch menu at Turn Restaurant. Both our menu options were indulgent to say the least; potentially a little greasy for some folks. Loads of nice details: square menus the size of a 12" vinyl album cover, an "album cover" wall, one 80s rock ballad after the other, lots of daylight, and a clean, contemporary setting. We'll come back some time for the breakfast items next time. Sending a big thanks to our server Naaja.

Cute spot! Closes too early is my only complaint! Nice spot for happy hour! The margaritas were generously poured! Discounted appetizers for happy hour. The fried pickles are amazing!! A must try! We also tasted the fish tacos and fish and chips, all tasty! Great service, highly recommended! Oh and the complimentary fried chick peas were yum!

My boyfriend and I went here on a late Sunday afternoon this past weekend.  We love local places and cajun food is our favorite.  

We started with the Hurricane Kennedy drink, it was perfect.  Right amount of juices and liquor.  We ordered the Spicy Shrimp Tacos for an app--they were super spicy but also super yummy!  If you don't like spicy I would steer clear.  I would order them again though because the flavor was great.  

My boyfriend got the dirty chicken and he was very happy with it.  The smokey flavor from the chicken is great and topped with gumbo, you can't go wrong! 
I had the blackenedd catfish po'boy topped with slaw, originally I was going to go with fried but our waitress/owner stated her favorite was blackened so I gave it a go.  It was seriously the best po'boy I have ever had.  

Besides the food being awesome (the entire meal) the owners were very friendly and welcoming.  We mentioned we would love to go back to New Orleans one day and they offered places to visit while down in the area, mentioning where they grew up and their love for cajun food.  

Pretty awesome experience on our Sunday afternoon.  We look forward to going back soon to try other items on the menu.

I'm slightly conflicted  about this one.  I didn't try everything they had to offer, and quite a few of their other offerings (In-house soda, craft brew, etc), so I'm giving them an extra star, but as far as burgers go, I was kinda meh on this one.  I had "THE cheeseburger" with 3 cheeses and it was good.  I asked for Med-rare and got med/med-well.  

The thing that perplexed me is that my first bite was quite good, but I didn't really crave more once I was 2/3's of the way through.  I ordered a side of the stroganoff sauce because I couldn't make up my mind, and I didn't really care for it.  I thought it should be creamier and it was kind of oily.

This is a very pleasant place to eat, but it does not get my vote for best burger in town, although I most definitely will be back.

Dirty, unscrupulous owners. Over priced and not worthy of your business. Go to publics, cvs or Walgreen's - all close by . This place seeks only to rip you off. Don't park there either, they'll call the towing company... They get a kick back.

This is our favorite spot for all you can eat sushi!!! The staff is friendly and the food has always been served fresh. Their miso soup and their Donald Duck is my favorite out of any other place here in town!!! If your looking for fresh food, friendly staff and quick service, this is the place to go!!!

I LOVE THIS PLACE! The appetizers are all delicious and the sushi is fresh and so pretty... like a piece of art! The service is great and the atmosphere is very welcoming. I go there almost weekly! So go

April 2014 we spent 9 days in Treasure Island, with my sister in law who owns a condo, and is some what a local. We dined out roughly 5 nights, and ended up at the Sea Hag 3 times. The location is great, the food plentiful, and the service outstanding. It's got the feel of a local hangout, and even the wait staff of the other restaurants we dined with, all agreed it was a great place. Everyone asked if we had the 
Blackened Grouper - we hadn't. 

The prices, portions, and quality of the food are great. We had the Shrimp Bucket, Marina Salad, Gorgonzola Burger, 1lb Peel & Eat Shrimp Cocktail, and the Soup, Salad, and Bread. All outstanding, even to the point where I had the Shrimp 
Bucket twice. It was HUGE, and I could never finish it. The marina salad comes served in a giant martini glass, as does the Peel and Eat Shrimp. 

We sat inside, and didn't have a chance to eat on the patio. Next time we will change it up. Already looking forward to going back. 

The wait staff here are all hard working, and always had a smile on their face. You could see they enjoyed their jobs, probably because their customers are made up of mostly locals. The hostess was young and sassy (in a good way), and was always quick with a comment, and greeted you with a huge welcome. 

The other restaurants we checked out where, Sloppy Joe's. Great food, but over priced and had a feel of a chain. But cool location and a fun evening never the less. Original Pizza was our go to for Cuban Sandwiches, and pizza. One of the best experiences we had was our last night, having the early bird special at the Middle Ground.  We could never seem to get into Willy's Burgers and Booze, as the wait was always over an hour by the time we got there. That's another local watering hole. and highly recommended.

Maybe I picked the wrong day to eat at Vic's, but my experience was just okay...nothing to write about.  

After reading all the Yelp reviews, my expectations were sky high.  I went there for lunch with my better half and we ordered number of rolls and Sashimi between two people.  And we were trying to convince ourselves that it were good when they were just okay.  

Amongst all the Japanese restaurants in the area I have tried, I have zeroed in on two Ooka and Kumo and they are both consistently great with great ambience.  Vic with its 5 tables feels like a take out Chinese joint with just okay Sushi!!!

One of the best dining experiences in
St Louis, the good was great, the service was fantastic. Come with a big appetite, go home stuffed.

Kale Yeah is exactly what this neighborhood needed! Healthy, fresh menu and great decor inside. The salad bowl was so delicious and the home made Thai peanut sauce is the real deal. The owner is a very impressive guy and I look forward to trying more of his creations!
Prickly Pear Margarita & Jalapeño Margarita were yummy!!! The food was wonderful and the ambiance was very nice! We will return!!

I love the Public Market in general so no surprise that this place is SO good. I love the Ensenada tacos (beer battered cod) you can tell that all the ingredients they use are super fresh. The chips and gauc are a must have has well! They have the best chips ever!!

I love this place. Its great to be able to have choices besides just 6" & 12". The fries are delicious and made when you order them so they don't have that soggy feel/taste...and the sandwiches are too! This location is always clean; which is always a bonus.

A brief review of a delivery order (through Postmates, if you're curious) and therefore just about the food:
- Lemongrass chicken when I've ordered it at most Vietnamese restaurants is a chicken breast (white meat) sliced into thin/long slices - this was weird bits of dark meat, definitely looked like the "leftovers"
- I'm only about 10 min away, but my eggrolls were no longer crispy because they were SO greasy
For $17 ($6 for 3 tiny eggrolls, by the way), I was expecting way better quality. I won't be ordering from them again; there are plenty of other nearby options that are similar in price but better in quality.
THIS PLACE IS SO GOOD!!!! I got a strawberry lemonade, the southwest scramble, and a biscuit! The homemade jam is exceptional! We were highly impressed!

Only come to this restaurant if you like ordering food but not eating.

Worst service I've ever experienced. Our group and the table next to us literally got up and left the restaurant together after waiting an unforgivable amount of time waiting and being disappointed. They weren't even that busy. The staff is just lazy, apathetic, and I assume high. 

The incompetent wait staff, who took 30 minutes to tell us the meals we ordered were no longer in stock (30 minutes to tell us we needed to order something else...) and an hour to tell the table next to us they forgot to put in their meal ticket, had both of our checks ready and waiting to give us as our two groups tried to leave. Amazing they could do that but it took over a half an hour for chips and salsa.

Yelp is a damn liar. I trusted these reviews and got burned. The food we did see on our way out also looked very subpar. The tacos were small and just some meat thrown on a little tortilla. The burritos looked like the size of appetizers.

Don't do it. Go somewhere else. Just because some transplants and an occasional tourist give good reviews doesn't mean it is good. Go to Rosa Mezcal or El Gato Negro or Juan's Flying Burrito if you want Mexican in the Warehouse District.
Always great food and the service at the Chesterfield location is always top notch. Especially great for large groups.

This is my first review ever.  Went here for an early dinner at 5:00pm...only two tables occupied.  It was around a shift change but a server who was going off shift soon took our order to get it started.  She said that she would get our appetizers and soup going first.  No one showed up until our entrees came marching out 10 minutes later....no soup or apps.  Now we are the only table occupied in the entire restaurant.  The first entree was warm, not cold.  Was it left over from lunch service?  The apps and soup showed up last.  The dishes were just ok...nothing stood out.  We finished our meal and noticed that all of the servers (we counted 4) were in the kitchen just talking.  No one circulated on the floor....ever.  Couldn't get anyone's attention.  Finally I went out to the host stand and asked if I could get a check.  The host printed up my check and brought it to me....no waiter or waitress.  All diners deserve some attention.  Most diners expect hot good food.  My party of 3 received neither.  Good luck to you if you go.  No one was in charge, and no one seemed to care.  Not my idea of a good dinner out.  Perhaps it was a supply chain issue....you decide.  There are much better Chinese Restaurants within a 5-10 minute drive than this one....get back in your car.

Good Mexican spot, the beat we've had coming to visit Reno so far. I ordered the crispy tacos place one chicken one shrimp both delicious. They have great salsa choices too, their medium hot and green are my favorite. We also ordered a couple street tacos on the side, steak and Al pastor and their taquitos appetizer. All was really good, the rice and beans have good flavor as well.  We'll be back!

I took a friend to the Safety Harbor Spa's "Father's Day" Special Buffet. To say it was EXCELLENT is an under statement. There was a nice  variety of breakfast selections (hello eggs Benedict) as well as meat and seafood (loved the lobster mac 'n cheese!!!!). I skipped the fruit, cheese, and salads to concentrate on the main courses. There was also a nice variety of deserts to satisfy anyone's desires. There was a band that played nice, soft, piano-bar type songs. The service was also first-rate and friendly. I'd give the experience an extra star if I could. I'll be back!

So happy I tried this new fast casual Mediterranean spot in Fishers.  I've eaten here several times now. The falafel sandwich and gyros are amazing with very fresh Ingredients. Go with the combo add fresh feta and Greek dressing to the fries and you won't be sorry!   Babaganouah appetizer is very good.  The smoothies are also delicious, love the mango and melon.  Very clean and friendly local  owners.  I will be back often.

Sadly this restaurant is not as great as it used to be. Not sure what's happened....lack of oversight from head chef maybe? Rigatoni used to be as good as my italian grandmothers now it's way too spicy (and I like spicy). Pizza is blah. Totally disappointing.

I have been visiting Mi Ranchito for years, under the radar I guess.  There are many reason to visit Mi Ranchito when looking for Mexican foods.  The lunch specials are really good deals.  The service is always spectacular.  Portion size in generous and usually a left over box is required.  

The Chimichangas are really good.  They come with melted cheese queso.  Pro Tip- ask for the queso on the side.  Then you can also dip chips in it!  It also keeps one of the chimichangas better if you are taking part of it home as a leftover.

Everyone at Mi Ranchito gets there own Salsa bowl.   I know this is a little thing...but this way you can add hot sauces to your own salsa if need be- love it.  They have two hot sauce choices on every table.  There is seating for two up to large group tables.   Mi Ranchito is always buzzing with activity.
Amazing, incredible, and delicious!  The sampler was great if you can't choose between all the amazing choices. But here's the real tip...get the sangria!

The food was excellent. The crab fried rice was delicious. The smoked collard greens and kale was a winner. Everyone in my party was completely satisfied with their meal. Service was great. And best of all, it's right in Overbrook. Will definitely be back.

Rarely does Yelp steer me wrong, but disappointed by this place. As soon as we walk in I notice that no one is there, but the restaurant is very dirty. Food on the floor, tables don't look clean. We order some slices of pizza that need to be heated up in the oven. After we have already paid, we notice a guy making the pizza dough crust, trying to stretch it by using his arms and forearm area where arm hair would be touching the pizza dough crust. Gag!!

This spot is new and tasty. I really enjoyed the spotted pig- fresh tasting ingredients and a unique blend of them. I was less thrilled with the deep dish. I've definitely had better, but if you're not used to real Chicago deep dish this is ok. There's too much sauce and not enough cheese. The crust for it is bland, not buttery. Again, it's tasty, but you can find better.

I'll definitely head back, but for the traditional style pizzas. I look forward to what's next!

This is probably the worst Chinese food I have ever tasted. There was no sauce on the sweet and sour chicken, it was all breading. The rice had a foul aftertaste. I could not eat it. Crab Rangoon was not good, and the egg roll  was not even close to warm. Did not eat any of it, I was afraid I would get sick.
Nice addition to downtown Clearwater Cleveland St scene.   Amazing Sicilian food met the chef ( from Aci Trezza . Sicily) and his wife.  Will be back.

Super dooper healthy delicious. This place has many food options including vegetarian and vegan. Everything is freshly made. 
I enjoyed the impossible burger and the tofu tacos. My friend and I shared the meals. Oh there is a check in offer for free iced coffee.
I hope to come back the next time I am in town

We have been to The Capital Grill many times.  For my wife's birthday we had planed  some shopping for her at International Plaza and dinner for both of us at CG.  We sat outside for the great people watching.  Service was great as usual (but not always based on one or two experiences).  I had Lobster Bisk rather than a salad.  It had large chunks of lobster but the broth was not very creamy.  I had a  Rib Eye Special and my  wife had the Lamb Chops  (with an oil and balsamic glaze) and both were to die for.  We finished off with a complimentary Flourless Chocolate cake and coffee.  For a corporate Steakhouse chain you can not do much better.  We will be back again!!

First time ever here, did not know it was a chain. Everyone said it was amazing. But It's okay.  Chip and cheese were just ok.  His burrito was ok. My BLTA taco was good because I added shrimp. The best thing of the meal would have been the shredded chicken in one of the tacos. Nothing blew us away.  I read on reviews taco Tuesday for $1.50, I will back for that.
Excellent pizza! I mean the crust was great! We took it to go! But inside was very small and romantic and personal place for date night!

The cheesesteaks are really tasty. I custom ordered mine with pizza sauce, mushrooms, onions, and green peppers. The nice elderly woman behind the counter is very hospitable and everything was made just the way I like. I'll have to come back to try the pizza and fries. It's conveniently located right next to PhilaMOCA theater.

WOW. This place goes down so far in history as the best meal I have ever had. No joke! I came to Nashville for my cousin's wedding, and this is where the rehersal dinner was. My Uncle loves wine (he has his own vineyard in CA), and he loves to impress people, and this place was truly supurb. The menu changes all the time, but I do remember having a trio of soups. Two were delicious, one was not, but needless to say that was the only bad thing I can say about my whole experience. I do remember having the best filet mignon in the world. Every component of the dish was executed perfectly in flavor, tenderness, and appearance. Other people said the halibut was just as wonderful. I am just sad that I live in Arizona, and can not get that satisfaction again! It is very expensive, but worth every penny!
This grocery store is great! I live in florida and am used to publix, so normally, when out of state, nothing compares. This surprised me, and I was very happy with all of the selections and quality.

This was the rudest bar I've ever been to. For a business that just opened, you would think they would be concerned with customer service. I'm from Florida and go to a local college so I have an out of state ID and had some friends from home visiting me, so all of our IDs were out of state and even though we provided our debit cards as alternate forms of identification, they still denied us. They even had a book of state IDs to verify all of the markings that make it valid and were too stupid to use it. I've never received such poor treatment and will never return.
Great salads and the best barbecue chicken pizza. Service is usually very good.

When I first moved to Philadelphia, one of my objectives was to find a nice unassuming neighborhood restaurant to make my go to place. Southgate is this place. I've passed by it so many times and was always struck by the simplicity of their menu + how warm and inviting the outdoor space was, and this week I bit the bullet and went for happy hour.

1) SERVICE: Great. Our waiter was impressively attentive to our table even though it was a busy night with full tables and a line for takeout. I remember barely finishing my water when he magically appeared to refill my cup. They also took precautions by wearing masks, using paper menus, and wiping down tables. 

2) FOOD: I had the happy hour burger of the day (kimchi burger) and southgate fries (garlic, gochugaru, gochujang aioli) to share. At first I thought I was saving a lot more, but it seems like their $16 regular menu burger includes fries whereas the $10 happy hour burger doesn't. From a happy hour perspective, you save $2 on banchan and $2 if you order the burger and fries separately. I didn't really get why the $4 mystery beer was in the happy hour menu since it's also $4 in their regular drink menu. Anyway, the food was solid. I'd describe it as Korean-American grub with a contemporary twist. The southgate fries were my favorite -- they had that honey garlicky smell that I love and there was more than enough for 2 to share. The burger was also well portioned, and I think people will appreciate the fusion element with the kimchi. However I wish there was more flavor from the patty or the cheese, since it seemed like the kimchi was the unilateral star of the show. 

Overall this was a great experience and I will be back to try other things on the menu. The pricing of the happy hour menu could be a little more transparent, and some of the menu does seem a little pricy, but it's a cozy place with attentive service and a no frills menu of creative but instantly recognizable food that packs a punch.

After an unexpected mishap in the kitchen I had to come here to the ER to stitch up my finger I had managed to slice while chopping up green peppers. The intake process was incredibly fast. The nurses were able to get my wound cleaned up and the doctor did a good job to make sure my finger was numb before stitching it. Now a couple of weeks later my finger is still healing but things progressed without issues. Their advice on cleaning and re-bandaging the finger helped me avoid getting an infection and having other complications.

As a Brazilian, it is best feijoada I have eaten here. The meat was perfectly cooked. My husband loved the pastel. Also, try the juices from Amazon fruits. The price is reasonable, really good service, and finish with a brigadeiro for dessert. I was missing my favorite dish of Brazil! The pão de queijo was incredible!

Amazing Chilean Sea Bass! I went here for a business dinner and it was amazing! Service was great, and the bacon sampler appetizer featured 3 different types of bacon and was delish! I would love to bring my family back here for a meal very soon!

I had very high expectations for this legendary restaurant. I'm glad I finally got to experience it, but the food did not live up to the hype. I started with the soup 1-1-1. A demi serving of 3 soups: Turtle, Chicken Gumbo & soup of the day, which was leeks & potatoes. The chicken Gumbo was amazing and had an incredible rich flavor. The other two soups were just ok. I ordered the Carribean Spiced Pork Tenderloin. It was flavorful, but nothing outstanding. The Bread Pudding Suffle was good, but once again, not great. The best part of this dinning experience was the atmosphere and the service. Perhaps if I would have ordered different dishes, I would have been more impressed. I'm willing to give it another chance since the atmosphere and service is fabulous.

Low grade sushi at best, the spider roll was not fresh from the crab to the cucumber slices that looked like they were cut up the day before. I also ordered a spicy tuna roll that was not spicy at all. The service was alright, without asking they never gave us back our change which wasn't much but makes me not want to come back.

Place we always like to take visitors enjoying the Gulf Coast.  On a nice day like to sit on the deck and enjoy the weather n senery.  Boat cruseing up n down the water way or tieing up to the dock to stay for a bite to eat.  Food is great never been disappointed.  Nice bar drink too.  Come enjoy n see what I'm talking about .

I've only eaten dinner here but they have started doing lunch so I still have to check that out.  I've had some very good food here and found this to be a great place to take dates.  It is probably one of the more expensive restaurants in New Orleans so I don't go frequently but every time I've been it has been a very enjoyable experience.  They have very good Italian food and they do some very good things with veal.  I also hear rumors that this is Martin Scorsese's favorite place to eat in New Orleans :)

Worst Taco Bell around. Good is constantly being substituted because they are out of beef. Got a nacho bell grande and it clearly had been made, cooled, and reheated. Tasted like dog food. Have had multiple bad experiences here and will not be returning.

This is a hidden gem in town. I suggest the atmosphere and food here quite a bit. I used to frequent this cafe at least twice a week when my schedule allowed for it. I'm going to make time just to get back here sometime soon. They'll even cater events. Love their food. They've got some great specials going on day to day. Check them out for sure.

We love Mexican food and will never go back, the complimentary chips and salsa were ok, the chips were crispy but the salsa was so bland I thought it was just tomato sauce with some salt...ugh, the burrito was small and bland and the 3 hard tacos I ordered were crispy and dry, so dry I could only eat 2, there was barely anything inside the tacos, I was like what!    I would say a tablespoon of each item and maybe like 12 little shreds of cheese....I told my fiance can we go to Wendy's and get a chicken sandwich I am starving....this was a lunch meal and with 2 sodas was around $25, way, way overpriced!   Will never ever go back

Let me start with the best - the waitress and manager , very helpful picking out drinks and a good beer.  But the oyster po boy ruined everything!!!! Awful over done so much it was just a dry husk of burnt breading. I didn't have the heart to complain because they had treated me so well but the food has caused this customer never to return and to warn everyone not to order the po boy sandwich.
Best Italian restaurant Reno? With our large and mostly wealthy Italian population, to be the best in Reno is quite an accomplishment. Try the veal Parmesan.

Just tried this place this week.Half the dining room was empty and we waited 40 minutes to be seated.Hostess took one name ran off   came  back took a name ran off? She just ignored next party in line.FOOD was pretty good ,draft beer ice cold and wife enjoyed sangria.2 for 1 much apreciated.Drinks took so long i thought the beer hadn't been imported yet.If wife could handle bar stool I'd sit at bar and not deal with front of house.

The food here was awesome.  The brussel sprouts were amazing.  The bbq shrimp was so good! Left feeling full and very satisfied.  Plus the owner was very helpful in finding us a parking spot.  Definitely need to check them out if in the area.

Great diner food!  Sodas that they make are great!
We drove 45 mins to get here and it was worth the drive.  Milkshakes are a must.  The disco fries are good.

Have gone for lunch a few times this summer based on a recommendation of a doctor colleague. Decor is stunning, food is excellent, service is above outstanding but down side is that many other people are aware of it. So I recommend you go early or a little past the normal hour to, hopefully, miss the crowd. But do visit and often as you will never be disappointed. I recommend the chicken dishes but all the food I have had is excellent. As a disciple of David Rosengarten, the former food critic and contributing editor of Gourmet Magazine, I normally wait til I have visited the fifth time, as he recommends, to praise a restaurant but with Amici's I could not wait to let you know.

Not sure what happened to this place. Since they transitioned ownership the machines are significantly tighter. That's not the total picture though. The Major problem I have with this casino are the extremely poor offers. I lost nearly a grand in 2 hours and they sent me $5 in food credit. Whoever runs their marketing needs to get a grip. For starters who would go back for $5 in food credit? Furthermore what casino doesn't offer free-play either?  I could chalk up my experience as just bad luck and get some redemption with an offer to try my luck again. However it appears there is absolutely no reason for me to patronize this establishment any further. Apparently they think I'm going to drive 30 mins to give away my money again when there are about 20 other casinos who actually send decent offers within a 5 mile radius of me.

We booked a reservation at six, something happened where we had to wait for our seats. We finally get our seat about an hour later. Our waiter was nice and understanding. It was quite loud, and crowded. I could bare hear my friends beside me. Know that the food is expensive, I will say that the food was delicious. My friends and I had a great time, just it was too loud.
I absolutely love the Soho Saloon. Bartender Maria is amazing. Owner and management are great people, working hard to take care their employees and a community staple.

Have eaten there twice now. A great lunch location. The dog theme is unusual and very interesting. I had an Irish setter sandwich Panini which was made with corn beef cheese and coleslaw instead of sauerkraut. Delicious! The golden retriever sandwich Panini was turkey bacon and cheese with chipotle sauce. I loved it. Very friendly staff and a lot of seating. Different selection of teas and coffees. A very popular destination for the hospital staff across the street. Get there early.

I like that Anna's went above and beyond to be different by serving a small complimentary taste of elote that was really good.  I hate to try the Chanclas sine I have never had it and it was also really good.  I think the carne asada and pastor were the best of the meats and the melty cheese added a nice touch.  Service was on point.

This place is a poor representation of PJs. I used to go to the Blue Bell almost weekly years ago for wing night and it was great. The service here is awful and so disorganized. 

I went here about a month ago and was told by our waitress the bar was closed and they weren't serving cocktails only beer. That's a bummer. However last night I went again and was told the bar was open but they don't have a drink menu but I can order whatever I want. 

My friend and I just got appetizers and drinks but we were told at the end of our meal (when I asked for the check actually) that we had to order more food to actually cash out. Why weren't we told that at the beginning of our meal?? We weren't even hungry and we barely ate half of the dessert we ordered.
Best damn burrito (chile relleno, beans cheese and rachero sauce) OMG .... AND so was the chips and salsa ... AMAAAAZING!!! VERY NICE SERVICE TOO !!

We waited in line to get in for about 30 minutes and it was worth it! 

I do not usually like oysters but the chargrilled ones were great! You put them on buttery french bread and they are so good! I ordered friend shrimp and it was a huge order with hush puppies and fries. It was so good I ate almost the entire thing. I get fried shrimp a lot when I go out and these were some of the best! 

If you like that kind of food you must go to Acme!!

This is my first official review for this restaurant, however it's my husband and I favorite place to eat and it's even where he proposed to me a little over a year ago now. 
This place never lets us down. I love falafel and theirs is delicious. The menu has a great selection of items and different items if you're looking to try something new. From the moment we walk through the door we are always greeted by several different employees. The service is the same no matter how busy they are and that's a good sign of great customer service. We never have to wait or wonder when the waitress/waiter will refresh our drinks and the food is always the right temperature when it arrives to our table.
My husband had the arugula with shrimp salad (which looked amazing) and I had a vegan dish which was falafel and a small mix greens salad topped with a variety of chopped peppers and cucumbers. 
Of course we finished dinner with dessert and some hot tea. 
It's only right that I give 5 stars. I can't wait to go back as always.

This Pizza Hut location is TERRIBLE! Each time I ordered, pizza was cooked completely different. My delivery driver came 56 minutes late and had he nerve to stand outside and take a smoke break first.  The food was cold! Called the store and she told me that they only had 2 drivers. WHY is that my problem? If they guarantee a time (which is already and hour and 15 minutes out), it is unacceptable to be 56 minutes late. She offered me $6 off when it should have been free. The pizza wasn't even worth it.

Brought the mum here for brunch when she was in-town and she loved it.  Definitely a great place to bring out-of-town guests.  It really does transport you to a whole other world just by walking through the alleyed-entrace.  

We shared a mushroom soup, pancakes, and steak - everything tasted just right.

This is one place that embodies all the best qualities of independent local business. Don and Lisa (proprietors) take incredible pride in their restaurant, reflected in the quality of their amazing food, service and overall sense of place. This rare combination is what's missing from so many establishments these days. It's refreshing to know that some of that refreshing local spirit lives on at the corner of Union & Pershing. Outstanding experience!

Food was tasty and healthy, service was quick.  However, the portions are smaller than advertised. The salmon is supposed to be 4 oz.; it turned out to be 3.15 oz.  (cost: $15).  Might not satisfy if you're very hungry.

Such a disappointment don't go to this one go to the one in Orlando or even betteF yet NYC the service was cra sooke with the manager who doesn't understand the concept of customer service either!!!! Don't go go to Orlando

I would definitely recommend this place if you're looking for a quick bite to eat. Place is very tiny and there are no tables available inside for one to eat. I believe they might have outdoor seating, but that might not be too desirable in the colder months. That put aside, the food here is very good and remember to talk loudly because they might not be able to hear you from behind the glass.

The fresh pastor tacos here take you to the winded summer streets of Mexico with nothing on your mind besides falling in love and not getting arrested. Each meal here leaves you in a epic wanderlust that can only be satisfied by their authentic cuisine one could only have found via a whisper from the local elderly mystic as you get more and more lost down the echoing labyrinth of a celebrating town where the jungle meets the sea.

Word on the street was that North Star bar got a new menu. Finally tried it out last night, and OMG. I have two words. Nacho. Fries.

The food is a great improvement from before. Burgers, sandwiches, and plates to share with an updated, slightly quirky vibe. I had Nacho Fries which were fries covered in cheese, black beans and guac. It tasted SO good and definitely fresh.

Looking forward to seeing where the menu goes from here and hoping the Nacho Fries never leave the menu.
Great salads, sandwiches, and of course the crepes were amazing. Have been here several times and it doesn't disappoint.

Well, what can I say... it's coffee! You can either do it right or wrong! And this place def does it right.

I'm my a fan of hot coffee, so I'm always in search of the best cold brew. This place has a great cold brew. Very strong in flavor. Will def give ya a kick of energy too.

If you are a coffee lover, stop going to Dunkin's and Starbucks, and give this place a try. They have multiple locations all over Tampa! So go!

I was driving on Board St and saw the grand opening sign in front of this new restaurant. I love sushi so I figured I'll give it a try. 

The staff are very welcoming; they greet you once you walk in. I like how the sushi bar was right in the front of the restaurant. I always like seeing what the chefs are making lol. This is a very tiny restaurant that can hold maybe 50ish people?

Now let's talk food. Whenever I see scallion pancake on the menu I always give it a try. And wow, this scallion pancake was sooo good! I like the flakiness of it. Must try item! Okay, sushi- I got 3 rolls for $33 (I think). At first, I didn't think it'll fill me up but these rolls are pretty big. I got the Spider roll, Double Eel, and Triple Spicy. It was worth it. I also ordered some sushi/sashimi on the side. The fish was fresh and rice was a good amount.

Pros: the employees were all very nice, the street corn and lobster fries were good. The food was cooked made to order. 
Cons: It was a pretty long wait to get the food, not sure if there is only one cook? It was pretty pricey for all the food as well. My husband got the prime 55 and was disappointed in the steak. It was bland and over cooked and definitely didn't look like a ny strip. It was not worth $38. I got the veggie gnocchi and it was also pretty tasteless. I also ordered a mojito and it wasn't made correctly (wrong alcohol maybe?) and didn't taste like a mojito. 

I think this place has a lot of potential but they definitely need to change some things or it will be short lived.
Was hoping to hit up Beilars but the line was really long in the early AM. Went to this diner ouster bar area for some breakfast. Very cool space and lots of diverse places to eat, drink and shop in.

Many things to like about this place. Very good for seating large parties; Dimly lit family style restaurant. It reminds me of being in some tropical rainforest. Servers are all extremely attentive. Food is a mix between Malaysian, Chinese, and Thai. 

Menu is huge.

Roti: very light and crispy. Kinda reminds me of a Chinese scallion pancake with thin, crispy edges. Comes with a side of curry with a piece of potato and chicken to dip in. 

Seafood Lo Mein: good mix of seafood with a small amount of shrimp, scallop, and squid. A bit bland, but nothing that a few squeezes of Sriracha won't fix. 

Seafood Tomyam Rice Noodles: fragrant with lemongrass. Good spice level. Definitely not too sweet like some Thai varieties. 

Kang Kung Belacan: delicious stir fried water spinach. Good spice as well, and very fragrant. 

Will be back.

The best Poki place around Nashville area!
Great fresh seafoods. Friendly and fun staffs.

This place is amazing. We stumbled upon it on Yelp this evening and were looking for close by Mediterranean after being told our go-to spot was filled for the night. We ventured out and it was a tiny spot on a corner in a neighborhood location away from many of the area we are familiar with. At first we were thinking where are we? Then, we went inside. Very warm, quaint, friendly. The food was amazing. The menu is huge and has so many options. Everything was super fresh and obviously made to order. We will definitely be back. The photos don't do justice. Prices were reasonable and it's byo!
Extremely wonderful staff and absolutely excellent food. The wonton soup is far and away the best I have ever had.
Yummy! There isn't anything on the menu that I wouldn't order again. Expect a wait time, but it is only because their chicken is cooked fresh!

My husband and I were craving some sushi and it was close to our daughters nap time so we decided to go somewhere close so we came here. 

I ordered tha joint long roll and a soft shell crap hand roll and there was so much rice I almost couldn't eat anymore sushi. The long roll was cut un-even so bad that I I had a mouthful or sushi then a nibble. Maybe a new chef? 

The waitress was very nice she was prompt with service and kept bringing us new order sheets. We ordered some of the appetizers and the sushi came out before the appetizers and all the appetizers didn't even come out. I wanted to feed my daughter the miso soup because she loves soup, but it did not come out, but I didn't make a big deal about it. 

Finally we were almost done so I ordered one last nigiri the tobiko with quail egg and they brought me the salmon eggs instead. Yuck! No thank you. This has happened a few times before. Maybe the chef doesn't know their sushi? She took it back and finly brought me the correct nigiri, but they also brought out 2 quail egg shooters. No thanks to that. I did not order that either. All in all they could be more consistent on the size of their rolls/nigiri. Hiroba is somewhat similar, but atleast hiroba now makes all their sushi fit in your mouth with one bite.

Don't waste your time reading this. If you love food, come to Yard House. If you like beer, you should also come to Yard House. The appetizers are absolutely amazing. Every single app I've had here has been amazing. They have 125 beers on tap so if you love craft beer, this is your stop. Christina F. Was our server and she did a wonderful job of making sure we were happy with beer and food. Katie was a manager who also stopped by to talk to us a litte about our experience. We all told her we loved the place and their food, we will be back soon!! Highly recommend this place but be prepared for how amazing and popular it is.

My boyfriend and I ended up at Elizabeth's based on a suggestion from a coworker who grew up here (we're visiting from Texas). It was nice to enjoy a more organically local scene.

I liked the corky atmosphere, but the food wasn't that great. My plain French Toast was super soggy and the side of praline bacon was a sugar overload. Plus, they only sold regular coffee, no cappuccinos *sad face*.

I did enjoy the service, and my bf's crab cakes were pretty good. I'll give Elizabeth's another try!
Monday nights Comedy Stand Up! Memorable drinks, "off the rails" so delicious. Great combination. What a relief to have such a place and venue in Reno to unwind, during this complicated year!

Still in my top 5 in St Louis. Eaten hear with elderly friends and 40-somethings friends and elderly parents. Forward thinking menus, priced correctly in comparison to the industry for the quality and creativity. Everything is clean. Staff clearly likes to work here and are treated well. Very covid conscious. Great for prior to a show at the Rep! I suggest making a reservation.

Went in on a Tuesday night. All of my friends told me it would be months for a reservation but since we just wanted a cocktail we didn't think it mattered. The hostess sat us immediately! We were offered the full menu too! We just had small stuff; tenderloin sandwich slider (appetizer) & a kale salad. Holy cow!! The slider came with a snack size portion of fries - AND THEY WERE FANTASTIC!! The salad was great too! I like the ambiance of this place. The energy is contagious & the meaning behind the name of the place just warms your heart. How can you NOT love it there? Be forewarned, it's not a place to go for a quiet, romantic dinner. It's hip, modern & energetic which brings the volume up a bit so if you need to tell any secrets or keep something private, better save that for another venue. Fantastic place! I plan on going again & again.

This place has the worst customer service that I've ever encountered. I came in to pick up my order and the hostess told me it would be a few minutes. 20 minutes later she tells me that the order hadn't even been sent to the kitchen yet!

Vibes: all-day cafe with counter and booth seating with gorgeous aesthetic; casual and chic; would bring a friend or two for dinner 

Tasting notes:
-Baked feta: cheese served warm, lends the dominating saltiness of the dish; definitely need the smooth, mellow muhammara with each spoonful to balance the saltiness; wish there were crackers/crisps to serve as a texture contrast and vector for transporting each bite 
-Mushroom toast: ratio of bread to slightly salty mascarpone to earthy, tender mushrooms is perfect; healthy dusting of za'atar on top; bread is crusty, on the denser side  
-Yemenite cauliflower: just right level of roasty-ness; love the nutty and sweet juicy surprises from the pine nuts and raisins; labneh comes as a dollop so definitely would toss the cauliflower a bit before spooning!
-Adeena's Couscous: if snowflakes didn't melt, they would be the texture of the airy, fluffy, slightly nutty (absolutely loved the generous topping of sliced almonds) couscous; prefer swirling couscous into the stew versus spooning stew onto couscous; stew is served piping hot, very flavorful and on the thicker side; a surprisingly filling dish 
-Chocolate babka: accompanying orange-apricot ice cream was subtly sweet, richly floral to the nose and tongue; chocolate was decadent but not overwhelming; babka itself was more on the bready side 

Other notes:
-Loved getting a sample of the experimental butternut squash soup with pickled chard 
-Very vegetarian-friendly menu
-Aforementioned dishes better to be shared (even the entree couscous)
-Service is attentive with multiple-server team, kept table very neat

Nice place in the resort and right on the water. Nice selection of burgers that include lamb, bison and chicken. Very nice inside and out and service was quick. Not busy so we were seated right away. We started with the cheeseburger dip. Very tasty and filling. Cheesy with great burger chunks. I then had the American BBQ burger. Basic burger cooked medium. Very tasty. Fixings were fresh and crunchy. Overall a solid spot for a great grilled burger.

Burgers kinda blah. They charge you separately for the burger and fries which is kind of strange. Waitresses need some training. Our waitress messed up the majority of our order and practically gave us half our meal for free. Customer's always right, right? :) However, she cursed like a sailor in front of the customers. I don't even think she knew she was doing it. Very unprofessional and made the place seem trashy.

Bella Vita has improved. The new general manager went out of his way for our big group. The servers kept up and were professional and prompt. Our entire group had a great time and enjoyed the food. We were quite happy we had our event here!

Came here for New Year's Eve dinner and this place didn't disappoint.
Started off with the whipped ricotta and the dates. Both were absolutely delicious as our server Kelsey mentioned they were the most popular.
As a main course, I had the short ribs. They were pull apart, tender and the fried garlic topper was seriously amazing. Mmm little crispy pieces of garlic. 
Drool. 
Drinks were also on point and their staff was very attentive. 
All and all it was a great place to bring in the last meal of 2021!

Bad bad experience this morning I never write reviews but I'm traumatized. A rat poked its head out of the ceiling this morning to say hello while we were having breakfast at the Penrose. Never ever going back. I ran out. Offered to move our table or box our food up. How bad does a rat problem have to be for them to start coming out of the ceiling?

Great service, really mind staff that go the extra mile. The food was delicious and the outdoor patio is dog friendly, but give them a heads up that you're bringing a furry friend. Highly recommend the maple old fashioned. It was mixed well and was very refreshing.

My favorite place to go for a steak! Everything is a la carte so it is a little pricey but definitely worth every bite! Their steaks are juicy and tender and cooked to perfection each time. I've had about everything on their menu and you cant really go wrong with whats on there. Although I do have to say, a side order of mac and cheese is a must ! My fiance hates cheese and even he agrees the mac and cheese is amazing!

This is a new hidden gem in the desert southwest. This is a tiny tattoo shop located in the back of the Monterey Court on Miracle Mile. 

This shop is clean and boasts some of the best custom artists in town. Dont come to this shop looking to buy a peice off the wall because you wont find one. All work in this shop is custome design. 

Do your research, think about what you really want and then bring it on in and watch it come to life. I personally go to Andy Pratt, (www.facebook.com/andy.pratt however I have seen the work of the other artists and it is just as AMAZING. 

So if you are in the mood to show off new art, head on down to The Painted Saguaro Studio. Currently they are by appointment  only and the best way to reach them is through facebook @ www.facebook.com/paintedsaguarostudio/ 

Come on down and see Rob, Manda, Andra, Bryce, Danny and Andy!

LOVE: the food, the high ceiling and natural light, the online ordering app, the location, the people-watching.
DON'T LOVE: recent increase in prices (I spec'd out a 14" pizza to go yesterday...$35! really?).

The wait staff vary in quality, but there always seems to be a manager close at hand to solve any mishaps.

Ozone Blue is off the beaten path but worth finding! The food was very good, portions were generous, and the wait staff was very attentive. The calamari app was some of the best I've ever had and my drink was never more than half empty. It was loud the day we came in but there was a large party. Even if it was a little loud, it was nice to see how accommodating the restaurant was to that big party. I love that there is a pool too!!

We haven't been for a couple of years. It could be better by now. The food was just ok, nothing extraordinary. The bread was always good, but the red sauce was overpowered with with a herb that I didn't care for.
I had the Pad Thai, veg rolls and mango sticky rice. The Pad Thai was extremely tasty and you can never go wrong with mango sticky rice, friendly service.

Great new addition to the Southside. Pub Food, and full bar in a cozy setting on one side and family dining and games on the other. The staff is new but you would never know it. Friendly and knowledgable just like their downtown location.

One of the few (very few) places on South Street that are actually worth the dodge-a-douchebag game. Seriously, do tourists get a guidebook that explains in detail how to walk like a lost drunk on a cell phone, or is there just something special added to Jim's Steaks that no one's told me about?

Oh yes, frozen yogurt. It's good stuff, but kind of expensive. You get these huge cups, and who in their right mind isn't going to fill that up? There are too many choices of flavors and toppings, and no way can you try them all in one shot. I got peanut butter, cookies&cream, and original tart. All delicious, and mochi topping makes it complete.

You get one sample. One.

Awesome place to get some delicious pastries at very good prices! My family was surprised in how much we took for so little money! Love their Tres Leches cake, missed out on the Churros because they were sold out at 10am! Can't wait to go back!
My favorite steakhouse, awesome managers. I had one the best service ever from Natasha, great job, wonderful server!!

Recommended to try this place by a local uber driver. Said to have one of the best and biggest burgers/ baked potatoe in all of nola. Ordered the cheese burger, medium rare. 

The burgers size did live up to the hype. Unfortunately, I wasn't too crazy about the burger. The patty was alright. A bit large and when you bit down, it's just a mouthful of meat. The bun itself was really dry. But this type of bread seems to be very common in the nola area. I had something similar with the po'bo on bourbon. Just a local thing. Sadness, cause the bread is like eating dry styrofoam.

The place does however have a great live band/concert at night. I would suggest people come here for that. Fyi, there's a cover charge.

We have been going to Asian Taste since it opened and have always enjoyed the food and service.  That was until the owners son, Tony, left for college.  Tony took care of orders and the register even waiting on tables. His replacement is an older gentleman with a horrible attitude.  He has consistently messed up orders that we have called in and displays a argumentative attitude.  Tonight was the last visit for us as no one should have to put up with that especially good customers.

The renamed Laurel Lounge is wonderful.  For many years this Lounge was a sit down restaurant with menu service.  Now, it is a small buffet of delicious New Orleans style food.  My husband and I ate there four nights in a row and we were never disappointed.
Customer service is good and the waiter was very respectful. The drinks were so good and the food was amazing. I'm not from New Orleans but if I ever comeback. I would definitely come here again.
Just discovered this the other day for brunch. I had the gumbo. Very good !! And crazy cheap too at like $7. Oh.. and they have a big fruit spread (complimentary) while you wait.

Hawthorne's is alright. We went this summer during the dead of summer and waited about a half hour to be seated for brunch. They finally seated us and were prompt to give us mason jars of water but without ice! The whole place was out of ice, they told us. Also, the AC must not have been working because it seemed like it was in the mid 80's while we were eating. We sat, hungover, unable to cool off and sweat our way through brunch. The service was strung out way too thin, as you could see they were understaffed. The food took about an hour, but was GREAT once we got it. They also don't take credit cards, which we learned the hard way. The only good thing about this place is the food & the beer selection. The service aspect was a missing child the day we went.

We split the Hog platter between two people which was the perfect amount.  Total was $20 which included 4 ribs, pulled pork, BBQ brisket, a side of chicken as well as 2 sides (we chose bean and salad) and it also came with a slice of corn bread.

Ribs and the brisket was excellent. The pulled pork wasn't bad, but wasn't anything to write home about. The chicken was soft and tender. 

I love how  there are 6 different BBQ sauces to choose from on every table. 

The dining experience is quite casual. Order up front, seat your self and go up and retrieve your food when you number is called. 

Tons of award winning trophies are displayed which are impressive although on closer inspection I noticed that a lot of them are from about 14-16 years ago. Nothing too recent, but hey maybe they are settled down and concentrating on the restaurant business instead of traveling around and entering competitions.  I'm sure that is a ton of work and takes away from the time and effort it takes to properly run a restaurant.  

In summary, this is a very solid place for BBQ.  Probably not the best you will ever have but in terms of price, taste, portion size I think Whole Hog is pretty awesome. 

We'll be back.

I've been to Black Powder Tavern three times (I think) now, most recently for lunch yesterday afternoon after my grad school graduation, and it's been excellent each time.  The food is good, and the menu items are creative and interesting while still falling under the umbrella of standard American food that will appeal to broad tastes.  For example, nachos made with potato chips... A little different, but we put the same things on nachos that we put in baked potatoes, so why not?  The polenta fries, which come with a slightly spicy cheese dip, are great.  They also have a pretty good beer list, and while I've only had one cocktail there, it was well made.

All of the servers that I've had there have been very good.  They're friendly, accommodating, knowledgable about the menu, etc.  And they're attentive but don't get in the way if you want to sit back and have a conversation with those with whom you're dining.

And the environment is warm and comfortable.  Like the food, it's not cookie cutter, and it's interesting but basically classic.

Some of the other reviewers have complained about the prices.  There are cheaper places out there, but there are also more expensive ones.  I think that  it winds up running an average of about $20/person (you could keep it to $15 if you were consciously ordering cheaply, and obviously you could push it up somewhat if you're ordering the most expensive items, adding expensive or multiple drinks, and/or piling on appetizers).  Assuming that you've accepted that price point before going, I think that you'll be happy with what you get when you're there.  The food, service and environment are all good.
