The desserts looked fabulous as well. They had HUGE cookies (literally the size of my face) for $3. They had 3 flavors but none were plain chocolate chip which I was craving. We decided to go to Locally Grown Gardens instead for pie. 

I will definitely go back there again. I enjoyed my experience and the food was great. I will get the kung pao brown rice again and some other dishes.
Amazing food great atmosphere. The employees are very professional and friendly. Highly recommend it.

I love their food! It's a good place for a dinner after a soccer game, or to watch a football game. Their raspberry lemonade is to die for, and it has free refills! It's a little expensive but again, free refills so it evens out! It's a good place to eat out with friends or family too. I recommend The Greene Turtle!

Tried this place on a whim as I was in the area.  The place was clean and welcoming upon arriving.  Staff was friendly.  Ordered a nitro coffee, a chai latte and 4 macarons (2 white chocolate; 2 raspberry) for my wife and I.  

Here's where things took a turn.  In lieu of the nitro coffee, I received a cold brew and when asked was assured it was a nitro (okay, maybe you all do coffees a little different here).  Cold brew was good but not what I ordered. 
 
Checked with the wife, chai latte was great!  Exactly what she was looking for.

Opened the bag of macarons at the end of the evening.  Raspberry macarons were great!  Very tasty.  White chocolate macarons were...not white chocolate but cinnamon (they were okay...but again not what I ordered).  

Hoping this might just be the case of a new employee / barista.  Things happen.  Will give it one more try at some point and update this review post.

This week we finally were able to get into the Hearthside BYOB. Reservations are extremely hard to get (usually a month or more in advance) and we had our table of four lined up for quite some time.

There seems to be a few restaurants outside of Philadelphia and in South Jersey that are building great reputations. Hearthside is one of these and definitely lived up its high reviews and acclaim.

Collingswood still has Blue laws so the restaurant is BYOB. The atmosphere of the restaurant is very nice, simple and elegant. The kitchen is open and patrons can watch their meals being prepared. There are tables outside and some propane heaters. The menu consists of small, medium, and large plates. Sharing is encouraged.

What our table of four ordered:

Grilled octopus - butternut squash, palapa, hazelnuts 

Gulf prawns- garlic, chili, lemon, and parsley

Roasted Caesar-house croutons, parmesan, boquerones

40 oz. Prime Dry-aged Porterhouse-mixed mushrooms, leeks, crispy potatoes. This was large and shared by our part of four.

Everything we ordered was delicious and recommended without question. I cannot even begin to write how good everything was. Even the desserts were outstanding. We ordered the carrot cake and a coconut milk panna cotta. Service was attentive, knowledgable, and friendly. He explained everything in perfect detail. Our water glasses were topped off regularly and our server ensured our wine glasses were full.

The wait for the Hearthside was well worth it and we already want ti go back to try the other menu items. 

Truly 5 Yelp Stars

Hot chicken sandwich, am Italian pizza (thin crust) , 2 pibbs $38.
Best chick sand I hav ever had. Pie was simply delicious.
We will b bak!
Oh beside the restaurant is an area to buy tie dye tees. $25 ea.
The food is amazing and the people are nice too  I got the chicken tikka masala, butter naan and samosas and omg it was delicious.

My husband and I used to always pass this interesting looking restaurant on the right side of Swan Road during our nightly race home to our old place, we've since moved, and have always said " we'll stop there next Friday". Or course next Friday never seemed to come, as goes the game of life. Today we declared this Friday shall be the day we finally see what it's all about 

On arrival I cannot get over the energy of this place; patrons socializing, staff being as professional as they can be, and a birthday party taking advantage of the crisp cool Tucson evening.  I'm in love with this place already and I have yet to sample their wares.  We're seated promptly and I put an order of calamari for our appetizer, coke and diet coke for our base drinks and wouldn't you know- they have Peroni on tap here too, we can't resist. 

Calamari arrives within ten minutes, crisp and hot in the center, cool horseradish and spicy marinara dipping sauces on the side, perfect complement to the dish's chewy goodness.  I order the Salmon Sorrento and my husband orders the special, some gnocchi dish.  

My salmon dish is epic, perfect flakiness without the dryness that salmon could easily succumb to, the chef is a professional with fish.  Unfortunately my husband's dish doesn't sit too well with him.  Nothing foul with the entree itself mind you, just wasn't his kind of flavor.  The manager offers to bring him a dish to keep his satisfaction, he orders the same salmon entree I ordered, did I mention the chef is a genius with fish?   

My husband is happy with his replaced entree and I treat myself to a second Peroni, and all is well with our night out.  I would like to extend my sincerest thanks to the manager and our server, who was an awesome young man who went above the call of duty to see to our satisfaction.  We will definitely return soon and partake of another dish of goodness in a very chic setting.  We highly recommend Vero Amore, which I am glad to report, truly lives up to its name.

I was very excited to try this restaurant & came for restaurant week with my co-workers. I'd give the food an 8/10 but the service was terrible. We arrived at 12PM & didn't even get bread until 12:30. By the time we got our meals, it was 1PM and we had to speed through & get dessert to-go to make it back to the office in time. It should not take that long to serve a party of 5. Our dishes were quite simple too. They didn't seem apologetic either. A place this pricey should have better service, even if it IS restaurant week.

My husband and I recently visited on my birthday. The food was so good and the prices are great. I had yellowtail with creamed spinach, and muscles in broth. My husband had fish and chips. The breading was golden and light. So good! Our new favorite place!

It's a little neighbourhood joint near the Airbnb where I was staying. We decided to check it out and it was worth it. the pizza was great and its very big. I might just be saying that because I'm Canadian and I'm not used to these type of portions but the pizza was quite large. It was delicious and they have a good variety of beers to choose from.

This place was recommended by a street vendor. She said the crab cake were "to die for" and she was right. 
Can't wait to go back.
Was super surprised to see this is owned by an old classmate from high school today! The drinks I had were both so strong and the food was awesome :)

Rob was our waiter & he was fantastic!!!  He made the night by bringing a special dessert for our son and to be DIL (13 days) 
The food was awesome! 
(Orange Chicken, Nashville Hot Chicken, Pork-loin, Nachos & a German Pretzel!!)
Beer choices are great. Long Island Ice Tea good. 
Went after a Colts game! Highly recommend!

My wife and I have been looking for a decent Filipino restaurant around Philadelphia, luckily we found Manila Cafe. We called ahead to let them know to heat up the BBQ. They close at 7pm but were nice enough to stay open for us. We ordered chicken adobo, fried milk fish and pork sinigang. The food tasted fresh and home made just like mom/dad made. Try the empanadas, it was GREAT! We also order Filipino sasperella(Sarsi) to finish off the meal with an authentic drink. I was so full that i didn't get to order Filipino desserts like Halo-Halo or Turon. The cafe was nice and clean. The owners were very friendly and helpful. 

i definitely will return!

This salumeria is without a DOUBT as authentic and as real as anything you will see anywhere.

I frequented this place for the 5 years I lived in St. Louis, before moving back to NYC.

The meats and cheeses are imported or made locally and are excellent.

The salsiccia is some of the best I ever had and the staff is friendly, and have no problem letting you sample whatever you want.

Tell Armando I said hi.

Enjoy!!!!!!!!!

Another delicious lunch with my friend Marisol.  The photos speaks for itself as coming back from a long vacation from Asia is not easy as jet lag kicks in and having a quality sashimi and sushi from their menu really brightens our day of catching up.  Happy lunch!
The band was great. A couple is hired to dance. Don't worry about any signage about drink minimum. Bartenders likely to ignore you. Bring your own booze and tip the band.

Good place for healthy (or healthier) fast food. The salads are ok. I really enjoy their sandwiches, pastries and hot chocolate. It's tough to get a table for lunch. You are better off eating here for dinner or a late lunch. Their WiFi connection depends on how many customers are using at one time. If the place is empty, you're in good shape. If a lot of people are working online, the connection can be spotty at times.

The staff is very friendly. They could do a better job wiping down the tables though. I understand that this could be difficult because so many patrons are arriving and leaving. However, as a customer with a laptop, you don't want to have to worry about setting your laptop on a table with the remnants of someone else's lunch.
Buffet with a great variety of delicious food. Signature drinks to go with the standard price for the buffet with lively music outside. Had so much fun.

This place has a very clean atmosphere, and the location and layout are perfect. Even on the busiest days I have always found room to sit, and I like that you have plenty of time to decide on what you would like to order before you get up to the register-- they have menus available beside the line. There is also a milkshake bar located up in front of the kitchen. 

I have ordered the harvest sandwich most of the time because it's so dang good. I'm a sucker for sandwiches with squash in them. It's really filling as well, and I don't need a side to feel full. I've tried the grilled cheeses my friends have ordered before, and the harvest also tastes the least greasy, which I imagine is something more difficult to accomplish in the grilled cheese business!

We visited Tavern on New Years Eve and had quite an enjoyable experience. We kicked off our visit by participating in the special where you are given two tokens and can cash them in for your next drink whenever you finish your first - the drinks were quite delicious! Our party started with the Maple Fondue plate to share because we were all pretty intrigued by the red velvet waffle. Overall the plate was delicious, especially the sausage! The red velvet waffle might have been better as a full meal (the Red Velvet Waffle with cream cheese drizzle) as it tasted similar to a regular waffle with the maple syrup. I had the Local Ham & Cheese omelet with white trash hash. The omelet is pretty large and was very flavorful, however, the white trash hash was surprisingly more on the mild side (or so I thought). I think I would have more enjoyed the grilled spicy chicken sausage. Overall, the atmosphere was a lot of fun and our server was delightful! Looking forward to returning to this location during our next Nashville visit!

Well I wanted Hot Chicken. I got what I wanted! This place is the kind of place you'd pass by and not glance at but why's inside is incredible! I eat extremely spicy food and there extra spicy had me in tears. The catfish is fantastic! 10/10 will be back!

This restaurant/jazz bar is AMAZING. Now don't get me wrong, it's also pricy but worth it. 

My fiancée and I went for our 1 year anniversary. We bought the tickets for the show (25.00 each) ahead of time. The show was at 9:00, but we got there at 8:00 and sat at the bar. They started seating at 8:30. 

Everyone was kind and welcoming from the moment you arrived, to the moment you left. We ordered probably a total of 6 drinks, 2 appetizers (shrimp and corn bread, very good) our main meal (fried chicken and salmon. The salmon was very small, but the sides made up for it; the fried chicken delicious) and dessert (chocolate moose with Toffee pieces) to DIE for, so delicious. 

The show was beautiful, amazing, so romantic. The chairs and the seating arrangement though, tight. I'm a plus sized woman, and I was a little cramped but it was all worth it! You cannot get up and dance, but the music is so relaxing and amazing; why would you want to. 

My fiancée and I had a magical time; but after the tickets, the meal, tip and tax it was about a 200.00 night easy. 

We most likely will be returning for another beautiful occasion. This was perfect.

Pretty pretty PLEASE add a location in Sierra Vista! Too far? Okay, how about Benson? I'll meet you half way! 

This is my priority stop for Mahi-mahi fish tacos! I love the Blanco ones as well, but no one can resist these!! Excellent choice. They make the original San Diego fish tacos proud! Atmosphere is festive but dated furniture. Salsa bar is great! 

I love introducing locals to this place, it's like they are all clueless to the great food in their backyards! What's up with that?? Enjoy.

Awesome chill coffee shop that attracts lefties, students, and working stiffs. There's a dog walking around. Good selection of teas and pastries. Mix of people with books, laptops, and friends. Great place for a cold day.

Not really a fan of large corporate run chain restaurants. Panera Bread didn't change my opinions at all, breakfast was expensive, portions were small, and tasted bad. The hospital cafeteria has better food than this place, and that's saying something

This is by far my sushi spot in tampa. It will please any kind of sushi lover. I am more of a specialty roll kind of person with the new tampa roll being my fave but I have tried at least half of them. My boyfriend goes for more of the nigiri but also loves their rainbow roll. All in all I love this place!

Most amazing Creole food.  Everything was outstanding, and with a prix-fixe menu it's enough to make you yelp for joy!  

If you're like me and love cheese, the gorgonzola tart is a good way to get the engines running, although it is very sharp and cheesy.  For the entree there are so many good options I was really torn, but the BBQ Shrimp were buttery and DI-VINE. Everyone else was raving about theirs; it's so hard to settle on one favorite.  And for the finale, you can never never go wrong with chocolate cake, pair it with raspberries and you've reached nirvana.

The staff was so gracious and welcoming they made the place feel intimate, perfect for the special occasion we were celebrating. These guys know what they're doing, and it's soo worth it.

So, curiousity got me to this place as I'd never been to a Chick Fil A before. The fact that every time I drove by it was packed seemed like a good sign too.

The experience brought back memories of being one of those young, bright eyed, fast food employees. Yes, I worked at McDonalds here in town and it was a great experience. The kids that are working here all seem to be enjoying their jobs and that was nice to see. 

I am now on a quest to try and replicate this at home. I mean really? How hard is it to make a pounded chicken breast, breaded and fried on a soft roll with two dill pickle chips?!

Very average restaurant.  I ordered a drink that came out wrong twice.  I ended up not having a drink.  I sent my sushi back because it did not taste fresh.  It was sort of mushy.  I went in hungry and thirsty and left the same way.  My family liked their meals but I will not go back.

I love this place and it is my go to takeout place.
The wings are very good , pretty consistent and have great choices in sauces.
They are always quick and do deliver , but I have never chose to have food delivered.
I mainly order wings, fries , their chicken cheesesteak & regular cheesesteaks.
A few choices of fry styles which is different.
Their extra hot sauce is super hot and I love it, their hottest sauce is not for anyone but an expert .
Almost forgot that our favorite item here is their boneless wings, really good .
Definitely recommend.

Copious amounts of beer and other libations always proceed me making the less than though tout decision to eat from Hungry Howie's

This trip was not exception we were even making beer! It was not but 400 feet from my friends house so I gave in and decided to give it a try.

One large pizza with feta and a order or cheesy bread was $20, long gone are the days of the $4 pick up deal.  The pizza is now gourmet as they put stuff on the crust, we tried sesame seeds.  The pizza overall is too fast and bread like and the sauce lacks flavor. The cheesy bread was good but greasy. for $20 I was disappointed.

If you are in this area and too far gone to drive then stager in for a pizza otherwise go somewhere good.

My husband & I returned to Juniper for the first time in a couple years and we were blown away by their new location in the CWE! 

We went early on a Friday night & were seated right away! The modern homey southern aesthetic of the place is so on point. And they've got that southern hospitality to match the food they serve. Everyone was so friendly & helpful!

We started with the fried green tomatoes. They're served with a yummy mustard sauce & we added some of their house made hot sauce per our server's recommendation and YUM. That hot sauce could make anything delicious. We also ordered the bread basket- this is a must order for anyone!!! We loved it all, but the biscuit was one of the best I've ever had. It's served with a delicious garlic butter and an apple butter. 

For the main, we had to go with the fried chicken! It's not the best I've had in St. Louis, but they cooked it perfectly. What we ended up fighting over was the augratin potatoes! Next to the bread basket, this was my favorite thing that we ordered; they are so cheesy and delicious and served in a tiny cast iron, so does it get better than that!?

We loved our dinner at Juniper! I would definitely recommend this place for southern food loving friends & would come back in a heartbeat for more of that bread.

I live in the neighborhood but had waited a long time to try this newest version of the seemingly ever-changing restaurant at the corner of Jackson & Pershing.  I really wanted the restaurant to be great.  Some of it was very good, some of it was not so good.

First the bad.  When we arrived at 6:00 p.m. on a Saturday night, the only other customers were one other family of 6.  They had taken the only large table, so we had to push two tall round bar tables together to sit which was not ideal for children.  But the next thing that happened actually made me laugh out loud--the waitress said they didn't have enough menus and could only give us two menus because the other table was still using theirs.  I couldn't imagine how a restaurant could not expect or plan for more than eight customers at a time on a Saturday night, but the waitress was unapologetic about it, so maybe that's a usual thing?  Finally, about one fourth of the menu entrees are pizzas but.......wait for it......no pizza was available because they didn't get any dough delivered that day.

The service was not as bad as others have described.  It was attentive and friendly enough, but there was an unapologetic quality about it--sort of a 'oh well, what do you expect?' kind of attitude that was--how shall I say--unusual.  The calamari appetizer was just okay--a bit over greasy. 

Now the good.  The little kids loved their spaghetti and meatballs and especially the gelato for dessert.  The older kids loved their croque monsieur sandwiches with sweet potato fries.  And the adults loved their entrees:  lamb kabobs and an ahi tuna sandwich.  The wine was reasonably priced and good.  The total bill was not exorbitant for a family of 6.

In sum, I guess I just wish they'd try a little harder.  With just a few small changes, Bici could be a great neighborhood restaurant.

This place smells and tastes like 5 stars every single day. 

Love their turkey Cobb sandwich. I go gaga over their monkey bread. Just about everything is good here. Honest. Check it out.

7 years after my last review of them, and let me take the opportunity to upgrade them for two reasons. 

One, the food merits it. My wife raved about the Huevos Rancheros. I raved about the smoked pork omelette which had a real nice smoke to the meat. And my boy loved the chocolate chip pancake. 

I must say that pancake deserves special mention. It comes off the grill with the perfect balance of crispness and fluffiness. 

Second, the staff has an attitude, and I mean that in the best way. Genuinely friendly and a little sarcastic. Perfect for Delco.

Okay..i'm not sure if I was that hungry or it was really that good!
 Was driving by and decided to try them...did a regular cheese burger with everything on it and it was amazing!!!
  I think it was a manager at the counter that took the order and she was so nice!
   Burger was really really good and it's definitely somewhere i'll be coming back to again!!!!

Today's experience left me a little hot under the collar. Although I am still a fan of Sasha's delicious salmon & trout crepe, trendy decor, extensive wine selections and it's gorgeous Demun location....the service has got to be better! The same flamboyant (bold) bartender/server who waited on me my previous visit waited on me today as well. He does not say "hello", he does not say "goodbye", he does not say "thank you", he does not ask if "everything is alright", he does not inquire if you "need anything else".

In short he does nothing aside from place the order and deliver it to the table. This could be a personal experience; I did notice he was a bit more social with other patrons on both occasions. I'm not certain if they are regulars, friends or just the right color.  Whatever the case it made me extremely uncomfortable. I enjoyed my crepe and even though I wanted to ask for other items I refrained from calling him over to make any additional requests. 
After dropping my food off he never returned. I even had to get up to ask him for my check. Then I had to get up to give him the check so I could finalize my stay and carry on with my day. 

The next time I visit this Sasha's location; if I decide to visit again at all, I'm running for my life if this guy is working. It's a shame for such a great spot to have left such a bad taste in my mouth. Service over everything!

~Christy

PROS: Live piano, large portions, tasty fish tacos
CONS: Crappy service, long waits

The food was okay --- slightly above average bar fare that took 30 minutes to get to us.  The appetizer and main entrees came together. Our water was never refilled. The waitress almost completely ignored us and forgot to bring the condiments we asked for. The piano was fun but got boring after a while.

Becoming my go-to spot to take out of town guests for a dinner and drinks before heading out on the town.

Good menu that everyone can find something they like.

The service is ALWAYS fantastic.
Awesome new sushi place! Very friendly staff and quick service. Rotating, fresh, small sushi plates! Also an excellent regular sushi menu as well. Prices are reasonable. I loved it here.

Excellent service and food. I had the pappardelle bolognese and my partner had the filet with mushroom ragout. Not a scrap of food left behind. Attentive and friendly service by Adrian. We will return!

We took shelter here during a passing downpour on the 4th of July. We were outside next door at old city beer garden. We actually met the owner outside who told us about it like "if it rains, you can just go next door to my place," which originally sounded very nice, but I soon realized it was just a really good way to get more customers. 

They have $2 tequila shots on Tuesdays, so that's neat. 

The restroom was extremely filthy. It's downstairs, and the stairs take up a lot of space in relation to the size of the building itself. 

The bar also takes up a good amount of space and only leaves an awkwardly small amount of space (across from the stairs) during busy times. I didn't go too far back, only stayed near the front. 

I would not return unless it were pouring again.

This is a decent place for the quick meal. Overall this place is small, seems like a family run business. The owners are really nice and friendly, anyways I ordered the Buffalo Chicken Sub, which was really good, the sub was fresh, the chicken was cooked to refection, the only negative I would say is that a little more flavor would have made it great, the flavor was mild for my taste. Besides that the restaurant was clean, the price was reasonable and the staff was really friendly.
Loved this place. Delicious meal, well presented, carefully crafted flavor combinations.  Well worth the price for a nice meal in a cozy atmosphere.  Will be back for sure.

So my wife hyped this place up since she had it for lunch one day. I definitely like a good burger. So we ordered and she got the fried mushrooms. We wasted money on that, the things on the burger was good but the meat itself was dissappointing. Thin, tasteless, and overcooked. Will not go there again.

El Rey is one of my favorite Mexican places in Philly. I have been coming here for years and I'm glad they're still running with the current restrictions as well. They offer outdoor dining- I would definitely recommend making a reservation on open table. They provide paper and QR code menus.  The menu is a bit more limited, but still has great options. As a vegetarian, I'm always impressed by the options I have at El Rey. We got a queso fundido for the table, which was absolutely delicious with the warm melted cheese and mushrooms. My friend and I got the eggplant enchiladas, with smoky enchiladas and some delicious (vegetarian) black beans and rice. Another friend got the seafood fajitas and thought they were seasoned very well. I got a classic margarita, which was pretty strong. Overall, a great place with delicious food and vegetarian friendly options.

Not the best place to eat. Husband decided to go there because the had fried calamari. It ended up being glorified fish sticks. The hot wings were okay. Based on the other reviews we decided to give this place a try. More than likely we won't go back. On a positive note though, the waitress was very sweet and helpful!

Stumbled into here on Monday after dinner in search of a nice drink and vibe. In no way was this planned out beforehand. 

What a find! Right on the main strip of DTSP and quite unassuming from the outside. Walking in you get the feeling of a speakeasy style restaurant. We sat at the bar right where the drinks are prepared. 

It truly showed the craftsmanship of a cocktail served by someone who takes pride in serving a perfected drink.

I got the Coochi Cutter and Michael got the Fall Forward (which the bartender said was his favorite)

Definitely want to go back to try more unique cocktails

This was a fun and unique experience. Our book club met here and it was nice to have all the food on the table so we could serve ourselves family style. 

The chicken was delicious, as were most of the vegetables. I was less than impressed with dessert, but it wasn't horrible.

Service was great-friendly and timely.

This place stinks. Literally. When you walk in you get the aroma of cheese. Once you are seated, you smell TOE cheese or maybe just OLD cheese. Please get new carpet, reupholster the booths and slap some paint on the walls. The stench is nauseating.

Don't bother using their waitlist online. I put my name in before leaving my house, it said it was a 36-40 minute wait and I was 21st in line. It dropped to 12th in line by the time I parked (20 minute drive). I figured once it dropped to 4th in line I would walk in and wait in the lobby. I watched multiple parties leave and it only dropped down to 8th in line over the next 30 minutes. I thought, maybe they take walk ins first. Sure enough, we go in, put our name in and 5 minutes later get showed to a table. Meanwhile the waitlist still had me as 8th in line. Not sure why there was even a wait... there were multiple empty tables and booths. Which sat unoccupied our entire meal.

I ordered a Watermelon Sangria. I was brought a Watermelon Margarita. That's fine, I like tequila, no big deal.

I ordered their limited time only Giant Meatball with Spaghetti. It looked like someone ate the one side. Then I realized it was made with an entire loaf of bread, so maybe it was just crumbling apart. Maybe. To be honest, the only reason I ordered it was for an Instagram worthy photo but that didn't happen since it looked like it rolled down the stairs.

The only reason I didn't give one star is because I like the breadsticks. I think I'd eat here again, but only for lunch - for the Unlimited Soup, Salad and Breadsticks. After renovations.

My friend came to visit me from Miami, and we stopped here for a late-night meal. This place is on the busiest street ever, and it's swarming with drunk people. My friend and I were actually sober, and we politely greeted the cashier when it was our turn to order. But my friend asked a forbidden question: "do you have any jalapeño chips?" Apparently, they did, but "in the back." The cashier made a super rude comment about how she had to go find his chips while there was a long line of people waiting. When she came back, I told her I didn't appreciate her attitude, she replied with, "I don't really care!" The other employees who were making our pitas were justifying her behavior by saying she was overwhelmed and that we had never worked in the service industry, so we wouldn't understand (meanwhile, my friend has worked at Arby's, at a pizza place, and as a bartender; I think he would understand, and that's why people shouldn't make comments if they don't know what they're talking about). Pitas were okay, but the employees' attitude really killed it for us. Being "overwhelmed" shouldn't be an excuse to treat people poorly.

Been here twice since they opened. Love the changes. I brought my family for dinner and their was something for everyone. Great place to watch sports and some 40 plus beers on tap. The salmon dinner and salmon BLT was delicious. My girls loved the cheese bites, Caesar salad and the white flatbread pizza. Check out Tucson's newest restaurant. We will be hanging out here.

This has slowly become my favorite bar and grill in the St Louis area. Even not living in the immediate area, it is always worth the trip! Great food, great tap selections, and great service all at a seriously reasonable price. Awesome neighborhood bar, but definitely worth stopping in no matter what part of the city youre from!

I came here a while ago and decided to come back after I was reminded of the place. I thought the place was good last time but couldn't remember too well. After today I'm wondering why it's been so long since I've come back. I got the pulled pork sandwich which was very good. Messy, but very good. The cabbage gives a little crispness that enhances the sandwich. I got the gumbo for a side and it was also very good. 

Although I didn't get a cocktail, since I had to go back to work, they looked good. I will definitely try one next time.

Went for an Eagles game - their fan club meets there.  Had great service and beer bucket specials.  I got the combo platter with mozzarella sticks, potato skins, and chicken fingers.  The chicken fingers were AMAZING!  I'd definitely go back here to watch a game - tons of TVs & good sports bar atmosphere.

I got the Pecan crusted halibut and it was amazingly scrumptious delicious awesomeness.   Whatever the buttery sauce was that comes with it literally made fireworks go off inside of me when I ate it.  

My wife had the Kansas City strip steak and it also was really good.  Her sauce was a red wine reduction and it was also incredible.  

We had the Parker station Pino Noir red wine and it was smooth and delicious.
Love this place I've never been inside the restaurant. I've only ordered delivery and it is always well worth it. My new number one place to go for phó.

Don't expect an eye pleasing building, great dining area, or any individual customer service.  This is not that type of place.  Just walk in order your Sonoran hotdog, eat, and I bet you will want to eat one more.  Very good Sonoran dog!

This has to be the single worst McDonald's in America. Extraordinarily long wait times, cold food, and ultimately an odd Chicken product that wasn't on the menu. Stale cheeseburger, cash only,  no chicken nuggets even though we ordered chicken nuggets. No Big Mac sauce on the Big Mac.  Probably worth avoiding.

Walking up to a cute older home set the mood more an intimate dinner. We were greeted and seated promptly.  The only bad thing about being in an older home is the bathroom is on the lower level.  Our server was okay, he was pushy to have us order quick.  I told him three times we wanted to wait and then he came back with "well you better get your order in soon or the kitchen will back up."  We were in on a Tuesday and there was only one other couple in our room.  

We like to eat our meal in stages so we first started with the wonderful cocktails at Husk.    We had oysters and griddle cakes for an appetizer.  The oysters seemed fresh right off the boat.   The griddle cakes were just okay, I wouldn't get them again.

We then had the shrimp and grits which was amazing.  It had a great flavor and right amount of spice.   We then had the steak and potatoes.  It was very good as well!  We were too full to have any dessert :( but they all looked delicious. 

I'd recommend going, make sure to make a reservation!!
I should have just eaten the box it came in. Yes, it is just that bad. Whoever it is that invented pizza would shoot the person who made the pie I attempted to eat.
So: colonial; outside, inside, the bones of foundation, the alleys, the frame and timbers, inside and out are veneered with kitsch while the old bones rest beneath. What a difference!

We are big fans of Ritz Carlton and always try to stay at one when we travel domestically and abroad. Last evening, we stayed at this Ritz for the first time. The location and grounds are beautiful and everyone is very polite and nice. However, I found that the service was not up to the standards of a typical Ritz experience. My dinner was not cooked right and I did not get a chance to tell someone until 15 minutes after it was delivered. The waitress just never checked on us. She said "I'm sorry." We asked for a dessert menu three times and each time they forgot. The server said, "I'm sorry." This morning we had breakfast in the room and called to have them pick up the tray of food since the birds were going after it on the balcony. Once again, it took three calls to get the tray picked up. Each time, when I called, they simply said "I'm sorry." Finally, we had lunch at the Bistro before leaving and we ordered appetizers before our lunch. Well, the appetizers never came and we finally got our food. The server simply said "I'm sorry." I love the Ritz Carlton where the brand promise is "Ladies and Gentlemen serving Ladies and Gentlemen." However, I left this property thinking the tagline was "I'm sorry." It is nice to say "I'm sorry" but it is not a get out of jail free card for poor service. Please step it up. We are schedule to arrive again this Thursday evening on the way back home. I hope it is better. Thank you.

Went here with the wife and newborn son.  Will definitely be back.  Came for lunch, which they have a series of "cafeteria-style" options that come with two side.

I got the lamb shank, which was solid, and my wife got the ropa vieja, which was similarly solid.  For the side, we got tostones (A+), broccoli (B+), creamed spinach (B+), and last but certainly not least was the SMOKED GOUDA MAC & CHESSE (WOW).  It simply stole the show.

We also got picked up some bread (a Cuban loaf and 6 Media Noche rolls) -- they were perfect.  We also got three A+ desserts:
- Guava Butter Cake
- Coconut custard something.
- Pineapple upside down cake.

The place is huge -- if you are going for the first time, walk around the place, see everything, including what others are eating, then make your choice.

The cafeteria lunch prices are high (about $12.50, but definitely generous portions).  

Service all the way around was high.

We will be back.
Great little Viet cafe. I come here to get my Mi Quang fix. I have had Mi Quang in Danang and this is as good if not better. More flavor in my opinion. The banh mi are the best in the region.

Met another couple for dinner here at Kona Grill, good service attentive waiter and even the manager checked on us after we got our food.  For an appetizer we had the calamari, which had a good spicy sauce with it but the calamari was only so-so and included way too many of the tentacle pieces which were dried out.  Shared the macadamia nut chicken full order and they split it on 2 plates, as you can see in the pictures it was more than enough food for two people, very impressive flavor and the gravy and mango sauce that comes with it take this entrée over the top. Ordered a side Cesar to split as well before the meal, it to was so-so and was very small and unimpressive in size. The couple we met each had the Asian chicken salad's, they appeared very large and they enjoyed them and even took some home. Overall good experience, surprisingly not as loud as we thought it would be and were able to talk freely at our table without too much background noise annoying us.

Ordered lunch delivery on a busy Saturday while I was working from home. Delivery was prompt and within the time range I expected. Ordering online charges convenience fees from the ordering platform, and there's a hefty minimum charge for delivery but hey, it's nice to indulge every once in a while.

I had the General Tso's chicken lunch special. Outstanding value, comes with the meat, pork fried rice (that yellow fried rice that many restaurants use), and a can of soda. To meet the minimum ordering requirements, I also ordered krab rangoon and Chinese donuts.

Everything was hot and delicious when it arrived to me. The chicken had the most depth of flavor I've had from a Chinese takeout restaurant. You could taste the difference from being cooked in a real wok. The rangoon was also nice, with a flaky, crispy exterior and a tasty filling. The Chinese donuts were also good but I was pretty full by then.

Every place I live I try to find a go to Chinese restaurant. I usually settle for an okay experience, but I'm happy to have found Great Wall and will not be settling when I pick them in the future.

(Unfortunately I was too busy with work to take photos...next time!)

The food is well seasoned and tasty, the portions are nicely sized. the quality is good. Everything was served hot and together. This pick up order for six was ready in 25 minutes. Egg Fo Yung was the best I've had in awhile, had good flavor and not heavy; gravy was not overly salty and not greasy at all. Happy Family was a nice mix of meats and veggies. We'll do carry out again.

Exceptionally poor and coldly indifferent customer service (especially the tall older gentleman, who seems as though he couldn't possibly care less if you ever come back). They rarely answer their phone and when they do, don't expect to be treated well. This makes it impossible to order take out and on top of that, just because it's on the menu doesn't necessarily mean they will feel like making it that day so if you drive there for take out, you're rolling the dice. The female staff are very friendly and attentive so it's hit or miss.

Well.  Here we are. Another burger chain implanted into a city (Tucson) which already HAS several great places to get a burger!  Not unlike many others...Blake's was way under par.  
Upon our arrival, we noticed that the parking lot was unusually small.  Only 12 spots and 2 were reserved for drive thru waiting.  We wondered why so few spots....then were immediately answered.  They really don't need any spots at all.  The food is THAT BAD!
One of the things that made the visit bearable was the French fries.  There were regular and seasoned and both were quite good.  But that was about it.  We had fairly high hopes since the food took so long to come out.  We suspected they were crafting the absolute freshest of burgers and perfecting each order to ensure a positive dining experience....wrong.  The bread was stale, the burgers were tough and flavorless and it still took nearly 20 minutes to come out.  
The bottom line is: if you're gonna go to all the trouble to taking your franchise to a glorious city of food such as ours, it really needs to be amazing!  I don't see either location lasting long.

Wow, man! This show was out of this world! Just stopped in for another great show at Mayfield Dinner Theatre, Hair, and was blown away again. 

Walking in the staff at the Mayfield Dinner Theatre is so professional, and processes everyone quickly into the hall. Doors open at 6, and there is already a line up to get in! Why? THE FOOD! Oh man, the food. But they get you in fast and on your way to the buffet. When you hear buffet, it's usually met with skeptical looks and visions of stagnant food, but the food at the Mayfield Dinner Theatre is AMAZING! Hot and fresh, because the team moves so fast to keep up with the appetites of the guests! You have two hours to fill your belly with an assortment of meat, veg, salads, seafood and more! The team they have there is simply outstanding. The only thing better than the perfectly cooked beef is the desserts. Oh man, the desserts. This time my fave was the pumpkin cheesecake. So yes. 

Then the show. Hair was breathtaking. Such a powerful show, and the fearless cast performing it did the story justice. Some of the lead voices gave me goosebumps while they sang. The use of the stage by the huge cast and band was so impressive. It gave such a close and intimate feeling to the group. We're so lucky to have this quality of productions available to our community. I hope to go back again some time during the run of the show! 

Peace.

What a great Boise Secret! My friend and I are always up for a new place to try. When we stumbled upon this, we were astounded! They have wonderful service, a great beer selection,  and a happy hour that many local businesses can't compete with (serving size, preparation, price). we had a great time and will definitly come back! Thank you Highland Hollow!
Slowest service of any sonic I've ever been to every single time. Drive through is the worst.

Good food, they are a little on the high aide but the portions are according to the price. If you go hungry there is something wrong with you. Friendly service and good food. Restaurant also look really clean.

I have had this place bookmarked for some time now but just never made my way here thinking it was more of a small bites with a drink place and not a meal spot, but after talking about this place with a buddy and looking at more Yelp photos decided to give it a try. 

We came here for a light dinner before a UNR game. They two guys working the place greeted us immediately and got us menus. A lil bit later one came back and asked if we would like to order a drink. I went with the Tenaya Creek Hefeweizen which was f$&@ing delicious and the fiancé with the classic mule. We also placed and order for the Fry Basket and per the waiters suggestion went half tots and half fries (which were more like wedges). They came out piping hot and were good but over salted. 

For our entree I ordered their special Bondiola Sandwich (thin sliced port shoulder with a bunch of goodness) and she had their chicken breast sandwich. I enjoyed my sandwich and would order it again. She on the other had not so much. The chicken was heavily over salted and honestly might have even been a lil under cooked at parts. Not their best work. 

Overall, It pains me to give them 3 stars but the salt was just to much. I will be back and hopefully be able to edit this review because the menu was fun, the beer was great, and the two guys were very polite. The salt was just to much.
Cold and Dry Chicken and Rib Tips are full of fat and cartilidge.

Hands down the best Mexican establishment in the area. Always worth the 30min drive out of Indy. Great prices and delicious entrees. Salsa is prepared better here than most as well. Always a great authentic taste =] "hidden gem" would definitely recommend to all friends and family.
Always seems to be new or rotating flavors. Haven't had one I didn't like. Pretty amazed we have a quality plant-based ice cream spot in DTSP! Yay, thanks for being here!

Sagami is a rare place in that the food is as impressive as the service and the service is as impressive as the food. 

The atmosphere is warm and inviting, the food is impeccable, and the staff so attentive and accomodating.

Went here for my anniversary dinner and it was the BEST gluten free place ever! Our server was incredibly knowledgeable about Celiac disease and answered my silly questions with such kindness. Service was fantastic even with a packed house.

Excellent authentic cuisine. Everything was fresh and freshly prepared I got the mixed fajita plate and it was scrumptious - I also got the tripe and it is a must experience! Friendly servers but my companion requests that they put English subtitles because he lovely server did not speak much English. Nachos were excellent - the homemade sauces are mild (spicy), medium (hot) and hot ( will combust if not careful) and are great as well. Huge portions - a fajita platter and a nacho platter could easily feed three people but leave room for the flan!  They serve beer and these magnificent looking drinks that I shall explore next time. This is a small friendly place with good food! Try it you can't go wrong!

In the Hyatt by the Arch, a bunch of us workers stayed here and did a dinner here.  It was nice, very good service.
A bit pricy but its a hotel bar/resturant so what do you expect?

They had good beers on tap and the food was solid.  A ton of TV's and we asked them to change some TVs to watch what we wanted and they obliged no problem

If I came back to the Hyatt, I would probably eat and drink here again, especially if there were sports on.

Stumbled upon this place across the street from our hotel we were staying at on a bachelorette weekend.  The line was out the door, so we figured why not.  OMG! I got the chicken spicy and the pimento mac and cheese.  The fact that the chicken isn't a saucy spicy, it's within the rub, makes it super easy to eat.  The mac and cheese...to die for.  I'm a fan of anything pimento cheese related. I had enough for leftovers and took a box to go to stick in our mini fridge for later.  Later that night, I chowed on my leftovers cold and it was just as good.  A must visit easy counter service place in Nashville!

From the price $$$& to the food. From the down home service to the size of the dining room. This place rocks. It knocks it out of the ballpark when it comes to that good ole fashioned Chinese that you dream of when you think "Chinese". I absolutely love this place. Great lunch specials and very generous portions. "The" spot to go when you've that hankering for some dank Chinese food.

Looking for an independent coffee place? Dash into Coffee Junkiez. They have a drive thru or indoor seating. I've never walked into the building but I have driven thru a couple times and each time my drinks were fine.  I do necessarily have a sweet tooth preferring mainly flat white type drinks. I've had the caramel macchiato and the salted caramel. I'd order both again anytime.  
The staff are friendly and efficient. 
Give 'em a shot! We need more independent coffee houses!

My husband and I stayed here for a quick babymoon before the birth of our second child. I will not say it was a horrible experience; however, we had a good time IN SPITE of our stay at the Opryland Hotel and certainly not because of it. 

Pros:  The scenery is lovely. We enjoyed chatting by the waterfalls and exploring the conservatories. The cleaning service was impeccable. The beds were comfortable. The shops were charming.  Because I was quite pregnant at the time, it was convenient to be able to stay at the hotel the entire time and still have plenty to see and do. 

Cons:  Unfortunately, the cons far outweigh the pros and I certainly wish I would have done a little more research before settling on this "resort" for our last vacation before the baby's arrival.  

The costumer service left much to be desired.  When we pulled in, my husband went to drop me off at the door. We were barked at by a parking attendant and sent to a Self-Pay lot near the Cascades canopy.  This put me still having to walk from that entrance to the hotel check-in which is what my husband had been attempting to avoid. It then took over a half an hour to check in as there were only two employees at the counter checking in a HUGE line of guests at the beginning of a holiday weekend. On the second day of our stay, we got turned around and ended up in the "Water's Edge" area, which was being set up for one of the Dreamworks events. We were yelled at to get out of the area, which we had not meant to enter in the first place and could not find our way out of because we needed a handicap entrance (I was in a wheelchair), rather than helped politely as a guest should be. The employees at Christi's Cookies as well as The Conservatory Cafe were also rather short with guests. It was disappointing. 

The food is mediocre and overpriced.  We ate at FUSE the first evening and we were not impressed. The food was alright but certainly did not justify the inflated prices.  The next morning we paid $15.00 for two small breakfast sandwiches and a cup of coffee and were appalled as we watched the employee pull two frozen sandwiches out of a box and microwave them. A fresh breakfast is certainly not too much to ask for that price, in my opinion.   

Finally, the fees are astronomical and uncalled for. There is an $18 a day room fee for bottled water and access to the pool and fitness center (neither of which we were able to utilize). My husband and I always make it a point to stay in luxury hotels when we go on vacation because we feel that the experience is worth it, and this is the first time that such basic amenities were not included in the price of the room. I could understand the fees if they included something above and beyond the average experience but they did not. You are paying for Wi-Fi and use of the hotel phone for local calls; things that should absolutely be included in your stay. There is also a $20 a day parking fee, in spite of the fact that the hotel is not located in a downtown area and has ample parking. It is simply how high these fees are that I find so ridiculous about them. 

Finally, and most appalling, in my opinion, was the wheelchair rental fee.  My pregnancy is high-risk and I am unable to walk much. In order to enjoy the hotel at all, I needed a wheelchair. On our first evening, we just wanted to go to dinner in another area of the hotel so my husband ran down to get what we assumed would be a complimentary wheelchair to get from our room to the restaurant.  He was informed that even to rent the wheelchair for one hour, he would have to pay $20. He was told that wheelchairs and scooters were controlled by a 3rd party and there was nothing that could be done to accommodate us.  In my personal opinion, you can not say that customer service is a priority when you have a guest that will not be able to comfortably enjoy your resort without the use of a wheelchair and then charge such a high fee for the privilege of mobility.  Perhaps a $10 fee would have been sufficient for a daily rental but considering that I have never been charged for a wheelchair in any other situation, including other hotel stays, I would have found even that frustrating. 

Basically, we paid a large amount of money for the "privilege"  of staying in what amounted to a basic hotel room (we have enjoyed much more impressive accommodations at other hotels) and then walk out with a bill for over $100 in extra fees, not including the restaurant bills for the below average food and a bad taste in our mouths from the lack of costumer service to make the price feel worth it. Thank goodness we enjoy each other's company and were simply happy to have a weekend to ourselves or the experience would have ruined our vacation. We will never stay here again.
As of 3/22- Temporarily Closed due to COVID-19.

Sat a the bar because it was slammed, good local craft brews and the bartenders had good recommendations on beer and food. The Cajon grouper sandwich is amazing but make sure they put enough sauce because it makes the sandwich. The guy playing music was terrible, like real bad. But it was fun to watch

Get your shit together! I ordered a lrg grilled pastrami and half the meat came off in the process. They didn't even attempt to put it back on. One soggy messy depleted sandwhich. Not worth the 10 bucks! Was going to have spinach added to it but the spinach was half black and slimy. Definately won't be back.

The ladies at the cash register are so rude and sassy and i feel disrespected.  They need to be more sanitary.  The other day the person in front of me got this chicken that was drenched in some nasty red sauce and they burrito maker used his hands and his hands were red....after he touched and rolled my burrito and my burrito tasted spicy when i got home.

Peche was recommended to us by friends as a great place and even a favorite place to get food in New Orleans. 

The atmosphere is loud and busy. Had we realized that, we may have passed. 

We went on a Monday night and had reservations - we still waited 10-15 minutes before being seated. The waiter felt rushed and not terribly helpful when talking about menu options, and barely spoke to us through the meal. The waiters assistant was great though. 

The food was okay. When paying $150+ for appetizers food and wine, I expected the flavors to be more thorough. The Brussel sprout side that we had for an appetizer was delicious. 

After tuna and mahi mahi entrees were served, the best flavor we experienced was in one of the compliments of the mahi mahi. The fish itself was good, but not worth writing home about.

When I call to place an order, the young man by the name of ANGELOS is ALWAYS very rude and nasty. I've been ordering food from this establishment for over 11 years and never had anyone speak to me the way he does. Whenever I call he gives me a hard way to go by asking for my name, address, phone number and etc. I am already in the system because like I said I've been ordering for the past 11 years! And NO ONE else asks me for that information because it comes up automatically when I call. I would hate to see you lose a lot of customers because many of my coworkers order there too and several of them has complained about this same young man.  Thanks a bunch

So glad that King State is the closest coffee/sandwich bar to my new business in Tampa Heights!  Their sandwiches are super fresh, and the right size (you don't feel like you're overstuffed leaving).  Also that potato salad is to die for - refreshing!

I love their outdoor area, but their indoors has a cool vibe too.

While I'm not a beer drinker, my husband realllly enjoyed their IPA.  

King State is a great local alternative to meeting someone at Starbucks. Great place to hang out, get some food or coffee or beer, and catch up with friends!
This is a great seafood restaurant! I really miss the fried pickles, and wish they would bring them back! Our waitress Nina was great showing us the new menu items.

Polenta fries = 5 stars (outstanding, amazing fries of warmth, and heat, and flavor, and texture and pure, guilt-free comfort) 
Pulled mushroom sandwich = 5 stars
Chocolate cake = 4.5 stars
Baklava = 5 stars (The.Best.Baklava.I.Have.Ever.Had.Sorry.Mom.)
Cheesecake = 3 stars
Brussel sprouts = 3 stars

Chai = 5 stars
Falcone = 5 stars
Qupe = 2 stars

Service = 5 stars!!!
My go-to sandwich in SB! I recommend the Super Deluxe - only $9.50 and packed w all the goodies. Fast and delicious every single time.

Our favorite spot for New York style pizza in Boise. Awesome tang to the sauce, crust is crunchy with a little bit of chew and great ingredients on top. Plus the service is always speedy and everyone is super kind. Definitely recommend!

What an amazing dining experience by Chef Robert and his team! The ten of us did the chef's tasting at the restaurant. The whole experience from start to finish was top notch. Once we had a date set, Chef Robert called to get info on the group; likes, dislikes, allergies etc. Then, he went back and created this delicious six-course menu: 

First Course -Antipasto
Second Course -Baked Brie Strudel with fig jam, baby arugula and white truffle honey
Third Course- Colossal Stuffed Shrimp served on a bed of fresh fettuccine pasta tossed in a sun-dried tomato-pesto cream sauce
Fourth Course-Oreganata-Crusted Fillet of Baramundi sautéed in a tomato-caper scampi sauce over spinach risotto
Fifth Course-Peppercorn Crusted Medallion of Filet Mignon topped with Gorgonzola crust, balsamic-roasted onion and mushroom sauce
Sixth Course-Bacio Dessert Sampler

The portions were generous and we were so full by the end. Thank you, Chef Robert, for this wonderful experience. Can't wait to plan the next tasting.

This is by far the best Nico's location in Tucson! The food is always perfect, the place is always clean and the staff is friendly. We go there at least once every two weeks, if not more, and it's consistently a good experience.

Went here last year while visiting and loved it. Came back this year and was not disappointed. Two families -- Group of 8 with 4 kids (2 teens 2 tweens) we shared pizzas: arugula prosciutto; short rib and cheese. All fantastic. We had risotto balls and mussels for appetizers.  All perfect. I had the beet/ apricot salad. Greens were buttery soft and dressing was perfect vinegary foil to sweet apricots and crunchy pistachios.  Hot bread bright to the table was devoured almost as soon as it was out on the table. Lightly crunchy on the outside and pillowy soft inside. Great choice for big or small groups. I will plan to come back every time I am in Philly.
Such a fun environment. Great food if you're a foodie. It is more on the $$$ side. The only negative is the restroom was out of stock and dirty. That was definitely an appetite suppressant.

My husband and I stood in line for an hour to get in, and it was worth it. Fried chicken, greens and mac-n-cheese is my favorite meal on earth - I make it myself and try it at restaurants all over the country - and Hattie B's is up there as one of the very best. I also like spicy food, so the Nashville spice works well for me. The staff is helpful and friendly. Two thumbs up.
Great service. Very patient waitstaff and treated us well. Good service goes a long way regardless of the quality of food but the food was delicious. The sauces they use are amazing.
Great place Russian mafia owned food not bad but the atmosphere is not good from junkies to old car sales people
On vacation and this place is close to where I'm staying. The atmosphere is great and very diverse. They have a live local band which is really good. Nice little local spot to check out.
Favorite Mexican place in Indy! Such quick service, great food, best tortillas, you cant go wrong with anything on the menu!

I honestly didn't have extremely high expectations coming into this restaurant because it just happened to be inside of the hotel we were staying at on vacation and I didn't see a ton of people eating in here each day but went into it with an open mind. I'm glad my mom pushed us into eating here the last night of our stay because the service and food were both excellent! You get a huge portion for your money as well. I had the grilled potatoes which were actually fried but still delicious and the fried shrimp which were huge and not at all greasy. I recommend trying this restaurant out, everyone in our group enjoyed their food!

There's nothing quite like walking into a restaurant and smelling all the food you're about to put into your body. New Delhi is just about the best Indian buffet in Philadelphia. There is a ton of variety in their dishes, each of which has its own unique flavor. All of the meats were incredibly juicy, and every dish was packed with spice. My favorites were the goat curry and the chicken tikka masala. The servers were constantly replenishing the bar so everything was fresh. Don't forget to grab some chai tea on your way back to your table as well. Because it's a buffet, there's no need to wait to eat; just walk in and dive in! Bring your student ID for 10% off!
I'd drink my weight in their vegan queso dip. You really can't go wrong here...a plant based paradise!

The food is always good.  I had the pasta special and it was delicious.  The setting was large enough, I was able to take the rest home and have ire the next day for lunch.  The servers are friendly and attentive.

Ate lunch here today with my parents and we were beyond impressed! We ordered a Cuban sandwich, the turkey & avocado sandwich and the 51st Philly cheesesteak. We also got a side of tortilla chips and sides of guacamole and pico de gallo. The sandwiches were huge and absolutely delicious. The guac and pico were both very fresh and very tasty. The prices were great. The employees were very friendly. I will definitely be back to try other sandwiches and the tacos as well.
We tasted 4 items and decided on etoufee and maque choux. Both were delicious.  Comforting.  soul-warming food.

I didn't exactly get the full meal experience at Fattoush...I just want to make that perfectly clear.  However, I certainly didn't catch very good vibes from the place.  It seemed a bit greasy, understaffed, and slow.  My buddy and I were in the area, and he was jonesing for a cup of coffee.  Considering the fact that this place is called Fattoush "Cafe," I figured it would at least be possible that they sold coffee...I mean, right?  Well they don't, and the guy suggested I try the Krystal across the street if I really wanted a cup of joe.

Anyhow, as long as I was there I figured I'd sample the hummus.  I love hummus.  It was pretty sub-par, however, and the place itself just rubbed me the wrong way.  I'd say that I'll update my review once I go and check out a full entree, but honestly I'd just rather not go back.  It didn't strike me as a place you'd want to frequent.
Enjoyed the lettuce wraps very much.  First time visit to this little gem, staff was very friendly, the food very tasty.  Planning to go back for sure.

This place is a f-ing dumpster fire. Burn, baby, burn. It is ridiculous. I cannot even to express my disappointment in my visit here and how poorly this zoo is ran! My friend had her birthday party here with a party of 20. The server was complaining about there being too many people at the event and she couldn't handle the volume of orders. She also verbally expressed dismay towards my friend holding the birthday that she should have had less people. WHO DOES THAT?!

Needless to say the entire experience went down the toilet. To make matters worse, the food came out cold or the order was wrong with at least 6 people. Even when a couple of items were returned back they were still incorrect and the server continued to complain to us. She said, "I have been working for 12 hours. I am so done here...." God bless, woman, if you do not like the hours or the job then move along. Don't make this experience for us terrible just because you're not happy with where you are.

Let me also make mention the food was bland, not edible and the drinks sucked. Wholeheartedly, a dumpster fire.

Totally fine Wendy's. Quick drive-thru, decent employees, predictable food.

Still mad they don't have sweet and sour sauce, though...

Came for the first time on a Saturday afternoon. There was only one car ahead of me in the drive thru line but it took a while to get my drinks. At least 15 mins but I wasn't in a rush so it wasn't that big of a deal. The guy working was also friendly. 

I ordered a lychee slush with golden boba. Texture of the golden boba was good but it also just tasted like regular boba. I couldn't tell the difference between the two. The lychee flavor was lacking and I wish it was more potent. Definitely disappointed with this drink. 

My partner ordered a taro milk tea with crystal boba. The milk tea was really good but there was SO much ice. 3/4 of his cup was filled with ice! 3 sips and it was gone. 

Since it was my first visit, I'd try it out again and choose something else. $13 for two drinks, not including tip. If y'all ever stop by, just make sure to ask for less ice to get the best bang for your buck.

REVIEW OF PICK-UP PIZZA ONLY

Relocated to Tucson a couple years ago and have since been searching for a decent pizza (not an easy find in this town). We ordered the "Canyon Combo" - a standard house pizza. At first glance, the toppings were generous and evenly distributed - a nice presentation. BUT, as we began to eat, my wife and I instantly agreed - "Something's missing". The pizza seemed a little dry, which was from a lack of sauce (very little and not very flavorful). Also, the topping were not anchored to anything, which was due to a VERY thin layer of cheese. (I actually questioned, "Is there ANY cheese on here?") There were nice big slices of sausage, but that sausage had no flavor. The crust was a little soggy in the middle, but otherwise pretty good. 
Unless something changes, we probably will not attempt another pizza here. The hunt continues...

I. Love. This. Place.

The space can be small as business is always booming. The food is authentic. 

The atmosphere is a bit different but this place does not disappoint. One of the best places in TPA to go to for Vietnamese food.

Went last Saturday night and the wait was long which is to be expected. We ordered crab cakes and pickles for appetizer and both were extremely salty. The salt level was so high it left bumps on your tongue. I ordered the pork Oso Bucco and the Pork was tender but once again the sauce was extremely salty. Overall we were very disappointed with the food, they need to get the salt under control. On a positive note the waitress and the management handled things professionally and we will give them one more shot at our business but it will be later in the season when they have the kinks worked out
Always professional, always tasty, always generous with time and effort. What else would you want when visiting a restaurant that prides themselves with a culture if hospitality? Go here!
Unique group activity with great whiskey selection and a friendly staff. Perfect place to relieve some stress after work!
Came in today had the grilled chicken tacos don't like them too spicy. Had chilli instead bland it tastes like Campbell's tomato soup with chilli powder in it yuck  I heard it was a yumy place

First Time: I had the oxtails and they were dry as well as the rice with beans and they were dry too. I'm disappointed because I had high hopes expecting fresh food and the cost did not justify the quality. I had the Run Punch and it was delicious though...it was worth the cost for sure. The meat patty did not see fresh either. I say eat here at your own risk.

This Felipe's location honestly doesn't even deserve to have the same name as the one Uptown off of S. Claiborne. I ordered via UberEats a super burrito with fried shrimp and al pastor burrito with jalapeños, salsa roja, chipotle onions, corn, and lettuce. The only things that made it into the burrito besides the meat was corn, lettuce, rice and beans. I received regular burrito, not a super burrito, and despite paying for the extra meat, there was hardly any meat in there. On top of all of this, the al pastor was dry dry dry, and didn't have the usual delicious flavor I've come to expect from the Felipe's Uptown. I definitely will not be ordering from or going to the Mid City location again and will be sticking to S. Miro. I wish they'd sign up on UberEATS, because it's obvious they're held to a higher standard there. Spending $36 for two burritos and not getting hardly anything right is horrible, that's more than half a day's pay for most people.
I've never heard a bad thing about either pics coda, but WHY do they close so early! The businesses downtown baffle me with their hours.

Great pan asian menu and amazing sushi. Eggrolls and crab rangoon are worth every bite. Bulgoki wrap and all salads are great. Get the sweet wasabi dressing. Spicy pork, fried rice, and bi bim bop are a nice change from everyday blah. Sushi: Crunch & Munch, Volcano, Princess Diana, Corona, Maui are the best rolls to try! Everything is fresh. Service is great.
The Hermanaki wings are the bomb, and the pizza is out if this world! The outdoor seating is great. This place is awesome!

Walked in on a Tuesday night and they were able to seat me right away. The server gave a great description of the menu. My choices:
-Fingerling Fries- terrific, the mustard sauce was exceptional
-Spicy Tofu- the tofu was amazing, but had a sauce that I wasn't too fond of
-Gold Beets- my favorite choice I made, had smoked tofu underneath and had excellent flavor
-Chocolate Uber Chunk- have to say it was probably my worst choice, but was still very good 

Vedge is definitely A MUST GO if you're in Philly. Like go. Now.

This place is awesome, and don't let the idiots who wrote negative reviews because they were shocked they had to wait for a table the first day it opened, tell you otherwise. 

It's really wonderful for the average person who wants a burger OR people like myself with various food allergies. You can take anyone here and be happy because of the large variety of everything. Plus it's open til 3 am (!) on Fridays and Saturdays, which is something that this neighborhood was very much missing until now. No, it's not McDonald's burger prices, but it's also not McDonald's quality. If you got a burger or sandwich meal in most restaurants it would be the same price, and these are better quality than the average pub or Applebee's burger. 

Love it here, PLEASE DON'T EVER CLOSE, the vegan milkshakes have changed my life.

If in your travels you end up in airside C..... Always go here if you're hungry and/or want a drink.  Don't think about it.... Just shrug off any bad TSA experience you may have had and go here to enjoy some great beer.... Rum... and great sandwiches and burgers.... Among other things.  

Great customer service - special mention to our server Freddie... Who was probably the nicest person I have ever met in my travels to Tampa int'l.  

Cuban sandwiches were delicious... Just ask for extra pressed to get authentic Cuban quality.  Don't forget to grab a beer.... My fav is the Maduro Brown Ale.

~ hiccup ~
Best place in town for several dishes. The Three Cup Chicken is DELICIOUS and they weree open for patrons on Christmas in 2016! Very good food always. No disappointments, ever.

We ate here Sunday 8/30/15 my boyfriend already know that this is my favorite restaurant,They have several seafood selections and I love most of the one that's served over pasta..Diablo..many more that I cant pronounce but all soo good. Want be disappointe.

Delicious food.  Cool porch.  Killer coffee.  Ants Pants should be analogous for breakfast.

Pumpkin pancakes were perfect sized and deliciously crafted, my god where they good.  I almost ordered a second round just to stuff myself and enjoy the taste a bit longer.  I totally dug the back porch.  The Blue Mountain coffee was just right.  Food came out snappy.  My friendly waitress, Megan, was just as awesome as the pancakes.  

I keep hearing about the Creme Bruele french toast which I must try.  I can't wait to go back again.

Ants Pants, you are G Ho gold.   

(If you forgot your cash, they had an ATM)
It's a wonderful place to eat very peaceful the attention it's great the food it's delicious you must go here in Clearwater plenty parking

The food is a bot pricey, but other than that this place is great after 10. However, I will say they have my favorite jalepeno poppers. The happy hour seems to satisfy me and my friends for some late night drinking. And the atmosphere seems to be a very laid back one with some high volume music and chatter in the background. If you are looking for late night drinks come check it out!

This location is horrible! Especially at night. My boyfriend and I decided to go thru the drive thru. We waited at the screen for a couple minutes before we could even order. When we did everything looked correct on the screen so we drove ahead. We waited in line for our food at least ten minutes! We get our food check the bag and all looks good so drive home. Get home half of our order is incorrect and the other half soggy! Drive back up there and get a refund bc at that point after waiting and dealing with poor customer service decided to go to the lemay ferry location. It was a great decision. Food at the second location was fresh, accurate, fast and hot. Long story short - don't waste your time at this location and go to the lemay ferry location.

The plantains are addictive and always sweet! Jolliof rice is my favorite and they make it Great! The place is never really busy on the inside but people are always ordering takeout! This place is definitely a gem!

Such a hard place to rate, because the fan fare does not live up to the finale. 
Side note we visited the previous restaurant which was a wine bar without a liquor license so it could cloud us.

It's such an odd place to rate, Armageddon restaurant. Once you got past the entrance though there was really no fear. Chairs stacked in front of the open kitchen were a bad sign. The fact that Sting was playing next door and walk ins were fine was a worse sign.

Service was good. The beer list was great except Lord Hobo is a brewery not a beer. DW wine was satisfactory.

The wings to me were the best part. Full wings with a good hot sauce that was buffalo like but not intense. Best part of the meal. DW got a Caesar salad that was a Caesar.

They want you to do the cooking on the black rocks that are hot or the Himalayan salt slab. My thought is, um I'm paying this much u cook for me. DW had the lobster pasta that was more fishy then lobster. I went with the burger that the kitchen cooks. Good but a lot going on there.

It's Ruby Tuesday in the zombiland

This review is a bit delayed but I was at raijin for their soft opening and have come back multiple times since then. When it first opened it was crazy crowded so the wait was not ideal. It's evened out a bit since then but you can still expect to wait at peak times (weekend, evenings thurs/fri) but I think it's worth it. 

I haven't had all the ramen in tucson but I've had my fair share and raijin is pretty good. Definitely top 3 for me. The staff is friendly, the prices are decent and most importantly the ramen is tasty. I've had the spicy tonkatsu, black garlic tonkatsu and umami, my wife had the chicken and my kids like splitting the white tonkatsu. You can ask for additional black garlic sauce if you want to add a little kick. This isn't as good as ramen in California, but you can't be too picky in the desert. We'll definitely be back again.
margaritas were great but the chicken enchiladas were inedible. The sauce was not good and the chicken was tough.

Tried this place out recently for brunch.  It's an all you can eat buffet with various food and drink stations at the mid $30 mark per person with booze included.  The alcoholic beverages included bloody marys, mimosas, white and red sangria.  

Food options were diverse from some token Mexican items, salsa/guac, chips, the normal breakfast foods (eggs/bacon/sausage/French toast/pancakes), and there were other options including meat carving stations and steamed crab legs and shrimp.  The dessert options weren't as plentiful as there was fruit and some breads to dip into the chocolate fountain that seemed to be sputtering all over the table.  Overall not a bad option if you're looking for an all you can eat type of meal with some booze included.  The quality of the food is decent and buffet grade.

This place is a great little stop for a quick meal. The food always good and well prepared. 
They have great donuts that I can't have. Alright I've had s couple. The good I do suggest the bacon maple donut dam it's good. 
24 hrs. A day so it works well with my schedule.

As far as pizza joints go, this one is pretty decent.  They have really tasty thin-crust pizza, but my major complaint about it is that their "large" thin-crust pizza is about 12" in diameter.  For the price, I'd rather go elsewhere and get a pie twice that size for cheaper.  But if you don't mind small, overpriced for the size pizza pies, the pizza they make at Primavera is pretty good.  They also make decent calamari.  

Location-wise, Primavera is right in the heart of Ardmore, in the busiest part of Lancaster Ave. as it cuts through the town.  But it's also right on the corner of one of the entrances to Suburban Square, so there's plenty of parking if you turn off of Lancaster into Suburban Square because they have huge parking lots for all of the square shoppers.  Primavera's building is pretty neat, as other Yelpers have mentioned.  Though this isn't my absolute favorite place to get pizza in the area, it's a nice place to go, especially if you're already in Ardmore.  Shopping till you drop at Suburban Square might work up an appetite.

Or you can be lazy and have it delivered.  You can order delivery online from mainlinedelivery.com.  I'm often lazy :)

The food is decant.  The staff can be rude at times and if you ask for something special like extra sauce on side you'll never get it.      
If the staff was a little more on the ball keeping up with the customers need and didn't come across as rude at times I think they could have a much better Business. 
I thought I was the only one that had this problem there but a few friends and 2 family members agreed.

First time here -- the food was great! Quesadillas, nachos, cilantro rice bowl with marinated chicken were all very good, good portions, freshly made and served hot. Server was friendly and attentive. Bar opens up to small patio outside. Great music playing. We will definitely be back to play some darts.

Went here for a intimate graduation party & the ombiance was nice our party room was located upstairs . They had elevators & well posted signs to lead us to our room. The waiter was awesome & the food was ok..nice presentation & very attentive staff.

We stopped by for a quick lunch after getting in from the airport. The wait staff was welcoming and polite. The food is typical bar food.. very salty. But it's good in a pinch. They are very dog friendly!

This is hands down the best Mediterranean restaurant in New Orleans outside of Shaya (and I've eaten at them all -- Lebanon, Pyramid, Mona's, etc).
