Great customer service. Wish they were closer to where I live I'd eat there more. Food sticks to your ribs. Love it. The staff are super friendly.

Stopped in for lunch on Saturday. We were the only two people in the restaurant on a Saturday afternoon, so hopefully things will pick up for these people.
Server was very nice although had to look for her to get some more iced tea.
Chicken salad was very good and came with peppered kettle chips. Spicy chicken sliders were not very spicy, but that could just be me. The chicken was a little chewy, but overall it was ok.

This place is an all around solid and great restaurant. Great location, nice ambiance, modern decor, good vibe, outdoor seating. The food is delicious and consistent and very fairly priced. The cocktails are some of the best in town although they are a little on the small side. My wife loves the "adult milkshakes."

Tonight, I had the chicken noodle soup which was obviously homemade but nothing too special and the chicken quesadillas which were really good. My wife LOVED her Moroccan Salmon Salad! The salmon was perfectly cooked and had a delicious cinnamon rub. She switched out the greens for kale and was very pleased. 

I've had burgers here before as well as some of their specials and was always satisfied.  

Definitely recommend this place for solid, delicious, fairly priced (if a little unimagined) food.
Our server was so rude we left before he even got drinks. He didn't say a single word to us, and practically threw our menus and silverware at us.

Andrew,  manager at Cristino's takes wonderful care of his customers! He went above and beyond last night to ensure that we had a wonderful experience!

Thank you for the excellent customer service, Andrew!

The one time I ate at Gran Caffe L'Aquila I was there for 3 hours. It's right next door to Nordstrom Rack and looks unassuming from the outside, but once you step inside and go upstairs you realize just how huge it is (great for large parties)! The menu is seriously extensive and mostly in Italian, which makes it a bit overwhelming, but the waiters are extremely knowledgable and more than willing to help out! I ordered the zuppa de pesce and the pear/cranberry salad, which were both delicious, but the highlight of the meal was definitely dessert! They bring you a huge platter with every dessert available so you can take a look at everything before you order, and their gelato is award winning, so don't miss out on that!
Food was good but much too expensive for what you get. There is not a lot of selection. I'd suggest going someplace else. Don't like the sense of getting ripped off even if the food is good.

We were on a 45 minute wait at neyow's and decided to get an appetizer at this spot while we waited. We decided to try the crabcakes and they were excellent. We got them within 10 minutes and paid with Amex and were back next door at Neyow's with time to spare. Our experience was such that we decided to try them for dinner on our next visit to New Orleans. We will let you know how that goes on our return to New Orleans.

I have visited New Orleans multiple times and have been searching for a decent place with fresh food... I found it! This place the food comes out quick and very fresh!! The food was perfect portion to prevent me from leaving stuffed but satisfied. Try the fried shrimp po boy and red bean side, it's phenomenal! Elizabeth was our server she was so nice and helpful, and didn't even mind that we opted to sit outside in 90 degree heat. I can't wait to come back!!!!

Helen's is a south county institution. Hard to believe it's been around for over 20 years, but it has endured with a basic formula: a good location with a huge bar area that's big enough for bands, dancing, and big groups such as work happy hours, bachelorette parties, etc.  They book well known local music- pop DJs, pop bands- and have great happy hour pricing.  Sexy bartenders, shot girls, you know the drill.  The food is your most basic bar food- lots of choices but average in quality.  For most of the packed crowd in here each weeknight and weekend, food is not the priority, so there is no impetus to offer anything but the most basic fried apps, wings, sandwiches, and a few dinner entrees.  
I work in Sunset Hills and occasionally wind up here for lunch.  It's not my first choice, but it does the job.  I had a decent burger a few visits ago, but the fries were undercooked and mushy.  My last visit I got a buffalo chicken sandwich that was overcooked and dry, plus light on the cheese and sauce that was supposed to accompany.  I got house-made chips as a side, and those were tasty, much better than the fries.  Lunch service is fast and friendly- they cater mostly to the business crowd for lunch so understand the need to get in and out quickly.  
There are a lot of people in my nearby office, and Helen's is one of the few places that we can actually have an impromptu work event.  In planning events, we often reserve a space to accommodate our large size.  Either that or pack ourselves like sardines into a smaller place while making every other patron hate us while also going drastically over fire code!  Helen's is a great, nearby alternative for us that we use all the time.  
I also appreciate their being an independent, local spot in a sea of mostly chain places out in the county.

This place is awesome! Dog friendly, very nice staff, and cool vibes going on in that place. Their cold brew and lattes are amazing, everything is fresh made and the staff is very knowledgable about what they sell. Will definitely be coming back!

Fun looking little place; banquet party room in the back and a full parking lot. My table was poorly lit, but I managed to order a 
Salmon Burrito - grilled salmon fillet, garlic, peppers, onions and mushrooms. Wrapped in a large tortilla, topped with low-fat cheese sauce. Served with Mexican rice and small salad. 

The good was very good - prices were kind of high and my server was sort of pushy and rude.  Sometimes, that makes all the difference in the world. Still, not a horrible stop.

My name is Moses, and I'm not a vegan, I'm not even a vegetarian, however when my lover suggested we stop on our way to Santa Barbara I couldn't refuse once I saw photos of the food. I'm definitely a meat guy so I was a little concerned as to if I would find something to enjoy. We walked I to the establishment and was greeted by a quaint yet sophisticated natural wood themed restaurant. The service was fast and the server was very friendly. I took a look at the menu and at first sight I immediately saw a few items that seemed interesting to me. Although I'm not a a vegetarian I do like humus, (WHICH I ORDERED), I also ordered an extra pita bread which had an beautiful assembly of herbs and spices. I also saw a very intriguing Umami burger, which my lover ordered and devoured! My lovers, beautiful friend ordered the Picadillo Empanadas, and was very pleased, especially with the Chimichurri that accompanied it. Midway through our meal the owner came over and checked in with us and he way the best! Ironically he is from our neighborhood which is 2 hours away. Overall it was a beautiful experience and to top it off we were gifted with the best baclava EVER!

Went here recently, and have to say they up'ed their game.  This was the best BBQ we went to.  Great flavor in the meat and really tasty.  This time Bandana's was better than Sugarfire.  Really impressed.

Really like this place. Relaxed atmosphere,  open plan so you can see everything from the bar to the kitchen. Great service. Good fresh food. Highly recommend the spicy crab salad. Prices are reasonable and selection is big but not too big. Did I say the food was really fresh? Because it is!

We live right down the street and decided to try this place for the first time. Our server was a C- D+. She was friendly but forgetful (nicely put). We ordered a pizza, meatballs, and caprese salad. I asked the server if I was able to add chicken to my salad and she said yes. Anyways, the pizza came out first, then the meatballs. We waited for the salad and nothing. Maybe 15 mins after we were done, our server came up and asked if everything was okay. I asked her for the salad and she had the "deer in a head light" look. 5 mins after the salad came out, and of course no chicken, I asked her about it and she told me "we can't add chicken to caprese salad but we can add chicken to everything else." What?!? So i waited almost half an hour for you to tell me you can't do something?!? We end up getting a Cesar salad instead after we've been done with everything else. She seemed to be distracted with her other table. If you wanted to drink with your other customers, you probably should have someone else serve us. And I can't tell you who she is cause she never told us her name. Other than bad service the food is amazing.

I was surprised how nice this restaurant looked when I walked in. I usually don't pay attention to that kind of thing but it looked clean, inviting and comfortable. From what little contact I had with the staff, they were also friendly and helpful.
They also offer free wifi.
The food is still KFC food. I wasn't unhappy with my chicken or mashed potatoes, but the food isn't reason enough for me to drive all the way over here.

Yummy food and very fair prices!

I ate there two nights in a row and I had: 

Ceaser Salad
Filet Mignon with veggies and mashed potatoes
Neptunes Sampler with a lobster tail, grilled scallops & shrimp, a crab cake, mashed potatoes and asparagus.
Seafood Bisque
House Salad

All of the food was pretty flavorful and served promptly.  Any feedback around improvements would be that the dressing on the cesear salad was way too strong.  I could only take a few bites and had to leave it alone.  The seafood bisque had a ton of cheese in it as well which was  a little different but it still had  a decent enough flavor and texture.

The filet and seafood items were perfectly cooked and not overdone.

Mahalo!
OMG!!
All my favorite things in one place at one time.
I'll have a bowl with salmon, avocado, pineapple, mango, edemame beans, seaweed salad, etc, etc, etc...
Solid place for a quick lunch.  Authentic flavor and good sauces; my go to lunch spot in the area.
Great mom and pop restaurant that has gluten free pasta and pizza. Not easy to find a place that serves both and that are actually good tasting. Would recommend to everyone.

I've only tried their veggie burger and veggie wrap so far and both have been okay. They are not amazing, but not bad either. I would definitely recommend the veggie burger over the wrap. 

The inside is a standard Irish pub look and both times I went it wasn't packed but wasn't completely empty either!

I am FULL AS A TICK... All I need is to pitch a hammock in City Park on this breezy, beautiful April the 13th... Hello!!!!!!

Oh my God!!!!! What a god-send in mylife. I think this place was personally created for me. 

When I got wind of the opening, I knew with haste I must make my way & today was the day; and there was NOOOOOOOOOO disappointment. 

Broad & St Phillip is where you'll find this treasure; located beneath a babershop the "pièce de résistance" lives!!!! 

Walking in, to the right are 3-4 tables & chairs for dining; to the left is a table for two that sits flush with the wall... then straight to the back is all the veganie-goodiness... The FOOD!!!!!

Two sides, one is for hot food & the other is a salad bar of sorts.  All the food is served by the staff, this is GREAT; I don't care for buffets, things happen at buffets, ewwwww.  

The food is served a la carte or you can get a combo-of sorts, 2 entrees and 2 sides.  I choose the Pasta, Okra Gumbo, Sweet Potatoes & Mac-n-Cheese (I'm a cheese lover, despite being lactose intolerant).  Then to top it off, I got some VEGAN ICE CREAM & a drink of Green-Goddess; all for under $20 bucks; winning with a CAPITAL W!!!!!!

ALL THE FOOD AMAZINGLY great & flavorful.  Lots of times, removing ingredients from foods you've been eating all your life, you anticipate am unfamiliar, 'gotta get used to it' taste; but that wasn't the case this time go round.  

The okra was robust & tasted of all things creole, thankfully it lacked that acidic tomato taste; this was fantastic, made my tummy happy.  

The sweet potatoes tasted like my granny's; enough said!!! 

The pasta was a new taste for me, just because it lacked seafood, but the replacements were right on time & made me glad I had made the selection.  

And the MAC N CHEESE; since this is an ALL TIME FAVORITE of mine... This was the seller for me.  It PASSED THE TGB-MAC-N-CHEESE test!!!!! I love it!!!!!!!!   

With some many other choices to select, I'll definitely be back to get more of this VEGAN SOULFOOD.  

Oh and the Ice Cream, you can taste the flavors should that be your desire; but it's VEGAN too... I'm over-joyed this little piece of heaven is open & in the direction of my house... HELLO, dinner as I head to the house.  

Ooooooh and the Green Goddess, to rinse it all down... I'm a happy, happy, dairy free, vegan food eating camper.

Every time I go to this place, I feel like I'm going to get stabbed (and I'm pretty adventurous).

I went here a lot before Katrina, so last summer when a friend's band was playing here, I jumped at the chance to check it out.  The place is smoky and gross.  A complete "guy" place, complete with pool tables.  Horrible for bands now.  The sound system just sucks.  I saw bands here all the time, Pre-K, now something is just off.  

There was only one bartender for the whole place full of people, so you had to wait forever to get service.  

I know people will say that places like this are what make NOLA unique.  Uh uh.  Places like "Lafitte's" make NOLA unique.  This is just a scummy hole in the wall.

Trust me, I am NOT a prissy snob who can't have a good time in a dive.  This place is just BEYOND.  I just thank goodness I didn't have to go to the bathroom while I was here, or I might not have made it out with my sanity.  ;)

I got the sashimi plate & it did not taste fresh. If you order online you cannot see or select what types of sashimi you're getting I figured I just didn't like that particular one so I choked down a second piece & realized that it every single piece was old, discolored & had that fishy smell that's not supposed to be there. Threw it all away immediately. 

I also really don't care for how they plate it I don't want to pick a bunch of shredded carrots, chopped up lettuce and onions off my sushi. But I guess I'll never have to worry about that again.

Food is tasty, drinks are great, with nice outdoor atmosphere, but unfortunately the service outside is not up to par. We sat for 30 minutes with no greeting, no waters, NOTHING!! After finally getting service, we had to wait 45 minutes to receive our appetizers, reminded our bar tender numerous times about our drink order, and eventually had to get up ourself to get the drink. Would love to return but hope some changes are made for a better experience.

I was on a trip with a bus full of friends from Chicago for the weekend in St. Louis and Sweetie Pies was our last stop. I had heard from a friend of mines that was there a year ago and boy was she right the food was NOT ALL THAT. We arrived on a Sunday afternoon which I knew it would be a wait since people are coming after church so the wait was like 20/30 minutes just to place an order. So I final get to the front of the line the sliver wear area was not clean which I already knew how this would be not good I decided I wouldn't get my food for hear I would take a to go container. It looks like they were short staff cause it was only one person per station it was an older lady that was handling the meats and another lady handling the sides and one lady on the register. I placed my order nothing on the meat menu caught my eye so i figured i can't go wrong with chicken wings , mac and cheese and string beans and white potatoes and a piece of pound cake . I got 3 chicken wings , the wings wasn't all that great and strings n white potatoes was OK and the mac and cheese was ok a lil under seasoned. The pound  cake was the only thing that was good the place the display case need to be cleaned the windows to the case was dirty this place is a dump I wouldn't be surprised  if the health dept wouldn't be called I love SOUL FOOD and be me watching her show I couldn't wait to get to try it . Never again. Oh the cornbread , yuck. My meals are better than that especially for $20 bucks .

I honestly can't say enough great things about this place! We hosted a private event and wow, all our guests were blown away. The food is phenomenal and the staff at Blue Oak were welcoming and helpful. Definitely a must-go spot!

Went in and tried to order white rice without cilantro and the manager would not do it. They said the rice wasn't ready. That means they couldn't serve food is that was the case. Terrible. I have been to several of these restaurants and have never had a problem. We walked out and won't come back.

My favorite pho joint outside of philly. 

I usually swing in for some take out. I've ordered the Brisket Pho, Beef Noodle Stew w/ Egg Noodle, Rice dish w/ bbq pork, and the beef wrapped in grape leaves. Most of these were great. 

For the beef noodle soup, the egg noodle is a pass, get it with pho noodle. They provide a generous serving of beef chunks that are super tender and delicious. The pho is great with a good tasting broth. Noodles are good. Brisket is so so. Beef w/ grape leaves are chewy and delicious. Rice w/ bbq pork is good too, but go for the pho.
The pizza here was so on point and cheesy. The service was quick,fast and professional. When ever I want pizza and I am in Reno. I will be back

A group of nine friends travelled from all corners of the country to celebrate a friend's bachelor party weekend.  The groom is one of my best, and in fact, my oldest friend.  We wanted a special Saturday night dinner to be the centerpiece of the weekend.  The election settled upon MiLa...and they delivered magnificently.

I'm going to rate this a 4.5 because the service (seemingly not fully engaged and sporadically absent) and setting (placed awkwardly in the front near the bar) were a notch below ideal, and because my cocktail (Louisiana 75) was pedestrian.  But the food was across-the-board phenomenal.  Absolutely outstanding.  Between the delectable dishes and the fantastic company, it was a wonderfully memorable evening.

A pleasant amuse bouche of crab salad on a cucumber slice.

An exquisite parsnip-puree soup with copious crab meat and a drizzle of lemon oil.  

Earthy scallion cornbread with sea-salted butter and lovely sweet potato rolls with a compelling lima bean puree.

Unbelievably rich, savory pan-roasted sweetbreads with black truffle grits and sherry bacon jus.

Simple but expertly prepared sweet potato pappardelle with mushrooms and cheese.

Venison tenderloin with mushrooms, red wine reduction, and edenic brussels sprouts.

Rice pudding, an elusive favorite, with super-sweet date chutney.

French-press coffee and an extra hour of reminiscence and revelry to top everything off.

Excellent choice:  too bad that I can't take all the credit.  In any case, I highly, highly, highly recommend MiLa for an evening of gastreauxnomic delights.

I debated for a couple of days of what kind of rating to give this place. I mean the service was good, so there is that. The flavor of the food was actually very good, so there was that. But the longer I waited the more bummed out I got. First off, the price is astonishingly outrageous. Of course I saw the prices before I ordered so shame on me. However what I didn't know is what is included with that price. I got brisket, $9.50, which wouldn't seem so bad, except that it comes with no sides, and is actually three moderately thin slices of brisket served cold. I also got a "half-rack" of baby back ribs, which apparently is 3 ribs....... though of course it isn't so there was false advertising on top of it. I mean for 18.50 I do expect more than 3 pork ribs and three slices of cold brisket. Part of teh joy of BBQ is that it is extremely cheap cuts of meat made delicious through know-how and time. I don;t expect to pay an equivalent per ounce cost of filet mignon. Since there is literally great beer everywhere now, especially in the area, I won't be back. Which is a shame, because they apparently know how to use the smoker quite well.
Fantastic food.  If you haven't been yet, do yourself a favor and go immediately!!  The vegetarian dumplings are superb and the curry can be prepared to your spice preference!

We had an amazing dinner tonight at rumba...the customer service was great...I would definitely recommend this place...being a restaurant owner myself I know a good place when I see it, this place is top notch...thank you to our two servers

I come here every time I'm in Philly. Beautiful views, super friendly staff who remember me whenever I come in. The food is great and reasonably priced. A great and reliable low key dining experience.
The lunch time boxes are great here. A hamburger with the works is do fresh and good. The strawberry blizzards are my fav

This location has had at least 4 different restaurants in the last 8 years. None of them had anything unique to offer.
Now that Grits has opened that has changed.
The people who run this restaurant know what southern food is supposed to taste like.
The Fried Chicken was great. Mac and Cheese had a great crust and the Colard Greens were on point. Oh, and the corn bread was perfect, not too sweet.
The only problem may be the parking. That can be solved as there is a beach parking lot down the block.
I hope this restaurant gets local support.

We sat at the counter and the guy making pizzas, I believe his name was Mike, starting talking to us. We ordered a large Iron Man and a slice of The People's Champ to split while we waited. We found out he has been at the restaurant since it opened.   

We went here because we had a Groupon, and man are we glad we did, the pizza was absolutely outrageous. The best I have ever had. My girlfriend is from NY and she said it is better than any she ever had in NY. Thin crust with wonderful flavor cooked to just the right consistency and great tasting fresh toppings. This will be a regular on our favorite restaurants list from now on for sure.  We told Mike that none of the pizza places in our neighborhood are anywhere close to this good. He asked where we were from and we told him Seminole. He said "Wow, this really isn't your neighborhood." I told him when it comes to pizza, this is my neighborhood now!!!  Their pizza rocks!!! As my NY girlfriend says, "it is to die for".  

Hope you enjoy it as much as we did!!!  Thanks Tour De Pizza, we will see you guys real soon!!!

So, let me start by saying that I have been here before and it was excellent. That said, I hosted a party of 4 last evening and the bartender Lance was an all star. The apps- cheese plate bacon and peppers were very Good, my 60 dollar bone in ribeye and the way it was handled were honestly the true issue. I asked our server what Med rare was to them prior to ordering and a warm red center is of course the correct answer, what I received when our food was delivered was a cold outside and raw inside ribeye. So cold that the butter on top remained a cold disc.  I politely sent it to be warmed and cooked a bit more and what returned was a luke warm, still raw steak with yet another ice cold blue cheese disc on top.  

Those that entertain for business (which i do regularly)know that sending back anything is disruptive and sending anything back twice is embarrassing for you and the establishment. 

I managed to sneak away to the restroom and speak to the manager which to my surprise seemed apathetic. In our conversation, I mentioned that I was not having this conversation to have someone come to the table, in fact, I asked they did not, I only wanted to express disappointment in a meal I had been looking forward to for so long. I managed to also let our server know.

The result - although I did not ask for the steak to be taken off our bill, it should have been.  I entertain weekly and have eaten at the very best of chop houses. While Kayne Prime has all it takes to be at the top, I will likely not return upon my next visit - whenever that may be.  Very disappointing indeed.

No. Just... no. 

Ordered a drink and it took FOREVER. 

Ordered fries and they took forever and 10 minutes after the fries were delivered they realized they hadn't provided the aioli (or whatever it was) to go with them and brought that out. I wouldn't have noticed it wasn't there if you hadn't brought it out, when I was a quarter of the way done with my order. 

Finished a drink and couldn't get the server's attention to order another, so I didn't. Had to get up and physically ask for my check after waiting and waiting and waiting.

It was a Monday. It was slow so the service should not have been. 

I will NEVER be back.
Love the food, love the staff, a great addition to Carpinteria's limited selection of good hang outs.

Went to Talulas with a client based on their recommendation. As with Vetri decided to try the tasting menu which was a set list of small dishes.  While Vetri's items were a little more out there, Talula's were more standard fare - but excellent.  Food was outstanding and the service was really great. Also pricey but great spot. They have an outdoor seating area which looked awesome but it was raining the night we went to wound up inside.
Had a great lunch here. It's a very clean space, and super vegetarian friendly. I was able to order a variety of items that were big on taste and not super expensive.

So, as we are still here at this establishment, I decided to take the liberty to write my review... The food is delicious, scenery is ok, the restaurant is nice, but the service SUCKS!!! 
 We were the only MEXICAN- AMERICANS here and you'd think they'd treat EVERYONE  with respect, but NOPE!!! They cater to Caucasians better. Let me make something clear, I AM NOT RACIST NOR DO I CONDONE RACISM!! 
 IT'S MY HUBBY'S AND I'S 8TH YEAR ANNIVERSARY we decided to drive to beautiful Santa Barbara all the way from Palmdale to celebrate this special occasion with our kids. We were going to dine at another Mexican restaurant located at the Plaza, but we decided to check out this place... BIG MISTAKE!! So, not only were we treated differently, it starts raining and NOT ONE SERVER bothers to open the patio umbrella for us!! Mind you, all the other guest dining at the patio (Caucasian people) had their patio umbrellas opened immediately and were accommodated with hand held umbrellas. WE HAVE OUR KIDS WITH US!!! 14 year old, 9 year old and a 4 year old. I had to get up from my wet search and ask a server to open our patio umbrella. Despite the horrible experience, we still tipped them.

 WE WILL NEVER RETURN TO THIS ESTABLISHMENT AGAIN!!!

Always liked this place. Their location is great. Tons of seating inside and outside. Whole wall can be opened if the weather permits. Sophisticated crowd, good service and good beer with very generous happy hour (50% off all drafts and pizza). Most importantly you can talk and have a conversation without a problem. Acoustics here are great.

Clearly, this place is awesome. I'm just here to confirm.

On a FREEZING cold night, the lights and warmth of Zahav were a lifesaver. We perused the menu while hummus and laffa were served. I could have eaten about five more servings of laffa but I managed to reign it in. The hummus had a smooth, buttery consistency and had an amazing, earthy olive oil drizzled on top. We ordered drinks (The New Jerusalem Cocktail was to die for and very strong) and our meal and then the salatim arrived. Everything was incredible. My favorite was the beets. I didn't even know I liked beets but whatever they did to them rocked my world. 

After that we were served a quick succession of dishes: stuffed grape leaves with tender mushrooms; potato latke with salty salmon and paper-thin cucumbers in a cool, creamy yogurt sauce; haloumi with thin slivers of apple on top of a sweet fig sauce (my favorite dish of the evening); fried kibbe, a sort of Israeli meatball; hanger steak with eggplant and trumpet mushroom with lamb bacon. It was never ending and who would want it to? I gobbled up everything. The spices and flavors were so different and wonderful. 

For dessert we both had the chocolate baklava which is good because that meant I didn't have to share. The one thing I didn't like about the meal was the pumpkin ice cream. I didn't think it tasted like anything and I wish I'd substituted the coffee ice cream that came with the rugelach. But no matter. The chocolate baklava rolls promptly disappeared and I'm hoping to try the rugelach and coffee ice cream next time. Yum!! 

To sum up: Our waiter and service in general was fantastic. The atmosphere was romantic. The food was delicious. Mad props to Zahav.

Decided to change up my normal order.  Went for a mady's madness (I think).  Called ahead and was ready when I walked in.  I definitely enjoyed the chicken and bacon.

No complaints.  Plus, they have front door parking for take out.  Still a favorite go to.

Got took on a surprise date here and didn't know what to expect. I ordered the Singapore street noodles with the lettuce wrap as an appetizer. Never tried any of these before so I was a little on edge, and I hate to waste food haha. Lettuce wrap came out and it was amazing. The sauce and meat were a mouth full of flavor! The noodles came out and the chicken and shrimp was spicy just the way I like my food at home! So glad I got out my comfort zone and dined here. Can't wait to go back

Commendations to our server Ruby. The restaurant was way understaffed and she hustled.  The food was more than disappointing. My wife's arugala and watermelon salad had 4 small chunks of watermelon. The salad was the size of a soup bowl and just filled with arugala and tasteless dressing. Nothing else. My prime rib dip was not good. Meat slices were burned crispy on the edges and many slices were just unrendered fat. The sandwich was sloppily made and half off the bread.  For the money we paid for lunch the chef should be totally embarresed. Shame on you.
Great Chicago style pizza! We had "The Works" Chicago style pizza and really enjoyed it. This will be our new in town pizza place.

Da Sesto did delivery catering for a large family event. It was amazing, every step of the way. Great menu, delicious food, prompt delivery and set up (by Sesto himself), friendly staff. My family was thrilled and I'm grateful how easy it was. Would absolutely use them again for a major event anytime.

Seems as if it just expanded, well at least to my eyes, the bar is a tight spot but the beers are worth the squueze. Need Room - go to the back for a table, there are a few booths too. Oh, want to eat Al Fresco - when warm - you may. And you're hungry...no disappointment here. Beer Geek kind or aspiring to be - come thirsty. Great all around.

My husband and I were wandering in and out of pizzaria's. We were completely ignored at a couple restaurants and enthusiastically greeted at several establishments until I revealed we were hoping to look at the menu before we committed. Once revealed, the hostess was indifferent.  
Then we walked into Flippers. we were greeted by Vincent who really is the nicest young man you could ever hope to meet!
Vincent was incredibly helpful in explaining the differences in crusts along with topping suggestions. 
I recently retired after over 30 years in retail Diamond and later, then furniture.  I had high expectations for my employees and expected as much when visiting retail shops and restaurants.
It takes a lot to dazzle and impress me and happens so rarely.  Vincent made my first visit one of those rare occasions. 
He greeted me with a warm and genuine smile. When informed we were just scouting out pizza restaurants and only wished to look over the menu, Vincent made us feel welcome and offered us a seat regardless of our uncertainty that we may not stay. 
I was incredibly impressed with his enthusiasm and pride in what he was serving. His confidence in the quality and there was no uncertainty in his voice .Vincent is the model employee!  As I am aware and am confident that you are also, employees with the customer service skills Vincent possesses is so rare! 
This young man is an amazing find! For every 500 hires I MIGHT find an employee HALF as good as Vincent. .
My husband and I just came to stay for a week while looking to buy a home or property to build on. Once we have settled in, we will be guaranteed regulars. In the meantime; we will be in every time we're in town. Please let Vincent know how much he was appreciated and that we will come in and hope to be greeted by Vincent on our next visit 
Give that young man a raise! He is such an assett!
Sincerely, 
Shelley Horsley

I dined at Zona 78 on Saturday night with 3 good friends. We started with wine, which was recommended by our server. He did not steer us wrong! We also enjoyed the Tomato and Mozzarella Bruschetta with a brilliant sauce that was just amazing. 
For my entree, I decided on the Macaroni and Cheese. I was torn, as I've enjoyed many meals at Zona 78 and didn't know if I wanted to "settle" for Mac and Cheese, but I was GLAD that I did. It was creamy and complex and delicious. 
Sadly, two of my dining companions had slightly less enjoyable meals with a bland salad and a salty pizza. From my experience, however, being unsatisfied seems to be the exception, not the rule. 
As a bonus, it was clearly Winter Formal night for a nearby high school, adding free entertainment watching girls in wobbly heels split salads while texting each other and boys in suits and tennis shoes scarf down whole pizzas in record time.
As always, the atmosphere was great - casual and relaxed yet somewhat sophisticated - and our server was attentive and knowledgeable about the wine and food. I'll be back!

I like this place. As a former New York resident, I know good pizza and this is pretty good pizza at a reasonable price (they don't claim to be "New York pizza" so that's not the bar to judge by). It seems a good place to take kids too, since they have an area with video games that seem to be free to use (I'm not a gamer so I didn't bother to ask). They also have this crazy contraption hooked up on the ceiling that flies a big model plane around on a track, which makes for another distraction for the kids (see photo).
I love this place for years I thought the only thing served was pizza one day during ladies night out a friend suggested this place we could not have been full and happier everything was good

I thought Philly only had hoagie shops and gastropubs, but Ekta turned my ignorant notions into... uh... non...ignorance.  Anyway I guess Philly has good Indian food as well.  Ekta was my first taste of Indian food in the great city of Philly and it did not disappoint. I went there with my bud DJ on a man-date, and we got lamb chettinad, samosa chaat, and garlic naan. We got the samosa chaat based on the recommendation of Manzur, the server/manager, and it was good but we had no idea it was a cold dish... kind of like a cold, mashed samosa gazpacho.  It's good, I promise, but if you're craving a samosa then that's probably not going to satisfy.  But no worries, Manzur sensed our slight disappointment and gave DJ and I an order of regular samosas ON THE HOUSE, which of course is my favorite. Free. 

A little tip: dine in and get a punch card.  If you dine in 5 times, you get 1 free entree the next time you eat in.  ALSO, if you bring your own gin, they can make authentic Indian cocktails and you can mix the gin in yourself. PARTY WITH MANZUR!

If you've been to Johnny Rockets before then this isn't anything different. The decor and atmosphere are the same as any other. They also offer the same food so don't be surprised. With that being said, we had great service, it wasn't overly crowded, and our food didn't take long to get to us. For us that is what we needed, somewhere quick and fun to eat that would hold us over for an early dinner. Our food was cooked exactly how we wanted it and the waitress went over and beyond what i expected her to do by always offering refills and asking if we wanted more fries. If your looking for a quick, inexpensive place to eat then Johnny Rockets is it!

Went for brunch and were disappointed. Waited over an hour to get our food after ordering. It seemed for brunch they were under staffed. Even when we got our food it was not very good. I had the steak and eggs and the steak was barely edible. It was extremely tough. It was nice to try something new but will not be going back.

Excellent Indian food. Much better than other fancier restaurants. Don't let the decor or location fool you. Excellent naans and chicken tikka masala. They even have lassi, not listed on the menu though.

My fiancé and I eat pizza probably twice a week. We love trying new places. This pizza was horrible. It tastes worse than movie theatre pizza. The crust wasn't flavored at all and the breadsticks tasted like they were frozen before. Will never go back. Don't waste your time. Only tried it because it's where Naked pizza used to be.

I stopped here for lunch and was seated in the tiny foyer area which was great for people watching but I have NO idea what the rest of the restaurant looks like. I had the Roasted Turkey wrap and was delighted it was also served with a side salad. For someone that went through an obsession with counting calories I thought the calories looked a little low for the amount of food served (about 350) but I am far from an expert on these things and kind of stopped caring. Overall - fresh food and quick service - I love a good 'healthy food' joint so this place fared well for me and I'd go back again.

I wanted a restaurant that was a bit off the beaten path, good wine, a bit interesting in food choices and quiet.  I got all that at Mambu.  Adorable, a lovely patio to sit on (after the rain, cooler weather than it has been the past few days), and wonderful service, I could not have asked for much more.  

I started with the mussels in a coconut curry sauce.  More coconut than curry; a lovely dish.  I also had the salmon pizza, and it was fantastic, but a lot for one person, especially after an appetizer.  They had good wine to pair with each dish, and the server was very familiar with both the menu and the beverages.  I was there for 2 hours, just hanging out after a long day, and Daniel was attentive and yet didn't hover.  He was always there when I needed him, but he left me alone to relax, as well.  

I couldn't ask for much more...it was a great end to a day I needed to get away from...a definite recommendation!

Some other dishes I wanted to try but didn't because I wasn't looking for a full dish: Salmon, Risotto and Scallops.  They had a Mango Creme Brulee that looked a-mazing as well!!!

this place is super cute and the food is GREAT!! i went with my three small children - i probably wouldn't do that again. the tables are small and close together. But the food was great. i have told my sisters and friends about this place and now they all go all the time. its great in the spring bc the farmer's market is right across the street. on saturday its free suds day (i think they still do it). over all a good place with good food

I am always on the hunt for places that have good chicken fried rice and they have it! Often I find places that have small, over cooked pieces of chicken but this was not the case here. I do tend to like a lot of chicken so next time I will order extra but only because that is how I specifically like it and not because it was hardly present. 

I also ordered the crispy spring rolls which I could go without next time. I found them to have very little filling compared to amount of wrap used, making the inside kinda mooshy. 

I ordered take out for lunch but they do have a sign out front that states they are open for dine in and take out, please note they are closed on Mondays.

Food was excellent..
I got salmon. It was delicious!
This BJs doesn't have the chalk board listing all the beers...
I got a BJs root beer, flavor was good but no flizz, thus a flop...
To end we r getting the pizookie triple!!! Yum
Save room for dessert
Tried this place a few Fridays ago for a change in what we typically order in Northern Liberties.  Actually not bad pizza.  Great crust & very fast delivery.  Would try again.

Place was ammmmazing!!!! Set at bar with Lyndsey and our server and she was fantastic! So sweet and helpful. The chargrilled oysters were some of the best I've ever had. The Bloody Mary and roast beef P.O. boy did NOT disappoint!
Table stinks like it was wiped with sour rag. Somebody somewhere is smoking I suspect in back. Take a pass
Very good and authentic. Not a Tex-Mex kind of place, just straight Mexican food.

This is probably my favorite place to kick back and get food and drinks in the area. Their weekly specials are always bomb. There's always a new beer to try. Bartenders/servers have all been super fun and kind. And the live music is always good!

Never again... straight trash 32 dollars worth of shit. How do u get 3 items a cheesesteak platter a chicken cheesesteak platter but get charged for two sides of fries...ummm tf i thought that consisted of a platter then gave an old two liter of formented sunny d im lost for words rn bc everything was wasted fue to the quality
What a joke. No service for 20 minutes. Then they brought water. Then 20 more minutes and no offer to take our order. Music too loud, couldn't hear myself think. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND

We went here for Easter brunch and it was great! I got a fruit & granola parfait and my husband got the chicken & waffles which looked amazing as well. Oh & they had $2 mimosas and bloody marys! A couple of the people that went with us ordered sausage & tator tots, which I actually did try & OMG talk about amazing! We'll be going back soon!

This place recently opened in Carmel and its great for a cheap lunch.  They have all the toppings you could ever want on your pizza and it is so fast.  However, even though I would never go for the single topping pizza remember less is more.  I went with a coworker and I think he almost put every topping on his pizza and it was a bit much. The meatballs are a must try if you are contemplating it.

Ordered this place for the first time. Asked for extra dressing for a $15 salad which was basically lettuce. They charged us $3 for dressing. My husband went to pick up the order. He did not see an extra dressing and the person said she was sure it was in the container.
Got home. No extra dressing. Called the restaurant. They said it was in the container, which is super annoying because we went through all of the containers. They said they would refund us the $3. No refund. 
We will not be back. Poor customer service.

Yes... I LOVED this place so much.

When I first walked in, I thought, "man, this place has a really great vibe." I was not wrong. First of all, when you walk in, there's a man playing jazz. How can you go wrong there?

We sat down and our server immediately came up to us and asked what we wanted to drink. There's a mimosa deal, so, that was a no brainer. We were constantly asked if we wanted an appetizer, refill on our drinks or if were ready to order our meal. I was very pleased at how wonderful the staff was. Our server got my table's sense of humor which made it all the better. (We weren't exactly the classiest that this particular brunch).  While on this subject, the air conditioner was broken and the staff also came by and sprayed Evian on us so we weren't warm. I immediately started singing the theme song to "The Jeffersons" b/c this was when I knew I was 'movin' on up' in the world.

I had the pleasure of getting the Goat Cheese Salad. YUM! I loved the flavor, and let's face it, anything with goat cheese is going to be a winner!

All in all I really enjoyed my experience at the Crumb&Cork and I really can't wait to go back! New fave place to brunch? I think so!

Hubby and I met at the Kentucky Derby, so going to he Belle Meade was a must. The horse history didn't disappoint, with an opportunity to learn about the racing industry in both the gorgeous barn and during the mansion tour.

The mansion itself was spectacularly appointed and Sara did a great job with the tour. One left with a sense of the Harding Family that gave insight to both their triumphs and their failures.

The grounds were also beautifully kept. The signage was beautiful and easily understood, there were places to lounge and relax (You could play Cornhole, rock on the porch or enjoy the Civil War Trail on a nicer day) and opportunities to enjoy wine or a meal presented themselves on site for those looking to make a day of it.

Overall, the tour was well done, but after my second plantation tour (The first being in New Orleans), I'm wondering how plantations can acknowledge the slaves that worked at the plantations (There were slave cabins and the claim that many are working to identify those who were at Belle Meade through photographs) and not gloss over this part of history. It wasn't completely swept under the rug, but wasn't exactly discussed either. Perhaps that's just me.

Overall an interesting way to spend a few hours in an interesting place.

I have never had chicken and waffles, but a coworker picked this place for her birthday lunch. There was almost no wait for a big group, which was nice   Our waitress, Cece, was great and checked on our table frequently and did a fabulous job. 

The food was good. I wasn't the biggest fan of the famously popular chicken and waffles, but tthe portion was veery generous and many of the people in our group also got the chicken and waffles and really loved it! I was a big fan of the peach butter that came on the waffles! So yummy! 

With the location, I was a bit unsure what this place would be like, but I was very happy with it!!

We were a group of four that were in town for the weekend. We ate here on a Saturday afternoon.  We got sat and greeted right away. Burgers came out quick, hot and tasted fresh.  We also had two milkshakes that were awesome. We will definitely be back when we are in area again.

Cheu is great, and while I want to dock it a star for its own success, that's really not fair. Expect to have to wait for a table, that's just the deal. Is it worth waiting? It's good, but I really hate waiting! But we're going with 5 stars because I think when you weigh the components: food, atmosphere, service, and price, it all makes sense and adds up to Cheu.

Let's focus on the food first -- for vegan/vegetarian options, the menu is well marked for veg things and things that can be veg which is awesome. The food is very tasty and comes out fast.

I've had the coconut curry noodles and the Sichuan fat noodles, and would recommend both -- possibly the fat noodles a bit more because I love those noodles.

It's got a good atmosphere, well done for a small space. While it's tight, once you're sitting down you really aren't encumbered by it (tables near the bar may disagree). The service is good, although I will say that the last time I went, our server forgot to put in our order, but the food comes out so fast that it didn't make a huge difference to us. Prices are pretty much what you'd expect, more expensive than say, Chinatown, but makes sense for this sort of place. Recommend!

Really nice staff with a sense of humor, food was a lot better then any place close by. I recommend the wings. Place felt like everyone was happy that you were there. Will be a good place for sporting events. Comedy club is close so you get waves of new people walking through. Eye candy everywhere!
pizza delivery was fast especially since we were at the hotel right behind this location.  pizza was tasty and the kids enjoyed it.

I have been waiting for ages to try the fried chicken at Willie Mae's, and I must say it did not disappoint! I went with a party of 3 for lunch on a Monday, and we waited in line about 20 minutes. Everyone we met was visiting the city and really friendly. I think the weather definitely played into how fast the line moved for us because it was pouring earlier that morning so the line was not long compared to others I had spoken to before.

We all ordered the fried chicken (bone-in and tenders) with mac & cheese, green beans, cornbread, and rice and gravy. The chicken was surprising light with the breading, and it was delicious. The white meat was definitely juicy, but not greasy. The dark meat had a tendency to be a little too greasy, but the flavor was great throughout. The sides were good and the green beans had a nice kick to them. I ordered a lemonade which was really good, not too sweet at all. 

The service was wonderful. Our waitress was quick and attentive. There were a couple of times she forgot some things, but she was managing a number of tables and multitasking so it's to be expected. She remembered without us having to say anything, and returned quickly.

I plan to return with family later this year!

First off it's instant seating on Easter Sunday dinner. The place was packed, but very large seating area. 

The waitress that greeted us was chipper and very nice. I didn't expect that in a holiday. She asked us for a drink/appetizer order. We were not ready, and she was back within 5 minute. Very commendable. 

I ordered the Patron Margherita and my wife ordered the the special 'deep eddy' strawberry marg. Both were strong and delicious. 

For dinner the kids had 2 x the 2 for $25 that included an appetizer or 2 salads, one of many entrees with 2 sides, and a shared deserts. One dinner 3 for $10 which is basically the same, but includes a drink.  Wife and I shared 3 meat fajita platter with chicken, steak and shrimp. The kids chose:

Chips and guacamole 
2 salads
Sirloin steak
2x Margherita grilled chicken
Bacon cheese burger
1/2 rack ribs
Cheese cake 
Pan cookie
Sides included: fries, loaded mash, lots of steamed broccoli, more broccoli...

First off, guacamole was quite delicious. They didn't have that fake powdery or watery style that you find in a lot of restaurants. There were real, large chucks of fresh avocado. The salads were standard. 

The salads and appetizers arrived really quickly, the dinner took abit more time. That is expected on Easter Sunday.  
 
The ribs were perfect, Tender and Smokey. The 'just Bacon' Burger was HUGE and cooked perfect. The fries were fresh. The meats for fajita were grilled and spiced really nice. 

The desserts arrived timely and both baked Cookie with ice cream and cheese cake were good. Not great but good. 

Overall the food was excellent, service great, price was amazing for the quality and quantity of food given. We will come back.

5 star all the way!

We found this new restaurant and it was so good!! The waitress made you feel as if you were a guess in her home. She was very on it, refilling our drinks, giving us more chips and that's not easy with a party of 8. The food was really good authentic Mexican food. We all had something different and none of us were disappointed. The price was very affordable.

Stopped here after an afternoon of thrifting in the area. What a great choice! We sat outside in the covered area with fans and it was quite cool despite the heat outside. Our waitress was very friendly and attentive and the service overall was exceptional! Their extensive menu ranges from salads to burgers and sandwiches to entrees. So many choices at terrific prices it was difficult to choose! I have Celiac Disease so I chose the grilled mahi salad with mango dressing. All of their gluten free dressings were listed seperately. The salad was not only extra large and the presentation beautiful but it was absolutely delicious! My only disappointment is that we live an hour away and can't come back more frequently to try other things on the menu! Will definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone traveling to the area!

This spot is amazing. Easily Top #4 Sushi spots out here in Sparks/Reno.  Real grwa working and even better food. The appetizer selection is great and they have many many delicious rolls. The restaurant is really clean and open to a lot of seating. Jorge & Donovan know what they're doing behind that bar! They have great attitude and make your overall experience enjoyable! Defiantly coming back!!

WOW! 

We arrived fashionably late ( 5 minutes) for our reservation and waited a few more minutes for the table. They have way too many tables in to small of a space. Service was friendly and upbeat especially in such a tight space with people milling around., 

Salad was good as well as the mushroom appetizer. 
The olive oil dip with basalmic was sublime and I dipped the mushrooms from the appetizer in it just to savor the fact. 

Wife got the salmon--she stated it was perfectly prepared. 
I got the filet mignon since my daughter's employer had stated it was the best she had ever had ( above LeBec Fin/Four Seasons) and.....she was right. second to none. The only filet I have ever ordered that I could not finish. Seriously.....could not finish it. 

Desert--homemade ricotta cannoli- delectable. 

Negatives- No ambiance, it's all about the food and they did not disappoint. The filet was drop dead out of control as was the cannoli. 

The only reason they did not get five stars was the ambiance. FYI no amex. Oh and the pricing was very reasonable. The 16oz filet was 26.95

We were visiting Tucson and after a long day we were looking for a  small family Italian restaurant. Nothing fancy, just good homemade food. We just happened to see Dolce Vita across from Walgreens and close to Sketchers on Campbell and Ft Lowell. What a gem!  The restaurant is small and has outdoor seating.  The menu covered all the bases. There were several items on there I would have liked to try but settle with linguine in white clam sauce.  It was a light olive oil sauce and pasta was perfectly done.  They served a complimentary farfalle salad to share. All entrees come with a soup or salad. Portions were large enough to enjoy for lunch today! Prices were very reasonable.  Will be back to try the Manicotti and we will save room for dessert.
I had the Bistro Benedict, it was very good! Cute spot, yummy food, and friendly service.

I haven't been to New Orleans in years and after eating at Royal House it made me question what the hell I've been doing with my life. 

The wait was short at only about 15 minutes and we started with what we had been craving for days, oysters on the half shell, but that wasn't enough so we moved on to oysters Rockefeller and they were absolutely amazing. Next we had the royal trio with jambalaya, red beans and rice, and crawfish étouffée. I cannot say enough this dish is why I love this city and it did not disappoint. Top that off with a few more oysters and a couple Abitas and you are off to a great night.

I've been wanting to try finch n fork for a while now and finally got the chance to do so. It was a very nice experience but a little pricy. To start with the ambiance is lovely. Definitely has a hotel feel but sometimes that can be fun. Very nice bar as well with really good cocktails. The food was good as well. I started off with the deviled eggs then had the beet salad. For my entree, I went with the sea bass. All of it was good. I would recommend this restaurant as long as you are ready for some higher prices. I will be back.

Hungry Howie's in general is great pizza... being from Michigan. 
Service at this location needs a lot of work. We always have to check the pizza at the counter when we are picking it up. 75% of the time the pizza does not have the flavor crust we request. 50% of the time the pizza isn't even cut into slices.

Very delicious sushi!! Menu was huge and had so many options! Almost overwhelming! 

Some cons: The lighting is very low so can be hard to read menu, quite loud, small vene. Pros: Great sushi, delicious appetizers, awesome staff (especially the hostesses!)

I absolutely love this place the food is really good and it is worth every penny but the thing that really stands out about this place its the staff they always have a big smile on their face and always make sure you are taken care of. Definitely recommend this place!

Anyone else find it disturbing that I actually waited 20 min, standing room only, at IHOP this morning, in the middle of shrieking infants?  Yeah, so did my super cranky boyfriend.  Sure, it's not the most sophisticated breakfast fare, but once we finally took a seat, our waiter was friendly, the service was fast, despite the massive crowd, and my country omelette with no ham, hashbrowns, and buttermilk pancakes were filling (ok, more like artery clogging) and tasty.

Would I wait 20 min at IHOP every weekend?  Nah.  Will I eat there again in the near future?  Probably not.  But every once in a while, why not?  Next time though, I might have to leave the bf at home.

Basically you can't go wrong with pizza in my opinion, but Longboards has some unusual toppings a s combos that totally elevate their pizza to a whole new level.  

Everything about the experience was great. Friendly staff, delicious pizza, the ability to customize your toppings, delicious crust, and that red chili oil they put on the tables. I had a pizza with pesto sauce and fresh ricotta (my absolute favorite pizza topping), and a few other yummy toppings. I received my pizza and was like "geez it's huge" and yet it was so good I just couldn't stop. Or rather, I did not want to. Dipping it into that chili oil and a hint of ranch.. just perfection. 

Absolutely will be back!!

The rolls here are pretty subpar. I come here only because they have good priced lunch specials, and the sushi rolls here are better than the pre-made rolls at Publix. With the lunch special you get miso soup and two rolls for $10. Pretty good price. Still I would be lying if I said the food here was good. It's just meh and I continue to come back because my USF friends appreciate the price and note it as "good enough" for a quick meal out.

Having moved to the area recently, bf and I were curious to try what seems to be a neighborhood staple. We were underwhelmed.

The space itself looks like it hasn't been touched for decades - very dark, very outdated. The cocktails we ordered were pretty awful -- we agreed this is definitely a place to order wine instead. The bread and peppers were the one good part of the meal. My boyfriend's chicken parm was ok but very under-seasoned, as were my gnocchi which came in the same bland red sauce.

Our waiter was perfectly friendly and polite, but spent a large percentage of our meal talking to us, when we would have been happy to have had a date to ourselves. The teens working the water refilling and table clearing seemed obviously annoyed to be there.

I hate to write a negative review but I genuinely don't get the appeal other than neighborhood sentimentality, and hope to see some more exciting options show up where I'd be more likely to spend what Anthony's is charging.

had an issue with the roast beef po'boy. Had an odd flavor that might be described as starting to be off. Not enough debris so it was drier than other places that offer these.  Mentioned to the server about this and no offer of taking it off the bill or offering something in its place.   I guess since it is the French Quarter there is nothing to be done. Alligator bites are good but sauce is not spicy.  Probably would not come back. Too many other options for food here   Server did take the sandwich off so kudos for her.  She will get a good tip for that.

Must try brunch! First off start with a mimosa or spiked coffee, but I recommend the $5 mimosas on Sunday! They were absolutely delicious. If you sign up online you will get a free order of beignets which are a MUST! They were dangerously perfect. Next good luck picking from the menu because there are so many amazing choices! I went with the Floridian omelette. It had cream cheese and crab mean and was amazing! But all the options looked so perfect it was a really hard choice. I do recommend using the checkin option to save your spot in line since they don't take reservations and it's small and gets packed easily. Absolutely must try !

Friday afternoon, Mix and Match, fried fish and the turkey wing, with collard greens and mac & cheese.  Washed it down with a little Homemade Sweet Tea.  Everything was great. Turkey was fall off the bone tender and the collard greens were the best I've had yet! We will be back!

Good food, nice atmosphere but completely ignorant and/or homophobic waiter who kept misgendering us and who had to be flagged down made this a place we are unlikely to come back to. Not sure what his problem was but even if he was just a homophobic douche, we still shouldn't have to flag down another waiter to order, get the bill and he got our order wrong.

I liked that it was a quiet street, we were outside which didn't have the best views with a loading dock across the street but it was quiet. Service at least our waiter was painfully slow and incompetent. The hostess and the other server were far pleasanter and they were the ones that actually got our order right and got us our check.

We ordered some cocktails that were all good and assortment of dishes.

We had
Smoked Salmon deviled eggs-the smoked salmon seemed to be missing but maybe it was mixed in the yolk. They still tasted good.

Strawberry and spinach salad.  this was large and fresh and it's hard to mess up and they didn't.

Strawberry and lettuce salad. this is the dish they messed up, didn't apologize for and it took at least 15 minutes to get a new one.

Duck confit club sandwich. On the plus side it was huge, on the minus side it was pretty bland. It desperately need a sauce or spread of some kind, maybe a fruit gastrique.

Fries with parmesan cheese. One the best things of the night. deep fried shoe strings fries topped with way too much melted cheese to ever be healthy.

Truffled mac and cheese. this was disappointing, the mac was overcooked and there was barely any truffle flavour. I think they probably just use a little bit of the oregon truffle oil. Much worse than truffled mac and cheeses I've had in NYC and San Francisco.

Honestly if it wasn't for the either incompetent waiter, I would go back and try more of the menu. It was nice for a late night snack.

If i could give them a 0 for customer service i would. I went to buy cheesesteaks with my uncle and my smaller cousins , and I asked the guy at the front if it was possible to cut it into 6 pieces. But the guy cutting the cheesesteak answered me with a big attitude, saying:" ARE YOU KIDDING ME!? HOW AM I CUT IT INTO 6 PIECES!? AM GONNA CUT MY FINGER!". So yeah instead of a yes or no answer, if you ask them something expect them to answer you back with a tone and attitude, so rude . Not worth the experience. Just got 1 cheesesteak from them and then went to GENO's to buy the rest.

Love this place. Didn't really get to experience drinks, but I did try their fish and chips and it was amazing (coming from a British person). My good friend goes there and gets the gourmet wings every time; he still dreams about them.

My husband and I stopped into The Cheesecake Factory, unexpectedly. The host was very pleasant. She informed us that it was happy hour. Great. We headed 2 the bar and was greeted by Jacob. Jacob was THEEEEEE BESTTTTTT. His service was awesome and very attentive. What really thrilled me with Jacob is that he DID NOT sterotype my husband and I and that means a lot to me. We ordered 4 appetizers and I must say, THEY WERE AMAZINGGGGGGGGGGGGGGG. The Tuna Tatare damn near gave me an orgasm. Omg. It was the best Tuna I've had in my life. This will be my all time happy hour spot. #2thumbsup #keepupthegoodwork
By far one of the best burgers I've ever eaten!  Great service, environment and food.  We will 100% go back!

Great service and food. Our waiter, friendly and knowledgeable, introduced us to the restaurant and made great recommendations which led us to try their octopus. It was grilled and very tender. Also glad we tried something new. The gyros were excellent and both meals were served with rice, peas and half a potato- all had plenty of flavor. Portions were more than enough. We almost never get desert but with their own bakery attached to the restaurant, we had to try some. Their cheesecake baklava was excellent and there were pages of baked delights to choose from. Don't miss stopping here when you visit Tarpon Springs!

A cute place but they have problems with the help. We went today for brunch and to watch the game. No brunch today, but we called?? We had a group of 12! Hope they get their act together!! Today they didn't have it!!

I got the chance to try a few of their sweet treats for a birthday outing.  The chocolate chip cookies are killer-- some of the best I've ever had.  But it was the smores blondie that my husband described as a religious experience--- ooey-gooey, and sinfully sweet.  I also really liked their iced tea, which has a hint of clove in it.  It goes particularly well with their chocolate treats.  We will definitely be back!

Wow! Great atmosphere and killer food.  I will we back as often as possible; we live an hour away but it is worth the drive!  Salads were top notch and fresh.  The pizza to die for.  Good wine selection.  Will try the beer next time.

This Steakhouse is at the Boomtown Casino on Hwy 80 just into Nevada, located in Verdi. The was a real treat! We regularly go to the Boomtown Buffet and carefully select several items we like for a light dinner. We have passed this Steakhouse numerous times thinking we would need to try it out, but fearing the worst based upon the variability of the buffet.
When we received a comp from Boomtown Steakhouse, we decided to go ahead and risk it. I only wish we had done it sooner.
First, the overall feeling of the Boomtown Casino is not glitzy or glamourous. But the Steakhouse is very nicely furnished and presents itself very well. We were greeted with smiling, happy service quickly and regularly attentive to our needs.
My wife had the Steak and Shrimp, I had the Steak and Lobster. They were excellent. But first, we were served our salad on a chilled plate, and very good too. I have always found a good salad usually leads to a good  meal. I don't know why but it's true. No exception here. After to salad, we were treated to a Champagne Sorbet palate cleanser. Very good. And of course the coup de gras, our Turf and Surf plates. The lobster was good sized and the shrimp were more like prawns. The steak was not super large, but quite well cooked and seasoned. We were too full for dessert; but then again, we are older and don't eat all that much.
As much as we wanted to try the desserts, we were too full and satisfied to complain.
This was a very pleasant surprise. We really like Boomtown for it's relaxed atmosphere in the feeling of casinos from yesteryear. But this was way better than we expected and we think it was a super good value.
We will definitely be back!

With the exception of the mumbling hostess, we had a great first experience at The New Berlin Diner. 
Our server was friendly and quick. 
I ordered the Western Omelet (4 eggs!) plus Hollandaise Sauce (of which the quality of is how I judge all diners!). Delicious! Fresh and yummy. Toast was typical and the huge portion of home fries were browned and crispy to my liking, but not my favorite part of the breakfast by any means.
While there we found out that some organization has rated TNBD the number one diner in South Jersey four years running! I can see why. 
Just wish they served Coca-Cola products!

It's pricey, but the food was very good. We selected from the combos with the garlic butter seasoning. Shrimp and Snow Crab, and the combo with mussels. It's a messy, eat with your fingers kinda place. Wear washable clothing and you'll be fine. They do supply gloves and bibs, but gloves make it harder to peel shrimp and crack snow crab shells.
Seating can be a little awkward for dinner, but great bar. Best Old Fashioned in Tampa.
Nice fried chicken and meat party! But the drink is wired and not so good. The environment is fine.

This restaurant is everything I love about the Philly food scene. Nice decor, casual atmosphere, reasonable prices and *delicious* food. 

The server was knowledgeable and friendly, and offered to let us sample a few beers before making a selection. (I recommend the Barbar Belgian Honey Ale).

Definitely get olives - you have three choices for only $3. We loved the pistachio ones. The Fromage plate was also great - you get to try all seven cheeses for $15. My boyfriend loved the burger, especially the wide range of choices for toppings. (He went with a fried egg, smoked gouda, and bacon).  I'm a vegetarian and the mushroom soup was perfect for a chilly day.

Not too crowded for two on a Saturday night. You should definitely go.

We were running behind and most restaurants were on a 2 hour wait.  We decided to go to Hard Rock because big name chains typically always give you exactly what you expect food and service wise.  No less and typically no more.  We arrived last Saturday evening and decided to go upstairs for the live band.  Band was awesome and the food was exactly what we wanted.  The service was far from acceptable though.

We thought it was weird that customers did not seem that happy and that during prime dinner time, the crowd was clearing out (though the 1st floor wasn't).  After waiting 15-25 min for our first round of drinks, it became very obvious what the issue was.  Everything took a ton of time.  We actually ended up walking up to the service bar and grabbing our 2nd round of drinks ourselves since our server was constantly walking past it.  We were there for quite a bit of time and not even a manager touched the table to ask us about our experience.

My wife and I both come from the service industry and typically always give people the benefit of the doubt.  This was not acceptable though.  There were not many sat tables and they had plenty of staff capable of helping each other.  The bar was empty and bartender was completely free to run drinks.
Delicious! One of our favorites in the neighborhood. The service is great and entrees always come out good. The pizza is excellent also. Love that it is byob !!
Excellent authentic Mexican food. Very friendly staff. Basic furnishings add to the experience. I will come here again for sure!
Coming back up again! Just had a pizza and it was a awesome! Last week I got a Stromboli it was literally the best I've had in a while.! Keep up the good work!
Dirty-needs to have management present with systems in place and daily checklists to get that place cleaned up!  We enjoy IHop food and it is a shame that we can't enjoy our local restaurant.
Just looking for brunch on the last day of our Big Easy get away and stumbled upon this place. Everything was wonderful!

For some reason this was recommended to me by a local and I just don't get it. First, the concierge tried to get reservations for me the night before. She was told they were booked until 2pm. We wanted 10am. I was told that this is the best Jazz Brunch in town so we decided to try our luck just walking in at 10 am.  There were plenty of open tables and we were seated immediately. Well....save your money folks! It's $29 for cafeteria food! I'll admit the hollandaise sauce on the eggs benedict was probably the best I've ever had but everything else was sub-par. The floors were old and just looked dirty and tired. The jazz was nice and the service was good but if you're a foodie (and I am)....allowing for buffet style food.....this is not worth it. Don't get me wrong, I'm willing to pay for good food but in my opinion, this buffet is probably worth $12.95, at the most!

So many things wrong with this place. I'll start with the worst. The guy rolling my burrito rolled it directly on my tray. When I said something to him about it, he acted like it was no big deal, as if this is normal procedure and he didn't understand that this is not normal. The next thing is the communication barrier, they had multiple people working here and no one really spoke English. The food tasted good, but I couldn't get over the fact that it was rolled on the tray.

I can't give them less than one star or I would. This gay hating disrespectful restaurant blew my mind away yesterday. Then when speaking to a manager who didn't do anything about It i realized it was not worth the 45 min. Wait. We got off a long day at the boat and we're hungry after being told about 45 min approached the host stand after an hour and asked how much longer as the young girl roled her eyes and my group all of a sudden she was able to pull two tables together and said here and I don't want to hear another word from you! Then when my friend decided to go talk to manager she profiled him from across the room and wouldn't even listen to him since he was dressed pretty flamboyant this lady was so rude she will never have my service nor anyone eles i know. She needs to get a job she's better at and not have the potential to serve the gay community! Not sure her name but it was at 6:00 pm on a Sunday if this restaurant even cares about this

February 8, 2019 Friday - 12:30 PM for lunch
1 Adult

Atmosphere - NA 
Food - 5 stars
Service - 5 stars

Background - Actually planning to do some Asian food for lunch.  Then at 11 am I received an office e-mail about the truck being here today. Perfect timing, now I do not have go out.

Atmosphere - A food "truck", which is really a trailer.  So not much to rate here.

Food
  Lunch - Laotian style sandwich with beef.  The picture from the menu does not do this sandwich justice.  I recommend that they take some better pictures.  The beef was so tender, crisp veggies, with a sauce which made for a five napkin mess of a sandwich.  I could have had another one.  I was sad when the sandwich was gone. 

Service - Today it was a one man operation, and fast and friendly.  I was the only one in line but the total time from ordering to finish eating was less than 15 minutes.

Future - Yes, please.

Great food and awesome little covered patio. Service was fantastic. 
We tried a variety of menu items to share, and everything was spot on.

I did a take out order of the bahn mi and sadly... it wasn't really bahn mi.  The meat was wrong.  It was the charred meat you would have in the bun dishes and then squirted with sriracha sauce.  It was ok in flavor but not what bahn mi should have been.

Four adults and one 4 yr old girl.  It was on a Saturday a little b4 noon.  They were not busy at the time.  Each of the orders were brought out about 10 minutes apart.  First the pancake for the young girl, then the others, one by one.  A sampling of our orders included a very unsatisfactory Breakfast Bowl containing two very un-crisp strips of underdone bacon that were supposed to be crispy and broken up.  Toast was burnt.  Biscuit was doughy.  The much-touted large portions were often child-sized. They were obviously having a bad day? Did we pick a bad day or time?  There was a real problem with this place on our visit.
Blaze pizza is the best pizza in town.I enjoy the pizza and customer service I received a employee named T seems to know how to treat people which seems to be lost in a lot of places these days .

Great for Lansdale, still needs a lot of work. Green Street coffee is a plus, but baristi who need a lot more training. Bagels and sandwiches are delicious. Dislike that creamer and sugar is not sself-serve.

OK, I broke down and ordered again.  I ordered the mixed grill.  It came with spicy, well-seasoned filet, chorizo and shrimp.  It was served with saffron rice and salad.

Such a perfect meal, especially if you don't feel like cooking.  I am hooked.

As my neighbor told me, this place is hit or miss in terms of service. At some random times, enormous groups of cyclists jam the place and there's no hope of table or toast. In other situations, there's no problem finding a table. Regardless, this place sure strikes me as a BOI institution and certainly a great place for coffee, pastries and breakfast. Be warned (in a good way), portions are enormous.

We tried a blueberry scone. Absolutely out of this world, not too sweet, great texture / crumbliness, would recommend to anyone (even my father in-law, the greatest scone baker I know). My wife had a low-cal or low-carb scramble (eggs, salsa, avocado) and it was terrific. I had a 1/2 order of biscuits and gravy (no need for a full order unless you are some monster eater or carbo loading for a marathon) and they were alright. Don't get me wrong; they were gourmet, beautifully presented and thoughtfully made. But they were not my style. The gravy did not seem to be made from sausage and there were no sausage crumbles present. It was topped with bacon, which I would never, ever associate with B & G. The biscuits were amazing, but I'm not in it for just biscuits and the biscuit to gravy ratio was a little out of whack. I think anyone else would have loved it and I just might be a bit too picky with my biscuits.

The coffee was great and, on the day we attended, the outdoor seating was perfect with the early morning summer temperature. I didn't order, so I can't attest to the service (I was reserving our table). No one really comes around to refill water or coffee (coffee is self-serve), so you return to the counter if you want more water.

If you're in Boise for the first time, this is a must-try (right behind Goldies, if you're looking for a more traditional restaurant experience).

I do not believe there to be any affiliation between Loveless Cafe and the Oregon based company Nike, but regardless, my only advice for anyone deciding whether or not to make the trek out to eat at Loveless is to JUST DO IT. We sort of went ham on this meal and ordered a whole lot because we couldn't decide. The best were the melt-in-your-mouth biscuits, the hashbrown casserole (!), the creamed corn, and the peanut butter pie. The waffle is better than the pancake, but both are very good. The fried chicken biscuit was good as well, just a bit small on the portion size. Key Lime pie was also very good and the mac n cheese was solid. This was definitely our favorite meal on our visit to Nashville. Highly recommended.

New restaurant visit as we are trying to find good Italian in our area. Smaller nicely decorated venue. Less than half capacity on our visit and yet we were seated at THE very worst table next to the counter - where the staff stands and chats and where the phone is located and yes it did ring. Thought perhaps the other available tables were reserved as we were a bit early but they were still empty when we left. Glances at the staff talking in our ears did nothing to change the situation so I finally asked them to hold their conversations elsewhere. By this time I was ready to pay for drinks and walk out. But the food soon arrived so we stayed. 
My veal tasted good but not nearly as hot  the vegetables. My husband's lasagna was ok, was a large portion but he could not taste the Italian sausage nor was it piping hot as expected.
