The only downfall is that it's a little warm inside and I feel like I need to go home and freeze myself after sitting there for a couple hours. They do have wine tastings during the summer which is a great way to get to know which wine pleases your palate. The happy hour is a great time to try plates at a discounted and smaller portion. Great way to represent Tucson, thank you Maynard's.

I've eaten at Parkshore Grill over 100 times and I consider it to be the best overall
Restaurant in St Petersburg, Florida. Chef Tyson has the highest standards and he's been a star at every restaurant he's overseen. He gets the freedom at Parkshore to show his creativity, and it really shows!! 

For me , the wedge salad , with its incredible buttermilk blue cheese dressing is off the charts. My favorite salad in St Petersburg! 

And the steaks are excellent!! Compares to Ruth Chris , at lower price points. Try the peppercorn dipping gravy. I could drink it straight from the service dish...so darn tasty!! 

The seafood is always fresh , and lobster and speciality meatballs are both fabulous appetizers . 

Service is A+ , ambience is great, location is prime , valet parking available. So overall , it's the best dining experience in St Petersburg.

Been here for dinner and happy hour a couple of times, and have had a pretty good experience as a whole.  The atmosphere is inviting and enjoyable overall for a bbq restaurant, complete with a decent sized bar, open grill emanating enticing aromas of smokey beef and pork ribs, as well as a humorous signs (ie free beer tomorrow, not sure if its true haha).  

I have had the Huli Huli Chicken Sandwich, Smoked Pork Ribs, and BBQ Shrimp, and they were all tender and flavorful with medium sized portions.  The Huli Huli chicken was especially good with exceptional hoisen sauce and freshly chopped pineapple.  The sides and happy hour specials are also pretty good, with 5 dollar domestic pitchers, and chipotle baked beans, tasty coleslaw (with crunchy cabbage, not soggy like some places!), and corn of the cob-all cooked on the grill.  However, they have unfortunately stopped serving my FAVORITE side of mashed sweet potatoes with toasted marshmallows on top, dropping the review 1 star.  Bring them back!!
Delish shrimp tacos and coconut shrimp. Our son had the quesadilla and it was a hit. The highlight was the fried mushrooms with the best homemade ranch I've ever tasted!
Great service, and amazing food! The variety of specials offered was very impressive, and everything tasted great. We are definitely eating here again next time we visit Tucson.
Chicken feast is my favorite in here. I love tomato chutney sauce as well.
We just killed our batteries playing Pokemon at the Battlefield and came here. Great find! Close and fast and delicious. Good grown up food for me and kids menu.
This place is disgusting! Everytime I eat here I end up with nausea and/or diarrhea. I will never eat here again. I don't even want a glass of water out of this place.

I wish I could give 10 stars.  The whole experience was phenomenal.  My wife and I went for the Farmer's Market class with Scott Schroeder.  It was such a relaxed atmosphere which allowed for some great Q&A, storytelling, tips, and tricks.  Scott seemed to be making up the dishes almost on the fly, but it was one of the best meals of our lives.  Yes, it's pricey but worth every penny.  It's all you can drink vino (with excellent selections) and they certainly don't skimp on the continuous pours.  Also, that tax and gratuity are included in the price, so you can kick back and enjoy then just stroll out the door when the night wraps up.  We can't wait to get to another COOK class.
I went this restaurant for my lunch they all nice person who work there Nd also food was good I would love to come back again

I like the concept of a gourmet hamburger - it's a nice change from fast food burgers which are satisfying if not exceptional.

Soda Jerks is first and foremost a gourmet hamburger restaurant. Most everything you order is, in some fashion, a hamburger or a sandwich. But the thing that sets it apart from, say Red Robin's, is that you can build your own burger.

For a fairly reasonable price, you get the chance to pick your meat, bun, sauce, and toppings. Want bacon and a fried egg on your burger? Done! Root Beer BBQ sauce? Sure, slather that on! Want some guacamole on there? Not a problem! It's fun to experiment with various flavors and toppings, trying to find something that works exceptionally well.

If you're not too sure about building your own hamburger (or wrap, or salad), there's also plenty of regular menu items that are spot on. Also keep your eye on the specials - they tend towards the tasty, as well. And don't be afraid to get the sweet potato fries on the side.

The drink menu is also fairly robust at Soda Jerks - which I guess it to be expected as "Soda" is right up there in their name. They have a full bar (and a lounge), which is nice - but it's the sodas that are the real find. They have a great selection of bottled pop, and you can order a vodka shot to spike any of them for some extra kick. On top of that, they'll also make any of them into a float. They also have some fun alcoholic milkshakes - though I admit the portions on them were a little on the smallish side.

Yes, Soda Jerks is still going through some growing pains, and there are some hiccups along the way. But OVERALL - in three visits - we've enjoyed adequate service, and had good food. I'll be going back, and I'd say that even if you had a "so-so" visit in the past, it's worth a second chance.

We stopped here thinking they would have good beer and good food. Wrong on both counts. Although I can usually appreciate a good micro brew, theirs really aren't that great. We had a beer sampler before our meal and I opted to get a soda with my meal.

The food here is overpriced and bland. I can't even remember what I got, but I know it wasn't very good. There are plenty of other good places to eat in the Quarter, skip this one.
Grate food lowsy survice took me 11/2 hour to get my food my water took like 3 brakes just not a good experience at all l had to ask and ask for things over over and over

World's worst margarita pizza. How can you call it a margarita with shredded processed mozzarella cheese. By the way there was more crust than pizza. Also had the "hickory wood fired" wings. Definitely no wood used to cook these wings. 
The only reason they get one star is their guest taps were great. It's a good thing because there beer is terrible. Unless you like your beer tasting like sweat socks. Zombie bust and Beir brewery saved the day.
GREAT customer service. Very delicious burgers and a good variety at the bar! Would recommend anybody to check this place out
Totally unorganized and rude wait staff. Will definitely not go back. Half of our food got to the table about 15 minutes after the rest.

We were looking for a great restaurant after a long day on the road on a muli-istate trip.
The motel clerk in Brentwood, TN had only boring suggestions, so we turned to Yelp and found fabulous Mere Bulles, barely a mile from our motel.  From the beginning the experience was outstanding!
The gracious hostess seated us at a quiet table promptly although we had no reservation.
Soon "the V man" our cheerful, energetic, most accommodating waiter made some suggestions to adjust the standard menu to match some dietary restrictions we have.
Both meals were extraordinary!  we are still talking about it days later.

Food is very good, nice atmosphere, friendly staff. There is an outdoor patio to sit on nice days. Drinks are pretty good. My only complaint is that there are servers with bull rings in their noses and it makes me lose my appetite.

Stopped by on a Saturday - this place is tucked behind Bistro 7 just past the VW dealership on South Virginia. Nice, clean, sparse decor. All sandwiches are named after local streets. I ordered the Lakeside - OMG!  So good. Toasted white Bread containing a flavor blast of turkey, bacon, chipotle mayo. Not disappointed!  My friend got Kietzke, London broil Boar's Head and horse radish cheddar.  So good! The owners were working - super nice people.

I absolutely love this place. The deep dish pizza was fantastic with tons of gooey cheese. The staff is very friendly too. I was a little early for my pickup order, and after chatting with the gentleman and he knew it was my first time trying Gennaros, he gave me a free slice of their artisan pizza while i wait, free of charge! It's a level of service that is unfortunately very seldom in this area (the artisan pizza was also fantastic!). I will definitely be a returning customer and I am excited to explore the rest of the menu.

For the price and efficiency, this place totally rocks. Occasionally, I need to pick up take-out for the kids. It's fast and I always get the same thing; honey walnut shrimp and fried rice.  I also enjoy the orange peel chicken and lo mien. Full of flavor and super convenient.

This place is a disgrace... setting up an X-Mas Eve take out for over 10 people is a nightmare in and of itself... family members all agreeing on one place? Ha, not happening.  It has always been a tradition to go out to dinner with our families on X-Mas eve but with the birth of many little ones, it's turned into takeout, allowing us to kick back and enjoy one another's company.  I called ahead and was specifically given instructions to call the day of X-Mas eve... we followed these instructions and when we went to place our order, we were told they weren't accepting any additional orders.  We explained we were specifically told otherwise and we called ahead so that we wouldn't be stranded with zero options on X-Mas Eve only to be told, Tough Sh$t in so many words.  

So now, at 4:00 on X-Mas Eve we have been left calling around to restaurants in the area with basically no worthy options and 4 families coming to our house with basically McDonalds for all... thanks so much for having the X-Mas spirit...

Love the food and atmosphere.  My husband and I have eaten here several times and have always enjoyed our meals.  Brian's food is very good and he always has some kind of interesting special!  The outdoor deck and the music is wonderful  Will be back very soon.

Saturday nights @ Trident I have become less than a place I want to visit. The manager sits at the end of the bar and drinks.  Puts UFC on just about every TV in the place when he knows my wife doesn't like it.  We were just about the only two in the place.  There was a PPV that night but not for another 2 hrs.   Food still good. We will just visit a different Trident for our Saturday nights out.

Can't tell you how disappointed we were to find they had changed their menu.  We loved their Crescent City Shrimp and it is no longer offered.  Our server offered us the substitute, but it just didn't do the trick

Went Here To Have A Quick B-Day Lunch/Dinner. I Ordered The Rasta Pasta w/ Salmon ‍& It Was DRY,COLD & BLAND. My Friend Ordered The Oxtails, Mac n Cheese(Which Was Noodles w/ Shredded Cheese On Top)Peas/Rice & Cabbage & Guess What,That Was Also COLD!! Smh It Was Very Warm & Tight Inside. The Cocktails & Music Was Good .. 
I Asked The Young Lady Who Waited On Us If She Could Put My Dessert In A To Go Container & She Told Me "Im Too Busy To Put It In A Container, I'll Bring You One" Like Wtf Sis You Just Blew Your Tip!! Ughhhhh Def Dont Think I'll Be Returning

This is where we go for Italian on the Westbank, it beats the pants off every other place we tried. 

The restaurant is dark, the wine glasses are huge, and your bread comes with compound butter and oil & vinegar. Everything we've tried has been good- my favorites are the Veal Parm, the Bracioloni, and the Chicken ala Pomodoro.

Great service and great food 


Loved the "wholewheat" pasta with veggies. 

Loved the Caesar salad.  $9 wow feed 2!

Amazing place with great value. .
Excellent food. Kind of cramped seating. Friendly and helpful workers. For sure we will be back. If you're considering this, go.

Grew up in Port Richmond so have had my share of Polish food. Thought the breaded pork chop was best thing we sampled. I'm not a chop fan normally but this was very thin and tender and the breading was very good. My wife liked the kielbasi best. I thought it was real good but I'm spoiled by Swiacki's which I think is best in city. The meat pierogies were real good too - thin, light dough and tender, finely ground meat. Deducted points since they were only boiled, not browned. Cole slaw and beets were good sides but potatoes were disappointing. Not creamy and kinda bland. Amazing part was the whole dinner cost $25 tax included. Portions were big enough to bring home leftovers. Service was a bit haphazard since one of the ladies works the kitchen and also serves up front. Will definitely return for the pork chop and to sample more items on menu.
This place is awesome. Really great and friendly service, good food and a fun atmosphere.

I am definitely qualified to talk sushi. I lived 15 years in Japan in a coastal city that is known for its fresh sushi.

Arigato is a tourist trap in the middle of all the hype on State street.  The sushi was good, and tasted fresh but the value is not there.  Way over priced for what you get. We ordered the rolls--again tasty--but tiny.  In most sushi joints, the rolls we ordered would be 3x the volume AND in some cases less expensive!

I was still a bit hungry when we left the restaurant and yet we spent a lot of money.

That shouldn't be.

Afterwards we went to McConnell's Ice Cream down the street and paid $4.00 for one scoop of ice cream.  No problem--because it was a HUGE scoop **AND** it was awesome quality.  People are after both...quality and value.  When one of those is missing, the business will not reach its full potential.

Well worth the high menu prices.  Excellent menu, variety of unique cocktails, and friendly staff.  Redfish Grill is known for their Po-boys but they are not on dinner menu. Had the grilled  redfish with crabmeat on top.  DELICIOUS!I I highly recommend this restaurant.
Always amazing food, excellent service, very polite staff, good for any celebration; romantic or night out with friends downtown, and ALWAYS AMAZING FOOD

Not sure if we came on an off night, but really leaning more towards giving this place 2.5 stars. Although the building is beautiful and we had a very nice waiter, the food is so bleh. The only thing we really enjoyed was the maple bacon grilled cheese and we still thought it needed some kind of dipping sauce on the side. Garlic shrimp- over cooked and mushy. Steak flatbread- over cooked and dry. Truffle ravioli was normal cheese ravioli (no truffle) so I'm not sure why they call them truffle ravs. Overall, confused how this place has so many good reviews based on the experience I had.

Run down, dirty and beware of the elevators! 
I found this place on hotels.com, and for the price and location thought it was a great find, but was disappointed upon check-in. 
I thought we would be staying in the main tower, but had a room in the second, seven-story building, which perhaps was the issue.
The elevators allow you, literally, 5 seconds to get on or off before abandoning you at the door, feeling a bit out of sorts. They should look into these 'elevators'...serially! lol
Anyway, the room was run-down and the cleaning staff apparently do not have a real eye for detail, e.g., the area behind the bathroom faucet reminded me of college-day apartments, not good.
On a positive note, the staff was somewhat friendly and the bar has a nice view of the arch. 
If I had not gotten such a good price on this place, it would get one star. I could not imagine paying standard rates here.
Good location, crappy hotel.

I debated between 2 and 3, but meh describes this place better than a-ok.

We went because yelp concierge suggested it to us.

The house cocktails are good, but overpriced.

We ordered the dry rub wings which were so salty, that my tongue hurt afterwards. (stick to devil's alley for dry rub)

The avocado fries were pretty good. something to try once anyway.

The pear and brie wrap with turkey was really dry, and kind of blah. French dip was nothing spectacular either. The coleslaw, however, was really good.

Mac and cheese was good, but nothing you couldn't make at home. possibly even from the freezer section.

I'm disappointed. I hate being disappointed.

I think i do like this comedy club but it really depends on the comedian.  Last show, pretty good. Tonight sucked ass. Show was to start at 10:15.  It actually started at 11:15pm. The opening act was soooooooooo bad. Usually if I'm enjoying myself I don't notice the two drink minimum. Tonight I was absolutely irritated about the two drink minimum.  I didn't want to order drinks. The comedian was soooo bad, I'm not sure I will return unless I know the comedian. PS. They make you make pay for your bill as soon as you order like McDonalds.  Sooooo fuckin classy!!! I want my money back

On a cold and windy winter afternoon I was in the mood for a hot soup! (I'm actually always in the mood for a hot soup no matter what the weather is) . . . Unfortunately in my area of the city, all the soup places I could walk to were closed on Sunday. I kept walking and remembered that there was a Mexican spot around the corner. I was cold and hungry so I decided to stop in. I always have the same problem of wanting to order one of everything from a new menu, especially when there are so many choices. Without having the chance to thoroughly plan and study the menu beforehand, I ended up ordering a beef cheek taco, a grilled steak with onions platter, a beef guisado with a side of rice and beans and I can never resist tamales if they are an option.

The place itself is in kind of an isolated, not so nice area of the city, surrounded by empty lots and abandoned looking homes, but when you step inside, the décor and service are bright and friendly. With Latin music playing in the background, brightly colored walls and native décor, this place definitely felt authentic. The food was good with big portions, a definite plus! Since it's close by, I'll be going back, probably in the spring and summer when it's less chilly.

Tikka masala is the basis of an Indian restaurant.    My visited to House of India prove they have mastered it.    The TM was perfectly prepared, good spice and creamy.   Bathe naan was great, lite and fluffy.     My appetizer was also great.     I highly recommend HOI, my favorite Indian place

We stopped for lunch hoping this new location might be better than the Southampton place. It isn't. We tried house margaritas - awful. Tasted like poor quality sour mix and very little tequila. Nachos were boring and lacking toppings. Everything costs extra. I would pay more for fresh ingredients and quality recipes - but won't find them here. Los Sarapes is still the place to go for Mexican in our area.

We are from Houston, Texas and took a trip to East Coast last week.  We made a special stop to visit Pat's and Geno's and just to see what all the fuss about their sandwich.  We decided to eat at Pat's from all the reviews on line.  I am not a cheese steak sandwich fan but since I am in Philadelphia it just won't be complete without having a Philly steak sandwich.  Their sandwich is just OK to me.  I think Pat's should have provided a restroom for the customers since a lot of tourists visit them.  There s no public restroom around that neighborhood.  All the business around Pat's all post sign "no public restroom".  I find Philadelphia is not a friendly city especially on Pat's side of town.

Food is eh. Servers are super nice . Parking is good . Need to revamp menu as it's just not appealing . Busy on the weekends . Decent specials during football season but it's not enough to come back . Just an ok spot if everywhere else is packed . So go if u can't find a table anywhere else and settle for just eh food .

Is Fat Jones's under new owners? Because I would not order from there again. Yesterday we ordered French toast sticks from Fat Joe's via GrubHub. Now on Snyder Ave instead of Columbus Blvd. For those who know French toast sticks, we know the bread is cut into sticks, dipped in batter and fried. Creating a deliciously crisp coating. At FJ's nope. 

Their French toast sticks were two slices of French toast, made like French toast and THEN CUT into sticks. I could have saved money and time by just making those myself. It is obvious they have no clue about the difference. Their French toast was flavorless and also soggy. Pro tip FJ's cut a notch in your containers for French toast and it won't steam itself to grossness.

To add to their ignorance, this was their response to my niece's review on GrubHub.

Thank you for your review. I apologize that our French toast sticks are homemade not freezer to fryer garbage, and as for our packaging this is a standard box we put our product in. Each of your orders.  And yes we ran out of milk.

We didn't want freezer to fryer. We wanted restaurant quality French toast sticks made the way any HOMEMADE recipe on the internet shows. You cut the bread first, dip and THEN fry.

While my niece didn't state this, we are still not sure if we received the correct amount of hash browns. We ordered two servings and received two in one box. GrubHub doesn't state how many in order. But, Hashbrowns $1.50, the S implies more than one per order.  Everything else was packaged one item to box as all items were not a part of a platter. So given this they didn't provide the correct amount.

Their review was ridiculous and snarky not in a good way. 
I highly suggest spending your money elsewhere if you are busy and want a restaurant that isn't lazy or provides subpar customer service.   

The sad part is we were repeat customers at the Columbus Blvd. restaurant. We will no longer order from them. There are plenty of other restaurants That make  homemade French toast sticks the right way.

Pretty standard and nothing fancy. Food is on par and I came here for a work conference. The four seasons is a bit dated and while the food was good I didn't think it blew me as typical four seasons standard.
Great customer service, I was seated right away and asked what I wanted to drink shortly after.  The portions are very generous with this delicious food. I would definitely recommend the place.

Nothing but great things to say about our experience. We got the 3 meat plate (ribs, brisket, pulled pork), which I would highly recommend. The ribs were perfectly smoked and the meat fell off the bone. There was little to no fat in the pulled pork and brisket, and they were both smoked to perfection. The kids chicken fingers had a very light and garlicky crispy batter and were clearly hand-dipped and fried - some of the best I've ever tried.

Although they only have one sauce, it is excellent. It's a sweeter smoky sauce. I personally thought the brisket mac was the best part of the meal. We actually packed up the leftovers so we could try dessert, and the skillet cookie did not disappoint. It's a fluffy skillet chocolate chip cookie topped with a giant scoop of ice cream. 

Thank you to the incredible waitstaff for the recommendations. The best and friendliest waitstaff around, by far. Keep up the great work!
yummy drinks and very tasty food! It is a little crowded when the outside seating is not available so you might want to come early.

The service was really bad. They didn't try and they were reckless. We asked for water and it took more than half an hour to arrive. The waiters threw down the menu and were really rude. The food also wasn't good either. The shrimps tasted like it was frozen and the beef was tasteless. The noodles and everything were colorless and you could barely taste anything. Compared to other places in Reno, this place is really bad and I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. The potstickers there were just covered in oil and weren't any good at all. Everything just tasted plain and tasteless. Overall, the service was bad, the food was bad, and I would never come back here again.

Food was great service was super. We sampled several apps all were very good. 
Can't wait to go back. You have to ask for bread put that's ok. I need to cut back anyway.

This is the worst Dunkin by far. It is always slow and/or  is never open when it says it is at 5 AM. You can wait in the drive-through forever. This morning I went at 520 and I was the head of the line for the drive-through got no acknowledgment that there were even cars in the drive-through. All the lights were on no employees.It is always dirty and their donuts are never fresh. I personally have never been a huge Dunkin' fan but I was getting them to take to work . I will say I left that Dunkin and went to another which will now be the Dunkin miles away, I go to that one if I have to take something for work..

Lived in broad ripple 5 years and this is my favorite place for authentic English-style food.

Amazing selection of beer and apps

Lindy is back in a huge way with his latest burger bliss!  How on earth is he so darn inventive?  Perfectly prepared burgers and sides are what you get, and the price point is insanely great.   I had the Farlow's B.A.M.F. (and I also got to find out what B.A.M. F. meant - I feel so out of touch) with sweet potato fries, and my husband had the Five Twenty with fries.  
My burger was massive!!   I think there may have been four patties, and one of them was rib meat.  Bacon, bacon jam, pepper jack, shredded lettuce, sweet pickles and thunder sauce in between two beautiful (and branded) buns meant that I was not putting down this behemoth after picking it up.  Juicy, delicious, and darn perfect.  The fries were perfectly prepared too - and who doesn't love chipotle mayo with sweet potato fries?  Holy moly - this meal was incredible!
Now, my husband's meal - just like Tucson, this burger had a nice spice.  A chorizo patty and regular burger patties (when I say regular, that just means some of the finest beef in town), green chiles, pepper jack, bacon, shredded lettuce, pickles, and Thunder sauce between those signature buns is just a work of culinary chicanery that blows the mind!!!  Oh, and the fries are crinkle cuts, which are just the best fries around.
The restaurant space is great, too, decorated in true Lindy fashion.  Still has the clothesline ticket delivery system, and the great views of 4th Ave is just icing on the cake!  
Drop what you're doing, and get over to Thunder Bacon Burger Co., and be prepared to leave filled to the brim with delicious eats!!!  It's so worth it!!!

Forget my last review.  So unhappy with my last visit.

The place is on a wait while every person working there is just chit-chatting away.

4 bar tenders talking while our drinks sat empty, I had to ask for refills twice.  Portions were so small, I got 12 small fried shrimp and about half a potato in fries.  Rude inattentive staff, small portions, dirty bathrooms avoid this place.

Excellent food, great service, and a fun, casual atmosphere.

I loved my hot chicken platter!  The spicy, breaded chicken tenders were flavorful, and the sides of Cole slaw, mac and cheese, and cornbread were good too.  My husband enjoyed his pulled pork platter as well, including his "Brunswick stew" (a tomato and meat soup).

The service was very friendly, pleasant, and prompt.  One of the servers cheerfully brought our friends' 5 year old a water refill when he asked for one, even thought it's not a sit down place - I thought that was very sweet!

The setting is welcoming, spacious, and casual.

Overall, a great spot!
Stuffed french toast is basically as it sounds. Amazing!!  Great service and atmosphere for a breakfast - business or otherwise.

coffee and atmosphere in Ybor City, more  the quote professional crowd, great place for work or to meet up and talk over a cup of coffee. Cool stuff to look through and small shop with cups mugs and cool stuff always consistent and always friendly!

I've found my new favorite place to eat and spurge. Foie Gras, oysters, warm mozzarella salad, edaname dumplings are all good. It's yummy in the tummy.  Just hope you brought enough cash. Otherwise it's very frustrating to eat here on a budget.
Soup was room temperature at best. Salad no longer comes with dinner. Garlic bread not on menu anymore. Pasta Bolognese lacking the Bolognese

I didn't want to download yelp just to leave a comment. But this KFC/Taco Bell is so deserving of it. This has to be the ABSOLUTE WORST fast food establishment in the CITY. The service is piss poor. The female worker in the drive thru was Extremely RUDE (when they messed up our order!). Then when we tried to get her attention...she kept walking up to the window but REFUSED to open it (FIVE TIMES!). We ended up honking, then her attitude met us before her rude comment did. We tried to STILL display "Christian virtues" and ask for the food they omitted. Before slamming the window she told us it would be one minute, 30 seconds. TEN MINUTES LATER, the male manager came and brought our item. She slid up beside him. As we were registering our complaint, he closed the window and walked AWAY!! We had just begun talking. He had No intention of listening to our complaint, much less doing ANYTHING about it.
With ALL the Negative reviews on here regarding this specific kfc it is obvious corporate does not review any of these. If they did they'd terminate them all and start over. This was my THIRD HORRIBLE experience with them...and Today, it IS my LAST.

Love the people at Bodega! We eat here regularly because the food is just that good. And I am a huge fan of the Cafe con Leche. If it wasn't for them, I don't think I would have the energy to make it through my workdays.

And today, everyone here needed a good drink. So, we headed over and grabbed a ton of Cafe con leches and a specialty Mexican soda. Really made our day. 

Their set up is pretty awesome and they have great outdoor seating. They've definitely got style. And I'm there so often they know my name - and usually my order. 

So, if you're looking for Latin food that spans the globe and prepared for you by some amazing people, Bodega on Central is the place to go.

The Hoke Poke (13.50$) is a three bite stack of spicy tuna, avocado, mango, and almonds. It comes with more wonton than you can use. The sauce on the spicy tuna makes the dish. It's like a sesame ginger teriyaki sauce (?). The appetizer is good but not worth 14$.

It's not on the menu anymore, but the crawfish bread is amazing ! If you get the chance to order it, don't hesitate. 

Thai Chicken (15$) is two grilled chicken breast brushed with a Thai BBQ sauce and served with coconut rice and Italian dressing drenched cucumbers. The chicken is succulent and the sauce isn't bad. It's a little sweet. The coconut rice is good. Just the perfect aroma of coconut. Italian dressing drench cucumbers do not go with the dish. 

Sesame crusted Ahi Tuna (22$). Fish is cooked to your liking. I like med-rare or even rare. The ginger, soy, teriyaki (?) sauce makes the dish. Comes with coconut rice and the Italian dressing drenched cucumbers again (& doesn't go with this dish either). 

Grilled Fish Tacos (19.50). It's not even typical because the $$ spent is not worth this dish. You only get two tacos. unless you're rich with a gastric sleeve, you'll be broke and hungry. 

Avery Island Duck (23$). Outstanding dish. Two pieces of duck on top of the spinach and Tasso dressing. The pepper jelly sauce is used to decorate the plate but next time I'll ask for it on the side because it is a little more sweet than I prefer. 

Be careful when ordering from the "fresh fish" menu. The server did not give us a price check & when the bill came out the fish dish was (I think) 30$. Expensive for a typical serving size of salmon. I forgot which preparation my friend picked. I tried it, but forgot too.

My husband surprised me for my birthday and took me to this superb restaurant. I ordered a Chocolate Martini and hubby ordered a Long Island Tea. The martini ended up being vodka and Creme de Cocao..very good, as was the Long Island.   BBQ Shrimp was our appetizer, it was very tasty..I had the Seafood Platter and my husband had the Blackened Yellowfin Tuna. Both were absolutely delicious. Our waitress, Mignon was informative, attentive and all around fabulous. In fact the entire staff was delightful and each and everyone wished me a happy birthday. We truly enjoyed ourselves there, and I'm looking forward to our next visit which will be very soon.

I know I have left a review before, but I just feel I need to again. The last two Tuesday's I have eaten at DosBros and the young man working, I think his name is Brandon (?) is the most kind and sweet young man. The best service!!! 
Oh yeah, I enjoyed the food too.
I eat At this place all the time they have the very best service,the food is the best I've ever eaten and the margarita are top notch,San Luis nachos are yummy

Their huevos rancheros was just eggs on a plain raw corn tortillas with tomatoes on it and a side of refried beans. 
To top it off,  it went through me and my sons body in 5 mins if you get what I mean. 
I had no problems with my server. She was great.
Excellent happy hour choices and great service. Ordered dinner and it was at our table within 10 mins. Highly recommend and plan on returning myself.
Nice food, good service and nice environment. A good place for coworker get together and after work dinner place.

I went here with my family and ordered the shrimp and grits, when it came it was not as described in the menu at all. In the menu it was shrimp and grits with collard greens and a drizzle of BBQ sauce. What came was a bowl with a bright redish orange greasy sauce with sautéed mushrooms and peppers. When we looked confused the waitress informed us that they changed some of the dishes but never changed the menu. She did not inform me of this when I ordered it. Why would they not serve the dishes as they are advertised on the menu? I did not enjoy the meal at all, nor do I have any idea what kind of sauce that was because there was no information provided on it anywhere. When you order you are expecting to get what you ordered not some random dish. This was beyond ridiculous.

The Farmers' Cabinet has some of the best bartenders in the city. They make an awesome Old Fashioned and many other old-school drinks. The house band is also really great and a lot of fun. The food is so-so, especially for the price. The duck sausage stuffed quail was decent, but the medium rare steak was a bit well done and lukewarm. I suspect that it was sitting under a heat lamp for 20 minutes waiting for the quail to finish. Basically, go for the drinks and atmosphere.

Still phenomenal. Thank you for existing in my life. 

When I return here again, I think I have tried everything on the menu. 
I'm serious..
Great lunch spot.  Really everything we had actually had a lot of great flavor. Sweet sour Spicey savory. The place was great.  Will be back again for sure!!

I stumbled upon this place during my staycation today. The owner was super friendly and I felt like we knew each other the moment I walked in. It was a delightful cafe with many different selections of pastries, coffee, and sandwiches. I recommend the iced caramel macchiato for a drink. I also ordered the banana bread which had a lot of excellent flavor and spices in the pastry. She has books all over the restaurant, which gives it a positive homey vibe to the atmosphere. I will be visiting this restaurant again soon. The coffee is better than Starbucks x infinity and beyond.
Excellent food, loved everything. I highly recommended if you like Pho soup and anything curry. They are fast and offer great service

Stopped in on a Tuesday for their beer & burger special.  $10 gets you a Pour House burger (normal price 8-9 bucks) plus a choice between three local brews.  I happened to choose the Flying Fish Abbey Dubbel at the time.

I found the burger to be pretty good, nothing stellar, but it definitely satisfies.  All that for 10 bucks only...you bet I'll be back here again.

The beer list was pretty great too.  Didn't leave without having at least another beer.

kind of slow service
food is so-so
a little too expensive for the so-so food
had the giant chilli dog... was pretty good! but be prepared for what you're asking for.

i like their hours and their location though
-M

I understand this venue is mostly a college hangout.  However, the quality and flavor of the food items should not be lower for this reason.  We tried their version of croque monsieur, cheeseburger, and grilled cheese with tomato soup.  All were underwhelming.  Service was average and we were a large group when we went.  Drinks were a bit watered down as well.  I suspect because of the college crowd.

Based on my experience, there are many pros to eating at Mama's Diner.  First of all, the warm tones and use of wooden decor create a warm and welcoming feeling.  Random trinkets and wall decor may show a lack of cohesion, but it just reminds me of the random objects, figurines, and  photo albums that I'd find and an old relative's house, giving this place a homey vibe.

The food itself: delicious.  I had french toast with blue berries and whipped cream, which also came with powdered sugar and butter.  It was like biting into a pillow of sugary goodness.  Another pro about the food is that the portions were ideal for me.  I didn't leave feeling annihilated, but I was still the perfect amount of full. 

Other random pros of this place were the plates and cups that added to the aesthetic. The servers were very friendly. Also the emergency button in the bathroom was good to see. 

One con was that they forgot a side of homefries that we ordered, but the staff had no problem removing it from our bill when we asked. Another possible con is that they lack vegan options.  I forgot to look if they had any on the menu, but I don't remember any standing out.  It's def something I'm gonna look out for next time I go. 

Overall, Mama's Diner succeeds in balancing trendy and homey, while also serving delicious food for a reasonable price. Good vibes all around.  I'm def coming back. :D

Very cool place!

Food is super fresh (and much is locally sourced). Ingredients and sauces are tasty and creative (garlic crisps, radish sprouts, etc.)

I had a bowl with greens but tried my daughter's rice noodles and they were delightful. 

They even have two flavors of "Saki Slush!"

You can sample pretty much everything, including their sauces, toppings, and 6 different iced teas and juices. 

Service was top notch, genuinely friendly, helpful, and generous. You can tell they truly enjoy working here. 

We'll be back!

I'll probably even buy a Pacific Counter hat
Great service. WAY overpriced for poor quality food. Would not recommend. We spent close to 100 dollars for 2 adults and 2 children. I felt like del taco was better quality.

My husband and I were very happy with our wedding reception at the WCI. We worked with Jane and Rachael for nearly a year and Rachael was our night-of coordinator, both were fantastic throughout the process! We had a Saturday wedding in March and were able to take advantage of their off-season rate, which allowed us to go for the premium reception package. This package included centerpiece flowers, candelabras, a 3 tier wedding cake, linens, 5 hr open bar, half dozen passed hors d'oeuvres, raw bar, pasta station during cocktail hour, soup, salad, entrée with 3 choices, venetian table, and bananas foster. The price was amazing and with all the inclusions, I'm not sure why anyone would look somewhere else for a ballroom style reception in the area. Our theme was science-chic and I had a ton of personalized details throughout the tables, all of which were handled very well and to my liking. The guests all gushed at how well everything was taken care of! The only negative thing I heard was that the steaks were not cooked to order after the waiters had asked people - they were all served medium/well. I can understand logistically that it would be difficult to make individual ones, but perhaps in the future the steaks should just be served without asking cooking preference so people won't be dissatisfied/ignored. Otherwise the food was terrific! We had 75 in attendance with 10 tables and the room felt spacious but not empty. Would definitely recommend!
Trashhhh.  They won't give u refunds because you tried the sample that tastes nothing like what they serve you. Horrible customer service. Horrible food.
Went on one occasion when I happened to be in downtown. Very happy with the crust on the calzone and the location made it easy for me to walk around the city.

We had a party of 12 for dinner and we were seated right on time. We ordered our drinks and it seemed to take forever for our order to come out. Our waiter was working really hard but there seemed to be an issue in the kitchen. We finally got our first round of drinks after being seated for an hour. Two hours after we were seated, we still didn't have our main courses. We had two drinks served in the two hours we had been sitting there. The bar was completely empty so I'm not sure why the delay in service. We had ordered appetizers, which were just okay. The fried okra was tasty and the hush puppies were the best thing I ate there. Finally, once our food came out, the disappointment continued. I have never sent a dish back when eating at a restaurant, and I was going to just suck it up and pay for it without eating, but I had to send my fresh raw oysters back. The taste and texture was definitely off. I eat oysters any time I go out for a seafood dinner and these were awful. Everyone else at the table got one of the boils. Everyone had the same complaint: the seasoning completely overpowered the seafood. We had a great time because of the company we had around the table, but we definitely recommend a different restaurant if you're craving good seafood.
Amazing food best Mexican food in town no question about it. Authentic Mexican food not your average Tex mex place you would find here in Nashville. I would recommend everything on the menu.

Other reviewers were pretty spot on-I read all of them before we went here.  I am not a huge fan of buffets, but I do love Asian food (especially good sushi), so I was hesitant but curious about this place, which is really close to my house.

We walked in around 730 on a Saturday night, it wasn't slammed or dead, we were seated right away.  The waitress was very nice and immediately took our drink order ($3.50 for a glass of vino? Hellz yea!) and invited us to the buffet.  The restaurant was clean and large.

There are many different types of food, and I only tried what I know I like:

*Dim sum and pot stickers- very tasty and well prepared
*crab rangoon and pork eggrolls- yummm, very full of stuffing and not too greasy
*sushi- surprisingly good and fresh and creative-better than Publix (which is also surprisingly good)
*hibachi-the food was good, but the 'yum yum' sauce was just honey mustard, as another reviewer noted, which sucked! Real yum yum would have been amazing
*hot sake-it was only $3.50, but very coarse and hard to down, couldn't finish it
*crab legs-I had a bite of my husbands, he filled about 4 plates with them and really enjoyed them
*Dessert--I had a tiny bit of ice cream and a cream puff, good selection of items

Other people seemed to be enjoying the seafood-oysters, shrimp, craw fish, but I didn't try these, I was too wary!

Over all it was a good experience and I would return. It's a casual, easy, inexpensive way to stuff yourself with Chinese food!

Funky graffiti decor and good burgers. The staff was very friendly and helpful with answering the menu questions. I had the blue cheese burger and it was delicious w grilled onions. I have onion rings and fries and my friend had a turkey burger. I was disappointed in the fries. I only ate a handful they were bland and a bit over cooked. But the onion rings and burgers were delicious!

First time coming here the food was amazing! Prices are very good. The service was interesting you actually pay at the counter before seating yourself which wasn't very well advertised. We sat for about 15 minutes before realizing what to do, no one came over to instruct us and it wasn't very busy. A little disappointing that you have to pay for chips, but the food we got was amazing and the portions are very big! Definitely woul go again!

I would give Rick's a 5 for ambiance....especially in the summer. Love sitting on the patio overlooking Eagle Creek when sailboats are out. It's lovely.   That said...everything I find and love on the menu is gone the next time.  Bring back the goat cheese salad for the love of.....
My family and I enjoyed eating here on a weekend for lunch. The food was really good and staff was friendly. We'd definitely return.

I been there with a few people, two of us including myself ordered the BBQ ribs.
They have been served quickly. you could not get them off the bones. We both returned them and ordered Quesedillas.
Nothing special either. I will not return to this restaurant. Service was below average.

Tonight we celebrated my stepson's high school graduation. We took our 10 party crew..aka blended family to enjoy dinner. From the beginning we were greeted with a smile from the hostess. Our reservation was for 7pm and they promptly on time! The server Brianna was amazing and so kind. My 10 year old stepson who is special needs was getting anxious and beginning to have a melt down. Brianna brought out food for hom to eat and calm his nerves. Our cook was so funny amd friendly along with his smooth food moves! We laughed, smiled, and celebrated our grad! Thank you for the experience, we all loved it!

The coffee is ok - the desserts are PHENOMENAL and the food is...bleh. I got their club sandwich and couldn't eat it - their turkey was old and reheated. For an $8 sandwich I expected better. Go here for the coffee and DO NOT PASS UP THEIR BAKED GOODS they are some of the best you will ever have!

Unbelievable,...I cant fathom the possibility that a well known steak house such as Charlie palmer would screw up a steak, then reheat the steak in a microwave and give it back to me. Unbelievable and unacceptable.  I first had a steak from here 10 years ago and thought it was fantastic.  I then went back to this same place 5 years ago and it was once again fantastic.  This time was like going to Disney World and all the rides were shut down and none of the characters showed up for work. What in the world happened. You were a world class steak house in my eyes, but now, .....not today. Side note, at least our waiter understood and didnt charge me for most of the food and Tho the beverage server was on top of his job. Great job Tho.
Best tomato pie around. Bread is always fresh and plenty to choose from but get their early.  They run out fast.  The deli selection is great. Love that they make fresh subs both cold and hot.
I've been here twice, both times I've got the Crawfish and they are awesomeness!!!  The service is good and fast.  You won't be disappointed.

We went out to dinner with a few friends a few weeks ago. She had been dying to try Wild Child, which she'd discovered on Instagram.  It turns out that not only is the food beautiful and very instagrammable, it's very delicious.

They don't take reservations, so plan ahead. We showed up around 6 on a Friday and had a 45-minute wait; they put us on the waitlist, took a phone number, and pleasantly waited a few minutes for us to get back from our drink nearby when they called early to tell us our table was ready.  Service remained pleasant and helpful throughout.

The drinks are excellent. They have a respectable beer and wine menu, but the cocktails are what you need to try.   Always a sucker for bubbles, I can vouch for the porn star martini (vodka with passion fruit and a champagne sidecar that you can pour in if you want) - it's refreshing and delicious and fun.  The Mezcalita and Lost Weekend (a watermelon drink with choose your own booze) got good reviews as well.

Don't fill up on drinks though because the food is also fantastic.   I would never have thought of jerk octupus, but it was creative and delicious and somehow the perfect texture (not squishy).  We also loved the snapper ceviche appetizer.  For entrees, I can't speak highly enough of the scallops: they come with a pea puree and snap peas and a mushroom risotto. It doesn't sound like it goes together but somehow it does, and I'd order it again in a heartbeat.  Everyone else had the skirt steak, which looked almost equally delicious.

Delicious modern-yet-tasty, combination of classy/trendy/chill with excellent food AND drinks. Five stars, let me go back soon please.
Amazing authentic Vietnamese food . The flavor is great I will be coming back . The food is so fresh . Very clean and great friendly atmosphere.

Came for dinner and everything was delicious. Got the gnocchi's on the daily menu and they were fabulous. Also got the pork chop with sweet peaches. Overall everything was great including the drinks and the service. Prices were good also. I would highly recommend

I went back for my birthday! Yummy as usual. 

Tried the mussels for an appetizer; they were DELICIOUS. I wish I didn't have to share with everyone else. 

For dinner, I was going to go with the seafood pasta, but after I heard that night's special (mustard crusted salmon with potatoes and grilled vegetables), I HAD to go with that. It was delicious. YUM. 

I love this place.

I use Yelp almost daily and attended a recent Yelp event and it occurred to me that I have yet to write a review for any local spots which made me feel a little guilty so here goes: 
I held off on trying this place out specifically because I knew it was going to be fabulous and I work next door. I made it two months. Not only is their staff incredibly friendly, they are as helpful as it gets. I've worked in the service industry on and off for over a decade and one of the tell tale signs of a great business is a happy employee. It was obvious that everyone I encountered not only enjoyed being there but more importantly, legitimately love the food. 
So far, I've only tried the sampler (couldn't pick just one) and then the Reina arepa. The intensity in flavor and uniqueness of each dish makes this newly non vegetarian want to try everything on the menu... and based on my experiences thus far, I'm sure that is bound to happen. 
Check it out .. and hey, why not come next door to the BEATnik for some great music afterwards? Winning combo *wink wink
I am not a cake donut fan but these are great.  Nice, friendly folks to help you decide toppings and there a lots to choose from.

This place has been going downhill for the last two years, the old owner was excellent, had a problem with last meal the whole meal was bad & told the waitress & owner, it was like they couldn't care less. I told them I would never be back. We used to go here at least once per week.
My cheeseburger was pretty dang good, and the only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because the fries were mediocre.

312 is perfectly placed, and honestly has some of the best food I've had in Nashville. Their friend mushrooms are amazing (I don't even like mushrooms) and their dry rubbed wings have just the right amount of spice. 

But frankly, I can't even come close to recommending their service or their pizza at this time (As good as it is). The first time I went, my pizza took 1.5 hours, but I figured it was busy, I'll come back a second time. 

I decided to do a pick up order the second time, it's relatively hard to mess up on that. The person who answered the phone the two times I called was rude but it seemed like she got the job done. Then, from what I gathered, my order was never put in. They said to come back in in half an hour, so I did. Then I waited an extra 20 minutes after that before I got my pizza. The managing owner then told me she'd comp the pizza but forgot to. I had to tell the server, who apologized and got it taken care of. After all of that, they gave me a free pizza certificate. That's a win. 

So I decided to come back and eat in last night, to give them a third chance, especially because free pizza is some of the best pizza out there, and their food is good. Well everyone, they forgot my pizza in the oven. Yes, of course after an hour and some change the manager on duty offered to comp the pizza, and Yay! The pizza was going to be out in 15-20 minutes! 30 minutes and another round of beer later, my pizza still wasn't ready. Normally, having worked in the restaurant industry for 8 years, I'd just mention it to the manager hope they take of a round or an appetizer and order another round of beer. But by now I'd been in the restaurant for two hours and had to go. 

I might go back since I still have that free pizza certificate, but I don't expect to bring friends or family with me again.

The Alligator Cheesecake was very unique. Definitely something to try if its yoru first time here. The fried green tomatoes were lacking in flavor. My friend ordered the veal and barely touched it. It tasted kind of bland and mushy. The fish were good. I read the reviews saying that the Watermelon mojito was good but to me it just tasted like iced water with a few pieces of watermelon tossed in there. The plus side was that the waitress was very nice and attentive. Maybe next time it would be better

Enjoyed a beautiful lunch with my friends! The food was so good, we ate way more than we planned to. The waitress was awesome and the service was phenomenal! Great place to go and enjoy fantastic food.

The Bun Bo (spicy beef noodle soup) did not disappoint and the tofu in the tofu spring rolls was fried to perfection.  There was only one guy in there working both the kitchen and the restaurant.  The service was slow, but very friendly.   

Pretty greasy though.
Food and service is awesome. I had a great time. The servers are very friendly. Watch out for the water though. I think its bad.
So delicious, definitely our go to spot! Pizzas are so fun, delicious, and amazing gluten free crust! What more can a girl ask for?

The food and service here are awesome. I enjoy coming here every year during the convention. Keith is, by far, my favorite server with his humor and zazz over the years. One thing about this place is they changed the uniforms from the fun diner attire to something slightly more formal. I liked the old look! Had a great time eating here regularly!

Beautiful ambiance with wonderful food and great service. One of our top 3 meals while in NOLA. Our server was very friendly. We had the blackened catfish poboy with their special sauces they make on the premises. Prices were very fair for the portions and the quality was tops. The beautiful paintings that line the walls are defiantly one of a kind and the courtyard is beautiful as well. I really encourage you to check this place out.

If you want a real daiquiri, The Organic Banana is definitely the best I've had. They're not shy on having a heavy hand, and their blend of fruits is everything. The perfect companion for the French Market.

Best doughnuts in soulard, however I will never give any of my hard earned money to Johns doughnuts again. I have been disrespected on the phone calling to check business hours. I have also witnessed my friend being disrespected in the store by another or maybe even the same employee. I don't appreciate giving money to a business and then treated like dirt. I figured the best thing I could do was write a bad review to warn everyone else. If you are a classless rude person working in customer service I understand but you atleast have to fake it!
Great food, very affordable and reasonable. Will be coming back for more this week. Clean and family friendly

4 stars for the long line but I guess that's what you expect when the food is that good. I opted for the pulled pork sandwich, it was great with Jane's sauce. The coleslaw is vinegar-based and didn't suit my fancy, but overall we were not in line for more than 30 minutes and the food came out quickly !

This is my first review on yelp but I felt the need to express my recent experience at FULL PLATE. This was the first time there and I ordered the vegan mac/cheese, catfish fingers and yellow  watermelon. The yellow watermelon was delicious. The vegan mac/cheese...so so...i have had better but it was edible. 

Now for the catfish fingers. They were TERRIBLE.  I am not sure what batter they use but I have never seen anything like it before. It looked like batter you would get at a fast food restaurant.  These were the worst catfish fingers I have ever eaten. A few minutes after receiving them my server asked how my food was. I told him everything was fine except the catfish. I just knew he was going to ask if he could get me something else but he did not. I then attempted to douse them in hot sauce and ketchup to try to make them edible. I ate maybe one more bite of the catfish to no avail. I at the rest of the mac/cheese and watermelon and asked for my check. 

After the server took away my FULL PLATE of catfish I just knew it was going to be comp. Got my check and it was not. And the server had the nerve to say he hated that I didn't like it but "it happens sometimes." 

Well FULL PLATE this will be my first and last time eating at your establishment. Hope you guys use my $18 well because that is the last of my money you will receive.

The only good thing about this experience is that they were playing Michael Jackson while I was there.

Steak 'n Shake. The name of the restaurant itself implies that their specialty might possibly be their hamburgers and milkshakes. I'm afraid to report that their milkshakes are majorly disappointing. We had burgers here and milkshakes, and all of the milkshakes served to the table were half way melted already when they served them. 
My dad ordered chicken strips, and the portion wasn't even suitable for a kids meal.  When he asked if they could give him another chick strip because one he got was so tiny, and some more fries -- they came back with one more super tiny chicken strip and still charged him for the extra fries. Not the best customer service. 
We have watched Steak 'n Shake since they broke ground. Watching the progress every single day driving to work. We were excited to get one here in south Reno right off the freeway, so we didn't have to go North to the other one. But you're better off passing this one up and going to their other location or somewhere else. 
I know they are still new and trying to get their groove. But we were definitely disappointed.

If I could give both the Ruby Slipper and our server Shameka a 10 star review I would. Her recommendations were amazing and the food is out of this world. Also phenomenal Bloody Marys!! Cannot say enough good things about this place. (Hint: order the Gulf Fish St. Peter- sounds a little weird and fishy but it's amazing.)

Very good. Excellent customer service from Mandy. I got catfish and chips, my son got a fish sandwich, daughter calamari basket, and husband cod fish and chips. Hard to find google was not helpful we almost left. If you are on Sierra heading south away from unr to downtown it is on the left next to the river and two other restaurants on the patio.

If you want good New Orleans style seafood in various forms, this is worth a go! Don't let the rough exterior fool you, you get the best bang for your buck from this joint. Ranging from $5.99/lb crawfish to freshly fried Po' Boys, its worth getting your hands dirty to enjoy some authentic New Orleans style seafood. I also recommend some unique meat items, particularly the Turkey Necks and Pig's Feet (less than $2!!! insane!) You can get full spending less than $10.
Best coffee in town and the owner very sweet and friendly. Food, music and coffee what more can you ask for?

I don't really want to give a bad review because I don't know how the food is.  All I am saying  is, don't eat here if you have food allergies.  Even though they mention it on the menu, they had no idea what we were talking about.

I love the look of this spot. Super cool vibe with very friendly wait staff.

Because it was my first time, they even gave me a huge baguette to take home!!

My only critique is that I thought there was a little too much going on in the turkey and cheese sandwich. I had to scrape the sauce off the bread because the flavor was overpowering.

And the side dish that comes with your meal is the "house side" that changes daily. It was potato salad when I went. Tasty, but the potatoes weren't as soft as I am used to in potato salad. Not a problem, just a difference.

Again, I will be going back to try some of the other awesome items on the menu!

These wings are HEAVENLY!!  Why go ANYWHERE else?!

After going to Native New Yorker (what a mistake!), I read their reviews online and noticed how many people raved about WOB.  So, earlier this week I tried it.  I have been there 3 times already this week!  Thus far I have had the lemon-pepper, medium (buffalo), hot (buffalo), honey gold, honey hot, and garlic-parmesan.  All ROCKED with the exception of the garlic-parmesan, which were a little mild for my taste (more GARLIC, please!).

Wings are always PLUMP with meat, hot, and cooked to perfection!  Veggies and dressing are chilled (like they're s'posed to be), like they just came out of the frig.  Beer is reasonably priced and cold!  The beer-battered bacon-ranch fries are AWESOME!  Service is SUPERB!  

Today is Tue., so I experienced their cheap wing night for the first time.  My friend and I agreed that we are going to make this a regular Tue. ritual. 

I can't say enough good things about this joint!  It's my new favorite place to go for food or just to hang out.  You can't go wrong going to WOB!

*****

WEAK. Calling this Cuban or Latin-Caribbean food would be like calling Domino's Italian food. The cocktails were as good as advertised though. My main reason for writing the review is to point out that service was not good. I'm pretty sure our waitress was drunk, which wouldn't have even been too bad if she acted like she gave a ---- about her job.

My first review in a few weeks! Money is tight so I haven't been able to go anywhere lately. Today is the first time in a month or so that I've been able to visit some place new. I don't know how long OEC has been here but this is my first time. It's much less expensive and closer than my favorite sushi restaurants.

OEC is like a fancy Chinese place but with Japanese food. Their prices are a lot cheaper than high end sushi restaurants which makes it an ideal sushi joint for those who dislike going to Publix for sushi. 

The interior is very nice and clean, dark red wood imitation like fancy high end restaurants, in addition the traditional lucky cats and Buddha. The atmosphere is quaint and relaxing with gentle piano tunes. 

Today I tried their lunch special - two rolls and a choice of soup or salad for only 8$ and a hot tea for 1.50$. Not bad at all. Their miso soup was tasty - of course you can never really go wrong with miso soup but I've been served watery miso before. The rolls came out quickly; I watched the cook make my unakyu and spicy tuna rolls at the bar - which, by the way, is smaller than the average sushi bar. You can taste the difference between quality rolls and these rolls, however I would not let that cloud your judgement immediately for I was satisfied by the filling-to-rice ratio. 

One of my favorite aspects of this restaurant is the absence of red cap soy sauce. Green cap, low sodium only. +1 for this place. They also have hibachi dishes for a good price; however I can't comment on those since I have yet to try it.

Finally, compliments to the staff for their gentle, attentive service. I liked the kindness and the willingness to help that was displayed to, not only me, but other customers that arrived after me. 

I'll be back with my girlfriend!

I said we would be back and I meant it. 
We shared a few items and they were all good, but my favorite was the chicken 
parm sandwich. Fantastic all around. 

The wife loved the wings, I loved the sauce but I ordered them well done and it just
was not crisp enough for me to love the wings. Still good.

Burger was good, but no really cooked to order temp. Still a hefty solid burger.
And once again, we for sure well be back.......

This place has such potential!  I really want to like this place.  Great atmosphere-  very cool vibe.  Outside patio is spectacular but then there is the service and food.  
I have been here 4 times.  The first time the wait from ordering until you get food was about 45 minutes.   The second time it was fine.  The third time it took a long time for server to engage and return- resulting in a long experience.  Today I walked out after being seated and no server for 15 minutes.  If you like to have a long drawn out meal, I guess this is the place for you.  
The food is alright.  I have tried several different things in the menu and they are fine.  Not great but not bad.  I was just really hoping that this would be a kid friendly place to eat with good food in Kirkwood.

These people are completely dishonest thieves, avoid at all costs!!!
We stopped by for a few drinks, even though the music was awful. There were three of us, we had three beers each for a total of 9 beers.  When we asked for the bill, it was not presented to us, but instead they ran my credit card for $143!!  When I asked for the bill, they claimed we had drunk 16 beers.  I informed them that this was completely wrong, but the manager claimed it was impossible for him to ever make a mistake, and he was sure the bill was right.  He would not refund my credit card even though I had never reviewed or approved the bill.  I am going to have to fight this bill via the credit card company.  The manager was arrogant, rude, condescending, and a dishonest thief.  Avoid this hell hole at all costs or prepare to be victimized!!!!!
I will never go here again. Service SUCKS. Servers ignore customers and the food is the worst.
The foods good but they always leave the phone off the hook, on purpose, and they are always out of main ingredients to make anything.

I think of Tampopo as Rotisseur's slightly less ambitious Asian stepbrother.  They both have a white American father because methinks this is not the most authentic Asian food out there so not full Asian, yet retain a some core features that make both pretty lovable.  Casual seating and atmosphere, a place to stop in for a good meal at a good price any day of the week.  Rotisseur knocks it out of the park for me with their chicken bahn mi, while the  tuna bi-bim-bop didn't quite reach that stratosphere.  But I'll keep trying. 

Now, I could absolutely be wrong about the authenticity of the food here, being a white guy from Jersey and all, but that's the feeling I get.  If anyone from Tampopo reads this please do not take offense.  I do not care if your food is authentic.  I care if it's good.  And it's real good.

Love this food. If you are looking to fill up and enjoy every last bite, or bring home yummy leftovers, this is your place! The portions are huge and service is speedy. It's all about the food here.  You won't be disappointed.

We were going to Tipitina's for a show and decided to have dinner beforehand at this lovely place.  

The decor is a bit low brow.  Kind of shacklike in the room we were seated.  My friend asked if I could think of any place in Atlanta with these prices and decor.  I couldn't.  Seems like they are all over New Orleans though. 

As for the food and service, both were good. Not the best I've ever had in either case, but not slackerific either. The server forgot my order of brussels.  Oh well... didn't need veggies anyway.  The bbq shrimp app was fabulous.  I was trying to limit my bread consumption, but once I finished the shrimp I had to use the grilled bread to sop up that delicious dark broth.  I ordered the bouillabaisse and it was just ok.  Nothing too special.

If you head on over make sure to get the BBQ shrimp.

My partner and I stopped in for some brunch and the food was kinda meh. I got the eggs Benedict with salmon and they got the chicken salad wrap. My food came out cold and my salmon was.. questionable to say the least. My partners food was okay as well with hardly any chicken in the wrap. Overall customer service was fine, we were the only ones there but it was still good. Maybe they had a bad day because I read good things but my experience was just overall kinda meh.

Came here on a Saturday around 7pm. No wait for a table for two. We got a nice big table. The atmosphere and decoration here is great! It has that warm buzzing feeling of a nice fun seafood restaurant. We ordered the sand dabs, Idaho trout almondine, and a Cuban. The drink was good and strong. Our server was friendly and attentive. The only complaint which seems silly but our food arrived WAY too fast. Within 5 minutes of ordering the food came on a hot plate. The food didn't seem to be freshly made but heated up/kept warm. Our entire meal lasted 40 minutes. We were looking for more of a sit down dining experience rather than a quick bite.

Seeing all these other positive reviews makes me think I went on a bad night. We went on a Friday with a Groupon and it appeared to be kids night? We don't have kids, so ... it wasn't really the atmosphere we were looking for - we're talking jumping castle in the parking lot. I ordered the turkey ruben and my hubs got the turkey burger. We also ordered the pita and artichoke dip. It took forever to get the artichoke dip. When it finally came, it was so salty I couldn't eat much. And my sandwich ... I can't say it was bad ... all the parts separately were fine, but it just didn't come together well. The toasted bread was crumbly and greasy and I didn't even eat all the chips - and that's saying a lot. My hubs said his burger was fine. I liked the decor inside, but we sat outside because with all the kids it was pretty loud. I definitely didn't leave feeling excited about a new find. The only reason I'll consider going back is all the other good reviews.

Brad Pitt ate at this hole-in-the-wall spot that really looks just like someone's house almost every day when he was in NoLa. 

Order EITHER the King Combo or the Jazz Combo.

I have ordered pizza, calzone and salad here on several occasions.  I love their food.  The pizza is the best, very cheesy, fresh vegetables and the calzone was huge.  I try to eat here every time I travel to Nashville.  The service is great.  I have picked up and had delivery, both very timely.  The prices are reasonable, especially with as much food as they give you.  Highly recommend!

I've only been here a couple of times but was pleased with the food and service. Prices are about the norm for sushi and the selection was pretty standard. The dining area was recently redone and so is clean and attractive. If I'm in the area this would be my choice for sushi, I don't believe I would go out of my way for it though.
Best bagel sandwiches I've ever had, hands down. Friendly staff, super duper atmosphere.

I've been here three times now and it's so freaking delicious we don't mind the 25 minute drive each way. All of the food is delicious, I've never had a problem with my OpenTable reservation, and the management is very involved and goes to every table. The sticky rice bowl with Salmon is huge and so deliciously fresh.

I just love this place. Beautiful setting. Wonderful service. Perfect sushi.  They have  a great lunch special too. $8.50 for miso  soup, salad with great ginger dressing and two perfect sushi rolls. What could be better.

We had so much fun sitting at the bar here! The margarita's were great and we stopped to have a drink while walking through y-bor and ended up staying for hours we had such a good time! The bartenders were hilarious and provided great entertainment! We haven't had the food yet but such a fun atmosphere that we will def be back!

Went to Zama last night with a few girlfriends and had a really nice meal.  Parking wasn't too bad but I bet on weekends it's awful.  We had a bunch of little appetizers, sushi and the dessert sampler.  Everything was really tasty and the service and atmosphere were excellent.  I will definitely be back for another fab dinner.  It's nice to find somewhere to eat that's reasonably priced  in the city that isn't a pizza shop.

It's crazy that this was my first visit to Shoefly. I had the romaine salad and Cuban flatbread. Tons of capers on the salad add a distinct biting flavor. Perfectly dressed and big enough to share. The flatbread was super crunchy on the edges of the pretzel crust. I like that but beware if your don't like a chewing challenge. No booze but their lemonade with sake is delicious and gets the job done. Cool environment in which to dine.

We order Several times a month Great Food & Fast delivery ...
 The pizza and cheesesteaks were Excellent !

We moved here from the Seattle area, so we were so excited to see a familiar favorite here in Boise, The Matador!! The food is SO good, our favorites are the chips and salsa, brussel sprouts, fajitas, mahi, and enchiladas! Food quality is always great and so fresh, never greasy. Happy hour offerings are hard to beat! Best Mexican food option in the area, IMHO, and always our go-to for Mexican food! Hope you enjoy it as much as we do!

I have been coming here for almost 2 years , figured why  not lets add this business to yelp. (that's how long its been here)

Great spot for this Super Wawa they have here with easy access points to 295. I'm always getting a coffee here, which is always fresh, these guys and gals (pretty ladies by the way) are always on the game, the staff is the friendliest around. Clean and bright, stations are clean, deli counter is in check.
  
They are always polite and they never mess up the order. Always stocked, no issues in making you what ever you ask for, seeing they do have an enormous amount of patience with me and my weird special orders. 

Plenty of parking, has a truckers station so these guys and gals can park their big rigs. 
Fueling stations for you to fuel up with regular or diesel ; accommodates both.

 If I could give it more than 5 stars  I would. 

Zero complaints here

This building has housed a number of establishments over the years.  The most recent switch came after a brief shutdown of the previous restaurant and a re-opening under this new name.  I hadn't been here when it was under its most recent previous name, so can't say whether it seems the same or not.   

The parking lot was eerily empty when we arrived at 6PM on a Saturday night, but after a brief discussion, we opted to give it a try.   

The decor that greets you is very bright and colorful.   Pretty much every inch of the tables, chairs and walls are decorated.    The chips and salsa are complimentary and were fresh and tasty.   I went with my usual choice for first visit to a new Mexican restaurant, the carne asada tacos.   The flavor of the meat was good, and the pico de gallo was fresh.  The assortment of hot sauces on the table were good for adding a bit of heat.    The beans were standard Mexican-American fare, and totally fine.   

For dessert, I had the yes-I-am-aware-this-is-not-authentic-Mexican dessert, fried ice cream.   It was done quite well with a good balance of crunchy coating to creamy ice cream, whipped cream, honey and chocolate sauce.   

The prices are crazy low.  The entire bill for two with two entrees, two desserts and two soft drinks was $30.   Service was fast, and our server did check on us periodically to see if we needed anything.   

More people did come in later, but it was still very quiet for a Saturday night. There were a few families here; it seems like it would be a good place for families to come with kids.  They'd love the decor, there's no wait for a table, the food is good, inexpensive, and comes out fast.
I don't live in Tucson but every time we come into town we always come here. Home style food, always a pleasant experience. Great prices!
This definitely hit the spot , im a little tipsy writing this but my girl Hanna knows how to make u feel welcome. I will be back and bring on them blue drinks again Hanna!!!!!

I rarely give out 5 stars and mean it, however this is the only Brazilian Steak House that I've liked. 

I found it amazing that all the meats that they bring around are cooked to perfection. Nothing was cold or seemed reheated, the meats were tender, juicy and in some cases to die for!

My favorites are the leg of lamb and the filet mignon. *Not to be confused with lambchops and filet wrapped in bacon, which was also good.* 

The filet mignon, medium rare was so soft, tender and juicy, I had to have more. When we were done and I was beyond stuffed, the filet came back for another round and I had to have another cut of it, that's how good it was!

$50 is a pricey to me but it was worth a one time trip.

So as everyone is nightly do I cool or do I order delivery. My husband decided this night we'd have Chinese takeout.  We both wanted to try something new and were reminiscing about one of our favorite restaurants in Austin.  We loved this place and from our first time, we never ordered 5 again. But ordered 3 and were always happy with the level of spice. 
When I looked up the menu on Yelp and looked at the reviews, I knew we'd have to try 101. We ordered potstickers, fried rice, generals chicken and Szechuan eggplant. Level 3, we wanted to enjoy dinner. 
The reviews were spot on.  The food was fresh, perfectly spiced and seasoned and good portions. Dinner for the next night. 
The generals chicken was perfectly cooked.  The eggplant was just soft enough that it didn't absorb the oil and become soggy. The spices on both were perfectly balanced for a back end pop.  The potstickers were golden brown and both sauces complimented them well.  I wish I had photos but we ate it all next time, there will be plenty of them.

I'm a fan of Qdoba already !! I love the taste of the food the options available and the freshness but the best part about eating out is the service!!  The service by management and staff was superb!  I am injured and on crutches they helped me to my table and grabbed napkins and eating utensils while at it!! It was one of the sweet and most customer friendly things I've experienced.  I will of course continue to eat Qdoba but may just try to bring my business to this location and little more often!

Found this little gem by luck and we are glad we did. We liked it so much that we went back the next day. I really don't want to call it a Mexican Restaurant because it's more than that. Cantina fits properly. It's very good so take my word in it. 

The salsa is more like a Pico de Gallo. Very fresh and tasty. Pair it with the quest and you're off to a good start. 

We had the plantains. They were good but we prefer them a little riper. The Ribeye Steak tacos are just perfect with the chipotle sauce that gives it a little kick. I also had the pulled pork sandwich. You will need an appetite to finish this bad boy and it comes with fries that you won't finish but feel free to try. 

Leave some room for the flan. You don't want to miss out on it.
