But, on our second visit for dinner, we had a different experience. I ordered the same pho and it tasted...different. The broth had less flavor Try it out...see if you like it. I would probably return if I was in New Orleans.

Although the customer service was phenomenal, a basic cheesesteak is not worth $9+ at Liberty Cheesesteak. 

 I basically paid $9+ (not including side) for a dry cheesesteak with very minimal amount of cheese.  I had to keep opening the sandwich and taking bites at parts where I just might get to taste cheese.   After all, it is a cheesesteak and if it's going to be called one, the customer should at least be able to taste cheese.

I suggest that the  owner  take a trip to Jersey Mikes or J Michael's in Wilmington, North Carolina to get ideas on a) what a cheesesteak is supposed to taste like and b) how to minimize or even maximize market price with customer satisfaction and expectation.  For instance, I pay around $7 for a cheesesteak at the abovementioned restaurants.  At Jersey Mikes, I received a gracious amount of melted Provolone cheese, peppers, onions, and the sandwich wasn't dry - not to mention it was bigger & cheaper than Liberty's.  At J Michael's, I also received a sandwich the same size as the one at Liberty's, except it comes with lettuce, mayo, other condiments of your choice, a liberal amount of melted cheese, etc - not to mention the cheaper price.  

I must add that you should still try Liberty Cheesesteak if for nothing more than  to support the young staff and small business owner.  They were extremely nice and good looking.  

That way, you can make your own observations and conclusions about whether you would visit Liberty again or recommend it to a friend.

HE SHOULD BE FIRED!!! I CANNOT BELIEVE THE SERVICE I RECEIVED THERE! I stood in line for 10 minutes, and when I went to order they told me they were out of steak and it would be 10 minutes. While I am waiting, I see another person go to order a quesadilla, and was told she had to order it online, when she went to go order it online, the website said it was down. Instead of working with her, he just said "oh well" and when she asked to speak with a manager, HE WAS THE MANAGER. While waiting, I saw FOUR people go to order the steak, and after a condescending sassy response from him, THEY ALL LEFT TO GO SOMEWHERE ELSE. After OVER 10 minutes of waiting for the steak, I asked if it was ready and his response? "It will be ready when its ready, if you don't want to wait, you can go somewhere else." YES, THAT IS CORRECT! THAT WAS A MANAGERS RESPONSE TO ME!!! Another girl (who was also waiting for the steak) quickly came to my side and said we have all been waiting here over 10 minutes, which is how long you said it would take, it is lunch rush hour and this is completely ridiculous. Now, a decent manager would just say "you're right, it is taking a little longer than expected, here is some free queso while you wait". Instead, this boy goes to yell at us!!! As you can see in the attached picture where he starts raising his hands and getting loud and defensive with us! We both ended up leaving after that altercation because to be spoken so rudely to by a manager is COMPLETELY UNACCEPTABLE. I had to drive 10 minutes away to another Chipotle, wait in another 15 minute line, and when I got to the front I asked to speak with their manager on how to report him (from the other store) to headquarters. She politely explained that they are over-worked, under-staffed, (and I also know that they are under-paid). She apologized for his behavior and gave me my meals for free. She was a saving grace in what is becoming a terrible institution. 

PLEASE FIRE THIS MANAGER! In the 20 minutes I was there he lost SO MANY CUSTOMERS completely based on his rude, condescending, arrogant behavior. HE DOES NOT DESERVE TO BE A MANAGER. THERE IS NO TRAINING OR DEMOTION THAT WILL EVER SOLVE SOMEONE WITH HIS TYPE OF PERSONALITY.
I had the breakfast tacos and they were delicious!  I highly recommend this restaurant.  Lots of healthy choices and a wide variety of options to select from.

I'm on the fence with this place... I'll skip the grocery side of this business since I've never bought anything there. 
The back of the business where the restaurant is has a bright and festive atmosphere. Considering how far back it goes, it's pretty large. The food they will make to your liking. Mexican or Americana... Personally, I don't think Americana should be an option. It just confuses people like myself who are expecting authentic. The food is fairly decent, and the portions are pretty large. I've only ordered takeout, and these folks package their meals better than most places. 
karaoke on the weekends is advertised. 
Their location is a larger and more of a restaurant upgrade from their previous location in town, and it's a nice addition to the lacking dining options we have  here locally...
, and no dirt kicked on this establishment....
-Tim Ebert

Ate at Geno's and Pat's.  Wow, Pat's is so much better.  Ordered wiz wit and it was tasty, juicy and flavorful.  I like the steak chopped here rather then the whole slice at Geno's. They were pretty generous with the wiz.

Stayed here for the weekend.  Really nice resort.  Excellent service.  Right along the water-could not be better!  Rooms on the small side IMO.  Outside terrace and bar very nice to have drinks /eat some tapas.  Loved the wine tour we arranged from here

Alright..... I've almost written a review for this location multiple times. It's right by my house and the only "fast food" I'll eat.
Every single time I go they are out of something (I've been going to this location for 18 months)
I always find out when I get home or at the checkout.
I don't change my order 
I get a strawberry harvest with no chicken and a veggie sandwich.
Things we've that have been missing 
Strawberries from my strawberry harvest salad  tofu off my sandwich and avocado off my sandwich 
Rolls and the chocolate covered strawberries off the pick two....
Tonight they were off out stuff.... Yet again 

Bought the kiddos deserts 
The gal smashed 1/2 out of the container 

There is 0 issues when the manager is working 
They are not short staffed, I honestly feel like the gals working don't have any type of communication or ever know wtf is going on.
Tonight is my last trip to this location.

Be prepared - I am about to change your life.

Number 14. Pork Soy Sauce Noodle. Shaved (if you're real hungry). Add about 5 heaping scoops of the homemade hot oil.

I now have that warm fuzzy feeling of knowing I made a difference in this world!

The food was terrible. The fries were too salty and also tasted like ginger. Portion sizes were a joke, and when I complained, the unskilled cook told me that I ate most of it. Well yea, you barely put any food on my plate buddy. Wouldn't be surprised if this place went out of business soon. What a joke of an establishment, no surprise they have barely any customers. If I could give them a 0 star rating I absolutely would.

Overall great experience! Temperature taken at door as well as clean pens to use. Just went for drinks, but I ended up ordering chips and guac as well. At $6 I didn't know what portion to expect, but there were plenty of chips and guac, I even ended up sharing. To drink I got "two to tango" with tequila. I had never had anything quite like it and it was delish. The curried mango was a unique touch. Would love to go back and bowl eventually.

Such a great market! It is so unique and such a fun place to take out of town visitors! The take and bake meals are an easy weeknight go to meal. The patio is a great spot to enjoy a glass of wine and one of their awesome subs! Prosciutto and mozzarella is my personal favorite! Don't forget to grab a canollj to take home too

OK so I heard this place was world famous from NYC. All my bosses at work are from NYC. They never heard of the place. Didn't let that stop me and ate it anyways. Damn good Pizza, would put St. Louis style way above it but hey that the best EVER. This is a good pie, that anyone should enjoy. Great location , kool bar and nice staff. Oh and Legends Mall is a must see.
Just one more 5 star for Killer Poboys Roast Beef.  Yes, it's a dump.  Yes, you'll think you're going to get mugged when you walk in...but all the folks are friendly and the food is just fantastic.
Delicious and great portion sizes! The asparagus fingers were amazing and everything we ordered was tasty. Ambiance was great as well!

I came here with some friends after work one day and was super excited try everything based on how good Le Petit Grocery is (same chef and similar menu). The ambience is great and I really liked how they decorated the restaurant. Their zesty green bean appetizer is to this day probably my favorite veggie dish I've tasted. It's lemony and spicy and zingy and just the best. However, unfortunately the octopus appetizer one of my friends ordered was just not good. Additionally, they were both unhappy with their main dishes as well. But I didn't want to taint this review based on that because the burger I ordered was phenomenal. My fries with malt vinegar aoli were also fabulous. So I would say the dishes they do right they really do right but they do have a few bad eggs on their menu.

This is a small location, so it does get uncomfortably crowded by the register with people waiting for food or using the self serve soda machine. At least the service is fast. The Cajun food is an embarrassment that is nothing like what you get in New Orleans. But the chicken and biscuits are great, and that's why this was a welcome addition to the center city food scene when it opened. Don't be tempted by the other food items. Stick with ordering what they do best - fried chicken that is much better and cheaper than federal donuts.

I ate here a few weeks ago and had a great experience! I came along with three friends and sat on the top floor. The food was great. I ordered the chicken cutlet, which was delicious. We all ordered the wine flights which were a great deal, and allows you to taste a variety of wines at a great price. The service and atmosphere were great as well. I will definitely eat here again.

I love this spot! Food is great and they have a great selection. If you have diet restrictions this is a good choice. The vegan chocolate "cheese" cake is amazing I order it every chance I get. The waffles are so yummy! Kid friendly. Great sangrias. There's a club you can join to earn points towards discounts birthday meals etc. Service is always friendly, fast and attentive without hovering.

A popular spot in the French Quarter that I've actually been to many years ago.  The level of service that Rebecca, my bartender as of course I sat at the bar, gave me was worth 5 stars.  My Golf Shrimp Po'boy  Was decent a little dry and light on the condiments.  The menu is quite impressive overall having a vast variety of Cajun and creo specialties and of course lots of oysters.  Looking back on it I probably shouldn't went with something else perhaps the baked golf shrimp tortellini or the cajun shrimp and cheese gouda grits?  Don't give me wrong, it was a decent poboy but I'm guessing I probably could have had something even better and just based off their hospitality I'd go back and give it another shot....Check it out and let me know what you think.
No masks were used by staff. This is unacceptable considering the uptick in cases. Not going back here.
Okay...I live in the 'hood and really wanted to like it but it really sucked for breakfast. But then again, I don't like everything fried or harmful to my health.

Don't go.. Use to be the best.. Food has gone straight down hill and they hire convicts with no education to cook it and serve it. Do yourself a favor and go to Quarter Master.. Yelp needs to give a no star option
We scheduled a reservation for 8 pm the day of, popped in the mall beforehand and then enjoyed dinner. Service was great and the food was fabulous. Well priced, cozy atmosphere and would return!

Came here as part of of a work event. We had about 20 people. 
They reserved tables for us no problem. Our server was great too. They should have probably gave her some help..It was alot of people for one server...But she rocked it. 
Food came out slow but it was delicious. Da beef is the way to go.  I got sweet peppers but the hot looked great too.  I recommend extra jus. 
Pretzels are phenomenal as well. 

As far as I can tell, those place is not wheelchair friendly...There is a pretty serious set of stairs to get up to the dining area so be prepared for that. 

Overall great place. 
Parking is a bear in this area fyi

Açaí was delicious. The service was amazing and the place was VERY clean. Definitely going back. Had the strawberry with peanut butter and fruit toppings. This is my go to place in Santa Barbara for Açaí.

Bubba never disappoints i go to his fb page and hunt him down and now i have my friends and family stalking him too. One of the main reasons is the surf and turf sandwich if its not on the menu ask for it. The best food truck in the Tri State area
Been here multiple times and the Pho never fails. However, Bun Bo Hue just isn't up to par.

Indeed, as noted, quick/attentive service along with a very nice atmosphere. Not every dish is a standout, but none that I've tried have been greasy or bland.  I think that the kung pao chicken and the chicken salad are some of the better that I've tried. Sesame chicken is delicious!  Always a winner. I actually find their prices to be in the ballpark of reasonable, but I live in a very expensive city so I'm biased. takeaway service is quick too.

I ordered a cappuccino and asked for " not too hot" ...the supposed barista with dreadlocks steamed my milk without even touching the pitcher to feel the temperature then proceeded to scoop the foam out with a spoon. The coffee was so hot it burned my mouth. So I asked him to remake it . He huffed and puffed, pulled a shot of espresso and poured cold milk into it .... So now I has a really cold gross drink. I actually couldn't believe it. Please don't go here ! Waste of money. There are plenty of good cafés in Philadelphia !!!!

Eating at the chef's table here was one of the best meals I've ever had in my life.  I did oysters cooked 4 differnt ways with the head chef, then foie gras, then a filet.  All I can say is WOW! A New Orleans staple, it'll be around for years and years.  If you don't want to eat in the kitchen, it's very finely appointed inside.

We ordered garlic bread and a sausage pizza.

The bread is really good.  They make it themselves fresh.  I'm anxious to go again and just have the bread plain next time without the butter and garlic stuff.  

The pizza was very good also.

And, I had diet soda and it was fine.  Not sure what happened the day the other reviewer had flat soda.

The service was perfect.  

The prices are very reasonable.  I think our pizza, garlic bread and soda was around 18 bucks.

A good dinner, and we'll be back.   It's every bit as good, or better, than some of the snobby, overpriced pizza joints in Kirkwood.

4 stars only because the drinks and the pretzels were amazing! 

Hugo made the drinks although it seemed like a bother for him to make them and then told us we COULD NOT bring drinks upstairs bc it was a different liquor law up there? Maybe that's the case 

Ashley the host didn't relay that message to us about drinks when we asked if we could order and bring stuff upstairs she said yes...she did get us a spot outside bc we were in a hurry but GOD FORBID we asked her for a napkin you woulda thought we asked for million dollars! She rolled her eyes and someone else brought the napkin! 

Rest of staff was nice and we will return bc the food was great!

We finally got the chance to to try out Pier Teaki! What a view!! We had frozen strawberry daiquiris that were delicious and refreshing in the 90° weather and sweet bbq chicken flatbread that was also delicious and enough for the 2 of us. Our server Seth had a great personality and was a delight! He was very attentive and we enjoyed chatting with him. We'll definitely make this our go to place!
This review is for the chicken tender: it's more to the salty side. The batter is crunchy but not hard. It's greasy though. When I heated up in the oven I could see some grease on the pan

After reading an article about FarmTable we were excited to try a "new to us" Italian restaurant. We made a reservation, drove 45 minutes to get there and paid to park only to be very disappointed.

First, we were seated at a tiny 2-top scrunched in between a loud party of 6 and the servers' station, jammed up against the fire extinguisher. When we asked for a different table we were told curtly that they were very busy and all the tables were spoken for. Meanwhile, the entire time we were there three tables in a quiet corner sat empty. I watched throughout our meal while servers' elbows were inches from my husband's head as he ate.

The food came out scary fast. So fast it's hard to believe it wasn't pre-prepared.

And unfortunately it was pretty mediocre. My husband ordered gnocchi. It came out lukewarm and he reported that it tasted bland. I ordered margarita pizza which also was unremarkable. The best part of the meal was the focaccia.

There are so many great restaurants in St. Pete, we won't be wasting our money here again.

A burger is at least $10.00.  Ad on tax and a three dollar soda, you would be much better going elsewhere.   Gone are the featured iHop breakfasts and  Ruddy-tooty-fresh-n-fruity.

Basically, your paying through the nose for cheap food and bad service.   Empty place and the cooks were playing rap music as loud as the dining room tunes and the manager was watching a game on his phone.

Just saw that it has been marked as closed, I'll leave this in case they ever come back, I really did enjoy my visit.

Great little coffee shop with a nice local feeling, relaxing place to stop by between museum visits.
So good and very authentic Vietnamese food. I tried the garlic tofu and avocado- shrimp salad. It was very tasty and fresh. The place is also very clean.

If you are in the manayunk/ Roxborough section of the city, this spot is worth the visit. Dalessandro's is one of the top cheesesteak places in my opinion. Great portion size perfect amount of cheese and perfectly fried onions. My only complaint is that I wish they would season the steak a little bit more. But other than that great steak for the money. Anything under $10 these days is a deal.

I like this place because it's open late. However the food is not great. The Buffalo chicken dip is pretty gross with almost no chicken and way too much blue cheese in it. Their mac & cheese says you could add lobster but they don't have lobster. The colonels  chicken bowl has beef gravy. Why the hell would you put beef gravy in a chicken bowl? I don't eat beef so I won't be ordering that. Since they ruined it with beef gravy.
They also have chicken breasts Entrées for $16 but they don't come with any sides. What?! $16 for an entrée with no sides?! No thanks. Almost no healthy options for food either. Which is unfortunate.. 
Two months ago me and my friend actually had dinner here. Service was extremely slow. I don't remember the waitresses name but it took her 10 minutes to bring ketchup. Seems like that's a big problem with this place and the majority of the complaints

Argumentative staff, overcooked food
Overpriced

Save your money, there are many better choices in the FQ

Great experience. Very nice concept and great service. And most importantly amazing food. Must visit. Finally good Indian taste in PA. I promise you won't regret trying this place and I am sure, u will visit again.
Loved it loved it loved it.
Great pour-overs! Coffee is some of the best in Edmonton, and the cafe vibes are excellent in all locations.

We're NOT rating the venue. We went there strictly for the beignets, and they were delicious. So much powdered sugar and carb love it's not even funny. The dough is wonderful, I think they put ecstasy in it. 

They make them hot to order and are pretty cheap.

Not only that, the cashier was kinda cute and gave me an extra ben. ;) 

"Oh no! I think me beignet is lost in the powdered suger!" 
"Sad panda, I finished mine..." 
"That was perfect." Mmmmm

I had eaten here several years ago and found the burgers to be decent so I thought I'd try it again for some beefy deliciousness and WOW did it suck. 

Hamburgers were very small, thin, tasteless and overcooked like they were just reheated in the microwave b4 being brought out.

I ordered fries and they were equally as bad. A small pet peeve of mine is when you reach for the ketchup bottle only to taste it and find out it's some inferior brand.  Believe me restaurant owners. We can tell !!

On the upside the staff was friendly and the vibe is fun but the food just doesn't cut it. Sorry Lindys you're off the list.
Was excited to eat here, but there were no vegetarian options. Very crowded and chaotic. Tables full. We left after 3 minutes.
For strangers in Reno, Peg's delivered a hearty, delicious breakfast.  We were impressed with their brunch options and thought the benedict with the chorizo sausage was excellent.

Very disappointing. Used to be a 5 but now that they limited the food options def not a 5 anymore. Food is still good but this place is deteriorating. My advice go back to your old brunch menu  and do some renovations this place is outdated and has A LOT of potential

One of my favorite new places in New Orleans. I've had the empanada, tacos, dumplings, bahn mi, papadum and arancini and all of it was fantastic (EXCEPT for the tacos which were all pretty bland). The only drink I had was the boom boom and it wasn't that exciting; I probably won't have it again. The restaurant is a little pricey and I didn't leave with a full belly but it was still delicious and I can't wait to try the rest of the menu!

Ate there last week an I must say food was good.Service was excellent.it was a weekend so no drink specials but the cocktails we ordered were good but pricey. Ordered friend green tomatoes an what a treat.The presentation was unique an it was delicious. I could have eaten more.Steak was good an enough to take home.Salmon dinner was good.The mushroom ravioli was good but I would have liked a bigger serving so I would have some to take home. I think the meals should come with bread an a salad for the prices.
Atmosphere is pleasant an a good place for a special occasion. I'd go back again an again.
Terrible experience. Food was not bad. But service was terrible. Took 1 hour and not even a single entree was ready. Asked waiter to check for so many times. Automatically applied 20% tips.

This is the type of place you walk into and think....'we're not in New Orleans anymore.' By this I mean both the people and portion sizes are much, much bigger. I ordered a 'half' oyster po'boy (a foot long) and a 'side' of mac n cheese which could've easily fed two people as main courses (total = $12.50). I wasn't too crazy about the oysters, but I think that's just because I'm not a huge fan of oysters. The mac and cheese, however, was deeeeeelicious. It's that kinda southern mac and cheese that has egg in it, super greasy, and may give you the shits later. Who cares, though! I can't wait to go back and try the fish po'boy and some red beans and rice, even if it comes with a heart attack for dessert....yolo?

Greats drinks! And that's about where it ends. Lots of servers walking around but no one really seeming to have assigned stations. We ordered a pizza at happy hour, it had tomatoes on it and ended up being really soggy; we sent it back thinking the fresh tomatoes made it wet. But then the second pizza, a plain margarita, had the same problem. A wet bottom that flopped over and was very difficult to eat and not very yummy. Wish I liked this place, but it's not as good as it looks to be.

This is absolutely a great Italian restaurant.   Located in a strip mall, it doesn't look like much from the outside,  but the servers are great, and the food is fabulous.  Known for their pizza and vodka sauce.

Love this place so I hate to do it but this is the Third time! Half pound of mussels 6 shells with Nothing in them only 6 with some thing actually in it (I do check the bag to see if they have fallen out of shell, not the case). The food is Very good, I just hate spending money for items I do not receive..My solution to this issue is to just be sure I dine in so if I have a problem I can let a server or management know just want those who do like to order take out to be aware...

A few friends kept recommending this place to me and they were right, it was great! Fast service, good atmosphere, loved the food and beer. I ordered the full tap sampler so that I could try all the brews. It came on a cute tray with descriptions of each beer under the glass. The Sockeye Salmon fish and chips was really good, made with REAL sockeye salmon!!! It paired perfectly with a lemon wedge and tartar sauce.

A welcome addition to the CWE. Fun atmosphere, but long waits for outdoor summer Fri/sat night seating, as you might expect. In contrast, I came for lunch on a Sunday & was seated immediately outside with a friendly & prompt server.

If you are looking for authentic Mexican cuisine, or even tex-mex the way it's classically done, this might not be the place for you. Instead its worth expecting a lighthearted, fun, Americanized/CWE/Pi version of Mexican/texmex experience. The tacos are good, platters are too, but the drinks are fantastic! Although I wouldn't expect less from the makers of Pi, love the cocktails there too. We had lousy service once on a busy night, ended up eating at the bar and had apologies galore when they realized someone messed up our names on the list. Sounded like a communication error that I'm chalking up to new restaurant opening mistakes, if it's a habit, I'll come back & edit this review. 'Til then, go check it out & have fun!

The food here is outstanding -- my fiance ordered the Screaming Mermaid and, not really as obsessed with Thai food as I, *loved* it.  I ordered Siamese noodles (vegetarian) which were delicious.  Both of us had soup and loved it -- a great start to a meal here, especially on a cold winter day :)  I had the (vegetarian) lemongrass soup and can honestly say it is the best soup I've ever had.

The service though... yikes!  There was only 1 server on for a FULL restaurant.  It took well over an hour to finish dinner (just dinner and soup -- no other courses).  It was an uncomfortable wait.

However, it was the only Thai restaurant open on a Monday night, so maybe everyone rushed in as we did, grateful to see them open.  

The food was sooooo good that we will be happy to return and give the service another shot.  The ambiance was very calming, and helped make a lovely night for us.
Arrived for a to-go order and every employee was in a bad mood claiming that they wanted to go home; and they had just clocked in! The service killed my excitement but the food was great
Amazing food and the wine selection is vast. Service is really top notch and the space is inviting. One of my very favorite restaurants.  During the warmer weather their patio is divine!!!

This little shop is easily one of Irvington's best lunch or dinner spots. It has a really good selection of specialty or build-your-own hot dogs or hamburgers, an Italian beef sandwich just like they serve in Chicago, and a few other menu items. The hot dogs are genuine Vienna Beef brand all-beef dogs. The food is generally all-around excellent, and the friendly staff go out of their way to give you the authentic Chicago experience--including scowling at you if you dare to order ketchup on your hot dog, in some cases. :)

If you've never had a genuine Italian beef, it's basically a fancier version of a French dip sandwich--but instead of just dipping the sandwich a little at a time into a tub of au jus, you can opt to have it poured over the sandwich (wet), or have the whole sandwich dipped (or double-dipped) into the broth. The wetter the sandwich is, the tastier it is--but the messier it is, too. Hold the sandwich by the foil wrapper while you eat it.

An interesting quirk is that the shop serves only beef and chicken products--no pork. Even the bacon they put on some specialty hot dogs or hamburgers is beef bacon, not the standard pork kind. If you've never tried beef bacon, it's actually pretty good; if I hadn't known it was beef, I wouldn't have been able to tell the difference.

The shop recently implemented a web-based order form, where you can place your carry-out order online for pickup within fifteen minutes. It's pretty handy, even if you do have to forego the scowl when you order ketchup. :) If you possibly can, I recommend placing carry-out orders for preference, rather than delivery. The delivery services do take a cut of the order price and I'd like to see this place stay in business for as long as possible!

Thoroughly enjoyed an early morning cafe latte and egg and havarti sandwich on a croissant. The latte was of excellent quality. The decor of the cafe is rustic and well thought. And right beside Monon trail too. 

At early hours of Saturday there was very little crowd and I could study without any distractions. But this is a great place to come and enjoy a leisurely chat with aroma of roasted coffee wafting all over. I was served very quickly but I think once more people come in the serving speed will compete with the French! 

Guys give Starbucks a break and head here!

Amazing. One of the best dining experiences I've ever had! Food is absolutely outstanding.  Service from Jason is top quality. He took charge of our requests and timed all food so that we were able to enjoy conversation, fine dining, and absolutely incredible cocktails. Very creative, well-made food, high quality service. I am looking forward to a return dining experience soon. I highly recommend Honey in Doylestown. Personally, I'll request Jason to be our server.
The food is fine. Unfortunately they don't live in this century where phones work. Good luck if you need to call them. They won't answer. Poor customer service and the food takes FOREVER.

We were so disappointed in our meal last night!  We could have cooked better quality steaks at home. The steaks were inconsistently cooked and not very tender.  Three of us ordered medium and we had a range of rare to medium well. My daughter ordered the shrimp which were too salty as well.  The chopped salad was also way too salty and overdressed that it was extremely unpleasant to eat.  The sweet potato casserole was delicious and the only highlight of the night. Our server was awkward and we had to keep after her for refills. Overall, we will not be going back after last night's meal!

Beautiful place, well lit during the day, and spacious interior. Large menu like its big brother Cheesecake Factory. Had the lunch sized chicken parmigiana. Very tasty, lightly breaded, came with delicious pasta and ended up taking half of it home. Looking forward to coming back and trying more dishes.
We split a breakfast plate and with the complimentary biscuits where enough to fill us up (2 people). Amazing biscuits!

Had an amazing brunch here with family. Enjoyed the blueberry pancakes, the hungry one combination plate, and the croissant sandwich. Service was friendly and not overbearing. Looking forward to trying dinner!
5 stars for Carmen F.! Would go back just for her service & fun atmosphere! Many TVs throughout for watching sports, etc. Food was alright but nothing to write home about.

recently went there for lunch.  tracked them down to a parking lot in goleta.  ordered the chicken banh-mi sando and a side of fries.  Way too much food for one person.  had to eat it in two meals.  all for $8.  awesome. 

the cha cha sauce is where its at.  I will definitely be back for more!

This place exceeded my expectations by far.  The fact that it's a chain and a sports bar were two mental strikes against it going in.  Add to the fact that I'd been inside that sad hovel of an OTB that formerly occupied the space.  So...the bar was set pretty low.

Inside, the space is clean and bright, with windows facing the street.  The interior is sleek and modern, and of course -- blue.  There are TVs EVERYWHERE.  There really doesn't appear to be a bad seat in the house, including the mens room, where hubby tells me you can watch TV through a 2-way mirror while at the urnials.  Gross, but cool. 

The service was excellent.  Our companion cut her finger on the way over.  The host immediately got her a bandage, and even put it on her!  Our server was attentive, but not hovery. He did my favorite thing -- waited until we had our food, had time to take a bite or two, then zoomed over to make sure everything was ok.  I love that!!  He also had them turn down the blasting music at my request.

On to the food.  I have been eating moderately healthy lately.  This KILLED my diet.  Hubby and I started by splitting the wings.  At our server's suggestion, we got the parmesan medium, which he warned was pretty darn hot.  He was right.  The sauce had a good flavor, but would have liked more of it on the wings.  The wings were a 8 out of 10 - meaty, flavorful, not too much fat, but the skin was too mushy.  If they would have fried them longer, they would have been near perfect.  The blue cheese dressing seemed thin, but if you digged, lots of cheese chunks had settled on the bottom.  Our friend got the cheddar bbq burger, which she deemed yummy, and the sweet potato fries sprinkled with cinnamon were very good.

Hubby and I split the burger (I could only eat a quarter of it).  When they brought it out, it was probably 6 inches high and sitting on top of a bowl of well seasoned tater tots.  So what did we get?  A burger with --wait for it -- two grilled cheese sandwiches instead of buns.  And the grilled cheese had bacon...and ranch dressing.  So incredibly unhealthy and absolutely delicious.  My only tip -- snarf it down.  It tastes perfect when it's hot, but as it starts to cool, it gets so heavy from all the cheese and grease.  

Go here...then go take a nap.  Go Colts!!

Saw Zoup when my wife and I were visiting Blue Bell. Great lunch. I had the sirloin chili and half a Tuscan chicken sandwich. Both excellent. My wife had tomato bisque and a turkey club. She loved it. Very fresh. Service is very friendly. I've eaten at the one in Exton and I'm glad to see one up here. Better food than pizza.

OK, its on the beach, had live music, good food, happy service, and its just a fun place.
This review is for the overall experience, not for gourmet food.
It's the overall experience that makes this a great place.
If I was rating food alone, its exactly what you expect, a solid 3 star.
but put 3 star food with 10 star atmosphere and you have a great location.
Great burgers and fried pickles! Love the atmosphere :)

Perfect balance of ambiance and caffeine. 

The intimate sipping area is comfortable, and yet productive. Nice lighting and perfect temperature while surrounded by windows and the typical sights and sounds of the La Marzocco expressing the delicious nectar out of the beans cup by cup. 

The girls behind the counter were upbeat and friendly greeting vehicles at the drive up and counter quickly and professionally. 

Simple menu selection of coffee drinks, tea, sodas and the limited selection of Nam Nams (breakfast burritos, baked goods). 

Wi-Fi is available and they employee Apple Pay as an option as well. 

The location is perfect for northbound traffic on meridian rd, but a little tricky if heading south towards the highway interchange. But it is worth the effort in smiles, value and smiles.

Thanks to other recommendations on Yelp I was able to discover this fantastic little restaurant while traveling in the area.  We followed much of the advice found here and weren't led astray.
We started with Oysters on the half shell from the Gulf, oil free, and Lobster Escargot.  Followed by Lobster bisque for her and Seafood Gumbo with rum and sherry for me.  Holy smokes this was good.  No doubt I looked odd with my nose buried in my cup smelling my concoction.  Who cares.  It was worth scaring those around me.
Grouper picatta style for main course.  Key Lime pie for dessert.
Yes, it's a lot of food.  It was fantastic.  I have no regrets.

Food is exceptional!  The macaroni and cheese is to die for.  My wife had the Wahoo special over crab risotto and it was melt in your mouth creamy.  I don't even like fish and would order that dish!  Says a lot coming from people that live near Charleston, SC.  Service was excellent also.  Highly recommend you stop in here on your next visit to Mass Ave.

Wow, what a stupid comment from the owner in response to my review.  Please read the idiotic reply if you want to see what kind of person owns this dump.  and I did not go there over and over again.  I went TWO times and that was two times too many.  I will say it again.  The customer service is HORRIBLE and after reading the discourteous owners reply (hint: most owners will say I'm sorry, please try us again) I can see why the rest of the staff is crap.  And apparently others agree.  I can only imagine that any good reviews are  from friends and family.

This place is close to home and after sight seeing in Tombstone all day, I didn't want to drive into the city to eat dinner.  My parents were visiting so we decided to give it a shot.  I felt like the drink menu was a little pricey for the venue and so was the food.  I ordered the chicken sonoma which was a large platter of chicken covered in a wine sauce.  It was so heavily covered that I didn't notice it that it was breaded until halfway through eating it.  Since I don't eat gluten, I was kind of pissed that the menu didn't list it as being breaded.  The rest of my family really enjoyed their meals so I'm still giving this place 3 stars.  Our waitress was fast and nice.  Plus they offer 50% to military on Mondays.
4 words. Cookie dough French toast. That's all you need to know about how amazing this place is.

Well Hilton Honors has done it again..... once again I was the Honors Member of the day...... was given an upgraded room with an balcony, super early check in and late checkout. The place was clean and service was great as always. Enjoyed and took advantage of the two hour happy with free drinks, it set the tone for the rest of the evening. The $42 per night valet was a bit much but oh well. The morning breakfast with made to order omelettes, fresha bacon, sausage and breakfast potatoes is always a staple when staying at an Embassy Suites, not matter the city.

High end quality dining, food, and atmosphere. Seasonal menu and local options. The nitrogen popcorn comes in a multitude of flavors, I have been 3 times and I've had 3 different flavors so the variety is nice. The only place in Greenwood like this. Come in on a Saturday and walk the weekly hot rod show across the street!

I was getting my haircut in the same plaza and noticed this little gem on the way out and thought that it would be a great time for a slice! I can't say enough about this place. The choices were more than ample, the dough was to die for(maybe best I've ever had) and it was priced just right($2.50 a slice). We had a slice of the peperoni, the white pizza, and the eggplant parmigiana. This place knows how to make a good pie. The locals seemed to know this also on the Saturday afternoon that we dropped in because the place appeared to do a pretty good business. If you get to this neck of the woods, give it a try. I'll bet you come back!

Took the Living Social coupon --- and boy was this worth it.  Our first time going into the shop - so the coupon worked for them.  

So many yummy things to buy.  We got some Valentine's Day cupcakes, some bagels (yes, bagels), some sort of iced bun, and an amazing flat pastry.  It seemed to be butter and cream.  Really good.  

They had a good assortment cakes, cookies, and all sorts of pastries all made in the shop.

We will visit again once we work off these calories.
Food was great. The service was kinda slow but I marked it up as it hasn't been open long and Covid... blame everything on Covid, right.

Been to the CBD location twice already . The inside of the restaurant is very welcoming . Wait staff very attentive.  Had a slight glitch with my order, however. Wait staff did keep me informed of the status of my order so that is a plus. . Husband had Catfish platter.  That was one of the best he has had.  When I received my Po Boy, I do have to say, it truly was worth the wait. . I received a side order of macaroni and cheese and that was really tasty as well.  
A few days later, we went there for breakfast.  Oh my gosh !  My BLT with an egg and breakfast potatoes were just divine ! Husband had a crawfish , shrimp omelette.  
So good .   Can't wait to go there again . !

The food was in the top five barbecue places I've ever eaten that we ate with a Ton of people so virtually every side was ordered the best was sweet potato casserole and the only thing people didn't like was the fried pickles. That's it. 15 people ate and the food was perfect. 

When I get back , it won't be anywhere near dinner time because the line was too long. We were 30 feet from the door on a Saturday night and it took 45 minutes to eat, perfect food but that's awhile for kids to wait
4 stars is for their flavorful (sazon) food and if they had hard shell tacos then I'd give them 5 stars!

Great lunch location for Vegan and Non-Vegan friends. 
Enjoyed a Mary Alice Sprout Taco and a Salmon Gyro. Both were amazing! 

A pot of tea and a hummus app really set the meal off right. 

Our server was overwhelmed - but swung by as needed. 

I would definitely go back and bring friends!

I went there on a friday night with my girlfriend for dinner date and also our first at joeys tbh and of course when it started to snow yes we all remembered that day. Anyways it was a good atmosphere when i came in they sat us in a booth the lounge near the window but facing he bar. We both order a bottle of wine to start then we proceeded to entrees and i ordered the steak with peppercorn sauce on the side then my server suggested for the to try out the baked potato that look like spring roll looky like at first i was like really so what the heck id try anyway and man did i ever not regret that cause it was good. My girlfriend ordered pasta and she loved her food as well. Our server did a phenomenal job that night. Thank you for the wonderful experience we will definitely be coming back here again.

This Perkins is in a shopping center on the north side of Route 38, although they have their own parking area. I can't speak for their lunch and dinner selections because I usually have breakfast at Perkins, even at dinnertime! That said, I thought the southern fried chicken biscuit platter was pretty good and the portion size was big enough for dinner. Service was pretty good on my visit but then again, the restaurant was not crowded at the time so your mileage may vary.

First time visitor. I will likely return, and may visit one of their other 8 locations. The food was great and arrived quickly. Barbacoa is in a spicy red sauce, chicken tinga is mild and flavorful, chorizo is mildly spiced and looks to be made in-house. Prices are very reasonable for the Main Line - $3 per taco, $8 for burritos, $10 for fajitas, etc.

My only real complaint was that the waitstaff seemed unable (or unwilling) to communicate with each other. Also they make a big deal in their ads about margaritas, but not a whisper was mentioned during my visit?

I have been going to Houlihan's at this location for many years.  Lately the service has just been lackluster.  The hostess on the last 2 occasions has been non attentive and borderline rude.  It has taken over 30 minutes each of the last 2 times to get our food.  When it finally came out, my daughter's chicken fingers were burnt.  Our server never seemed to be around for refills, to check on us or to get the check.  Probably won't be going back any time soon.  Such a shame for a long standing restaurant.

Awesome food and service! TONS of choices of food at the buffet! Home style cooking at its best! Anything you could possibly want, it's here! The cornbread is to die for! Will return next time I come back to Florida!

We made a special trip to Baguette after reading a few reviews in Boise Weekly. We won't be making a special trip to go back. The bread they use is wonderful. I would go there just to buy bread... (do they sell it?) It's a sub shop with a twist. I ordered the rotisserie chicken and my husband ordered the beef. I inquired if the chicken was breast meat (I don't like dark meat) They chatted and told me yes it was all white meat. I get the sandwich and honestly thought it was wrong. A foot long sandwich with Fresh cucumber,cilantro, too much jalepeno and where is the chicken? The mystery dry, brown, beyond shredded, minute amount of ???? Stopped me from my first bite. She saw the shock on my face and told me to try it and if I did not like it she would get me something else. I was nice and ate half and ended up throwing other half away. :( My other choices would have been turkey/pesto or the cajun shrimp. My husband thought his beef sandwich was ok. We both agreed that there was too much bread and light on ingredients on the inside. We also tried shrimp spring rolls. I was uneasy ordering because they were premade , wrapped and no refrigeration.... Just sitting on front counter. There was also mystery meat in shrimp spring roll.  Ordered beignets, they were cold amd premade. Would be better if made per order and hot. We might try again but is no longer on list of must try or lets go across town because it's so darn good.

Disclaimer: There's nothing nutritious about this review. So if you're trying to live until 90 or have low sodium/cholesterol, keep scrolling. 

I've tried my fair share of the menu. Here's what you need to get. Pepperoni breadsticks. Get a side of Ranch. They have the best Ranch ever. You're going to be tempted by the monthly special breadsticks. But trust me, stick with the classic. If your table needs an app, the cheese curds are delightful. And to drink? Any of the Long Island pitchers, although I'm partial to the TieDye and water Long Island (extra fruit). 

Great place to watch games, get a buzz, and eat some greasy food. Highly recommend.

Excellent! Very flavorful food. We got the taco sampler, buffalo greens and beans and the grasshopper cake. Impressed by all of it. The staff was very friendly and helpful and the service was fast. Will come here every time we visit Nashville.
Great service.    Knowledgable and attentive.  Fun menu for either a full scale meal or sharing with others.  Great beer selection as well.
Amazing coffee, and sweetest baristas. The outdoor seating area is very busy, but worth the wait.

Amazing!!

I love the sandwiches here, extremely fresh. My personal favorite is "The Corey" which has breaded chicken cutlets, arugula, fresh mozzarella, bruschetta and balsamic vinegar. Yum! I've had "The Sinatra" as well and liked it too. 

There are always a million things I want to try every time I order. Very busy always, and great customer service.
Staff is very nice but the rooms are filthy! Killed two cockroaches! They immediately moved me to another room only to find 3 dead beetles!  Aghhh never again.

I used to eat here on a regular basis. However, in the last several years the quality of the food has gone down considerably. Today I decided to try one more time. I ordered a cheese crisp and it was totally burned and they served it anyway. Will not go there again.

Really great spot.  Grabbed dinner for me and husband.  Ordered many different things and enjoyed it all.  Egg rolls are outstanding.  Location is in a Asian grocery.  Once inside, the entrance to the restaurant is between two freezers.

Best sushi in town, we had the spider roll, west pine roll (unlike any roll I've had, nice grilled flavor on the salmon, and the sunshine roll (the shrimp was slightly buttery tasting and warm).  The green tea tempura ice was also the best I've ever had salty, sweet, matcha combo.

great addition to downtown Santa Barbara's restaurant scene! a creative menu with many options that could be considered Asian, Indian, Mexican, fusion - something for everyone! Also great vegetarian and vegan options. Every entree and appetizer was very thoughtfully created and their presentation is on point, making sure that every dish that goes out of the kitchen looks amazing (very photogenic food - just wait until you see your friends posting about it!). I don't eat meat so the tofu banh mi and roasted squash/kale tacos are my go-to, but all the ones my friends got with meat looked awesome - big portions of the meat with tasty fresh veggies and homemade sauces. Great ambiance to sit and have a beer with friends or chow down with the family - even a few outside tables for those sunny Santa Barbara evenings. Fair pricing for the quality of the food served and the servings are hearty! Heard they will be open late so this will be the new go-to for a late night snack after hitting downtown with your friends.

Kingfisher is a Tucson classic and one of my personal faves. It's a place where more often than not, you will run into people you know, it's a place where the service is personalized because over the years I think all of us have gotten to know the great staff (more specifically the team that serves in the bar area), and it's definitely the best place in Tucson for delicious mussels, oysters, jazz and late night snacks. 

Although you can aways rely on the fact that your favorite dish will probably never be taken off the menu, you can also rely on the fact that Kingfisher keeps things fresh by offering special menus, like their Summer tour menu that highlights awesome dishes from across the United States, and it's not all seafood!

As long as they keep the chilled grilled shrimp, the fish and chips and the grilled cheese on the menu, I'm happy as clam.

Went with a friend who had been previously and invited me to come and check it out.

The restaurant is very nice! Parking  right out front and  in a newly remodeled  stand alone building.

I am not a vegan. To be honest , I was a little skeptical because the last time I went to a Vegan restaurant, the food tasted like disappointment and sadness! 

Fortunately not the case here!!!  Yassss! 
They have a written chalkboard menu with a variety of options. There were so many options I wasn't sure what to get so I let my partner choose since he had been previously! 

For starters  we had Brussel Sprouts which were incredible! They were cooked to perfection and seasoned well with what  I think  was balsamic dressing. We also had French fires which were awesome! They were  cooked well and had some type of breading maybe? Delicious!!

We both had the Veggie Lasagna witjh garlic bread and a side salad which was all very tasty!!! I also had a Strawberry Lemonade to drink! 

Thank you 10th Diner! I ate all of my veggies! 
I will be back!  menu !
Similar to five guys burgers only that it has more of a selection on their menu. Pretty much like BergerFi and Smashburger. Loved the Philly Burger

I love the Cheesecake Factory,  specifically because of the different flavors of cheesecake.   It's a great place to go have a meal with a group of friends.  I can't think of any other place that serves pumpernickel bread.   The portion sizes are humongous.   However,  there is a skinnylicious menu for those who want portion control.  My only complaint is that the menu is too extensive.   I know that sounds crazy but you could get a headache trying to figure out what to order.
Great good! Loved the dip and gumbo. Chargrilled Oysters were as good as acme! Saved us a crowded trip and fighting the lines in the French quarter.

This is the best pizza I've ever had. I got the Big Ang. The sauce, crust, and overall flavor was out of this world. The pecorino-Romano sprinkled on top added a delicious note to each and every bite. Thanks Angelo.

I really enjoyed my lunch here. The cheese and basil thin-crust pizza was superb as was the vegetable salad with a nice mix of chopped veggies. Order at the counter, get your drinks, take a comfortable seat, and relax until they bring you your delicious meal.

This was our second visit to 3 Sisters' Cafe, and both visits were lovely! The staff is friendly and helpful, the atmosphere is laid-back but nice, and the food is unique and delicious! Honestly, I'm not sure why we don't visit more often!

I got the black bean burger with (cooked) kale as a side. I was nervous about the kale, but I had no reason to be. It was absolutely mouthwatering. I couldn't hardly believe how good it was. My black bean burger was also phenomenal. It was probably the best I've ever had. I dumped house-made salsa and guacamole on top, and my taste buds were doing summersaults with every bite. I always have to put cheese on my burgers, but I didn't even realize this one came without cheese until just now. That's how good it was. My gf got Sara Jo's Grilled Cheese which was also very tasty. Her potato salad was a treat as well. I was really hoping she would leave some behind for me to finish, but no luck.

I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for good, casual dining in the area.
All you can eat is great, value for money! Ambience and food taste is very good! One of my favorite places for sushi!

The spinning out had been beckoning me from my hotel room window for 3 days before I finally made the trip over. I bought a huge family platter and it was all just okay. I was so disappointed because everything seemed like it was going to be amazing. Maybe it was just an off day but some locals told me that this is pretty much hoe this one is. Presentation was great but taste was just okay. Also the place us incredibly noisy (far greater than the typical noisy spot). No big deal, just warning you if that bothers you.

Ambience is great.
The location is super cute.
Decor on point 
Food is OK but, tbh, not really worth the price. 
I will say though that they apparently try to source their food sustainably and locally so I guess that's where the $$ goes. 

I got the banh mi ($8.5) and the poutine fries ($5).

The banh mi was very underwhelming. 
While they didn't skimp out on the meat, which was much appreciated, the flavor wasn't really there.
The pork was kind ok but the veggies and spread were what made it really disappointing. 
Banh Mi is supposed to have picked veggies that give it a nice tang, but I couldn't even tell if these veggies were picked or not since they were very bland and had no flavor.
Also couldn't even taste the spread?? 
Bread was nice and soft though.

The poutine fries were better. Nothing to write home about but more worth the money. 

All in all, would I got back? 
Maybe if someone else was paying.

Also to be fair to this restaurant, the person who says they got queasy a couple of hours after they had HiWi: you probably didn't actually get food poisoning. It *usually* takes at least 1-2 days for symptoms to show.

The vegan toast comes with none of the items in the description or the picture. No veggies, no nutritional yeast, nothing. I literally just paid $9 for bread and butter. Jokes on me I guess but I don't appreciate the false advertising.

This place has such a great selection of beers. You want it they got it. The bartender was super helpful and thanks to him I found just the beer I wanted. It was a peanut butter chocolate stout and it was AMAZING!!!

Absolutely amazing Italian fine dining experience, from the service to the atmosphere to the food! So many complimentary snacks throughout, and extremely accommodating to your dietary needs.

Atmosphere: Quite cozy and small space. The largest table, which we sat at, can accommodate 5. Make sure to book early! The lighting was nicely dim, and all the dining ware looked so visually aesthetic - generally a modern feel, in a traditional-feeling space. They don't rush you at all, even though our entire dinner probably took ~3 hours in total.

Service: All the wait staff treat you like royalty, and are incredibly polite. I had been going for lower-carb options, and they tailored each course to my diet - for example, as our first snack, they offered me almond wheat crackers over bread, and would generally substitute fish instead of their heavier pasta options. So considerate!

Food notes: I won't detail every course we ate (included in images), but instead just give some tips/highlights. As a recommendation, try the bread, but do not eat too much of it, or pack it back home! I was staying away from bread, and felt like I could enjoy every course without feeling too full. I had went with my boyfriend's family, and, with eating the bread in between courses (3 sets of bread in total) they all felt too stuffed at the end. With the tasting menu, they give a good variety of dishes to our table of 5, which is incredible if you enjoy sharing / trying a bit of each dish. As their "complimentary" dishes, they brought out an alcoholic, fruity seltzer to start, a plate of snacks (including foie gras, duck breast, and brussel sprouts), and included a grapefruit sorbet as a palate cleanser right before dessert. Overall, each dish was wonderfully and delicately prepared - the only slight complaint was that the veal genovese ravioli tasted a tad too salty for my liking. Otherwise, you get a variety of tastes, and not any dish felt too heavy.

Slight aside: They also provided a sampling of raw vegetables (e.g., fennel, peppers, cauliflower) as a "complimentary" dish. This was paired with a small plate of a balsamic vinegar and dijon blend. You can see in the pictures, but this came out as a black, swirly, relatively thick paste. The shape made me giggle.

Recommended must-try: Some of my personal favorites were the sweet onion crepe (literally tasted like you were biting into a bowl of french onion soup; so creamy), the squab, and the almond flan (surprising, because I'm usually such a sucker for chocolate). 

Overall: 5  / 5, I would love to come back for another meal, at a different time of year! There was a surprising amount of variety across each course. Personally, I preferred the antipasti over the actual entrees (the bollito misto / bowl of pho-tasting meat was a cool concept, but tasted a bit on the blander side). 5 stars for such an incredible experience though, when you consider the food in combination with the atmosphere and service. They really make you feel like royalty! A truly special experience in Philly, and would recommend for a fine dining meal!

After a long-awaited reservation (4 months out!) four of us headed to Hearthside with wine in our hands and excitement in our hearts. 

The atmosphere of the restaurant is stunning. It's inviting, cozy, and chic. The open-air windows/doors were fabulous, as we were lucky enough to visit on an unseasonably warm spring day. Warm breezes and fun music enveloped us like a giant hug. 

The menu consists of small, medium, and large plates. In order for the kitchen to pace and pair your selections appropriately, you are encouraged to place your entire order at the onset (minus dessert). The pacing, the presentation, the portions, and the flavors of our dishes were impeccable. I am unable to rank our favorite items, as we genuinely loved everything equally. If I had to choose one dish that stood out slightly above the others, then it would be those sensational PEI Mussels (coconut curry, scallions, and lemongrass focaccia for dipping). If I could have ordered vats of that broth to go, then I would be drinking it daily at home. 

Service was attentive, knowledgable, and friendly. They would check-in periodically without conveying an impression that you're being rushed. Water glasses were topped off regularly and our server ensured our wine glasses were full.

Our experience at Hearthside makes me reconsider every other 5 star rating I've ever given to a restaurant on Yelp. This, my friends, was sheer perfection. Five stars are simply not enough!

Good food. Good service.

SMALLL portions, OVERLY priced!

This restaurant sets itself up to be amazing. It has built in ambiance and I think they hang their hat on that and don't worry about much else. I will say that the first time I came here, I absolutely loved it. The food, the service, the atmosphere was perfect. So when my family and I decided to return for a birthday, we were all looking forward to it. We left a disappointed and settled on the fact that we wouldn't be returning any time soon. 

It started out poorly with a waiter who didn't even attempt friendliness and approached without so much as an introduction. It took about 20 minutes to even get offered a drink, let alone get them on the table. There were more slip ups by this guy (bringing the wrong beer to the table, saying it was "on him" and then charging us for it anyway) but I will move on... 

The menu is not much to talk about. Its quite limited and definitely not what is listed on their website. They now have a reasonably priced 4-course prix fixe however everyone at the table must agree to do that or a la carte, they cannot do both at the same table. This must have something to do with timing but I think in a fine dining establishment they should be able to accommodate all diners in whatever they choose. 

Our food was good, nothing knock-your-socks-off great though. I chose the one salad they had on the menu to start and duck for dinner. The duck was good and beautifully cooked but it fell in the too-sweet trap that duck often does. I understand the pairing of sweet with duck but this was just too much. 

Other good choices at the table - crab cake appetizer - 3 nicely sized crab cakes of pure crab, grilled branzino and the side order of sauteed spinach. 

Desserts were yummy and maybe the best part - beignets (our tables favorite), their take on s'mores and the house made gelato. 

All told, there are SO many other better restaurants in town - for both food and service that we won't be visiting Water Works again anytime soon. I know people who haven't been will probably want to go to check it out - maybe try it for brunch so you can see the view in the daylight and not spend as much!
Amazing raspberry glazed vegan donut, all the donuts have been wonderful.  My kids loved the Oreo, sprinkle, Nutella flavors.  Highly recommend if you are in the neighborhood!

Stay away from here.  First, when we got there, they wouldn't let us come in without a mask.  Mask requirements were just put in effect by the city the day before, and we only had two masks for the three of us in our party.  Instead of providing one to us, they "graciously" sold one to us.  Once I put the mask on, we walked literally 10 steps to our table at which point we were allowed to take off our masks!   And the place was almost empty!  The few people that we did pass by weren't wearing masks because they were already at their table.  How ridiculous! After being completely annoyed by the mask fiasco, the chef made the food so salty, none of us could finish it.  Do yourself a favor and pick another place to eat.

Some of the best Vietnamese food I have ever had.  Everything was amazing from the appetizer, to the beer, and pho.   I really think you can judge how good the Vietnamese restaurant is by the quality of their pho; and theirs was outstanding.  And the amount served is unbelievable.  I have a hefty appetite but was unable to finish everything.  My wife and I shared a dinner, and an appetizer, each had our own bowl of pho and two beers a piece and walked out under $50.  They have fresh lobsters in the tank and lobster specials.  I will definitely have to try one on my next visit.

NOT IMPRESSED. It took 15 minutes to be seated (even though there were many open tables), 15 minutes for someone to ask for our drink order, and when the drinks finally came out 10 minutes later and we were able to order, it took our food FORTY-FIVE minutes to come out. Keep in mind, this place wasn't packed or extremely busy. Not only was the server not attentive throughout our entire visit, after the wait our order came out WRONG. Not happy, and no longer a customer there.

Would make this 4.5 if we could! Overall, cool spot in the CBD. Very seafood heavy menu (as the name of the restaurant implies). Mostly small plates, good wine list and cocktails and great service. We shared about 7 dishes for a group of 4. All of the fish large plates were delicious. Peel and eat shrimp appetizer and the ceviche were both excellent - would order again. Will go back again!

Absolutely disgusting!!! The beans are CANNED!!!!!.....CANNED BEANS!!!! There is nothing authentic about this place at all. This location was filthy inside and the help was slow. Bypass this crap and head straight to Dell Taco.

Authentic my ass........

I understand Wednesday's may be a little hectic & I tried to take that into consideration HOWEVER you still have a job to do! I had a horrible experience from start to finish. The cashier that greeted us was short & rude. I stood by a table for about 15mins waiting for it be cleared so that I could seat myself & my Godson. We waited an additional 5mins or so for it to be wiped down. That's 20mins wasted when there were ppl that appeared to be servers traipsing around the floor on cell phones. Our waitress was very nice but that's the only positive for this review. The bartender (older white male) was unbearably RUDE!The food was NOT good & had I gotten adult entrees I would've asked for a refund. There were numerous games that were out of service & even more that weren't marked& took your credits without letting you play. Very disappointing.

Delicious! I've loved everything I've tried. Vegan, vegetarian and gluten free friendly. The staff is really nice, they even gave us a free appetizer the first times we dined in. Lots of options to please anyone with tastebuds. I'm a huge fan of the vegetable korma, raita, and chutney and their roti and naan are fantastic. I always ask for them to make my entrees spicier and they do a great job. Even when I leave the Plainfield area I know I'll be going out of my way to come back and eat there, it's just that good.
Definitely liked the chicken and waffles and the mac and cheese was some of the best I have had but overall the menu was unimpressive and it has lost the trendy-ness it had when it first opened.

So been here four or five times since my first trip with above average results. I have had amazing marrow, mussels, charcuterie, burger, rib eye and a few other. I have however had some below average dishes. The French onion taste like they use can over salted beef broth and the daily chicken dish is hit or miss. The beer is still always good and service vacillates between average and below average. 

My biggest complaint with the service is that they don't try to make anything better. Had a party of 8 with a $200 plus tab and ended up with a cold chicken. Asked for something to be done and they reheated it which made it warm but left it overly dry. I ended up eating less then half the dish. One quick apology from a less then attentive server and that is all I got. They didn't comp the dish or even a $4 dollar beer. Don't expect anything but a better effort would have been nice.

So, I walked into Kyoto and ordered an order of California rolls and a miso soup to go. When the hostess passed on my order to the sushi chef in the back he came out looking annoyed. When I got my rolls, I opened the box and found that they were all deformed. But, the miso soup was nice. I won't return unless i'm invited by a friend.

Love it! My 1st trip to NOLA n i found this place by accident. Tons of shrimp in their po'boys, tons of wings for a great price. The place doesn't look grea but i kind of like the feel to it, real not tourist-based. Been here for a week and i hadta go back again before i left. Only reason it didn't get 5 stars was cuz the lady taking my order was on her cell phone the entire time. Rude service but can't let one bad employee ruin the experience.

Editor's note: I am basing this review only on the Chinese food.  The Japanese unfortunately leaves much to be desired (lord knows I've certainly given it enough chances).

As far as fast food Chinese goes, Chow's is on top of their game.  I get lunch here often (shrimp and broccoli with white rice is around $6 and if you are REALLY poor, a whole quart of wonton soup is $2.50).  My boyfriend says none of the Chinese in Philly comes close, so we are constantly hitting them up for take-out when he's on my side of the bridge.

The best thing about Chow's is their Amazing Chicken.  It's basically General Tso's, but with all white meat.  Freaking awesome.

First off, the smell of this place is unreal. It smells AMAZING. Everything, and I mean everything, was insanely delicious. The quinoa with mango in the sweet heat Havana bowl was mind blowing. Do yourself a favor and try this spot!! The customer service was great as well:)! They definitely know what they're doing.

Some of the best chips and queso I've had in the city - lots of jalapeno, so it's hot after a while. I love the simplicity of the fried chicken taco, with plenty of fresh lettuce and tomato plus a nice lime sauce (lime always gets my vote!). The spicy bean taco is messy but very good. I really should branch out to other taco options, but I'm stuck on those two for favorites. I usually come here during my work lunch hour, so I haven't tried the frozen drinks, sadly. Service is always friendly, haven't had a bad experience here yet.

Got a croissant breakfast sandwich and a classic turkey. I was pretty excited to try their mexican cheesecake and some how they forgot to charge me but since i didnt get a reciept i didn't know it until i got back to the hotel and no cheesecake. Bummer. The breakfast sammie qas good but qish they put salsa in the bag to add to it. They never even asked and with covid we had to wait outside so i was never asked or offer. All in all, just OK.
One of the better places for Thai in Stl! Pad Thai is delicious and their tea is damn good. I've tried the duck noodle soup as well, just be prepared to share it!

Food was terrible. Fruit was warm. Mimosa was straight orange juice. The brunch was something i could only laugh at. Not sure if i would feed that to my dog. Crab legs smelled like they were bad. This was suppose to be mother's day brunch. They charged us 360 dollars for 6 people. What a rip off. I don't usually complain but this place pissed me off. Never go here.

I love this unique place.  The food is absolutely delicious and the cocktails I have reason to believe are made with legitimate "love". The staff is always hospitable and knowledgeable. I love this unique ambience and that it gives you a reason to dress up. A recommendation would be asking for a private booth so that you can get a real Speakeasy experience.

Good food in Philly. Make all their own bread and rolls every day. That results in awesome sandwiches. Today we both had Totally Tuna, had cucumbers, tomatoes, lettuce & avocado. It was an early appointment so by 10 am we were state restaurant and had ordered our Jimmy John's!

We were not disappointed. Very good. Made with perfection. Neat and the perfect amount of meat and toppings

Always service with a smile and quick.

good location, good- authentic indian food.  they even have a good selection of south indian food, yay! love their masala dosa- if you like spicey, try their mysore masala, chicken 69, and malabar goat curry.

They seem to always be out of tenders and any mild chicken, but can't be bothered to put up a sign or anything to let you know that, so you just sit there for a long time for nothing just to be told when you try to order. 
I don't know what they do in between orders, but they seem to take forever to take another order after the vehicle at the window has already left, leaving you to sit there and wait even longer for them just to answer to take your order.

None of the waitstaff wore masks. The food was mediocre. In fact, my "home cut fries" for which I paid extra, were cold. Don't go unless you are a rabid Trumpanzee, because the decor is all Trump flags & Fox News.

TIP: If you want to try their baked goods/pastries this week, get here when they open at 8 am!! We arrived at 8:45 am, and after waiting in a looong line for 30-40 min, everything had sold out except three different baked goods (chocolate chip tehina cookies, walnut cake, and Swiss chard boreka) :'( Hopefully as the weeks go on their pastries will be available even later in the day!

K'Far officially opened today (7/31/19) right behind Target, just a couple blocks from Rittenhouse square. They are operating as an all-day cafe from 8 am-2 pm for now, and carry Israeli baked treats in a serene and relaxing ambience with the warmest/nicest staff ever.

We tried the Tehina cookie, Swiss chard boreka, salt-roasted beets Kubaneh toast, and Yemenite latte. I LOVED the salt-roasted beets Kubaneh toast. It tasted like the incredible Salatim beets dish at Zahav, but on top of warm Kubaneh bread -- HIGHLY recommend!! The Swiss chard boreka was delicious too, it was savory/oniony and reminded me of a spinach croissant. The Yemenite latte is a must try. It had a strong cardamom aroma and very unique spicy flavor (but reaaally good). The chocolate chip cookie was on the dry/crispier side with a subtle Tehina flavor.

The back area of K'Far also has an open kitchen where you can watch the chefs cook behind a glass wall. I got to watch the incredibly talented chefs, including Executive Chef Camille Cogswell work her magic! This place is so beautiful and already one of my favorite cafes in Philly. I can't wait to be back to try more! :-)

Update 8/3/19: Came back to try a few more menu items! This time we came at exactly 8 am and still had to wait 30 min to order (!!) but there were many pastries left. The potato boreka filling tastes like curry-flavored mashed potato and is delicious!! The boreka complet ($6) comes in a platter with a side of tehina (omg so good), and the schug was very hot/spicy. The jam & sweet cheese boreka had apricot jam, was pretty sweet, and would be a nice dessert. The chocolate pastries are light and not overly sweet, kind of like in Asian-style pastries.
The food here is dreadful...  Ordered the CHICKEN Noodle soup- not a piece of chicken to be found anywhere in the cup. Tasted like the same soup the serve at Subway

If you're familiar with most of the boba spots/ shops around Tucson, I think you will find this one to be a pleasant surprise. 

First off, it has giant pictures of some of their drinks, labeled in both English and Chinese. To me, that's a good sign, and makes visualizing the more exotic flavors easier when ordering.

Secondly, their milk tea actually taste like tea, and is made with real brewed tea, rather than that weird powder everyone else uses. It actually taste the closest to what I've had in Asia, and is probably one of the better ones I've had in the US. I've only tried their regular milk tea with boba so I can't comment on the other flavors. Some of the flavors are definitely intriguing. 

Thirdly, you can customize how much sugar you want in your drink. That's a first for me. I had regular sugar with my drink, and it doesn't taste overly sweet like most places.

Lastly, It's a nice large space with plenty of seating, and SURPRISE, free wifi. The tables are large, and I see several university students holding study sessions here at night. Although I can see how the constant shaking drinks with ice, and blenders going off can be distracting for someone trying to focus. 

You may not find the shop the first time because the sign of the shops name is tiny, to the point that it's almost nonexistent. It's right next door to China Szechuan, if that helps.

There are two types of reviews I look forward to - the "I'm going to kill this restaurant once I get back on yelp because this place sucked" kind of review (I'm not good at naming things), and the "5-star oh my lord this was terrific" review.  This is the latter.

Castile is a nice restaurant situated in the Hotel Zamora on St. Pete Beach, maybe 1/4 mile north from the Don Cesar.  It is a boutique hotel with a rooftop bar and this restaurant.  Our plan was to watch the sunset from their rooftop bar, but it was closed at this hour on Sunday (8:15).  No matter, we sat on the patio overlooking the pool area and enjoyed the outdoors.  Granted, it was a hot and humid Florida summer evening, but at least that means my girlfriend gets to enjoy me sweating the whole time, and we all know how appetizing that can be.  Okay, moving on...It is a very nice restaurant from the ambiance perspective.  Can be romantic, minus the sweat factor, and would be good for a group as well.  On the fancier side, but this is Florida at the beach, so fancy equals khaki shorts instead of cargo shorts and only your Sunday best sandals, too. 

If there was anything bad, besides my girlfriend having to deal with my sweat, and her entree not being as tasty as mine, it would be our service.  I can't take off a star for it because the food for me was that good, but it probably deserves 1/2 to a full star less.  We were sat, and waited 5-10 minutes to be greeted.  Once greeted and told about the menu, the server offered to give us a few minutes, but instead gave us 10+.  We ordered from the restaurant week menu and my girlfriend ordered a glass of wine with dinner.  Appetizers came out 5-10 minutes later, but still no wine at that point.  Finally, we were halfway through our meal when the server asked us if we were brought any bread.  All in all, he seemed incredibly disinterested in our table.  He was knowledgeable about the menu, but not attentive.

Onto the food.  We both loved the tuna poke appetizer.  It was raw, above sushi-grade tuna served mixed with some minced pickled veggies, like a salsa.  A bit spicy, but far from overwhelming.  You could have served this in a bowl and i would have eaten it.  In fact, you could have served this in a doggie bowl, and I would have gotten down on all fours and devoured it face first.  Probably a good thing it was served on the table on a plate.

My next course was the roast chicken, which was served over a vegetable ratatouille and a green peppercorn jus. Mouthwatering is the only way to describe it.  That, and too small.  Seriously, next time, bring me the entire chicken drowning in that sauce.  Better yet, drown me in that sauce.  Gluttony aside, it was a fine size portion and filling, especially with the appetizer and too-late bread I was using to soak up the extra sauce.

Final course was dessert.  Chocolate lava cake.  Admittedly, not the best chocolate lava cake I have ever had, but it was still very good and frankly, nothing was going to bring this meal down, and certainly not molten chocolate goodness.

My wife and I went to the Stillery based on Yelp reviews during a visit to Nashville. Admittedly, my wife was tired and I may have tried to convince her to get dinner with me. We aren't familiar with Nashville and weren't aware that the Stillery is near Vanderbilt and maybe some other colleges.
