We learned that from the pounding music at nearby bars and the proliferation of young students. But we're not old people, so we decided to try it out.

The Mac-and-cheese with Nashville hot chicken that was so vaunted on Yelp was drier than a zombie's heart. Obviously enough, we didn't eat the same thing as the reviewers that claimed it was rich and creamy. The cocktails my wife and I got--Blackberry Lime & Southern Peach--might as well have been juice. Very little alcohol present, I think, if at all.

Perhaps aspects of this were me and my wife's fault for expecting a better dinner at a restaurant near a college area / filled with students. But for the most part, the Stillery was a disappointment.

Everyone always talks about the tofu bahn mis and I have to say that I once was similarly in love with the famous tofugies.  But recently my neighbor suggested I try the chicken bahn mi and it was FANTASTIC.  The chicken is shredded and in a flavorful sauce and it's probably one of my favorite sandwiches of all time.  Perfect spice and sweetness, with crunch and I love how the chicken is shredded.  Honestly, give this a try, you will not be disappointed!!  I am officially a convert.

Our waitress was rude , our food was cold, oysters and mussels were grainy , no flavor , veggie of the day looked like gerber baby food. Best thing we got was the free onion rings , but the sauce that came with it was disgusting too. We will not be back.

This used to by my all time favourite cafe in Edmonton. I came here at least once a week even though i don't live nearby. Sadly it seems to have lost some of it's charm within the last year. The coffee isn't as good and there isn't the same selection or quality of food as before. It used to feel like the Wild Earth had something really special, but unfortunately has become just rather standard, which makes me sad because I really loved this place. I still visit but not with the same frequency.

This place popped up near me and I simply could not resist checking it out despite never hearing any raving reviews.

I can see why it is getting middle of the road reviews, because some things they do well, some things are eh.

First pros: We had wonderful service! She was friendly and informative and joked around with us. She explained the menu well (though I am pretty sure they are expected to) and made it clear she didn't mind at all if we wanted to try a different soda from the one we first picked. They make their own sodas and it was a lot of fun to try a few different flavors, all that we tried were good! Another big thumbs up? Their fries. Delicious. I could have eaten more (not sure my waistline would have agreed). I wanted to try their sweet potato chips but I was craving fries. 

In the middle: My husband got the Italian beef and while he said it was good, he said it was nothing special. They allow for full customization of a burger which is cool if you want your own unique burger or are picky but after taking a look at it, it seemed like it could get pricey quickly if you want a variety of toppings!

Cons: My burger was such a letdown....I got the Tuscan with the beef patty instead of turkey. The fresh basil was tasty but every other flavor was forgettable and the burger was very dried out, noooo! What a way to ruin a burger! They really need to figure this out since burgers are supposed to be their selling point. 

My husband and I agreed that we would probably come again to give it another shot and at least try those sweet potato chips!

We usually go here for breakfast foods, no matter what time of day it is. This place is better than the IHOP, which I never thought I would be saying. Service is always good and friendly, the food is like homemade so it is really comfort food. Their pies are to die for... if nothing else go in for their pies and see for yourself.

We wanted to like this location because we love the ones in Corvallis, Portland and Camas. However, we will not be coming back. The young lady working the counter is apathetic and I am being polite. The food took 25 minutes, no exaggeration, to be ready and when it came out it was cold. Furthermore, one of the dishes had al dente rice and the other had al dente beans. The reason I still gave two stars is my wife's dish, while cold, did have good flavor. Great potential, poor execution. With so many other excellent vegan options in Reno this one is off our list.

Omg, I found this hidden gem parked on corner of Rock Blvd and Glendale in Sparks...I actually have been seeing posts from them on Facebook that others were posting so I decided to like their page! I've seen several different items they've posted in the past couple weeks, and then I saw lettuce wrap tacos!! I was so excited to give them a try so I headed over!

They have a good looking menu and also have samples on the counter outside of the truck of what the item looks like...no tasting! That was alright bcuz when I saw those lettuce tacos I was definitely in! 

I ordered 4 Carne Asada with everything $3 each. They have a fresh I think it's like a butter lettuce of some sort, I forgot to ask but it's definitely Keto tacos if that's what you are into...I'm just into lettuce wraps period, different types. They had the juiciest steak I've had so far (seasoned different from your average taco truck) purple onion ( I really enjoy as it's not a strong onion), cilantro light tomato, and cheese, enough to bring it all to a perfect gift wrapped in lettuce! 

You must give them a try, the service is outstanding, they are very knowledgeable as to what they are serving, and they have table set up outside for you to eat on site. They also have a table with a gal serving fresh Horchata and playing some great music! 

I highly recommend and can't wait for my next visit and they may be tonight (2 nights in a row?) keep in mind the seasonings I think aren't you average street taco, but the ones in tortillas are probably spicier! I will add some pictures with my meal and a menu! Some of it seems expensive but remember you get what you pay for...I'm into supporting our local and I appreciate Valentine for talking to me about the lettuce tacos before and after my visit! Good luck to you on your fantastic taco truck
Loved the atmosphere, and the servers were super friendly.  Just thought the food was overpriced.  It was good, but i've had better for the prices they're charging.

Amazing jazz brunch! The archafalaya eggs were eggs Benedict with lump crab meat over a fried green tomato. I didn't think I liked eggs Benedict, but I'm a believer now!! The Bloody Mary bar was so clever and had a wide variety of pickled items and hot sauces to add in your drink.

Pizza is good, but haven't been wowed by anything else I've had yet. Menu is on the small side as well. 4 stars for being family friendly, good service, and having live music often. I do think that kids menu is overpriced. $10 per child is pushing it. So we get pies when we visit.

Amazing. Amazing. Amazing.

I haven't been to a Texas Roadhouse in atleast 10 years. I noticed how crowded this location get and thought I'd give it a try again. Our server Asher was exceptional. We were immediately greeted and seated in our food was served in a timely manner. To top it off the warm bread with cinnamon butter is absolutely amazing. We will be back soon.

Talk about tequila opportunities this place has so many tequilas to try you might have to be wheeled home!!  I love everything on the menu here plus the fact that the tequila is in an abundance.  I love this place!!

BLESSED to have a Chopt closer to me! I can never make my way to the Brentwood location and a second location is now at the Green Hills Mall.  For a first-timer I went the easy route and orders a salad from the menu and I was very impressed with it and how they prepare each salad to your liking. They also have warm bowls that use rice or quinoa as a base and with over 20 different dressings that will make your dish just right. 

The service was very friendly and helpful. The building is visually pleasing and there are tons of places to sit and when the weather gets better there is some outdoor seating that I want to try out!

The absolute worst food I've had at any Shoneys. When I got here, there was one biscuit and hardly any eggs on the buffet. When I left, the eggs still hadn't been refilled and I had to ask about the biscuits which she said had been sitting in the back. The gravy was watery and I could barely chew through the bacon. The smoothie I ordered was not blended well at all. While the staff was very friendly, the experience was definitely not worth the $12 I paid.

Skip 7th & Grove...sure the grits and collard greens were great but everything else was just meh. This was also the second time I went trying to give them another chance because of all the good reviews. The first time was a disaster for brunch. 

We had the Shrimp & grits, fried chicken and catfish. And the Kool-Aid cocktail you should definitely skip unless you like syrupy sweet drinks.

We stopped here on a Saturday night for ice cream after dinner. I really liked the atmosphere. The ice cream portion sizes were very large and reasonable prices. 

We did not order any food so I can't comment on that.

But base on ice cream and vibe I will come back again and try the food.

I've gotten take out orders from Laziz many times over the years and the food is always fabulous. I normally order the veggie samosas, which are fried hot and fresh with delicious sauce on the side as well as garlic naan and mild butter chicken. 

The naan is excellent and is always full of flavor but also nice and soft. The butter chicken is a very large portion and comes with a side of rice as well. I love the flavor of the butter chicken, theirs is one of the best I've ever had. I can't say much about the service since I have never experienced a sit down meal here but no complaints with the take out so far.

My only complaint is that they close from 2 - 5 daily. I realize it's a cultural thing for them to close for an afternoon break, but the other day at 3:00 I wanted indian food like it was nobody's business and they were closed. womp womp. Just keep that in mind before you go in the middle of the afternoon.

I'd love to come here again and try the buffet and get an idea of the dine in experience here.

This is was a weird one for me. We came to eat here soon after it opened. The menu is limited and there's nothing too special on it. 

The Greek salad was served on plain ol' disappointing iceberg lettuce. The Gyro Sandwich was ok, I've had better. 

We saw two parties of 3 come in, look at the menu and walk out. As we ate our dinner, a woman stood up and showed the chef her Greek Salad and said it was one of the worst she has had and refused to pay for it. 

Don't know if its worth another shot. I'm all about supporting local but, this one may be an exception.

The food was extraordinary.  For a food with such great food, they seemed to be unprepared for food allergies.  When I discussed my allergies with the server, she said I could have steak or chicken and left it at that. I had to ask if I could have the scallops and she said yes.  When one of my friends asked for devilled eggs, they brought me one.  I asked about the source of the mustard in the eggs.  They were unwilling/unable to look at the jar.  With the food we did have, it was great.  My dining companions will probably give it five-stars, but I have to warn people with allergies to be vocal about having the food adapted to suit their needs and be careful, because they don't seem to know about all their ingredients.

Great wine and good bar out of the qtr.  we had an amazing super Tuscan.  The cheese was good with little extras.  The brussel sprouts could have fed a family of 6 on Thanksgiving.  Everything was tasty.  Service was friendly and atmosphere was nice.  Enjoy!

Apparently this place has new owners and they don't know what customer service or flavor is. The food is different now, NO FLAVOR. I don't know if they're dumbing down the food for white people but it lacks flavor and is BLAND. I ordered "Hot and Sour" soup, it was neither hot nor sour, it was BLAND BLAND BLAND. I complained and every time I spoke I got heavy accented jibber and they spoke over me so I couldn't make any points.

Then the manager came over and told me that HOT and sour soup isn't spicy.... ya know, because I'm stupid. I told her I've ordered it before and it was always spicy and why is it called "hot" then, hot isn't because of the temperature, hot sauce isn't temperature "hot", she just kept rudely talking over me and not listening to me THEN BROUGHT OVER A (black) PEPPER SHAKER and told me I need to add black pepper to make my soup spicy, not the chili oil with crushed red peppers and sriracha sauce I was adding, that won't make my soup spicy, but the black pepper will, again... because I'm stupid. At this point all my food was COLD and I boxed it up, she yelled in her language to the rest of her staff that I'm taking the food I don't like home, lol. This little show has been played before I can tell... she's a veteran when it comes to fighting with customers.

The food here now SUCKS so don't come back expecting the same food or nice service.

Love the food,service & the atmosphere.
One of our favorite places to go.
Love their Red Sangria!
Just really good Italian food, a little pricey, but worth it.
The food was very good, but the ambience leaves a lot to be desired.   They need to warm the place up.

Empanada Mama is a gourmet kitchen!!!'
The empanadas, salads, and deserts are all made on the premises.   The dipping sauces that come with each of the meals add something special.  
I've tried empanadas all across the country and these are....by far...the best!!
Bucks County has no other eatery like this.  I just wish there were a chain of these so that we could enjoy them when we are on the road.

Ordered through DoorDash, order came quickly but part of the order was wrong.  No big deal, chicken fingers instead of chicken sandwich, but the chicken fingers were dry and tough, the spinach pie was dry and seems like it was day old, the fries were ok, the only good part was the avacado spring rolls.  Probably should stick to pizza.

First of all, it's an amazing building.  It feels (and smells) like you're in a mountain lodge -- but with the convenience of walking distance to the track! 

Three of us went there after qualification day.  We ended up sitting at the bar because there was a wait for tables (plenty of open tables but must have been understaffed?).  I had the wasabi tuna tacos.  The tuna was very unseasoned, bland.  I asked for salt and the tacos were better with it but it still needed something. 

The real downer was the bartender.  He never gave us the opportunity to order a second beer.  In fact, at one point he actually took away our beer menus to give to someone else.  He didn't say a word or ask if we wanted another. It felt both awkward and rude.

Having said that, we'll give it another try, but the service and food needs to better to make it a regular destination
They didn't have the decency to give me utensils with my cinnamon melt. Service slow for fast food.

Ordered 2 cheese dogs, 1 plain hot dog & fries =$21.16. Waited nearly 8/9 minutes for 3 hot dogs with my 3 children (under age 6).
Brought it home, had 3 plain dogs and disappointed kids. 
There was one other person waiting for their order. 
Paid extra for something not received. If you have time to go here and remove everything from the take out bag and check it, then you're fine, but if you expect to receive what you paid for and be out, then go elsewhere!

So if this is, as other reviewers state, the best sushi restaurant in Santa Barbara, I feel sorry for the locals. Although the sushi was very tasty, the portions were VERY small. Most of the rolls are only 6 pieces and six small pieces at that! The rolls were also very slim and the pieces of fish were small. Service left something to be desired as well. I got the distinct impression from the server that I was a big inconvenience in her day. So if you are really craving sushi in Santa Barbara, I'd recommend the Brazilian place across the street.

The bruschetta type starter they give you free was good so were the crab empinadas.  I ordered the P. Del Choclo, not that impressed, although I admit I'm ignorant to this type of food.  My wife got the steak topped with eggs.. the steak had no flavor, maybe were too use to American steakhouses were they are cooked with seasoning but I tried it and it was very bland.. she added salt to it for flavor.  The wine was good and dessert was OK.  The waiter was nice & attentive and restaurant was quaint but I can't see how it's #1 on trip advisor and given constant 5 stars on here.  Maybe it's like a movie that's extremely hyped up and at the end you're thinking, meh it was just good, not great.  Overall I'd say it's above average & like I said it could be my ignorance of this type of food, but I expected the food to wow me but it fell short.  If you want to try something different I'd say go for it.

I visited Steve's before the macaroni bowls. I got a normal hot dog for the meat and half gorilla, half stormtrooper on top. The woman that was at the register was exceptionally friendly and helpful. I also enjoyed that your first visit earns 3 punches on your punchcard (9 punches yields a free meal).

The Stormtrooper half of my dog was better than the gorilla half-- I just didn't like the cheese of the mac and cheese that much. Maybe if they are doing mac and cheese bowls now, the pasta game has been stepped up. 

The meat of the original hot dog was very bland, it seemed like my hot dog was a little old or overcooked. I would recommend going for a salsicca or more exciting meat than the plain hot dog. 

The soda offerings were impressive and made me very happy!

Please double check your reservations for Valentine's Day. Good thing I double checked to confirm my reservation for Valentine's Day, there was a mixup in the dates and when i received a phone call from this establishment, the date was corrected over the phone to 02/14/2018, 19 days ago, Jan 21, 2018. Something told me to call and confirm my reservations today, low and behold the correction was never made. The manager CARMEN was put in the phone, she was very rude and very inconsiderate of the situation, she told me "well every day is Valentines Day" telling me I can celebrate it another day or  that " They have a 10 pm reservation that's available".There is a reason you only have 10pm reservations open (PEOPLE WHO WANT 10 PM RESERVATIONS BOOK 10pm RESERVATIONS) My lost reservation was at 6:30pm not 10pm. Needless to say I'm left scrambling to find a place to take my Love for dinner on Valentine's Day!


(Not over exaggerating even the slightest bit)

Thanks CARMEN & Capital Grille!

We were in Philly for a wedding in the Old City. My brother lives in Philly, so over the years, I had many Philly cheesesteaks to enjoy. Usually, you can't go wrong with any place in Philly -- even if they are not the cheesesteak kings Pats or Genos. We Googled cheesesteaks in Old City and saw Sonnys. We tried to go to Sonny's, but it wasn't opened yet and since we were starving, we went to Campos, which is located a few doors down. Big mistake. First, we were hoping to get a mouth-watering Philly cheesesteak. You know the kind: sizzling on the grill while sliced and diced by the grillmaster. Not happening. The steak was lumped into the roll with wiz on it and while the steak was somewhat tasty, you had to rip it apart with your teeth. Not what I expected. Not only that, but the personnel were rude. They had a photographer taking photos of their alleged delicious food on tables in the front of the store and made us move. What happened to the old rule of "customer's first?" I guess this is Philly where rudeness rules. Also, the price for one drink, a cheesesteak, Caesar salad w/ chicken and chicken sandwich came to $40. Very disappointing.

We've already been to La Cabana 2x and had take out once. I could go again right now. 
The first time we had dinner we were offered complimentary butternut squash soup, which was fresh and delicious. 
I was planning to bring half my meal of trifungo home, but I just couldn't stop eating. Our take out meal of black bean soup, fajitas mixtas, and Arroz con pollo was enough for yummy left overs. 
I also stopped by for breakfast one morning. The corn pancakes are a great gluten-free alternative, sweet and wonderful, served with whipped cream. 
And there coffee is real, and it's spectacular! 
The best part...we can walk or bike here from home.Yay!
Adored Soubu.  Nothing bad has ever come out of the kitchen and the  service and ambience is excellent.
We went for brunch on a Sunday, and the food was absolutely delicious!  Great, very friendly service with a laid back vibe.  Awesome little place to grab an affordable bite!

We have eaten at this restaurant at least 10 times and have always loved the food and service. However, today we were there for lunch; I had a shrimp salad which had undercooked shrimp(which was sent back) and no dressing. My wife's lentil soup which was ill tasting and also sent back. Has the chef been sent up to the new place in Oro Valley?
By the way, no apologies or bill adjustment were forthcoming.

I have been here for Brunch, happy hour, and dinner, each time getting great service and food in a cool retro environment.
   Their huevos rancheros come in a huge portion and are delicious. Another brunch favorite of mine is the their house cured and smoked fish board, it's great for sharing even though I wanted all the smoked trout to myself. 
   Their dinner menu is the only time I have been a tad disappointed. Their fried chicken was a little too salty and their mashed potatoes were a bit too seasoned and heavy on the garlic. Recently I was here I had their stroganoff ravioli. The mushrooms and creme fraiche sauce were spot on in flavor but the actually ravioli filling again-was too salty.
   Every time I come here I have to get the cheese curds, which are hands down the best I have ever had. You also cannot come here and not get the nashville hot buns. 
    Cocktail wise their radio days is a favorite of mine-tangy but tasty! When they first opened they also had a tiki bar in their courtyard which I hope will return again. They served amazing tiki drinks in coconuts and the environment was so fun.

The pizza here is consistent and the staff is very friendly. The pizza, steaks and fries are all good here. Can't go wrong with any selection. The pepperoni knots are also very good. Give this place a try
These teenagers don't know what they are doing the tables are never wiped down and the food always comes out cooked awfully. Any other McAlister's has great food but this specific location needs help

The food was delicious and we sat outside by the fountain. Really cute vibe and is probably really fun at night. Service was friendly and fast. I thought to tacos were super small for the price. The burrito barbacoa however was fresh and a large portion.
Good tasting Indian food thats made quickly. Staff is polite and there is ample seating. Typical North Indian menu options to choose from that are average price for Indian food

Unfortunately the Matcha Latte had no flavor and was extremely watery. No chai flavor what so ever, this may have been a fluke cause I can't imagine this is what it was supposed to be like. Would have taken it back but took my first drink after I had already left. Not a good experience, $10 wasted.
Terrible ordered the sampler and got cold junk. With half of my order not even in the bag. Just a place to drink.

You are seated and then told they do not have 75% of the items for the entire menu.

Basically, they only have bone-in and boneless wings.

The BEST part was the celery and carrots.  The 'orange' sauce for the boneless chicken tasted more like garlic and spices and did not have any "orange" taste what so ever.

Then, when you go to use the restroom the toilet is clogged up with brown paper towels.

With only THREE tables of customers (willing to eat there) in the 'restaurant' you would think instead of standing around and talking the employees would take the time to take care of their facilities and clean up around the building.

NOT ONE 'manager' was seen the entire time we were there.  I'm guessing they were asleep in the office or trying to find out where the food for their menu went to.

Really bad visit, and food that should have been thrown away rather than eaten!

What a wonderful place! We had a mix of savory (chicken and mushrooms) and dessert (raspberry and white chocolate) crepes which were fantastic. Hope I get back to try something else on their extensive menu.

Ordered three cheeseburger  platters with lettuce  and tomatoes plus fries.  Only good thing about this order was my side order of onion rings... one platter I asked for Swiss cheese with fried onions .. was told they did not have Swiss  cheese.  Got fried onions that must have been the ends of the onions... no sliced rings.... plus fries were cold and mushy... for a $30.00 price tag.. will not be back....
This place has changed.  It's now hit or miss.  I was very disappointed in the service we received last night.

Sushi are a go, and Philly got dozens of major sleek sushi restaurants, Fat Salmon is one of them. So go on, you like-minded yelpers, enjoy Dancing vampire or the White Forest and happy slurping.
An order of sashimi & sushi( $29.50) is just little bites of heaven. Perfectly textured, fresh and very filling- can you ask for more?
Ice cream for dessert? Yaaaaaaaaaaawn. Try something a little different, like Tempura Ice Cream ($6.00). It will make your dessert a whole lot more pleasant. 

Four and Half Yelps.

I'm not sure why this pho got 4 stars overall. Reading the other reviews, I thought this would be a good place to get some dinner but I thought wrong. The pho here isn't that great.  It still puzzles me how others think it's the best pho. Out of all the pho places I've tried, this is probably on the bottom list. There was nothing great about it.  I usually order the spring rolls and pho noodle soup. The spring rolls didn't stand out nor did the peanut sauce (and the sauce is always the best part!) The broth for the soup was ok- nothing outstanding about it either. The food was OK. That's pretty much it.  

The price for the amount of food I got was a little expensive for my taste. Two spring rolls and a small soup = $13.10. I've been to other pho places that were less costly with larger food proportions. It's sort of a rip off. 

The location isn't the best. It shares the same dining area with Port of Subs. Personally, I could care less for location. As long as the food is great, it doesn't matter. The best foods usually come from little hole-in-the-wall places. For this place, it isn't the case. 

If you're hungry and looking for a place to eat, it's an ok place- but not the greatest. If you're eating out to experience great food or a special occasion, I wouldn't really recommend this place.

It is not the best pho in Reno. If it is, that's pretty sad.

Sorry, I can only give it 2 stars.

Okay so this place advertises that it has Gluten Free, Vegetarian, & Vegan dishes.  They have Salad for vegetarians & vegans, and a gluten free pizza.  Their pizza could be vegetarian/vegan but they won't cook it without cheese.  They have only one burger option, only one bun option, no dairy free options.  This place is a joke.

Here on a special Girls week vacation; causin' trouble and makin' new friends with our awesome bartender Shelley who kicked ass!  Our new home away from home.  We will be back for Shelley.  We love Shelley!

great service.
great pho.
clean facilities.
quick service.

No complaints here! All the people that work here are very nice. Their product is solid and very healthy portions. No way I was able to finish the small pho in one sitting. Will definitely be coming back!

The food was very good however when we first walked in we were immediately hit with the strong smell of fish. We were not expecting this from a Italian restaurant that being said it was a nice restaurant and food was good.

We needed a late night nosh before a 45 minute drive home, and found Fries and Pies on Yelp. It's a fun and funky place with really good fries! The hubs got the "Thai Fighter" and reports that it was a good mix of flavors but a bit dry - so you may want to ask for a side of peanut sauce. I got the basic fries, which were delightfully salty, with a flight of five sauces (peanut wasn't among them, but maybe they should make it an option!). Definitely get the flight of sauces - our favorite was the Siracha Mayo (SO good), but the others were also good.  We didn't have dessert, but the individual pies looked delish. Fun atmosphere, and HiHo has a convenient mini bar in the space. So glad we looked and found this place!

Jake's has a very homestyle feel. It is very clean. Breakfast menu is decent, they have a good options available.
They make their potatoes very well. It's very crispy, best breakfast potatoes I have had in a while.
Pleasant experience

This was our 3rd visit , don't know why we keep coming back . This time was the worst , everything was cold , grits were Ice cold they said the steamer pan had not had time to get hot so they took the cold grits and nuke them , biscuit's were cold , almost sure they were made the day before . Coffee tasted as if it was just heated up , $23 for two .............never again
Perfect view of the ocean, delicious and fresh food, and good service. Parking was easy to find and the bar service was great too! If you go at night consider a jacket because it does get cold!

If you are eggetarian or vegetarian don't order egg biryani (non-vegetarian) because it doesn't clearly say they give you same rice which is used in chicken biryani. I ordered egg biryani which had CHICKEN, they were not concerned or felt sorry about it. I want to give ZERO STAR. 
Never coming back again!!!

A wonderful experience. The old fashion is probably the most perfectly balanced I have experienced yet. Our server was amazing and made great suggestions and was very wine knowledgeable. Made reservations on the spot to return.

I went to this place recently having gone to the Dale Mabry location in the past. The food is still as good as I remember and is very reasonably priced.  They have omelets, really delicious huge pancakes in different flavors and there's also a decent sounding lunch menu. Service is fast, the food is prepared promptly, at it's very family friendly.  My 9 year old nephew is a hot mess and loves to make towers,  and therefore messes, with the coffee creamers. The atmosphere's bright and airy thanks to large windows.  If you happen to be having your car serviced at the dealership next door, this is the place to step in for a bite to kill some time.

Waited an almost 1 to 1.5 hours for food only to receive food that was half warm at best. Grilled cheeses for the kids were good but fries with my meal and son's received cold fries. Drink slowly because refills may take a while. Awesome Father's Day. Thank you Cheesecake Factory for the $80 worth of mediocre food.

Edit - not sure if this review shows for all locations but this review is only for Cold Springs, TN mall location. The other Cheesecake Factory locations have usually always been good.

Right away I noticed the service was very slow.

Poor attitudes and I could hear one of the older ladies say "and they wonder why I'm cranky".

Orange juice was thick as maple syrup . They must have someone back they're preparing it who knows nothing about how it's really supposed to be processed and diluted with water prior to serving

Salt and Pepper shakers were dirty and sticky. I requested for my eggs to be cooked over easy but what they brought me were eggs cooked over hard.

I get the impression that the ladies who work here are pretty much coming to work not caring anymore  and going home at the end of the day.

I'm curious to know if that attitude is reflected from the management down. 

Overall, a very disappointing experience for dining out.
The Americano coffee and sweet potato muffin is outstanding! Very friendly staff. What a cool coffee house.

I can always count on First Watch. There has never been anything I don't like when we eat here. Their waffle and campo is my favorite and I always get the morning meditation juice. They are a chain, but a solid brunch option. The atmosphere is  definitely a vibe. The staff is always helpful and kind. You will wait a while on the weekends to be seated. Great option for a morning with girlfriends and also hardy enough for my husband too. They have great seasonal specials. We do tend to stick to breakfast so I don't have experience with their lunch options. There is a bit or an odor when you first walk in, but I believe it's due to the open kitchen style. Very clean and well maintained restaurant. Breakfast tacos are great! So is hash when they have it and lemon ricotta pancakes are rich enough to share. Always get the million dollar bacon if on menu!

I don't even know where to start IT WAS JUST THAT WONDERFUL! We happened to stop by yesterday AM for their kickoff of their new Sat/Sun brunch that will be happening EVERY WEEKEND! My husband and I both had the veggie goodness, which is also gluten free, and unreal. He ordered a side of the house pancakes- ridiculous, melt in your mouth good, and his side dish was grits while mine was the potatoes---which were too good to be true. They have an excellent bloody mary bar which was on point. But the best part...the dog friendly atmosphere. We are constantly searching for do friendly places to go with our dogs on the weekends and their front porch with high top tables complete with caribeners to hook your dog leashes, mats for the dogs and water bowls is out of this world awesome. Oh, and the two dog parks out front that the patio goes into? Umm, yes please. The service, is over the top unreal good. Like, been a long time since we've been treated with so much kindness good. Go check out their brunch today! You won't be disappointed!

The food is pretty good and the staff is generally nice. There is a  great variety for both salads and stir fry... my only 2 complaints are that it is a little overpriced, but not a huge complaint and also the tables are ALWAYS STICKY!! Ewww! I still come frequently but it is so gross that the tables are ALWAYS so sticky. I've never seen anyone wiping or cleaning the tables.

I really like brunch, and I'm into trying out new places, trying to find where I want to regularly eat breakfast.  Simply put, Carmen's is at the top of the breakfast game, possibly the best place in the whole city.  The menu offers four choices that change daily.  Each is $12, a side of meat is $2 extra.

I had the scallops with eggs, toast and potatoes.  I really like seafood, but I'm not a scallop lover.  These were the best scallops I've ever had.  My housemate and brunch partner Jonny had a lima bean omelet that looked delicious.  Despite having a limited menu, most people, including vegetarians, shouldn't have a hard time finding something they want.  

The service is unbeatable. Carmen's is a tiny little place, there are about five tables, and then a small bar.  Reservations are required.

Carmen's will become a regular stop for me.  It's one of, if not the, best breakfast places in the whole city.  Do yourself a favor and wake up early, make a reservation, and head over and see what Carmen is serving up today.
Second time in two weeks . If your not scrapping the cheese of the skillet, you are doing it wrong

We were here early on a Sunday - around 5 it was empty. Much bigger inside than the front of house suggests. We had the lamb w humus, babaganouj, zucchini, and kale. All were excellent! Attentive service, music a little loud but nice ambiance otherwise! Go here!!!

So I went here last night and let me tell you literally sick right now writing this review. It's so messed up because we went to daisy dukes up the way and it was great..   I tell everybody to run away from this place do not I repeat do not eat Daisy Dukes express fucking gross

The gumbo i s Straight  food poisoning
The red beans and rice was burnt it just wasn't a friendly experience or an appetizing one.
If I could rate damn negative stars I would
The Haven is awesome.   Great food, good atmosphere, and friendly people.

About 4-5 years ago, a person I knew got their sandwich from Koch's.

I used to be so annoyed by the waiting time, and the lack of places to sit while waiting for your order. I did like how they got down to business with a order placed. 

The final outcome was a large-filling sandwich, with a long wait, lack of seating, and semi-attentive staff.

I haven't been back in a long time due to the fact that I'm not in the area as much and I don't have a craving for their food. It's an aiight sandwich shop to be fair.

First of all their drinks are amazing like the super cool waitress said their like a pair of boobs one is not enough and three is to many ha PS the service was great and the food was really good but did I mention the drinks :)

We usually say how awesome this place and the food and everything. Today our server virginia remembered even our order!! Being a server for awhile in my life before I know how hard it is to remember everyone so great job virginia and thank you for the excellent service! The food is clean and everything about this place makes us happy and satisfied :)
Grilled lamb was marinated perfectly. Bread fresh and thin. Homemade desert. Yogurt soda. I'm going back.
I asked for spicy pho with brisket nd a grilled chicken bahn mi nd it was soooooooo good ! Quick and easy service !

This place is simply awesome! I have only been here a few times but everything I have had is great. They have a nice selection of slices , ice cream and everything Nutella... I have to say the Nutella banana split was really good. Nutella flavored soft serve , who'd think they would have that.
The pizza is tasty, not the best ever but very good. Super thin crust and delicious sauce make it different then the traditional Neapolitan.
The cheesesteak Stromboli was off the charts ! Quality meat , delicious tomato sauce and the dough is cooked to perfection. They cook it great and the dough is crunchy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, very unique and not a lot of extra dough that is usually uncooked. Really impressed but I didn't really liked the choices of toppings inside.... the chicken cutlet sandwich was so good , not greasy at all.
I couldn't believe how great the salad with grilled chicken was , very fresh and a nice portion.
There are still some things I need to try here and I am looking forward to future visits!

This place is awesome!!! Soo good and fresh. I was worried that it might not be fresh due to covid but the quality was definitely there. The place is nice and clean. The person who helped me didn't speak much English but was very friendly. Upon entering they have menus for you to write on and turn in which is what I ended up doing. I thought he wouldn't give me a lot of toppings or decease the amount since I got everything that was possible but he still gave me really good portions of toppings. Another reviewer said their bowl was small but for me the bowl was definitely bang for your buck! When I got home I had to take some of the toppings off it was so bountiful. I'll definitely be back! Don't forget to ask for a stamp card either!

I've definitely had better Tapas. I went with a group of 3 and we tried about 10 dishes. The mussels were served cold (which they did warn you about), but this seemed to result in a complete loss of flavor. The lamb skewers were excellent, but everything else was rather bland. Combine this with so-so service and it was an overall mediocre experience.

My kids think the wings here are the best around.  One complaint - their online menu is really old.  Several times I've been surprised by the cost of my order.  The prices are considerably higher now.  It would be nice if this business would be more honest and take the time to update the prices.

Thankful 3 Agaves opened where it did. It's by another restaurant my family loves, but I don't!! When they order from there, I get my favorite! The portions are huge! I ate my chicken fajitas for 3 meals! My preference is more veggies, so next time I might order more peppers and onions. Queso is delicious and the perfect accompaniment to the tortilla chips! A must get with every order. Workers are very friendly and orders are usually ready quicker than the quoted times so you can be in & out of the restaurant in no time!

I just ordered take out. I'm speechless! We ordered Ribs, Brisket, BBQ Beans, Fries and Cole Slaw. Amazing. The meats are seasoned perfectly and you don't need sauce. However the sauce is incredible. South Tampa has new best BBQ in the South!

I usually would give this place 5 stars, but last night we had the worst service ever.  Waited very long for drinks, the waiter seemed unenthusiastic and the menu choice on yelp are different from the actual menu.  Food was amazing as always but, other factors influenced the low rating.

We used to frequent this restaurant but had not been in over a year because the quality of the food had declined. We decided to give it another try. No complaints about the food. We were a party of five. Ordered the Land sampler and Sea sampler appetizers which were good, though not as outstanding as on earlier visits. One person had the rib steak, two of us had the rack of lamb, one had the veal chop special and one had Pad thai. The rack of lamb was tasty, but was only 4 little chops. The unpleasant surprise came when we got the bill. We were charged $54 for the two appetizers (should have been$36). Waiter explained that they gave us more because there were 5 of us. Not true, as I have had both appetizers before, same quantity. He did take $19 off bill, which was still high $262 for 5 people and it is BYOB. Good thing I looked closely at bill, as I was ready to add 20% tip. Well waiter had already done that. Since when does a restaurant add tip in for only 5 people. Between that, and the attempted overcharging for the appetizer, I feel that they tried to take advantage of us. I will not be back.

Got a Groupon and went to try this place out for the first time. The food was great. 

We asked the server what two dishes we should try and they suggested go with the beef brisket and the pork ribs. The rub on the ribs was excellent. A little spicy. The meat was lean not fatty and it fell off the bones. 

The brisket was lean as well and very good. Sides of baked beans and Mac n cheese were excellent.

A little more expensive than other BBQ places in illinois. We ended up paying quite a bit even with groupon savings. Overall even though it's out of the way it's worth the trip.
Good food. Solid service. Really good margaritas. NO WIFI!?! Come on now, your right out side Maryland farms, gotta have wifi. Sorry, the no wifi cost you a star.

Wow! passed this place every day on my work commute & finally gave it a try this weekend. Now I wish I had tried it sooner. Our party had the Shrimp Po-Boy, the Surf & Turf Po-Boy & the friend Shrimp platter. Everything was great! an interesting spin on the batter & spices but believe me an oral orgasm is to be had....:-). Go try this place...you won't regret it.

My wife and I moved here from the Bay Area 3 weeks ago. We had a DMV apt and were hungry so we yelped a local Mediterranean place to go to. She found Suri's and off we went. (it's a 2 minute drive from DMV!) Upon walking in, the place was super clean and the staff were all friendly and family owned from what I could tell. We ordered the Chicken and Mixed Schawarma plates. I haven't had schawarma that good before. The plate was huge to begin and there was so much chicken and rice + large chucks of tasty potatoes. The flavoring was also amazing. next time I will order a kabob. Their seasoning is so good they should sell on a Safeway shelf.

My wife went back up to the counter to order Persian ice cream. While she was doing that the owner was passing out samples of his Persian tea. My wife is half Persian and we spoke about their food. The ice cream is amazing, I will be going back for sure to get more of it. I have learned and experienced enough authentic Persian cuisine from my in laws to know this was by far excellent food. They take pride in their restaurant and I'm super glad we went! 

Thanks for the great food and service!

The food is pretty nasty  this is the worst place to receive bbq this is not the place to visit is you are in New Orleans. The shrimp Taste like pre cooked shrimp from Walmart. I really did not enjoy my meal. Do not get the shrimp po boy or the Mac and cheese or potato salad just. Horrible.

I thought the chicken was wack.  Put differently, the chicken just did not live up to expectations.  The chicken was hot and moist, but it lacked bold flavor.  The collar greens were wack as well and the macaroni was okay/all right.  I'm glad I tried it, but I will never return.

First time and was very impressed!
- Staff was excellent as was our waiter
- Food was great ... key highlights:
- Antapasto plate for a group (we had 6) which included calamari, etc was the best I ever had. The meats and cheeses were really tasty, but it was the seafood that put it over the top
- Everyone loved their entree's, whether they were pasta, fish (my buddy had salmon)or veal.
- For the meal that we had it was a bargin (about $110 couple with drinks/wine)

Tucked away under a canopy of shade trees, this little gem is my new go-to Mexican joint.  Service was sweet...a team effort of friendly, knowledgeable servers who had no qualms recommending the "house" margarita (cheapest) as their favorite.  The food was sublime...crunchy corn tortillas and tangy salsa...fluffy rice and flavorful beans...and efficient t service with a smile.  Must go again this week!

Their fajitas are absolutely delicious. I got the steak and chicken and it was so much food! We also did the chocolate piñata which is actually even better than I expected, but make sure you have a big group to eat it all (we had 4 and did not coms close to finishing). Overall I think it's a bit overpriced, but a great place to go for a celebration every once in a while.
Service is steadily declining.  I blame poor management as the servers appear overwhelmed while managers walk around.

Doughocracy is a make-your-own pizza place that has consistently good pizza. I don't deviate much from my go-to ingredients but here are a couple tips when you go there next time.

- Get meatball on your pizza. Their meatballs are awesome!
- If you pick out more than 2 cheeses, you will be upcharged.
- You can mix sauces together. For ex. an excellent base is the tomato and bbq sauce mixed together.
- The argula is tossed with a tangy vinaigrette and will add another dimension to your pizza if you appreciate acidity like I do. 
- Free soda with a yelp check in.

Sometimes their dough can be thin especially around the center of the pizza which makes it harder to eat, but that is why we have forks.

My husband and I used to visit the El Maguey on Olive Blvd in St Louis, and were excited when it moved to our hometown.  We have eaten here many times and are never disappointed. Most of the time we have no complaints, but occasionally we have had a slow server.

Not sure how I haven't reviewed Bamboozle yet. We come here every couple of months and we just got takeout a few days ago.
This isn't a typical Vietnamese place, it's more fusion.  As a vegetarian this is a great place for both me to find something to eat (yay tofu) as well as my boyfriend. He loves their pho. My usual go to is the red curry with tofu... so good. We usually split a couple of their fresh rolls (peanut sauce.. mmm). Perfect. 
The reason for not the full 5 stars is because I once ordered the Udon noodles in miso broth. Unfortunately it was like eating a salt lick. I am sure that was enough sodium for 3 days. (Looking back, I should've returned it). Also, for some reason they often want to put us at a small table right in the middle of the walkway when they're much better tables available out of the way. We just started asking if we could have another table. All is good.

If you're ready to indulge and be a bit of a glutton, this is the right place. The burgers were huge and treated great. But the appetizers were insane. Deep fried bacon with gravy was so bad for me but tasted so good. Because I value keeping my cholesterol down, not a place I would be a regular at but definitely worth exploring.

I love Grillsmith, yes I do!  This is the first Grillsmith I ever visited and every experience at this location has been great (including the Yelp event I recently attended here).

My favorite dish that Grillsmith offers is the chicken with artichokes and sun dried tomatoes (can't remember the name of it at the moment), but it is SO good.  If you are looking for something healthy, the fitness chicken is really good.  Grillsmith also has a great happy hour (especially on Wednesdays).  This is a great spot to go for a nice meal that won't absolutely break the bank.

I'm not sure what I was expecting from a strip mall sushi joint, but it wasn't this sort of quality.

 The sushi was delicious! My wife had the American Dream Roll and the 465 Roll, and I had to stop myself from eating it right off her plate. I will be getting those two for myself the next time, along with the Spider Roll. 

We also had the edamame as an appetizer, and was glad to have some hot and salty finger food between bites of surprisingly fresh fish.

The great thing about this place is that it is all you can eat, so you can feel free to try something different, and if you don't care for it, go back to your favorites. 

I'm very glad to welcome Watami to the Lawrence restaurant scene. Heaven knows we needed something other than Applebees or another bar.
This is our second time here and we've been blown away for the second time. The food is great, the atmosphere is perfect and the waitstaff it TOP NOTCH! Go! Try it out!!

So I heard about this place from a friend who lives in the area.  So while on vacation in New Orleans I knew that I  couldn't leave without eating here. I was so glad that I did however I wish that I hadn't waited until the day before I was leaving town. I ordered the gator and pork sauage poboy and it was the best poboy ever! The bread was perfect and there was plenty of meat and so delicious and huge. I was only able to eat half due to the fact that I ordered boudan balls that was great! I know when I return I will be eating here more than once.

All food good . Tried various items . Authentic Mexican food . Manager friendly and she runs a clean environment . Sanitizer everywhere thank you we like that . She pay good attention to customers . It's a must try food delicious

I feel bad... The staff are incredibly nice and the hoagies are good. The pizza wasn't that great ....
But on the positives, they are open beyond typical dinner hours and they are super quick with getting your order ready.
I will definitely be back when in the area, and who knows maybe I just caught the pizza on a bad day.
Though after a few days eating my way through NYC, 2 things are apparent:
1. These folks are way nicer than any of the shop keepers in NYC 
2. I just had some of the best pizza in the world so my comparison may be hard to live up to

I really enjoyed my experience here tonight.  The staff was eager to help, for it was my first time visiting.  I am new to town and I have found my sushi "home."  The menu was diverse, offering options for vegetarians and patrons who prefer cooked rolls.  I can't wait for my next visit!
GREAT service, food and atmosphere. Were very accommodating and throughly enjoyed. Will definitely be on the to do list for future trips to the Big Easy
Friendly staff. Happy hour from 2-6 even on weekends. Drinks were amazing and food was delish!

On my search for some Italian.. I noticed the laughing cat had No reviews. Wth!?! Ok I know allot of people have come here.  I want to first say that I liked the place when the owner had a smaller place.  Expect a long wait for your food and expect the portions to be big! I have to say the food is good there but it's not the best Italian I have ever had. Although you know someone is making the dish from scratch and made to order. Waiting  30-45 mins for my food to come out is a bit crazy. Came here several times and not impressed. I rather have smaller portions for better quality

We should have run for the hills after we waited nearly 10 minutes for our server to bring Kristy her Sprite, only it turned out to be soda water. It was the start of a long night.

That was after our server failed to say hello or introduce himself. His opening line was "Whatcha have to drink?"

It took maybe 20 minutes after we ordered before we got our sandwiches, a French dip and a smoked turkey club. One bite and it became clear. Both sandwiches and the fries were cold. No hint of warmth.

We told our server and he offered a lukewarm apology and asked if we wanted them redone. Yes, please. After another 12 minutes a woman, maybe a manager (?), brought out the new sandwiches and everything was hot and fine. 

She apologized, but if she was a manager I would have expected her to identify herself, her position and say she was really sorry and hoped that the second batch met our expectations. 

Later, our server came back and explained that it was obvious the first batch of sandwiches and fries had gotten done and had sat in the window too long before he picked them up and brought the plates to our table. I appreciate him taking responsibility for that. He also explained that another served hadn't shown up and that he and another server were trying to cover that person's tables. 

That's a hard call, but I would have appreciated knowing that from the start. We could have decided to stay, knowing service might be slow and uneven, or we could have chosen to go somewhere else. 

It seems odd that the cooks would have let two plates of hot food sit at the window so long they were cold by the time the server got to them. Wouldn't they call the person to make sure they got out? Call a manager to bring them out, or something?

I never ask for freebies, but our poor experience seemed to beg for them to offer to take one of the entrees off the bill or offer us dessert. Nothing.

When we left, we passed by two other staff members. Neither one said thanks or acknowledged us at all. 

We came here while it was still warm and sat outside. That night, we had a wonderful service and everything went smoothly. It was a reason we looked forward to tonight's meal there.

In eight years of Yelping and 534 reviews, this is only the eighth time I've given a one-star review. It's rare and something I don't give lightly.

This bad experience will make it hard to return. It was so unsatisfactory that I can't see us giving Smoky Mountain another chance.

I hope someone from the restaurant reads this and responds with a thoughtful answer and not the canned, written-exactly-the-same response I saw in a couple of other recent bad reviews.

So I can't remember why I waited so long to come back, but I had ordered take out last week and then dined in tonight with my daughter because I had a craving for their curry! 

We started off with the curry puffs, tofu pad thai, Veggie Thai fried rice, yellow curry with beef and for dessert had the sweet mango rice since the mango is seasonal and an all time favorite Thai dessert. Our food came out fairly quickly and I was glad because I was starving and the yummy smells were driving me crazy. The flavors of their yellow curry, pad Thai, Thai fried rice and sweet mango rice will forever be imbedded in my taste buds and it will keep me coming back for more, more often. 

Generous portions for a great price and the flavors are out of this world! Friendly young female server this past Monday 4/25 she wasn't overbearing and gave us the right amount of attention. I cannot wait to come back and hopefully bring more friends.

If you believe that Guiness should be mixed with ice cream and chocolate sauce, then you have found your heaven on earth.  And if not , well then you can do the math.  Kid's mac and cheese portion is microscopic, i guess designed to guarantee they will order dessert.  I had to go to front desk to get silverware after the food was served.  And again to get service.  Appetizer was not served, replaced instead with comped fries.  "The kitchen was busy."    That with the place at half capacity.  Disaster.  Never again.
Oh yea, read the other reviews.  The kids stretched out the wife's sweater by sharing it in a futile effort to stay warm.
The slowest Taco Bell ever! I probably waited 25 mins to get my food with only 2 people ahead of me and their orders didn't look big.

Fin and Pearl was amazing!! I had the fish and chips and the crab dip for an appetizer! I would recommend both:) I also had a private dining event event there and the staff was amazing in setting everything up and they were all so helpful! I cannot wait to come back!

Don't understand the bad reviews?
BKF great 
Lunch great 
Desert great 
Price great 
Choices great
I was really disappointed in this hotel. It was very dated, our bed was not comfortable. I've stayed at other Hyatt's that were fine but I will not stay at this one again.

I've been regularly visiting The Hungry Greek for years.  The food is fantastic and prices are competitive.  But... managers need to keep an eye on employees who aren't focused on customers.  On a Sunday evening, the outstanding work of the people who were doing the food preparation was overshadowed by a poorly trained, negligent, underperforming cashier who didn't pay attention to detail, and exhibited a careless attitude toward customers.  Otherwise, easily 4-5 stars for The Hungry Greek.

Rating for Breakfast

They have a fantastic bacon, egg (sliced, not scrambled) and jack cheese wrap for breakfast. Stop here almost every morning on my way to the office. My wife gets the same thing except they exchange goat cheese for the jack cheese, plus add spinach. The wrap is nicely grilled before it is served.

The wrap is much larger, and more filling, than the $1.99 wrap from Dunkin' Donuts. Will easily hold you until lunch, or even later.

Unfortunately they do not serve coffee so you always have to make a 2nd stop, otherwise I would give this breakfast 5 stars.

Note: Ritz-Carlton guests receive a 20% discount. Just show your room key.

Mikawa is a very interesting place. It's located on Broad in the theater district but is never really that busy. The inside is long and narrow with interesting/trendy? lighting. This is also consistent with their food, as many dishes are served with blinking or fluorescent lights to enhance the presentation. The biggest problem I have with Mikawa is that the menu is so large. Sushi is their strong-suit and they should have stuck with just that. There are a ton of fun rolls to choose from, all pretty tasty. They also offer Chinese food, which I did enjoy but I find hard to mess up. For my most recent visit I decide to try their Pad Thai. Please avoid ever getting this! It tasted nothing like Pad Thai, or anything for that matter. They also added a ton of green & red peppers, which I found to add a strange flavor to the mix. It was only $10, which is definitely the cheapest you can get in the area but it still doesn't make it worth it. I will compliment them on the speediness of their delivery (and free! only $10 min). And it's nice their BYOB. But again, stick with the sushi!

Stella Pizza is a fantastic family friendly pizzeria.  You can rearrange the tables and have a larger party.  This is good news! 

They serve chicken fingers and fries if you have a kid who inexplicably dislikes Pizza.  Win-win.

We had the white pizza and the Margarita.  Both were thin crusted and very good.

There's parking.  What can I say!  It is Collingswood, and parking is a gigantic plus.

We were starving and stumbled upon this cute little restaurant. We liked the decor, so we decided to eat lunch there. Bad idea. This was the most expensive, bland Mexican food I've ever had. After lunch my stomach was a bit upset, I went back to my hotel room and had diarrhea for the next few hours. AVOID THIS PLACE! I've had better food and service at taco bell.

I would give this place a 0 if I could. They messed up our entire order: no cheese on our fries, my wrap was completely incorrect, my sister was given her wings with literally no sauce on it??? With none on the side?? Everyones meal came with none of the sauce we asked, we paid for extra sauce and the two we got maybe a tablespoon of sauce in every cup. But that's not even the best part. We called and explained our issues, none of us were upset at this point because we expected our meals to be remade or taken care of. We go to the place, and the manager has the audacity to say "bring the food and show me we got it wrong and will remake it." I'm sorry?? Come back for a third time for you to do your job correctly? What is this horrible customer service from a MANAGER. His name was Christian. Absolutely ridiculous. And as you may guess, we did not get a refund.

Our kid has been obsessing over a noodle burger for weeks and we live clear on the other side of town. We're now on our 3rd attempt to get one, but both Yelp and their website list outdated or conflicting hours. Please update, or add info to your phone message with current hours to save us a 40 minute trip!

Quaint little deli in Santa Barbara on Figueroa St. 
Chicken Enchilada & Beef Stroganoff were the Choices for lunch topped off with an amazing piece of Carrot Cake! 
The Stroganoff was creamy loaded with tender beef cubes and mushrooms & farfalle
The Chicken Enchilada was large & stuffed with chicken and just the right amount of jalapeños to spice it up plenty of cheese and served hot!
A coke and a Latte for drinks!
What a relaxing lunch we had and a great conversation with Kathy really brought our the hospitality and homeliness of the Savoy! 
Highly recommend you visit this little deli!
They also have a nice wine selection if you choose to pick up a bottle or two!

we were looking for good bbq and stumbled upon this place. it was packed - always a good sign! but the service was so quick and the food was delicious! my husband got a side of mac and cheese which was sooooo good. i got baked beans which were way too smoky tasting for me but still good! we travel to nashville often so this is definitely going to be a must visit for us from here on out! the lunch special was a sandwich, side and drink for $9 so a great deal! highly recommend!

The food here is excellent! We went on a Saturday night (2nd Saturday) and there was a lot going on downtown so it was quite busy. The line moved fast and I took no time at all to get our food. The salsa bar was awesome as were the chips. The medium salsa was a little hotter than medium for those that don't like a lot of heat, but I loved it. My husband had carne asada and shredded beef tacos with the calabacitas and loved all of it. I had the carne asada and the al pastor tacos with the pinto beans. It was all amazing although I thought the beans could have used a little more salt. There was also a great selection of local beers which pleased the husband.  The prices are very reasonable....make sure you use the check in feature to get a free taco. We can't wait to go back!

Amazing tea, amazing atmosphere, amazing staff.. I think I'm in love. 
Try this place soon, you won't regret it.

I had the shrimp fajitas. They were solid. They made jalapeño toreado for me and gave me twice as much. They have a good but not wide selection of beers. The chips were too salty and not fresh, perhaps from a bag. The building and furniture were clean. I sat at the bar. The flour tortillas were high quality. The charro beans were great. After I ran out of flour tortillas, I loaded the house beans into the corn tortillas and cleared all the plates. The menu is split into two styles. They have cantina food and then they have New American, or that's the closest type that occurs to me. Osso Bucco. Steaks. Wings. It seems odd but makes sense when the team explained that the Tubac original started as a steak place and morphed into a Mexican place. I would go back and try the chef's specials. This is a solid place and a great addition to the area.

My wife and I have tried this place several times now because it is so close to our home. Unfortunately, this place will most likely not last long. It's sad that a place with such great potential doesn't understand it's demographic.
1. This is a brewpub situated directly in the middle of a family oriented neighborhood. It does not have booster seats or high chairs, yet has a kids menu. 
2. The only outdoor seating that is shaded, does not allow kids because of some imaginary line they drew inside the building that sits "behind the bar". The seating is completely separate from the inside and on the exterior of the building, so that excuse made no sense. We actually had an employee tell us we weren't allowed to sit there. But you can bring your dogs out there, just not your toddler. 
3. The food is catered from Patrick's kitchen, which is a delightful restaurant and Patrick is an amazing chef (and a great guy in general). However, the price you have to pay for this is outrageous for what you get. 
4. They cater more to dogs and they do tiny humans. While we were sitting in the restaurant trying to hold onto our almost 2-year-old, there were several dogs on the patio that had water and doggy dishes brought to them. 
How is it possible that you think about providing water bowls for dogs but not high chairs for kids? 

I really truly hope management reads this and gets their act together. If you want a neighborhood restaurant and brewpub to succeed, you might want to think about the people that actually live within a mile of your establishment. Most of these people have kids and they are looking for a place they can bring the whole family and have a nice relaxing afternoon. My wife and I will not be back until we have heard that these issues are fixed. I hope this place doesn't fall under because they have decent beer and it's in a convenient location.

Absolute disaster of a lunch. Our server was never around. 25 minutes after ordering drinks he came back to tell us they didn't have 2 of the alcohols we ordered. Finally drinks arrived after 35-40 minutes. The couple sitting next to us had the same trouble. If you could get a manager they were quick to bring what you needed. Food was decent but with so many amazing places in New Orleans I don't think I would try here again.

Just ate breakfast with a friend. We had the cinnamon swirl pancakes and pig candied bacon, fried chicken eggs Benedict and the corned beef eggs Benedict. Everything was delicious. Our server Michelle was friendly and attentive, checking in on us to make sure we had everything we needed.

These guys are so quick. They're like the Jimmy Johns of pizzas. You can make any pizza your imagination can conjure up in the time it takes you to think of it. 

The toppings are tasty and fresh! The staff and ambiance are upbeat. The prices are good. 

If you like building your own pizza, give those folks a try.
Food was excellent, beer was good, and it was crazy inexpensive. A good pint of beer for $4 on a Saturday night?!? Amazing!

I ordered their delivery.  The order was prepared and delivered fast.  nice work.

Not a good value:
the product was good,  but it is overpriced for what you get.  The pizza isn't substantial enough to make ordering from here worth it.  It's thin crust, thin layer of sauce and a thin layer of cheese.  If I'm spending $23 for a delivered pizza, I expect to have some for left-overs.  Not enough food for the high price.

I come from a part of the country where a $20 pizza could feed a family of four.  This pizza would barely feed the heterosexual dad!

Woodstock's pizza is worth the money, but beware the college kids will randomly close early so I stopped counting on them.

Would have been an easy 5 star.  Great food and service.  But the music (96.5 FM) and volume leads to indigestion.  Note to trendy restaurant owners, don't play lousy music at any decibel level.  And tune your speakers so I don't have to hear loud static.  Patrons want to dine, not to be subjected to the eccentric music tastes of your employees

Wow what a change in quality of the food I got. I hadn't eaten here in 3 years because the food was so bad. Very friendly staff and helpful. Food was ready on time after I called in my order a head of time.

Well.. The owner burped in my wife and my face when we walked around the corner trying to find the front door. As he continued to talk on his phone he pointed to the front door for us. Thanks. So we came in and waited a few minutes to sit down. They weren't too busy. Had a few open tables at 1pm. I ordered a beer. Server came back and said the keg was tapped and there was a couple other kegs in the way of the replacement so that I needed to order another beer. So I did. Got the food menu. Made my first choice. They didn't have it. Made my second choice. They didn't have it. Which was surprising because all it was a chicken sandwich on the second choice. So just went with a pork slider for a healthy 11 bucks. The cut you get is pretty slim. So you gotta power through a couple straight bun bites to get to the meat. Here I close my tab just leaving frustrated about the whole deal, and I paid for it. I guess this is the best I can do.

If you're going to charge high end prices, offer high end items with high end service.

This place is probably my new favorite place to go in Nashville. It truly felt like little Italy meets a safe haven for fairies. We went there for dinner and the food was great (I had a Malbec wine that was suggested and it didn't disappoint by any means). Although dinner was fab I have a feeling their brunch menu is even better. Can't wait to go again so I can try everything else!
The Hollow has the best Caesar Salad in town!! The beer and fries are also great and the service is always on point!

I held a birthday dinner here and the service was impeccable. The food was outstanding!!!! I can't wait to get back at one of their tables. This is a great date spot. Me and my husband will definitely be back for a date night. The staff was so friendly and accommodating. They even had a birthday surprise for me that included some singing. It was awesome! Love this place!

My husband and I had a weekend away and showed up on a saturday nite w/o reservations and were lucky enough to get in.  I give this place 5 stars for service as everyone was totally solicitious!! The four stars was for the food, oysters rockerfeller, chicken scalopini, 20 oz tbone, potatos augratin, choco mousse and 2 long islands.  The oysters were awesome!! The drinks excellent! Tbone good-chicken was just ok which was diappointing for the price tag, $28. Skip the mouse as it was a waste of $9.  I would go back and just skip the desert and try a different option.  Super pricey-party of two for $131.54!

A decent chain steak house experience.

Stopped in with the family on saturday afternoon and it was good.

We were earlier in the day and we were able to get lunch sized portions which was a good value.   

My steak was cooked correctly and that is a bonus when you deal with chains!

The only issue I'd have to say and I can clearly see i'm not the only one is the waitress.

It was like her first day or something as she clearly could not get it right.   Is it really that hard for good service for a lunch at a chain steakhouse?

Apparently it is.

Wow...really gone downhill. Everything tastes stale. Not stale, as in it's been sitting out too long, but stale, as in, "How long have you been storing this rice? It's tastes like basement." The service is still fast and friendly, but the quality...

Tried it for the first time yesterday.  Had soft tacos with carnitas.  Meat was great.  They put rice on my tacos and it wasn't cooked all the way.  Also expected corn tortillas and they were flour.  My son got a steak burrito and the meat was gristly.

Went by to try this local byob place we haven't been, in a location we HAD been. Glad we did! I was happy to still smell the garlic wafting by...good sign! Started with a Caesar salad (eehh) & forget the tasteless bread, but the main course specials were redemption! A perfectly cooked short rib with the best gnocchi I've EVER had - usually dislike the dense dough balls I THOUGHT were real gnocchi - these were lighter pillows of deliciousness! And if that's not "real" gnocchi, I don't care lol. Fabulous dish!! Hubby had the cioppino which was stuffed full with amazing & fresh seafood and he raved as well.  Not a bad price for the quality and flavor ($30-$35 per dish) & far exceeded expectations! Portions were large so we have yummy leftovers.  Well, not the amazing flourless chocolate cake...that was a goner, especially with our good bottle of red! Very happy we took a chance & we will be back!

Okay I do like the salsa. I like the filet tacos when they are hot. My food and my husbands food was Luke warm. I returned it and I think the server returned the same food at the same temperature.  I told her and she told that's how it comes out. I asked for a side of sauce which I never got but they charged me for the sauce..  Ps! Rice needs to be kept at a certain temperature or can cause food poisoning. Look it up.

My Fiance and I just Moved to Harbour Island From N.Y.  We ordered from Precinct Pizza hoping it would hold up to its claim of being like New York pizza.  It was anything but.  The crust tasted like cardboard and the Sauce tasted like ketchup covered with sugar.  I recomend Eddie and Sams if you want some pizza similiar to N.Y Pizza.

Germantown has a jewel! This will be my new favorite restaurant. I can't say enough about the service, the ambience and the food. The beer menu was extensive.  I tried a Passion fruit cider and it was delicious! Jimmy was the server for our group. He made sure we were taken care of and went over & beyond to provide exemplary service. Will definitely be back to Sedona!

Two friends and I went here on a Friday night. This place is exactly how the name is, half Chinese and half Thai food mixed with one or two Vietnamese appetizers. So you can definitely get a decent amount of Asian variety here. Everything was pretty good, we got the lettuce wraps, different noodles, and curry and everything was good. Definitely a place to check out if you're too far from Chinatown but in the city. Prices were normal for center city. Service was decent and place is nice and clean.

Have had 3 horrible experiences here regarding my food and the fourth and final time was with management. They don't care to fix anything as far as they are concerned "it's your problem, not mine" I've never felt so disrespected in my entire life than I did today. Extremely disappointed and will never come back. Wish I could give negative stars. Trashy employees and establishment.

The atmosphere here was just as wonderful as the coffee. You have the option of using kitchenware to drink from if you're planning to stay in (better for the environment). Additionally, there was a woman giving us her own musical show at the piano- her voice and music selection was absolutely wonderful! It made the experience go from a 4 to a 5. The coffee was rich and they have tea options as well. The chai didn't have as much scent as i wanted, but it still satisfied. Definitely worth a visit!
Really good, and fast service! Go and give it a try. For my Keto babes you can go breadless!
Hands down the best pizza I've ever had. The plain is great but the bacon, onion, and goat cheese pizza is out of this world. A little pricey but worth every penny.

Bob's Haven Deli is fresh and good. I have more than once bought lunch for my whole department, weather it's pizza or Italian zeps it is all well received by my team. Friendly staff there always willing to help.

Megan was our server and she is so delightful!  We had bbq pulled pork nachos, salmon dip with pita bread and cheese shrimp for appetizers and half of rack of ribs plate, 2 catfish dinners and a Cajun pasta!  All the meals had sides and very, VERY delicious!
I would highly recommend the restaurant not only do you get a very decent helping of food but it is very tasty and be much like home cooked food.  The staff was wand the restaurant is clean.  ( yes bathroom too)
We will be back for the prim rib.  I suggest that if you want prime rib that you come early because they run out fast so I'm sure it's good.

I was so so excited to get in to some brisket. I had tried the Fette Sau in Brooklyn and was impressed by the beef cheeks. Unfortunately, I paid over $15 for 3 slices of brisket that really lacked flavor. I dream about the melty fat produced by Austin's Franklin BBQ. This was not that kind of fat.

I want to love this spot, and I used to eat here almost daily since I work around the corner, however the service was so bad I had to stop going. 

I'll start with the good stuff:
Their burrito bowls and salads are amazing; delicious, healthy, and filling. They have a ton of vegan and vegetarian options. This place has a ton of potential and I love that this place is a hearty, healthy option in the city. 

The not so good stuff:
The customer service can be rude, slow, and incredibly frustrating. Though you can customize their menu options, you should bank on them messing it up. If they do mess up your order, no they will not remake it, you will have to reorder it and pay again, and even then they may mess it up.
It can take forever to get your smoothie, often times I saw a staff member neglect a ticket as they chatted or did nothing for a while while multiple orders were hanging. And sometimes they'll make your smoothie and put it in a fridge until you ask where your smoothie is (????). 
The smoothies often had a weird soap taste and they often use fruit that isn't ripe and leaves you with a waste of money in a cup, and a literal bad taste in your mouth. 
For a while the terrible service was worth the food but 
the final straw for me was ordering a Maria's Favorite with real cheese in a bed of lettuce to-go (something I ordered almost every time I went). When I got my order it was in a wrap, so I told them what I had ordered and rather then correct it they told me that the Maria's favorite comes in a wrap and if I want it done differently I have to go to the cashier and reorder. I needed to get to work and didn't have time to argue about the absurdity of this so I went to the cashier ordered the exact same thing (paid a second time), double checking that it would be in a bowl this time and sat at a table to wait. I got my order, it was in a bowl, I walked to work and discovered they had omitted almost every ingredient, including the lettuce,sweet potatoes, etc. Hangry and low on time I ran back over told them about the errors in my order and they threw some of the ingredients on top and handed it back to me.
