I enjoy Felipes because it's quick and convenient, something which is sorely lacking on this side of campus.  That being said, I really, really dislike how their menu/pricing is set up.  I feel like most of these assembly line Mexican-type places only charge you extra for guacamole; generally the price of the entree includes everything else.  Here, not so; depending on what you order, you could end up paying extra for beans, sour cream, and even cheese; seriously?  The food is tasty here but 3 steak tacos with a cup of water cost me over $12, which is totally insane considering they can be pretty skimpy with the portions.  This same meal at Chipotle would have been around $7, just as tasty, and would have had more food.  Chipotle doesn't make you eat an entire meal with only 2 napkins, either.  

Their nachos here are amazing, but nachos are not an everyday thing for me.  I'll try to stick to the burritos; overall though, I still think Chipotle has a slight edge.

Oh my goodness! The best food I've had in so long! We discovered this little gem last month and have been back about 6 times already! 
The chicken papusa! DELICIOUS! 
Gluten free! Friendly staff, generous chips and salsa bar. 5 stars. order the paco duo! So so good!

The ambiance is amazing. Really cool looking place, I love the idea of being able to have fun there at any time of the day. I love that they have couches and board games! Good drinks, vast menu. I had dinner and I wouldnt say the food was amazing but it was pretty good. I come back for the fun enviroment rather than the food
Food was nasty. I think the burgers are frozen. But I guess it's a wings place. There was nobody else in the place. The server was nice. I'll give it another shot.
We've visited several times when we come to Clearwater Beach, one of the best restaurants on the beach!

The chicken gyros, lamb gyros,  lemon potatoes, Greek yogurt with honey and spanikopitas were delicious! The yogurt needed a lot of honey if you're not used to the strong Greek yogurt.  Servers were nice and service was quick.

I love this place for a few  reasons: 

1) It is open late. I work til 9pm some nights so it's great that I can go to a restaurant, relax, and not have to worry that I'm coming in right before closing. 

2) NO KIDS! I like going to a place and enjoying a great meal without  potentially hearing fits or whining. 

3) The food is just fantastic. I'd recommend the Texas Sized Nachos to share, unless you are extremely hungry; we got them at the $5 happy hour price and I just couldn't finish them. My boyfriend got the Calamari and a taco, and he absolutely loved them. For dessert, the coconut flan is SO GOOD! It's made with coconut milk and is just sweet enough.  We will be back for sure.

4) Excellent servers. Ours took the time to explain the menu, answered what questions we had, and filled our drinks without us waiting. Decor is also very fun and beautiful.

Sorry not a fan - We both got the Pharmacy Burger, the burgers were extremely thin, extremely dry and arrived cold and the bun well I don't want to experience that cold dry dense bun ever again. I don't know if our food sat for awhile while our server BS'd with the other members of the staff there was a lot of that going on or he is just that inattentive. Even though this place wasn't busy it took forever to get our food and all of it was cold and soggy. I did appreciate the root beer being poured like a beer but serving it warm without ice didn't really insinuate the flavors by any means - we asked our server after our food arrived where our drinks were and he replied "they are probably sitting on the bar I noticed them sitting there awhile ago" If I were to review this place on anything but the food or service I could see giving them 4 stars okay it a cool building, but I came here to eat and it was so disappointing. I'm not a huge fan of Sonic Drive-Ins but I've had better burgers there (sorry just trying to give you a visual) this dining experience was that bad.

I really don't see the attraction here - bad parking, mediocre service, horrible food - I find it impossible to think that anyone could rate this burger "the best they've ever had", maybe it started out that way and they lost their vision or it's changed ownership regardless this place was terrible. I've eaten a lot of burgers in my life and this may have been the worst ever and that is no exaggeration...

I love everything about Nadies! In all the years I have been a customer I have never had a bad experience, they even did a spectacular job on my wedding cake! 

The whole wedding cake process was a breeze. I went in to try samples and had fun taste testing and then they delivered right on time and then I even got money back for returning the cake stand pieces too! Sweet! 

The cheese pocket is my cannot-resist treat! And their birthday cakes are all so good and so cheap! You can't beat the price and they add the writing on top for free in 2 minutes. Love it!

I ordered a pizza at 6:13 the time said 80 mins which was already ridiculous but we said whatever it's Friday at dinner time and then by 8:30 we still hadn't received our pizza we called the staff was extremely rude and hung up on us we called back and sat on hold for 30 mins before they answered telling us the pizza was on the way and after 25 mins we FINALLY got out pizza which was cold, it wasn't correct and it burnt with bubbles and halrdly any topping and the wings didn't even have sauce on them. So I went to the store to speak to the manager and he took 15 mins to come talk to me and was very rude and unprofessional. I would recommend going to any other place in the world because you'll probably never even get to eat.

Tried and true. This family has 3-4 stores now and they never dissapoint. 

Get the all you can eat no matter what ;) It's like going around the world !

Not even worth a penny ... more like an Italian fast food, horrible taste, horrible smell, low quality ... just simply go to across street and have something from Cheesecake fac. But never step in this place

Used to be my go-to bar/eatery when I lived in the neighborhood.  Pub & Kitchen and I have had a long and cherishing relationship together (almost three years).  If there are two words that I had to use to describe P&K they'd be "versatility" and "class".

A nice sized list of great draught beers, a full wine menu, and superb food... from pub grub to fine dining.  A beautiful decor of dark wood finishes that somehow fits all seasons.  Massive windows that open wide in spring and summer for great amounts of natural ventilation.  An attractive and more mature crowd free of college bros.  Outdoor dining in nice weather.  The list goes on and on.  You can take a date here for dinner, you can take your best friend here for beers, or you can take your parents here to prove to them you don't live in da hood.

I don't live in philly anymore, but I keep finding my way back here whenever I'm in town, which is no easy feat.  Much praise P&K.

Give me Whiz or give me death. After walking around the stomping grounds of our nations forefathers, hubby and I went to the intersection where Geno's and Pat's duke it out daily,  with ongoing rivalry for the best sandwich. 

Let me just say, fellow Americans, that Pat's took my breath away in more ways than one. The cheese! The cheese! Let us stand and rejoice! Who would have thought that Cheese Whiz would be such an integral part of a Philly cheese steak sandwich? I would have honestly never tried it, but a coworker of mine swore up and down that this fake cheese was better than the viewing of the Liberty Bell itself... and she was right. Deliciousness rang, folks, loud and clear above the lines of hungry patrons, looking to free their tired, their weary, and their huddled taste buds. 

This is the stop for the best. Geno's? Yeah, they may have signs that diss people who can't fluently speak English... But you know what my momma said? When you can't say nuthin' nice, you shouldn't say nuthin' at all. Relying on bad manners for media coverage is a travesty, and when you have a great sammie across the street at Pat's.. well, I guess you gotta do something to make yourself well known.

I rarely give my opinion or just bad reviews of restaurants but I had to chime in here.  I have ordered (3) times from food delivery services to get Popeyes from this location in the past 5 months.  All three times my Postmates, Uber, etc order was either given to someone else, delayed so long until they closed, and/ or cancelled by the drivers 

All 3 times it was not the drivers fault but this locations fault.  I live close and they are not crazy busy so I am not sure if they just don't care about any orders that are NOT coming from their drive thru.

Popeyes is a good sandwich and good franchise that post all these food delivery promotions but not this location either can't keep up or doesn't deem them to be worth their time.

I will take my business elsewhere.  Thank you.

This place hits the spot when it comes to wanting cheesy greasy food and their big daddy pizza is delicious.  The owner is always extremely friendly, but the staff isn't the greatest. Don't expect excellent service.  There's also no seating available so plan to eat outside or somewhere else.
Great food! Drinks are decent! Happy hour prices are good! Service can be miserable at times!

Daisy Dukes was located very close to the hotel I stayed at. It's very convenient that's it's open 24/7 and the food is tasty. Their menu is huge and there so many options to choose from. I got to try the Rajun Cajun Shrimp Po Boy and an omelette. They weren't the best food I've had in NOLA but pretty good. I appreciated that the service was attentive and fast.

This location has not been open very long. Husband and I wanted to try it out as it's something different than the regular. There were only a few people eating in. Our wait time for food wasn't bad. I did notice that as they got busy, people were having to wait a little longer than us. I ordered an original taco which i personally feel could have had a little more cheese on the shell but was still good and a bean burrito with the side chips and queso dip. The queso dip comes in 4 or 8 oz. we got the 8oz and it was too much. My husband had the street fries and tacos. He said although all was good he wished the street fries had a little more fries and steak. Seemed a little flat to him. The soda machine was broke and they were currently trying to get it up and working. The walls inside was a little bare. Inside has plenty of tables and plenty of parking. We will definitely try them out again.
Tried their Pho Today and its one of the best I've had in the Tampa Bay area.  Atmosphere was great and it service was good.

This place is truly a gem!! I first ordered breakfast for the hubby and I over DoorDash. They did make a mistake with one of the meals but they took care of the issue quickly and even had it delivered. This place goes above and beyond for their customers and the food is soooo good. I highly recommend this place if you are looking for something yummy and fresh. Thank you D'licious caffe for making my experience amazing.

Have had take-out dinner here several times and it's yet to disappoint. Chicken Marsala and Chicken Savoy are both outstanding--well seasoned and flavorful--savoy in particular will keep me coming back. Pasta, vegetables, and chicken soup are excellent and well above the median line of typical south jersey Italian joints. There are many such pizza places in the Medford area, and I can safely the food here is as good as any. Definitely worth a try! Will come back.

A new, closer purveyor of the many splendoured Modern Times offerings. Been twice now and the menu has changed enough to make a flight a new and exciting experience. Great Cuban food in house and parking around the corner. This is a well-appointed and generously-tapped location.
Let's get right to the point...l think we should rename this place "The Red Outhouse".
This place is worth seeking out.  A little hard to find,  but it's a hidden secret.  Everything is vegan and very good.

I normally don't do this.. I actually made fun of people who Yelp'd things because they only do it to leave negative reviews and complain.
But I have to say, my experience at this particular Fords Garage was so good, I made an account just to leave this review.
Our server Chris was phenomenal. He was attentive, charismatic, and all around great at his job.
If you ever find yourself in the area, do yourself a favor and stop in and ask for Chris.
Great food, great service.
10/10.

We ate here for Mother's Day. We have eaten at downtown location quite a few times and have always had fantastic food and great service. Sadly, that wasn't the case today. We made reservations and we were seated quickly, that was where the "quick" ended. I ordered the pre fixe 4 course brunch, the rest of my family ordered off the brunch menu. The first two courses came out in a reasonable amount of time, then the rest of my family's food was served. They finished their meals and we continued to wait... and wait some more for my 3rd and 4th courses. I finally had them box it up so I could leave with my family, who had finished their meals. I was disappointed with the service and the amount of time we waited. Our food was really good though.

This place gets five stars all around. After driving around for literally half an hour looking for parking (just Uber and thank me later) my boyfriend and I walked in to the cutest Mexican spot. Frida is all over the walls of course, it's very vibrant and colorful (in true Mexican fashion), and very cozy. We both ordered steak tacos, and I ordered the traditional margarita. Before they brought our food out we were given complimentary chips and salsa (as it should be). The salsa was yummy! Both the green and red salsa were spicy, but not too spicy. Then my delicious margarita was brought out. It was really good. Just as a note they have a lot of margarita flavors, so next time I will try the guava for sure! Then they brought the tacos out. You get three in your meal, which is a great deal for the price. The steak was well seasoned, tender, juicy, and delicious! The music was nice and chill (pretty sure they were playing Mexican ballads in the beginning). 

Lastly, the service was great! The waiter checked on us just enough were we felt attended to, but not so much that we felt like he was hovering. 

I love this place and this is definitely bae and I's New Mexican date night spot in Philly!

I have been a supporter for years but I think they have grown beyond their capacity to provide the level of service they once did.  I ordered to go by phone and came in to find the staff overwhelmed and unable to help me get my food.  Only after telling the manager my name and realizing that she had completely spaced on getting my food I had to take it upon myself to find my food after waiting for 20 minutes in the very crowded restaruant.  I would suggest the one on de la vina as milpas is soo busy and crazy nobody there know wtf is going on they are running around like chickens with their head cut off

If you're the type of guy who would like to have 5 star quality food, but also not feel like you'd be judged for getting right ripped and arm wrestling you're ex-girlfriend who you're still sleeping with because she claims that she's stronger than you and wants to prove it to the two random people you met at R Bar and then invited to dinner after your other friends got too drunk at the Drifter to make it to dinner, then THIS is the place for you my friend!

The red fish amandine is one of my favorite meals in a city full of them, and the duck fat popcorn is first place in the "shit I make fun of on a menu, especially for $6 that's so fucking stupid, what kind of asshole orders that-oh wow the ppl we're eating with just did, what a bunch idiots-oh wow this is actually delicious and *I* am the idiot for thinking this was stupid and actually they should be charging $60 for this it's my new favorite food" department.

P.S. I did lose the arm wrestling contest, but ONLY because I'm a gentleman.

Small, very quaint shop with a hidden patio out back.  Serves La Colombe, pastries and charcuterie.  The guy (owner) behind the counter makes it even better, a warm, gracious and welcoming host.  Thumbs up!

Love this place! Used to live up the block from this here. Always stop in when I'm in the neighborhood. I remember when they were just a taco truck and I could only order these on a Saturday. Fresh and local ingredients! Breakfast tacos and coffee = great start to your day!

I had dinner here 8-16-2014. 
Great Sushi! I had the Sake House Special and the Volcano! Great service and the prices are very reasonable!

Came in and got seated right away, waitresses were AWESOME. Quick to take our order, get us our food and ANYTHING else that we needed. Loved the atmosphere and positive energy radiating from everyone there. Food was also INCREDIBLE. You will most likely see me here every weekend!

Our favorite Mexican food in Reno. Authentic and flavorful. The ingredients are always fresh and everything tastes homemade. The staff is warm and friendly and they even remember what we like to drink. I don't think there is a better restaurant for Mexican food in Northern Nevada.

The sushi fish here are not fresh at all compare to other sushi place in town. I'm a sushi lover and I only eat nigiri . The menu they have has not been updated in awhile.  But if you ask for chef special in long rolls they always have something good.the service is top notch they have the best chef in town.

This is a review of $1 raw oysters on Sundays. The best things about a late Sunday night snack (9:00 PM) are 1) arriving at the restaurant and finding a parking spot at the door.  2) it's Sunday, so street parking is FREE. 3) the dinner crowd has left. 4) no waiting for a seat at the bar. 5) A BUCK A SHUCK.   6) bread and pickled veggies are included. 7) AND MOST IMPORTANTLY, the oysters are FRESH!

Great addition to the Rittenhouse restaurants. Came for Christmas Eve dinner and wasn't disappointed! Seating took about 10 minutes, longer than expected with a reservation but service was very pleasant. Atmosphere is romantic and warm. Cocktails and food are great! Definitely would recommend the rolls with chive butter, fried chicken, and the BROCCOLI is to die for. Who would have thought it would be such a stand out? 

Would definitely come again.

@Ramen is a welcome addition to the philly ramen scene.  This casual eatery is centrally located along Main St. in Manayunk, and it's a spot you won't want to miss.  I tried the tonkatsu ramen and was really pleased.  The broth was pretty well rounded and had enough umami depth to make me feel full but not food coma full.  The noodles were cooked well too with a good amount of chew.  The only thing that could probably use work is the pork, the two slices I got had good char but not much more flavor wise.  It had the doneness of a chip so I didn't particularly care for it.  If it was perhaps sliced a little thicker with a little more jelly like fat and some more pork taste I'd be hooked.  The other glaringly awesome thing about this place is its service.  Our server was fantastic and attentive and seemed to handle the place well on her own and never once rushed us out of seat giving @Ramen a really nice neighborhood gathering place feel.  If you're craving noodles on main street @Ramen is a must try!
Very good meal at Conners, great steak, deMonaco was amazing, celebrating my sons graduation form college

First timers, the 2 of us ordered a bean & cheese burrito, 2 orders of cheese enchiladas, and a shrimp taco, all à la carte.  If you don't eat meat, as we do, the lard was obvious.  There was too much for the 2 of us, so we brought home one of the enchilada orders. I got talked out of throwing it out, because the cheese wasn't even melted.  The burrito was plenty to eat by itself, but again, the lard will prevent us from returning.  Plenty to eat, but poorly prepared, what apparently we got with one $.
Omg, so good! Limited menu, but it was all delicious! Highly recommend the mahi mahi tacos and speciality guacamole! Wish this was close to home.

We Came here the 2th day from our nice trip.....This sushi here is sooo good here...I came here last year with my partner and we loved it here very much......the rolls start from 12-13$ dollars and up but it's worth it......it gets pack here in the afternoon and night...we got here on a Friday night .....people drink good Japaneses beer and warm Saki always get the tofu rolls with some energy rolls....OMG GOOD GOOD!....we will be coming agenda soon...

Where do I even begin? The pizza was amazing. We ordered an 18 inch pizza, garlic knots, and a salad.  We placed order online and went to pick it up. I was pleasantly surprised that online orders have a separate pick up window. I was able to get my food quickly and get home to eat it. We ordered four garlic knots covered in garlic and olive oil and they came with a side of marinara. The salad was just ok. I was excited to see however they had a creamy balsamic vinaigrette dressing which was delightful. For our pizza we ordered a half cheese for the kiddos and half Super Bianca. OMG  it was delicious. We were in pizza heaven as we gobbled down the huge New York cut slices. I would absolutely recommend this place if you are looking to have pizza for dinner.
I go there often usually at late hours even everything is closed..It's the perfect midnight food..the torta Mexican sandwich is the best thing to get there.

Wow, where to start. We're from the Nashville area (25 yrs) and have many choices for a nice dinner. This is not one I will return to or recommend to our friends. Upon walking in, very cool decor. Greeted and showed our seats of our reservations. 6 of us squished into a booth. Ordered cocktails: only high end vodka left (upcharged the high end), out of bourbon we wanted. Ordered the prix fixe menu... out of the dessert, as well as the cream brûlée. When we asked for a substitute we were told the chef would only allow us one option, not our choice. Our waitress was okay but after a night of being told they were out of many things, she was not accommodating at all. Our appetizers were wrong, and waited a long time to have them replaced. Waited even longer to order our dinner. My husband ordered a salad with a balsamic dressing. When it was delivered it had a different dressing and he asked again for the balsamic. Waitress reply, "will that dressing do?"  No it won't. Then was charged extra for the dressing!! Our food was good, but by this point, the experience ruined our dinner. We Won't Be Back! Many options in Nashville and Franklin that put customer service first!

Lambertis is in a small shopping center,  The restaurant is small, with a bar and no lounge. The decor is simple and clean.

The menu is very extensive offering a wide array of appetizers, soups, salads, pasta dishes and seafood,  Pizza's of all kinds including gourmet.  Chicken  or veal entrees, panini's and homemade desserts!

They make their own fresh Mozzarella and roast their own marinated peppers and this is a good choice for an appetizer or salad course.  Their clams casino are good, mine are better and the fried zucchini is the best!

My husband had the spaghetti with sausages, peppers and onions and he can not wait to go back, he especially loved their sauce. 

I had the shrimp parmesan, which had a good half dozen jumbo shrimp, which were perfectly cooked.  I personally could use a bit more basil, oregano and seasonings in my sauce, but next time I will just ask.

Save your money from going to Toscana's, this local Italian restaurant does not have all the glitz, but it certainly delivers on the food and service! 

I thought it was neat, how mid day they pushed a bunch of tables together and brought out huge bowls of salads, pastas and the best looking cheese steak hoagies I have seen,  Then they all sat down together to eat!  The entire staff and owners seemed to be Italian and once in awhile spoke their own language. You know it's going to be good, when it is in their blood!

www.lambertis.com
Just got here from Northern Virginia, this place is amazing, unbelievable pizza, great ingredients, can't go wrong, if you don't like this, please tell me what's better
Subs are the best and the customer service here is outstanding. My wife and I come here every week. Always get them "Mikes Way".

Cute place, friendly servers, we stopped here twice. Once at outside patio bar, had apps and bloody Mary's. Second time ate in restaurant, had an assortment of food. I had the grouper, was very good and plentiful. Friend had the crab claws, 7 of them on the medium plate, we all shared with her, very good. I was surprised at the casual appearance of the dining room, kind of like red lobster, which was ok, didn't like that you get water in plastic glasses.

I've gone to flemming's a few times and I must say they make a pretty good steak. My favorite is their bone in rib eye. The meat is tender, juicy and cooked just the way you want it. Their wine selection is pretty good if you go during happy hour it's a pretty good value. The appetizers are ok, didn't care much for the pork belly as I felt the sauce was not complimentary of the fat in the pork belly. Nice atmosphere with dim lighting and nice dark rich decor. Overall a satisfying experience, a bit on the pricey side but I'd rather pay more for a steak I enjoy that to be disappointed by a less expensive but not enjoyable culinary experience.

Went here with my boyfriend and were seated upstairs at a small table near the window. There was quite a selection of drinks. We ordered several dishes but my favorite was definitely the chicken pot pie! So flaky, buttery and delicious and definitely a must try. Dishes were a little pricey for what you get but overall good food, good service.
Friendly service and awesome food as always! The chicken fingers, fries, burgers and shakes are amazing! Oh and they have a sweet happy hour menu with cheap tasty drinks!

after many years we decided to try them  out again and it was terrible.  Got there at a little after 5 and the place was literally empty.  We waited for ever to get waited on.  Another server kept passing by us and waiting on another table but ours left us sitting there.  We got our food and my order was wrong.  I ordered ribs with fries and a salad.  I got the salad but they served mashed potatoes and some sort of cumber salad I think it was with my ribs.  The potatoes were dried out and the ribs had to be pried off the bones.  If I was to guess they were left in the window for a long time before they were served.  Well we told the server and he went to get me fries and came back with mac n cheese.  He then offered to get the fries and I decliend.  Meal was soo bad I just wanted to leave.  The manager did take the ribs off the check but I still cant believe that as slow as they were the food and service could be so bad.  Been many years since I have been there and probably will be many years if I go back.  Too many other BBQ places in the area.

Stop playing around and eat here. If you live in Tampa and haven't been here you should be ashamed of yourself. Cafeteria style food with the baddest Dominican flavors. The owner is legit and super friendly and cool. Support local business and stop giving five star reviews to The Cheesecake Factory you incompetent ass fake foodie! 

James

We have been here a handful of times and recommend it to many friends. The last two times we were there the food seemed sub par. The mussels that we always order were not edible the last two visits so it was less than pleasurable. The staff has always been top notch.

I've never been charged for hot water. I order a coffee and a hot water. I've always been charged $1.09 after taxes. Today My total wat $2.18. Juan (the manager) charged me for 2 coffees and tried to tell me that they always charge for water. McDonald's employees and employers are stealing from us now.

Pacos $1.25 taco deal is always a family favorite. The tacos meat is always seasoned well. The food is cooked in front of you and cooked fresh to order. The service is quick and polite. The interior is bright and great for  eating in. The Groupon deal is an extra bonus for those ballin on a budget!!

This place deserves like 20 stars. Chipotle ain't got shot on Taco Maya. The food is amazing here, I always explain it to be the authentic chiptole. More options in everything here and their roared tomato salsa is to die for. They give you great portions and you even get chips with your burrito!!! Every time we are home we hit this place and have never been disappointed with anything!!

Let me first say, Jill's Place has by far the best steaks in town! Their wait staff is superb (their manager is simply incredible) and their bartenders (especially Willy) make the best drinks in SB. Jill, the owner, can be found there on any given night and is always a pleasure to have at the bar. If you're looking for a great steak or burger, look no further. And if you are in the mood for a delicious (and strong) cocktail, just ask Willy to make you an Old Manfashion, a signature drink at Shalhoob's.

This place has become my go-to place. You can always get a good burger and a decent drink. The servers are always nice and helpful. And although it might be a bit noisy- I love eating out on the porch. I'm not too fond of eating in the tent however and the live music on the weekends has been pretty bad the two times I've gone recently - in fact it has actually stopped me from coming back. CDs and a sound system would be much preferred _ or no music would be better that that music.

I went for lunch and got the Goat Nuggets and TGB Burger.  It wasn't bad, but I was not wowed.  The Goat Nuggets were highly recommended, and basically chicken poppers.  Well fried and good, but not amazing.  The burger was solid as well.  A bit burnt, which I do not enjoy.  Flavors had sweetness from the caramelized onions and the buttery brioche bread.  I think I will give it another try and try other items on the menu.

Food was great and the server was great however the manager on duty suck. She was very rude and clap her hands at us just to find a pen of hers in which I'm sure she could have got another pen from somewhere else in the restaurant if I was to go back and she her working I wouldn't go back at all.

Hands down, best ribs I have ever had.  I have traveled the U.S. and these are the real deal.  The cherry wood smoke makes them fantastic.  They are perfect.  If you want to add one of the four sauces, it adds to the experience, but totally unnecessary.  They are perfect without it.  I also had the burnt ends -- again perfect.  The fried corn and green beans made a nice complement to the ribs.  Don't go too late as they will run out.  I went around 1 p.m. and waited for about 30 minutes.  Totally worth the wait.  I would have waited longer, but glad that I did not have to.

Have always wanted to try City Diner and finally got the opportunity to this weekend. My friend and I came on Saturday afternoon around 1/2 pm and it was empty enough that we could be seated immediately. 
Between the two of us we ordered French onion soup, a cheese omelet with home fries and toast and French toast. 
The food came out so fast that I was only able to take two bites of my soup before my food camp which definitely was a downfall because while I was eating my soup, my omelet got cold as I wasn't eating touching it. 
The French toast was absolutely delicious. It was so fluffy and well cooked. The home fries were also delicious. 
I would definitely come back here again and again. So wonderful that they are open 24/7 and have an alcohol license!

I lived in Philly for about 2 years and this is by far the restaurant I miss the most. It's almost embarrassing how often I used to come here, but good vegetarian fast food is hard to come by! My favorite was always the crispy hip city ranch, but just about everything I tried was delicious. The green lemonade is awesome and so are the fries. The only thing I was not a fan of was the burger, but that's just because I tend to prefer actual beans and veggies in my burgers. 

I'm not sure why people complain about the pricing here. Its Philly, things are expensive, and they use high quality ingredients.

It seems to be a trend here I work till midnight and stopped in for some food and a beer and after waiting for almost 10 minutes I stood up and put on my jacket and then the bartender wanted to serve me, but by then I spotted the Wendy's and hit the drive thru.

Despite living less than 3 blocks from this tavern, it is my place of last resort and tonight continued to prove why. A party of 5 took almost 40 minutes to be seated despite there being empty tables. Twice I asked why we could not be seated sooner and was met with either millennial malaise, that is lack of being proactive and creative, or met with a lame excuse to where they were putting the band. Finally seated at high tops which were less than desirable but after waiting 40 minutes, what were our options? We waited a ridiculous amount of time for food and were treated like second class citizens. When delivering one meal of five and asked by a waitress who appeared high whether we were waiting for other food, it was truly laughable. Drinks were slow. Will seriously consider whether to ever come back based on bad service and truly lack of caring that we were even paying customers. Good luck!

This Chipotle is not one that I visit often because of the service I've experienced which seems to be the same when I go here. Absolutely love Chipotle but how can 1 location always be extremely slow, always out of food and slow to restock on the pass, and always have stale kids chips!? It's because of the employees you've got running your shifts. The last time I was here OMG...the fajita veggies weren't cooked enough, the salsa was watery, the kids chips were stale, then the girl at the register places my orders on the tray and spills my salsa all over the tray. Proceeds to continue to place my stuff on the dirty tray and ring me up. Ummmm no! Not gonna work. Had to actually ask for a clean tray which I got a nasty look and a huff for. Ridiculous to treat your customers this way.

I had the generals chicken lunch special. The salad was great, but The chicken was very heavily breaded and the sauce was too thick and seemed super artificial, which was off-putting. It wasn't bad, but I've had better. I definitely would not order it again. The staff were excellent though, great service.

I went back and ordered one of the crabs in the aquariums prepared salt & pepper style.  It was AWESOME.  Price = $30 but enough to feed two.  And it was less than 5 minutes from tank to table... talk about fresh.

I had heard good things about Loren & Mari's so we decided to go tonight. It was excellent!! The guacamole was amazing. The food was very good and arrived fairly quickly. Service was great. We will be back!!

Guppy's looks, acts, and smells like a typical neighborhood taproom.  Then your order food.  The menu is cleverly disguised as bar food but SO MUCH BETTER!  Their "Poutine" is straight out of Montreal; hand-cut french fries with gravy and cheese curds.  Order a burger, any burger; they're amazing.

I like this place a lot! I don't go to Lumiere often but when I'm there, Stadium it is. I was there tonight at a Blues game viewing party and finally got to try the food, and boy am I glad I did. (Sports are going to make me fat, by the way. I'm pretty sure I haven't stopped eating out since the Blues season started & it only got worse during the World Series. It's no joke anymore. But I digress.)

We got a couple of different things, one being the burger, and it was just alright. Nothing too special, except that it came with... oh dear God... the most amazing steak fries on the planet! Perfectly cooked and seasoned just right, I dare you to try and just eat one. Funny how I tried that and soon the whole basket was gone. We also had the mac'n'cheese (loaded with Italian ham, basil, riccotta & fontina cheese -- yeah, it's as good as it sounds.) We considered doing the man vs. reuben challenge but then I remembered that I only have one stomach instead of four, so there went that. :( The menu as a whole is great though... steak, pizza, pasta, ribs, loaded tator tots. Solid.

If you want a dessert, definitely go for the warm chocolate brownies. It's actually bite-sized pieces of brownies deep fried and served with cinnamon ice cream. I just laughed out loud while I wrote that because I can't believe how badly & how much I ate tonight, but it was just so good! 

There are tons of TV's here, a friendly staff, and a really big bar to sit at while you watch the game and eat. I don't really have many negatives for this place and I hope it sticks around for a good long time!

"Latte" seemed like regular drip coffee with a bit of warm milk. Menu said $4, but was charged $10.25 for two lattes, not sure how they calculated the extra $2.25 in there. Also last time I was in here, purchased food and paid the server in cash. Server "forgot" to give me my change.... A significant amount, and then when I asked for my change back said she had already given it to me. No one else in there at the time so not sure how that got mixed up. Nice location but not impressed with the service or quality of food and drink for the price. 

Your review helps others learn about great local businesses.

Please don't review this business if you received a freebie for writing this review, or if you're connected in any way to the owner or employees.I will be there. Thanks

my boyfriend and I went here for dinner and it was a nice experience :) we each got a caipirinha to drink which was good and my boyfriend LOVED the stroganoff! My Brazilian cesar was good and the brigadiero which we got to go was AMAZING! I would go back to try more! The lady told us to make ourselves at home which was a sweet sentiment!! The people were very nice :,)

I have only been to Harp & crown for weekend brunch.  I love it!  It's a nice. fun space--especially near the entrance where there is lots of light.  The buffet has a nice selection of cold and hot foods.  There is also a great brunch drink special on mimosas and Bloody Mary's.  I highly recommend this as a brunch spot and I look forward to trying an evening meal!

This was our 2nd pick for Restaurant Week, and it was definitely a great one! We had a 7:30pm reservation, and were seated right on time. It seems like the servers kind of rotate through all of the tables, and they were all very friendly and attentive.

There were plenty of options available on the menu, which is always nice. I chose the avocado green salad, the fried veggie gyoza, and the sushi veggie style combo. My boyfriend also went with the salad, and then chose the zushi with salmon, and the white tiger roll. 

The salad portion was the most generous I've seen at a Japanese restaurant- with loads of fresh leafy greens, peppers, avocado, cucumbers, tomatoes, and cabbage. The veggie gyoza was very delicious- typically there's something about the green dough that I don't like, but these were excellent through and through. The sushi veggie style was amazing- one the most unique and flavorful veggie rolls I've ever had. My boyfriend thoroughly enjoyed his selections as well. I did try a bite of the zushi, and thought that it was very tasty. In addition to our restaurant week selections, he ordered the bulgogi donburi, which he said was not very good, unfortunately. We tasted the mochi ice cream, but were both very full and not very interested in it, to be honest.

I had the spirited away cocktail with dinner, and it was very nice and not overly sweet like some elderflower drinks can be. I know that we would both like to return at some point in the future!

This restaurant is amazing! We went for the first time last week, after hearing great things from family and friends. Delicious coffee, cocktails, and entrees, as well as a friendly staff and owner. Tucson finally has a fantastic breakfast restaurant!

The day when taco bus was just "The Taco Bus" and when they had lengua. And when the location near USF no one believed me was really a Taco Bus...now finally has its sign. 3 stars simply because...where's my lengua? The burritos have shrunk and locations have grown. Why close St. Pete Central Ave too? Place has just become an ok chain. Good spot for late night after hours, sober up mode.

This is a really fun place. It had multiple dining levels and the energy was positive. We didn't get a chance to eat because we had to leave for a boating venture, but we were able to stop in for a beverage before we had to board. The bartender was very quick. This place is a great place to people watch. We hope to go back soon to eat!

This steakhouse is like no other in St. Louis. I was absolutely blown away at how delicious my meal was. I ordered the Certified Hereford Bone-In Ribeye and twice baked potato. I asked for medium rare and I got medium rare. It was so tasty. Their customer service is the best a customer could ask for at any restaurant. I want to personally thank them for a great experience.

Lark, the Elmi angels sing, glory to the new burb king!

We had an amazing dinner last Friday. Service was impeccable (decrumbing the table and new plates after every course, friendly waiters, and the chef himself even made time for a selfie). Shout-out to our  waiter Danny who made the night even more fun (and added a candle to dessert for my friend's birthday)!

For cocktails we started with a mezcal pineapple cocktail served in a tiki glass and then had a fair amount of wine. We loved the decadent uni devilled eggs and charred brassicas. The lobster squid ink pasta and truffle ravioli were delicious and the steak and duck were cooked perfectly. For dessert we opted for the lemon cake and chocolate bar. We were not expecting the bar to come out wrapped (great to take to go), but once we unwrapped it and tasted the hazelnut cream inside we took back our initial underwhelmed thoughts.

The bill was not cheap, definitely a splurge (about $100 pp), but cheaper than Elmi's city spot Laurel, and cutting down on wine could have significantly reduced the bill. The ambiance is great too, great lighting and high ceiling, but not too loud if it want to bring your mom or grandma.

Great spot to celebrate a special occasion or convince your city friends to come out for a city caliber restaurant on the Main Line.

Best bagels in St. Pete/Tampa area. Handmade, fresh daily with AMAZING customer service.  Pumpernickel everything is always my go to and I get "double toasted" for extra crunch! The veggie cream cheese is my favorite, but you really cannot go wrong with your selection here. You will not be disappointed! All the northern transplants, you will love this place! 

I want to try their tempting donut selection soon, made fresh daily as well. You have to get them fast, as they sell out quick!!! 

You will never have to worry about the bagels selling out before you get here, though. Well... what are you waiting for?!?!

Man, what can I say about Cochon Butcher?!! My wife and I heard about this place from some friends while we were out and they told us that we should try it. Now, being that we are from Southeast Louisiana, but now living in Nashville, just like everyone else from that region, we remain skeptical when a restaurant advertises anything pertaining to a taste of where we are from. It's just who we are. No one does it like us Cajuns !! Anyways, we saw that they have hogs head cheese and boudin (pronounced: boo-dan) which are foods that we grew up on as kids and still enjoy and stock up on when we go home for the holidays.

So, we arrived had a couple of drinks at their bar. I had a beer and my wife had the "Pimp Cup". It is a mixed drink in a rocks sized glass. Not sure what is in it but it was good.. It was however $11. No complaints, its Germantown. High drink prices are expected. Rent is not cheap in that area, I understand.

So we ordered some food. What you ask?!! Of course boudin and hogs head cheese !!! Pay attention. Let me tell ya, don't skip either of them !! The hogs head cheese was on point. They call it head cheese but trust me, its the real deal and tastes exactly like my friends and family back home used to make. Now the boudin.....ohhhhhhh the boudin !!!! Talk about delicious. Filled with pork, rice, and just enough spices to make you want to go and, well.....(cue Johnny Depp in the movie Once Upon a Time in Mexico talking about "restoring the balance"). After we were done with that we ordered a Cubano. It was good, not the best I have had but definitely far from being the worst. I am not what you would call a Cuban aficionado.

Our bill was about $50. Before you say "that's crazy" its because we also bought a pound of boudin to go so that we can cook it later which was about $10 or $11. I'm telling you, it was as good as home. How could we not buy some?!! Nice to find a place where we can get a taste of home at a fairly decent price along with many other things that they offer.

In all honesty, give this place a try, you will not be disappointed I assure you. It is a little on the pricey ($$) but not by much. As previously stated,  it's Germantown in Nashville, its not cheap to open up shop in the area so the prices are understandable. Apparently some people can't grasp that.

That's all I'm saying !!!
Amazing experience great food NY strip was perfect my wife got the gnocchi with steak she loved good service

Hadn't been here in a while, but after almost a year, I was pleasantly surprised! They have changed things up a bit for the better. For the money, I don't think there is a better sushi place in SB. 

Definitely recommended.

In all actuality I would give the Den 6 stars, even though I'm only allowed to put 5.  I'm writing an update because I moved back to South Philly in June and this has become my new bar to go to.  

I have one complaint about the DD, there aren't enough good servers here.  There are two I really like and the other two I can't stand.  There was another I liked as well, but he's gone now.  If they upped the ante and got a few more awesome servers then this place would be more awesome than it already is.

Onto the good stuff now.  They have two full time bartenders that you could almost count on being there every time.  Both of them, one a man and one a woman are probably the two best bartenders in all of Philadelphia.  Both are sarcastic, witty, and always quick to pour a beer.  We're on a first name basis with each other now too which is pretty awesome because now it just feels like my very own Cheers every time I stop in to sit at the bar.  I actually have to stop over there(maybe tonight after a ridiculously long day at school) to talk to the lady bartender about the Phillies landing Roy Halladay.  She's even more gun ho about the Phillies than I am which is insanely hard to believe.

The Atmosphere is great.  It is really clean and kept very nice.  The bar is really long which I like so there is plenty of room to sit down and watch a Phillies or Sixers game.  There are double sided fire places so in the winter I get to drink a beer by a cozy fireplace.  In the summer their big double door windows are open so the fresh air comes in.  I think this place gets so many piss poor reviews because it is actually clean thus making it non hipster friendly.  

Onto the rest of the great stuff about the Den.  The food is excellent.  I'm completely shocked I have seen two bad reviews on the food here.  There may be more, but I've only found two thus far.  It must have just been a bad experience one time or something.  I wouldn't be surprised because no establishment is going to be perfect every time.  I for one have never had a bad experience with the food here.  It is a little pricey, but it's no more pricey than the other gastro pubs in the neighborhood.  For anyone reading this that wants to go grab a bite and a beer at the Devil's Den then I'll suggest what I like there:  The French Dog, the Burger, the Cuban, the Pulled Pork Sandwich, and the Fried Zucchini are all out of this world.  I hear the vegan food is excellent as well, but being the fat kid carnivore I am if I'm spending $9 on a meal I want meat with it.  

The beer selection is one of the best in the city aside from the obvious places like Monk's and Eulogy.  The prices are all reasonable as well.  The Happy Hour is incredible, half price draughts and unlike their counterparts down Passyunk the Devil's Den actually has a reasonable Happy Hour 5-7 unlike the other two places which I speak of whose Happy Hour's are 4-6.  

Lastly, I have to write about the perk of the Devil's Den card.  I'm an alcoholic and I love food, so I'm at the Devil's Den often especially considering it is two blocks from my apt.  They have this little card that the staff swipes for me every time I go there.  Once you get to $300 on the card they give a $25 food credit which is awesome because it is a free meal.  The best is when I go with a large group of people and the tab is like $200.  

Anyway, I could go on forever about how awesome the Devil's Den is so I'll just stop here.  Next time you happen to be in South Philly and are looking for a bar to have a beer and dinner then I highly recommend stopping in the Devil's Den.

Cute buzzy bistro with a luscious roast chicken that could feed a family (in this case fed two) and interesting sweet potato mole side. Wait staff galore want to engage you in chitchat. Delivered a tasty parsnip soup amuse bouche that leaves a good impression. Tables so close together enables easy eavesdropping.

Barbuzzo late night is great. 

Love ability to add arugula to any pizza. 

Also attended a wedding here. The flowers were beautiful and service staff was very attentive.
My favorite place for fresh guacamole. Great food, and fast service. Request Taylor she's the best server!

My wife and I just celebrated our 32nd anniversary at Acqua Alta and could not have been more satisfied. The owner Paulo took it upon himself (along with his wife) to make our special night more than memorable. This was our first time in for dinner (and definitely will not be our last), so Paulo introduced us to the menu, and the many different aspects of our meal. My wife advised him that she is on a vegan diet, and Paulo lit up with all the different options they have to offer for this particular diet. After a complimentary cup of soup and fresh bread, we both shared one of the eggplant appetizers which was simply delicious. My wife chose the fresh vegan pasta dish with sautéed vegetables, and I chose one of the daily specials, homemade rigatoni, fresh sausage, and vegetables. Both meals were cooked to order and in a word amazing. After dinner we were treated to a homemade dessert made from fresh pizza dough stuff with homemade marmalade and a delicious fruit drizzle. All in all the meal was excellent and the service impeccable. We will be back soon to further explore the menu.
Very good food andservice. They are very attentive and friendly. The athmospere is nice and classy. We been here many times and we will keep coming back. The food has a lot of taste into it.

Found myself here this past Thursday night for the bar's birthday!  I didn't know they turned one year old this week, or I would have bought them a cutsy card.  But they gave everyone free margs and cake at midnight.  Joe Gunn, the owner, sat down with us for a bit and let us try his beer.  I had fun.

Wow this place is awesome. We came here on a Saturday night and had a ton of different choices when it comes to food. They also had a circus of sorts with a woman hula hooping with fire, crazy!!'

The food: 
We got a Barbacoa Quesadilla and a Chicken Tostada. The quesadilla was incredible albeit a little greasy. The tostada was also good, but wasnt as big of a meal as the quesadilla.  Our server was super nice too, and was telling us if we needed anything feel free to waive her down and ask. 

The dessert:
We tried both a sweet crepe and a mint chocolate chip paleta the crepe was filled with chocolate, strawberries, and walnuts. It was really good, but the paleta was the star of the show. 

Overall, this place is like an upscale latin food court, and is truly awesome! Give it a shot.

As a big fan of Bamboo Terrace, I knew I would become a big fan of this place too.
It is an odd location, but convenient for me, other than having to make a uturn to get there.
The first time there, one of the owners gave us a sample of a dish the chef was trying, and it
was amazing.  I said put it in the menu so I can have it whenever I think about it.  It was an enchilada with a creamy cheese sauce...mmmm.  But I didn't see it on the menu so I just got a chimichanga.  The best I have ever had.  Now I know you are saying,it's a chimi, how hard is that.  It was light and crispy.  They use nice thin tortillas so you don't get a mouthful of dough.  I even had the all the extras and still crispy all the way to thru.  Now I want another one....
My friends all liked what they had as well, which I did t attention to.  We also had a chorizo cheese dip that delish too.  
My only complaint is the chairs are not comfy unless your butt is the size of an 8 yr old.  But I'll suffer thru that.

So many good things to say about han Lao. I stay at the nearby hotel often for work and it's a great place for dinner whenever I'm in town. The cooks prepare very authentic cuisine with a passion for what they're making, sit at the bar and you can provide some input on just how spicy you want it. My one complaint is I have on a few occasions had very slow and inefficient service, not enough to lose a star but something to work on. Will be back many more times in the future

We had a lovely brunch in a private igloo. It was a nice experience, our kids loved it! The food was fantastic (I have never had a sub par meal here). The blackened lobster was delicious! My only complaint is that I couldn't eat another bite, stick a fork in me Im done :P

I was hoping for more when I first decided to try this place out. Like most people, I was interested to try a pizza baked at 900 degrees for only 90 seconds. Sounds impressive, right? Unfortunately it fell flat. I gave them a second chance and again it just didn't wow me.

Admittedly, the outside crust is pretty good. It's seasoned pretty well and has an enjoyable chew to it. The underside, however, was floppy and soft. Maybe there were just too many ingredients on top for the heat to penetrate through during such a short baking period. 

To sum it all up: the pizza isn't bad, but it's just not that good. Also, in my opinion, the carne calzone is much too small to carry a $12 price tag.

Food was alright. All of our appetizers came out at different times, gumbo for us came out at different times- but isn't it all made in a large batch? Some of the weirdest, slowest, most aloof service. They did NOT honor our Yelp promotion, and it also doesn't show the limiting terms until you click through and only AFTER you check-in. We have been waiting more than 45 minutes JUST to get our check. Talking to a manager, who is not apologetic, and very confused and incapable of remedying the situation. Total mess, avoid. Bad service. No semblance of a customer experience.

I've been stopping by here recently before a regular gig I have in Ardmore.  I went for the first time on a recommendation I got after randomly popping into some sort of picture frame/random decor store around the corner to ask about cheap places to eat close by.   The man there said he'd been having some "great experiences" at Firinji so I decided to go check it out.

The guy who owns the place is really friendly, as are his staff.  Maybe a little too friendly, even--I'm not surprised his background is hotel management.  Too friendly is of course better than not friendly enough.

The place is set up essentially like a fast food joint, although not quite as fast.  It's never been busy at all when I've come but I could see there being a problem with food preparation time if there was ever a long line.  The foods all seems to be quite fresh but since it's also reasonably priced I don't think you're getting free-range organic chicken here, either.  Everything I've had, including the lamajhoun wrap (not sure if I'm spelling that correctly) and veggie burrito, has had an appealing taste.  On my first visit I had lentil soup that was especially good--I've never had lentil soup that was pureed into a uniformly smooth texture so that was also a bit of a novelty.

What I struggle with the most at Firinji is that the combination of ingredients is rather odd.  It can't seem to decide whether it's serving Middle Eastern, Mexican, or American food.  This was most notable in one of the Kumpirs I ordered.  There were so many different things on it that it just made no sense.  One feels a bit of unease when confronted with the combination of pico de gallo and hummus, or yogurt in a burrito instead of sour cream.  You can combine a lot of these things together and the result won't taste "bad" but I really wish they would make their menu a bit more cohesive.  I'd really like to see some kind of "Middle Eastern plate" with hummus, baba ghanoush, dolmas...as well as some more entrees that were more consistent with respect to the melding of ingredients and flavors.  It's also important to mention that customers are equally encouraged to build their own wrap/kumpir/etc. combining all these different ingredients as they wish.

I've gone there for a few weeks consistently and may try out some other places in the area before returning.  On the whole though I'd say it's a good bet.

Bonus: they also have free wi-fi.  The unsecured "guest" network didn't work for some reason, but the owner gave me a password to the secured one.
Best Steak House in Florida! I love there Beef Tartar, bone in Bye-bye can you do amazing desert Room
FANTASTIC!!!! AWESOME sauce! INCREDIBLE crust and dough! Gelato is great too. What a great find!

I like raging sage and go there all the time because I prefer to support local business. But that stops today. I stoped in with orders for a small group and the women behind the counter refused to fulfill the order telling me there was a limit on the amount of pastries she would sell to me. The this brain dead short hair, and quite snarky young women got the other wrong.  I'll be going to cartel from here on out.

I'm so glad this restaurant decided to land in Wesley Chapel. What a wonderful change from big box chains that lack flavor and charm. 
This was our first time here, and we were highly impressed. Updated interior decor was appreciated, along with LESS TV's (previous restaurant had them lined across the bar) made for a homey feel. We ordered the deviled eggs and crab stuffed mushrooms for appetizers and both were delicious. My ONE complaint is that the mushrooms were fried. I had the tacos and they were sooooo good. Staff were friendly, manager came over to greet us, and food was amazing. Definitely will return.

Excellent food.  In town often for work and I'm always looking for new places to eat.  I enjoy a relaxing environment where the food is good.  This place definitely fits the bill. The BBQ was top notch and the service was excellent.  My waitress Carly was super sweet and gave me some excellent suggestions on the food.   I will definitely be back and recommend it to everyone who is looking for good BBQ with a unpretentious atmosphere.

I set out to Reading Terminal today on my meager half hour lunch break for a cheap and quick bowl of ham and bean soup from the Dutch Eating Place. I failed to realize, however, that the Amish section is closed Monday and Tuesday. Upon making this discovery, I was getting desperate to find something fast and reasonably priced. Every place either had a line, or was outside my budget for lunch. There was no line at Kamal's. I should have known something was amiss. The gentleman at Kamal's said a falafel sandwich would be done in less than five minutes. Sold! After all, how bad could a falafel in the terminal be, right? Yeah, OK. 

I will give it this--it WAS done lickety split. That is where the good ends. As a previous reviewer said, they microwaved their pre-fried falafel balls. When I saw the woman pop them in the microwave, my heart sank. I felt the wave of impending doom wash over me. She then drizzled the small, not toasty-looking pita with a couple sauces, added lettuce, tomato, cabbage, and the falafel, and, then...I think she microwaved the whole sandwich. You know what that means, folks. More warm lettuce than a McChicken sandwich in a glove box. The soggy falafel was more like warm grape nuts formed into a haphazard ball. All I have to say about this sandwich at this point is...ewwww. Seriously, not just the worst falafel sandwich ever, but one of the worst sandwiches, period. The rest of the food might be decent, but after this falafel litmus test, I don't care to find out.

My friends and I decided to try this wing place with their groupon coupon.  It was much smaller than I thought with a few booths and tables in the centre.  

They ordered wings and fries and onion rings but I wasn't in the mood for wings so I decided to have the chicken wrap.  There were a lot of fries and onion rings and after snacking on that, I wasn't sure I could eat any of my meal.

The first time they brought out my wrap, they forgot the chicken.  I let them know and unwrapped it for the waitress to see, and she brought it back in the kitchen and came back with a wrap with chicken.  The wrap wasn't anything special, but I didn't expect it to be.  There was ample lettuce, tomato, and cheese.

My friends really enjoyed their wings though.  There were so many flavours to choose from but they were both happy with their choices.  I found the wings weren't oversaturated with sauce but enough to make them flavourful and tasty.  No doubt you will need extra napkins and hand washing after eating though.

Go for the wings if you are in the mood.

Major fail in that their website said they're open today, New Year's Day, from 11:00-4:00. We're in town for a concert and staying at a hotel across town. Took Uber after checking they were open. Arrived to a closed restaurant with a lot of people standing around in disbelief, the same as we were. Very disappointed that we couldn't enjoy this iconic place, especially because of inaccurate information on the part of the business. Maybe next time, Hattie B's.

Maggiano's is a great Italian dining experience. The thing that I would recommend most is the signature pastas; not just because of the great flavors, but you get a second order of pasta to take home! What a great deal! Typically I would give a 5 star for Maggiano's as I have been to locations all around the country and have loved them all but this specific location I had super hard bread last time and it was a little slow, but overall still a great meal!

We ate there over the TGiving Holiday twice. 
Great service and food.

Well, I just was not that impressed with the food.  The sandwich I got was kind of, well, just gross!  Perhaps because it was almost 10pm, but it is still not an excuse.  The service was great though.

We came here on a Sunday afternoon- busy but with no wait. The coconut shrimp appetizer was AMAZING!!!! Unfortunately the rest of the meal was lacking. I ordered the eggplant, which was so soggy it was mostly inedible, but the flavor was decent. The generals chicken my co-diner ordered was bland and dripping in too much sauce. The servings were well portioned, and they had a variety of sides to choose from- egg roll, crab star, or the tiniest wing you would think is from a pigeon, not a chicken. 

Service was prompt but the staff not very friendly 

Will probably not be dining here again.

Could not tell you about the food. Got seated took forever for waitress to show up. Then waited a long time with salad and breadsticks then when asked wheres the food the reply was a sarcastic it's cooking it has to cook before I bring it out , did not want to escalate situation told management and they apologized but at this point it was better to leave. Will not return to this olive garden location .

I got my wedding cake from Crushcakes! It was so good and exactly what I asked for! I didn't have the time to go and taste the cakes so I communicated with them 100% through email (and trusted my coordinators referral-Smith and Murphy). I sent over pictures of cakes I liked and they helped me design the cake of my dreams. It tasted delicious and everything was perfect!

Fool Me Once...

I guess when you have the word 'prime' in your name, you can call your steaks 'Prime' without having to use that grade of beef.  

My wife and I both ordered the center cut filet mignon for $32.  This should be a tender, buttery, flavorful cut of beef.  Instead, each bite was an effort in sawing off a hunk, and a lot of chewing.  Definitely not a prime cut-- maybe not even choice.

We paid up the $150 tab, went home and paid the babysitter, and made ourselves something to eat.

I dined at I Fratellini on Wednesday September 25 fir my birthday. The dinner was superb! The service was superb! The lobster dish with pasta left me, breathless! It was divine The Tiramisu was en pointe.

I have followed Zoe Robinson around town since her Lafayette Square location, as always, Zoe exceeds expectations.  Zoe Robinson is the  best!! Thanks for making a monumental birthday dinner unforgettable.

I've been to this place several times over the years, and it's always fresh and really good! So filling too! Love me some of that sweet sauce, I also tried the donair poutine that's good too, and add tzatziki sauce on that!
Nice sports restaurant, yet still cozy enough to create a dinner-date atmosphere as well.
Great BBQ, very friendly staff, generous portions. I wasn;t as enraptured by the dsides as some reviewers, but the pork was top-notch.

Horrible! The food and service were almost bad beyond description...almost. First I sat for 15 minutes before I could order a drink. My Irish coffee took 25 minutes. Why? No whipped cream or mint or chocolate shavings or powder. It was a mug of coffee with (I guess) Irish whiskey and milk. We had reservations for a party of eight so they finally took our meal order. When the food finally arrived, half the orders were wrong and/or cold. They reheated my black bean burrito and it returned a white food on a white oval plate. No presentation value at all. Also, no avocado which I ordered at $2 extra. I could have had a far better burrito at Taco Bell. The wait staff never got some orders correct.  I have never been served by a more dull and dim-witted wait staff. The sooner this food atrocity closes the better. I wouldn't walk across the street for a free meal from the Bellefonte Cafe, let alone venture to this dreary neighborhood.
Save your money, your palette, and your sanity. Go anywhere else.
Atmosphere was cute but the service and food were lacking. Mezze plate was almost grocery store quality. French toast was good but plating was a bit odd. Don't feel a need to return.
We tried this place for our 1st time yesterday. I had the duck tacos OMG hella good. My wife had the Ramon noodles w/pork bellies & it was also hella good. Great happy hour as well.

Not bad and the sandwich keeps well, but it's only good for takeout and reminds me of a sandwich I could make at home. That being said, the food is decently high quality and you get what you pay for. The old Italian sandwich is quite delicious. And the cheese is really good.

We bought a groupon for this place to try it out. Service was great and food came out in a timely manner. We ordered kimchi fries to start. It was pretty tasty, but I was missing the kimchi cabbage component as it was rather scarce on the dish. The sushi sashimi boat came with a variety of fish. My personal favorite was the torched white tuna with sauce and garlic pieces. Fish quality was pretty good and reasonably priced. They offer some affordable lunch specials I'll be sure to come in for in the future. The mochi ice cream was also good. The mango flavor is a must if you're thinking about getting dessert.

The Statesman ranked it #1 Mexican food so had to try.  Sorry, the food was okay. The salsa was okay.  What I did not like first, was the spider webs and the live spiders in the window behind my daughter.  The window shades have not been cleaned in how long?  Tiles on wall were missing and my impression is this is not a clean place to eat.  Service was okay but sooo noisy could not talk.
Based on all this we will stick with Enampa Mexican food in downtown Meridian. It is clean and food is decent.  Portions, however, on small side.  My only complaint.

This is not a good place to eat!!!!!! The piada sticks are burnt and taste like horse poop. The burrito just fell apart and was mostly made of cheese it tasted like  goat munuer! Just being honest but I do respect there service. I feel like they just need more people working there. Thank you for your time!!!
The taste if the food is absolutely Superb, the quality and authenticity definitely surpassed the other competitors in the area. So happy to have Indian Cuisine finally on the Westbank!!!

Great Place to meet for a business lunch or after work

Stay for drinks and have a delicious dinner!

Great atmosphere and a friendly staff!
The bread is amazing and the butter looks like it has sprinkles but it actually is salt

This place is great and looks like it is the most creative breakfast place in town. I have yet to eat breakfast here, but have had pastry and espresso, both of which are great. From what I could tell, the pastry bar had no vegan options, but I may be wrong on that. 

The staff is nice. 

The place opens at 7 am on the weekends, but doesn't start serving breakfast until 9am. If you arrive before 9am your choices are pastry, coffee, cocktails.

A good place for a good steak, and a nice drink.  The bartenders are always very attentive.  They have a very nice selection of Bourbon, and interesting cocktails.  The filet mignon is delicious.  The carrots that come with the steak are actually my favorite part. The bar staff will have to give you a key card for bathroom access if you're not a hotel guest, but it's definitely a nice bathroom.  A nice date spot!

I was at Nectar for the first time on Friday night. At 7 PM the place was full and we had a reservation. First the food is amazing! Some of the best Asian inspired dishes I have had in a long time. The service was really 2 stars. We had a waiter but he seemed to disappear only for our table-- he waited on the other tables around us . It took forever to get a drink order in and even longer to get them. Our waiter was replaced by a second waiter and he did a bit better but again it seemed like our table of 4 was not getting the service people around us were. My expectations are not that high to begin with but we were averaging a 300+ bill and I thought the service should have been better. My friend's drink was missing an ingredient, overall the drinks were stingy on the alcohol but not the price, water was hard to get refilled, and they served us dessert but no new silverware. We took it off the table next to us,
Good food for the money , nice atmosphere a little noisy but good time. Could use more TV's as it is apparent they are after the sports croud

I had a great time until what I thought was a bouncer came and grabbed my hand and started to drag me out. I was terrified, this large black man did not explain himself and was just dragging me out of the dance floor. He was acting as if he was a  bouncer, but I'm still not sure because he was not wearing any identification and did not introduce himself at all. I pulled my hand away because I was scared for my life, and he grabbed at it and then pulled me down to the ground and started to drag me across the floor as everyone watched but did nothing to help. My friend ran over and tried to stop him and he shoved her down to the ground as well. I was being dragged down the stairs, he was grabbing at my neck and eventually broke my bra in half at the front because of how fiercely he was pulling me down. My knees are bleeding and I took pictures of them, as well as my ripped clothing. Once outside, the other bouncers were telling me that I was crazy and that I was at fault because I was hitting the guy on the head with a beer bottle. Of course I was hitting him, he was choking my air supply off by grabbing my neck and I seriously thought that I was going to die at that moment. I was doing anything I could to stop him from dragging me across the floor. I started to hit him in the crotch so that he could let go of me and let me breathe for a moment. Another friend of mine was crying because of the way that I was being treated. I did nothing. I filed a police report and I am hiring a lawyer to represent me and access the video tapes. I did nothing wrong and was treated like a savage animal. I am suing this club and my goal is to shut them down.

I found this place because I was in the mood for a Mongolian BBQ. The one on Dale Maybry closed but I managed to find this one and thought I would give it a shot. The food is exactly what you make of it since you assemble it yourself, however have to say that I think maybe some of the items on the Buffet we're not up to par. I had some stomach issues for several days after eating here. Or it may have been the cocktail I had at the bar which I have to say was fine but I think the liquor may have been watered down. While I was there I also noticed some inappropriate and immature behavior by the younger staff and I also noticed several staff members keeping personal items in Plain-view at the bar. And looking at their health score which I probably should've done before I ate here, that was something that was a problem in the kitchen in the past.The staff here is super nice and they really appreciate compliments I wish I could give them more.  
My bartender was terrific and really took care of me.  
I may one day give this place another shot but after my stomach experience it will be a while.

called at 1148pm to order a small pepperoni pizza and an order of fries. the girl who answered the phone was on point. she took my order, told me the cost, then told me it'd be 20 mins. okay, cool. so I take my time rollin over there and arrive at like midnight. I was greeted at the counter by a super friendly and courteous guy who waited on me. gave him my name, he looked up my order and took my money after which he said it'd just be a few more mins. fine, no problem. so I'm standing around watching people come and go and also at the same time looking into the pizza oven every time the cook opens it and I notice there's no small pizza in it. so I give em the benefit of the doubt and wait a few more mins then I notice the cook preparing a small pepperoni pizza at 1215! so 25 mins after I placed the call this guy is just now beginning to make my order. so I go back to the cool guy at the counter and ask him if that's my pizza that's just going in the oven almost 30 mins after I ordered it and 15 mins standing in the shop. he turns to ask the cook and he responds "yeah." so I ask how long do u think it'll be and the counter guys says just a few mins. so I wait 5 more mins and by now I'm pissed. I ask the cook himself how much longer and he says "one minute" then throws my fries on the coumter in front of me in what I viewed as a "buzz off" fashion. so he pulls this pizza out and dumps it in the box and I can clearly see this thing hasn't even slightly browned .. neither the crust nor the cheese. he closes the box and slides it over to me. I immediately open the box and say to this moron "this pizza isn't even done" and he shrugged it off and went on his way. had I not been pressed for time I would've ripped into this clown. if anything, he should make the customer wait longer rather than deliver a half cooked pizza. 

needless to say, when I got back to my spot I opened the box and half the pizza slid over to one side. I was so effing pissed. I will NOT be returning to del rossis and I would advise anyone else who goes there and sees a slim older white guy with graying hair and glasses making pizzas to turn around and walk right back out the door. poor attitude and poor work ethic. and aside from having to use a fork to eat my pizza it tasted like shit. super thin and soggy crust and just not very good. 

to the owner, if you read these reviews you need to have a talk with this guy. he's gonna cost you business.

The downward slide continues at the Skybox.  On this visit I ordered the half chicken half shrimp plate.  Both the shrimp and the chicken were brown to the point of being cremated - no moisture left.   Something must be done to get the kitchen back on point.  Maybe they should be re-trained at Lucky Wishbone.  My two stars is totally for the waitresses which I find A-OK.  One more failure at this establishment and I am gone forever.

I can't comment on their food, but definitely a fun place to stop by on a night out on State Street! To start with, they had some nice tables outside in the fresh air (with space heaters, major bonus for anyone wearing those cute dresses that just don't go with a winter jacket). Outside we we were able to hear and enjoy the music, but could also chat without needing to read lips. Further back there was a dance floor and a DJ who a) played an awesome mix of newer and older dance-able tunes, b) didn't get stuck in a genre rut, and c) didn't try to sing along on the mic. All good signs. This place also seemed to have a bit more of a ...normal...crowd compared with some of the other bars on the street.
I would love to come by for a happy hour if I am back in SB.

It was my first time ever at a Win Win. Let me tell you this place was the best! Amazing customer service. If you're new don't be afraid to ask the staff what to get. They gave an amazing recommendation (go for the Korean BBQ). Loved their vibe. Definitely coming back. THANK YOU!

I dropped by Denny's this morning while waiting to have my oil changed at nissan two buildings down. I come here only because it's convenient and not because of the food. Though the servers are great here, food comes out quick but the quality of the food is not so good - which you can't really blame them since the menu prices are so cheap. I had biscuits and gravy and something about it just didn't sit well with me. It just tasted like mush without enough spice or sausages. Any way there are better breakfast places in the area, I wouldn't recommend this place for out of towners, I'd only come here as a last resort since there aren't many breakfast places on this road.

I've been here twice now and both times the food was just ok. The service was even worse. When my friend went to pay they gave the waitress cash and she didn't give them the correct change back and accused them of taking the money. Not a fan and won't be back, it was too expensive for what we got.
Good lunch buffet . Everything was fresh and hot. Reasonably priced and pleasant wait staff. Would definitely visit again. Loved the samosa and mango lassi.
