I just knew it would be in a corn tortilla, as ALL of the enchiladas I have ever eaten are always in a corn tortilla.  The waitrees was nice, but it was a complete waste of money for me.

I read most of the reviews here and some have some validity to them. First of all i would like to address the reviewers who say the Nostalgic or fun factor isnt there any more. I'm willing to bet that they are seen the mall from the point when they where in their late teens or early 20's. Therefore of course it isnt going to be the same now that you are in your 30's. So its kind of an unfair assessment. On to the review its true that the mall wasnt the best designed mall. Its long and narrow and a bit confusing. The perceived large crowds are merely about 10 or so people but the design of the mall makes it feel like 30. Usually these are high traffic areas that tend to get "crowded". Ummm its a mall so of course it's going to attract unruly teenagers. I myself back in the 90's use to go there to try and hit on girls. True as most reviewers say the mall has seen better days. Some of this is due to the economy. Some of its due to simple fact the mall itself is now approaching 25 years. Most of the anchor stores have left. It is true what 1 reviewer said there are many stores basically selling the same thing. However, there is still plenty of  different stores and plenty of variety in here. Another thing i think may of hurt the mall is about 6 years ago rumors where circulated about the mall been demolished. Well fast forward and she is still there. On the security issues yes there are some break ins but overall i consider the mall basically safe. I think some of the reviewers are jittery Suburbanites. That been said they probably could use extra security patrolling the parking lots. There are lot of areas to cover and again the design of the mall itself can make it difficult for 2 or so Security Patrol cars to cover. So although the Mills is probably past her prime i still feel there is something to offer. It's not yet in too bad of despair as some of the reviews suggest.

Very mixed feelings on this place. Please also keep in mind my review is based strictly on sushi and not on the hibachi. 

After being dead tired of Delta delaying my flights (in Atlanta), I decided to opt on getting Goten as opposed to going out to Franklin to visit one of my favorite sushi places anywhere, Sake. 

The prices seemed to be moderately reasonable for the sushi. $5 was the typical price for the average rolls and the Nigiri pieces were around $5 for two pieces. I ordered the White Tuna & Yellowfin Nigiri along with an Alaskan Roll and a Shrimp Crunchy Roll. 

I will say the Nigiri pieces were astonishingly flavorful. This is also extremely applicable to the yellowtail. Impressively fresh and tasty. I was very satisfied with those two choices. 

However the quality took a bit of a sharp nosedive when it came to the rolls. The Alaskan roll was about a 6 out of 10 on the flavor-o-meter. The sushi was standard in flavor but not anything eye opening. 

I was however extremely disappointed with the Crunchy Shrimp Roll. The roll was very very flavorless. And the tempura within the roll was not crunchy at all. My guess is probably the shrimp was fried way ahead of time. Otherwise I don't know how to explain soggy tempura. (But as I said, just a guess). I felt that I totally wasted my money on that roll. 

On a final note, I was not very impressed at all with the staff. Even though it was a pickup order, they did not show the slightest of courtesy when I picked up my food. Their stares were cold and in a sad way, mean. I was thanked though as I left, so at least at the end they attempted to act like humans if even for a split second. 

I don't know that I will try this place again, but if I do catch a crave for fresh nigiri, I may pop on over again.

The food was absolutely delicious! We were visiting New Orleans on a trip and we actually found this place on yelp. We came in thinking it was a little restaurant, however it turned out to be a bar that served food on the side.  The problem with that was since we were expecting to dine in, the bar was wanting to charge us a $10 cover fee per person in order to stay on the place..which wasn't what we were expecting. The live music seemed good though, but we ended up getting our food to go to bring back to our hotel.  The Kitchen was out of their wings and ribs (which happened to be their top seller). But the brisket and pulled pork was still delicious. We wish we had ordered more because one order was definitely not enough to share. Be sure to try out all their BBQ sauces.

I have given Rosalita's 3 chances.  I really wanted to like it!  However, the service has been TERRIBLE all three times.  We hardly got any refills, had no one checking to see if everything was ok, and couldn't get our bill at the end of the meal.  What I realized on this last visit was that there didn't appear to be any sort of manager or boss making sure the staff was working.  As a result, they were all chatting with each other and moving slowly.  The only thing that can make up for bad service in a restaurant is excellent food and, well, they don't seem to have that either.  The only thing that can make up for bad food AND bad service at a restaurant is good margaritas, and well....fail again.  Darnit Rosalita's!  I really wanted to fall in love with you but we just aren't meant to be.

I did some research and found this place on yelp which happened to open shortly before the pandemic found our state.  We all enjoy fresh and beautifully presented poke bowls, appetizers, rolls, and sweet service.  We will definitely be coming again - don't pass this place by because of the location - when you walk inside it is upscale and worth dining in.

Went for $6 lunch to be disappointed that they took off the 3 piece tender as an option. Wasn't told why just was blocked off the menu. Asked if we could still get tenders she said yes. We got the 4 piece meal which is supposed to come with 4 tenders, toast and fries. We received the smallest tenders and both did not receive any toast. Now who would complain about not getting toast? Well when you're paying full price not even getting a drink or sundae you expect to receive the full meal. I also looked up on the website the $6 buck meal deals and everyone else seems to still have the chicken tenders available.
I call to order for delivery and the woman that picks up is so rude and her attitude is unbelievable. Don't think I will be ordering from here anymore

Die Bedienung war sehr freundlich und aufmerksam und das Restaurant sehr sauber und stimmig eingerichtet. Die Minestrone und der Salat waren eine gute Einstimmung auf die Hauptspeise: Linguine alle Vongole. Diese hatten eine gute Schärfe und Biss!
Great service and atmosphere! Loved the Mexican Firing Squad and the Hummus and Yuca Platter for Happy Hour

Decent.  I'm not from the area, but come to visit my friend often enough.  We love to play no limit poker and discovered this casino recently.  It fulfills our poker needs for the weekends when we can't get away to Vegas.  Usually busier at the tables and the poker room on Thurs/Fri/Sat evenings -- there are a lot of poker regulars so if you go a handful of times you start recognizing the faces.  Some nights are action packed, others are slow and uneventful.  But the dealers are super nice and it's a clean poker room.  Will keep playing here when in town until another poker room offers better for a less than 30 minute drive.

This place got decent reviews but my wife and I were not impressed. Sushi was mediocre but the price was not. Wouldn't go there again. Service is ok. I say that because it didn't seem like the server was familiar enough with the menu to assist us in making a food order.

I love this place!  Food is consistently good, servers are friendly and they do an amazing job with the patio not feeling as though you are sitting as close as you are to super busy Manchester Rd.  Nice wide range of food choices for vegetarians, too!  I've been here several times with friends, neighbor ladies and family.  Will continue to keep going back!

Wow!!  By far the best meal I had while vacationing in Nashville.  The food was amazing. And I loved meeting people from other states and from Nashville. 

I didn't think I would like the corn pudding but it ended up being my favorite, along with the fried chicken. I also was curious about the 'no cell phone rule' but it allowed me to have meaningful conversation with those around me.

We go to BWW almost every week, so we figured this one would be good while visiting. This place had the worst service I've ever had. Servers were just standing around, there were tons of dirty tables they could've been cleaning and empty cups they could've been refilling. Pretty sure there was vomit on the floor that hadn't been cleaned. The chicken was burnt and hard as a rock, and tasted like someone had dumped a whole box of salt into it. I couldn't eat it. The manager thankfully took off the drinks because the waitress messed up the orders and then we had to get our own refills because our server was nowhere to be found. There were groups of servers standing around chatting, clearly too busy to help. Just not good. Not even okay-ish, it was awful. If you value your time at all, go anywhere but here.

The crawfish and grits are one of the best things I've ever eaten.  Perfect!

Crab cakes were very good too. 4.5/5

Jambalaya was good but not great

Beer list could use some work. Overall great spot.

We are almost daily customers at this location.  My daughter had an issue today here so I called.  I asked if I could speak with the manager.  She was no help so I asked her name & she hung up on me.  So disrespectful.  Very disappointed as a loyal customer.
Food was incredible. Place was clean. The hostess was the sweetest ever!! We will definitely come back to eat here again. Specially the beef ribs!!

WaWa-WEEEEE-WAAAAA!!!!!!!!!!!!! Quick someone call Borat this place is stocked better than the whole country of Kazakhstan.

I heard some rumblings around the work place about how cool this place was, but it was not until I got the down-low from Steve E. that I started obsessing about checking this place out. 

I am a sucker for gas stations with sweet convenience stores. I drive out of my way to hit up a Race Trac, which I always considered the best... then I met WAWA and it made me WAWA-WEEE-WAAA all the way home. 

Did I die and go to heaven? Don't stare at the LIGHT! Well that is exactly what I did when I walked in. I was pulled toward the light of the order your own sub screen. I was not even that hungry, but I wanted to play with the computer game looking digital order screen so much that I just decided I might as well fancy myself a Cuban Sandwich. I got a big one expecting to bring it home and share it with my fiancee... WHOOPS!!!! I at the whole thing driving down the road and I have the mustard stains on my shirt and jeans to prove it! IT WAS AWESOME. I think Publix puts all subs to shame, but a Cuban is not exactly a sub. Nevertheless, while Wawa is not going to de-thrown Publix, it will murder Subway 10 times, and that is just before lunch.

Wawa also had some good deals, like Red Bull 2 for $4. 

Their gas seemed to be priced just slightly lower than everything else around (but maybe I just have pearl color glasses after how much Wawa WOWED me). 

Huge selection inside the gas station, very spacious lot with lots and lots of filling stations. Clean inside and out. Prompt and friendly service. I have absolutely no complaints. Wawa is going to become my go-to gas and convenience. Let's just say, I'M PUMPED!!!
This sweet little business left me with a happy little smile, the breakfast was amazing! Genuine experience, got a cute little sticker at the end of our visit :) five stars always

Best Mexican food in the Northeast! The quality is great, the portions are generous, and the price makes this perfect!

The atmosphere is nice and the restaurant is clean! Everything I have ever ordered is delicious. There is a small language barrier issue with some of the wait staff but it is minimal and doesn't take away from the over all dining experience. You definitely get the best service on week nights where there are fewer people in the restaurant.
The best restaurant on St. Pete Beach!  The atmosphere and service are exceptional. Be adventurous and try something new. Check Facebook for specials and you won't be let down.

If I could give this place 10 stars I would. It's so awesome. I love going here. It's a tad bit pricey but totally worth it. The food is fresh and delicious. My favorite party is the amazing sauces that are available. This particular store is under new management and there is a promotional being offered but I has yet to have a disappointing experience.

The place just never fails. I've been coming here for almost ten years. Delicious Chinese take out every time. Tina, the owner, is awesome. She's always there and hustling to make your experience positive. Just love this place. They recently opened a sister, sit down, restaurant a few doors down (golden bowl) which has equally good food and is BYO. Wish I lived closer but I always make the stop when in the area. They have the normal Chinese take out menu items but somehow everything just tastes better and more fresh then other places. Some of my favorites are the hot and sour soup, combination platters, house lo mein, and steamed dumplings. 10/10 in my book as far as Chinese takeout goes. For any bad day, Golden China is there to lift your spirits. The end.

Pro tip: when you open a new restaurant, OVERSTAFF it. Too many restaurants bomb in Kirkwood and Webster because of incredibly poor service in the initial few weeks. 

Note the example of Circle 7 Ranch. Always packed, and always tons of servers, bus boys, hostesses etc. 

We sat at a bar table tonight and got our appetizer before our drinks. I asked for a glass for my large canned beer but had to go to the bar to get it myself after 10 minutes of waiting. The server hadn't even noticed. She was the only one serving all the bar tables and seemed in no hurry to do anything. 

The cauliflower app was dynamite, but my wife's lamb sharwama had a massive bone in it that would've broke her teeth had she not noticed it before biting. The server simply said "I'll let the kitchen know". $1000 says the kitchen was never told. Oh, and if you insist on an electronic machine at the table to run a credit card, do not hover over me as I leave a tip. Tacky. 

Here's one family that will never return. That's a shame. We live in the neighborhood and used to frequent Milagro once a week when it was in the same location.

Well my Yelp family I am going to make this short and sweet. If you want to go into "Caveman mode" just take a walk inside and you'll feel something unleash. Let that beautiful aroma just carry you away, leading you into a food coma.

If you walked past and thought to yourself  "eh another barbecue joint" you're basically missing out. Sophie's  will basically hit you in the mouth with that goodness.    

If you're looking at the prices and you're asking yourself why so expensive? Just go somewhere else , go to your local supermarket and get their version of barbecue. Those prices indicate quality, Sophie's knowing how to smoke that perfect brisket, the crunch or spiciness from their chicken dishes, watching the meat just fall off the bone of those amazing ribs, getting lost in that mac and cheese , and dare I say that cornbread. There alone separates the amateurs  from the professionals. Sophie's is in that elite class. 

Pure bliss I say,  yes I said bliss. I feel the smell alone wafting through the air will convert a vegetarian, quite possibly a vegan the minute they reach their entrance. That's right, I said what I said.

Get in there and enjoy ! 
~Nando

Honestly, the only reason Jamie W. and I stopped here is because I was intrigued by the multi-story structure which reminded me of Tokyo's Ginza District where restaurants were piled on top of each other in tall buildings crowded next to each other. The Diner spreads its expansive 18,000 square feet vertically over six floors (photo: http://bit.ly/2Jg0Jru), but we stayed on the main floor where the coffee shop is operated since we weren't looking for a dining experience in the middle of the afternoon. Each floor is apparently devoted to different cuisines with the top floor offering oysters and sushi. We just came for the $3.25 cups of Drip Coffee (photo: http://bit.ly/2KRbrdN) which we found satisfactory. Even though Yelp feedback appears tepid, it's good to know this is a 24/7 operation just in case we grow tired of the honky-tonk music in the middle of the night.

COFFEE - 3 stars...readily available when you're in the area
AMBIANCE - 3.5 stars...fancier than most diners, clientele not so much
SERVICE - 3 stars...on the perfunctory side
TOTAL - 3 stars...am I in Tokyo?

How have I not written a review for Kite & Key before? Even more puzzling, how is it my neighborhood and I'm not there more? 

I'll keep this review brief and to the point. This is an excellent craft beer establishment. Aside from always carrying unique brews, they are also involved with Philly Beer Week and host other beer-related events. They are a Philly Tapfinder bar and will always post their events there. 

The food is also above average bar food. You almost shouldn't think of it as bar food and just think of it as good food. It's been a while since I've dined there last, but I've never been disappointed. 

They also have my favorite indoor/outdoor seating setup of probably anywhere I've ever been. If you don't want to sit totally outdoors, but don't want to sit totally indoors, one of their window high tops in the summer is the perfect spot. They have the full length window open when the weather is nice. So it's like you are sitting outside, but can see the TV, which are usually showing whatever game is big. Yep, it's a pretty great set up. 

Kite & Key is a perfect example of the gastropub, beer scene in Fairmount. Keep up the great work!

I've lived 3 blocks away for 4yrs and this is the first time I went in. A friend I was with goes often and wanted to stop today. Got Chicken finger on Hoggie w/fries. It was awful. Very little chicken, mostly breading, runny hot sauce soaked the bread and the fries had NO flavor. The place had a strange smell, musty. Very disappointed.

Huge portions and great tasting food! The fried chicken dinner is half a chicken with sides! I'm a foodie and can eat a lot, but beaten my husband and I we had a whole meal left over! Definitely big enough to share! Love the diner atmosphere also!

Horrible. Have ordered here over 60 times over the last 4 years. Have seen witnessed the chicken wings of all new owners. If these are the same owners since February they have gone downhill very quickly. What was once the best wing s in st Pete have turned into almost something inedible. Today I received my wings and it seems as though they've gone with a different brand of wings since I've never seen these before with them. Chicken was hard and pretty much inedible on over 50% of the chicken. Never again.

Went through the drive through and had to wait they said they had to cook my hotdog but when I finally got my food the chili on my dogs was cold. Like it had come out of the fridge. Probably want be back.

Tamales. As basic Central American food, most are pastey and heavy. Few North Americans ever really embrace them beyond an emoji hug. Surely, Joe is wanting to change that. I like a good tamale. As a most-of-my-life resident of Texas (and a tamale maker myself) yes, I'm skeptical of a restaurant whose focus has such a bland history. But, it's a brave effort.

First tasted at a catered event, the tamales left me surprised at what had been presented as "gourmet" food. It was a solid disappointment. A trip to the restaurant was needed. Surely that first taste just suffered from the difficulties of catering? Nope. Your mileage is going to vary to a point your engine may need a tune-up.

The catered tamales were properly cooked, but the brisket had been tough and bland. At the restaurant, I ordered brisket, pork, and chicken to get a broader sample. Though I enjoyed the flavor of the red pork filling, the food was even worse at the restaurant. The masa served was mostly under-done, spreadable paste that needed quite a bit longer in the steamer to set the starches. The queso was so disappointing it took me back to penniless college days of gritty, canned cheese soup and chilies.

Gourmet tamales? Nope. Nada. None here. You'll need to drive to Fort Worth for those. Joe's seems yet another generationally focused bar with a kitchen and no clear focus on which will truly anchor the enterprise. It offers a fast-food order line more at home to a food truck than a restaurant. And the food experience can't even set Joe a place at the table with most every other Mexican restaurant in the area. That's sadly shocking.

Poor execution? Definitely, but there's little to praise even when better executed. Platefuls of flashy marketing too often taste of cardboard and paste. There's a small band stage. It might be loud and lively. Maybe Joe can save face if you only go for a drink?
Relaxed little diner with HUGE variety of meals and MASSIVE portions!  Very cheap too for excellent home style southern food!

Cigar City Jai Ali beer was great.  The Cigar City Maduro Brown tasted old and stale.

Food was marginal.  Buffalo chicken sandwich was horrible. Over cooked.  To small, tough and not juicy.  The bun was just a hamburger bun instead of a brioche bun.  French fries were good and hot.

The salsa was on point, which led us to believe the food was going to be amazing. Wrong. I got the Layered Tacos and in the description is said,"ground beef and refried beans...etc", what i got was boiled shredded roast beef, with no flavor, and some cheese and tomatos. I'm not picky, as long as I can throw hot sauce on it, i'll eat it so i was willing to give it another try until my boyfriend realied how sad his plate was. he ordered (I'm going to murder the spelling) "Ross Compollo"? basically it's chicken rice and cheese. what he got was an entire plate of terrbily seasoned and not fully cooked veggies, and a small bed of rice with hald a chicken breast on it. 
Never again.
Will definitely go back for drinks and that awesome salsa though.

My group went to Dante's Kitchen when we were in town for Mardi Gras and it turned out to be the highlight of our trip. We walked in and immediately felt at home in the sleek, yet cozy atmosphere.

The waiter was extremely attentive, with plenty of drink suggestions.  Hint:  their house cocktails are seductive, with just the right balance of spirits and freshly squeezed fruits.

The menu contained innovative dishes with nuances of down-home, comfort food.  When our dishes arrived, everything tasted like it was plucked straight from the vine, caught in the ocean and conjured up for your delight the same day.  Oh, their head chef really poured his heart and soul into these dishes.  Just Scrumptious.

You will be stuffed once you're done with your plate and picking off other's, but for heaven's sake, Do Not Miss Out on Dessert!

Dan dan noodles were good! All my friends liked it and had a good time. Waiter tried to make me pay more for whiskey so boo on him. Whole snapper isn't worth the price. Definitely had much better and cheaper places.

One of the best lunches that I've ever had was at Monk's, the first stop on a mini-pub crawl organized for my best friend's Bachelor Party Weekend.

The Beer Bible is massive, the Belgian fries couldn't have been more perfect, and the mussels were succulently delicious.  We all enjoyed our sandwiches or sausages as we sat in the downstairs cellar.  Our large group was well accommodated and they didn't mind our noise, or the fact that were already drinking beer at noon.

It's nice to have a place like this and the next time I'm back in Philly, I will definitely hit it up for quality food and drink.  Beer drinkers, this is an absolute MUST stop for you.

Alto is incredible. We were too late to try the food, but after dark looking out over the city was awesome. The bar staff was very inviting and polite, and prices were average. The pool and deck makes this the best bar we visited in NOLA. I can see where this area could get very crowded.

Excellent vegetarian food.  I've eaten here the past two days and no I'm not a vegetarian - recommend any of the sandwiches but I really like their version of a Philly cheese steak.  Get it with the goddess dressing and side of spicy kale - yum.  Service is friendly and the decor is subtle but can keep your eyes busy with all the cool photos hanging on the wall.  Leave the meat alone for one meal and enjoy the goodness of the wild cow.

absolute favorite place for parisian macarons. 
they take bulk orders, too. one of the most reasonably priced in the area.

Very less option for Vegetarian people. Ordered Sandwich with roasted pepper and side of grilled potato.. Not as good as Dennys or ihop. At 10 o'clock they are out of avocado how come they don't have it in the morning. They should come up with better option for vegi people.
really great food for the price point. super nice salad for me and son loves the chix strip meal..comes with a sundae

Was this a Panera Bread last week?  Ok, I'm being snarky but there are many similarities between this and Panera, and that's NOT a good thing.

I had the entree-sized Cobb salad.  The small amount of chicken was dry and poorly seasoned.  It was all iceberg lettuce which means an unflattering watery crunch.  Bacon had decent flavor but was cooked so long it was hard as a rock.  Dressing was nothing special.  The small piece of focaccia was warm and a welcome accompaniment.

Sloooooooow service. Cant believe how long it takes for one to go order. Its ridiculous. The cashier (dont remember her name but she is the brown one on May 27,2017 (the other one is white), not trying tobe racist)  is bitchy too. No smile on her face for the whole time. If you work for customer service job, learn to smile!
Food is ok, but the service is the slowest I have seen. If you see more than three cars in the drive-thru, go inside.

There's FUNGUS in my tiramisu!!! The chocolate mouse smelled like it was 6 months old and we ate it by mistake only to taste like something died in our mouth. We ordered via Grubhub and complained after we got it. They called the owner and they did not acknowledge this was their fault. They lotreralit brushes this off like of was not a big deal. No refund after we ate something that should not be in any restaurant being served to customers. We have been going to Byblos for years, outside of great hookah they surprisingly had great tiramisu and food overall. Absolutely terrible customer service and here are the pictures to prove it. Feel sick to my stomach. They probably should not be offering food to go if they can't quality control it - I wonder when this food was even prepared. Gross.

Any place with shrimp tacos is a must try restaurant, the tacos were a solid fours meal. They were not the best tacos ever but they were not the worst either. The portions was more than I could eat in one sitting and I eat a lot, lol. The staff was friendly but the food was not delivered fast. The prices were okay.
Not sure what's happening at this restaurant but not nearly as good as it used to be. Egg flower soup has no flavor anymore and rice tasted like leftovers. Meals are way too hit-and-miss now

Went for a birthday dinner. Not the first time we have been to this place but this time we were not impressed. While all the other chefs were putting on a show our chef just cooked the food never interacted with us or talked.  Asked the waitress to do the happy birthday singing she said no but when we made the reservation the front said yes we will sing but no feee meal if not on the day of the birthday.  We did talk to the manager who said it was the kitchen manage who said no. My daughter was disappointed so were we especially since our chef was not happy to cook for us.   The food was good the waitress was not around to fill drinks either.  Must have to a bad night cause it's usually good place to go

Tried this place for lunch to welcome a new hire for the office.  I split a burger with my coworker, which was huge, perfectly cooked and came with some extremely amazing fries.  Everyone at the table was served promptly, the food was enjoyed all around and we almost left full.  Since we could squeeze a bit more in, we decided on the dessert menu and I split a tiramisu with my coworker.  Super tasty and my first experience with this particular dessert since I am not a big fan of wet bread/cake.  Definitely will be back to try other offerings!

Absolutely amazing! I have been wanting to go here for a while and finally did! I got the Buffalo Blue Chicken pierogies! I love them...I will definitely be going back...I didn't know about all of the sandwiches either...those are on my list for next time! Rockin'!!!

If you are a "foodie", you "get" this place.  If not, you won't....simple as that.  

Presentation and creativity wins here.  And the textures of the adorning crisp vegetables, the depth of flavor of the food, actually have you dropping superlative adjectives as you eat, e.g. "this is fucking amazing".  When the plates appear in front of you, the conversation at the table jumps from whatever topic (whether it be some bullshit family issue or sex later that evening) to the food, the artistry on the plate, and how the buds on your tongue respond...oh my.

Starting with the service, every server helped out at this 39 seat cozy gem, and each person had a happy, pleasant disposition.  Even the chefs in the kitchen beyond the doorway were smiling, and on a busy Saturday night no less.  Their verbal description of the items on the menu was from a root of knowledge, not just brain cramming prior to opening.  The dinner was well paced, and never had to turn over my shoulder to seek attention.

For apps, we had a delicious cauliflower veloute, a nice creamy soup with wonderful additions for garnishment and palate pleasure.  Also, the spring lamb terrine was fascinating, and complimented perfectly with amazing pickled vegetables.

Entrees ordered were the Arctic Char, an excellent fresh piece of the tender white fish with crispy skin served up, oh how I love crispy skin, served with artichoke hearts and a blend of crisp, colorful, eye and mouth pleasing textures and flavors.  The pork "two ways" were sliced pork loin and pork belly, very tender, delectable pieces of pork,   and the shell beans served with the dish were to die for.

For dessert we split the Peanut Butter pot de creme.  Very creative peanut butter custard with bourbon marinated raisins and crushed peanuts added for texture topped with a very smooth and creamy cream.   It was dreamy ;-)

Definitely the worst Mexican I've ever had, which I had previously believed was a difficult cuisine to screw up. All of the ingredients tasted cheap and canned. Also the entire staff seemed to be a bunch of high school kids who were all in training. At one point they brought an appetizer to the table which we informed them was incorrect, then they walked it around the restaurant, passed it to another person, who then brought the same (now cold and filmy) dish right back and plopped it in front of us. The service I could have overlooked, but the food tasted like a day old TV dinner.

Dragon roll eel. Eel supposed to be on the outside of the sushi and a whole eel will be cut into small pieces. But This store only has Avocado on the outside and tiny Eel bits on the inside. Charged me $11 for a tiny eel and avocado roll. Will not come back again and it's not even a adequate sushi restaurant.

I came here yesterday for drinks and dinner.  The service was impeccable.  Management were extremely pleasant and the food was absolutely delicious!  We got the Who Dat shrimp and it was amazing!!!  I also ordered the shrimp remoulade.  Fresh shrimp and fantastic dressing.  Can't wait to go back.

This was a great place to have brunch with the family. It is very clean and the staff were great. I love the decor!! Plus, my four year old actually ate here!!! That is a HUGE deal. He doesn't like anything.
Kudos, Cindy I am a cook so I know food! Who Dat! The quantity, quality and presentation was awesome.

Nice restaurant, passable Pad thai (nothing special but I enjoyed eating it)

Returned again twice, Pad thai was much better, more flavorful, and tofu was fried to perfection.  Drunken noodles (vegetarian without oyster sauce) ok, but not too flavorful, and a little too spicy for me.  Will definitely be back for the pad thai and promising curries!
Good secluded spot off Rock. Cool football theme too but without being a jock/douche spot. Good food. Chad the owner is great to the costumers.

In an airport, you typically encounter bars where the food is mediocre and the service abysmal.  This place could only hope to improve to such a level.  The bartenders are inattentive, I got doused with dishwater as the bartender shook a glass to rid it of extra water and the dirty dishes pile up at the end of the bar amid the smell of garbage.  And, to top it all off, because they have a captive audience, they pillage the wallets of their patrons, charging ridiculous amounts for a beer.  Their table wait staff falls into two distinct categories: should-be pensioners and haggard, inattentive ogres.  It's a pretty sad place and its a shame there's not an alternate on this concourse at STL.
They took forever to seat and they kept forgetting our reserved spot . hostess was rude. Each time we asked to know how much more time. So to conclude terrible food, rude hostess.
This place offers some great Mexican food with New Mexican salsa. Great breakfast place . You should check out the dream team Tony an Trisha at the bar. They are there every Weekend working the bar.

What can I say about "La Boca", well when you want a good Argentinian grill La Boca is where you need to go.  I like all their meats with a side of chimichurri sauce.   You must try their ñoki (potato dumplings), and their grilled asparagus.  Their selection of steaks and wines is great.  I am not a wine connoisseur, but the friendly staff provided excellent advise based on my preferences (i.e. - I dont like really dry wines).  

I only have a handful of places that I must visit when I am in New Orleans.  La Boca is  the one I go when I want good steak.

The staff is awesome here; they're so nice and welcoming! The food I would say is a solid B. The only critique I have is to rely far less on the fish oil. I can taste it in the chow mein, the vegetables, everything. The one dish I will never get again is the sesame chicken. It was scrawny little pieces of chicken overpowered by fried crap, and drowning in sauce. 
Great place for convenience. Okay for food.

I really wanted to like paying $10 for a tiny portion of Granola and avocado toast but the people were rude. It was our first time here So not sure how the seating worked and walked up and politely asked if we could grab a seat and we were snipped at to let us know that they were on a wait and to please stand over there. I said no need and we would we takeout and then the people right behind us came in and took the seats we were eyeing without talking to the hostess. Granola was good but apparently not the same with manners. Oh well. 

Update***
We tried this place again and had a much better experience. The manager, Kurt, was extremely thoughtful and courteous and helped up to get seated as quickly as possible. This time we tried two of their entrees which were great and tried the cold brew and a latte. All good- we'll be back
The owner is in there making pizzas by himself and they were outstanding! Definitely get some food here!!

20+ years ago I was at an Outback in Colo. and it was awesome. I had the same expectations when I went to eat at the West Nashville Outback last night . I'm pretty tolerant and am reluctant to post a bad review, but it the experience last night was poor. Once our long wait for our booth was over, we did get drinks and bread promptly. It was all down hill after that . We had to ask for utensils and napkins, ask for water refills. Got our blooming onion in a reasonable time but never got the refill of save we'd asked for. Took forever to get our meals correct, and they were mediocre. The steak on my salad was cold, and the juice on it was dry like it had been surt

Reeeaaallly amazing experience. Best sushi we have had in Reno since moving here from California. The service was exceptional even though it was a full house. The owners even visited our table and chatted towards the end of our meal. We have 3 children under 9 and it was a very pleasant atmosphere with prompt service. I would recommend everything on the menu!!! Would definitely return again and again!!!

Spectacular! My husband and I traveled out of our county to find a new restaurant - and were we so happy that we did! We would come back just for the house garlic bread & bruschetta - which was simply delicious!  Everything was awesome - the portions are HUGE and the service was fantastic! Our waitress (Josefina) she was fabulous!   We will definitely be back again soon - so many other dishes that we want to try!
Very cool local neighborhood cafe....small menu but large portions!!! Friendly staff and if you have food restrictions the Chef is very helpful in accommodating your needs!
Great service great food and the pistachio cheescake cup if amazing !!! Easy to find ! All fresh and preferred organic foods ! No preservatives ! Mmmmm

Hit and miss...sometimes it's good sometimes it's mediocre. Took my folks here and spent a fortune for mediocre food. Steam broccoli is usually not good here so I scratch that one immediately. Cowboy ribeyes usually good. Not the last couple times. Places struggle to be consistent that is a common theme.

Came tonite, sunday nite w six. Forth nite in a row for dinner in FQ.
Others were great, this was very disappointing. 
Drink service was very slow, waiter Not  attentive. Had to send two of the six dinners back as way too salty. Waiter and manager didn't really care, just minor lip service.
Other places are so good, don't bother with this. 
Needs better management, supervision.

Amazing food! 
Amazing people! 
Clean restaurant! 
Been coming here almost 16 years. Amazing food!

Went with a few girlfriends for brunch on a Saturday morning and the food and drinks were delicious, plus it has a cute fun little vibe! I will say that the bottomless drink deal is a bit pricey: it's $45 for an entree and then unlimited of basically any drink (mimosa, Bloody Mary, Paloma, drink of the day) and you can mix and match as you like. Also, they told us that technically it's supposed to be all or none for the table, so if some people want bottomless but others don't, everybody has to do it or just pay a la carte. Overall, will probably return but would have to be in a super thirsty mood to feel like spending $45/person and have gotten my money's worth!

Very late review.  I was so busy on the trip then just forgot about it until I was reviewing my photos. 
We were in New Orleans for st Patrick's day. We wanted to try a authentic brunch place and we found it. It's a very small establishment and if there's a wait you have to wait outside. We waited for about 5 minutes but it was a lovely day. We were a party of two and our server was friendly and helpful. We tried the biscuits and gravy to share as an appetizer it was delicious. My bf licked the plate clean. It's a must try if you are a fan of biscuits and gravy. We ordered special pancakes and pulled pork Benedict! We shared everything and it was perfect and filling. Our waitress helped us with directions to the closest catacombs and places in the area to check out. We will be back next time we are in Nola.

I was disappointed in this place on several levels.  I stopped in today for lunch with great hopes of having some good comfort food.  First off, they didn't have a specific chicken and waffles entree.  They were separate items where you could get a waffle for $6 and then order a 1/2 pound of chicken for $9.  Secondly, I ordered a buttermilk waffle that tasted nothing like a buttermilk waffle.  It was heavy, chewy with more of a bread-like mouth feel.  The meal was served in one of those plastic baskets with a paper liner thats more appropriate for burger and fries and not for food that you need to cut with a knife and fork.   Also, I could be wrong but the iced tea tasted store bought. Finally the design of the space was confusing.  There was a long bar and then a bunch of hi-tops for dining.  I think it might be hard for people to figure out if it's truly a restaurant or a bar, or whatever.

I went to this location TWICE and both times the service was terrible. Fool me once, shame on you..TWICE?? Never again......save yourself the disappointment and go to another location. There's one not far from there on Veterans right next door to Barnes and Noble. Grab a bite to eat and a good book to read.

eclectic wine list that ranged down to affordable and delicious.  4 appetizers, 4 main courses, 2 desserts, all delicious!  All were so good that we had difficulty choosing a favorite.  

On top of the delicious food, was wonderful service.  Anatoly was professional, charming, knowledgeable, attentive, humorous . . . everything I like and want in a server.  

I recommend this restaurant highly!

The drinks were good, and the calamari was average. The service was great, and the atmosphere was what you would expect. However, what we did not expect was to receive a tilapia filet being passed off as a cut of grouper.  The thickest section of the fish was under a half inch thick, the meat was grey and dingy. Management denied serving tilapia, and we may have happily eaten the sandwich if they had admitted they ran out of grouper.  Unfortunately, we will not be back, and consumers should be aware.

I returned to this establishment after finding out that ownership had changed hands, before the food was horrible, but after returning, i was surprised to find that the food like with ownership had also changed, yes the food was a lot better. I am a fan of the Stromboli, I get it with steak , bacon and onions. Though the food is better and the prices are not bad, I did find that the staff isnt that friendly, when we went it wasnt very busy, but we ended up waiting a lot longer than 30 minutes for the food, which wasnt to bad as we were conversing, but they never even came over to ask if we wanted refills. I actually ended up getting my own drink, which brought the waitress over and she got upset that I did that. I did not want to argue with her over it so I said my sorry and went about my business and we laughed it off. That was the last time we got a refill for anyone on our table. 
They actually got our order wrong, after the wait which then she told us that it would take another 15 or so minutes, one of the people at our table ordered and Italian hoagie, they simply brought a ham and cheese, we thought it was weird that it would take that long to make a sandwich. when they brought the sandwich, they brought it in a plate, though we asked for it to go, it was plane to see that she got upset.

The food is good, the prices are not bad, comparable to other like places, for that they can get return customers.

Staff not the friendliest, there were at least four people standing near the register talking about personal issues, not a big deal but when you have customers waiting and even get a refill well then you have an issue. The furniture is not in the best shape tables wobble and seem to be crammed in as to where is makes it hard to get in and out of the table without bumping into your neighbor.

It grading only on the food, would have given at least 4 stars, but since I included overall service, must give two stars, will return again and when I do, will write again.

Steak was terrible & over priced! I ordered the Cowgirl. It was tough, gristle, had a weird flavor & certainly was not cooked medium. It was more like medium rare. The salad was even of poor quality. The only thing good was the 2 little breads & baked potato. Many reviews say how good the food is. NOPE! Steak tasted like it was cooked in liquid smoke,. There was NO meat flavor at all. I couldn't even finish it because of the weird taste, fighting to cut it & chew, chew, chew. As I thought about it later, there was no smell of steaks cooking in the air when walking from parking lot to front door & back to car. Makes me wonder just how they cooked them. On top of all this, the waitress never returned to ask how the food was. Apparently, she knows. I had been to the place 20yrs ago & remembered now why I had never returned & will NEVER again!

We love Billy G's. The atmosphere is great as well  as the service. Unfortunately the "Christmas cocktail" menu was vile. I kept ordering more off of the menu hoping it would get better... Unfortunately it didn't. The wings were amazing, but the nachos lacked cheese sauce. I felt like I just kept digging. Digging. Digging. Digging. No CHEESE. :(.      I would definitely come here again.
Used to come here all the time. Now i remember why i stopped, nothing as good as it used to be. The lady who ran it was "in charge". Too bad she's gone...
The food I ordered was pretty good. It's hard to find a good asian restaurant here in Reno. By far, this is the best I've had in the area. Will be coming back.

Yummmm! Landed in Tampa and got on Yelp and Tin Can Cafe was highly rated, so my husband and I thought let's go for it. Glad we did! Awesome down home breakfast! Cheap, big portions and delicious. I had the spinach & feta omelet and home fries. Man, it was good. Get the home fries!!! Great service. Right off of South Myrtle drive just up from Clearwater Beach. Looks like a little hole in the wall---well, it is---but those are typically best spots and this is that!

Food was amazing as always. The waiter was super friendly and gave great recommendations. The wait wasn't too long and just the atmosphere was super chill and friendly. Texas de Brazil is one of my favorite restaurants to go to and I highly recommend to the people that haven't got a chance to try it. Can't wait to go again!
Tasty pie and fast. Pep, mushroom was fantastic and staff was friendly. Will be back.

Black Cod!!! Get it. Beautiful ambiance, somewhere between a 70's spaceship and aquarium. We had a jalopeno infused cocktail, so good. Special scallops, several amazing rolls, and of course Black Cod. Be ready to drop some coin but it's so worth it. I don't feel like anything was lacking. Definitely order lots and share family style, as you should everywhere.

They also threw in a coffee cocktail with a candle for my friends bday, class. We will be back as soon as I save up for it.

The. Best. Tacos. Ever. I went both today and yesterday. I had the chicken fried tacos which were delicious. The tortillas are fresh and crunchy. The queso, chips and salsa are all good as well. I will definitely be back.

Never had a bad meal here. Not only do they have great pizza, calzones and other Italian dishes, this particular location also offers sushi, which isn't the best I've ever had, but pretty cool concept. Cute, but small outside dining area. Inside can get a little cramped, but they have a bigger back room. It's almost always been busy when I've gone there.

I'm a bit jaded when it comes to ramen. I have had some of the very best anywhere - i.e. Momi in Miami or Momofuku in NYC. I also make a killer Tonkotsu broth (IMHO) and this place was at least as good as mine. I liked this place and will absolutely go back, as it holds up to some of the better places I've been. It has a bunch to go to be Momofuku, but that's a tough act to follow. The place is very clean, super friendly, small but with plenty of tables & bar style seats. The broth was a flavorful miso, the pork was fall apart yummy, and the noodles were top notch. I asked one of the servers if the noodles were Sun Noodles, the best besides 'do it yourself', and he confirmed they were. In the world of ramen, if you're not doing the noodles yourself, then Sun is really the only other way to go - don't think the ramen you ate in college, these are much tastier. I highly recommend this place and if you've been to Momofuku I think you'll not be disappointed.
Food is ok for the price, love the menus being that its not your everyday cuisine. Unfortunately the service is absolutely horrible. It's a shame because this is the 3rd time we've tried it.
Always enjoy lunch here! Tomato basil soup, mandarin crunch salad and garlic pasta were tasty. The service was quick. Good place for grabbing quick lunch. Parking can be challenging, though.

Not really impressed. The coconut shrimp tasted no better than what you can buy in the freezer section of Publix. The Lobster Bisque lacked lobster, but did have shrimp. We ordered from the lunch menu, which was not impressive. I was hoping for better. On the positive side, the happy hour prices are good from 3 - 7 and this isn't a very expensive place. It was clean and the serve was prompt.
Ordered the lunch special Pechuga de pollo with rice and beans. Also ordered some tostones and rellena. Yum! Why didn't I discover this place before?

Great little corner cafe just off the streetcar line. Big windows, good service, and tasty pastries! 

They have wifi and plenty of chairs. I've never had trouble finding a table and have often ended up here over the summer--they're doing some work in my buidling and...having a sander going right outside your window isn't exactly conducive to...anything. So NOCHI has been a great interim option!

Check them out--there's apparently a happy hour as well. And don't forget to tip your baristas!!

This place is a breath of fresh air! For vegans and non-vegans alike. You walk up and choose either burrito, tacos (3), nachos or burrito bowl. Then you pick from five plant based proteins, modeled after the traditional Mexican style (chicken, carne asada, chorizo, al pastor and barbacoa). The last 3 are even gluten-free, if that's what you're looking for :) From there you build it your way... add onions/cilantro, refried beans, Mexican rice, potatoes/peppers, salsa, Pico de Gallo, guacamole. I mixed and matched tacos and was NOT disappointed. My only regret was not trying the queso...next time! The Kombucha on tap (6 flavors), superfood lemonades (matcha, lavender and turmeric) and hemp horchata offer so many drink options you'll have to come back 10+ times just to try them all. You can even get Kombucha + lemonade (mind blown). Everyone was so friendly and all your Vegan Club friends are on the walls (Prince, Miley, Woody Harrelson). I loved all the artwork. Quick and easy to-go or eat in. I will definitely be returning and singing their praises all over town!!
Got some panang curry chicken and general tso. Both were phenomenal. Fast and attentive service with a smile
Ben to a bunch of otb's,  usually service sucks.   Not bad this time.   Food was good

The 2 stars are purely for the service. Everyone was awesome there and super helpful for this first timer. 
On to the food...  it was AWFUL! We ordered the brisket cheesesteak, ribs, mac'n'cheese, their version of fries, and broccoli salad.  The brisket cheesesteak was soggy and waaaaay too salty. The ribs were flavorless and totally dry.  The mac n cheese was mushy, and the broccoli salad was ok, a little salty too, but you can't help that when you include bacon as an ingredient. The "fries" were ok, not my favorite. 

I've had lots of BBQ that was soooo much better than this.  I'm so shocked that this place is so highly reviewed.

We've driven Route 40 hundreds of times and have always bypassed this diner, either because it's at the beginning of our trek or near the end.

Bad move. We stopped in last night for dinner before we continued our journey to Northern VA and were very pleased. The diner was clean, comfortable and well-lit. The staff was friendly without being overly so. Our waiter made some suggestions we hadn't considered that were excellent choices. My wife had the Turkish chicken (a house specialty) and I had fish and chips. Both were excellent.

Our beverages were regularly replenished and we were checked on continuously. 

We were very pleased and look forward to stopping in on our next journey to or from the shore.

There is always chatter about restaurant week, some people fancy it others despise. I'm a big fan and up tonight was Amada.

The best part of the meal for me was dessert, rice pudding with fig. I'm not a big dessert person but this was awesome. The sangria was great, full of flavor. The rest of my meal was ok. I walked in wanting to be wowed.  I tried shrimp and garlic & a Spanish cheese with cherry fig jam. I love garlic and felt more garlic was needed otherwise both dishes were fine.  Next, the grilled octopus and hanger steak. The steak was salty and octopus was ok.  

Great atmosphere and pleasant staff. I will try Amada on another night not during restaurant week.
Hair in my Pizza, salad and plate I would highly not recommend this place for anything. Good pizza tho

I was so incredibly disappointed.  I ordered a papaya salad with shrimp to go, waited about 10 mins longer than they told me, got home and there was (I am not exaggerating) one pea-sized part of a piece of shrimp.  So essentially, I waited almost a half an hour, paid $11 for some shredded papaya. I will never go here again.

Flew into PHL and came here before driving out to Virginia. 

I have to say that when I walked in, I was pleasantly surprised! The inside definitely did not look anything like I was expecting it to look haha! Gorgeous interior, it sort of looked like a high class diner to me. I mean, it definitely doesn't look like your typical diner on the side of the road. Very clean and also pretty spacious.

We were here for breakfast, loved the selection on the breakfast menu. Its always hard for me to decide what I want for breakfast, but this place made it easy with all the basic stuff and you can do additional add ons of meats and sides for less than $5. The menu was the perfect size. I ended up going with the French toast with a side of bacon. Wasn't the best French toast, but the portion was pretty big for the price I paid. Orange juice came with the meal too.

Service was good! 

If you need a quick breakfast and are in the area, skip those chain restaurants and come here.

The set up is a little strange as there is a large open area in the middle with no furniture or seats. The drink machines are off to the side. 

There is a wide variety of drinks that are sweet. I ordered the Peach Bellini. They have a decent amount of alcohol in there but by the time that you're half way through the container, it starts to smell like vomit.
Everything is so good. Maybe the best take-out food in Delco!

Expensive, but well done.

It's pricey, but the portions are well done and the atmosphere is nicely "grown up" for this end of town. The only real competition for this class of dining in the south-west or near-south-west is Vivo.

For a nice date night away from the kids, but close enough to get home in time, XIX is  a winner.

Once again this location failed at getting an order right. Stopped placing orders months ago due the quality of the products and service.  On this visit not only did they provide the wrong toppings on one of my pizzas someone failed to properly cut the veggies placing oversized chunks of bell peppers and onion my pizzas!
This place is solid with good food at a good price and quick service.  I just wish they stayed open later.

What a fantastic experience!  We had not one, but TWO "best evers" tonight.  My wife and I had the ahi ceviche, prickly pear albondigas, charred romaine wedge and carne asada with a 16oz lobster tail.  Amazing meal.  The meatballs and the lobster tail were the best we've had, and that includes all Italian meatballs, and New England lobster tails (of the same size).   The service was exceptional throughout the meal (Mallory), and the manager (Steve) was by our table several times to check on our evening.  The food was perfect, the prices were very competitive, and the overall experience was ideal.  We'll eat here on every trip to Tucson, the place is a gem!!!

I'm so happy we stopped by this amazing sandwich shop! We absolutely loved the food. The sandwiches were stellar, the beef heart was delicious and the yuca fries were crisp and wonderful in the dipping sauce provided. The chicha Morada is delicious too! We will definitely be back!

**Update** 1/11/20

Today I had the Don Juan sandwich; breaded steak tenderloin, fried plantains with wonderful sauces on perfect bread! Sooooo delicious! We love this place

So good! This is my favorite pizza. I also had the chicken Parmesan once and the filet, which was delicious! My bf and I ordered the twin filet and split it, which turned out to be a good deal. The pizza though!!!
3 time back and still love the the place can't believe there no one else hear and it hasn't caught on around hear good food the kids love it to they get to pick what they want
Loved it! Came in for lunch because the R House was packed. Great service, great food. Would definitely go back.

Wow wow wow. The best Vegan food I've ever had. You would swear the sausage was real....but the taste is what matters. Great tamales, Had this great green curry eggplant dish. Wonderful margaritas.
I can't believe how good it was. 2 appetizers, 2 meals, 4 margaritas...about $60

Ordered take out...the tuck special sandwich with sides of Mac and cheese and beans. A delicious mess of a sandwich with beef brisket, pimento cheese & over easy egg. Although I was only there briefly it looked like a great place to stay and eat as well. The bartender was ready with my order when I arrived.

 I definitely recommend.

Was so glad to find this dive bar on the edge of the Warehouse District for a really tasty lunch.  Located on a corner is an old school bar, nothing fancy or trendy here.   Inside you will find a bar, some picnic tables and the food counter at the back.  The menu is fairly simple, but also has plenty of choices of what kind of Poboy or platter you will get.

I was lucky enough to find that they had soft shell crabs as one of the specials.  I ordered the soft shell poboy and a side of the bread pudding for dessert.  The Crab was the largest soft shell I have seen about 8 inches long and was really excellent.  The breading was crisp and the crab inside was fresh and incredibly tasty.  The bread they use is crusty, but not quite as good as the rest of the bread I had in New Orleans.  The rest of the poboy was decent, but nothing special, fresh tomato, lettuce, pickles and plain mayo added the flavor and texture you look for.

The surprise of the meal to me was the bread pudding; for $3 you get a large slab of pudding topped with a nice sugary sauce.  The bread pudding was moist and delicious, studded with raisins and diced fruit cocktail.  The fruit cocktail made for a nice old school touch and while unexpected I really enjoyed it.

Corporation Bar is a great old school dive bar to get some simple, but really tasty food.  Highly recommended.

I have been coming here for the last 6 years. This restaurant is the best Turkish restaurant in the southeast US. I have visited majority of Turkish restaurants in AL TN SC GA FL. If you are passing by or live here, this is the spot to get your Turkish food. Fine dining environment and kids friendly. They have crayons and balloons for little ones. Kunefe is baked and served just like in Turkiye. Adana and lamb Shish are my favorite. They will only serv fresh food for you. I never seen a Turkish restaurant consistently serving perfect fresh food every time for so long time. I feel lucky to have a great restaurant like this in my neighborhood. Staff is also very friendly and they are close like family.

I've tried a few Thai places in the Nola/BR area and SukhoThai did not meet my expectations . I felt the food was overall bland when Thai food typically has really rich and unique flavors. The Tom Yum soup, which is usually my favorite Thai dish, was meh and a very small portion. The Crispy Pork and Chinese Broccoli was also quite bland and not worth $17. The only dish that I enjoyed was the Pad thai, but you can't mess that up. My family and I came here for reservations at 8. Once we ordered, our food did not come out until 9. Our waitress told us the kitchen is held up a little bit and she apologized for the wait. She was gracious enough to give us a discount on our bill since our wait was so long. I don't think I will be back here, just people I would rather other Thai places and the stress of street parking was not worth it to me.
Went tonight to see billy A play. Bartender with beard SO rude we left. Never again and I'm a local. Never!!!!

Came here for breakfast and lunch several times. Loved the veggie burger and the breakfast sandwiches. Owners were so nice. Had the best homemade iced tea. I get it, it may take a bit to make your food. It's a family back there working hard. Don't let these ridiculous reviews change your mind about coming here. They have the cutest little space you can hangout at while some ACTUALLY takes their time to prepare a nice meal for you. I'll be back over and over.

What a great neighborhood pub/restaurant (no one under 21 years old) with a good selection of drinks and food.  Went for the first time this weekend (dog/house sitting on NW side of town so it was convenient).

Friendly and good service and as I said above a good selection of food items to meet everyone's appetite. 

Highly recommended and I'll be back again.

One comment: Similar to another pub/grill in Indianapolis its just a bit strange when you see on the menu: designed by Sysco.  Its something that everyone knows - i.e. a big truck with food arrives everyday from the Sysco warehouse but darn it there are times I would like to think the food is a bit more original.

It's a bit hard to find but it's right across from harp and crown. I took off a star for the lack of organization. There is a constant gaggle of people not knowing where to order and wait for food. I also received my food after someone who ordered before me. Fries hot, crisp, well seasoned. Falafel huge delicious messy but worth it. Everything is reasonably priced and delicious. I can't wait to come back and bring friends!

Good quality food and extensive menu. Came in when it was not busy, but received sub standard service. Some of the specifications we made for the order were not met and some of the food was colder than it should be. We asked for specific additions on menu items but those were not included with our order. Cheque took an abnormally long time to come the table. Waiter did take off 10% off of menu items for the mistake.

And I came back!

I was really wanting those chargrilled oysters and they didn't disappoint! I also got the seafood etouffe with some fried crawfish tails on the side. I tried the bf's gumbo and didn't like it as much as the etouffe. 

Third time's a charm in NOLA and Acme Oyster House!

Went here once.. Food was great! Only thing I didn't like was the feel of it. It looks like a fancy Italian restaurant, but the workers weren't dressed like it, nor talked like they were working in a nice place. They were very nice though! Other than the manner of the employees, the experience was great and will definitely return.

This place is the reason fast food workers won't get $15 an hour. I just got off. Went to 2 other fast food locations, this was my last one. The workers are flirting with guys outside the front and had them park their cars in the drive through lanes so customers couldn't order. It's sad, disappointing, and frustrating. If you don't want to work, don't apply for the job. You are earning free money by not having to work at all. It's ridiculous.

Service was good. Food was really good. Had the bbq shrimp over a very large toast, I dont know my bread terms, but it was good. For dessert I had Cookies and milk, cookies were warm and gooey = great, and milk was vanilla flavored -very noice.

One thing I regret which hopefully I have enough time to correct. Come during lunch they offer a wider breadth of things you can order a lot of picks you see on here is from lunch time.

Very large portions enough to share. As always the food is above par. The drawback here is the service and the hostess. You are greeted once you enter with poor attitude and a sense of entitlement by the hostesses. On this occasion our waiter stop by took off quarter brought us our drinks and returned at the end of our meal to see if we wanted anything else. I ate my meal with nothing to drink no one seem to care. I would recommend that you get Take out over table service.
Great fried chicken at great prices. Cheesesteak is good. Not quite great. But they have a huge menu with great prices

I haven't tried their ice cream because I am addicted to their Bubble Tea! They have great flavors whether your wanting something sweeter or a more true to traditional Thai style. Their exploding bubbles are new to me and definitely add something unique to the experience. 
A cute place, I can't wait to bring my niece and nephews in for the ice cream.

Somehow this place won #1 hot chicken in Nashville.   It makes me sad to think what the competitors are serving.  Ultimately, try it once for the experience, but the approach to this hot chicken leaves a lot to be desired.  It seemed to be hot because seasoning was caked onto the chicken. It was not an authentic spicy coating fried into the skin.  With some bites I felt like someone dumped a tablespoon of cayenne into my mouth.  The flavor was solid, but the consistency was not great.  As so many folks have said in their reviews, the service is pretty slow.
The menu white dog café is amazing they always have fresh seasonal fair on hand it's a family favorite we have never had a bad meal there

Legends is just that- legendary. One of the many hidden gems of the Eastside and many people will tell you this. 

I went for a Christmas dinner with my best friends family and we were all very full and very satisfied. I even went after just getting over the flu and was still thrilled with my meal and service. I had the crispy chicken which was an excellent selection and one of the others got the seafood risotto which I tried and loved.

They have a menu that changes - so I'm planning a trip back soon to try the Brussel sprouts I've heard so much about!

Never disappoints, great food, I go there for the beef tartare & the escargots most of the time, but I've tried the filet mignon, fish, chicken, all very good. Service has always been good, wonderful servers. Drink selection is large that's also a plus!

I went here for lunch and ordered French onion soup and a half oven-roasted turkey sandwich. The soup was extra salty and the sandwich was seriously a piece of turkey between two tiny pieces of bread. Unfortunately, I didn't notice you could ask for mayo or mustard for a mere $.75 extra at the time I placed my order. Perhaps it's my own fault for assuming that a sandwich is more than meat and bread. 

The service was mediocre at best. The only reasons I might consider going back is because it's near my apartment and relatively cheap. If that ever happens I will definitely order something different. Sorry, but I'm far from impressed.

My 1st visit to the awaited opening of Milo did not disappoint!  The space is light, airy and welcoming.   I was overwhelmed by the vegan choices on the menu and settled in on the Ko Curry -- I literally wanted to put my entire face in it - that good!   Rich, creamy from the coconut milk,  just the right amounts of spice,  seitan,  pineapple and rice.   I want to try every vegan item on their menu board!

Will be back - many times!

Since first review,  I generally go back weekly and Chef Craig and crew never disappoint!  I love the Pad Thai,  every single taco,  the Savannah burger and the breakfast frittata.    Just last evening,  got the Hot Moroccan sandwich for the first time and it was deeelish.

Ignore the Milo nay-sayers on Yelp and make a visit,  see for yourself first hand.   There are many of us simply bringing friends and the word-of-mouth has helped this place take off and be appreciated for the shining star it is in this E. Falls neighborhood.   I have nothing but LOVE for Craig and what he is offering.

I highly recommend checking out the Sunday Brunch buffet. Not only do you get an extensive buffett, which has all sorts of lunch items, from salads to rice ishes, various chicken or pork, chesses, salami, French bread, quiches, and dessert. Also present salmon on a plank and a carved meat station. Sangria is also included in the price, coffee is not... but alas there is a Bloody Mary bar for just a slight upcharge. 
I am partial to the made to order items, which are also included and you can eat as many of those as you want. The French toast is to die for, light and fluffy, served with a vanilla sauce, berries and a dollop of whip cream. There are omelet made to your liking and Eggs Benedict. Always interesting is the Chef Special, which in my case was Ham and cheese pancakes... sounded very odd, but turned out to be quite delicious.
Blizzard was under filled and soupy.  They couldn't serve it upside down if they had to.  Exceptionally light on the mix ins.

It was absolutely disgusting, i started choking on a bone, the mac and cheese was absolutely gross, and the mash potatoes were as dry as flour, cornbread 0/10. Don't eat here! The customer service was good though. If I could erase this place from my memory I would.

Happy Hour Central for my work colleagues & I! We come here at least once a week for their happy hour food menu & drinks. $4 drinks & most food items are under $5. 

My fav drinks are the red sangria & the dirty dog w/ extra spicy green beans. The menu is basically the same every happy hour with an occasional new item. The staff is always extremely friendly & never have a problem the specifics of a certain food item that we may have been curious about. 
(Ask for the bread rolls while you wait for your food) it's not advertised that they have rolls nor does every server just bring them out but they are amazing & a must try) 

Breakdown of the things we've tried....

fried pickles -amazing 
Lobster mac & cheese- pretty good -ask them to cook it a little longer for an amazing crisp
Crispy cauliflower - a bit of a curry sauce on it & it's a big  bowl so definitely share it. 
Wings- my friends love their wings 
Truffle fries- so gooood 
Salmon latkes- I'm not a fan at all but my friend said it's okay. 

We only visit here for happy hour so I've never actually seen their regular menu lol who even eats at restaurants anymore unless there's a happy hour involved. Haha

Craving Vietnamese tonight.... and for the most part we were satisfied with their flavors! The pork chop dish tasty yet it was ver, very thin however. Nothing like the picture that enticed me to get it. Avocado smoothie fresh and yummy, yet no boba available! 
I will definitely return because their prices were fair and oxtail is available in their pho options.

I would leave zero stars if possible. I stopped in for what I hoped would be a quick breakfast. 20 minutes later the 2 sandwiches were ready, but when I got home I noticed neither had bacon. Just eggs on a roll for $7 each!

On top of that, the employees were arguing loudly for the full 20 minutes I was there which clearly made all of the customers uncomfortable. As I was leaving, it had escalated into a shouting match - terrible experience!

I have always loved dining at Ceviche! They have the best patatas bravas on the face of the earth. They also have excellent seafood.  Lately, I've been disappointed with the portion size on meats (listen you are not french nor a manhattan restaurant - this is Tampa). Tapas are small plates but they are not an amuse bouche. Come back to your old roots! They also got rid of the best dessert - almendrado. So sad, please bring it back!! But I still love the place. Amazing music and ambience- make sure to go on the nights when Sombre Flamencas plays. They play the most amazing spanish guitar. And always make sure to have a glass of the cava sangria - simply the best!
Had the redfish a glass of wine.  Very mellow atmosphere even when busy.  Food is excellent.

This place was exactly what I wanted from my NOLA visit.  I had a recommendation from a friend of a friend, and followed up on it when we were in the neighborhood.  Yes, they're efficient, yes, maybe a little bit rude of you don't have your shit together.  Pro tip, look at the menu first, and be ready!

HOWEVER.  That means I got through the huge line quickly, got my food in the time it took for me to wash my hands, and it was SO good.  We got the Ferdi special as recommended, and a cup of the jambalaya.  SO GOOD.  We shared one full sandwich and one cup for 2 of us, and we went in hangry, and came out delighted!

Best sandwich place in town!  I've been a regular customer since they first opened.  The De La Guerra is my favorite - roast beef with salsa, cheese & avocado - this is a hot sandwich with au jus for dipping.  The Italian cold cut sandwich is awesome too - crispy capicola, salami, etc with your choice of cheese on a roll or on your choice of bread.
Salads are good too - and they offer Petrini's salad dressing.  The owners are the nicest, friendliest people you could hope to meet and the atmosphere is comfortable with tables, a bar, and outdoor tables.  A great place for lunch.
Prices, service and food were excellent! The decor is Detroit themed and I ordered the buffalo chicken pita with red potatoes. Yum!  The portion was large enough I had to take half of the pita home.

Best tacos in Reno! Handmade tortillas! Salvadoran food is quite delicious, and this place only uses FRESH ingredients, and you can certainly taste that.

This place is a hidden gem, so to speak. I wandered in here with a friend while we were playing Magic at Comic Kingdom next door. And wow, is all I have to say.

This is actually the second time I've been here now, and I had to come back to make sure it wasn't some amazing anomaly. Sure enough, this food is really the best Latin American cuisine I've had in Reno... and I get around! 

From what I hear, they have a different owner/management from a couple of years ago. I'm not sure when that occurred, and I really don't care. All I care about is they are in great hands now.

I cannot stress enough how much the handmade tortillas add to the simple taco. You'll be able to tell right away. And they sell these tacos for only two bucks each! Two or three of them will fully satisfy even the most demanding of appetites.

They offer a variety of meat for their tacos: asada, al pastor, pollo, carnitas, cabeza, chorizo, shrimp, and vegetarian. They're served with fresh cut limes and some slices radish.

So far I've had the asada (steak), carnitas, and al pastor. All were delicious, but the al pastor is my favorite, by a slim margin. 

They have a plethora of other options, like PAPUSA!, tamales, burritos, enchiladas... you name it.

They have combos for lunch, and they have a dinner menu, as well.

The staff is very friendly and makes you feel welcome. It's also a very clean environment, which definitely matters to me. 

I think I've found a new top 10 food spot in Reno, for sure.

They're right on the northwest corner of Kietzke and Moana. Make sure to check them out next time you can't figure out what to eat.

Hitting up another cool place that's so close to home! 
I sat at the bar and ordered some food to go.
Host was super friendly & welcoming.  
Bartender was polite.  The place was pretty packed for a Thursday evening, considering there were no major sporting events playing. 
It is a sports bar and I will say it's super classy - a nice mix.
Seems like a place for a date or a night out with friends.  Lots of tvs all the way around.  Lots of beer choices and some nice wine selections.
Food!  A++ I ordered the New Orleans pasta dish and the spicy chorizo queso dip.
The pasta was delicious just enough of everything: sauce, thinly sliced seasoned well chicken and andouille sausage.  It was terrific and so satisfying.
The dip was a large serving - definitely a great appetizer to share.  It was flavorful and full of chorizo not spicy - but it did have some slices of jalapeños on top which made those bites a little spicy. 
My favorite part of this meal was how easy it was to accommodate my request of no tomatoes for both dishes. 
I am already thinking about stopping by again - and again mad at myself for not trying these places sooner!

Just went in for a pitcher after eating at Marra's.  It's a cozy, little neighborhood pub with 30-40ish South Philly Italians having a good time at the bar and in the dining room area with the fireplace.  On a rainy Friday after Christmas there was plenty of space.  A typical tap selection with mostly big domestics.  They did have Yards Pale ale on tap.  A terrible song came on the jukebox and we decided to head elsewhere for better beer.  However, I would consider coming back for drinks and to try the food.

My wife and I spent the day at the WW2 Museum and walked here after (only 2-3 blocks).  It is pretty eclectic, but the food is crazy good. Mina was our server and GREAT!  There is a good variety of specialty dinks, beer on tap, and beer in bottle. I am a big cider fan and they had a great bottled cider from France.  We enjoyed the ceviche and then split one of the specialty shrimp dishes with rice. AWESOME!  I would have liked to order 6 more dishes but serving size was good and we could not finish what we ordered.  The pictures don't really give you a good idea of what to expect - there is espresso coffee bar, nice sized regular bar, sushi bar, a "library" area where you could drink a latte' and chill, and the owner is developing a movie / entertainment venue in the back.  You owe it to yourself to visit Carmo's and experience great new flavors served by attentive staff at reasonable prices.
The absolute best FRESH lobster roll and FRESH grouper sandwich in Florida.  The staff is also AMAZING.

My boyfriend and I used to come here all the time before they changed owners. Our first visit back was good, the food came out quickly and the waitress was very friendly. Practically no wait at all to get a table on a Saturday evening. The food was outstanding! Better than I remember, honestly, and better than a lot of other Mexican restaurants in the city. I wasn't in love with the decor changes though, the restaurant used to have really ornately decorated, high back chairs which gave a more intimate vibe. Now you're just eye to eye with everyone else, no dividers or partitions between tables and booths.

Impressive beer selection!!  Ask for the local stuff-it rivals Cali!  
Zombie Dust, Saucy Intruder
Get Patrick- knows the city and the beer. Great place , atmosphere and great food whether your Vegan or not!!
It just rocks!!!!
