So we have noticed this new Donut Cafe located next to Tinuana Flats and decided to stop by and see if they have opened yet.  They were closed, but to our surprise, the owners who were there working inside, saw us and invited us in.  They have is half a dozen free donuts and two coffees to try.  The owner also took me in the back to show me their kitchen.  I am so impressed by their hospitality and generosity.  Not only were their donuts delicious, but the vanilla flavored coffee was, probably the best I have ever tasted in my life, and I hate coffee...they get their beans from a long time business partner in Ft Lauderdale.  I wish more mom & pop shops had this type of morale.  Check out their menu and stop by, they open up on about a week.  they have everything from cereal donuts, to chicken waffle sandwiches and grilled cheese made out of donuts.  I can't WAIT to try their menu items, I think I am already addicted to their coffee/latte.
Real and tasty burger cooked to perfection. .great slightly crunchy sweet potato fries and lots of beer choices including their own Narrow Gauge products.   Great meal...attentive staff.

Ocha Thai is great! This is the 3rd time I've been there and ordered their lunch special. Very reasonable prices for a solid amount of food. Everything I got to try was solid! I've had their seafood noodle soup, Curry, rolls, Tom Yum Noodle Soup.

I even asked if they could cater on Saturday lunch (when they are typically not open) and they said yes! They also gave us extra rolls, more than what we ordered.

This place is awesome, and I'll keep coming back

I only came here once, near closing time, because my friend is IN LOVE with their steak sandwich. Alright, I'll give it a try.

Décor: Dark, dim, cozy restaurant. Definitely family style with a bit of a bar feel to it.

Service: Spectacular. We came near closing time, but the server was still very cordial and served our food up asap since she told us that the kitchen was closing soon. I really liked her 

Food: So of course, my friend got his much-wanted steak sandwich. It was pretty good! And decently sized!

I got their toasted ravioli since I wasn't too hungry. And you know, I'm not the biggest fan of toasted ravioli (STL-er's.. don't kill me..), but they had some pretty delicious ones! Their sauce was homemade and it was just.... Really yummy. I recommend it if you want toasted ravioli!

Bottom Line: I haven't really come here since that visit, but only because it's kind of out of the way for me. Otherwise, it was good service with good food, so why not??

So-so margaritas made with cheap tequila and LOTS of sweet and sour mix that kills you the next day.  Like every other tex-mex place north of the border they have chips and salsa and queso, etc.  Ive been on multiple occasions with friends and have found it nothing special or spectacular about it.  Just a place to see and be seen kind of thing, and a little over priced due to this.

This was a very special night - our anniversary and Luckys made it special.  The wine and food were excellent, only exceeded by the good service. We had been there before and chose it because of past experiences - we were not disappointed.

Nope. 
Went in, read their extensive specials sign which was right inside the doorway - saw the sign that said to seat yourself. I did. Sat for awhile, then a little longer... finally someone came over with a menu and water - was told my server would be over... nope. The other gal came over and said 'you just snuck in on us'... um, I'm a 6 ft tall pushing 200lb chick that sneaks nowhere, and I stood in the doorway reading your specials for how long? But, Ok...
She took my order - I got the meat sampler. It came outlooked decent enough, but sadly the highlight was the potato salad. The brisket was chewy and tough, I only ate one small piece. The pulled pork was ok... The ribs were kind of chewy, and just a really weird texture, not delicious. I ordered a cornbread after the fact and had one bite, not good. 
The BBQ sauce was alright. 

So... when she said 'come see us again' .... nope.
Craig they were closed but it was still 3 minutes before she stated the close time. Lazy! You don't want my business you get 1 Star.

Reno definitely doesn't have the amazing breakfast variety and quality that the Bay Area has. This place was just ok to me. 

The wait ended up being about and hour. First thoughts were that the decor is beyond tacky (almost unforgivably). The menu is horribly designed and had way too much going on visually. My whole table was talking about how difficult it was to read. I seriously kept losing my place and getting lost on this thing. 

None of their vegetarian options really stood out at me so I went with a simple breakfast - eggs, toast, potatoes and a mimosa. Everything was standard and cooked properly, nothing extra special. 

I did love that they had a free mimosa for the check-in offer. Wanted a hibiscus mimosa but the ingredients said it just had cranberry juice so I was a little confused by that...

Anyway, if you're in Reno this is probably one of your best bets, but partially because it's one of the only bets.

Probably one of my favorite restaurants in Nola! Excellent tacos - I've had almost every one on the menu. I could eat here every single day. Salsa, queso, nachos and quesadillas are great appetizers. I get tacos and plantains every time I go. Favorites are Caribbean jerk, calypso beef, brisket, bbq pork(?)! The drinks are all great. You can't go wrong with a margarita but the key lime drink is great! 

The only bad experience I've had here was with wait times - taco Tuesday is usually packed. They serve $2 tacos and at least a 2 hour wait. It's expected. I've also tried the shrimp curry and didn't like it.

Food was not impressive, service was bad, staff were inattentive and ignorant. Will not come back.

Came here with fds (party of 10) for dinner. 
We were seated near the kitchen and at times we smelled chlorine. 
Garlic bread was good. 
We werent sure about the portion and we werent too hungry so we ordered less plates than headcount. 
Dishes came split, though, portions were SMALL. 
Pasta was fair, pizza was not good. 
Bill came out with a $12 split fee for our 6 dishes. 
WTF. 
1) they did not offer a split when taking our order; 
2) the portion after split was not significantly larger; 

Would have given negative ratings if we could.

We just discovered this on a Saddlebrookian jaunt.  Happened upon it yesterday as many places were closed for lunch due to the holiday or due to it being Monday.  We were so lucky to choose this place.  The service was gracious and unobtrusive, we got a personal visit from the owner, we were served promptly yet not rushed or interrupted incessantly, and the food was fresh and satisfying, and the waitress was proud of where she worked and clearly had a good rapport with the kitchen and the food.  She said the seafood was always fresh and was a specialty.  Our table had the moussaka and the salmon salad and a giro sandwich, all were superb.  And yes, the homemade desserts, especially the cake, was wonderful.  I highly recommend this tucked away gem.

We wanted to come to this place just to try it out. We've heard all about it and the line is always crazy, so when we had a little extra time in the AM on a work trip, we made our way over. The line wasn't terrible, but it's not something I would necessarily wait in again (in the heat with kids). 

The favorites: The bonuts were great. The chronic bacon was a fave. The OJ was legit. 

I got the Lindstrom and i didn't find it remarkable but I at least felt healthy while eating it so I guess that counts (?). My husband got the East Nasty and loved it. 

Line was long-ish but staff was kind and the process was smooth. Overall, we are glad we went and tried it out.

Great tacos. Loved the abodabo. Def would come back. 

Very basic menu. Super cheap.

Best gelato in Nashville. There, I said it. 

I used to be a big fan of the Whole Foods gelato bar or places like Bravo Gelato, but now I can't go to either without sighing. *sigh* This isn't Legato.  
Legato, you have ruined me. I'm not even mad. 

Parking can be interesting in Edgehill, especially if you're cheap like me and avoid the pay lot at all costs.  Pick a side street and take a little stroll to walk off what you're about to indulge in. 

I can't really give an accurate flavor recommendation because they change often and are basically all amazing.  Lately the peach has been my favorite and dark chocolate is always good mixed with banana or pretty much anything else. 

Bonus: Find them at the 12th South farmer's market on a hot day to cool you off while you browse!

What a wonderful experience. Classy and classic in the heart of St Louis' The Hill.  Outstanding food, outstanding service, great atmosphere. We had the toasted ravioli which was crispy and very delicious but the real star in the late was the red sauce. WOW! I tried each of the three main meals we were served. Veal?  Spectacular. Rigatoni with (red sauce) homemade sausage. Killer. My all around fav was what I had. Eggplant Napolitano. What? Huh? Really? Must get!  I posted a picture. 

Service by professional wait staff is always a plus. Prices are decent. Wine selection is abundant and diverse. Parking totally stinks but they have a very responsive valet service so no worries there. 

Come and eat and have the red sauce!

This used to be Marathon Grill, now it's just Marathon. They changed the decor, darkened it up, added a nice bar, and changed the menu slightly.

I had the cheese steak sandwich which was very good. The fries were warm but soggy. A place like this needs to be able to serve crispy fries at least. 

I had lunch there on a Monday. The tables are crowded in very close, annoyingly so -- you feel like the people sitting next to you can hear every word, and that's because they can.

We decided to try this place out as it's next to my favorite consignment shop. I had my daughter with me and we met my best friend for lunch. Despite being described as pub, its very family friendly and there were several others kids seated with their families. The Bloody Mary was on point and the wings were amazing. They have a great variety of bar food and I highly recommend.

Very yummy & quick! Not over priced at all. They have a large menu to choose from and open 24 hours which is nice. Guess you can go shopping at Walmart at 2 am and stop at Mel's after for a nice meal. LoL joking aside they have a cute 50's diner theme too! Fun place to stop and good place to bring the kids too.

First time eating Indian cuisine, and my family and I ordered delivery from Uber Eats. We wanted to try an array of dishes, so we went with 2 appetizers, 2 chicken dishes, 2 lamb dishes and 2 vegetable dishes, which included chicken tandoori and chicken tikka apps, butter chicken, chicken korma, lamb curry, lamb saag, dal palak and baigan bhartha. We also ordered a side of Raita, which we all loved! While we loved everything we ordered, we narrowed it down to our favorite dishes, which included chicken tandoori appetizer, chicken korma, lamb saag and dal palak. We will definitely be ordering from Flames again soon! Wish I would've taken some pictures, but it smelled so delightful that we all just dug in!! Highly recommend Flames! The owner is super nice and helpful too!
The Chianti caramelized onion burger with Fontana is so amazing!!! The beef ragu gnocchi is so good. Great food consistently and good service

Was here for dinner recently. Small restaurant but nice atmosphere. I thought the menu was a bit limited--particularly since it was so eclectic. Also portions were a bit small. For example, the angry crab spaghetti was a rather modest portion of pasta and very light on the crab. Loved the squash hummus however: had nice kick to it and homemade breadsticks were one of the highlights of the meal. On the other hand I was a little let down by the broccoli starter after all the positive reviews I read about it. The tempura style batter gave broccoli a nice crunch but I just didn't think it was anything that special....
Finally the wine pours were maddeningly small. Sorry--when you're paying $16 for a glass of wine you should never feel like the waitress is rationing it. But I got the message: if I go back I will definitely order a bottle. Or better yet I will try the breakfast.

Holy macaroni and everything else they sell there. Fresh scratch food it's like parking in front of 100 food trucks and having your choice of every type of Philadelphia fare you could imagine. Breakfast lunch and dinner every day if I could...

This is a great, trendy pizza place, plopped right into the middle of our lovely beaches.

Expect a wait to be seated.  My party of 2 had to wait 1 hour, and that was not even during peak dining/tourist season.

Then the food ordering to food served time was about 45 minutes.

The pizza was really great!  We got the meatball/mushroom special and were pleasantly surprised.

Fair warning:  This may be the LOUDEST restaurant I've ever dined in.  I'm not sure if it was from sports shown at the bar or a few drinks too many by the others?  But wow...

We nearly had to SHOUT at our table to be heard.

To conclude:  This joint is clearly aimed at our beach tourists.  A bit overpriced for the locals, but great food.  If you enjoy bar-noise and chaos, you will love it here!

But for me?  Never again, except for take-out.....

This is a place where they get you so hammered on their exotic beers that you don't realize what you're eating unless you're sober. Terrible dining experience. There's plenty of options here in Doylestown, so choose wisely! 
My husband and I are in town for our honeymoon. We knew tonight wouldn't be an upscale dinner. And I wanted ribs, so we came here. 
Overall dining experience: poor. 
They seated us near the bar. Neither of us drink, but the patrons sitting at the bar and the bartender were shouting from the moment we sat down. The waitress moved us upstairs no problem.
We sit and the whole table feels slanted. I felt like I would fall out of the booth. Not to mention the table was sticky. Not dirty, just that kind of sticky you can't really get rid of. 
We had nachos as an appy. They were pretty good. Highlight of my evening. My husband ordered a Coke, which was flat and had to ask for a new one. I ordered ribs and it came with a side Caesar salad. The dressing tasted sour, like it had turned. My husband ordered the peppercorn steak, which was delicious despite being covered in salt.
My ribs were a huge disappointment. Not only did it look unappealing, they were stacked on top of one another like a game of Jenga. But it was all fat. Every bite was mushy, so I asked for a steak knife and cut the meat off. There was barely anything edible about it. The very few meaty parts were hard and weird to chew. I finally gave up trying to enjoy this meal as my stomach had turned and I began to feel sick. My husband wasn't feeling too hot either. 
The waiter was very nice and friendly though. He had no problem getting us a new coke, or answering our questions. The staff brought us extra BBQ sauce on request in a quick manner. As a meal though? Skip it!
Here I am, an hour later and I'm writing this from my phone on the toilet. My dinner is pouring out of me like lava. I have many regrets. Eating here is one of them.

The chicken is fantastic - no question. Maybe the best I've ever had. Portions a bit small but the taste is amazing. Be prepared to wait- it's always poppin. Also a bit off the beaten path, but that didn't seem to bother any of the patrons. Service is hit or miss.
Great Place for lunch, will need to take some of those frozen dinners to try at home!!

Ordered last night. They forgot a soda, bread, herb mix, olive oil and utensils.  Even asked fir extra bread and he said it was in the bag. When I called, they said there was nothing they could do. Unfortunately, their customer service at this location has gone down the tubes.

Oh my goodness! I'm from the West where Mexican food is a staple--- REAL mexican! I've been looking everywhere, for years... where have you been D'Mexican???! 

I have found my go to place. This place is FAB. Everything was PERFECT. So, so fresh. Salsa to die for. (I added my own pepper sauce at home to add a little more kick) but such GREAT flavor to that stuff!

Tacos- Chicken, beef and pork- the meat was seasoned amazingly.

Chili Rellano- Melt in your mouth! 

I read reviews from their other locations (they have one on Central Ave too!) and a few people said they are heavy on cilantro. Say wha??? Are those people nuts?! This was indeed the perfect blend of spices including cilantro. I would have never used the word HEAVY on anything we got other than "heavy on the flavor".

Keep in mind I was also feeding a family of 6, and everyone loved it. It was well worth the money for fresh food, although I am not at all into cheap food. I find value in spending more to put good stuff into our body and this was no exception. 

Right across from the VA on Bay Pines Blvd in the Bay Pines Plaza. It's tucked away but it's truly a hidden gem. So stop reading this and run over now to grab a bite of real fresh mex!

First time at this new restaurant. The parking lot is small and tight if you are in a bigger vehicle. To order you walk up to a counter and place your order for the meat item. Then you can decide on the sides, kind of buffet style, pay and seat yourself. My hubby got two slices of brisket and a handful of chicken. Both items were laid on a piece of paper that was on a metal tray. I ordered a turkey club. Mine was brought to the table after my husband had finished his meal. My husband also got a piece of cornbread wrapped in cling wrap and a styrofoam cup of baked beans. He got tea and I did not get a drink. Total $28.00. At the table there are several large squirt bottles of sauce. Cold sauce on warm meat, laying on a piece of paper. He ate what he ordered. I took my sandwich home. Sorry but I don't get it. The food was okay but for almost $30 I'd like a plate and table service. I wouldn't serve food in my own home this way. We won't be back.

Nice place to stop and eat. It was very crowded and we managed to get two stool seats by the window.   We actually preferred these seats as one cud people watch.  The service was very nice.  There was very little in the way of selection for my friend who is gluten free.   
However, I did enjoy my dumplings.   I would definitely stop back in the next time I am in Philly.
This is about the worst pizza I have ever had. The crust is ok, but the cheese and sauce are just blah. I guess I shouldn't expect much for airport food, but this place is not good.

I called in for a pick up and ordered the western omelet with hash brown. Never got the hash browns and the egg part of my omelet (main ingredient to an omelet) was not cooked all the way in the center. It was runny and I tried nuking it in the microwave at my hotel but no luck. It's a 17 min drive back and I cannot go back to switch it. The service was very friendly!!! But hopefully next time my experience will be like everyone else's with 5 stars. My husband loves his food so I know it's not entirely bad.

Food is good. Made a big mistake and sat at the bar.. A older gentleman is waiting on us .. I have never ever in my life experienced someone so angry and rude at a restaurant. Sadly this was my mom and I's first time here and for sure will be our last. Judging by his interactions with guests and employees this is very common behavior from him . I am in shock this is tolerated at a place like this . You can get friendlier service at Wendy's so save your money !!! Happy dining everyone.  Should have sat on the other side of the bar the female working looks very sweet and engaging with guests .
Last time we ordered from here we got awesome sauces with our dumplings that really enhanced the flavors, this time absolutely no sauce. Very disappointing!

I've been coming here for years, and it is such an easy choice because they have such good food and a very chill atmosphere.  You can't miss the game because of all the flat screens... Nice service too!

Second time at this restaurant and it did not disappoint. I had an payment issue from previous visit and one of the lead cashier (Brent?) helped me sort it out. We ordered Korean short rib, chicken katsu, takoyaki, and imperial rolls. The Korean short rib was a little underwhelming, definitely could have eaten more meat LOL! The chicken katsu were so good! The imperial roll were very good as well, but the takoyaki were not as I expected. I've had takoyaki before and I guess this one was just different than what I was used to. The wait wasn't too long and I was able to hang out next door to tea shop while I waited for my order (to-go).

Great place for Bocce and Italian sandwiches. They have a great, laid back atmosphere and very reasonable prices. Try the Milo's Special, the Roast Beef, and the Salsiccia. Spring for the Garlic-Bread - you won't regret it!

I am a fan of all the Marc Vetri Restaurants and can not wait for him to keep opening up more. I was at Amis on friday night and once again, it did not disappoint.

This place is always packed so reservations are necessary. Even with reservations, you may need to wait a few minutes but, for my group, it was friday and we were happy with having some cocktails at the bar. 

I was thrilled with the table they seated us at. One of my complaints has always been how close they seat you to other tables but our table was sort of off in the corner with plenty of room. 

There are a few highlights at Amis that I must mention. First, they have my favorite preparation of sweetbreads that I've ever had. They're almond dusted, fried and served with an orange fenel marmalade. They are juicy on the inside, crispy on the outside and the marmalade adds an awesome sweet flavor to a salty dish. YUM!
That aside, the pastas are always a highlight as well. My favorite pasta this time was a rigatoni with a wild mushroom ragu. The pasta was aldente and the ragu was creamy, salty and delicious...especially if you love mushrooms like me.

From here, there were two seafood dishes that blew my mind. The skate wing and the swordfish meatballs. HOLY skate wing. They dust it in this super fine flour and pan fry it just to give a little texture, serving it with a lemon butter sauce with fried brussel sprouts...very approachable. The flavors and textures in this dish were heaven. I could eat this dish all the time and be happy. After that, the swordfish meatballs. YUM! The meatballs just fell apart when you touched them and were perfectly tender and juicy, served over some creamy polenta. 

The only thing I wasn't crazy about for this meal were the desserts. They were good but not great. Honestly, I can't even remember what we had but everything else was so delicious, it doesn't even matter!

Went for dinner.
Great addition to neighborhood.

Goof food good drinks friendly service! 

Will certainly return.

Wish I could have given no stars. My husband and I went on 2/15 for Valentines. They were not all that busy but you would have thought they were packed. We both ordered the Tour of Italy. After almost 45 minutes, the food was delivered and wasn't even room temp. We waited almost 10 minutes for our server to check on us. When she did it was obvious that she didn't appreciate us not saying everything was fine. She took our plates "to have our food refixed" and returned with it about 10 minutes later. AGAIN, served cold. I actually wonder if it was  the same food on different (hotter) plates. We never saw her again. We did see the manager who said he didn't want us to leave and then complain to others about the quality.  Very disappointed we left and will not return. After over 1 1/2 we left there and had to find somewhere/something to eat!!!

I usually love Bonefish but last night the experience was awful!  We waited almost 2 hours for a table because the kitchen staff was so far behind.  I'm sure they are struggling to find workers like all restaurants.  When we got to our table and ordered appetizers we were asked to share a napkin and silverware as they were out of clean silverware.  She told us the manager refused to order more.  My mom are her entree with her fingers and I luckily ordered soup which came with a spoon.  The server kept disappearing to serve others so my husband went without drink refills.  This was the worst experience we have ever had here so will be back but not if it happens again.
Any of the salads with grilled chicken are a bit gamey but ones with tuna are always safe.
Great white fish salad on perfectly toasted bagel! Quick service with a smile and reasonablely priced to boot!

Staff is super friendly and polite. Atmosphere is chill and the food is delishhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh. I had PO BoY tacos. Not big on tofu but this def. changed my mind! So yummy and filling. And Peruvian home fries are really really good. Perfect amount of spice.
One of our favorites when we visit New Orleans. Crab cakes are excellent! Always get great service. Never had a bad meal or food item.

I stumbled upon this cafe after getting my haircutnearby and my friend and I finally tried it today. This cafe has wonderful Mediterranean/Turkish salads, dishes and you can sample some before you order. So we both had Russian Salad, and she also had white bean salad. I tried the Israeli Couscous Salad and Bulgher Salad. Yummy! All homemade, she uses dried beans. She also has homemade bakery items which look really good as well as Ice Cream. In colder months, I want to try the homemade lentil soup. The Owner is very sweet. We will be backwhen we have more adventures on South Street.

I really liked the ambience the food was amazing my brother didn't think it was amazing but he really enjoyed it anyway! I had the red fish wood grilled with shrimp on top it was really good had some nice sauce and sausage with mushrooms

is always  here and the service was really good. We had our pizza delivered with the quickness. The  we ordered we're tiny but plentiful so no complaints. The fries were terrible....soggy & looked old. We didn't touch them at all & kinda upset us we wasted our money on them. I'll reorder again bc the  is amazing....but the fries need improvement.

My mother was visiting for the weekend and we, my husband and I, decided to take her to Paciugo for dessert.  We have always had a decent experience until tonight.  One of your employees, Lauren, bypassed us to another patron.  As I explained to her that we were there first, she told us that it didn't matter.  It matters who came to ask for a taste first.  Apparently, us waiting patiently does not signify we are waiting in line to taste your offerings, however, we were and we were dismissed.

Wow! I am going to write my review in chronological order. First of all, the ambiance is really nice! You can tell they just updated everything in the front part of the restaurant, its very modern, edison bulb lighting, rich woods, new booths- very nice! My friends and I sat down and I had a glass of red wine, can't remember what it was but it was great! We ordered toasted ravioli for the table and OH MY GAWD - give me all of those, I don't care if I gain 10 lbs, it will be worth it! Soooo yummy! Oh and pro tip, get a side of the house dressing and dip a toasted ravioli in that and then the marinara sauce - you'll thank me later. Ordered the spaghetti and meatballs for dinner and holy moly that was the best I have ever had! You can taste the freshness! Everything is homemade and delicious. Bottom line, if you are looking for good Italian this is your place!

This Thai restaurant does everything right! Crispy spring rolls served with a delicious sauce, coconut chicken soup that is full of flavor and Tofu in chili sauce that is perfectly spicy but not hot! The Amazing Chicken entree is yummy too.

The service is friendly, fast and efficient. You will love the food, atmosphere and service. I'll return often.
Exceedingly slow and poor service. Nearly unbelievable levels of slowpokey incompetence.
Excellent food and great service.  Have been here several times and consistently exceeds expectations.
Their pasta is pretty good. We also Iike their cheese bread. It's different from Olive Garden, so yeah if your trying to decide between the two. Oregano's has more spicier flavor than Olive Garden.
Portions are very generous. Pork was delicious. Limited seating indoors, but they have a very nice patio
THE BEST WINGS. I've been to this location a million times, good food, fast service, fun karaoke nights AND the best wings ever. Worth going just for the wings.

Yelp is now grub hub.  Beware grub hub with all their money can't afford to put their logo on the fake menu. 

The pho was great from this place. Only cost $40 bucks for 3 kid portions of pho off the fake menu. 

That's 40 bucks for 3 bowls of soup that I had to pick up myself. 

Lesson learned.

The one star is not fair for this restaurant but you got in bed with these people.
I've ordered food from here 2x. The renovations are great. The staff are friendly and the salads (cedar and straeberry) were fresh and delicious. Ww have, yet, to order the pizza

We ate here on 7/23 after visiting a friend in Pottstown.  I'm a sucker for a diner so in we went.  It was great!  Very nice waitstaff, clean, reasonably priced food.  We had cheesesteaks and the chicken appetizer that my kids shared as a meal.  Portions were nice.  Definitely would eat here again given the chance!

Oh my God this place is so good. My first appetizer ever there was the seared scallops with pork belly one of the best meals I have ever eaten. I returned today for breakfast and had to chorizo sausage burrito. I would highly recommend this place to anyone
Cute little spot!  We didn't eat, we only grabbed some cocktails. Smelled amazing though!

Came for dinner on a Saturday night with some girlfriends, and were greeted with a smile, and immediately sat down (so happy there wasn't a wait, because we were ready to chow down)!

We ordered the fried spring rolls and fried wontons for appetizer. The spring rolls were a little greasy, but that's to be expected. I LOVED the fried wontons! The flavor of the pork and the dipping sauce they provide was so flavorful! Definitely a must have appetizer!

We decided to eat family style, and got the Moo Dang fried rice, drunken noodles, and pad Thai. All three dishes were extremely flavorful, and served in portions that are meant to be shared! The drunken noodles are definitely on the spicier side, but totally delicious if you like a little kick!

Service was beyond excellent, and food was so great that we started diving into everything so fast, I completely forgot to take pictures. Whether you order online (they're currently doing 15% off of online orders), or go to the restaurant and eat, you will not be disappointed!

After having passed by Little Anthony's for many years in favor of places that didn't feature classic cars and 50's theme schtick (and a fear of getting sucked into the Gaslight for a magic show), we decided to try it anew as a place where my two little boys could have a fun meal.  Little Anthony's fit the bill and has provided a solid place for the family to go for dinner--and when combined with classic auto show nights a trip here can be the highlight of the week for my car loving 5 year old. 

Pizza is very good and hasn't changed in decades (and that's a good thing!). Though i wish that the pizza wasn't made egg, which my littlest is allergic too. Burgers are big with a good beef flavor and fries are served hot and golden--what else could you want in a red basket? Ice cream sundaes and shakes also make this a more interesting alternative to a bland frozen yogurt strip mall joint. 

Kids get an extensive menu akin to the regular-sized menu but with pictures to circle for their choices. I would like to have more 'fresh' alternatives for the kids plates, but considering this is a burger and pizza diner that is a condition of the offerings across the board. The food here is good, but secondary to the experience. The game room/arcade, crayons and butcher paper table covers,  and the occasional trivia questions and songs from the live DJ (on busier times) is entertaining while waiting on meals to be served.

I have tried this place twice now . My first visit was ok at best . I had the oxtails , rice and peas with cabbage. The portions are HORRIBLE !!!  They offer one of the side dish options to fill the largest portion of their takeout container. I'm sorry for 16.00 i would expect that the container would be used appropriately the largest space would contain the protein and the sides would be in the smaller spaces . This is why i will not return. I don't need and email apology and/ or direct message. You need to correct this for new customers .

I understand the difficulty right now with COVID and takeout orders.  That being said, preselected pickup times should help with that.  When you select a 5:45 pick time, it should be in a reasonable timeframe from that.  Have been outside since 5:40 and still do not have my food...current time is 6:30!  Many other restaurants have figured this out.  Many have the order walking out the door before I even put my car in park at curbside pickup!  Trattoria Marsala, Weber's Bar and Grill, Twisted Tree...0 issues and 100% on time.  The sushi here is great, but carry out is an EPIC FAIL!!
Great choices on slices, great busy atmosphere and I got a free cannoli from yelp's coupon, it was so yummy!  Def a place to visit when Downtown!

How can you not love this place?  Tried the muffaletta & the hot boudin, and both were awesome.  For the sammy, the meats are cured in-house, and the bread / cheese/ tapenade combo kicked some serious ass.  The boudin is odd given the difficult casing, but that's generally how they are, and the flavor is amazing, and perfectly paired with their mustard.

Since I've been here last year, it's undergone a major expansion, tripling in size.  We surprisingly had no problem getting a table at 1pm on a Sunday.  If you're in the mood for a good relatively affordable sandwich, check this place out.

Pros: Good chicken and shrimp. Satisfies your cravings.

Cons: There can be quite a line on some days.

I'm no stranger to First Watch. And now, neither is my mother. Based on my previous visits to their north Phoenix location, I thought it would be fun to introduce my mother to this excellent breakfast chain while in Tucson last weekend.

Right away, the decor is familiar and inviting. Plus, the dining room is bright and airy. And to top it off, our server Reanna was awesome! My mother wasn't familiar with the menu and asked a lot of questions, but Reanna was patient and made some good recommendations. Her timing and pleasant demeanor made our breakfast very enjoyable.

The more I explore the menu at First Watch, the more I'm impressed. And their Million Dollar Bacon was already pretty impressive! My mom enjoyed her Lemon Ricotta Pancakes and my Market Hash was delicious. And in case I've never mentioned it, the fruit preserves they serve with the toast is another impressive item on a long list.

First Watch has demonstrated their standards are high. This visit to their Tucson location also demonstrates their consistency. If you've never dined here, you're missing out!

I really enjoyed our experience. They bring patatas bravas while you pursue the menu. The portions of each tapas plate was a good size and all the dishes we had had good flavors. The wine list leans pretty heavy on higher priced (more than $50) wines, so be prepared to shell out some cash. You definitely need reservations on the weekends, and they try to be as accommodating as possible when making reservations. It's a fun funky vibe that is just so perfectly Tucson. Check it out!

Ahhhh where do i begin , the pizza crafted here makes me feel like no other food exists. Makes my palete blossom into complete sensations i've never felt or tasted. Orgasmic in a sense . Other than the pizza , the employee that assisted me  (Bryce) was help like no other.  I know a thing or two about customer service and pizza but Bryce or as i would say the (pizza Mr. Miyagi) , showed me how's it's done . I felt like a little school boy learning his final lesson on how to really treat a customer . 10/10 recommended .
Great carne asada and grilled onion. Recommend carmelo, tacos, and papancha
1st time here and the food was absolutely delicious!!! The seafood omlette was to die for so much flavor. Highly recommend and the chicken and waffles was awesome!!! You will not be disappointed!!!
Love this place, we always come here when visiting Tuscan. Indian fry bread is yummy. Haven't had anything on the menu we didn't like. Friendly staff and clean restaurant.

Surprised by some of the negative reviews - I am assuming this was due to some kinks being ironed out as they only recently opened.  A friend recommended it to me and my wife and I ate there last night.  Great service, varied menu, and the food was great.  I'd recommend.

This restaurant is huge. It is located across the street from the Gaylord and co-located with an ice cream shop. It has a large private lot that it shares with the ice cream shop.  The place is huge and if you have a choice I recommend sitting near the back or by the pond. We were near the front and had tons of people walking by us going in and out.  As with most dine-in restaurants now adays, you must wear a mask until you are seated. The staff here is very friendly and the restaurant has a great atmosphere/vibe. Each table is given complimentary corn fritters (they tasted like funnel cake to me).

The restaurant has a log cabin/country feel with stuffed wild animals all over the restaurant. My kids love the ram and the bear cub. The menu has wild game, traditional grille food (burgers, salads, wraps...), and adult beverages.  I opted to live on the wild side and go with the elk slider with fries. They were delicious.  It was a bit nervous because all through out the menu you are warned that there is no refunds for wild game purchases and beware. Apparently, they have had some issues with this in the past, so much so that they had to print it in their menus. They have some savory signature cocktails for those over 21 and we were treated to live music while we were there dining.

They restaurant is a must stop if you are in Nashville.  The prices are a bit higher than other places, but you are paying for the food as well as the experience.

In today during the lunch rush at 12:40 there were 15 people ahead of me in line. Only waited 4 minutes to be served. The restaurant was clean, comfortable temperature, lighting and music volume. Restroom clean and stocked. Selection case was clean, everything looked fresh and nicely presented. Employee who took my order smiled warmly and offered a nice welcome. I did a 'create my own' and added additional toppings, packing in the protein. The employee kept me up to date with my topping number and asked nicely if additional charge for extra toppings was okay. He has worked here for some time and I have never encountered him in a bad mood or not being focused on great customer service. A mature gentlemen at the register also smiled and asked my fresh roll type, I declined that and a beverage, I don't drink when I eat. He then nicely asked if I would like a courtesy cup of water, nice gesture! I was seated with my salad just 7 minutes after entering with that long line. My salad was excellent with every item cut perfectly, fresh and delicious. The tables were being kept wiped as soon as they emptied. It doesn't get any better then this!

Dinner on a Thursday night and everything was great. Busy place but was seated in 5 minutes. From our appetizers (fries) to the meals (peel and eat shrimp and calamari) and the bisque (my favorite) everything was great! And the hush puppies!  Service was excellent!  Atmosphere was great outside. Great place with fresh seafood done right.

This place reminds me of a Buffalo Billiards vibe from the late 90's- happening! Although I'm not 20 anymore and I felt a bit old to be there. Still, this place is cool! Very large with lots of games such as shuffleboard, ping pong, foosball, etc. They have some house made punches, and I really enjoyed my hurricane in a souvenir plastic cup. They have an outdoor back patio which houses the ping pong tables and the left side of the place where the bar is has games and was packed! The right side of the place was more of a sit down restaurant vibe and much smaller. Didn't try food, but they had a ton of beer on draft. Great for a group, will be back!

I was first impressed by the service. I came in at lunch time and was met by a nice man who offered me hot tea (very sweet) while I waited. 
I ordered two dishes under sauces. While I thought the dishes were a little pricey at first, when the food came out, I was impressed. I ordered two dishes and my fiance and I got over two meals out of them. 
I can't speak to authenticity because I have never had West African before.  The chicken was delicious, if spicy. If you are not into spicy food be sure to ask about it. 
The fish was overcooked, but tasted good. 
Overall, I am definitely going back to experiment with something new!

I love this place, the vibe is super grown and sexy and the food is yum in ur tum!! I love the island style vibe and when I go inside, I want to come in with a drink with a little umbrella in it!! 

My Fav item so far are the Tostones Tuesday thing...I always modify the items on there but damn it tastes like a shot of love....nom nom!!!

The ambiance: We sat on the outside patio with a view of the wheel to one side and the pond (with fire show!) on the other. It's a magical experience at night, with the hanging lights twinkling around you.

The food: the food menu is not extravagant, offering the American diner food you'd expect. We tried a smash burger and a fried chicken sandwich. The chicken was pressed thin and overflowing the brioche bun, served with lettuce, tomato and mayo, fried to perfection :) For this dish, I'd like to see some special house made aioli spread generously to rev up the flavors a bit, but I know other folks will like the simplicity.

The smash burger is Steak 'n Shake - esque and was cooked perfectly. Both sandwiches paired well with a strawberry shake (not one of the fancy ones on the menu, but still delicious) and some crinkle fries. 

Tips: when you go, expect a 15 minute wait at minimum, but could go much longer at peak times as this place is still new and very much buzzed about. You'll have time to peruse the gift shop / candy store and even stroll the grounds of the train shed. The host will text your phone when your table is ready, so wander as much as you'd like! 

Overall, a great place for families. It's hard not to smile while you're here. They are still working out some service kinks-- be patient. They'll get you all taken care of!

Note, they are NOT open on Sundays.

PARKING: There is plenty of street parking as it is located in a random neighborhood.  We found some right in front.

WAIT: They open at 11:30 but by the time we got there around 11:15 there were already people lining up outside.  By the time we got let in ordering took some time as there was only one cashier.  There is a bar area where you can sit down right away and order but since we had a large group we snagged one of the few tables inside.  

ATMOSPHERE: The inside is small with wooden benches and a lot of decor on the walls, it's very fun and lively inside.  You can go outside where there are more tables and the bathrooms.  You order first then sit down and they call your name and bring the food to you.  It didnt take much for the food to come out, maybe 5 or so minutes.

FOOD: I got the W special with 2 sides but I think 1 side would have been plenty.  I think the total is $13 with 1 side dish.  

It comes with 2 ribs, 3 slices of brisket and a helping of the pulled pork.  The meat does not come with any sauce but at the table there was a vinegar-y sauce, bbq sauce and a spicy habanero sauce.  Their sauces are very watery, but has a tangy type taste.  Not bad, but the bbq actually didnt even need it to taste good. 

Brisket was fatty and tasty, each bite had a little bit of fat in it.

Ribs were also very good.  Fall off the bone and had their own flavor and taste despite not having any sauce to go with it.

Pulled pork was pretty tender but not the best I've had - I probably could have stuck with the 2 meat combo.

Mac n Cheese - SO good.  They bake it and yet the pasta was still al dente and the sauce wasnt overly runny or saucy.  

Cole Slaw - not that saucy either, which was good because it didnt feel like it was drenched in mayo.  Probably my least favorite part.

They also include a toasted piece of white bread.

Overall, definitely worth coming to.  The bbq was dry in the sense it wasnt smothered with sauce but it was so delicious!

Never been for lunch...but just I always get the Pad See-Ew (sp?) chicken.  It's everything I expect and a good enough portion that I always have enough to take home.  But, that's usually because I get white rice which is given in very hefty scoops.

Good prices and servers are amazingly nice.  I've eaten there a few times and got take-out once.  Service is always fast.

Eden is my favorite Korean restaurant in this area. It does get crowded real quick so it is always best to go early or make a reservation! The staff are super nice there and very attentive. When I eat at a Korean restaurant, I always love to see what banchans they offer. Here, if there's a particular banchan that you want, you can always ask for more. To start, I usually get the Kimbap or seafood pancake, both tastes amazing! For entree, I typically get the Bulgogi Dolsot Bibimbap! I love how it's served in the clay pot and you can hear the sizzle when it's served, then you have to quickly mix it unless you are like my husband, who enjoys eating the burnt crispy rice. I love how big of a portion it is and served with all sorts of veggies so I get my fair share of meat and vegetables. I love this restaurant and I'll definitely be back soon!
i orderd the alligator sausage po boy with gumbo and it was good as heck i was extremely hung over and that gumbo brought me back to life...thanks yall!

This place is super lovely. I'm intrigued by the decor and the coffee they offer, Although I found the menu a bit disappointing. I was hoping for more whole food options. Wilfred's is in a great location with ample parking so I will be back to try it again!

Israel you better give Carly a raise! Thank you Israel  for reserving a table for my friends and I last minute and thank you Carly for giving us great service. You made sure we were well hydrated with our orders to make sure we stayed awake and have a good time.

A nice diner. Tons of options, yet everything we had was fresh and delicious. We ate here twice in the same day if that tells you anything :P Breakfast was great, chicken croquettes, chicken parm, hot turkey, soup.. everything we had I would order again!

i consider Byrnes one of the most overrated places in philly. there food is mediocre....AT BEST!  the wings are intensely inconsistent. the rost beef sandwich is about the size of a quarter. the logs taste exactly like they sound. the crabs are small, bland and expensive. it is crowded and cramped. i just dont get it.  probably never will. if you want crabs and fries, go to chickie and petes. if you want wings, i am sure you will find better. they must hypnotize people as they come in because there is simply NOTHING special here.

I am familiar with the Desi Village in King of Prussia, and was very excited when the Baltimore Avenue location opened.  The food is quality, and they offer a several levels of spiciness, including "Indian hot".  Desi Village is my first choice for neighborhood take out, especially since the kitchen is open until 10pm.

I don't understand previous reviewers' complaints about portion size, unless they are comparing Desi Village to the New Delhi buffet.  This is a fallacy, as New Delhi food is just not good, and never has been.

As for concerns about plastic waste, when I order take-out, I bring back my washed take-out containers, and the kitchen uses them to fill my new order.  I appreciate this practice, as it limits the size of the plastic container collection in my kitchen.
My favorite place to eat!!  Nice clean atmosphere and great service the food is always good  perfect for date night!!

This restaurant very very bad service I went to the restaurant today and server he is very bad.. food is was okay..and we went with friends 8 people and we know that's the tip is already including and we're paid by credit card...but they're double charge the tip more $31 ...but they're already changed tip &19.20 total bill is $106.80 and they're charge more $31 so,,total bill is $146.52 ...what is that???so,,you can't do that..it's mean you shit on me..

So, what else can I say but very, very impressed with this place, what a find!!   From the food, service and the entertainment, cant believe its right here in Clearwater....First class, all the way!!   Our waiter, Chris, friendly, knowledgeable, the food, delicious and ample portions, so much fun, we are coming back Friday with friends, to see the female sax Player, great concept here and worth the money!!!    This will be one of my "go to" spots to take friends for sure!
Its different from the "rest", try it, you will like it :)
What a meal!  One of the best I've ever had. Great food, wonderful service, cozy, romantic ambience. Loved it all. Can't wait to go back.

Ordered a couple more times since my initial review.  The service has been great and the fried rice has seemingly improved.  Perhaps I caught them on a bad day before.  We love China Sea and will keep ordering until we leave the area.

Be prepared to wait. No really, be prepared to wait.  Sometimes even the little waiting area gets all filled up, and you have to wait outside in the cold.  But when you get seated, the server is nice, and your Loco Moco is AMAZING.

The gravy is so bomb.  So clearly unhealthy, but hey, it tastes so delicious.  I asked for extra gravy and they willingly obliged, yay!!  Love the piece of fruit that's on there too.  But yeah, we waited for at least 25 minutes for our food after ordering, and we waited at least 20 minutes to get seated.  Not good if you have impatient children.

Great old school Italian subs, can't get them like this anywhere else! The store is amazingly clean and the staff is friendly and fast to put together an order. Honesty, couldn't eat a sub from any where else. Highly recommend the Italian Prosciutto, and ask for the sharp provolone! The prices beat any other sub shops or grocery stores. Check them out!

Went to see Time Jumpers show Monday nite; excellent experience! The staff advised we get there near 5:30 (for 9PM show) since it fills up quick for popular shows; so, the 3-hr wait inside was a bit long. But we got great table; even that early the stage-front tables were taken. Probably will wait a bit later next time, maybe 6-6:30. Table service was terrific all nite; waitress was very attentive and got every order right despite a full house. Drink and food prices reasonable, although I couldn't recommend going here to expect a culinary delight ... just basic bar food. Parking available on street and at nearby business (except for the clowns across from the entrance that have a "we'll tow you any time" sign posted, like they'll need the spaces after they close). The venue has great acoustics and it's intimate enough that there's not a bad seat in the house. even the bathrooms are clean. Just pay attention to your GPS to get to the place. Best show ever!!

Ordered take-out at the bar, I got the Hung Leh which was pork shoulder with peanuts, ginger, and a tasty sauce. I was surprised to find that I made three large meals out of that and the rice. Also order some crab cheese wontons, super creamy and flavorful.

We heard good things about Giodano's so we tried it last night. Very disappointed. We requested no,blue cheese in the salad and no onions on the veg pizza and got both anyway. We also had indigestion most of the night. We will not return. There are many better places for pizza.

Great place for a burger, wings, or some quick bites to eat. We opted for mozzarella sticks and cauliflower bites while we had a drink at the bar. Friendly bartenders. I'd definitely rather do lunch or an early dinner here. They have an outside deck with seating and a bar, clean bathrooms, and a indoor seating area other than the bar. They have a pool table, darts, and change machine as well.
Great breakfast specials, large portions, fast service, friendly staff. My only complaint, and reason for 4 stars is that they don't take cards of any type. The ATM there is $2.50 service charge.

We went here for dinner and the service wasnt that great.  You could tell they were understaff.  For appetizer we ordered the spinach and artichoke dip which I have to say was not that great.  It was the weirdest dip I ever eaten before.  For entree I had the Gourmet Burger and it wasn't good.  It was like they put so much different things in it that a mixture of that and some other meat on my patty and their sauce was gross.  I didn't like the bun either it was fairly dry.  The only thing that I really ate was the dessert which was their turtle cheezecake.  Only eat it if youre a chocolate fan but other than that I will not be coming back.
Everything is fresh and I love the cinnamon bread! The drop biscuits are amazing as well. Their coffee is amazing as well.

After enjoying a delicious meal at Mosaic, a friend and I decided to cap off the evening with a malt from Crown Candy.  This was my first visit to this clean little store in the middle of a somewhat sketchy neighborhood.  I had been looking forward to visiting this place for a while since I had seen the Man V Food episode where Adam failed the malt challenge (5 malts in 30 minutes).

We both ordered cherry malts.  For $4.50, they give you a 24 oz styrofoam cup full of super thick cherry ice cream nirvana.  It was so thick that it was initially impossible to suck it up the straw until it melted a bit more.  They offer a $1 option to make it extra thick but I can't imagine why anyone would need it thicker.  Both of us thought that the malts were outstanding.

The service was great and they were very friendly.  We were the last customers to enter the restaurant just before closing.  We were warmly greeted when we entered and they expressed their gratitude when we left.  Crown Candy really lives to their fine reputation.   I am looking forward to my next trip to St Louis so that I can visit Crown Candy again and sample their BLT which my St Louis friends have raved about.

Their prices are high compare to other Vietnamese restaurants. I guess it's because of the location? Their special fried rice is good, flavorful But they too much salt in it. Be prepare to have hypertension after it lol.

This place is relatively new, so I'm assuming they will work out some of the kinks soon enough. That said, they definitely need to get a handle on estimated wait time. If you tell someone 45 minutes, and it winds up being almost twice that long to get a table, something isn't quite right. 

The neighborhood was in desperate need of a large Mexican restaurant; there are some smaller authentic ones nearby, and of course there are some Chipotles mostly anywhere you look, but there was a real need for a place to go when you want a big menu, some tableside guac, burritos and enchiladas, and a bar.  Senor Salsa, which has had success elsewhere (Connecticut, for instance), if it can continue to improve, can fill that void. 

The first issue is the weird rules all over the menu. You can't share. How strict are they about that? It's almost so comical that you want to test it out to see if someone will really be monitoring how you eat your meal, but the steep price tag is scary.  Another oddity? Chips and salsa for the table is not complementary. But the name of the restaurant is Senor Salsa! So read all the fine print. There's a lot of it, and if you break a rule, you may find yourself with a large bill. 

(Note: If you order the tableside guacamole, the chips that come with it are included, thus temporarily solving the chips for the table conundrum.)

The food is pretty good. I ordered an enchilada plate with four different kinds: bean, cheese, beef, and chicken. The bean and chicken enchiladas were good. The cheese enchilada was inedible. The cheese was very odd.  The beef was practically inedible.  

Will definitely give it another try in about 6 months, when they have had some time to grow and work stuff out. Hoping for the best.

Call ahead if you are driving out of your way to eat here. Both last week and this week they were closed for catering when I came by. I tried Jumbo and Delicious next door they lived up to the hype. Hope that Rays will be open next time!
I wish I could give this place a 0. The food is terrible!!!! I have been there twice and after each time I got extremely sick. The food is so greasy and disgusting. Never go here!!!

First time going here and had a great time. My husband, our 3 kids (14, 8 & 1), and myself. They were very accommodating with my husband being in a wheelchair. Gave us two spaces for him so he had space. Also very clean. The food was delicious. Not too fond of the lobster but tried the scallops, yokisaba noodles, terriyaki steak, hibachi steak...all yummy. & of course the show of them cooking our food was cool. Entertained all 3 kids. Can not wait to head back there again.

This was our third time at Etch; all visits were on a Saturday evening. This time the restaurant was more crowded, and so loud we couldn't hear the music [which makes it pointless to play]. Service was polite and knowledgable, but less attentive: forgot a drink order, no quick refills on water, and no bread. The food was good overall. The soup and salad, and appetizer were excellent, but the main dishes were a bit disappointing. Two people in our party ordered the same dish but one came out slightly over-cooked and lacking garnish. We'll go back... but probably not any time soon.

Came here after watching Ella Brennan's documentary and wasn't sure about how the food was but this family sure do know how to cook.  Every single dish we ordered was delicious in taste and presentation. We went for brunch and had made reservations prior and the food was just incredible including some of the table side entrees and deserts we had ordered- banana fosters is to die for. The service was amazing and our wait staff were so down to earth, it made the experience very enjoyable.  The outside area is beautiful with greenery and so is the inside decor- makes great for pictures.  I would definitely recommend making the trip to eat here!

Great happy hour. Their specialty martinis are awesome. Also their bartender was extremely helpful and kind. Great service for sure. Food was okay. It is relatively decent sized menu and there is no shortage of options. Was dieting at the time so I didn't get to try the best of the best on the menu. Giving it a 4 because of the food I did try it was okay. Not my favorite place to eat food but environment, staff and drink specials made up for it!

First time at Charley's for me and the family on Father's Day 2021. The atmosphere was really nice and it wasn't too loud inside the restaurant to carry on a conversation. For apps we ordered calamari and the lobster bisque, both excellent. For entrees we ordered the filet and angus ribeye,  roasted cauliflower, lobster Mac and cheese, and mushrooms. The steaks were great, especially the ribeye; so juicy, tender, and flavorful. I wasn't in awe of the sides however. Maybe next time we'll keep it simple and just order a baked potatoe and broccoli. For dessert we had the chocolate cake which the kids loved and the butter cake...omg, the best! The only negative thing I can say was I wasn't too impressed with the attentiveness of the server. He stopped at other tables a lot more than ours. We ended spending over 2.5 here mostly due to waiting on the server to come around to take our dessert order and give us the check. I also had to keep looking for him just for water refills. Other than that, we loved it here and will be back!

For how much I didn't like the Roman Cavalry. the Pieta Pastrami I had today was amazing, the house made pickles and onions offered a nice balance. 2/3 isn't bad and I bought their Groupon so I will definitely be back for many more.

I've been to Union Public House a couple of times, and I always have mixed reactions after eating there. I really like the outdoor patio space -- the atmosphere is a lot of fun, and they have always been accommodating when we have come with fairly large groups of people (anywhere from 6-10). They also have a neat interactive cocktail menu on iPads that I always find way more amusing than I probably should.

The food here is what I'm torn about. Some things I love--for instance, their soft pretzel appetizer is one of my favorites, and I always have to get it. But, the entrees are just OK. I've had the union burger with a side salad before, and the salad has come out with barely any dressing and the burger is good, but nothing to write home about. Recently on a visit, one member of our party got the seafood stew, and actually had a piece of wire in his meal--it almost looked like a wire you would get from a cleaning brush. Yikes!

All in all, come for the ambiance and a cocktail, but probably eat somewhere else.

The staff at this location beats any other fast food in the city! Friendly, fast, great food and they serve liquor (beers and coolers). This is my top choice for a quick lunch plus there are lots of gluten free choices :)

Came into the Manayunk location on Saturday evening for an early-ish dinner. Han Dynasty has several locations in the area and this was my first experience at any of them.
Because it was early, we were seated quickly. We were also provided with hot tea/ water. The menu features several categories but the majority of the dishes are family style. There are numbers by each dish which indicate the spiciness level. We opted to split two tofu dishes: the cumin tofu and the hot sauce tofu w/ cabbage. Both dishes were tasty, but not above average. The hot sauce tofu was very oily. 
Overall, service was friendly and prices were reasonable.

Waited an hour for our food.  Then we were told they had no idea how much longer it would take.  How is that even possible?  No wonder no one wanted to make eye contact or talk to us when we walked in.  People were walking out without even speaking to anyone.   Maybe they should change the slogan from "Gourmet Chicken Fast" to "Gourmet Chicken Eventually."  Or "Theoretically."

This review is for their customer service. We had dinner at Ruby River and my mother-in-law, who was visiting from out of town, accidentally dropped a bank envelope with $700 cash under our booth. She didn't realize it until 2 days later - I know what you are thinking... that's crazy, but it's true.  When I called 2 days later, I fully expected the money to be gone.  BUT... the restaurant manager, Sergio, said a waiter found the envelope and turned it in. They held it in their safe until we picked it up. Now that is true integrity!  My mother-in-law got 100% of her money back.  Thank you to Sergio and the rest of the staff at Ruby River for being so honest.  PS - I actually like the food and atmosphere at Ruby River, and we always have fun & friendly waiters.

I was doing a presentation today and it was great. Service was awesome and Jame was very helpful. My steak was delicious and I didn't need steak sauce. 

The shrimp were large the cocktail sauce was a good compliment. I didn't have room for the bread that came. The cake was to die for and had some kind of cream on the inside. I ate it in my car because it didn't make it home. 

Can't wait to go back for a date night with my wife.

I can only review the pho and will say that it is excellent.  Expect a 5-15 minute wait if you come on weekends.  With that in mind, they always take my order right away and my pho comes out in the blink of an eye. All the ingredients are extremely fresh. I always order a small which is more than enough food. You really can't beat the price either. Since they are extremely busy on weekends, I understand people complaining about the service.  However, if you stop any of the servers they will gladly (and quickly) tend to your needs.

Very delicious food. Pasta was so flavorful and serving was quite large. Pizza was very well balanced as well. We also tried tiramisu and loved it. 
Yum!

What a dining experience! Located in the picturesque Garden District and across from Lafayette Cemetery #1, you can just feel the history and tradition as soon as you walk up to this famous restaurant. Reservations only, so our reservations were made a couple of weeks in advance. Business casual or more formal attire restaurant.

Earliest reservations available were at 6pm, so my party was one of those first seated. Luckily for us, we were seated in the Ronald Reagan booth in the corner, providing a nice view of the restaurant floor.

Cocktails: Crescent City Cooler and classic Sazerac were both refreshing and smooth.

Chef Tory's 3 course special was a great deal for those planning on ordering an appetizer, entree and dessert item for the price of approx $40.

Being a soup aficionado, my server kindly informed that I could order a demi serving of all 3 soups so that I could sample each one. The Crawfish Bisque was my favorite and had the best flavor of them all. Then I would say the Chicken and Sausage Andouille Gumbo. In last place was the Turtle Soup which is their specialty item, but it just wasn't my favorite. 

Entree dish was also amazing. Beautiful presentation, appetizing and well prepared. I ordered the local Redfish, which was served with crawfish tails on top, green beans, bokchoy. My friend ordered the Swordfish (caught in the Gulf Bay) which came seasoned/blackened on the spicier side packed with lots of flavor.

Dessert was the grand finale and did not disappoint! I ordered the Bread Pudding Soufflé which was melt in your mouth decadent and delicious! My friends also enjoyed their desserts: Pecan Pie and Praline Parfait with whipped cream.

Service was excellent, timing of the 3 course meal servings was perfect, and all the dishes were top-notch impeccable. We were asked if we were celebrating anything, as a lot of parties did seem to be celebrating an occasion of some sort. If I lived here in this area, I would most definitely find any excuse to come back to Commander's Palace. It's just that good!

I have to be honest I ordered house fried rice foil wrapped chicken and hot-and-sour soup 
house fried rice was good foil wrapped chicken was gross no flavor just regular chicken in foil and a hot and sour soup was extremely water down unfortunately I think I'm giving up on this place

I stumbled across La Cabra during my stay and didn't really know what to expect but overall awesome little brewery. Decor definitely gave me the brewery vibe, beer was good, and food was also very good. The saison was my favorite followed by the IPA.

Santorini is my favorite restaurant! I'm so sad to see it closing, but I understand that Jeanette and Taki need a bit of a break. I love the atmosphere and the food. Best Greek cuisine I've ever had. Calamari is on point! Lamb done right, and the Greek potatoes make me drool! I will definitely miss Santorini, but I look forward to ordering some catering in the future!

Nice new addition to the Wilmington bar scene! Great decor inside and out. Great drinks. Only tried the shishito peppers so far food wise but super yummy. The one night we went it was very crowded, which is s as great sign. Drinks are a wee bit pricy for this town but it's a nice place so I get what they're trying to do. Il def be back. Hope they fix the lights though, they kept flickering big time all while we were there. Fodder for a headache for sure.

Went twice while visiting New Orleans for moose conference. Best foods. Fish and chips were delicious. Sausage platter was good by mom said. My mom and I shared dip and calamari that was also good. Mango tea was good.

Hometown bar feel without the bad bar food!
This tiny gem is one of those places you'll always go back to. Inventive and classic cocktails and great small plates (no wings or poppers!) All the dishes are thoughtful, unique and flavorful, whether you're at a table or bellied up to the stone bar. I'd love to see the wine list expanded beyond the "one of each flavor " range. Service was stellar, though, and that makes up for a lot.

Excellent street style tacos. Friendly- helpful staff. Cash/ check only establishment. 3 (&1/2) ate for under $40. 

4+ stars only due to it could have used a good cleaning. Would become a regular if we were locals.

Three words: Ah. Maze. Ing.

Dining at Columbia Restaurant was an amazing experience- it is no wonder they have been in business so long! 

Our party of 7 was seated at a round table on the patio with a great view of the water. Our waiter gave us plenty of time to look through the menu which was good given all the options! The menu also features some history of the restaurant in addition to the thorough description of each menu item. 

I started with a red sangria which was a real treat. For dinner I had the hearts of palm salad and the black bean cakes. Both were delicious! The hearts of palm salad was fresh with great flavor, and the cakes had just the right crispness to them. Before our food arrived we were each served a large piece of Cuban bread with butter. The bread was heavenly- but easy to fill up on! 

All the waitstaff at Columbia were so friendly as well and we had great service from beginning to end of our dinner at Columbia. I would definitely go back the next time I visit!

Naomi put it best this place has a very weird crowd. Sorry that it is not my kind of bar but when I happen to head in there after getting back in town with some friends for a quick drink before heading home and there is a guy in his early to mid 50's sloshed at the bar at 3am what does that tell you about the clientele? If you want to relive your college days with drunk guys who think they are mike Tyson then this is the place for you, but if you are looking for a place to relax with friends without all the drama then I suggest you find another place to have a cocktail.

Excellent service and food. Brooke was our server. Very polite and charming. She knew the dinner menu. Service was a quick and food was delicious. We started with the Board. Nuts,cheese,salmon, garlic and bread. We had Chicken Cobb salad. Short ribs and Pesto and pistachios with chicken. For dessert,Salted Caramel homemade ice cream.
Hands down the best Margaritas in town!!! Amazing Tacos and awesome bartenders!! Colin made us a seasonal pineapple margarita and wow!!! Definitely ask for Colin when you are at bakersfield!!

UPDATE: they're open at the new location in Trail dust town now! Open today! 12/7

Love this place. Delicious brunch and breakfast choice for east side Tucsonians! 

They are moving into Trail Dust Town across the street. Just a heads up.

THE BEST! Knead is by far my favorite bagel shop in Philly. The fennel and sea salt bagel is amazing and the specials are always interesting and delicious. But it's the egg sandwiches with aioli I crave the most! Even when it's busy the staff is always friendly and kind, and the quality of the food never disappoints! Wonderful place, atmosphere and people running/working the shop. You know you Knead it!
We were seated quickly for breakfast on a busy Saturday and our waitress was friendly and great. The coffee wasn't great but the waffle arrived hot and crispy which was exactly what I wanted

Service & servers are awesome...we had shrimp po-boys which was a special today. Unfortunately the bread/contents ratio was way off...the bread was good but way too thick and the very minimal fried shrimp on it had no seasoning or flavor. What we had was a bland breadwish...ya know...wishing there was sumtn in between!   The fries and tater-tots were very good...could of been a winner, just step it up with Cajun seasoning, better roumalad, and double the small shrimp !
It's ok.  Pad Thai and cashew dish was a bit bland and some dishes didn't come with all their listed ingredients.  Service was pleasant and atmosphere wasn't as inviting as other places I have been.
Service and food were great. Ambiance depicted bistro setting in Paris. Groupon offer was a plus. Will come back for sure with or without Groupon. Server Amanda rocked!!!

We had not visited El Corral in many years - the last visit was not very good, but we decided to try it again. This used to be one of the go to places in Tucson for all things beef - steak, prime rib, etc. We had reservations and were seated right away - a little before our designated time. Our waiter was right there to take our drink order - we had an ice tea & a sangria. Sangria was fantastic - great fruity flavor with white wine ! First part of order was appetizers - fried zucchini. It was ok - I have had the zucchini at other restaurants, this one is middle of the pack. We ordered our main course - 2 filets. When the steaks arrived - they were done just right, but seemed like a poor cut of meat. Nothing like a filet - kind of tough and full of hard, chewy pieces. The meal seems to be going downhill as it went on . . . One bright spot was the service - it was good most of the evening and helped save this 3 rating (the food would probably be a 2 without the good service). One other negative would be the prices - high for the quality of food you get. Sorry El Corral - unfortunately, I probably won't be returning  in the future until I know the food has improved !

Four stars at a fast food level. Much better than the compitition. The burgers are really good. Great flavor and cooked right. The slight crust on the outside of the burger and the juicy flavors inside. Yum!  The fries are good. They're shoestring style and offer a variety of flavors. Just a bit too much seasoning for my taste. I'll ask hem to scale back next time. My daughter had the chicken sandwich and said it was good. You have to wait a bit longer than the McKings... but Worth the wait .

Big fat Gyros and big fat booties!  This place is a ghetto paradise!  

Some of the best food in this part of Indy. Seriously if your around here try it!

I say this is better than Sushi Kingdom but that's prob a preference. Let's just say the app. Was amazing! Beef ,salmon and red snapper teriyaki was all very flavorful and tender. Sushi was really good. Fresh and not a lot of rice! (Rice was also good quality) the only reason I'm not giving it five stars it was because we got there on a Sat. Night. (First time as well) and there was only one sushi chef. We waited 1 hour and 30mins for our 6 rolls to come out. We stopped ordering sushi and just ate the appetizers the rest of the night to satisfy us. Service was great, very attentive. But please have more than one sushi chef on a weekend.

This is a great place to catch some jams....

I have lived in New Orleans for several years and am "guilty as charged" for never having of been here...

Cheap drinks.  Good service.  And I hear the food is good, though I did not sample any...


Definitely a good place to see live music.

And they have a couple huge flatscreens behind the bar, great for watching football as well.

I wasn't sure what to expect when I first stumbled upon this place. Once I entered I was shocked to see the place was empty at 7:30 on a Saturday night!! The server claims there was a rush earlier, and it is more of a spot for early dinner people. I ordered the calamari appetizer as my meal and the crab coup... both were good, but not out of this world. Their menu was very extensive and had a nice variety. The atmosphere was a bit stuffy for my taste, but I could definitely see my older relatives loving it! I think I'll need to give this place another shot at a later date.
Absolutely outstanding service. Of course Ian is the best!!! It was mine & my friends first time there. We had an amazing time.

Big Jud's has stepped it up during my last visit, so I have no problem stepping up the rating.  I guess the 3rd time is a charm, previously my last two visits were plagued by long wait times, low quality food.  This time I went Friday night right before the BSU game!  Yes I knew it would be busy and being in the restaurant biz I know it's the perfect time to see them under pressure.  I'm happy to report they scored more points with me then the Broncos against Airforce that night lol 
  We entered in and all we could see was the place was packed and filled with blue and orange, yeah this was the spot to eat before the game.  We were seated quickly, our orders arrived in 11 mins 54 sec (oh yeah I timed them).  I still find the tater tots lacking flavor but hey they are part of my chicken strip basket so I live with it.  Best part is EVERYTHING is HOTT, the chicken was juicy and my friend loved his juicy burger.  Our waitress kept our drinks filled and made sure we were not lost in the crowd, she had great vision unlike a certain bronco defense lol (can't ya see I'm taking the loss hard?)
  Way to go Jud's you scored some touch downs with me for this visit but will you repeat next time? We shall see.

Decent lunch special deal (two slices + drink for $5), and occasionally they have some interesting stuff by the slice.  But the basics are good.  If you catch the pizzas fresh out of the oven, it's better than when they reheat.  They tend to over-reheat the slices, and they get gooey.

Crust is too thick to be called a NY pizza, but too thin to be a Chicago deep dish.

Very kid friendly.  Great family place.  Free wifi (from them or the coffee shop next door, I'm not sure).  Overall a very comfortable place to spend a few hours with a laptop if you need a break from home or office.
Honestly the best service I've ever had...server Nathan Thompson is the best server I've ever encountered

Bartender was absolutely rude and racist. The table service was apologetic about the bartender and explains he has been here since the beginning so the owners put up with him. News flash owners: your bartender is unprofessional and should be fired! My food was mediocre, it was hot but not much flavor. Mexican food should be bursting with flavor and this meal fell flat. This place needs to get it together!

This place is what I miss most about living in Philadelphia. It was right down the street from my apartment, and the pho was absolutely amazing for the price. It was pretty casual, small, intimate, and a great place to go with friends or on a casual date. If you're looking for extra-attentive service, you won't find it here-- they take your order, refill your water, but they don't mother you. They give you the space to enjoy your huge bowl of pho. So that might be a turn-off for some, but it was perfectly fine for me.

I miss this place so much.
Amazing.  Great staff, great food, great size portions.  Very accommodating to requests.  Addicting.
