When you order over the phone, they don't cook it right away. You get their and usually have to wait for your order. I usually pick up. I think their prices are fair-this is not Domino's- this is really good pizza.

I go to the same place because they are reliable in good pizza.

I've been coming here for years with family it's getting better. Surprisingly is not as crowded usually for the Easter Sunday today and it's only about half full. I was disappointed today because they change the flavor the brand of dressing at the salad bar and it's terrible so I'm going to tell them about it but I won't be doing the salad bar again because they got rid of my dressing the red stuff. It's called French.

Consistently friendly service and yummy food. If you're in the mood for traditional Italian fare and to byob, this is one of the best in the city. One night we were there and the power went out and they kept cooking somehow and fed everyone by candlelight!

I stopped into this tiny cafe for an early brunch and I was lucky that I was able to grab a table just as someone else was leaving.

Going in, you should know that this place is pretty small. If you have to wait for a table, please wait outside so as not to take up too much space. I was pretty hungry, so I decided to get the pork grillades Benedict and a small bowl of the full blast grits.

The pork grillades benedict is huge chunks of pork and gravy served with eggs Benedict on top with sliced potatoes on the side. It was delicious! The pork was so tender and the gravy was delicious. This honestly felt like more of a dinner than a breakfast, but I loved it. 

The full blast grits is grits topped with bacon and cheese and it's as decadent as you can imagine. A large bowl of this would easily be enough for a full meal, even though it's offered as a side. There's just something magical about melty cheese and bacon on top of savory grits. Needless to say, I had plenty of food to take home.

The waiter was attentive and the staff was great. My only complaint is how small the place is and I kept getting bumped because I was seated right by the door. Next time I'm going to request a table more in the back, even if I have to wait. The food was fantastic and I'll be back.

We built up an appetite hiking at Wall Springs Park, so we chose to visit the Tuscan Sun on a Sunday afternoon. We were greeted by a friendly host, and even though it was about 5:15 PM and fairly busy, were given three seating options, booth, high-top, or outside. A server greeted us in a timely manner, provided menus, water, and bread with a marinara dipping sauce, and left us to peruse the menu. There were three of us and we ordered "Grandma's Lasagna" , "Pesto Pasta", and "Veal Parmigiana" . Each entree also comes with a house salad, which were soon delivered and good. My veal parmigiana was excellent and came with a side of spaghetti. It was also huge, so I took half of it home with me. My wife reported that her "pesto pasta" was excellent, and she'd order it again. My mother-in-law said her lasagna was the best she'd ever had, high praise from someone in their 80's! Our server was attentive but never "hovered". To encourage diners to arrive early, they offer an early diner discount if your order is placed before 5:30. We did (barely) so for three meals and a bottle of house wine, about $60. The only suggestion I have would be to offer a arrabbiata (spicy) sauce as an option. Anyway, good atmosphere, good food, good service, good price, what more do you want?
Spicy, delicious, and juicy chicken. Enough said

Stopped there on a cross country trip. They served us even though they had just closed, and the food was amazing and cheap! Try the beef lo mein or the sesame chicken. They even gave us a free order of egg rolls!

Love Tony Roni's! My favorite is the tomato pie! Absolutely nothing like it anywhere. I have ordered sandwich platters for parties, pizzas, wings, salads and have always been more than happy! Consistently great quality food. I frequent three of their many locations and am always impressed with the manner in which I am treated by any employee I deal with. Excellent customer service.

holy heck is this place good. Never have I been to a breakfast place where literally EVERYTHING on the menu was on my #1 list. I went with a large group and everyone had different things, each thing looked better than the next. I had the steel cut oatmeal, and it was heaven in a bowl. I wish I could go back again and again to try everything. Service was excellent, too. I can't imagine a better breakfast restaurant to go to. I just wish it were bigger so I wouldn't have to wait so long to get in. But the food is SO WORTH IT!

I love the atmosphere of this place even though it is a franchise in the quarter, and I prefer not to go to franchise's. The drinks are delicious, and the food is pretty good.

The main reason why I come here is because they have tire swings at the upstairs bar. However, the last time I came, it was closed for some reason and the time before that, all the swings were taken up. I guess it's more of a reason to keep me coming back.
This place used to be awesome.. But the bartenders now.. Worry more about their coke sniffing friends than waiting on the people actually spending money.

Amazing bread pudding with bourbon sauce. Chef de cuisine Denmon Bateman is the man. After being closed for an hour, he managed to personally go above and beyond for us. By far best service we've received all week. Will definitely be back. A million thanks!

yuck, yuck, and yuck.....eloquent i know....i went to visit my mother in florence, and thought i'd pick up cheesesteaks on the way there. man was i dissappointed! the order was wrong, the rolls and meat dry, and my parm had an itsy bit of suace on it. and while i'm at it, i am NOT a fan of a ton of high school kids running amuck and b.sing with the staff, because it obviously affects their concentration.....

I got a chance to go to Mother's during Mardi Gras, I was very excited to check out the food. Me and my girl came for breakfast, we arrived at around 9am and the line was a little long already. We were lead around to the overflow of the restaurant, where we waited in a buffet style line to order. After glancing at the menu I noticed the prices were a little high that got a Side Eye from me. We ordered our food- I got 3 pancakes and ham and my friend got 3 pancakes and a side of eggs. We go and sit down and the food comes out. The pancakes were big and the ham was plentiful. Needless to say I was not impressed with how those pancakes tasted- they were just Okay and the ham was just Okay. I'm made though that the food cost me like $13. Side Eye. Needless to say, I'm glad I tried this place out, but I won't be back. The only good thing about this place is they do take credit cards for your convenience.

Absolutely love this cute little cocktail bar. We came here on a Saturday night after my friends birthday dinner and the place came highly recommended by others. It's a smaller place, more intimate but wonderful since you can hear your company. In addition, they have some tasty cocktails and also some pretty good food as well. My friends I just really loved the atmosphere of the place.

Unfortunately a week later i had wanted to come for my own birthday after our dinner at sabor but the place was too busy to acoomodate us. That's definitely a downfall for Friday and Saturday evenings. Also remember if you're coming down to have some drinks and food, that the prices are a bit higher than most. I'd definitely come back Moreso for special occasions!
No refills on fountain drinks? $2.49 each or $5.19 for a pitcher? That's enough to keep me and my Diet Coke Crew from coming back.

Tiny neighborhood deli with delicious hoagies.  Park next door at the Wawa. Lunchmeat is sliced to order and produce is crisp and fresh. You can get your hoagie on a regular amoroso roll, a hard Italian roll or a seeded roll. I prefer their sandwiches over Primo's and Meatheads, and their prices are more reasonable.  They also have some hot sandwiches, like homemade meatballs and hot roast beef and pork, a small selection of salads and Italian specialties like shooters, marinated mozzarella and long hots.  It's the only place I can find anise oil when I make pizzelles at Christmas!
Dirty and overpriced.  Somehow I'm still drawn to it.  No food available, but I have brought food in and they didn't seem to mind.

The food was very good but the service was spotty.  I had the lamb special, which was good but there were a few pieces that couldn't be cut with the dull knife and also couldn't be chewed.  When I told one our many waitstaff to tell the chef that there should be no inedible food on the plate, she was disinterested.  Having too many waitstaff makes it difficult to pin down who is doing well and who isn't.  In general, the waitstaff could be much improved.

Decent hotel and nice location. 

Facilities (particularly the bathroom) seemed a bit dated but the rooms were very spacious! Plenty of room which was surprising given the central location. 

We were able to walk to plenty of restaurants as well as other activities. We arrived rather late but there was still plenty to do in this area. 

My main complaint is the parking. As I said, we arrived rather late and this was our first time in Indianapolis so when the receptionist asked if we wanted to park on site we agreed. We were very surprised that the parking would cost nearly $40 a night but were unfamiliar with the area so assumed this was normal. After walking to dinner we found multiple parking garages within a five minute walk for a fraction of the price. 

Not sure if we would return, but I know we would not park on site again.

Oh my God! Where to begin? This place was overwhelming! I needed several days to eat my way through here! I will be back. The smoked and rotisserie chicken wings along with their rotisserie carrots were fantastic at Dienner's BBQ. It is tucked away in the back of the Amish corner. Go there! Also if you like soft pretzels, you must to go to Miller's twist pretzels and more! The best I've ever had! Be sure to get there honey mustard dipping sauce if you like honey mustard. I can't wait to come back to the market.

Good lunch specials during the week. The service was kind of slow. Plan for an hour and a half lunch total if you are dining in on your lunch break. Food was hot and the salad was delicious. Will be back, but probably to go only.

Underwhelmed. 
Nice atmosphere, great service, but the food was unimpressive. 
Very technically good and tasty but nothing imaginative or exciting. 

Bottom line, totally unexciting, well prepared, and expensive food.

Really cool space. Can grab a coffee to go, hit the bar, or park it in one of the two dinning rooms. The lofted dinning area over looks the coffee roaster And has an industrial warehouse vibe that is well done. Was told new indoor hydroponic herb garden was also going in soon, which would be cool and bring more life into the space - also would block the view of the HVAC ducts which is needed. 

Reminded me of a larger Cafe Rose on the east side. Top notch all around on the food and drinks. 

I had a cortado coffee, mimosa, amazing sausage egg sandwich with tapenade mayo which really was amazing and something I wouldn't think to make at home, side salad perfectly dressed - very lightly. 

Friendly, but of course it is because it's not cheap. Would recommend for a nice brunch, maybe not so much for a hungover brunch.

James was our delightful server. 

During our visit we had the Imperial Dip, 8oz Filet Mignon with sautéed spinach and the Pecan Crusted Trout with the Bacon Mac & cheese and Broccoli. 

James recommended the Pecan Crusted Trout and it was amazing. The bacon Mac and cheese was just okay-nothing was special about it, it's just a side of cheesy pasta with diced bacon on top, not mixed in not bacon flavored. Just okay. 

We enjoyed our first time patronizing this restaurant.
Great food! The staff are really nice and the food comes out quickly. Look at how big the Nachitos appetizer is!!

Interesting menu and awesome beer selection. "Blue chip deal" is a tasty appetizer. 

My favorite drink is the "Macho Margarita," made with habanero infused tequila. If you like spicy, you have to try it. See the decanter on the bar with the peppers floating in it. Mmm.

It's not very easy to find an amazing place like this in an area like Castleton and maybe that is why they are always so so so busy! Even though they are always busy, the service was very fast. We had a large group and were sat pretty quickly! I have always heard amazing things about their chicken fingers, but these were not just any chicken fingers, they were whole chicken strips of delicious white meat chicken! The outside was crispy with just the right amount of sauce! The portion sizes are crazy big, like about 3 meals worth! Great place to stop in for dinner and drinks if you're in the Castleton area!

Everyone in my class has mentioned that Jacques-Imo's was their favorite restaurant ever. So... when my parents finally came in to visit me, this is where we headed (Parent's treat, wahoo!!). My parents think every restaurant is just.. okay, but once we finished everything up, they kept saying how good this place was. Definitely a great place and amazing food.
Awesome atmosphere and excellent food! The lamb lasagna, gnocchi, and crispy goat were perfect as were the coconut and banana pies. This is our new favorite when we visit.

My friend and I came here for sandwiches.  We placed our order and received it promptly.  But that is where the service ended.  Our waiter never came back to check on us and never asked if we wanted coffee or dessert.  He then came back with our bill and said he would take it when we were ready.  We were busy talking away and he kept walking by, looking over at us.  And came back several times to say he would take our money when we were ready.  We were still thinking about getting coffee and maybe dessert.   Finally my friend asked him if he was finished his shift and he replied yes so we told him we would go pay our bill.  He came back to the table where I gave him his tip.  We told him we might want something else.  He then told us the other waitress on duty would come and get us anything else we needed.  She never came by, we didn't know where she was.  We waited and were so busy talking and catching up and within that whole time no one came around.  When they did walk by, they just looked over and stared and just didn't seem very friendly.  Needless to say, we became frustrated and ended up leaving.  The staff did not seem customer friendly at all and made us feel very uneasy.  We were very disappointed.

Actual visit 3/2/12. I was pleasantly surprised at Carrabba's !  Warm bread to start, a great side salad, the chicken spinach mezzaluna was quite GOOD. Service by Samantha was also above average.  I appreciated the time checks to make sure I wasn't rushed to catch my flight.
The tofu goreng was the best tofu I've ever eaten. Perfect texture and incredible taste, and fairly priced!

Derek's is extremely pricey, and for the price I expected much more!

Starting with service, it was terrible. Our waitress was uninterested and did not smile! I ordered a Caesar salad and took a bite (will explain below). She came and asked if I was done with my salad which was obviously untouched, but she didn't bother asking if everything was ok, just cleared the dish. We also waited a long time for the check and when it finally came I explained that one of the people in our party had to catch the train if she could handle quickly, still no rush.

I ordered a Caesar salad to start. At $9 for a side salad I would have expected it to be good! I don't even know how to describe the taste other than terrible. I have had lots of Caesar dressings, some fishy and others not, but all good! This was nothing like that and looked like mayo. I also ordered a chicken dish which the menu described as dark and the waitress explained would be dark because of the marinade. It appeared as explained but tasted some what burnt. It wasn't terrible, but again, for the price I expected more.

The ambiance is nice and I have ate here in the past and not had nearly as awful of an experience. However, this experience this time around is enough for me to not want to go back. Too many strike outs in one visit!

So, I would have to agree not to go here during "non prime" hours. Kinda bad service- not awful or anything, but just not "on top of it" either. So I do agree with other posters on that. 

However, some of these people are being way super petty. Seriously you're concerned about 2 ounces of soup? I would love to see if the person complaining about that could even identify what 2 ounces of liquid looks like- that's 60mL or 12 teaspoons. Sounds kinda silly to me. And inedible? How ridiculous. I've had the same dishes referenced in that review, multiple times mind you, and that couldn't be further from the truth. Silly silly. 

Anyhow, amazing selection of burgers. The bleu cheese fries are amazing and the sweet potato fries aren't far behind. Of all the burgers, I like the Monaco the best. 

Go on a Friday or Saturday night. You won't be disappointed.

Came here with the family for a nice meal over thanksgiving break and although the service was behind, the food was so delicious we didn't mind. The management was also on top of it and sent out some free goodies when our food was taking a long time, which we really appreciated. The burger is awesome, and might be the best burger in town. The fries are great too which is always a plus. Some family members had the mussels and loved them as well as the steak frites. I understand now why this is a staple in the CWE. Will definitely be back next time we have guests in town.

After reading all the Yelp reviews I decided to give this place a try. We stopped in here for dinner. We tried the steak burrito and chicken nachos. The staff was friendly and the food was good. The seasoning on the meat was really good. The burrito, nachos, and one drink was approx $18.

You can't go wrong with this place this is one of my favorite Hawaiian places that I've ever been to. The service is always great the sauces, the chicken, and pulled pork is all phenomenal. I have yet to have anything go wrong at this place. Definitely the best Hawaiian in Tucson and probably anywhere. I would like to see some imported Hawaiian drinks but other than that I can't complain about anything.

I just moved into the area and discovered this place.  I like supporting small local business and this is a great example.  Their Mango Breeze sandwich is wonderful.  I will be a regular customer here for sure.

Great spot! My husband and I ended up here twice during our weeklong vacation. We stopped in for drinks on Monday night and we caught the end of Bingo night. I am glad we came at the end because there were some very drunk, obnoxious people playing, luckily they finished and left. Bartender was great, drinks were good. We came back again on Saturday night and had dinner. The pretzels are sooooo good! I don't normally like beer cheese, but I tried this and really enjoyed it. I had boneless wings for my meal and the portion was huge and they were tasty. We will definitely come back!

As former area residents, we make it a priority to eat here no matter the length of visit. Very traditional.  Parking can be a challenge, but is definitely worth a nice walk.  Best on the hill. Wait staff friendly and knowledgeable.

My wife and I usually have a hard time getting in because it's so packed but strangely on Easter we missed the rush and was seated right away. My wife got this healthy drink that was great and the matcha pancakes that was equally as good. The waitress was very warming and attentive. I ordered the biscuits and gravy with the million dollar bacon. Couldn't be happier with the food and the side potatoes were great. Definitely a spot I'll try again when back in Franklin.

We always had great food here but today the host and hostess were rude because we asked to  be seated in a section that was going to open 10 minutes late. Results: we get a sour smoothie and burnt pancakes!

Came here on my last night in New Orleans with a local. She recommended Napoleon House for its atmosphere and menu. I'm so glad that  we did! We were seated immediately in the main dining  area. The prices are reasonable and the service was great. I had yet to try a muffuletta sandwich and I was not disappointed! It was delicious!

Everytime I'm in Philadelphia I stop in at Down Home Diner. I'm always so impressed by the food, atmosphere and most of all the service. Tonight was different and stood out from the many times I've enjoyed a meal here. My server, Eddie, was SO WARM, SO HELPFUL, SO WELCOMING, and SO INCREDIBLY NICE! I felt like I was at a family home and this dinner was held in my honor! I ordered the crab cakes with poached eggs (delicious) and Eddie described everything so articulately. He made sure I had everything I needed and checked on me frequently. I travel all over the US and eat out alllll the time. It's so rare to have such an enthusiastic and personable server like Eddie. I hope the management team reward him for his extraordinary presence at their restaurant! Thank you Eddie!!
Wow. Better than Olive Garden even though they didn't have those delish breadsticks. They give Macaroni Grill a run for their money. Delish!
Excellent service! The parking was tough but the food was excellent! Great food, great selection, superb price for value!

Excellent sandwiches and salads.
We highly recommend the Chinese Chicken Salad and any of the 2 meat sandwiches.

Let me say that the staff and everyone at Grille 116 are amazing!
We scheduled a private room for our daughters "sweet sixteen" party and it turned out awesome!
Chris and Eric ( the managers) were extremely helpful and made sure everything we absolutely perfect. Rich, our waiter, could not have been better, terrific job!
The room was ready and looked perfect, the food was spot on and with the attention to detail made this truly a very special day for our daughter.
I totally recommend this restaurant for anyone looking to schedule a special event or simply to go and enjoy a great meal.
Thanks to all.

I used to be quite the regular at Sullivan's because I lived just across the street. Plus, it was open late enough for me to drop in after work. I haven't dined in the dining room but I have dined on the patio, in cocktail, and at the bar many of times.

My favorite meal is the scallops by far! They are cooked absolutely perfectly and come in a bacon sauce. I do have a tendency to love scallops but I believe these are the best I've ever had. I have ordered them two or three times now and each time they are prepared perfectly. Food and drinks are a bit expensive but once in a while it's worth it! Live music also makes the experience worth the expense!

The bar service is great and the bartenders always make sure to remember you if you visit a few times. Clayton is the bartender to visit! He makes the best martinis and I'm sure other cocktails as well. You'll never feel like the service or company is even slightly under par. 

My boyfriend and I most recently visited on valentines day. We both worked until about 930 and didn't expect to go out for a nice dinner. We popped into Sullivan's just to see if there was a chance they were still serving and had an open table. Lucky enough they did and got us right in! The only downfall was that we were completely forgotten about for about 15 minutes and had to go ask for service. This was a few months after we had stopped being weekly regulars so I'm unsure if it was just the busy night, the holiday, or if service started slacking within the time we were absent. We will definitely go back and give it another shot. I just hope one of our favorite restaurants isn't slacking on service and going downhill. If it does seem to be that way, the bar is always a safe bet!
Never disappoints. Everything I've tried is excellent! Longer than average wait on weekends, though

Really like the food here however I went here today and could not believe my service.  My wife and were seated quickly only to wait for about 15 minutes for the person who initially sat us to ask if we had ordered drinks yet.  When we told her we had not been helped yet she took our drink order and about 5 minutes later they came out.  Now an additional 10 minutes went by before our server came out and said he would be right with us.  And yes another 5 minutes we wait before we can order.  we have been waiting well in excess of 30 minutes before we even get to order.  Needless to say at this point we elected not to eat at this fine establishment.  It is one thing if a restaurant is very busy and the servers are just trying to keep up and it is another when you are just not seen!!!
Awesome spot! Great service and menu. It's clean, well organized and a nice chill spot. Of course the food is great!!
Drinks are wonderful and deviled eggs are divine!!  The best I've ever tasted!!  I can't wait to come back and utilize the patio when it's warm outside.

Full disclosure:  I am really allergic to seafood.   Because of this, I generally would not go to a restaurant where sushi is the main offering.  However, Mayday and I were heading back from a school event in the city, he really loves sushi and he hadn't gone to Jason's yet.  We stopped in on our walk home from the train. 

The restaurant itself is quite small, occupying a space formerly a mediterranean grill and prior to that a wings place.  It's set up primarily for takeout, with some tables set against walls for those who want to eat in.  There's an open refrigerated cooler where grab & go items for those in a rush.

I ordered the cucumber roll, honestly my favorite sushi roll of all the non-fish options.  Mayday got a combo with sushi and nigiri.  For appetizers I picked gyoza, another favorite, and he got shrimp shumai.  We were both given complimentary miso soup that comes with each order.  

Jason and his sushi artists were all quite friendly, helpful and funny. The setup for checkout is a little awkward, primarily because of the narrow space, but they make it work quite well.

As for the food?  Mine was completely YUM, very very fresh, and so was Mayday's.  He was especially complimentary of the freshness of the fish, he was quite impressed with the quality.  There were no leftovers.

I am certain Mayday will be back, along with the NMT and I may even stop to get my beloved cucumber roll again.  It's a great addition to the Ardmore dining scene and I'm thrilled to have them here.

I came in the drive thru of this business I've been here multiple times and the people are rude, they did not answer the drive thru when I went in right now there was a truck parked backwards fucking around in the drive thru not letting us through or taking out order I'm never coming back to this place and I am not recommending it to anyone at least at this location.

I ordered the salmon with the wasabi mash potatoes and Asian slaw that's what Cooper's Hawk calls it.  Ask the waiter about the wasabi potatoes.." are my nose and eyes gonna be running all over the place"? of course he didn't know.  I thought they should be experienced with the menu? I ordered it anyway because I like wasabi.. I don't know why they call them wasabi mash just because they've included it but they didn't taste anything like what I thought they might taste like. I am glad I could eat them without tearing up but the real issue was with the potatoes themselves,they had clumps and hard potatoe lumnot mashed smoothly. Can someone tell me why our waiter came out with food stuck in his beard? 
 
 Okay update to come been here 3 times since that post And my complaint is the gnocchi (see photos) was extremely salty!!! I sent it back and I didn't want anything else. 
 You would think that because Cooper's Hawk is a chain the food should be consistently the same all the time. I'm gonna suggest they go back to the drawing board on that dish. It's a restaurant right..so a possible fruit fly/gnats invasion is the norm? We were shooing flies the whole lunch long! 
 The Thai lettuce wrap appetizer was yum nice flavor profile of sweet and spice!  no complaints the Mediterranean salad that my girlfriend enjoyed was okay I tasted one of the shrimp I wasn't impressed. We had a flat bread roasted veggie appetizer that arrived to our table ice cold! the balsamic glaze and goat cheese was the ticket.  
Cooper's Hawk in my opinion is overrated. I go with girlfriends who are part of the wine club.

My friends and I loved everything about this place! The Spiked Nutella latte was delicious as were the Mimosas (such a great place for Brunch drinks). The Waffle Sliders with Agave butter were out of this world! The food and drink choices are unique, making you want to go back multiple times to try everything. Our waiter Stuart did a great job at making us feel welcomed and gave us good advice on things to do around town! We will definitely be going back whenever we're in Nashville.
Yum yum . Very authentic and different. This place will fill your appetite. Friendly staff and prompt servixe

philly's newest iron chef really comes into his own as stephen starr's first and only competition for restaurant dominition.  the difference?  while both starr and garces are good at putting people and places together, garces is a chef on top of that, and it shows.  garces is always messing around in his kitchens and walking around the dining room.  based on absolutely no foundation in fact, he seems to be a genuinely nice guy.  for those who have never worked in a kitchen this is indeed a rarity.  so enough about garces, distrito itself is well executed and delicious.  the only thing i was even mildly disappointed in was the skirt steak quesadilla.  ceviche was clean and flavorful and my first mole was above and beyond what i thought it would be.  the first time well prepared duck breast was an afterthought to me.  looking forward to garces' next ventures: beer and brats & an international supermarket!

I ordered their miso soup and fried rice and the miso soup was approximately two sips and the fried rice tasted like cardboard. I put yum yum sauce on the rice and it just tasted like wet spicy paper. It seemed like they seasoned it with pepper and that's it. Way overpriced for what I got.

Still AMAZING!!!! 

Always an amazing treat to look forward to. Only heart break is sharing. It's a double edged sword. The joy of introducing these amazing cookies to someone else and the heartache of them asking you for another!!!!
Always one of my need to go locations when in town. Great staff, great atmosphere and the best bang for your buck!!
The food here is amazing! I had the salmon & asked for it medium & it was perfect!!! Oysters were fantastic, service was great! Will return soon!

Best Biriyani (Chicken, Goat and Fish) I have had in the US. Biriyani king always has the consistency in taste and quality.

Highly recommended to try!

So on a day trip to Tampa, I was really in the mood for a snack.  My guy and I thought Bartaco would fit the bill, but we were sadly disappointed.

When we first walked in, the place really wasn't busy at all but the hostess (who also ended up as our waitress) kept acting like we were bothering her.  The menu doesn't have a single description on it so we had to ask her what was in each taco. She would just answer quickly and then stare at me waiting for me to fill out the order card.  We ended up with two tacos each and shared the guacamole (which was barely enough for one person).

The food tasted good (not great).  We could tell the ingredients were somewhat fresh, but the execution was about 70% there.  I felt like my food was just missing that little something extra to make it great. Plus for the price, it should have been MUCH better.

We ended up not seeing the waitress again until it was time to pay and even then she seemed bothered. (*shrugs*)

Average food and awkward service, we probably won't be back.

We enjoyed our meals for dinner. The Rockefeller oyster appetizer was fantastic! The dinner menu had a great variety of choices. Went with a simple meal to make room for dessert. 

Please order their Kahlúa chocolate mousse cake it was phenomenal!

Last but not least our waitress Ashleigh was wonderful. She was so personable and sincere! She was very attentive to our order and made our stay there even better!

This is my first review. Take it or leave it. 

I'm a beer guy. Love the stuff. Beneluxx has great beer. Their Belgium selection is top notch and they always have great select drafts available. I've heard they're good for wine too. But I can't comment to that.

However, there greatness ends at their beer selection. 

I decided to order some food. To preface, I did not know this was a tapas establishment. It's not indicated on the menu, signage or even mentioned by their wait staff/ bartender. 

So when I saw the butternut squash ravioli pasta for $10, I figured I was in for a treat. Turns out three 1 inch squares of (under cooked) pasta equal a meal here. I'm no fan of tapas and I continue not to be. 

Come for the beer, stay for the beer, but don't waste your money ordering any food here.
Love the food. Service a little scarce and slow on a Saturday at 12am - but do yourself a favor and get a Salted Carmel Pretzel milkshake

Bells has excellent pastas, calamari, and specials that really are special. The portions are large, the prices are reasonable (they only take cash - but there is an ATM in the back), the people are terrific, and the meals are memorable. They have the best bread pudding EVER.

My husband and I stopped in on Monday night around 9:25pm. We were looking for hot coffee and a dessert. The employees looked annoyed when we walked in, but we continued to look. We had never been here. I worked in coffee shops years ago and I understand what it is like to be tired at the end of the night. Still, the girl at the register did not smile, did not talk to us, she just looked annoyed. The man working was trying to be funny, but only to her and she was looking less happy each time. 

We ordered two desserts (berry cheesecake and apple bread pudding) and two coffees.  The coffee that we got was luke warm at best! When we finished putting coffee in our cups, the girl came out, set our food on a table, and literally threw two forks on the table beside them. I was just praying someone had cleaned the table! 

At 9:40, my husband tried to get more coffee, but the creamer had been put away.  When he asked for the creamer, she looked very frustrated and brought us a giant cup of it.

All in all, the food was good, the coffee was cold, and the service was unfriendly. Next time, we will stop at the gas station for HOT coffee and a candy bar!

Fabulous service by Mylissa for our impromptu party of 18 on a sunny Friday Lunch.
We ate outdoors and enjoyed a mountain of wings (with various sauces - try the Kickin' Korean, Mexican Garlic or BBQ), excellent cheese steak nachos (so bad for you, but tasty stuff), burgers and salads.

My $12.99 "special" salad with 7 tiny shrimp was just OK, but the $5 Strawberry Mojito made up for it.

It's really 3 star food but we had such a good experience I am giving 4 stars.
I ate a freaking stink bug in their soup, so disgusting and dangerous. Do not recommend to go!b

One of my favorite restaurants in the burg! Menu has a lot of variety in case you want to try something different, everything we have tried has been phenomenal. We tried the special burger for the vote of best burger in the bay and it was way outside the box but hit a home run. Great beer always on tap, a lot of rotating taps. Burger is always a go to if you can't make up your mind on the menu. You guys are doing a great job, see you again soon.

I've been back to Cavanaugh's Headhouse a handful of times since the November 2013 YEE. It's become a reliable, comfortable sports bar to me. I even once stopped here because I knew they had nice, clean bathrooms -- and, obviously, also stuck around for a beer.

Speaking of beer, there are many choices and they are affordable. Nothing extensive, but you're likely to find something up your alley.

The fun and most noticeable thing about Cavs that most everyone else has said is the space itself. It's huge -- with a bunch of little bar rooms with different themes. It's nice to have options!
Fantastic meal, great atmosphere and impeccable service. My new favorite restaurant. Do yourself a favor and take the short cab ride from the Quarter and discover this wonderful place.

Went here when our favorite Pho Restaurant was full and had over an hour wait.  They do have vegetarian options, which was a plus.  It is located in a shopping mall, near a "not so good" side of town.  The atmosphere was lacking, outdated and dirty.  The soup was served hot with all of the fixings, jalapenos, cilantro, basil and bean sprouts.  But the soup itself was kind of flavorless and tasted mostly like water with a few veggies thrown in.

First of all the the 22 filet & mashed we're wonderful as usual. Steak was cooked perfectly as ordered. The server was friendly & attentive, excellent! I had forgotten a hat and called the following day. It was not immediately found. I wrote my favorite hat off. Four days later I received a call that they had located it. We confirmed it was mine. It was mailed to me the next day. The Management went beyond there duty in this case with the follow up. I am extremely happy and give a lot of credit to management for this! Having a steak at there Jacksonville location tonight. Thanks again!

Interesting beer selection. 

Tuesday is open mic night. They have local artists and musicians. 

It's a nice find in EF. Service is good. 

Street parking.
This is a simple no thrills dinner.  It doesn't need any.  The food is great and prices are perfect.  The place is small and it was crowded, but this is just a testiment to their business

I'm a huge seafood fan and have wanted to go here since they opened.  I finally got my opportunity!  I gotta warn you that it's VERY busy at lunch time.  So I suggest maybe calling your order in ahead, otherwise you'll be like me and wait half an hour for your food.  I wasn't in a rush though, and knew they were making it from scratch, so i wasn't mad.  I know that when I saw all the other dozens of patrons waiting alongside me, I had made the right choice to go.  I got a shrimp po boy and some hush puppies and was blown away.  The homemade remoulade is perfect!  I want to go back and get some sea scallops to sear up at home!  Again, take my suggestion of ordering ahead and picking up your food.  You can still eat there, but it will be ready when you get there!

It all depends on who the cook is. You got some really good cooks who take their job serious and you have a few who or big on burning and smothering with grease.

When you have the right person cooking, you get an amazing meal at a great price. 

Their soda is off brand and taste DISGUSTING! Be sure to order a drink at the bar first. I usually get a $2 Stella perfect companion with a hot dog or burger .   

Customer service is above average most of the time.

This place has some "rare to find" items on the menu, which is very nice. But the skate wings I ordered definitely needs some adjustments. Everything was just too sweet. It definitely needed some acidity and seasoning to balance the sweetness. Also, louder for a fine dining place. Overall, it  is not bad.

Local Chinese restaurant on State street that has good grub at a very good price and you get a free soup with every meal dine in only. I come here about every other week. Today I had the shrimp curry and when I left I even asked them if I could take some of the curry sauce home and they were more then happy to make me some to go. The family who owns this place are super kind and accommodating. If you want Chinese food and dont want to pay an arm and a leg, come visit.

I see the name on my morning commute, and had been wanting to investigate the cuisine for a while. One recent morning, I mentioned it to my wife, and later that day she said her coworker mentioned wanting to go AND one of my coworkers came up and told me that was the choice for lunch that day. Alright! I'll go! The signs are clear! 
I threw my lunchbox back in the breakroom fridge and had an enormously successful and delicious lunch.

I got into sushi a few years ago, having wanted to try it but not brave enough to go it alone, when a friend of mine invited me out to Mikado here in downtown Indianapolis. Since then, I've been hooked. Ali'i Poke is threatening to become my new sushi obsession. For the same amount you'd spend on 6-10 rolls at a restaurant, you can get literally two pounds of what is essentially sushi salad here.

It doesn't taste pre-fab. It doesn't taste, look, or smell old. They've got options for the adventurous and the beginner. Plus, they have Ramune soft-drinks, which is a true treat for kids and adults alike. If you've never enjoyed soda from a bottle stoppered with a marble, then get yourself over to Ali'i Poke, grab one, and then load your "salad" with seaweed and sesame seeds. 

You really don't want to miss this. I promise you.

I don't recommend this place!!!   Myself and my friend wanted to have a late healthy lunch, we went there today about 3 30.  It was buzzing and food looked good!!  I walked up to the hostess stand I said 2 please before saying anything thing else this young not so polite girl says I can't seat you there pointing to 2 --- 4 top tables because we are very busy,  but I can seat you outside,  it was raining by the way,,,  so I asked how long she didn't answer. I felt very unwelcome I told Carol Born what she said, and both looked at each other and our surroundings, where no one was waiting in front of us or behind us and said we are out of there,   Our response was how F'ing rude when we left this place they actually Offered to seat us in the rain.  We walked for 15 - 20 minutes.  Walked past the Cider Press again and those 2. 4-top table were still vacant!   We went to the Lure, spent a boat load of money, and tipped the staff well.....

OhMyGoodness!!! Smokehouse offers excellent service and top notch food! I have used them for catering several times with great success.
This morning our order was for the basic breakfast buffet which included fluffy scrambled eggs, crispy bacon and sausage, hash brown casserole, fresh fruit salad, bakery fresh biscuits with butter, honey and jam along with pitchers of orange juice and coffee.

Our staff was very pleased with everything that was served, which is rare for our group. 

Smokehouse deserves more than 5 stars!!!

One person was late arriving so I made a to-go plate for him, it's pictured in the photos.

About 20 years between visits to this Santa Barbara institution and just as good as I remembered! Super fresh oysters, rich chowder, fast friendly service in a stunning harbor setting. Reminds me once again how lucky I am to live in California..

Help Wanted

The food and ambiance were good, but the service was bad, glacially slow and the management sorely lacking. We were told we would have a 20 minute wait because we didn't have a reservation - even with plenty of open tables in sight. A while later, after noticing that they were seating guests who had arrived after us, I checked back with the host and was told we had been forgotten. It took 20 more minutes to get water and drinks and over an hour to get served. The waitress got our order wrong - I had asked for gluten free bread on a sandwich and was brought the sandwich with regular bread plus a side of gluten free bread (?) and my date ordered a side salad with his meal and was brought a whole salad, plus the hot items were cold when they arrived. It took 20 minutes to get the check once we had asked our server for it - and only then after chasing her down. There were dirty plates strewn on the bar on many of the tables.  We were told that one of the servers couldn't make it in so they were a bit stretched, which could understandably throw a lunch shift off, but which didn't explain being forgotten by the host and the poor service we received from our server.  I hope it was a fluke bad day. It was my first time in Santa Barbara and as a vegan I was excited to find such an interesting looking restaurant.  Not sure I'll go back.

I really liked cleavers for their cheesesteaks.  The style of beef and cut was much different and in my opinion much better than another cheesesteak place I had.  I'm sure the meat quality is a lot better too.  They also serve very cheap beer bottled! I don't mind it's cheap beer, a lot of the beers are crated beers or imported but will only cost 3 or 4 a bottle!

The amount of food that that you get from 1 order is outstanding! This cute little breakfast place is eco friendly in which I love. Prompt seating and the waitress was very attentive. French toast is delicious & the pancakes had the right amount of sweetness. My daughter and I are looking forward to returning soon.

Where's the 8 star button?

Finally went for lunch today after reading the insanely good reviews. Oh yes, they are extremely well deserved. Had a ham and guyere sandwich that was somewhere between delightful and orgasmic. It came with a sweet onion mustard that was just the perfect compliment, and some fried chips that are awesome. And I don't even like potato chips!

Also stepped into a delicious Heath Bar cupcake, and I was doing so well by only eating half, but it kept looking at me, all half-eaten, saying "are you to good for me? WHY DON'T YOU LOVE ME??" So I finished it. Sorry new August diet, I can't always control the voices. 

My bartender Sabrina also said it's an entirely different atmosphere at night for dinner, but that the food is just as amazing. The owner Kevin even gave me a tour of their amazingly impressive kitchen, and I found out when you're eating the bread at some of your other favorite local restaurants it was actually prepared by Pane earlier that day. And wow, what bread it is. This place is truly special, and I'm a little mad at myself for not making it there until now.

So the good news is I finally got to Pane Rustica... but the mission is only half-complete. I now have to head back for dinner sometime soon and get the hanger steak that looked just incredible on the menu.

Duuuuuuuude. The food is dank. The beer is dank. The staff is dank. JJ the bartender is also dank. He's cool and made us feel like regulars. I don't live super close but I will definitely make the  trip up more often!

My wife and I have been going steadily for about 4 years. This is he friendliest, warmest spot in Philadelphia. It is nice to be greeted , welcomed, and offered nice choices. Happy hour specials are really nice and the $1 oysters on Tuesday are great, A 'go to" spot any day of the week. Highest recommendation.

Service and food excellent!
Great happy hour hangout! 
Check out jazz night..... Fridays.

The food is good but the prices are very high for Jamaican food and $3.99 for a pattie is outrageous!!! And kola champagne for $2.99 is ridiculous!! And $14.99 for curry goat is way too much! Their jerk chicken is good and ok in price but other than that Patties Of Jamaica is just as good but their prices make them better overall but da blue lagoon has better jerk chicken.

I have eaten here a couple of times, and the food was delicious. The drinks were even better. The old manager, Justin created every single recipe and cocktail on their menu. The main reason WE ever went into kingside diner was to see Justin, Claire, and Heidi. What an amazing bartender Justin is. Not only that, but we saw how he ran his staff- treating them with respect always. What a horrible loss kingside has had when losing Justin.  We will follow him wherever he goes. Unfortunately we will never be at kingside diner again. 

This is a great spot to go in the morning as I always see it packed. However, if this place wants to make profit or stay in business it is time that they step up their game. Nights are a problem here. Why? Is it because of the name? Kingside diner?  Maybe. Is it because of the staff? No the staff is great. Is it because of the owners who don't know what they are doing? Probably. I salute this place and wish the best of luck to anyone still at this establishment, but the owners need to step up their game. This is a decent spot and could be a lot more than it is currently if the staff were treated better, and the owners could just get a clue.

Really love this place! My family has gotten take out dinner from here before but last night was the first time that we dined in and it was a great experience. 

The decor is so Italian restaurant--they hit the nail on the head. When you enter the restaurant you come in through the bar area which has a bar and multiple tables. The room to the right is the main dining room, which also has many tables for dining. 

We were seated right away and were promptly attended to for drink orders and were brought a basket of their delicious garlic knots. So good! Almost every beer on tap was a local Arizona beer, many from the Tucson area, so that was a big plus. They also have Peroni on tap and a good wine selection. 

We chatted and drank for a while and our server was completely understanding and let us have our time. When we did order, my mom and I decided to split the fettuccine alfredo--that's what we've done when we've gotten take out--and it was delicious as always. We also had the garden salad with the house dressing--and the house dressing is amazing! In fact my dad loves the house dressing so much he got the entree salad with the house dressing. My partner also got the garden salad with the house dressing and the chicken parmesan--both of which were excellent. 

We were so full that we passed on dessert, but that might be on our list to try next time. Overall this is a gem of a restaurant in the NW area and some of the best Italian food I've had in Tucson. We will definitely be back--either for dine in or carry out.

I understand that the Nashville location is new, but we waited over two and a half hours for a bay. Once we finally got in, we passed at least eight bays that were unoccupied. It was quite annoying to see that the spaces were not even being used to their full potential. We were put on the first floor where you can't really see the ground/what you're aiming at as well as the higher floors. Further, we are inexperienced and right handed and were put at the bad side for this. The waitress took so long to help us that the people playing by us gave us some of their beer because they felt bad for us. Sub par experience and I do not expect to go back.

Don't waste your time here. This was the worst location I have ever been to. Why you ask?  Because of the following:
Debby/Debbie which ever way she spells it. The assistant manager of this location. But when I called to complain, she said she was the manager. What a classic Sigmund Freud case. This is why...
She was so rude to me. The location screwed up the order and didn't cook our meat good. Raw meat after I said well done. 

After realizing I would get no where with her I stopped trying to make my point. She was soooooo big and tough over the phone, but wouldn't talk to me after I came back. This is so typical of this type of person. I will take the high road, oh yes I could take the low road, and not let this...type of person bother me. Big fish in a little pond. Knows nothing...nothing about customer service 101. 

Yes, the meal was comped. The district sent us $40.00 in gift certificates.  But, that didn't make up for the bad experience. 

Debbie/Debby.... You suck!

Very friendly staff. Line gets long but the place is pretty big so they turn around table pretty fast. If you dont mind sitting at the counter, even faster. 
Very unique menu which actually also taste yummy. The drink menu is really fun.

Average Mexican. Fajitas were bland, rice and beans were good. Seafood chimigangas were not properly deep fried and sauce tasted "flour-y". White queso was really good. Service was excellent and prompt.
Great authentic Indian food in a nice atmosphere. Happy hour from 5-7pm! Loved the lamb saag and the tandoori shrimp.

I had been a fan of this place since they opened, but recently moved to Sparks about 8 months ago and had not had the chance to visit since then.  I went back a few nights ago around peak dinner time and was surprised to see that this place was empty.  I sat at the bar where the was one couple and then at a table was a couple with a young child.  Despite the lack of customers, I found that service was slow.  I was several rolls in before my appetizer of tempura shrimp came, which was tasty.  The rolls were ok, and seem to have decreased in quality from what I remember in a way that I can't put my finger on.  Its not that the fish wasn't or other ingredients weren't fresh, it just seem to be less than wow.  I would recommend their crystal shrimp roll and any of the veggie rolls.  Yes, I know you are there for the fish, but seriously, they are good.  AYCE starts at $24, which is high and you can get a better tasting roll at one of the other AYCE places for less.

This was on my bucket list for years, and did not disappoint. The road trip over the Huey to the simple clapboard roadhouse is a huge part of the adventure. And in a stroke of luck, we arrived as the regular meeting of the Westwego Italian Lodge was wrapping up... a table of twenty or so men singing a capella in Italian was quite the welcome! 
I'm glad I opted for the simple Italian salad, because the Oysters Mosca, bread and then pineapple fluff (Mosca's classic, and, I believe, their only dessert) was more than filling.
The service was great, the time capsule ambiance... perfection.

I've never had Thai Food before, but had been wanting to try it for a while! This place did not disappoint! I decided to try the Pad Thai, safe dish for a first timer. Definitely would go back simply for this dish alone. I like a little bit of spice, but not too much, so the medium heat was perfect. The portion size was great, enough for leftovers and the atmosphere of the restaurant is relaxing, great after a long week. We had a large group when I went, so I was glad we made a reservation as the restaurant is smaller. Can't wait to go back!

Can't say enough about the place - Food is as fresh as it gets , terrific and personalized service , beautiful inside , ... and a swell owner !  Happy to say Selene is here to stay - thanks again to all.

Have never ordered here and NOT been asked to park in the shady abandoned gas station parking lot next door. ALL YOU SELL IS CHICKEN! And I KNOW you don't cook it to order. What is so hard about having cooked chicken available???

This breakfast and lunch restaurant is truly a throwback to an earlier time when service , friendliness and good food was the norm . When you walk into Claire's it is like going back in time . The servers are very friendly , the ambiance is like you are coming home and the food is imaginative, copious and delicious. Prices are reasonable . Great artwork and curios adorn the walls. There are very few eating establishments like this left. Get there and see for yourself.

if you like apple bees then you will love this place, food was so,so.  but they do have a vast selection of brews that apple bees does not have...  customer service little slow,  but in all fairness they were very busy....
Great food and easy to grab a beer with lunch. Wife had the lobster roll and I had the grouper sandwich (Cajun style).   Both were delicious.

I got the hot leg quarter and it was really good. All chicken is made to order so be prepared to wait, but it is worth it. There are not many options for sides and the fries are...meh, but the chicken makes up for it. The spices they put on the chicken have great flavor and lots of heat. There was not so much sauce that it made the breading soggy, which for me is a big no no. I would say the chicken is a 4.5, The establishment and the way it is setup is odd and it takes about 30 minutes to get your food so I would give that a 3.The sides would get a 3 just because there are not a ton of options and the fries were just ok. They did have some amazing looking pies but I was too full to try one. Maybe next time. I will definitively be going back though.

The Culinary Adventures of Tom Coghlan, FB
·
Last week I went to Parc with my friend and Brother Drywall Finisher, Jeff ...We arrived just before 10am and easily got a seat at the bar...Stef and Mark were our servers... I introduced Jeff to Stef and Mark. Stef asked me if Jeff was "having a Romarin as well? "..."Of course!" was my immediate response. We started our Brunch by sharing BREAKFAST PASTRIES Chocolate croissant, croissant, brown butter madeleine, pistachio cherry financier, apricot and orange blossom pastry. All pastries are made by the in-house Pastry Chef, and are AMAZING! The basket of pastries is served with a raspberry spread that is also house made... and AMAZING!!! I ordered GAZPACHO red pepper, cucumber, basil. I also ordered MACARONI GRATIN. Jeff took my recommendation and ordered EGGS NORWEGIAN* Smoked salmon, hollandaise sauce (My personal favorite thus far) All three dishes came at the same time... I started with the GAZPACHO. A cold soup made from Red Bell Pepper, Cucumber and Basil. It was topped with greens and corn. You could taste the FRESHNESS of the ingredients!  Next, I attacked the MACARONI GRATIN. It was Macaroni and Cheese with dice sized chunks of Ham. The Ham was both flavorful and plentiful. There was Ham in every spoonful. It was topped with bread crumbs. The flavors worked so well together that I savored every bite so much I didn't want to swallow! Jeff certainly seemed to enjoy his EGGS NORWEGIAN as he made a "Happy Plate"!  Three more Romarins each and we were on our way!

They are on time and the pizza is decent for a single guy on a Tuesday night!! It's not
Brooklyn style pizza but it works with a beer or two!! 

I'll keep ordering from there.

There's parking out front but there's a larger parking lot nearby so it wasn't too hard to find a spot when I went.

I came with friends for breakfast. And walking in it's a small place with some areas to sit and enjoy your coffee or food. About half of the people that came took their orders to go. There's multiple locations and I've only been to Ybor location before coming here. This one is certainly smaller and has a different vibe. I almost feel this is the perfect family breakfast spot and has that low key feel.

The employees working there greeted us with a smile and we're very attentive in keeping the utensils and napkins stocked. 

As for food we ordered:
Avocado toast: good and filling (devoured it before I could get a picture)
Belgium waffles: standard waffles, no complaints
Breakfast tacos with corn tortillas: my friend who ordered them really liked it. Who knew, tacos for breakfast?!
Coffee: delicious and a good morning pick me up.

It's a good neighborhood Blind Tiger spot! Would definitely go there again.
Good timed service (considering for an airport Chick-fil-A), friendly staff/cashiers, and kid-friendly.

Very disappointed. My husband and I stop here frequently (2-3x per month) for a beer after shopping at Kroger. Tonight We were told rudely we would have to wait 15-20 minutes for a seat at the bar (even though there were only 2 people at the bar) because the servers were busy. The red headed waitress needs to ask for advice rather than make stupid decisions that result in Dales regulars leaving to go to Wings Etc for their cold one

This has been added to our rotation of delicious restaurants in Tucson! I love the beef brisket and hearty noodles. The clear broth is flavorful. Price point to amount of food is right on target. If you're looking for more meat, try the salty chicken wings. Juicy and fried to perfection! My husband likes spicy and enjoys the Taiwanese beef. Can't say enough good things about the noodles. You have to try it!

Whoa! The amount of food you are served is crazy. Like other reviewers have said, share and item. Food was very good. To the reviewers that stated the place is dirty.... it is like a dive bar. Get over it.
Their Chile relleno en caldo is a dish I dream about. Margaritas are top notch. Ask for the spicy salsa (they don't normally bring it as part of the salsa selection with chips)

Oh my... I'm seriously at a loss for words, and that is rare! Yelpers, you did not steer me wrong on this place!! 

This has to be some of the best fried chicken I have ever consumed! Light, not greasy, with a hit of spiciness, pipping hot right out of the fryer! I'm not one for chicken wings, but even those were quickly devoured! 

And knowing that I might not ever be in New Orleans again, or anytime soon, I ordered yet another fried chicken plate to go! The butter beans were surely homemade, the bay leaf gave that one away. They aren't what I'm used to being from the semi-south (Maryland/Va) where everything is seasoned with ham! These beans were served with a side of white rice, and were very creamy and light.

Seating is very minimal (about 7-8 tables), and If they are busy please do not let the wait deter you! Every second of your wait will be worth it! For now, I'm back in Atlanta, and the only thing I can do is fantasize over some of the best food I had while I was in town.

Can't figure out why this place has good reviews! Mediocre at best. Not worth it:( 
Much better options in Boise.

Order here if you've run out of options late in the evening.  It's not terrible, but it's heaven if you want something delivered late, because it's one of the few options.  
We ordered a white pizza with broccoli and sliced tomatoes. The toppings and ingredients were good.   The crust is not as much local Philadelphia thin as much as it is like Pizza Hut crust.  Fast delivery, it was still pretty warm when we got it.  Next time I don't want to leave the apt late at night, I'll order from here.

Ate here on both of my trips to Nashville and has never disappointed.  The portions were very filling and the food tasted great.  Have been to Puckett's for both brunch and dinner and both were very good but I give a slight edge to the dinner menu.  Good beer selection.

I love this place! I was back in NOLA visiting my family and went here to watch the Saints game and came back again 2 days later!!! The place is an old gas station that has been redone with inviting colors and decor. It is open, airy, and just a cheerful fun place to sit, chat, eat and drink.  We actually sat and drank for so long we had both lunch and than dinner!!! The food is spot on, the happy hour is AMAZING and the employees are funny and attentive.  One of my new fav spots in New Orleans for sure. I highly recommend the Smoked Sausage. Come on a nice day and sit outside or chill at the bar and listen to the rain on one of those fabulous lazy, rainy, NOLA days ;)

Around Historic Philly and looking for a quick convenient affordable bite ? Look no further than Gianfranco Pizzeria Rustica!
At the night before Philadelphia Marathon last weekend, my family and I opted here for dinner to "carb-load" after finding out the Italian Restaurant I initially set eyes on (Panini Old City) was closed due to renovation. Since there's no pasta to carb load here and plus we wanted quick dinner nearby as it was getting late, we ordered a large pizza (~24"!) with chicken , peppers and onions pizza and a tuna salad. As we dined in, where seating is limited and is high stool style (for 2 - 3 people max), we only waited 10 min before our fresh food arrived. Pizza pie and tuna salad were fresh and delicious at enormous portions. Pizza toppings quantity could be more generous, but delicious.  
For 3 hungry people, we paid only $27 and barely finished it all! With lots of delivery & take-out orders and quality fast affordable food , it's no wonder they were GrubHub #1 restaurant award recipient! 
Some personal general tips to runners:
1. Not a good idea to eat foreign food before marathon or long race. Pizza especially ... as it may upset stomach and contains lactose, which may promote lactic acid and stiffen muscles.
2. With the big meal for carb-load, Take a #2 sometime before the race. Running with bloated stomach not efficient or good idea... I learned the hard way!
3. Get good night sleep!
4. Hydrate and eat a light hearty breakfast for the race! 
5. Do some warm up and dynamic stretches before race.

Holy moly this was the perfect breakfast after a night out! The Mac and cheese skillet was so creamy and tasty! It was like breakfast and lunch in one bowl. Each entree gets a side, the mini waffles could have been a meal by themselves! The coffee was great, and our waiter was attentive and helpful!

Hands down one of the best seafood restaurants in the Nola metro area. Would have given 5stars but server was a little off. 2 of the 5 drink orders wrong. Forgot my gumbo!!! But that will not stop me from returning and trying something new.  Biggest oysters I've ever had! Very well seasoned crawfish!! Fried green tomatoes might be the best I ever had!!!

*Hit and miss.

Lunch - Ignored when I walked in, even though the staff saw me, had to seat myself, waited for a good 5-7min with waitresses constantly passing me and actually rude to an extent. Finally ordered and the food was old.  Chicken teriyaki lunch special tasted like it was cooked hours ago and just got heated up.  Other ingredients didn't taste fresh as well. 
Left unsatisfied for sure

In contrast to...

Dinner - the week prior (the reason I came back) where we shared a few rolls that were delicious and we both raved about.  The Chef special foll was $15 and huge and tasty, and the normal rolls were packed with meat and flavor, and deliciousness.  

Not sure on a return now.

That sushi addiction hurts so good.
Their seafood is the best.  We stop at one of their locations every time we are in Tucson.  Wish they would accept credit cards.

I used to have Their prime rib, but today I just had their bbq roasted chicken, and I was so impressed. The chicken was so tender and juicy. 

btw, their free bread is a must try.

definitely one of the best sea food locations in santa barbara! the location is absolutely beautiful. i got the mary's chicken under a brick and it was cooked to perfection. the chicken itself was a large amount and came with really good sized portions for the price. also had the calamari which was some of the best that my mouth has ever come into contact with. also our bartender chris makes the best drinks around! i'd definitely recommended the serrano margarita! thank you also to ricardo and megyn for making this such a pleasant experience! definitely will be coming back!

The black pepper tuna appetizer was quite good but everything went downhill after that.  It took a long time to place our order (even though they only had two tables) and the sushi was underwhelming.  It did come out quickly though.

The rice was loose (fell apart when you picked it up) and the rolls looked nothing like the photos in the menu (normally I run from places that have food photos.)  The rolls were fairly plain as well and the sauces lacked much flavor.

The fish itself was fresh which gets points.

The miso soup looked good but lacked the umami flavor you expect.

Clean restaurant but no plans to go back.

Food is fabulous. The deli is great. Their cappuccinos and copies are very good. If you need something Italian for a meal this is the place to go. Call ahead for lunch orders is recommended to speed up your time. Or you can just sit at one of their tables are around the coffee bar. Can't say enough nice things about this place. Even their catering is fabulous.
Love this place! I come here before work and everything is delicious!!! La Colombe coffee and fresh baguettes!! Yay!!

Went for a girls night and had a great time. Our server was good, very friendly. I had the Afterthot cocktail which was the best part of the experience. The food left a lot to be desired. Overpriced and very underwhelming. I had the Vaca Frita Tostones. The pork was good but the bottom cracker was soggy with oil and had an undesirable texture. Also had the jerk chicken egg rolls which were just ok. Not a lot of flavor. Would come back if others wanted to go. The view was nice, will be better once construction is done.

For the two stars I would like to see that it was a horrible experience. But although the food was not enjoyable the management looked after us and took care of the bill and went above board and bought us drinks and were sincere in their apologies
We love this place some of the best food in our area. We don't normally eat fish but the fish from lure is outstanding in my opinion

First time here, really good. Fantastic lentil soup! Simply great beef broth and lentils, the way it should be. Great sandwich and pasta too. (My pasta was a bit overcooked, but that can easily happen and judging by everything else I'm sure that's out of the ordinary)

Its like a bigger dossier version of the bluebird cafe.  Great performers.  Downtown location. Valet parking.  Great cocktails.  The food is okay.  Eat at the southern or Ichiban
instead and then come here for music and drinks.

I've gotten takeout and eaten in here and both times have been great. It's very vegan- and vegetarian friendly and I really enjoyed their happy hour specials like the strawberry crostini! Even the side salad is simple but super yummy :) the wait is usually a bit long but pretty great experience overall!

Royal House is a restaurant that plays to there strengths  OYSTERS.  The oyster are fresh shucked to order. We were told to only go to a res6that shucks the oysters to order. The alligator app is good, french onion soup is great, taste of NOLA ok, but the banana foster cheesecake is money. I have actually went twice for the oysters and may go again before leaving town. At the end of the day it's New Orleans Eat, Drink, and Be Merry.

Best Mexican restaurant we've been to in Florida, have been searching for a place that has as good of food as we're used to where we're from. The salsa is amazing! The food we ordered was perfect, the steak is spot on tender and juicy! Definitely best steak we've had ever at a Mexican restaurant. We found our new favorite!!

Waited forty minutes for my lunch.  When I complained, told by two different people that manager was going to come over, but he didn't.  When we were finally done, and I had cancelled the meeting I had missed because of the long wait, waiter brought full bill with nothing comped.  He just said "it's not my fault."

There was a very strong smell of gas or some other chemical in the restaurant on Opening Day. It smelled awful in there. My kids were covering their noses. Not sure whether that has been taken care of. If they don't get rid of that smell, I would knock them down to one star.

The tenders are delicious and tender but TINY for the price. I used to eat at Guthrie's in North Florida and the tenders have SHRUNK by at least half. You need to get the Big Box. The regular box is not enough food.

The fries were soggy, not crispy.

The totally addictive Guthrie's sauce is still addictive.

This is definitely closer to 3.5 stars. But the scenery and service were great so I rounded up. 

We were looking for outdoor dining without a parking lot view. I heard about this place in a Facebook group and made a reservation. 

We started with the cheese board. Ok cheeses, large portions, nothing too fancy or stinky. The grapes were a little on the mushy side, but the fig jam was wonderful. I ordered the beet salad. Again great portion size, easily shareable. We ordered the halibut special and it was just ok. It lacked flavor. The fish and rice were so under seasoned. It didn't ruin the meal, but it was definitely a disappointment. Everything until then was pretty good. I would certainly return and try it again.

This ice cream stop was amazing. Line was long so you know it was a local fav along with tourists in full force. We were on vacation and stopped at several ice cream spots and this was by far the friendliest, tastiest and had the best options.

Came here because my dinner partner never had Indian food, I had to take care of that. We were seated quickly since it was pretty dead, the owner came out to greet us and was a awesome guy. Real genuine and personable I love hospitality he's shown. The food was all great, we got a few different naan for her to try, butter chicken, onion pakora and chicken Briyani. Can't go wrong with butter chicken and naan bread. My friend could eat the broth and naan alone. The Briyani was well seasoned, great texture on the rice not soggy. Oinion pakora was better than onion blooms or rings. All the naan bread we had were great.

Live near this place and decided to finally give it a shot since I love being healthier and thought healthy fast food was a great concept.  I created my own wrap, got a strawberry lemonade and split a banana frozen dessert with my boyfriend.

The good: the wrap was actually pretty decent and definitely hit the spot after a long twelve hour shift at work. I LOVED the banana dessert. For an ice cream fanatic like me, I was so impressed how much it tasted just like ice cream.  Topped with berries, granola and a little chocolate sauce made it even better.  Such a great idea, and something I can definitely copy at home!

The bad: I was SO looking forward to the strawberry lemonade but it was EXTREMELY sour. I never sweeten my drinks and I felt like I needed to dump loads of sugar in this to make it drinkable :(. Also, about an hour later my boyfriend and I got pretty bad stomachaches :( Not sure what from, but we felt it must have been something we ate.

Overall, I would probably come here again at least for the banana dessert.

I have a soft spot for Alphie's. I lived and worked in Goleta back in the day and Alphie's is one of the few places still around from those times. Ok, I will admit that diners of the greasy spoon variety are no longer my dining establishments of choice but I still stop by Alphie's from time to time. What distinguishes them from other diners is the Hawaiian influence on some of their food, which I love.

I give this place a very "iffy" 2 stars. You walk in and if you come in the side entrance you have to dodge people to get in line to order. The whole set up of the restaurant does not flow and it seems as if you are always in the of either another patron or employee. The girl behind the counter had very little patience and made it seem like I was disrupting her day as I made my decision.

I ended up ordering the New Jersey burger and the others in my group each got a BBQ Bacon and Cheddar. We weren't really paying much attention to the price but when the cashier asked for $22 my jaw almost hit the counter. Three meals came to $22, it might not seem like a lot but we didn't even get fries just the sandwiches. After realizing there were no fries we got up and ordered two fries at $1.99 each. That wasn't that bad but when we received the order each fry came in 8oz cups! 

So to the taste, my burger was thing and the blue cheese was over powering the rest of the toppings. To be honest I am not sure if it even had bacon. Definitely not worth $7 a burger. The others somewhat enjoyed their burgers but not to the point they would return. The shoestring fries were lacking salt and tasteless.

In conclusion I would not return to SmashBurger and would not recommend it to anyone. In fact I felt somewhat sick later that evening, it might be due to the amount of blue cheese on the New Jersey. Just go to Five Guys and get better quality at a cheaper price.

This is one of the few places I know where you can get authentic Haitian food in 'Nawlins. 

Period. Full stop. 

Formerly known as La Belle Fouchette, 
it is indeed a hole in the wall and if you drive too fast you might miss it, so slow down!

I got the lambi with du riz blanc avec sauce pois and legume with riz cole and fried plantains. All were delicious and no one freaked out when I asked for the legumes without meat. We also got Cola Lacaye. :D I will definitely go back again.

I think the best part of Adello is that it is a fun atmosphere. Friendly staff, live music, and a crowd outside drinking and eating (BYOF). So if you're looking for a Sunday/funday experience outside sipping wine with others than by all means you should put Adello on your list.

 As i've noted before, the local winery experience has evolved into a retail business model -- essentially being a "proprietary" wine bar, i.e., you are paying bar prices for wine by the glass, with a bit of a discount when you buy their bottles.  It's the setting/experience that helps justify the pricing. I don't think it's a bad thing - it seems to generate enough business that we've had a plethora of localized wineries spring up. I know a lot of people who complain about paying a higher price for PA local wine -- comparing it to the better stuff they can get in the store. Folks, that's not the point. You pay a premium in a bar every time - for the experience. So stop thinking about your local winery like its a distributor, and start thinking about it like an outdoor bar.

The wine here is "good" - not great, not bad. Personally, I found their whites to be the best. There are a couple of unusual standouts that get honorable mention: The reserve Chardonnay has a quite unusual and pleasing profile that reminds me a bit of a california Hess. The sauvignon blanc was really unusual. Hard to describe - totally out of the standard flavor profile of any SB i've ever had - but again worth trying. I thought the Rose was also worthy of mention. It a slightly off dry style that is a bit Rhone-like. Was not a fan of the reds so much - the merlot was the best of the bunch there. Their tasting do encompass 10 wines, but the pour is so small it's a bit hard to get the flavor. I would have liked a little larger pour to get a better feel for the wine. 

One thing they do here that is really unusual are the fruit wines. I have to say, i typically avoid these due to the overly sweet profile that characterizes them. The proprietor assured me that was not the case - and so we sampled. Lo and behold, they have managed to capture the wonderful fruit essence of fruit in a off-dry format that really accentuates the core flavor. The blueberry and peach were amazingly good - like summer in glass. I don't drink fruit wine all the time, but when i do you can bet Adello will be on the label.

We saw this place from an interview by WTHR a couple of weeks ago.  We said next time we were in Indy this was a must try place.  Today we went to Indy.  Stopped by and OML.  Hank is very friendly.  He asked if we had been there before we said "no".  He was quick to offer a sample.  He also asked how we had heard of his place.  If you want some excellent BBQ this is the place to go.  Great food and excellent service.  And if you do stop you have to try the Caramel apple cobbler it also is out of this world.

Food is pretty good. However, for the prices that are charged, I really expected more food.
