Us were now having a bad experience because of this unnecessary charge. So paid for the app. And none of us or our friends of 20 friends will be back. Way to wreck you're reputation and treat a group who basically was your only business from 3-5pm today. Nice customer service!!!

One of those really good places in nashville to bag out that everyone knows about. It's generally been pretty crowded so is be prepared to wait if you go sometime like for weekend brunch or at a prime time for sports. It's a great little place though. I've had the burger and truffle fries which were great. Their tacos are good as well, but better if you're going to order something else or really want to eat light. Only real criticism aside from it being popular is I think it might be a little loud for my taste. Maybe that's just me showing my age. This place is money though if you want some food in the later afternoon or a weird time like that when it's not crowded or a weeknight when it's not a major sporting night.

Really good stuff plus really good stuff plus more really good stuff on a big roll does NOT always equal a very good cheesesteak.  We really liked Brick & Brew.  Gina was fantastic.  The roll was far too big for this cheesesteak.  Minimally scoop most of the bread out of it.  The charred vidalia onion, sauteed spinach and tomato jam were fantastic and probably worked together but I think it was just too many flavors.

If you visit New Orleans, you MUST visit K-Paul's for dinner! It was the best meal we had in New Orleans and also the best memory we have from our visit!

My husband and I planned to spend our special anniversary, "date night," dinner at K-Pauls, and we are still in awe about how perfect our night was. We expected to splurge a little on great Cajun cuisine, but we were not prepared for the welcoming hospitality that awaited us.

We were greeted warmly at the door and seated on the second floor by the windows overlooking Royal Street. Our table was adorned with confetti hearts and we were greeted by every employee with a jovial "happy anniversary!"

One of the main reasons our dinner was so special was because we loved our waitress. If you plan to enjoy dinner at K-Paul's ask to sit in Sheila's section. From the minute Sheila introduced herself, you can observe that she loves her job, and truly cares about your dining experience.  She is welcoming, has a genuine interest in the people she serves and is honest about the food selections if you have any questions. She helped us decide on what to order and we loved every bite! By the time we paid our bill and were ready to leave, we felt like we gained a new friend in Sheila.

We ordered Jambalaya, the Blackened Beef Tenders with Debris Sauce, and the Blackened Louisiana Drum. Every bite was phenomenal. My husband wondered why he was not given a steak knife with his meal, but soon found out that he did not need a steak knife because the filet mignon was very tender.

We cannot wait to return to New Orleans and eat at K-Paul's again!!!

Sweet Jesus!!!!!!! There strip steak is sheer magic, the mashed potatoes are perfectly flavored . There lobster tail was perfection . I washed this delicacy down with a Manhattan- which was amaze balls!!!!!! My dessert was the divine  baked Alaska- best baked Alaska on the planet! Great service !!!!!! I felt at home . Beautiful decor

I'm giving this place 4 stars because I suspect it has earned its high ratings, plus as a rule I don't think it is fair to give out a bad rating on the basis of one bad meal, so consider this simply a warning: don't buy pork and green beans cooked in what they call "XO sauce"!  And perhaps avoid XO sauce altogether. It had potential: a garlic sauce obviously made from fresh garlic with a hint of basil; but it was incredibly greasy and oily. Imagine a plateful of fresh green beans cooked with a quarter pound of ground pork and all the oil it generates,  then add a third of cup of cooking oil and you'll get the idea. By eating the greasy beans with generous amounts of steamed rice it was edible, but as soon as the rice was gone I was done, with less than half of the entrée eaten. XO sauce: Xtra Oil?

On the plus side, the hot and sour soup was excellent. And all around me were happy people eating crayfish. So give it a try, but be forewarned about the XO sauce.

For some reason I decided to "treat myself" by coming here and spending $50. i ordered the sirloin, it was dry and bland and  the dish looked like something that would be served in a hospital cafeteria. nothing on this menu is worth the price. nothing on this menu is worth putting in your mouth. wow I really hate this place.

I think I may have finally found my favorite dan dan noodles in the city!

Came here on Saturday night with my sister and boyfriend after an afternoon of shopping. I remembered reading about this place in a recent article about the best new restaurants in the city, so when we passed it by we decided to try it out.
 
The ambiance was modern, open and bright. It was pretty crowded but we managed to snag some bar seats and ordered a round of drinks. Drinks were decent, a tad on the sweet side but we still enjoyed them. We also put in an order of the Dan Dan noodles. 

I have to say, I don't handle spice all that well to begin with. Unfortunately for me, dan dan noodles tend to be on the spicy side and up until this point I haven't been able to find the perfect balance between spicy and sweet. Dan Dan definitely found that balance for me! They were not too spicy, perfectly cooked noodles and I was able to taste the peanut sauce without being overwhelmed with heat.

I will definitely be back to try the other menu items!
If I could give it ten I would. Super friendly good food and live music. Great water side place.
This is a great addition to our community in Florence.  Rays has great food, friendly workers and fast!  Make sure you are really hungry because the portion sizes are very big!
Love it here! Fun atmosphere, great food, generous portion sizes. I just wish they had Magic Hat #9.

We really enjoyed the dumplings from Bai Wei. We ordered delivery through caviar and was very pleasantly surprised by the quality of the soup dumplings and pan-fried dumplings! Will certainly order again!

This place was really happenin' last night (Saturday). I had a couple of beers, a few friends and a great time! 

I didn't order any food... already had dinner at my temporary home (that I will be at for the next 7 weeks).

A Place with NO COVER on a weekend? Fantastic!
Great DJ
Great Live Music
The atmosphere was relaxed but happy and still full of LIFE!
Seemed to be All Ages, some dancing, some viewing...

I need to get back there and try the food. Any suggestions?

The gyro platter w/ Persian rice and an appetizer of tabouli & warm pitas (side of tazaki) is amazing. I am super impressed with all the selections and intend to visit ali more often. The bread pudding is the best anywhere.
This place for sure gets Italian food right! Everything we ordered was great! I strongly recommend the Ahí Tuna Carpaccio and the Fresh Rhode Island Calamari Fritti as appetizers.

I've been to this restaurant several times now.  The food is really delicious and they have a great menu.  The price to eat is affordable but on the higher end of the scale.  The restaurant is very clean and the staff is nice.

Went to try big sky cafe tonight with family.  I have been wanting to give it a try and we were heading to a party in the area so it was a great reason.  
  It started out decent with some drinks and the complimentary carrot hummus.  After a little wait we ordered some appetizers.  Tomato soup, a salad, kale chips and mussels.  The tomato soup came out after awhile and it was good.  We ordered dinner expecting our other apps to be out soon.  After quite a wait and no sign of our waitress we realized we had still not received our mussels or kale chips.  Not being in a rush we just waited, and waited, and waited.  Every attempt to wave down our waitress failed.  She finally came by and said our dinner would be out soon.  I asked about our apps and she said she was sorry.  But really I'd like to know what happened there.  There seemed to be plenty of staff, and yet somehow that had been totally overlooked.  We let it go and told her to just take it off our bill.  By now we were already starting to feel full.  You know that feeling when you've eaten your appetizers and waited far too long for food and the messages from stomach to brain are telling you that it is satiated.  Yeah that.  
    Alas our food arrived via another waiter.  Everything was alright.  My wife liked her lamb, my eggplant was good and my inlaws didnt like either the duck, or stew.  I agreed the persimmon glaze did nothing for the duck breast.  I felt like it was a reach to try using seasonal fruit in a dish that just flopped.  After this we waved down our waitress to get our check, waved down another waiter to take our credit cards, waved down the same different waiter to get our cards back finally, and then our waitress returned for one final encore and return our checks to us.  
     Final words, if you start the night off with a waitress that reminds you of the sloth from Zootopia.  Leave while you still can.  Otherwise it will be a long slow night.  Waiters should wait on their customers, customers should not wait for their waiters.  In the end the service killed this one for us.
Good food, good customer service, and good prices. My experiences have been good so far.

They are only getting 2 stars because the fries were crispy, fresh and not greasy.  Other than that the pictures that are posted are not what I received at all!  I did not think to take a picture before but I got the fajita box and I am not exaggerating when I say there was maybe an 1/8 cup of diced chicken some diced onion and a few cheese curds and this what is suppose to be a meal cost me $8 without a drink!!  My friend and I were there yesterday for Octoberfest d should have been clued in when the place was pretty empty on such a busy day!  I do have to also say the staff were friendly but I won't be spending my money there again!

I had the Oysters and Grouper Tacos while visiting for dinner a couple weeks ago. The oysters were fresh and satisfying. The tacos were pretty good. The Grouper was flakey, the slaw crisp, and avocado creamy but the amount of fish in the taco was on the light side. However, Olde Bay Café is a solid place for seafood.

Great size oyster! Very fresh....They also have good kitchen food too with nice presentation. Employees are nice and attentive....oh yea one more thing they have 4 karaoke room there!! they close late during weekend, so its gonna be another good spot to hang out  :)

I used to go here a lot and went back for lunch on a recent Saturday and was quite disappointed. I git wings which were fair and hubby got chicken quaesidillas whih wer just plain bad- just chicken and cheese. A couple of hours later he got sick and we attributed it to the food. The service was civil though not as attentive as I remember.
What happened?

I thought the decor and ambiance were just average. Our waiter was outstanding. I got a Rainbow Poke Bowl that god but a little too sweet and too drenched in sauce.
The wait was ridiculous. We were told 30 minutes for two and after 45 minutes we were still not seated and took two seats at the bar. The hostess snapped at us rudely for doing so even though it was protocol. 
After taking our name and phone number the hostess ignored us. She never apologized for the wait, sat and chatted with the other hostess most of the evening. I'd say she pretty much ruined the evening. They need to find decent hostesses.

This is absolutely hands down my favorite restaurant.... not just in Nashville. I use this as the standard to compare any restaurant I visit in any city. The brunch on the weekends is packed to the gills but so worth the wait. In fact , I even ordered my Thanksgiving dinner from here.

Definitely a great buffet. The fish is really great and fresh. Service was great refilled drinks regularly. Food was served in a timely manner. My boyfriend and I were hungry coming in and I think we got our money's worth! It's best of the all you can eat places in the area! Just don't order to much. I'm happy but I need a nap!
Too many awesome places just a block or two away from here. Just don't bother. Sweet server.
Sorry. We didn't like it much. Meat was tough! The only thing good was beans and drinks.

Worse customer service I've ever experienced from a wingstop location. I ordered my food and was told that there would be a 15min wait. Multiple customer who had ordered after me at the register received their meals before I did. I noticed that my order had sat in the kitchen when they called my name after 30mins wait from the time I ordered, my order sat cold in the kitchen for over 15mins. Long story short I will never return to this establishment and refuse to recommend it to anyone else.

I am probably one of the few yelpers (judging by the ratings) not blown away by this place... Maybe it's because I have known French people who have been so kind as to make me crepes before... And if you tell me I can't base my experience here on my experiences with my French friends, I have also been to Cafe du Monde numerous times... 

Right inside the door next to Twenty-Two Juicery is the location of this crepe place.

I have tried the Green Eggs and Ham and the Bakin' Pumpkin (my doctor wants me to eat more). First and only time. And this was because Twenty Two Juicery was closed to renovate/expand (ps - they're now back open)

Anyway, I wanted the Bakin' Pumpkin - which seems like a dessert crepe as its mascarpone and pumpkin and spices - without the bacon (see what they did there with Bakin' Pumpkin? They are clever) but they had to check to make sure they could do that - which seemed weird as I was NOT asking for a price adjustment so really it was saving them $$. But they finally agreed to do it. 

And I got the Green Eggs and Ham unaltered.

They're like machines making the crepes. It was wonderful to watch. Their set up is great.

The Bakin' Pumpkin was also pretty decent 

So why 3 stars?

The Green Eggs and Ham (spinach, ham, eggs) was incredibly oily and lacked flavor. Which seemed so odd as ham when it cooks lets out juices that very much have flavor. 

I couldn't physically command myself to eat even half of it.

And so I am going 3 stars. Seems the right average from both crepes and the service

I know I said I wouldn't go back, but that might not 100% be true. If I ever see their crepe cake I probably would buy a slice

My boyfriend and I went here for our one year anniversary. The service was amazing. We never had to go out of our way to find a waiter even though it was quite busy. All staff was friendly and willing to help. The food was AMAZING. And best of all decently priced. I recommend getting the cava from Spain for a drink. Highly recommend.
Love this place! Great fried chicken with wonderful savory sauces! Staff is always friendly and helpful when trying to decide which sauce to go with since they are all so good!

The best sandwiches I've had in a long time, the meatball sandwich is to die for I would definitely recommend 
La Cucina Fanti to anyone who wants great pizza and great sandwich's

Family and I ate here a few weeks ago. I mentioned the good reviews, and they said, yes we've been before!

We arrived, were greeted within minutes, was immediately offered Tequila or a Margarita (I must look the type), said yes, will have a Margarita with Herradura* tequila. 

When they came back with our drinks ordered the Shrimp Diabla and Chicken Tacos with green sauce. The waiter looked at me like I was loco, so I suspected I was in for a treat.

The Margarita was huge, like the watered down ones at the chain restaurants, but boy was it potent, double the volume of a real bar made tequila and more potent. Was quite good, the heavy glass was hard to lift so the straw (which I normally consider gauche), was definitely a necessity. It was also quite good, highly recommended.

The Shrimp Diablo was appropriately spicy, but not as much as I would have liked and could have used a touch of cream, but was otherwise quite nice, the Shrimp were properly cooked, juicy with just the right texture.

I left the Chicken Tacos for last, when I tasted them I understood why the waiter looked at me strangely. The restaurant's green sauce seems to be not a traditional verde sauce but something special made with spicy green peppers, jalapeños I think. They turned out to quite nice, but I could only manage to stuff down one before I realized how full I was! Ate the remaining two for lunch the next day, even microwaved they were quite good.

I left happy, quite full and toasted on the one enormous Margarita. Will definitely be back.


* Herradura is one of the few brands that make ONLY 100% Pure Agave Tequilas, quite important if you drink Tequila or Margaritas or other drink that has tequila, because the taste has the proper bitter twang.

Sat in their private room with its own sound controls.  The waitress was awesome and let us control the playlist in the room.

It was a really happy occasion as we were celebrating a friend's engagement from earlier in the day.  It was a perfect restaurant to end the night with a intimate and quaint dining room with just our party.

we had a pre fixe menu.  the duck confit dish was absolutely splendid with thick slices of duck.  what made the duck amazing was fatty it was.  it was 60% fat, 40% meat =).  The corn succotash was delicious.  It was very lightly flavored and the flavors of the produce really shone through more than anything else.  

i also tried some of the lamb.  i honestly don't know what's in it, but it's lamb crack.  By far the best lamb i've ever had.  it's too bad i couldn't get 2 entrees =(

Blueberry Upside down cake =).  just do it, it's good!

Enjoying this beautiful restaurant in Old City Philadelphia has become a family tradition for our family. There are gluten free options and a wonderful variety of colonial dishes. Yards ales are available as a flight, using traditional founding fathers recipes.

Was never contacted by Parx after giving them my full name and Phone number. They are trying to save face from poor reviews of this dump of a restaurant. Beware! They don't give a sh!t about their patrons or high tier card members.

We had dinner at Russels and had a wonderful time! Our server, Bill, was so engaging and warm and he made for a great experience. He really took care of us and made sure we were happy. The food was also AMAZING. The flatbread is out of this world and a must have for an appetizer! Definitely coming back and can't wait!

Cakes taste AMAZING! However the staff is NEVER friendly. They are downright rude. I've been buying cakes here for 3 years but am looking elsewhere because I'm not giving my nearly $200 for a birthday cake to people who just don't care about providing good customer service.
Found this place through Yelp reviews. Great food and good service. The crab cakes were delicious, seafood stuffed mushrooms were to die for. Highly recommend this place if you are from out of town!

My husband hates how much I love this place because I spend too much money here. Everything about this restaurant is perfect and the food is the best comfort food in Reno. The parmesan garlic fries are perfectly crispy and the bumble Brie makes me feel like I'm a whole person again.

Got a craving for some French tartlets but still feel unsatisfied :(
Tried the lemon citron and the vanilla with blueberry . Both have a weird aftertaste of something .. reminds me of baking powder?  
Still searching for that perfect French pastry ..

Perfect wing , chicken and beer place.  Owners are very friendly and knowledgeable. Great selection of on-tap and bottled beer. Sample the beer until you find one you like. Prices for great beers are extremely competitive compared to Santa Barbara. Atmosphere is open friendly and clean. Food is fresh and delicious. Sauces or dry rub are both very tasty
The best Italian food in the area. I was in today to place my Christmas order and as always, was welcomed like family. Great selection of both cooked foods and grocery items. A must see for all!!
Excellent Persian food. From the people who own the other location. Great lamb, basmati rice with saffron is great. Have the kabob!
Nicks chili parlor hasBest chili in Indianapolis my family has been coming here since it opened in 1974 while the building has been updated, the chili never changes its the best!

I normally love the customer service and the staff here but they've recently gotten multiple orders messed up and it's disappointing to not receive what you paid for and end up finding out you have items missing from your meal.

We have been twice now. It has been great both times. The menu is more original than other local burger and tavern style restaurants. Burgers are money. Nashville hot chicken with biscuit and chorizo gravy was incredible.

The hubby and I love this place! Originally I wanted to check this place out because I had seen it on The Bad Girls Club. The service was great, the food was pretty good and happy hour is the best!! They also constantly send you mobile alerts with all their new events and specials. I wish I lived closer to Santa Barbara so I could come here more often. During my weekend stay in Santa Barbara I did visit this place twice! Love the outdoor setting and the atmosphere and how it is conveniently located on the strip.
Omg!!! Truly amazing. If you're in the mood for a great sandwich you must stop here. Good selection of craft beer also.

First time here... I checked in through yelp to get on the wait list. Once I got to Finney's I was taken to a table right away which was nice! I came with one of my friends and we decided to order the Bavarian pretzel... it was yummy! It is salty and freshly made! It came with pale ale cheese, grain mustard and another dipping sauce that I did not try. For dinner I ordered Peggy's crispy chicken sandwich which came topped with pepper jack cheese, Fresno chili's, tomato, a amazing slaw and a spicy aioli. It was YUMMY! My friend ordered the sausage and garlic flatbread.. she said it was one of the best flatbreads she has ever tasted! Over all this place is great! The atmosphere is inviting and welcoming. They play good music and have the heated lamps out on the patio which is always nice! Attached below is a picture of the Bavarian pretzel.. did not get photo of the other food was to excited to eat lol

My wife,, our 4 year old, and myself had dinner here. It was the first week that they opened. The menu features smaller and regular size plates. My wife ordered a small mussels. The mussels were good, but there was about 10. I ordered a shrimp app, it was $7 for 2 shrimp. We both ordered pasta entrees for our meal. My wife's meatballs were soggy. My rigatoni Bolognese was good. We asked for bread. At first our waitress told us they had none. Then another waiter said that they had some, but there was a charge. The manager came over to our table, and asked how was everything. I told her about our disappointment with the value of the meal, but to pay for bread? She said that they wouldn't charge us for bread.  The manager said to have the waitress find her before we were done.  This never happened, and we were given the check and left.  This experience was a shame, considering this is such a nice restaurant

I was really excited to try this restaurant......everything with bacon is amazing, but sadly my experience was not.  The service was great....friendly and quick.  Sadly that didn't save the day.  Our table was sticky and somewhat dirty.  The bottle of ketchup and maple syrup on the table were in need of cleaning.  My dad loved the corned beef and bacon hash.  It came out piping hot.  The French toast was limp and cold.  Potatoes were overdone and hard as rocks.  The bacon was cold too.  Interesting concept, but not well executed.  The menu was big, but maybe focusing on fewer options would allow for higher quality products.

Not many options for lunch (a burger, fish sandwich and one salad) but the burger was very good. Good service as well and a lot nicer atmosphere than most of the French quarter. Go here if you want a higher end/less frat bro experience.

Let's just say this.... I ate everything on my plate.

I ordered the crab cakes and fried green tomatoes, and really enjoyed it. It comes with two crab cakes, 4 fried green tomatoes and a small spinach and Goat cheese salad.  I really enjoyed everything. 

My server was nice and attentive and we got there pretty early so there was no wait. I'll definitely be back!

Wilko has never provided me with good service. The waiters/waitresses have always been extremely rude. Recently I was there and we waited an hour for our food and when we asked for them to check on it because we wanted to make it to the basketball game they replied, "everyone is trying to go to the game." Also the waiters are not knowledgeable about the menu and when asked questions about the menu they are rude and cannot answer the question. I literally had to ask the chefs. (who were very nice) Don't think I'll be coming back here again. (Daily lemonade is bomb though)
The food was good. We were ignored for a few min after we were seated. Our orders were accurate and delivered in a reasonable period of time.  Lots of beers on tap and outdoor seating.

The meal that I was looking forward to the most on our trip to New Orleans was a seafood crab boil and the Fiery Crab did not disappoint. Literally the best seafood boil I've ever had. Also the first time I really enjoyed crawfish-shoutout to the bartender who showed my sister and I how to eat them properly!

Good food. Very generous portion. Prices are reasonable. Service is top notch. Decor is fun. My kids enjoy looking at them. We eat here at least once a week and they r always on top of their game even though sometimes they r super busy.

Only one, guava & creamof the three donuts I've had here (chocolate & S'mores, other two) was great, in my opinion anyway. Though the s'mores appears yummy I didn't care for it. Didn't have much taste, strangely.

3stars cause these things are DEFINITELY overpriced despite the fact I find one Of them addictive!

Overpriced and underwhelming. I keep giving this place more chances and am disappointed each time (not just this location, multiple). I'm curious as to why and how it became such a large popular chain. Perhaps it was a better restaurant before it became widespread? Anyhow, I've got nothing specific about service or food just "meh" in general.

I love the bolognese and sausage pasta! Service cannot be beat. The waiters and hostesses are very kind and attentive towards all customers. I especially enjoy the piano performance at the upstairs section of the restaurant. In short, Giovanni Ristorante has extremely exquisite food and caring employees. I will definitely venture back to Giovanni in the future!

-
Harrison Mobley

Look.
Read the reviews.
Not much I can add.
This place is perfect.
I want to sleep here.
Food here is excellent. We eat bbq all over . This is one of the best . I would highly recommend this location

Ok so after my cheesecake issue I talked with some of the people that work there. They were very sincere in their apology and genuinely want their customers to be happy. They do have great pizza and wings and their prices are very reasonable. I still need to try their calzones. I'm sure they're wonderful. If you're in donelson and looking for pizza this is the perfect choice

Had a brisket sandwich there last week - sooo good.  Tender doesn't begin to describe it and not too fatty.  I believe the bun is LeBus.  The place is warm and inviting, and servers are friendly and laid back.  I will definitely be back, maybe to check out the live blues on the weekend.

I'm so glad I found out about this place on Yelp. I was looking for a nice breakfast place for Palm Sunday breakfast. When we first checked it out, my son wasn't impressed with the outside of the place, but when I went in and looked around, it smelled great, was clean, and everyone was friendly. We decided to eat there as planned on Sunday. I have to say that it was the most delicious and fresh breakfast we've ever had eating out! My husband, my son and I all loved our meals. They make things from scratch, including their own butter!! While I was waiting to be seated, I asked some other guests what they thought and they said it was their first time but that they would definitely be back. So will we!!

I can't say enough good things about Lori & Victoria at North Bowl - also John and Erin and everyone who helped make my 6 year old's birthday party with 14 5 & 6 year olds a smashing success.

The food was good - plain pizzas from rustica, veggies 'n dip, the famous tots, chicken fingers.

The bowling was great!

And the single shot on Absolut Vanille hit the spot.

Got a party to plan?  I highly recommend you consider North Bowl.
Delicious coffee and a remarkably good vegan banh mi. Very convenient to the Arden--perfect for a quick bite before the show.

Penn Taproom doesn't disappoint with a beautiful patio overlooking a busy and quaint main street of Doylestown.  Service is friendly and prompt, even if your team is playing against the Eagles. Only had drinks here but they were good. They will even make you a tasty mocktail.

Came for the lunch buffet - not great.  Tikka has no depth of flavor, lentils were undercooked, tandoori chicken didn't taste like it came from a tandoor.  Drive the extra 2 miles to go to Woodland, which is quite good even for non-vegetarian diners.

I have been to Bangkok several times and I've never had a bad experience. It's perfect for a date night, intimate family outings, or for a few friends catching up. The ambiance is very relaxing and the always have soothing music playing. 

Typically you're greeted by a server and it doesn't take long to get seated. I've only made a reservation one time and had no problem getting seated right away.  The service is always pleasant and they are very attentive. 

As far as Thai cuisine goes they are on point, but I don't feel that it is truly authentic based on the other Thai restaurants I've been to in the city. My favorite dish there is the drunken noodles. Their curry and rice dishes are really good too. I recommend going there for the lunch buffet. Some of the dishes have chicken, but most have tofu. The buffet will have popular Thai cuisine; pad thai, green curry, and drunken noodles. You won't be disappointed.
Great place for people with Celiac disease. Gluten free pancakes and gluten free toast. Best breakfast I've had in over a year!

Pie Guys is my favorite pizza in the city! So good, so fast, and open late! They have specialty pizzas that are unique and tasty as well as the good ol' classics! You can order whole pizzas or by the slice. Pie Guys is attached to Gezellig which is a craft beer bottleshop and tap house. You can order your pizza and take a number and they will come and find you at Gezellig with your pizza. Everyone working there is so friendly and helpful, always a great time with great pizza! Love Pie Guys!
food was very good and staff was fairly attentive.  my wife would have liked some blueberry in her blueberry mojito.  but really that's our only gripe

We needed a quick fill of Chinese food, and china wok was nearby. I ordered through the yelp app and  picked up within 15minutes. 

The food was fresh and hot, we were overly satisfied with everything!

Great job!

Pastrami bagel tastes like absolute trash. It is truly inedible. The everything bagel is completely uninspired and doesn't even have salt, garlic, onion, or any flavor aside from sesame and poppy. Fresh squeeze orange juice tastes like from concentrate minute made. We spent nearly $30 on 2 bagels and an orange juice that is pure garbage. Absolutely despicable and they should be ashamed of themselves.

In reference to the dessert room only, haven't eaten in the restaurant.  The desserts are amazing, and worth the price.  Missing a star because of the service.  I would say about 40% of the time, it is not up to par.  I shouldn't have to flag down another server to refill my water or coffee.  With prices up to $15 for a dessert, the service should be spot on.  Please work on attentiveness.
Great beignets, wonderful breakfast and live jazz music while we ate... Open air café. So fun

The Machaca was great and the lady behind the counter was so helpful and friendly. I'm low-carbing now, and she fixed me up and even charged me less because I didn't need the tortillas. Great little place!

I have never written a yelp review until now but I had to do it. ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTING ESTABLISHMENT! I was in last night with a friend. The two young men behind the counter look absolutely miserable to be there but it gets so much worse. They ask what I want. I say burrito. They grab the burrito lay it down, scoop their hand into the rice and put it one the burrito and pat it down with their hands. Scoop into the beans, once again hands (they have plastic gloves on but this is still clearly unacceptable) I get pork, my friend chicken, all the meanwhile using no utensils. Straight hands all the way down the bar, even the vegetables. Same gloves!!!!!! 
I actually paid for my order, walked out and threw the burrito out. Why I didn't say anything or even paid for it, I have no idea. I think I was more so in shock and couldn't get a word out. 

Long story short: DISGUSTING. NEVER EATING AGAIN. These kids better not have jobs once someone sees this because this is so unacceptable. Does this place have training? Do they monitor their employees? Clearly not.

I've been to Morimoto 19 times, 18 of which I had the highest price point omakase. I was almost always impressed with the quality of food, the presentation, and service at Morimoto. I enjoy the see-and-be-seen atmosphere of Morimoto and sipping exotic drinks while dining on good food, but... there are times when I feel I'd rather sit down and actually enjoy the food and put atmosphere and drinking aside. Ro-Zu is this type of place. It is absolutely unpretentious. Chef Todd Dae Kulper is cool beans and he seems to really care about making me a good meal on the two times I was there. If you sit at the bar, you can talk to him and give him feedback on what you like and don't like and he can tailor a meal completely to your liking. The first time at Ro-Zu I had Todd's premium sushi platter there, which I thought was very good, but pricey. I especially liked the squid tentacle and sea urchin sushi. The second time I had the $50 omakase and it was every bit as good as the $120 or even $150 omakase at Morimoto. My omakase dishes were: 

1 o toro with mussels
2 red snapper ceviche with orange garnish
3 sliced yellowtail seared in hot oil with serrano
4 seared tuna
5 calamari in sea urchin soup
6 sushi course with three white fish, boston mackerel, tuna, salmon, fresh eel, sea urchin
7 fish tail soup

The last course might sound unusual to many of you, but I will tell you that the meat off of this fish tail was some of the most tender, meaty, juicy fish meat I have ever had the pleasure of eating and I have had plenty of fish in my lifetime. Morimoto advocates will cry out that there's no dessert course in Ro-Zu's omakase. That didn't matter to me, because I rarely liked my desserts at Morimoto. To me, it was all about the small plates of food and sushi, not the Americanized desserts.

Chef Todd mentioned that his vision of owning a restaurant involved serving only the very freshest ingredients. To give you an idea of how fresh everything is, he gave my companion and I a demonstration of skinning a fresh eel, which was both fascinating and grotesque at the same time. "Can you eat it raw?" I asked. "No, I wouldn't recommend it," he said, "because of the toxins in it, but once we cook it, it'll be fine." Absolutely true, because the fresh eel sushi I had was perhaps the best piece of eel sushi I have ever eaten. Once you try it, you will never go back to the crap most sushi places pass off as eel sushi.
Cunetto salad is the best....service is good.....booze drinks are some of the strongest and best made in the city...food is classic....

Slow, slow, slow. Even at 10 am when place was mostly empty. Horrible customer service. Tampa native here, and have never understood how they cant fix service after decades of experience. Food is fine but by no means worth an hour wait.

Started off well, but didn't end so great. Morgan, our waitress kept disappearing. Not a lot of check-ins with us, so ok, not too big of a deal. We ordered drinks and dinner, with the understanding our drinks were 2-4-1. Nothing out of this world, the drinks tasted like watermelon sprite mind you. Yet when the bill came we were surprised at the amount. Clearly a miscommunication on what were the drink specials. This could easily have been not a big deal, but it was her lack of concern over the miscommunication and how she treated the situation. Don't apologize if you aren't going to at least sound like you mean it. Nor, offer a manager that you don't want to have to get. We were clearly unhappy and it could have been fixed if the concern would have been there.

I love the Italian beef! Get the peppers and ask for it to be dipped. I also like a good ole burger too. Of course I always get onion rings. The restaurant smells so good when you walk in! However, I've always found the dining areas to be a bit dirty. I would suggest they have workers assigned to keeping the dining room and restrooms clean.

Heard good things, so we decided to stop in for happy hour. I ordered a dozen oysters, and they were huge. I'm used to myrtle beach sized oysters, where I could easily polish off 4 or more dozen, but I could barely eat my 12. My date got chicken nachos, which were so big they didn't get finished. Talked to the owner, b.s'd with employees. Had a great time with a few stiff drinks, at a very reasonable price. A+

Had the brisket and pulled pork sandwiches, which was absolutely awesome. Employee's were very friendly and helpful. Thanks "J"
for the great dining experience. Will definitely return for more BBQ.

Sadly I could not buy coffee here because they only accept cash despite having an iPad as the primary cashier interface. I've helpfully pasted some solutions to this below and hope the owners decide to join the 21st century. When I asked why they only took cash, one person glibly replied "so you know how much you can spend" which implies to me that the management is incapable of managing their own money electronically, therefore requiring their customers to pay cash to compensate. 

Best of luck guys. 

https://squareup.com/
https://www.paypal.com/webapps/mpp/credit-card-reader
http://www.payanywhere.com/

It was a Tuesday night and the place was busier than they expected to be as they did not have enough coverage. Let's start with the bad and that was with the service, mainly our server Alexa. It was supposed to be a night of celebration and we had a server with no personality or enthusiasm for her job let alone her customers. Dinner was practically served and I had to ask if we could have bread when other tables got theirs with their drinks. Throughout the entire evening it was a passing question of how everything was, never a pause at the table and wait for a response. Then to absolutely end the evening on a sour note, she delivers our free dessert with the check while I'm in the restroom not even asking if I wanted coffee. Oh yeah about the check, they conveniently added a large beer that we never ordered. So frustrating, for the price you pay for everything you can't even get decent service. For the good, the food was very good, my sirloin was cooked to perfection the stuffed mushrooms were very tasty and they gave you a nice salad. Overall rating just below 3 stars, being generous with a 3 star rating.

Love this place!! We always get the lemon and pina colada flavor and they are very yummy. The ranch they serve with french fries is somehow differently tasty and we love it.

Employees are friendly and we would love to keep going.
Love this place .. the food is real .. the service is awesome and can't wait to take all my friends
Ok flavor, some are tasteless, some are good, the texture of shrimp dumpling skin is way to soft and thick. We didn't get durian pastry today, maybe will come back for that again

Went last night for happy hour...  drinks were good. Until I picked up my menu and a giant roach ran across the bar top in front of me and went under the fruit bowl. I literally thought I was seeing something until I looked up and it went running out from under the bowl and the bartender then grabbed it with a napkin. This then ruined my appetite and I decided I would not be coming back. I would not suggest eating here. Especially if there are bugs on the bar top. Imagine what the kitchen is like. It was pretty disheartening I had to pay my full bill after this.

So, the wife, our 12 yr old and I travelled to Boise from San Diego and had a great dinner somewhere else, we stopped by Barbacoa to have a couple of drinks before calling it a night. The place is super cool, hype and was crowded. The menu sounds amazing and will partake in that the next time. The HIGHLIGHT of our experience was the cocktail server Tam. She turned simple drinks in a hip place into a deeper personal experience. She was not only a fantastic and attentive server, but a super sweet woman we got to know in our hour long stay. She is amazing and we all talked about her on our ride back to our hotel. IF you make it in to Barbacoa, ask to sit in Tam's section! She's the best

This McDonald's is McAwful. All three times I've been through the drive through, I received Coke instead of my beloved Dr. Pepper. One of the times, the worker at the window was texting . I waited for him to finish sending his message so he could take my card. He called his girlfriend a bitch and took my card. The buns on my burger were firmer than the terminator's ass cheeks. They went sicko mode on the onions, lemme tell you. I tried to kiss my grandmother later that day and she's been unresponsive ever since. Fries were soggy, and they forgot my straw. People call McDonald's comfort food. At least I can take comfort in knowing that I will someday be dead.

Love this place, everything I've tried has been excellent but my favorite and go to order is the white fish salad on everything bagel. The owners are very welcoming and friendly, they encourage you to try samples of the salads & cream cheeses. This is one of my favorite spots in the neighborhood.

We picked this place for my wife's bday party for a group of 16.  They had no problem accommodating that many people in their restaurant.  The staff was very attentive and did a great job with our party.  The food was really good!  I am excited that we found a place that serves plantains and yucca root.  I would recommend this place to my friends and to anyone wanting to try something a little different.

Love Chill We Always visit when in St. Pete. Great Food, breakfast  or brunch and dinner  Our waiter, Gilbert has become our good friend. Awesome service, knowledgeable with Everything and friendly. Recommend to many others.
Oh my, oh my.  I have never been to a restaurant that the toilets were so dirty.  I'm not sure but this is probably the one and only time that I will come here.

The worst bar food in Indy. Bar none. Wings are trash. Salad was drinsed in dressing. The chefs are obviously drinking or making food because they don't have anyone else to do it. Other than that it's not a bad place but eat before you come.

This was a nice surprise.
F and I were hankering for Asian food, but our first choice was not at all what we had in mind. So what now... Yelpers to the rescue!
What was close? We were damp and starving, and what was open? Golden Triangle 4.5 stars and basically a block away.
Don't let first glance fool you. This is not a run of the mill Chinese place. The food is Malaysian, Thai and Burmese.
As we walked in we saw every table was taken but one...Yay! And the smell of some yummies...
This is nothing fancy but the service and the prices are great. 
The food was wonderful. Appetizers of steamed dumplings with ginger vinegar dipping sauce, and Roti Canai with magical dipping sauce were a great start.
F had pineapple chicken fried rice and I had Rendang (I think I messed up the spelling).
Both were bursting with flavor and exactly what we wanted.
I want to go back right now!

Long wait times, unorganized staff, and shitty rap music ruins the ambiance here. Tasty sandwhiches and the free carmel apple pops kept us coming back, but now that every add on costs 2$ more (including gluten free bread now!!!) To their already pricey sandwhiches. This will be our last time coming to this location. Once an iconic bay area, gluten freend vegan friendly sandwhich shop, is again ruined by corporate greed. Shame on you Ikes
Great place to have a BAM ( big ass margarita ) and dinner.  The hogfish is a delight!  And Anthony was busy as anything on a Friday night and still took care of us.
This place sucks!!! They plays no music! she gave me only two options NASCAR and Soccer!  I'm not here for either soccer or NASCAR!!!!

Dat Dog offers a bunch of meaty hot dogs, but I go right for the veggie.  These suckers are so good, but the other big draw regardless of your meat choice is the super fresh and soft Poboy bun.  Simple but particularly important, and these guys get the roll right.  Fun, kitschy vibe, outdoor patio is nice and spacious, no frill picnic table action, great for people watching on Magazine(at the Magazine location).

I've been back a number of time since I originally reviewed 55 South. They do the gastro-pub thing well. After this latest visit I'm a little disenchanted. Not enough to remove a star but if I had another sub par, gastro-pub food experience I would notch it down. During my visits I've sampled their shrimp and grits, oyster po-boy, oysters, and "tater tots". 

The shrimp and grits was my mother's idea when she was in town. I wish I would have been as inspired. I don't like really like grits and yet I kept stealing "tastes" from her plate. She probably would have let me have her dish if it weren't so freaking good. So what was I letting get cold while I stole her meal? I had ordered the oyster po-boy. It wasn't amazing and actually paled in comparison to my mother's flavor feast. I found the sandwich just bit bland. 

Recently, I stopped here for snacks with my boyfriend. We tried the oysters and the "tater tots". The oysters were pretty good, not great and definitely not the best I've had in Nashville. If I were in the area, felt like oysters, and it was happy hour pricing, I would probably order them again. The tater tots are really risotto balls shaped into tots and served with a horseradish sauce that didn't taste like horseradish. I honestly found them to be a bit heavy and greasy. I mean they are fried, what did I expect? My boyfriend ordered them. I'm just giving my opinions.

Milo is a much needed casual vegan eatery in East Falls. We were able to visit on Friday night, day two of operation, and had a wonderful experience. Their simplistic approach to their cafe's design and menu works to their advantage. Nicely priced items make frequenting this new establishment realistic. All day service including coffee and baked goods make it easy to visit at any time of day.

We had the Savannah vegan burger and the Pad Thai for dinner. Both were outstanding and we quickly forgot we were at a vegan restaurant. A variety of dishes such as salads, tacos, and grilled cheese sandwiches were delivered to nearby tables. Everyone agreed the food exceeded expectations. We returned the following day for the grilled cheese for lunch. They also have a smoothie and coffee bar. The smoothies looked really good.

BYOB is also an attractive point for this restaurant. The service was friendly, welcoming, and educational. We highly recommend Milo to anyone looking for an excellent meal and memorable experience.

This place is by far the BEST Chinese in Pinellas County. Always fresh and delicious. Try the "I don't know chicken". Mmmmm. And please don't tease me with good reviews for Big Bok Choy. That's gotta be the worst Chinese on the planet.

Great food for cheap great pre game for downtown or another party center 
Giant drinks for dirt cheap. And on mondays hospitality workers get 50% off there bill includes alcohol as well. Me and my GF got 8 margaritas 24ozTOTAL a few tacos and burritos and are bill was $50

What a fun spot! My colleague was more familiar with Tampa than I, and she took me here for Flamenco and dinner. It was such fun and WOW, PACKED, for a weeknight. 

Food was fantastic, as well as the famous mojito.

We had lunch here today and sat on the patio. They have 3 tables outside with umbrellas which today was a perfect day for that. We obviously had the burgers. We got a classic and then 2 of the 3oz burgers. We asked for well done burgers and they still had quite a lot of pink but we ate them anyway. One thing we took advantage of was that they allow you to split your sides and get two 50/50 sides. So the options were fries, onion rings, mozzarella sticks and sweet potato fries. We got all of them but sweet potato fries and had I thought about it we would have tried them too. The fries are thick and odd shaped but tasted fine. The mozzarella sticks were good. However we did not like the onion rings at all. It was more like a funnel cake sweet batter which we didn't like at all. I always get ranch or honey mustard to dip my fries so today I got ranch and it wasn't that good. Seemed like store bought Kraft brand or something. I definitely prefer homemade over store bought sauces. The staff was friendly and you order at rhe the counter and then they bring your food to you when it's ready. They are in an odd location and unless you were using GPS and knew you were going there you might miss it because it's not easily seen from the road. I'd give this place 3.5 stars if it were an option. Their website want very impressive and wasn't helpful at all. I couldn't even see the menu prior to arrival. I am going to attach pics of the menu now so everyone will be able to see what they offer.

I went for the first time tonight. The burger I received was burnt like a hockey puck. The next one was a soggy mess. I didn't even ask them to do it again. I was very unhappy with my experience there. I will not be going back. Really mad that I paid for that meal.
I did not like this place. Very expensive and soo much cilantro..guess my experience was nothing like Southern California.

This restaurants brunch certificate was part of a travel package that i received from my travel organizer when i attended the 24th annual Essence Music Festival.

The ambiance is very quaint and old world.
The food was tasty
The service/servers were prompt polite and courteous.

I had only one small negative.. i made reservations before i left home requesting a seat in the area overlooking the courtyard, as that was where the Jazz Band spent most of their time. Upon arrival i was told that they had no record of my request. Needless to say that annoyed me but they were accommodating and quickly seated us in the large dining hall at the front of the restaurant.

Overall my food experience was good especially given the fact that it was a brunch buffet but overall the dining experience was enjoyable. 

One word of advice ... the bottle of champagne for $32. is a bit pricey for a low level brand and the carafe of orange juice was extra.... 

I suggest you try the turtle soup! it was very tasty.
One of the friendlies locations from the staff and the food was excellent as well.  Great job and I say kudos to the team.

Love it here!! Great tacos and marinated meats. It gets really busy during lunch hour so it's good to call ahead. I like the poc chuc meat the best. It comes with good salsa and lettuce. Tacos are on the smaller side. But would definitely recommend!
The keto fajita was amazing. The cauliflower rice tasted so good. I didn't think keto food tasted so good. The place was empty and so clean. You can eat inside or out and everyone wears a mask.

My girlfriend had gone to Cafe Masala once before for their lunch buffet, but this was my first time.  Overall, we definitely rate it 5 stars due to the great, tasty food and the pleasant staff.  We had chicken masala and aloo bengun which were both very flavorful!  We also had the garlic naan which was very tasty.  This is a great place for this location as Indian is very hard to come by outside Clay Oven.  My girlfriend and I both highly recommend Cafe Masala and will be back again soon!

I honestly think the only reason why this place is in business is because Indy doesn't have very many soul food restaurants. The food is not great, it's soggy usually too salty or not salty enough and the portions are not worth the price.

This is my absolute favorite Taiwanese restaurant in Reno.The food is always fantastic and no matter what I order I am always delighted with my meal! Servers are also great and always efficient, happy and polite. Can't wait to return and wouldn't hesitate to recommend to anyone looking for somewhere to eat Taiwanese food in Reno. Highly recommend popcorn chicken. Boba is a plus.
Terrible!! Bad service, extremely slow. Poor quality food. Looked like it had been prepared, then reheated again. It took forever for our food & drinks !

The Patio is wonderful! I've only ever ordered delivery, and it's always prompt. The Greek salad with chicken, gyros, Greek pizza with extra Tzaziki, chicken quesadilla, chicken fingers, and cheese fries are our top menu items. They've never missed a written request when ordering thru Grubhub or DoorDash. The delivery drivers have all been very kind! Definitely a restaurant to add to your delivery repertoire!!

Fantastic!! We sat at the bar and instantly the owner (same owner of the original Hiroba) began making us his special roll, one after the next. We didn't need to look at a menu and everything was incredible. I HIGHLY recommend doing this. Each chef has their own creative rolls which makes the whole experience that much more fun.
This place is amazing! It would be easy to miss I the shopping center, but don't. We got the pupusa platter and it was excellent. The staff and owner were so nice and welcoming.

The food is amazing.   Lisa has a tough New York style attitude but the energy and creativity definitely goes into the food.  Everyone rave about their meal and our group of 10 was out of there within 75 minutes for Easter brunch

Excellent atmosphere. Excellent choice of microbrews. Would drink here again!

Highly recommend the Hook Up Shandler and the Goldie Hopsm

nice find here.  new breakfast spot with lots of benedicts on the menu, but as I recall?  I had croque madam.  this was a nice change of pace and scrumptious.   I don't recall it being quite croque french bread sandwich style, but more served with the spinach underneath in a plate.

I just know it was a find, and its been a while but NOW I must return.
great place to take people who are visiting you for something new and fun.
excellent waitstaff.
food was ehh. waitress were nasty, blondie had an awful attitude. I found DN in my side of sauce. #dissapointed
I dined here on Monday 13 November. I had the seafood Pho and everything was imitation. The broth had a pretty good flavor. I would try them again but not the seafood.
This bus is addicting! Open late into the morning...way exceeds any fast food run you've ever been on! Order online for your convenience... Authentic tacos like no other!

The burnt sugar latte with an extra shot of espresso is one of my top two favorite lattes in all of Nashville. Seriously. Please try it. 

This place is has a great breakfast/brunch menu. Chicken & waffles are my go to, and the hot honey is a must. 

If you're just in the mood for sweets, they always have a marvelous looking selection of baked goods. And their gelato is a-m-a-z-i-n-g! Summer Strawberry is the best in my opinion.   

This place was one of my favorite reasons to visit Chattanooga. I'm so happy Milk & Honey found a home in Nashville!

Check your preconceived ideas at the door. The food is great! I had the halibut chunks and they were fantastic. Perfectly lightly breaded with a ton of flavor. Plus you get two sides! I had a salad and onion rings. In all my years in Boise I have never thought about eating here and that idea has now changed. Great older "classy dive" atmosphere and good food. Come check this place out!

Complete and Utter FAILURE!

I was invited by an old friend to choose a place to eat. I love Thai food, required a place with wheelchair access, and wanted something relatively close to my home.  Unfortunately, unforgettably, and quite sadly I found Thai Paradise on Yelp it fit all those criteria.  However it missed arguably the most important measurement of a restaurant, the quality of the food.

Up until now I had found yelp to be quite accurate in its ratings. Either the regular cooks were not present, they were just having an off day, or somehow  a large number of reviewers missed the mark.

Because of transportation problems my friend got take-out.  He ordered Pad Thai(chicken), Red Curry (Beef), Druken noodles (chicken), and THom Yum.  My first impression was olfactory and unpleasant.  There was a stale pungent fishy smell which permeated through the paper bags and polystyrene containers. This was particularly odd as we had not ordered any sea food.  Which lead me to believe they must have made a mistake in the order even before I unloaded it.  However, when I opened the containers I became convinced of it. The Pad Thai was a just a pile of smelly noodles.  Initially, I couldn't find the chicken nor any of the other standard ingredients.  Until I unpiled the noodles and discovered large peaces of chicken. (They had a horrible flavor).    Photo will be included.

I was later convinced by my companion that the was indeed ours and that its lack of resemblence to what we previously knew of these dishes was due merely to the equally unauthentic (non-asian) staff working in the kitchen.  I then assured him that this does not necessarily mean the food will be bad but a lack of people of the ethic background supposedly represented by the restaurant eating the food is a good indication, if of nothing else, its lack of authenticity.  

As we started to eat the food I swore to my friend that had we ate in the restaurant it would have been an impossibility for us to eat more than a few bites and that we would have been forced to leave after complaining to the management of the nearly inedible nature of what they were selling as food.  I added that had I been pressed I would have preferred to be escorted to the precinct than pay a red cent, or rather allow him to pay, for that meal. I  further realized the great blessing it had been for us all that we had not dined-in as I certainly would have made a scene had management been anything but apologetic and completely acquiescent in my refusal to pay.

In the end, this was a lesson in doing one's due diligence.  I should have looked a bit deeper into the reviews and information about this restaurant.  I figure because of its location this venue is probably most often frequented by hungry lunch time clients, and half-drunk people whose taste buds have been sterilized by their alcohol consumption.

Or then again maybe its one of those excusable instances which I mentioned at the beginning of this review.....but I DOUBT IT.  As far as I am concerned that was the first and last time at Thai Paradise now Better Known As "Thai Pi$&."

Exacerbating experience, definatley not coming back.  After wasting an evening here my review will be short and concise.  

Without explanation our original server was replaced with someone new.

New server failed to ask about the meal or if everything was cooked properly, offer a second drink to replace the obvious empty glass (before desert had even arrived) and then disappered.  She was so absent we had to ask the hostess about her then watched her literally chase our server down.

Food was subpar overall, the bread offered was not appetizing, cold and just bland.  The meatballs were very dry and warm at best.  My entree was very good, the salmon was cooked perfectly but not at all exceptional.  Finally the Tiramasu was not worth more than a few bites, kind of dry (not as bad as the meatballs) and just medocre in general.  

After being stuck here 30 minutes too long the parking garage machine ate our validation ticket, we had to back up and talk to a manager.  The manger was lovely and very helpful.

My experience was so bad I could easily say more but I am more than done wasting my time on this place.

Good pancakes and they should be after 50 years or so of business!  Used to also be a place to see the occasional celebrity chowing down on some awesome sweet potato pancakes, but I doubt they wait in the line these days.  They're famous for a reason - their pancakes really are good, and they have a nice vibe inside, friendly service, and the prices are fair.  If you don't mind standing in line for a while, come see why they've been around so long.

OK I know it's just  a 3 star for me at Jalopy's.  It's too unfair to give more or less because we only had the pizza and an appetizer.  I read a review a few weeks ago in the Tucson Weekly and it was quite good.  So needless to say, off we go to check out this newer domain.  I like to support non chain businesses because it is the right thing to do in my books.  It's tucked away and not too easy to find in the back end of a popular shopping plaza where Home Depot is. Oracle and Limberlost area. It's  closer to the back end of Walgreens.  Some of the other Yelpers have said it was pretty empty the times they were there.  We were there Sat. early evening and it held true.  Pretty quiet.  We had this darling wait staff young  lady Jenny serve us and we were her first customers ever.  She was delightful.  There were some great choices on the menu such as different varieties of burgers, ruebens, brisket sandwiches, all with some interesting add ons.  The pizza was highly touted so we decided to try their hand tossed crust with onions and sausage.  It lived up to its recommendation.  For a non Italian restaurant it was excellent.  The reason we just simply ordered the pizza was a bit of because of  being overheated from the 106 degree temp. outside.  Even took home 2 slices.  We will go back and try some of the other menu items.  The atmosphere was funky with tee shirts, racing car outfits, momentous hanging all over the place.  Of course, there was a 49's chevy parked outside.  Obviously the owners are into old cars.

This restaurant has a really great ambience and location, but I was a little disappointed with the food. We came for the Sunday dinner buffet, and there weren't very many options. The jasmine rice was cooked to absolute perfection - fragrant and fluffy, just like it should be - but the lentil curry was dry and not flavorful.

This is a pretty nice spot to chillaxe, take in some live music, or watch a sporting event. When I was there apps are half off if it rains.. it didn't  :P

You can rent kayaks next door. There's also a park very nearby.. A bar with pool tables is across the way and this is in the same stretch with Hooters, the casino boat, and a couple of other barsy restaurant places.

The food was solid Americana. Beer prices were.. decent not great. Sweet tea was good. :) Service was pretty good. I like the high throne chairs. :)

Almost got to a 5 for this coffee house because it was so dang good. Fairmount Ave is busy and right next to the eastern state jail (museum now). Lots of students as Philly is a college town, especially northern Philly. This place is not just a coffee shop though, baked goods, brunch, bagels, lunch galore. Had a great breakfast sandwich and price was reasonable for the taste and atmosphere. 

Some folks just studying and some were dining/chatting. We got lucky and got a table but I wouldn't want to guarantee most will be as lucky. Lots of takeout food and beverage too. Good Philly cafe but crowded.

A welcome new addition to the neighborhood. They have a convenient location and the food is delish! Pizza take out beats all the others by a long shot. They are quickly becoming our go-to last minute dinner spot.

This place is cool! I enjoyed the vibe. The parking was easy. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because some of the staff weren't very friendly. They all seemed like they didn't want to be there. Also it can attract a strange crowd, so go with people you know.

The grouper was great. Needed more flavor, i had to add lots of lemon and salt/pepper so it could have some. The okra and oysters came fried and they were okay. if your just starting out in seafood i guess you might enjoy it but honestly i don't think i will be coming back for "seafood". felt more like fair food than seafood. It did not excite my tastebuds. 

however the staff were super friendly and the place was very clean and modern. so my review is fully based off the food.

Had never tried Greek food before my wife came home talking about this amazing food.  Long story short, she convinced me to try the grilled chicken plate...it was everything (and more) she was boasting! Delicious grilled chicken breast, tasty saffron rice, the most AMAZING and fresh tabouli, 
with choice of sauces...mmmmmm. I like to mix everything and scoop it up with the nice warm pitas that come with the meal.
   The staff is usually very friendly and act like you are a good friend.
   Reasons I didn't give it 5 stars: I prefer sit-down service with non-disposable utensils, plates, and cups. But for fast food, it raises the bar.

Best international market I have been to. 

They have everything, just know, that they have everything. 

Great prices on produce that would be super expensive at a typical market. 
Noodles, noodles, noodles, of every variety.

A bakery on site where you pick up the bread and it is still steaming hot. 

A Mexican eatery inside, every cooking utensil and vessel you will ever require, crazy amounts of fresh seafood, candy, EVERYTHING! 

Make sure you leave plenty of time to browse, you won't regret it. 

Don't get a bad attitude because the place doesn't look like Kroger, it's representative of what most markets look like all over the world, especially the developing world....so just immerse yourself and enjoy.

This spot is gross. This is not good Mexican food. Que pena me da! I got bistec tacos ( false advertisement). Don't know what beef that was but not bistec. 

The bistec is not bistec- it is thick beef meat that is bland and over cooked. It was also too thick to be called bistec and seriously dry as paper. The bistec i know is thin and juicy. 

I waited almost an hour to be disappointed. No flavor whatsoever. The salsa was ok and was so the horchata. Ok one star. 

True Mexican food lovers stay away. Santa Bárbara has better options.
Best Thai food in New Tampa. Food & service are consistently good. Facility is clean. Prices are moderate.

Zero stars really. Manager/owner yelled at my grandfather when we asked him to honor our reservation before a show at the Palladium. Yes, he really yelled at an 80 year old man. Yes, we really had a reservation. AVOID!

I ordered the lobster tacos and they were very good. My kids got the coconut shrimp and they loved them. I also ordered a spicy bloodymary and yes it is spicy and so good for that hangover. This place has little sitting area. It took about a good 45 minutes for us to be seated, if you want to sit outside it may take longer. Unfortunately with hungry kids that wasn't an option for us. Our server was very nice and offered great service. Will definitely be back.
This is a great restaurant. Wonderful food great service. We always enjoy coming here and recommend it to anyone who likes a relaxing enjoyable dinner.
Best wings hands down!  Many wing places have tried to create the perfect spicy garlic wings and only R&R Extreme Wings have mastered that flavor!   I definitely will be back for more :)
Delicious sours. And multiple sample sizes. Tons of stuff on tap, parking was abit rough. But great place to grab a sour beer or cider.

OMG, where do I start? I love this restaurant so much and I've never had a bad meal or poor service. Highly recommend the artichoke appetizer (flash fried)  one of my favorites, the black spaghetti if you like seafood and the sausage and fennel pizza.
Great food and margaritas. We really enjoy the fried tacos as well as the fajitas. The staff is very friendly and there is a good atmosphere.

This location usually provides great service. Which is probably why I didn't check my order before driving away from the drive through.  My fault - won't do that again as I didn't have everything I ordered.  Food was fine but hard to swallow paying for something I didn't get.
Favorite place in East Nasty. Delicious burgers. Inside has a lot of character, outside patio is adorable.

We've been eyeing up Route 6 since it opened, as its close to my residence.  We finally made it in on Labor Day and were surprised to see patrons belly up, bar full, on a rainy, holiday weekend at 5PM.  This was an immediate good sign and we were pleased to sit in front of the open air kitchen, to watch the chefs and the kitchen team prepare our food.

We ordered a combo from the chilled/raw bar.  It was delicious, had a nice presentation, but it was expensive.  The clam chowder and our entrees were equally good.  

The interior design was kind of shore-ish, I don't know how else to describe it.  White walls were offset with unfinished, aged, grayish colored wood planks.  The devices in the kitchen, including a wood fired stove and a wood fired grill, adjustable heat lamps above a wooden-topped island, made me want to don my pair of Dansko Clogs, jump over the divider and get to cookin!

Our service was just ok.  We had to iterate our orders to our server, who forgot our simple requests.  He may have been stretched too thin.  The maitre'd did notice this and did take one of our drink orders when he noticed our glasses were empty-which frankly, they never should be.  Two dirty martinis came out non-dirty.

The simplet mistakes with our service, combined with the price tag of roughly $200/me and my gf, only allow me to provide it a two star rating.  I'll go back, but not anytime soon.

This is a great date night or girls night out restaurant to check out if you're on the North side of town. The ambiance gives off a lounge/ upscale feel and the staff is courteous and polite. The food is delicious and reasonably priced. The servers are knowledgeable and the wine options are endless. The portion sizes of the food aligns with the prices. The mashed potatoes taste as if your grandma is working in the kitchen and the southwest egg roll appetizers are so good they will make you slap your mother, lol.

Don't let the outside or inside decor of this restaurant fool you. The food is absolutely positively LEGIT & DELISH! Today we had the asparagus soup along with the shrimp panang curry, the tutti fruit duck and the coconut ice cream with mango sauce. Everything was BOMB! We didn't take pics of the soup because we were that excited to eat it but we did take pics of everything else.

Coaches is what I'd consider your standard sports bar, minus the TVs. They do have pool tables, dart boards (the dart boards are in a god awful spot though), a few arcade games and a shuffleboard table, so there are activities other than gambling, which is nice. 

Staff is friendly, depending on who is working, but the service can be super slow if you're not a regular. Biggest issue with the staff is they have no idea at all how to make basic drinks outside of 2 ingredient cocktails like a run and coke. Asked for a whiskey sour and got something that was red. Bartender said it was her own version, which isn't what I ordered. I had to explain how to make the drink in order to get a (still very poorly made) whiskey sour.

Food is pretty good, I've never really had anything bad there, but nothing I've had is memorable either. Really no complaints come to mind.

Bar still allows smoking, and the ventilation system is laughable, so if you're a non-smoker, the haze and smell may be a deterrent. It's too bad when 2 or 3 people can hurt the experience for the other 20 there because they way to chain smoke. 

Pros: 
Location
Food
Activities 

Cons: 
Smoke 
Can't make drinks
Wait times

I made a reservation for my girlfriend and I at this cake bake shop location in advance for 12 p.m. We were seated almost right away. The staff are so cute, friendly and attentive. I ordered a creme brûlée latte, the Turkey and gruylere sandwich, and key lime pie for dessert. The presentation is so beautiful, the food and drinks were all delicious. I walked away full with a smile on my face. The only complaint would be price however I walked in knowing it was going to be an expense and a once in a while treat. I would love to come again or even check out the Carmel location.

I've never had Indonesian food before a few months ago, but I'm so happy that part of my life is over. I've been to Sky Cafe 2x in the past 2.5 months and it's amazing. The food is delicious and comes out quickly. The prices are crazy low for the entrees. I tried several new items tonight, including one or two that were just added to the menu and they were incredible. I can't wait to go back and try something new next time.

Really delicious pizza. Thin crust New York style. We had the florentine which was so good - anything with ricotta, garlic, and spinach has my vote. The supreme was also amazing - had like 8 different types of meat on it and veggies.  It'll definitely be our new go to place for delivery. So much better than a chain.

I honestly can't recommend this place enough. The food was so delicious and authentic; Mexican food that tasted unlike I've had in a long time (and I grew up next to some really good Mexican food in San Diego). The three women who were working there made us feel like we were friends being invited into their home. The potato sopita was incredible, so good that my friend got a second order of it after finishing his first one. Everything at Baja is made fresh in the restaurant and on such a hot day, their homemade ice cold melon water really hit the spot! 
I would say this place is definitely worth the trip! I would give it 6 stars if I could!

I dont know how  anyone may not like that place, their happy hr is THE BEST around here, on weds, bang bang shrimp for $5, cant beat that. Quiet, place, with moderate prices, great seafood and meats. The atmosphere is nice and cozy the music is not too loud. Very good servers. The only part i dont like is a paper tops on the table cloths. But I m still there every few weeks !

Another great Ugly Sweater Pub Crawl! We had so much fun last year we decided to do it again. This year they had twice as many stops and they were all different. We did not get to all the stops but the ones we did were great.

They do pub crawls frequently and they also do trips to brewers in Pinellas County. I would check them out because these crawls are a lot of fun. Everyone participating was friendly and in good spirit too.

Love it !
Great food and atmosphere. I had the creole shrimp and cheese grits and my husband had the boneless fried chicken and waffles. The shrimp was fresh and fabulous not bait like in some restaurants. We will definitely be back !
We found out about this place because my husband attended two promotion parties there and they did a great job with those too .
This is a great find. It's a small simply run spot in a residential setting. The food was delicious and a welcome change. The staff was gracious and welcoming. We will be back.

Food was average and catfish was very "fishy" tasting. Nowhere as good as the catfish we have had all week in town. Service was incredibly slow. Workers at the hostess stand were more worried about talking to each other rather than acknowledging guests. Took 15 minutes to place our drink & food order. Then took another 15 minutes for our drinks to arrive. Almost the same time as our food.  Server never gave us silverware or napkins. When I asked for napkins she brought bars napkins. I'd tell anyone thinking of going here to consider it twice and go somewhere else. There are way too many great places to eat in New Orleans to bother with this place.

Checked out this place while visiting parents. Coming from Los Angeles I had a high expectation for Chinese food and this place didn't disappoint. Awesome authentic Chinese food and cheap pricing. Got the house combo and house fried rice. House special had plenty of seafood (shrimp scallop) and house fried rice had a kick but not too spicy. Service is good and food came out quickly. I think the restaurant opened not too long ago cause everything looks brand new. Definitely will have to come back and check out some of the other dishes next time I'm in town.

I have been there several times, and I am overwhelmed how good the service is as well as the food every single time!

The prime rib. It was juicy, Medium rare, and seasoned exceptionally perfect! 

The service has always been terrific. Even getting a sit at the bar, Iavarone's filled the bill in every way.

Yes. Yes. Yes. Everything was excellent! There is a little wait but that is to be expected with a new and awesome place. Food was excellent service was excellent. We got 2 shack burgers one was a double, 2 amazing shakes, a plain fry and one fry with cheese/bacon cost about 33.00 but worth it! Will go again and again!

My boyfriend and I have been to Cielito two times and have had an amazing dining experience each time.  On our last visit, we sat at the raw bar where we watched Keegan and Andrew whip up ceviche'.   Oh the ceviche, it is incredible. These two guys kept us entertained while we sipped on cocktails and enjoyed the ceviche trio, which I highly recommend.  We decided to try the pork belly quesadilla based on a few reviews we read.  Great food!

e got there the restaurant was empty, except for a man from Bite Squad there to pickup a delivery.  We looked at the menu and asked some questions. Placed our order for Scallop Tacos with Coleslaw and a Crawfish Platter, an order of Hush puppies to start with one Sweet Tea and one Regular Tea. The food was delivered hot and was delicious. My dinner companion enjoyed the Tacos (soft shell) with the coleslaw and the Hushpuppies. I ate the Crawfish Platter which included Andouille Sausage, potatoes and corn in your choice of spicey  and their mild was spicy. Because it is The end of October the Crawfish were from frozen but it doesn't take much away from the taste. The server was Alec, he was very pleasant and knowable about the food. Also very pleasant to talk with. The meal was ended with and order of Cheesecake with a Strawberry sauce and Whipped Cream. Also delicious and and took an order of Hushpuppies to go. We will definitely will return. To try the other food on the menu.
